papers.title: Less Decoder is More Encoder: Geometric Representation Learning from Novel View Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: This paper examines the role of Novel View Synthesis (NVS) in geometric representation learning. In principle, NVS should reason about 3D scene structure, thereby enabling transferable multi-view geometric representations. Yet, existing encoder-based NVS methods yield poor representations. This is not because of a lack of supervisory signal, but rather due to inconspicuous architectural choices: \textit{spatially expressive decoders} that dilute representational capabilities of the scene encoder, and \textit{low-level pixel-space targets} that hinder feature learning. We present SNAP, a self-supervised encoder-decoder transformer that addresses both through a pose-conditioned local decoder and a latent-space reconstruction objective. SNAP is task agnostic, and we show that it is competitive with special-purpose geometry-supervised methods. SNAP also performs competitively against self-supervised representations across five tasks: visual localization, pose estimation, point correspondence, depth estimation, and robot manipulation. Remarkably, SNAP's patch features exhibit emergent viewpoint invariance that approaches heavily supervised models despite lower compute and data budgets. Under camera shifts where standard 2D representations collapse, SNAP degrades more gracefully, revealing that restricting decoder expressivity actively prevents the suppression of transferable geometric structure. https://snap-nvs.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SNAP 用受限解码器的 NVS 自监督学习几何表征：把空间表达力强的解码器换成 pose-conditioned local decoder，并把重建目标从像素空间移到 latent space，使场景编码器不再被解码器稀释。在视觉定位、位姿估计、点对应、深度估计与机器人操作五项任务上与专用几何监督方法竞争，patch 特征在低算力与低数据预算下逼近重监督模型的视角不变性，相机偏移下比标准 2D 表征退化更平缓。
Motivation: 基于编码器的 NVS 本应学到可迁移的多视角几何表征，但现有方法表征质量差；作者认为瓶颈不在监督信号不足，而在空间表达力过强的解码器稀释了编码器能力、像素空间低层目标妨碍特征学习。
Method: SNAP 是自监督 encoder-decoder transformer：pose-conditioned local decoder 限制解码器空间表达力，latent-space reconstruction objective 把重建目标从像素移到潜空间；任务无关，无需几何监督。
Result: 在视觉定位、位姿估计、点对应、深度估计、机器人操作五项任务上与专用几何监督方法及自监督表征竞争；patch 特征呈现涌现的视角不变性，逼近重监督模型，且算力与数据预算更低；在标准 2D 表征崩溃的相机偏移下退化更平缓。
Conclusion: 限制解码器表达力能主动防止可迁移几何结构被抑制，NVS 表征差是架构选择问题而非监督信号问题。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: MoSE3: Learning World-Space SE(3) at Every Pixel
papers.abstract_en: Dense 3D point tracking has been a prominent paradigm for modeling motion in dynamic scenes, but a point track is just a 3-DoF translation curve per pixel: it captures where pixels go, not the rotation of the underlying part, nor which pixels move together as one body. We propose MoSE3, the first feed-forward model that predicts dense SE(3) motion from monocular RGB video, producing full 6-DoF rigid transforms at every pixel in world space. Per-pixel SE(3) motion offers a richer view of how a scene moves: rotation, translation, and grouping all at once. Directly predicting SE(3) is challenging: rotations lie on a curved manifold that is ill-suited to Euclidean regression, and annotations for SE(3) are particularly difficult to acquire. To address these challenges, MoSE3 predicts per-pixel SE(3) through two jointly learned intermediates, 3D point tracks and rigidity embeddings, and recovers SE(3) by differentiably fitting transforms within each soft rigid cluster, enabling end-to-end prediction and supervision. To close the data gap, we introduce Art-Kubric, a large-scale synthetic dataset with dense SE(3) and rigidity labels for articulated objects with rich physical interactions. MoSE3 achieves state-of-the-art SE(3) estimation at pixel, part, and object levels on both rigid and articulated benchmarks, and state-of-the-art average 3D point tracking accuracy across three datasets, while showing strong generalization to real-world videos despite being trained solely on synthetic motion data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MoSE3 是首个从单目 RGB 视频前馈预测逐像素 SE(3) 刚体运动的模型，通过 3D point tracks 与 rigidity embeddings 两个联合学习的中间量，在每个软刚体簇内可微拟合变换来恢复 6-DoF 变换。在刚体与铰接基准的像素、部件、物体层级上取得 SOTA，并在三个数据集上取得 SOTA 平均 3D 点跟踪精度，仅用合成运动数据训练仍能泛化到真实视频。
Motivation: 稠密 3D 点跟踪每像素只给 3-DoF 平移曲线，既不刻画底层部件的旋转，也不说明哪些像素作为一个刚体一起运动；而直接回归 SE(3) 受旋转流形非欧氏性与标注难获取的双重阻碍。
Method: MoSE3 用两个联合学习的中间量预测逐像素 SE(3)：3D point tracks 与 rigidity embeddings，再在每个 soft rigid cluster 内可微拟合刚体变换恢复 SE(3)，实现端到端预测与监督。为补数据缺口，引入大规模合成数据集 Art-Kubric，含铰接物体在丰富物理交互下的稠密 SE(3) 与 rigidity 标签。
Result: 在刚体与铰接 benchmark 的 pixel、part、object 三个层级上达到 state-of-the-art SE(3) 估计；在三个数据集上取得 state-of-the-art 平均 3D point tracking accuracy；仅用合成运动数据训练即对真实视频表现出强泛化。
Conclusion: 把点跟踪扩展为逐像素 SE(3)（旋转、平移、分组一体）并以合成数据补标注缺口，可同时拿到更强的 SE(3) 估计与点跟踪精度，且合成到真实的迁移成立。

papers.title: 4DCodeBench: Benchmarking Agents on Inverse Graphics of Dynamic Scenes
papers.abstract_en: We introduce 4DCodeBench, a benchmark for 4D inverse graphics through code generation, in which agents reconstruct dynamic scenes from video as executable graphics programs. To accomplish this, agents must translate visual observations into compact representations of scene structure and dynamics, by implementing abstractions such as physical simulations to reproduce complex behavior. To evaluate this capability, we curate a set of real-world videos and construct synthetic scenes spanning diverse physical phenomena, including deformation, fluid flow, and fracture. We perform extensive benchmarking of frontier models, finding that strong static reconstruction capabilities do not yet translate into reliable reconstruction of complex dynamics. 4DCodeBench provides a testbed for tracking progress toward agents that can interpret the dynamics of the world through code. Our benchmark is available at https://github.com/4DCodeBench/4DCodeBench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 4DCodeBench 把动态场景的 4D 逆图形问题转成代码生成任务：agent 从视频重建可执行的图形程序，用物理仿真等抽象复现形变、流体、断裂等行为。对前沿模型的基准测试发现，强静态重建能力尚不能转化为对复杂动力学的可靠重建。
Motivation: 视频中的动态场景需要把视觉观测压缩成同时描述场景结构与动力学的紧凑可执行表示，而现有 agent 在静态重建与复杂动力学重建之间存在能力断层，缺少统一的评测载体。
Method: 构建 4D 逆图形代码生成基准：整理真实视频集并构造覆盖形变 (deformation)、流体流动 (fluid flow)、断裂 (fracture) 等多样物理现象的合成场景，要求 agent 输出可执行图形程序（含物理仿真抽象）来复现场景结构与动力学，并对前沿模型做系统评测。
Result: 在该基准上对前沿模型的广泛评测显示，强静态重建能力目前尚不能迁移到对复杂动力学的可靠重建；场景涵盖真实视频与覆盖形变、流体、断裂的合成场景。
Conclusion: 通过代码解释世界动力学的 agent 仍是未达标能力：静态重建强不等于动力学重建可靠，4DCodeBench 提供了追踪该能力进展的测试台。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: What Should World Models Forget? Stratified Retention for Continual Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning treats degradation on previously seen data as evidence of failure, a convention inherited from settings with a stationary prediction target, where a correct label remains correct indefinitely. World models do not satisfy this condition. Their prediction target is the environment, which changes, so knowledge that was accurate when acquired may later become false, and discarding it is required behavior rather than a defect. Non-stationary ground truth is well studied in the concept drift literature and in the temporal factuality of language models, but has not been formulated for world models, which are distinctive in that they also encode knowledge that must never be revised. We argue that continual world models require retention stratified by invariance timescale, separating invariants such as physics and object permanence, which must never be revised, from instance-level facts that should be revised as soon as the environment changes. Standard forgetting metrics cannot distinguish a world model that has correctly revised outdated knowledge from one that has suffered catastrophic forgetting, and consequently rank a frozen model highest, while existing physical-reasoning benchmarks evaluate only frozen checkpoints. We propose differential retention, which reports invariant regression testing across the adaptation stream jointly with revision latency, without aggregation.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Continual World Models Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 differential retention：把世界模型的知识按不变性时间尺度分层，物理与物体恒存等不变量永不修改，实例级事实随环境变化立即修订，并联合报告适应流上的不变量回归测试与修订延迟 (revision latency)，不做聚合。由此可区分正确修订过时知识与灾难性遗忘，而标准遗忘指标会把完全冻结的模型排在最高。
Motivation: 持续学习把旧数据性能下降一律当作失败，这一约定继承自预测目标平稳的场景；世界模型的预测目标是会变化的环境，旧知识变假后丢弃是应有行为，而现有遗忘指标无法区分正确修订与灾难性遗忘，物理推理基准也只评冻结检查点。
Method: 按不变性时间尺度对知识分层：不变量（物理、物体恒存）与实例级事实分开处理；提出 differential retention 指标，同时报告适应流上的不变量回归测试与 revision latency，且不把两者聚合成单一分数。
Result: 指出标准遗忘指标会把冻结模型排在最高，现有物理推理基准只评估冻结检查点；differential retention 以不变量回归与修订延迟的联合报告替代聚合指标。
Conclusion: 世界模型的持续学习需要按不变性时间尺度分层的保留策略：不变量永不修订，实例级事实应随环境变化尽快修订，评价也必须同时看回归与修订延迟。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: RNADyn: A Benchmark for Generating and Understanding RNA Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Ribonucleic acid (RNA) functions through conformational changes that are not fully captured by static structures. However, large-scale standardized RNA dynamics data remain limited, and existing approaches typically treat trajectory generation and dynamics understanding as separate objectives. Here, we introduce RNADynBench, a standardized RNA molecular dynamics (MD) benchmark with 2585 quality-controlled 100-ns all-atom trajectories and leakage-controlled splits. Building on RNADynBench, we develop RNADynNet, a unified model for RNA dynamics learning that uses a shared backbone for both trajectory generation and dynamics fingerprint extraction from a single conformer. It combines coordinate denoising, single-frame-to-trajectory alignment, and physical grounding to connect all-atom trajectory generation with dynamics representation learning. Physical grounding improves both generated dynamics and the physical information recoverable from these fingerprints. Across both test sets, including the high-flexibility challenge set, the generated trajectories achieve RMSF correlations of 0.875 and 0.766, while single-conformer predictions show comparable agreement with MD-derived dynamics. RNADynBench and RNADynNet together establish a benchmark and unified modeling framework for generating and understanding RNA dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RNADynBench 提出首个标准化 RNA 分子动力学基准，含 2585 条质控 100-ns 全原子轨迹与防泄漏划分；其上的 RNADynNet 用共享骨干同时做轨迹生成与从单构象提取动力学指纹，生成轨迹的 RMSF 相关性在两个测试集上达 0.875 与 0.766，物理 grounding 同时提升生成质量与指纹可恢复的物理信息。
Motivation: RNA 的功能依赖构象变化，但静态结构无法刻画，且缺少大规模标准化的动力学数据；现有方法把轨迹生成与动力学理解当作两个割裂的目标。
Method: RNADynNet 以单一共享骨干统一两类任务：从单构象做轨迹生成并提取动力学指纹，训练结合坐标去噪 (coordinate denoising)、单帧到轨迹对齐 (single-frame-to-trajectory alignment) 与物理 grounding；基准 RNADynBench 提供质控轨迹与 leakage-controlled splits。
Result: RNADynBench 含 2585 条质控 100-ns 全原子 MD 轨迹；在两个测试集（含高柔性挑战集）上生成轨迹的 RMSF 相关性分别为 0.875 与 0.766，单构象预测与 MD 导出动力学的一致性相当；物理 grounding 同时改善生成动力学与指纹中可恢复的物理信息。
Conclusion: 轨迹生成与动力学理解可以在一个共享骨干下统一建模，且物理 grounding 对两者都有增益；RNADynBench 与 RNADynNet 共同构成 RNA 动力学的基准与建模框架。

papers.title: EyeRobot 2.0: Active Gaze for Precise Manipulation without Wrist Cameras
papers.abstract_en: Inspired by human vision, we introduce a framework using active gaze to enable fine-grained bimanual manipulation with only a single stereo camera. EyeRobot 2.0 physically attends to a 3D fixation point in the scene by swiveling two eye viewpoints to center their gaze on it. The resulting images are processed foveally by allocating more visual tokens to the image centers, focusing computation on task-relevant features. Such Active Visual Fixation (AVF) requires carefully coordinated gaze during task execution, which we accomplish hierarchically by first training a low-level gaze servoing policy conditioned on a goal object, then training a target selector which emits fixation goals based on task progress. Both modules are trained with RL on real-world data: the first is trained with a dense geometric reward and the second co-trains with the BC gripper policy which allows it to discover fixation sequences that can resemble a human's fixation sequence while performing the task. EyeRobot 2.0 further takes advantage of fixation by canonicalizing gripper information into a fixation-relative SE(3) frame, which compacts the size of the action distribution to learn. We collect teleoperation data for 7 real-world and 6 simulated tasks, and conduct over 1000 physical and 1800 simulated robot trials comparing EyeRobot 2.0 against passive stereo and ego + wrist camera policies trained on the same data. Removing wrist cameras is costly for standard policies: with only passive stereo, real-world success drops from 52% to 27%. EyeRobot 2.0 closes this gap with only stereo, outperforming passive stereo by 40% in real and 20% in sim. It matches ego + wrist policies when their wrist views are clear (69% vs. 64%), and more than doubles their success when grasped objects occlude the wrist cameras (48% vs. 22%)

Motivation: 腕部相机能提供近距视角但增加硬件成本与故障面，而仅靠被动立体相机的标准策略在去掉腕视角后性能大幅下滑，需要在不装腕相机的前提下补回任务相关的精细视觉信息。

papers.title: From Mixing to Tearing: Graph Decomposition in Decentralized Optimization via Message Passing
papers.abstract_en: We study the minimization of sums of smooth strongly convex functions over undirected graphs, with each function held by one agent and communication restricted to neighbors in the graph. Existing decentralized methods, whether based on gossip or on routing over spanning trees, typically use the network to mix or aggregate information to enable {\it prescribed} local optimization updates. What this communication-centered viewpoint lacks is a general framework that uses graph structure to {\it jointly} design the optimization subproblems and the cooperative computation and communication through which agents solve them cooperatively. We develop such a framework from first principles, jointly designing the linear representation of agreement constraints, the blocks of the resulting dual variables (jointly optimized), and connected cluster of agents that cooperatively solve each block subproblem over the assigned subgraph. GATE (Graph-Tearing message passing) is a first instance of this framework: one variable per edge and tree blocks. At each iteration, agents update their assigned edge variables by minimizing the sum of the two endpoint cost-to-go messages and relaxing the result. The messages are updated through local minimizations following the tree recursion. To reduce per-iteration computational and communication costs, we develop GATE-S, a surrogate variant using tractable local models and lightweight message parametrizations. We establish linear convergence with a rate explicit in the interplay among function regularity, network topology, and the chosen partition, revealing the effects of graph decomposition. Numerical experiments are conducted to validate the theoretical results and evaluate the efficiency of our algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出去中心化优化的消息传递框架 GATE：按图分解联合设计一致性约束的线性表示、对偶变量分块与求解各分块子问题的连通簇，每条边一个变量、树形三块结构，迭代中用两端点 cost-to-go 消息之和的极小化再松弛更新边变量。收敛率显式依赖函数正则性、网络拓扑与划分方式，另有低成本变体 GATE-S；数值实验验证理论并评估效率。
Motivation: 现有 gossip 或生成树路由方法只用网络混合/聚合信息以支撑预设的局部更新，缺少用图结构联合设计优化子问题与协作计算通信的通用框架。
Method: 从第一性原理联合设计：一致性约束的线性表示、由此得到的对偶变量各块（联合优化）、以及在指定子图上协作求解每个分块子问题的连通 agent 簇。首个实例 GATE 为每边一变量、树形三块；每轮 agent 极小化两端点 cost-to-go 消息之和并松弛结果，消息沿树递归经局部极小化更新。GATE-S 用可处理的局部模型与轻量消息参数化降低单轮计算与通信开销。
Result: 建立线性收敛，收敛率显式依赖函数正则性、网络拓扑与所选划分的相互作用，从而揭示图分解的影响；数值实验用于验证理论结果并评估算法效率。
Conclusion: 把优化子问题与协作计算通信按图结构一起设计是可行的，图分解方式直接进入收敛率，且可用 GATE-S 换取更低的单轮开销。

papers.title: LESSER: Post-Training Data Selection with Output-Layer Gradients
papers.abstract_en: The choice of post-training data for large language models substantially affects downstream performance. Gradient-based data selection is a popular approach that ranks training data by how well their gradients align with those of a small validation set. However, ranking with full-parameter gradients requires an expensive backward pass on every sample, making computation intractable for large candidate pools. This raises a natural question: can we approximate full-gradient features at a fraction of the cost? Conveniently, we find that output-layer gradients suffice for effective data selection, yet require only the cheaper forward pass. We implement this as LESSER, a drop-in wrapper for selection methods that reduces the feature-extraction FLOP cost by $9.7\times$ for SFT and $3.0\times$ for RL benchmarks, while tracking full-gradient performance on downstream tasks. Empirically, we find that even when output-layer and full gradients rank individual samples differently, they select batches with aligned gradients.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LESSER 发现 LLM 后训练数据选择只需输出层梯度即可逼近全参数梯度的效果，且只需前向传播。作为即插即用 wrapper，它把 SFT 特征提取 FLOP 成本降到 1/9.7、RL 基准降到 1/3.0，同时在下游任务上跟住全梯度选择的性能。
Motivation: 基于梯度的数据选择要用小验证集梯度给候选样本排序，但全参数梯度需对每个样本做反向传播，候选池一大就算不动。
Method: LESSER 作为数据选择方法的 drop-in wrapper，用输出层梯度替代全参数梯度做特征提取，只需前向传播；可套在现有基于梯度的选择流程上。
Result: 特征提取 FLOP 成本降低 9.7×（SFT）与 3.0×（RL 基准），下游任务性能与全梯度选择持平；尽管输出层梯度与全梯度对单个样本的排序不同，两者选出的 batch 梯度是对齐的。
Conclusion: 输出层梯度足以支撑有效的后训练数据选择，把逐样本反向传播换成前向传播即可大幅降本而不掉下游性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Decoding the Functional Roles of Register and High-Norm Patch Tokens in Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised Vision Transformers (ViTs), such as DINOv2, learn rich visual representations, but the functions of their internal tokens remain poorly understood. Recent architectures introduce dedicated register tokens to reduce high-norm out- lier patch tokens that emerge in background re- gions, yet the semantic and functional roles of both token types have not been fully established. In this paper, we analyze these roles by training sparse autoencoders (SAEs) on register-token and outlier-token activations in DINOv2. Using an automated interpretability pipeline, UMAP clus- tering, and CLIP-space cross-checks, we find that register-token features are more strongly associ- ated with high-level semantic concepts. Outlier- token features, by contrast, are more often associ- ated with lower-level structural, background, and texture-dominant patterns. Causal ablations fur- ther reveal a substantial functional asymmetry: disrupting top-activating register-derived features produces a 48.17% drop in representation cosine similarity, whereas disrupting outlier-derived fea- tures produces only a 0.31% drop. Together, our results provide evidence for token specialization in self-supervised ViTs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 DINOv2 上对 register token 与高范数 outlier patch token 分别训练稀疏自编码器 (SAE)，发现 register 特征绑定高层语义概念、outlier 特征绑定低层结构与纹理背景；因果消融显示功能高度不对称：扰动 top-activating register 特征使表征余弦相似度下降 48.17%，扰动 outlier 特征仅降 0.31%。
Motivation: ViT 内部 token 的语义与功能角色缺乏理解，register token 虽被设计来吸收背景区域的高范数离群 patch token，但两类 token 各自承担什么功能尚未确立。
Method: 在 DINOv2 的 register-token 与 outlier-token 激活上分别训练 sparse autoencoders (SAEs)，配合自动可解释性 pipeline、UMAP 聚类与 CLIP-space 交叉验证来解码特征语义，再用 causal ablation 打断 top-activating 特征测表征变化。
Result: register 特征更强地关联高层语义概念，outlier 特征更多关联低层结构、背景与纹理主导模式；因果消融中扰动 register 派生特征使表征余弦相似度下降 48.17%，扰动 outlier 派生特征仅下降 0.31%。
Conclusion: 自监督 ViT 中存在明显的 token 专业化：register token 承担高层语义且功能上远比 outlier token 关键，outlier token 主要编码低层结构与背景信息。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Transcriptome-informed multi-modal AI for predicting neoadjuvant therapy response from breast cancer biopsies
papers.abstract_en: Scarcity of labeled data limits development of deep learning biomarkers in oncology. We develop a two-stage AI model predicting pathological complete response (pCR) to neoadjuvant therapy in breast cancer. The first stage learns the transcriptome from histopathology using 8,742 patients across 32 cancer types, corroborated by pathologist review and spatial agreement with measured expression. This simplifies the second stage to predicting pCR from inferred expression and clinical variables. Developed using 1,080 patients (five cohorts) and evaluated in 1,412 patients (nine cohorts), the model achieves a pooled AUROC of 0.79 (95% CI, 0.73-0.85), discriminating responders within molecular subtypes. It outperforms histopathological biomarkers, remaining stable across intratumoral sampling and with minimal biopsy tissue. Ablations show transcriptome-wide inference improves discrimination over clinical variables alone or one-stage pathology models, and robustness by avoiding genomic assays' gene selection constraints. These results indicate that biologically informed compression may generalize to data-sparse applications in precision oncology.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出两阶段多模态 AI：先从乳腺癌活检的组织病理图像推断全转录组表达，再用推断表达加临床变量预测新辅助治疗后的病理完全缓解 (pCR)。在 1,412 例、九个队列的评估中 pooled AUROC 0.79 (95% CI 0.73–0.85)，优于组织病理学生物标志物，且在分子亚型内仍能区分应答者。
Motivation: 肿瘤学深度学习生物标志物受标注数据稀缺限制；直接从组织图像预测 pCR 的单阶段模型受病理信息压缩瓶颈制约，而基因组检测又受基因选择约束。
Method: 两阶段模型：第一阶段用 8,742 例、覆盖 32 种癌种的患者从组织病理学学习转录组，经病理医生复核并以推断表达与实测表达的空间一致性佐证；第二阶段以推断表达加临床变量预测 pCR，开发集为 1,080 例（五个队列），评估集为 1,412 例（九个队列）。
Result: 评估集 pooled AUROC 0.79 (95% CI 0.73–0.85)，在分子亚型内区分应答者；优于组织病理学生物标志物，在不同瘤内取样与最少活检组织条件下保持稳定。消融显示全转录组推断的判别力高于仅用临床变量或单阶段病理模型，且规避了基因组检测的基因选择约束。
Conclusion: 生物学先验的压缩（先推断转录组再预测疗效）可在数据稀疏的精准肿瘤学场景中泛化，比单阶段病理模型和临床变量单独使用更有效。

summary_sections.conclusion: 生物学先验的压缩（先推断转录组再预测疗效）可在数据稀疏的精准肿瘤学场景中泛化，比单阶段病理模型和临床变量单独使用更有效。

papers.title: FlowHMR: Physically Plausible Motion Capture from Video
papers.abstract_en: We present FlowHMR, a framework for recovering physically plausible global 3D human motion from monocular video. Previous learning-based methods typically regress human motion directly from video and train the network with geometric supervision. However, recovering human motion from monocular video is inherently ambiguous in depth, and direct regression tends to collapse toward an averaged solution. Moreover, the recovered motions are not guaranteed to be physically plausible, so physics-based tracking of them often fails. To address these challenges, we formulate video motion capture as a video-conditioned motion generation problem and first pretrain a flow matching model for this task. Given an input video, the pretrained model generates diverse motion candidates, but not all of them are faithful to the video or physically trackable. We therefore post-train the model using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with two rewards. A fidelity reward encourages consistency with the input video. A tracking reward favors motions that a physics-based controller can track successfully. Together, these rewards shift the model's output preference, so the post-trained model stays faithful to the input video while producing more physically plausible motion. We further introduce Wild-4K, a large and diverse dataset of about 4K internet videos, for evaluating human motion recovery in the wild. Qualitative and quantitative experiments on Wild-4K show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art methods in overall motion fidelity and achieves a physical tracking success rate of 82.47%, compared with 62.82% for the strongest baseline, GVHMR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlowHMR 把单目视频动作捕捉改写为视频条件下的运动生成问题：先预训练 flow matching 模型生成多样候选，再用 GRPO 以保真度奖励和物理跟踪奖励做后训练。在自建 Wild-4K（约 4K 网络视频）上，物理跟踪成功率 82.47%，最强基线 GVHMR 为 62.82%，整体动作保真度也超过现有方法。
Motivation: 单目视频恢复人体运动在深度上天然歧义，直接回归会塌向平均解，且生成的动作不保证物理可行，导致基于物理的跟踪经常失败。
Method: 将视频动作捕捉建模为视频条件运动生成，先预训练 flow matching 模型产生多样运动候选；随后用 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 后训练，含两个奖励：保真度奖励约束与输入视频一致，跟踪奖励偏好能被 physics-based controller 成功跟踪的动作；另发布 Wild-4K 数据集用于野外评测。
Result: 在 Wild-4K 上定性与定量实验显示整体动作保真度超过 state-of-the-art 方法；物理跟踪成功率 82.47%，最强基线 GVHMR 为 62.82%。Wild-4K 包含约 4K 段网络视频。
Conclusion: 用保真度与可跟踪性双奖励后训练生成式运动生成模型，可以在保持视频一致性的同时把输出推到物理可跟踪的一侧，优于直接回归式方法。

papers.title: SigLIP2 for aerial fire risk classification
papers.abstract_en: We examine the transfer of a pretrained SigLIP2 image encoder to seven class fire risk classification from aerial imagery. We introduce a reproducible partition of the public FireRisk training mirror and an implementation that records data provenance, preprocessing and model selection. Two initial runs compare a frozen encoder probe with full model adaptation. On the validation partition, full adaptation reaches 63.05% accuracy and 58.94% macro F1, compared with 55.95% and 50.19% for the probe. Both runs use one training seed and select their checkpoint on the same validation partition. These development results support further evaluation of SigLIP2 but do not establish performance on an independent test set or unseen regions. The accompanying code provides a common framework for repeated experiments and comparisons with additional visual encoders.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Code available at https://github.com/yunusserhat/firerisk
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把预训练 SigLIP2 图像编码器迁移到航拍影像的七类火险分类，在公开 FireRisk 训练镜像的可复现划分上比较冻结编码器探针与全量微调：全量微调在验证集达到 63.05% accuracy、58.94% macro F1，探针为 55.95% 与 50.19%。作者明确这两次开发性运行只用一个训练种子、且在同一验证划分上选 checkpoint，尚不能证明独立测试集或未见区域上的性能。
Motivation: 航拍火险分类缺少可复现的数据划分与实验记录规范，预训练视觉编码器在该任务上的迁移收益也未经系统比较，导致结果难以复现和横向对比。
Method: 以 SigLIP2 预训练图像编码器为骨干，做七类火险分类；发布 FireRisk 公开训练镜像的可复现划分，并实现记录数据来源、预处理与模型选择的流程。两次初始运行分别采用冻结编码器探针 (frozen probe) 与全量适配 (full model adaptation)，均用单一训练种子、按同一验证划分选 checkpoint。
Result: 验证集上全量适配 accuracy 63.05%、macro F1 58.94%，冻结探针为 55.95% 与 50.19%；两次运行均为单种子、同一验证划分选模型，属开发性结果。
Conclusion: 全量微调比冻结探针在该验证划分上高出约 7 个百分点 accuracy、约 8.7 个百分点 macro F1，支持继续评估 SigLIP2，但结论仅限当前验证划分，尚需独立测试集与未见区域检验。

papers.title: Simulation-Free Learning of Population Dynamics with Wasserstein Lagrangian Residuals
papers.abstract_en: The dynamics of cells, organisms, and fluids are often modeled as probability distributions evolving over time. Reconstructing and extrapolating this evolution from unpaired snapshots requires assumptions about the underlying process. Wasserstein gradient flows are a common choice, but they cannot describe conservative or periodic dynamics. Lagrangian mechanics in Wasserstein space covers both, but existing methods for learning it are simulation-based: they run a numerical solver at every training step, which makes training expensive. We propose Double-Stitch, a simulation-free method that learns these mechanics by penalizing the residual of the equation of motion along a learned population path. We derive this equation from a Clebsch variational principle that does not require gradient velocities, and show that the residual vanishes exactly when the equation holds. We test Double-Stitch on synthetic, single-cell and ocean vortex datasets and find that it matches or outperforms gradient-flow methods and simulation-based WLM on most tasks, while training $4$-$14$ times faster than WLM. We provide a JAX implementation of Double-Stitch at https://github.com/BasisResearch/stitching.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Double-Stitch 用沿学习到的总体路径惩罚运动方程残差的方式，免数值求解地学习 Wasserstein 空间中的 Lagrangian 动力学，可覆盖梯度流无法描述的保守与周期运动。在合成、单细胞与海洋涡旋数据集上，它在多数任务上匹配或超过梯度流方法与基于仿真的 WLM，训练快 4–14 倍。
Motivation: 从非配对快照重建概率分布演化需要对底层过程作假设：Wasserstein 梯度流无法描述保守或周期动力学，而能覆盖两者的 Wasserstein Lagrangian 方法每步训练都要跑数值求解器，代价高昂。
Method: 提出 simulation-free 的 Double-Stitch：从不要求梯度速度的 Clebsch 变分原理导出运动方程，沿学习到的 population path 惩罚该方程的残差作为训练损失，残差在方程成立时精确为零；提供 JAX 实现。
Result: 在合成、单细胞 (single-cell) 与海洋涡旋 (ocean vortex) 数据集上，多数任务匹配或超过梯度流方法与基于仿真的 WLM，训练速度比 WLM 快 4–14 倍。
Conclusion: 不必在训练循环里跑求解器也能学到 Wasserstein Lagrangian 动力学，且能同时表达保守与周期运动，训练成本大幅低于 simulation-based WLM。

papers.title: FrugalEvo: Towards Cost-Aware LLM-Guided Program Evolution
papers.abstract_en: LLM-guided evolutionary methods, such as AlphaEvolve, have emerged as powerful approaches for challenging computational optimization problems, such as circle packing. However, prior work typically optimizes performance gain over a fixed number of iterations. We argue that practical optimization should maximize gain per unit cost. To this end, we propose FrugalEvo, a cost-aware evolutionary framework where a stronger, higher-cost LLM explores solution strategies, and a cheaper LLM implements them and iteratively refines the resulting code. We also design a cache-efficient evolution process, where our harness and prompts maximize the sharing of prefixes across different evolution steps, to improve cache reuse. To measure solution quality throughout a fixed cost budget, we introduce Budget-Aware Area Under the Curve (BA-AUC), defined as the area under the best-so-far evaluation score curve over cumulative LLM cost, up to the budget. Across 10 mathematical and systems optimization tasks, FrugalEvo matches or surpasses state-of-the-art baselines, including OpenEvolve, ShinkaEvolve, AdaEvolve, and EvoX, in final solution quality and achieves higher BA-AUC on 9 tasks. It also achieves higher average performance than these baselines on 10 algorithmic optimization tasks from ALE-Bench-Lite. Notably, on circle packing, FrugalEvo achieves new state-of-the-art performance with GPT-5.6 Terra and Luna for only 1.68 USD and with GLM-5.3 and its Flash variant for only 0.55 USD, matching or surpassing all baselines, including multi-agent methods such as CORAL and SwarmResearch, which cost approximately 50 USD on average.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FrugalEvo 把 LLM 引导的进化优化目标从固定迭代数改为单位成本收益：强而贵的 LLM 负责探索策略，便宜的 LLM 负责实现与迭代改写代码，并通过前缀共享的 harness 与 prompt 提高缓存复用。在 10 个数学与系统优化任务上，其最终解质量持平或超过 OpenEvolve、ShinkaEvolve、AdaEvolve、EvoX，并在 9 个任务上取得更高 BA-AUC；circle packing 上用 GPT-5.6 Terra 与 Luna 仅花 1.68 USD、用 GLM-5.3 及其 Flash 仅花 0.55 USD 即达到新 SOTA，而多智能体基线 CORAL、SwarmResearch 平均约花 50 USD。
Motivation: 既有的 LLM 进化方法（如 AlphaEvolve）在固定迭代数下只优化性能增益，忽略了实际优化应最大化单位成本收益这一目标，导致高成本方法在预算受限时不划算。
Method: 提出成本感知进化框架 FrugalEvo：由更强、更高成本的 LLM 探索解策略，较便宜的 LLM 实现并迭代精化代码；设计缓存高效的进化流程，使 harness 与 prompt 在不同进化步之间最大化前缀共享以提升缓存复用；并提出 Budget-AUC (BA-AUC) 指标，在固定成本预算内度量累计 LLM 成本下 best-so-far 评分曲线下的面积。
Result: 在 10 个数学与系统优化任务上，FrugalEvo 最终解质量持平或超越 OpenEvolve、ShinkaEvolve、AdaEvolve、EvoX 等 SOTA 基线，并在 9 个任务上取得更高 BA-AUC；在 ALE-BENCH-Lite 的 10 项算法优化任务上平均性能高于这些基线。circle packing 上用 GPT-5.6 Terra 与 Luna 仅花 1.68 USD、用 GLM-5.3 与其 Flash 变体仅花 0.55 USD 达到新 SOTA，持平或超越包括 CORAL、SwarmResearch 在内的多智能体方法，后者平均成本约 50 USD。
Conclusion: 把优化目标改为单位成本收益并配合分层 LLM 分工与前缀缓存复用，能在远低于多智能体方法的成本下达到或超过其解质量，BA-AUC 可作为固定预算下的标准度量。

papers.title: Planning to Learn
papers.abstract_en: Policy-gradient methods are central to modern reinforcement learning, including LLM post-training. When they struggle, the usual suspects are exploration, credit assignment and action-sampling noise. Classification has none of them. A classifier is a policy whose expected reward, its \emph{expected accuracy}, is the probability it assigns to the correct label, and because that label is known, the policy gradient is exact and smooth. Yet exact policy gradient loses to cross-entropy, even on expected accuracy. The exact gradient is myopic: it values an update only by what it buys now, but each update also sets where the next one starts, so an update's value depends on how much learning remains. Viewed this way, cross-entropy is patient accuracy, the total error an example would pay if its log-odds rose at unit speed forever, while exact policy gradient is the zero-horizon limit. Truncating this total at the learning that remains yields the horizon loss, a one-line change that moves from cross-entropy toward exact policy gradient as training runs out. In a simple allocation model, it provably escapes the trap that catches each endpoint. On MNIST and on ImageNet with ResNet-50, ResNet-101 and ViT-S/16, the horizon loss improves top-1 accuracy over cross-entropy at a flat learning rate, and the gain grows with label noise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在分类任务上，精确 policy gradient 因短视而输给 cross-entropy；作者提出 horizon loss，把总误差截断到「还剩多少学习量」，随训练推进从 cross-entropy 平滑移向精确 policy gradient。在 MNIST 与 ImageNet（ResNet-50、ResNet-101、ViT-S/16）平坦学习率下 top-1 accuracy 均超过 cross-entropy，且标签噪声越大增益越大。
Motivation: policy-gradient 方法在 LLM post-training 等场景中常被归因于探索、credit assignment 或采样噪声，但分类任务三者皆无，精确 policy gradient 仍输给 cross-entropy；原因是精确梯度只按当下收益评估更新，忽略了更新会决定下一次更新的起点。
Method: 把分类器视为 policy，其期望奖励（expected accuracy）即正确标签概率，从而得到精确且光滑的 policy gradient；将 cross-entropy 解释为 log-odds 以单位速度上升时的总误差（patient accuracy），再把该总量截断到剩余学习量，得到一行改动的 horizon loss，在简单分配模型 (allocation model) 中分析其逃逸两端各自陷阱的性质。
Result: 在 MNIST 与 ImageNet 上用 ResNet-50、ResNet-101、ViT-S/16，horizon loss 在平坦学习率下相对 cross-entropy 提升 top-1 accuracy，且增益随标签噪声增大而变大；在简单分配模型中可证明逃逸分别困住 cross-entropy 与精确 policy gradient 两个端点的陷阱。
Conclusion: cross-entropy 与精确 policy gradient 是同一连续谱的两端，按剩余学习量截断的 horizon loss 能同时避开二者的失效模式，标签噪声越高收益越明显。

papers.title: Pivot-SD: Efficient Self-Distillation for Masked Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Masked diffusion language models (dLMs) offer a promising parallel alternative to autoregressive models for complex reasoning. However, they face a distinct credit-assignment challenge, since a few commitments during denoising sharply reduce the uncertainty over the remaining masked positions and shape much of the response. Most post-training recipes for dLMs do not use this signal to decide which tokens to train on: they typically train on the final text or assign rewards to whole denoising steps, rather than selecting the individual commitments that shape the response. We introduce Pivot-SD, an efficient offline self-distillation framework that supervises only these high-impact commitments (pivots). Pivot-SD selects pivots using an information-gain metric measuring uncertainty reduction over the remaining masked positions. Pivots from successful trajectories are trained with cross-entropy, and pivots from failed trajectories with targeted unlikelihood, leaving the rest of the failed trajectory untouched. Using only 200 questions and four rollouts each, Pivot-SD improves LLaDA-8B-Instruct over full-sequence SFT and budget-matched diffusion RL baselines across math and code benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Pivot-SD 用信息增益度量在去噪轨迹中挑出对剩余掩码位置不确定性削减最大的关键 token（pivots），只对成功轨迹的 pivots 做交叉熵、失败轨迹的 pivots 做定向 unlikelihood，其余不动。仅用 200 道题、每题 4 次 rollout，即在数学与代码基准上超过全序列 SFT 和预算对齐的 diffusion RL 基线。
Motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型 (dLM) 存在信用分配难题：去噪中少数几次承诺会大幅削减剩余掩码位置的不确定性并决定整段回答，但主流后训练只在最终文本或整步奖励上训练，不区分哪些 token 真正塑造了回答。
Method: Pivot-SD 是一个高效的离线自蒸馏框架：用衡量剩余掩码位置不确定性下降的信息增益指标选择 pivots；成功轨迹的 pivots 用交叉熵训练，失败轨迹的 pivots 用针对性 unlikelihood 训练，失败轨迹其余部分保持不动。

papers.title: ProAR: Learning Prospective Reasoning with Autoregressive Video Models
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive (AR) video models excel at causal generation, but their reliance on next-chunk prediction confines them to a short-sighted, reactive paradigm. This limitation is particularly consequential for reasoning-oriented generation, where achieving a target outcome through valid intermediate states matters more than local visual plausibility. To address this challenge, we propose Learning Prospective Reasoning with Autoregressive Video Models (ProAR), a novel framework that transforms autoregressive video generation into a goal-oriented reasoning process. ProAR introduces two key components: (1) To anchor generation to the long-range outcome, we integrate goal-frame prediction into the autoregressive loop via an asymmetric attention mask, enabling the predicted goal frame to guide the generation of intermediate states without being disrupted by them. (2) To guide short-range transitions, we introduce future representation self-alignment to encourage current hidden states to anticipate upcoming temporal dynamics. By leveraging teacher-forcing in AR training, we extract clean future representations in a single forward pass and align current representations with them using a lightweight, training-only predictor. Together, these two mechanisms seamlessly combine explicit, sparse target supervision with implicit, dense step-wise guidance, promoting coherent, goal-directed reasoning progress with modest computational cost. Experiments show that ProAR's complementary components consistently improve performance across diverse visual reasoning benchmarks. The framework proves highly training-efficient, surpassing fully trained standard AR baselines using only 25% of the training steps. This paradigm also demonstrates promising applicability to embodied reasoning tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ProAR 把自回归视频生成改造成目标导向的前瞻推理：用非对称注意力掩码把 goal-frame 预测嵌入 AR 循环，让目标帧引导中间状态生成而不被反向干扰，再用 future representation self-alignment 让当前隐状态预判后续时序动态。在多个视觉推理基准上两个组件一致提升性能，且只用 25% 训练步数就超过完整训练的标准 AR 基线。
Motivation: 自回归视频模型受 next-chunk prediction 束缚，只能短视、反应式地生成；而推理式生成更关心通过合法中间状态达成目标结果，而非局部画面的视觉合理性。
Method: 两个组件：一是把 goal-frame prediction 经非对称注意力掩码接入 AR 回路，预测的目标帧引导中间状态生成；二是 future representation self-alignment，借助 AR 训练中的 teacher-forcing 单次前向取出干净的未来表示，用仅训练期使用的轻量 predictor 对齐当前表示，形成稀疏显式目标监督加稠密逐步隐式引导。
Result: 在多个视觉推理基准上，ProAR 的互补组件一致提升性能；训练效率上仅用 25% 训练步数即超过完整训练的标准 AR 基线；框架在具身推理 (embodied reasoning) 任务上也展示出适用性。
Conclusion: 把稀疏的目标帧监督与稠密的逐步表示对齐结合，能让自回归视频模型以适度计算开销产生连贯、目标导向的推理进程，并以约四分之一训练预算超过标准 AR 基线。

papers.title: Forecasting from Counterfactual Simulator Rollouts: A Sim2Real Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Deploying a new decision policy creates a cold-start problem for prediction models whose targets depend on the policy's actions: historical observations reflect earlier policies, while real observations under the new policy are not yet available. Simulation offers a way to address this gap by rolling out the target policy across counterfactual scenarios and using the resulting trajectories to learn how the system responds to those controls. The simulation-to-reality (Sim2Real) transfer of this simulator-trained model can then be backtested by evaluating it against real observations from past deployments. Using two real-world inventory-control deployments, we evaluate this process from three angles: simulator fidelity, zero-shot transfer to real behavior, and adaptation as real target-policy observations accumulate. The simulator-trained forecaster achieves lower point-estimate mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) than the same architecture trained on historical real data, reducing MAPE by 1.2-3.1 percentage points in Study 1 and 12.5-18.7 points in Study 2. After deployment, lightweight calibration using early real observations further reduces error by up to 2.5 percentage points. These results provide empirical evidence that simulator-generated counterfactual data can support cold-start forecasting under a new policy, and the resulting model can be further refined as real deployment data become available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在库存控制 (inventory-control) 换新策略的冷启动场景下，用反事实模拟器 rollout 生成轨迹训练预测器，其 MAPE 低于同一架构在历史真实数据上训练的模型：Study 1 降低 1.2–3.1 个百分点，Study 2 降低 12.5–18.7 个百分点；部署后用早期真实观测做轻量校准，误差再降最多 2.5 个百分点。
Motivation: 新决策策略上线后，历史观测来自旧策略、新策略的真实观测尚未产生，依赖策略动作的预测目标出现冷启动缺口，直接用历史数据训练的模型会失配。
Method: 在反事实场景上 rollout 目标策略得到模拟轨迹，用这些模拟数据训练 forecaster，再通过历史真实部署观测做 backtest；评估分三个角度：模拟器保真度、对真实行为的 zero-shot 迁移、以及真实目标策略观测累积后的 adaptation（轻量校准）。
Result: 两个真实库存控制部署上，模拟器训练的 forecaster 点估计 MAPE 低于同一架构用历史真实数据训练：Study 1 降低 1.2–3.1 个百分点，Study 2 降低 12.5–18.7 个百分点；部署后用早期真实观测做轻量校准，误差再降最多 2.5 个百分点。
Conclusion: 模拟器生成的反事实数据可以支撑新策略下的冷启动预测，且模型可随真实部署数据累积进一步校准改进。

papers.title: Revisiting Input Time-frequency Representations in Multi-pitch Estimation for Vocal Ensembles
papers.abstract_en: Multi-pitch estimation in vocal ensembles is challenging because singers occupy overlapping pitch ranges and often sing at closely spaced fundamental frequencies, causing their harmonics to overlap in time-frequency representations. Existing models commonly use harmonic constant-Q transform (HCQT)-based representations to provide frequency-adaptive resolution, at the cost of expensive feature extraction when training mixtures are generated on the fly. We revisit this design and compare HCQT with a linear short-time Fourier transform (STFT), whose frequency bins are directly provided as model inputs. Despite its fixed frequency resolution and the absence of a pitch-aligned input grid, the linear STFT outperforms HCQT while substantially reducing feature-extraction cost. Further analysis shows that a longer analysis window or broader spectral coverage provides no additional improvement, while restricting the input to the predicted pitch range reduces the advantage of the linear STFT. These results suggest that finer frequency resolution does not necessarily improve vocal-ensemble MPE, and that shorter analysis windows can be more effective for time-varying vocal pitches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在人声合奏多基频估计 (multi-pitch estimation, MPE) 中，线性 STFT 输入在精度上胜过常用的 HCQT 表示，同时大幅降低特征提取开销；更长分析窗或更宽频谱覆盖不再带来增益，而把输入限制到预测音高范围会削弱线性 STFT 的优势。结论是更细的频率分辨率并不必然改善人声合奏 MPE，短分析窗对时变人声更有效。
Motivation: 人声音域重叠、基频接近导致谐波在时频表示中混叠；HCQT 提供频率自适应分辨率，但在 on-the-fly 生成训练混合时特征提取代价高昂，其设计收益需要重新检验。
Method: 对比 HCQT 与线性 STFT 两种输入时频表示（STFT 频率 bin 直接作为模型输入），并做消融：改变分析窗长度、频谱覆盖范围，以及把输入限制在预测音高范围内，观察 MPE 表现与特征提取成本的变化。
Result: 线性 STFT 在 MPE 上优于 HCQT 且显著降低特征提取成本；更长分析窗或更宽频谱覆盖没有带来额外提升；限制输入到预测音高范围会缩小线性 STFT 的优势。
Conclusion: 更细的频率分辨率对人声合奏 MPE 并非必要，较短的分析窗因适配时变人声而更有效，HCQT 的高特征提取开销不值得。

papers.title: MRVQ: One Resident Index for Dimension- and Rate-Elastic Vector Search
papers.abstract_en: Dense-retrieval services must switch among embedding-prefix dimensions and index bit rates as latency, quality, and memory budgets change. Tuning a quantizer separately for each rate gives the best quality, but the retrieval tier then holds several code streams and quantizer states at once. We introduce Matryoshka Residual Vector Quantization (MRVQ), a post-hoc residual quantizer for frozen embeddings. Its maximum-rate code can be truncated two ways: dropping residual stages lowers the rate, and dropping embedding coordinates lowers the dimension. One resident artifact therefore serves every (dimension, rate) pair we evaluate. Across FiQA and NFCorpus, four embedding families, and {4, 8, 16}-byte codes, MRVQ is the lowest-RAM design we evaluate. It uses 17.8-22.0x less memory than three separately trained QINCo2 indices, and 1.89-2.02x less than a lean shared-model steelman. The saving is not free: per-rate QINCo2 is 0.026-0.107 nDCG@10 better on FiQA. But MRVQ beats PQ, OPQ, and AdANNS-OPQ at matched code size. We also evaluate a low-build-cost PCA-scalar design that attains quality comparable to RaBitQ and its extension while fitting 420x faster at the median. Finally, we report two negative results: QINCo2 collapses when trained at high rates, and a ranking-bound hypothesis misses its pre-specified acceptance criteria. MRVQ is therefore a low-memory operating point for elastic retrieval, not a universal quality winner.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MRVQ（Matryoshka Residual Vector Quantization）对冻结 embedding 做后处理残差量化，用同一份常驻码同时支持截断残差阶段降码率、截断 embedding 坐标降维度，一个 artifact 覆盖所有 (维度, 码率) 组合。在 FiQA 与 NFCorpus、四类 embedding 家族、{4,8,16} 字节码上，其内存比三套独立训练的 QINCo2 索引低 17.8–22.0 倍，比精简共享模型低 1.89–2.02 倍，但逐码率 QINCo2 在 FiQA 上 nDCG@10 高 0.026–0.107。
Motivation: 稠密检索服务需随延迟、质量与内存预算在 embedding 维度和索引码率间切换；为每个码率单独调量化器质量最优，却让检索层同时持有多个码流与量化器状态，内存开销高。
Method: MRVQ 是针对冻结 embedding 的后处理残差量化器：最大码率码可双向截断，丢残差阶段降码率、丢 embedding 坐标降维度，从而单一常驻 artifact 服务全部 (维度, 码率) 对。评测覆盖 FiQA、NFCorpus、四个 embedding 家族与 {4,8,16} 字节码，对比 QINCo2、PQ、OPQ、AdANNS-OPQ，并另评估低构建成本的 PCA-scalar 设计（对照 RaBitQ 及其扩展）。
Result: MRVQ 是所评测设计中 RAM 占用最低的：比三套独立训练的 QINCo2 索引省 17.8–22.0 倍内存，比精简共享模型 steelman 省 1.89–2.02 倍；在匹配码长下胜过 PQ、OPQ 与 AdANNS-OPQ。代价是逐码率 QINCo2 在 FiQA 上 nDCG@10 高 0.026–0.107。PCA-scalar 设计质量与 RaBitQ 及其扩展相当，中位数拟合快 420 倍。另报告两项负结果：QINCo2 在高码率下训练会崩溃，一个 ranking-bound 假设未达预设验收标准。
Conclusion: MRVQ 是弹性检索的低内存工作点，而非普适质量最优：用可接受的 nDCG@10 损失换取单一常驻索引覆盖全部维度与码率组合。

papers.title: PoCoFL: POlicy-COmpliant Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) is a privacy-oriented learning paradigm that enables collaborative model training while keeping training data local to participating clients. However, it does not guarantee that clients submit policy-compliant contributions or that aggregators process admitted contributions correctly. Existing verifiable FL systems tailor validation rules to specific FL settings, learning workflows, and cryptographic constructions, limiting their applicability across network topologies, participant roles, and aggregation semantics. In this paper, we present PoCoFL, a policy-compliant federated learning framework that separates three aspects: (i) FL type, (ii) policy semantics, and (iii) cryptographic realisation. We provide a formalisation that captures client and aggregation requirements as policy-dependent relations. Clients prove compliance of their contributions using commitments and non-interactive zero-knowledge proofs, while aggregators prove that the recorded set of admitted contributions was processed according to the selected aggregation policy. We demonstrate PoCoFL through four formal instantiations: (i) vanilla, (ii) continual, (iii) personalised, and (iv) threshold-encrypted federated learning. We evaluate the effects of policy enforcement on the learning objectives of vanilla, personalised, and continual FL. We further implement proof-of-concept realisations of all four instantiations, demonstrating the versatility and practical feasibility of PoCoFL. Overall, these results show that PoCoFL can capture complex policy representations while remaining network-topology agnostic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PoCoFL 把联邦学习的可验证合规拆成 FL 类型、策略语义、密码学实现三层，客户端用承诺与非交互零知识证明 (NIZK) 证明贡献合规，聚合器证明被接纳的贡献集合按所选聚合策略处理。四个形式化实例（vanilla、continual、personalised、threshold-encrypted）均给出概念验证实现，并检验了策略执行对 vanilla、personalised、continual FL 学习目标的影响，结论是该框架能表达复杂策略且与网络拓扑无关。
Motivation: 现有可验证 FL 系统把校验规则绑死在特定 FL 设置、学习流程和密码学构造上，跨网络拓扑、参与者角色与聚合语义的适用性受限；FL 本身也不保证客户端提交合规贡献、聚合器正确处理被接纳的贡献。
Method: 将 FL 类型、策略语义、密码学实现三者解耦，用策略依赖关系形式化客户端与聚合要求；客户端以 commitments + NIZK 证明贡献合规，聚合器证明被记录的接纳集合按选定聚合策略处理；给出 vanilla、continual、personalised、threshold-encrypted 四种形式化实例并实现概念验证。
Result: 四个实例全部给出概念验证实现，展示框架的通用性与实际可行性；并评估了策略执行对 vanilla、personalised、continual FL 学习目标的影响，框架可表达复杂策略表示且与网络拓扑无关。
Conclusion: 把策略语义从 FL 类型和密码学构造中独立出来，可让同一套合规证明覆盖不同拓扑、角色与聚合语义的联邦学习。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On-Board Anomaly Detection for Efficient Marine Environmental Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Marine ecosystems are impacted by various threats such as oil spills, algal blooms, and sediment floods, which disrupt habitats, wildlife, and human activities. Advances in satellite imagery and Artificial Intelligence (AI) have enhanced our capabilities for early detection and mitigation of such hazards. In this paper, we propose a marine event detection pipeline for Earth observation satellites equipped with multi- or hyperspectral sensors. Our approach includes a self-supervised neural network encoder that compresses satellite images into a reduced latent space, enabling efficient onboard processing. A machine learning anomaly detection model identifies deviations from normal sea patterns to detect environmental anomalies. We compare its performance against traditional algorithms such as Isolation Forest, One-Class Support Vector Machine and Local Outlier Factors. Our lightweight, resource-efficient pipeline is optimized for deployment on satellites with limited computational resources, ranging from embedded CPUs to AI hardware accelerators. By prioritizing the transmission of critical information, our solution enhances system responsiveness and optimizes satellite communication bandwidth. Demonstrated through current integration across multiple missions, including European Space Agency's (ESA) Phisat-2 mission and Microsoft/Thales Alenia Space IMAGIN-e mission, our pipeline aims to improve marine environmental monitoring by providing timely alerts and efficient data reduction.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Presented at the 9th International Workshop on On-Board Payload Data Compression (OBPDC 2024), Gran Canaria, Spain, 2-4 October 2024
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 9th International Workshop on On-Board Payload Data Compression (OBPDC 2024), Gran Canaria, Spain, 2-4 October 2024
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向星载多光谱/高光谱卫星的海洋异常检测流水线：自监督神经网络编码器把卫星图像压到低维 latent 空间，再用机器学习异常检测模型识别偏离正常海况的事件（溢油、藻华、沉积物洪水），并与 Isolation Forest、One-Class SVM、Local Outlier Factor 对比。流水线按算力从嵌入式 CPU 到 AI 加速器优化，优先回传关键信息以节省通信带宽，已集成到 ESA Phisat-2 与 Microsoft/Thales Alenia Space IMAGIN-e 任务。
Motivation: 溢油、藻华、沉积物洪水等海洋灾害需要尽早发现，但星上算力与下行带宽受限，把全部多/高光谱数据下传再分析既慢又浪费带宽。
Method: 自监督神经网络编码器将卫星图像压缩到降维 latent 空间以支持星上处理，其上接一个机器学习异常检测模型，检测偏离正常海况的样本；与 Isolation Forest、One-Class SVM、Local Outlier Factor 等传统算法对比，整体针对嵌入式 CPU 至 AI 加速器做轻量化部署优化。
Result: 流水线已在多个任务集成演示，包括 ESA Phisat-2 与 Microsoft/Thales Alenia Space IMAGIN-e；输出为及时告警与数据缩减，优先回传关键信息以提升系统响应并节省卫星通信带宽。
Conclusion: 把自监督压缩与异常检测放到星上，可在算力受限的卫星上实现海洋事件的及时告警和带宽优化的数据缩减。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Amortized Structured Stochastic Variational Inference for Gaussian Process Latent Variable Models
papers.abstract_en: Many machine learning methods aim to approximate the lower-dimensional manifold on which the data lives. A desirable feature of such methods is that they should capture the epistemic uncertainty of this learned manifold. One model that achieves this is the Gaussian Process Latent Variable Model, in which a Gaussian Process (GP) mapping from the latent space provides an estimate of the uncertainty of the manifold. However, the effectiveness of this uncertainty estimation is limited by the mean-field variational approximation between the GP inducing points and the latent variables. In this work, we apply Amortized Structured Stochastic Variational Inference to allow the variational posterior for the latent space to be conditionally dependent on the value of the inducing points. We demonstrate that this more flexible variational posterior improves several metrics relating to the reconstruction of points on the data manifold.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 GP-LVM 中均场 (mean-field) 变分近似割裂诱导点与潜变量、低估流形认知不确定性的问题，把 Amortized Structured Stochastic Variational Inference 引入高斯过程潜变量模型，使潜空间变分后验对诱导点取值条件依赖。摘要称这种更灵活的后验改善了数据流形上点重建的多项指标。
Motivation: GP-LVM 用 GP 映射给出流形不确定性，但 GP 诱导点与潜变量之间的均场变分近似限制了不确定性估计的有效性，使学到的低维流形上的认知不确定性不可靠。
Method: 将 Amortized Structured Stochastic Variational Inference 应用于 GP-LVM，令潜空间的变分后验以诱导点取值为条件（条件依赖而非均场独立），从而得到更灵活的结构化变分后验。
Result: 在数据流形点重建相关的多项指标上，该结构化变分后验相较均场近似取得改善；摘要未列出具体数值。
Conclusion: 打破 GP 诱导点与潜变量之间的均场独立假设、让潜变量后验条件依赖于诱导点，能提升 GP-LVM 对数据流形的重建质量。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: When May a Bandit Leave Its Anchor? E-Process-Authorized Thompson Sampling under Non-stationarity
papers.abstract_en: Stationarity rewards memory, but after a change the same history can mislead. We ask when forgetting should be permitted. E-process-authorized Thompson sampling (e-ATS) gives each arm full-history and discounted Beta states. An anytime-valid e-process first authorizes the discounted state, then a reversible relevance score controls its influence. Before authorization, e-ATS exactly follows optimistic Thompson sampling (OTS). Under a Beta-Bernoulli prior-predictive stationary model, e-ATS's probability of ever departing from OTS is at most the chosen $α_E$, without fitted thresholds. Relative to e-ATS, removing authorization increased mean normalized dynamic pseudo-regret by $38.4\%$ on the registered suite but reduced it by $7.5\%$ on the literature-derived replay suite. Therefore, evidence controls when adaptation begins, not whether it always helps.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 3 figures. Accepted to the E-Values Workshop at NeurIPS 2026 (poster)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 e-ATS（e-process-authorized Thompson sampling）：用 anytime-valid e-process 先为折扣 Beta 状态“授权”，再由可逆 relevance score 控制其影响，未授权时完全等同于乐观 Thompson sampling (OTS)。在 Beta-Bernoulli 先验预测平稳模型下，e-ATS 偏离 OTS 的概率不超过所选 α_E，无需拟合阈值；去掉授权在注册测试套件上使平均归一化动态伪遗憾上升 38.4%，在文献复现套件上反而下降 7.5%。
Motivation: 非平稳环境下同一历史在变化点后会误导决策，但何时允许遗忘（放弃锚定的全历史状态）缺少有统计保证的判据：阈值常靠拟合，且适应并不总是有益。
Method: 每个 arm 同时维护全历史与折扣 Beta 状态；anytime-valid e-process 先授权折扣状态，可逆 relevance score 再调节其权重；授权前严格遵循 OTS。理论分析在 Beta-Bernoulli 先验预测平稳模型下给出偏离 OTS 的概率界 α_E，并在注册套件与文献来源 replay 套件上做对照（移除授权环节）。
Result: 相对 e-ATS，移除授权使注册套件上平均归一化动态伪遗憾增加 38.4%，在文献来源 replay 套件上减少 7.5%；理论上偏离 OTS 的概率至多为所选 α_E，且不依赖拟合阈值。
Conclusion: 证据（e-process 授权）决定适应何时开始，而非适应是否总是有益——授权机制在一类非平稳序列上保护性能，在另一类上则可能抑制有益的遗忘。
Relevance: 12

papers.title: On the Convergence of Success Conditioning for Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Success conditioning is a strategy for improving decision-making policies in stochastic environments; it updates a policy by increasing the probability of taking actions that yield successful outcomes. Success conditioning is common to many reinforcement learning applications, yet its limiting behavior and convergence rates are not well understood. In this work, we demonstrate that success conditioning converges to an optimal policy on a broad class of Markov decision processes (MDPs). We also derive convergence rates in some common settings. For discounted MDPs, we prove convergence within $\mathcal{O}(1/\varepsilon^p)$ iterations to an $\varepsilon$-optimal policy, where the exponent $p$ depends on problem data. For single-period MDPs, such a policy is obtained within $\mathcal{O}(\log(1/\varepsilon))$ iterations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明 success conditioning（成功条件化）这类提高成功动作概率的策略更新，在一大类 MDP 上收敛到最优策略并给出收敛速率：折扣 MDP 中 O(1/ε^p) 次迭代达到 ε-最优（指数 p 依赖问题数据），单周期 MDP 中仅需 O(log(1/ε)) 次。
Motivation: Success conditioning 在强化学习中被广泛使用，但其极限行为与收敛速率缺乏理论理解，无法判断何时能收敛到最优策略以及需要多少次更新。
Method: 对 success conditioning 策略更新做收敛性分析：在一大类 Markov 决策过程 (MDP) 上证明收敛到最优策略，并针对折扣 MDP 与单周期 MDP 两类常见设定分别推导迭代复杂度。
Result: 折扣 MDP：O(1/ε^p) 次迭代内达到 ε-最优策略，指数 p 依赖问题数据；单周期 MDP：O(log(1/ε)) 次迭代内得到该策略。
Conclusion: Success conditioning 在一大类 MDP 上是收敛到最优策略的方法，其速率在折扣与单周期设定下分别呈多项式与对数级。

papers.title: IDRF: Inverse-Distilled Reward Fine-tuning of Masked Discrete Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Masked discrete diffusion models offer a promising alternative to autoregressive generation, but iterative sampling can be costly, and intractable sequence likelihoods complicate reward fine-tuning. We introduce IDRF, a framework for reward fine-tuning of few-step masked discrete diffusion generators. Starting from a standard reverse-KL-regularized objective, IDRF replaces the intractable sequence-level KL penalty with inverse-distillation regularization. With an optimal auxiliary denoiser, we prove that the population inverse-distillation loss upper-bounds the sequence-level KL divergence to the reference distribution. IDRF optimizes a trajectory-based surrogate of this loss without reference-model rollouts, so the student keeps its own few-step sampler. We view few-step generation as a finite-horizon Markov decision process and optimize reward with a clipped policy-gradient objective over the student's trajectories. Across DNA, image, and text generation, IDRF achieves high reward with up to $32\times$ fewer denoising steps than the reference while mitigating reward hacking and preserving sample quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IDRF 对少步数掩码离散扩散 (masked discrete diffusion) 生成器做奖励微调：用 inverse-distillation 正则替代不可解的序列级 KL 惩罚，并在学生自身轨迹上做截断策略梯度。在 DNA、图像、文本生成上，它以最多 32× 更少的去噪步数达到高奖励，同时抑制 reward hacking 并保持样本质量。
Motivation: 掩码离散扩散的迭代采样开销大，且序列似然不可解，使基于 KL 的奖励微调难以直接实施。
Method: 从 reverse-KL 正则目标出发，用 inverse-distillation 正则替换序列级 KL；证明在最优辅助去噪器下该总体损失上界于到参考分布的序列级 KL；再把少步生成建模为有限视界 MDP，用学生自身轨迹上的 clipped policy-gradient 目标优化奖励，无需参考模型 rollout。
Result: 在 DNA、图像、文本生成三类任务上，IDRF 相对参考模型以最多 32× 更少的去噪步数达到高奖励，同时缓解 reward hacking 并保持样本质量。

papers.title: Broken scale symmetries in undercomplete linear autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Neural network loss landscapes have many symmetries, which are preserved by gradient flow but broken by finite-stepsize stochastic gradient descent (SGD). A canonical example of such a symmetry is scale in homogeneous networks: one can scale up the parameters in one layer and down in the next without changing the network output. Previous work has documented cases in which SGD breaks this symmetry in favor of balancing gradient noise or minimizing fluctuations. Here, we show that the solution geometry of undercomplete linear autoencoders instead selects a preferred sign for scale drift: on the PCA solution manifold, SGD favors large decoder weights. This directed scale drift occurs on a slow timescale, and its dynamics admit an analytically-tractable effective description. However, it cannot continue indefinitely: increasing scale eventually drives the dynamics towards a finite-stepsize stability boundary. The resulting solutions are sharper than a balanced baseline in the sense of the maximum eigenvalue of the loss Hessian, but different sharpness measures can move in opposing directions. Thus, undercomplete autoencoders give a concrete illustration of how loss geometry can convert residual gradient noise into directed motion along a manifold of functionally-equivalent solutions.
papers.comment: NeurIPS 2026 Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 欠完备线性自编码器 (undercomplete linear autoencoder) 的 PCA 解流形上，有限步长 SGD 不是随机漂移而是定向推动尺度：偏好增大 decoder 权重，且该漂移最终把动力学推向有限步长稳定性边界。所得解按损失 Hessian 最大特征值衡量比 balanced 基线更尖锐，但不同 sharpness 度量可反向变化。
Motivation: 梯度流保持损失景观的尺度对称性，而有限步长 SGD 会破缺它；此前工作只记录了 SGD 为平衡梯度噪声而破缺对称的案例，缺少对破缺方向及其动力学的解析刻画。
Method: 在欠完备线性自编码器的 PCA 解流形上分析有限步长 SGD 的尺度漂移，给出可解析处理的有效动力学描述，并以损失 Hessian 最大特征值等 sharpness 度量刻画所得解。
Result: SGD 在 PCA 流形上定向选择大 decoder 权重的尺度漂移，发生在慢时间尺度上；漂移受有限步长稳定性边界限制而不能无限继续；所得解的 Hessian 最大特征值比 balanced 基线更尖锐，但不同 sharpness 度量可朝相反方向变化。
Conclusion: 损失几何可以把残余梯度噪声转化为沿函数等价解流形的定向运动，尺度对称破缺的方向由解几何而非噪声平衡决定。

papers.title: Do Large Language Models Know Colombian Law? A Reliability Benchmark for the Colombian Legal System
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support legal practice, education, and research, yet their reliability in national legal systems outside the United States remains largely undocumented. We introduce an expert-validated benchmark for evaluating LLM reliability on the Colombian legal system. The benchmark comprises 1,042 items spanning ten areas of law and three question formats (closed multiple-choice, semi-open, and open-ended IRAC), built through a human-in-the-loop pipeline with multi-stage expert review. We evaluate 15 contemporary proprietary and open-weight models with format-appropriate metrics. Accuracy on closed questions ranges widely, from 0.905 (Gemini 3.1 Pro) to 0.577, but on free-text legal answers factual correctness never exceeds 0.45 (on a 0-1 scale) for any model. We find a dissociation between answer relevancy and correctness (Spearman rho = -0.46): models reliably sound responsive while frequently being wrong, a pattern of particular concern for non-expert users. Closed-question accuracy and free-text correctness are strongly rank-correlated (rho = 0.94), so cheap multiple-choice screening predicts model ranking but overstates absolute reliability. An independent rubric-based LLM judge and blind human expert scoring both reproduce the free-text ranking (rho >= 0.88). The judge further reveals that only about half of the norms models cite are correct; the rest are wrong or non-existent. Reliability varies systematically by legal area and follows an inverted-U across question complexity. Our results indicate that current LLMs require expert supervision for Colombian legal tasks, and that grounding answers in authoritative sources is a promising path to higher reliability. We release the benchmark construction pipeline to support reproducible evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 构建哥伦比亚法律体系的 LLM 可靠性基准：1,042 道题覆盖十个法律领域与三种题型，评测 15 个专有与开源模型。封闭选择题准确率最高 0.905（Gemini 3.1 Pro）、最低 0.577，但自由文本法律回答的事实正确性对任何模型都不超过 0.45（0–1 刻度），且模型引用的规范中仅约一半正确。
Motivation: LLM 已用于法律实务、教育与研究，但其在美国以外国家法律体系上的可靠性基本没有系统记录，非专业用户难以判断答案对错。
Method: 通过 human-in-the-loop 流水线加多阶段专家评审构建 1,042 题基准，含封闭多选、半开放与开放式 IRAC 三种题型、十个法律领域；用与题型匹配的指标评测 15 个专有与开源模型，并以基于量规的独立 LLM judge 与盲评人类专家双重打分。
Result: 封闭题准确率区间 0.577–0.905（最高为 Gemini 3.1 Pro）；自由文本事实正确性所有模型均不超过 0.45（0–1 刻度）；相关性与正确性呈负相关（Spearman rho = -0.46）；封闭题准确率与自由文本正确性秩相关 rho = 0.94；LLM judge 与人类专家复现自由文本排名（rho >= 0.88）；模型引用的规范仅约一半正确，其余错误或不存在。
Conclusion: 当前 LLM 处理哥伦比亚法律任务需要专家监督，廉价的多选筛查能预测模型排名但会高估绝对可靠性，把回答锚定到权威来源是提升可靠性的可行路径。

papers.title: LoGo: Local-Global Rewards for Consistent Long-Horizon Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Camera-controlled video models are rapidly advancing toward long generation horizons and complex camera control. A key failure mode is 3D inconsistency: as the camera moves, objects lose permanence and scene structures shift. Existing post-training techniques, which assign a single scalar reward to the entire generation, are poorly suited to correcting these inconsistencies over long horizons. We introduce LoGo, which blends global and spatially localized rewards for camera-controlled video models. The local reward provides fine-grained credit assignment, which substantially improves 3D consistency, while the global reward preserves camera following and video quality. Across three base models, LoGo shows a clear advantage on DL3DV and TrajectoryBench, a new benchmark for long-horizon, complex-camera-control generation that current evaluations lack. LoGo effectively reduces local object shifts, artifacts, and global scene changes, illustrating the importance of credit assignment in post-training video models. Project website: https://ziqi-ma.github.io/logo-website/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LoGo 把单一整段标量奖励拆成全局奖励与空间局部奖励的混合，用于相机可控视频模型的后训练：局部奖励提供细粒度 credit assignment 直接压低 3D 不一致，全局奖励守住相机跟随与画质。在三个基座模型上于 DL3DV 与新基准 TrajectoryBench 均显示优势，局部物体偏移、伪影与全局场景变化都被有效减少。
Motivation: 相机可控视频模型生成时长变长后，相机一动就出现物体失去永久性、场景结构漂移的 3D 不一致；现有后训练只给整段生成赋一个标量奖励，无法在长时程上把误差归因到具体位置。
Method: LoGo 混合全局奖励与空间局部奖励做后训练：局部奖励对生成片段做空间分辨的细粒度 credit assignment，全局奖励约束相机跟随与整体视频质量；方法在三个不同基座模型上验证，并配套提出长时程复杂相机控制基准 TrajectoryBench。
Result: 在三个基座模型上，LoGo 在 DL3DV 与 TrajectoryBench 上均展现明显优势，有效减少局部物体偏移 (local object shifts)、伪影 (artifacts) 与全局场景变化 (global scene changes)；TrajectoryBench 是针对长时程复杂相机控制生成的新基准，作者指出现有评测缺少这一维度。
Conclusion: 长时程相机可控视频的 3D 不一致主要源于奖励的 credit assignment 粒度不够，把奖励拆到空间局部并保留全局约束即可在不牺牲相机跟随与画质的前提下改善一致性。

papers.title: Credit Where It Matters: Dependency-Aware Policy Optimization for Terminal Agents
papers.abstract_en: Terminal-using agents benefit from reinforcement learning (RL) in coding, debugging, and other multi-step terminal tasks. In these tasks, later commands often depend on information or intermediate results produced by earlier commands. However, existing trajectory-level and step-level credit assignment methods do not explicitly trace the read-write dependencies through which commands affect the final outcome. Consequently, training signals could still be assigned to irrelevant operations, weakening learning from relevant steps. In this paper, we propose Dependency-Aware Group Policy Optimization (DepGPO), which uses execution dependencies between commands to guide credit assignment for terminal agents. Specifically, we construct a command dependency graph from execution traces and trace backward from the resources inspected by the task verifier. We then assign credit to relevant writes and their supporting reads along these paths, and use it to redistribute trajectory advantages across steps. Extensive comparative experiments and ablation studies demonstrate that DepGPO improves task performance and training stability on complex terminal tasks.
papers.summary_zh:

Method: 从执行轨迹构建命令依赖图，从任务 verifier 检查的资源出发沿依赖反向回溯；沿路径把 credit 分配给相关写操作与支撑读操作，用该 credit 重新分配各步的 trajectory advantage，用于终端 agent 的策略优化。

Conclusion: 把命令间读写依赖显式纳入 credit assignment，能让终端 agent 的 RL 训练信号集中在真正影响结果的步骤上，从而提高性能与训练稳定性。

papers.title: World Embedding Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Physical fidelity has received increasing attention in world models and video generation, yet how video representations encode physical information remains less understood. We introduce the World Embedding Benchmark, comprising 8,000 controlled simulation cases from 80 families spanning fluid mechanics, solid mechanics, dynamics, and optics & electromagnetism. Each case pairs a rendered video with simulation-derived physical annotations, supporting three complementary tasks: text-video retrieval, physical-property regression, and multiple-choice video-description pair classification. We use these tasks to distinguish cross-modal physical alignment from the recoverability of quantitative physical information. Evaluated pre-trained omnimodal embedding models show weak retrieval and near-chance within-family pair classification, while lightweight probes recover useful physical information from frozen video embeddings. Continual contrastive training with physics-specific video-text pairs improves retrieval and pair classification but degrades physical-property regression, revealing a trade-off between alignment and quantitative information recoverability. Finally, we use the embeddings to retrieve reference videos for retrieval-augmented generation with MiniMax-H3. Retrieved references improve the physical fidelity of generated videos, with stronger retrieval models yielding larger gains in our experiments. Together, these findings highlight the need to evaluate physical alignment and property recoverability jointly, and demonstrate the utility of physical representations for improving video generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 World Embedding Benchmark：8,000 个受控仿真案例、80 个家族，覆盖流体、固体、动力学与光学电磁，每个案例配渲染视频与仿真物理标注，用检索、物理属性回归、多选视频-描述配对分类三任务区分跨模态物理对齐与定量信息可恢复性。评测显示预训练 omnimodal 嵌入检索弱、家族内配对分类接近随机，轻量探针却能从冻结嵌入恢复有用物理信息；持续对比训练提升检索与配对分类但降低属性回归，揭示对齐与可恢复性的权衡。
Motivation: 世界模型与视频生成日益强调物理保真，但视频表示如何编码物理信息缺乏受控、可量化的评测手段，无法区分跨模态对齐与定量物理量的可恢复性。
Method: 构建 8,000 个受控仿真案例（80 个家族，横跨流体、固体、动力学、光学与电磁），每个案例配渲染视频与仿真导出的物理标注，支撑文本-视频检索、物理属性回归、多选视频-描述配对分类三项任务；在预训练 omnimodal 嵌入上评测并用轻量探针读取冻结嵌入，再做物理专用视频-文本对的持续对比训练，最后用嵌入检索参考视频供 MiniMax-H3 做检索增强生成。
Result: 预训练 omnimodal 嵌入检索表现弱、家族内配对分类接近随机；轻量探针可从冻结视频嵌入恢复有用的物理信息；持续对比训练提升检索与配对分类但降低物理属性回归；检索增强生成中被检索的参考视频提升了生成视频的物理保真，且检索模型越强增益越大。
Conclusion: 物理对齐与定量属性可恢复性需联合评测，二者存在权衡；物理表示可用于提升视频生成的物理保真。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: NeutronGym: Physics-Graded Neutron Instrument Design for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Designing a scientific instrument tests whether language-model agents can do physics rather than recall it, provided the grading cannot be argued with. We introduce NeutronGym, to our knowledge the first executable environment for neutron instrument design: agents build instruments through validating tools, McStas ray-traces what they build, and a level-resolved ladder grades syntax, runtime, structure and science with no LLM judge. Procedural families supply unlimited instances of a fixed layout whose design parameters the agent must set, with held-out parameter regimes; a curated slice, McStasBench, adds 16 tasks from published instruments behind memorization probes and a sandbox. Seven models reproduce at most 7 of the 16, none retrieves a reference, and none meets an improvement target. The environment also trains. Reinforcement learning on its reward takes Qwen3-8B from 11% to 77% of held-out instances of a family whose targets come from a hidden design (69% at a second seed), past an untrained Qwen3-32B, and the recipe holds, at one seed each, on three further gated families. The analysis says what that gain is. Without the ladder's partial credit it collapses by 60 points. From reward alone the trained model reaches what a classical optimizer reaches, at the agent's simulation budget, only when handed the closed-form physics (77% against 81%, a gap that does not separate at this size), while frontier models still solve 98-99%. Getting a trustworthy result meant failing four task designs that no-model baselines could solve, and we release the probes that found them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NeutronGym 是首个可执行的中子仪器设计环境：agent 用验证工具搭建仪器，McStas 做光线追踪，按语法、运行时、结构、科学四级阶梯打分且不用 LLM judge。RL 训练让 Qwen3-8B 在 held-out 实例上从 11% 升到 77%（第二随机种子 69%），超过未训练的 Qwen3-32B；去掉阶梯的部分分奖励后成绩塌陷 60 个百分点。
Motivation: 要检验语言模型 agent 是真在做物理还是在回忆物理，前提是评分不可争辩；中子仪器设计此前缺少可执行、可复现的评测环境。
Method: agent 通过验证工具构建仪器，McStas 对其构建做光线追踪；四级阶梯分别评语法、运行时、结构与科学，不使用 LLM judge。程序化生成族提供固定布局的无限实例并留出参数区间，McStasBench 收录 16 个来自已发表仪器的任务并配记忆探针与沙箱；训练用该环境的奖励做强化学习。
Result: 七个模型在 McStasBench 16 个任务中最多复现 7 个，无一检索到参考设计，也无一达到改进目标。RL 训练的 Qwen3-8B 在某族 held-out 实例上从 11% 升至 77%，第二种子 69%，超过未训练的 Qwen3-32B，且该配方在另外三个 gated 族上各以一个种子成立。去掉部分分奖励后成绩下降 60 个百分点；仅凭奖励训练的模型在给定闭式物理时达到经典优化器水平（77% 对 81%，该规模下差距不显著），而 frontier 模型仍达 98–99%。
Conclusion: 中子仪器设计可以做成评分不可争辩、且能用 RL 训练的环境；性能增益主要由阶梯的部分分奖励支撑，且在拿到闭式物理后才追平经典优化器，与 frontier 模型仍有差距。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Depth as Time in One-Step Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: The recent wave of one-step generative models, which compress the multi-step trajectory of diffusion via either distillation or learned flow maps, has reached an inflection point where they can generate high-quality images. Here, we ask a natural question that follows from these advances: what happens to the denoising trajectory of multi-step diffusion when generation is compressed into a single forward pass? We offer an empirical observation we call \textit{depth as time}: the denoising computation that multi-step diffusion performs across sampling steps appears to unfold across the depth of a single forward pass, and can be recovered by decoding intermediate layers with the model's own output head. Most interestingly, we show that this depthwise computation depends on the transport task a flow map is trained to solve. The most surprising case is MeanFlow, where probing shorter transport intervals reveals both denoising and renoising within a single network evaluation. In contrast, generators trained without a time-indexed transport task, such as drifting models, do not exhibit the same depthwise denoising. Consequently, we show that models that exhibit the depthwise denoising phenomenon are more compressible across the layerwise computation: a MeanFlow \texttt{SiT-L/2} model can be compressed by $16.6\times$ in parameters into a single time-conditioned block. We offer an explanation for this denoise-then-renoise behavior and show that, when we treat the layerwise computation explicitly as a flow, a single time-conditioned block can be trained to denoise across layers, compressing a MeanFlow \texttt{SiT-L/2} model by $16.6\times$ in parameters. Together, these results suggest that the temporal computation of diffusion is not eliminated by one-step generation, but reorganized across network depth.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出经验观察 depth as time：单步生成模型一次前向传播的网络深度，复现了多步扩散沿采样步展开的去噪轨迹，且可用模型自身输出头解码中间层恢复。该现象取决于 flow map 所解的 transport task：MeanFlow 在单次网络评估内同时出现 denoising 与 renoising，而无时间索引 transport task 的 drifting 模型不出现逐层去噪；据此把逐层计算显式当作 flow 训练单个 time-conditioned block，可把 MeanFlow SiT-L/2 参数压缩 16.6×。
Motivation: 一步生成模型已能产出高质量图像，但压缩后多步扩散的去噪轨迹去向不明：它被消除了，还是被重组进了单次前向传播的网络深度。
Method: 用模型自身输出头解码中间层，逐层探查一次前向传播中的去噪计算；对比不同 transport task 训练的模型（MeanFlow 与 drifting model），并探测更短的 transport interval；随后把逐层计算显式当作 flow，训练单个 time-conditioned block 在层间执行去噪。
Result: MeanFlow 探测更短 transport interval 时在单次网络评估内同时呈现 denoising 与 renoising；drifting 等无时间索引 transport task 的模型不呈现逐层去噪。呈现逐层去噪的模型在层间计算上更可压缩：MeanFlow SiT-L/2 参数压缩 16.6×，压进单个 time-conditioned block。
Conclusion: 一步生成并未消除扩散的时间计算，而是把它重组到网络深度上；是否具备逐层去噪取决于 flow map 训练的 transport task，并决定了模型能否被大幅压缩。

papers.title: FALCON: A Model and Dataset Agnostic Framework for Synthetic Data Generation for NL2SQL Pairs
papers.abstract_en: Relational databases are among the most widely deployed forms of structured knowledge, and natural language access to them requires grounding language onto schema entities and relations while handling the ambiguity inherent in how people phrase requests. Existing synthetic NL-to-SQL data generation methods largely ignore this ambiguity and produce oversimplified queries that fail to prepare models for the complexity of real-world structured knowledge access. We present FALCON, a framework that generates realistic, ambiguity-aware NL-to-SQL data matching the complexity of challenging real-world benchmarks, at low cost using compact open models. Our approach combines reserved-word SQL seeding and persona-based prompting to generate structurally complex queries, while alignment-based filtering preserves difficulty by distinguishing genuinely incorrect examples from complex but valid queries. Human evaluation confirms consistent high quality across model sizes, and our generated data exceeds existing benchmarks in both SQL complexity and natural language richness. Difficulty-stratified analysis shows models trained on FALCON data increasingly outperform baseline-trained models as query complexity increases, validating our pipeline's success in generating challenging training data. When combined with a small proportion of existing benchmark data, mixed training recovers performance on simpler queries while preserving these advantages on complex ones. The model- and database-agnostic design enables organizations to generate high-complexity NL-to-SQL training data locally without external APIs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FALCON 用保留字 SQL 播种 (reserved-word SQL seeding) 加 persona 提示生成带歧义、结构复杂的 NL-to-SQL 合成数据，再用基于对齐的过滤区分真正错误与复杂但合法的查询。难度分层分析显示，随查询复杂度上升，FALCON 数据训练的模型相对基线训练的模型优势扩大；混入少量现有基准数据可在简单查询上恢复性能同时保住复杂查询上的优势。
Motivation: 现有合成 NL-to-SQL 数据生成忽略自然语言表述歧义，产出的查询过于简单，无法让模型应对真实结构化知识访问的复杂度。
Method: 保留字 SQL 播种与 persona-based prompting 生成结构复杂查询；alignment-based filtering 保留难度，区分真正错误样本与复杂但有效的查询；用紧凑开源模型低成本生成，并做难度分层分析与混合训练。
Result: 人工评测确认各模型规模下质量稳定；生成数据在 SQL 复杂度与自然语言丰富度上超过现有基准；随查询复杂度增加，FALCON 训练模型相对基线训练模型的优势递增；混入少量现有基准数据的混合训练在简单查询上恢复性能并保留复杂查询优势。
Conclusion: 模型与数据库无关的设计使组织可在本地用开源模型生成高复杂度 NL-to-SQL 训练数据，无需外部 API；简单与复杂查询的取舍靠混合训练解决。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 保留字 SQL 播种与 persona-based prompting 生成结构复杂查询；alignment-based filtering 保留难度，区分真正错误样本与复杂但有效的查询；用紧凑开源模型低成本生成，并做难度分层分析与混合训练。
summary_sections.result: 人工评测确认各模型规模下质量稳定；生成数据在 SQL 复杂度与自然语言丰富度上超过现有基准；随查询复杂度增加，FALCON 训练模型相对基线训练模型的优势递增；混入少量现有基准数据的混合训练在简单查询上恢复性能并保留复杂查询优势。
summary_sections.conclusion: 模型与数据库无关的设计使组织可在本地用开源模型生成高复杂度 NL-to-SQL 训练数据，无需外部 API；简单与复杂查询的取舍靠混合训练解决。

papers.title: Normal-Form Correlation in Markov Games
papers.abstract_en: There has been a surge of recent work on correlated equilibrium concepts in Markov games. However, existing results focus on concepts weaker than normal-form correlated equilibria (NFCEs), leaving open the more challenging question of computing such equilibria, which goes back to the seminal work of Papadimitriou and Roughgarden (JACM'08). Here, we establish the first efficient algorithm for NFCEs in finite-horizon Markov games with a fixed number of players $n$. In particular, with $S$ states, horizon $H$, and at most $A$ actions per player, it computes an $ε$-NFCE in time $S(AH/ε)^{O(n)}$. This is the first algorithm polynomial in $1/ε$ and the description of the game for NFCEs in an interesting class of problems beyond the normal-form setting. Moreover, under the usual assumption that recommendations are independent across states, we show PPAD-completeness---that is, computational equivalence to Nash equilibria---either in many-player games or when the precision is exponentially small. The key idea behind our approach is to run backward induction on a sequence of auxiliary stage games, but with the twist that in each step we compute a constant-expectation correlated equilibrium. This is a natural refinement of correlated equilibrium in which the conditional expected payoff from obeying is independent of the recommendation. In fact, our reduction goes both ways, establishing an equivalence between constant-expectation CEs and NFCEs in Markov games. For a fixed number of players, we observe that a constant-expectation CE can be computed approximately by combining linear programming with suitable discretization. In contrast, it is PPAD-hard in i) polymatrix (many-player) games at constant precision, and ii) two-player games at exponentially small precision. The latter result follows from an unexpected connection to rank-2 two-player games.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 给出有限时域 Markov 博弈中 normal-form correlated equilibrium (NFCE) 的首个高效算法：固定玩家数 n 时以 S(AH/ε)^{O(n)} 时间求 ε-NFCE，是首个对 1/ε 与博弈描述均为多项式的 NFCE 算法；同时证明在跨状态推荐独立假设下，多玩家或指数小精度时问题 PPAD-完全。
Motivation: Markov 博弈相关均衡的已有结果只覆盖弱于 NFCE 的概念，NFCE 的计算问题自 Papadimitriou 与 Roughgarden (JACM'08) 起一直悬而未决。
Method: 对一列辅助 stage game 做 backward induction，每步计算 constant-expectation correlated equilibrium（服从推荐的条件期望收益与推荐无关）；固定玩家数时用线性规划加离散化近似求解，并证明 constant-expectation CE 与 Markov 博弈 NFCE 双向等价。
Result: 固定 n 个玩家、S 状态、时域 H、每玩家至多 A 动作时，ε-NFCE 求解时间为 S(AH/ε)^{O(n)}，对 1/ε 与博弈描述均为多项式；在推荐跨状态独立假设下，多玩家博弈或精度指数小时 PPAD-完全（与 Nash 均衡计算等价）；constant-expectation CE 在固定玩家数时可由 LP 加离散化近似求得，但在 i) 常数精度的 polymatrix 多玩家博弈与 ii) 指数小精度的两人博弈中 PPAD--hard，后者源于与 rank-2 two-player games 的联系。
Conclusion: NFCE 在固定玩家数的有限时域 Markov 博弈中可高效近似计算，而玩家数增多或精度指数降低即退化到与 Nash 均衡同等的 PPAD-完全难度。

papers.title: UniIntervene++: An Adaptive Intervention Agent for Efficient Real-World Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Online reinforcement learning (RL) enables robot policies to improve through physical interaction, but the assistance they require changes as their competence evolves. Existing intervention strategies based on offline estimates or fixed decision rules can therefore become mismatched to the current policy. To address this, we propose UniIntervene++, an adaptive intervention agent that learns to allocate control between autonomous execution and heterogeneous assisted behaviors during online RL. Specifically, UniIntervene++ first formulates the evolving RL policy, trajectory correction, and a task-structured CodePolicy as Options in a unified semi-Markov decision process and learns their relative values online. Building on this, competence-adaptive intervention periodically probes the RL policy through unassisted execution, keeping control allocation responsive to its evolving capability. Finally, coupled experience learning allows assisted behaviors to improve the RL policy, whose evolving outcomes in turn reshape future intervention decisions. In this way, UniIntervene++ jointly determines when to intervene, how to intervene, and when to return control as the RL policy improves. Across five real-world manipulation tasks, UniIntervene++ achieves an average success rate of 89.67%, outperforming all baselines by at least 6 percentage points, while reducing human intervention to 0.77%, a relative reduction of at least 94.6% from the best baseline. Code is available in our \href{https://github.com/dannyyudong/An-Adaptive-Intervention-Agent-for-Efficient-Real-World-Reinforcement-Learning}{GitHub repository}.
papers.comment: Yudong Lin and Haoyuan Deng contributed equally. Ziwei Wang is the corresponding author. Code is available in our \href{https://github.com/dannyyudong/An-Adaptive-Intervention-Agent-for-Efficient-Real-World-Reinforcement-Learning}{GitHub repository}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniIntervene++ 把在线 RL 策略、轨迹修正与任务结构化 CodePolicy 统一成半马尔可夫决策过程 (SMDP) 的 Options，用 competence-adaptive intervention 定期无辅助探测策略能力，动态决定何时介入、如何介入、何时交还控制。在五个真实机器人操作任务上平均成功率 89.67%，至少领先全部基线 6 个百分点，同时把人工介入降到 0.77%，相对最优基线至少减少 94.6%。
Motivation: 机器人在线 RL 所需的辅助随能力演化，而基于离线估计或固定规则的介入策略与当前策略不匹配，导致要么过度代劳、要么放任失败。
Method: 将演化中的 RL 策略、轨迹修正 (trajectory correction) 与任务结构化 CodePolicy 建模为统一 SMDP 中的 Options 并在线学习相对价值；competence-adaptive intervention 周期性用无辅助执行探测策略；coupled experience learning 让辅助行为改进 RL 策略，其结果反过来重塑后续介入决策。
Result: 在五个真实世界操作任务上平均成功率 89.67%，比所有基线至少高 6 个百分点；人工介入降至 0.77%，相对最优基线至少降低 94.6%。
Conclusion: 把介入时机、方式与交还控制统一到在线学习的 SMDP 价值里，可在真实机器人上同时抬高成功率并大幅压缩人工介入。
Relevance: 2
