papers.title: Low-Cost Video--Time Priors as a Strong Baseline for EEG--fNIRS Emotion Regression on Familiar Videos
papers.abstract_en: Continuous emotion regression estimates moment-to-moment valence and arousal while a viewer watches a video. In familiar-video deployment, responses fron training participant-specific estimate, and prior-dominating fixed fusion tests whether physiology adds residual correction. In five-fold subject-held-out evaluation on 24was within 0.05 and 0.32 MAE of fusion in the internal and external evaluations, respectively. Source-explicit ablations showed that video identity and within-video tine accounted for most of the reduction, while EG-FNIRS gains were smaller and varied across participants and videos. These results identify the video-time prior as a strong, low-cost baseline and position EEG-fNIRS as an optional residual signal for familiar-video emotion regression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在熟悉视频的连续情绪回归中，仅用视频身份与片内时间构成的先验（video-time prior）就已接近融合生理信号的性能：五折被试留出评估下，该先验相对 EEG-fNIRS 融合的 MAE 差距在内部与外部评估中分别只有 0.05 与 0.32。来源显式消融显示主要下降来自视频身份与片内时间，EEG-fNIRS 带来的增益更小且因被试和视频而异。
Motivation: 熟悉视频场景下连续 valence/arousal 回归中，生理信号到底贡献了多少残差修正并不清楚；若低成本的视频-时间先验已足够，昂贵的同步 EEG-fNIRS 采集就未必必要。
Method: 以视频身份与片内时间构造低成本先验作为固定融合中的 prior-dominating 分支，再检验生理信号是否只提供残差修正；评估采用五折被试留出 (five-fold subject-held-out)，并做来源显式消融 (source-explicit ablations) 分离视频身份、片内时间与 EEG-fNIRS 各自的贡献，含内部与外部两种评估。
Result: 五折被试留出评估中，视频-时间先验相对融合模型的 MAE 差距在内部评估为 0.05、外部评估为 0.32；消融显示视频身份与片内时间解释了大部分性能下降，EEG-fNIRS 的增益较小且随被试与视频变化。
Conclusion: 视频-时间先验应作为熟悉视频情绪回归的强低成本基线，EEG-fNIRS 只作为可选的残差信号而非主要性能来源。

papers.title: DEPICT: Scoring Text-to-Image Alignment by Answer Agreement
papers.abstract_en: Image-text alignment is a core problem in computer vision with applications in caption evaluation, hallucination detection, data curation, and the benchmarking of text-to-image (T2I) generators. As T2I models improve, benchmarking has become demanding, requiring metrics capable of finding a series of issues like missing objects, swapped attributes, miscounts, and ignored negations. Recent work addresses this by fine-tuning evaluators on preference data or by prompting a vision-language model, either holistically with the caption or with decomposed verification questions. However, existing approaches fall short: fine-tuned metrics remain bound to one backbone and training distribution; holistic metrics miss fine-grained details; and decomposed metrics rely on a fixed-YES assumption that penalizes faithful images whenever that assumption fails. In contrast, we propose DEPICT, a training-free metric that replaces fixed reference answers with expected agreement between image-based and caption-only answers, weighting questions by how decisively the caption determines them. By replacing fixed references, our agreement rule increases negation accuracy from 19% to 88%. To recover the context lost during decomposition, DEPICT merges this agreement score with a holistic score. We evaluate DEPICT on five benchmarks and eleven backbones from three model families and find that it surpasses all training-free metrics and exceeds fine-tuned evaluators on two out of three human-correlation benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DEPICT 是一个免训练的图文对齐评分指标：把分解式验证问题的固定参考答案换成「基于图像的回答与仅基于 caption 的回答之间的期望一致度」，并按 caption 对该问题的决定性程度加权，再与整体 (holistic) 分数融合以补回分解丢失的上下文。该一致度规则把否定 (negation) 判别准确率从 19% 提到 88%，在五个基准、三个模型家族的十一个骨干上超过所有免训练指标，并在三个人类相关性基准中的两个上超过微调评估器。
Motivation: T2I 生成器变强后，基准评测需要识别漏物体、属性互换、计数错误、忽略否定等细粒度问题；现有微调评估器绑定单一骨干与训练分布，整体式指标漏细节，分解式指标依赖 fixed-YES 假设、在假设不成立时惩罚忠实图像。
Method: DEPICT 为 training-free 指标：对 caption 分解出验证问题，不用固定参考答案，而计算基于图像的回答与仅基于 caption 的回答之间的期望一致度，并按 caption 对问题的决定性程度加权；再把该一致度分数与 holistic 分数合并，恢复分解过程丢失的上下文。
Result: 一致度规则使 negation accuracy 从 19% 提升到 88%；在五个基准、三个模型家族的十一个骨干上评测，超过全部 training-free 指标，并在三个人类相关性基准中的两个上超过 fine-tuned evaluators。
Conclusion: 用图像与 caption 回答之间的一致度替代 fixed-YES 参考答案，可以在不训练的前提下同时拿到细粒度判别力与人类相关性，且不绑定特定骨干。

papers.title: Mastering Atari 2600 Games with Discovered Options
papers.abstract_en: Temporal abstractions, often instantiated as options, have long been regarded as a mechanism for accelerating credit assignment, facilitating exploration, and enabling generalisation in reinforcement learning (RL). However, developing general option discovery methods that are effective in large-scale, high-dimensional domains remains a fundamental challenge. Existing option discovery methods are either confined to relatively simple domains, depend on handcrafted or quasi-symbolic representations, or offer little improvement over learning without options. We present Wayfarer, a general, domain-agnostic, online deep RL agent that discovers options through Laplacian representation learning from high-dimensional observations and leverages them for control. We show that the resulting options simultaneously improve exploration, accelerate credit assignment, and generalise effectively to unseen settings, enabling substantially faster learning of complex policies. Wayfarer achieves state-of-the-art performance among single-stream agents on the most challenging Atari 2600 games, with the largest gains in games that require long-horizon exploration and strategic behaviour, such as Montezuma's Revenge and Private Eye.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Wayfarer：一个领域无关的在线深度 RL 智能体，用 Laplacian 表示学习从高维观测中自动发现 options 并用于控制，使探索、信用分配与泛化同时改善。在单流 (single-stream) 智能体中于最难的 Atari 2600 游戏取得 SOTA，长时程探索与策略性游戏 Montezuma's Revenge、Private Eye 提升最大。
Motivation: 现有 option discovery 方法要么局限于简单领域、依赖手工或准符号表示，要么相对无 option 学习改进有限，在大规模高维域上仍缺少通用有效方案。
Method: Wayfarer 通过 Laplacian representation learning 从高维观测在线发现 options，并将这些 options 用于控制；整体是 domain-agnostic 的在线深度 RL 智能体。

papers.title: ManifoldSplat: Language-Guided Semantic Shape Editing of 3D Gaussian Head Avatars
papers.abstract_en: High-fidelity 3D head avatars have reached near-photorealistic quality. While recent methods enable text-driven manipulation, they struggle to provide fine-grained localized control, often entangling features or lacking geometric consistency. Modifying geometry through natural language currently requires slow per-prompt optimization or compromises identity and rigging. We present ManifoldSplat, the first end-toend framework for language-guided semantic shape editing of animatable 3D Gaussian Splatting avatars reconstructed from monocular videos. By performing edits within the structured FLAME manifold rather than directly optimizing an unstructured Gaussian cloud, we strictly preserve identity and animation. We introduce DeltaRegion, a per-region disentangled Conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE) delivering feedforward shape deltas, alongside a refining stage to recover view-consistent details. ManifoldSplat reconstructs and edits an avatar in ~90 seconds on a consumer GPU, rendering at ~800 FPS. Extensive evaluations demonstrate our approach sets a new state-of-the-art in localized prompt alignment, geometric coherence, and identity preservation. Project page and code: https://a-canela.github.io/manifoldsplat/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ManifoldSplat 在 FLAME 形状流形内做语言引导的头像形状编辑，而非直接优化无结构 Gaussian 点云，从而在编辑时严格保持身份与可动画性。单目视频重建的 3D Gaussian 头像可在消费级 GPU 上约 90 秒完成重建与编辑、渲染约 800 FPS，并在局部 prompt 对齐、几何一致性与身份保持上达到新 SOTA。
Motivation: 现有文本驱动的 3D 头像编辑要么需要逐 prompt 的慢速优化，要么纠缠特征、牺牲身份与绑定（rigging），缺少细粒度的局部几何控制。
Method: 端到端框架 ManifoldSplat：在结构化 FLAME manifold 内执行编辑而非直接优化无结构 Gaussian 云；引入 DeltaRegion，即按区域解耦的 Conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE)，前馈输出 shape delta，再加一个 refining 阶段恢复视角一致的细节。输入为单目视频重建的可动画 3D Gaussian Splatting 头像。
Result: 在消费级 GPU 上重建并编辑一个头像约 90 秒，渲染约 800 FPS；在局部 prompt 对齐 (localized prompt alignment)、几何一致性 (geometric coherence) 与身份保持 (identity preservation) 三项评估上被作者称为新的 state-of-the-art。
Conclusion: 把语言引导的形状编辑放进 FLAME 流形而非直接动 Gaussian 点云，可以同时拿到前馈速度、身份与动画的严格保持，以及局部可控的几何编辑。

papers.title: When a Correct Reward Is Not Enough: Diagnosing and Guiding PPO in an Analytically Solved Broker-Trader Game
authors: Carlo Campajola (1 and 2) ((1) Institute of Finance and Technology
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly used for financial optimal-control problems when complex dynamics make analytical strategies difficult to obtain. There are financial mathematics literactures which provides many solved models whose equations and controls could evaluate and guide learning; we ask whether RL can exploit these results. We place a proximal policy optimisation (PPO) agent in an analytically solved continuous-time broker--trader game. PPO replaces the broker and chooses its trading speed while interacting with an informed trader and stochastic uninformed order flow. We derive a finite-step reward from the broker's continuous-time payoff and verify its discrete implementation through grid refinement and an exact one-step identity. With zero uninformed flow, a validation-selected PPO--FFNN approaches the reference action. With stochastic uninformed flow, the tested PPO--FFNN and PPO--LSTM remain inaccurate, although supervised learning confirms that their actors can represent the action. Monte Carlo diagnostics show that their critics do not reliably rank nearby actions; potential-based reward shaping also gives no reliable improvement. Under partial information, a causal certainty-equivalent controller based on the broker's observable history remains close to the reference, while PPO has larger errors and lower payoffs. Finally, we freeze the analytical policy and train PPO to adjust it after the execution cost changes. Halving the cost yields a repeatable improvement that closes \(2.22\%\) of the gap to the changed-cost reference. The analytical solution therefore provides both a benchmark for diagnosing RL and a useful starting policy for adaptation.
papers.comment: 8 pages; accepted for publication at ICAIF 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在解析求解的连续时间 broker–trader 博弈中，PPO 即使拿到由解析 payoff 推导并经网格加密与精确单步恒等式验证的正确 reward，仍学不好交易速度控制：有随机非知情订单流时 PPO–FFNN 与 PPO–LSTM 误差大、critic 无法可靠排序邻近动作，而基于解析解的因果确定性等价控制器贴近参考动作。把解析策略冻结后让 PPO 只学执行成本变化的修正，成本减半时可重复地补上距新参考 2.22% 的差距。
Motivation: 金融最优控制里有大量已解析求解的模型，其方程与控制本可评估和引导学习，但 RL 能否利用这些结果尚不清楚；同时需要判断 reward 正确是否足以让 PPO 学到接近解析参考的策略。
Method: 把 PPO 智能体放进解析求解的连续时间 broker–trader 博弈，由其替代 broker 选择交易速度，与知情交易者和随机非知情订单流交互；从 broker 连续时间 payoff 推导有限步 reward，并用网格加密与精确单步恒等式验证离散实现；网络为 PPO–FFNN 与 PPO–LSTM，另设监督学习检验 actor 表达能力、Monte Carlo 诊断 critic 排序、potential-based reward shaping 对照，以及基于 broker 可观测历史的因果 certainty-equivalent 控制器。
Result: 零非知情流时，验证集选型的 PPO–FFNN 逼近参考动作；有随机非知情流时 PPO–FFNN 与 PPO–LSTM 仍不准确，尽管监督学习确认其 actor 能表示该动作，Monte Carlo 诊断显示 critic 不能可靠排序邻近动作，potential-based reward shaping 也无可靠改进；部分信息下因果 certainty-equivalent 控制器贴近参考，而 PPO 误差更大、payoff 更低；冻结解析策略后训练 PPO 适应执行成本变化，成本减半带来可重复改进，补上距变化后成本参考 2.22% 的差距。
Conclusion: 解析解既可作为诊断 RL 的基准，也可作为适应新条件的起始策略：reward 正确本身不足以让 PPO 学好该控制问题，而解析策略加小幅修正能有效适应成本变化。

papers.title: A Path Integral Surrogate for Multi-Step Gradient Inversion in Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning lets many clients train a shared model together without ever sending their private data to a central server. Each client shares only a model update, and this update should reveal far less about the client than its raw training examples would. This premise is what protects the privacy of the clients. Gradient inversion attacks challenge it directly by trying to reconstruct a client's private input images from the single update it shared. Under FedAvg, a client's update accumulates several local training steps, so the server sees only the two endpoints of a hidden weight trajectory. Recent gradient inversion attacks fit a surrogate model along the path between these two endpoints but they still read its gradient at a single point. We propose the Path-Integral Surrogate Model Extension (PI-SME) which treats the accumulated update as a path integral of the gradient field and approximates it by Gauss--Legendre quadrature over several nodes along a learnable Bézier path. On CIFAR-100 and FEMNIST images across a range of trajectory lengths and class-restricted batches PI-SME reconstructs the private inputs more faithfully than the strongest surrogate baseline on several inversion metrics and the matching loss.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PI-SME 把 FedAvg 下客户端累积更新视为梯度场的路径积分，用可学习 Bézier 路径上的 Gauss–Legendre 求积在多个节点取梯度，而非只在端点单点求值。在 CIFAR-100 与 FEMNIST 图像、多种轨迹长度和类别受限批次上，其私有输入重建在多个反演指标与 matching loss 上比最强 surrogate 基线更忠实。
Motivation: FedAvg 下服务器只看到隐藏权重轨迹的两个端点，现有 surrogate 类梯度反演攻击仍只在单点读取梯度，无法忠实刻画多步累积更新所泄露的信息，从而低估隐私风险。
Method: 提出 Path-Integral Surrogate Model Extension (PI-SME)：把累积更新建模为梯度场的路径积分，沿可学习 Bézier 路径用 Gauss–Legendre 求积在多个节点近似，并在这些节点上读取 surrogate 模型梯度以重建客户端私有输入图像。
Result: 在 CIFAR-100 与 FEMNIST 图像上，跨多种轨迹长度 (trajectory lengths) 与 class-restricted batches 设置，PI-SME 在多个梯度反演指标和 matching loss 上均比最强 surrogate 基线更忠实重建私有输入。
Conclusion: 多步梯度反演应把累积更新当作路径积分而非单点梯度来建模，沿轨迹多节点取值即可在相同攻击预算下恢复更忠实的私有输入。

papers.title: HazardWeaver: Scientific Route Selection for Hazard Analysis Agents
papers.abstract_en: Understanding and assessing natural hazards is essential for disaster preparedness and risk reduction. Recent advances in large language models have spurred growing interest in AI agents for hazard analysis, particularly their ability to integrate scientific data, models, and tools into automated workflows. However, effective automation requires agents to determine which scientific methods are appropriate for a given event and executable with the available data and tools. As new evidence and execution results become available, these conditions can change, requiring agents to reconsider their choices. We formulate this problem as state-dependent scientific route selection and introduce HazardWeaver. Specifically, HazardWeaver first leverages the Hazard Knowledge Compiler to extract evidence-linked conditions governing scientific applicability, then its Hazard Capability Graph represents executable scientific capabilities and checks compatibility between their inputs and outputs. Using these complementary representations, the Hazard Weaver Agent component selects applicable and executable routes, carries out their workflows, and revises its decisions as the analysis state changes. To evaluate both the scientific outputs and the decisions that produce them, we introduce the Hazard Weaver Benchmark, comprising 141 instances across seven single-hazard domains and four multi-hazard interaction classes. The benchmark accommodates multiple valid scientific routes and evaluates output correctness, route validity, and justified abstention. Extensive experiments on this benchmark show that HazardWeaver outperforms existing agent systems, with the largest gains on tasks with multiple eligible scientific routes. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/LabRAI/HazardWeaver.
papers.comment: 24 pages, including references and appendices. Code is available at https://github.com/LabRAI/HazardWeaver
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HazardWeaver 把灾害分析中的科学方法选择形式化为随分析状态变化的路线选择问题：Hazard Knowledge Compiler 抽取带证据的适用条件，Hazard Capability Graph 校验能力间输入输出兼容性，Agent 据此挑选可执行路线并在新证据到来时修订决策。在含 141 个实例、覆盖七个单一灾害域与四类多灾害交互的 HazardWeaver Benchmark 上，其表现超过现有 agent 系统，且在存在多条合格科学路线的任务上提升最大。
Motivation: LLM 灾害分析 agent 需要判断哪种科学方法适用于当前事件、且在现有数据与工具下可执行；随着新证据与执行结果出现，这些条件会变化，agent 必须重新考虑选择，而现有系统缺少对这一决策过程本身的评估。
Method: Hazard Knowledge Compiler 抽取约束科学适用性的证据关联条件；Hazard Capability Graph 表示可执行的科学能力并检查其输入输出兼容性；HazardWeaver Agent 结合两者挑选适用且可执行的路线、执行工作流并随分析状态变化修订决策。配套提出 HazardWeaver Benchmark，允许多条有效科学路线，评估输出正确性、路线有效性与合理弃答 (justified abstention)。
Result: HazardWeaver Benchmark 含 141 个实例，覆盖七个单一灾害域与四类多灾害交互；实验显示 HazardWeaver 优于现有 agent 系统，在存在多条合格科学路线的任务上提升最大。
Conclusion: 把科学方法的适用条件与能力兼容性显式建模并随状态更新，能改善灾害分析 agent 的路线选择决策，且多路线场景收益最明显。

papers.title: Threat-Preserving Representation Sensitivity in Agent-Security Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: Security benchmarks for LLM-based agents often report the attack success rate (ASR) as a measure of model robustness and use these scores to compare different models and defense mechanisms, assuming that they describe the security of the agent. In this paper, we explore whether it also influences the benchmark's measurement. To measure the effect of the benchmark representation, we introduce threat-preserving representation sensitivity (TPRS), which measures how much the ASR changes when we change the agent-visible representation while holding the underlying task, harmful action, security policy, ground truth, environment, and the evaluation criteria fixed. On Agent Security Bench (ASB), replacing threat-related tool names with threat-neutral names raises the committed attack success rate by 11.67 percentage points on GPT-5-mini and by 13.21 points on Claude Haiku 4.5. On MCPTox, replacing the original neutral tool name with an explicit threat-related name lowers the ASR by 11.00 percentage points on GPT-5-mini and 4.11 points on Claude Haiku 4.5. On AgentDojo, adding threat-related wording to the attack-relevant tool changes ASR by only 0.50 percentage points on GPT-4o-mini, yet the benign utility falls by 5.36 points on tasks requiring that tool. We ran an experiment on MCPTox where we observed that a threat-neutral name matched on token count, length, and casing reproduces most of the shift produced by the threat-explicit name (8.54 of 11.00 points on GPT-5-mini). The results show that a security score measured under one representation may fail to generalize across threat-preserving representations of the same security problem. Robustness claims should therefore be supported by performance across a controlled set of threat-preserving representations rather than relying on a single representation-dependent score.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出威胁保持表示敏感性 (TPRS)：在任务、有害动作、安全策略、真值、环境与评测标准全部固定时，只改 agent 可见的工具名表示，看攻击成功率 (ASR) 变多少。在 ASB 上把威胁性工具名换成中性名，GPT-5-mini 的 committed ASR 升 11.67 个百分点、Claude Haiku 4.5 升 13.21 点；作者据此主张鲁棒性结论必须跨一组受控的威胁保持表示报告，而非依赖单一表示下的分数。
Motivation: LLM agent 安全基准用 ASR 比较模型与防御，隐含假设该分数描述 agent 本身的鲁棒性；但分数可能随 agent 可见的表示方式漂移，使跨模型、跨防御的比较失真。
Method: 定义 TPRS 指标，固定任务、有害动作、安全策略、ground truth、环境与评测标准，只替换攻击相关工具的命名与措辞；在 Agent Security Bench (ASB)、MCPTox、AgentDojo 三个基准上做替换实验，并在 MCPTox 上加一组按 token 数、长度、大小写匹配的中性名对照，以分离威胁语义与表面形式的影响。

papers.title: Rethinking What to Cache in Few-Step Diffusion Transformers: Solver-Aware Target Selection
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) can generate high-quality images and videos, but generating each sample requires multiple costly DiT forward passes. Two common ways to accelerate DiT sampling are step distillation, which reduces the number of sampling steps, and caching, which skips some DiT evaluations by reusing a tensor computed at an earlier step. Most caching methods decide in advance which tensor to reuse. After distillation, adjacent sampling steps are farther apart. Reusing a tensor across this larger gap introduces more error, so choosing what to cache becomes especially important. We therefore introduce AutoTarget, a method that chooses the cached tensor for a given model, solver, and reuse schedule. AutoTarget uses a small set of runs without cache reuse to measure the error caused by reusing each candidate tensor, then selects the candidate with the lowest error. We also analyze how an error at one reuse step affects the final sample. For Euler sampling, we identify cache targets that produce the same trajectory and show why a stored solver update may not. Experiments on distilled image and video DiTs show that the best cache target changes with the model, image resolution, and solver. AutoTarget reduces DiT evaluations and retained cache storage. Generation quality remains close to the corresponding uncached run. On the tested PixArt-LCM and FLUX.1-schnell settings, its calibration ranking matches the ranking from held-out cached runs. To help others reproduce the method, we provide its core implementation on GitHub at https://github.com/wali1024-offical/AutoTarget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AutoTarget 用少量不复用缓存的试跑，逐个测量复用候选张量带来的误差并选误差最小者，为蒸馏后的 Diffusion Transformer 挑选缓存目标。在 PixArt-LCM 与 FLUX.1-schnell 上，其校准排序与留出缓存跑的排序一致，且最优缓存目标随模型、分辨率和 solver 改变。
Motivation: 步数蒸馏后相邻采样步距离变大，跨更大间隔复用张量引入更多误差，而多数缓存方法预先固定复用哪个张量，缺少按模型与 solver 选择的依据。
Method: AutoTarget 对给定模型、solver 和复用调度，先做少量不复用缓存的运行，测量复用每个候选张量的误差，再选误差最低的候选；同时分析单个复用步误差如何影响最终样本，并对 Euler 采样给出产生相同轨迹的缓存目标，说明存储的 solver 更新为何可能不行。
Result: 实验覆盖蒸馏后的图像与视频 DiT：最优缓存目标随模型、图像分辨率和 solver 变化；AutoTarget 减少 DiT 前向评估次数与保留的缓存存储，生成质量接近不缓存运行；在 PixArt-LCM 与 FLUX.1-schnell 的测试设置上，其校准排序与留出缓存运行的排序一致。
Conclusion: 缓存目标应按模型、solver 与复用调度实测误差来选，而非预先固定；核心实现已在 GitHub 公开以便复现。

papers.title: HyperBrowseComp: A Multilingual and Multimodal Stress Test for Web-Browsing Agents
papers.abstract_en: We introduce HyperBrowseComp, a multilingual and multimodal browsing benchmark comprising 423 manually authored and human-validated questions across 13 languages, written by native or highly proficient speakers. Questions are designed to be extremely challenging. Each question targets a concise, publicly verifiable answer whose discovery requires locating obscure evidence, following multi-step clue chains, or inspecting heterogeneous sources such as videos, scanned documents, images, or maps. Easier questions are filtered out by evaluating them with models without internet access to reduce the likelihood that they can be answered with parametric knowledge alone. We evaluate several models using provider-native search and a shared external retrieval harness under a common agent protocol. To contextualize model performance and effort, we also conduct a human evaluation on a sample of the questions. HyperBrowseComp provides a challenging testbed for persistent information seeking across languages and evidence modalities, with difficulty arising from discovering and connecting evidence on the open web.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HyperBrowseComp 是一个多语言多模态网页浏览 agent 压力测试基准，含 423 道人工撰写并经母语者校验的题目，覆盖 13 种语言，答案公开可验证但需定位冷僻证据、追多步线索链或查阅视频、扫描件、图片、地图等异质来源。用无网络模型先筛掉可凭参数化知识答对的简单题，再在统一 agent 协议下用 provider-native search 与共享外部检索 harness 评测多个模型，并配一份人类表现对照。
Motivation: 现有浏览 agent 评测在多语言与多证据模态上的难度不足，题目常可凭模型参数化知识直接答出，无法检验跨语言、跨模态的持续信息检索能力。
Method: 由母语或高水平使用者人工撰写 423 道题，每题对应一个公开可验证的简短答案；先用无互联网接入的模型作答以过滤掉仅靠参数化知识即可完成的简单题；评测时在统一 agent 协议下比较 provider-native search 与共享外部检索 harness 两种配置，并对抽样题目做人类评测作为参照。
Result: 基准规模为 423 道题、13 种语言，全部人工撰写并经人工校验；评测覆盖多个模型的两种检索配置（provider-native search 与共享外部检索 harness），并含一份抽样人类评测；摘要未给出具体分数。
Conclusion: 跨语言、跨证据模态的开放网页证据发现与连接本身构成足够难度，可作为持久信息寻求 (persistent information seeking) 的高难测试床。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Learning to Assess Heartbeat Observability for mmWave Heart-Rate Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Contactless heart-rate sensing with millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar requires assessing whether individual measurements support reliable estimation. We study learning to assess heartbeat observability, defined as the readability of the heartbeat component in an acquired phase spectrum, for selective heart-rate estimation. Coherent superposition of scatterer returns can suppress this component even under similar macroscopic observation geometry, motivating assessment directly from acquired measurements. To obtain training supervision across different observability conditions, we develop a controllable multi-scatterer frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) simulator. Agreement between the dominant heartbeat-band peak and the known heart rate provides an automatic observability label for each simulated measurement. We propose HEAR (Heartbeat Estimation with Assessed Reliability), a compact dual-task Transformer that jointly predicts an observability score and heart rate. Its input combines spectral magnitudes with frequencies relative to the respiration fundamental, providing context for respiratory harmonics. Trained solely on simulated observations, HEAR transfers zero-shot to two public real-world datasets collected at 60 and 120 GHz from 134 subjects. The same learned score supports selective prediction with both HEAR's own heart-rate head and multiple existing estimators. On the 120 GHz dataset, score-based selection reduces the HR head's mean absolute error from 17.9 BPM at full coverage to 1.6 BPM at 50% coverage. The complete pipeline achieves an end-to-end processing latency of 50.8 ms on an edge device. Project page: https://yuxuanhu9.github.io/HEAR/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 HEAR：紧凑双任务 Transformer 同时输出心跳可观测性分数与心率，用可控多散射体 FMCW 仿真器自动生成监督标签，仅在仿真数据上训练后零样本迁移到真实雷达。在 120 GHz 真实数据集上按分数做选择性预测，心率头 MAE 从全覆盖 17.9 BPM 降到 50% 覆盖的 1.6 BPM，边缘设备端到端延迟 50.8 ms。
Motivation: 毫米波雷达接触式心率估计中，散射体回波的相干叠加会在相似宏观观测几何下压制心跳分量，导致单次测量是否可读无法从几何判断，需要直接从采集到的相位谱评估可观测性以支持选择性估计。
Method: 先构建可控多散射体 FMCW 仿真器，用主心跳频带峰值与已知心率的一致性自动生成可观测性标签；再训练紧凑双任务 Transformer HEAR，联合预测可观测性分数与心率，输入为频谱幅度加上相对呼吸基频的频率以提供呼吸谐波上下文，且仅用仿真观测训练。
Result: 在 60 与 120 GHz、134 名受试者的两个公开真实数据集上零样本迁移；同一分数可同时服务于 HEAR 自己的心率头与多个已有估计器；120 GHz 数据集上基于分数的选择使心率头 MAE 从全覆盖 17.9 BPM 降至 50% 覆盖的 1.6 BPM；完整流程在边缘设备上端到端处理延迟 50.8 ms。
Conclusion: 心跳可观测性可以直接从采集测量中学习并跨仿真到真实零样本迁移，用它做选择性预测能在保留一半覆盖的同时把心率误差压到接近可用水平。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Knowledge or Calculator? Decomposing the Skill Premium in Verifiable Financial Agent Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Financial AI agents must do more than retrieve facts: investment workflows require correct quantitative execution, reliable use of procedural resources, and auditable structured outputs. We introduce FinSkillBench, an evaluation suite of 2,603 point in time episodes across 12 subtasks in portfolio construction, risk management, and fundamental analysis, with hidden regenerable ground truth and task specific deterministic verifiers. Executing 17,820 episodes across 9 models and 3 resource conditions, the paired analysis across 8 models shows that curated skill packages raise mean scores by +16.2 points (0.366 to 0.528), whereas skills generated within a single episode add only +0.5 points while consuming more tokens and turns. We then decompose the curated premium by granting human authored procedural documents and executable domain tools separately: documents alone add +5.6 points, tools alone add +19.5 points, and their combination is subadditive. The premium is strongly workflow dependent: executable tools dominate numerically intensive workflows, documentation matters more when procedural or output schema guidance is the bottleneck, and interpretive tasks benefit from both. The effects are sign stable across 10 scoring variants and cluster bootstrap analyses, and an independently implemented second harness reproduces the directional pattern while showing that effect magnitudes depend on how tools and data are exposed. Overall, a measured "skill premium" is a property of the full model, resource, and harness system rather than of the underlying model alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FinSkillBench 用 2,603 个时点金融 agent episode、12 个子任务与确定性 verifier 拆解技能溢价：人工整理的 skill package 把均分从 0.366 抬到 0.528（+16.2 分），而 episode 内即时生成的 skills 只加 0.5 分还多耗 token。拆开看，工具单独 +19.5 分、文档单独 +5.6 分，两者叠加次可加；结论是技能溢价属于模型-资源-harness 整体系统而非模型本身。
Motivation: 金融投资 agent 不只需检索事实，还要正确执行量化计算、可靠调用流程性资源并产出可审计结构化输出，但模型能力与外部资源、执行框架各自的贡献未被分离度量。
Method: 提出评测套件 FinSkillBench：2,603 个时点 episode、12 个子任务（组合构建、风险管理、基本面分析），带隐藏可再生真值与任务特定确定性 verifier；在 9 个模型、3 种资源条件下执行 17,820 个 episode，用配对分析（8 个模型）分别授予人工撰写的流程文档与可执行领域工具，并做 10 种打分变体、cluster bootstrap 与独立实现的第二 harness 复现。
Result: curated skill package 使均分 +16.2 分（0.366→0.528），episode 内生成 skills 仅 +0.5 分且消耗更多 token 与轮次；文档单独 +5.6 分、工具单独 +19.5 分，组合次可加。效应在 10 种打分变体与 cluster bootstrap 下符号稳定，第二 harness 复现方向性模式但幅度取决于工具与数据的暴露方式。
Conclusion: 可测的技能溢价是模型、资源与 harness 整体系统的属性，而非底层模型单独的属性；数值密集型工作流由可执行工具主导，流程或输出 schema 指导受限时文档更重要，解释性任务两者皆受益。

papers.title: Cephalonauts One: A deep fMRI dataset for decoding naturalistic speech in the human brain
papers.abstract_en: Cephalonauts One is a whole-brain 3 Tesla (3T) functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) dataset recorded while subjects listened to audio podcasts. Three healthy subjects underwent multiple scanning sessions, each consisting of five 15-minute runs, while listening to podcasts in their native language. With 30 hours of fMRI data per subject, the current release is the deepest available fMRI dataset using naturalistic speech stimuli. The dataset pairs brain activity with the corresponding podcast audio, transcript annotations, and derived stimulus embeddings. Furthermore, we introduce a brain decoding benchmark formulated as audio segment retrieval: given fMRI activity from a held-out session, the decoder must identify the corresponding time-aligned podcast audio segment among candidate segments. We provide standardized splits, evaluation metrics, and baseline decoders for this task. Finally, a scaling analysis shows that decoding performance improves continuously with the amount of training data per subject.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations & Datasets Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Cephalonauts One 是一个 3T 全脑 fMRI 数据集，被试听母语播客，每人 30 小时数据，是目前用自然语音刺激最深的 fMRI 数据集。配套提出音频片段检索式脑解码基准：给定留出 session 的 fMRI 活动，在候选片段中找出时间对齐的播客音频段，并给出标准化划分、指标与基线解码器。缩放分析显示解码性能随每人训练数据量持续提升。
Motivation: 自然语音刺激下的 fMRI 数据集普遍偏浅，难以支撑随数据量增长的脑解码缩放研究，也缺少统一的解码评测任务与划分。
Method: 三名健康被试各多次扫描，每次 5 个 15 分钟 run，配对脑活动与播客音频、转写标注及衍生刺激嵌入；提出 audio segment retrieval 解码任务，用留出 session 的 fMRI 在候选片段中检索时间对齐音频段，提供标准化划分、评测指标与基线解码器，并做每人训练数据量的缩放分析。
Result: 每人 30 小时 fMRI 数据，为当前最深的自然语音刺激 fMRI 数据集；缩放分析显示解码性能随每人训练数据量持续改善。
Conclusion: 自然语音脑解码的性能受每人训练数据量连续驱动，深数据集加统一检索基准可作为该方向的评测标准。

papers.title: Get a GRIP, this will be a long TRIP: A Quantifiable Long-Range Framework for Verifying Over-squashing
papers.abstract_en: Empirical claims about the connection between over-squashing and long-range interactions in GNNs, can only be trusted if the benchmarks used to validate them genuinely require long-range interactions. The de-facto standard, the Long Range Graph Benchmark, has been repeatedly shown to be saturated by tuned short-range models, with existing synthetic alternatives being tied to specific topologies. As such, there is a lack of principled certificate of long-rangedness on arbitrary graphs. This state reflects the absence of a precise characterization of long-ranged benchmarks. We address this fundamental gap by introducing four verifiable axioms: Predictability, Tightness, Strictly $k$-Range, and Topology-Invariance, that any task claiming to test $k$-hop interactions must satisfy. We formally prove that violating any one of them admits failure modes that undermine conclusions drawn from the task. Based on these axioms, we introduce TRIP (Truly Ranged Interactions Problem) and its generalisation GRIP (Generally Ranged Interactions Problem), constructive procedures that turn any graph into a provably long-ranged task by drawing features from stable distributions. Moreover, by construction, GRIP admits a closed-form, per-range Maximum-Likelihood oracle that yields the first a priori per-range lower bound on test error available on any benchmark. Using our framework, we: (i) audit 4 common long-range benchmarks and identify their failures modes with respect to our axioms; (ii) on TRIP-instantiated topologies, we find a popular notion of curvature is uncorrelated with GNN performance, supporting topological-vs-computational bottleneck distinction; and (iii) we show that a novel benchmark's over-squashing measures factors beyond pure long-rangedness. Code to use the framework and reproduce experiments is released https://github.com/ferranhernandezc/graph-grip.
papers.comment: Published at the Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Track on Evaluations and Datasets
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出四条可验证公理（Predictability、Tightness、Strictly k-Range、Topology-Invariance）作为图任务是否真正测试 k 跳长程交互的证书，并给出构造式框架 TRIP/GRIP：从稳定分布取特征，把任意图变成可证明长程的任务，且 GRIP 自带闭式逐范围最大似然 oracle，给出任何 benchmark 上测试误差的先验逐范围下界。审计 4 个常用长程 benchmark 后发现曲率与 GNN 性能不相关，且新 benchmark 的 over-squashing 度量混入了纯长程性之外的因素。
Motivation: 关于 GNN over-squashing 与长程交互的实证结论依赖 benchmark 真的需要长程交互，但 Long Range Graph Benchmark 已被调优的短程模型打饱，合成替代品又绑定特定拓扑，任意图上缺少有原则的长程性证书。
Method: 先形式化四条公理并证明违反任一条都会引入破坏任务结论的失败模式；再给出 TRIP 与其推广 GRIP 的构造流程，从稳定分布抽取特征把任意图转成长程任务；GRIP 推导闭式逐范围最大似然 oracle 作为测试误差下界；最后用该框架审计 4 个常用长程 benchmark 并在 TRIP 实例化拓扑上做实验，代码已开源。
Result: 审计 4 个常用长程 benchmark 并识别其相对四公理的失败模式；在 TRIP 实例化拓扑上发现一种流行的曲率概念与 GNN 性能不相关，支持拓扑瓶颈与计算瓶颈的区分；并展示一个新 benchmark 的 over-squashing 度量分解出纯长程性之外的因素。
Conclusion: 长程 benchmark 需要可证明的长程性证书而非经验假设：违反四公理中任一条都会让基于该任务的 over-squashing 结论失效，而 GRIP 的逐范围 MLE 下界提供了首个可先验计算的误差基准。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Objects Without Morphisms: What LLMs for Mathematics Do Not Represent
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have reached expert-level performance on competition mathematics largely through the volume of search placed around them: candidate solutions are sampled in quantity and retained only when an external criterion accepts them. Such a procedure improves the outcome that survives it while leaving untouched what the model represents. We examine that question where no external criterion exists: translating statements between the dialects of neighbouring subfields, where fidelity turns on the level of generality at which content is asserted. The source leaves that level implicit in its vocabulary, so a faithful translation must recover it from the relation between the theories. We introduce an instrument that codes truth, content and scope in separate blind queues, with a judge-free measure of whether a rewrite states the hypothesis implicit in its source, and establish its sensitivity with a planted-positive control. Across seven models from four families, translating towards the general framing widens the domain of quantification in 60.6% of rewrites and narrows it in none; translating towards the concrete framing narrows it in 28.3% and widens it in 0.3%. The hypothesis that would prevent it is stated in 21.6% of model rewrites and 4.2% of human statements. Capability does not govern the asymmetry: it appears in every model tested, and the most capable widens least. It replicates on the half of the benchmark held out by a pre-registered rule, and on statements written by mathematicians. Instructing a model to state every hypothesis it requires raises that rate but not its sensitivity to direction. We argue that these systems have acquired an object-level correspondence between subfield vocabularies without the constraint under which a translation between theories carries hypotheses to hypotheses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出一种把真值、内容、作用域分盲队编码的评测工具，检验 LLM 在相邻数学子领域间翻译陈述时能否恢复源陈述隐含的量化范围。七个模型、四个家族中，向更一般框架翻译时 60.6% 的改写扩大了量化域、无一收窄；向具体框架翻译时 28.3% 收窄、仅 0.3% 扩大，且能力越强扩大越少。
Motivation: 竞赛数学的高分主要来自外部判据筛选大量采样，而非模型表征本身；在没有外部判据的理论间翻译任务上，模型是否携带隐含假设这一问题尚无检验手段。
Method: 设计一种将真值、内容、作用域分开盲评的仪器，给出不依赖 judge 的“改写是否陈述了源隐含假设”度量，并用 planted-positive control 校验灵敏度；在预注册规则留出的一半基准上复现，并加入数学家所写陈述。
Result: 七个模型、四个家族：向一般框架翻译时 60.6% 扩大量化域、0% 收窄；向具体框架翻译时 28.3% 收窄、0.3% 扩大。阻止该偏移的假设仅在 21.6% 的模型改写和 4.2% 的人类陈述中被陈述。能力不决定该不对称，出现在所有受测模型中，最强模型扩大最少；结果在留出半集与数学家陈述上复现。要求模型列出全部所需假设会提高该比率，但不改变其方向敏感性。
Conclusion: LLM 已获得子领域词汇间的对象层对应，却缺少使理论间翻译把假设带到假设的约束；提示补假设只能提高陈述率，不能修复方向敏感性。

papers.title: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement for Frontier Reasoning Data Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Generating progressively harder reasoning problems requires synthesis procedures that adapt as the task distribution evolves. Existing task-level recursion reuses generated problems as seeds but leaves the construction harness unchanged. We present task-harness co-evolution, a framework for recursive harness self-improvement (RSI) in reasoning-data synthesis. Online self-improvement converts intermediate solver failures into reusable skills during generation. Post-task self-improvement revises skills, prompts, and workflows after each batch, adopting candidates only when they generate harder valid tasks within a bounded cost increase. Model weights and verification criteria remain fixed. Across mathematics, coding, and science, mean solver accuracy decreases from 100.0% to 54.8% over fourteen evolution rounds. Ablations show that combining both update schedules produces harder tasks than fixed-harness recursion or either schedule alone. The resulting data improves downstream SFT and GRPO performance. In particular, a 27B student fine-tuned on 10K synthesized mathematics examples achieves 62.5% mean-16 accuracy on APEX, competitive with selected frontier-model references. These results support adapting the synthesis harness alongside the tasks to generate increasingly challenging data with downstream training value.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出任务-框架协同演化 (task-harness co-evolution)：在推理数据合成中让构造 harness 随任务一起递归自改进，模型权重与验证标准保持固定。经十四轮演化，数学、代码、科学三域的求解器平均准确率从 100.0% 降至 54.8%，且合成数据能提升下游 SFT 与 GRPO。
Motivation: 现有任务级递归复用已生成题目作种子，但构造 harness 本身不变，难以随任务分布演化持续生成更难的推理题。
Method: 框架含两套更新调度：Online self-improvement 在生成过程中把求解器中间失败转成可复用 skill；Post-task self-improvement 在每批之后修订 skill、prompt 与 workflow，仅当候选能在成本有界增长下产出更难且有效的任务时才采纳。模型权重与验证标准固定。
Result: 跨数学、代码、科学，求解器平均准确率在十四轮演化中由 100.0% 降至 54.8%；消融显示两套调度组合比固定 harness 递归或任一单独调度产出更难的任务。下游训练中，27B 学生模型用 10K 合成数学样本微调后在 APEX 上 mean-16 准确率达 62.5%，与部分前沿模型参考相当。
Conclusion: 构造 harness 应与任务一起自改进，才能持续生成更具挑战性且有下游训练价值的数据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ZeroMAG: Zero-Shot Multimodal Adapter Generation for Plug-and-Play EEG Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: EEG foundation models (EFMs) capture reusable knowledge from large-scale EEG data, while many EEG recordings also include companion physiological signals that provide complementary information beyond the EEG-only interface. The challenge is to preserve this pretrained knowledge while extending the EFM to heterogeneous multimodal recordings through an adaptation inferred from unlabeled target data. We introduce ZeroMAG, a zero-shot multimodal adapter generation framework that extends a frozen EEG encoder and prediction head using unlabeled target recordings, without target labels or target-side optimization. The target datasets are held out from all model training and selection in the ZeroMAG pipeline. ZeroMAG organizes companion modalities around a configuration-invariant adapter, constructs a modality-subject-task condition from unlabeled recordings and task context, and generates adapter weights in a function-constrained latent space learned from source adapters. Across six held-out target datasets and three EFM backbones, ZeroMAG improves balanced accuracy by 7.22 percentage points over EEG-only inference and 4.89 points over direct weight regression, while coming within 0.50 points of supervised multimodal adaptation on average. Ablations further show that removing functional supervision from either representation learning or conditional generation degrades generated-adapter performance, confirming the contribution of both components.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ZeroMAG 在不使用目标标签、也不做目标侧优化的前提下，为冻结的 EEG foundation model 生成多模态 adapter：用无标签目标记录构造 modality-subject-task 条件，在由源 adapter 学到的函数约束潜空间中直接生成 adapter 权重。在 6 个 held-out 目标数据集与 3 个 EFM backbone 上，平衡准确率比 EEG-only 推理高 7.22 个百分点、比直接权重回归高 4.89 个百分点，平均只比有监督多模态适配低 0.50 个百分点。
Motivation: EEG foundation model 只暴露 EEG-only 接口，而许多记录还带有互补的伴随生理信号；要在保留预训练知识的同时接入异构多模态，通常需要目标标签或目标侧优化，这在无标签目标数据场景下不可行。
Method: ZeroMAG 冻结 EEG encoder 与 prediction head，围绕 configuration-invariant adapter 组织伴随模态；从无标签目标记录与任务上下文构造 modality-subject-task 条件，在由源 adapter 学到的函数约束潜空间 (function-constrained latent space) 中生成 adapter 权重，目标数据集全程不参与训练与模型选择；消融分别去掉表示学习与条件生成中的 functional supervision。
Result: 在 6 个 held-out 目标数据集、3 个 EFM backbone 上，平衡准确率较 EEG-only 推理提升 7.22 个百分点，较直接权重回归提升 4.89 个百分点，平均与有监督多模态适配相差 0.50 个百分点；消融显示去掉表示学习或条件生成任一侧的 functional supervision 都会降低生成 adapter 的性能。
Conclusion: 无标签目标数据加函数约束的潜空间足以生成可用的多模态 adapter，把零样本适配推到接近有监督多模态适配的水平，且 functional supervision 两个组件缺一不可。

papers.title: DuoMatching: Joint-Marginal Distribution Matching for Few-Step Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Streaming video generation has benefited from distribution matching distillation (DMD), which matches the joint distribution of video frames to a video teacher's approximation of the real video distribution. Although this joint matching mitigates drift during autoregressive rollouts, limitations remain in visual quality and semantic alignment. To address these limitations, we propose DuoMatching, a distribution matching framework that approximates the real video distribution through a unified joint-marginal formulation. On top of existing joint matching formulations, the additional marginal matching objective provides dedicated frame-level supervision from an image generator, transferring complementary visual and semantic priors from it. To apply this frame-level supervision in video generation, we introduce LatentBridge to resolve the latent representation mismatch between the video student and the image teacher. Latent Variation Sampling further distributes such frame-level supervision across distinct temporal segments, reducing redundancy. Experiments demonstrate that DuoMatching improves visual quality, composition, and semantic alignment while largely preserving motion dynamics. Human evaluations show overall preference rates above 80% against all evaluated baselines. The project page is available at https://johnzhan2023.github.io/DuoMatching/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DuoMatching 在流式视频生成的分布匹配蒸馏 (DMD) 上叠加逐帧边缘分布匹配：在既有联合匹配之外，用图像生成器提供帧级监督，并通过 LatentBridge 打通视频学生与图像教师的隐空间表示差异，再用 Latent Variation Sampling 把该监督分散到不同时间段以降低冗余。人工评测中对全部被评估基线的整体偏好率超过 80%，同时基本保持原有运动动态。
Motivation: 流式视频生成依赖 DMD 匹配视频帧的联合分布以抑制自回归 rollout 中的漂移，但视觉质量与语义对齐仍受限，缺少来自图像生成器的帧级先验。
Method: 在既有 joint matching 之上加入 marginal matching 目标，从图像生成器迁移互补的视觉与语义先验；引入 LatentBridge 解决视频学生与图像教师之间的隐表示不匹配，使帧级监督可用于视频生成；Latent Variation Sampling 将帧级监督分布到不同时间段以减少冗余。
Result: 实验显示 DuoMatching 提升视觉质量、构图与语义对齐，同时基本保持运动动态；人工评测中对全部被评估基线的整体偏好率高于 80%。
Conclusion: 联合-边缘联合匹配 (joint-marginal) 框架能借助图像教师的帧级先验改善流式视频生成的质量与语义对齐，且不牺牲运动动态。

papers.title: Autonomous Robotic Navigation for Endovascular Brain-Computer Interface Access
papers.abstract_en: Endovascular brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) avoid craniotomy but require precise device delivery through anatomically variable cerebral veins. This work presents the first demonstration of in vitro autonomous robotic navigation for endovascular BCI access in the cerebral venous system. Soft Actor-Critic controllers were trained in silico for two sequential tasks spanning the right internal jugular vein to the superior sagittal sinus, using geometric augmentation of one training anatomy. Navigation was evaluated in a training anatomy and an anatomically unseen hold-out model over 250 in silico episodes and five fluoroscopy-guided in vitro robotic runs per task-anatomy condition, comprising 1,000 simulated episodes and 20 physical runs overall. Task recurrent predictors were also evaluated for online identification of impending navigation failure. In silico success rates for Tasks A and B were 85.6% and 98.4% in the training anatomy and 42.0% and 91.6% in the hold-out anatomy, respectively. Fourteen of 20 physical runs were successful (70% overall), including 80% success for Task B in the hold-out phantom. In silico the predictors detected 99.3-100.0% of failures with false-alarm rates of 0.8-6.7%. During in vitro evaluation, predicted risk increased before failed episodes, but elevated probabilities during some successful runs showed reduced calibration after transfer. These results demonstrate the feasibility of autonomous cerebral venous access and show how online failure prediction could support human oversight, while also identifying anatomical generalization and sim-to-real calibration as priorities before preclinical translation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 首次在体外演示 endovascular BCI 脑静脉自主机器人导航：用 Soft Actor-Critic 在单一训练解剖的几何增广上训练两段顺序任务，仿真成功率在训练解剖为 85.6%/98.4%，在未见 hold-out 解剖降到 42.0%/91.6%；20 次实体 run 成功 14 次（70%）。在线失败预测器在仿真中检出 99.3–100.0% 的失败、误报 0.8–6.7%，但迁移到实体后校准变差，作者把解剖泛化与 sim-to-real 校准列为进入临床前的优先项。
Motivation: endovascular BCI 免开颅，但器械要穿过解剖差异极大的脑静脉，人工推送耗时且依赖术者经验；现有导航缺乏在个体解剖差异与 sim-to-real 落差下仍可靠的自主控制与失败预警。
Method: 用 Soft Actor-Critic 在 silico 训练两段顺序任务（右颈内静脉到 superior sagittal sinus），训练数据只来自单一解剖的几何增广；每个 task-anatomy 条件做 250 个仿真 episode 与 5 次荧光透视引导的体外机器人 run。另训练 task recurrent predictor 在线识别即将发生的导航失败，并在训练解剖与未见 hold-out 模型上评测。
Result: 仿真成功率：Task A/B 在训练解剖 85.6%/98.4%，在 hold-out 解剖 42.0%/91.6%；共 1,000 个仿真 episode、20 次实体 run，实体成功 14/20（70%），其中 hold-out phantom 上 Task B 达 80%。仿真中失败预测器检出 99.3–100.0% 的失败，误报率 0.8–6.7%；体外失败前预测风险上升，但部分成功 run 也给出高概率，迁移后校准下降。
Conclusion: 自主脑静脉通路在体外可行，且在线失败预测可支撑人工监督；进入临床前必须先解决解剖泛化（Task A 在未见解剖从 85.6% 掉到 42.0%）与 sim-to-real 校准两个问题。

papers.title: Divergence controls entropy in distillation
papers.abstract_en: Distillation has become a core primitive of large language model training, but its properties are not yet well understood. We take an entropic perspective, studying how the entropy of the student depends on the data and the divergence that define the distillation objective. We prove that forward KL inflates the entropy of the student above that of the teacher. Since cross-entropy training is a special case, this yields an identity that we verify quantitatively in pretraining and supervised finetuning. Other divergences come with no such guarantee: reverse KL deflates entropy until the gap between student and teacher gets too large, and interpolating between the two changes entropy smoothly early in training but abruptly at convergence. The lower entropy of on-policy distillation comes from token-level reverse KL, not from on-policy sampling. The divergence therefore acts as an implicit entropy regularizer, whose role is clearest in self-distillation: as conditioning on privileged information deflates entropy, the divergence hyperparameters that work best are those that compensate for it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 从信息熵视角证明蒸馏目标中的散度充当隐式熵正则器：forward KL 使学生熵高于教师，reverse KL 则压低熵、直到师生差距过大失效，插值在训练早期平滑改变熵、收敛时突变。on-policy 蒸馏的低熵来自 token 级 reverse KL 而非 on-policy 采样；自蒸馏中条件化特权信息会压低熵，最优散度超参正是补偿这一效应的那些。
Motivation: 蒸馏是 LLM 训练的核心原语，但其性质尚不清楚：不同散度如何决定学生模型的熵、以及这与数据和超参的关系缺乏理论刻画。
Method: 以熵为分析视角，推导学生熵如何依赖于定义蒸馏目标的数据与散度；证明 forward KL 抬高学生熵高于教师，并把交叉熵训练作为特例得到一个恒等式，再在 pretraining 与 supervised finetuning 中定量验证；对比 reverse KL 与两者插值，并分析 on-policy 蒸馏与自蒸馏中的散度超参。
Result: 证明 forward KL 使学生熵高于教师，交叉熵训练作为特例给出恒等式，并在 pretraining 和 supervised finetuning 中定量验证；reverse KL 压低熵直到师生差距过大，插值在训练早期平滑、在收敛时突变地改变熵；on-policy 蒸馏的低熵被归因于 token 级 reverse KL 而非 on-policy 采样。
Conclusion: 散度是隐式熵正则器：自蒸馏中条件化特权信息会压低熵，应选择能补偿该效应的散度超参。

papers.title: Beyond Trained Models: Compiling GNNs for a Sound Explainer Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Explainers for Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are commonly evaluated by their plausibility, i.e., how well their explanations recover a predefined ground truth, such as a motif planted in the data. This protocol implicitly assumes that a GNN trained on such data relies on the intended motif. Although prior work has questioned this assumption, plausibility remains widespread. First, we show that the assumption is violated on several widely used benchmarks, where, e.g., degree statistics alone suffice to solve the task. Then, we remove this confounder by replacing training with compilation. We achieve this by introducing $\mathsf{Gracr}$, the first compiler translating graded modal logic formulas into GNN weights, yielding models that replicate the behaviour of the corresponding formulas. Since the behaviour of the model is now known by construction, we can define its ground truth explanation formally and compute it exactly. Building on this, we introduce $\mathsf{Gracr}\mathsf{Bench}$, a benchmark of compiled GNNs for the evaluation of explainers against this exact ground truth. Experiments on eleven explainers across six tasks show its effectiveness for fine-grained diagnostic evaluation: notably, we discover that most explainers are not robust to indirect influences or alternative implementations of the same formula. These results position $\mathsf{Gracr}\mathsf{Bench}$ as a novel, rigorous evaluation setting for graph post-hoc explainability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GNN 解释器评测普遍假设训练模型确实依赖预设 motif，作者证明多个常用基准上该假设被违反（如仅凭度数统计即可完成任务），因此改用编译替代训练：Gracr 把 graded modal logic 公式直接编译成 GNN 权重，使模型行为按构造已知，从而可精确定义并计算 ground truth 解释。基于此提出 GracrBench，在六个任务、十一个解释器上发现多数解释器对间接影响与同一公式的不同实现不鲁棒。
Motivation: plausibility 评测隐含假设训练出的 GNN 确实依赖预设 motif，但该假设在多个常用基准上不成立（度数统计等混淆因素即可解题），导致解释器评测结论不可靠。
Method: 提出 Gracr 编译器，将 graded modal logic 公式翻译为 GNN 权重，得到行为与公式等价的模型；据此形式化定义精确 ground truth 解释并构建 GracrBench 基准，对解释器做细粒度诊断评测。
Result: 在六个任务上评测十一个解释器，发现多数解释器对间接影响 (indirect influences) 以及同一公式的不同实现 (alternative implementations) 不鲁棒；并展示多个常用基准中度数统计 alone 即可解题。

papers.title: From Benchmarks to Production: A Text-to-SQL System for Complex Financial Data
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose Text-to-SQL systems achieve strong performance on academic benchmarks like Spider and BIRD, where schemas are relatively shallow and column values are often human readable. In production financial databases, where concepts are stored as opaque integer keys rather than human-readable strings, these methods fall below 50%, as even simple queries require multiple joins and filter predicates reference opaque IDs. We present Financial LINking Text-to-SQL (FLINT), a domain-specialized Text-to-SQL system that closes this gap through three key components: (1) a lookup agent that dynamically resolves natural-language concepts to question-specific reference table constraints, (2) embedding-based retrieval of structurally similar query templates from a compact, expert-authored bank, and (3) schema linking that prunes a large table schema to the relevant subset by traversing foreign-key chains, rather than relying on name similarity alone. We evaluate on two datasets totaling 359 questions over production financial schemas. FLINT outperforms various state-of-the-art baselines using the same LLM. The system is deployed in production as part of a financial data retrieval service.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FLINT 是面向生产级金融数据库的 Text-to-SQL 系统，用 lookup agent 解析自然语言概念、检索结构相似查询模板、并沿外键链做 schema linking 来剪枝大表。在两个共 359 题的生产金融 schema 数据集上，同一 LLM 下超过多个 SOTA 基线，而通用系统在该场景准确率低于 50%。
Motivation: Spider、BIRD 等学术基准 schema 浅、列值可读，而生产金融库用不透明整数键表示概念，简单查询也需多表 join 与 ID 过滤，通用 Text-to-SQL 准确率跌到 50% 以下。
Method: FLINT 三组件：lookup agent 动态把自然语言概念解析为该问题的参考表约束；从专家编写的小型模板库中做 embedding 检索结构相似查询模板；schema linking 沿 foreign-key 链遍历剪枝大 schema 到相关子集，而非只靠列名相似度。
Result: 在两个合计 359 题、基于生产金融 schema 的数据集上评测，FLINT 在使用相同 LLM 的条件下优于多个 SOTA 基线；通用方法在该场景低于 50% 准确率。
Conclusion: 生产金融 Text-to-SQL 的瓶颈在于不透明键与深层 schema，靠概念解析、模板检索与外键链 linking 可闭合与学术基准的差距；系统已作为金融数据检索服务的一部分部署上线。

papers.title: Feedforward Novel View Synthesis for Heterogeneous Cameras
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward novel view synthesis has recently shown promising results from sparse posed images, but most existing methods assume that context and target views share a fixed camera family. This homogeneous-camera assumption breaks in practical multi-sensor systems, where perspective, fisheye, and panoramic cameras may coexist and where the target projection may be unseen during training. We study feed-forward NVS across heterogeneous central cameras and identify a key ambiguity introduced by tokenization: a visual token aggregates a projection-dependent bundle of pixel rays, while existing camera encodings mainly expose absolute rays or token-center relations. To address this, we combine token-center relative Camera Positional Encodings and proposed local raymaps, a token-level representation that explicitly describes the intra-patch ray distribution summarized by each token. We further propose projection-aware 2D RoPE, which replaces raw image-grid coordinates with ray-induced angular coordinates so that relative positional reasoning is aligned across camera projections. Together, these components treat diverse cameras as calibrated samplings of a shared ray space rather than separate visual domains. On ScanNet++ with heterogeneous-camera system, our method improves over camera-conditioned baselines under mixed-camera evaluation and demonstrates zero-shot generalization to panoramic views.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 前馈新视角合成 (feed-forward NVS) 在透视、鱼眼、全景混布的多传感器系统中会因 token 化引入射线束歧义：一个视觉 token 聚合了依赖投影的像素射线束，而现有相机编码只给绝对射线或 token 中心关系。作者用 token 中心相对 Camera Positional Encodings 加局部 raymaps 显式描述 token 内射线分布，并用投影感知 2D RoPE 把图像网格坐标换成射线诱导的角坐标，使跨投影的相对位置推理对齐。在 ScanNet++ 异构相机系统上，该方法在 mixed-camera 评测中优于 camera-conditioned 基线，并对全景视图展示零样本泛化。
Motivation: 现有前馈 NVS 假设上下文与目标视图同属固定相机家族，这一同质相机假设在透视/鱼眼/全景共存、且目标投影可能训练时未见的多传感器系统中失效。
Method: 组合 token 中心相对 Camera Positional Encodings 与新提出的局部 raymaps（token 级表示，显式刻画每个 token 汇总的 patch 内射线分布），再提出 projection-aware 2D RoPE，用射线诱导的角坐标替代原始图像网格坐标；整体把不同相机视为共享射线空间的标定采样而非独立视觉域。
Result: 在 ScanNet++ 的异构相机系统上，mixed-camera 评测中相对 camera-conditioned 基线有提升，并展示对全景视图的零样本泛化能力。
Conclusion: 把异构相机统一建模为共享射线空间的标定采样，配合 token 内射线分布与角坐标相对位置编码，可在未见投影上做零样本新视角合成。

papers.title: Reasoning Models Are Accurate but Unsound on Identification
papers.abstract_en: A reasoning model asked whether a causal effect is recoverable from observational data can fail in two ways: it refuses an identifiable query or answers a nonidentifiable one. The latter is more consequential, as no observational data can validate the claimed formula. Measuring this failure requires queries that are provably non-identifiable, which prior evaluations lack, and grading that accepts correct formulas in any equivalent form, which string matching cannot provide. We build CERTID, a formal identification pipeline that addresses both limitations. CERTID uses the sound and complete causal identification algorithm ID to certify whether an effect is identifiable from a given graph and query, and verifies returned formulas against structural causal models whose interventional distributions are known exactly. CERTID further develops theoretical results to mitigate structural leakage, repair non-identifiable queries, and establish grading guarantees. We evaluate three frontier reasoning models (Gemini Flash, Gemini Pro, and GPT5.5) on 1,200 certified instances spanning 4 to 50 vertices. Accuracy proves a poor proxy for soundness: on identical instances, the false-claim rate on non-identifiable queries varies by seventeen-fold across models. We also find that models decide identifiability with 97-100% accuracy on graphs generated after the strongest model's training snapshot. Instances, the certification procedure, the verifier, and per-instance records are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/certid-D718.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CERTID：用因果识别算法 ID 证明查询是否可识别、并用已知干预分布的结构因果模型 (SCM) 校验模型给出的公式，从而度量推理模型在因果识别上的 soundness。在 1,200 个经认证的实例（4–50 个顶点）上，Gemini Flash、Gemini Pro 与 GPT5.5 在完全相同实例上的不可识别查询 false-claim rate 相差十七倍，说明 accuracy 是 soundness 的差代理。
Motivation: 推理模型对不可识别查询给出看似正确的公式时，观测数据无法证伪；现有评测既缺少可证明不可识别的查询，也缺少能接受任意等价公式的判分方式，因而无法度量这种失败。
Method: CERTID 是形式化识别流水线：以 sound 且 complete 的 ID 算法认证给定图与查询的可识别性，用干预分布精确已知的 SCM 校验返回公式；另给出缓解结构泄漏、修复不可识别查询与保证判分正确性的理论结果。
Result: 在 1,200 个经认证实例（4–50 个顶点）上评测 Gemini Flash、Gemini Pro、GPT5.5：相同实例上不可识别查询的 false-claim 率跨模型相差十七倍；在最强模型训练快照之后生成的图上，模型判定可识别性的准确率为 97–100%。
Conclusion: 准确率不能代表推理模型在因果识别上的可靠性：模型在判定可识别性上近乎全对，却在不可识别查询上以大幅跨模型差异的比率断言不存在的公式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: XGenAct: Geometry-Enhanced World Action Models through Cross-Task Generation
papers.abstract_en: World action models (WAMs) have advanced robot control by predicting how observations and actions evolve over time. Despite this progress, RGB and action based future prediction does not explicitly address the spatial understanding needed for robot manipulation. Existing efforts often add a limited set of spatial prediction tasks through specialized heads or branches, leaving both the range of spatial supervision and the model architecture fragmented. We introduce XGenAct, a world action model that represents RGB observations, robot actions, metric depth, surface normals, and functional role segmentation as RGB videos through deterministic codecs. By sampling perception and action tasks during training, XGenAct uses one video diffusion transformer and one objective to learn temporal prediction across these spaces without modality specific learned heads. On held out RLBench tasks, structured perception training improves average closed loop success over RGB only training, and XGenAct achieves 52% success in the five task external comparison, versus 26% for the strongest evaluated baselines. It also predicts future depth and segmentation more accurately than the evaluated pipelines that generate RGB first and then apply a frozen perception expert.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: XGenAct 把 RGB、机器人动作、metric depth、surface normals、functional role segmentation 统一编码成 RGB 视频，用单个 video diffusion transformer 和单一目标在训练时采样感知与动作任务，实现跨任务时空预测而不依赖模态专用头。在 held-out RLBench 任务上，结构化感知训练相比纯 RGB 训练提升平均闭环成功率；五任务外部对比中达到 52% 成功率，最强被评估基线为 26%。
Motivation: RGB 与动作的未来预测不显式覆盖机器人操作所需的空间理解；现有工作靠专用 head/branch 加少量空间任务，导致空间监督范围与模型架构双重碎片化。
Method: 用确定性 codec (deterministic codecs) 把 RGB 观测、机器人动作、metric depth、surface normals、functional role segmentation 全部表示为 RGB 视频；训练时采样感知与动作任务，用一个 video diffusion transformer 和一个目标学习跨这些空间的时序预测，不使用模态专用学习头。
Result: 在 held-out RLBench 任务上，结构化感知训练的平均闭环成功率高于纯 RGB 训练；五任务外部对比中 XGenAct 成功率 52%，最强被评估基线 26%；未来 depth 与 segmentation 的预测精度高于先生成 RGB 再接冻结感知专家的被评估 pipeline。
Conclusion: 把空间感知任务统一编码进单一视频生成模型、用一个目标联合训练，可以在机器人操作上同时提升闭环成功率与未来深度/分割预测精度，无需模态专用头。

papers.title: ProgressNet: Sketching and Prompting with a Frozen Text-to-Image Model
papers.abstract_en: Humans draw progressively: a few strokes, a look at the result, a stroke erased, a prompt revised. Image generators do not work this way. They typically take a finished sketch and produce the image in a single pass, so every edit starts the picture again, and the models that do keep state across turns are driven by text, cannot take a stroke, and are too slow to draw with. We present ProgressNet, a training-free framework that lets a frozen text-to-image model follow a drawing session as it unfolds: strokes are added and erased, the prompt is revised, and the image keeps up at about a second per turn. It needs no new parameters because the frozen model already has what a progressive generator needs, a pathway through which the previous turn can be remembered, layers that can carry appearance forward without freezing structure, and an internal signal of how far to trust an unfinished sketch; three inference-time mechanisms (Previous-Concept Memory, Layer-Selective K/V Injection and Banded Adaptive Control) use each in turn. As a sketch fills in, every existing method degrades, the FID of the FLUX+ControlNet baseline doubling between 10% and 100% completion on FS-COCO, while ProgressNet's barely moves; it maintains strong fidelity and progressive coherence across three sketch domains and is preferred by users over five competitors, most widely on erasure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ProgressNet 是一个 training-free 框架，让冻结的 text-to-image 模型跟随渐进绘画过程：笔画增删、prompt 修改时图像持续更新，每轮约 1 秒。随着草图完成度从 10% 升到 100%，FLUX+ControlNet 基线的 FID 在 FS-COCO 上翻倍，而 ProgressNet 的 FID 几乎不变。
Motivation: 现有图像生成器要么一次性吃完整草图重画，要么跨轮状态由文本驱动、无法接收笔画且速度太慢，无法支持人类边画边改的交互式创作。
Method: 三个推理时机制复用冻结模型的既有能力：Previous-Concept Memory 记住上一轮、Layer-Selective K/V Injection 让特定层携带外观而不冻结结构、Banded Adaptive Control 提供对未完成草图的信任度信号；无需新增参数。
Result: 在 FS-COCO 上，草图完成度从 10% 到 100% 时 FLUX+ControlNet 基线 FID 翻倍，ProgressNet 几乎不变；覆盖三个草图域，在用户偏好上胜过五个竞争方法，其中在擦除 (erasure) 场景优势最大；每轮更新约 1 秒。

papers.title: Weave Forcing: Compositional Memory Routing for Interactive Long Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in autoregressive video generation have improved temporal consistency over extended durations, yet interactive storytelling requires more than continuous scene extension: a new shot may combine characters and backgrounds from different historical shots. Whole prompt retrieval can overlook the distinct reference needs of individual components, while directly combining all historical memories may introduce unrelated visual content. To address these problems, we present Weave Forcing, a training-free framework for compositional memory reuse in interactive long video generation. First, we use an LLM for semantic slot routing to decompose user prompts into character and background descriptions and explicitly select suitable historical references for each component. To isolate the required content, masked memory weaving uses contrasting attention maps conditioned on semantic slots to construct refined semantic masks, selectively exposing relevant tokens from compressed historical KV memories to guide the generation of the current shot. We further introduce coverage adaptive RoPE to adjust temporal offsets and memory retention according to no, partial, or full reference coverage, addressing visual artifacts observed when incomplete historical references are positioned close to the current generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Weave Forcing improves cross-shot subject and background consistency while maintaining competitive visual quality and text alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Weave Forcing 是免训练的交互式长视频生成记忆复用框架：用 LLM 做语义槽路由，把 prompt 拆成角色与背景并各自挑选历史镜头参考，再用语义槽条件下的对比注意力图构造掩码，从压缩历史 KV 中只暴露所需 token。覆盖自适应 RoPE 按无/部分/完全参考覆盖调整时间偏移与记忆保留，缓解不完整历史参考贴近当前生成时的视觉伪影；实验显示跨镜头主体与背景一致性提升，同时保持有竞争力的视觉质量与文本对齐。
Motivation: 交互式叙事需要把不同历史镜头的角色与背景组合进新镜头：整段 prompt 检索会忽略各成分各自的参考需求，直接拼接全部历史记忆又会引入无关视觉内容。
Method: 免训练框架，含三步：LLM 语义槽路由把用户 prompt 分解为角色与背景描述并为各成分显式选择历史参考；masked memory weaving 用以语义槽为条件的对比注意力图构造精细语义掩码，从压缩历史 KV 记忆中选择性暴露相关 token 引导当前镜头生成；coverage adaptive RoPE 按无、部分、完全参考覆盖调整时间偏移与记忆保留。
Result: 实验表明该方法提升跨镜头主体与背景一致性，同时保持有竞争力的视觉质量与文本对齐；摘要给出的是定性比较结论，未附具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 按成分分别路由并掩码式复用历史记忆，可在免训练条件下改善交互式长视频的跨镜头一致性，且不牺牲视觉质量与文本对齐。

papers.title: Efficient Reasoning Training Does Not Always Harm CoT Faithfulness and Monitorability
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning allows humans to inspect how large language models reach their answers, and oversee model behaviour. This reasoning comes at an increased inference cost, motivating efficient methods that train models to solve tasks using fewer tokens. However, a common concern is that such training may cause models to skip important reasoning steps, so the CoT no longer faithfully reflects the model's decision. It is unclear whether or when this occurs in practice, since different efficiency methods apply length pressure to models' CoT in distinct ways, and faithfully explaining a model's decision takes more tokens on some tasks than others. To understand these dynamics, we fine-tune a variety of models with three methods that apply length pressure differently, namely a fixed generation budget, a per-example length target, and a group-relative length reward. We evaluate how efficient reasoning affects CoT faithfulness (i.e., how well the CoT reflects model decisions on related inputs) and monitorability (i.e., whether the CoT reveals when input interventions alter the output). We find that it affects faithfulness and monitorability differently. Faithfulness falls in most settings, primarily because the trained models are less consistent. Monitorability is more robust, as models keep acknowledging the influence on their answer even when the CoT is much shorter.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用三种施加长度压力的方式微调 LLM（固定生成预算、逐样本长度目标、组相对长度奖励），检验高效推理训练是否损害 CoT 忠实性与可监控性。忠实性在多数设置下下降，主因是训练后模型一致性变差；可监控性更稳健，即使 CoT 大幅变短，模型仍会承认输入干预对答案的影响。
Motivation: 高效推理训练以减少 token 为代价，担心模型跳过关键推理步骤使 CoT 不再忠实反映决策；不同效率方法施加长度压力的方式不同，且不同任务忠实解释所需 token 数不同，实际何时发生尚不清楚。
Method: 微调多种模型，比较三种长度压力方式：固定生成预算 (fixed generation budget)、逐样本长度目标 (per-example length target)、组相对长度奖励 (group-relative length reward)；评估 CoT 忠实性（CoT 在相关输入上反映模型决策的程度）与可监控性（CoT 是否揭示输入干预改变了输出）。
Result: 忠实性在多数设置下下降，主要因为训练后模型一致性降低；可监控性更稳健，模型在 CoT 明显变短时仍会承认输入干预对其答案的影响；两种指标受影响方式不同。
Conclusion: 高效推理训练不必总是损害 CoT 的可监控性，但通常会通过降低模型一致性损害忠实性；长度压力的作用在忠实性与可监控性上并不一致。

papers.title: An Automated and Reproducible Workflow for Crack Identification and Damage Assessment of Fusion Materials
papers.abstract_en: Post-exposure microscopy is central to qualification of fusion materials. However, manual analysis does not scale to the volume, heterogeneity, and multiresolution character of modern fusion-materials campaigns. To address this challenge, we present a reproducible workflow, implemented in the Galaxy scientific workflow environment, for automated crack identification and quantitative damage assessment from scanning electron microscopy images. The workflow processes SEM images and experimental metadata to identify cracks, quantify damage, and retain the intermediate products and processing history needed for reproducibility. Outputs include crack masks, skeletonized crack networks, quality-control visualizations, and scalar damage descriptors. The method is designed to operate without image-specific parameter tuning across tungsten grades, microstructures, magnifications, and damage states. We demonstrate the workflow on a sparse electron-beam thermal-shock dataset containing 418 images from 114 experiments spanning five tungsten grades and three microstructural states. We define a crack-density descriptor, which provides standardized inputs for downstream machine-learning prediction and physics-based crack simulation. These predictive components are exposed in the same Galaxy environment and are intentionally treated here as extensible workflow modules. The principal contribution is therefore an end-to-end, shareable, and computationally portable workflow that links experimental characterization, automated image analysis, preliminary damage prediction, and simulation-guided data acquisition for fusion-materials research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Galaxy 工作流环境中搭建端到端可复现流程，自动从 SEM 图像识别裂纹并量化聚变材料损伤，输出裂纹掩膜、骨架化网络与标量损伤描述子，且无需按图像调参即可跨钨等级、显微组织、放大倍数与损伤状态运行。在含 418 张图像、114 次实验、5 个钨等级与 3 种显微组织状态的电子束热冲击数据集上做了演示，定义的裂纹密度描述子为下游机器学习预测与物理裂纹模拟提供标准化输入。
Motivation: 聚变材料辐照后评估依赖人工分析显微图像，无法跟上现代聚变实验在数据量、异质性与多分辨率上的规模，且结果难以复现。
Method: 以 Galaxy 科学工作流环境实现可复现流程：输入 SEM 图像与实验元数据，经自动裂纹识别产出裂纹掩膜、骨架化裂纹网络、质控可视化与标量损伤描述子，并保留中间产物与处理历史；设计为免图像级参数调参，另在同一 Galaxy 环境中以可扩展模块形式挂接机器学习预测与基于物理的裂纹模拟。
Result: 在稀疏电子束热冲击数据集上演示，该数据集含 418 张图像、来自 114 次实验，覆盖 5 个钨等级与 3 种显微组织状态；定义了裂纹密度 (crack-density) 描述子作为下游预测与模拟的标准化输入。
Conclusion: 作者主张主要贡献是一条端到端、可共享、计算可移植的工作流，把实验表征、自动图像分析、初步损伤预测与仿真引导的数据采集连成一体，预测部分在此被有意当作可扩展模块而非最终模型。

papers.title: Getting Your Guidance Weights Right in diffusion and flow-matching posterior sampling
papers.abstract_en: Training-free posterior sampling methods, also known as Plug-and-Play methods, leverage pretrained unconditional diffusion or flow-matching models to solve inverse problems. Most existing approaches rely on guidance weights to balance, at each time step, prior information from the unconditional score or velocity network with measurement consistency, yet the tuning of these weights is often not discussed and is largely left to heuristics. We introduce a simple and principled offline strategy for automatically tuning these guidance weights. Our key observation is that, at each time step, the conditional denoising score-matching objective for diffusion models, or the conditional flow-matching objective for flow-matching models, is a least-squares objective. Therefore, when the conditional prediction is expressed as a weighted sum of the unconditional network output and a measurement-guidance term, optimizing over these weights reduces to a two-dimensional linear least-squares problem. The resulting time-dependent guidance weights can be optimized offline for a given measurement operator, noise level and sampler at the cost of a single minibatch of sampling trajectories, without retraining or fine-tuning the pretrained generative model. Instantiated with the standard Tweedie-based measurement-consistency term, our approach improves posterior sampling and achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction performance across diffusion- and flow-matching-based methods. Moreover, the optimized guidance weights enable diffusion samplers to reduce the number of sampling steps from 1000 to 50 with no significant degradation in reconstruction quality. Code will be made available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 训练无关的后验采样中，guidance weight 靠启发式调参。作者指出条件去噪 score-matching / flow-matching 目标在条件预测写成无网络输出与测量引导项加权和时是二维线性最小二乘，可按测量算子、噪声水平和采样器离线优化出时变权重，无需重训生成模型。在扩散与 flow-matching 方法上达到 SOTA 重建性能，并把采样步数从 1000 降到 50 而重建质量无显著下降。
Motivation: Plug-and-Play 后验采样靠 guidance weight 在先验与测量一致性之间折中，但现有工作对权重调节基本留给启发式，缺少原则性调法。
Method: 把条件 denoising score-matching（扩散）或条件 flow-matching 目标视为最小二乘问题：条件预测表示为无条件网络输出与测量引导项的加权和，对权重的优化化为二维线性最小二乘，得到时变 guidance weight；对给定测量算子、噪声水平和采样器离线优化，代价仅为一个 minibatch 的采样轨迹，不重训或微调预训练生成模型，测量一致性项用标准 Tweedie 形式。
Result: 在扩散与 flow-matching 方法上取得 SOTA 重建性能；优化后的 guidance weight 让扩散采样步数从 1000 降到 50 而重建质量无显著退化。
Conclusion: guidance weight 可以作为二维最小二乘问题离线求解而非启发式调节，且足以支撑大幅减少采样步数；代码将公开。

papers.title: Certified Mechanistic Edits: Behavioral Guarantees for Skill Removal and Preservation
papers.abstract_en: Mechanistic edits (ablations, weight edits, activation steering) are the standard tools for unlearning a harmful capability from a neural network while preserving useful ones. Current approaches validate their effects only by testing, which can never cover an entire continuous region of inputs. Prior work at the interpretability-verification boundary certifies descriptions of a model: what a circuit computes, or whether it faithfully explains the whole. We instead certify the behavioral effect of an edit: that disabling a circuit removes one skill and provably preserves another, for every input in a region; a feature non-interference guarantee in the information-flow-security sense. We demonstrate such certified edits from toy ReLU networks up to a standard softmax + LayerNorm transformer, proving removal and preservation over continuous embedding-space regions and reaching roughly 9x the input-perturbation dimension an exact solver can handle by switching to sound bound propagation. Furthermore, we prove that no finite deterministic black-box test can certify removal, exhibiting an edit that passes exhaustive testing yet provably fails on a survivor pocket that can be made arbitrarily small. Guarantees hold on small, standard-architecture networks and, like any removal claim, presuppose that the target skill admits a decidable specification, a property which real-world harms may not have.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出对机制编辑 (mechanistic edits) 的行为认证：在嵌入空间的连续输入区域上，证明关闭某条电路确实移除目标技能且保留另一技能，即信息流安全意义上的特征不干扰保证。方法从 toy ReLU 网络扩展到标准 softmax + LayerNorm transformer，借助可靠的界传播 (sound bound propagation) 达到精确求解器可处理输入扰动维度的约 9 倍；并证明任何有限确定性黑盒测试都无法认证移除——存在一个通过穷尽测试却在可任意小的幸存者口袋 (survivor pocket) 上失败的编辑。

Method: 对编辑的电路在连续嵌入空间区域上做形式化认证：用可靠的界传播替代精确求解器以扩大可处理的输入扰动维度，证明移除与保留性质；并构造反例证明有限确定性黑盒测试的不完备性。

papers.title: Below what training size do deep tabular generators stop beating trivial baselines? A preregistered benchmark on a size ladder of clinical and standard datasets
papers.abstract_en: Deep tabular generative models are benchmarked on datasets with tens of thousands of rows; clinical datasets have hundreds. We preregistered and ran a size-ladder benchmark to find where the two regimes diverge: 8 public datasets subsampled from 200 to 20,000 training rows, seven generators (independent marginals, Gaussian copula, SMOTE, unconditional SMOTE, CTGAN, TVAE, TabDDPM) with a fixed 20-trial tuning budget and 5 evaluation seeds, plus 4 natively small clinical datasets at true size, for 2,220 committed runs in total. The primary metric is the AUROC of fixed classifiers trained on synthetic and tested on real data. In 23 of 24 (dataset, deep model) pairs no deep model ever beats the best trivial baseline by more than seed noise, at any training size we measured. The best baseline wins 40 of 49 (dataset, size) cells. Our preregistered prediction that the deep models' ranking would be unstable at small sizes is falsified: mean Kendall tau between adjacent rungs below 5,000 rows is 0.806, above our 0.8 threshold, and stability is highest at the smallest sizes rather than lowest. One caveat bounds all of this: in 81% of cells the gap between the top two methods is smaller than the variation between seeds. Finally, method rankings on natively small clinical datasets agree only moderately with rankings on subsampled large ones (mean tau 0.57 to 0.64), which questions whether a subsampled large dataset can stand in for a small one. All 2,220 result files, the preregistration and its hash, and the code that regenerates every figure and number from those files are public.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 5 figures. Code, all 2,220 result files and the frozen preregistration: https://github.com/ShivamShrivastava18/sdts-benchmark ; archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22712401
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 预注册的表格合成模型规模阶梯基准显示：在 200–20,000 行的 8 个数据集与 4 个原生小临床数据集上，24 个（数据集, 深度模型）组合中 23 个的深度生成器（CTGAN、TVAE、TabDDPM）从未以超过种子噪声的优势胜过最佳平凡基线，且在所有测量规模下皆然。作者预注册的“小样本下深度模型排序不稳定”预测被证伪：低于 5,000 行时相邻阶梯的平均 Kendall tau 为 0.806，高于 0.8 阈值，且最小规模处稳定性最高。
Motivation: 深度表格生成模型的基准几乎都在数万行数据上做，而临床数据集只有数百行；两个规模区间是否给出一致结论此前没有受控检验，小样本下该不该用深度生成器缺乏证据。
Method: 预注册并执行规模阶梯基准：8 个公开数据集从 200 到 20,000 行下采样，7 个生成器（独立边缘分布、Gaussian copula、SMOTE、unconditional SMOTE、CTGAN、TVAE、TabDDPM），固定 20 次调参预算与 5 个评估种子，另加 4 个原生小规模临床数据集，共 2,220 次运行；主指标为在合成数据上训练的固定分类器在真实数据上的 AUROC。
Result: 24 个（数据集, 深度模型）组合中 23 个，深度模型在任何测量规模下都未以超过种子噪声的优势胜过最佳平凡基线；最佳基线在 49 个（数据集, 规模）格子中赢下 40 个。预注册预测被证伪：低于 5,000 行时相邻阶梯平均 Kendall tau 0.806，高于 0.8 阈值，且最小规模处稳定性最高。81% 的格子中前两名方法的差距小于种子间变异。原生小临床数据集上的方法排序与下采样大数据集的排序仅中等一致（平均 tau 0.57 至 0.64）。
Conclusion: 在数百到数万行的规模区间，深度表格生成器基本不比平凡基线更好，且用下采样的大数据集替代原生小临床数据集来排名方法并不可靠；全部 2,220 个结果文件、预注册及其哈希与代码均已公开。

papers.title: Detect and Suppress: A Mechanistic Defense against Adversarial Patches in VLA Models
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial patches can disrupt Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models by manipulating visual observations, leading to failures in robot control. However, it remains poorly understood which internal mechanisms underlie these failures and how targeted interventions can mitigate them. In this work, we mechanistically analyze VLA representations using a sparse autoencoder (SAE) and identify a feature whose activation strongly correlates with the presence of an adversarial patch. Based on this analysis, we suppress the identified feature at inference time only when a linear probe detects an attack. This intervention improves robustness without the cost of fine-tuning the VLA. We evaluate our method against VLA adversarial patch attacks on LIBERO-10. Conditional intervention improves success rate under intermittent attacks, whereas continuously applying the same intervention substantially degrades policy performance. These results show that attack-related internal representations can provide useful targets for VLA adversarial defense and that controlling when to intervene is important for limiting disruption to nominal policy behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 VLA 模型被对抗补丁 (adversarial patch) 干扰的问题，用稀疏自编码器 (SAE) 找到一个激活与补丁存在强相关的特征，并仅在线性探针检测到攻击时才在推理期抑制该特征。在 LIBERO-10 的对抗补丁攻击下，条件式干预提升了间歇攻击时的成功率，而连续施加同一干预会显著损害策略性能。
Motivation: 对抗补丁能通过篡改视觉观测使机器人控制失败，但其内部机制与如何定点干预仍不清楚；无差别抑制会伤及正常策略。
Method: 用 SAE 对 VLA 表示做机理分析，定位与补丁存在强相关的特征；训练线性探针判断攻击，仅在探针报警时于推理期抑制该特征，不做微调。
Result: 在 LIBERO-10 的 VLA 对抗补丁攻击评测中，条件式干预改善了间歇攻击下的成功率；持续施加同一干预则大幅降低策略性能。
Conclusion: 攻击相关的内部表示可作为 VLA 对抗防御的干预靶点，且干预时机的控制对限制对正常策略行为的扰动至关重要。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Most-Recent Anchoring with Recurrent Ordering for Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Long-term forecasting models commonly process all patches in a look-back window using the same fixed stack. Older contextual patches and recent evidence therefore receive the same computational depth. Yet the information closest to the forecast and the more distant context do not contribute equally. Uniform processing leaves this distinction unexpressed in the architecture. We propose MARO, a Most-Recent Anchoring with Recurrent Ordering model that processes the look-back window from the most recent patch to the oldest. The most recent patch serves as the anchor. It initializes the latent state and conditions each subsequent step, so older patches are folded into a representation that remains centered on recent evidence. A single shared module is reused at every step, so extending the scan further into the past introduces no additional parameters. Intermediate states retained during the scan allow the forecast head to weigh short and long portions of the history separately. This expresses recency through the order of recurrent refinement. Extensive experiments across multiple real-world time series datasets show that MARO achieves state-of-the-art performance on both long-term and short-term forecasting tasks.Ablation studies examine the contribution of the main architectural components.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MARO 把回看窗口按从最新 patch 到最旧的顺序循环扫描，最新 patch 作为 anchor 初始化 latent state 并条件化每一步，使表示始终围绕近期证据；共享模块复用使向更早历史扩展不增加参数，中间状态让预测头分别加权长短历史。在多个真实时间序列数据集上，MARO 在长期与短期预测任务均达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 长期预测模型对回看窗口内所有 patch 用同一固定网络栈处理，近期证据与远期上下文获得相同计算深度，架构无法表达两者对预测贡献不等这一事实。
Method: MARO (Most-Recent Anchoring with Recurrent Ordering)：从最新 patch 向最旧逐个扫描，最新 patch 作为 anchor 初始化 latent state 并在每步条件化后续输入；同一模块在各步共享复用，扫描保留的中间状态供预测头对短、长历史分别加权；并做消融研究检验各主要组件贡献。
Result: 在多个真实世界时间序列数据集上，MARO 在长期与短期预测任务均取得 state-of-the-art 表现；消融研究检验了主要架构组件的贡献。
Conclusion: 把 recency 通过循环精化的顺序而非更深网络来表达，可在不增加参数的前提下同时覆盖长期与短期预测并达到 SOTA。
Relevance: 37

papers.title: Dual-Context Analog Retrieval for Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Most long-term time-series forecasting models map the look-back window directly to the full horizon in a single pass. While efficient, this design does not explicitly identify which historical states are most relevant to different future segments or exploit what followed those states. Analog forecasting addresses this by retrieving past states similar to the present and using their observed continuations, but single nearest matches can be unreliable and overlapping patches may produce redundant candidates. We propose DuoTS, a Dual-Context Time Series forecasting model that uses retrieved evidence without relying on it exclusively. DuoTS first produces a base forecast with a parallel patch encoder and linear prediction head, then progressively refines it one future patch at a time. Each refinement combines two views: a current context that attends to recent tokens and captures the latest dynamics, and a detail context that provides distinct retrieved analogs together with their subsequent trajectories. Patch-wise refinement allows the model to balance these views across the forecast horizon and associate each future segment with evidence appropriate to its temporal distance from the present. Experiments on multiple real-world datasets show that DuoTS achieves state-of-the-art performance, while ablations confirm the contribution of each context. The refinement mechanism is also model-agnostic, requiring only an encoded look-back window and the future-patch position, and can therefore be integrated into existing forecasting models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DuoTS 先用并行 patch 编码器加线性预测头给出基础预报，再逐个未来 patch 精修：每个 patch 同时融合当前上下文（关注近期 token）与细节上下文（检索到的不同 analog 及其后续轨迹），按未来片段与当前的时间距离分配证据权重。在多个真实数据集上达到 state-of-the-art，消融确认两个上下文各有贡献，且精修机制只需编码后的回看窗口与未来 patch 位置即可接入现有模型。
Motivation: 长期时序预报模型通常一次把回看窗口映射到整个预测期，不区分哪些历史状态对不同未来片段最相关，也不利用这些状态之后实际发生了什么；而 analog 预报中单一最近邻不可靠、重叠 patch 会带来冗余候选。
Method: DuoTS 分两阶段：并行 patch 编码器加线性预测头产生基础预报，随后逐个未来 patch 精修；每次精修融合 current context（attend 近期 token、捕捉最新动态）与 detail context（检索到的互异 analog 及其后续轨迹），并按未来片段与当前的时间距离平衡两个视图。精修机制 model-agnostic，只需编码后的回看窗口与未来 patch 位置。
Result: 在多个真实世界数据集上取得 state-of-the-performance；消融实验确认 current context 与 detail context 各自都有贡献。
Conclusion: 把检索到的 analog 证据与近期动态作为两个视图、按未来片段逐 patch 精修，可以在不完全依赖检索证据的前提下提升长期时序预报，且该精修机制可直接嫁接到既有预报模型。
Relevance: 36
