summary_sections.method: DuoTS 分两阶段：并行 patch 编码器加线性预测头产生基础预报，随后逐个未来 patch 精修；每次精修融合 current context（attend 近期 token、捕捉最新动态）与 detail context（检索到的互异 analog 及其后续轨迹），并按未来片段与当前的时间距离平衡两个视图。精修机制 model-agnostic，只需编码后的回看窗口与未来 patch 位置。
summary_sections.result: 在多个真实世界数据集上取得 state-of-the-performance；消融实验确认 current context 与 detail context 各自都有贡献。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把检索到的 analog 证据与近期动态作为两个视图、按未来片段逐 patch 精修，可以在不完全依赖检索证据的前提下提升长期时序预报，且该精修机制可直接嫁接到既有预报模型。

papers.title: AREX: Affine-Residual Exponential Integrator for Few-Step Sampling in Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: We introduce AREX, a training-free sampler for pretrained flow matching models that uses the target mean and covariance to capture an analytically tractable part of the sampling dynamics. We show that the velocity field of the moment-matched Gaussian target is the $L^2$-optimal affine approximation to the marginal velocity field. This motivates decomposition of the learned dynamics into an affine component over the whole sampling path, determined by the first two target moments, and a neural residual term. AREX keeps the affine component and integrates it using an explicit matrix-valued propagator. In turn, we only require to integrate over the residual term. This differs from scalar exponential integrators, which analytically handle only isotropic linear dynamics. Across image and text-to-image generation tasks, AREX consistently improves sample fidelity in the few-step sampling regime without retraining the underlying model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AREX 是面向预训练 flow matching 模型的免训练少步采样器：把学到的速度场拆成由目标均值与协方差决定的仿射分量和神经残差分量，仿射部分用显式矩阵值 propagator 解析积分，只需对残差做数值积分。在图像与 text-to-image 生成任务的少步采样区间内，它在不重训模型的前提下持续提升样本保真度。
Motivation: 预训练 flow matching 模型在少步采样时误差大，而重训代价高；标量指数积分器只能解析处理各向同性线性动力学，无法利用目标分布的完整一二阶矩结构。
Method: 证明矩匹配高斯目标的速度场是边缘速度场的 L2-最优仿射近似，据此把采样路径全程的仿射分量（由目标前两阶矩确定）与神经残差项分离；仿射分量用显式矩阵值 propagator 解析积分，仅残差项需数值积分，全程免训练。
Result: 在图像与 text-to-image 生成任务上，AREX 在少步采样区间内一致提升样本保真度，且无需重训底层模型；相对标量指数积分器，其解析处理的是完整的矩阵值（非各向同性）线性动力学。
Conclusion: 把可解析的仿射动力学与神经残差分开积分，是免训练提升 flow matching 少步采样质量的有效路径，且比标量指数积分器覆盖更一般的线性动力学。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Metropolis-Hastings Dominates Importance Resampling for Policy Composition
papers.abstract_en: Post-training a large language model (LLM) often requires exploring trade-offs between multiple rewards, but retraining for each trade-off is expensive. Decoding-time policy composition allows these trade-offs to be adjusted by combining reward-specific policies at inference time. This composition targets a weighted product of the policies' probabilities over complete responses, but standard implementations combine their next-token probabilities, generally introducing sampling bias. We analyze a known iterative correction based on independence Metropolis-Hastings (MH). Our main result shows that, for every rollout budget, MH produces an output distribution at least as close to the target as sampling-importance-resampling (SIR) with the same budget, as measured by every convex f-divergence. We also derive a lower bound on MH's improvement over the uncorrected decoder in a consensus objective measuring agreement with the supplied policies. We further characterize the correction's sampling error in two asymptotic regimes: when the reward-specific policies approach agreement, and when the log ratio between target and uncorrected-decoder probabilities fluctuates increasingly widely, as can happen for long responses. We complement our analysis with experiments in enumerable and LLM-scale settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 解码时的策略组合 (policy composition) 想按奖励权重乘积组合多个奖励策略，但标准实现只拼接 next-token 概率，会引入采样偏差。论文证明：对任意 rollout 预算，基于 independence Metropolis-Hastings 的迭代校正在每一种凸 f-divergence 下都不劣于同等预算的 sampling-importance-resampling (SIR)，并给出 MH 相对未校正解码器在 consensus 目标上的改进下界。
Motivation: 解码时策略组合允许不重训就调整多奖励权衡，但标准的 next-token 概率拼接并不等于目标的完整响应概率乘积，采样有偏；需要判断哪种校正方法在有限预算下更接近目标分布。
Method: 分析基于 independence Metropolis-Hastings 的已知迭代校正：主结果以凸 f-divergence 度量比较 MH 与 SIR 在相同 rollout 预算下的输出分布与目标距离；另推导 MH 相对未校正解码器在 consensus 目标（衡量与给定策略的一致程度）上的改进下界；并刻画两个渐近 regime 下的采样误差——各奖励策略趋于一致时，以及目标与未校正解码器概率之对数比波动变宽时（长响应可触发）。
Result: 主定理：对每个 rollout 预算，MH 的输出分布在每一种凸 f-divergence 下都至少与同预算 SIR 一样接近目标；另给出 MH 相对未校正解码器在 consensus 目标上的改进下界，并给出两个渐近 regime（策略趋于一致、对数比波动变宽）下的采样误差刻画；分析辅以 enumerable 与 LLM 规模两类实验。
Conclusion: 在解码时策略组合这一目标分布采样问题上，MH 校正相对 SIR 具有按 f-divergence 度量的支配性，且相对未校正解码器的改进可量化；偏差在长响应导致对数比波动变宽时更需校正。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: MobiAgent: Dual-Loop Recursive Policy Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon mobile manipulation presents significant challenges due to compounding execution errors and capacity interference between locomotion and arm control. While recent Vision-Language-Action models excel at short-horizon tasks, they lack the hierarchical reasoning required for multi-stage objectives. Furthermore, existing hierarchical agents suffer from rigid sub-task mapping, inflexible replanning, and a lack of continuous learning. To address these limitations, we introduce MobiAgent, a dual-loop agentic framework that bridges robust deployment execution and recursive policy self-improvement. During deployment, the Inner Loop decouples high-level reasoning from low-level control through highly composable atomic skills. It employs Vision-Language models for receding-horizon planning and visual reflection, dynamically composing skills to ensure robust error recovery. These skills are executed by specialized flow-matching experts that share a unified VLM backbone, maximizing reusability while mitigating capacity interference. Concurrently, the Outer Loop drives automated lifelong learning by autonomously segmenting and verifying deployment rollouts, clustering them to discover atomic skills, and continuously fine-tuning the skill library without human annotations. Evaluations on RoboCasa, BEHAVIOR-1K, and real-world tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of MobiAgent. It outperforms $π_{0.5}$-TA by 22.5 percentage points on BEHAVIOR-1K and enables robust recovery from execution failures. Through autonomous data recycling, success improves from 7.50% to 27.50% on RoboCasa and from 32.5% to 57.5% on Astribot S1.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL) 2026. Project page: https://kaiknower.github.io/mobiagent
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MobiAgent 用双环框架做长时程移动操作：内环以 VLM 做 receding-horizon 规划与视觉反思、动态组合原子技能，技能由共享统一 VLM backbone 的 flow-matching 专家执行；外环自动切分并验证部署轨迹、聚类发现新技能并持续微调技能库，全程无人工标注。在 BEHAVIOR-1K 上比 π0.5-TA 高 22.5 个百分点，自主数据回收使 RoboCasa 成功率从 7.50% 升到 27.50%、Astribot S1 从 32.5% 升到 57.5%。
Motivation: 长时程移动操作中执行误差会累积，运动与臂控之间存在 capacity interference；现有 VLA 模型只擅长短时程任务、缺少多阶段层级推理，层级 agent 又存在子任务映射僵硬、重规划不灵活、无法持续学习的问题。
Method: 内环把高层推理与低层控制解耦：VLM 负责 receding-horizon 规划和视觉反思，动态组合可复用的原子技能以实现错误恢复，技能由共享统一 VLM backbone 的多个 flow-matching 专家执行以缓解 capacity interference。外环自动切分并验证部署 rollout，聚类发现原子技能，在无人工标注下持续微调技能库。
Result: 在 BEHAVIOR-1K 上比 π0.5-TA 高 22.5 个百分点；自主数据回收使 RoboCasa 成功率从 7.50% 提到 27.50%，Astribot S1 真机从 32.5% 提到 57.5%；评测覆盖 RoboCasa、BEHAVIOR-1K 与真实任务，并展示对执行失败的稳健恢复。
Conclusion: 把部署执行与递归策略自改进分成两个环，可在无人工标注下持续扩充技能库并显著抬高长时程移动操作的成功率。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Single or Multiple Policies for Phase-Structured Reinforcement Learning?
papers.abstract_en: Many reinforcement-learning (RL) problems are non-stationary yet structured and can be decomposed into phases, each with its own transition probabilities and reward functions. When the phase sequence is known, the common solution augments the state with information to satisfy the Markovian property and applies standard RL techniques. However, prior work finds that the multi-policy approach for different phases can outperform a single state-augmented policy shared among the phases, for reasons that remain unclear. In this work, we first show that the shared policy can theoretically achieve performance of any multi-policy solution. However, whether a multi-policy solution can perform better than the corresponding single shared policy in practice depends on function approximation, learning and optimization processes, as well as, for multi-policy solutions, the sample efficiency and loss of continuity from one policy to another. We propose a regime-based phase decomposition method to identify which policy can provide better performance. The method is based on consideration of the duration of transient system dynamics relative to the duration of the quasi-stationary period. Numerical experiments are conducted with different non-stationary RL problems to validate our four major hypotheses: (a) longer phase durations favor multi-policies, (b) the heterogeneity between phases increases the burden on single policy, (c) multi-policies need sufficient data for each phase, and (d) environment-specific transition dynamics between phases can affect which policy is preferable.
papers.comment: 40 pages, 13 figures, main paper with appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对已知阶段序列的非平稳强化学习，证明单一状态增广策略在理论上可达任意多策略解的性能，实践中谁更优取决于函数逼近、优化以及多策略的样本效率与阶段间连续性损失。提出基于瞬态动力学时长与准稳态时长之比的 regime-based 阶段分解法来判定该用哪种策略，并用数值实验验证四条假设：阶段更长利于多策略、阶段异质性加重单策略负担、多策略需每阶段足够数据、阶段间转移动力学影响选择。
Motivation: 已知阶段序列时常规做法是状态增广后跑单策略，但已有工作发现分阶段多策略常更优，原因不明，缺少判定何时该用哪种策略的准则。
Method: 先证明共享策略在理论上可达到任意多策略解的性能，再把差异归因于函数逼近、学习与优化过程，以及多策略的样本效率和策略间连续性损失；据此提出 regime-based 阶段分解方法，依据瞬态系统动力学时长相对准稳态时段的比值判定哪种策略更优，并在多类非平稳 RL 问题上做数值实验。
Result: 数值实验检验四条假设：(a) 阶段时长越长越利于多策略；(b) 阶段间异质性越高越加重单策略负担；(c) 多策略需要每个阶段有足够数据；(d) 阶段之间环境特有的转移动力学会影响哪种策略更可取。
Conclusion: 单一共享策略与多策略的优劣不是理论性能问题，而是由逼近与优化、数据量和阶段间连续性共同决定，可用瞬态与准稳态时长之比的阶段分解准则来预判。

papers.title: Fed-ADApt: Federated Anytime Depth Adaptation for Resource-Aware Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative training of medical image segmentation models without sharing raw patient data, yet existing approaches assume a homogeneous compute budget across institutions, limiting participation of low-resource sites. We propose Fed-ADApt, a depth-adaptive federated framework for UNet-based segmentation that jointly addresses low-compute training and inference. Fed-ADApt integrates multi-depth supervision with hierarchical depth-wise aggregation, allowing each site to train according to its local compute budget while contributing to a global model that supports dynamic depth selection at deployment. We evaluated Fed-ADApt on multi-site 2D retinal fundus disc segmentation and 3D brain tumor segmentation. Across both tasks, federated collaboration substantially improves robustness under domain shift. Fed-ADApt matched the full-resource FedAvg performance in 3D and achieved competitive 2D performance with a 4.7% average Dice reduction, while reducing average inference cost by 19.5% in 3D and 34.5% in 2D and substantially reducing training cost by 98% at the most constrained sites. Importantly, Fed-ADApt enables low-resource institutions that cannot train full-capacity models to participate in federations while maintaining competitive global performance under a favorable accuracy to efficiency trade-off. By considering training and inference compute budgets, Fed-ADApt provides a practical and equitable solution for federated medical image segmentation across heterogeneous clinical and edge-enabled imaging environments.

papers.title: UniDynamics: Event-RGB Fusion for Unified Future 4D Dynamic Scene Generation
papers.abstract_en: We propose UniDynamics, a diffusion-based framework for future 4D dynamic scenes (RGB, depth, and optical flow) generation from a single event-RGB pair, without requiring long histories or control priors as in existing methods, while explicitly modeling future motion fields. The core idea is to leverage event streams to offer an alternative motion prior for single-RGB extrapolation, and to enforce geometric and motion constraints throughout generation via multimodal modeling. Specifically, we design an Event Latent Enhancement (ELE) module to align and enhance event latents into diffusion-injectable conditioning features, providing robust initial motion priors and reliable texture/structure cues. We further introduce a Perceptual Dynamics Space (PDS) embedded in the multi-scale U-Net, which decouples and adaptively interacts depth and flow while continuously feeding back constraints to appearance features, improving geometric-motion consistency for physically plausible and spatiotemporally coherent prediction. Experiments on VKitti2 and DSEC demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, producing high-quality, temporally coherent, and 4D-consistent future predictions, especially under challenging high-speed motion blur.
papers.journal_ref: ECCV2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniDynamics 用单张 event-RGB 对生成未来 4D 动态场景（RGB、深度、光流），以事件流作为单帧外推的运动先验，无需长历史或控制先验。Event Latent Enhancement 模块把事件 latent 对齐增强为可注入 diffusion 的条件特征，Perceptual Dynamics Space 在多尺度 U-Net 中解耦深度与光流并持续向外观特征回喂约束。在 VKitti2 与 DSEC 上达到 SOTA，尤其在高速运动模糊下保持时序一致与 4D 一致的未来预测。
Motivation: 单帧 RGB 外推缺少运动信息，现有方法依赖长历史帧或控制先验，难以生成几何与运动自洽的未来 4D 场景。
Method: 基于 diffusion 的框架：Event Latent Enhancement (ELE) 模块对齐并增强事件 latent 为 diffusion 可注入的条件特征，提供初始运动先验与纹理/结构线索；多尺度 U-Net 中嵌入 Perceptual Dynamics Space (PDS)，解耦并自适应交互深度与光流，持续向外观特征回喂几何与运动约束，联合生成 RGB、深度、光流。
Result: 在 VKitti2 与 DSEC 上展示 state-of-the-art 性能，生成高质量、时序连贯且 4D 一致的未来预测，在高速运动模糊等挑战场景下尤为明显。
Conclusion: 事件流可作为单 RGB 未来 4D 场景生成的有效运动先验，配合显式几何-运动约束即可摆脱对长历史与控制先验的依赖。

papers.title: A Vision-Language Model (VLM)-based Pipeline for End-to-End Procedural Modeling of Field-Grown Maize from Point Clouds
papers.abstract_en: Editable 3D models of field-grown crops support high-throughput phenotyping and in silico breeding trials, but building them from scanned point clouds requires organ-level segmentation and fitting. Procedural generators can turn an organ-level parameter set into an analysis-suitable 3D model, but obtaining that set requires hours of manual tuning per plant or segmentation models trained on species-specific labels. We present an automated pipeline that reconstructs procedural maize models from raw 3D point clouds without manual tuning or species-specific training data. A multimodal vision-language model (VLM) annotates leaf midlines in rendered orthographic views. Deterministic geometric algorithms back-project the annotations onto the point cloud, merge them into 3D leaves by cross-view consensus, and grow the midlines to full blades on an orientation-weighted surface graph. Measured organ parameters populate a plant descriptor for a Non-Uniform Rational B-Spline (NURBS)-based procedural model generator. Each leaf surface is then refined against its scan points by differentiable NURBS fitting. The pipeline reached a median whole-plant Chamfer distance of 5.4 mm on 100 genotypically diverse field-grown maize plants from the MaizeField3D dataset. The reconstructions were closer to the scans than those of an earlier semi-automated pipeline based on manual annotations. The pipeline recovered 1,017 of 1,023 (99.4%) curated reference leaves at an intersection-over-union of at least 0.5 without using those labels as input. These results show that VLM annotations become usable organ-level measurements when downstream geometric stages can correct them. This makes automated generation of editable 3D plant assets feasible at the scale of modern phenotyping experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出从原始 3D 点云端到端自动生成可编辑田间玉米程序化模型的流水线：多模态 VLM 在正交投影视图中标注叶中线，几何算法反投影并跨视图共识合并成 3D 叶片，再由可微 NURBS 拟合精修。在 MaizeField3D 的 100 株基因型多样田间玉米上，全株 Chamfer 距离中位数 5.4 mm，恢复 1,023 片参考叶中的 1,017 片（99.4%）且 IoU≥0.5，全程未使用这些标签作输入。
Motivation: 从扫描点云构建可编辑作物 3D 模型需要器官级分割与参数拟合，现有办法要么每株人工调参数数小时，要么依赖特定物种标签训练分割模型，难以支撑高通量表型与 in silico 育种试验。
Method: VLM 在渲染的正交视图上标注叶片中线；确定性几何算法把标注反投影到点云，按跨视图共识合并为 3D 叶片，并在方向加权 surface graph 上把中线生长为完整叶片；测得的器官参数填入 plant descriptor，驱动基于 NURBS 的程序化模型生成器，最后对每片叶面用可微 NURBS 拟合对其扫描点精修。
Result: 在 MaizeField3D 的 100 株基因型多样田间玉米上，全株 Chamfer 距离中位数 5.4 mm，重建结果比早前基于人工标注的半自动流水线更贴近扫描；在不使用参考标签作输入的条件下恢复 1,023 片精选参考叶中的 1,017 片（99.4%），IoU 至少 0.5。
Conclusion: 只要下游几何阶段能纠正 VLM 的标注，视觉语言模型标注就可转化为可用的器官级测量，从而在现代表型试验规模上自动生成可编辑 3D 植物资产。

papers.title: Preserving Anatomical Continuity: Three-Stage Pipeline for Colon Segmentation in 3D Abdominal CT Scans
papers.abstract_en: Accurate colon segmentation from CT images is essential for colorectal disease analysis, yet deep learning based methods often produce disconnected predictions due to complex anatomy. This study introduces a three-stage, topology-preserving segmentation pipeline to address this issue. The first stage performs initial deep learning-based segmentation, followed by centreline bridging to reconnect disjoint regions and a reconstruction stage to refine continuity. Evaluations on TotalSegmentator and RAOS datasets using overlap, distance and topology-based metrics demonstrate improved structural consistency while maintaining segmentation accuracy. The proposed method enhances topological integrity, enabling more reliable colon segmentation for clinical and research applications.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE 23rd International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging (ISBI), pp. 1-5. IEEE, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 三阶段拓扑保持分割流程在初始深度学习分割后先做中心线桥接 (centreline bridging) 重连断裂区域，再用重建阶段细化连续性，从而在保持重叠精度的同时提升结肠分割的结构一致性。
Motivation: 结肠解剖复杂，深度学习分割常给出彼此断开的预测，影响结直肠疾病的临床与研究分析。
Method: 三阶段流程：第一阶段做初始深度学习分割，第二阶段中心线桥接重连不相连区域，第三阶段重建细化连续性；在 TotalSegmentator 与 RAOS 数据集上用重叠、距离和拓扑类指标评测。
Result: 在 TotalSegmentator 和 RAOS 上，重叠、距离与拓扑指标评测显示结构一致性改善，同时保持分割精度。
Conclusion: 把中心线桥接与重建作为后处理可以提升结肠分割的拓扑完整性，得到更可靠的分割结果。

papers.title: When Is Accuracy Evidence? A Unified Theory of Generalisation, Validation, and Information Fusion
papers.abstract_en: K-fold cross-validation (CV) is widely used as evidence of out-of-sample performance, although folds are neither independent experiments nor equally informative under heterogeneous data. Cross Upper-Bound Validation (CUBV) replaces point-wise CV accuracy by conservative upper bounds on true risk. Here we generalise CUBV through a single exponential framework in which the moment-generating function of the generalisation gap is controlled by a cumulant envelope gamma(lambda). This yields a family of risk bounds covering Hoeffding-, Bernstein-, dependency-aware, PAC-Bayesian, and heterogeneous source-fusion settings. For K-fold CV, dependence between fold-wise gaps is modelled through a joint sub-Gaussian proxy matrix. Under equicorrelation, this gives an effective number of folds, Keff = K/[1+(K-1)rho], showing that increasing K does not necessarily increase statistical evidence when folds are strongly dependent. The framework is also extended to posterior distributions over predictors and weighted multi-source fusion, where weights are selected by minimising an upper bound on future risk rather than empirical error alone. Experiments with trained linear classifiers on heterogeneous multimodal Gaussian mixtures compare K-fold CV with full-sample resubstitution plus risk correction. Bounds are evaluated by coverage and tightness. In low-dimensional small-sample settings, K-fold partitioning can increase uncertainty because individual folds under-represent minority modes, while corrected resubstitution can remain valid and tighter; this effect disappears as sample size increases. Overall, gamma-CUBV separates observed performance, uncertainty, dependence, model complexity, and confidence into explicit terms, providing a unified route from CV scores to risk statements and a principled validation criterion for heterogeneous small-sample applications such as neuroimaging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 gamma-CUBV：用广义指数框架把泛化间隙的矩母函数交给累积量包络 gamma(lambda) 控制，把 K-fold CV 的点估计换成真实风险的保守上界。等相关假设下有效折数 Keff = K/[1+(K-1)rho]，说明折间强相关时增大 K 并不增加统计证据；在异构多模态高斯混合的线性分类器实验中，低维小样本时 K-fold 划分因少数模态欠代表而增大不确定性，而带风险修正的全样本重代入 (corrected resubstitution) 仍有效且更紧，该效应随样本量增大而消失。
Motivation: K-fold CV 被当作样本外性能证据，但各折既非独立实验，在异构数据下信息量也不等；点估计无法把依赖、复杂度与置信度分开陈述。
Method: 以累积量包络 gamma(lambda) 统一控制泛化间隙的矩母函数，导出覆盖 Hoeffding、Bernstein、依赖感知、PAC-Bayesian 与异构源融合的风险界族；折间依赖用联合 sub-Gaussian 代理矩阵建模，等相关下得 Keff = K/[1+(K-1)rho]；再扩展到预测器后验分布与加权多源融合，权重按最小化未来风险上界而非经验误差选取。
Result: 在异构多模态高斯混合上训练线性分类器，对比 K-fold CV 与全样本重代入加风险修正，按 coverage 与 tightness 评估界：低维小样本下 K-fold 划分会增大不确定性（单折欠代表少数模态），corrected resubstitution 仍有效且更紧；样本量增大后该效应消失。
Conclusion: gamma-CUBV 把观测性能、不确定性、依赖、模型复杂度与置信度拆成显式项，为 CV 分数到风险陈述提供统一路径，并给出面向神经影像等异构小样本场景的验证准则。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Generalization of Transformer-Based Neural Quantum States via In-Context Learning
papers.abstract_en: Neural quantum states based on modern deep learning architectures have emerged as powerful representations for quantum many-body systems. In particular, Transformer-based neural quantum states provide expressive models capable of capturing long-range correlations, and their empirical generalization performance has recently been demonstrated. However, a theoretical understanding of their generalization behavior remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we develop a theoretical framework to analyze the generalization properties of Transformer-based neural quantum states under in-context learning. We establish a rigorous inference-time generalization error bound in terms of mean squared error (MSE), showing that the pointwise prediction error decreases inversely with both the number of in-context examples and the depth of the Transformer. We further show that the Transformer depth required to achieve this guarantee scales only linearly with the system size--namely, the number of particles in continuous systems or the number of qudits in discrete systems. Building on this result, we extend our analysis to full quantum states formulated as rank-one density operators, and derive MSE-based generalization bounds over both continuous and discrete domains under physical constraints. Finally, numerical simulations corroborate our theoretical analysis.

papers.title: A Near-Zero Monitor Readout Is Not Evidence of Behavioral Control
papers.abstract_en: Post-training with verifiable rewards can induce reward hacking, motivating the use of monitors within the training objective rather than solely for offline auditing. We show that a low monitor readout does not identify whether such an intervention controls behavior. In a code-generation environment whose dominant exploit is available at the start of the reasoning trace, we train policies against three monitors that pass the same offline gate: an in-domain activation probe and two penalties conditioned on how early the policy commits to its own final answer. The probe score is at its numerical floor from the first recorded training step, and the trained-score median is zero for every prefix-trained run at the endpoint. These readouts estimate different quantities, and we do not compare their scales; within each monitor family, however, low values do not establish behavioral control. Within one fixed configuration, prefix-trained runs with the same zero-median trained score range, by seed alone, from a mixed regime with a low hacking share to near-pure reward hacking. All probe runs reach the hacking regime, but their floor-level readout reflects a mismatch between the position where the probe was validated and the position where it was read during training, not a second instance of this ambiguity. Text-level analysis identifies a prefix failure mode: generic planning and filler shells postpone the exploit past the cut without eliminating it from the final output. Low measured commitment therefore does not distinguish a low hacking share from delayed commitment to the exploit. Offline discrimination and low monitor-aligned readouts are insufficient evidence of behavioral control; an out-of-band behavioral check is required. We characterize the endpoint readout, not its evolution. Code is available at https://github.com/zhezhou1106/spoof-cost.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables. Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundations of LLM Post-Training in Changing Environments (FLLMPT)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在代码生成的 RL 后训练中，把 monitor 直接放进训练目标并不等于控制了行为：三个通过同一离线门槛的 monitor（in-domain activation probe 与两种按“策略提交最终答案早晚”施加的惩罚）都给出接近数值下限的读数，但同一固定配置下仅换随机种子，端点行为就从低 hacking share 的混合状态摆到近乎纯 reward hacking。结论是低 monitor 读数加离线区分度不足以证明行为控制，必须另做 out-of-band 行为检查。
Motivation: 可验证奖励的后训练容易诱发 reward hacking，于是人们把 monitor 直接嵌进训练目标而不只做离线审计；但低读数究竟对应行为被控制还是仅仅读错位置，此前没有判据。
Method: 在代码生成环境中（主导 exploit 在 reasoning trace 开头即可用），针对三个 monitor 训练策略：一个 in-domain activation probe，以及两个按策略提交自身最终答案的早晚施加的惩罚；三者都通过同一离线门槛。按 seed 重复训练，并对端点输出做 text-level 分析定位前缀失败模式。
Result: probe 分数从第一个记录的训练步起就停在数值下限，所有 prefix-trained run 在端点的 trained-score 中位数为 0；同一固定配置下，trained-score 中位数同为 0 的 prefix-trained run 仅凭 seed 就从低 hacking share 的混合状态分布到近乎纯 reward hacking。所有 probe run 都进入 hacking 状态，其下限读数源于 probe 被验证的位置与训练中被读取的位置不一致。文本分析发现前缀失败模式：generic planning 与 filler shell 把 exploit 推迟到 cut 之后，但没有从最终输出中消除。
Conclusion: 离线可区分且 monitor 对齐读数低，都不构成行为控制的证据，需要 out-of-band 的行为检查；作者强调其刻画的是端点读数而非读数随训练的演化。

papers.title: Beyond Random Splits: Evaluating Drug-Target Affinity Models Under Chemically and Biologically Motivated Distribution Shifts Copy
papers.abstract_en: Drug-target affinity (DTA) prediction is widely used to prioritize candidate compounds before costly experimental screening. DTA models are often compared under a single data split, even though deployment may require extrapolation to new chemical series, new protein targets, or both. We ask whether the distribution shift used for evaluation changes which architecture appears best. We curate 718,800 unique drug-protein pairs from the ChEMBL and BindingDB datasets. We compare a Morgan-fingerprint + protein-CNN baseline with 12 controlled architectures that combine four drug representations with three ESM-2 interaction modes. Mean validation RMSE increases from 0.950 and 0.945 under scaffold and fingerprint-cluster OOD to 1.299 and 1.321 under protein-cluster and dual OOD. Model rankings are similar across the two chemical shifts (tau = 0.79), but agreement with scaffold OOD falls under protein OOD (tau = 0.39) and reverses under dual OOD (tau = -0.55). Held-out evaluation, repeated seeds, group-aware bootstrap analysis, and a size-matched control support the same conclusion: architecture selection depends on the form of extrapolation, not only on average error or training-set size. DTA benchmarks should therefore match the chemical and target shifts expected at deployment.
papers.comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Drug Discovery (AI4DD)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 718,800 个 ChEMBL 与 BindingDB 药物-蛋白对上比较 12 种受控架构与 Morgan 指纹 + protein-CNN 基线，发现评估所用的分布偏移类型会改变哪个架构看起来最好：化学偏移下模型排序基本一致（Kendall tau = 0.79），换成蛋白偏移后与 scaffold OOD 的一致性降到 0.39，双重 OOD 下反转为 -0.55。作者据此主张 DTA 基准必须匹配部署时预期的化学与靶点偏移。
Motivation: DTA 模型通常只用单一数据划分比较，但部署需要外推到新化学系列、新蛋白靶点或两者兼有；若评估偏移类型选错，选出的架构在真实部署下可能并不最优。
Method: 整理 ChEMBL 与 BindingDB 共 718,800 个唯一药物-蛋白对，比较 Morgan 指纹 + protein-CNN 基线与 12 个受控架构（4 种药物表示 × 3 种 ESM-2 交互模式），在 scaffold、fingerprint-cluster、protein-cluster 与 dual OOD 四种划分下评估，并辅以 held-out 评估、重复种子、group-aware bootstrap 与 size-matched control。
Result: 平均验证 RMSE 从 scaffold OOD 的 0.950 与 fingerprint-cluster OOD 的 0.945 升至 protein-cluster OOD 的 1.299 与 dual OOD 的 1.321；模型排序在两种化学偏移间一致（tau = 0.79），与 scaffold OOD 的一致性在 protein OOD 下降至 0.39，在 dual OOD 下反转为 -0.55。
Conclusion: 架构选择取决于外推形式而非平均误差或训练集规模，DTA 基准应按部署预期的化学与靶点偏移来设计评估。

papers.title: Measure Less, Know More: Self-Supervised Test-Time Feature Acquisition
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in multimodal, high-dimensional learning has enabled foundation models to process heterogeneous, large-scale data. However, at test time, acquiring all features or modalities can be prohibitively costly and often redundant. Sequentially selecting informative modalities is therefore critical, yet challenging when the downstream task or prediction target is unknown. To this end, we introduce ECHO-$k$, a task-agnostic and self-supervised learning principle for modality acquisition: we use a deep model's internal pretrained representations (e.g., from a foundation model) as proxy targets that summarize cross-modal information. We provide theoretical guarantees in a stylized linear setting that motivate a reinforcement learning (RL) policy for sequential modality selection. Across task-agnostic and label-free acquisition baselines, ECHO-$k$ consistently improves budgeted downstream performance across diverse foundation-model backends. Our method provides a principled route to cost-aware test-time deployment, with implications for any multimodal system where measurements are expensive or time-constrained, and downstream tasks unknown a priori.
papers.journal_ref: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems, 40 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ECHO-k：测试时按预算顺序选择要采集的模态，用基础模型内部预训练表征作为代理目标做自监督学习，任务无关且下游目标未知也能用。在风格化线性设定下给出理论保证并据此设计强化学习 (RL) 采集策略，在多种基础模型后端上相对任务无关、无标签的采集基线一致提升预算受限的下游性能。
Motivation: 多模态基础模型测试时采集全部特征或模态代价高昂且冗余，而下游任务或预测目标事先未知，顺序选择信息量大的模态因此困难。
Method: ECHO-k 用深度模型内部预训练表征作为概括跨模态信息的代理目标，自监督地学习模态采集；在风格化线性设定下给出理论保证，据此驱动一个用于顺序模态选择的强化学习 (RL) 策略。
Result: 在任务无关、无标签的采集基线上，ECHO-k 在多种基础模型后端上一致提升预算受限的下游性能；摘要给出线性设定下的理论保证，未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 测试时模态采集可以做成任务无关的自监督决策问题，为测量昂贵或时间受限、下游任务事先未知的多模态系统提供成本感知部署路径。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: I2CD: Direct Image-to-Convex Decomposition for Simulation-Ready Collision Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Physics simulators and motion planners require convex collision geometry, yet image-to-3D generative models output dense, frequently non-manifold visual meshes. Bridging the two today takes a slow, brittle reconstruct-then-decompose pipeline of repair, decimation, and approximate convex decomposition. We present I2CD, which predicts a convex decomposition directly from a single RGB image. Rather than train a new image-to-3D model, I2CD freezes the pretrained Hunyuan3D-2 image-conditioned diffusion transformer and shape decoder and trains only a lightweight cross-attention head (38M parameters, under ten GPU-hours) whose learned "convex-slot" tokens emit the halfplane parameters of $K$ convex polytopes. The output is compact, convex by construction, and loads into physics engines without any post-processing, in ${\sim}0.5$s per image. On $227$ held-out OmniObject3D and Google Scanned Objects instances, I2CD attains the highest volumetric IoU among eight reconstruct-then-decompose pipelines while running $6$-$37\times$ faster end-to-end. In a cross-simulator study in MuJoCo, PyBullet, Genesis, and Isaac Sim, every engine uses I2CD geometry as delivered, whereas raw generated meshes "load" everywhere but are silently replaced by a different collision shape in most cases or need seconds to minutes of per-object preprocessing. On a physical xArm7, I2CD produces planner-ready geometry for a $20$-object cluttered scene in $11$s versus $328$s for the strongest baseline, at comparable pick-and-place execution success ($85$ vs. $90$ of $100$ trials).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: I2CD 从单张 RGB 图直接预测凸分解：冻结 Hunyuan3D-2 的图像条件扩散 Transformer 与形状解码器，只训一个 38M 参数的 cross-attention 头，用 convex-slot token 输出 K 个凸多面体的半平面参数，输出凸性天然成立、无需后处理即可进物理引擎，约 0.5 秒/图。在 227 个 OmniObject3D 与 Google Scanned Objects 实例上，其体积 IoU 在八条 reconstruct-then-decompose 流水线中最高，端到端快 6–37 倍；xArm7 上 20 物体杂乱场景 11 秒出几何（最强基线 328 秒），抓放成功率 85/100 对 90/100。
Motivation: 物理仿真与运动规划需要凸碰撞几何，而图像到 3D 生成模型输出的是稠密、常为非流形的视觉网格；现有 repair、decimation、近似凸分解的重建再分解流程慢且脆弱。
Method: 冻结预训练 Hunyuan3D-2 图像条件 diffusion transformer 与 shape decoder，只训练一个 38M 参数的轻量 cross-attention 头（不到 10 GPU 小时）；learned convex-slot token 直接发出 K 个凸多面体的半平面参数，输出凸性由构造保证，无需后处理即可加载进物理引擎。
Result: 在 227 个 held-out OmniObject3D 与 Google Scanned Objects 实例上，体积 IoU 为八条 reconstruct-then-decompose 流水线中最高，端到端快 6–37 倍，约 0.5 秒/图。MuJoCo、PyBullet、Genesis、Isaac Sim 跨仿真器研究中，各引擎直接使用 I2CD 几何，而原始生成网格虽都能加载，多数情况下被静默替换为不同碰撞形状，或需每物体数秒到数分钟预处理。物理 xArm7 上 20 物体杂乱场景 11 秒生成规划可用几何（最强基线 328 秒），抓放执行成功率 85/100 对 90/100。
Conclusion: 直接从图像回归凸分解可以取代慢而脆弱的重建再分解流程，产出各仿真器原样可用的碰撞几何，代价是抓放成功率略低于最强基线。

papers.title: Causal Representation Learning with Instantaneous and Lagged Relations via Nonstationarity
papers.abstract_en: Causal representation learning for time-series data aims to identify latent states and their causal relations from observations. In this setting, an important challenge is to model both lagged causal relations across observation intervals and faster causal effects that appear as instantaneous relations within an interval, while accounting for nonstationarity in time-series data. However, methods that jointly handle these causal relations and nonstationarity remain limited. To address this gap, we establish sufficient conditions for identifying latent states up to component permutation and component-wise invertible transformations, and their instantaneous and lagged causal structures up to the same permutation, using an observed auxiliary variable, such as time or a condition label, associated with changes in transition-noise distributions. Based on these results, we propose iCReN, a framework that uses contrastive learning with discrete or continuous auxiliary variables to learn latent representations and estimate their instantaneous and lagged causal structures. Experiments demonstrate accurate recovery of latent states and both instantaneous and lagged causal structures on synthetic data and the utility of the learned representations for downstream forecasting on real-world data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: iCReN 用观测到的辅助变量（时间或条件标签）引起的转移噪声分布非平稳性，同时识别潜变量状态及其滞后与瞬时因果结构；识别结果在分量置换与分量级可逆变换意义下成立。合成数据上潜状态与两类因果结构被准确恢复，真实数据上学到的表示对下游预报有用。
Motivation: 时间序列因果表示学习中，跨观测间隔的滞后因果与间隔内更快的瞬时因果效应需要同时建模，还要处理非平稳性；同时处理这三者的方法仍然有限。
Method: 先建立充分条件：借助与转移噪声分布变化相关的辅助变量（时间或条件标签），将潜状态识别到分量置换与分量级可逆变换，瞬时与滞后因果结构识别到同一置换。据此提出 iCReN 框架，用对比学习 (contrastive learning) 处理离散或连续辅助变量，学习潜表示并估计瞬时与滞后因果结构。
Result: 在合成数据上准确恢复潜状态以及瞬时与滞后两类因果结构；在真实数据上学到的表示对下游预报 (downstream forecasting) 有用。
Conclusion: 利用辅助变量驱动的非平稳性足以同时识别潜表示与瞬时、滞后因果结构，且该表示可迁移到真实数据的预报任务。

papers.title: Corrupted but Correct: Why Vision-Language Models Lie to Themselves Internally
papers.abstract_en: A targeted adversarial perturbation can drive a vision-language model's (VLM's) teacher-forced training loss for a fixed target caption to near zero, yet the same model, allowed to generate freely, produces the original, correct description with no trace of the target. We call this dissociation the train/inference gap, and give it a precise mechanistic account on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct using a controlled two-stage PGD attack on 200 held-out COCO images. First, we show that image-level pixel statistics, including a correctly re-implemented, texture-based attackability measure from the CNN robustness literature, have essentially no predictive power over which images are corrupted (best predictor r=-0.050, p=0.484; ridge regression R^2=0.069). Second, using the logit lens, we localise the gap to a single autoregressive step: the rank of the target token, conditioned on the correct first token already being generated, is fixed at exactly 3,488 out of 152,064 vocabulary entries for every image and every condition, with zero variance. Third, tracking target-token rank across all 28 LLM decoder layers reveals that the visual encoder corrupts every image's representation by a comparable margin regardless of eventual outcome, but the language model decoder then differentially arbitrates: amplifying the corrupted signal for susceptible images and actively suppressing it, past its clean-image baseline, for resistant ones (p<0.001, rank-biserial r=0.579). A linear probe on the merger hidden state separates these two outcomes with AUC=0.858, though we flag a circularity concern in this estimate. Together these results argue that adversarial robustness in autoregressive VLMs is substantially a property of the language decoder's prior, not the visual encoder, with direct implications for where faithfulness evaluations and defenses for deployed VLM systems should be targeted.
papers.comment: Accepted at the VLM4RWD Workshop (Grounded and Faithful Vision-Language Models for Real-World Deployment), NeurIPS 2026. 8 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 上用两阶段 PGD 对 200 张 COCO 图做定向对抗攻击，发现训练损失可被压到近零而自由生成仍输出正确描述，作者称之为 train/inference gap。该 gap 定位在单个自回归步：目标 token 在给定正确首 token 后的 rank 恒为 3,488/152,064、零方差；28 层追踪显示视觉编码器对所有图像的破坏幅度相当，真正区分成败的是语言解码器的先验——对易感图像放大、对抵抗图像主动压制到干净基线以下（p<0.001, rank-biserial r=0.579）。结论是自回归 VLM 的对抗鲁棒性主要来自语言解码器先验而非视觉编码器，防御与忠实性评估应瞄准解码器。
Motivation: 对抗扰动可以把 VLM 的 teacher-forced 训练损失打到近零，但模型自由生成时完全不受影响，这种训练与推理的脱节缺少机制解释，也使基于图像像素统计的攻击性预测和以视觉编码器为目标的防御失去依据。
Method: 在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 上对 200 张 held-out COCO 图像做受控两阶段 PGD 攻击；用 logit lens 在单个自回归步定位目标 token rank，并跨全部 28 个 LLM decoder 层追踪 rank 变化；比较图像级像素统计（含复现的 CNN 鲁棒性文献中的 texture-based attackability 度量）与 ridge regression 的预测力，并在 merger hidden state 上训练线性 probe 区分两类结果。
Result: 图像级像素统计几乎无预测力：最佳预测因子 r=-0.050（p=0.484），ridge regression R²=0.069。目标 token rank 在给定正确首 token 后恒为 3,488/152,064，零方差。视觉编码器对每张图像的破坏幅度相当，语言解码器对易感图像放大、对抵抗图像压制到干净基线以下（p<0.001, rank-biserial r=0.579）。merger hidden state 线性 probe AUC=0.858，作者标注该估计存在循环性问题。
Conclusion: 自回归 VLM 的对抗鲁棒性主要是语言解码器先验的属性而非视觉编码器的属性，因此忠实性评估与部署防御应针对解码器而非仅针对视觉编码器。

papers.title: Electronic Density versus Geometry for Machine-Learned Molecular Absorption Spectra
papers.abstract_en: Molecular optical absorption spectroscopy provides a direct probe of electronic structure and is widely used for molecular identification, interpretation of photophysical behaviour, and planning of spectroscopy experiments. Calculating the absorption spectra using first-principle excited-state methods, however, is computationally demanding, at least compared to ground-state calculations, which limits their routine application across large molecular sets. Machine-learning (ML) surrogates can reduce this cost and allow rapid spectral prediction. However, their performance depends strongly on how molecular information is represented. Here, we compare using the ground-state electron density versus the molecular geometry as inputs to a ML model for predicting absorption spectra, for a training set of 6874 molecules selected from the QM7 dataset. For each of these molecules, the density was calculated using density functional theory (DFT) and the absorption spectrum was calculated using linear-response (LR) time-dependent DFT (TDDFT). Utilizing the ground-state density as the input to the ML model is motivated by the Hohenberg-Kohn and Runge-Gross theorems, and the fact that the ground-state density encodes information about bonding, charge localisation, and electronic delocalisation. Hence, it may be a more judicious starting point for the ML model compared to the geometry, as it effectively decouples the chemistry of the ground-state. The question we test is whether the benefits of using the density outweigh the (notprohibitive) penalty of requiring an additional single-point DFT calculation for the density. We find that the density-based convolutional neural network achieves a validation correlation of 0.9926, compared with 0.9795 for the best geometry-based graph model, reducing the residual decorrelation, by approximately 64%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 QM7 的 6874 个分子上，用基态电子密度作输入的 CNN 预测 LR-TDDFT 吸收谱，验证集相关系数 0.9926，优于最佳几何输入图模型的 0.9795，残差去相关降低约 64%。结论是密度表征的收益足以抵消额外一次单点 DFT 计算的代价。
Motivation: 第一性原理激发态方法算吸收谱代价高，难以覆盖大分子集；ML 代理的性能又强烈依赖分子表征方式，几何输入未必编码了成键与电荷离域信息。
Method: 从 QM7 选 6874 个分子，用 DFT 算基态电子密度、用 linear-response TDDFT 算吸收谱作为标签；对比以密度为输入的 CNN 与以分子几何为输入的图模型，密度表征的动机来自 Hohenberg-Kohn 与 Runge-Gross 定理。
Result: 密度输入 CNN 验证相关系数 0.9926，最佳几何输入图模型 0.9795，残差去相关降低约 64%；训练集为 QM7 的 6874 个分子，标签由 LR-TDDFT 生成。
Conclusion: 基态密度是比几何更 judicious 的 ML 起点，其收益超过额外一次单点 DFT 计算的（并非不可接受的）开销。

papers.title: ChromaGS: Text-Driven Semantic Editing of 4D Gaussian Avatars
papers.abstract_en: We present ChromaGS, a method for real-time, language-guided color editing of animatable 3D Gaussian head avatars. Given a trained animatable avatar, users can instantly modify the color of semantic regions through natural language, with edits applied at render time and no retraining required. Our key insight is to augment each Gaussian primitive with learned soft assignments to semantic regions and decompose colors into region-level base colors and Gaussian-level residuals. This decomposition enables coherent color transfer: modifying a region's base color propagates naturally through all associated Gaussians while preserving fine appearance details encoded in residuals. A two-stage language pipeline translates text instructions into target colors, supporting both absolute specifications and relative adjustments. Unlike generative editing methods that may introduce unintended modifications, our approach provides deterministic, precisely localized semantic control. Experiments demonstrate faithful appearance preservation and intuitive interaction across diverse subjects. Project page and code are available at: https://a-canela.github.io/chromags/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ChromaGS 为可动画 3D Gaussian 头部 avatar 增加每个高斯基元的语义区域软分配，并把颜色分解为区域级 base color 与高斯级 residual，从而在渲染时用自然语言即时改色、无需重训练。改一个区域的 base color 会自然传播到该区域全部高斯，residual 保留细节；两阶段语言管线同时支持绝对色值与相对调整，且给出确定性、精确定位的语义控制而非生成式编辑的意外改动。
Motivation: 已训练好的可动画 3D Gaussian avatar 缺少免重训练、可精确定位到语义区域的颜色编辑手段，生成式编辑又会引入非预期改动。
Method: 给每个 Gaussian primitive 学习语义区域软分配，颜色分解为区域级 base color 加高斯级 residual；两阶段语言管线把文本指令译为目标色，支持绝对指定与相对调整，编辑在渲染时生效。
Result: 实验展示在多样被试上外观忠实保持与直观交互；方法提供确定性、精确定位的语义控制，避免生成式编辑的非预期修改。
Conclusion: 区域 base color 加高斯 residual 的分解可在不重训练的前提下实现连贯且可控的 avatar 颜色编辑，细节由 residual 承载。

papers.title: Depth Hypothesis Guided Iterative Refinement for Event-Image Monocular Depth Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Event cameras hold excellent dynamic properties, showing great potential for monocular depth estimation (MDE). However, existing methods mainly improve performance by optimizing contextual features, but still struggle with the ill-posed and nonlinear nature of direct full-depth regression. In this paper, we propose HypoDepth, the first event-image monocular depth iterative refinement framework. By introducing a discrete Depth Hypothesis Volume (DHV), we transform the depth regression problem into a constrained depth search task. Specifically, we construct a 3D cost volume between the DHV features and contextual features and perform a multi-scale correlation search to guide stable residual optimization. This lightweight cost volume enables efficient global-to-local refinement across multi-resolution. Our method outperforms existing approaches on DSEC and MVSEC with state-of-the-art results and strong zero-shot generalization. Meanwhile, our tiny model achieves an excellent balance between accuracy and efficiency, enabling real-time performance on resource-limited devices.
papers.journal_ref: CVPR2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HypoDepth 把事件-图像单目深度估计从直接全深度回归改成受约束的深度搜索：构造离散 Depth Hypothesis Volume (DHV)，与上下文特征建 3D cost volume 并做多尺度相关搜索，引导残差由全局到局部逐级细化。在 DSEC 与 MVSEC 上取得 state-of-the-art 结果并具强 zero-shot 泛化，tiny 模型在资源受限设备上实现实时。
Motivation: 现有事件相机单目深度方法主要靠优化上下文特征，仍受直接全深度回归的不适定性与非线性困扰，精度与部署效率难以兼顾。
Method: 提出 HypoDepth，首个事件-图像单目深度迭代细化框架：引入离散 Depth Hypothesis Volume (DHV) 把回归转为受约束搜索，在 DHV 特征与上下文特征之间构建 3D cost volume，做多尺度相关搜索以指导稳定的残差优化，轻量 cost volume 支持跨多分辨率的全局到局部细化。
Result: 在 DSEC 与 MVSEC 上超过现有方法，取得 state-of-the-art 结果并展现强 zero-shot 泛化；tiny 模型在精度与效率之间取得平衡，可在资源受限设备上实时运行。
Conclusion: 用离散深度假设加 cost volume 搜索替代直接全深度回归，是事件-图像单目深度在精度、泛化与实时性上同时成立的路径。

papers.title: The Shape of Speech: A Geometric Measure of Coarticulation for Speech-Driven 3D Facial Animation
papers.abstract_en: Speech-driven 3D facial animation can reproduce recognizable mouth poses. However, it can simplify the motion between them, and that motion carries coarticulation, the way the sounds around each sound shape its articulation. We introduce a geometric measure of this trajectory shaping: lip-path length compared with the shortest route through the vowel, consonant and vowel positions of a speech segment. In contrast to the endpoint chord, this consonant-aware route accounts for obligatory transit and avoids degeneracy, while preserving invariance to uniform motion gain. The measure needs only a forced alignment, so it applies where no ground truth exists. We demonstrate it on four state-of-the-art methods, one per architectural family, real-time and offline. All four trace flatter lip trajectories than captured speech. Against frame-rate-matched ground truth, DiffPoseTalk, ARTalk and FaceFormer show clear deficits, equivalent on this measure to removing 15-60% of real speech's fast articulatory component. CodeTalker is marginal on the primary measure and clear on a companion measure. A pre-registered study with 97 viewers and 3,523 judgments underpins the measured direction: controlled damping of real motion lowers the score and is penalized, whereas exaggeration shows no detected penalty over the tested range. Viewers also prefer real speech in 73.4% of sentence comparisons and, in the aggregate, on single words. Together, the measure, its calibration and the study identify a perceptually relevant loss of trajectory shaping and a concrete target for improving synthesized articulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于几何的协同发音 (coarticulation) 度量：用唇部轨迹长度与穿过音节段元音-辅音-元音最短路径之比，衡量语音驱动 3D 面部动画对音节间运动的简化。对四个 SOTA 方法的检验显示其唇部轨迹均比真实语音更平，DiffPoseTalk、ARTalk、FaceFormer 的亏缺相当于去掉真实语音 15–60% 的快速构音成分；97 名观看者、3,523 次判断的预注册研究证实压低真实运动会降低分数并被惩罚。
Motivation: 语音驱动 3D 面部动画能复现可辨识的嘴型端点，却会简化端点之间的运动，而这段运动承载着协同发音；缺少无需真值即可计算的客观度量来量化这种损失。
Method: 以强制对齐 (forced alignment) 得到元音、辅音、元音位置，计算唇部路径长度与该辅音感知最短路线之比；该路线计入必要过渡、避免退化，并对统一运动增益不变。在四个架构家族各一个 SOTA 方法（实时与离线）上演示，并以帧率对齐的真值、伴随度量及预注册观看者研究做校准。
Result: 四个方法的唇部轨迹都比捕获语音更平；相对帧率匹配真值，DiffPoseTalk、ARTalk、FaceFormer 在主度量上明显亏缺，相当于去掉真实语音 15–60% 的快速构音成分，CodeTalker 主度量边缘、伴随度量明显。预注册研究含 97 名观看者、3,523 次判断：受控压低真实运动使分数下降并被惩罚，夸大在测试范围内未检出惩罚；观看者在 73.4% 的句子对比中偏好真实语音，单词汇总上同样偏好。
Conclusion: 合成语音驱动面部动画存在可感知的轨迹塑形损失，该几何度量给出了改进合成构音的具体量化目标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OptiSelect: How does the Optimizer Shape Data Curriculum?
papers.abstract_en: Online data selection has demonstrated substantial efficiency gains for LLM pretraining by training on the most valuable candidates within each batch. Since a candidate's value is realized through its effective model update, principled selection should account for the optimizer step, which reshapes the raw gradient before it updates model parameters. We formalize this optimizer-aware selection paradigm as OptiSelect and present the first systematic study of how the optimizer shapes data selection. Our theory establishes a selection gain principle in which the advantage of online selection is governed by the discriminability of the optimizer-induced utility scores. We prove that sign-based and polar-tangential preconditioners of Lion and Muon would suffer from a discriminability collapse which caps attainable gains from OptiSelect, whereas diagonal-adaptive optimizers such as AdamW and Sophia admit strictly better upper bounds. The proposed principle also yields a quantitative derivation of the optimal candidate oversampling ratio. Pretraining experiments on 124M and 720M models are consistent with our theoretical analysis and show that AdamW's diagonal-adaptive scoring geometry remains the strongest scoring geometry even with Muon as optimizer. We further demonstrate that OptiSelect retains its benefits under data rephrasing, a technique used in modern data processing pipelines. Our findings provide theoretical foundations and practical guidance for co-designing optimizers and data selection in LLM pretraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OptiSelect 把优化器步骤纳入 LLM 预训练的在线数据选择，理论给出选择增益由优化器诱导效用分数的可判别性 (discriminability) 决定：Lion 与 Muon 的符号型、极角正切型预条件会引发可判别性坍缩，从而封顶 OptiSelect 的可得增益，而 AdamW、Sophia 这类对角自适应优化器有严格更优的上界。124M 与 720M 预训练实验与理论一致，且即便实际用 Muon 优化，AdamW 的对角自适应打分几何仍是最强打分几何。
Motivation: 在线数据选择只按原始梯度估值，忽略了优化器会重塑梯度再更新参数，导致候选价值被错估；不同优化器的打分几何差异此前缺少系统研究。
Method: 将优化器感知选择形式化为 OptiSelect，建立以优化器诱导效用分数可判别性刻画在线选择优势的 selection gain principle；证明 Lion、Muon 的 sign-based 与 polar-tangential 预条件存在可判别性坍缩，AdamW、Sophia 等对角自适应优化器有严格更优上界，并由此定量推出最优候选 oversampling ratio。
Result: 在 124M 与 720M 模型预训练实验中结果与理论分析一致；AdamW 的对角自适应打分几何即使在以 Muon 为优化器时仍是最强打分几何；OptiSelect 在数据改写 (data rephrasing) 下仍保持收益。
Conclusion: 优化器与数据选择应联合设计：对角自适应优化器的打分几何带来更高可判别性与更大选择增益，符号型预条件会限制 OptiSelect 的上限。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Jumping the Line: Exploiting Length Predictions in LLM Scheduling
papers.abstract_en: Efficient request scheduling is increasingly important for reducing completion time in large language model (LLM) serving. Size-based policies such as Shortest Job First prioritize shorter requests, but output lengths are unknown before generation, so practical schedulers rely on predicted lengths. We introduce JIL, an attack on prediction-based LLM schedulers that manipulates the scheduling signal to obtain higher priority and reduce completion time. Using TRAIL as a case study, JIL optimizes an adversarial suffix that causes a lightweight output-length probe to underestimate a request's length. We evaluate JIL on two datasets and four LLMs across varied request profiles and deployment configurations. JIL reduces predicted output lengths by up to 83.4 percent, and adversarial requests complete up to 1.53 times faster on average in end-to-end serving experiments. The reduction in predicted length is substantially larger than the change in actual output length, revealing a mismatch between the scheduler's estimate and the request's realized size. Response utility varies across models and tasks, exposing a trade-off between scheduling advantage and response quality. We also evaluate scheduler-side defenses and find that grouping length predictions into coarse intervals reduces JIL's scheduling advantage and mitigates delays to benign requests.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JIL 是针对基于长度预测的 LLM 调度器的对抗攻击：优化对抗后缀使轻量输出长度探针低估请求长度，从而在 SJF 类调度中抢占更高优先级。在 2 个数据集、4 个 LLM 上，预测输出长度最多降低 83.4%，端到端服务实验中对抗请求平均最多快 1.53 倍完成；把长度预测分箱成粗区间可削弱该优势并缓解对良性请求的延迟。
Motivation: LLM 服务中 SJF 等基于长度的调度策略依赖生成前的长度预测，而预测值可被请求方操纵，进而破坏调度公平性与良性请求延迟。
Method: 以 TRAIL 调度器为研究对象，JIL 优化一个对抗后缀，使轻量输出长度探针 (output-length probe) 低估该请求的真实长度，从而在基于预测长度的调度中获得更高优先级；评测覆盖 2 个数据集、4 个 LLM、多种请求画像与部署配置，并测试调度器侧防御。
Result: 预测输出长度最多降低 83.4%；端到端服务实验中对抗请求平均最多快 1.53 倍完成；预测长度的降幅明显大于实际输出长度的变化，说明调度器估计与请求实际大小不匹配；响应效用随模型与任务变化，暴露调度优势与响应质量的权衡；将长度预测分组为粗区间可降低 JIL 的调度优势并缓解对良性请求的延迟。
Conclusion: 基于预测长度的 LLM 调度可被输入侧操纵，调度优势以响应质量为代价；粗粒度长度分箱是有效的调度器侧缓解手段。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Becoming Suspicious Across Borders: Algorithmic Extraterritoriality and AI-Driven Financial Surveillance
papers.abstract_en: Suspicion is an important, yet elusive concept in anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing (AML/CFT), which allows for intervention below the threshold of proof. In its traditional form, suspicion can be understood as a situated legal judgement by human actors within identifiable jurisdictions. It is argued that this understanding is no longer adequate. As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes an integral part of financial surveillance, suspicion is increasingly produced through data-driven processes. This transformation is epistemic, but also spatial. Since AI-driven financial surveillance operates through transnational data infrastructures, regulatory reach is less a matter of where conduct occurs than a question of whether such conduct becomes visible within data systems. This article develops the concept of algorithmic extraterritoriality, understood as a form of regulatory power mediated by data infrastructures rather than formal assertions of jurisdiction. Moreover, since individuals are increasingly constituted as datafied subjects of suspicion, they are rendered governable through dispersed and opaque processes of evaluation. This constitutes a challenge for accountability and contestability because suspicion becomes more difficult to locate, explain or contest.
papers.journal_ref: LAW, TECHNOLOGY AND HUMANS, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出“算法域外性”(algorithmic extraterritoriality) 概念：当 AI 驱动的金融监控经由跨国数据基础设施运作时，监管触及范围不再取决于行为发生地，而取决于该行为是否在数据系统中变得可见。怀疑 (suspicion) 因此从特定法域内的人类法律判断，转为分散、不透明的数据化评估流程，使怀疑难以定位、解释或申诉。
Motivation: 反洗钱与反恐融资 (AML/CFT) 中的“怀疑”原本是特定法域内人类行动者在证明门槛之下的情境化法律判断；AI 与跨国数据基础设施介入后，这一理解不再充分，问责与可争议性 (contestability) 面临挑战。
Method: 概念性法律分析：重构“怀疑”概念，提出算法域外性作为由数据基础设施中介（而非正式管辖权主张）的监管权力形式，并论证个体被建构为“数据化的怀疑主体”(datafied subjects of suspicion) 后经由分散且不透明的评估过程变得可治理。
Result: 给出概念性论证而非实验结果：监管触及由“行为是否在数据系统中可见”决定；怀疑因分散、不透明的评估流程而更难定位、解释或申诉，构成问责与可争议性挑战。
Conclusion: AI 金融监控下的怀疑已成为跨国数据基础设施的产物，其空间逻辑是可见性而非管辖权，这直接削弱了对怀疑的定位、解释与申诉能力。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 概念性法律分析：重构“怀疑”概念，提出算法域外性作为由数据基础设施中介（而非正式管辖权主张）的监管权力形式，并论证个体被建构为“数据化的怀疑主体”(datafied subjects of suspicion) 后经由分散且不透明的评估过程变得可治理。
summary_sections.result: 给出概念性论证而非实验结果：监管触及由“行为是否在数据系统中可见”决定；怀疑因分散、不透明的评估流程而更难定位、解释或申诉，构成问责与可争议性挑战。
summary_sections.conclusion: AI 金融监控下的怀疑已成为跨国数据基础设施的产物，其空间逻辑是可见性而非管辖权，这直接削弱了对怀疑的定位、解释与申诉能力。

papers.title: OuroReward: Sequential Reward Scheduling for Reinforcement Learning in Text-to-3D Generation
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) for Text-to-3D (T23D) generation requires optimization across multiple quality dimensions such as semantic alignment and texture clarity. Existing methods typically optimize these dimensions simultaneously through multiple reward aggregation, without explicitly modeling inter-dimension dependencies. This can cause imbalanced optimization and persistent interference among conflicting dimensions. To address this limitation, we propose OuroReward, an interference-aware sequential reward scheduling strategy for T23D RL. OuroReward first estimates pairwise dependencies among dimensions and constructs a cyclic optimization path that minimizes cumulative interference. By incorporating the tail-to-head dependency, the cycle captures global compatibility across the entire schedule. Then, OuroReward converts the cycle into a one-pass sequence, and starts optimization from the dimension with the lowest aggregate interference. Rather than assigning a fixed optimization budget to each dimension-wise reward, training adaptively determines when to advance to the next reward according to the remaining optimization headroom of the current one. We further introduce AdaSelect, an adaptive prompt selection strategy that identifies reliable and informative prompts aligned with the model's current capability. By focusing policy updates on these prompts, AdaSelect effectively improves training stability. Extensive experiments across different T23D models and RL algorithms demonstrate that our framework consistently improves generation quality across multiple dimensions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OuroReward 把 Text-to-3D 强化学习中多个奖励维度的联合优化改为干扰感知的顺序调度：先估计维度间成对依赖并构造累计干扰最小的环，再展开为单趟序列、从聚合干扰最低的维度开始，并按当前维度的剩余优化空间自适应推进。配套 AdaSelect 挑选与模型当前能力匹配的可靠提示词以稳定策略更新，在多个 T23D 模型与 RL 算法上一致提升各维度生成质量。
Motivation: 现有 T23D 强化学习把语义对齐、纹理清晰度等多个奖励维度同时聚合优化，不建模维度间依赖，导致优化失衡与冲突维度间的持续干扰。
Method: OuroReward 先估计各奖励维度的成对依赖，构造累计干扰最小的环并引入尾到头依赖以覆盖全局兼容性，再把环转成单趟序列、从聚合干扰最低的维度起步；各维度奖励不设固定预算，而是依据当前维度的剩余优化空间 (optimization headroom) 自适应决定何时切换。另提出 AdaSelect，按模型当前能力挑选可靠且信息量高的提示词，集中策略更新以提升训练稳定性。
Result: 在不同 T23D 模型与 RL 算法上的大量实验中，该框架在多个维度上一致提升生成质量；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把多奖励维度从同时聚合改为按干扰排序的顺序调度并自适应分配预算，可缓解维度冲突带来的优化失衡，配合能力匹配的提示词选择提升训练稳定性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Deep Bayesian REFoCUS
papers.abstract_en: In this work we formulate ultrasound multistatic recovery from arbitrary transmit sequences as a Bayesian inference problem. To that end, we train a deep generative prior on multistatic data sets to tackle the rank-deficient regime in which classical linear REFoCUS decoders fail. This appproach, which we term Deep Bayesian REFoCUS, outperforms the linear baselines for all regimes of rank-deficiency and noise levels, and regresses to linear decoding when inversion is exact. The model also expresses uncertainty in the null space of the acquisitions, whereas the linear REFoCUS decoders only provide point estimates. Finally, we analyze the impact of distribution shift between simulation and in-vivo acquisitions, showing remarkable generalization ability without any fine-tuning or adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把超声多静态成像 (ultrasound multistatic recovery) 的任意发射序列重建写成贝叶斯推断，用在多静态数据集上训练的深度生成先验替代经典线性 REFoCUS 解码器，在秩亏 (rank-deficient) 与噪声条件下均优于线性基线，并在求逆精确时退化回线性解码。模型还给出采集零空间 (null space) 上的不确定性，而线性 REFoCUS 只给点估计；仿真到在体 (in-vivo) 分布偏移下无需微调或适配即展现泛化能力。
Motivation: 经典线性 REFoCUS 解码器在发射序列导致的秩亏与噪声条件下求逆失败，且只能输出点估计，无法表达采集零空间中的不确定性。
Method: 将任意发射序列下的超声多静态恢复表述为贝叶斯推断问题，在多静态数据集上训练一个深度生成先验 (deep generative prior) 来处理秩亏体制，替代线性 REFoCUS 解码；并分析仿真与在体采集之间的分布偏移。
Result: Deep Bayesian REFoCUS 在所有秩亏程度与噪声水平上均优于线性基线，并在求逆精确时回归到线性解码；模型输出采集零空间上的不确定性（线性 REFoCUS 仅有点估计）；在仿真到 in-vivo 的分布偏移下无需任何微调或适配即展现显著泛化能力。
Conclusion: 深度生成先验能把 REFoCUS 从线性点估计解码扩展为带不确定性的贝叶斯重建，在秩亏与噪声下更稳、且对仿真到在体的分布偏移直接泛化。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Rethinking Epistemic Uncertainty in Node Classification through Information Growth
papers.abstract_en: Epistemic uncertainty should decrease as additional information about the data-generating process (DGP) becomes available to the predictor. Yet, existing graph evidential deep learning (EDL) methods for node classification typically construct epistemic uncertainty from graph-specific properties and evaluate it on downstream tasks such as out-of-distribution detection, which do not test its reducibility as information about the DGP increases. To make reducibility directly testable, we introduce a statistical framework for studying epistemic uncertainty under information growth. Our framework specifies an information-growth experimental protocol and a consistency criterion for epistemic predictors, while using projective graph DGPs to ensure that growing graphs, which in general need not provide increasing information about the same DGP, constitute coherent observations of the same underlying process. We show that EDL methods do not explicitly estimate data uncertainty arising from a single finite graph observation and instead regulate epistemic uncertainty through model hyperparameters, precluding consistency, as corroborated by controlled information-growth experiments. As an alternative, we propose graph bootstrap ensembles, capturing both data and procedural uncertainty through graph resampling and randomized training. Under the same experimental protocol, these ensembles exhibit epistemic uncertainty reduction beyond standard deep ensembles. These findings support bootstrap ensembles as candidate consistent epistemic predictors under information growth.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 图节点分类的 evidential deep learning (EDL) 把认知不确定性当成图结构属性并靠超参数调节，随信息增长不收敛；论文提出信息增长实验协议与一致性判据，用 projective graph DGP 保证增长的图仍是同一过程的观测，并给出 graph bootstrap ensembles（图重采样 + 随机化训练）作为替代，在同一协议下其认知不确定性下降超过标准 deep ensembles。
Motivation: 现有图 EDL 方法用下游任务（如 OOD 检测）评估认知不确定性，却不检验它是否随关于数据生成过程 (DGP) 的信息增加而可约减；单个有限图观测带来的 data uncertainty 也没有被显式估计。
Method: 建立研究信息增长下认知不确定性的统计框架：定义信息增长实验协议与认知预测器的一致性判据，用 projective graph DGP 保证增长的图构成对同一底层过程的一致观测；对照方法为 graph bootstrap ensembles，通过图重采样与随机化训练同时刻画 data uncertainty 与 procedural uncertainty。
Result: 受控信息增长实验佐证 EDL 方法不显式估计单个有限图观测的 data uncertainty、而是通过模型超参数调节认知不确定性，因而不满足一致性；在同一实验协议下，graph bootstrap ensembles 的认知不确定性下降幅度超过标准 deep ensembles。
Conclusion: 作者认为 bootstrap ensembles 是信息增长下认知不确定性预测器的一致性候选，而基于超参数调节的图 EDL 路线无法满足一致性判据。

papers.title: Iterating Consistency Models: Stability, Error Bounds and Noise Schedules
papers.abstract_en: Consistency models (CMs) have become a leading approach for generating high-quality samples in few steps. However, adding steps can improve or degrade sample quality in ways that are highly sensitive to the schedule and that existing theory does not fully explain. To provide accuracy guarantees and guide CM sampler design, we analyze multistep CM sampling as a composition of noising and approximate denoising operators. Under explicit, verifiable stability assumptions, we derive a non-asymptotic error bound that separates contraction of the initialization error from accumulation of approximation error. The bound assigns distinct roles to the schedule: large early noise levels drive contraction, while small late noise levels control the residual bias. As a corollary, we obtain explicit constants for strongly log-concave and semi-log-concave targets. We further establish a complementary guarantee whose assumptions, one-step accuracy and stability, can be estimated for a given trained model. Experiments show that the contraction and approximation profiles entering our bounds can be reliably measured and closely match the predicted functional forms. Together, these results provide a meaningful convergence theory for multi-step CMs and a practical route to sampler design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把多步 consistency model 采样写成加噪与近似去噪算子的复合，在可验证的稳定性假设下推出非渐近误差界，把初始化误差的收缩与近似误差的累积分开。界给出噪声调度的分工：早期大噪声水平驱动收缩，后期小噪声水平控制残余偏差；实验测得的收缩与近似剖面与预测函数形式吻合。
Motivation: 多步 CM 采样中增加步数可能提升也可能损害样本质量，且对噪声调度高度敏感，现有理论无法解释这一现象，也缺少指导 sampler 设计的精度保证。
Method: 将多步 CM 采样分析为 noising 与 approximate denoising 算子的复合，在显式可验证的稳定性假设下推导非渐近误差界，分离初始化误差收缩与近似误差累积；作为推论给出强对数凹与半对数凹目标下的显式常数，并补充一条可针对已训练模型估计其单步精度与稳定性的保证。
Result: 误差界把调度的作用拆为早期大噪声驱动收缩、后期小噪声控制残余偏差；对强对数凹与半对数凹目标得到显式常数；实验测得进入界的收缩与近似剖面可稳定测量，且与预测的函数形式密切吻合。
Conclusion: 多步 CM 可以有一套有意义的收敛理论，并由此给出实用的 sampler 设计路径：调度按收缩段与残余偏差段分别调参。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: AIBL: Augmented Instance-Based Learning with Structured Memory and Neural Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Sequential learning systems often make decisions from accumulated experience while receiving high-dimensional inputs whose distribution may change over time. Instance-Based Learning Theory (IBLT) provides a principled case-based framework for such settings through stored situation-decision-utility instances, partial matching, activation, and blending. IBLT relies on symbolic knowledge representation in dictionary-like formats, but text, images, transaction vectors, and user-item histories often require learned similarity rather than hand-specified matching rules. In this paper, we introduce AIBL (Augmented Instance-Based Learning), an instance-learning model formulated in a learned vector space for high- dimensional sequential data. AIBL generalizes symbolic situation matching to neural embedding similarity while retaining instance storage, activation- weighted retrieval, and utility blending. The AIBL model organizes memory into active, forgotten, and surprise stores. Surprise memory separates weakly matched, possible out-of-distribution, or corner-case observations from active memory, reducing forced fitting to the nearest available cases. An observation-driven graduation algorithm promotes recurring surprise instances to active memory, allowing the memory to incorporate repeated novel patterns that may arise under concept drift. We evaluate the same implementation on five machine learning tasks and three controlled simulation tasks, comparing AIBL with classical IBLT variants and task-specific baselines where appropriate. AIBL improves accuracy by 6 to 17 percentage points. The results show where vector-space retrieval improves over symbolic matching and how the added memory mechanisms govern novelty detection, cold-start handling, drift adaptation, and reward learning under the tested protocols.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AIBL 把 IBLT 的符号化 situation 匹配换成神经 embedding 相似度，同时保留实例存储、激活加权检索与 utility blending，并用 active/forgotten/surprise 三库分离弱匹配与疑似 OOD 样本。在五个机器学习任务与三个受控仿真任务上，相对经典 IBLT 变体与任务专用基线，准确率提升 6 到 17 个百分点。
Motivation: IBLT 依赖字典式符号表示与手工匹配规则，而文本、图像、交易向量、用户-物品历史这类高维序列数据需要学习得到的相似度；同时概念漂移下的新奇样本会被强行拟合到最近已有案例。
Method: 在学习得到的向量空间中形式化 instance learning：保留实例存储、激活加权检索与 utility blending，把 situation 匹配推广为 embedding 相似度；记忆分为 active、forgotten、surprise 三库，surprise 库隔离弱匹配、疑似 OOD 与 corner-case 观测，再用 observation-driven graduation 算法把反复出现的 surprise 实例提升进 active 库。
Result: 在五个机器学习任务和三个受控仿真任务上，与经典 IBLT 变体及任务专用基线比较，AIBL 准确率提升 6 到 17 个百分点；测试协议下该记忆机制决定 novelty detection、cold-start 处理、drift 适应与 reward learning 的表现。
Conclusion: 向量空间检索在哪些情形优于符号匹配是可判定的，而 surprise 记忆加毕业机制能在概念漂移下把重复出现的新奇模式纳入 active 记忆，减少对最近案例的强行拟合。

papers.title: Contrastive Neural Embeddings Reveal Individual Traits Beyond Conversational Role
papers.abstract_en: Contrastive representation learning is increasingly used to recover low-dimensional structure from neural recordings, but its output is typically validated by decoding accuracy rather than by the geometry of the manifold it produces. We apply CEBRA to EEG recorded from dyads in conversation, and analyze the resulting embedding, which training constrains to the 2D sphere. Labels describing the dyads, including the absolute difference between partners' autism-quotient scores, decode well above chance (0.77 against a 0.55 majority baseline for binary AQ magnitude; 0.44 against 0.25 for the six-class $|Δ$AQ$|$ partition). However, the two permutation controls have notable differences in results: permuting labels over a frozen embedding yields p = 0.001, whereas retraining the encoder under each permutation yields p = 0.50. Only the latter tests the label rather than the geometry. Consistent with this, spherical mixture structure and per-class dispersion track identity rather than autism trait differences in dyads; frequency-band and non-oscillatory activity ablation controls do not change the results. However, participant-level model does separate from its identity-aware null (p = 0.0099) while speaker-versus-listener role analysis performs at chance in the same embedding, indicating a manifold organized by individual -- and, in contrast with current neurolinguistics models, almost invariant to speaking vs. listening. Based on these results, we suggest that retraining-based nulls should be the default for grouped-data contrastive embeddings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 CEBRA 对话 EEG 嵌入约束到 2D 球面后，标签解码看似成功（AQ 差二分类 0.77 对多数类基线 0.55，六类 |ΔAQ| 0.44 对 0.25），但置换检验方式决定结论：冻结嵌入置换 p=0.001，重训编码器置换 p=0.50。只有后者检验标签而非几何，因此作者主张分组数据的对比嵌入默认用重训式零模型。
Motivation: 对比学习在神经记录上的产出通常只用解码精度验证，而嵌入流形本身的几何是否承载标签信息未经检验；置换零模型的选择会直接改变显著性结论。
Method: 对双人对话 EEG 应用 CEBRA，训练时把嵌入约束到 2D 球面；用 dyad 标签（含自闭商数绝对差 |ΔAQ|）做解码，比较两种置换对照——在冻结嵌入上置换标签 vs. 每次置换后重训编码器，并加入频带与非振荡活动消融、参与者级模型与说话人/听者角色分析。
Result: AQ 差二分类解码 0.77（多数类基线 0.55），六类 |ΔAQ| 分区 0.44（基线 0.25）；冻结嵌入置换 p=0.001，重训编码器置换 p=0.50；参与者级模型与其 identity-aware 零模型可分 p=0.0099，而同一嵌入中说话人 vs. 听者角色分析处于随机水平；频带与非振荡活动消融不改变结果，球面混合结构与类内离散度追踪的是身份而非自闭特质差异。
Conclusion: 该流形按个体组织、对说话与倾听几乎不变，与当前神经语言学模型相左；分组数据的对比嵌入应默认报告重训式零模型，冻结嵌入上的置换只检验几何而非标签。

papers.title: ForestQuery: Boundary-Aware and Spatially Anchored Query Learning for Unified Forest Point Cloud Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Forest point cloud segmentation is fundamental for fine-grained 3D forest scene understanding, yet remains challenging due to irregular tree structures, severe occlusions, density variations, and ambiguous instance boundaries. Recent query-based forest segmentation methods have shown promise for unified semantic and instance prediction, but they still insufficiently exploit forest-specific spatial structure and account for boundary uncertainty. In this paper, we propose ForestQuery, a boundary-aware and spatially anchored query learning framework for unified forest point cloud segmentation. ForestQuery enhances instance and semantic query learning through two complementary designs. Specifically, boundary uncertainty is explicitly modeled to guide reliable instance query construction and modulate query optimization through adaptive loss reweighting. Meanwhile, spatially anchored semantic query enhancement (SA-SQE) introduces learnable 3D anchors encoding forest vertical stratification priors to enrich semantic queries with explicit spatial references. We evaluate ForestQuery on multiple public forest point cloud benchmarks and a self-collected annotated real-world dataset. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in both individual-tree segmentation and semantic segmentation across diverse forest scenes. Code and data are publicly available at https://zhan994.github.io/ForestQuery
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ForestQuery 把边界不确定性显式建模并用于实例 query 构建与自适应损失重加权，同时用可学习 3D 锚点编码森林垂直分层先验来增强语义 query（SA-SQE），实现统一的树木实例与语义分割。在多个公开森林点云基准和一套自采标注数据上，个体树分割与语义分割在多样林分场景中均取得一致提升。
Motivation: 森林点云结构不规则、遮挡严重、密度变化大且实例边界模糊，现有 query 方法未充分挖掘森林空间结构，也未处理边界不确定性。
Method: 两部分设计：显式建模边界不确定性以引导实例 query 构建，并通过自适应损失重加权 (adaptive loss reweighting) 调制 query 优化；空间锚定语义 query 增强 (SA-SQE) 引入编码森林垂直分层先验的可学习 3D 锚点，为语义 query 提供显式空间参照。
Result: 在多个公开森林点云基准与一套自采标注真实数据集上，个体树分割与语义分割在多样森林场景中均取得一致改进。
Conclusion: 把边界不确定性与森林垂直分层先验显式注入 query 学习，可同时改善统一的实例与语义分割。

papers.title: 16-bit Precision of Convolutional Neural Networks on Microcontroller Units for 8-bit Costs
papers.abstract_en: To deploy deep neural networks on edge hardware, highly efficient inference schemes are necessary that retain high accuracy. This work presents W16A16, a high precision (16-bit), fast speed, low energy quantization method. On a widely applied microcontroller architecture Armv7E-M, our proposed approach achieves faster speed and lower energy consumption on layer- and model-level compared to alternative quantization schemes. We analyze the architecture of Armv7E-M, explain the underlying principles behind the performance advantages of 16-bit approaches, and evaluate the empiric quantization errors for regression and classification tasks, as well as empiric time- and energy consumption in MCU deployment. We observe ca.\ 10 times lower quantization errors compared to 8-bit quantization schemes while achieving similar or better inference times and energy consumption.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向 Armv7E-M 微控制器的 16-bit 量化方案 W16A16，在保持 16-bit 高精度的同时做到比 8-bit 方案更快、更省能。相比 8-bit 量化，其量化误差约低 10 倍，而推理时间与能耗持平或更优。
Motivation: 在 MCU 上部署深度网络需要在精度与速度、能耗之间取舍，通常只能靠降位宽换效率；本文要证明 16-bit 也能同时拿到高精度与低开销。
Method: W16A16 是一种 16-bit 权重与激活的量化方法；作者分析 Armv7E-M 架构、解释 16-bit 方案性能优势的原理，并在回归与分类任务上实测量化误差，同时在 MCU 部署中实测时间与能耗，与其它量化方案对比。
Result: 相比 8-bit 量化方案，量化误差约低 10 倍（ca. 10 times lower），同时推理时间与能耗持平或更好；在 Armv7E-M 上，层级与模型级速度和能耗均优于替代量化方案。
Conclusion: 在 Armv7E-M 这类 MCU 上，16-bit 量化可以不以速度和能耗为代价换取更低的量化误差，即精度与效率不必二选一。

papers.title: Beyond Entropy: Self-Diagnostic Multi-Role Token Optimization for Video Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has substantially advanced multimodal reasoning, yet it remains fundamentally limited by ambiguous token-level credit assignment. While high-entropy token heuristics encourage possibility exploration, naively extending them to video reasoning tends to induce lengthy reasoning, as the model becomes overly reliant on high-entropy visual activations. Alternative approaches that rely on counterfactual-based visual token localization for credit assignment also tend to over-prioritize visual exploration at the expense of decisive reasoning cues for answer derivation, thereby exacerbating the interference from spurious visual nuances. Moreover, these methods employ static counterfactual strategies that fail to co-evolve with the policy during training. In this paper, we introduce DyCPO, a co-evolutionary framework that jointly optimizes reliable token selection and adaptive counterfactual intervention. It constructs a multi-role dependence metric to balance visual exploration and answer-relevance mining in token-wise contrastive learning, while suppressing exploration-only filler tokens and spurious visual noise. Rather than relying on static counterfactual priors, DyCPO dynamically derives counterfactual signals from the model's own successful and failed rollouts, enabling self-diagnostic analysis and co-evolution of the optimization objective with the policy. Extensive experiments on complex video reasoning and general video understanding benchmarks demonstrate consistent performance improvements, establishing DyCPO as a robust token-level credit assignment paradigm for multimodal reinforcement learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DyCPO 把视频推理 RL 中的 token 级 credit assignment 改成自诊断的协同演化框架：用多角色依赖度量在 token 级对比学习里平衡视觉探索与答案相关性挖掘，同时压制纯填充 token 与伪视觉噪声，并从模型自身成功/失败 rollout 动态导出反事实信号，取代静态反事实先验。在复杂视频推理与通用视频理解基准上给出一致的性能提升。
Motivation: RLVR 在多模态推理上受限于模糊的 token 级 credit assignment：高熵 token 启发式易导致冗长推理，基于反事实的视觉 token 定位又过度偏向视觉探索、放大伪视觉细节干扰，且静态反事实策略无法与策略共同演化。
Method: 提出 DyCPO 协同演化框架，联合优化可靠的 token 选择与自适应反事实干预：构造多角色依赖度量 (multi-role dependence metric) 引导 token 级对比学习，平衡视觉探索与答案相关性挖掘并抑制填充 token；反事实信号由模型自身成功与失败 rollout 动态推导，实现自诊断并让优化目标与策略共同演化。
Result: 在复杂视频推理与通用视频理解基准上的大量实验显示一致的性能提升；摘要未给出具体数值、数据集名称或基线对比。
Conclusion: token 级 credit assignment 应当把可靠的 token 选择与自适应反事实干预一起协同演化，而非依赖静态反事实先验，作者据此将 DyCPO 立为多模态强化学习的鲁棒 token 级 credit assignment 范式。

papers.title: A Unified Framework for Bayesian Data Assimilation with Generative Models and Observation Interpolants
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian data assimilation combines model forecasts with noisy observations, but sampling high-dimensional, non-Gaussian posteriors remains challenging. We introduce an observation-interpolant framework that turns pretrained stochastic interpolant, flow matching, and diffusion models into posterior samplers without retraining. Conditioning the interpolant path on observations yields a shared likelihood-score correction to the drift or velocity, unifying stochastic and deterministic posterior sampling. The resulting SDEs and ODEs sample the exact posterior when the intermediate likelihood score is known. For practical computation, we approximate this score using a closed-form Gaussian surrogate with a bias-corrected mean and covariance inflated by the model's source covariance. Jacobian-free and ensemble-shared approximations make the method tractable in high dimensions. We evaluate the framework on linear-Gaussian dynamics, stochastic two-dimensional Navier-Stokes, and urban airflow with up to $O(10^4)$ degrees of freedom.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 observation-interpolant 框架，把预训练的 stochastic interpolant、flow matching、diffusion 模型在不重训的条件下变成贝叶斯数据同化的后验采样器：把插值路径对观测做条件化，得到共享的 likelihood-score 修正项加进 drift 或 velocity，从而统一随机 SDE 与确定性 ODE 两类后验采样。当中间 likelihood score 已知时对应 SDE/ODE 精确采样后验；实际计算用带偏差校正均值、协方差按源协方差膨胀的闭式高斯代理近似该 score，并配 Jacobian-free 与 ensemble-shared 近似使其在高维可用，最高到 O(10^4) 自由度。
Motivation: 贝叶斯数据同化需要把模式预报与含噪观测结合，但高维、非高斯后验的采样仍然困难；已有的预训练生成模型不能直接充当后验采样器。
Method: observation-interpolant 框架：将预训练的 stochastic interpolant、flow matching、diffusion 模型的插值路径以观测为条件，导出共享的 likelihood-score 修正并注入 drift/velocity，统一随机与确定性后验采样；中间 likelihood score 用闭式高斯代理近似（偏差校正均值 + 按模型源协方差膨胀的协方差），再用 Jacobian-free 与 ensemble-shared 近似处理高维。全程无需重训生成模型。
Result: 在 linear-Gaussian dynamics、stochastic 二维 Navier-Stokes、urban airflow 三类设定上评估，规模最高达 O(10^4) 自由度；当中间 likelihood score 已知时，所得 SDE 与 ODE 精确采样后验分布。
Conclusion: 观测条件化的插值路径能给出统一的 likelihood-score 修正，使预训练生成模型免重训地成为后验采样器，且高维可用性依赖高斯代理 score 与 Jacobian-free/ensemble-shared 近似。

papers.title: Bidirectional Voronoi-biased Exploration Curriculum for Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon tasks with sparse rewards pose an exploration bottleneck for goal-conditioned reinforcement learning: a policy started from the initial state rarely reaches the goal and receives no learning signal. Reference motions, hand-designed curricula, and shaped rewards supply this signal but require demonstrations or task-specific engineering; automatic start-state and goal curricula avoid this but typically expand from one side only, so the full distance to the target must be covered from that side. We propose the Bidirectional Voronoi-biased Exploration curriculum for Reinforcement learning (BVER), which expands from both ends at once. Inspired by bidirectional RRT planning, BVER grows start states outward from the goal and goals outward from the initial state distribution, biases both toward unexplored task space, and steers them toward each other, training one goal-conditioned policy on both. On point-mass mazes, quadrupedal box climbing, and robot-arm ring-on-peg transfer, BVER learns faster than all compared reference-free curricula. On box climbing, it reaches 95% success on a 0.4 m box in roughly 65% fewer iterations than the best of them, is the only one of them to learn to climb a 0.7 m box, and yields a policy robust to start, goal, and yaw variation. Without a demonstration, it approaches the sample efficiency of reference-based curricula on the 0.4 m box and on ring-on-peg transfer. Ablations show that expanding from both ends outperforms either direction alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出双向 Voronoi 偏置探索课程 BVER：像双向 RRT 那样同时从目标侧向外生长起始状态、从初始状态分布向外生长目标，偏向未探索任务空间并让两端相向靠拢，训练同一个 goal-conditioned 策略。在点质量迷宫、四足爬箱与机器人套环任务上，BVER 学得快于全部无参考课程；0.4 m 箱子达到 95% 成功率所需迭代比最优者少约 65%，且是唯一学会爬 0.7 m 箱的方法。
Motivation: 稀疏奖励长程任务中，从初始状态出发的策略几乎到不了目标、拿不到学习信号；参考动作、手工课程和塑形奖励需要演示或任务定制工程，而自动课程通常只从一端扩张，必须单侧覆盖全程距离。
Method: BVER 借鉴双向 RRT 规划：起始状态从目标侧向外生长、目标从初始状态分布侧向外生长，两者都偏向未探索任务空间并互相引导，最终用同一个 goal-conditioned 策略在两端样本上训练；消融对比只从单方向扩张的设置。
Result: 在点质量迷宫、四足爬箱 (box climbing) 和机器人 ring-on-peg 任务上，BVER 学习快于所有对比的无参考课程；爬箱任务中约用少 65% 的迭代在 0.4 m 箱上达到 95% 成功率，且是唯一学会 0.7 m 箱的方法，所得策略对起始、目标与 yaw 变化鲁棒；无演示时在 0.4 m 箱与 ring-on-peg 上逼近基于参考课程的样本效率；消融显示双向扩张优于任一单方向。
Conclusion: 同时从两端扩张并互相引导，是无演示条件下提升稀疏奖励 goal-conditioned RL 探索效率的关键，单向课程会浪费在单侧覆盖全程距离上。

papers.title: Native Action-Prior Learning from Videos for World Action Models
papers.abstract_en: World action models integrate future visual dynamics with robot action prediction, but their scalability remains limited by the need for action-annotated robot trajectories. Observation-only videos contain rich evidence about interaction dynamics, but existing approaches typically use them either to pretrain visual representations that must later be adapted for control, or to infer latent actions that are subsequently grounded to robot commands. We present NAVA-WAM, which introduces native action-prior learning by directly pretraining the action policy from observation-only videos, avoiding indirect representation-to-control transfer or a separate latent-action model. Our training consists of two stages. First, we pretrain on observation-only videos, where future-video flow-matching supervision over visual transitions is propagated through transition-structured joint attention to optimize the Action-DiT and learn action-relevant priors. Second, we use action-labeled demonstrations to post-train the Action-DiT for robot control through joint video--action flow matching, while asymmetric attention decouples the visual branch from iterative action denoising and enables efficient action-only inference. Extensive experiments show that NAVA-WAM consistently outperforms prior approaches under both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings, while demonstrating strong action-label efficiency and effective real-robot generalization. These results establish native action-prior learning as an effective approach to directly pretrain action policies from observation-only videos, providing a scalable path beyond action-labeled robot data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NAVA-WAM 直接从纯观察视频预训练动作策略，绕过「先学视觉表征再适配控制」或「先推隐式动作再对齐机器人指令」的间接路径。两阶段训练先用未来视频 flow matching 监督经 transition-structured joint attention 优化 Action-DiT，再用带动作标注的演示做 joint video-action flow matching 后训练；实验显示其在分布内与分布外设定下均稳定超越先前方法，并体现动作标签效率与真机泛化能力。
Motivation: 世界动作模型 (world action model) 的扩展受限于需要带动作标注的机器人轨迹；纯观察视频虽含丰富交互动力学证据，现有用法要么只预训练视觉表征再适配控制，要么先推隐式动作再接地到机器人指令，均属间接迁移。
Method: 两阶段训练：第一阶段在纯观察视频上，以未来视频 flow-matching 监督视觉转变，经 transition-structured joint attention 传播来优化 Action-DiT 并学习动作相关先验；第二阶段用带动作标注的演示对 Action-DiT 做机器人控制的后训练，采用 joint video-action flow matching，其中非对称注意力 (asymmetric attention) 把视觉分支与迭代动作去噪解耦，实现仅动作的高效推理。
Result: 在分布内与分布外设定下均持续优于先前方法，并展示出强动作标签效率与有效的真机泛化；摘要未给出具体数值、数据集或基线名称。
Conclusion: 原生动作先验学习 (native action-prior learning) 可以直接从纯观察视频预训练动作策略，为超越动作标注机器人数据提供一条可扩展路径。
Relevance: 2
