papers.title: DriftTTS: Few-Step Text-to-Speech Without Distillation via Distribution-Matching Drift
papers.abstract_en: Few-step neural text-to-speech models often rely on short- ened diffusion or flow-matching schedules, or on distillation from pretrained multi-step teachers. To avoid these depen- dencies, we present DriftTTS, a few-step mel-spectrogram generator trained without a generative teacher, distillation, or adversarial discrimination. DriftTTS uses a distribution- matching drift objective in a mel-domain feature space defined by raw mels and a frozen masked-autoencoder encoder pretrained on the same LJSpeech training split. On-policy rollout trains the decoder on its own interme- diate states and supports inference up to the trained roll- out depth. On LJSpeech, DriftTTS at NFE=4 achieves 3.87 dB MCD and 3.7% WER, compared with 3.85 dB and 3.4% for Matcha-TTS. In a fully paired blind listen- ing test, DriftTTS obtains 4.18 MOS, compared with 3.96 for Matcha-TTS and 4.22 for ground truth. These results demonstrate competitive few-step synthesis without a pre- trained generative teacher. Code can be found at https: //github.com/BASHLab/driftTTS.git
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DriftTTS 用分布匹配漂移目标 (distribution-matching drift) 在 mel 域训练少步语音生成器，无需生成式教师、蒸馏或对抗判别。在 LJSpeech 上 NFE=4 时 MCD 3.87 dB、WER 3.7%，盲听 MOS 4.18，接近 Matcha-TTS 的 3.85 dB/3.4%/3.96。
Motivation: 少步 TTS 依赖缩短的 diffusion/flow-matching 调度或从多步教师蒸馏，两者都要求已有生成式教师或人工设计调度。
Method: 在 mel 域定义分布匹配漂移目标，特征空间由原始 mel 与同一 LJSpeech 训练集上预训练的冻结 masked-autoencoder 编码器构成；on-policy rollout 让解码器在自身中间状态上训练，推理可推进到训练过的 rollout 深度。
Result: LJSpeech 上 DriftTTS NFE=4：MCD 3.87 dB、WER 3.7%（Matcha-TTS 3.85 dB、3.4%）；完全配对盲听测试 MOS 4.18，Matcha-TTS 3.96，ground truth 4.22。
Conclusion: 不借助预训练生成式教师也能做到有竞争力的少步合成，on-policy rollout 支持推进到训练深度的推理。

papers.title: From Patching to Pruning Visual Computation in Vision Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision language models (VLMs) incur substantial inference cost because every visual token is processed by the attention and MLP projections of every decoder layer, even when token-specific visual computation is unnecessary at many depths. We introduce Patch-to-Prune (P2P), inspired by Mechanistic Interpretability, a training-free framework that converts activation patching from a diagnostic tool into an inference-time computation bypass. P2P performs validation-guided forward and backward layer sweeps to identify decoder regions whose visual-token projection outputs can be replaced by fixed neutral proxy activation vectors within a user-specified accuracy tolerance. Unlike conventional token-pruning methods, P2P preserves the sequence length, token order, positional information, attention mask, and residual pathways, thereby pruning computation without removing tokens or modifying the pretrained model weights. We evaluate P2P on four VLMs from the Qwen2.5-VL and LLaVA families across seven multi-modal benchmarks using mutually disjoint calibration, validation, and test partitions. P2P at a 3% tolerance retains around 94% of dense accuracy while reducing FLOPs by 55%. Beyond these efficiency gains, our layer-wise analysis suggests that visual processing in VLMs is non-uniformly distributed across decoder depth: early and late layers often require little token-specific visual computation, whereas intermediate layers appear to perform most task-relevant visual integration, enabling later reasoning to rely largely on visual information already embedded in shared residual and textual representations. This makes P2P both an efficient inference framework and a causal lens into visual information processing in VLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Patch-to-Prune (P2P) 把 activation patching 从诊断工具变成推理期计算旁路：用验证引导的前后向层扫描，把可省略的视觉 token 投影输出替换为固定中性代理激活，在不删 token、不改权重的前提下剪掉计算。在 Qwen2.5-VL 与 LLaVA 两族四个 VLM、七个多模态基准上，3% 精度容差下保留约 94% 稠密精度同时 FLOPs 降低 55%。
Motivation: VLM 推理中每个视觉 token 都要过每一层 decoder 的 attention 与 MLP 投影，但很多深度上 token 特异的视觉计算并无必要，造成大量冗余推理开销。
Method: P2P 是 training-free 框架：做 validation-guided 的前向与后向层扫描，找出其视觉 token 投影输出可用固定中性代理激活向量替换的 decoder 区域，且满足用户指定的精度容差；保留序列长度、token 顺序、位置信息、attention mask 与残差通路，不改动预训练权重。校准、验证、测试划分互不相交，在四个 VLM 上评测。
Result: 在 Qwen2.5-VL 与 LLaVA 家族共四个 VLM、七个多模态基准上，P2P 在 3% 容差下保留约 94% 的 dense accuracy，同时 FLOPs 减少 55%。逐层分析显示视觉处理在 decoder 深度上分布不均：早期与晚期层常只需很少的 token 特异视觉计算，中间层承担大部分任务相关的视觉整合。
Conclusion: VLM 的视觉计算可按层剪枝而不删 token 或改权重，同时 P2P 可作为因果视角说明后续推理主要依赖已嵌入共享残差与文本表征中的视觉信息。

summary_sections.result: 在 Qwen2.5-VL 与 LLaVA 家族共四个 VLM、七个多模态基准上，P2P 在 3% 容差下保留约 94% 的 dense accuracy，同时 FLOPs 减少 55%。逐层分析显示视觉处理在 decoder 深度上分布不均：早期与晚期层常只需很少的 token 特异视觉计算，中间层承担大部分任务相关的视觉整合。
summary_sections.conclusion: VLM 的视觉计算可按层剪枝而不删 token 或改权重，同时 P2P 可作为因果视角说明后续推理主要依赖已嵌入共享残差与文本表征中的视觉信息。

papers.title: Benchmarking Candidate Coverage in Typed Decision Models
papers.abstract_en: Typed decision models return choices or distributions over answer options supplied at request time. Accuracy with complete options does not establish whether a model recognizes that a reference answer is missing or avoids rejecting valid candidates. We present a paired candidate-coverage benchmark protocol and an initial evaluation of Laya and Jev across AG News, DBpedia, Emotion, and TREC. The models receive identical frozen texts and requests: 300 calibration and 589 test texts yield 23,932 predictions per model. Present/absent pairs match ordinary candidate count, and name variants preserve descriptions, members, and order. Native rejection behavior differs sharply: at five TREC candidates with natural names, Laya detects 97.2% of missing-answer cases but falsely rejects 69.7% of present controls; Jev's rates are 24.8% and 0.0%. Calibration-only none-score thresholds change these rates to 33.9%/3.7% and 45.0%/1.8%, respectively. On DBpedia, Jev's high coverage-score AUROC supports a stronger operating point, whereas both models have weak complete-set accuracy on Emotion. Competence-conditioned analysis, probability-precision sensitivity, and interface audits show why classification, score ranking, and rejection policies need separate measurement. This initial benchmark is descriptive and limited to reference-label omission; it does not establish natural out-of-scope generalization, causal mechanisms, or a new rejection method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出配对候选覆盖 (candidate-coverage) 基准协议，用 present/absent 成对请求检验 typed decision model 是否能识别参考答案缺失、又不误拒有效候选。在 AG News、DBpedia、Emotion、TREC 上评测 Laya 与 Jev：TREC 五个自然名候选时 Laya 原生检出 97.2% 缺失案例但误拒 69.7% 的 present 对照，Jev 为 24.8%/0.0%；仅用校准集的 none-score 阈值把两组改成 33.9%/3.7% 与 45.0%/1.8%。
Motivation: 在完整候选集上测准确率，无法说明模型能否察觉参考答案缺失、或是否会拒绝本应有效的候选；分类、分数排序与拒绝策略此前被混在同一指标里衡量。
Method: 配对候选覆盖协议：present/absent 对在候选数量上对齐，name variant 保留描述、成员与顺序；模型接收完全相同的冻结文本与请求，300 条校准文本加 589 条测试文本，每模型 23,932 次预测；阈值只在校准集上按 none-score 选定，并辅以 competence-conditioned 分析、概率精度敏感性与接口审计。
Result: TREC 五个自然名候选下，Laya 原生检出 97.2% 缺失案例、误拒 69.7% present 对照，Jev 为 24.8% 与 0.0%；校准阈值后 Laya 变为 33.9%/3.7%，Jev 变为 45.0%/1.8%。DBpedia 上 Jev 的 coverage-score AUROC 支持更强操作点；Emotion 上两模型完整集准确率都弱。
Conclusion: 分类准确率、分数排序与拒绝策略必须分开测量；该基准是描述性的，仅覆盖参考标签缺失，不建立自然的 out-of-scope 泛化、因果机制或新的拒绝方法。

papers.title: CVE2AP: Automated Generation of PDDL-Encoded Attack Paths via Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Attack Path (AP) modeling is fundamental to cybersecurity analysis, where the Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL) has been widely adopted to encode APs into formal and machine-verifiable representations for automated reasoning about vulnerability exploitation, attack progression, and their potential impacts. However, existing AP modeling approaches largely rely on expert-driven manual construction, limiting their scalability and ability to keep pace with rapidly evolving cyber threats. Large language models (LLMs) are promising candidates, as their extensive pre-trained knowledge and reasoning capabilities enable them to interpret and transform threat intelligence into formal representations. In this paper, we propose \textbf{CVE2AP}, an LLM-based approach for automatically generating PDDL-encoded attack paths from natural language CVE (Common Vulnerability Exposure) descriptions. CVE2AP leverages structured prompting and incorporates an error-feedback mechanism that iteratively refines the generated paths using planner-reported syntactic and solvability errors. We conduct a systematic empirical evaluation across multiple LLMs and generation configurations, assessing generation quality across syntactic, solvability and semantic dimensions, together with token consumption and generation time. The results demonstrate that CVE2AP effectively generates high-quality PDDL-encoded attack paths, achieving up to 86.9\% syntax correctness, 78.6\% solvability, and 93.1\% semantic correctness under LLM-as-expert evaluation, while \texttt{GPT-5.5} offers the best quality-cost trade-off and error feedback yields the most consistent quality improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CVE2AP 用 LLM 把自然语言 CVE 描述自动转成 PDDL 编码的攻击路径，靠结构化提示加 planner 报错的迭代纠错回路精修结果。在多 LLM 与生成配置的经验评估中，语法正确率最高 86.9%、可解性 78.6%、语义正确率 93.1%（LLM-as-expert 评估），GPT-5.5 质量-成本权衡最佳，error feedback 带来的质量提升最稳定。
Motivation: 攻击路径建模依赖专家手工构造 PDDL，扩展性差，跟不上快速演化的网络威胁，需要把威胁情报自动转成机器可验证的形式化表示。
Method: CVE2AP 对自然语言 CVE 描述施加结构化 prompting 生成 PDDL 攻击路径，并引入 error-feedback 机制，用 planner 报告的语法错误与可解性错误迭代精修；在多个 LLM 与生成配置上做系统经验评估，从语法、可解性、语义三个维度以及 token 消耗和生成时间衡量质量。
Result: 在 LLM-as-expert 评估下，语法正确率最高 86.9%、可解性 78.6%、语义正确率 93.1%；GPT-5.5 提供最好的质量-成本权衡，error feedback 带来最一致的质量提升；评估同时记录 token 消耗与生成时间。
Conclusion: LLM 加 planner 报错反馈可以自动生成高质量 PDDL 攻击路径，摆脱专家手工构造；在所测配置中 GPT-5.5 是质量与成本的最佳折中，error feedback 是最稳定的提质手段。

papers.title: Interpretable Deepfake Detection in Videos via Explicit Forensic Features and Temporal Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Deepfake detection in videos remains challenging, as manipulated content may appear visually consistent at the frame level while exhibiting subtle temporal inconsistencies. This paper introduces an interpretable deepfake detection framework that models spatially and temporally coherent facial features in video sequences. Unlike end-to-end deep models relying on implicit representations, the proposed approach explicitly encodes physically grounded forensic cues, enabling transparent analysis and improved multi-dataset generalization. The pipeline transforms videos into identity-consistent facial trajectories, segments them into fixed-length temporal windows, and represents each frame using 68 structured descriptors spanning four complementary domains: photometric, textural, geometric, and compression-based features. These descriptors provide a compact multi-domain representation of manipulation artifacts and are processed by a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network to capture temporal dependencies and subtle irregularities. Evaluation on four benchmark datasets, FaceForensics++, Celeb-DF v2, a curated subset of the DeepFake Detection Challenge (DFDC), and DeeperForensics, yields strong and consistent F1-scores of 98.0%, 91.0%, 97.6%, and 96.2%, respectively. The approach also demonstrated a good cross-dataset generalization, providing a robust and interpretable solution for video deepfake detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可解释的视频 deepfake 检测框架：把视频转成身份一致的人脸轨迹，切定长时间窗，每帧用 68 个跨光度、纹理、几何、压缩四域的结构化取证描述子表示，再送入 LSTM 建模时序不一致。在 FaceForensics++、Celeb-DF v2、DFDC 精选子集与 DeeperForensics 四个基准上 F1 分别为 98.0%、91.0%、97.6%、96.2%，并展示跨数据集泛化。
Motivation: 视频 deepfake 在帧级视觉上可能完全一致，只有细微的时序不一致；端到端深度模型依赖隐式表示，既难解释也难跨数据集泛化。
Method: 流水线先将视频转为身份一致的人脸轨迹并切成固定长度时间窗，每帧用 68 个结构化描述子编码，覆盖 photometric、textural、geometric、compression-based 四个互补域，再由 LSTM 网络捕捉时序依赖与细微不规则。
Result: 在四个基准上 F1 分别为 FaceForensics++ 98.0%、Celeb-DF v2 91.0%、DFDC 精选子集 97.6%、DeeperForensics 96.2%，并展示了良好的跨数据集泛化。
Conclusion: 显式物理取证特征加时序建模能同时给出可解释的操纵伪证表示和强且一致的多数据集检测性能。

papers.title: Operator-informed initialization for Fourier features physics-informed neural networks
papers.abstract_en: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) typically exhibit spectral bias, where some frequencies of the target function converge more slowly than others. In this work, we analyze the training dynamics of Fourier Feature PINNs in the Neural Tangent Kernel regime to address this limitation. We derive an explicit evolution equation to estimate the residual error in the frequency domain, demonstrating that the convergence rate of specific frequencies is primarily governed by the product of the differential operator's symbol and the spectral density of the initialization weights. Leveraging this theoretical insight, we propose an informative initialization strategy that tailors the initial weight distribution to the specific PDE being solved. With this method, we can diminish the operator-induced spectral bias, balancing the convergence rates across the frequency spectrum and achieving better prediction accuracy. Numerical experiments on linear and nonlinear partial differential equations confirm that this initialization strategy improves learning dynamics and approximation accuracy across frequencies compared to standard initialization methods, with no additional training cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 Fourier Feature PINN 的谱偏差，论文在 Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) 制度下推导频域残差误差的显式演化方程，指出各频率收敛率主要由微分算子符号与初始化权重谱密度之积决定，并据此提出按目标 PDE 定制初始权重分布的算子知情初始化 (operator-informed initialization)。该初始化压低算子诱导的谱偏差、均衡各频率收敛速度，在线性与非线性 PDE 数值实验中相对标准初始化提升各频率的逼近精度，且不增加训练开销。
Motivation: PINN 存在谱偏差 (spectral bias)，目标函数的部分频率收敛明显更慢；此前缺少解释各频率收敛率由什么决定、并据此定向修正的理论刻画。
Method: 在 NTK 制度下分析 Fourier Feature PINN 的训练动力学，推导频域残差误差的显式演化方程，把频率收敛率分解为微分算子符号与初始化权重谱密度之积；据此设计按具体 PDE 定制初始权重分布的 informative initialization 策略，替代标准初始化。
Result: 在线性与非线性 PDE 的数值实验中，该初始化策略相比标准初始化改善了学习动力学与跨频率的逼近精度，并降低算子诱导的谱偏差、均衡各频率收敛率，且无额外训练成本；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 各频率收敛率由算子符号与初始化谱密度共同决定，因此按 PDE 定制初始权重即可在不增加训练成本的前提下缓解谱偏差、提升预测精度。

papers.title: EVEWorld: Physical Evolution Supervision for Embodied World Models
papers.abstract_en: Embodied world models enable scalable simulation of embodied interactions for robot learning. However, existing models are prone to Model Laziness, as they focus on visual fidelity at the expense of physical reasoning and lack process-level supervision over the temporal dynamics of manipulated objects. In this work, we propose EVEWorld, a physical evolution-supervision framework for physically consistent target evolution. EVEWorld consists of two components: Instance-Guided Restoration (IGR) and Temporal Instance Alignment (TIA). First, IGR promotes instance consistency through restoration supervision. Second, TIA promotes cross-frame consistency by aligning target instances across adjacent frames. We further introduce the Model Laziness Rate (MLR), a metric that measures persistent violations of instance consistency in generated trajectories. Extensive experiments on DreamGenBench, EWMBench, and PBench demonstrate the effectiveness of EVEWorld, notably achieving an 87.5% reduction in MLR compared with GigaWorld-0. On the WorldArena 2.0 Track 1 leaderboard, our model ranks 6th in JEPA Similarity and 17th overall, which further validates the performance of our evolution supervision strategy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EVEWorld 用物理演化监督 (physical evolution supervision) 约束具身世界模型中被操作物体的跨帧一致性：IGR 用恢复监督保证实例一致，TIA 对齐相邻帧的目标实例。在 DreamGenBench、EWMBench、PBench 上将 Model Laziness Rate (MLR) 相对 GigaWorld-0 降低 87.5%，并在 WorldArena 2.0 Track 1 榜单 JEPA Similarity 第 6、总排名第 17。
Motivation: 现有具身世界模型偏向视觉保真度而牺牲物理推理，对被操作物体的时间动态缺少过程级监督，导致生成轨迹中实例一致性被持续违反（Model Laziness）。
Method: 框架含两部分：Instance-Guided Restoration (IGR) 通过恢复监督促进实例一致性；Temporal Instance Alignment (TIA) 通过跨相邻帧对齐目标实例促进跨帧一致性。另提出度量 Model Laziness Rate (MLR)，量化生成轨迹中实例一致性的持续违反。
Result: 在 DreamGenBench、EWMBench、PBench 上实验，MLR 相对 GigaWorld-0 降低 87.5%；WorldArena 2.0 Track 1 排行榜上 JEPA Similarity 第 6 名、总排名第 17。
Conclusion: 对被操作物体施加实例级与跨帧的演化监督，能显著减少具身世界模型生成轨迹中的物理不一致（Model Laziness）。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: SCAD: Structured Credit Assignment and Distillation for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract_en: Training long-horizon agents to solve complex tasks requires effective supervision over extended interaction sequences. However, sparse terminal rewards obscure intermediate contributions, while on-policy distillation can lose informative teacher guidance as student-generated histories grow. To address this problem, we introduce SCAD, which organizes interactions into planning and bounded subtask execution, distills execution in local contexts, and refines planning credit through cross-rollout subtask prefix trees, with planning receiving full terminal credit and execution receiving positive terminal credit and teacher guidance. Across all evaluated benchmarks, SCAD improves macro-average accuracy over the strongest training baseline by 4.48 percentage points for text tasks and 4.19 points for multimodal tasks. SCAD effectively combines outcome-based credit assignment with teacher-guided distillation to improve planning and execution in long-horizon agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SCAD 把长程 agent 的交互拆成规划与有界子任务执行两层：执行段在局部上下文做 on-policy 蒸馏，规划段用跨 rollout 的子任务前缀树 (subtask prefix tree) 重算信用分配，规划拿全部终局信用、执行拿正向终局信用加教师指导。在全部评测基准上，SCAD 比最强训练基线的宏平均准确率高 4.48 个百分点（文本任务）与 4.19 个百分点（多模态任务）。
Motivation: 稀疏终局奖励掩盖了长序列中各中间步骤的实际贡献，而 on-policy 蒸馏会随着 student 自生成历史变长而丢失教师的有效指导，导致长程任务的规划与执行都难以训练。

papers.title: LAS-CLIP: A Lightweight Adapter Steering Approach for CLIP's Visual Encoder
papers.abstract_en: CLIP's visual encoder produces only global image representations, limiting its use in region-level tasks. Existing adaptations rely on visual prompting, input masking, or encoder fine-tuning, each compromising pre-trained representations. We propose LAS-CLIP, a Lightweight Adapter Steering approach that keeps every CLIP parameter frozen. A compact MaskAdapter generates per-head, per-layer attention biases from an input mask and injects them into the frozen self-attention layers, steering attention toward the target region. Crucially, because the backbone remains strictly untouched, LAS-CLIP seamlessly reverts to vanilla CLIP when no mask is provided, preserving its foundational zero-shot capabilities. With approximately 116K to 145K trainable parameters and 100K training samples on two T4 GPUs, LAS-CLIP achieves competitive or superior results compared to Alpha-CLIP on ImageNet-S zero-shot classification and RefCOCO referring expression comprehension, despite the latter fine-tuning its entire encoder on millions of samples. Qualitative analysis further confirms stronger representational fidelity under incorrect masks and in downstream generation. Our project page is link to https://github.com/AnhKhoa585/lasclip
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LAS-CLIP 用一个紧凑的 MaskAdapter 从输入 mask 生成逐头逐层的注意力偏置，注入完全冻结的 CLIP 视觉编码器自注意力，把注意力导向目标区域。仅用约 116K–145K 可训练参数和 100K 训练样本（两块 T4），在 ImageNet-S 零样本分类与 RefCOCO 指代理解上达到与 Alpha-CLIP 相当或更优的结果，而后者需在数百万样本上微调整个编码器；不提供 mask 时可无缝回退到原版 CLIP。
Motivation: CLIP 视觉编码器只输出全局图像表征，难以直接用于区域级任务；现有视觉提示、输入掩码或编码器微调方案都会破坏预训练表征。
Method: 提出 LAS-CLIP（Lightweight Adapter Steering）：保持 CLIP 全部参数冻结，用紧凑的 MaskAdapter 依据输入 mask 生成 per-head、per-layer 注意力偏置并注入冻结的 self-attention 层以导向目标区域；不给 mask 时回退到 vanilla CLIP。训练用 100K 样本、两块 T4 GPU，可训练参数约 116K–145K。
Result: 在 ImageNet-S 零样本分类与 RefCOCO 指代表达理解 (referring expression comprehension) 上，相对 Alpha-CLIP 取得相当或更优结果，而 Alpha-CLIP 在数百万样本上微调了整个编码器；可训练参数约 116K–145K，训练样本 100K，硬件为两块 T4。定性分析显示在错误 mask 下与下游生成中表征保真度更强。
Conclusion: 只在冻结 CLIP 的注意力层注入由 mask 驱动的轻量偏置，就能以极小参数量和数据量换取区域级能力，同时保留零样本能力并可随时回退到原版 CLIP。

papers.title: Mixture-of-Experts for Cryptocurrency Order Execution: Training Stability, Tail Risk, and Failure Modes
papers.abstract_en: Deep reinforcement-learning policies for order execution can vary substantially across training seeds, so apparent architectural gains may reflect favourable training realisations rather than reproducible properties of the architecture. We evaluate vanilla Double Deep Q-Learning (DDQL), K-means-partitioned mixtures of DDQL experts at $K \in \{2, 4, 8\}$, and dense networks parameter-matched to the $K{=}4$ and $K{=}8$ expert budgets on 5-minute mean-aggregated BTC/USDT limit order book data from Binance. No learned configuration significantly improves mean implementation shortfall over DDQL. Under the reported specification, all have higher mean shortfall than TWAP (0.39 bps) and immediate liquidation (0.21 bps) in an environment whose frictionless replay and terminal-urgency penalty make early liquidation nearly costless; 11/100 vanilla-DDQL runs, versus none in either MoE $K{\geq}4$ arm, converge to a policy that waits until forced liquidation. We then decompose this specification on a device-matched baseline. Annealed exploration alone eliminates observed collapses (12/100 to 0/100; exact McNemar $p{=}4.9{\times}10^{-4}$), matching the elimination under expert partitioning. Combining annealed exploration with the aligned reward restores collapse in 19/30 runs; with all three specification changes, it rises to 48/100. In this environment, expert partitioning is unnecessary to suppress collapse and appears to mask a training-specification failure rather than confer an intrinsic performance benefit. No MoE $K{=}8$ run collapses under any of the six specifications tested. Across-seed dispersion is lowest at $K{=}8$ but non-monotone and not robust to family-wise adjustment, while within-policy tail risk worsens monotonically with $K$. The apparent attribution of the failure mode reverses between 30 and 100 seeds, illustrating the importance of repeated-seed evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Binance 5 分钟 BTC/USDT 限价订单簿上评估 DDQL 与 K-means 分区的 MoE 专家执行策略，发现没有任何学习配置显著改善平均 implementation shortfall，且都差于 TWAP（0.39 bps）与立即清算（0.21 bps）。专家分区本身并不抑制训练崩溃，只是掩盖了训练设定缺陷：仅退火探索就将崩溃从 12/100 降到 0/100（McNemar p=4.9×10⁻⁴），而叠加对齐奖励后崩溃回升至 19/30，三项设定改动全用时达 48/100。作者主张跨 seed 重复评估，因为失败模式的归因在 30 与 100 个 seed 之间会反转。
Motivation: 深度强化学习执行策略在不同训练 seed 间差异很大，架构上的表面收益可能只是有利的训练实现，而非可复现的架构性质；需要区分真正的架构收益与训练设定缺陷。
Method: 对比 vanilla Double Deep Q-Learning (DDQL)、K-means 分区的 DDQL 专家混合（K∈{2,4,8}），以及与 K=4、K=8 专家预算参数量匹配的稠密网络；数据为 Binance 5 分钟均值聚合的 BTC/USDT 限价订单簿。再在设备匹配基线上分解设定：退火探索、对齐奖励等三项规格改动，并做跨 seed（30 与 100）重复评估。
Result: 无学习配置显著改善平均 implementation shortfall，且均高于 TWAP 0.39 bps 与立即清算 0.21 bps；vanilla DDQL 有 11/100 次运行收敛到拖延至强制清算的策略，MoE K≥4 两组为 0。退火探索单独将崩溃从 12/100 降到 0/100（exact McNemar p=4.9×10⁻⁴），与专家分区的消除效果相当；退火探索加对齐奖励使崩溃回升到 19/30，三项改动全用时 48/100。六种设定下 MoE K=8 无一崩溃；跨 seed 离散度在 K=8 最低但非单调且经族系校正后不稳健，而策略内尾部风险随 K 单调恶化；失败模式归因在 30 与 100 seed 之间反转。
Conclusion: 在该环境中专家分区对抑制崩溃并非必要，反而可能掩盖训练设定失败而非带来内在性能收益；结论依赖重复 seed 评估，单次或少量 seed 的归因会翻转。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multilingual GSM-Symbolic: What determines capability transfer across languages?
papers.abstract_en: We understand little about how capabilities acquired in one language carry over to another, or what governs this transfer: evaluations rely on incomparable, saturation-prone datasets and rarely examine its determinants jointly. Identifying what predicts transfer would let us avoid exhaustive evaluation across all language pairs and let developers target the factors that limit performance in low-resource languages. To evaluate cross-lingual capability transfer, we introduce Multilingual GSM-Symbolic, an extensible multilingual mathematical dataset covering 30,000 item-matched question-answer pairs and spanning 15 languages. It utilises symbolic templates to prevent overfitting and ensure generalisation by allowing generation of millions of high-quality variations from a single sample. Using Multilingual GSM-Symbolic, we quantify the largest determinants of capability as model size ($β= 1.77$), language resource level ($β= 0.77$), reasoning ($β= 0.67$) and typological distance ($β= -0.25$). This joint estimation allows these determinants to be expressed in terms of one another: a 32B model evaluated in Marathi performs like a 10B model in English. Our findings have important implications for model developers, showing that model size and reasoning narrow the performance gap between low- and high-resource languages ($β= -0.27$ and $β= -0.20$, respectively), while similar levers have little or no effect on typologically distant languages. Overall, our analysis framework explains 92% of between-language variation, but only 23% of the model-by-language variation, and predicts a model's performance on an unseen language within 6.0pp (r=.96). Incorporating measurements from just 10 templates in the target language reduces this to 4.19pp, enabling reasonable estimates of performance with little or no downstream dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Multilingual GSM-Symbolic：30,000 条 item-matched 数学问答、覆盖 15 种语言、用符号模板生成变体，联合估计跨语言能力迁移的决定因素。模型规模 (β=1.77)、语言资源水平 (β=0.77)、推理 (β=0.67) 影响最大，类型学距离为负 (β=-0.25)：32B 模型在马拉地语上的表现相当于 10B 模型在英语上的表现。
Motivation: 跨语言能力迁移如何发生、由什么决定，目前理解很少；现有评测数据集互不可比且趋于饱和，也极少联合考察各决定因素。
Method: 构建可扩展的多语言数学数据集 Multilingual GSM-Symbolic，含 30,000 条 item-matched 问答对、覆盖 15 种语言，用符号模板从单个样本生成数百万变体以防过拟合；对模型规模、资源水平、推理、类型学距离做联合估计，并用该框架预测未见语言上的表现。
Result: 决定因素系数：模型规模 β=1.77、语言资源水平 β=0.77、推理 β=0.67、类型学距离 β=-0.25；模型规模与推理缩小低资源与高资源语言差距 (β=-0.27 与 -0.20)，对类型学距离远的语言几乎无效。分析框架解释语言间差异的 92%，但仅解释模型×语言交互差异的 23%；对未见语言的预测误差 6.0pp (r=.96)，加入目标语言仅 10 个模板的测量后降至 4.19pp。
Conclusion: 模型规模和推理能缩小低资源与高资源语言的性能差距，但对类型学距离远的语言作用甚微；用目标语言少量模板测量即可把未见语言的预测误差压到 4.19pp，几乎不需要下游数据集。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 模型规模和推理能缩小低资源与高资源语言的性能差距，但对类型学距离远的语言作用甚微；用目标语言少量模板测量即可把未见语言的预测误差压到 4.19pp，几乎不需要下游数据集。

papers.title: Geometry Meets Physics: Data-Efficient Pre-Training for Unstructured Neural PDE Solvers
papers.abstract_en: Neural surrogate models for Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) on unstructured 3D geometries are often limited by poor generalization and the high cost of generating large-scale training datasets. Consequently, pre-training on massive datasets of related PDE dynamics has emerged as a critical alternative to enhance the robustness and scalability of these models. However, this strategy is neither compute- nor data-efficient, as it relies on massive pre-computed data that is very costly to generate. In this work, we introduce a disk-data-free pre-training framework tailored to both steady-state and transient regimes. For steady-state problems, we propose a geometry-driven strategy that leverages intrinsic shape descriptors to learn representations of complex 3D domains. For transient problems, we introduce a physics-driven approach based on online generation of synthetic PDE data, enabling scalable pre-training without reliance on expensive datasets. Across multiple experiments, our approach achieves faster convergence, greater data efficiency, and higher accuracy during fine-tuning, particularly under realistic low-data regimes. This methodology provides a practical pathway toward data-efficient neural emulators for large-scale simulations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出免预计算数据 (disk-data-free) 的神经 PDE 预训练框架：稳态问题用几何驱动策略，借内蕴形状描述子学习 3D 域表示；瞬态问题用物理驱动策略在线合成 PDE 数据。多组实验显示其收敛更快、数据效率更高，且在真实低数据微调 regime 下精度更高。
Motivation: 非结构 3D 几何上的神经 PDE 代理模型泛化差，而依赖大规模预计算数据的预训练既费算力又费数据，生成成本极高。
Method: 分稳态与瞬态两条路线：稳态用几何驱动策略，从内蕴形状描述子 (intrinsic shape descriptors) 学习复杂 3D 域表示；瞬态用物理驱动策略在线生成合成 PDE 数据，实现无需昂贵数据集的可扩展预训练，随后微调到目标任务。
Result: 在多组实验中，该方法收敛更快、数据效率更高，微调精度更高，优势在 realistic low-data regimes 下尤为明显。
Conclusion: 免预计算数据的几何与在线物理合成预训练，是通往大规模模拟用数据高效神经 emulator 的可行路径。

papers.title: Follow the Winners: Conservative Policy Improvement with the Cross-Entropy Method for Critic-Free RFT
papers.abstract_en: Critic-free reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) for agentic large language models is often done through GRPO-style methods, which compute a group baseline over repeated rollouts to reduce target variance. However, this setup is ill-suited to agents acting in stateful environments such as live services or security sandboxes, where repeated rollouts are impractical to obtain and aggressive updates entrench the noise of long, sparsely verified trajectories. We propose \textit{Follow the Winners} (FTW), a critic-free policy-learning algorithm that adapts the cross-entropy method to RFT, replacing group rollouts with an ordinal filter on replay-buffer samples that yields polynomial concentration in the order statistic of returns. We derive FTW through a control-as-inference lens, which also recovers GRPO and DPO as specific modelling choices, identifying GRPO as risk-neutral while DPO and FTW share a bounded risk-seeking offset that FTW controls. We identify this offset as an inherent trade-off of variance reduction through ordinal filters on samples, whereas a critic model induces a different trade-off between bias and variance. Scaled to agentic LLM post-training, FTW matches GRPO and PPO on Sokoban and Search-R1 baselines, showing a viable trade-off from a value model or group rollouts to CPU memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 critic-free 强化微调算法 Follow the Winners (FTW)，把 cross-entropy method 移植到 RFT，用 replay-buffer 样本上的序数过滤 (ordinal filter) 取代 GRPO 的组内重复 rollout，并给出回报序统计量的多项式集中界。在 Sokoban 与 Search-R1 基线上，FTW 与 GRPO、PPO 打平，代价从 value model 或组 rollout 转为 CPU 内存。
Motivation: GRPO 式 critic-free RFT 依赖同一状态的重复 rollout 来构造组基线，这在有状态环境（在线服务、安全沙箱）中难以获取；同时对长且稀疏验证的轨迹做激进更新会把噪声固化进策略。
Method: 以 control-as-inference 视角推导 FTW：把 cross-entropy method 用到 RFT 上，用 replay-buffer 样本的序数过滤替代组 rollout，并证明回报序统计量的多项式集中；该视角同时把 GRPO 与 DPO 恢复为特例，指出 GRPO 是 risk-neutral，而 DPO 与 FTW 共享有界的 risk-seeking 偏移，FTW 可控该偏移。
Result: FTW 在 Sokoban 与 Search-R1 基线上与 GRPO 和 PPO 表现相当；序数过滤带来回报序统计量的多项式集中，其 risk-seeking 偏移被识别为方差削减的固有代价，而 critic 模型对应的是另一类偏差-方差权衡。
Conclusion: 在 agentic LLM 后训练中，可以用 CPU 内存换掉 value model 或组 rollout，同时保持与 GRPO/PPO 相当的策略改进；risk-seeking 偏移是序数过滤做方差削减的固有属性，需要显式控制而非消除。

papers.title: ReFract: Benchmarking Perspective Awareness in Language Model Agents with Text World Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings such as industrial maintenance and equipment fault troubleshooting, where workers occupy a variety of roles. A capable agent must therefore act in a way that is calibrated to user's role: taking actions and providing information that respect the role's knowledge and capability boundaries. Unlike coding, where mistakes are usually recoverable, agent responses in these settings are enacted on physical equipment, and can therefore cause irreversible equipment damage, production loss, or personnel harm. Existing benchmarks, however, largely overlook the need for agents to infer what a role intends and acting only through tools that role may legitimately use, a capability which we term Perspective Awareness. To this end, we introduce ReFract, a benchmark of 150 expert-validated entries in which an agent must act differently in response to the same query depending on user's role. Entries of ReFract are grounded in anonymized queries from domain support conversations, against which we construct Text World Models that simulate the agent's operating environments and assemble perspective-aware action trajectories. State-of-the-art LLMs solve at most 69% of the tasks with more than 50% of their trajectories contain attempts of taking perspective-violating actions. ReFract exposes perspective awareness as a distinct, largely unsolved axis of agent evaluation and motivates agents that calibrate not just how to act, but for whom.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReFract 是一个评测 LLM agent 角色视角对齐能力的基准：150 条专家校验条目要求 agent 对同一查询按用户角色给出不同动作，环境由匿名领域支持对话构建的 Text World Models 模拟。SOTA LLM 最多只解出 69% 的任务，且超过 50% 的轨迹中出现视角越界动作。
Motivation: 工业维护、设备故障排查等高风险场景中，agent 的动作会直接作用于物理设备，错误不可回退；现有基准几乎不检验 agent 能否推断用户角色意图、只使用该角色合法可用的工具。
Method: 以匿名化的领域支持对话查询为依据构建 Text World Models 模拟 agent 操作环境，组装视角感知的动作轨迹，形成 150 条专家校验条目，要求同一查询按用户角色产生不同响应。
Result: SOTA LLM 在该基准上最多解决 69% 的任务，且超过 50% 的轨迹包含尝试执行视角越界 (perspective-violating) 动作。
Conclusion: 视角感知 (Perspective Awareness) 是一个独立且基本未被解决的 agent 评测维度，agent 需要同时校准怎么做动作和为谁做。

papers.title: Stochastic thermodynamics and predictability of Ornstein-Uhlenbeck processes: an application to the Madden-Julian Oscillation
papers.abstract_en: Climate oscillations are intrinsically out-of-equilibrium phenomena, yet the connection between their predictability and nonequilibrium thermodynamic properties remains unexplored. We develop a coarse-grained stochastic thermodynamic framework for Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (OU) processes and apply this framework to climate data via linear inverse models (LIMs), linking predictability, entropy production, dynamical activity, and path action. Climate oscillations are often studied in a 2d phase space of climate indices, which are even under time-reversal, motivating our focus on 2d OU dynamics with even variables. We find that coordinate-invariant properties of 2d OU processes can be reduced to a minimal three-parameter description: two diffusivities and a phase-space rotation. We show that these quantities fundamentally characterize distinct aspects of the dynamics. We find that higher irreversibility and dynamical activity do not necessarily imply reduced predictability. Rather, it is the path action which is most closely connected to a commonly used measure of predictability, the anomaly correlation coefficient (ACC). As an illustrative example, we apply this framework to the Madden-Julian Oscillation (MJO) over the twentieth century. We find that the MJO has become simultaneously more predictable, as seen previously, while at the same time becoming more irreversible and more active. Predictability is driven predominantly by the reduced mean diffusion. Entropy production reflects the combined evolution of all three parameters. These results suggest that stochastic thermodynamics provides a powerful lens for studying nonequilibrium climate phenomena.
papers.comment: This work was submitted to Physical Review E on September 29, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把非平衡随机热力学 (stochastic thermodynamics) 框架接到线性逆模式 (LIM) 上，用三个坐标不变参数（两个扩散系数加一个相空间旋转）刻画 2d OU 过程的可预测性、熵产生与路径作用量。发现不可逆性与动力学活性升高并不必然降低可预测性，真正与异常相关系数 (ACC) 紧密对应的是 path action；20 世纪 MJO 同时变得更可预测、更不可逆、更活跃，其可预测性主要由平均扩散下降驱动。
Motivation: 气候振荡本质上是非平衡现象，但其可预测性与非平衡热力学量之间的联系此前无人建立；而常用的 2d 气候指数相空间对时间反演对称，需要一个能同时容纳熵产生与可预测性度量的统一描述。
Method: 为 2d OU 过程（时间反演偶变量）建立粗粒化随机热力学框架，证明坐标不变性质可约化为三参数描述：两个扩散系数与一个相空间旋转；再通过线性逆模式 (LIM) 把该框架接到气候数据上，关联 predictability、熵产生、dynamical activity 与 path action，并以 20 世纪 Madden-Julian Oscillation (MJO) 为例做应用。
Result: 2d OU 的坐标不变量约化为两个扩散系数加一个相空间旋转的三参数描述；更高不可逆性与更高 dynamical activity 不必然意味着可预测性下降，而 path action 与常用可预测性指标 ACC 关联最紧密。20 世纪 MJO 同时变得更可预测（与既往认识一致）、更不可逆、更活跃；可预测性主要由平均扩散下降驱动，熵产生则反映三个参数的共同演化。
Conclusion: 随机热力学可作为研究非平衡气候现象的统一视角：判断可预测性应看 path action 而非熵产生或活性，MJO 的可预测性上升与不可逆性上升可以并存且由平均扩散下降主导。
Relevance: 58

papers.title: Equivariant Visual-Tactile Diffusion Policy for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Imitation learning for contact-rich manipulation requires high-quality expert data that is expensive to obtain. This makes learning a sample-efficient policy a key issue. To address this, we propose VISTA, a workspace-level equivariant visuotactile diffusion policy for data-efficient contact-rich imitation learning. VISTA projects visual and tactile observations into spherical tokens, injects tactile contact cues into visual spherical directions through permutation-equivariant spherical fusion, and rotates the fused harmonic representation using the end-effector orientation. The resulting representation conditions an equivariant diffusion policy to predict spatially consistent actions. Extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world robotic settings show that VISTA substantially improves data efficiency over strong visuotactile imitation learning baselines. Project website: https://vista-paper.github.io/
papers.comment: 21 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to the 10th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VISTA 是面向接触密集操作的视觉-触觉扩散策略，把视觉与触觉观测投影为球面 token，用置换等变的球面融合把触觉接触线索注入视觉球面方向，再按末端执行器姿态旋转融合后的球面调和表示，以此条件化等变扩散策略预测空间一致的动作。在仿真与真实机器人实验中，VISTA 的数据效率显著高于强视觉-触觉模仿学习基线。
Motivation: 接触密集操作的模仿学习依赖高质量专家数据，采集成本高，因此如何用更少样本学到可用策略是核心问题。
Method: VISTA 将视觉与触觉观测投影为 spherical tokens，通过 permutation-equivariant spherical fusion 把触觉接触线索注入视觉球面方向，并用末端执行器 (end-effector) 朝向旋转融合后的 harmonic 表示；该表示条件化一个 workspace 级等变扩散策略 (equivariant diffusion policy) 输出动作。
Result: 在仿真与真实机器人两类设置的实验中，VISTA 相比强视觉-触觉模仿学习基线大幅提升了数据效率。
Conclusion: 把视觉-触觉融合放进工作空间等变的球面表示，是降低接触密集模仿学习专家数据需求的一条有效路径。

summary_sections.result: 在仿真与真实机器人两类设置的实验中，VISTA 相比强视觉-触觉模仿学习基线大幅提升了数据效率。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把视觉-触觉融合放进工作空间等变的球面表示，是降低接触密集模仿学习专家数据需求的一条有效路径。

papers.title: A Fully Automatic Pipeline for 3D Dendrite Instance Segmentation in SBF-SEM
papers.abstract_en: Accurate three-dimensional (3D) reconstruction of individual dendrites in serial block-face scanning electron microscopy (SBF-SEM) is essential for quantifying structural plasticity in the brain, yet manual annotation at scale is infeasible. We present a fully automatic pipeline for 3D dendrite instance segmentation that unifies YOLOv6-guided Segment Anything Model (SAM) prompting on downsampled slices, iterative two-dimensional mask refinement, random forest 3D instance linking, and instance-aware high-resolution refinement using nnU-Net at native resolution into a single system requiring no manual prompting at inference. Applied to hippocampal CA1 SBF-SEM datasets from a control rat and a pilocarpine- induced epileptic rat, our pipeline reconstructs coherent, well- separated dendrites with high semantic accuracy (Dice 0.93 and 0.91) and strong instance-level performance on control tissue, while analysis of the more challenging epileptic tissue identifies instance recognition in dense regions as the principal remaining limitation. The high-resolution refinement stage recovers thin dendritic protrusions, providing a basis for downstream spine- level analysis. Code is available at https://github.com/ ZE-WEN/dendrite-3d-instance-seg.
papers.comment: Accepted at 2026 IEEE-EMBS Conference on Biomedical Engineering and Sciences (IECBES)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出全自动 3D 树突实例分割流水线：YOLOv6 引导 SAM 在降采样切片上提示、迭代 2D 掩膜精修、随机森林做 3D 实例链接，再用 nnU-Net 在原分辨率做实例感知精修，推理时无需人工提示。在对照与匹罗卡品致癫痫大鼠的海马 CA1 SBF-SEM 数据上取得 Dice 0.93 与 0.91，稠密区实例识别仍是主要瓶颈。
Motivation: 脑结构可塑性量化需要逐个树突的 3D 重建，而 SBF-SEM 数据的人工大规模标注不可行。
Method: 流水线四段：YOLOv6 引导的 Segment Anything Model (SAM) 在降采样切片上生成提示，迭代式 2D 掩膜精修，随机森林完成 3D 实例链接，最后由 nnU-Net 在原分辨率做实例感知高分辨率精修；推理阶段无需人工提示。
Result: 在对照大鼠与匹罗卡品 (pilocarpine) 诱导的癫痫大鼠海马 CA1 SBF-SEM 数据上语义精度 Dice 分别为 0.93 与 0.91，对照组织上实例级表现强；高分辨率精修阶段恢复细树突突起，稠密区实例识别被确定为主要遗留限制。
Conclusion: 该流水线可全自动重建连贯、分离良好的树突并支撑后续 spine 级分析，但在癫痫组织的稠密区域实例识别仍需改进；代码已开源。

papers.title: Cordial Learning: Distributed Training with Correlated Data
papers.abstract_en: We consider a distributed learning task with agents that have correlated data. Specifically, the label of an agent depends on the input of other agents for the same sample, and these inputs are also correlated. Correlated data is the reality when agents share the same environment. Existing decentralized methods, such as federated learning, ignore the structure of the problem and perform poorly on correlated data. On the other hand, centralized approaches are infeasible due to privacy and communication constraints. We introduce cordial (correlated and distributed) learning to address this gap by sharing only low-dimensional outputs between the agents while training local models to extract informative signals from peers. This distributed learning induces a game in which the loss function of each agent depends on the models of others. Assuming a linear model, we prove that cordial learning converges with probability one to a globally optimal solution, despite the nonconvex global objective. Experiments on structured multi-digit MNIST tasks demonstrate that cordial learning remains highly effective even in highly nonlinear settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 cordial learning：分布式训练中各 agent 的标签依赖同一采样下其他 agent 的输入，各方只在训练时交换低维输出、由本地模型从同伴输出中提取信号。假设线性模型时证明该过程以概率 1 收敛到全局最优解，尽管全局目标非凸；在结构化多位 MNIST 任务上，高度非线性设定中仍保持有效。
Motivation: 同一环境下的 agent 数据相关时，联邦学习等去中心化方法忽略这种结构、表现差，而集中式方案又受隐私与通信约束不可行。
Method: 各 agent 训练本地模型，仅在 agent 之间共享低维输出作为同伴信号；由此诱导出每个 agent 的损失依赖其他 agent 模型的博弈。在假设线性模型的条件下给出收敛性证明，并在结构化多位 MNIST 任务上做实验。
Result: 线性模型假设下证明 cordial learning 以概率 1 收敛到全局最优解，尽管全局目标非凸；在结构化多位 MNIST 任务的实验中，方法在高度非线性设定下仍保持高度有效。
Conclusion: 只交换低维输出的分布式训练可以在数据相关的多 agent 场景中达到全局最优，且不依赖全局目标的凸性。

papers.title: SyntaxBench: A Statistical Diagnostic Framework for Character-Level Reasoning in Large Language Models
authors: Kazem Taghva (1) ((1) Department of Computer Science
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly used where small syntactic errors matter, yet character-level reasoning is still evaluated mostly through isolated probes and aggregate accuracy. We introduce SyntaxBench, a diagnostic benchmark and statistical evaluation framework for character-level reasoning. It contains five core tasks, character counting, letter containment, palindrome detection, edit distance, and longest-string selection, plus index_to_span, a harder substring-extraction stress test. The five core tasks use paired English and character-length-matched random-string inputs. index_to_span documents share a 200-500 word band and are not character-length matched. All six tasks use zero-, one-, and four-shot prompts. We evaluate eight open-weight models from 2B to 32B parameters across 11 reasoning-mode configurations. The framework reports exact-match and relaxed accuracy, Cohen's kappa, paired McNemar tests with odds ratios, bootstrap confidence intervals, Kendall's tau, class-conditional metrics, tokenization analysis, and multiple-comparison-corrected tests. Three findings stand out. First, tokenization shapes accuracy: random strings are more character-visible than English strings (1.892 vs. 3.169 characters per token), and character-counting accuracy falls as English words occupy more tokens. Second, reasoning mode is not uniformly helpful: Gemma4-31B is nearly unchanged across modes on the near-saturated tasks, while Qwen3.6-27B is worse with thinking on palindrome detection (0.952 non-thinking vs. 0.886 thinking at four-shot). Third, index_to_span remains largely unsolved; the best four-shot exact-match accuracy is 6.75%. Character-level evaluation needs controlled inputs, paired tests, and analyses of tokenization and reasoning mode rather than aggregate accuracy alone.
papers.comment: 32 pages, 17 figures. The first two authors contributed equally. The code will be released soon
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SyntaxBench 是字符级推理的诊断基准与统计评测框架，含 5 个核心任务加 index_to_span 子串抽取压力测试，用配对输入与 McNemar 检验取代单一总准确率。结果显示 tokenization 直接决定准确率（随机串 1.892 字符/token vs 英文 3.169），thinking 模式并非一致有益（Qwen3.6-27B 四-shot 回文检测 0.952 降到 0.886），index_to_span 最好四-shot exact-match 仅 6.75%。
Motivation: 字符级推理目前多靠孤立探针和聚合准确率评测，无法区分 tokenization、推理模式与任务难度各自的影响，小的句法错误在实际应用中却很关键。
Method: 构建 6 任务基准：字符计数、字母包含、回文检测、编辑距离、最长串选择，配对英文与字符长度匹配的随机串输入；index_to_span 文档统一 200-500 词且不做长度匹配。全部任务用 0/1/4-shot 提示，评测 8 个 2B–32B 开放权重模型 × 11 种推理模式配置，报告 exact-match 与 relaxed accuracy、Cohen's kappa、配对 McNemar 检验与优势比、bootstrap 置信区间、Kendall's tau、类条件指标、tokenization 分析及多重比较校正检验。
Result: 随机串比英文串更字符可见（1.892 vs 3.169 字符/token），英文词占 token 越多字符计数准确率越低；Gemma4-31B 在近饱和任务上各推理模式几乎不变，Qwen3.6-27B 四-shot 回文检测 thinking 0.886 低于 non-thinking 0.952；index_to_span 最好四-shot exact-match 仅 6.75%。
Conclusion: 字符级评测必须用受控输入、配对检验并分析 tokenization 与推理模式，单看聚合准确率不够；thinking 模式在已近饱和的任务上无益甚至有害，index_to_span 仍是未解决问题。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Preserving Mathematical Reasoning in Compressed Diffusion Language Models via Trajectory-Aware Low-Rank Approximation
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion language model (dLLM) compression faces a known challenge because calibration is typically performed on clean, fully visible activations, whereas inference traverses partially masked intermediate states. For low-rank compression, this raises two questions. First, can low-rank optimality still be characterized when approximation quality is measured over trajectory-distributed states, and second, does the choice of calibration states affect mathematical reasoning preservation under compression? We address these questions by formulating a trajectory-aware low-rank objective over corruption levels and masking realizations. To estimate this objective efficiently, we propose Traj-MC, which estimates the trajectory second moment through Monte Carlo sampling and yields exact sampled-state optimality and population consistency. Under matched compression budgets, trajectory-aware calibration improves reconstruction over the generation trajectory and preserves substantially more mathematical reasoning than clean calibration on mathematical reasoning benchmarks. Our results connect trajectory-aware low-rank optimality to the reasoning capability retained after dLLM compression. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Zishan-Shao/traj-mc.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 扩散语言模型 (dLLM) 低秩压缩的校准通常用干净、全可见激活，而推理走的是部分掩码的中间态。作者提出轨迹感知低秩目标（覆盖 corruption levels 与 masking realizations），并给出 Traj-MC：用 Monte Carlo 采样估计轨迹二阶矩，具有精确的采样态最优性与总体一致性。在相同压缩预算下，轨迹感知校准在生成轨迹上重建更好，并在数学推理基准上比干净校准保留多得多的推理能力。
Motivation: dLLM 低秩压缩的校准分布（干净全可见激活）与推理时实际遍历的轨迹分布（部分掩码中间态）不匹配，导致压缩后数学推理能力损失，且轨迹分布下的低秩最优性此前缺少刻画。
Method: 构造覆盖 corruption levels 与 masking realizations 的轨迹感知低秩目标；提出 Traj-MC，用 Monte Carlo 采样估计轨迹二阶矩，证明其对采样态精确最优且总体一致；在匹配压缩预算下与干净校准对比。
Result: 在匹配压缩预算下，轨迹感知校准在生成轨迹上的重建质量优于干净校准，并在数学推理基准上保留显著更多的数学推理能力（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 低秩最优性应在轨迹分布而非干净激活上刻画，轨迹感知校准是保留 dLLM 压缩后数学推理能力的有效途径。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Information Limits of Low-Rank Approximation Certification
papers.abstract_en: Low-rank approximation can require additional matrix--vector products to verify that its error meets a prescribed tolerance. We characterize this certification cost for both relative matrix error and mean-square output error. For a single approximation matrix candidate, we determine the exact dimension-uniform minimax query constant as the allowed failure probability vanishes. Our main result concerns reusing validation responses as the approximation space expands. For a candidate family constructed independently of validation, one batch supports an entire nested path without increasing the query budget with the number of checks. Across \(W\) paths, a concentration bound exploiting shared residual energy yields a \(\sqrt{\log(W+1)}\) dependence. A matching lower bound establishes its optimality for fixed interior error targets and sufficiently small separation gaps. Finally, we compare two uniformly valid certificates on the same dispersed-spectrum family. Optimizing the validation budget within each rule family yields costs of orders \(N^{1/3}\) and \(N^{2/3}\) for validation and construction beyond the true target. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Low-rank-approximation-1275/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 低秩近似的误差认证需要额外矩阵-向量乘积，本文给出认证查询代价的极小极大刻画：对与验证独立构造的候选族，一批验证响应可复用于整条嵌套逼近空间路径，查询预算不随检查次数增长；跨 W 条路径的代价只有 sqrt(log(W+1)) 依赖，且在固定内部误差目标与足够小分离间隙下有匹配下界证明最优。
Motivation: 低秩近似常需额外矩阵-向量乘积来验证误差是否满足给定容差，但认证代价随候选数、路径数与逼近空间扩展如何增长缺少刻画，尤其是验证响应能否复用这一问题。
Method: 针对相对矩阵误差与均方输出误差两种准则，先确定单个候选在允许失败概率趋于零时的维数一致极小极大查询常数；再对独立于验证构造的候选族分析嵌套路径上的响应复用，用共享残差能量的集中不等式得到跨 W 条路径的界，并给出匹配下界；最后在同一 dispersed-spectrum 族上比较两族一致有效证书并各自优化验证预算。
Result: 单候选情形得到失败概率趋于零时的精确维数一致极小极大查询常数；嵌套路径上一批验证响应支持整条路径且查询预算不随检查次数增加；跨 W 条路径代价为 sqrt(log(W+1)) 且匹配下界证明其最优（限固定内部误差目标与足够小分离间隙）；两类证书优化后在真实目标之外的验证与构造代价分别为 N^{1/3} 与 N^{2/3} 阶。

papers.title: Refinement Buys Intelligibility, Search Buys Identity: What Test-Time Compute Buys in Masked-Diffusion TTS
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion language models for text-to-speech combine two forms of computation: model depth (parameters) and refinement steps (inference budget). We ask whether they scale equally across capabilities. We train 15 masked-diffusion codec TTS models varying depth (19-133M parameters, 3 seeds) on 2,000 hours of speech and sweep refinement steps T in [1,16] at inference, measuring zero-shot synthesis via ASR word error rate (intelligibility) and speaker verification (identity) on 174 held-out speakers. Against measured floors, refinement closes 86.2% of the intelligibility range but only 46.4% of the identity range - a 1.86x asymmetry robust across multiple error metrics. Retraining at 3x and 6x schedule attenuates but does not reverse this gap (1.84 to 1.36 to 1.23x), because intelligibility saturates with steps while identity continues improving. Best-of-K search recovers speaker identity where refinement fails, with 64.6-79.0% win rates across four independent encoders. Depth and steps are not interchangeable: separable B(d)B(T) fits significantly better (Delta AICc=+69.3) than substitution models. Analysis shows 62% of remaining identity deficit lies in the codec, not the generator. We conclude that refinement and depth target different bottlenecks and should be optimized separately.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 masked-diffusion codec TTS 上，增加推理期 refinement 步数主要买到可懂度而非说话人身份：相对实测下界，refinement 收敛了 86.2% 的可懂度区间却只收敛 46.4% 的身份区间，非对称达 1.86 倍。Best-of-K 搜索在四个独立 encoder 上以 64.6–79.0% 胜率补回身份，且 62% 的剩余身份缺口在 codec 而非生成器，因此深度与步数应分开优化。
Motivation: 扩散语言模型 TTS 同时消耗模型深度（参数）与推理期 refinement 步数，但两者对不同能力（可懂度 vs 说话人身份）是否等价换算尚不清楚，导致算力预算该投向深度、步数还是搜索无法判断。
Method: 训练 15 个 masked-diffusion codec TTS 模型，深度覆盖 19–133M 参数、3 个 seed，训练数据 2,000 小时语音；推理时扫描 refinement 步数 T ∈ [1,16]，在 174 位 held-out 说话人上做零样本合成，用 ASR 词错误率 (WER) 度量可懂度、用 speaker verification 度量身份；另做 3x 与 6x schedule 重训、Best-of-K 搜索，并用可分离模型 B(d)B(T) 与替代 (substitution) 模型做 AICc 比较。
Result: 相对实测下界，refinement 收敛 86.2% 的可懂度区间、仅 46.4% 的身份区间，非对称 1.86 倍且在多个误差指标上稳健；3x 与 6x schedule 重训使该差距从 1.84 降到 1.36 再到 1.23 倍但不反转，因可懂度随步数饱和而身份仍在改善。Best-of-K 搜索在四个独立 encoder 上取得 64.6–79.0% 胜率；可分离 B(d)B(T) 显著优于替代模型（ΔAICc=+69.3）；剩余身份缺口中 62% 归因于 codec 而非生成器。
Conclusion: refinement 与深度针对不同瓶颈、不可互换，应分别优化：步数预算买可懂度，搜索买身份，而身份上限受 codec 制约。

papers.title: Multi-Task Evolution for Zero-Shot Cross-Problem Generalization using LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Designing effective heuristics for diverse combinatorial optimization problems requires substantial expertise and repeated search. Large language models (LLMs) automate heuristic generation and refinement, but heuristic search typically depends on evaluation feedback from the problem being optimized. Generalizing to new problem definitions using only source-task feedback therefore remains a central challenge. We introduce MECo, an LLM-driven multi-task evolutionary framework for zero-shot cross-problem generalization. MECo maintains task-conditioned heuristic populations and uses a transfer gap based on cross-task population performance to guide their interactions. These interactions enable the transfer and recombination of heuristics. A complementary selection criterion then constructs a compact heuristic set by rewarding each member's additional coverage of source combinations. The selected set is applied to target problems without further search or adaptation. Experiments on 32 problem variants across vehicle routing (VRP) and flexible job-shop scheduling (FJSP) show that MECo achieves the lowest mean costs compared with eight automated heuristic design (AHD) baselines under the same budgets. On out-of-domain problems, it outperforms the strongest baseline in each family. Moreover, integrating the framework of MECo with different AHD methods improves their ID and OOD performance in both families, supporting its effectiveness across different methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MECo 用 LLM 驱动的多任务进化做启发式生成，靠跨任务种群表现的 transfer gap 引导启发式迁移重组，再用覆盖度选择准则压出一个小的启发式集合，直接零样本套到目标问题上、不再搜索或适配。在 VRP 与 FJSP 共 32 个问题变体上，同预算下平均成本低于八个自动启发式设计 (AHD) 基线，OOD 上也胜过各家族最强基线。
Motivation: LLM 生成启发式通常依赖被优化问题本身的评估反馈，换到新问题定义就得重新搜索；只靠源任务反馈做零样本跨问题泛化仍是核心难题。
Method: MECo 维护按任务条件化的启发式种群，用基于跨任务种群表现的 transfer gap 引导种群间交互以迁移和重组启发式；再用补充选择准则按每个成员对源组合的额外覆盖度构造紧凑启发式集，直接应用到目标问题。
Result: 在 VRP 与 FJSP 两个家族共 32 个问题变体上，同预算下 MECo 的平均成本低于八个 AHD 基线；OOD 问题上胜过每个家族最强基线；把 MECo 框架接入不同 AHD 方法后，这些方法在两个家族的 ID 与 OOD 表现均提升。
Conclusion: 跨任务 transfer gap 加覆盖度选择足以让启发式在无目标反馈的条件下零样本迁移，且该框架作为通用增强层对不同 AHD 方法都有效。

papers.title: Lightweight, Rubric-Guided Trajectory Evaluation for Production AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Trajectory evaluation is essential for improving the reliability of LLM-based agents, but production use makes it expensive to run repeatedly. Modern agents generate long traces containing tool calls, observations, retries, and external outputs, while not all raw tokens are equally useful for diagnosis. We present \textit{LiteTrajEval}, a lightweight architecture for budget-bounded trajectory evaluation. LiteTrajEval derives compact domain-specific rule profiles offline, then preprocesses each trajectory online, marks heuristic failure signals, serializes it under a fixed global budget, and invokes a single rubric-guided LLM judge to produce structured diagnostic reports. Evaluated on public Magentic-One-style and $τ$-bench-style trajectory datasets, LiteTrajEval improves failure-localization alignment with human annotations by roughly 20--35 percentage points on Magentic-One and up to 23 percentage points on $τ$-retail compared with AgentRx, while reducing cost by about 6$\times$ and evaluation time by more than 8$\times$. This solution has also been deployed in our enterprise agentic platform.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LiteTrajEval 是面向生产级 LLM agent 的预算受限轨迹评估架构：离线派生领域规则画像，在线预处理轨迹并标记启发式失败信号，在固定全局预算下序列化，再由单个 rubric 引导的 LLM judge 输出结构化诊断报告。在 Magentic-One 与 τ-bench 风格轨迹数据集上，失败定位与人工标注的对齐度比 AgentRx 高约 20–35 个百分点（Magentic-One）和最高 23 个百分点（τ-retail），成本降低约 6 倍、评估时间降低 8 倍以上。
Motivation: 生产环境中 LLM agent 轨迹长、含工具调用与重试，反复评估成本高，且原始 token 并非都对诊断有用，需要在预算受限下保持失败定位质量。
Method: LiteTrajEval 分两阶段：离线派生紧凑的领域专用规则画像 (rule profiles)，在线对每条轨迹做预处理、标记启发式失败信号，在固定全局预算内序列化，最后调用单个 rubric 引导的 LLM judge 生成结构化诊断报告。
Result: 在公开的 Magentic-One 风格与 τ-bench 风格轨迹数据集上，失败定位与人工标注的对齐度相比 AgentRx 提升约 20–35 个百分点（Magentic-One）、最高 23 个百分点（τ-retail）；成本降低约 6 倍，评估时间降低 8 倍以上。
Conclusion: 在固定预算下用规则画像预压缩轨迹再交给单 judge，可在生产 agent 平台上以约 1/6 成本和 1/8 时间达到更高的失败定位对齐度；该方案已部署到作者的企业级 agentic 平台。

papers.title: DAWIS: Data Assimilation with Windowed Inverse Sampling via Multitask Interpolants
papers.abstract_en: Flow- and diffusion-based generative models have recently emerged as flexible and highly efficient forecasting models for dynamical systems. When combined with inference-time guidance, they offer a promising route to high-dimensional non-Gaussian data assimilation (DA), the problem of combining forecasts with observations to estimate latent system states. Existing filters, however, condition on a fixed history and assimilate only the most recent observation, leaving them unable to revise past states when new observations arrive. Estimates then stay tethered to a history that later observations may contradict, and errors accumulate over the assimilation run. To this end, we introduce **DAWIS**, a unified DA method covering filtering, fixed-lag smoothing, and block smoothing within a single framework. DAWIS replaces the single flow time of a state-level prior with a multitask stochastic interpolant over a window of consecutive states, assigning a separate flow time to each. An assimilation cycle inverts the window to a vector of per-state turning points and regenerates it under observation guidance, with the turning points controlling how strongly each state is held fixed, revised, or generated from scratch. The same construction can also absorb the forecast into the assimilation cycle, removing the need for a separate forecasting model. Experiments on challenging nonlinear systems show that DAWIS improves on both filtering and smoothing baselines under sparse, noisy, and nonlinear observations. The code for DAWIS is available at https://github.com/Erik-Wikingsson/DAWIS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DAWIS 把基于流/扩散生成模型的数据 assimilation 从「固定历史 + 只同化最新观测」的滤波范式改成窗口化逆采样：用多任务随机插值 (multitask stochastic interpolant) 覆盖一段连续状态窗口，每个状态分配独立流时间，同化时把窗口反解为逐状态 turning points 并在观测引导下重生成，turning points 决定各状态被固定、修订还是从头生成。该框架统一覆盖 filtering、fixed-lag smoothing 与 block smoothing，并可把预报并入同化循环、省去独立预报模型；在含稀疏、含噪、非线性观测的困难非线性系统上，改进了滤波与平滑两类基线。
Motivation: 现有生成式 DA 滤波器只能条件在固定历史并同化最新一条观测，新观测到来时无法回修过去状态，估计被可能已被后续观测否定的历史绑住，误差沿同化过程累积。
Method: 以多任务随机插值替代状态级先验的单一流时间，在连续状态窗口上为每个状态各分配一个流时间；一个同化循环把窗口反解 (invert) 为逐状态 turning points 向量，再在观测引导下重生成窗口，turning points 控制每个状态被固定、修订或重新生成的强度。同一构造还能把预报吸收进同化循环，无需单独的 forecasting model，从而在一个框架内覆盖 filtering、fixed-lag smoothing 和 block smoothing。
Result: 在具有挑战性的非线性系统上、观测为稀疏且含噪并具非线性的设定下，DAWIS 同时优于 filtering 基线与 smoothing 基线；代码发布于 github.com/Erik-Wikingsson/DAWIS。
Conclusion: 让生成式 DA 能按新观测回修窗口内过去状态、并把预报与同化合并到同一循环，是在稀疏含噪非线性观测下同时压过滤波和平滑基线的关键。
Relevance: 86

papers.title: SDECast: Probabilistic Weather Forecasting in Continuous Time with Neural SDEs
papers.abstract_en: Existing machine learning weather forecasting models typically generate forecasts through autoregressive rollouts at a fixed temporal resolution. While highly efficient for long-range prediction, this formulation can suffer from severe error accumulation when used with shorter time steps and does not explicitly encode the locality and temporal continuity of atmospheric dynamics. To address these limitations, we introduce **SDECast**, a Neural Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE) framework for continuous-time probabilistic weather forecasting. SDECast extends SDE Matching to learn stochastic dynamics directly in physical space, without requiring repeated SDE simulation during training. On a simulated geophysical flow, we show that SDECast recovers meaningful drift dynamics and faithfully reproduces the underlying continuous-time behavior. We then demonstrate its scalability to global weather forecasting at hourly resolution, where SDECast produces skillful probabilistic forecasts for lead times of up to five days.
papers.comment: Accepted to *AI for Stochastic Dynamics* & *Sim2Science* workshops at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SDECast 用 Neural SDE 在连续时间上直接学习随机大气动力学，绕开固定时间步自回归 rollout 的误差累积问题。它扩展 SDE Matching 在物理空间训练、训练期无需反复仿真 SDE，在模拟地球物理流上恢复出有意义的 drift 动力学，并在小时分辨率全球天气预报上给出最长 5 天的有技巧概率预报。
Motivation: 现有 ML 天气模型按固定时间分辨率做自回归 rollout，短时间步下误差累积严重，且没有显式编码大气动力学的局地性与时间连续性。
Method: 提出 Neural SDE 框架 SDECast，扩展 SDE Matching 直接在物理空间学习随机动力学，训练过程中不需要重复进行 SDE 仿真；先在模拟地球物理流上检验，再扩展到小时分辨率全球天气预报。
Result: 在模拟地球物理流上恢复出有意义的 drift 动力学并忠实再现底层连续时间行为；在全球天气预报上以小时分辨率产出对最长 5 天预报时效有技巧 (skillful) 的概率预报。
Conclusion: 连续时间 Neural SDE 可以替代固定步长自回归 rollout 做概率天气预报，既避开短步误差累积，又保留大气动力学的时间连续性。

papers.title: Optimal Planning in a Dynamic World
authors: Andrew Coles (4) ((1) University of New Hampshire
papers.abstract_en: Background: We address the problem of planning when the set of feasible states or actions changes over time. For example, in the problem of path planning among moving obstacles (sometimes known as SIPP), the feasibility of being at a particular location can change as the obstacles move. Or, the action of boarding a particular train is feasible only while it is stopped at the station. This dynamism means that the optimal plan and its duration can change depending on when execution begins. In practice, execution start time is often unknown until planning has completed or another agent gives the go-ahead. However, most prior planning work either ignores dynamism or assumes a known start time. This makes it straightforward to assess state and action feasibility but is impractical for some applications. Objectives: In this paper, we relax the assumption of a known start time. We define the setting of {\em any-start-time planning} and provide algorithms for it. Methods: We present a data structure called a compound arrival time function (cATF) that compactly encodes the optimal plan as a function of start time. We provide general-purpose planning algorithms, based on heuristic graph search, that assemble cATFs by propagating functions along edges instead of scalar costs. Results: We prove that the size of a cATF is at most linear in the problem size. An experimental evaluation of an implementation for the specific problem of SIPP shows that, on difficult problems, agents that rely on replanning often fail, while any-start-time algorithms using cATFs can quickly look up the optimal plan once the execution start time is known. Conclusions: By enabling efficient representations and reasoning for time-dependent plans, this work provides a foundation for planning in dynamic worlds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 any-start-time planning 设定：执行开始时刻未知时，用 compound arrival time function (cATF) 把最优计划编码为开始时刻的函数，规划算法沿边传播函数而非标量代价。已证明 cATF 规模至多随问题规模线性增长；在 SIPP 实验中，依赖 replanning 的 agent 在困难问题上经常失败，而 cATF 方法在开始时刻确定后可快速查出最优计划。
Motivation: 动态环境中状态与动作可行性随时间变化，最优计划取决于执行开始时刻，但多数既有规划工作要么忽略动态性、要么假设开始时刻已知，这在开始时刻要到规划结束或由其他 agent 给出信号时才确定的场景中不实用。
Method: 定义 any-start-time planning 设定并给出算法：数据结构 cATF 紧凑编码最优计划关于开始时刻的函数；通用规划算法基于启发式图搜索，沿边传播函数（而非标量代价）来组装 cATF。
Result: 证明 cATF 的规模至多与问题规模成线性关系；在 SIPP 的实验评测中，困难问题上依赖 replanning 的 agent 经常失败，而基于 cATF 的 any-start-time 算法在执行开始时刻已知后能快速查得最优计划。
Conclusion: 用可高效表示与推理的时间依赖计划，可以支撑动态世界中的规划，且无需事先知道执行开始时刻。

papers.title: T3lescope: Arbitrary-Resolution High-Fidelity Generative Surface Reconstruction from Images
papers.abstract_en: We reconstruct high-fidelity 3D scene meshes from posed multi-view images without per-scene optimization, across scales ranging from single objects to large outdoor scenes. Per-scene optimization methods lack the learned 3D prior needed when observations are sparse or surfaces are glossy or transparent. Existing generative methods leverage such priors to complete geometry in sparsely observed regions, but typically operate at a fixed resolution over a limited spatial extent, trading spatial coverage against detail. Reconstructing a large scene therefore often requires partitioning it into independently processed overlapping local regions, making it difficult to maintain global geometric consistency. To address these issues, we propose T3lescope, which applies a single fixed-resolution generator across scene scales in an inference-time coarse-to-fine cascade. A coarse level establishes the scene layout, and finer levels perturb and denoise geometry inherited from the coarser level within progressively finer spatial cells to recover surface detail. The model is trained on individual cells at multiple scales and shares its weights across all levels, so no hierarchy is fixed during training, and the number of levels, cell scales, and cell locations are determined at inference time. On indoor, outdoor, and city-scale scenes, T3lescope outperforms feed-forward and generative baselines, matches or surpasses per-scene optimization, and recovers fine structures as well as glossy and transparent surfaces. These results show that our method generalizes across diverse scenes, view counts, and image resolutions. Project page: https://pfnet-research.github.io/t3lescope/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: T3lescope 用单一固定分辨率生成器在推理时做由粗到细的级联，从多视角 posed 图像直接重建高保真 3D 网格，无需逐场景优化。粗层确定场景布局，细层在逐级更细的空间 cell 内对继承的几何做扰动与去噪；训练只在多尺度单个 cell 上进行并跨层共享权重，层数、cell 尺度与位置全部在推理时决定。在室内、室外与城市尺度场景上超过 feed-forward 与生成式基线，并达到或超过逐场景优化，同时恢复光泽与透明表面。
Motivation: 逐场景优化缺少稀疏观测、光泽或透明表面所需的学得 3D 先验；已有生成式方法固定分辨率、覆盖范围有限，大场景需切分成重叠局部区域独立处理，难以保持全局几何一致性。
Method: T3lescope 在推理时做 coarse-to-fine 级联：粗层建立场景布局，细层在逐级更细的 spatial cell 中对继承几何做 perturb 与 denoise 以恢复表面细节。模型在多尺度的单个 cell 上训练、所有层共享权重，训练期不固定层级结构，层数、cell 尺度与 cell 位置由推理时给定；输入为 posed multi-view images，输出为场景网格。
Result: 在室内、室外与城市尺度场景上，T3lescope 超过 feed-forward 与 generative 基线，并达到或超过 per-scene optimization，恢复出精细结构以及光泽 (glossy) 与透明 (transparent) 表面；结果覆盖不同场景、视角数与图像分辨率。
Conclusion: 单一固定分辨率生成器配合推理时由粗到细的 cell 级联，可以在不逐场景优化的前提下跨尺度重建，兼顾大范围覆盖与表面细节，并保持全局几何一致性。

papers.title: Training-Loss Guarantees for Muon with Finite-Step Newton--Schulz Orthogonalization
papers.abstract_en: Existing convergence analyses of Muon either assume exact orthogonalization or analyze classical Newton--Schulz polynomials, and guarantee only stationarity, so it is unresolved what Muon's five tuned Newton--Schulz steps preserve and whether that suffices to reach a prescribed neural-network training loss. We establish a finite-time training guarantee that accounts for both momentum accumulation before orthogonalization and the tuned finite-step update. For full-batch training of a sufficiently wide two-layer ReLU network with fixed random output weights and a positive-definite limiting neural tangent kernel, we prove that Muon reaches any target empirical squared loss $\varepsilon>0$ with high probability over initialization. For every momentum parameter $μ\in[0,1)$, a target-dependent constant learning rate proportional to $(1-μ)\sqrt{\varepsilon}$ yields a hitting-time bound of $O((1-μ)^{-1}\varepsilon^{-1/2})$, with other problem parameters fixed. The sufficient width is independent of both target accuracy and momentum. The analysis shows that the tuned Newton--Schulz map preserves alignment with the momentum buffer while bounding the update's spectral norm. Control of gradient variation near initialization transfers this alignment to the current gradient, ensuring descent until the target is reached without requiring exact orthogonalization. Numerical experiments support these mechanisms at widths below the sufficient theoretical threshold: gradient-update alignment remains above the analytical reference, and all 30 runs across six widths and five student initializations on a fixed teacher-student dataset reach the target loss while maintaining kernel positivity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 Muon 优化器的有限步 Newton--Schulz 正交化给出有限时间训练损失保证：在全批量训练的足够宽两层 ReLU 网络（固定随机输出权重、正定极限 NTK）上，对任意动量 μ∈[0,1)，取与 (1-μ)√ε 成正比的目标相关学习率，以高概率在 O((1-μ)^{-1}ε^{-1/2}) 步内达到目标经验平方损失 ε，且所需宽度与 ε 和 μ 均无关。
Motivation: 现有 Muon 收敛分析要么假设精确正交化，要么只分析经典 Newton--Schulz 多项式，且只保证到驻点，无法回答 Muon 调好的五步 Newton--Schulz 究竟保留了什么、以及是否足以达到指定的神经网络训练损失。
Method: 建立同时计入正交化前动量累积与有限步调参更新的有限时间保证：证明调参 Newton--Schulz 映射在约束更新谱范数的同时保持与动量缓冲的对齐，再用初始化附近梯度变化的控制把该对齐转移到当前梯度，从而在不需要精确正交化的条件下持续下降；理论针对全批量、固定随机输出权重、正定极限神经正切核 (NTK) 的宽两层 ReLU 网络。
Result: 对每个 μ∈[0,1)，目标相关常数学习率正比于 (1-μ)√ε 时 hitting time 为 O((1-μ)^{-1}ε^{-1^{-1}ε^{-1/2})，其余问题参数固定；充分宽度与目标精度和动量均无关。数值实验在低于理论充分宽度处支持这些机制：梯度-更新对齐保持在解析参考之上，固定 teacher-student 数据集上跨 6 种宽度、5 种学生初始化的全部 30 次运行都达到目标损失并保持核正定。
Conclusion: Muon 的五步调参 Newton--Schulz 无需精确正交化即可保证达到任意指定训练损失，且保证同时覆盖动量累积与有限步更新，所需宽度不随精度或动量增长。

papers.title: S$^{2}$-PINN: Stochastic Separable Physics-Informed Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) for random partial differential equations (PDEs) is ubiquitous in computational science and engineering. However, classical spectral solvers for this class of problems face the curse of dimensionality, and existing neural solvers often ignore the stochastic structure that makes moments and calibration tractable. We introduce a stochastic separable physics-informed neural network, dubbed S$^{2}$-PINN, that represents the solution $u(t,\mathbf{x},\mathbf{Z})$ of a random PDE with a learnable Gaussian spatial dictionary, Fourier temporal features, and a generalized polynomial chaos (gPC) stochastic basis, coupled by a low-rank Canonical Polyadic (CP) tensor decomposition core. The method is trained with a hybrid strong-form and gPC-projected residual loss. Our theoretical analysis establishes that the separable class is dense in $L^2$ under mild conditions, and the projected residual corresponds exactly to a stochastic Galerkin constraint. Furthermore, we show that mini-batch projection coefficients are logarithmically dependent on the number of gPC modes, and that the orthogonality penalty controls the conditioning of the learned spatial dictionary. Using four manufactured random PDE benchmarks, we show that S$^{2}$-PINN outperforms nine baselines in terms of mean and variance accuracy, as well as calibration, while using significantly fewer parameters. Further evaluations on non-manufactured Poisson and Darcy problems, a stochastic Navier--Stokes problem, a diffusion scaling study of higher random dimensions, and two stochastic inverse problems reveal the generalization capabilities of the proposed structure. Together, these results support stochastic separability as an effective design principle for physics-informed neural UQ. The code for the experiments can be found in https://github.com/DMax1314/s2pinn

TL;DR: S²-PINN 用可学习高斯空间字典、Fourier 时间特征与广义多项式混沌 (gPC) 随机基，经低秩 CP 张量核耦合随机 PDE 解 u(t,x,Z)，训练采用强形式与 gPC 投影残差的混合损失。在四个 manufactured 随机 PDE 基准上，其均值、方差精度与校准 (calibration) 均优于九个基线且参数量显著更少。
Motivation: 随机 PDE 的 UQ 中，经典谱求解器受维数灾难限制，而现有神经求解器忽略随机结构，使矩与校准难以处理。
Method: 解表示为可学习高斯空间字典 × Fourier 时间特征 × gPC 随机基，由低秩 Canonical Polyadic (CP) 张量核耦合；损失为强形式残差与 gPC 投影残差的混合，并加正交惩罚约束空间字典条件数。理论上证明可分族在 L² 中稠密、投影残差等价于 stochastic Galerkin 约束，且 mini-batch 投影系数对 gPC 模态数呈对数依赖。
Result: 在四个 manufactured 随机 PDE 基准上，均值与方差精度及校准均优于九个基线，参数量显著更少；另在非 manufactured 的 Poisson、Darcy、随机 Navier–Stokes、高随机维扩散规模研究与两个随机反问题上检验泛化性。
Conclusion: 随机可分性 (stochastic separability) 可作为物理信息神经 UQ 的有效设计原则，兼顾精度、校准与参数效率。

papers.title: JOVE: Joint Execution and Verification for Resource-Aware LLM Task Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Complex reasoning queries can be decomposed into directed acyclic task graphs and distributed across heterogeneous LLMs, reducing latency through parallelism and enabling smaller models to solve complex tasks. In practice, however, the suitability of an LLM for a given subtask may be a priori unknown, and execution alone does not reveal output correctness. We propose JOVE, an online framework that jointly assigns executor LLMs and selects intermediate outputs for paid verification. Verification runs asynchronously and is used to improve future allocations, so the system must balance spending on execution now against learning for later. We study how to optimize this trade-off under a long-term budget and a per-query latency constraint, with stochastic, initially unknown LLM service quality, invocation costs, and execution times. JOVE makes execution and verification decisions by solving a sequence of per-query mixed-integer linear programs. Online learning updates task-dependent estimates of LLM quality based on verification feedback, while an information-gain bonus incorporates the value of learning into allocation decisions. Under a natural set of assumptions, we establish sublinear quality-learning regret for JOVE. Across four reasoning benchmarks, JOVE achieves competitive accuracy against standard inference baselines while reducing average cost and latency by at least 3.17 times.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JOVE 把复杂推理查询拆成 DAG 任务图并分发到异构 LLM，在长期预算与单查询延迟约束下，用逐查询混合整数线性规划同时决定执行模型与哪些中间结果付费验证，验证反馈再在线更新模型质量估计并以 information-gain bonus 计入学习价值。在四个推理基准上，相对标准推理基线精度有竞争力，同时平均成本与延迟至少降低 3.17 倍，并在自然假设下证明次线性 quality-learning regret。
Motivation: 复杂推理查询可并行拆分到异构 LLM，但各子任务适合哪个模型事先未知，且只执行无法判断输出对错；系统还需在当下花钱执行与为后续积累学习之间权衡。
Method: JOVE 为每个查询求解一串混合整数线性程序 (MILP) 来联合选择执行 LLM 与待付费验证的中间输出；验证异步执行，其反馈经在线学习更新任务相关的 LLM 质量估计，information-gain bonus 把学习价值纳入分配决策，优化目标同时受长期预算与单查询延迟约束，服务质量、调用成本与执行时间均为随机且初始未知。
Result: 在四个推理基准上，JOVE 相对标准推理基线取得有竞争力的精度，同时将平均成本与延迟降低至少 3.17 倍；并在一组自然假设下建立 JOVE 的次线性 quality-learning regret。
Conclusion: 把执行与付费验证放进同一个在线决策问题、用学习价值调节探索，可以在满足延迟与预算约束的同时压低成本与延迟而不牺牲精度。

papers.title: Wrong Organ, Right Physics: Transferring Echocardiography Pretraining to Lung Ultrasound for Tuberculosis Screening
papers.abstract_en: Lung ultrasound (LUS) is attractive for tuberculosis (TB) screening at primary-care level, but labelled cohorts are small. Echocardiography carries no such constraint, while sharing the same underlying ultrasound imaging physics, signal processing and B-mode appearance as LUS. We ask whether an encoder pretrained on that high-resource ultrasound domain carries representations that remain usable in the low-resource one. Only the encoder varies, across seventeen encoders spanning three architecture families. Among them, a latent-predictive video encoder pretrained on generic video (V-JEPA2-L) and its echocardiography counterpart (EchoJEPA-L) differ in pretraining corpus alone. The choice among these encoders does not resolve the classification, the whole family spanning 2.50 percentage points against a measurement resolution of 2.71. What moves the task instead is feature conditioning. Standardising the features between the encoder and the classifier improves all seventeen encoders by a mean of +1.23 percentage points at $p=1.5\times10^{-5}$. On the held-out test set every encoder selected on the development folds stands above the baseline system by up to +2.57 percentage points of area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC), and specificity at 90% sensitivity reaches 79.3% against 60.3%. The contrast specified in advance, EchoJEPA-L against V-JEPA2-L, measures -0.16 percentage points at $p=0.926$. We therefore find no evidence that shared ultrasonic physics alone makes echocardiography a more productive pretraining corpus than generic video, and any advantage, if present, is smaller than this cohort can resolve. The video encoders receive replicated still images, however, so whether this absence of an effect reflects the pretraining domain or a video encoder applied to static frames cannot be separated. The limiting factor is the labelled cohort rather than the encoder.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at SATNAC 2026, Drakensberg, South Africa, 11-14 October 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在结核病肺超声 (LUS) 筛查的小标注队列上，跨 17 个编码器、3 个架构族的对照显示：决定性能的是编码器与分类器之间的特征标准化，而不是预训练域。特征标准化使全部 17 个编码器平均提升 +1.23 个百分点 (p=1.5×10⁻⁵)；预先指定的 EchoJEPA-L 对 V-JEPA2-L 对比仅 -0.16 个百分点 (p=0.926)，即共享超声成像物理并不让超声心动图预训练优于通用视频。
Motivation: LUS 适合基层结核病筛查但标注队列很小，超声心动图数据充足且与 LUS 共享成像物理、信号处理与 B-mode 外观；需要判断高资源超声域的预训练编码器在低资源域是否仍可用。
Method: 只变编码器，比较横跨 3 个架构族的 17 个编码器；其中 V-JEPA2-L（通用视频预训练）与 EchoJEPA-L（超声心动图对应版）仅预训练语料不同，构成预先指定的对照。评估用开发折选择编码器、留出测试集报告 AUROC 与 90% 灵敏度下的特异度，并检验特征标准化（feature conditioning）的影响。
Result: 17 个编码器整体跨度仅 2.50 个百分点，小于 2.71 的测量分辨率；特征标准化平均提升 +1.23 个百分点 (p=1.5×10⁻⁵)；留出测试集上所有按开发折选出的编码器均高于基线系统，AUROC 最多 +2.57 个百分点，90% 灵敏度下特异度 79.3% 对基线 60.3%；EchoJEPA-L 对 V-JEPA2-L 为 -0.16 个百分点 (p=0.926)。
Conclusion: 没有证据表明共享超声物理本身让超声心动图成为更有产出的预训练语料，若有优势也小于该队列的分辨能力；限制因素是标注队列而非编码器。视频编码器只收到复制的静帧，因此效应缺失无法区分是预训练域还是视频编码器用于静态图像所致。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Architecture-Dependent Fusion Pathways in MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance across vision-language tasks, yet the internal mechanisms by which visual and textual information are fused across layers remain insufficiently understood. We investigate representative MLLMs from two architectural paradigms: concatenation architectures and native multimodal architectures. We conduct three progressively connected analyses: alignment decoupling identifies which modality changes, attention routing and entropy characterize how cross-modal information is distributed, and intrinsic dimensionality examines how fusion reshapes feature spaces. Separately, we perform causal intervention experiments as a validation of the resulting interpretation. As a supplementary analysis, we use visual CKA to examine the Platonic Representation Hypothesis. Together, these analyses reveal two distinct fusion pathways: concatenation models follow a text-first, vision-later pathway, whereas native models exhibit earlier visual-textual co-adaptation and feature-space reorganization. This work provides a mechanistic perspective for understanding multimodal fusion and supports architecture-aware diagnostics of multimodal representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对拼接式 (concatenation) 与原生多模态 (native) 两类 MLLM 做机制分析，发现融合路径随架构分叉：拼接模型走 text-first、vision-later 通路，原生模型则更早发生图文共适应与特征空间重组。作者据此主张按架构区分的多模态表征诊断。
Motivation: MLLM 跨层融合视觉与文本信息的内部机制不清楚，且两类主流架构范式是否走同一条融合通路未被区分。
Method: 三步递进分析：alignment decoupling 定位哪一模态在变，attention routing 与 entropy 刻画跨模态信息分布，intrinsic dimensionality 检验融合如何重塑特征空间；另做因果干预实验作为解释的验证，并用 visual CKA 补充分析 Platonic Representation Hypothesis。
Result: 识别出两条融合通路：拼接架构呈 text-first、vision-later，原生架构呈现更早的图文共适应与特征空间重组；因果干预实验被用作上述解释的验证手段。
Conclusion: 多模态融合不是架构无关的统一过程，理解与诊断多模态表征需要 architecture-aware 的机制视角。

papers.title: HexVIO: Towards All-Day Stereo-Inertial Tracking Through Commodity DSPs
papers.abstract_en: The ability of a device to localize itself within its surroundings is a fundamental prerequisite for spatial computing. Visual-inertial odometry (VIO) has proven to be a cost-effective and accurate solution for this task. Robots, wearables, XR devices, and drones can benefit significantly from efficient implementations of VIO since they allow for cooler, lighter, and cheaper devices with longer battery life and a better user experience. In this work, we propose to enhance the efficiency of a VIO system by leveraging the Hexagon DSP, a commodity co-processor present in many modern smartphones and XR devices. Our approach offloads the visual frontend of a stereo-inertial odometry system to the DSP while keeping the backend on the main CPU. By optimizing the implementation for the DSP architecture, we achieve significant reductions in power consumption and latency compared to CPU-only execution. Our system, HexVIO, demonstrates a 67% reduction in power consumption or an 86% increase in throughput on a commodity smartphone, with the ability to sustain long-term real-time 30 fps tracking for 0.83 W, corresponding to ~18 hours of tracking on the testing device. These results highlight the potential of commodity DSPs for enabling all-day visual-inertial tracking in robotics and mobile devices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HexVIO 把双目惯性里程计 (stereo-inertial odometry) 的视觉前端卸载到手机的 Hexagon DSP、后端留在 CPU，通过面向 DSP 架构的实现优化降低功耗与延迟。在商用手机上功耗降低 67% 或吞吐提升 86%，以 0.83 W 持续 30 fps 实时跟踪，对应约 18 小时跟踪时长。
Motivation: 机器人、可穿戴、XR 与无人机需要更冷、更轻、更省电的 VIO 实现以延长续航，而纯 CPU 执行在功耗与延迟上受限。
Method: 将双目惯性里程计系统的视觉前端卸载到 Hexagon DSP 协处理器，后端保留在主 CPU；针对 DSP 架构优化实现以降低功耗与延迟，系统命名为 HexVIO。
Result: 在商用智能手机上实现功耗降低 67% 或吞吐提升 86%；以 0.83 W 维持长期实时 30 fps 跟踪，在测试设备上对应约 18 小时跟踪。
Conclusion: 商用 DSP 足以支撑机器人与移动设备上的全天候视觉惯性跟踪，前端卸载到 DSP、后端留 CPU 是可行的分工路径。
Relevance: 0
