summary_sections.method: 将双目惯性里程计系统的视觉前端卸载到 Hexagon DSP 协处理器，后端保留在主 CPU；针对 DSP 架构优化实现以降低功耗与延迟，系统命名为 HexVIO。
summary_sections.result: 在商用智能手机上实现功耗降低 67% 或吞吐提升 86%；以 0.83 W 维持长期实时 30 fps 跟踪，在测试设备上对应约 18 小时跟踪。
summary_sections.conclusion: 商用 DSP 足以支撑机器人与移动设备上的全天候视觉惯性跟踪，前端卸载到 DSP、后端留 CPU 是可行的分工路径。

papers.title: Moving Forward with Video Saliency: A New Dataset and Benchmark where Motion Matters
papers.abstract_en: Video saliency prediction is inherently harder to model than static image saliency due to the additional temporal dimension. Video saliency benchmarks rest on the premise that predicting gaze on video requires utilizing temporal activity distributed across frames. Prior work has challenged this, showing that static baselines recover a significant fraction of the explainable gaze information on LEDOV, a popular video saliency dataset, and that video saliency models fail in the same places as this static baseline. We verify that this diagnosis still stands: under a more capable gold standard than the original analysis, and an updated panel of recent architectures, the strongest temporal architecture in the panel still does not substantially improve over a fine-tuned static baseline. However, it remains unclear whether the marginal gain reflects limitations of current temporal architectures or a lack of temporal patterns in the benchmark itself. We introduce SalTempto, a video saliency benchmark with greater dynamism: 224 clips of highly dynamic content, sourced from the HACS-Segments dataset so that each clip contains an event together with its lead-up and aftermath, with gaze recordings from up to 16 subjects and a training split for adapting pretrained models. On SalTempto, the static baseline recovers only about 13\% of the headroom above the centerbias, against more than half on LEDOV. A fine-tuned temporal architecture shows a substantial gain in performance over the static baseline, indicating that it does capture meaningfully more temporal information, which LEDOV fails to measure. Yet, even this SoTA model still leaves nearly half of SalTempto's headroom unexplained, indicating room for improvement in video saliency modelling. Examination of SalTempto also lets us describe human tendencies that models miss. SalTempto link: https://huggingface.co/datasets/bethgelab/video_saliency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出高动态视频显著性基准 SalTempto：224 段取自 HACS-Segments 的强动态片段（每段含事件及其前因后果），最多 16 名被试注视记录，并设训练划分供微调预训练模型。在 LEDOV 上静态基线可回收 centerbias 之上超过一半的可解释注视信息，而在 SalTempto 上仅约 13%，微调后的时间架构相对静态基线取得实质提升，说明 LEDOV 测不出的时间信息确实存在。
Motivation: 既有视频显著性基准（如 LEDOV）被质疑缺乏真正的时间模式：静态基线就能恢复大部分可解释注视信息，视频模型与静态基线失败位置一致，因而无法区分是时间架构能力不足还是基准本身不够动态。
Method: 构建 SalTempto 基准：从 HACS-Segments 选取 224 段高动态内容片段，每段包含事件及其 lead-up 与 aftermath，采集最多 16 名被试的注视数据，并提供训练划分用于微调预训练模型；在更强的 gold standard 与更新的近期架构面板下重做 LEDOV 上的静态基线诊断。
Result: 在更强 gold standard 与更新架构面板下，最强时间架构相对微调静态基线仍无实质提升（复现 LEDOV 诊断）。LEDOV 上静态基线回收 centerbias 之上超过一半的 headroom，SalTempto 上仅约 13%；微调后的时间架构在 SalTempto 上相对静态基线取得实质提升，但该 SoTA 模型仍留下接近一半的 headroom 未解释。
Conclusion: LEDOV 无法度量真实的时间信息，动态性足够的基准才能区分时间架构的能力与基准缺陷；即便如此，视频显著性建模仍有接近一半的 headroom 待改进。

papers.title: EVOL: Simulator-Guided Evolutionary Expert Synthesis for Deployment-Free Learning Path Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) for learning path recommendation (LPR) faces two coupled obstacles. First, the policy must commit to a sequence of L concepts without intermediate feedback, producing a combinatorial search space that grows super-exponentially with L and provides reward only at the final step. Second, expert learning paths would be the natural cure for sparse-reward RL, but they do not exist in educational data, because student logs record what learners did, not what they should have done. We address both obstacles by importing a recipe from simulator-based demonstration learning in robotics: the knowledge tracing simulator is used both to synthesize per-learner expert demonstrations through evolutionary search and to train a deployment-free policy that distills these demonstrations into a feed-forward learner. Our framework, EVOL, instantiates this pipeline with an asymmetric actor-critic where the actor commits to deployment-realistic blind planning while the critic exploits the privileged simulator state during training. Across three datasets (ASSIST15, Junyi, and EdNet; 39-189 concepts) and path lengths L = 5, 10, and 20, EVOL surpasses 8 baselines spanning heuristic, sequential, RL, graph-enhanced RL, and LLM-enhanced methods. We further compare three imitation strategies (BC, AWR, and DAPG) and show that final performance is governed by the quality of evolutionary experts rather than by the particular imitation objective.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EVOL 用进化搜索在 knowledge tracing 仿真器里为每个学习者合成专家示范，再以非对称 actor-critic 把示范蒸馏成可部署的前馈学习路径推荐策略，actor 只用盲规划、critic 训练时利用特权仿真状态。在 ASSIST15、Junyi、EdNet 三个数据集（39–189 个概念）、路径长度 L=5/10/20 上超过 8 个基线，且最终性能由进化专家质量而非模仿目标（BC/AWR/DAPG）决定。
Motivation: 学习路径推荐的 RL 必须一次性承诺 L 个概念的序列，搜索空间随 L 超指数增长且只有终局奖励；而教育数据只记录学生做了什么、不记录应该学什么，专家路径缺失使稀疏奖励 RL 无从示范学习。
Method: 把机器人领域的 simulator-based demonstration learning 移植过来：用 knowledge tracing 仿真器经进化搜索合成逐学习者专家示范，并训练 deployment-free 策略；框架采用非对称 actor-critic，actor 在部署可行的盲规划下决策，critic 训练时访问特权仿真状态，再用 BC、AWR、DAPG 三种模仿策略对比。
Result: 在 ASSIST15、Junyi、EdNet（39–189 concepts）与 L=5、10、20 上超过 8 个基线，覆盖 heuristic、sequential、RL、graph-enhanced RL 与 LLM-enhanced 方法；三种模仿策略对比显示最终性能由进化专家质量决定，而非取决于具体模仿目标。
Conclusion: 稀疏奖励的学习路径推荐 RL 可以靠仿真器内进化合成的专家示范解决，且改进的关键在专家质量而非选 BC、AWR 还是 DAPG。

papers.title: SPEAR: A Spectral-Disentangled MoE Neural Operator with Knowledge-Guided Expert Aggregation for Large-Scale PDE Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale pre-training has improved the generalization of neural operators across diverse PDEs. However, existing PDE foundation models still struggle with heterogeneous dynamics, where shared representations may cause knowledge interference, while mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures suffer from increasing expert redundancy. We propose SPEAR, a spectral-disentangled MoE neural operator with knowledge-guided expert aggregation for large-scale PDE pre-training. SPEAR decouples latent features into low- and high-frequency components, enabling shared modeling of transferable dynamics and specialized learning of PDE-specific patterns. To address expert redundancy, we design a knowledge-guided expert aggregation strategy that measures expert similarity from dataset-specific learned knowledge and routing preferences, enabling the identification and consolidation of similar experts. Experiments on twelve PDE datasets and multiple downstream benchmarks demonstrate superior performance in pre-training, fine-tuning, and transfer learning. Furthermore, our aggregation strategy reduces the number of experts by 50\% while maintaining or improving prediction accuracy, achieving a balance between model efficiency and generalization for PDE foundation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPEAR 用谱解耦把隐特征拆成低频与高频分量，让 MoE 神经算子共享可迁移动力学、专学各 PDE 特有模式，再按数据集学到的知识与路由偏好度量专家相似度并合并冗余专家。在十二个 PDE 数据集与多个下游基准上，预训练、微调与迁移学习均取得更优表现；聚合策略把专家数减少 50% 而精度持平或提升。
Motivation: PPE 基础模型面对异构动力学时共享表示会互相干扰，而 MoE 架构又随规模增大出现专家冗余，效率与泛化难以兼顾。
Method: SPEAR（spectral-disentangled MoE neural operator）将隐特征解耦为低频与高频分量，低频承载可迁移动力学的共享建模、高频承载 PDE 特有模式的专门学习；知识引导的专家聚合策略依据数据集特有的学习知识与路由偏好度量专家相似度，识别并合并相似专家，用于大规模 PDE 预训练。
Result: 在十二个 PDE 数据集和多个下游基准上，预训练、微调与迁移学习均取得更优表现；聚合策略将专家数量减少 50%，同时保持或提升预测精度。
Conclusion: 谱解耦加知识引导的专家合并能在 PDE 基础模型上同时换来效率与泛化：专家减半仍不掉点，说明冗余专家可安全压缩。

papers.title: Consecutive Posterior Fusion for Diffusive Recovery of Unobservable Image Structures
papers.abstract_en: Solving severely ill-posed imaging inverse problems requires recovering image structures that are unobservable or weakly constrained by the measurements. Diffusion models provide expressive learned priors for inferring such missing information, while posterior sampling incorporates measurement consistency along the reverse process. Standard diffusion posterior samplers, however, rely on instantaneous measurement-aware estimates, without explicitly exploiting information carried by previous posterior corrections. We introduce Consecutive Posterior Fusion Denoising Diffusion Null-Space Models (CPF-DDNM), an inference-time strategy that fuses consecutive measurement-aware estimates to improve the diffusive recovery of unobservable image structures, without requiring retraining or additional denoiser evaluations. We instantiate this principle within DDNM, whose range/null-space decomposition reveals that consecutive fusion preserves the measurement-determined component while acting exclusively on the prior-driven null-space estimate. We thus provide a geometric interpretation of CPF-DDNM and a local error analysis that characterizes the optimal time-dependent fusion coefficient, including the extrapolative regime. Experiments on sparse-view and simulated low-dose computed tomography, as well as medical image super-resolution, show consistent improvements over DDNM and competitive performance against diffusion-based inverse solvers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CPF-DDNM：在 DDNM 的推理过程中把连续多步的 measurement-aware 估计做融合，只改动先验驱动的 null-space 分量而保持测量决定的 range 分量不变，从而改善严重不适定逆问题中不可观测结构的恢复，无需重训也无需额外 denoiser 评估。在稀疏视角与模拟低剂量 CT、医学图像超分辨率上相对 DDNM 有一致提升。
Motivation: 标准 diffusion posterior sampler 只用当前一步的瞬时测量感知估计，丢掉了先前后验修正中携带的信息，导致被测量弱约束或完全不可观测的图像结构恢复不足。
Method: 在 DDNM 内实现推理时策略 CPF-DDNM：利用其 range/null-space 分解，对连续的 measurement-aware 估计做融合，融合操作只作用于先验驱动的 null-space 估计、保留测量决定的分量；给出几何解释与局部误差分析，导出最优的时变融合系数（含外推 regime）。
Result: 在稀疏视角 CT、模拟低剂量 CT 与医学图像超分辨率三类任务上，CPF-DDNM 相对 DDNM 有一致改进，并与基于 diffusion 的其他逆问题求解器表现相当；无需重训或额外 denoiser 调用。
Conclusion: 把连续后验修正融合进 null-space 分量即可提升 diffusion 逆问题恢复，且是免训练的推理时改动，最优融合系数可由局部误差分析按时变形式给出。

papers.title: PaMIR: Open Benchmark of Public Credit-Default Datasets
papers.abstract_en: We release PaMIR (Public Arrival-ordered Measurement for Inference in Risk), an open benchmark for credit-default prediction when labels are scarce and arrive late. The field's reference benchmark studies use eight datasets each, only two or four of them public. PaMIR brings together 19 public datasets with binary default labels -- 1.24M loans, firms and card accounts from nine countries -- rebuilt from pinned source snapshots by one leakage-audited recipe and never redistributed; to our knowledge it is the one of its kind as of today. Every model is a single function, scored under a repeated i.i.d. split and a label-delayed stream in which each application is scored on arrival, with AUC reported by label budget; fleet means are withheld unless every dataset is scored. A synthetic-data harness tests generated training rows without letting a generator see held-out rows. This report describes release 0.4.0 of this living benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PaMIR 是一个面向标签稀缺且延迟到达的违约预测开放基准：把 19 个公开二分类违约数据集（124 万笔贷款/企业/信用卡账户，来自 9 个国家）用同一套防泄漏配方从固定快照重建，统一在重复 i.i.d. 划分与标签延迟流两种设定下按标签预算报告 AUC。与现有参考基准各用 8 个数据集（仅 2 或 4 个公开）相比，PaMIR 全部公开且不重新分发原始数据。
Motivation: 违约预测领域参考基准各用 8 个数据集，其中只有 2 个或 4 个是公开的，标签稀缺与延迟到达的场景缺少统一、可复现的评测口径。
Method: 用单一防泄漏 (leakage-audited) 配方从固定源快照 (pinned source snapshots) 重建 19 个带二分类违约标签的公开数据集，原始数据不重新分发；所有模型视为单一函数，在重复 i.i.d. 划分与标签延迟流 (label-delayed stream) 下评测，每个申请到达即打分，AUC 按标签预算报告，且只有全部数据集都评测才给出 fleet 均值；另配合成数据 harness，禁止生成器看到留出行。

papers.title: Mapping and Advancing the Scalability-Accuracy Frontier of Nonlinear Causal Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Scalable nonlinear causal discovery requires methods that combine flexible mechanism estimators with efficient search over large graph spaces. Several algorithmic families have been proposed to address this challenge, yet their accuracy-runtime trade-offs remain poorly understood. We empirically compare the four major approaches: differentiable structure learning, amortized structure learning, score-matching, and combinatorial search. Our results reveal complementary bottlenecks: differentiable and amortized methods scale well but exhibit an accuracy gap, score-matching methods can be accurate in low dimensions but degrade quickly for increasing feature sizes, and combinatorial methods remain accurate but are slowed by repeated and redundant local scoring. Motivated by this bottleneck, we develop SPADE, a spline-based score-evaluation scheme that compiles sufficient statistics once and reuses them throughout combinatorial search. Under bounded indegree, its Gaussian variant reduces algorithmic complexity from O(nd^3) to O(nd^2+d^3). Empirically, SPADE shifts the observed scalability-accuracy frontier by orders of magnitude: it solves 100-variable problems with 160K samples in seconds and 1600-variable problems with 2.5K samples in minutes, while retaining high structural accuracy across synthetic and real-world benchmarks. These results reveal a substantial shift in the practical scale of combinatorial search and highlight the importance of evaluating scalable causal-discovery methods along the full accuracy-runtime frontier.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPADE 用样条分数评估把充分统计量一次性编译并在组合搜索中复用，在有界入度下把高斯情形的算法复杂度从 O(nd^3) 降到 O(nd^2+d^3)，使组合式因果发现在秒级解 100 变量/160K 样本、分钟级解 1600 变量/2.5K 样本，同时保持高结构精度，从而把可扩展性-精度前沿整体外推若干数量级。
Motivation: 非线性因果发现的四类主流方法（可微结构学习、摊销结构学习、score-matching、组合搜索）在精度-运行时间权衡上各有瓶颈且缺乏系统对照：可微与摊销方法可扩展但精度有缺口，score-matching 随特征数增加迅速退化，组合方法精度高却被重复、冗余的局部打分拖慢。
Method: 先实证对比四种主流因果发现路线的精度-运行时权衡，再针对组合搜索的重复打分瓶颈提出 SPADE：基于样条的分数评估方案，一次性编译充分统计量并在整个组合搜索过程中复用；在有界入度 (bounded indegree) 假设下给出高斯变体的复杂度分析，并在合成与真实基准上检验。
Result: 高斯变体在有界入度下把算法复杂度从 O(nd^3) 降至 O(nd^2+d^3)；实证上 SPADE 把可扩展性-精度前沿外推若干数量级，秒级求解 100 变量、160K 样本的问题，分钟级求解 1600 变量、2.5K 样本的问题，并在合成与真实基准上保持高结构精度。
Conclusion: 组合式因果搜索的实用规模被重复局部打分而非搜索本身限制，复用编译后的充分统计量可大幅外推其精度-运行时前沿；评估可扩展因果发现方法应看完整的 accuracy-runtime 曲线而非单点。

papers.title: Cross-cohort TB classification using clinical data gathered in Uganda and South Africa
papers.abstract_en: We present a first evaluation of machine learning applied to patient clinical and demographic data gathered in two different countries for the purpose of tuberculosis (TB) screening to identify people who would benefit from expensive molecular testing. Experiments are based on the recently-compiled CAGE-TB dataset, which includes sub-cohorts of people with presumptive TB presenting at community health care centres in South Africa and Uganda. Three neural network architectures (logistic regression (LR), multilayer perceptrons (MLP) and convolutional neural networks (CNN)) are considered in conjunction with greedy feature selection. For the convolutional neural network, a strategy that jointly optimises feature selection and feature ordering is proposed and shown to lead to consistent development and test set improvements. For all three models, development set area under the receiver operating characteristic (AUROC) curve is improved by 2-7% using feature selection. LR after feature selection achieves an AUROC of 0.8 [0.75,0.86] (95% CI) and 0.84 [0.78,0.9] when testing on the held-out Ugandan and South African data respectively. Although outperforming LR on the development cohort, the deeper networks (MLP, CNN) show inconsistent trends on the held-out cohorts, while LR achieves performance within 1-2% of the best achieved in terms of AUROC. LR narrowly misses the WHO minimum requirements by 4-9% in sensitivity even though the network is being evaluated on a completely held-out cohort. The development of neural-network based classifiers for TB screening therefore appears viable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 CAGE-TB 数据集（南非与乌干达两个亚队列）上做跨队列结核病 (TB) 筛查分类，LR 配合贪心特征选择在完全留出的乌干达与南非数据上 AUROC 分别为 0.8 [0.75, 0.86] 与 0.84 [0.78, 0.9]，且敏感度距 WHO 最低要求仅差 4–9%。更深的 MLP 与 CNN 在开发队列上优于 LR，但在留出队列表现不一致，因此简单模型加特征选择是更稳的跨队列方案。
Motivation: 跨国采集的临床与人口学数据存在队列差异，需要判断机器学习能否在完全留出的另一国队列上仍可用于 TB 筛查，以决定谁值得做昂贵的分子检测。
Method: 基于 CAGE-TB 数据集，比较 logistic regression (LR)、多层感知机 (MLP) 与卷积神经网络 (CNN) 三种架构，并结合贪心特征选择；对 CNN 提出联合优化特征选择与特征排序的策略。
Result: 三种模型的开发集 AUROC 经特征选择均提升 2–7%；特征选择后 LR 在留出的乌干达数据上 AUROC 0.8 [0.75, 0.86]、南非数据 0.84 [0.78, 0.9]（95% CI）；MLP 与 CNN 在开发队列上超过 LR 但在留出队列趋势不一致，LR 距最优 AUROC 仅 1–2%；LR 敏感度比 WHO 最低要求低 4–9%。
Conclusion: 基于神经网络的 TB 筛查分类器开发可行，但在跨队列场景下 LR 加特征选择已接近最优且更稳定，敏感度仍差 WHO 门槛 4–9%。

papers.title: COSMI: COmpositional Synthesis of Multi-object Interactions
papers.abstract_en: Generative models of human-object interaction are bounded by the data that exists: everyday activities involve several objects, but most captured datasets record one at a time, as multi-object capture is combinatorially expensive. Our observation is that interactions are local, so single-object captures already contain the parts of multi-object activities. We compose them: contact-consistent clips of single interactions, mirrored to balance the hands, transfer between bodies, and a language model and geometric checks admit only the pairings that are plausible, semantically and physically. Therefore, the dataset grows combinatorially with the clips rather than recording time. The COSMI dataset holds 222k sequences and 275 hours with up to five objects, nearly thirty times the largest multi-object capture, and can be extended by adding datasets or even hand-object recordings. On this data we train the COSMI method, a text-to-interaction diffusion transformer that follows how the data is built: weight-shared object slots generate a variable number of objects, predicted relative to the body parts that move them. On a benchmark with an unseen object and unseen interaction combinations, models trained on the dataset generalize to the unseen combinations. COSMI outperforms baselines in text alignment and contact accuracy, where its margin is largest on the unseen object. Code, models, and the dataset pipeline will be released on the project page: https://ptrvilya.github.io/cosmi.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: COSMI 用组合合成把单物体交互片段拼成多物体交互数据集：接触一致的单交互片段先镜像平衡双手、再在身体间迁移，由语言模型加几何检查只保留语义与物理上合理的配对，使数据量随片段数而非录制时长组合增长。由此得到 222k 序列、275 小时、最多五物体的数据集，约为最大多物体采集的近三十倍；在其上训练的权重共享 object slot 扩散 Transformer 在未见物体与未见交互组合基准上泛化，并在文本对齐与接触精度上超过基线，未见物体上差距最大。
Motivation: 日常活动涉及多个物体，但现有采集数据集多为单物体录制，多物体采集成本随组合数爆炸，导致生成模型的训练数据受限。
Method: 把接触一致的单交互片段镜像以平衡双手、在不同身体间迁移，用语言模型与几何检查筛选语义和物理上合理的配对，组合生成多物体数据集 COSMI；再训练文本到交互的扩散 Transformer，采用权重共享的 object slot 生成可变数量物体，且物体相对驱动它的身体部位预测。
Result: COSMI 数据集含 222k 序列、275 小时、最多五个物体，规模接近最大多物体采集的三十倍；在含未见物体与未见交互组合的基准上，用该数据训练的模型能泛化到未见组合，且在文本对齐与接触精度上优于基线，未见物体上优势最大。
Conclusion: 交互的局部性使单物体采集可以组合成多物体数据，数据规模随片段数而非录制时间增长；按数据构造方式设计的权重共享 object slot 模型能泛化到未见的物体与交互组合。

papers.title: Learning a Fact Is Not Learning How to Retrieve It
papers.abstract_en: A model trained on "The capital of X is Y" may produce "Y" after "The capital of X is" but fail after "The capital of X:". We call these different ways of eliciting the same fact request forms. To separate learning a fact from retrieving it, we train two models in two stages. In the first stage (request-form training), one model sees each fact in five forms and the other sees the same facts only as statements. In the second stage (target-fact training), both receive identical training on new facts, all as statements. Both then retrieve the new facts almost equally well from statements, but differ sharply on other request forms. Thus, a model can learn how to retrieve through a request form before it learns the facts. To understand this difference, we examine the hidden state immediately before the answer, which we call the context state. When given two different request forms for the same fact, the model trained on five forms in stage one produces more similar context states than the model trained on statements alone in that stage. Changing this state at retrieval time can enable or prevent retrieval of an already learned fact, and the same effect transfers across facts and factual relations, such as capitals and currencies. To test its role during learning, we change the context state only during target-fact training. This intervention changes later retrieval without intervention at test time. Together, these results show that later retrieval depends on earlier request-form experience and the context state during fact learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把同一事实的不同提问方式称为 request form，发现模型可以先学会「如何检索」再学会事实本身：第一阶段见过五种提问形式的模型，在第二阶段与只见过陈述句的模型对新事实的陈述式检索几乎一样好，但在其他提问形式上差异显著。答案前的隐状态（context state）在五形式模型中跨提问形式更相似，且在检索时改动该状态可开启或阻止已学事实的检索，该效应可跨事实与关系（首都、货币）迁移；只在事实训练阶段改动它也能改变之后的检索。
Motivation: 把「学会一个事实」与「学会如何检索该事实」混为一谈，会掩盖模型对提问形式的依赖：同一事实在不同 request form 下检索成败不一，而现有训练评估多只用陈述式提问。
Method: 两阶段训练对照：第一阶段 request-form training，一个模型对每个事实见五种提问形式，另一个只见证述句；第二阶段 target-fact training，两者对新事实接受完全相同的陈述式训练。随后比较新事实在各提问形式下的检索，并分析答案前的隐状态（context state），在检索时以及仅在目标事实训练时对该状态做干预。
Result: 两个模型在陈述式提问下对新事实的检索几乎一样好，但在其他提问形式上差异显著；五形式模型对同一事实的不同提问形式产生更相似的 context state。检索时改动 context state 可开启或阻止已学事实的检索，效应跨事实与跨关系（capitals、currencies）迁移；仅在 target-fact training 期间改动该状态即可改变之后的检索，测试时无需再干预。
Conclusion: 后续检索同时取决于早期的提问形式经验和事实学习时的 context state，因此「学会事实」与「学会如何检索事实」是可分离的两件事。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.motivation: 把「学会一个事实」与「学会如何检索该事实」混为一谈，会掩盖模型对提问形式的依赖：同一事实在不同 request form 下检索成败不一，而现有训练评估多只用陈述式提问。
summary_sections.method: 两阶段训练对照：第一阶段 request-form training，一个模型对每个事实见五种提问形式，另一个只见证述句；第二阶段 target-fact training，两者对新事实接受完全相同的陈述式训练。随后比较新事实在各提问形式下的检索，并分析答案前的隐状态（context state），在检索时以及仅在目标事实训练时对该状态做干预。
summary_sections.result: 两个模型在陈述式提问下对新事实的检索几乎一样好，但在其他提问形式上差异显著；五形式模型对同一事实的不同提问形式产生更相似的 context state。检索时改动 context state 可开启或阻止已学事实的检索，效应跨事实与跨关系（capitals、currencies）迁移；仅在 target-fact training 期间改动该状态即可改变之后的检索，测试时无需再干预。
summary_sections.conclusion: 后续检索同时取决于早期的提问形式经验和事实学习时的 context state，因此「学会事实」与「学会如何检索事实」是可分离的两件事。

papers.title: EmbPASS: Towards Cross-Embodiment Open Panoramic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Panoramic images provide a complete 360-degree field of view, enabling comprehensive scene understanding for embodied perception. However, heterogeneous embodied platforms exhibit substantial differences in observation viewpoints and spatial layouts, giving rise to cross-embodiment observation shifts that pose additional challenges to consistent and reliable panoramic perception, while systematic studies of this problem remain limited. To bridge this gap, we introduce a new task, termed Cross-Embodiment Open Panoramic Segmentation. Meanwhile, we establish EmbPASS, a multi-platform panoramic semantic segmentation benchmark spanning Vehicle, Drone, Wearable, and Quadruped platforms under a unified semantic taxonomy, providing a testbed for systematically studying cross-embodiment panoramic perception. We further propose EPONet, an open-vocabulary panoramic semantic segmentation network that integrates Relation-Aware Metric Adapter (RAMA) and Content-Adaptive Semantic Transfer (CAST) to enhance spatial modeling and semantic transfer under heterogeneous embodied observations. Extensive experiments show that EPONet achieves the best platform-balanced performance on EmbPASS with 35.82% mIoU, outperforming the strongest baseline by 1.10%, while remaining competitive on existing panoramic segmentation benchmarks. The source code and EmbPASS benchmark will be made publicly available at https://github.com/guopj1/EmbPASS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出跨具身开放全景分割新任务与 EmbPASS 基准，覆盖 Vehicle、Drone、Wearable、Quadruped 四类平台的统一语义体系，并提出 EPONet（含 RAMA 与 CAST 模块）做开放词汇全景语义分割。在 EmbPASS 上 EPONet 取得最佳平台均衡性能 35.82% mIoU，比最强基线高 1.10%。
Motivation: 不同具身平台的观测视角与空间布局差异造成跨具身观测偏移 (cross-embodiment observation shift)，使全景感知难以保持一致可靠，而系统性研究此前很少。
Method: 建立 EmbPASS 多平台全景语义分割基准（Vehicle/Drone/Wearable/Quadruped，统一语义分类体系）；提出 EPONet 开放词汇全景分割网络，用 Relation-Aware Metric Adapter (RAMA) 增强空间建模，用 Content-Adaptive Semantic Transfer (CAST) 做异构观测下的语义迁移。
Result: EPONet 在 EmbPASS 上取得最佳平台均衡性能 35.82% mIoU，比最强基线高 1.10%，并在既有全景分割基准上保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 跨具身观测偏移可通过关系感知度量适配与内容自适应语义迁移缓解，EmbPASS 与 EPONet 源码将公开发布。

papers.title: WAMpy: Efficient Synthesis of Prolog Programs in Python
papers.abstract_en: We present WAMpy, a Python framework optimized for synthesizing Prolog programs. Unlike general-purpose Prolog systems, WAMpy targets workloads that repeatedly generate and evaluate small candidate programs. WAMpy compiles Prolog clauses into NumPy array-based WAM instructions and supports partial recompilation of hypotheses against fixed background knowledge. Performance-critical routines are accelerated using Numba just-in-time (JIT) compilation. In a benchmark of repeated compilation-and-evaluation workloads, WAMpy improves end-to-end performance compared with SWI-Prolog accessed from Python using Janus.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 2 figures. Accepted as a demo at the 6th International Joint Conference on Learning and Reasoning (IJCLR 2026). Code: https://github.com/cognitive-modeling/WAMpy
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WAMpy 是面向「反复生成并评估小程序候选」这一工作负载的 Python 端 Prolog 综合框架：把 Prolog 子句编译成基于 NumPy 数组的 WAM 指令，支持针对固定背景知识对假设做部分重编译，性能关键路径用 Numba JIT 加速。在重复编译-评估基准上，其端到端性能优于通过 Janus 从 Python 调用的 SWI-Prolog。
Motivation: 程序综合类工作负载需要高频编译并评估大量小候选程序，通用 Prolog 系统（如从 Python 经 Janus 调用的 SWI-Prolog）在这一场景下端到端开销偏高。
Method: 将 Prolog 子句编译为 NumPy 数组表示的 WAM 指令；针对固定背景知识支持假设的部分重编译 (partial recompilation)，避免整段重编译；性能关键例程交由 Numba JIT 加速，整体以 Python 框架形式提供。
Result: 在重复编译与评估工作负载的基准中，WAMpy 的端到端性能优于通过 Janus 从 Python 访问的 SWI-Prolog；摘要以定性比较表述，未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 对以反复生成、评估小候选程序为特征的 Prolog 综合任务，专用编译到 NumPy 加部分重编译的路线比调用通用 Prolog 系统更高效；该工作定位为 IJCLR 2026 的 4 页 demo。

papers.title: D2K-Bench: Can LLM Agents Turn Expert Designs into Efficient GPU Kernels?
papers.abstract_en: GPU kernels generated by large language model (LLM) agents can remain less efficient than expert implementations, but runtime alone does not reveal how the gap relates to design discovery and implementation. We introduce D2K-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark of 26 tasks and 85 workloads that measures how effectively agents translate expert design guidance into efficient GPU kernels. The guidance covers L1: high-level algorithmic insights, L2: dataflow design, and L3: low-level optimization tricks, including dependencies among these levels. Pairwise runs with and without guidance share task descriptions, workloads, tools, hardware, and a 350-turn budget. Complementary assessments examine independently proposed designs and the design properties implemented in generated code. Across five models on NVIDIA B200 GPUs, guidance raises correctness over 130 model-task pairs from 93.1% to 98.5% and increases the Performance Score over all 26 tasks from 1.46 to 1.95. For the three frontier models with correct submissions on all 26 tasks in both runs (GPT-6-Astra, Claude-Opus-4.8, and GPT-5.6-Sol), geometric mean speedup increases from $1.69\times$ to $2.49\times$. Across all five models, the mean combined implementation score increases from 57 to 70 out of 100. These results show the value of expert design guidance while identifying design properties that remain unimplemented.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: D2K-Bench 是一个诊断性基准，用 26 个任务、85 个 workload 和 L1 算法洞察/L2 数据流/L3 底层优化三级专家设计指导，成对比较 LLM agent 有无指导时把设计转成 GPU kernel 的能力。在 NVIDIA B200 上五个模型的 130 个 model-task 对中，指导把正确率从 93.1% 提到 98.5%，26 任务 Performance Score 从 1.46 提到 1.95。
Motivation: LLM agent 生成的 GPU kernel 常不如专家实现，但只看 runtime 无法区分差距来自设计发现还是实现本身，缺少能把两者拆开度量的基准。
Method: 构建 26 任务、85 workload 的诊断基准，指导分 L1 高层算法洞察、L2 数据流设计、L3 底层优化技巧三级并标注层级间依赖；成对运行有/无指导两组，共享任务描述、workload、工具、硬件与 350 轮预算，另设独立提出设计与生成代码中已实现设计属性的互补评估。
Result: 五个模型在 NVIDIA B200 上：130 个 model-task 对的正确率由 93.1% 升至 98.5%；全部 26 任务的 Performance Score 由 1.46 升至 1.95；三个在两种设定下 26 任务全对的前沿模型（GPT-6-Astra、Claude-Opus-4.8、GPT-5.6-Sol）几何平均加速由 1.69× 升至 2.49×；五个模型的平均 combined implementation score 由 57 升至 70（满分 100）。
Conclusion: 专家设计指导显著提升 agent 生成 GPU kernel 的正确性与性能，同时基准定位出仍未被实现的设计属性。

papers.title: The Neuro-Physical Inverter: A Modular Framework for Magnetotelluric Inversion Coupling Ensemble Conditioning with Residual Learning
papers.abstract_en: We present the Neuro-Physical Inverter (NPI), a modular, uncertainty-aware framework for geophysical inversion that couples ensemble-based conditioning with constrained residual learning, demonstrated in the 1D magnetotelluric (MT) setting as a controlled testbed. The framework operates in two stages. An Ensemble-Conditional Gaussian Process (EnsCGP) conditions a prior ensemble of resistivity models on the observed response, producing a physically admissible reference ensemble. A residual-learning neural network then predicts targeted corrections to this reference, trained on synthetic data and fine-tuned per station for field application through a physics-coupled objective. Because an ensemble is conditioned, refined, and propagated through both stages, every estimate carries an associated ensemble spread. Synthetic experiments show that NPI systematically reduces ensemble-mean error without destabilizing the ensemble. Applied to broadband MT data from the Gabbs Valley geothermal region (Nevada, USA), NPI reduces the across-station mean misfit over the mid-period band while retaining comparable ensemble spread. The propagated ensemble yields a factor of uncertainty that serves as an operational measure of constraint within the assumed model class. Both stages are dimension-agnostic in formulation, and the design principles established here are intended to scale to higher-dimensional parameterizations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NPI 把集合条件化 (ensemble conditioning) 与约束残差学习两阶段耦合用于 1D 大地电磁 (MT) 反演：EnsCGP 先把先验电阻率集合条件化到观测响应上，残差网络再在此参考集合上预测修正，两阶段都传播集合，因此每个估计都带集合离散度。合成实验中 NPI 系统性降低集合均误差且不破坏集合稳定性；在 Nevada Gabbs Valley 地热区宽带 MT 数据上降低中频段跨台站平均失配，同时保持相当的集合离散度。
Motivation: 地球物理反演需要既给出物理可接受的模型又给出可操作的不确定性度量，纯数据驱动方法缺少物理约束，纯集合方法的参考解往往残差偏大。
Method: 两阶段框架：Ensemble-Conditional Gaussian Process (EnsCGP) 把电阻率先验集合条件化到观测响应，得到物理可容许的参考集合；随后残差学习神经网络在该参考上预测针对性修正，先用合成数据训练、再按台站用 physics-coupled objective 微调。集合在两阶段都被条件化、精化并传播，两个阶段在表述上 dimension-agnostic。
Result: 合成实验中 NPI 系统性降低集合均误差且不使集合失稳；在 Gabbs Valley (Nevada, USA) 宽带 MT 数据上，中频段跨台站平均失配 (mean misfit) 下降，同时保持相当的集合离散度；传播得到的集合给出一个不确定性因子，作为模型类内约束程度的可操作度量。
Conclusion: 作者主张集合条件化加残差学习的组合能在不牺牲不确定性的前提下收紧 MT 反演估计，且该设计原则意在推广到更高维参数化。

papers.title: Uncertainty as a Proxy for Semantic Correctness in Diffusion-Based Medical Image Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models can synthesise contrast-enhanced CT (CECT) from non-contrast CT (NCCT), avoiding contrast administration and its environmental and patient-access costs. However, visually realistic images are not necessarily anatomically correct, and the pixel-intensity and feature-space similarity metrics used to assess generation quality do not directly measure anatomical correctness. In this work, we investigate whether uncertainty can serve as a proxy for semantic correctness in diffusion-based medical image synthesis. We study NCCT-to-CECT synthesis using AortaDiff, a multitask diffusion framework that jointly generates CECT images and lumen segmentations. The segmentation output provides an explicit representation of the generated vascular anatomy, enabling segmentation-derived errors to be used as a quantitative measure of generation correctness. Six methods spanning weight (Ensemble, HyperDiff, BayesDiff), architecture-perturbation (MCDropout), generative-stochasticity (RDS) and input-perturbation (TTA) uncertainty are compared at the pixel, region and image levels, and for detection of clinically relevant out-of-distribution (OOD) cases. Uncertainty proves informative at all three spatial scales, remains informative on an external multi-centre dataset under distribution shift, and supports OOD detection. MCDropout stands out among the six: it ranks among the leading methods at every scale, generalizes well on the external dataset, and can be enabled at inference on any model already trained with dropout, so reliable uncertainty comes at no extra training cost. Uncertainty reliably flags severe failures but discriminates poorly among already high-quality images. These findings support uncertainty as a practical and computationally economical signal for quality filtering, reliability assessment and OOD detection in NCCT-to CECT synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 NCCT→CECT 扩散合成中，不确定性可作为解剖正确性的代理：六类不确定性方法在像素、区域、图像三个尺度及 OOD 检出上都提供有效信号，并在外部多中心数据集分布偏移下仍保持信息量。MCDropout 在各尺度均居前列、外部泛化好，且只需模型训练时已用 dropout 即可在推理期开启，零额外训练成本。不确定性可靠标记严重失败，但对本已高质量的图像区分力差。
Motivation: 扩散生成的 CECT 视觉逼真不等于解剖正确，而常用的像素强度与特征空间相似度指标并不直接度量解剖正确性，需要一个可计算的正确性信号来做质量过滤与 OOD 检出。
Method: 用多任务扩散框架 AortaDiff 联合生成 CECT 图像与管腔分割，以分割输出显式表示生成的血管解剖，从而把分割误差当作生成正确性的定量度量；比较六类不确定性方法：权重扰动（Ensemble、HyperDiff、BayesDiff）、架构扰动（MCDropout）、生成随机性（RDS）与输入扰动（TTA），在像素、区域、图像三个尺度以及临床相关 OOD 检出上评估。

Conclusion: 不确定性是 NCCT→CECT 合成中实用且计算经济的质量过滤、可靠性评估与 OOD 检测信号，其中 MCDropout 是零训练开销的首选；但它适合抓严重失败而非给高质量图像排序。

papers.title: AdaStep: Adaptive Step Credit Weighting for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon LLM agents are typically trained with sparse outcome rewards, making trajectory-level objectives too coarse to distinguish the contribution of individual decisions. Step-level credit assignment provides finer-grained supervision, but its estimates can be unreliable because observed returns also depend on subsequent actions, environment transitions, and trajectory length. We propose AdaStep, an Adaptive Step-credit weighting method that controls how strongly each group-derived local advantage modifies the trajectory-level signal. We formulate this weighting as a mean-squared-error estimation problem for the latent step advantage and, under an explicit conditional sampling assumption, derive an optimal per-state shrinkage coefficient. The coefficient admits a signal-to-total-variance interpretation: it preserves local credit when return variation is attributable to the selected action and suppresses it when variation is dominated by downstream randomness. AdaStep requires only lightweight scalar computation, with no critic, additional rollouts, or extra model inference. Experiments with three model backbones on ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld show consistent improvements over baselines at low computational cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdaStep 把步级信用分配写成对隐变量步优势的均方误差估计问题，在显式条件采样假设下推导出最优逐状态收缩系数，用它控制 group 局部优势对轨迹级信号的修正强度：回报方差主要来自所选动作时保留局部信用，方差由下游随机性主导时抑制它。在 ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld 三个 backbone 上相对基线一致提升，且无需 critic、额外 rollout 或额外模型推理。
Motivation: 长程 LLM agent 只有稀疏结果奖励，轨迹级目标太粗，无法区分单个决策的贡献；而步级信用估计又不可靠，因为观测回报同时受后续动作、环境转移和轨迹长度影响。
Method: AdaStep 用一个逐状态收缩系数调节 group 推导的局部优势对轨迹级信号的修改强度，把加权形式化为隐步优势的 MSE 估计问题，在显式条件采样假设下求出最优收缩系数，其形式具有信号对总方差的解释；实现只需轻量标量计算，不含 critic、额外 rollout 或额外模型推理。
Result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld 三个环境、三个模型 backbone 上相对基线取得一致改进，计算开销低；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 按回报方差来源自适应收缩步级信用，可以在不引入 critic 或额外采样的前提下稳定改进长程 LLM agent 的步级信用分配。

papers.title: Near-Optimal Convex Optimization with Lazy Second-Order Oracles
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies the complexity of convex optimization using lazy second-order oracles (Doikov, Chayti, and Jaggi, ICML 2023), where an algorithm queries gradients every iteration and Hessians once per $m$ iterations. Under this setting, we show a lower bound of $Ω(m+ m^{1/7} ε^{-2/7})$ on the number of total iterations to find an $ε$-solution using a novel block zero-chain construction. Then we propose a novel method that achieves a new upper bound of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(m+ m^{1/7} ε^{-2/7})$, which significantly improves the prior one (Chen, Liu, Luo, and Zhang, COLT 2026) of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(m+ m^{13/21} ε^{-2/7})$ and is tight up to logarithmic factors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究 lazy 二阶 oracle（每步取梯度、每 m 步取一次 Hessian）下的凸优化复杂度，用新型 block zero-chain 构造证明总迭代数下界 Ω(m + m^{1/7} ε^{-2/7})，并给出匹配的上界 Õ(m + m^{1/7} ε^{-2/7})，在对数因子内紧。
Motivation: lazy 二阶 oracle 模型下已知上界 Õ(m + m^{13/21} ε^{-2/7})（Chen, Liu, Luo, Zhang, COLT 2026）与真实下界是否匹配尚不清楚，m 的指数存在缺口。
Method: 提出新型 block zero-chain 构造以证明下界；并设计新算法达到 Õ(m + m^{1/7} ε^{-2/7}) 的上界，与下界在对数因子内一致。
Result: 总迭代数下界 Ω(m + m^{1/7} ε^{-2/7})；新上界 Õ(m + m^{1/7} ε^{-2/7})，相对先前的 Õ(m + m^{13/21} ε^{-2/7}) 改进了 m 的指数（13/21 → 1/7）。
Conclusion: lazy 二阶 oracle 下的凸优化复杂度在对数因子内是紧的，m^{13/21} 的旧上界可被降到 m^{1/7}。

papers.title: VDOT++: Unified Few-Step Video Generation via Unbalanced Optimal Transport Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Video creation spans text-to-video (T2V), image-to-video (I2V), and condition-based generation, yet video diffusion models remain costly because they repeatedly evaluate large backbones during sampling. Distribution matching distillation (DMD) reduces this cost, but its reverse Kullback--Leibler (KL) objective can provide unstable or incomplete guidance when the student and teacher distributions have limited overlap. VDOT addressed this issue by adding optimal transport distillation (OTD), whose explicit coupling supplies geometric directions for condition-based generation. Balanced OTD, however, performs full-mass matching between the spatial tokens of each corresponding student--teacher frame pair. This assumption weakens for T2V and I2V, where one condition admits many valid outputs and spatial content need not align across different realizations. We present VDOT++, a unified distillation framework that applies the same training recipe separately to generators for the three task families. It makes OTD robust to output diversity through an asymmetric unbalanced formulation that allows unreliable student tokens to carry less mass while maintaining coverage of the teacher tokens. An $\ell_1$ ground cost further replaces mean-based aggregation with a more mode-preserving weighted median that limits the influence of distant transport targets. The two changes respectively determine whom to match and how the selected targets should be aggregated. We additionally combine distribution matching and adversarial refinement through sequential backward passes, and exploit the decoupled score networks for cross-scale distillation, where larger score networks improve a compact generator. Experiments on UVCBench, VBench, VBench-I2V, and the VACE benchmark show that the resulting four-step generators are competitive with many-step teachers and strong few-step baselines across all three task families.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VDOT++ 把视频扩散的少步蒸馏统一到 T2V、I2V、条件生成三类任务：用非平衡最优传输蒸馏 (unbalanced OTD) 允许不可靠的学生 token 携带更少质量、同时保持对教师 token 的覆盖，并以 ℓ1 ground cost 的加权中位数替代均值聚合以保留多模态。四步生成器在 UVCBench、VBench、VBench-I2V 与 VACE 上与多步教师和强少步基线相当。
Motivation: DMD 的反向 KL 在学生与教师分布重叠有限时给出不稳定或不完整的引导；VDOT 的 balanced OTD 要求逐帧空间 token 全质量匹配，而 T2V/I2V 中一个条件对应多个合法输出、空间内容不必对齐，该假设失效。
Method: 在统一训练配方下分别蒸馏三类生成器：非平衡 OTD 允许不可靠学生 token 减少质量但维持教师 token 覆盖，ℓ1 ground cost 用加权中位数替代均值聚合以限制远距离传输目标的影响；再通过顺序反向传播 (sequential backward passes) 结合分布匹配与对抗精修，并利用解耦的 score 网络做跨尺度蒸馏，让更大的 score 网络提升紧凑生成器。
Result: 在 UVCBench、VBench、VBench-I2V 和 VACE benchmark 上，四步生成器在三类任务上与多步教师及强少步基线相当 (competitive)。
Conclusion: 非平衡传输与 ℓ1 加权中位数分别决定匹配对象与聚合方式，使同一蒸馏配方能覆盖 T2V、I2V 与条件生成三类视频生成任务的输出多样性。

papers.title: Evolving Hybrid Quantum-Classical Architectures for Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid quantum classical neural networks integrate parameterized quantum circuits (PQCs) with established deep learning architectures, but their performance depends strongly on the choice of quantum circuit architecture, a choice that remains largely manual. Most existing approaches rely on hand-designed or fixed circuit ansätze, requiring circuit structure, gate composition, and qubit connectivity to be specified in advance with no guarantee that they suit the task. This limitation is especially acute in image classification, where quantum circuits must transform features extracted by classical networks while remaining compact enough for practical training, requirements that generic, task-agnostic ansätze are unlikely to satisfy simultaneously. We extend EXAQC, an evolutionary framework for automated quantum circuit discovery, to image classification. EXAQC evolves PQCs as intermediate processing modules while retaining classical feature-extraction and prediction layers. On MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10, EXAQC achieves 98.42%, 90.62%, and 85.47% accuracy, respectively, while using comparable gate counts to other quantum architecture-search methods. Against classical networks, evolved hybrid models maintain comparable accuracy with substantially fewer trainable parameters, reaching 85.68% on CIFAR-10 with over 25$\times$ fewer parameters than a 10-layer CNN. Encoding choice also matters: rotation-based encodings (RX, RY, U3) outperform amplitude encoding by 22-25 points on CIFAR-10. These results demonstrate that automated circuit discovery yields compact quantum modules that can replace larger classical components in vision architectures while retaining competitive accuracy.
papers.comment: Under Review at The Fifteenth International Conference on Learning Representations 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把进化式量子线路自动搜索框架 EXAQC 扩展到图像分类，用进化算法演化参数化量子线路 (PQC) 作为经典特征提取与预测层之间的中间处理模块。在 MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10 上分别达到 98.42%、90.62%、85.47% 准确率；CIFAR-10 上以比 10 层 CNN 少 25 倍以上的可训练参数达到 85.68%，旋转类编码 (RX、RY、U3) 比振幅编码高 22–25 个百分点。
Motivation: 混合量子-经典网络的性能强依赖量子线路结构，但现有做法多用手设计或固定 ansatz，线路结构、门组成与比特连通性需事先指定且无任务适配保证；图像分类要求线路既变换经典特征又足够紧凑，通用 ansatz 难以同时满足。
Method: 扩展 EXAQC（进化式自动量子线路发现框架）：把 PQC 作为中间处理模块进行进化搜索，保留经典特征提取层与预测层；同时比较旋转类编码 (RX、RY、U3) 与振幅编码 (amplitude encoding)，并与其他量子架构搜索方法比较门数、与经典网络比较可训练参数量。
Result: MNIST 98.42%、Fashion-MNIST 90.62%、CIFAR-10 85.47% 准确率，门数与其他量子架构搜索方法相当；CIFAR-10 上进化混合模型达 85.68%，可训练参数比 10 层 CNN 少 25 倍以上且准确率相当；CIFAR-10 上旋转编码比振幅编码高 22–25 个百分点。
Conclusion: 自动线路发现能产出紧凑的量子模块，在视觉架构中替代更大的经典组件并保持有竞争力的准确率；编码方式（旋转类 vs 振幅）是影响性能的关键选择。

papers.title: VisionMX: Unlocking Microscaling Post-Training Quantization for Vision Models
papers.abstract_en: Microscaling (MX) formats are emerging as a hardware-supported approach to efficient training and inference. They combine low-precision elements with shared block scales, but their impact on vision models remains underexplored. We systematically investigate post-training MX quantization across vision models and tasks. An analysis of direct conversion identifies three sources of error: block-scale representation, the poor alignment of some small convolutional weight tensors with nonuniform element grids, and the underuse of signed codes by nonnegative activations. These findings motivate VisionMX, a post-training MX quantization method that optimizes bounded weight rounding and applies a foldable affine correction to activations. We evaluate VisionMX across image classification, object detection, semantic segmentation, and low-light image enhancement using several MX-style formats. It improves on direct conversion and the evaluated post-training quantization baselines, with the largest performance recoveries in architectures most sensitive to MX conversion
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VisionMX 是面向视觉模型的 Microscaling (MX) 后训练量化方法：先定位直接 MX 转换的三类误差源，再用有界权值舍入 (bounded weight rounding) 与可折叠仿射校正 (foldable affine correction) 分别修正权值和激活。在图像分类、目标检测、语义分割与低光增强四类任务上，它优于直接转换和所评测的 PTQ 基线，在对 MX 转换最敏感的架构上性能恢复幅度最大。
Motivation: MX 格式以低精度元素加共享块尺度支撑高效训练推理，但对视觉模型的影响研究不足；直接转换存在块尺度表示、小卷积权值张量与非均匀网格错配、非负激活浪费有符号码三类误差。
Method: 先系统分析直接 MX 转换，识别块尺度表示、小卷积权值张量与非均匀元素网格对齐差、非负激活未用满 signed codes 三类误差；据此提出优化有界权值舍入的 VisionMX，并对激活施加可折叠仿射校正，覆盖多种 MX-style 格式。
Result: 在图像分类、目标检测、语义分割和低光图像增强上，用多种 MX-style 格式评测，VisionMX 改进直接转换与所评测的 PTQ 基线，性能恢复在对 MX 转换最敏感的架构上最大。
Conclusion: 视觉模型的 MX 后训练量化误差可归结为三类具体来源，分别用有界舍入与可折叠仿射校正处理即可在多任务上取得更优恢复。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Kernel Singular Value Decomposition with Extension to Multiple Data Sources
papers.abstract_en: Kernel Singular Value Decomposition (KSVD) learns a pair of singular vectors w.r.t. an asymmetric kernel matrix, which can be induced by two data sources, e.g., the queries and keys in self-attention or the rows and columns of a given matrix. In this work, we extend KSVD to multiple data sources, namely eKSVD, which conducts joint nonlinear feature learning upon asymmetric kernels. In the primal formulation, the projections associated with each data source are jointly learned to capture maximal information, while incorporating pair-wise couplings. With the Lagrangian and its Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions, the optimization in the dual leads to a generalization of the shifted eigenvalue problem in Lanczos decomposition theorem of KSVD. Further, a covariance-based framework is derived together with using neural networks (NNs) for explicit feature mappings, complementary to the kernel-based interpretation and optimization. Numerical experiments verify the effectiveness of our eKSVD compared to methods based on Mercer kernels for tackling multiple data sources, and our innovation of deploying NNs demonstrates great flexibility for kernel methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把只处理非对称核矩阵（两个数据源）的 Kernel SVD 推广到多数据源的 eKSVD：对每个数据源的投影联合学习以捕获最大信息并加入成对耦合，对偶优化经 Lagrangian 与 KKT 条件化为 KSVD 中 Lanczos 分解定理移位特征值问题的推广，并另推导一个基于协方差、用神经网络做显式特征映射的框架。数值实验验证其在多数据源问题上相对 Mercer 核方法的有效性。
Motivation: KSVD 只能由两个数据源诱导的非对称核学习一对奇异向量，无法处理三个及以上数据源之间的联合非线性特征学习与耦合。
Method: eKSVD 在原始形式中为每个数据源联合学习投影并加入 pair-wise coupling；写出 Lagrangian 与 KKT 条件，把对偶优化化为 KSVD 的 Lanczos 分解定理中移位特征值问题的推广；另推导 covariance-based 框架并用神经网络 (NN) 做显式特征映射，与核解释互补。
Result: 数值实验验证 eKSVD 在多数据源问题上相比基于 Mercer 核的方法有效；用 NN 做显式特征映射展示了核方法的灵活性。
Conclusion: KSVD 可自然推广到任意多数据源的联合非线性特征学习，且核推导与 NN 显式映射两条路线互补。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Toward SLM-based agentic task-tool intent matching
papers.abstract_en: Tool-equipped AI agents use tool calls to access data and act on external systems. Horizontal growth of agentic systems increases the number of these interactions, and further motivates the need for automated, per-call oversight that can operate at low latency and/or on-prem. Conventional authorization schemes can determine whether an agent is allowed to invoke a tool, but cannot assess the agent's underlying cognition, specifically, whether the tool selection represents a logical, relevant step toward satisfying the intent of the task or not. Consequently, an allowed call may still deviate from the task's intent: a rogue agent might deviate the calls or nudge other agents to make a combination of calls that would not align with the intent of the task. Therefore, every call needs to be verified. In this study we investigate the applicability of Small Language Models (SLMs) to this purpose: an SLM functions as a task-tool relevance classifier that evaluates every selected tool independently against the assigned task and returns a relevance signal for downstream enforcement. Equipped with a novel dataset with multi-tool tasks whose required tools span distinct Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, we used prompt-optimization, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning through GRPO to optimize and specialize SLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用小型语言模型 (SLM) 做任务-工具意图匹配：把每个被选中的工具调用独立地与任务意图比对，输出相关性信号供下游强制执行，以补上传统授权只能判“是否允许调用”、无法判“是否合乎任务意图”的缺口。作者构建了跨多个 Model Context Protocol (MCP) server 的多工具任务数据集，并用 prompt 优化、监督微调与 GRPO 强化学习来专门化 SLM。
Motivation: agentic 系统横向扩张使工具调用数量激增，需要低延迟、可本地部署的逐调用监督；而现有授权机制只检查权限，无法识别偏离任务意图的调用（包括 rogue agent 偏移调用或诱导其他 agent 组合出不合意图的调用序列）。
Method: 以 SLM 作为 task-tool relevance classifier，对每次选定工具独立打相关性分并输出信号；构建覆盖不同 MCP server 的多工具任务数据集，依次用 prompt-optimization、监督微调 (SFT) 和 GRPO 强化学习优化与专门化模型。
Result: 贡献为方法与数据集层面：提出 SLM 逐调用相关性分类框架，并给出跨多个 MCP server 的多工具任务数据集；摘要未给出准确率、F1 等数值指标。
Conclusion: 权限检查不足以约束 agent 行为，每个工具调用都需要独立的意图相关性验证，且该验证可由低延迟、可 on-prem 的 SLM 承担。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: HyperFuse: Fast Self-Supervised Node Embeddings for Attributed Hypergraphs
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised hypergraph representation learning can produce informative node embeddings, but existing methods often require deep encoders trained for hundreds of epochs, making embedding generation costly even for hypergraphs with a few thousand nodes. This limits applications requiring embeddings for many or evolving hypergraphs. We present HyperFuse, a label-free pipeline for fast hypergraph representation learning. HyperFuse (i) computes structural node coordinates by maximizing a spectral relaxation of hypergraph modularity using Banerjee's hypergraph adjacency and a matrix-free operator with cost linear in node-hyperedge incidences; (ii) constructs multi-scale feature summaries and assigns bounded utility weights to hyperedges based on member stability under feature and membership masking; and (iii) trains a lightweight utility-weighted hypergraph encoder for 100 epochs using an invariance-decorrelation objective. We compare HyperFuse with TriCL, SE-HSSL, VilLain, and HypeBoy on nine public hypergraphs using six downstream classifiers and k-means clustering. On the eight datasets where all methods completed, HyperFuse required 8.7 s per dataset on average, achieving 13-179x geometric-mean speed-ups over the baselines. It achieved the highest average accuracy with five of six classifiers, while classification and clustering performance was not significantly different from TriCL and SE-HSSL. Compared with HypeBoy, HyperFuse was 13x faster and 2.1-4.1 percentage points more accurate across all classifiers. HyperFuse provides a practical approach for fast, repeated hypergraph embedding generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HyperFuse 是无标签的超图节点嵌入流水线：先用超图模块度谱松弛最大化求结构坐标（矩阵自由算子，代价随节点-超边关联数线性），再按成员稳定性给超边赋有界效用权重，最后用不变-去相关目标训练轻量编码器 100 个 epoch。在九个公开超图上，八个可完成的数据集平均 8.7 秒，几何平均加速 13–179 倍；六个分类器中五个取得最高平均精度，且与 HypeBoy 相比快 13 倍、精度高 2.1–4.1 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有自监督超图表示方法需要深编码器训练数百 epoch，即便几千节点的超图生成嵌入也很贵，难以支撑大量或持续演化的超图场景。
Method: 三段式流水线：(i) 用 Banerjee 超图邻接与矩阵自由算子最大化超图模块度的谱松弛，得到结构节点坐标；(ii) 构造多尺度特征摘要，按特征与成员遮蔽下的成员稳定性给超边分配有界效用权重；(iii) 训练轻量效用加权超图编码器 100 epoch，目标为 invariance-decorrelation。
Result: 在九个公开超图上与 TriCL、SE-HSSL、VilLain、HypeBoy 对比，用六个下游分类器与 k-means 聚类评测；八个全部完成的数据集上平均 8.7 秒，几何平均加速 13–179 倍；六个分类器中五个取得最高平均精度，分类与聚类性能与 TriCL、SE-HSSL 无显著差异；相对 HypeBoy 快 13 倍，全部分类器上精度高 2.1–4.1 个百分点。
Conclusion: 超图嵌入可以靠结构坐标加效用加权的轻量编码器做到快速、可重复生成，代价是与最强基线 TriCL、SE-HSSL 的精度差距不显著。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hamiltonian locality testing and certification do not achieve the Heisenberg limit
papers.abstract_en: We establish lower bounds for Hamiltonian property testing with access to the time-evolution operator but not its inverse. Each experiment may query the time-evolution operator multiple times, and distances between Hamiltonians are measured in the normalized Frobenius norm. In this model, we show that testing whether a Hamiltonian is $k$-local or $\varepsilon$-far from every $k$-local Hamiltonian requires $Ω(1/\varepsilon^2)$ total evolution time, matching the upper bound of Kallaugher and Liang (TQC'25). We also prove that testing whether an unknown Hamiltonian equals a target Hamiltonian or is $\varepsilon$-far from it requires $Ω(1/\varepsilon^2)$ total evolution time, matching the upper bound of Sinha and Tong (2025). These are the first lower bounds for natural problems in Hamiltonian learning and testing that rule out Heisenberg-limited scaling of $1/\varepsilon$. As a third result, we show that amplitude estimation to precision $\varepsilon$ requires $Ω(1/\varepsilon^2)$ total time evolution, recovering the result of Tang and Wright (QIP'26) in the continuous-time query model. All three results follow from the hardness of distinguishing the zero Hamiltonian from a suitably chosen ensemble of random Hamiltonians. We establish this hardness by adapting the continuous-time adversary method to forward Hamiltonian evolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在只能访问时间演化算符、不能访问其逆的模型下，Hamiltonian 的 k-local 性质测试、与目标 Hamiltonian 的等价性测试、以及幅度估计到精度 ε 都需要 Ω(1/ε²) 的总演化时间，即无法达到 1/ε 的 Heisenberg 极限。三个下界均由区分零 Hamiltonian 与特定随机 Hamiltonian 集合的困难性导出。
Motivation: Hamiltonian 学习与测试此前只有上界，缺少匹配的下界，无法判定 1/ε 的 Heisenberg 标度在只有正向演化的实际模型中是否可达。
Method: 把连续时间 adversary 方法改造到正向 Hamiltonian 演化上，证明区分零 Hamiltonian 与精心选取的随机 Hamiltonian 集合是困难的；Hamiltonian 之间的距离用归一化 Frobenius 范数度量，每次实验可多次查询时间演化算符。
Result: k-local 性质测试（判定 Hamiltonian 是否 k-local 或与所有 k-local Hamiltonian 相距 ε）需 Ω(1/ε²) 总演化时间，匹配 Kallaugher 与 Liang (TQC'25) 的上界；判定未知 Hamiltonian 是否等于目标或与之 ε-相距同样需 Ω(1/ε²)，匹配 Sinha 与 Tong (2025) 的上界；幅度估计到精度 ε 需 Ω(1/ε²) 总演化时间，重现 Tang 与 Wright (QIP'26) 在连续时间查询模型中的结果。
Conclusion: 这是 Hamiltonian 学习与测试中首批排除 1/ε Heisenberg 标度的自然问题下界：在只有正向演化的条件下，精度提升只能按 1/ε² 换取演化时间。

papers.title: Contextual Flow Matching: Adaptive Step Selection in Flow Models for Efficient Visual Generation
papers.abstract_en: Flow Matching enables high-quality visual generation via continuous-time dynamics, but inference remains costly due to multiple sequential function evaluations. Existing acceleration methods reduce the number of function evaluations but often introduce additional training overhead, degrade quality, or fail to account for input-dependent variability. We propose COFLOW, an inference-time method that adaptively selects the step counts each generation based on the prompt features. Our context-aware COFLOW is trained online with an unsupervised reward that balances inference efficiency and generation fidelity. Our method is plug-and-play, requiring no retraining of the underlying generative model. It generalizes to image and video generation, achieving over 2.5x speedup while preserving perceptual and semantic quality. We further provide a theoretical analysis establishing an O(1/K) forward-Euler discretization error bound under standard regularity conditions.
papers.summary_zh:

Method: COFLOW 以 prompt 特征为条件在推理时自适应选择每次生成的步数，采用无监督奖励在线训练调度策略，即插即用、不重训底层生成模型；另给出 forward-Euler 离散化的理论误差分析。
Result: 在图像与视频生成上实现超过 2.5 倍加速，同时保持感知与语义质量；理论分析在标准正则条件下建立 O(1/K) 的 forward-Euler 离散误差界。
Conclusion: 按 prompt 条件在线调度 flow matching 步数，可以在不重训生成模型的前提下同时换取推理加速与质量保持，且离散误差随步数 K 以 O(1/K) 收敛。

papers.title: Predictively Oriented Gaussian Process Posteriors
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian Processes (GPs) are a powerful tool for modelling and quantifying uncertainty in functional relationships. However, they require practitioners to make a number of design decisions, such as the choice of the kernel and the observation model. Suboptimal choices can produce misspecified models that do not capture the underlying data generating process. We introduce Predictively Oriented Gaussian Processes (PrO-GPs), which treat predictive uncertainty as the primary inferential target and provide a robust alternative to standard GPs. Although direct computation of a PrO posterior for nonparametric models is intractable, we derive a reduced formulation and practical sampling scheme for efficient computation. Through synthetic and real data experiments, we show that PrO-GPs produce better calibrated predictive distributions under model misspecification compared to standard GP approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Predictively Oriented Gaussian Process (PrO-GP)，把预测不确定性当作首要推断目标而非后验副产品，并推导出可计算的降维形式与采样方案。在模型误设 (misspecification) 条件下，PrO-GP 的预测分布在合成与真实数据实验中比标准 GP 校准更好。
Motivation: GP 使用者需手工选核函数与观测模型，次优选择会造成模型误设，标准 GP 后验无法捕捉真实数据生成过程，预测不确定性随之失真。
Method: 将预测不确定性设为首要推断目标定义 PrO 后验；因非参数模型下直接计算不可行，推导降维表述 (reduced formulation) 与实用采样方案 (sampling scheme) 实现高效计算。
Result: 在合成数据与真实数据实验中，PrO-GP 在模型误设下比标准 GP 方法给出校准更好的预测分布 (better calibrated predictive distributions)。
Conclusion: 以预测不确定性为推断目标的 GP 后验可作为标准 GP 的稳健替代，尤其在核与观测模型可能误设时。

papers.title: Predicting and Repairing Merge Collapse in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models fine-tuned from a shared base can be merged by averaging their task vectors, but some merges collapse far below the base model, and common merge operators give no warning before evaluation. We show that one statistic of the specialists' task vectors both predicts this collapse and calibrates its repair. The power that averaging removes equals the variance of the task vectors across specialists, our measure of interference. Under a working noise model, the disturbance that a merge injects grows with the merge coefficient and with interference, yielding a pre-merge score. In our experiments on twenty-two merge configurations from four model families, only destructive merges exceed a threshold on this score. We find that statistics of sign conflict between specialists, a common target of existing merge operators, are anti-predictive. We then predicted the outcomes of fourteen merges before evaluating them, and twelve predictions were correct, including the destructive outcome of a specialist pair pushed past the threshold by continued pretraining. To address this collapse, we introduce PRISM, an operator that averages the task vectors first and then soft-thresholds each layer at a level set by the layer's interference. Without data or tuning, PRISM keeps all five destructive merges above the threshold within evaluation noise of the base model, where plain averaging falls at least 14.4 points below it or collapses entirely. We apply PRISM only above the threshold and keep the plain average for merges below it, which include all fifteen harmless ones. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/PRISM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 任务向量合并中，专家任务向量的方差（interference）既能在合并前预测塌缩，也能标定修复强度：PRISM 先平均任务向量，再按每层 interference 设定软阈值。在 22 个合并配置上，只有破坏性合并超过该分数阈值；14 次预判中 12 次正确；PRISM 无需数据或调参，把 5 个超阈值破坏性合并保持在基线模型的评估噪声内，而普通平均至少低 14.4 分或完全塌缩。
Motivation: 从共享基座微调出的专家模型可用任务向量平均合并，但部分合并远低于基线且常见合并算子在评估前不给任何预警。
Method: 以专家任务向量的方差定义 interference，证明平均所消除的功率等于该方差，并在工作噪声模型下推出随合并系数与 interference 增长的合并前分数；修复算子 PRISM 先平均任务向量，再按每层 interference 设定阈值做 soft-thresholding，仅在超过阈值时启用，阈值以下保留普通平均。
Result: 在四个模型家族的 22 个合并配置上，只有破坏性合并超过分数阈值；符号冲突统计量对塌缩是反向预测 (anti-predictive)。对 14 个合并的事前预测中 12 个正确，包括一对经 continued pretraining 推过阈值的专家组合的破坏性结果。PRISM 不用数据与调参，把 5 个超阈值破坏性合并保持在基线模型评估噪声内，普通平均至少低 14.4 分或完全塌缩；阈值以下的 15 个无害合并全部保留普通平均。
Conclusion: 任务向量的 interference 是合并塌缩的统一预测与修复标定量：阈值以下用普通平均，阈值以上用按层 interference 定阈值的 PRISM 即可避免塌缩。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: KV$^2$: A Self-Refining KV Cache
papers.abstract_en: The memory footprint of the key-value (KV) cache constrains the practical use of long-context models, and it dominates cost when one prefilled context must later serve many different queries. In this reusable setting, query-agnostic compression trades cost against quality: lightweight estimators are cheap but less accurate, whereas full-context reconstruction scoring is more accurate yet reprocesses the entire prompt. We introduce KV$^2$, a query-agnostic KV-cache compression method based on selective reconstruction. KV$^2$ first uses a lightweight proxy scorer to identify informative in-context tokens, then reprocesses only this subset to compute final eviction scores. On RULER, Needle-in-a-Haystack, and LongBench, KV$^2$'s margin over baselines widens as the budget tightens: on RULER 16K at a 2% KV-cache budget it improves the average score over the next-best baseline by more than 40 percentage points, and on LongBench it attains the highest average across 2%-10% budgets at lower compression-stage runtime and peak memory than full-context reconstruction. Reusable KV-cache compression thus does not require reprocessing the full context. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/KVsquared-0B97.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KV² 是一种 query-agnostic 的 KV cache 压缩方法：先用轻量 proxy scorer 找出有信息量的 in-context tokens，只对这个子集重算以得到最终 eviction score。在 RULER、Needle-in-a-Haystack、LongBench 上，预算越紧优势越大：RULER 16K 在 2% KV cache 预算下平均分比次优基线高出 40 个百分点以上，LongBench 在 2%–10% 预算区间取得最高平均分且压缩阶段运行时与峰值内存低于 full-context reconstruction。
Motivation: 长上下文模型的 KV cache 占用限制了实际使用，且当一份预填充上下文要服务多个查询时成本占主导；现有 query-agnostic 压缩在轻量估计器（便宜但不准）与 full-context reconstruction（准但要重处理整个 prompt）之间只能取舍。
Method: 两阶段 selective reconstruction：轻量 proxy scorer 先筛出有信息量的 in-context tokens，再只对子集重处理计算最终 eviction score，从而避免对完整上下文打分。
Result: 在 RULER 16K、2% KV cache 预算下，平均分比次优基线高出 40 个百分点以上；在 LongBench 上于 2%–10% 预算区间取得最高平均分，且压缩阶段运行时与峰值内存低于 full-context reconstruction；预算收紧时相对基线的差距扩大。
Conclusion: 可复用场景下的 KV cache 压缩不必重处理完整上下文：先粗筛再对子集精算即可在极低预算下大幅领先基线，同时降低压缩开销。

papers.title: Bridging Research and Practice: A Systematic Evaluation of Generalist and Dermatology-Specific Models in Clinical Skin Lesion Classification
papers.abstract_en: The application of machine learning to dermatology has grown substantially in recent years, moving beyond proof-of-concept studies toward potential applications. However, clinical dermatology remains a challenging and still open problem. Diagnostic assessment is often ambiguous, and skin lesions exhibit high variability, compounded by differences in acquisition modality, device quality, and patient demographics. These factors hinder the development of robust models suitable for safe and equitable clinical use. To support translation into practice, it is essential to systematically evaluate how contemporary models generalize across heterogeneous data sources. In this work, we benchmark a diverse set of architectures on recent dermatology datasets, spanning dermoscopic images and smartphone-based clinical photographs. We assess the robustness of recent general-purpose and medical vision-language models, as well as foundation models, and compare them against task-specific dermatology classifiers, including embedding-based approaches and convolutional neural networks. Our study provides an evaluation of model performance under distribution shifts, modality changes, and demographic variability. By quantifying the gap between current state-of-the-art models and the requirements of clinical deployment, we aim to contribute to the development of reliable, accessible, and clinically applicable AI systems for dermatology.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables, approved at MICCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在近期皮肤科数据集上系统评测通用视觉模型、医学视觉-语言模型、基础模型与皮肤科专用分类器（含 embedding 方法和 CNN），覆盖皮肤镜图像与手机临床照片两类模态。评测在分布偏移、模态变化和人群差异条件下量化当前 SOTA 与临床部署要求之间的差距，结论是现有模型尚不足以安全公平地用于临床。
Motivation: 皮肤病变诊断本身模糊、病变外观变异大，加之成像模态、设备质量和患者人群差异，使模型难以稳健到可安全公平地临床使用；缺少对当代模型跨异构数据源泛化能力的系统评测。
Method: 在近期皮肤科数据集上对多样架构做基准测试，涵盖皮肤镜图像与手机拍摄的临床照片；对比通用模型、医学视觉-语言模型、基础模型与任务专用皮肤科分类器（embedding-based 方法和 CNN），在分布偏移、模态变化、人群差异条件下评估性能。
Result: 给出当前 state-of-the-art 模型性能与临床部署要求之间差距的量化评测，覆盖分布偏移、模态变化与人群多样性三种条件；摘要未列出具体数值。
Conclusion: 现有通用与专用模型在异构临床数据上的泛化仍不足以支撑安全、公平的皮肤科部署，跨数据源的系统评测是转化落地的必要环节。

papers.title: PocketSplat: Mobile Gaussian Reconstruction via World-Space Latent Allocatio
papers.abstract_en: Mobile Gaussian reconstruction must satisfy two requirements: the reconstruction model must execute within a device resource envelope, and the resulting Gaussian asset must expose a representation size suited to downstream mobile use. Existing feed-forward Gaussian reconstructors commonly decode dense, image-aligned candidates whose final cardinality is implicitly determined by the input resolution and number of views. We present PocketSplat, a feed-forward framework for budgeted mobile Gaussian asset construction. Given a prescribed output budget, PocketSplat organizes dense geometry-aware latent candidates in predicted world space, allocates exact integer capacity across local latent cells, and decodes complete Gaussian attributes only for retained candidates. Cell-conditioned latent fusion aggregates repeated multi-view evidence before decoding, while spatial responsibility decoding adapts Gaussian support after local sparsification. Experiments on DL3DV and out-of-distribution benchmarks establish a strong quality--budget trade-off against feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction baselines. On Mip-NeRF 360, PocketSplat executes directly on a target iPhone and constructs compact, higher-quality Gaussian assets substantially faster than a deployable streamed MVSplat variant; native MVSplat and DepthSplat exceed the device memory budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PocketSplat 是面向移动端的前馈 Gaussian 重建框架：给定输出预算，在预测的世界空间中组织稠密几何感知 latent 候选，按局部 latent cell 分配精确整数容量，只为保留的候选解码完整 Gaussian 属性。在 Mip-NeRF 360 上可直接在 iPhone 运行，比可部署的流式 MVSplat 变体显著更快地构建更紧凑、质量更高的 Gaussian 资产，而原生 MVSplat 与 DepthSplat 超出设备显存预算。
Motivation: 前馈 Gaussian 重建器解码的是与图像对齐的稠密候选，最终 Gaussian 数量由输入分辨率和视角数隐式决定，无法满足移动端对资源包络与资产体积的显式约束。
Method: PocketSplat 在预测的世界空间中组织稠密几何感知 latent 候选，按给定输出预算在局部 latent cell 间分配精确整数容量，仅对保留候选解码完整 Gaussian 属性；Cell-conditioned latent fusion 在解码前聚合重复多视角证据，spatial responsibility decoding 在局部稀疏化后调整 Gaussian 支撑。

papers.title: Not Until the Evidence Says So: Teaching LLM Investigators When to Close a Case
papers.abstract_en: Accident, defect and outage investigations end with a decision that ordinary question answering never faces: whether the evidence gathered so far is enough to close the case. We study this decision for LLM investigators, which request evidence from a case file, revise their hypotheses, and either close the case with a conclusion grounded in what they read or leave it open and name what is missing. This judgment does not come with capability: an untrained 9B model overstates its evidence in 97% of its answers, and a frontier model that identifies the right cause in 84% of cases still overstates in 91% and closes 17 of the 41 cases whose official finding is "cause undetermined". Measuring it is also non-trivial: the source of a case largely predicts its label, and a rule that reads only the source reaches 83.0 balanced accuracy on our test cases. We therefore evaluate closure with three tests: closure accuracy, reported against this rule and within each source; evidence dependence, which removes the grounds of a conclusion and checks whether the model stops closing; and conclusion and gap quality, a judged checklist of what the model asserts and what it says is missing. We build Nautil, 731 audited cases from aviation, rail, maritime, chemical-safety and vehicle-defect reports and production server incidents, with teacher trajectories, an out-of-distribution test set and counterfactual evidence versions. Fine-tuning a 9B model on these trajectories makes its closures follow the evidence: removing the grounds lowers its closure rate by 26 points relative to a matched control, overstatement falls from 97% to 35%, and correct, non-overstated conclusions rise from 3% to 43%. Reinforcement learning that rewards only the closure decision then raises balanced accuracy from 69.2 to 83.3, on par with the teacher, and within-source accuracy from 60.4 to 74.1, at some cost in evidence dependence.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Nautil 针对 LLM 调查员「何时结案」这一判断：731 个经审计的事故/故障案例上，未训练 9B 模型 97% 的回答夸大证据；用教师轨迹微调后夸大率降到 35%、正确且不夸大的结论从 3% 升到 43%，再用只奖励结案决策的 RL 把 balanced accuracy 从 69.2 提到 83.3，与教师持平。
Motivation: 事故、缺陷与宕机调查的终点是「证据是否足够结案」，普通问答不面对这一决策；LLM 调查员天然会夸大已有证据，且案例来源几乎直接决定标签，使结案判断难以评测。
Method: 构建 Nautil 数据集：731 个经审计案例，覆盖航空、铁路、海事、化工安全、车辆缺陷报告与生产服务器事故，含教师轨迹、分布外测试集与反事实证据版本；评测用三项测试——结案准确率（对照只读来源的 83.0 规则并在各来源内部分别统计）、证据依赖性（移除结论依据后检查模型是否停止结案）、结论与缺口质量清单；训练为教师轨迹微调 9B 模型，再用只奖励结案决策的强化学习。
Result: 未训练 9B 模型 97% 的回答夸大证据；前沿模型 84% 找对原因仍 91% 夸大，并在 41 个官方结论为「原因未定」的案例中结案 17 个；只读来源的规则在测试案例上达 83.0 balanced accuracy。微调后移除依据使结案率相对匹配对照降 26 个百分点，夸大率 97%→35%，正确且不夸大的结论 3%→43%；RL 使 balanced accuracy 69.2→83.3，来源内准确率 60.4→74.1，代价是证据依赖性有所下降。
Conclusion: 结案判断不是模型自带能力，需要靠带审计轨迹的微调与针对结案决策的强化学习来获得；后者能把准确率推到教师水平，但会牺牲一部分证据依赖性。

papers.title: Lightweight and Resource-Efficient Perception for Robotic Guide Dogs
papers.abstract_en: Multi-camera streaming perception is increasingly deployed on heterogeneous edge platforms shared with co-resident workloads, yet accelerator placement is often evaluated using isolated single-stream experiments and mean streaming average precision (sAP). Using two end-to-end pipelines on a single GPU--NPU platform, we show that isolated evaluation can mis-rank deployment-time placement. Although the GPU pipeline is preferred in isolation, GPU-localized contention introduces deadline misses that make detections stale and can reverse the preferred placement before full GPU saturation. The NPU pipeline is less accurate than the GPU pipeline on small and medium objects in isolation, but nearly matches it on large objects. The largest absolute sAP losses in our latency and contention experiments occur for large objects. In our four-stream experiments, the preferred placement depends on which path becomes stale, and increasing GPU-side contention shifts the best placement from All-GPU to All-NPU. Under a GPU-saturating vision--language co-tenant, All-NPU achieves $5.2\times$ the worst-stream sAP of All-GPU. Because mean sAP can hide severe single-stream degradation, evaluation should report contention sweeps, deadline-miss rates on both paths, and worst-stream sAP alongside mean sAP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 GPU–NPU 异构边缘平台上，用两条端到端多相机流式感知流水线证明：隔离单流实验会误排部署时的加速器放置，GPU 侧争用造成的超时会使检测变陈旧并反转偏好。在 GPU 饱和的视觉–语言共租户下，All-NPU 的最差流 sAP 达到 All-GPU 的 5.2 倍；作者主张评测须同时报告争用扫描、双路径超时率与最差流 sAP。
Motivation: 多相机流式感知常与共租负载共享异构边缘平台，但加速器放置通常只用隔离单流实验和平均 sAP 评估，会掩盖单流严重退化与争用导致的陈旧检测。
Method: 在单一 GPU–NPU 平台上跑两条端到端多相机感知流水线，做隔离、争用与四流实验，比较 All-GPU 与 All-NPU 放置，并引入 GPU 饱和的视觉–语言共租户制造争用；按对象大小与流的陈旧程度记录 sAP 与超时。
Result: 隔离下 GPU 流水线更优，但 GPU 本地化争用在 GPU 完全饱和前就会造成超时并反转偏好；NPU 在小中型目标上精度低于 GPU、大型目标上接近；延迟与争用实验中最大绝对 sAP 损失出现在大型目标；四流实验中最佳放置随哪条路径变陈旧而变，GPU 侧争用增加使最优从 All-GPU 移向 All-NPU；GPU 饱和共租户下 All-NPU 最差流 sAP 为 All-GPU 的 5.2 倍。
Conclusion: 隔离平均 sAP 会误导放置选择，评测应报告争用扫描、双路径超时率与最差流 sAP，而不只看平均 sAP。

papers.title: Gains and Collapse in On-Policy Distillation:A Reinforcement Learning Perspective
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become an important approach to language model post-training. However, despite its performance gains, OPD can also collapse into excessively long and repetitive generation, and the mechanism underlying these divergent outcomes remains poorly understood. We explain these outcomes through a reinforcement learning perspective: the teacher implicitly rewards student behaviors, even those it rarely exhibits itself. From this perspective, our experiments show that OPD improves performance without expanding the student's capabilities. When the implicit reward model is reliable, OPD makes correct responses easier to sample. In contrast, when the preference misaligns with quality, reward hacking happens: the implicit reward model amplifies overlong, repetitive student rollouts, even though it rarely generates such text itself. Guided by this diagnosis, we find that masking unhealthy responses during training and using SFT initialization can each effectively mitigate the collapse. Together, these findings show that OPD amplifies student behaviors favored by the teacher's implicit feedback, shifting the focus from how well the teacher generates to how reliably it evaluates student rollouts. Our code is available at https://github.com/HancCui/opd_hacking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用强化学习视角解释 on-policy distillation (OPD) 的两种结局：教师的隐式奖励在放大被其偏好、而非其自身会生成的行为。隐式奖励可靠时 OPD 让正确回答更易被采样、性能提升但不扩展学生能力；偏好与质量错位时则出现 reward hacking，隐式奖励放大过长重复的学生 rollout，即使教师自己很少生成这类文本。诊断后用训练中屏蔽不健康响应或 SFT 初始化均可有效缓解 collapse。
Motivation: OPD 虽能带来性能提升，却会坍缩到过长重复的生成，两种分歧结局背后的机制此前缺乏解释。
Method: 把 OPD 建模为教师隐式奖励学生行为的强化学习过程，通过实验区分隐式奖励可靠与偏好错位两种情形，并据此测试两种干预：训练时屏蔽不健康响应、用 SFT 初始化。
Result: 实验显示 OPD 提升性能但不扩展学生能力；隐式奖励可靠时正确响应更易被采样；偏好与质量错位时隐式奖励放大过长重复的学生 rollout，即使教师很少生成此类文本；屏蔽不健康响应与 SFT 初始化各自都能有效缓解 collapse。
Conclusion: OPD 放大的是教师隐式反馈所偏好的学生行为，评估重点应从教师生成得多好转向它评估学生 rollout 有多可靠。

papers.title: Geometry-Aligned Semantic Matching for Cross-Modal Planar Image Registration
papers.abstract_en: Cross-modal image matching establishes stable and accurate geometric correspondences across modalities for planar registration. Existing semantic representations provide cross-modal consistency, but semantic similarity does not necessarily imply geometric correspondence. Meanwhile, fine-grained CNN features provide accurate local details but lack global cross-modal semantic guidance for stable refinement. To address these issues, we propose CDPM, which first establishes geometrically consistent semantic representations and then preserves their dominant role in correspondence estimation during fine-grained localization. Specifically, we progressively adapt DINOv3 using geometrically consistent cross-modal patch pairs, enabling feature similarity to better reflect true cross-modal spatial correspondences. We then construct a DINO-Centric Feature Pyramid, where multi-scale DINO representations maintain stable cross-modal correspondences, while a lightweight CNN branch provides auxiliary structural details for precise local refinement. Extensive experiments on three cross-modal datasets demonstrate the superior performance of CDPM. On VIS-IR, compared with the dense matcher RoMa, CDPM improves AUC@3/5/10/20 by 7.36, 13.40, 13.75, and 10.42 percentage points, respectively, and reduces mACE from 5.83 to 2.78 pixels. It also outperforms RoMa v2 across all metrics while requiring 45.6% fewer FLOPs. The online demo and dataset are available, and the code will be released on our project page at https://warren-wzw.github.io/CDPM/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CDPM 面向跨模态平面图像配准，先用几何一致的跨模态 patch 对逐步适配 DINOv3，使特征相似度贴近真实空间对应，再构建以 DINO 为中心的特征金字塔，让多尺度 DINO 表征主导对应估计、轻量 CNN 分支只补局部结构细节。在 VIS-IR 上相对 RoMa 将 AUC@3/5/10/20 分别提高 7.36、13.40、13.75、10.42 个百分点，mACE 从 5.83 降到 2.78 像素，并在全指标上超过 RoMa v2 同时少用 45.6% FLOPs。
Motivation: 跨模态配准中语义相似并不等于几何对应，而细粒度 CNN 特征虽有局部精度却缺全局跨模态语义引导，导致稳定精化困难。
Method: CDPM 分两步：用几何一致的跨模态 patch 对逐步适配 DINOv3，使特征相似度反映真实跨模态空间对应；再构建 DINO-Centric Feature Pyramid，由多尺度 DINO 表征维持稳定对应，轻量 CNN 分支提供辅助结构细节做局部精化。
Result: 在三个跨模态数据集上实验；VIS-IR 上相对 dense matcher RoMa，AUC@3/5/10/20 分别提升 7.36、13.40、13.75、10.42 个百分点，mACE 从 5.83 像素降至 2.78 像素；相对 RoMa v2 全部指标更优且 FLOPs 少 45.6%。
Conclusion: 让语义表征先对齐几何、再在精化中保持其主导地位，可在跨模态平面配准上同时提高精度并降低计算量。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.method: CDPM 分两步：用几何一致的跨模态 patch 对逐步适配 DINOv3，使特征相似度反映真实跨模态空间对应；再构建 DINO-Centric Feature Pyramid，由多尺度 DINO 表征维持稳定对应，轻量 CNN 分支提供辅助结构细节做局部精化。
summary_sections.result: 在三个跨模态数据集上实验；VIS-IR 上相对 dense matcher RoMa，AUC@3/5/10/20 分别提升 7.36、13.40、13.75、10.42 个百分点，mACE 从 5.83 像素降至 2.78 像素；相对 RoMa v2 全部指标更优且 FLOPs 少 45.6%。

papers.title: LiBRA: Detection-Aware Image Watermark Removal via Bidirectional Latent Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Digital watermarking supports source attribution for AI-generated images, but its reliability depends on resistance to removal attacks. Some attacks attempt to remove watermarks by forcing the decoded watermark to differ from the original. However, this can produce an inverted watermark that remains detectable, causing removal to fail, while further attempts to alter the watermark may unnecessarily degrade image quality. To address these limitations, we present LiBRA (Latent In-band Bidirectional Removal Attack), which aims to make watermarks undetectable while preserving image quality. Instead of continually pushing the watermark toward inversion, LiBRA adjusts the image to conceal the watermark without encouraging further changes that could degrade image quality. Some attacks keep pushing decoded bits away from the original watermark, even when further changes preserve detectability and damage image quality. With access to the watermark key and decoder, LiBRA makes bounded changes in a public autoencoder's latent space. Unlike inversion-driven objectives that cannot correct excessive inversion, LiBRA guides average decoding confidence toward random guessing from either direction. This helps avoid an inverted but detectable watermark. Leaving individual bits flexible allows image-quality constraints to favor less damaging changes, while an optional frequency-guided mask limits their location. We verify removal using an exact two-sided binomial test rather than assuming the confidence target guarantees success.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LiBRA 针对图像水印移除攻击中「把解码位推向反相但仍可检测」的失败模式，改为在公开 autoencoder 潜空间里做有界修改，把平均解码置信度从任一方向引导到随机猜测水平，同时放开单个比特自由度并用可选频率引导掩码限制改动位置。移除成功用双侧精确二项检验 (two-sided binomial test) 验证，而非假设置信度目标必然奏效。
Motivation: 现有移除攻击持续把解码水印推离原水印，可能产生反相但仍可检测的水印导致移除失败，且进一步改动会不必要地损害图像质量。
Method: 在持有水印密钥与解码器的前提下，于公开 autoencoder 潜空间中施加有界修改；目标不是反相驱动，而是把平均解码置信度从两个方向引向随机猜测，保留单个比特的灵活性以让图像质量约束选择破坏更小的改动，并可用频率引导掩码限制改动位置；最终用精确双侧二项检验判定移除是否成功。
Result: 提出 LiBRA (Latent in-band Bidirectional Removal Attack)，以双向置信度引导替代反相驱动目标，并以精确双侧二项检验验证移除效果。
Conclusion: 把水印移除目标从「推向反相」改为「推向随机猜测」并配合质量约束，可避免反相却仍可检测的失败，同时减少对图像质量的不必要损伤。

papers.title: Sample complexity of variance-reduced policy gradient: weaker assumptions and lower bounds
papers.abstract_en: Several variance-reduced versions of REINFORCE based on importance sampling achieve an improved $O(ε^{-3})$ sample complexity to find an $ε$-stationary point, under an unrealistic assumption on the variance of the importance weights. In this paper, we propose the \algo (Defensive Policy Gradient) algorithm, based on defensive importance sampling, which achieves the same rate without any assumption on the variance of ordinary importance weights. We also establish lower bounds in a generalized black-box policy-optimization model that hides states and actions and permits parameter-dependent rewards. In this model, the optimal rates are $Θ(ε^{-4})$ with bounded-variance one-policy feedback and $Θ(ε^{-3})$ with mean-square-smooth coupled two-policy feedback. Under standard policy-regularity conditions, REINFORCE and \algo realize the corresponding oracle conditions and attain the $O(ε^{-4})$ and $O(ε^{-3})$ upper bounds, respectively. Although the lower bounds do not apply directly to the classical MDP interaction model in which these algorithms operate, this correspondence provides oracle-level evidence that the faster rate of \algo is optimal and genuinely separated from that of vanilla policy gradient.
papers.journal_ref: Paczolay, G., Papini, M., Metelli, A.M. et al. Sample complexity of variance-reduced policy gradient: weaker assumptions and lower bounds. Mach Learn 113, 6475-6510 (2024)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Defensive Policy Gradient（DPG），用 defensive importance sampling 让方差缩减的 REINFORCE 在不对普通重要性权重方差做任何假设的前提下达到 O(ε^{-3}) 的 ε-平稳点样本复杂度。在隐藏状态与动作、允许参数依赖奖励的广义黑盒策略优化模型中，最优速率在有界方差单策略反馈下为 Θ(ε^{-4})、在均方光滑耦合双策略反馈下为 Θ(ε^{-3})；标准策略正则条件下 REINFORCE 与 DPG 分别实现这两个 oracle 条件。
Motivation: 已有基于重要性采样的方差缩减 REINFORCE 虽把样本复杂度改进到 O(ε^{-3})，但依赖对重要性权重方差的不现实假设；同时缺少能判定策略梯度最优速率的下界模型。
Method: DPG 基于 defensive importance sampling 构造方差缩减的 REINFORCE 变体；下界建立在隐藏状态与动作、允许参数依赖奖励的广义黑盒策略优化模型上，并区分有界方差单策略反馈与均方光滑耦合双策略反馈两种 oracle 条件。
Result: DPG 在不对普通重要性权重方差做假设时达到 O(ε^{-3})；黑盒模型下最优速率为 Θ(ε^{-4})（有界方差单策略反馈）与 Θ(ε^{-3})（均方光滑耦合双策略反馈）；在标准策略正则条件下 REINFORCE 与 DPG 分别达到 O(ε^{-4}) 与 O(ε^{-3}) 上界。
Conclusion: oracle 对应关系为 DPG 更快速率的最优性提供了证据，说明它与 vanilla policy gradient 存在真实分离；但下界并不直接适用于这些算法实际运行的经典 MDP 交互模型。
Relevance: 0
