papers.title: Predicting Steering Vectors and Adapter Weights for Few-Shot Author-Style Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Adapting large language models to an individual author's style from a few examples is challenging, and scientific writing sharpens the difficulty: formal conventions leave little surface variation, and authors write about their own topics, so extracted ``style'' easily entangles with content. We study style-conditioned abstract generation from a few example abstracts per author and propose three methods: (1) contrastive activation steering, (2) a network that predicts steering vectors, and (3) a hypernetwork that predicts LoRA adapters. We find a consistent trade-off between style imitation and output quality: fine-tuning buys most of the available style signal but forfeits fluency, while the hypernetwork achieves the best trade-off on both seen and unseen authors. Our steering operates at author level, contrasting an author's abstracts against style-neutral generations for the same content. This holds topic fixed, removes the need for a predefined style inventory, and outperforms inventory-based steering. % [EDIT 1a] softened "no single optimal axis" claim Moreover, our analyses demonstrate that manually extracted and predicted steering vectors are near-orthogonal yet score comparably, indicating that style conditioning here can admit at least two unrelated directions rather than requiring one particular axis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在少样本作者风格迁移上提出三条路线：对比激活引导 (contrastive activation steering)、预测 steering vector 的网络、以及直接预测 LoRA 权重的 hypernetwork。作者级引导把同一作者摘要与同内容的风格中性生成对比，固定话题并胜过基于 style inventory 的引导；hypernetwork 在已见与未见作者上都给出风格模仿与输出质量的最佳折中，而微调拿到大部分风格信号却牺牲流畅度。
Motivation: 科学写作风格形式约束强、表层变化少，且作者总写自己的主题，从少量样例抽出的 style 容易与 content 纠缠，导致少样本作者风格适配困难。
Method: 三条方法：对比激活引导；一个预测 steering vector 的网络；一个预测 LoRA adapter 权重的 hypernetwork。引导在作者层面构造，把该作者的摘要与针对同一内容的风格中性生成做对比，从而固定话题、无需预定义 style inventory。
Result: 微调获得大部分可用风格信号但牺牲流畅度；hypernetwork 在已见与未见作者上都取得风格模仿与输出质量的最佳折中；作者级引导优于基于 inventory 的引导；人工提取与预测出的 steering vector 近似正交却得分相当。
Conclusion: 风格条件化至少可以沿两个互不相关的方向实现，不必依赖某一条特定轴；在该任务上 hypernetwork 预测 LoRA 权重是比微调更均衡的选择。

papers.title: Budgeted-GS: Real-Time Large-Scale Gaussian Splatting via Factoring LOD
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting achieves excellent visual quality with real-time rendering, but at the scale of entire cities it does not fit: a trained model carries millions of primitives and gigabytes of memory, and real-time rendering at high quality on a consumer GPU remains out of reach. We introduce Budgeted-GS, a post-hoc method that turns any trained 3DGS model into a factoring tree, a multi-resolution hierarchy of moment-matched aggregates. After a construction pass of a few seconds, a single quality parameter selects, for each view, the level of detail that fits the memory of the target device, so the same city-scale model serves GPUs with widely different memory capacities. When a new scene is to be trained, the same theory applies: instead of growing a full-sized model and compressing it afterwards, budget-centered training first measures how many primitives the scene needs and then trains the model directly at that size, avoiding the wasted effort of optimizing primitives that are later discarded. Both methods are grounded in a measurable capacity floor, a budget-error law derived from optimal transport in phase space; selection rules certified by recent covering theorems decide which primitives are redundant. The floor answers how many primitives a scene actually needs and how many can safely be given up. We validate the floor on 13 public scenes under a preregistered protocol, and exercise both methods from object scenes to an official city capture, rendering it at native 1920x1080, full SH, in real time on one consumer GPU.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 21 figures. Preprint of the EG 2027 submission (paper1075)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Budgeted-GS 把已训练好的 3DGS 模型事后改写成分层聚合的 factoring tree，用一个质量参数按视图选择适配目标显存的 LOD，使同一城市级模型可服务显存差异很大的 GPU。其预算-误差律由相空间最优传输导出，并以覆盖定理认证的选择规则判定哪些 primitive 冗余；在 13 个公开场景上验证 capacity floor，并在官方城市拍摄上以 1920x1080、full SH 在单张消费级 GPU 实时渲染。
Motivation: 城市尺度的 3DGS 模型含数百万 primitive、占数 GB 显存，消费级 GPU 上高质量实时渲染做不到，同一模型也无法适配显存差异大的设备。
Method: 事后构造 pass（数秒）把任意已训练 3DGS 变成 moment-matched 聚合的多分辨率 factoring tree，单个质量参数按视图选 LOD；新场景改用 budget-centered training，先测场景所需 primitive 数再按该规模直接训练。理论支撑为相空间最优传输导出的 budget-error law 与由近期覆盖定理认证的冗余选择规则，给出可测的 capacity floor。
Result: 在 13 个公开场景上按预注册协议验证 capacity floor；两种方法从物体级场景到官方城市拍摄均被检验，该城市模型以原生 1920x1080、full SH 在单张消费级 GPU 上实时渲染；构造 pass 耗时数秒。
Conclusion: capacity floor 能回答一个场景实际需要多少 primitive、可安全舍弃多少，因此按预算选 LOD 与按预算训练可让同一城市级 3DGS 覆盖显存差异大的设备并保持实时。

papers.title: Landscape-Dependent Performance of Photonic Quantum Solvers in QUBO Feature Selection for Financial Risk Detection
papers.abstract_en: Feature selection for imbalanced classification tasks such as credit card fraud and consumer default detection requires balancing predictive relevance, inter-feature redundancy, and computational feasibility. We benchmark three computing paradigms, classical branch-and-bound optimization (Gurobi), photonic entropy computing (QCI Dirac-3), and simulated photonic boson sampling (Piquasso), across thirteen feature-selection methods on two datasets: ULB Credit Card Fraud (30 features) and AmEx consumer default (159 features). Each method is routed to the solver matched to its mathematical structure. On ULB, Dirac-3 MI-Spearman matches the all-features model using 13 of 30 features (mean F1 0.873 +/- 0.023 over five runs, best run 0.896), and Piquasso is the best method at k=5. On AmEx, performance rises steadily with the feature budget and every paradigm approaches F1 = 0.80 only near the full feature set. Most differences between Gurobi and Dirac-3 on identical methods fall within run-to-run variation; the large gaps occur where the certified optimum generalizes poorly, most sharply for distance correlation on AmEx at k=25 (Gurobi F1 = 0.422 vs. a Dirac-3 mean of 0.746). At matched budgets, F1 varies about ten times more across methods on ULB than on AmEx, which we trace to how concentrated the predictive signal is in each feature space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 QUBO 特征选择上对比三种计算范式：Gurobi 分支定界、光子熵计算 QCI Dirac-3、模拟光子玻色采样 Piquasso，按数学结构把 13 种特征选择方法路由到匹配求解器。ULB 欺诈数据上 Dirac-3 MI-Spearman 用 30 个特征中的 13 个即达到全特征模型水平（五次运行 mean F1 0.873±0.023，最佳 0.896）；AmEx 上性能随特征预算单调上升，接近全特征集才逼近 F1=0.80。
Motivation: 不平衡金融分类的特征选择要在预测相关性、特征冗余与计算可行性之间权衡，而不同求解器在不同数学结构上的表现差异缺乏系统基准。
Method: 在 ULB Credit Card Fraud（30 特征）与 AmEx consumer default（159 特征）上，把 13 种特征选择方法按数学结构路由到 Gurobi、QCI Dirac-3 或 Piquasso 三种求解器，比较各范式在不同特征预算 k 下的 F1。

papers.title: Multimodal reasoning for broadly neutralizing antibody discovery from label-free human B cell repertoires across virus families
papers.abstract_en: Discovering broadly neutralizing antibodies (bnAbs) from human natural immune repertoires remains a fundamental challenge in immunology, hindered by: the extreme rarity of bnAb, incomplete understanding of their cellular origins across pathogens, and the inability of existing computational tools to generalize across emerging viral threats. Here we present ImmuneAgent, a closed-loop AI system that integrates multimodal reasoning with continual meta-learning and wet-lab feedback to overcome these barriers. Applied to screen the natural BCR repertoires from vaccinated or infected cohorts, the system achieves a ~55% neutralization antibody discovery rate (60 of 110 cloned candidates) and a ~11% bnAb yield (12 of 110), substantially outperforming a state-of-the-art sequence-based neutralization predictor or cofolding models evaluated at the same cloning budget. Five ImmuneAgent-discovered antibodies conferred 100% in vivo protection against lethal influenza challenge, comparable to the clinical-stage therapeutic MEDI8852. The system recovered the cellular and structural determinants of bnAb activity and identified FCRL5+CD27+ atypical memory B cells as a conserved bnAb reservoir and hydrophobic interface enrichment as a cross-viral structural signature, which generalized to unseen antigens, discovering human metapneumovirus (hMPV) cross-neutralizing and human papillomavirus (HPV)-neutralizing antibodies without antigen-specific sorting. These results validate that ImmuneAgent is a generalizable framework for rapid therapeutic antibody discovery against emerging viral threats.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ImmuneAgent 是一个把多模态推理、持续元学习与湿实验反馈闭环结合的抗体发现系统，用于从接种或感染队列的天然 BCR 库中筛广谱中和抗体 (bnAb)。在 110 个克隆候选上达到约 55% 中和抗体发现率（60/110）与约 11% bnAb 产率（12/110），同克隆预算下显著优于序列型中和预测器与 cofolding 模型；5 个抗体对致死性流感攻毒提供 100% 体内保护，与临床阶段 MEDI8852 相当。
Motivation: 天然免疫库中 bnAb 极度稀有，其跨病原的细胞来源认识不完整，现有计算工具也无法跨新发病毒威胁泛化，导致治疗性抗体发现慢。
Method: ImmuneAgent 为闭环 AI 系统：多模态推理加持续元学习 (continual meta-learning) 驱动候选筛选，湿实验反馈回灌模型；应用于接种/感染队列的天然 BCR repertoires，并在相同克隆预算下与序列型中和预测器和 cofolding 模型对照。
Result: 110 个克隆候选中 60 个为中和抗体（约 55%），12 个为 bnAb（约 11%），在同克隆预算下大幅优于 SOTA 序列型中和预测器与 cofolding 模型；5 个 ImmuneAgent 发现的抗体对致死流感攻毒提供 100% 体内保护，与临床阶段 MEDI8852 相当；系统还发现 FCRL5+CD27+ atypical memory B cells 为保守 bnAb 库、疏水界面富集为跨病毒结构特征，并在无抗原特异性分选下发现 hMPV 交叉中和与 HPV 中和抗体。
Conclusion: ImmuneAgent 被验证为可泛化的框架，能跨未见抗原快速发现针对新发病毒威胁的治疗性抗体，并同时回收 bnAb 活性的细胞与结构决定因素。

papers.title: Does Physics Live in the Activations? Localizing Physical Quantities in Video Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Video generation models produce strikingly realistic sequences and are increasingly proposed as world models, yet recent benchmarks reveal pronounced deficits in their physical reasoning. This raises the question of whether these models internalize physical principles or merely reproduce familiar motion patterns. We address this by probing internal representations of video Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) for simulator-derived ground-truth physical quantities spanning kinematic motion and rigid-body dynamics under gravity and contact. We find that these quantities are linearly decodable with high accuracy early in the denoising process, substantially outperforming a baseline decoded directly from the model's own noised latents, indicating that the relevant physical information is actively constructed during denoising rather than already present in the input. Additionally, we show that activations at on-object tokens carry the relevant physical information and that quantities defined over multiple frames are readable from single latent frames. Hence, information is sharply localized within the token sequence and is computed globally but stored locally. The probes further show partial extrapolation, transferring to scene variations and object configurations outside their training regime, so what they read is not simply a correlate of the scenes they were fit on. When fitted directly in the full-resolution activation space, the probing directions can serve as steering vectors to change the model's output.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对视频 Diffusion Transformer (DiT) 的内部激活做线性探针，读出由仿真器生成的真实物理量（运动学量与重力/接触下的刚体动力学量），发现这些量在去噪早期即可高精度线性解码，且显著优于直接从模型自身含噪 latent 解码的基线，说明物理信息是在去噪过程中被主动构建的。跨场景与物体配置有部分外推能力，探针方向还可作为 steering vector 改变模型输出。
Motivation: 视频生成模型被当作 world model 提出，但基准显示其物理推理能力明显不足；需要判定模型是内化了物理原理还是只复现熟悉运动模式。
Method: 在视频 DiT 的内部表示上训练线性探针，目标量由仿真器提供 ground truth，覆盖运动学与重力/接触下的刚体动力学；对照基线是直接从模型自身含噪 latent 解码；另在全分辨率激活空间拟合探针方向用作 steering vector。
Result: 物理量在去噪早期即可高精度线性解码，显著优于从含噪 latent 解码的基线；on-object token 承载相关信息，跨多帧定义的量可从单个 latent 帧读出；探针对训练分布外的场景与物体配置有部分外推；拟合方向可作为 steering vector 改变模型输出。
Conclusion: 视频扩散模型在去噪中主动构建物理信息，且该信息在 token 序列中全局计算、局部存储，因此可用线性探针读出并用于操控生成结果。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: EvoRiskBench: An Evolving Benchmark for Runtime Security Risks in Workspace Agents
papers.abstract_en: Workspace agents combine large language models with execution harnesses to perform stateful, multi-step tasks that access or modify external resources. Existing benchmarks leave gaps in executable coverage of their runtime security risks, while evolving model capabilities, harnesses, tools, and threats motivate benchmark evolution. We introduce EvoRiskBench, an evolving benchmark organized around the EP-Path-EF framework, which links an initial risk entry point to a one-hop technical effect through an agent-mediated risk path. The framework defines nine entry-point categories and five effect categories; a 20-participant study supports their interpretability and classification consistency on representative cases. Guided by this framework, an automated end-to-end workflow constructs and executes risk cases in isolated environments and independently verifies outcomes using runtime traces and environment states. The benchmark provides a reproducible dataset of 450 adversarial tasks across six scenarios. We evaluate nine model-harness configurations spanning three models (GPT-5.6 Sol, DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813, and Claude Opus 5) and three harnesses (Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw). Our results reveal substantial vulnerabilities across systems. The most vulnerable configuration, Codex with DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813, reaches a 68.44% attack success rate (ASR), indicating that configuration of workspace agent is insufficient to ensure secure autonomous execution. ASR varies more across models than harnesses, and harness differences depend on the model. The benchmark cases and evaluation platform will be released after completion of artifact safety and reproducibility checks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvoRiskBench 是面向 workspace agent 运行时安全风险的可演化基准，用 EP-Path-EF 框架把风险入口经 agent 参与的风险路径连到一跳技术效应，自动化工作流在隔离环境中构造并执行风险案例、用运行时 trace 与环境状态独立核验结果。含 6 个场景共 450 个对抗任务，评测 9 个模型-harness 配置，最脆弱的 Codex + DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 攻击成功率 (ASR) 达 68.44%，说明仅靠配置 workspace agent 不足以保证安全的自主执行。
Motivation: 现有基准对 workspace agent 运行时安全风险的可执行覆盖不足，而模型能力、harness、工具与威胁持续演化，静态基准很快失效。
Method: 以 EP-Path-EF 框架组织风险（9 类入口、5 类效应），由自动化端到端工作流在隔离环境中构造并执行风险案例，依据 runtime traces 与环境状态独立核验结果；用 20 人研究检验分类可解释性与一致性。
Result: 450 个对抗任务、6 个场景；评测 3 个模型（GPT-5.6 Sol、DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813、Claude Opus 5）× 3 个 harness（Claude Code、Codex、OpenClaw）共 9 个配置，最脆弱配置 Codex + DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 的 ASR 为 68.44%；ASR 在模型间的差异大于 harness 间，且 harness 差异依赖于模型。
Conclusion: workspace agent 的安全不能靠配置保证，风险随模型-harness 组合而变，基准需随能力与威胁演化；案例与评测平台将在完成 artifact 安全与可复现性检查后发布。

papers.title: TSGuard: A Real-Time Framework for Detecting and Imputing Missing Data in Streaming Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Streaming sensor applications routinely suffer from delayed or missing observations caused by faults, communication losses, or environmental interference. Although recent imputation methods exploit temporal and spatial dependencies effectively, most either assume offline access to future observations or prioritize throughput without enforcing domain plausibility. We present TSGuard, a real-time demonstration system for monitoring, validating, and imputing missing values in streaming time series. TSGuard combines a lightweight graph-aware temporal imputation model with constraint-aware validation, fallback estimation, and operator-facing explanations. Rather than treating imputation as an isolated prediction task, TSGuard integrates it into a broader data-quality loop: detect problematic observations, impute missing values, validate estimated against physical and spatial constraints, and either retain the original value as a plausible anomaly or replace it when it violates domain constraints. Using environmental sensing as a motivating setting, the demo enables users to inspect delayed sensors, compare imputers, define constraints, and validate flagged values in real time. The combination of lightweight online spatiotemporal imputation, domain-aware validation, and explicit retain-or-replace decisions is our central contribution, while interactive explanations make these decisions inspectable and actionable. for operators.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TSGuard 是一个流式时间序列缺失检测与填补的实时演示系统：用轻量图感知时序填补模型给出估计，再用物理与空间约束校验，按约束违反与否做保留或替换的显式决策，并向操作员给出可检查的解释。核心主张是把填补嵌进「检测—填补—约束校验—保留/替换」的数据质量闭环，而非孤立的预测任务。
Motivation: 流式传感器常因故障、通信丢失和环境干扰出现延迟或缺失观测；现有填补方法要么假设能离线访问未来观测，要么只追求吞吐而不管领域合理性。
Method: TSGuard 组合轻量图感知时序填补模型 (graph-aware temporal imputation)、约束感知校验 (constraint-aware validation)、回退估计 (fallback estimation) 与面向操作员的解释；闭环流程为检测异常观测、填补缺失值、用物理与空间约束校验估计值，再决定保留原值（视为合理异常）或替换（违反领域约束）。以环境传感为示例场景，用户可实时查看延迟传感器、比较不同填补器、定义约束并校验被标记值。
Result: 系统以环境传感为设定，支持实时检查延迟传感器、比较填补器、自定义约束并校验被标记值；中心贡献是轻量在线时空填补加领域感知校验与显式保留或替换决策，交互式解释使决策可检查、可操作。
Conclusion: 缺失值填补应作为数据质量闭环的一部分，由领域约束决定保留还是替换，而不是孤立的预测步骤；可检查的解释让操作员能审查这些决策。
Relevance: 18

summary_sections.method: TSGuard 组合轻量图感知时序填补模型 (graph-aware temporal imputation)、约束感知校验 (constraint-aware validation)、回退估计 (fallback estimation) 与面向操作员的解释；闭环流程为检测异常观测、填补缺失值、用物理与空间约束校验估计值，再决定保留原值（视为合理异常）或替换（违反领域约束）。以环境传感为示例场景，用户可实时查看延迟传感器、比较不同填补器、定义约束并校验被标记值。
summary_sections.result: 系统以环境传感为设定，支持实时检查延迟传感器、比较填补器、自定义约束并校验被标记值；中心贡献是轻量在线时空填补加领域感知校验与显式保留或替换决策，交互式解释使决策可检查、可操作。
summary_sections.conclusion: 缺失值填补应作为数据质量闭环的一部分，由领域约束决定保留还是替换，而不是孤立的预测步骤；可检查的解释让操作员能审查这些决策。

papers.title: CalCErt: Bin-wise Certification of Confidence Calibration in Medical Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks remain vulnerable to adversarial perturbations, which can distort not only predictions but also confidence scores, undermining uncertainty calibration. While existing certification methods focus on preserving the predicted category, providing guarantees on how calibration behaves under adversarial attacks remains overlooked. In this work, we introduce CalCErt, a simple and efficient post-hoc strategy that certifies bin-wise confidence calibration for any pretrained differentiable classifier. Our approach combines empirical calibration estimates, statistical concentration bounds, and local Lipschitz estimates of the confidence function to derive data-dependent upper bounds on worst-case miscalibration within an $ell_2$-ball of radius R. We evaluate CalCErt across 11 medical image classification tasks and multiple adversarial perturbations, demonstrating substantially higher certified coverage than baseline strategies while maintaining competitive tightness. Our code is available at https://github.com/leofillioux/calcert.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CalCErt 是一种事后 (post-hoc) 认证策略，为任意预训练可微分类器给出分箱 (bin-wise) 置信度校准在 ℓ2 半径 R 扰动球内的最坏情况失准上界，组合经验校准估计、统计集中界与置信度函数的局部 Lipschitz 估计。在 11 项医学图像分类任务与多种对抗扰动上，其认证覆盖率显著高于基线策略，同时保持有竞争力的紧致度。
Motivation: 现有认证方法只保证预测类别在对抗扰动下不变，置信度分数本身会被扰动扭曲，校准在攻击下如何表现缺少可认证保证。
Method: 对预训练可微分类器做事后认证：用经验校准估计加统计集中界，再结合置信度函数的局部 Lipschitz 估计，推导 ℓ2 半径 R 球内最坏情况失准的数据依赖上界，按 bin 逐箱给出。
Result: 在 11 项医学图像分类任务和多种对抗扰动下评估，认证覆盖率 (certified coverage) 显著高于基线策略，同时紧致度 (tightness) 保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 校准本身可以在 ℓ2 对抗球内被逐箱认证，且比只保类别标签的认证做法给出更广的覆盖。

papers.title: Behavior Pack Optimization for Video MLLM Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Video multimodal large language models (MLLMs) keep climbing video question answering benchmarks, yet shuffling the frames, masking the segment that supports the answer, or occluding the target object barely changes their predictions. The accuracy rests on appearance and language priors, not on the temporal evidence the question asks for. We trace this to the unit of post-training: rewards are computed on a single response to the original clip, so the model is never asked to behave consistently across views. We propose Behavior Pack Optimization (BPO), which replaces the single response with a behavior pack of outputs across counterfactual views chosen by question type, scored jointly. The pack reward asks for stability when the intervention is irrelevant, sensitivity when key evidence is removed, and abstention when no evidence remains. To keep this objective stable at small pack sizes, BPO uses an anchor-relative advantage: the response on the original view serves as a per-prompt reference instead of a group mean over mixed views. On TempCompass, MVBench, and NExT-QA, BPO improves the macro accuracy of Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct by 4.7 pp, the temporal-hard subset by 7.8 pp, and abstention F1 by 20.0 pp over a budget-matched vanilla GRPO baseline from the same SFT checkpoint. The gains transfer to Video-MME, LongVideoBench, and to LLaVA-Video-7B; ablations confirm they follow the view sets, not the rollout count. We hope this pack-level perspective offers a useful starting point for the video MLLM and multimodal post-training community as the field moves toward evidence-grounded video reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 视频 MLLM 的后训练奖励只算原始片段上的单条回答，模型即使被洗牌帧、遮掉支撑答案的片段或目标物体也几乎不改预测，说明其准确率靠外观与语言先验而非时序证据。BPO 把单条回答换成按问题类型选取的反事实视图行为包 (behavior pack) 联合打分：干预无关时要求稳定、关键证据被移除时要求敏感、证据全无时要求弃答，并用原始视图回答作 per-prompt 锚点的 anchor-relative advantage 替代组均值。在与 vanilla GRPO 同预算、同 SFT checkpoint 下，Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 在 TempCompass、MVBench、NExT-QA 上宏精度 +4.7 pp、temporal-hard 子集 +7.8 pp、弃答 F1 +20.0 pp。
Motivation: 视频 MLLM 在视频问答基准上持续涨分，但对帧洗牌、证据片段遮挡、目标遮挡几乎不敏感，准确率依赖外观与语言先验；根因是后训练的奖励单位是原始片段上的单条响应，模型从未被要求跨视图保持一致行为。
Method: 提出 Behavior Pack Optimization (BPO)：按问题类型选择反事实视图组成 behavior pack，把单条响应替换为整包输出并联合打分，奖励同时约束干预无关时的稳定性、关键证据移除时的敏感性、证据耗尽时的弃答 (abstention)。为在小 pack 尺度下稳定训练，用 anchor-relative advantage——以原始视图的响应作为 per-prompt 参照，而非混合视图上的组均值。
Result: 在与预算匹配的 vanilla GRPO、同一 SFT checkpoint 对比下，BPO 使 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 在 TempCompass、MVBench、NExT-QA 上的宏精度提升 4.7 pp，temporal-hard 子集提升 7.8 pp，弃答 F1 提升 20.0 pp；增益迁移到 Video-MME、LongVideoBench 以及 LLaVA-Video-7B，消融显示增益来自视图集合而非 rollout 数量。
Conclusion: 把后训练的奖励单位从单条响应提升到跨反事实视图的行为包，能让视频 MLLM 的预测真正绑定时序证据而非外观与语言先验，且该 pack-level 视角可迁移到其他视频 MLLM 与多模态后训练。

papers.title: Keeping JEPA World Models Plannable When Little of the Frame Moves
papers.abstract_en: Specifying a goal in language rather than as a goal frame is a natural interface for planning with a latent world model, but testing it needs scenes in which language must discriminate between several objects. We build SLIM, a pushing benchmark with several small objects and paired visual and language goals on identical scenes. On SLIM a LeWM world model that solves PushT succeeds on under 1% of trials, although a scripted controller with simulator state solves every tier. Probes locate the failure in the encoder: its latent is nearly action-insensitive, neither pusher nor object positions can be decoded from it, and rollouts are no better than copying the current latent forward. One inverse-dynamics auxiliary loss, applied to encoder latents and to predicted latents through a shared head discarded at test time, restores every probe and raises success from 0.003 to 0.35 (0.16 on the hard pushing tier, where a goal-agnostic policy scores zero), and improves PushT at twice the trained horizon. Controls attribute the repair to the gradient into the encoder, and a response sweep shows that the vanilla model plans once enough of the frame responds to actions. A cheap action-sensitivity probe, computable without environment access, acts as an empirical necessary condition: all configurations below its threshold failed to plan. On the repaired latent, a small language-goal head plans from sentences without retraining the world model: it reaches 0.84 on navigation (visual-goal oracle 1.00), follows the named zone when it is swapped with a decoy, and degrades gracefully to unseen nouns. A single goal sentence rarely completes a push, but given the push as a sequence of stage sentences the head raises success on the medium and hard pushing tiers from 0.04 to 0.25, on par with the goal-frame oracle, also when the switch between stages is read from the latent alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SLIM 基准上，LeWM 世界模型（在 PushT 上训练）用语言指定目标时成功率不足 1%，探针定位故障在编码器：其 latent 几乎不随动作变化。加入一个共享头的逆动力学 (inverse-dynamics) 辅助损失后成功率从 0.003 升到 0.35，且无需重训世界模型即可用语言目标头规划。
Motivation: 用语言而非目标帧指定目标是 latent 世界模型规划的自然接口，但需要能区分多物体的场景；现有基准（如 PushT）无法暴露语言目标规划在何处失效。
Method: 构建 SLIM 推物基准（多小物体、同一场景配对视觉与语言目标）；用探针检测 latent 的动作敏感性与可解码性；在编码器 latent 与预测 latent 上共享一个测试时丢弃的逆动力学辅助损失头；训练小型语言目标头直接从句子规划。
Result: SLIM 上 LeWM 成功率不足 1%（0.003），脚本控制器全层级成功；辅助损失将成功率提至 0.35（hard 层 0.16，goal-agnostic 策略为 0），并在两倍训练视界上改进 PushT；语言目标头导航达 0.84（视觉目标 oracle 1.00），换诱饵后仍跟随指定区域，对未见名词平滑退化；分阶段句子将 medium/hard 推物从 0.04 提至 0.25，与 goal-frame oracle 持平；动作敏感性探针阈值以下的配置全部规划失败。
Conclusion: latent 对动作的敏感性是可规划的经验必要条件，逆动力学辅助损失通过向编码器回传梯度修复它，从而支持无需重训世界模型的语言目标规划。

papers.title: Page-EntroKV: Hardware-Aligned, Entropy-Weighted KV-Cache Eviction under Grouped-Query Attention
papers.abstract_en: Serving long-context autoregressive language models is constrained by the key-value (KV) cache. Most dynamic eviction methods score token importance per query head and choose tokens independently. This fits poorly with grouped-query attention (GQA), where several query heads share one physical KV buffer: divergent per-head selections force the serving engine to retain the union of their choices - inflating the cache by up to the group ratio r - while arithmetic mean pooling dilutes the specialized retrieval heads that carry factual recall. We introduce Page-EntroKV, a formal framework for KV-cache eviction operating at the granularity GQA serving actually allocates. Heads within each physical group are pooled by weights derived from sink-isolated collision (Renyi-2) entropy - one inner product per head, computed once at prefill with no calibration - so sink heads cannot masquerade as retrieval heads. Pooled scores are projected onto PagedAttention page frames, and eviction executes at the hardware tuple (layer, group, page). We formalize the union overhead ratio (UOR) and intra-group disagreement, prove an exact identity linking them for two-head groups alongside two-sided bounds at every group ratio, prove strict budget preservation and a finite-context needle-retention bound that arithmetic mean pooling provably violates, and give exact per-layer page accounting. On a pilot architecture (Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, r=6), head-independent replay over 2,240 group measurements yields union overhead up to 4.75x at a 2% budget, while Page-EntroKV holds UOR exactly 1.000; sink isolation removes a 13x sink masquerade; needle recall is 100% versus 0% for mean pooling at a 20% budget; retained cardinality is exact for every page size; and QA and code tasks remain solvable at 20% retention.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 8 figures, 10 tables. Formal framework with pilot-scale empirical validation on Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct. Includes step-by-step derivations (Appendix C) and PyTorch reference implementation (Appendix D). Code and data available at: https://github.com/bruce12-glitch/PageEntro-KV
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Page-EntroKV 把 KV-cache 淘汰粒度对齐到 GQA 实际分配的物理组：组内各头用 sink 隔离的 Rényi-2 碰撞熵加权合并，再投影到 PagedAttention 页帧上按 (layer, group, page) 执行。在 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct（r=6）上，2% 预算时逐头独立选择的 union overhead 达 4.75x，而本方法 UOR 恒为 1.000；20% 预算下 needle recall 为 100%（均值池化 0%）。
Motivation: GQA 中多个 query 头共享同一物理 KV buffer，逐头独立打分会让引擎保留各头选择的并集，缓存最多膨胀 r 倍；而算术平均池化又会稀释承载事实召回的 retrieval 头。
Method: 组内各头按 sink 隔离的 Rényi-2 碰撞熵导出权重做池化（每头一次内积，prefill 时算一次、无需校准），池化分数投影到 PagedAttention 页帧，淘汰在 (layer, group, page) 三元组上执行；形式化定义 union overhead ratio (UOR) 与组内分歧，证明两头组的精确恒等式、各组比下的双边界、严格预算保持与有限上下文 needle 保留界。
Result: 在 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct（r=6）上，2,240 组测量的逐头独立重放给出最高 4.75x 的 union overhead（2% 预算），Page-EntroKV 将 UOR 精确保持 1.000；sink 隔离消除 13x 的 sink 伪装；20% 预算下 needle recall 为 100% 对均值池化的 0%；各页大小下保留基数精确；20% 保留率时 QA 与代码任务仍可解。
Conclusion: 在 GQA 下按物理组而非按头做熵加权淘汰，可以同时消除并集膨胀、保住 retrieval 头与 needle，并严格满足缓存预算；算术平均池化被证明违反 needle 保留界。

summary_sections.result: 在 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct（r=6）上，2,240 组测量的逐头独立重放给出最高 4.75x 的 union overhead（2% 预算），Page-EntroKV 将 UOR 精确保持 1.000；sink 隔离消除 13x 的 sink 伪装；20% 预算下 needle recall 为 100% 对均值池化的 0%；各页大小下保留基数精确；20% 保留率时 QA 与代码任务仍可解。
summary_sections.conclusion: 在 GQA 下按物理组而非按头做熵加权淘汰，可以同时消除并集膨胀、保住 retrieval 头与 needle，并严格满足缓存预算；算术平均池化被证明违反 needle 保留界。

papers.title: Safe Streaming Flow Planning by Aligning Sampling Dynamics with Execution Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Generative planners based on diffusion/flow matching can learn to synthesize long-horizon trajectories from demonstrations. However, real-world deployment requires (i) enforcing safety constraints during execution and (ii) tight online replanning at fast execution rates. Prior safe diffusion/flow planners generate the agent's full trajectory at once, while repeatedly perturbing intermediate states to satisfy safety constraints. This approach is not only computationally intensive, but also introduces distribution shift since the learned sampling dynamics is distinct from the system's execution dynamics. We propose SafeStreamingFlow, a goal-conditioned planner that aligns flow sampling dynamics with execution dynamics by sequentially integrating a learned state vector field with hierarchical state prediction. Importantly, we need to enforce safety constraints only for the executed step via high order control barrier functions. Across navigation, racing, and locomotion benchmarks, SafeStreamingFlow reduces planning latency and improves safety compared to existing methods, while maintaining competitive goal-reaching success.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 10th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026). Project page: https://jang-seunghwan.github.io/SafeStreamingFlowPlanning/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SafeStreamingFlow 把扩散/流匹配生成式规划器的采样动力学与系统执行动力学对齐：目标条件下顺序积分学习到的状态向量场并做分层状态预测，只对被执行的那一步用高阶控制屏障函数 (high order control barrier functions) 施加安全约束。在 navigation、racing、locomotion 基准上，该方法相比既有安全扩散/流规划器降低规划延迟、提升安全性，同时保持有竞争力的目标到达成功率。
Motivation: 既有的安全扩散/流规划器一次性生成整条轨迹，再反复扰动中间状态以满足安全约束，既计算开销大，又因学习到的采样动力学与系统执行动力学不一致而引入分布偏移。
Method: 目标条件的 SafeStreamingFlow 顺序积分学习到的状态向量场 (state vector field)，配合分层状态预测 (hierarchical state prediction) 逐步推进；安全约束只在被执行的单步上用高阶控制屏障函数强制满足，而非对整条轨迹反复修正。
Result: 在 navigation、racing、locomotion 三类基准上，相比既有安全扩散/流规划方法，规划延迟下降、安全性提升，目标到达成功率保持有竞争力；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把流匹配的采样过程按执行步逐步积分并只约束被执行步，可以同时缓解安全规划的计算负担与分布偏移，代价是安全保证只覆盖单步执行。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Trading Strategy Optimization via Textual Gradient
papers.abstract_en: Quantitative trading strategy design aims to discover trading programs from historical data that remain effective in future markets, which can be viewed as a black-box program optimization problem. LLM-based textual gradients offer a promising approach by providing explicit optimization directions for iterative strategy refinement. However, directly applying textual gradients faces two challenges: (1) optimization is myopic, underutilizing experience from previous evaluations; and (2) aggregate backtest feedback overlooks temporal robustness, potentially favoring strategies that perform well only in specific market periods. To address these challenges, we propose TradeGrad, an experience-guided textual-gradient framework for robust trading strategy optimization. TradeGrad leverages accumulated optimization experience to estimate textual gradients and employs multi-scale revisions for both strategy exploration and refinement. It further introduces the Cross-Period Robust Objective (CPRO), which emphasizes performance in unfavorable historical periods to promote temporal robustness. Experiments on cross-sectional and time-series strategy design in Chinese A-share and U.S. equity markets show that TradeGrad achieves the best in-sample and out-of-sample performance across all four settings. Notably, its Chinese cross-sectional strategy achieves 27.99% annualized return, 12.19% maximum drawdown, and a Sharpe ratio of 1.63, approximately 68% higher than the CSI 300 benchmark. Further analyses validate the proposed components and show consistent improvements in both in-sample and out-of-sample performance throughout optimization. The code is available at https://github.com/transcend-0/TradeGrad.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TradeGrad 用 LLM 文本梯度 (textual gradient) 迭代优化交易策略程序：以累积优化经验估计梯度方向，做多尺度修订，并用 Cross-Period Robust Objective (CPRO) 偏重不利历史时段的表现以提升时间稳健性。在中国 A 股与美股的截面及时间序列四类设定中，其样本内外表现均为最佳，A 股截面策略年化收益 27.99%、最大回撤 12.19%、Sharpe 1.63，约比 CSI 300 基准高 68%。
Motivation: 直接套用文本梯度有两个缺口：优化是短视的，用不上历史评估积累的经验；聚合回测反馈掩盖时间稳健性，容易选出只在特定行情时段有效的策略。
Method: TradeGrad 框架以累积优化经验来估计文本梯度，配合面向策略探索与精化的多尺度修订；目标函数用 CPRO，强调在不利历史时段上的表现以促进 temporal robustness，在历史数据上做黑盒程序式迭代优化。
Result: 在中国 A 股与美股市场的截面 (cross-sectional) 和时间序列 (time-series) 策略设计共四个设定上，样本内与样本外表现全部最佳；中国截面策略年化收益 27.99%、最大回撤 12.19%、Sharpe 1.63，约比 CSI 300 基准高 68%。消融与进一步分析显示各组件有效，且优化全程样本内外表现持续提升。
Conclusion: 把经验积累的文本梯度与偏重不利时段的 CPRO 结合，可以在跨行情时段的策略搜索中同时拿到更好的样本内外收益与回撤控制。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Coverage You Can Steer: Online Conformal Calibration for RL-Driven Hardware-Aware NAS
papers.abstract_en: Hardware-aware neural architecture search (NAS) is dominated by evaluation cost: every architecture must be trained before its reward is known. Conformal-prediction filters cut this cost by pruning candidates whose predicted-reward upper bound misses a threshold, with a distribution-free guarantee that at most a fraction $δ$ are wrongly discarded. That guarantee assumes exchangeability between calibration and test candidates, which the surrounding reinforcement-learning (RL) loop violates: the policy's proposals improve as search proceeds and, in layer-by-layer construction, shift within every episode. We replace one-shot quantile estimation with online feedback control (Adaptive Conformal Inference, with tuning-free, locally-adaptive, and group-conditional variants), restoring steerable coverage: dialing the target delivers it, monotonically and reproducibly, for arbitrary sequences. Across three neural-network architecture families and both single-step and sequential search (three seeds), it tracks every requested level to within ${\sim}10^{-3}$ while pruning 25-50% of evaluations at no measured accuracy cost, whereas static calibration loses control of its coverage and a Gaussian-process baseline stays conservative regardless of the request. Finally, used as an acquisition function on one constrained testbed, the same optimistic bound beats random search, a gain that fixed optimism already carries and online calibration sharpens. The source code is available at https://github.com/Vicomtech/rl-hw-nas.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 硬件感知 NAS 中用 conformal 过滤剪掉预测奖励上界不达标的架构，但 RL 搜索的候选分布随策略改进而漂移，破坏一次性分位数校准的可交换性假设。改用在线反馈控制（Adaptive Conformal Inference，含 tuning-free、locally-adaptive、group-conditional 变体）后，任意请求的覆盖率都能单调、可复现地达成，在三个网络架构族上跟踪到约 10⁻³ 以内，同时剪掉 25–50% 的评估且无测得的精度损失。
Motivation: 硬件感知 NAS 的代价主要来自逐个训练评估；conformal 过滤能剪枝，但其分布无关保证依赖校准集与测试候选可交换，而 RL 循环中策略提议随搜索推进不断改进、逐层构造时在每个 episode 内漂移，一次性分位数估计因此失控。
Method: 用 Adaptive Conformal Inference 的在线反馈控制替代一次性分位数估计，提供 tuning-free、locally-adaptive、group-conditional 三种变体，把目标覆盖率当作可调设定值；在三个神经网络架构族上做单步与序列式搜索，各三个随机种子，并把乐观上界作为采集函数在一个受限测试床上与随机搜索对比。
Result: 在线校准把请求的每个覆盖率水平跟踪到约 10⁻³ 以内，同时剪掉 25–50% 的评估且无测得的精度损失；静态校准失去覆盖率控制，高斯过程基线则无论请求多少都保持保守。作为采集函数时，该乐观上界在受限测试床上胜过随机搜索，这一增益固定乐观度已具备、在线校准进一步锐化。
Conclusion: 把 conformal 覆盖率当成在线反馈控制的设定值，可以在被 RL 破坏可交换性的搜索过程中给出可转向、可复现的剪枝保证，且不牺牲精度。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: ParaGeo: Decomposing Paralinguistic Variation into a Shared Latent Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Speech delivery varies with both the requested paralinguistic attribute and the linguistic content. We introduce ParaGeo, a matched-content decomposition of paralinguistic variation in a frozen speech language model. Synthesized audio tokens are replayed with a fixed listening prompt; pooled key/value (K/V) representations are centered and projected into a shared low-dimensional space. Our GLM-4-Voice probe spans 80 requested controls from 12 benchmark families across eight sentences. With a globally fitted calibration basis, content-held-out centroid accuracy using this basis is 9.49% versus a 1.25% permutation baseline; same-label cross-content cosine similarity is 0.285 versus 0.017, and both conditional permutation tests yield p = 0.001. A separate ten-scenario, six-style probe reveals reproducible contrast directions across scenarios. Static, additive, and temporal interventions produce attribute-, layer-, and schedule-dependent response profiles. These results provide a shared coordinate representation for measuring paralinguistic structure and an empirical starting point for latent speech control. Code is available at https://github.com/yuhanlydia/ParaGeo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ParaGeo 在冻结的语音语言模型 GLM-4-Voice 中，把合成音频 token 以固定聆听提示回放，将池化后的 key/value 表示中心化并投影到共享低维空间，从而把副语言属性变化与语言内容变化分解开。全局拟合的标定基底在 content-held-out 条件下质心准确率为 9.49%，置换基线仅 1.25%；同标签跨内容余弦相似度 0.285 对 0.017，两项条件置换检验 p = 0.001。
Motivation: 语音表达同时随所请求的副语言属性和语言内容变化，二者混杂使副语言结构难以度量，也难以在冻结模型上做可控干预。
Method: 在冻结的 GLM-4-Voice 上做 matched-content 分解：合成音频 token 用固定聆听提示回放，池化 K/V 表示中心化后投影到共享低维空间；用全局拟合的标定基底评估 12 个 benchmark 族、80 个请求控制、8 个句子的 probe，另有十场景六风格 probe，并施加 static、additive、temporal 三类干预。
Result: content-held-out 质心准确率 9.49%（置换基线 1.25%）；同标签跨内容余弦相似度 0.285（对照 0.017）；两项条件置换检验均为 p = 0.001。十场景六风格 probe 显示跨场景可复现的对比方向；三类干预产生随属性、层和调度变化的响应谱型。
Conclusion: 副语言结构可在一个共享坐标表示中被度量，该表示可作为潜空间语音控制的经验起点；代码已在 GitHub 开源。

papers.title: The Fragility of Trigger-Tag Mechanisms for Misuse Detection in Open-Weight LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Open-weight language models can be downloaded, modified, and deployed beyond their developers' control, limiting the effectiveness of centrally enforced safeguards. Recent work has therefore proposed \emph{trigger-tag} mechanisms that produce a detectable signal when a model is used under a target condition, such as generating phishing contents. Although these mechanisms borrow from established techniques, their use for conditional misuse detection in open-weight LLMs is relatively new. Therefore, existing research works have not systematically studied the robustness of trigger-tag mechanisms under adversarial attacks. To close this gap, (i)~we formalize trigger-tags and distinguish \emph{token-level trigger-tags}, which introduce watermark-inspired signals during decoding, from \emph{weight-level trigger-tags}, which learn backdoor-inspired associations between target conditions and detectable model behavior. Furthermore, (ii)~we introduce \Untag, a unified attack framework that organizes their mechanism-specific attack surfaces into a common taxonomy. We evaluate representative token-level and weight-level trigger-tags using phishing as a case study. We find that while trigger-tags may provide useful evidence in controlled settings, our attacks render the existing trigger-tag mechanisms to be entirely ineffective. Consequently, we argue that these mechanisms should not be treated as robust misuse detectors when attackers can transform outputs or modify open weights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 开放权重 LLM 的 trigger-tag 滥用检测机制在对抗攻击下完全失效：作者区分 token-level（解码期水印式信号）与 weight-level（后门式关联）两类 trigger-tag，提出统一攻击框架 UNTAG 组织其机制特定攻击面，并以钓鱼内容生成为案例评估代表性机制。攻击可变换输出或修改开放权重，使现有 trigger-tag 完全无效，因此不应被当作稳健的滥用检测器。
Motivation: 开放权重模型可被下载、修改、部署在开发者控制之外，中心化安全护栏难以强制执行；trigger-tag 被提出用于条件式滥用检测，但现有研究未系统考察其在对抗攻击下的鲁棒性。
Method: 先形式化 trigger-tag 并区分 token-level 与 weight-level 两类机制，再提出 UNTAG 统一攻击框架，把两类机制各自特有的攻击面归入同一套 taxonomy；以钓鱼内容生成为目标条件，评估代表性 token-level 与 weight-level trigger-tag。
Result: 在钓鱼内容生成案例下，UNTAG 的攻击使现有 token-level 与 weight-level trigger-tag 机制完全失效；作者同时指出 trigger-tag 在受控环境中仍可提供有用证据。
Conclusion: 当攻击者能变换输出或修改开放权重时，trigger-tag 不应被视为稳健的滥用检测器。

papers.title: Foresight: planning future perception in streaming VLMs without retraining
papers.abstract_en: Existing streaming vision-language models (VLMs) continuously perceive and reason over visual streams, but their computational pathways remain fixed throughout inference. Consequently, they cannot adapt computation to evolving scene dynamics, where different future events demand different levels and forms of perception. We show that streaming VLMs inherently possess the ability to anticipate the immediate future, and leverage this capability to dynamically configure future computation in a training-free manner. Realizing such anticipatory computation, however, is very challenging: future anticipation must be sufficiently reliable to guide computation, planning must run concurrently with streaming inference, and online reconfiguration must incur negligible overhead. To address these challenges, we introduce FORESIGHT, a dual-stream architecture comprising two Siamese LLMs with shared weights, input encoders, and KV cache. The first LLM continuously processes incoming tokens, while the second runs ahead of the stream to anticipate future context, plan future computation, and generate task responses without interrupting streaming inference. Each plan decides when to reason next, what to check then, and how densely to sample, keeping transient evidence separate from persistent control. The resulting computation plan is executed online through an efficient reconfiguration protocol with schemaguided decoding and lightweight diff-based updates, enabling dynamic adaptation with low overhead. With a frozen Qwen3-VL-8B backbone, FORESIGHT achieves 23.0 mean joint F1 on OmniPro Online evaluation beating strongest trained baseline by 9.5%, while improving the backbone by 6.7 on StreamingBench and 15.4 on OVO-Bench, with the largest gain of 18.7 when evidence arrives later in the video stream. Our source code will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FORESIGHT 用共享权重、输入编码器与 KV cache 的双流 Siamese LLM 架构，在不重训的前提下让第二个 LLM 跑在流前端，预判未来上下文并生成计算计划（何时再推理、检查什么、采样多密），再通过 schema-guided decoding 与 diff 更新在线重配计算。冻结 Qwen3-VL-8B 时在 OmniPro Online 上 mean joint F1 达 23.0，比最强训练基线高 9.5%。
Motivation: 流式 VLM 的计算路径在推理全程固定，无法随场景动态调整感知与推理的强度和形式，而不同未来事件对感知的需求不同。
Method: FORESIGHT 双流架构：两个 Siamese LLM 共享权重、输入编码器与 KV cache，一个持续处理流入 token，另一个超前运行以预判未来上下文、规划计算并生成任务响应；计划以 schema-guided decoding 和轻量 diff 更新在线执行，全程 training-free，骨干为冻结的 Qwen3-VL-8B。
Result: OmniPro Online 上 mean joint F1 23.0，比最强训练基线高 9.5%；相对骨干在 StreamingBench 提升 6.7、OVO-Bench 提升 15.4，证据在视频流中较晚到达时最大提升 18.7。
Conclusion: 流式 VLM 自带的近期预判能力足以在不重训的情况下驱动在线计算重配，且开销可控；证据后到的场景收益最大。

papers.title: In-Distribution Forcing for Long Video Generation at Test Time
papers.abstract_en: Modern autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models excel at short-horizon video generation, yet generating long videos remains challenging due to drifting, where colors and textures shift, and motion dynamics decay. Existing works primarily rely on KV conditioning, which selects or modifies cached key-value (KV) entries to mitigate drifting. However, we observe that KV conditioning alone is insufficient as it assumes cached KV entries remain in-distribution. This assumption fails beyond the training horizon: nothing constrains the construction of KV entries during rollout, giving rise to the KV-provenance problem where cached entries themselves become out-of-distribution (OOD). To address this, we propose In-Distribution Forcing (ID-Forcing), a test-time framework that aligns both KV caching and KV conditioning with training configurations. Its key mechanism, self-caching, prevents OOD KV entries at their source. Each chunk is cached without attending to prior KV entry, keeping the rolling window exactly in-distribution. Consequently, ID-Forcing seamlessly extends short-horizon models to minute-scale video generation. Extensive evaluations show that our method remains competitive on standard video generation benchmark while substantially outperforming prior work in mitigating drifting, as validated by both our drift metrics and a user study.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 长视频生成中漂移 (drifting) 的根源是缓存的 KV 条目本身越出训练分布（KV-provenance 问题），而非仅条件化方式不当。ID-Forcing 在测试时用 self-caching 让每个 chunk 不注意先前 KV 就完成缓存，使滚动窗口严格保持训练时的分布形态，从而把短时域 AR 视频扩散模型直接延伸到分钟级生成。
Motivation: 自回归视频扩散在短时域表现好，但 rollout 超过训练时域后颜色纹理漂移、运动动力学衰减；现有 KV conditioning 假设缓存 KV 仍在分布内，该假设在长 rollout 下失效。
Method: 提出测试时框架 In-Distribution Forcing (ID-Forcing)，核心机制 self-caching：缓存每个 chunk 时不 attend 先前 KV 条目，使 KV 缓存与条件化都对齐训练配置，保持 rolling window in-distribution。
Result: 在标准视频生成 benchmark 上保持竞争力，并在缓解漂移上大幅超过先前工作；证据来自作者自定义的 drift metrics 与 user study。
Conclusion: 漂移应从 KV 条目的分布来源上解决：让缓存过程本身符合训练分布，即可把短时域模型无改动地扩展到分钟级视频。

papers.title: How to Find and Reuse Policies for Continuous Adaptation in Lifelong Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: In lifelong reinforcement learning, retaining previously learned policies is not sufficient for effective transfer to a new task. Useful knowledge may be distributed across several prior policies, and its relevance may change as the learner acquires experience. One hypothesis is that task similarity can be effectively used in a continual learning setting to find and combine previously learned policies. To test it, Adaptive Mask Selection and Composition (AMSC) is designed to estimate similarity from online experience via non-parametric Wasserstein task embeddings from state-action-reward samples. The z-score-normalized sparsemax of the similarity scores are used to derive a variable-size support to periodically choose and weight policies to form a prior when learning a new task. On CT-graph and MiniGrid, AMSC achieves higher mean performance and forward transfer than the evaluated modular composition baselines while exhibiting no forgetting. Results on Continual World suggest that identifying relevant prior knowledge and determining its layer-specific composition may require additional layer-specific tuning. Ablations show that selecting relevant sources and determining how strongly to reuse them are central to these gains. Independently measured pairwise transfer is also positively associated with task-embedding similarity. These results indicate that task similarity can be an effective criterion to select and weight specific knowledge for reuse in lifelong reinforcement learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AMSC 用在线状态-动作-奖励样本构造非参数 Wasserstein 任务嵌入估计任务相似度，经 z-score 归一化的 sparsemax 得到变长支撑，周期性挑选并加权旧策略作为新任务的先验。在 CT-graph 与 MiniGrid 上其平均性能和 forward transfer 高于所评估的模块化组合基线且无遗忘；Continual World 上则提示层特定组合还需额外调参。
Motivation: 终身强化学习中仅保留旧策略不足以实现有效迁移，有用知识可能分散在多个先前策略里，且其相关性会随经验变化，需要一个可在线判定“该复用哪些、复用多强”的准则。
Method: AMSC 从 state-action-reward 样本估计非参数 Wasserstein 任务嵌入，对相似度分数做 z-score 归一化后取 sparsemax，得到变长支撑以周期性选择并加权策略、构成新任务的 prior；并用消融拆开“选来源”与“定权重”两步，另测 pairwise transfer 与嵌入相似度的关联。
Result: 在 CT-graph 和 MiniGrid 上，AMSC 的平均性能与 forward transfer 高于所评估的模块化组合基线，且不表现出遗忘；Continual World 结果显示识别相关先验知识及其层特定组合可能需要额外的 layer-specific tuning；消融表明选择相关来源与决定复用强度是这些增益的核心；独立测得的 pairwise transfer 与任务嵌入相似度正相关。
Conclusion: 任务相似度可以作为终身强化学习中挑选并加权特定知识以供复用的有效准则，但跨数据集的层特定组合仍需额外调参。

papers.title: Exploring the Trade-Off Between Structured Pruning and Fault Tolerance in Deep Neural Networks for Space Applications
papers.abstract_en: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) inherently exhibit a degree of robustness to bit-level faults due to their distributed representation of information. As a model increases in width, this information becomes more dispersed, theoretically reducing the impact of any single bit fault. In this paper, we empirically investigate the relationship between model width and robustness to Single Event Upsets (SEUs). We conduct a comprehensive experiment in which baseline models undergo iterative structured pruning to reduce their width while preserving task performance as much as possible. At each pruning stage, we run a targeted fault-injection campaign to evaluate the model's performance under simulated bit-flip scenarios. Our results show that, although structured pruning increases per-inference sensitivity to faults by reducing redundancy, this effect is effectively counterbalanced by shorter execution time, which lowers the probability of encountering an SEU. These findings suggest that structured pruning can yield significant energy and latency savings without compromising overall reliability, providing useful guidance for designing robust AI systems for space applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在航天 DNN 上做迭代式结构化剪枝 (structured pruning) 缩窄模型宽度，同时逐阶段注入单粒子翻转 (SEU) 位翻转故障：剪枝使每次推理对故障更敏感，但更短的执行时间降低了遭遇 SEU 的概率，两者相互抵消，因此剪枝可在不牺牲整体可靠性的前提下带来显著能耗与延迟收益。
Motivation: 航天场景中 DNN 需在抗位故障能力与模型宽度带来的能耗、延迟之间取舍，而宽度与 SEU 鲁棒性的关系缺少经验证据。
Method: 对基线模型做迭代式结构化剪枝以缩窄宽度并尽量保持任务性能；在每个剪枝阶段运行针对性故障注入 (fault-injection) 活动，评估模拟位翻转下的模型性能。
Result: 结构化剪枝因冗余减少而提高单次推理对故障的敏感度，但更短的执行时间降低了遭遇 SEU 的概率，该效应被有效抵消。
Conclusion: 结构化剪枝可同时带来显著能耗与延迟节省而不牺牲整体可靠性，为航天鲁棒 AI 系统设计提供依据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: S2S-JEPA: Predicting the Predictable at Subseasonal-to-Seasonal Timescales
papers.abstract_en: The subseasonal-to-seasonal (S2S) timescale, roughly from two weeks to two months ahead, is a critical forecast window for sectors such as agriculture, energy, and water management. Yet, it is widely known as the `predictability desert'. Recent AI weather models excel up to two weeks ahead but deteriorate beyond, largely because they are trained to predict fine-scale details that are neither predictable nor essential at S2S timescales. We argue that a more physically grounded objective is to forecast only the slowly varying components that remain predictable. Computer vision reached the same conclusion with the Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA), which predicts in latent space, discarding unpredictable details. In this work, we introduce S2S-JEPA, which brings the JEPA paradigm to S2S forecasting. It is tailored to this task through design elements from state-of-the-art AI weather models. S2S-JEPA achieves comparable skill to the gold-standard ECMWF physics-based ensemble and surpasses it on multiple metrics at weeks 5 to 6.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: S2S-JEPA 把视觉里的 Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) 搬到次季节到季节 (S2S, 约 2 周至 2 个月) 预报：只在 latent space 预测慢变、可预报的分量，丢弃既不可预报也非必需的细尺度细节。该模型在 5–6 周时效上多项指标超过 ECMWF 物理集合这一 gold standard，整体达到与其相当的技巧水平。
Motivation: S2S 时段被称为“可预报性沙漠”：现有 AI 天气模型两周内表现好、之后迅速退化，原因是训练目标要求预测细尺度细节，而这些细节在 S2S 尺度上既不可预报也非必需。
Method: 引入 S2S-JEPA，把 JEPA 的 latent-space 预测范式用于 S2S 预报，并结合当前最先进 AI 天气模型的设计元素做针对性改造；训练目标只预测慢变、仍具可预报性的分量，不重建不可预报的细节。
Result: S2S-JEPA 达到与 gold-standard ECMWF 物理集合相当的技巧，并在第 5 至 6 周 (weeks 5 to 6) 的多项指标上超过该集合预报。
Conclusion: 在 S2S 尺度上，只预测 latent 空间中慢变可预报分量是比逐点重建细尺度更合理的训练目标，足以匹配乃至在 5–6 周超过物理集合预报。

summary_sections.conclusion: 在 S2S 尺度上，只预测 latent 空间中慢变可预报分量是比逐点重建细尺度更合理的训练目标，足以匹配乃至在 5–6 周超过物理集合预报。

papers.title: A Benchmark for Spatially Grounded Gesture Generation
papers.abstract_en: Communication in shared space interweaves verbal and non-verbal signals, and pointing gestures anchor language to the environment: "put the cup on that one" is uninterpretable without the gesture that fixes the referent. Yet no common framework exists for evaluating whether generated gestures indicate their intended referent; distributional metrics reward a gesture aimed at the wrong object as long as it looks natural. We introduce a benchmark for spatially grounded gesture generation, comprising ~2K pointing-annotated clips from naturalistic VR dialogue with ground-truth 3D referents, a task in which systems must decide when, how and where to point within conversational speech, and a protocol that separates temporal alignment, spatial grounding and perceived naturalness. We also provide a flow-matching baseline, MM-Conv-Flow. Evaluating it alongside an independent retrieval-based system and captured human motion, we find that geometric grounding can exceed that of human pointing without any gain in perceived naturalness, showing that referential gesture quality must be measured along separate dimensions.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 9 figures. Benchmark of the Referential Gesture Challenge at the HSI Workshop, ECCV 2026. Data and video: https://huggingface.co/datasets/hsi-workshop/referential-gesture-challenge
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出空间落地指称手势生成 (spatially grounded gesture generation) 基准：约 2K 段带指向标注的自然 VR 对话片段，附真值 3D 指称对象，并把时间对齐、空间落地、感知自然度拆成三个独立维度评测。配 flow-matching 基线 MM-Conv-Flow，与检索式系统和真人动作同台评测发现：几何落地可超过真人指向而感知自然度毫无提升。
Motivation: 现有分布性指标只看手势像不像，指向错误对象也能得高分，缺少判断生成手势是否真指向目标指称物的公共评测框架。
Method: 基准含 ~2K 段指向标注的自然 VR 对话片段与真值 3D 指称物，任务要求系统在对话语流中决定何时、如何、向何处指；评测协议把 temporal alignment、spatial grounding、perceived naturalness 分开打分。另提供 flow-matching 基线 MM-Conv-Flow，与独立检索式系统及真人捕获动作对照。
Result: 在该基准上，MM-Conv-Flow 的几何落地 (geometric grounding) 可超过真人指向，而感知自然度没有任何提升；评测同时覆盖一个检索式系统与真人捕获动作。
Conclusion: 指称手势质量必须沿空间落地与感知自然度等独立维度分别测量，单一自然度或分布性指标会奖励指向错误对象的手势。

papers.title: Ask, Relax, or Act? Evaluating Actionable Indeterminacy in LLM Preference Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: An LLM agent can recognize uncertainty yet still choose the wrong next step: asking when action is already justified, or seeking clarification when the constraints must change. We formalize actionable indeterminacy: act when an accepted action is shared across all admissible preferences or objectives, clarify when each possibility is feasible but no action is shared, and propose a minimum-cost permitted constraint repair when the request is infeasible. We construct a solver-grounded benchmark spanning object allocation, meeting scheduling, apartment choice, and stable matching. Matched pairs retain the same source while changing whether intervention is necessary, and evaluation separates decision correctness, matched-pair reliability, and fully correct responses. Our findings reveal a recurring difficulty in recognizing when intervention is unnecessary: models can identify situations requiring clarification or repair yet still intervene when a justified action already exists. Correct decision labels also fail to guarantee usable actions, questions, or repairs. Crucially, response requirements shape not only how decisions are expressed but also which decisions are made. Making the required content explicit substantially improves fully correct responses and can change intervention decisions, even when outputs are already parseable. These findings highlight that reliable agency requires more than recognizing uncertainty: it requires intervening only when necessary and translating the chosen next step into a verifiable response.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM 的偏好不确定性形式化为 actionable indeterminacy：有共同可行动解就直接行动，各方案各自可行但无共同解才澄清，请求不可行则给出最小代价的约束修复。用求解器支撑的四类任务基准（物体分配、会议排程、公寓选择、稳定匹配）发现，模型能识别需要澄清或修复的情形，却在已有正当行动时仍去干预；把响应内容要求写明可显著提高完全正确率并可能改变干预决策。
Motivation: LLM agent 能察觉不确定性却选错下一步：该行动时去提问，或在必须改动约束时只求澄清；现有评测没有把“是否需要干预”与“干预产出是否可用”分开。
Method: 提出 actionable indeterminacy 形式化（共同可行动解→act，各自可行无共同解→clarify，不可行→最小代价 permitted constraint repair），并构造 solver-grounded 基准，覆盖物体分配、会议排程、公寓选择、稳定匹配四类任务；用 matched pairs 保持同一来源只改变是否需要干预，评测分三层：决策正确性、matched-pair 可靠性、完全正确响应。
Result: 核心发现是模型反复难以识别“干预不必要”：能识别需要澄清或修复的情形，却在已有正当行动时仍干预；正确的决策标签也不保证产出可用的行动、问题或修复。把所需响应内容写明会显著提高完全正确响应比例，并且会改变干预决策的做出，即使输出本身已可解析。
Conclusion: 可靠 agency 不止于识别不确定性，还要只在必要时干预，并把选定的下一步翻译成可验证的响应；显式声明响应要求是提升完全正确率的直接手段。

papers.title: Invariance of Clustering Operations in Causal Effect Identification
papers.abstract_en: Clustering variables in causal graphs reduces the size of the graph and simplifies causal inference. However, arbitrary clustering can alter crucial causal relations among variables and lead to erroneous conclusions. While the identifiability of a causal effect in the clustered graph implies the identifiability in the original graph under mild conditions, nonidentifiability in clustered graph does not imply nonidentifiability in the original graph without further assumptions. When both identifiability and nonidentifiability are preserved, the clustering operation is called identification invariant. We present a broad class of clustering operations that are identification invariant based on conditions related to the c-components of the original graph. Finally, we demonstrate use of the results in practical settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在因果图上对变量做聚类会缩小图规模，但任意聚类可能改变变量间的关键因果关系并导致错误结论。论文给出基于原图 c-component 条件的一整类聚类操作，使因果效应的可识别性与不可识别性在聚类前后都被保持，即 identification invariant。
Motivation: 聚类变量能简化因果推断，但聚类图上的不可识别并不自动意味着原图不可识别，任意聚类可能把可识别的因果效应误判为不可识别或反之。
Method: 以原图 c-component（闭合子图）相关条件刻画一整类 identification invariant 的聚类操作，并说明在温和条件下聚类图可识别蕴含原图可识别，最后在实际场景中演示这些结果的用法。
Result: 给出一整类基于 c-component 条件的 identification invariant 聚类操作；证明聚类图可识别在温和条件下蕴含原图可识别，而聚类图不可识别需附加条件才反映原图；并在实际设置中演示结果应用。
Conclusion: 只要聚类操作满足基于 c-component 的条件，聚类前后的可识别性与不可识别性都得以保持，因而可在不改变因果效应识别结论的前提下缩小因果图。

papers.title: Beyond Single Videos: Benchmarking and Active Evidence Seeking for E-Commerce Cross-Video Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: E-commerce videos are information-dense and frequently compared by consumers evaluating products and merchants assessing marketing strategies. However, existing multimodal models mainly focus on single-video understanding and have limited ability to compare information across videos. We introduce AdsCVR, the first e-commerce cross-video reasoning benchmark, containing 2,483 videos and 6,110 question-answer pairs across six reasoning dimensions. Cross- video reasoning requires models to locate fine-grained evidence among many redundant frames and integrate visual details, speech, and on-screen text. We therefore propose AdSeek, an agentic framework that dynamically selects visual and audio tools during multi-turn exploration, replacing static uniform sampling with active evidence acquisition. To address the sparse credit assignment of reinforcement learning, we develop an offline trajectory rectification mechanism that identifies reasoning errors and missing multimodal evidence in RL-generated trajectories. The corrected trajectories provide supervised fine-tuning signals that reduce biases learned during RL. This mechanism supports a rectified bootstrapping pipeline in which initial RL exposes reasoning bottlenecks, supervised fine-tuning corrects them, and a final RL stage further improves the policy. AdSeek achieves 74.30 percent accuracy on the AdsCVR test split, outperforming its Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct backbone by 27.90 percentage points. It also generalizes to the open- domain CrossVid benchmark, demonstrating effective active evidence gathering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出电商跨视频推理基准 AdsCVR（2,483 条视频、6,110 个问答、六个推理维度）与主动取证框架 AdSeek：多轮探索中动态选择视觉与音频工具替代静态均匀采样，并用离线轨迹修正缓解 RL 稀疏信用分配。AdSeek 在 AdsCVR 测试集达 74.30% 准确率，比 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 骨干高 27.90 个百分点，并可迁移到开放域 CrossVid。
Motivation: 现有 multimodal 模型主要做单视频理解，跨视频比较能力有限；而跨视频推理要求在大量冗余帧中定位细粒度证据并整合视觉、语音与屏幕文字。
Method: AdSeek 是 agentic 框架，在多轮探索中动态选择视觉与音频工具做主动证据获取；配合离线轨迹修正机制，识别 RL 轨迹中的推理错误与缺失多模态证据，将修正轨迹作为 SFT 信号，构成 RL 暴露瓶颈、SFT 纠错、再 RL 提升策略的 rectified bootstrapping 流程。
Result: AdsCVR 测试集准确率 74.30%，较骨干 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 高 27.90 个百分点；基准含 2,483 条视频、6,110 个问答对、六个推理维度；在开放域 CrossVid 上同样展现有效的主动证据收集能力。
Conclusion: 跨视频电商推理需要主动、按需的证据获取而非静态采样，RL 与 SFT 交替的轨迹修正可缓解稀疏信用分配带来的偏差并提升策略。

papers.title: Predictor-Guided Latent Space Codon Optimization for Maximizing Protein Expression
papers.abstract_en: Codon optimization, the process of selecting synonymous codons to improve mRNA translation efficiency and protein expression, is central to therapeutic protein production and mRNA vaccines, yet it remains a hard problem. The design space is discrete and combinatorially large, precluding gradient-based methods, and existing tools rely on heuristic proxies (e.g., Codon Adaptation Index or GC-content) that poorly capture true expression. We introduce Latent-Space Codon Optimization (LSCO), which recasts this discrete problem as a continuous one by mapping sequences into the latent space of a pretrained mRNA language model, enabling efficient gradient-based search. LSCO combines four components: a data-driven expression objective from an uncertainty-aware predictor, a Minimum-Free-Energy regularizer for structural stability, a naturalness prior from a protein-to-codon back-translation model, and constrained decoding for protein fidelity. On a real-world, wet-lab antibody expression dataset, LSCO outperforms simple frequency-based, as well as modern deep generative baselines in predicted expression, while retaining suitable biophysical properties.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LSCO 把离散组合爆炸的密码子优化问题映射到预训练 mRNA 语言模型的隐空间，转为可梯度搜索的连续问题，用不确定性感知的表达量预测器、MFE 结构正则、天然性先验与约束解码四个组件联合优化。在真实湿实验抗体表达数据集上，其预测表达量优于基于频率的简单基线和现代深度生成基线，同时保留合适的生物物理性质。
Motivation: 密码子优化的搜索空间离散且组合巨大，梯度方法无法直接使用；现有工具依赖 Codon Adaptation Index、GC-content 等启发式代理，与真实表达量吻合差。
Method: LSCO 四组件：不确定性感知预测器给出的数据驱动表达量目标、Minimum-Free-Energy 正则保证结构稳定性、蛋白到密码子反向翻译模型提供的天然性先验 (naturalness prior)、以及保证蛋白序列保真的约束解码；序列先由预训练 mRNA 语言模型编码进隐空间再做梯度搜索。
Result: 在真实湿实验抗体表达数据集上，LSCO 的预测表达量高于基于频率的简单基线与现代深度生成基线，同时保留合适的生物物理性质。
Conclusion: 把密码子设计搬到语言模型隐空间后，可直接对预测表达量做梯度优化，而不必依赖 CAI、GC-content 这类启发式代理。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在真实湿实验抗体表达数据集上，LSCO 的预测表达量高于基于频率的简单基线与现代深度生成基线，同时保留合适的生物物理性质。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把密码子设计搬到语言模型隐空间后，可直接对预测表达量做梯度优化，而不必依赖 CAI、GC-content 这类启发式代理。

papers.title: Peer Influence across Heterogeneous AI Models
papers.abstract_en: When two AI agents disagree, who persuades whom? As multi-agent systems increasingly combine language models of different families and sizes, the answer can determine which judgments survive interaction. Measuring persuasion as the probabilistic shift in an agent's decision after a single exchange with a dissenting peer, we test seven open-weight models across three language understanding tasks. We find that persuasion is strong: when models disagree, receivers often abandon their initial judgment after seeing a peer's answer and explanation. Surprisingly, however, neither standalone certainty nor model scale reliably predicts persuasion dynamics. Models producing almost perfectly consistent decisions in isolation can be among the most susceptible to persuasion, and small models can match larger ones as persuaders and resist their influence just as effectively. Furthermore, we show that the size of the shift depends more on the susceptibility of the listener than on the persuasiveness of the speaker. Persuasion patterns are therefore specific to each model pairing, with heterogeneity amplifying persuasion in some combinations and suppressing it in others, allowing a dissenting agent running a small model to overturn the judgments of a much larger one. These findings show that the behavior of interacting models cannot be inferred from their individual properties but must be evaluated in the combinations in which they will operate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把说服定义为单次分歧交换后决策概率的偏移，在 7 个开源模型、3 个语言理解任务上测量，发现说服普遍很强：接收方常在看到同伴答案与解释后放弃初始判断。独立一致性与模型规模都不能预测说服动力学，偏移幅度更多取决于听者的易感性而非说话者的说服力，因此小模型也能推翻大模型的判断。
Motivation: 多智能体系统开始混合不同家族与规模的语言模型，但谁说服谁、哪些判断会在交互中存活，无法从单模型的独立属性推断。
Method: 以单次与持异议同伴交换后决策的概率偏移度量说服，在 7 个 open-weight 模型、3 个语言理解任务上两两配对测试，比较独立确定性、模型规模与配对异质性对偏移的解释力。
Result: 说服效应强，接收方在看到同伴答案与解释后常放弃初始判断；独立确定性与模型规模均不能可靠预测说服动力学，独立决策近乎完全一致的模型可能最易被说服，小模型在说服与抵抗两方面都能匹敌大模型；偏移幅度更依赖听者的易感性而非说话者的说服力，异质性在某些配对中放大、另一些中抑制说服，使运行小模型的异议智能体能推翻远大于它的模型的判断。
Conclusion: 交互中模型的行为不能由其单独属性推断，必须在实际运行的配对组合中评估；说服是配对特异的，由听者易感性主导。

papers.title: LS-AR: Future-Predictive Latent Steering in Autoregressive LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Standard autoregressive (AR) models process high-level task instructions, state history, and transient tokens within a single shared sequence of tokens. Consequently, they lack the architectural mechanisms needed to isolate macro-objectives from context noise. To overcome this single-channel limitation, we introduce Latent-Steered Autoregressive (LS-AR), a dual-channel architecture that decouples continuous goal steering from discrete token decoding via FiLM conditioning. We evaluate a Static Goal Encoder (P_0) for persistent macro-objective retention across long rollouts and a Dynamic State Tracker (P_t) for recurrent latent updates during generation. On long-horizon retrieval past context limits (H=1024, W=500), LS-AR (Static) achieves 100% target recall where parameter-matched baselines collapse (0%), while increasing throughput by ~35% and cutting peak VRAM by 52.8%. In Blocksworld planning under forced perturbations (k=1), LS-AR (Dynamic) sustains an 89.0% completion rate vs. 71.0% for the baseline, though zero-shot entity scaling (N -> N+1) exposes single-vector capacity limits (0%). Finally, dual-channel authority analysis shows that text goal dropout establishes latent-dominant control, offering structural defence against text prompt injection while introducing a latent vector attack surface.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Long-Context Foundation Models
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LS-AR 用双通道架构把连续目标引导与离散 token 解码解耦：Static Goal Encoder (P_0) 跨长 rollout 保留宏观目标，Dynamic State Tracker (P_t) 在生成中递归更新隐状态，经 FiLM conditioning 注入。在超出上下文窗口的长程检索 (H=1024, W=500) 上目标召回 100%（参数匹配基线 0%），吞吐提升约 35%、峰值 VRAM 降 52.8%；Blocksworld 强制扰动 (k=1) 完成率 89.0% 对基线 71.0%。
Motivation: 标准自回归模型把高层任务指令、状态历史和瞬时 token 塞进同一条共享序列，缺少把宏观目标与上下文噪声分离的架构机制，长程检索与扰动下目标易丢失。
Method: 提出双通道架构 LS-AR：Static Goal Encoder (P_0) 持久保留宏观目标，Dynamic State Tracker (P_t) 在生成过程中递归更新隐状态，两者通过 FiLM conditioning 与 token 解码通道耦合；另做双通道权威分析，用文本目标 dropout 建立 latent 主导控制。
Result: 长程检索（H=1024, W=500，超出上下文限制）上 LS-AR (Static) 目标召回 100%，参数匹配基线 0%，吞吐提升约 35%，峰值 VRAM 下降 52.8%；Blocksworld 强制扰动 (k=1) 下 LS-AR (Dynamic) 完成率 89.0% 对基线 71.0%；零样本实体扩展 (N → N+1) 暴露单向量容量上限，召回 0%。
Conclusion: 双通道解耦能在长程生成中保住宏观目标并抗扰动，但单向量表示在实体扩展时容量见顶；文本目标 dropout 建立 latent 主导控制，构成对文本 prompt injection 的结构性防御，同时引入隐向量攻击面。

papers.title: ULTRADISCOVERY: Abductive Exploration in an Interconnected, Epistemically Open Universe
papers.abstract_en: Scientific discovery often begins when scattered clues call for a new way of describing the world. Such abductive exploration can require constructing the representation in which an explanation is stated, when the world is epistemically open, and composing evidence scattered across contexts, when it is structurally interconnected. Existing benchmarks rarely separate these two demands or control them independently. We introduce ULTRADISCOVERY, an interactive world of five domains in which an agent revises an initially successful theory and predicts the outcome of an unseen cross-domain intervention. A $2 \times 2$ design leaves the representation open or discloses it, and leaves the evidence distributed or aligns it, with the latent dynamics fixed. With the representation open, agents across eleven models often retract the axiom they were taught, and none introduces the unobserved entity or rewrites the variables that a replacement requires. Disclosure triples intervention requests and adds about one of the eighteen findings the world affords, and alignment adds less. Two vendor-harness systems carry discovery into more domains, and one of them rewrites the variables in Open episodes. No system makes the exact prediction within 200 paid actions. At larger budgets one exact prediction appears with both aids, while every Open episode remains inexact. The results locate the difficulty in the step from accumulating evidence to composing it into a representation that transfers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ULTRADISCOVERY 构建一个五领域交互式科学发现世界，用 2×2 设计独立控制表征是否开放与证据是否对齐，检验智能体能否在认识论开放的环境中重写理论表征并预测未见的跨领域干预结果。十一个模型在表征开放时常常撤回被教的公理，却无一引入替代理论所需的未观测实体或重写变量；披露表征使干预请求增至三倍并多带来约十八个可发现结论中的一个，对齐证据的增益更小。
Motivation: 现有科学发现基准无法把「构造解释所在的表征」与「跨情境组合分散证据」这两种需求分开，也无法独立控制它们，因而难以定位智能体失败发生在哪一步。
Method: 提出交互式世界 ULTRADISCOVERY，含五个领域：智能体需修正一个起初成功的理论，并预测一次未见的跨领域干预结果；采用 2×2 设计，分别开放或披露表征、分散或对齐证据，同时固定潜在动力学；评测十一个模型与两个 vendor-harness 系统，并设置付费动作预算。
Result: 表征开放时，十一个模型常撤回被教的公理，但没有任何模型引入未观测实体或重写变量；披露表征使干预请求数增至三倍，并带来约十八个可发现结论中的一个，证据对齐的增益更小；两个 vendor-harness 系统把发现扩展到更多领域，其中一个在 Open 场景重写变量；在 200 次付费动作内无系统做出精确预测，更大预算下同时具备两项辅助才出现一例精确预测，而所有 Open 场景仍不精确。
Conclusion: 科学发现的难点在于从积累证据跨到把证据组合成可迁移的表征这一步，而非证据收集本身；表征开放是当前系统的瓶颈。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Securing Computer-Use Agents Against Branch Steering Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Modern Computer Use Agents (CUAs) directly interact with graphical user interfaces and execute third-party web tools, exposing them to indirect prompt injection across every rendered page and tool response. While the Dual-LLM pattern is the primary system-level architecture offering formal security guarantees - using an isolated Planner LLM (P-LLM) to fix execution paths before processing untrusted inputs via a Quarantined LLM (Q-LLM) - these guarantees break down in graphical environments. Because CUA interaction is inherently dynamic, plans cannot remain data-independent; they must branch based on anticipated runtime web content - covering all possible cases the agent may encounter. This exposes agents to branch steering attacks, where an adversary crafts untrusted data to coerce a CUA down a hazardous, pre-approved branch without injecting explicit instructions. We systematically study branch steering attacks and introduce STEER-Bench (101 tasks across 9 domains), showing high attack success against both standard (94.4%) and vanilla Dual-LLM (89.5%) CUAs. We then propose COBRA, an architecture that pairs trusted branching plans with ahead-of-time capability constraints, strictly bounding the parameters and destinations each branch may execute. On STEER-Bench, COBRA reduces attack success to 0% while retaining 97% benign utility.
papers.comment: 16 pages, including 2 figures. To be presented at the "Agents in the Wild" Workshop at the NeurIPS 2026 Conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 图形界面 Computer-Use Agent 必须按运行时网页内容分支，使 Dual-LLM 的数据无关安全保证失效，攻击者可用无显式指令的 branch steering 把 agent 逼进预先批准的危险分支。STEER-Bench（9 个领域 101 项任务）上该攻击对标准 CUA 成功率 94.4%、对原版 Dual-LLM 89.5%；COBRA 用可信分支计划加提前能力约束把成功率压到 0%，同时保住 97% 良性效用。
Motivation: Dual-LLM 靠 Planner 先固定执行路径来给出形式化安全保证，但 CUA 交互是动态的，计划必须按预期运行时网页内容分支，保证随之失效，agent 可被无显式指令的注入逼入危险分支。
Method: 提出 COBRA：把可信的分支计划与 ahead-of-time capability constraints 配对，严格限定每个分支可执行的参数与目标地址；并构建 STEER-Bench，含 9 个领域 101 项任务，用于系统研究 branch steering attacks。
Result: STEER-Bench 上 branch steering 对标准 CUA 攻击成功率 94.4%，对原版 Dual-LLM CUA 89.5%；COBRA 将攻击成功率降至 0%，良性效用保留 97%。
Conclusion: 在图形环境中，安全保证必须约束每个分支的参数与目标，而不只是隔离不可信输入；COBRA 在保住 97% 良性效用的同时把 branch steering 成功率压到 0%。

papers.title: Zephon: Elastic Determinism for Online, Stateful Foundation Model Data Loading Pipelines
papers.abstract_en: Deterministic data loading is important for foundation model development: model researchers need confidence that differences they observe across costly ablations are caused by the parameter they changed rather than non-determinism in the training data sequence. The data loader must provide elastic determinism, i.e., a deterministic sequence of global training data batches despite changes to the GPU topology across runs (e.g., due to GPU scarcity), frequent checkpoint-resume cycles, and different data processing execution backends. Achieving this is difficult because modern foundation model data pipelines tokenize, pack, and mix samples online, introducing stateful n-to-m transformations that break sample indexing. Existing data loaders largely assume indexable 1-to-1 pipelines, and the common workaround of offline materialization is expensive and, for some modalities such as video, infeasible. We present Zephon, a data loader for foundation models that supports online, stateful pipelines while providing elastic determinism and efficient resumption from checkpoints. It partitions the global stream into topology-independent lanes, serializes ordering decisions while parallelizing stateless work on interchangeable backends, and checkpoints only bounded in-flight state so recovery cost does not grow with training progress. We evaluate Zephon on text and vision-language workloads and show that it achieves competitive throughput while providing a combination of guarantees that no existing loader offers for online, stateful pipelines.
papers.comment: preprint; currently under revision at VLDB'27
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Zephon 为在线、有状态的基础模型数据加载提供弹性确定性 (elastic determinism)：把全局数据流切成与 GPU 拓扑无关的 lane，串行化顺序决策、并行执行可互换后端上的无状态工作，并只 checkpoint 有界的在途状态，使恢复开销不随训练进度增长。在文本与视觉-语言负载上评测，吞吐量具有竞争力，同时提供现有数据加载器对在线有状态流水线无法兼得的一组保证。
Motivation: 消融实验的差异必须只来自被改动的参数，而非训练数据序列的非确定性；但 GPU 拓扑变化、频繁 checkpoint-resume 与不同执行后端都会破坏确定性，而现有加载器假设可索引的 1-to-1 流水线，离线物化代价高且对 video 等模态不可行。
Method: Zephon 支持在线有状态流水线：将全局流分区为拓扑无关的 lanes，把顺序决策串行化、无状态工作在可互换后端上并行，checkpoint 仅保存有界的在途状态，从而实现弹性确定性与高效恢复。
Result: 在 text 与 vision-language 负载上评测，Zephon 吞吐量具有竞争力，并提供现有数据加载器对在线有状态流水线所不具备的保证组合。
Conclusion: 在线有状态的数据流水线可以同时做到拓扑无关的确定性序列、有界 checkpoint 与可用吞吐，无需离线物化。

papers.title: Light Entropic Optimal Transport on Riemannian Manifolds
papers.abstract_en: Entropic Optimal Transport (EOT) has become a practical framework for learning stochastic couplings between complex distributions, with applications in generative modeling and domain adaptation. However, most EOT solvers are designed for Euclidean spaces, while manifold extensions remain limited and often rely on costly iterative methods, simulated dynamics, or generic neural models that do not fully exploit the underlying geometry. We introduce ManifoldLightOT, a light approach for learning kernel-induced EOT couplings directly on common manifolds. Using the kernel form of the EOT solution, we construct geometry-specific Gibbs kernels together with compatible potential parameterizations for spheres, tori, $\mathrm{SO}(3)$, and $\mathrm{SE}(3)$. These choices yield closed-form normalization and directly sampleable conditional distributions. Our formulation naturally extends to products of manifolds, making it applicable to more complex geometries. The parameters of the potentials are optimized directly from samples using Monte Carlo estimates of the learning objective. Through synthetic and real-world experiments, we show that ManifoldLightOT often outperforms existing manifold OT methods while retaining direct sampling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ManifoldLightOT 在球面、环面、SO(3)、SE(3) 等常见流形上直接学习 kernel-induced Entropic Optimal Transport 耦合：用 EOT 解的 kernel 形式构造几何专用 Gibbs 核与匹配的势参数化，使归一化闭式、条件分布可直接采样。合成与真实数据实验中它常优于已有流形 OT 方法，同时保留直接采样能力。
Motivation: 现有 EOT 求解器多面向欧氏空间，流形扩展依赖昂贵迭代、模拟动力学或未充分利用几何的通用神经模型，难以在常见流形上高效得到可采样的随机耦合。
Method: 基于 EOT 解的 kernel 形式，为球面、环面、SO(3)、SE(3) 构造几何专用 Gibbs 核与兼容的势参数化，得到闭式归一化和可直接采样的条件分布；势参数用 Monte Carlo 估计学习目标直接从样本优化，框架可自然扩展到流形乘积。
Result: 在合成与真实数据实验中，ManifoldLightOT 常优于已有流形 OT 方法，并同时保留直接采样；可处理球面、环面、SO(3)、SE(3) 及其乘积上的 kernel-induced EOT 耦合学习。
Conclusion: 把几何先验写进 Gibbs 核与势参数化，可在常见流形上以轻量、可直接采样的方式求解 EOT，而不必依赖迭代求解器或通用神经网络。

papers.title: NegT2IBench: When Negation Changes the Picture. A Polarity Benchmark for Text-to-Image Models
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image (T2I) models are judged by benchmarks that measure whether requested content appears, but these benchmarks largely overlook the complementary ability to satisfy negated constraints, for example, generating "a non-red cup." Measuring negation raises challenges not faced by affirmation-based benchmarks and requires careful prompt and evaluation design. We introduce NegT2IBench, a benchmark of 4,800 prompts covering two attribute types and four relation categories. Prompts are organized by polarity: the number of positive statements that must hold and negated statements that must not, each ranging from 0 to 2. Varying the two independently separates the effect of negation from the effect of prompt complexity. Our detector-based scoring is reproducible, auditable, and pinpoints which requirement failed. On 600 images with three-annotator labels, it agrees with humans as closely as vision-language judges up to 30x larger, while using only a fraction of their GPU memory. Across eleven T2I models and 211,200 images, nine score lower on a single negated statement than on a single positive one. Per-statement scoring reveals that the loss is largest for color and near zero for proximity, and that 41.5% of failed statements render exactly what the prompt forbids. Rendering what a prompt asks for and withholding what it forbids are distinct capabilities that an aggregate compositional score cannot distinguish. NegT2IBench measures the latter directly, providing a controlled testbed for diagnosing negation failures and developing methods to overcome them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NegT2IBench 是一个测 T2I 模型否定约束能力的极性基准：4,800 条提示按必须成立的正向陈述数与必须不成立的否定陈述数（各 0–2）独立排列，从而把否定本身与提示复杂度分开。在 11 个 T2I 模型、211,200 张图上，9 个模型在单条否定陈述上的得分低于单条正向陈述，且 41.5% 的失败陈述恰好渲染出提示明令禁止的内容。
Motivation: 现有 T2I 基准只测请求内容是否出现，忽略满足否定约束（如 a non-red cup）这一互补能力；否定带来的评测难题与肯定式基准不同，需要专门的提示与评分设计。
Method: 构建 4,800 条提示的基准，覆盖两种属性类型与四类关系，按正向/否定陈述数（各 0–2）正交组织；采用基于检测器的评分，可复现、可审计并定位具体失败的陈述；在 600 张带三人标注的图像上与人类及视觉-语言 judge 对比。
Result: 检测器评分与人类的一致性可比至多大 30 倍的 vision-language judge，同时只占其一小部分 GPU 显存；在 11 个 T2I 模型、211,200 张图上，9 个模型的单条否定陈述得分低于单条正向陈述；逐陈述评分显示损失在 color 上最大、在 proximity 上接近零；41.5% 的失败陈述渲染出提示所禁止的内容。
Conclusion: 渲染提示要求的内容与扣留提示禁止的内容是两种可区分的能力，聚合式组合得分无法分开；NegT2IBench 直接测量后者，作为诊断否定失败与开发改进方法的受控测试床。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Smart Sensing for Safer Bridges: From Sensor Signals to AI-Driven Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Bridges contribute significantly to transportation connectivity and urban development. Therefore, reliable bridge monitoring is crucial for protecting public safety and detecting anomalous behavior in bridge sensor data that may provide early indications of abnormal structural conditions. This paper investigates anomaly detection in real-world bridge sensor data using two different complementary approaches, namely signal processing and the data-driven machine learning model Isolation Forest. The real-time bridge sensor data is collected from an iBridge sensor device installed on a bridge in Norway. The methods are evaluated using anomaly counts, anomaly detection time, processing rate, anomaly rates, visualization, and temporal agreement. Moreover, a controlled anomaly-injection analysis is performed to evaluate the sensitivity of each method. Numerical results demonstrate distinct detection characteristics and computational requirements, highlighting the potential of machine learning, particularly the data-driven Isolation Forest, alongside signal processing for identifying anomalies in bridge sensor measurements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在挪威一座桥梁的 iBridge 实时传感数据上，用信号处理与 Isolation Forest 两条互补路线做异常检测，并以受控异常注入检验各自灵敏度。结果显示两者检测特性与计算开销不同，Isolation Forest 与信号处理结合对识别桥梁传感异常更有潜力。
Motivation: 桥梁传感数据中的异常可能预示结构状态异常，需要在真实实时数据上比较信号处理与数据驱动方法的检测特性与计算开销，以支撑公共安全监测。
Method: 两条互补方法：一是信号处理，二是无监督的 Isolation Forest；数据来自安装在挪威桥梁上的 iBridge 传感器设备，另做受控异常注入 (anomaly-injection) 分析评估各方法灵敏度。
Result: 评估指标为异常计数、异常检测时间、处理速率、异常率、可视化与时间一致性；受控异常注入用于灵敏度分析，结果显示两方法在检测特性与计算需求上存在差异，Isolation Forest 表现出潜力。
Conclusion: 数据驱动的 Isolation Forest 可与信号处理互补，用于桥梁传感测量的异常识别。
