papers.title: MintEval: Do LLMs Implement the Trading Strategy You Asked For? A Behavioural-Equivalence Benchmark for Natural-Language-to-Strategy Code
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are moving from producing trading signals to writing the code that executes them. The failure mode of the second role is silent: generated code runs, a backtest plots, yet the risk logic that the trader described is not the logic being executed. Existing code benchmarks test functional correctness on unit tests and finance benchmarks test forecasting; neither measures whether an implementation behaves like the strategy that was asked for. We introduce MintEval, a benchmark in which reference strategies are generated programmatically from a library of composable building blocks, back-translated into colloquial trader instructions, and re-implemented by the model under test. Generated and reference programs are executed bar by bar on identical market data and frictions, and compared on their actions rather than on code similarity or profit: alpha is differenced away. MintEval v0 contains 800 tasks on BTCUSDT 15-minute data, stratified by an execution-measured state-span complexity tau that is decoupled from description length. Low-cost models reach a mean ActionMatch of at most 0.544 and reproduce at most 0.087 of tasks exactly; on a stratified subset of 200 tasks a frontier model (Claude Opus 5.5) reaches 0.889 and reproduces 0.575 exactly, yet still fails silently on 0.275 of tasks. Given a menu of building blocks, models identify the strategy almost perfectly, yet 79.2% of the implementations whose specification was read correctly diverge on more than 10% of active bars. The LLM judge of a recent strategy-generation benchmark, applied verbatim, accepts every one of these silent failures.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, benchmark code and evaluation harness available at https://github.com/spearmintai/minteval. Siyu Wang and Varstern Yifan Wang contributed equally, Yifig Wang is corresponding author
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MintEval 是一个行为等价基准：把可组合构件生成的参考策略反译成口语交易指令，让被测模型重写代码，再在相同行情与摩擦下逐 bar 执行并只比对动作（差分掉 alpha）。BTCUSDT 15 分钟数据 800 个任务上，低成本模型平均 ActionMatch 最高仅 0.544、完全复现率最高 0.087；Claude Opus 5.5 在 200 任务分层子集上达 0.889、完全复现 0.575，却仍在 0.275 的任务上静默失败。
Motivation: LLM 正从产出交易信号转向直接写执行代码，失败是静默的：代码能跑、回测有图，但执行的不是交易员描述的风险逻辑。现有代码基准只测单元测试的功能正确性，金融基准只测预测，都不度量实现是否与所要求的策略行为一致。
Method: 参考策略由可组合构件库程序化生成，再反译 (back-translate) 成口语交易指令，交由被测模型重写；两份程序在完全相同的市场数据与摩擦下逐 bar 执行，按动作而非代码相似度或收益比对，并把 alpha 差分掉。任务按执行测得的状态跨度复杂度 tau 分层，该复杂度与描述长度解耦。
Result: MintEval v0 含 800 个 BTCUSDT 15 分钟任务：低成本模型平均 ActionMatch 最高 0.544，完全复现任务比例最高 0.087；在 200 任务分层子集上 Claude Opus 5.5 达 0.889、完全复现 0.575，仍在 0.275 的任务上静默失败。给定构件菜单时模型几乎能完美识别策略，但 79.2% 被正确读懂规格的实现仍在超过 10% 的活跃 bar 上发散；近期某策略生成基准的 LLM judge 原样照搬后，接受全部这些静默失败。
Conclusion: 按动作逐 bar 比对才能暴露 LLM 交易代码的静默行为偏离，而基于 LLM judge 的评估会把这类失败全部放行；即使规格被读懂，实现发散仍是主要失败模式。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: RIFAR: Reliability and Forgetting-Aware Replay for Continual Robot Learning
papers.abstract_en: Genuine embodied agency requires robots to turn continuous real-world experience into lasting, transferable skills. This demands continual learning that integrates new capabilities without eroding prior knowledge as tasks and environments evolve. Experience replay mitigates forgetting, but storing complete demonstrations becomes costly as tasks accumulate. World-action models offer a generative alternative, reconstructing past experience through joint predictions of actions and future observations. However, visually coherent rollouts may contain actions that cannot realize the predicted transitions, while new-task adaptation can disrupt previously learned behavior. RIFAR therefore combines reliability screening with drift-aware replay selection. It reconstructs trajectories from compact demonstration prefixes and uses a frozen inverse-dynamics model to assess action-visual consistency. Training first combines current demonstrations with the highest-quality screened trajectories. RIFAR then compares action predictions before and after this adaptation on identical historical inputs, reselecting trajectories with larger normalized drift from the same screened pool for continued training. Across three LIBERO suites and real-world experiments, RIFAR surpasses the previous state of the art in WAM-based generative replay. On LIBERO-Goal, it achieves 90.97 AUC while retaining only 320 historical time steps per task, approximately 4.9% of the steps retained using 50-demonstration replay.

papers.title: Learn Feasibility Once, Optimize All Objectives: Derivative-Free Diffusion Models for Chance-Constrained Programming
papers.abstract_en: Chance-constrained programs (CCPs) optimize decisions under uncertainty by limiting the probability of constraint violation. Despite advances in traditional and learning-based approaches, optimizing non-convex or non-smooth objectives and adapting to different objectives under fixed chance constraints remain challenging. In this paper, we propose a \textbf{D}erivative-free \textbf{D}iffusion-based framework that \textbf{D}isentangles constraint modeling from objective optimization, termed \textbf{D$^3$Opt}. We learn the chance-feasible structure once, independently of any particular objective, by training a risk-conditioned diffusion model solely on constraint-filtered decisions and freezing it as a reusable prior for post-specified objectives. At inference time, we propose an annealed, particle-based Feynman--Kac correction along the frozen reverse diffusion process to optimize post-specified objectives using only function evaluations. This enables derivative-free optimization of non-convex and non-smooth objectives without objective-specific retraining. We prove that the correction preserves feasibility when this property holds for the frozen prior, and derive an optimization-error bound separating learned-prior coverage, finite-particle approximation, and finite-temperature effects. Experiments on linear Gaussian CCPs, objective-transfer tasks, and chance-constrained economic dispatch demonstrate effective optimization across smooth and non-smooth objectives, including non-convex cases, and objective generalization under fixed chance constraints without retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 D³Opt：把机会约束可行性与目标优化解耦，用约束过滤后的决策训练一次 risk-conditioned diffusion 模型并冻结为可复用先验，推理时在冻结的反向扩散链上做退火的粒子式 Feynman–Kac 修正，仅用函数评估优化事后指定的目标。证明该修正保持先验的可行性，并给出把先验覆盖、有限粒子近似与有限温度效应分开的优化误差界；在线性高斯 CCP、目标迁移任务与机会约束经济调度上，对光滑与非光滑、含非凸目标均无需重训即可优化。
Motivation: 机会约束规划 (CCP) 中非凸、非光滑目标难以优化，且固定机会约束下换目标通常要重训，传统与学习式方法都难以兼顾。
Method: D³Opt 先仅用约束过滤后的决策训练 risk-conditioned diffusion 模型，学一次与目标无关的机会可行结构并冻结为先验；推理时在冻结的反向扩散过程中加入退火的粒子式 Feynman–Kac 修正，只用函数评估 (derivative-free) 优化事后指定目标，无需针对目标重训。
Result: 在 linear Gaussian CCPs、objective-transfer 任务与 chance-constrained economic dispatch 上，对光滑与非光滑（含非凸）目标均实现有效优化，并在固定机会约束下无需重训即可泛化到新目标；理论上证明修正保持先验的可行性，并导出分离先验覆盖、有限粒子近似与有限温度三类误差的优化误差界。
Conclusion: 把可行性学习与目标优化解耦后，一次训练的冻结扩散先验加函数评估式修正即可支撑事后换目标的机会约束优化，前提是冻结先验本身可行。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Where to Look Is Not How to Fix: Pre-Denoising Diagnostics and Modality-Dependent Control in Diffusion Composition
papers.abstract_en: Understanding compositional failures in text-to-image diffusion requires identifying both where stress is detectable and how intervention changes the output. We study these questions through a controlled anchor--stress protocol that jointly evaluates text-encoder diagnostics and denoiser interventions. We introduce a text-only Compositional Stress Index (CSI), which separates common from rare compositions across SD1.5, SDXL, and the SD3 text path and provides an upstream diagnostic coordinate. A matched six-prompt localization study links intervention location to distinct outcomes: residual-minimizing embedding adapters improve representation fit, while downstream cross-attention intervention increases color hit rate (CHR) by 0.0272. Across SD1.5 and SDXL denoiser blocks, the largest positive signed diagnostic-accessibility mean occurs at the deep encoder, whereas selective boost has its largest positive mean CHR response at decoder blocks. Selective subtraction and broad ablation reveal further modality- and architecture-dependent responses, including a substantial CHR decrease when SDXL decoder cross-attention is broadly ablated. We find a diagnosis-control dissociation under our controlled attribute-object composition setting: compositional defects are diagnosable before denoising, but the representation coordinate that exposes risk is not necessarily the coordinate or modality that improves generation.
papers.journal_ref: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在文本到图像扩散的属性-物体组合设定下，用 anchor--stress 协议同时检验文本编码器诊断与去噪器干预，发现诊断位置与控制位置分离：组合缺陷在去噪前就可被诊断，但暴露风险的表示坐标未必是能改善生成的坐标或模态。下游 cross-attention 干预使 color hit rate (CHR) 提升 0.0272，而最大正向诊断可及性均值出现在 deep encoder、最大正向 CHR 响应却出现在 decoder blocks。
Motivation: 文本到图像扩散的组合失败需要区分两个问题：压力在何处可被检测，以及干预在何处真正改变输出；此前缺少把上游诊断与下游控制放在同一受控协议下对照的框架。
Method: 提出受控 anchor--stress 协议，联合评估文本编码器诊断与去噪器干预：先用纯文本的 Compositional Stress Index (CSI) 在 SD1.5、SDXL 与 SD3 文本路径上区分常见与稀有组合，作为上游诊断坐标；再做匹配的六提示 (six-prompt) 定位研究，比较残差最小化 embedding adapter、下游 cross-attention 干预，以及 selective boost、selective subtraction 与 broad ablation 在 SD1.5/SDXL 去噪器各 block 上的效果。
Result: 下游 cross-attention 干预使 CHR 提高 0.0272；跨 SD1.5 与 SDXL 去噪器 block，最大正向诊断可及性均值出现在 deep encoder，而 selective boost 的最大正向 CHR 均值响应出现在 decoder blocks；SDXL decoder cross-attention 被广泛消融 (broad ablation) 时 CHR 显著下降。
Conclusion: 在该属性-物体组合设定下存在诊断-控制解耦：去噪前即可诊断组合缺陷，但暴露风险的表示坐标不等于能改善生成的坐标或模态，因此干预位置需按模态与架构分别选择。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Explainable Molecular Structure Inference from GC--MS with Diffusion Models and LLM Reranking
papers.abstract_en: GC--EI--MS is an important technique for analyzing volatile and semivolatile compounds in complex samples. However, conventional methods rely heavily on reference spectral library matching, limiting their ability to identify compounds absent from these libraries and to infer complete molecular structures directly from fragmentation information. Here, we present DiffGCMS, a spectrum-conditioned discrete graph diffusion model for de novo structure elucidation from GC--EI--MS, and further develop a framework that integrates DiffGCMS with second-stage reasoning by a large language model (LLM). In the first stage, DiffGCMS generates candidate molecular structures from input spectra; in the second stage, the LLM uses mass spectral information to validate, repair, and rerank the candidates and provides interpretable analysis of fragment-ion peaks. This framework can generate plausible molecular structures for compounds absent from reference spectral libraries and provide traceable evidence supporting its decisions. On a test set comprising 13,696 spectra from NIST 20, the generative model achieved Acc@1 and Acc@10 of 6.01\% and 15.76\%, respectively. On the test subset containing molecules with no more than 10 heavy atoms, LLM-assisted molecular graph repair and reranking increased Acc@1 from 21.28\% to 21.95\%, Acc@10 from 46.91\% to 47.99\%, and candidate validity from 91.04\% to 100\%. These results demonstrate that spectrum-aware postprocessing can correct errors produced by the generative model while providing auditable and traceable explanations for the final ranking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DiffGCMS 是以 GC–EI–MS 谱为条件的离散图扩散模型，直接从碎裂信息生成候选分子结构，再由 LLM 用质谱信息验证、修复并重排，同时给出碎片离子峰的可解释分析。在 NIST 20 的 13,696 条谱测试集上生成模型 Acc@1/Acc@10 为 6.01%/15.76%；在重原子数不超过 10 的子集上，LLM 修复重排把 Acc@1 从 21.28% 提到 21.95%、Acc@10 从 46.91% 提到 47.99%、候选有效率从 91.04% 提到 100%。
Motivation: 常规 GC–EI–MS 解析高度依赖参考谱库匹配，遇到库中不存在的化合物就无法识别，也难以从碎裂信息直接推出完整分子结构。
Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段 DiffGCMS（spectrum-conditioned discrete graph diffusion）以输入质谱为条件生成候选分子图；第二阶段 LLM 利用质谱信息对候选做验证、图修复与重排，并对碎片离子峰给出可解释分析。
Result: NIST 20 上 13,696 条谱的测试集，生成模型 Acc@1 6.01%、Acc@10 15.76%；重原子数 ≤10 的子集上，LLM 辅助修复与重排使 Acc@1 由 21.28% 升至 21.95%，Acc@10 由 46.91% 升至 47.99%，候选有效率由 91.04% 升至 100%。
Conclusion: 谱感知的后处理能纠正生成模型的错误并给出可审计、可追溯的排序依据，使库外化合物的结构推断附带可解释证据。

papers.title: Learning Transferable Policies from Action-free Time Series Through Dynamical Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Learning control from action-free recordings is challenging because intervention effects are unobserved and policies may exploit errors in reconstructed dynamics. We present a hierarchical model-based reinforcement learning framework that uses shared structure across related systems to learn system-specific control policies from action-free recordings. A hierarchical dynamical system reconstruction model captures shared dynamics and individual variation through low-dimensional embeddings. These embeddings are then reused to parameterize shared policy and value networks, linking differences in reconstructed dynamics to differences in control. Policies are trained entirely via simulation under an explicit intervention model with additive latent perturbations. Piecewise-linear recurrent neural networks enable mechanistic analyses of the controlled dynamics, while decoder-based constraints make the immediate effects of interventions interpretable in observation space and permit interventions on one modality while protecting another from direct manipulation. On Lorenz-63 and double-pendulum systems, hierarchical policies improve transfer over independently trained policies. On Lorenz-63, they also achieve a higher mean reward than repeated planning with the same reconstructed models, perform comparably to methods trained with controlled interactions, and generalize to systems absent from policy training after embedding inference alone. Applications to neural-behavioral recordings demonstrate suppression of predicted movement under constrained neural perturbations. Together, these findings show how shared dynamical representations support transferable control and mechanistic hypothesis generation from action-free recordings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出分层基于模型的强化学习框架，从无动作 (action-free) 记录中学习可迁移控制策略：用共享动力学重建模型加低维系统嵌入刻画跨系统共性与个体差异，再用这些嵌入参数化共享策略与价值网络。在 Lorenz-63 与双摆上，分层策略比独立训练的策略迁移更好，在 Lorenz-63 上平均奖励高于用同一重建模型反复规划，并能仅靠嵌入推断泛化到训练中未出现的系统。
Motivation: 从无动作记录学控制时干预效应不可观测，且策略可能利用重建动力学中的误差；跨相关系统共享结构可缓解这一问题。
Method: 分层动力学系统重建模型用低维嵌入同时捕捉共享动力学与个体差异，嵌入再用于参数化共享 policy/value 网络；训练完全在显式干预模型（加性 latent perturbations）下的仿真中进行，骨干为分段线性 RNN，decoder 约束使干预在观测空间可解释，并允许扰动一个模态而保护另一模态。
Result: 在 Lorenz-63 与 double-pendulum 上，分层策略相对独立训练策略提升迁移；在 Lorenz-63 上平均奖励高于用相同重建模型的重复规划，表现与用受控交互训练的方法相当，并可在仅做嵌入推断后泛化到未参与策略训练的系统；在神经-行为记录上实现对预测运动的抑制（受约束的神经扰动）。
Conclusion: 共享动力学表征能把重建动力学的差异直接映射为控制差异，从而支持从无动作记录出发的可迁移控制与机制性假设生成。
Relevance: 34

summary_sections.method: 分层动力学系统重建模型用低维嵌入同时捕捉共享动力学与个体差异，嵌入再用于参数化共享 policy/value 网络；训练完全在显式干预模型（加性 latent perturbations）下的仿真中进行，骨干为分段线性 RNN，decoder 约束使干预在观测空间可解释，并允许扰动一个模态而保护另一模态。
summary_sections.result: 在 Lorenz-63 与 double-pendulum 上，分层策略相对独立训练策略提升迁移；在 Lorenz-63 上平均奖励高于用相同重建模型的重复规划，表现与用受控交互训练的方法相当，并可在仅做嵌入推断后泛化到未参与策略训练的系统；在神经-行为记录上实现对预测运动的抑制（受约束的神经扰动）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 共享动力学表征能把重建动力学的差异直接映射为控制差异，从而支持从无动作记录出发的可迁移控制与机制性假设生成。

papers.title: When Does Synthetic Relational Data Teach Models to Use Relations? Tracing Predictive Structure from Pretraining Data to Model Behavior
papers.abstract_en: Relational foundation models are increasingly pretrained on synthetic databases, yet downstream benchmarks reveal little about why one synthetic corpus produces a better model than another. In particular, strong performance may arise from realistic row-level statistics without the model ever learning to use relational structure. We study this as a data-attribution problem: which property of synthetic pretraining data induces relational computation? Using four Relational Transformer checkpoints trained with the same architecture, initialization, objective, and compute budget on corpora produced by four relational data generators, we trace a measurable property of the data to learned computation and downstream behavior. We hypothesize that relational mechanisms emerge when cross-table information is predictively necessary for the masked-cell pretraining objective. RelDiff exhibits by far the largest predictive gain from foreign-key-linked parents, and its corresponding model is uniquely sensitive to foreign-key interventions on unseen databases. This dependence survives a random-initialization control, grows monotonically with the fraction of corrupted links, and localizes to a serial cross-table pathway. Finally, disrupting the same mechanism during downstream inference removes RelDiff's advantage on relational tasks while leaving structure-insensitive models nearly unchanged. These results connect a property of synthetic training data to a learned mechanism and, through intervention, to downstream behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把「合成关系数据教会模型用关系」当作数据归因问题：只有当跨表信息对 masked-cell 预训练目标具有预测必要性时，关系机制才会出现。四个同架构同初始化的 Relational Transformer 中，RelDiff 语料带来的外键父表预测增益最大，其模型也唯一对未见库的外键干预敏感，且该依赖随链接损坏比例单调增长、定位到串行跨表通路；推理期破坏该机制即抹掉 RelDiff 在关系任务上的优势。
Motivation: 关系基础模型普遍用合成数据库预训练，但下游基准无法解释为何某个合成语料训出的模型更好：高分可能只来自真实的行级统计，模型从未真正使用关系结构。
Method: 固定架构、初始化、目标与算力预算，用四个关系数据生成器各训一个 Relational Transformer checkpoint，把数据的可测属性（外键链接带来的预测增益）追踪到学到的计算与下游行为；含随机初始化对照、按链接损坏比例的消融、外键干预以及推理期机制破坏。
Result: RelDiff 语料从外键关联父表获得远大于其余三者的预测增益，对应模型是唯一对未见数据库外键干预敏感的；该依赖在随机初始化对照下仍成立，随损坏链接比例单调增长，并定位到串行跨表通路；推理期破坏该机制后 RelDiff 在关系任务上的优势消失，而结构不敏感模型几乎不变。
Conclusion: 合成语料中跨表信息对预训练目标的预测必要性，是模型学会使用关系结构的成因，并经干预把这一数据属性与下游行为连起来。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MOF-VERIFY: A Failure-Aware Agentic Harness for MOF Hypothesis Verification
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly used as reasoning components in AI-driven materials Co-Scientists, yet the reliability of the resulting verification pipeline remains unclear. Metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) provide a particularly challenging setting because structures may appear under different identifiers, synthesis outcomes depend strongly on experimental conditions, evidence is distributed across heterogeneous sources, and some hypotheses require computation rather than literature alone. We introduce a diagnostic benchmark with four task families covering structural grounding, synthesis-condition verification, evidence-sufficiency verification, and MLIP-based computational verification. T-MOF-1-3 are evaluated under closed-book, retrieval-enabled, and oracle-evidence settings to localize failures in knowledge access, evidence acquisition, and reasoning, while T-MOF-4 separately evaluates computational verification. Guided by these diagnosed failure modes, we develop MOF-Verify, a failure-aware agentic harness that targets structural, literature, evidence-sufficiency, and computational bottlenecks before producing a final verdict. Across multiple backbone LLMs, MOF-Verify substantially improves hypothesis-verification performance over direct inference and retrieval-based baselines. Benchmark datasets are released at https://github.com/IMMS-Ewha/MOF-Verify-Benchmark.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshops XAI4Science and AI4Mat
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MOF-VERIFY 提出面向金属有机框架 (MOF) 假设验证的失败感知 agentic harness，先诊断结构、文献、证据充分性与计算四类瓶颈再给出最终判定。在多组 backbone LLM 上，其假设验证表现显著优于直接推理与基于检索的基线。
Motivation: LLM 作为 AI 材料 Co-Scientist 的推理组件时，验证管线可靠性不清：MOF 结构存在异名同体、合成结果强依赖实验条件、证据分散在异构来源，且部分假设需要计算而非仅查文献。
Method: 构建含四类任务的诊断基准：T-MOF-1 至 T-MOF-3 分别在 closed-book、retrieval-enabled、oracle-evidence 三种设定下评测，以定位知识访问、证据获取与推理环节的失败；T-MOF-4 单独评测基于 MLIP 的计算验证。据此开发 MOF-Verify harness，在输出最终判定前依次处理结构、文献、证据充分性与计算瓶颈。
Result: 在多个 backbone LLM 上，MOF-Verify 的假设验证表现相比直接推理与 retrieval-based 基线有大幅提升；基准数据集已发布于 github.com/IMMS-Ewha/MOF-Verify-Benchmark。
Conclusion: 先按诊断出的失败模式分环节处理结构、文献、证据与计算瓶颈，再产出判定，是提升 LLM 材料假设验证可靠性的有效路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: hacktrace: behavior-supervised detection of reward hacking during code generation
papers.abstract_en: A coding agent can earn a passing grade by fixing its code, or by deleting the test that exposes the bug. Detecting such reward hacking requires recognizing attempted shortcuts, including those that fail. We release 173,561 annotated multi-turn coding trajectories from Qwen3-8B and show that supervising shortcut behavior independently of exploit success substantially improves detection. We introduce HACKTRACE, a behavior-supervised monitor that reads the internal states the agent already computes while generating code. Reusing these states enables monitoring before a turn is complete, without additional language-model tokens or passes. Combining this evidence with static features of the final files achieves a mean per-problem AUC of 0.997 with 8 ms of monitoring overhead, improving both accuracy and latency over monitors that run the model again on an honesty question and answer. The same generation states also provide an inexpensive monitoring signal for reinforcement learning. With strong GRPO penalties, HACKTRACE reduces the cheating share of passing solutions from 82-91% to 1-5%, while retaining honest, correct solutions and maintaining high detection accuracy as the policy evolves. Our results show that both the supervision target and the source of monitoring evidence matter for turning accurate detection into a useful training signal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HACKTRACE 用行为监督检测代码智能体的 reward hacking：把「走捷径」本身（无论是否成功）作为监督目标，直接读取智能体生成代码时已算出的内部状态，再与最终文件的静态特征融合。在 173,561 条 Qwen3-8B 多轮轨迹上，逐题 mean AUC 达 0.997、监控开销 8 ms；配合强 GRPO 惩罚后，通过解法中的作弊占比从 82–91% 降到 1–5%。
Motivation: 编码智能体可以通过删测试而非修代码拿到通过，且失败的捷径尝试同样危险；现有监控要么等一轮结束、要么重跑模型回答诚实性问题，延迟与成本高，也难以作为 RL 的训练信号。
Method: 发布 173,561 条带标注的 Qwen3-8B 多轮编码轨迹，以捷径行为（独立于 exploit 是否成功）为监督目标训练 HACKTRACE；监控器读取生成过程中已有的内部状态，实现轮次未完成即可监控、不额外消耗 LM token 或前向，再与最终文件静态特征融合，并将该信号接入强化学习（GRPO 惩罚）。
Result: 逐题 mean AUC 0.997，监控开销 8 ms，准确率与延迟均优于在 honesty 问答上重跑模型的监控器；强 GRPO 惩罚下通过解法的作弊占比由 82–91% 降至 1–5%，同时保留诚实且正确的解法，并在策略演化中维持高检测准确率。
Conclusion: 监督目标（盯住捷径行为本身）与监控证据来源（复用生成内部状态而非重跑模型）共同决定准确检测能否转化为可用的训练信号。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: RIPPLE in Still Water: Zero-Shot Clustering in Federated Learning with Wavelet Scattering Transform
papers.abstract_en: Clustered Federated Learning (FL) partitions a client population into groups of similar local distributions and trains one specialized model per cluster, mitigating client drift that degrades single-model methods under non-IID data. Prior methods discover cluster structure inside the training loop through gradient similarity, loss evaluation, or EM-style updates, thus increasing communication overhead, exposing gradients to inversion attacks, and providing no mechanism to assign clients absent from training. We propose RIPPLE, a clustered FL framework in which cluster assignment is computed entirely offline from a spectral characterization of each client's local data: a variance-weighted principal-component prototype embedded via the Wavelet Scattering Transform and decoded by a Gaussian Mixture VAE trained server-side on synthetic client populations before federation begins. Per-round communication cost matches FedAvg exactly, and a client absent from training obtains a personalized model from a single forward pass, without gradient computation, model evaluation, or extra communication round. We prove that the gap between RIPPLE's surrogate clustered objective and the oracle is bounded by a computable quantity decaying with client sample size and independent of federation duration; per-cluster convergence matches the minimax-optimal rate for non-convex smooth objectives. Across five benchmarks spanning controlled and realistic heterogeneity, RIPPLE consistently outperforms all baselines, with margins growing on the most realistic partitions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RIPPLE 把联邦学习的聚类分配完全搬到训练环外：用小波散射变换 (Wavelet Scattering Transform) 嵌入各客户端本地数据的方差加权主成分原型，再由服务端在合成客户端总体上预训练的 Gaussian Mixture VAE 解码聚类。每轮通信量与 FedAvg 完全一致，缺席客户端只需一次前向即可拿到个性化模型；在五个异构基准上一致优于全部基线，且在最真实的划分上差距扩大。
Motivation: 现有聚类联邦学习在训练环内用梯度相似度、损失评估或 EM 式更新发现聚类，带来额外通信开销、梯度易受反演攻击，且无法给未参与训练的客户端分配模型。
Method: 离线计算聚类分配：对每个客户端本地数据做谱刻画，得到方差加权主成分原型，经 Wavelet Scattering Transform 嵌入，再由服务端在联邦开始前用合成客户端总体训练的 Gaussian Mixture VAE 解码为聚类标签；训练阶段按聚类各训一个专用模型，通信模式与 FedAvg 相同。
Result: 证明代理聚类目标与 oracle 之差被一个可计算量界定，该量随客户端样本量衰减且与联邦轮数无关；每簇收敛速率匹配非凸光滑目标的 minimax 最优速率。在覆盖受控与真实异构性的五个基准上，RIPPLE 一致优于所有基线，且在最真实的划分上优势幅度更大。
Conclusion: 聚类分配可以完全离线完成而不损失收敛质量：通信开销与 FedAvg 持平，缺席客户端零额外通信即可个性化，且异构性越真实优势越大。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BeeWhere: Segmenting Bumble Bee Colonies to Quantify Behavioral Effects
papers.abstract_en: Social bees are important pollinators that support biodiversity and crop pollination globally and serve as important model systems for collective behavior, but scalable measurement of individual- and colony-level behavior remains difficult in dense, occluded nest environments. Existing monitoring workflows use fiducial tags (e.g., ArUco) to preserve individual identity, yet tag-based tracking can fail when markers are obscured and provide limited information about body extent, spatial context, and untagged individuals. We present BeeWhere, an AI-assisted annotation and analysis workflow that combines ArUco detections with deep-learnt instance segmentations to quantify bumble bee behavior from high-resolution colony images and videos. Using bumble bee (Bombus impatiens) microcolonies as a test case, we annotate 483 frames containing 8,443 bee instances. We additionally annotate pollen balls, nest structures, and chamber boundaries, and train YOLO instance segmentation models for downstream behavioral analysis. Instance segmentations enable quantification of important behavioral metrics based on body contours, including nearest-neighbor distance, proximity to nest structures, spatial occupancy within the nest, and detection counts over time. We apply the BeeWhere models to tag-based tracking in an exploratory validation study assessing the behavioral impacts of neonicotinoid pesticide exposure. BeeWhere increased detection rates compared to tag-based tracking, particularly when bees were partially obscured or under challenging imaging conditions, and also captured treatment-associated changes in bee spatial organization not captured using tag-based tracking alone. These results suggest that instance segmentation can complement fiducial-marker tracking by recovering behaviorally meaningful signals under challenging colony conditions.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BeeWhere 把 ArUco 标记检测与深度实例分割结合，用于密集遮挡蜂巢图像/视频中的熊蜂个体与群体行为量化。在 Bombus impatiens 微蜂群上标注 483 帧、8,443 个蜂体实例并训练 YOLO 实例分割模型，检测率高于纯标记追踪，尤其在部分遮挡与困难成像条件下，并额外捕捉到新烟碱类农药暴露引起的蜂群空间组织变化。
Motivation: 密集遮挡巢内环境中个体与群体行为难以规模化测量：ArUco 标记在遮挡时失效，且对身体轮廓、空间语境和未标记个体提供的信息有限。
Method: 将 ArUco 检测与深度学习实例分割（YOLO instance segmentation）融合成 AI 辅助标注与分析流程；在 Bombus impatiens 微蜂群上标注 483 帧共 8,443 个蜂体实例，同时标注花粉球、巢结构与巢室边界，训练 YOLO 实例分割模型，基于身体轮廓计算最近邻距离、距巢结构距离、空间占据与随时间的检测计数。
Result: 在新烟碱类农药暴露的探索性验证研究中，BeeWhere 相比标记追踪提高了检测率，尤其在蜜蜂部分遮挡或成像条件困难时；并捕捉到仅用标记追踪无法得到的处理组相关的蜂群空间组织变化。
Conclusion: 实例分割可作为 fiducial-marker 追踪的补充，在困难巢内条件下恢复有行为学意义的信号。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Parasitic Co-Denoising: Unlocking 3D Human Motion Generation in a Frozen Video Diffusion Model
papers.abstract_en: Despite never being supervised on explicit 3D motion, large-scale text-to-video diffusion models synthesize realistic human motion in their generated videos. We ask whether this implicit knowledge can be turned into explicit 3D motion generation, without training a separate motion model. Probing a frozen Wan2.1 reveals that a recoverable motion signal is present in its intermediate states across the entire denoising schedule, not confined to the clean output. Motivated by this, we introduce parasitic co-denoising, a paradigm in which motion is decoded from the host model along its denoising schedule rather than produced by an independent generator. We instantiate it as the Parasitic Motion Decoder (PMD), an efficient flow-matching decoder that shares the host's noise schedule and reads its intermediate features through a $σ$-adaptive multi-layer fusion, leaving the host unmodified. Drawing its coverage from the host rather than from motion data, PMD leads dedicated motion generators on text-motion alignment at a small fraction of their trainable parameters, while producing paired video and motion in a single pass that motion-only baselines cannot match.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在冻结的 Wan2.1 视频扩散模型上，用寄生式协同去噪 (parasitic co-denoising) 从宿主去噪全程的中间状态直接解码显式 3D 人体运动，宿主完全不改动。PMD 以 flow-matching 解码器共享宿主噪声调度并经 σ-自适应多层融合读取中间特征，在文本-运动对齐上以远少于专用运动生成器的可训练参数取得领先，同时单次前向同时产出配对视频与运动。
Motivation: 大规模文生视频扩散模型从未在显式 3D 运动上受监督，却已合成逼真人体运动；问题是能否把这份隐式知识转成显式 3D 运动生成，而不必另训一个独立运动模型。
Method: 先探测冻结 Wan2.1，确认可恢复的运动信号存在于整个去噪调度的中间状态而非仅干净输出；据此提出 Parasitic Motion Decoder (PMD)，一个与宿主共享噪声调度的高效 flow-matching 解码器，通过 σ-adaptive 多层融合读取宿主中间特征，宿主保持冻结不改。
Result: PMD 在文本-运动对齐 (text-motion alignment) 上领先专用运动生成器，可训练参数只占其一小部分；并能在单次前向中同时产出配对的视频与运动，这是 motion-only 基线无法做到的。
Conclusion: 运动生成可以寄生在冻结视频扩散模型的去噪过程上：覆盖度取自宿主而非运动数据，就能用极少可训练参数对齐专用生成器，并顺带拿到配对视频。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HyperThink: Text-to-Parameter Hypernetworks for Efficient Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Long-form thinking traces can substantially improve the multi-step reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs), but they introduce high inference-time overhead, with latency dominated by sequential decoding. We propose HyperThink, a text-to-parameter approach that amortizes this reasoning computation into a single query-conditioned parameter update: a lightweight hypernetwork reads the question and predicts updates to a small subset of the base LLM's parameters, while a vector-quantized decoder constrains them to a finite set of reusable patterns to improve robustness and transfer. Trained end-to-end on outputs from the base model itself, HyperThink eliminates long thinking traces at test time: after one hypernetwork forward pass, the adapted model generates a concise step-by-step solution and final answer without an intermediate trace, using far fewer tokens while retaining strong reasoning performance. Empirically, HyperThink improves the low-latency region of the accuracy-latency trade-off on mathematical and general reasoning tasks, with its strongest gains in the near-non-thinking regime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HyperThink 用轻量 hypernetwork 把长思维链的推理开销摊销成一次查询条件化的参数更新：读题后直接预测基座 LLM 小部分参数的增量，并用 vector-quantized 解码器把更新约束在有限可复用模式内，测试时不再生成中间 trace，用远少的 token 生成简洁分步解答与最终答案。在数学与通用推理任务上改善了 accuracy-latency 权衡的低延迟区，增益在 near-non-thinking regime 最强。
Motivation: 长思维链能提升 LLM 多步推理，但推理开销高，延迟被顺序解码主导，需要在保留推理能力的同时压掉这段 token。
Method: text-to-parameter 路线：轻量 hypernetwork 读入问题并预测基座 LLM 少量参数的更新，vector-quantized 解码器把更新限制在有限可复用模式以提升鲁棒性与迁移；整体在基座模型自身输出上端到端训练，测试时一次 hypernetwork 前向后直接生成分步解答与答案。
Result: 在数学与通用推理任务上改善 accuracy-latency 权衡的低延迟区域，最强增益出现在 near-non-thinking regime；测试时省去中间 thinking trace，token 用量远少于长思维链，同时保持较强推理性能。
Conclusion: 把长思维链摊销成一次查询条件化的参数更新，可以在低延迟档位保住推理能力，尤其适合 near-non-thinking 的部署场景。

papers.title: WebFovea: When the Model Is Right but the Click Is Wrong -- Reliable Round Trips for Vision-Based Web Agents on Live Websites
papers.abstract_en: We present WebFovea, a vision-based web agent that placed 2nd in the WebRetriever Challenge 2026 with a final score of 57.0 out of 100. The challenge evaluates agents end to end on Protocol III of the WebRetriever benchmark (arXiv:2607.06118): starting from an entry URL on a live website, the agent must operate the site's own interface and return a verifiable answer. A capable multimodal large language model (LLM) is necessary for this, but not sufficient. The model's decisions reach the browser through the harness, the code between the model and the page. At every step, four things must go right: the model's reply must be parsed into the intended action, the action must take effect on the page, the result must be reported back accurately, and the model must be shown the information it needs. On real websites, many of the failures we observed occurred at one of these four stages rather than in the model's reasoning. A coordinate-space mismatch placed every click at 3/4 of its intended coordinates; actions on native dropdowns, inside iframes, and in text boxes failed silently; and self-generated chat-template tokens contaminated 4.9% of task episodes. WebFovea hardens each stage and surrounds the loop with guardrails that keep the agent within the rules and its budget. The four-stage view does not depend on the model, although some individual fixes do. Because we used the same model in all four submissions, the rise of our official hidden-set score from 31.0 to 57.0 reflects changes to the harness, up to run-to-run variance on live sites. We describe the design, the evidence for each component (including negative results), a failure analysis, the limitations, and a roadmap that includes routing different steps to different models.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. Technical report of the 2nd-place solution in the WebRetriever Challenge 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WebFovea 是面向真实网站的视觉 web agent，把模型与页面之间的 harness 拆成解析、执行、回传、呈现四个环节并逐段加固，配以规则与预算护栏。同一模型下官方隐藏集分数从 31.0 升到 57.0（满分 100），获 WebRetriever Challenge 2026 第二名，说明多数失败出在 harness 而非模型推理。
Motivation: 多模态 LLM 在真实网站上做任务时，模型判断正确但点击落空：坐标错位、原生控件与 iframe 内操作静默失败、自生成 chat-template token 污染 episode，端到端得分被 harness 拖垮。
Method: 在 WebRetriever benchmark Protocol III（从入口 URL 起操作站点界面并返回可验证答案）上，把每步拆为动作解析、页面生效、结果回传、信息呈现四段，逐段加固并加规则与预算护栏；四次提交使用同一模型以隔离 harness 变化，并报告各组件证据（含 negative results）与失败分析。
Result: WebFovea 在 WebRetriever Challenge 2026 以 57.0/100 获第二名；官方隐藏集分数由 31.0 升至 57.0，且归因于 harness 改动、上界为真实网站的 run-to-run 方差。观测到的故障包括坐标空间错配使每次点击落在预期坐标 3/4 处、原生下拉/iframe/文本框操作静默失败、自生成 chat-template token 污染 4.9% 的任务 episode。
Conclusion: 模型能力对这类 web agent 是必要非充分条件：四阶段 harness 视图与模型无关，把可靠性工程放在 harness 上即可在同模型下大幅抬分；部分具体修复依赖特定模型，路线图包括按步骤路由到不同模型。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Balancing Multimodal Learning via Functional Progress
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal learning often suffers from modality imbalance, where the joint optimization process is dominated by a single modality. Existing methods typically estimate modality imbalance from score disparities derived from prediction uncertainty or optimization statistics. However, due to distinct prediction uncertainty and learning dynamics across modalities, direct comparison of such scores may misinterpret intrinsic modality differences as progress gaps, leading to biased imbalance estimation. In this paper, we propose Function-Space Guided Multimodal Optimization (FGMO), which leverages a function-space progress signal to assess modality-wise optimization progress and coordinate optimization across modalities to alleviate modality imbalance. Specifically, we introduce Functional Progress Estimation (FPE) to measure each modality's update-induced function-space response and calibrate it against a loss-aligned unimodal reference, producing a comparable progress signal. Based on this signal, Functional Response Control (FRC) redistributes modality-level function-space budgets and realizes the target responses through tensor-wise learning-rate adjustment. Theoretical analysis establishes a one-step target-contraction property of FRC under bounded controller-state mismatch, and extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of FGMO across multiple multimodal benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多模态学习中直接比较各模态的预测不确定性或优化统计分数，会把模态本身的固有差异误判为进度差距，导致失衡估计有偏。FGMO 用函数空间进度信号 Functional Progress Estimation (FPE) 度量每个模态更新引起的函数空间响应，并用 loss-aligned 单模态参考做校准，再由 Functional Response Control (FRC) 重新分配模态级函数空间预算、通过张量级学习率调整实现目标响应。
Motivation: 多模态联合优化常被单一模态主导；现有方法用预测不确定性或优化统计的分数差估计失衡，但各模态预测不确定性与学习动态本就不同，直接比较会把固有差异误读为进度差距，造成有偏的失衡估计。
Method: 提出 Function-Space Guided Multimodal Optimization (FGMO)：FPE 度量每个模态更新引起的函数空间响应，并对照 loss-aligned 单模态参考做校准，得到可比的进度信号；FRC 据此重新分配模态级函数空间预算，通过张量级学习率调整实现目标响应。理论分析给出 FRC 在有界控制器状态失配下的 one-step target-contraction 性质。
Result: 理论结果为 FRC 在有界控制器状态失配下的 one-step target-contraction 性质；实验在多个多模态 benchmark 上验证 FGMO 的有效性，摘要未列出具体数据集名称或数值指标。
Conclusion: 用函数空间响应而非预测分数来衡量模态进度，可以在有界失配条件下把各模态的优化响应收敛到目标，从而缓解多模态学习中的模态失衡。

papers.title: Adaptive Second-Order Solvers for Fast Stochastic Diffusion Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models rely on numerical solvers requiring time-discretization, which has a large influence on the tradeoff between sampling cost and quality. However, the computational difficulty of the reverse process varies along the sampling trajectory and across data distributions, making the choice of discretization important. We adapt proportional-integral (PI) step-size control to diffusion, using our diffusion noise-normalised error estimator. Unlike existing adaptive methods in diffusion that respond only to the current error, the PI solver also incorporates the previous error, yielding smoother step adaptation. We further show that these per-sample trajectories exhibit shared structure and can be aggregated into a fixed schedule that retains much of the benefit of adaptive sampling. We evaluate both approaches on natural-image and language datasets, in terms of quality, measured by FID at a matched number of neural network evaluations (NFE), comparing them with widely used stochastic solvers and schedules. For images, our fixed discretization outperforms the commonly used EDM schedule in terms of sample quality when used with the stochastic Heun sampler, and with the EDM-churn sampler at low NFE. Additionally, our PI adaptive solver obtains better FID than most stochastic and adaptive baselines, although it does not beat the EDM-churn sampler at low NFE. Moreover, we find our solver outperforms both the EDM and the entropy schedule on language diffusion at low-to-medium NFE in terms of perplexity, with the drawback of lower token entropy. Lastly, we find that the benefit of per-sample adaptivity is problem-dependent. It is highly beneficial in 1D toy examples, while only marginal for image and language data, where the average schedule sometimes even outperforms the PI-adaptive solver. Code is available at https://github.com/ellakemperman/adaptive-second-order-diffusion-solvers
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 PI (proportional-integral) 步长控制移植到扩散采样，用噪声归一化误差估计器同时看当前与上一步误差，得到更平滑的自适应步长；并把逐样本轨迹聚合成固定 schedule。在匹配 NFE 下，固定 schedule 配 Heun 采样器的图像 FID 优于 EDM schedule，PI 自适应求解器 FID 好于多数随机与自适应基线；语言扩散上低到中 NFE 的 perplexity 优于 EDM 与 entropy schedule，但 token entropy 更低。逐样本自适应的收益依问题而定：1D toy 上收益很高，图像与语言上仅边际，平均 schedule 有时反而胜过 PI 自适应。
Motivation: 扩散采样的时间离散化直接决定成本与质量的权衡，而逆过程的计算难度沿轨迹和跨数据分布都在变化，固定步长与只响应当前误差的自适应方法都难以匹配这种变化。
Method: 将控制里的 PI 步长调节引入扩散，配一个 diffusion noise-normalised error estimator，在当前误差之外纳入上一步误差以平滑步长调整；再把逐样本自适应轨迹聚合成固定 schedule。在自然图像与语言数据集上按匹配的神经网络评估次数 (NFE) 以 FID（图像）和 perplexity、token entropy（语言）评测，对比常用随机求解器与 schedule（EDM、EDM-churn、entropy schedule）。
Result: 图像上，固定离散化配 stochastic Heun 采样器时样本质量优于常用 EDM schedule，配 EDM-churn 采样器在低 NFE 下也更优；PI 自适应求解器的 FID 好于多数随机与自适应基线，但在低 NFE 下不敌 EDM-churn。语言扩散上，低到中 NFE 时求解器在 perplexity 上胜过 EDM 与 entropy schedule，代价是更低的 token entropy。逐样本自适应在 1D toy 例子中收益很高，在图像与语言数据上仅边际，平均 schedule 有时甚至超过 PI 自适应求解器。
Conclusion: PI 自适应步长能改善扩散采样的质量-成本权衡，但逐样本自适应的增益是问题相关的：高维图像与语言任务上聚合出的固定 schedule 已保留大部分收益，低 NFE 段仍以 EDM-churn 为强基线。

papers.title: When Numbers Start Talking: Numerical Signalling and Strategic Behaviour Among LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-based agents increasingly operate in multi-agent systems (MAS) characterised by strategic interaction. However, little is known about whether, and to what extent, different types of messages affect the outcomes of strategic games. By investigating AI agents based on four popular LLMs, playing four games with different cooperation equilibria, we study whether messages of different kinds (natural language, numerical signals, or random sequences) significantly modify the levels of cooperation in each game, also depending on the agents' assigned personalities. We observe that structured messages alter the final payoffs for most games and LLMs, but without a predictable pattern; this challenges the assumption that AI agents can converge to stable equilibria regardless of additional capabilities. Moreover, we observe that agent-generated numerical messages depart from randomness, most strongly and consistently when agents are explicitly instructed to communicate; however, they introduce an additional interpretability challenge, as their symbol distributions are mostly associated with the payoff structure and typically become more concentrated with repetition, but are overall difficult for humans to interpret. Monitoring for coordination of AI agents through restricted channels should thus prioritise message-level fingerprints, which generalise across models, over behavioural decisions, which do not.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多智能体博弈中给 LLM 代理发送结构化消息（自然语言、数值信号、随机序列）会改变多数博弈的最终收益，但方向没有可预测规律，且随人格设定而变。代理自发生成的数值消息显著偏离随机分布，尤其在明确要求通信时，其符号分布随重复使用越来越集中、并与收益结构绑定。作者主张：监控 AI 代理是否形成协调，应优先看跨模型可泛化的消息级指纹，而不是其行为决策。
Motivation: LLM 代理在多智能体系统中进行策略互动，但消息类型（自然语言、数值、随机序列）如何影响博弈结果、以及能否据此识别代理间协调，此前几乎未知。
Method: 以四个主流 LLM 为代理，在四种具有不同合作均衡的博弈中进行策略互动，操纵消息类型（自然语言、数值信号、随机序列）并结合代理被赋予的人格设定，观察合作水平与收益变化，并分析代理生成数值消息的符号分布相对随机性的偏离。
Result: 结构化消息在多数博弈和多数 LLM 上改变了最终收益，但变化无可预测模式；代理生成的数值消息偏离随机性，在明确指示通信时偏离最强最一致；其符号分布主要与收益结构相关、随重复变得更集中，且对人类难以解读。
Conclusion: 消息类型会破坏 LLM 代理收敛到稳定均衡的假设；监控 AI 代理协调应依赖跨模型泛化的行为无关的消息级指纹，而非不具泛化性的行为决策。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CrowdOcc: Monocular Semantic Scene Completion for Quadruped Robots in Crowded Indoor Environments
papers.abstract_en: Monocular semantic scene completion (SSC) for quadruped robots remains underexplored in real crowded indoor environments, where human-scene occlusion disrupts static geometry and human occupancy predictions are often incomplete or spatially misplaced. We present CrowdOcc, an RGB-D dataset and monocular SSC framework for this setting. CrowdOcc contains 25.1K frames from 11 indoor scenes, with semantic occupancy annotations constructed through static dynamic decoupling. Our framework combines: (i) Normal Guided Scene Geometry Fusion (NGSGF) to complement depth-aware lifting with surface-normal cues for occlusion robust geometry; and (ii) Human-Centric Sparse Interaction (HCSI) to selectively model human-human and local human scene relations in 3D. Our method achieves state-of-the-art SSC performance on CrowdOcc's scene-disjoint test set, reaching 15.80 IoU, 11.40 mIoU, and 46.23 Human IoU, demonstrating generalization to unseen indoor scenes.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA) 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CrowdOcc 提出面向拥挤室内四足机器人的单目语义场景补全 (SSC) 框架与 RGB-D 数据集：用法向引导的场景几何融合 (NGSGF) 在深度提升中补入表面法向以抵抗遮挡，用以人为中心的稀疏交互 (HCSI) 在 3D 中选择性建模人人与人-场景关系。在 CrowdOcc 场景不相交测试集上达到 15.80 IoU、11.40 mIoU 与 46.23 Human IoU，取得 SOTA 并泛化到未见室内场景。
Motivation: 拥挤室内环境中人-场景遮挡会破坏静态几何，人体占据预测常不完整或空间错位，而四足机器人的单目 SSC 仍缺乏真实场景数据与针对性方法。
Method: 发布 CrowdOcc：25.1K 帧、11 个室内场景，语义占据标注通过静动解耦 (static dynamic decoupling) 构建。框架含两模块：NGSGF 用表面法向线索补强深度感知提升 (depth-aware lifting) 以获得遮挡鲁棒几何；HCSI 在 3D 中选择性建模人人与局部人-场景关系。
Result: 在 CrowdOcc 场景不相交测试集上取得 SOTA：IoU 15.80，mIoU 11.40，Human IoU 46.23，并展示对未见室内场景的泛化。
Conclusion: 在拥挤室内场景中，把法向引导的几何补全与以人为中心的稀疏关系建模结合，可在场景不相交划分下同时改善静态与人体占据预测。

papers.title: SoftGene: Protein Language Model-Enhanced Soft Prompting for Interpretable Gene Set Annotation
papers.abstract_en: Gene set analysis is a cornerstone of functional genomics, yet it remains labor-intensive and heavily dependent on manual curation and expert biological interpretation. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful tools for genomic reasoning and annotation, most existing approaches rely on symbolic gene names and fail to capture domain-specific biological structure, particularly protein sequence information that governs molecular activity, interactions, and downstream gene function. In this work, we propose SoftGene, a novel framework for LLM-based gene set annotation that leverages the hierarchical structure of gene sets. First, we use a hierarchical attention-based encoder built on ESM, a protein language model, to represent each gene set using protein-level amino acid sequence information. Second, we construct a hybrid prompting scheme that combines soft prompts derived from gene set embeddings with hard prompts containing auxiliary context generated by an LLM, and feed the resulting prompt into a local LLM for annotation. We evaluate our framework on two benchmark datasets: Gene Ontology (GO) and the Molecular Signatures Database (MSigDB). Our results show that integrating protein-sequence representations with textual context improves gene set annotation overall, while per-domain analyses reveal that the contribution of protein embeddings varies across biological domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SoftGene 用 ESM 蛋白语言模型的层次注意力编码器把基因集表示为蛋白序列级嵌入，再与 LLM 生成的硬提示拼成混合提示喂给本地 LLM 做基因集注释。在 Gene Ontology (GO) 与 MSigDB 两个基准上，蛋白序列表示与文本上下文结合整体提升注释效果，但蛋白嵌入的贡献随生物学领域不同而变化。
Motivation: 基因集分析依赖人工整理与专家解读，现有 LLM 注释方法只用符号基因名，抓不到决定分子活性与基因功能的蛋白序列结构。
Method: 先用基于 ESM 蛋白语言模型的层次注意力编码器，以氨基酸序列表示每个基因集；再构造混合提示，把基因集嵌入导出的 soft prompt 与 LLM 生成辅助上下文的 hard prompt 结合，输入本地 LLM 完成注释。
Result: 在 Gene Ontology (GO) 与 Molecular Signatures Database (MSigDB) 两个基准上评测：整合蛋白序列表示与文本上下文整体提升基因集注释；分领域分析显示蛋白嵌入的贡献在不同生物学领域间存在差异。
Conclusion: 蛋白序列信息与文本上下文互补，能整体改善 LLM 基因集注释，但其增益不是各领域均匀的，需按领域判断蛋白嵌入的价值。

papers.title: Tailoring the Quantization Space for 1-Bit KV Cache Compression
papers.abstract_en: The key-value (KV) cache becomes a major memory bottleneck in long-context LLM inference, placing substantial pressure on memory capacity and bandwidth. To mitigate this bottleneck, vector quantization (VQ) has emerged as a promising approach for aggressive KV cache compression. However, existing VQ methods degrade substantially in the 1-bit regime. At such extreme compression, each codebook must represent a larger group of channels with a limited set of centroids, making effective use of its capacity increasingly challenging. To address this, we introduce $\textbf{TaSQ}$, which tailors the VQ target space by combining query-guided channel weighting, cross-head normalization, and covariance-aware channel grouping to better reflect the error sensitivity and statistical structure of cached activations. Since these transforms are RoPE-compatible and can be easily merged into projection weights and codebooks, TaSQ preserves the conventional VQ lookup structure and adds negligible serving overhead. Across general, long-chain-of-thought reasoning, and long-context retrieval benchmarks, TaSQ consistently outperforms existing low-bit KV cache VQ baselines while preserving reasoning stability. On a single RTX 6000 Ada GPU, its SGLang implementation supports up to $14\times$ larger batch sizes and achieves $1.87\times$ higher peak throughput compared to the BF16 baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TaSQ 通过 query 引导的通道加权、跨头归一化与协方差感知通道分组来定制 1-bit KV cache 的向量量化目标空间，使码本更好地匹配缓存激活的误差敏感度与统计结构。变换与 RoPE 兼容且可并入投影权重与码本，保留常规 VQ 查表结构、服务开销可忽略。在通用、长链式推理与长上下文检索基准上一致优于现有低比特 KV cache VQ 基线，单张 RTX 6000 Ada 上 SGLang 实现支持最大 14× 批量、峰值吞吐较 BF16 基线高 1.87×。
Motivation: 长上下文 LLM 推理中 KV cache 是主要内存瓶颈，向量量化 (VQ) 可激进压缩，但在 1-bit 极端压缩下现有 VQ 方法性能大幅退化：每个码本需用有限质心表示更大通道组，容量难以有效利用。
Method: TaSQ 定制 VQ 目标空间，包含三个变换：query 引导的通道加权 (query-guided channel weighting)、跨头归一化 (cross-head normalization)、协方差感知通道分组 (covariance-aware channel grouping)，以反映缓存激活的误差敏感度与统计结构；变换与 RoPE 兼容，可并入投影权重与码本，保留常规 VQ 查表结构。
Result: 在通用、长链式思维 (long-chain-of-thought) 推理与长上下文检索基准上，TaSQ 一致优于现有低比特 KV cache VQ 基线并保持推理稳定性；单张 RTX 6000 Ada GPU 上其 SGLang 实现支持最大 14× 批量，峰值吞吐较 BF16 基线高 1.87×。
Conclusion: 1-bit KV cache 量化的瓶颈在于目标空间与误差敏感度不匹配，定制该空间即可在几乎不增加服务开销的前提下同时提升压缩质量与推理服务吞吐。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Verifiable, Articulable, and Tacit Components of Preference
papers.abstract_en: What makes a short story gripping; a news article newsworthy; or a math proof elegant? These constructs resist articulation or verification; their meaning is at least partially tacit. However, modern AI models are improved primarily via articulated constitutions, rubrics and verifiers (i.e. in RLAIF and RLVR); tacit components of preferences are typically understudied. We introduce a large, labeled preference dataset CreativePreferences, containing 2.8M texts labeled by 317M human preference judgments across 7 creative domains, with 42 benchmark tasks. We model these labels with executable programs, rubric banks and densely trained models (V, A and VAT, respectively). We observe robust articulability gaps, VAT-VA; and verifiability gaps, VAT-V; we estimate upper and lower bounds for each gap with a novel measurement approach that discovers articulable and verifiable metrics, identifies spurious variables and estimates the value of undiscovered metrics using capture-recapture. These gaps occur across all domains, even in domains traditionally treated as fully verifiable: correctness-centered domains (i.e. mathematics and software engineering) and claim- and novelty-centric domains (i.e. news, patents, peer review). The size of the gap varies based on domain (e.g. peer review and creative writing have the largest articulability gaps) and widens as more people take part in the judgment, consistent with Collins' collective tacit knowledge. We show two consequences: (1) on human generations, the full model more closely matches human preferences, often in disagreement with articulated criteria, and (2) in an analogy to Goodhart's law, articulating preference shifts it away from the tacit dimension. Articulability and verifiability gaps are consequential; we give recommendations on when tasks can be prompted; how learning mechanisms might improve; and when to leave judgments with humans.
papers.comment: 15 pages main text, 14 pages of references, 107-page appendix (136 pages total); 15 figures, 48 tables; 213 references
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 CreativePreferences：280 万条文本、3.17 亿次人类偏好判断、覆盖 7 个创意领域与 42 项基准任务，用可执行程序、评分细则库和稠密训练模型分别建模偏好中可验证 (V)、可表述 (A) 与整体 (VAT) 三部分，发现可表述性差距 (VAT−A) 与可验证性差距 (VAT−V) 在所有领域稳健存在，且随参与判断人数增加而扩大。
Motivation: RLAIF 与 RLVR 主要靠明文 constitution、rubric 和 verifier 改进模型，但偏好的部分含义是 tacit 的、既难表述也难验证；这一部分长期缺少测量手段，导致以明文标准优化可能系统性偏离真实人类偏好。
Method: 构建 CreativePreferences 标注数据集（2.8M 文本、317M 人类偏好判断、7 个创意领域、42 个 benchmark 任务），分别用 executable programs、rubric banks 和 densely trained models 建出 V、A、VAT 三个模型；用一套新测量方法估计各差距的上下界，包括自动发现可表述与可验证指标、识别 spurious variables，并用 capture-recapture 估计尚未发现指标的价值。
Result: 在全部领域都观察到稳健的 articulability gap (VAT−A) 与 verifiability gap (VAT−V)，包括通常被视为完全可验证的数学与软件工程等 correctness-centered 领域，以及新闻、专利、同行评审等 claim- 与 novelty-centric 领域；差距大小随领域变化，peer review 与 creative writing 的 articulability gap 最大，且随参与判断的人数增多而变宽，与 Collins 的 collective tacit knowledge 一致。两项后果：在人类生成文本上完整模型更贴近人类偏好、常与明文标准相悖；类比 Goodhart 定律，把偏好表述出来会把它推离 tacit 维度。
Conclusion: 偏好中存在无法完全表述或验证的成分，且其规模随领域与评审人数变化，因此何时可以靠 prompt 规定任务、学习机制如何改进、以及何时应把判断留给人类，需要按差距大小分别决定。

papers.title: ReSCUE: Re-translation with Sentence Commitment for Unsegmented Long-Form Simultaneous Sign Language Translation
papers.abstract_en: Simultaneous Sign Language Translation (SLT) is critical for real-time communication, yet existing methods remain largely confined to sentence-level, offline settings that assume pre-segmented inputs. These assumptions hinder deployment in realistic scenarios involving continuous, unsegmented video streams. We present ReSCUE, a unified framework for simultaneous SLT on unsegmented long-form sign language videos that aligns training and inference with realistic streaming conditions. ReSCUE combines inference-aware training to handle partial inputs, non-signing pauses, and multi-sentence contexts, stabilized re-translation to enable low-latency yet revisable predictions with reduced output flicker, and a sentence commitment mechanism for online segmentation and memory management. Experiments on standard sentence-level benchmarks show that ReSCUE achieves lower latency and the best translation quality under low-latency settings. On long-form unsegmented datasets, ReSCUE approaches the translation quality of oracle offline systems that use ground-truth sentence boundaries, while operating at substantially lower latency, demonstrating its practicality for real-world streaming scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReSCUE 把同声手语翻译 (simultaneous SLT) 从预切句的离线设定搬到未切分长视频流：用 inference-aware training 处理部分输入与非手势停顿，用稳定化重翻译压低输出抖动，再用句子承诺机制在线切句并管理记忆。在标准句级基准上它在低延迟设置下取得最佳翻译质量与更低延迟；在长格式未切分数据上逼近使用真值句边界的 oracle 离线系统质量，同时延迟大幅降低。
Motivation: 现有同声 SLT 假设输入已按句切分且可离线处理，无法直接用于连续、未切分的视频流，训练与推理条件也不一致。
Method: ReSCUE 是统一框架，含三部分：inference-aware training 让训练看到部分输入、非手势停顿与多句上下文；stabilized re-translation 在低延迟下允许改写预测并减少输出 flicker；sentence commitment 机制负责在线句子分割与记忆管理。
Result: 在标准句级基准上，ReSCUE 在低延迟设置下取得更低延迟与最佳翻译质量；在长格式未切分数据集上，其翻译质量接近使用真值句边界的 oracle 离线系统，而延迟显著更低。
Conclusion: 训练与推理对齐流式条件、配合可改写的重翻译与在线切句，可以在未切分长视频上把同声 SLT 做到接近离线质量的低延迟实时翻译。

papers.title: DyadMem: A Long-Term Memory Benchmark of How Agents Work with Users
papers.abstract_en: Long-term agents must remember not only what is true about a user, but also how a particular agent should work with that user as their shared history evolves. Existing benchmarks primarily supervise user facts and preferences or experience reusable across users, leaving this relationship-specific agent memory implicit. Additionally, most prior works measure the model solely with final-answer QA over long interaction histories, making the assessment still incomplete and unreliable. To this end, we introduce DyadMem with the proposed new definition User-conditioned Relational Agent Memory (URAM). DyadMem jointly annotates user-side memory and URAM along the same multi-session trajectories, resulting in 6 memory categories. To summarize, it includes 3,065 episodes, 50,961 sessions, and 61,210 QA instances, with extensive session-level Capture and Update gold annotations, query-level Recall support, and two QA settings: Gold-Memory and Full-Pipeline. Across 16 open-weight and 4 proprietary models, Gold-Memory QA is consistently strong, yet Full-Pipeline QA drops sharply. Such a gap explicitly supports our fine-grained evaluation design. Additionally, several quantitative results further reveal low Capture recall, incomplete Recall, and unsafe-deletion issues arising from even the frontier LLMs. We further conduct a rigorous experiment to validate the effectiveness of our URAM and observe the positive effects for all 20 models. In summary, DyadMem is a dual-domain, full-pipeline memory benchmark with extensive annotation efforts for advancing the domain's development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DyadMem 提出 User-conditioned Relational Agent Memory (URAM) 定义并构建双领域长程记忆基准，在同一批多会话轨迹上同时标注用户侧记忆与关系型 agent 记忆，共 6 类记忆、3,065 episodes、50,961 sessions、61,210 QA。Gold-Memory QA 在 16 个开源与 4 个专有模型上普遍表现良好，而 Full-Pipeline QA 大幅下滑，且前沿 LLM 仍出现低 Capture recall、不完整 Recall 与不安全删除。
Motivation: 现有基准只监督跨用户可复用的用户事实、偏好或经验，把「该 agent 如何与该用户协作」的关系型记忆留为隐式；且多数工作只用长交互历史上的最终答案 QA 打分，评估不完整也不可靠。
Method: 提出 URAM 定义，在同一批多会话轨迹上联合标注用户侧记忆与 URAM，形成 6 类记忆；带 session 级 Capture 与 Update 的 gold 标注、query 级 Recall 支持，并设 Gold-Memory 与 Full-Pipeline 两种 QA 设置，覆盖 16 个开源与 4 个专有模型。
Result: 基准含 3,065 episodes、50,961 sessions、61,210 QA 实例；Gold-Memory QA 在 16 个开源与 4 个专有模型上一致较强，Full-Pipeline QA 则大幅下降；定量结果揭示前沿 LLM 存在低 Capture recall、不完整 Recall 与不安全删除；URAM 的有效性实验在全部 20 个模型上均呈正向效果。
Conclusion: 把关系型 agent 记忆显式标注并分环节（Capture/Update/Recall）评测，能暴露只看最终答案 QA 掩盖的失败；URAM 对全部 20 个模型都有正向作用，说明该记忆维度值得单独建模。

papers.title: Signal Simplification Is Not Predictive Simplification: Diagnosing Residual Neural Forecasting in Short-Horizon Volatility
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid statistical-neural pipelines often assume that a successful statistical first stage leaves a cleaner and more learnable residual target. We examine that assumption in short-horizon volatility forecasting through a signal-forecast-system diagnostic framework. Across five liquid U.S. assets, a volatility-aligned HAR-style model outperforms AR, MA, and ARIMA. Within expanding training windows, the pre-standardization fitted residual process used to construct residual-LSTM sequences has about 82% lower variance than the corresponding target and near-zero lag-1 autocorrelation; independently, rolling pseudo-out-of-sample HAR errors show about 74% variance reduction and similarly weak lag-1 dependence. Residual-only LSTM augmentation nevertheless raises mean squared error from 0.3049 to 0.3594 on average, with deterioration on every asset. Pure LSTM records the lowest selected pseudo-out-of-sample MSE, 0.2649, while the residual hybrid requires substantially more end-to-end runtime without improving accuracy. We describe this pattern as forecaster-preconditioner asymmetry: first-stage forecasting success and statistical residual simplification need not translate into useful downstream neural preconditioning.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 10th Computational Methods in Systems and Software (CoMeSySo 2026). 17 pages, 4 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在五个流动性美国资产的短时波动率预测中，HAR 式一阶段确实把残差压得又白又小（方差降约 82%、lag-1 自相关近零），但把该残差喂给 residual-LSTM 反而使 MSE 从 0.3049 升到 0.3594，且每个资产都变差。作者称之为 forecaster-preconditioner asymmetry：统计残差简化不等于下游神经网络更易学习，纯 LSTM 反而取得最低的伪样本外 MSE 0.2649。
Motivation: 混合统计-神经流水线普遍假设一阶段预测成功会留下更干净、更可学的残差目标，这一前提在短时波动率预测中从未被直接检验。
Method: 提出 signal-forecast-system 诊断框架：先在五个流动性美国资产上比较 volatility-aligned HAR 与 AR、MA、ARIMA，再用扩张训练窗内预标准化的 HAR 拟合残差构造 residual-LSTM 序列，与滚动伪样本外 HAR 误差的方差和 lag-1 自相关分别度量，并对比纯 LSTM 与 residual 混合模型的端到端运行时间。
Result: HAR 式模型优于 AR、MA、ARIMA；预标准化拟合残差方差比目标低约 82%、lag-1 自相关近零，滚动伪样本外 HAR 误差方差降约 74% 且 lag-1 依赖同样弱。residual-only LSTM 使平均 MSE 从 0.3049 升至 0.3594，五个资产全部恶化；纯 LSTM 取得最低的选定伪样本外 MSE 0.2649，residual 混合模型端到端运行时间显著更长且精度未提升。
Conclusion: 一阶段预测成功与统计残差简化并不自动转化为有效的下游神经预条件，残差白化应被当作需要单独验证的假设而非默认收益。

summary_sections.result: HAR 式模型优于 AR、MA、ARIMA；预标准化拟合残差方差比目标低约 82%、lag-1 自相关近零，滚动伪样本外 HAR 误差方差降约 74% 且 lag-1 依赖同样弱。residual-only LSTM 使平均 MSE 从 0.3049 升至 0.3594，五个资产全部恶化；纯 LSTM 取得最低的选定伪样本外 MSE 0.2649，residual 混合模型端到端运行时间显著更长且精度未提升。
summary_sections.conclusion: 一阶段预测成功与统计残差简化并不自动转化为有效的下游神经预条件，残差白化应被当作需要单独验证的假设而非默认收益。

papers.title: Personalized Automatic Speech Recognition for a Dysarthric and Tracheostomic Speaker using Artificial Conversations
papers.abstract_en: This work presents an automatic speech recognition (ASR) system personalized for a Czech speaker with a permanent tracheal stoma and severe dysarthria rendering their speech unintelligible to untrained listeners. We release a public dataset containing 33 annotated hours of the speaker's speech, collected using a novel "artificial conversation" protocol designed for high engagement and dialogue realism. We propose a multi-stage training pipeline based on Whisper Base: fine-tuning on standard Czech speech, acoustically simulated tracheostomic speech, and the speaker's data. We evaluate the system across three near real-time scenarios: scripted conversations, question answering, and spontaneous dialogue, achieving a 50\% relative reduction in Character Error Rate compared to Whisper Base baseline and surpassing the average recognition accuracy of their assistants in acoustic recognition of isolated utterances. We demonstrate that even for severely impeded speech, a helpful ASR is achievable, as evidenced by the quantitative results and the feedback from the speaker.
papers.comment: 8 pages, three figures, to be published in IEEE Speech Language Technology workshop 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对一位带永久气管造口、重度构音障碍 (dysarthria) 的捷克语说话人，提出基于 Whisper Base 的多阶段个性化 ASR：先在标准捷克语上微调，再用声学模拟的气管造口语音，最后用该说话人数据。在脚本对话、问答、自发对话三个近实时场景上，相对 Whisper Base 基线的字符错误率 (CER) 下降 50%，孤立语句的声学识别准确率超过其助手的平均水平。
Motivation: 重度构音障碍加气管造口的语音对未经训练的听者完全不可懂，通用 ASR 无法服务这类说话人，而以往缺少可用的个性化数据与采集协议。
Method: 提出多阶段训练流程，以 Whisper Base 为起点依次微调标准捷克语、声学模拟的气管造口语音、以及说话人本人数据；数据用新提出的 artificial conversation 采集协议获得，并发布含 33 小时标注语音的公开数据集。
Result: 在脚本对话、问答、自发对话三个近实时场景上，相对 Whisper Base 基线实现 50% 的 CER 相对下降；孤立语句的声学识别准确率超过该说话人助手的平均水平；发布 33 小时标注数据集。
Conclusion: 即使对严重受阻的语音，通过多阶段个性化训练也能得到有帮助的 ASR，量化结果与说话人反馈共同支持这一结论。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: From Expression to Reaction: Role-aware Visual Transfer and Stimulus-guided Reasoning for Interlocutor Emotion Recognition
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a Role-aware Stimulus-guided (RASG) framework for interlocutor emotion recognition, which predicts listener emotions from listener-only videos and speaker-only audios. RASG consists of Role-aware Visual Transfer (RVT) and Stimulus-guided Boundary Reasoning (SBR) modules, which address supervision mismatch due to the lack of labeled listener data and ambiguity among visually similar listener reactions whose interpretation depends on speaker context, respectively. More specifically, RVT selects speaker samples whose facial expressions support their emotion labels. It then filters listener tracks and uses reliable pseudo-labels to train a listener-centric visual expert. SBR uses a two-class language reasoner only when the visual model is uncertain. It treats speaker audio and text as context rather than direct emotion evidence to distinguish similar listener reactions. Experiments conducted on MER-Cross dataset shows that RASG achieves 76.25\% on MER-Cross and improves the performance of the baseline over 17\%. Our team ranks second in Track 1 (MER-Cross) of the MER Grand Challenge at ACM MM 2026.
papers.comment: Technical report of the second-place solution in Track 1 (MER-Cross) of the MER Grand Challenge at ACM MM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对只有听众视频、说话人音频的对话情绪识别，提出 RASG 框架：用角色感知视觉迁移 (RVT) 从说话人样本筛出表情与标签一致的可靠伪标签训练听众视觉专家，再用刺激引导边界推理 (SBR) 在视觉模型不确定时以两分类语言推理器把说话人音频与文本当上下文而非直接情绪证据，区分外观相似的听众反应。在 MER-Cross 上达到 76.25%，比基线提升超过 17%，获 ACM MM 2026 MER Grand Challenge Track 1 第二名。
Motivation: 听众侧缺少标注数据造成监督不匹配，且听众反应在视觉上彼此相似、其含义依赖说话人语境，仅凭听众视频无法区分。
Method: RASG 含两个模块：RVT 先挑选面部表情支持其情绪标签的说话人样本，过滤听众轨迹并用可靠伪标签训练 listener-centric 视觉专家；SBR 仅在视觉模型不确定时启用两分类语言推理器，把说话人音频与文本作为上下文而非直接情绪证据来判定相似反应。
Result: 在 MER-Cross 数据集上 RASG 取得 76.25%，相对基线提升超过 17%；团队获 ACM MM 2026 MER Grand Challenge Track 1 (MER-Cross) 第二名。
Conclusion: 以可靠伪标签迁移视觉知识、并在不确定时用说话人语境做边界推理，可以在无听众标注的条件下有效识别听众情绪。

papers.title: OmniAct3D: Leveraging Foundation Geometry and Evidence-Grounded Reasoning for Panoramic 3D Detection
papers.abstract_en: Accurate 3D detection is essential for mobile embodied agents, while Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) offer transferable visual and geometric priors. Yet existing VFM-based 3D detectors rely on narrow-view monocular images or discrete perspective views, limiting coherent surround perception; equirectangular projection (ERP) instead encodes a continuous 360 scene in a single image. Direct transfer remains difficult because ERP organizes geometry and visual information differently, making object-relevant cues hard to model, localize, and preserve. We propose OmniAct3D, a framework that adapts perspective-trained VFM detectors to ERP while preserving transferable VFM priors. To resolve geometric mismatch, the ERP-Ray Geometry Adapter (ERGA-Ray) models spherical viewing rays and periodic spatial structure. To localize evidence in scene-wide context, the Visual-Action Reasoning Chain (VARC) grounds each hypothesis in relevant panoramic evidence and converts it into a structured geometric action. To recover local cues lost under fixed token budgets, the Appearance-Guided Heading Expert (AGHE) re-encodes object regions at higher resolution for heading estimation. Experiments show that OmniAct3D improves over the previous best 3D detector by 2.96 NDS points on Spheriverse and over the unadapted VFM baseline by 24.87 mAP points on PanoMMOcc. With target-specific geometry adaptation, VARC retains 95--98% of the same-configuration mAP, indicating reusable object-level 3D reasoning across sensing configurations. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/FeiT-FeiTeng/OmniAct3D.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OmniAct3D 把透视视角训练的视觉基础模型 (VFM) 3D 检测器迁移到等距柱状投影 (ERP) 全景图上，用 ERGA-Ray 建模球面射线与周期空间结构、VARC 把假设锚定到全景证据并转成结构化几何动作、AGHE 以更高分辨率重编码目标区域估计朝向。在 Spheriverse 上 NDS 比此前最好 3D 检测器高 2.96 点，在 PanoMMOcc 上比未适配的 VFM 基线 mAP 高 24.87 点。
Motivation: 现有基于 VFM 的 3D 检测器只吃窄视单目或离散透视视图，无法形成连贯的环视感知；直接把它们搬到 ERP 上又因几何与视觉信息组织方式不同而难以建模、定位和保留目标线索。
Method: 三个组件协同：ERGA-Ray 适配器显式建模球面观测射线与周期空间结构以化解几何失配；Visual-Action Reasoning Chain (VARC) 在全景上下文中为每个假设检索相关证据并转成结构化几何动作；Appearance-Guided Heading Expert (AGHE) 在固定 token 预算下对目标区域重编码以高分辨率估计朝向。
Result: Spheriverse 上 NDS 超过此前最佳 3D 检测器 2.96 点；PanoMMOcc 上 mAP 比未适配的 VFM 基线高 24.87 点；在目标特定几何适配下，VARC 保留同配置 mAP 的 95–98%。
Conclusion: 把几何适配与证据锚定的推理链分开处理，透视 VFM 的目标级 3D 推理可以在不同全景传感配置间复用，而不必整体重训。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Beyond Predefined Sinks: Security-Aware Dependency Analysis for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-based agents increasingly connect model-generated decisions to security-sensitive software capabilities such as command execution, filesystem access, network communication, browser control, and external tools. Existing analyses often use predefined sensitive operations as anchors, but operation identity alone is insufficient to determine security implications. We present AgentSecGraph, a security-aware static analysis framework that constructs a candidate-centered Security-Aware Agent Dependency Graph (Security-ADG) for each security-sensitive operation. It augments operation identity with agent relevance, source and dependency evidence, trust-boundary context, guard evidence, and external-effect semantics. We further introduce AgentSecBench, a corpus of 67 real-world LLM-agent repositories spanning 11 ecosystems and 37,542 source files. The current analyzer identifies 23,866 static security-sensitive operation candidates across 65 repositories and emits one Security-ADG artifact per candidate. Corpus-wide analysis recovers source-to-operation dependency evidence for 9,821 candidates (41.15%) and potential guard evidence for 3,075 (12.88%), completing in 50.8 minutes. Using a separate reproduction-backed evaluation layer, we establish 22 security-sensitive behaviors across 13 repositories: one confirmed vulnerability, one pending disclosure candidate, and 20 guarded behaviors. In nine held-out cases, Security-ADG preserves 91.1% of the reference context and all five observed guards, compared with 20.0% for a sink-only view and 40.0% for a simplified ADG. These results show that security-aware dependency and contextual evidence enable distinctions that cannot be recovered from sensitive-operation identity alone.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 3 figures, including supplementary appendices. Preprint
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentSecGraph 为 LLM agent 的每个敏感操作构建以候选为中心的 Security-Aware Agent Dependency Graph，把操作身份与 agent 相关性、依赖证据、信任边界、guard 证据和外部效果语义结合。在 67 个真实仓库语料上，9,821 个候选（41.15%）恢复了源到操作的依赖证据，3,075 个（12.88%）有 guard 证据，50.8 分钟跑完；九个留出案例中 Security-ADG 保留 91.1% 参考上下文与全部五个 guard，sink-only 视图仅 20.0%、简化 ADG 40.0%。
Motivation: 现有 LLM agent 安全分析以预定义敏感操作为锚点，但仅凭操作身份无法判定其安全含义，缺少依赖与上下文证据。
Method: 提出 AgentSecGraph：为每个安全敏感操作构建候选中心的 Security-ADG，在操作身份之上补充 agent relevance、源与依赖证据、trust-boundary 上下文、guard 证据与外部效果语义；配套发布 AgentSecBench 语料与独立的 reproduction-backed 评估层。
Result: AgentSecBench 含 67 个真实 LLM-agent 仓库、11 个生态、37,542 个源文件；分析器在 65 个仓库识别 23,866 个静态敏感操作候选，为每个候选产出一个 Security-ADG。全语料恢复 9,821 个候选（41.15%）的源到操作依赖证据、3,075 个（12.88%）的潜在 guard 证据，耗时 50.8 分钟。评估层在 13 个仓库确立 22 个安全敏感行为：1 个已确认漏洞、1 个待披露候选、20 个有 guard 的行为。九个留出案例中 Security-ADG 保留 91.1% 参考上下文与全部五个观测 guard，sink-only 视图 20.0%、简化 ADG 40.0%。
Conclusion: 安全感知的依赖与上下文证据能做出仅凭敏感操作身份无法实现的区分，因此安全分析不应停在预定义 sink 上。

papers.title: RYOPO: Bringing End-to-End Category-Level Object Pose Estimation into Real Time
papers.abstract_en: Category-level object pose estimation predicts the rotation, translation, and metric size of unseen instances within known categories. Many accurate RGB-D methods rely on external instance segmentation and crop-based pose estimation, introducing separate stages and object-dependent processing costs that hinder real-time inference. To bring accurate pose estimation into real time, we present \ours{}, an end-to-end trainable query-based RGB-D set predictor. It jointly detects and segments objects and estimates their \mbox{9-DoF} poses without explicit CAD-derived shape priors or a separately trained instance segmentor. Shared image and scene encoding avoids repeated per-object crop encoding. A query-conditioned geometry pathway associates observed 3D points and RGB features with object queries and incorporates shared scene context. Object-centric refinement uses the resulting point descriptors to update an explicit pose state through pose-conditioned cross-attention and recurrent residual corrections. On NOCS, \ours{} substantially improves on published RGB-D joint detection and pose estimation results. It achieves competitive performance compared with two-stage methods under all-object evaluation on REAL275 and HouseCat6D, while enabling real-time full-frame pose estimation at $31.8$ FPS on an RTX~A6000. Project page: https://yopo-series.github.io/RYOPO-project-page/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RYOPO 是端到端可训练的 query-based RGB-D 集合预测器，把类别级物体检测、分割与 9-DoF 位姿估计合到一次前向里，共享图像与场景编码避免逐物体 crop 重编码。在 NOCS 上显著改进已发表的 RGB-D 联合检测与位姿结果，并在 REAL275 与 HouseCat6D 的 all-object 评测中达到与两阶段方法相当的精度，同时在 RTX A6000 上以 31.8 FPS 实现全帧实时位姿估计。
Motivation: 准确的 RGB-D 类别级位姿方法依赖外部实例分割与逐物体 crop 处理，阶段分离且推理成本随物体数增长，难以实时。
Method: 端到端 query-based RGB-D set predictor：共享图像与场景编码，query-conditioned geometry pathway 把 3D 点与 RGB 特征关联到 object query 并引入共享场景上下文，object-centric refinement 用点描述子经 pose-conditioned cross-attention 与 recurrent residual corrections 更新显式位姿状态；不使用 CAD 形状先验，也不需要单独训练的实例分割器。

papers.title: Rethinking Fixed Temporal Grids: Frequency-Disentangled Motion Generation
papers.abstract_en: Most human motion generation methods encode motion as tokens on a uniform temporal grid, where every token spans the same fixed time window. Human motion, however, is temporally heterogeneous: slowly evolving global trajectories coexist with rapid transient events such as foot contacts and joint impulses. Forcing such multi-scale dynamics onto tokens of identical temporal resolution entangles motion frequencies, leaving slow regions redundant while smoothing out the rapid details that distinguish realistic motion. We propose \textbf{FreqMo}, a scale-adaptive motion representation that decomposes motion into wavelet frequency bands, separating dynamics across temporal scales while preserving temporal localization and exact reconstruction. Unified Frequency Residual Quantization (UFRQ) then encodes all bands within a single shared codebook, compressing the token sequence threefold and enabling stable single-stage generation. Experiments show FreqMo attains SOTA fidelity with substantially improved high-frequency preservation, and the same decomposition transfers to continuous diffusion backbones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FreqMo 把人体运动按小波频带分解成尺度自适应表示，慢变全局轨迹与快速瞬态事件（触地、关节冲击）分离开，再用统一频率残差量化 (UFRQ) 把所有频带压进单一共享码表，token 序列压缩三倍并支持单阶段生成。实验达到 SOTA 保真度且高频保留明显改善，同一分解可迁移到连续 diffusion backbone。
Motivation: 均匀时间网格让每个 token 覆盖相同时间窗，把多尺度运动动力学压到同一分辨率上，导致慢变区域冗余、快速细节被平滑掉，运动频率纠缠。
Method: FreqMo 用小波频带分解运动，在保持时间局部性与精确重建的同时分离各时间尺度的动力学；UFRQ 在单一共享码表内编码全部频带，压缩 token 序列三倍，实现稳定的单阶段生成；同一分解可迁移到连续 diffusion backbone。
Result: 实验中 FreqMo 达到 SOTA 保真度，高频保留显著改善；token 序列压缩三倍；该分解可迁移到连续 diffusion backbone。
Conclusion: 把运动表示从固定时间网格改为频带解耦的尺度自适应编码，能在压缩 token 序列的同时保住区分真实运动的快速细节。

papers.title: AvoKV-E: Payload-Aware KV Cache Eviction for Long Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Long-output reasoning shifts the KV-cache bottleneck from the fixed prompt to the generated trace. Existing reasoning-cache eviction methods largely treat cached entries as routing objects, estimating whether an old key will still be read, will recur, or can be replaced. This routing-only view overlooks two effects: low-attention entries can carry large value payloads whose removal changes future predictions, and newly generated states can appear stale before later queries have had a chance to read them. We introduce AvoKV-E, a training-free eviction policy that first delays eligibility for recent states and then ranks eligible entries using candidate-normalized read pressure, key redundancy, and value-payload potential. According to empirical evaluation across different models and datasets, AvoKV-E matches or exceeds redundancy-aware, recurrence-based, and thought-adaptive eviction baselines at matched active-KV budgets, with its largest gains in the tightest-cache regime. Component and counterfactual analyses further connect these gains to delayed observation, payload-aware scoring, redundancy, and scale-robust normalization. Together, the results show that long-reasoning KV eviction should preserve not only keys that are likely to be read, but also the value payloads that sustain the reasoning trajectory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AvoKV-E 是面向长推理 KV cache 淘汰的免训练策略：先延迟新生成状态的淘汰资格，再按候选归一化读压力、key 冗余与 value 载荷潜力给可淘汰项排序。在多模型多数据集的经验评估中，它在同等 active-KV 预算下追平或超过冗余感知、复发式与 thought-adaptive 淘汰基线，且在最紧 cache 预算下增益最大。
Motivation: 长输出推理把 KV cache 瓶颈从固定 prompt 转移到生成轨迹上；现有淘汰方法只把缓存项当路由对象，忽略低注意力项可能携带大 value 载荷、以及新状态可能在被后续查询读取前就被误判为过期这两个效应。
Method: AvoKV-E 免训练，分两步：先对最近生成的状态延迟其可淘汰资格（delayed observation），再对合格项用候选归一化读压力、key 冗余和 value-payload 潜力三项打分排序；并做组件与反事实分析归因各机制贡献。
Result: 在不同模型与数据集的经验评估中，同等 active-KV 预算下 AvoKV-E 追平或超过 redundancy-aware、recurrence-based 与 thought-adaptive 淘汰基线，最紧 cache 预算下增益最大；组件与反事实分析把增益归因于延迟观察、载荷感知打分、冗余与尺度鲁棒归一化。
Conclusion: 长推理的 KV 淘汰不应只保留可能被读到的 key，还要保留支撑推理轨迹的 value 载荷；缓存越紧张，载荷感知与延迟淘汰越关键。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Recursive Self-Improvement in Unified Multimodal Models
papers.abstract_en: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) understand and generate both text and images, which lets a model produce its own training data. Existing self-improvement in UMMs keeps supervision on the visual side, where image understanding judges image generation. We propose recursive cross-capability self-improvement (RSI), a training loop in which the text and visual abilities of a UMM supply training data for one another. In each round, the model generates images and reads them to find where it falls short. It then writes programs aimed at these shortcomings, and execution verifies every result against its specification. Verified renders train image generation, while labeled renders and the model's own correct programs train visual understanding and program writing. Program execution thus acts as a source of truth outside the model, so errors do not accumulate across rounds. We study RSI on charts and build BasicChartBench to evaluate open models early in training. On requests worded differently from training, four rounds of RSI raise the score from 45.7% to 60.2%, while continued training stays at 46.3%. Verified construction carries most of the gain, and targeting the model's failures adds 3.5%. Along the way, the share of verified programs rises from 48.9% to 95.2%, and the reader's accuracy on edited renders rises from 55.6% to 87.4%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出递归跨能力自我提升 (RSI)：统一多模态模型每轮先生成图像并读图找短板，再写程序、用程序执行结果作为模型外的真值来源，验证通过的渲染反过来训练图像生成，带标注的渲染与模型自己写对的程序训练读图与写程序。在图表任务上四轮 RSI 把改写请求上的分数从 45.7% 提到 60.2%，而继续训练停在 46.3%。
Motivation: 现有 UMM 自我提升只在视觉侧做监督（用图像理解去评判图像生成），能力之间没有互相供给数据，且缺少模型外的真值来源，错误会随轮次累积。
Method: RSI 训练循环：模型生成图像并读图定位不足，针对不足写程序，程序执行按 specification 核验每个结果；验证通过的渲染训练图像生成，带标注渲染与模型自己写对的程序训练视觉理解与程序编写。研究落在图表领域，并构建 BasicChartBench 用于在训练早期评估开源模型。
Result: 在与训练措辞不同的请求上，四轮 RSI 分数 45.7% → 60.2%，同期继续训练为 46.3%；其中验证式构造贡献大部分增益，针对模型自身失败再加 3.5%。通过验证的程序占比 48.9% → 95.2%，reader 在编辑后渲染上的准确率 55.6% → 87.4%。
Conclusion: 让两种能力互供数据、并用程序执行作为模型外真值，可以在多轮递归中持续提升 UMM 且不让误差累积；针对自身失败的定向数据只在已验证构造之上再贡献 3.5%。

papers.title: Neural Data Needs Semantic Tokenization: Behavioral Events as Boundaries of Session-Transferable Tokens
papers.abstract_en: Extracellular electrophysiology records a different set of neurons in every session. Neural foundation models embed each neuron and each session into their tokens, so every new session is an input they have never seen, and they fail to generalize to it. A tokenizer for new sessions needs a unit that every session shares and that carries behavior. Population activity offers such a unit. It evolves on a low-dimensional manifold that persists across neuronal turnover and across animals once sessions are aligned. This manifold changes regime at task events such as stimulus onset and movement onset. Within each regime the population occupies a state, the part of the manifold it spans between two events, and each state carries its own behavioral meaning. We propose Tokenization with States (TWS), which segments each trial, one repetition of the task, at these events and converts every state into tokens of population geometry, with no neuron or session embedding. On held-out International Brain Laboratory (IBL) sessions, TWS decodes movement even from regime boundaries that carry no information about the target, while a per-neuron foundation model pretrained on those sessions decodes at chance. Frozen after training on mice alone, TWS transfers to macaques and Utah arrays with only a linear probe. On reach direction, a target that its boundaries do not define, it achieves a Matthews correlation of 0.23, where the event time alone achieves $0.01$. For cross-session generalization, the token matters more than the model on top.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 神经基础模型因每个 session 记录的神经元不同而无法泛化，提出 Tokenization with States (TWS)：按任务事件（刺激起始、运动起始）把每个 trial 切成 regime，把每个 state 编成群体几何 token，完全不用 neuron/session embedding。在留出的 IBL session 上，TWS 能从不携带目标信息的 regime 边界解码运动，而同批 session 上预训练的 per-neuron foundation model 只有随机水平；仅用小鼠训练并冻结后，靠一个线性探针迁移到猕猴与 Utah 阵列，reach direction 上 Matthews 相关 0.23（仅事件时间为 0.01）。
Motivation: 胞外电生理每个 session 记录到的是不同的一组神经元，神经基础模型把每个 neuron 和 session 都编成 token，新 session 就是从未见过的输入，跨 session 泛化失败。需要一个所有 session 共享、且携带行为含义的 token 单位。
Method: TWS (Tokenization with States)：利用对齐后跨神经元更替、跨个体仍保持的低维群体流形，按任务事件把每个 trial 切成 regime，每个 regime 内群体占据一个 state；把每个 state 转成群体几何 (population geometry) 的 token，不引入任何 neuron 或 session embedding。
Result: 在留出的 International Brain Laboratory (IBL) session 上，TWS 能从不携带目标信息的 regime 边界解码运动，而在这批 session 上预训练的 per-neuron foundation model 解码处于随机水平。训练仅用小鼠并冻结后，TWS 迁移到猕猴与 Utah 阵列只需一个线性探针；在边界并不定义的 reach direction 上 Matthews correlation 0.23，仅事件时间基线为 0.01。
Conclusion: 跨 session 泛化中 token 的构造比其上的模型更重要：以行为事件为边界的 state token 不依赖具体神经元身份，因而可跨 session、跨个体、跨设备迁移。
Relevance: 1
