papers.title: Temporal Geometry of Deep Networks: Hyperbolic Representations of Training Dynamics for Intrinsic Explainability
papers.abstract_en: Intrinsic explainability remains a challenging problem, particularly in contexts where multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) require dynamic re-training within an optimization environment. This paper investigates how MLPs and their training dynamics can be represented and studied in non-Euclidean spaces; our representation features the Poincaré model of hyperbolic geometry. We aim to capture the geometric evolution of their weighted topology and self-organization over time. Instead of restricting the analysis to single checkpoints---as per established measure-based explainability methods---we construct temporal \textit{parameter graphs}, i.e., snapshots over time $T$ steps of the optimization/training process for MLPs. This reflects the view that neural networks encode information not only in their weights but also in the trajectory traced during training. Drawing on the idea that many complex networks admit embeddings in hidden metric spaces where distances correspond to connection likelihood, we present a geometric and temporal graph-based metalearning framework for obtaining dynamic hyperbolic representations of the underlying neural parameter graphs. Our model embeds temporal parameter graphs in the Poincaré model ball, and learns from them while maintaining equivariance to within-snapshot neuron permutations and invariance to permutations of past snapshots. In doing so, the approach preserves functional equivalence over time and recovers the latent evolving geometry of the network. Experiments on regression and classification tasks with trained MLPs show strong meta-network performance, accompanied by hyperbolic temporal representations. This reveals how the network structure emerges over time under specific training environments, thus providing insights into the network's self-organization.

papers.title: Sentry: Learning to Recover from LLM Agent Failures at Test Time
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents often fail mid-task due to invalid tool calls, repeated actions, or poorly grounded reasoning, and learning from these failures is a path to reliability. We find that how failure knowledge reaches the agent matters as much as what it contains. Failure lessons are conditional: kept in the agent's context, they misfire when their failure is absent, and removing them from an evolving playbook improves performance. Runtime interventions, in contrast, act only when a failure occurs but do not learn from their repairs. We argue that failure knowledge is conditional knowledge and should be conditionally exposed, and instantiate this principle in Sentry, a failure-management layer that runs alongside the agent. When Sentry detects a failure, it retrieves matching lessons from an external playbook to guide recovery, verifies without access to task rewards whether the agent recovered, and stores a new lesson only if it did; the full playbook never enters the agent's context. Across multiple agentic benchmarks, Sentry outperforms the strongest runtime-intervention baseline on every benchmark, by 37\% on average, and the strongest context-evolution baseline by 39\% on the two benchmarks where both are evaluated; combining Sentry with context evolution yields further gains. Learned lessons transfer to held-out tasks, and controlled experiments show that exposing the full playbook to the agent lowers performance even when relevant lessons remain available on demand.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Sentry 把失败教训当作条件知识：只在检测到失败时从外部 playbook 检索匹配教训引导恢复，且不依赖任务奖励验证是否恢复成功，只有未恢复才存入新教训，完整 playbook 永不进入 agent 上下文。在多个 agentic benchmark 上，Sentry 比最强 runtime-intervention 基线平均高 37%，比最强 context-evolution 基线在两者共同评测的两个 benchmark 上高 39%。
Motivation: LLM agent 常因无效工具调用、重复动作或推理失准在任务中途失败；把失败教训常驻上下文会在对应失败未发生时误触发，而 runtime 干预虽只在失败时动作却不从修复中学习。
Method: Sentry 作为与 agent 并行的 failure-management 层：检测失败后从外部 playbook 检索匹配教训指导恢复，在不访问任务奖励的条件下验证是否恢复，仅在未恢复时存入新教训；playbook 全量不进上下文，并可与 context evolution 组合使用。
Result: 在多个 agentic benchmark 上，Sentry 在每个 benchmark 上都超过最强 runtime-intervention 基线，平均高出 37%；在两者共同评测的两个 benchmark 上超过最强 context-evolution 基线 39%；与 context evolution 结合还有进一步增益，学到的教训可迁移到 held-out 任务。受控实验显示，把完整 playbook 暴露给 agent 会降低性能，即使相关教训仍可按需获取。
Conclusion: 失败知识是条件知识，应按条件暴露而非常驻上下文：外部按需检索加无奖励验证的恢复闭环能同时带来跨任务迁移与性能提升。

papers.title: Differentiable Koopman Operator for Contrastive Learning on Dynamic Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Real-world interaction networks are inherently dynamic: edges form and dissolve as node behavior shifts over time. Most snapshot-based contrastive methods encode temporal dependencies implicitly in encoder weights, without an explicit model of how node representations evolve, making them brittle under distribution shifts. We propose KAIROS (Koopman-Aligned Invariant Representations for Open Dynamic Systems), a self-supervised framework that embeds a differentiable Koopman operator within a dynamic graph contrastive learning loop to linearize temporal evolution in the learned embedding space. A dual-view encoder pairs raw node features with a graph-diffused structural view and is optimized with multi-granularity contrastive objectives across temporal windows. For anomaly detection, KAIROS uses the Koopman prediction residual together with temporal inconsistency and local neighborhood deviation to separate irregular behavior from predictable graph evolution. Evaluated on nine dynamic graph benchmarks, KAIROS achieves state-of-the-art anomaly detection results on all nine datasets, with gains of up to 23.15 ROC-AUC points over prior work, while remaining competitive for unsupervised node classification. These results show that explicit dynamics modeling provides a scalable and effective inductive bias for temporal graph representation learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KAIROS 把可微 Koopman 算子嵌入动态图自监督对比学习环路，在嵌入空间中线性化节点表征的时间演化，并用 Koopman 预测残差加时序不一致度与局部邻域偏差做异常检测。在九个动态图基准上全部取得 SOTA，ROC-AUC 相比先前工作最高提升 23.15 个百分点。
Motivation: 基于快照的对比方法把时间依赖隐式编码进权重，缺少节点表征如何演化的显式模型，在分布偏移下脆弱。
Method: 双视图编码器配对原始节点特征与图扩散结构视图，用跨时间窗的多粒度对比目标优化；可微 Koopman 算子在嵌入空间线性化时间演化；异常打分由 Koopman 预测残差、时序不一致度和局部邻域偏差共同构成。
Result: 在九个动态图基准上，KAIROS 在全部九个数据集上取得 state-of-the-art 异常检测结果，ROC-AUC 相比先前工作最高提升 23.15 个百分点；在无监督节点分类上保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 显式动力学建模是时间图表示学习可扩展且有效的归纳偏置，Koopman 残差可直接用作异常分数。

papers.title: PLCWorld: Benchmarking LLM-Generated PLC Programs in Closed-Loop Plant Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Programmable logic controllers (PLCs) coordinate industrial equipment by reading sensor inputs and issuing control commands. Evaluating whether large language model (LLM)-generated PLC programs satisfy task requirements and safety constraints requires observing how their commands affect device and workpiece states. We introduce PLCWorld, a common closed-loop execution environment and benchmark that couples Structured Text (ST) execution with simulated plant responses and sensor feedback. Grounded in control relations identified in industrial PLC programs and engineering documentation, PLCWorld contains 100 synthetic tasks and 473 registered task-condition pairs across Motion Control and Material Handling, with difficulty defined by control-dependency scope. A common protocol reports Task Success and Safety Violation separately. Validation combines practitioner review, reference and alternative programs, targeted counterexamples, specification-evaluator alignment checks, and comparisons with independent ST runtimes. Reference and alternative programs satisfy their applicable cases, while all 542 targeted counterexamples activate their designated evaluator rules under at least one registered condition. Execution Gap relates submission-profile acceptance to subsequent task failure or observed Safety Violation. Across the constructed task groups, direct GPT-5.5 achieves 82.70% Task Success on Easy cases but 25.10% on Hard cases. Evaluations of six LLMs and four adapted generation-and-verification workflows further expose differences between completion, safety, and generation cost. Our code, simulation environment, benchmark tasks, and baseline implementations are publicly available at https://yunji0516.github.io/PLCWorld/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PLCWorld 把 Structured Text 执行与仿真工厂响应、传感器反馈耦合成闭环环境，用于评测 LLM 生成的 PLC 程序是否满足任务与安全约束。基准含 100 个合成任务、473 个 task-condition 对，按控制依赖范围分 Easy/Hard；GPT-5.5 直接生成在 Easy 上 Task Success 82.70%，Hard 上仅 25.10%。
Motivation: 判断 LLM 生成的 PLC 程序是否满足任务要求与安全约束，必须观察指令如何改变设备与工件状态，静态代码审查无法给出这种闭环证据。
Method: PLCWorld 将 ST 执行与仿真工厂响应、传感器反馈耦合为统一闭环执行环境；任务与控制关系来自工业 PLC 程序与工程文档，按控制依赖范围定义难度；统一协议分别报告 Task Success 与 Safety Violation，验证手段包括从业者评审、参考与替代程序、针对性反例、规格-评估器一致性检查以及与独立 ST 运行时的对比。
Result: 基准含 100 个合成任务、473 个已注册 task-condition 对，覆盖 Motion Control 与 Material Handling；全部 542 个针对性反例在至少一个注册条件下触发其指定评估器规则。GPT-5.5 直接生成在 Easy 上 Task Success 82.70%，Hard 上 25.10%；另评测六个 LLM 与四个改造的生成-验证工作流，比较完成度、安全性与生成成本差异。
Conclusion: 闭环仿真能把 PLC 程序的任务完成与安全违规分开量化，且 LLM 生成程序的失败集中在控制依赖范围大的 Hard 任务上。

papers.title: Safeguarding Mutual Correction in Source-Free Domain Adaptation via Cut Statistics
papers.abstract_en: Source-Free Domain Adaptation (SFDA) aims to adapt a source-pretrained model to an unlabeled target domain without access to the original source domain. While early single-model approaches rely on self-refinement, they are inherently susceptible to confirmation bias and struggle to correct their own systematic errors. To overcome this limitation, recent methods introduce Vision-Language (ViL) models as external knowledge sources. However, these approaches operate in a largely unidirectional paradigm, using the ViL model primarily to supervise the source-pretrained model. This overlooks a key structural property: the two models exhibit distinct failure modes -- where one produces an incorrect prediction, the other may produce a correct one, creating a natural opportunity for mutual correction within the target domain. Yet, without ground-truth labels, identifying which model is correct on any given sample is non-trivial, and naively exchanging predictions risks propagating errors across models. To address this challenge, we propose SafeCut, a novel approach that leverages the cut statistic as a label-free measure of prediction reliability to gate cross-model supervision. Our approach dynamically controls both the direction and strength of supervision based on relative reliability, selectively amplifying true corrections while suppressing miscorrections on a per-sample basis. We further provide theoretical justification showing that this reliability-gated mechanism guarantees a net-positive correction signal. Extensive experiments across diverse SFDA benchmarks demonstrate that SafeCut achieves state-of-the-art performance, highlighting the effectiveness of safeguarding mutual correction in SFDA via cut statistics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SafeCut 用无标签的 cut statistic 衡量源预训练模型与 Vision-Language 模型各自的预测可靠性，按相对可靠性门控跨模型监督的方向与强度，逐样本放大正确纠正、抑制错误纠正。理论上该可靠性门控机制保证净正向纠正信号，并在多个 SFDA benchmark 上达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: SFDA 中单模型自精修易受 confirmation bias、难以纠正系统性错误；引入 ViL 模型后监督基本是单向的，而无标签条件下无法直接判断哪个模型在某个样本上是对的，盲目互换预测会跨模型传播错误。
Method: 提出 SafeCut：以 cut statistic 作为无标签的预测可靠性度量，门控源预训练模型与 ViL 模型之间的跨模型监督，按相对可靠性动态决定监督方向与强度，逐样本选择性放大真实纠正、抑制 miscorrection；并给出该门控机制保证净正向纠正信号的理论论证。
Result: 在多个 SFDA benchmark 上取得 state-of-the-art 性能；摘要给出的量化内容为理论保证（可靠性门控产生净正向纠正信号），未列出具体数值。
Conclusion: 在无源域、无标签条件下，用可靠性统计量门控双向互纠比单向用 ViL 监督源模型更有效，且该门控可被证明带来净正向纠正。

papers.title: RASPER: Reward-Aligned Summarization of Clinical Notes for EHR Outcome Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Unstructured discharge notes in Electronic Health Records (EHRs) often carry signal complementary to structured medical codes, holding patient-specific evidence that standardized cohort-level codes alone cannot capture. However, this evidence in notes is frequently buried in lengthy, noisy text that is not intentionally written with any specific clinical prediction in mind. Summarization is an obvious mitigation, but generic summaries, tuned for fluency rather than the outcome, routinely omit decisive evidence while retaining plausible but uninformative detail. To this end, we propose RASPER, a Reward-Aligned Summarizer for Prediction in EHR, that optimizes note summarization directly against the downstream clinical task. RASPER employs a tunable LLM-based summarizer to extract task-relevant evidence from discharge notes and trains it via reinforcement learning from prediction feedback, using a reward derived from the downstream predictor's loss. To ground the summarizer, a longitudinal encoder converts structured codes into soft prompts that incorporate each patient's clinical context into note summarization. By rewarding the quality of the resulting multimodal prediction, RASPER encourages the summarizer to retain patient-specific evidence that complements, rather than duplicates, information captured by structured codes. RASPER consistently outperforms strong baselines on both readmission prediction and medication recommendation across MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV.

papers.title: Relevant Evidence Decoding for Audio-Visual Hallucination Mitigation
papers.abstract_en: Audio-Visual Large Language Models (AV-LLMs) remain prone to cross-modal hallucinations, where one modality incorrectly affects predictions about another. Although contrastive decoding reduces hallucinations in vision-language models, its direct extension to AV-LLMs overlooks a key challenge: different questions require different perceptual evidence, including audio, video, or their interaction. Notably, we observe that joint audio-visual inference can weaken the prediction even when a model can recover the correct answer from a single informative modality. For example, when asked which instrument is heard, a model may correctly predict violin from the audio alone. Once a video showing a guitar is added, its confidence in violin may drop. In this paper, we introduce Relevant Evidence Decoding (RED), a training-free method that identifies question-relevant evidence and selectively strengthens its contribution. RED uses pointwise mutual information to quantify the predictive support provided by audio and video beyond the question alone. It decomposes their joint contribution into audio, video, and residual interaction components. A question-only inference pass determines the required evidence type, after which the model augments the original audio-visual prediction with the corresponding PMI contribution. Across three audio-visual hallucination benchmarks and three AV-LLMs, RED improves accuracy over standard decoding by up to 7% on CMM, 6.3% on AVHBench, and 3.8% on SVHalluc, with an average relative time to first token of 1.5x standard decoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RED 是免训练的音视大模型 (AV-LLM) 跨模态幻觉缓解解码法：用点互信息 (PMI) 把音视频联合贡献分解为音频、视频与残余交互分量，先用 question-only 推断判定该题需要哪类证据，再只增强对应分量。在三个音视幻觉基准、三个 AV-LLM 上，相对标准解码准确率最高提升 CMM 7%、AVHBench 6.3%、SVHalluc 3.8%，首 token 平均耗时为标准解码的 1.5 倍。
Motivation: 对比解码在视觉语言模型里能压幻觉，但直接搬到 AV-LLM 会忽略不同问题需要不同感知证据（音频、视频或二者交互）；联合音视推断反而会削弱单模态本可答对的预测。
Method: 免训练的 Relevant Evidence Decoding (RED)：用点互信息 (PMI) 量化音频与视频相对仅问题输入的预测支持，把联合贡献分解为音频、视频、残余交互三部分；一次 question-only 推断决定所需证据类型，再把对应 PMI 贡献加到原始音视预测上。
Result: 在三个音视幻觉基准与三个 AV-LLM 上，相对标准解码准确率最高提升 7%（CMM）、6.3%（AVHBench）、3.8%（SVHalluc）；平均相对首 token 时间为标准解码的 1.5 倍。
Conclusion: 按问题选择性增强相关模态的 PMI 贡献，比直接做联合音视解码更能缓解跨模态幻觉，代价是约 1.5 倍的首 token 延迟。

papers.title: Reliable Self-Evolution with Imperfect Proxy Rewards
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-based self-evolving search is a promising approach to scientific discovery. However, high-fidelity evaluation of every candidate is prohibitively expensive in some domains. Self-evolving systems in such settings therefore rely on low-cost but imperfect proxy rewards, which may assign high scores to infeasible candidates. These false positives may contaminate both the final output and the feedback used to guide subsequent generations. This motivates statistically calibrated reward intervals for more reliable self-evolving search. We propose Conformal Interval-Driven Self-Evolution (CISE), which constructs candidate-specific reward intervals using conditional conformal inference and iteration-wise online density-ratio estimation. CISE uses conservative interval-based rewards for evolutionary feedback and returns candidates only when all required property intervals lie entirely within their respective feasible regions. We derive fixed-iteration coverage results under explicit assumptions of independence and covariate shift. We evaluate CISE on three self-evolving search tasks in materials science. In our experiments, all candidates returned by CISE are true positives under high-fidelity evaluation, whereas the baselines return more candidates but include false positives. These results highlight the value of a smaller, more precise shortlist when downstream validation budgets are limited. Our repository is available at https://github.com/MLAI-Yonsei/CISE.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Conformal Interval-Driven Self-Evolution (CISE)，用条件 conformal 推断与逐轮在线密度比估计为每个候选构造带覆盖率保证的奖励区间，只有当所有属性区间完全落在可行域内才返回候选。在三个材料科学自演化搜索任务上，CISE 返回的候选在高保真评估下全部为真阳性，基线返回更多候选但含假阳性。
Motivation: 自演化搜索中对每个候选做高保真评估代价过高，只能用低成本但不完美的代理奖励，而代理奖励会给不可行候选打高分，假阳性同时污染最终输出和后续生成的反馈信号。
Method: CISE 用 conditional conformal inference 结合 iteration-wise 在线密度比估计 (online density-ratio estimation) 构造候选特定的奖励区间；进化反馈改用保守的区间奖励，返回阶段要求所有必需属性区间完全位于各自可行域内，并在独立性与协变量偏移 (covariate shift) 的显式假设下推导固定轮次的覆盖率结果。
Result: 在三个材料科学自演化搜索任务上，CISE 返回的全部候选在高保真评估下均为真阳性；基线返回候选数量更多但包含假阳性。
Conclusion: 当下游验证预算有限时，用带统计校准的奖励区间换取更小但更精确的候选短名单，比追求召回更多候选更可靠。

papers.title: From Language Priors to Field Adaptation: Preference Learning for Traversability Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Image-based traversability estimation is inherently dependent on the robot platform, deployment domain, and mission preferences, which limits the applicability of purpose-trained models. To facilitate domain adaptation, this work aims to reduce the number of required annotations in the target domain using sample-efficient preference learning. Our method represents traversability through von Mises-Fisher mixture prototypes in a frozen vision-language feature space. Relative natural-language rules provide a commonsense prior, while sparse relative image annotations adapt the prototype directions and utilities to a target domain through computationally and sample-efficient fine-tuning. Experiments on WayFAST demonstrate accuracy competitive with end-to-end trained estimators while enabling sample-efficient image-based adaptation. Qualitative experiments further demonstrate the language prior's zero shot applicability and the fine-tuned estimator's improved dense prediction on semantic maps. Evaluation is complemented via semantic interpretation of learned prototypes by dissecting semantically close natural language prompts. Code and trained estimators available at https://resireg.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向机器人可通行性 (traversability) 估计，提出用 von Mises-Fisher 混合原型在冻结视觉-语言特征空间中表示可通行性：自然语言相对规则提供 commonsense 先验，稀疏的相对图像偏好标注再微调原型方向与 utility，从而把目标域所需标注量压到样本高效水平。在 WayFAST 上精度与端到端训练的估计器相当，并展示语言先验的零样本适用性与微调后在语义地图上的稠密预测改善。
Motivation: 图像可通行性估计强依赖机器人平台、部署域与任务偏好，专用训练的模型难以迁移；目标域逐像素标注成本高，需要减少目标域标注量的域适应手段。
Method: 在冻结的视觉-语言特征空间里用 von Mises-Fisher 混合原型表示可通行性；以自然语言相对规则作为 commonsense 先验，再用稀疏的相对图像标注通过计算与样本高效的微调调整原型方向与 utility，实现目标域适应。
Result: 在 WayFAST 数据集上，精度与端到端训练的可通行性估计器相当，同时实现样本高效的图像域适应；定性实验展示语言先验的零样本适用性，以及微调后估计器在语义地图上更优的稠密预测，并通过语义相近的自然语言 prompt 剖析对学到的原型做语义解读。
Conclusion: 把语言先验与稀疏偏好学习结合进冻结视觉-语言空间，可以在少标注条件下把可通行性估计适配到新域，且不牺牲与端到端模型相当的精度。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CreateScore: Domain-Theory-Informed Bayesian Routing for LLM-Based CV Screening
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can support rubric-based screening of CVs, but applying a high-capability model to every candidate and criterion is costly. We present CreateScore, a domain-theory-informed Bayesian network for criterion-level LLM routing. A hand-specified directed acyclic graph with Dirichlet-multinomial conditional probability tables converts CV evidence into posterior uncertainty; low-uncertainty decisions are resolved by a local 8B model and uncertain ones are escalated to a 120B reference model. The graph is causally motivated, but the system performs standard Bayesian conditioning, not causal inference. The escalation threshold is calibrated on a training fold (target: 70% resolved locally) and then frozen. On 200 synthetic Data Science CVs (139 training and 61 test candidates, five criteria), 77.7% of criterion decisions were resolved locally (237 of 305). Relative to a reference condition in which the 120B model adjudicated every criterion, routed escalation reduced token use by 65.2% and raised exact score agreement from 32.8% (8B alone) to 42.6% (95% CI 31.0-55.1%); at n = 61 the gain was not statistically distinguishable. The uncertainty signal did not, however, identify the decisions on which the 8B model erred: disagreement with the reference was 16.2% among escalated and 19.4% among locally resolved decisions (AUROC 0.47, 95% CI 0.39-0.56), no better than random selection. We also document how an earlier evaluation was invalidated when truncated reasoning-model outputs were silently replaced by local labels, and we recommend safeguards for cascade evaluation. CreateScore is supported as an auditable cost-reduction mechanism, not yet as a targeted error detector, and is not an autonomous hiring system.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables (Excluding Appendix). CreateScore Planner App GitHub repo link: https://github.com/rupsa-arc1-2441139/createscore
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CreateScore 用手工指定 DAG 与 Dirichlet-multinomial 条件概率表的贝叶斯网络，把 CV 逐条准则的证据转成后验不确定性，低不确定性交本地 8B 模型判定、高不确定性升级到 120B 参考模型。在 200 份合成 Data Science CV 上 77.7% 的判定在本地解决，token 用量降 65.2%，与 120B 全量裁决的完全一致率从 32.8% 升到 42.6%（95% CI 31.0–55.1%），但不确定性信号识别 8B 错误的能力等同随机（AUROC 0.47）。
Motivation: 对每个候选、每条准则都调用高能力 LLM 做 rubric 筛选成本过高，而现有级联路由缺少可审计的不确定性来源与对错误检出能力的检验。
Method: 手工指定因果动机的 DAG，配 Dirichlet-multinomial 条件概率表做标准贝叶斯条件化（非因果推断），把 CV 证据转为后验不确定性；升级阈值在训练折上按 70% 本地解决率标定后冻结，低不确定性交 8B、高不确定性升级 120B。评测用 200 份合成 Data Science CV（139 训练、61 测试、5 条准则），并记录一次因截断 reasoning 输出被静默替换为本地标签而失效的早期评估。
Result: 77.7% 的准则判定在本地解决（305 条中的 237 条），相对 120B 全量裁决的参考条件 token 用量下降 65.2%；完全一致率从 8B 单独的 32.8% 提到 42.6%（95% CI 31.0–55.1%），n=61 时增益无统计显著性。不确定性信号无错误检出力：升级组与本地组对参考的分歧率分别为 16.2% 与 19.4%，AUROC 0.47（95% CI 0.39–0.56），与随机选择无异。
Conclusion: CreateScore 可作为可审计的降本级联机制，但尚不能当作定向错误检出器，也不是自主招聘系统；作者据此建议为级联评估加入防护措施。

summary_sections.result: 77.7% 的准则判定在本地解决（305 条中的 237 条），相对 120B 全量裁决的参考条件 token 用量下降 65.2%；完全一致率从 8B 单独的 32.8% 提到 42.6%（95% CI 31.0–55.1%），n=61 时增益无统计显著性。不确定性信号无错误检出力：升级组与本地组对参考的分歧率分别为 16.2% 与 19.4%，AUROC 0.47（95% CI 0.39–0.56），与随机选择无异。
summary_sections.conclusion: CreateScore 可作为可审计的降本级联机制，但尚不能当作定向错误检出器，也不是自主招聘系统；作者据此建议为级联评估加入防护措施。

papers.title: Reasoning with Evidence, Not Merely Rationales: Verifiable Preference Proofs for LLM-Based Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can infer user preferences from interaction histories and reviews, yet the rationales they generate may not reflect the information actually used for recommendation. A preference claim may be weakly supported by its selected evidence, or may have little effect on the final ranking. We refer to these two failures as the grounding-influence gap. We introduce PROVE-REC, a general framework for verifiable preference reasoning in LLM-based recommendation. Pass A converts the complete pre-target history into a compact preference proof consisting of positive and avoidance claims linked to selected evidence entries. Pass B predicts the next item using only the proof and its selected evidence, preventing the recommender from bypassing the reasoning path. To verify evidence-to-proof grounding, we compare the effect of masking selected evidence with masking a comparable control entry. To verify proof-to-recommendation influence, we remove a preference claim and measure the resulting decrease in the target item's ranking margin. A ranking-preservation objective further retains useful information from the complete history. Comprehensive experiments on wide-ranging real-world datasets demonstrate that PROVE-REC consistently outperforms strong sequential, generative, and LLM-enhanced baselines, with improvements of up to 7.45%. Controlled ablations confirm the effectiveness of the two-pass architecture and verification objectives. Moreover, PROVE-REC produces claims that are more strongly grounded in historical evidence and more influential to recommendation while preserving ranking quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PROVE-REC 把 LLM 推荐中的偏好推理做成可验证的两遍流程：Pass A 从完整历史生成带证据的偏好证明，Pass B 只凭该证明与所选证据预测下一物品，从而堵住绕过推理路径的捷径。在多种真实数据集上相对序列式、生成式与 LLM 增强基线最高提升 7.45%，消融确认两遍架构与验证目标有效。
Motivation: LLM 从交互历史与评论推出的 rationale 可能并不反映推荐实际使用的信息：偏好主张可能被所选证据弱支撑，或对最终排序几乎没有影响，即 grounding-influence gap。
Method: Pass A 将完整 pre-target 历史压缩为由正向与回避主张构成、并链接到所选证据条目的偏好证明；Pass B 仅用证明与所选证据预测下一物品。证据到证明的 grounding 通过遮蔽所选证据与遮蔽可比对照条目的效应差验证；证明到推荐的 influence 通过移除某偏好主张后目标物品排序 margin 的下降量验证；另加 ranking-preservation 目标保留完整历史中的有用信息。
Result: 在多种真实世界数据集上，PROVE-REC 持续优于序列式、生成式与 LLM 增强基线，提升幅度最高达 7.45%；受控消融确认两遍架构与验证目标有效，且产出的主张在历史证据上 grounding 更强、对推荐影响更大，同时保持排序质量。
Conclusion: 把偏好推理拆成可独立验证的 grounding 与 influence 两条通路并强制推荐只走证明路径，能在保持排序质量的同时产出更可信、更起作用的 LLM 推荐理由。

papers.title: Post-Training Frontier Text-to-Image Models by Composing Preference and Rubric Rewards
papers.abstract_en: Recent text-to-image generation models have achieved remarkable visual quality, but improving them through post-training remains challenging because no single reward signal captures the full range of human preference. In this work, we develop a simple and effective post-training recipe for open-domain text-to-image generation based on the composition of complementary reward signals. Our reward system consists of two main components: a preference reward, trained on large-scale human preference data using a Bradley-Terry objective to capture overall human aesthetic and perceptual preferences, and rubric-based rewards, which explicitly evaluate prompt faithfulness and other desirable properties while providing safeguards against reward hacking. A key challenge is how to combine these heterogeneous reward signals. We show that a naive weighted average leads to suboptimal optimization behavior, and propose a simple reward composition strategy that more effectively balances preference optimization with rubric satisfaction. In the Arena text-to-image leaderboard (https://arena.ai/), our RL-trained Flux2dev achieves an Elo rating 69 points above the base model, and our post-trained Ideogram-4 surpasses every open-source model on the leaderboard, reaching an Elo of 1223.5. (Claims of state-of-the-art performance are based on the Arena leaderboard snapshot as of September 4, 2026.) Our results suggest that effective rewards for frontier generative-model training require broad coverage of user intent and robustness to exploitation under optimization. To support reproducible research, we release Arena-T2I-Training, a 1K subset of training data that recovers some gains of full-scale training, providing a resource that we hope will facilitate future work on post-training for text-to-image models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向开放域文生图后训练，用 Bradley-Terry 偏好奖励与 rubric 奖励组合替代朴素加权平均，后者会导致次优优化行为。RL 训练的 Flux2dev 在 Arena 文生图榜上 Elo 比基座高 69 分，后训练的 Ideogram-4 达到 1223.5、超过榜上所有开源模型。
Motivation: 文生图后训练缺少单一奖励信号能覆盖全部人类偏好，而异构奖励如何组合会直接决定优化行为，朴素加权平均已被证明次优。
Method: 奖励系统含两部分：在大规模人类偏好数据上以 Bradley-Terry 目标训练的 preference reward，以及显式评估 prompt 忠实度等属性、并防 reward hacking 的 rubric-based rewards；再提出一种 reward composition 策略平衡偏好优化与 rubric 满足，并发布 1K 训练数据子集 Arena-T2I-Training。
Result: Arena 文生图榜（2026 年 9 月 4 日快照）上，RL 训练的 Flux2dev Elo 比基座高 69 分；后训练的 Ideogram-4 Elo 达 1223.5，超过榜上每个开源模型；1K 子集 Arena-T2I-Training 可恢复全量训练的部分增益。
Conclusion: 前沿生成模型的有效奖励需要广泛覆盖用户意图，且在优化下对被钻空子（exploitation）保持稳健；朴素加权平均不是正确的组合方式。

papers.title: Dirac-Interconnected Neural Elements: Discovering Modularity in Physical Systems Without Reduction
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning has shown remarkable success in the data-driven modeling of dynamical systems. Much of its success is attributed not to the flexibility of neural networks but to inductive biases based on physical prior knowledge, such as energy conservation and symplecticity. However, existing methods do not fully exploit the fact that real-world physical systems are interconnections of components. Some methods require the interconnection to be known a priori, while others assume the system to be reducible to an ordinary differential equation (ODE) and learn only the reduced ODE, discarding the algebraic constraints imposed by the interconnection. Here, we propose Dirac-interconnected neural elements (DINEs), a neural network model that represents a physical system as a differential-algebraic equation (DAE), whose algebraic constraints are given by a Dirac structure in kernel representation. With DINEs, we simultaneously identify from data the interconnection among the components as a Dirac structure and learn the characteristics of the components as neural networks. This allows us to keep the learned subsystems in unreduced form and isolate or compose them to make a new system without retraining. Moreover, DINEs can handle partially observable systems. Experimental results demonstrate these capabilities on physical systems beyond the reach of existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Dirac 互联神经元件 (DINEs)，把物理系统表示为以 Dirac structure 核表示给出代数约束的微分-代数方程 (DAE)，从数据中同时辨识部件间互联与部件本身的神经网络特性。学到的子系统保持未降阶形式，可隔离或组合成新系统而无需重训，并能处理部分可观测系统。
Motivation: 现有动力系统数据驱动建模要么要求互联结构先验已知，要么假设系统可降阶为 ODE 而丢弃互联施加的代数约束，无法利用真实物理系统由部件互联构成这一事实。
Method: 用 DINEs 将系统建模为 DAE，其代数约束取 Dirac structure 的核表示；训练时同时从数据辨识部件间互联（Dirac structure）与部件动力学（神经网络），保留未降阶子系统以支持隔离与组合，并支持部分可观测情形。
Result: 在超出既有方法能力范围的物理系统上给出实验结果，展示互联辨识、子系统未降阶隔离与免重训组合、以及部分可观测系统处理这些能力（摘要未列具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把互联结构作为 Dirac structure 与部件神经模型联合学习，可在不降阶、不重训的前提下复用与重组学到的子系统。

papers.title: TerraVis: Towards Evaluation of World-Grounded Visual Consistency in Text-to-Image Generation via MLLM Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Recent text-to-image models have made substantial progress in photorealism, aesthetics, and text-image alignment. Yet visually appealing images can still violate real-world plausibility, exhibiting malformed object structures, impossible anatomy, physically implausible interactions, or inconsistent spatial relationships. Such failures are not well captured by existing fidelity, aesthetics, preference, or alignment metrics. To address this gap, we introduce TerraVis, a framework for evaluating world-grounded visual consistency in generated images. TerraVis defines a structured taxonomy of world-consistency violations spanning object-, interaction-, and scene-level failures, and employs a multi-stage evaluation framework to identify and quantify them. Given an image, TerraVis first uses an MLLM to assess its eligibility for evaluation, then detects violations across 18 taxonomy-defined types and classifies them as minor or major to derive an overall world-consistency score. Across diverse open-source and proprietary text-to-image models on two widely used benchmarks, TerraVis achieves the strongest correlation with human judgments of world consistency among existing metrics. Our benchmark results further show that models that achieve strong performance on conventional metrics can still exhibit substantial world-consistency failures. These findings highlight world consistency as a complementary evaluation dimension and demonstrate that TerraVis enables systematic quantification, diagnosis, and comparison of such failures. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/ShyFoo/TerraVis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TerraVis 用 MLLM 工作流评估文生图图像的世界一致性：先判定图像是否可评，再按 18 类物体、交互、场景级违规检测并区分 minor/major，汇总为 world-consistency score。在两个常用基准上跨开源与闭源模型，它与人类判断的相关性最强，且常规指标高的模型仍可出现大量一致性失败。
Motivation: 现有保真度、美学、偏好与对齐指标抓不住畸形结构、不可能解剖、物理上不合理的交互与空间关系不一致这类违反现实可行性的失败。
Method: 定义覆盖物体级、交互级、场景级的世界一致性违规分类体系 (taxonomy)，共 18 类；多阶段流程先用 MLLM 判定图像是否适合评估，再检测违规并分类为 minor 或 major，据此计算总体 world-consistency score。
Result: 在两个广泛使用的基准上、跨多种开源与专有文生图模型，TerraVis 与人类世界一致性判断的相关性在现有指标中最强；常规指标表现强的模型仍表现出大量世界一致性失败。
Conclusion: 世界一致性是与现有指标互补的评估维度，TerraVis 可对这类失败做系统量化、诊断与模型间比较；代码已公开。

papers.title: Understanding Trajectory Heterogeneity in Federated World Model Learning
papers.abstract_en: World models learn state evolution from trajectories, making access to temporal context a central training requirement. Federated learning can use distributed records, while ownership boundaries within a trajectory restrict the examples each client can construct. Our study benchmarks this cross-time setting through hourly action-conditioned clinical prediction on eight MIMIC-IV disease cohorts, comprising 40.87 million transition memberships. We specify severity-based client ownership, patient-separated construction, local history and future-window rules, and paired rollout evaluation from one to 32 hours. A matrix of ten federated algorithms covers 32 disease--partition configurations under five rounds of ten-percent participation. Three findings emerge from existing results and training logs. First, client ownership and participation jointly restrict long-window coverage: only 7.55\%--21.36\% of pooled-available 32-step windows have a locally complete anchor visited during training, averaged across diseases. Second, finer severity partitions accompany higher FedAvg error in 15 of 16 paired comparisons, while algorithm gains are small and horizon-dependent: FedProx reduces mean error by 0.56\%, with no consistent improvement at 32 steps. Third, algorithm labels conceal distinct update behavior, including inactive extrapolation and orders-of-magnitude differences in update scale. Cached-update performance also varies strongly across trajectory partitions under the same benchmark protocol. These results establish temporal access, participation coverage, optimization behavior, and horizon-resolved prediction as complementary dimensions for evaluating federated clinical world models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 MIMIC-IV 八个疾病队列上以小时级动作条件临床预测基准化联邦世界模型的跨时间轨迹异质性：客户端所有权与参与率共同限制长窗口覆盖，32 步窗口中仅 7.55%–21.36% 在训练中被本地完整锚点访问到。更细的严重度分区在 16 组配对比较中有 15 组抬高 FedAvg 误差，而 FedProx 平均误差仅降 0.56% 且在 32 步无一致改善。
Motivation: 轨迹内所有权边界限制每个客户端能构造的样本，联邦学习难以获得世界模型训练所需的时间上下文；现有基准无法区分时间访问、参与覆盖与优化行为各自的作用。
Method: 在 MIMIC-IV 八个疾病队列上做小时级动作条件临床预测，共 4087 万条转移归属；设定基于严重度的客户端所有权、患者分离构造、本地历史与未来窗口规则，以及 1 到 32 小时的配对 rollout 评估；用十个联邦算法覆盖 32 个疾病-划分配置，五轮、每轮 10% 参与。
Result: 32 步窗口中仅 7.55%–21.36% 在训练期间被本地完整锚点访问（跨疾病平均）；更细严重度分区在 16 组配对比较中有 15 组伴随更高 FedAvg 误差；FedProx 平均误差降低 0.56%，在 32 步无一致改善；算法更新行为存在数量级尺度差异与非活跃外推，缓存更新性能在同一协议下随轨迹划分强烈变化。
Conclusion: 联邦临床世界模型的评估必须把时间访问、参与覆盖、优化行为与分 horizon 的预测作为互补维度，单看算法标签会掩盖实际更新差异。
Relevance: 18

summary_sections.tldr: 在 MIMIC-IV 八个疾病队列上以小时级动作条件临床预测基准化联邦世界模型的跨时间轨迹异质性：客户端所有权与参与率共同限制长窗口覆盖，32 步窗口中仅 7.55%–21.36% 在训练中被本地完整锚点访问到。更细的严重度分区在 16 组配对比较中有 15 组抬高 FedAvg 误差，而 FedProx 平均误差仅降 0.56% 且在 32 步无一致改善。

papers.title: Hyperparameter selection for equation learning with biologically-informed neural networks
papers.abstract_en: Biologically-informed neural networks (BINNs) have emerged as a flexible subclass of physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for learning terms in partial differential equations from data. BINNs are particularly suited for biological systems, where the governing equations are highly nonlinear and only partially known a priori, and where data observations are often sparse, noisy, and incomplete. However, applying BINNs effectively in practice depends critically on hyperparameter selection, which remains a central challenge in equation-learning frameworks. Hyperparameters are often chosen heuristically and only cursorily documented, which limits the reproducibility of results and the transferability of methods. We present a diagnostic workflow for hyperparameter selection that can be used when the ground-truth equations are not known. The workflow is guided by three main questions: (1) Are the benefits of greater network capacity worth the cost? (2) Do more training epochs keep reducing the validation loss? (3) Do the learned terms stop changing as network capacity and training increase? We apply our workflow to synthetic systems of varying complexity with known ground truth, spanning diffusion and growth right-hand side terms and data ranging from 1D+t to 2D+t. We demonstrate that the validation loss generally follows the true error in the learned terms and distil practical rules of thumb for selecting hyperparameters in the BINN architecture. By providing a structured workflow, practical guidelines, and suggested starting values for hyperparameter selection, this work lowers the barrier to BINN-based equation learning.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 11 figures, 2 tables (main text); 29 pages, 13 figures, 1 algorithm (appendices and supplementary material)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一套在真实方程未知时仍可用的 BINN 超参数选择诊断流程，围绕三个问题展开：网络容量增益是否抵得过代价、更多 epoch 是否仍在降验证 loss、学到的方程项是否随容量与训练停止变化。在含已知真值的合成系统（扩散与增长右端项，数据从 1D+t 到 2D+t）上，验证 loss 总体跟随学到项的真实误差，并据此给出超参数选择的经验规则与建议起始值。
Motivation: BINN 学 PDE 项时超参数多靠启发式挑选且记录粗糙，导致结果难复现、方法难迁移；而真实方程未知时没有直接的误差参照。
Method: 给出三问式诊断流程：比较网络容量的收益与代价、检查验证 loss 是否随 epoch 继续下降、监测学到的方程项是否随容量与训练收敛；在复杂度递增、含已知真值的合成系统上应用，数据维度覆盖 1D+t 到 2D+t，右端项含扩散与增长项。
Result: 验证 loss 总体跟随学到项的真实误差变化；流程在含已知真值的合成系统上给出超参数选择的经验规则与建议起始值。
Conclusion: 验证 loss 可作为真实方程未知时判断 BINN 学项质量的可用代理，配合结构化流程与起始值能降低 BINN 方程学习的使用门槛。

papers.title: SlimKV: Joint Token-Feature KV Cache Compression with Reconstruction-Free Beacon Attention
papers.abstract_en: Long-context LLM serving is increasingly bottlenecked by KV-cache memory, especially in resource-constrained scenarios. Among existing KV-cache compression strategies, token-wise methods reduce cached states but risk information loss through eviction or condensation, while feature-wise methods reduce per-token KV dimensions but can require full-dimensional reconstruction to apply positional embedding, limiting decoding speedups. We introduce SlimKV, a question-agnostic joint token-feature KV-cache compression method. SlimKV uses low-rank-aware training to compress long contexts into beacon memory states with latent KV representations, together with layer-adaptive rank allocation. We further uncover a positional asymmetry: removing key-side RoPE affects beacon and raw tokens differently, with much smaller degradation for beacon tokens. Exploiting this asymmetry, SlimKV trains beacon KV projections under a K-RoPE-free constraint and enables latent-space attention during decoding, mitigating reconstruction latency. On LongBench, SlimKV outperforms baselines at 16x/32x compression and remains leading at 4x/8x, where it retains over 96% of the uncompressed model's score. Needle-in-a-Haystack confirms robustness across evidence positions, and efficiency evaluation shows up to 7.34x attention speedup and 3.38x end-to-end decoding speedup over the uncompressed model at 128K length.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SlimKV 面向长上下文 LLM 服务，把 token 级剪除与特征级降维联合起来：用低秩感知训练把长上下文压成 beacon memory states（latent KV 表示），配合 layer-adaptive rank 分配，并利用「去掉 key 侧 RoPE 对 beacon token 的损害远小于 raw token」这一位置不对称性，让 beacon KV 投影在 K-RoPE-free 约束下训练，解码时直接做 latent-space attention 免去全维重建。在 LongBench 上 16x/32x 压缩超过基线、4x/8x 仍领先且保留未压缩模型 96% 以上分数，128K 长度下注意力加速最高 7.34x、端到端解码加速 3.38x。
Motivation: 长上下文 LLM 服务被 KV-cache 显存卡住：token 级方法靠剪除或凝缩会丢信息，特征级方法降维后仍需全维重建才能套位置编码，拖慢解码。
Method: SlimKV 是 question-agnostic 的 token-特征联合压缩：低秩感知训练 (low-rank-aware training) 把长上下文压成带 latent KV 的 beacon memory states，加 layer-adaptive rank allocation；发现 key 侧 RoPE 移除对 beacon 与 raw token 影响不对称后，令 beacon KV 投影在 K-RoPE-free 约束下训练，解码走 latent-space attention 免重建。
Result: LongBench 上 16x/32x 压缩优于基线，4x/8x 仍领先并保留未压缩模型 96% 以上分数；Needle-in-a-Haystack 确认证据位置鲁棒；128K 长度下注意力加速最高 7.34x、端到端解码加速 3.38x（相对未压缩模型）。
Conclusion: token 与特征两级压缩可以同时做而不牺牲长上下文精度，而 K-RoPE-free 的 beacon 表示是绕开重建延迟、拿到数倍解码加速的关键。

papers.title: GTDD: Generative Test-Driven Development for AI Coding Agents with Adversarial Testing
papers.abstract_en: Test-driven development gives AI coding agents executable requirements for implementing software. Because these agents can adapt their implementations to the examples they observe, passing a predetermined collection of tests can leave substantial parts of the intended behavior unimplemented. We propose Generative Test-Driven Development (GTDD), a formulation of test-driven development in which a separate testing agent generates new inputs after each candidate implementation is fixed, using a human-specified behavioral contract and the feedback from earlier rounds. A trusted evaluator checks these inputs, returns reduced counterexamples to the coding agent, and saves them for regression testing, so development continually confronts failures beyond the initial examples. We characterize the evidence that this process provides through a finite-population analysis of false acceptance under adaptive candidate selection. The resulting bounds quantify how test visibility and repeated feedback affect acceptance, and show that fresh random audits after candidate commitment control false acceptance across development rounds. In a paired experiment on a stateful key-value store, both policies that regenerated tests during development ended with lower mean failure rates than the policy whose tests were generated once by the same language model, and giving the tester the candidate's source produced no detectable additional improvement. Further conditions requesting equal numbers of tests did not isolate any single feature of the policies as the source of this difference. GTDD combines this adaptive development feedback with established regression tests and an independent acceptance rule.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GTDD 让独立测试 agent 在候选实现定型后基于行为契约与前轮反馈继续生成新输入，可信评估器校验并把归约后的反例回传给编码 agent 存入回归测试，使开发持续面对初始样例之外的失败。在有状态 key-value store 的配对实验中，两种开发中重新生成测试的策略最终平均失败率都低于只由同一语言模型生成一次测试的策略，且把候选源码给测试者未带来可检测的额外改进。
Motivation: AI 编码 agent 会针对观察到的例子调整实现，通过预设测试集仍可能留下大量预期行为未实现，固定测试集无法约束这种过拟合。
Method: GTDD 由编码 agent 与独立测试 agent 组成：测试 agent 依据人类给定的行为契约和前轮反馈在候选定型后生成新输入，可信评估器校验输入、返回归约反例并保存用于回归测试；用有限总体分析刻画自适应候选选择下的错误接受证据，并叠加既有回归测试与独立验收规则。
Result: 有限总体分析给出错误接受界，量化测试可见性与重复反馈对接受的影响，并表明候选提交后的新鲜随机审计能在各开发轮次控制错误接受。配对实验在有状态 key-value store 上：两种开发中重新生成测试的策略平均失败率均低于仅由同一语言模型生成一次测试的策略；给测试者候选源码未带来可检测的额外改进；要求相同测试数量的进一步条件未能把差异归因到策略的任一单独特征。
Conclusion: 开发中持续重新生成测试比一次性生成测试更能降低最终失败率，而向测试者暴露候选源码并非该收益的来源；GTDD 把这种自适应反馈与回归测试和独立验收规则结合。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Dynamic Expert Pruning for Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures scale language models efficiently by activating only a few experts per token, but the saving is confined to computation: every expert must stay resident on the accelerator, so memory bounds where these models can be deployed. Expert pruning reduces this footprint, yet existing methods are static --- a single mask, calibrated offline, is applied to the model for every subsequent request. This assumption can fail when the workload is heterogeneous, most prominently in multi-agent systems, where one backbone serves many tasks and roles at once: our analysis shows that different tasks and roles recruit different experts, while static methods assign one fixed subset to all of them. We therefore propose Dynamic Expert Pruning (DEP), which rests on a finding we establish here: an agent's system and task prompts are by themselves sufficient to identify the experts that agent and its task require, since that text already describes what the agent will do. A lightweight predictor, trained once on workflow transcripts, turns those prompts into a specialized per-request mask in a single forward pass, with no per-configuration calibration. Across diverse tasks and roles, model scales, and MoE architectures, DEP achieves better overall accuracy than static pruning and merging baselines, and generalizes to workflows unseen in training without retraining. Its margin over those baselines is largest when few experts are retained, suggesting that the role specialization inherent to multi-agent systems permits sparser serving than static pruning allows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多智能体系统里一个 MoE backbone 同时服务多种任务与角色，静态专家剪枝对所有请求套用同一固定掩码，浪费显存。DEP 用一个轻量 predictor 直接从 agent 的 system/task prompt 一次前向生成按请求的专用掩码，无需逐配置校准；在多种任务、角色、模型规模与 MoE 架构上整体准确率高于静态剪枝与 merging 基线，且保留专家越少优势越大。
Motivation: MoE 的省算力不省显存，所有专家都必须常驻加速器，限制部署范围；现有专家剪枝是离线标定的静态单一掩码，在一个 backbone 服务多任务多角色的多智能体系统中失效，因为不同任务与角色实际调用的专家并不相同。
Method: 提出 Dynamic Expert Pruning (DEP)：核心发现是 agent 的 system 与 task prompt 本身已描述该 agent 将做什么，足以确定所需专家；一个在 workflow transcripts 上只训练一次的轻量 predictor，把这些 prompt 在单次前向中转成按请求的专用掩码，不做任何逐配置校准。
Result: 在多样任务与角色、不同模型规模和 MoE 架构上，DEP 的整体准确率优于静态剪枝与 merging 基线，并能泛化到训练中未见过的 workflow 而无需重训练；相对基线的领先幅度在保留专家数很少时最大。
Conclusion: 多智能体系统固有的角色特化允许比静态剪枝更稀疏的服务配置，而 prompt 已足够定位所需专家，因此按请求动态剪枝可行且无需逐配置校准。

papers.title: When Predicting Nothing Beats SAM 3: Revisiting Evaluation in Video Object Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Video Object Segmentation (VOS) in complex and long videos is increasingly important for real-world applications, where target objects often appear only intermittently within long temporal horizons. However, existing benchmarks largely focus on temporally salient objects that remain visible for most of the video. To address this gap, we introduce FaVOS (A Benchmark for Video Object Segmentation with Fractional Temporal Visibility), a benchmark designed to evaluate VOS methods under low temporal visibility. We show that, in this regime, the standard J&F metric can collapse VOS evaluation into absence classification, because empty predictions receive high rewards on target-absent frames. Consequently, even a trivial empty-mask predictor can outperform strong models such as SAM 3, revealing a fundamental mismatch between current metrics and practical VOS performance. To mitigate this issue, we propose Volumetric J&F, which evaluates mask sequences as spatio-temporal volumes and reduces the dominance of target-absence rewards while preserving sensitivity to segmentation quality and temporal structure. Project page: https://aidaslab.github.io/FaVOS.

Motivation: 现有 VOS 基准集中在目标大部分时间可见的时序显著对象，而真实长视频中目标常间歇出现；此时 J&F 在缺席帧奖励空预测，指标与实际性能错位。

papers.title: Continual Graph Memory for Mathematical Research Agents
papers.abstract_en: Using frontier agent harnesses to tackle mathematical research problems has emerged as an effective means of advancing mathematics. However, solving frontier problems in mathematics may require a massive number of agents working in parallel for extended periods to construct proofs, thereby generating an enormous volume of intermediate proof results. Organizing these intermediate results throughout a long-horizon proof-search process and reusing knowledge gained from prior explorations remain major challenges. We present Ansatz, a mathematical research agent built around Continual Graph Memory, a graph-based, evolvable, cross-problem mathematical research memory system that explicitly organizes the entire proof search process and reuses information from exploration trajectories of previous problems. Specifically, we develop a unified graph memory that represents all intermediate exploration results, including facts, plans, and counterexamples, together with edges that explicitly represent the relationships among them; dependency-aware retrieval supplies precisely targeted local context; an evidence-sensitive curator updates the research frontier and distills lessons from prior attempts; and scoped recall surfaces earlier statements and negative findings for local re-proving rather than uncritical reuse. Experiments cover runs across all ten First Proof Second Batch problems, together with four component studies. Ansatz reports closure on all ten research tasks, demonstrating its ability to sustain and resume long-horizon mathematical search. Beyond these problems, Ansatz also produces solutions to the Jamison caterpillar conjecture and Erdős Problems 289, 348, and 488 without human intervention, and makes partial progress on several open problems, illustrating its strong ability to solve open mathematical research problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Ansatz 用 Continual Graph Memory 把数学研究 agent 的全部中间探索结果（事实、计划、反例及关系边）组织成可演化的跨问题图记忆，靠依赖感知检索、证据敏感的前沿更新与作用域化召回来复用先前探索。在 First Proof Second Batch 全部十道题上报告全部闭环，并无人工干预地解出 Jamison caterpillar 猜想与 Erdős Problems 289、348、488。
Motivation: 前沿数学问题需要大量 agent 长时间并行构造证明，产生海量中间结果；长程证明搜索中组织这些结果、复用先前探索所得知识仍是主要瓶颈。
Method: 构建统一图记忆表示全部中间探索结果（facts、plans、counterexamples）及显式关系边；依赖感知检索 (dependency-aware retrieval) 提供精准局部上下文，证据敏感的 curator 更新研究前沿并蒸馏先前尝试的教训，scoped recall 把早期陈述与负面发现召回做局部重证而非无条件复用。
Result: 实验覆盖 First Proof Second Batch 全部十道题加四项组件研究 (component studies)，Ansatz 在全部十个研究任务上报告闭环 (closure)；另无人工干预地给出 Jamison caterpillar 猜想与 Erdős Problems 289、348、488 的解，并在若干开放问题上取得部分进展。
Conclusion: 把证明搜索过程显式组织成可演化图记忆并按依赖与证据复用，足以让 agent 维持并恢复长程数学搜索，甚至独立解出若干开放问题。

papers.title: Cross-Fitting Under Nonregularity: Normality and Inference via Locality
papers.abstract_en: Cross-fitting is routine in much of applied research. While conventional confidence intervals that ignore cross-fold dependence are asymptotically valid in several settings, they undercover in many applications that share a common form of nonregularity: from the classic cross-validation problem of testing whether a fitted model outperforms another, to testing for heterogeneous treatment effects with machine learning, to estimating the value of a potentially non-unique optimal treatment regime. Exploiting a new locality condition, I show that a large class of cross-fitting estimators still satisfies a central limit theorem despite the nonregularity, but with an asymptotic variance that must be adjusted for the cross-fold correlation. Then, I propose a method for estimating this correlation and construct new confidence intervals that attain asymptotically nominal coverage. Finally, I show that the proposed confidence intervals attain approximately nominal coverage in a simulation study with random forests and neural networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 交叉拟合 (cross-fitting) 估计量在非正则性 (nonregularity) 下仍满足中心极限定理，但渐近方差必须按折间相关性调整；作者提出估计该相关性的方法并构造新置信区间，在随机森林与神经网络的模拟中达到近似名义覆盖率。
Motivation: 忽略折间依赖的常规置信区间在许多共享同一类非正则性的应用中欠覆盖 (undercover)，例如交叉验证比较模型、用机器学习检验异质性处理效应、以及估计可能非唯一的最优处理策略。
Method: 利用新的 locality 条件证明一大类交叉拟合估计量在非正则性下仍满足 CLT，但渐近方差需按折间相关调整；据此提出估计该相关性的方法并构造新置信区间。
Result: 在含随机森林与神经网络的模拟研究中，所提置信区间达到近似名义覆盖率 (approximately nominal coverage)。
Conclusion: 只要按折间相关修正渐近方差，交叉拟合估计量在非正则情形下仍可做渐近有效的推断。

papers.title: Kinematics-Induced Multimodal 3D Human Pose Estimation with Subject-Level Privacy
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal 3D Human Pose Estimation (3D HPE) combines complementary information from RGB, LiDAR, and mmWave radar, but models trained on correlated observations from the same individuals, raise privacy risks overlooked by record level analysis. We present a unified framework for multimodal 3D HPE that couples kinematics-induced sensor fusion with subject level privacy auditing and private training. First, our multimodal model aligns modality specific joint representation, injects skeletal structure and adaptively aggregates complementary sensor evidence for accurate pose prediction. Second, we formulate a black-box subject membership inference attack for 3D HPE, complemented by an empirical pointwise maximal leakage analysis, which characterizes how individual attack score outcomes change inference about the membership outcome. Third, we instantiate user-level differential privacy via Action Temporal Stratification, a population weighted within-subject sampling strategy that enforces action and temporal coverage. We evaluate our framework on the MM-Fi dataset across three diverse experimental protocols. Source-code will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出统一的多模态 3D 人体姿态估计 (3D HPE) 框架，用运动学驱动的传感器融合对齐 RGB、LiDAR、mmWave radar 的关节表示并注入骨骼结构，同时把隐私审计从记录级提升到个体级。框架在 MM-Fi 数据集上按三种实验协议评估，配套黑盒成员推断攻击与用户级差分隐私训练。
Motivation: 同一受试者的多模态观测高度相关，记录级隐私分析会漏掉个体级成员推断风险，而现有 3D HPE 训练未处理这一漏洞。
Method: 三部分：多模态模型对齐各模态关节表示、注入骨骼结构并自适应聚合互补传感器证据；黑盒个体成员推断攻击，辅以经验性 pointwise maximal leakage 分析刻画单次攻击得分对成员结论的推断变化；用 Action Temporal Stratification（按人群加权的被试内采样，保证动作与时间覆盖）实例化用户级差分隐私训练。
Result: 在 MM-Fi 数据集上跨三种不同实验协议评估整个框架；pointwise maximal leakage 刻画个体攻击得分如何改变对成员结果的推断。
Conclusion: 3D HPE 的隐私风险须在个体（subject）级而非记录级审计，并可通过动作-时间分层的用户级差分隐私在训练中缓解；源代码将在录用后发布。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: FASTDIAR: Frame-level speaker encoder for Streaming Diarization
papers.abstract_en: Real-time conversational agents require speaker diarization that streams and runs on a CPU. Most systems apply an utterance-level speaker encoder to short, heavily overlapping chunks, which wastes computation and leaves the model optimized for the wrong task. We instead turn a state-of-the-art speaker recognition architecture into a causal frame-level encoder that reads the stream once and emits one embedding every 80~ms from a bounded two-second window of past audio, and pair it with online clustering that gates every update on the self-similarity of the stream. Trained only by distillation from an utterance-level teacher on simulated and out-of-domain mixtures, and evaluated with one fixed set of hyperparameters, the system is the most accurate streaming diarizer on low-overlap benchmarks at sub-second latency, degrades far less than cache-based systems as the number of speakers grows, and runs five times faster than real time on a single CPU thread.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FASTDIAR 把说话人识别架构改造成因果的帧级编码器，每读一次流就从过去 2 秒有界窗口输出一个 80 ms 间隔的 embedding，配合按流内自相似门控更新的在线聚类，实现 CPU 上的流式说话人分离。仅用 utterance 级教师在模拟与域外混合语音上蒸馏训练、固定一组超参评测，它在低重叠基准上以亚秒级延迟取得最高精度，随说话人数增加的性能退化远小于 cache 类系统，单 CPU 线程达实时的 5 倍速度。
Motivation: 实时对话代理需要能在 CPU 上流式运行的说话人分离，而现有系统把 utterance 级编码器用在高度重叠的短 chunk 上，既浪费算力，也让模型优化的目标与流式任务错位。
Method: 将 SOTA 说话人识别架构改造为因果帧级编码器，单次读流、从过去 2 秒有界窗口每 80 ms 输出一个 embedding；配对在线聚类，每次更新由流的自相似性门控。训练只用 utterance 级教师的蒸馏，数据为模拟与域外 (out-of-domain) 混合语音，评测固定一组超参数。
Result: 在低重叠基准上以亚秒级延迟取得最准确的流式 diarizer；随说话人数增加，性能退化远小于 cache 类系统；单 CPU 线程运行速度为实时的 5 倍。
Conclusion: 把说话人编码从 utterance 级搬到帧级并让聚类更新受流内自相似门控，可以在 CPU 实时预算内同时拿到低重叠精度、说话人数扩展性和速度优势。

papers.title: When to Compile a Computer-Use Agent? Measuring Payback and Making Compilation Decisions for Token Efficiency
papers.abstract_en: Compiling GUI procedures that agents execute repeatedly into programs can reduce their token costs. However, measuring payback and deciding when to compile have two challenges. First, compilation costs are uncertain because attempts can require repair and still fail to produce a usable program. Second, future reuse is unknown because tasks may stop arriving or GUI drift may stop the program from working. To address these challenges, we propose PACE (Payback-Aware Compilation from Experience), a system with a measurement protocol and an online compilation algorithm. The measurement protocol records successful and failed compilation costs, and compares agent and program execution costs on matched task inputs to estimate per-use savings and payback counts. Using these measurements, the online algorithm compares estimated future savings with compilation costs, including failed attempts, based on past task arrivals and compilation outcomes. It checks execution and compilation charges against a cumulative budget determined by observed task arrivals before allowing either action. Under stated action-cost assumptions, total cost after each arrival is at most $1+ε$ times the cost of running every task with the agent. For successful compilation attempts, estimated payback counts excluding source agent runs are 2-16 uses. In simulations using recorded task arrivals, PACE reduces token costs by 17.3% compared with ReAct, 24.9% with the AutoRPA adaptation, and 17.3% with the ToolPro adaptation on average ($ε=0.25$).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PACE 为 computer-use agent 的 GUI 流程编译做回本感知决策：测量协议在配对任务输入上记录成功/失败的编译成本与 agent/程序执行成本，估出每次使用的节省与回本次数；在线算法据此比较预期节省与含失败尝试的编译成本，并用观测到的任务到达量约束累计预算。在声明的动作成本假设下，每次任务到达后的总成本至多为全程用 agent 的 1+ε 倍；成功编译的估计回本次数（不含源 agent 运行）为 2–16 次使用。
Motivation: 把 agent 反复执行的 GUI 流程编译成程序能省 token，但编译成本不确定（可能要修复甚至失败），未来复用也不可知（任务可能停来、GUI 漂移可能让程序失效），因此无法判断何时该编译。
Method: PACE 含一个测量协议与一个在线编译算法：协议在配对任务输入上记录成功与失败的编译成本，并对比 agent 与程序执行成本以估计单次节省和回本次数；算法结合历史任务到达与编译结果，把失败尝试计入编译成本，比较预期未来节省，并以观测任务到达决定的累计预算限制执行与编译两种动作的开销。
Result: 在声明的动作成本假设下，每次任务到达后的总成本至多为全部任务用 agent 运行的 1+ε 倍（ε=0.25）。成功编译尝试的估计回本次数（不含源 agent 运行）为 2–16 次使用。在用记录的任务到达做的模拟中，PACE 平均比 ReAct 降低 17.3% token 成本，比 AutoRPA 改编版降低 24.9%，比 ToolPro 改编版降低 17.3%。
Conclusion: 把编译当作带失败风险与未知复用的投资问题、用回本感知的在线决策控制预算，可以在任务到达不确定时稳定削减 computer-use agent 的 token 开销。

papers.title: Discriminating Fixture Coverage in Agent-Infrastructure Verification Suites
papers.abstract_en: Invariant suites and runtime monitors increasingly gate agent deployment decisions, and the evidence offered for any particular suite is almost always a single observation: it passes an implementation believed correct and fails one believed broken. We measure what that observation is worth. Applying mutation analysis to an invariant suite for a multi-session agent state-projection layer, we first find that this standard validation certifies a suite in which a first-order mutant removing event-identity deduplication survives every check. We then freeze the repaired twelve-check suite, record its hash, and run it once against ten mutants specified by an adversarial reader who designed none of its fixtures: it kills five. Instrumenting the five survivors against the reference shows they fail in two distinct ways, not one. Three are never activated, because no fixture supplies an input on which the mutated code behaves differently at all. The other two corrupt internal state that no oracle in the suite can observe. The two modes need different repairs, and neither is visible from a pass/fail report. Treating the missing inputs as a coverage question, we enumerate seven discriminating dimensions of the input space, register in advance which are uncovered and which survivors they should explain, and add one fixture per uncovered dimension while reusing the existing oracles verbatim. All five survivors then die, each to the check written for its predicted dimension. We report this as a repair result on the same challenge set rather than a second held-out estimate, and give the artifact, including the frozen hash, the registered predictions, all mutants and the run logs, so the distinction is checkable.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对多会话 agent 状态投影层的 invariant suite 做变异分析，发现“通过一个正确实现、拒绝一个错误实现”这一标准验证会认证出一阶 mutant（去掉事件身份去重）全部存活的套件。冻结后的十二检查套件对对抗读者指定的十个 mutant 只杀五个；把五个幸存者按失效模式归因到输入覆盖后，预先登记七个判别维度、每个未覆盖维度补一个 fixture（oracle 原样复用），五个幸存者全部被杀，且各死于为其预测维度写的检查。
Motivation: Invariant suite 与 runtime monitor 正在成为 agent 部署门禁，但支撑某个套件的证据几乎总是单次观察（过正确实现、拒错误实现），无法区分“输入根本没激活变异代码”与“oracle 看不见被破坏的内部状态”这两类失效。
Method: 对多会话 agent 状态投影层的 invariant suite 施加 mutation analysis；先修复被一阶 mutant 钻空的套件，冻结为十二检查并记录 hash；再由未参与设计 fixture 的对抗读者指定十个 mutant 跑一次；对五个幸存者对照 reference 插桩定位失效方式，枚举输入空间的七个判别维度并预先登记未覆盖维度及其应解释的幸存者，每个维度补一个 fixture、oracle 逐字复用。
Result: 标准验证认证的套件中，去除事件身份去重的一阶 mutant 通过全部检查；冻结的十二检查套件对十个对抗 mutant 杀五个；五个幸存者分两种失效模式——三个因无 fixture 提供差异化输入而从未被激活，两个破坏了套件中任何 oracle 都观察不到的内部状态；补七个维度各一个 fixture 后五个幸存者全部被杀，且各死于为其预测维度写的检查。
Conclusion: 单次 pass/fail 观察不足以支撑 agent 验证套件：幸存者需要按失效模式分别修复，而两种模式在 pass/fail 报告里都不可见；作者把结果明确报告为同一挑战集上的修复结果而非第二次 held-out 估计，并公开 artifact（冻结 hash、登记预测、全部 mutant 与运行日志）使该区分可核查。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Positive-Unlabeled Learning for Agent Safety False Alarm Auditing
papers.abstract_en: Safety monitors help safeguard language-model agents interacting with external tools and environments, but conservative monitoring can generate many false alarms, consuming extensive review resources and weakening trust in alerts. Because false and genuine alarms often remain interleaved in native monitor scores, obtaining a reliable cutoff still requires substantial manual verification. In practice, a small set of verified-safe non-alarmed trajectories may be available while alarms remain unlabeled, naturally casting false-alarm auditing as a positive-unlabeled (PU) ranking problem. The key challenge is monitor-induced selection, since observed safe references are accepted by the monitor, while the hidden safe alarms of interest are precisely those it incorrectly flags, making the observed positives poorly representative of the positives to be recovered. To address this challenge, we propose a two-stage framework in which Trust-aware PU Supervision adapts safe references toward the alarm domain and protects plausible false alarms from excessive negative pressure, while Reliability-gated Rank Distillation consolidates consistent ordering preferences from multiple PU reference models into a single student. Consensus-guided Structural Refinement then improves the student ranking using hierarchical safe-reference support, alarm relations, and predicted reference consensus. The framework requires no alarm safety labels for fitting and leaves the underlying monitor unchanged. Across mainstream safety monitors, our method achieves a macro AUPRC of $0.6444$, outperforming eight evaluated PU baselines by 5.27--16.98 absolute percentage points; compared with PULDA, the strongest evaluated PU baseline, it recovers 33.3% more false alarms at a 5% review budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LM agent 安全监控器的误报审计建模为 PU 排序问题：用 Trust-aware PU Supervision 把已验证安全参考适配到告警域并减轻对疑似误报的负压力，再用 Reliability-gated Rank Distillation 与 Consensus-guided Structural Refinement 合成学生排序。在主流安全监控器上 macro AUPRC 达 0.6444，超八个 PU 基线 5.27–16.98 个百分点；对比最强基线 PULDA 在 5% 审阅预算下多找回 33.3% 误报。
Motivation: 保守的安全监控器产生大量误报，真假告警在原始分数中交织，确定阈值需大量人工核验；而可用的少量已验证安全参考是被监控器接受的，与被误标的真实安全告警分布不一致（monitor-induced selection）。
Method: 两阶段框架：Trust-aware PU Supervision 将安全参考向告警域适配并保护疑似误报免受过强负压力；Reliability-gated Rank Distillation 把多个 PU 参考模型的一致排序偏好蒸馏进单个 student；Consensus-guided Structural Refinement 再用层次化安全参考支撑、告警关系与预测共识改进排序。拟合不需要告警安全标签，也不改动原监控器。
Result: 在主流安全监控器上 macro AUPRC 0.6444，比八个评估的 PU 基线高 5.27–16.98 绝对百分点；对比 PULDA（最强 PU 基线）在 5% 审阅预算下多找回 33.3% 的误报。
Conclusion: 在存在 monitor-induced selection 的条件下，无需告警标签的 PU 排序框架即可显著提升误报找回率，同时保持底层监控器不变。

papers.title: HASTE: Evolving Agent Harnesses Against Emerging Attacks Using Sparse Evidence
papers.abstract_en: Agent harnesses play a critical role in defenses by enforcing safety constraints to prevent unsafe actions. However, rapidly emerging attacks outpace manual harness adaptation, motivating automated harness evolution. Yet the signals available for harness evolution are often sparse, such as brief descriptions or a few attack examples in threat reports and preprints. To address this limitation, we introduce HASTE, a multi-agent framework that evolves agent harnesses from sparse threat evidence through an adversarial interplay between safety-specification generation and attack-case generation. Safety specifications guide harness updates toward addressing identified safety vulnerabilities, while attack cases probe for remaining safety vulnerabilities after each update. By feeding evaluation outcomes back into both processes, HASTE enables harness evolution against emerging attacks beyond the initially observed evidence. Experimental results across multiple backbone models, attack types, and evidence forms show that HASTE consistently reduces attack success rates while preserving benign-task utility. The code is available at https://github.com/xxiqiao/HASTE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HASTE 用多智能体对抗框架从稀疏威胁证据（威胁报告或预印本中的简短描述与少量攻击样例）自动演化 agent harness：安全规格生成与攻击用例生成互相博弈，评估结果回灌两边，使 harness 能应对超出初始证据的新攻击。在多种 backbone 模型、攻击类型与证据形式上，攻击成功率持续下降且良性任务效用保持。
Motivation: 新兴攻击的出现速度快于人工改写 harness 的速度，而可用于演化的信号又很稀疏，只有威胁报告里的简短描述或几个攻击样例。
Method: HASTE 多智能体框架：安全规格生成指导 harness 更新以覆盖已识别漏洞，攻击用例生成在每次更新后探测残留漏洞，评估结果反馈回两个过程形成对抗式迭代演化。
Result: 在多个 backbone 模型、多种攻击类型与多种证据形式的实验中，攻击成功率 (attack success rate) 持续降低，同时保持良性任务效用；代码发布于 github.com/xxiqiao/HASTE。
Conclusion: 稀疏威胁证据足以驱动 harness 自动演化，对抗式的规格生成与攻击生成能把防护推广到初始证据之外的新攻击。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Jazz Pianist Style with Cross-Attention Conditioning
papers.abstract_en: Jazz pianists develop distinctive traits that experienced listeners can often identify within seconds, yet the features underlying this recognition resist formal description. We study jazz pianist style through the lens of a pretrained symbolic music transformer, showing that its learned representations already encode pianist identity well enough for highly accurate classification across two benchmarks. We then augment the transformer with cross-attention over learned pianist identity embeddings, enabling it to generate music conditioned on a specific artist's style. Two evaluation protocols confirm that the generator captures meaningful stylistic structure: a sliding-window classifier consistently attributes conditioned continuations to the correct artist, far above unconditioned baselines; and a classifier trained entirely on synthetic generations identifies real pianists across 12 classes with 87% chunk-level and 95% song-level accuracy. Finally, we repurpose the classifier to locate the most characteristic moments within a performance, surfacing the specific musical gestures that distinguish each pianist's voice.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at ISMIR 2026. Audio demos, code and checkpoints: https://almostimplemented.github.io/jazz-pianist-style
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用预训练符号音乐 Transformer 的表征做爵士钢琴家风格识别，再在其上加对可学习钢琴家身份嵌入的 cross-attention，使模型能按指定艺术家风格续写生成。滑窗分类器把条件生成的续写稳定归到正确艺术家，远高于无条件基线；完全在合成生成上训练的分类器在 12 类真实钢琴家上达到 87% chunk 级、95% song 级准确率。
Motivation: 爵士钢琴家数秒内即可被听者辨认的个人特征难以形式化描述，需要一种能显式建模并按身份条件生成的表示与生成框架。
Method: 先在两个基准上检验预训练符号音乐 Transformer 的表征对钢琴家身份的可分性，再给该 Transformer 增加对可学习 pianist identity embedding 的 cross-attention，实现按艺术家风格条件生成；用滑窗分类器归因条件续写，并把分类器反用为定位演出中最具特征片段的工具。
Result: 钢琴家身份分类在两个基准上达到 highly accurate；滑窗分类器对条件续写的归因 consistently 正确且 far above unconditioned baselines；完全在合成生成上训练的分类器在 12 类真实钢琴家上取得 87% chunk-level 与 95% song-level 准确率。
Conclusion: 预训练符号音乐 Transformer 已编码足够的钢琴家身份信息，加上身份嵌入的 cross-attention 条件化即可生成具风格结构的音乐，且该分类器可反用于定位区分每位钢琴家的具体音乐手势。

summary_sections.motivation: 爵士钢琴家数秒内即可被听者辨认的个人特征难以形式化描述，需要一种能显式建模并按身份条件生成的表示与生成框架。
summary_sections.method: 先在两个基准上检验预训练符号音乐 Transformer 的表征对钢琴家身份的可分性，再给该 Transformer 增加对可学习 pianist identity embedding 的 cross-attention，实现按艺术家风格条件生成；用滑窗分类器归因条件续写，并把分类器反用为定位演出中最具特征片段的工具。
summary_sections.result: 钢琴家身份分类在两个基准上达到 highly accurate；滑窗分类器对条件续写的归因 consistently 正确且 far above unconditioned baselines；完全在合成生成上训练的分类器在 12 类真实钢琴家上取得 87% chunk-level 与 95% song-level 准确率。
summary_sections.conclusion: 预训练符号音乐 Transformer 已编码足够的钢琴家身份信息，加上身份嵌入的 cross-attention 条件化即可生成具风格结构的音乐，且该分类器可反用于定位区分每位钢琴家的具体音乐手势。

papers.title: Custom Forcing: Training-Free Subject Customization for Autoregressive Video Generation
authors: (2) The University of Texas at Austin)
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive video models can generate minute-long videos in real time, but they produce generic subjects from text rather than specific subjects from user-provided images. Existing customization methods either require costly per-subject optimization or use pretrained conditioning networks that jointly process all video frames with bidirectional attention. Neither approach is designed for causal streaming. We present Custom Forcing, a training-free method that stores reference-based anchor frames in the persistent KV cache of a frozen autoregressive video model. However, fixed anchors face two limitations: simple conditioning allows identity to drift, and the text prompt continues to favor a generic subject. To address these problems, drift-adaptive value amplification (DVA) scales reference influence with the degree of identity drift, while anchor contrast guidance (ACG) steers generation away from the generic class prior. Over two-minute rollouts, fixed anchors fall from 0.58 to 0.42 in DINO-I, while Custom Forcing keeps it between 0.58 and 0.62 without reducing motion. Custom Forcing also achieves higher subject similarity than bidirectional customization methods and better preserves identity over 30s than causal image-to-video and reference-to-video models, while generating each frame 9.5--28.5 times faster than these long-video baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Custom Forcing 是面向自回归视频模型的免训练主体定制方法：把参考图像锚帧写入冻结模型的持久 KV cache，并用漂移自适应值放大 (DVA) 按身份漂移程度放大参考影响、用锚帧对比引导 (ACG) 把生成推离文本提示偏好的通用类先验。两分钟长程生成中，固定锚帧的 DINO-I 从 0.58 跌到 0.42，而 Custom Forcing 维持在 0.58–0.62 且不牺牲运动量。
Motivation: 自回归视频模型只能从文本生成通用主体，无法锁定用户图像中的特定主体；现有定制方案要么逐主体优化代价高，要么用双向注意力联合处理全部帧，都不适配因果流式生成。
Method: 免训练：将参考锚帧存入冻结自回归视频模型的持久 KV cache；DVA 按身份漂移程度动态缩放参考值的影响，ACG 引导生成避开文本提示隐含的通用类先验，两者共同对抗身份漂移与通用主体偏好。
Result: 两分钟 rollout 中固定锚帧 DINO-I 由 0.58 降至 0.42，Custom Forcing 维持在 0.58–0.62 且运动不下降；主体相似度高于双向定制方法，30 秒区间内的身份保持优于 causal image-to-video 与 reference-to-video 模型，逐帧生成速度比这些长视频基线快 9.5–28.5 倍。
Conclusion: 在因果自回归视频模型中，用 KV cache 锚帧加漂移自适应放大与类先验对比引导，即可在不训练、不降运动的前提下把主体身份稳定到两分钟级长程生成。

papers.title: Probe the Harness: Setup Checks for Stale-Data RL Comparisons in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Methods for training language models on stale samples are judged by comparisons against importance-corrected baselines. We show that details of the experimental harness can reverse the observed ranking of methods, and we introduce PTH (Probe The Harness), a set of checks that makes the harness visible. Our case is a comparison between SAN, a behaviour-free method, and truncated importance sampling (TIS) on verl and in a single-GPU trainer, in which SAN first finished ahead in both stacks. Four details of the harness changed this comparison: the PPO ratio was taken against the learner's own recomputed probabilities, the data seed did not reach the TIS arm, the replay queue reused its first batch for 33 updates, and two loss normalisers differed from their description. In each case the logged quantity looked consistent with a working setup, while the quantity that defines the comparison went unchecked. With the harness checked, TIS matches SAN on verl, and in the trainer TIS learns steadily while SAN keeps a margin. We contribute the signature of each detail and its effect on the comparison, reference results for TIS and uncorrected GRPO under sampler lag, and the PTH checklist.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在陈旧样本 (stale data) 的 RL 训练对比中，实验 harness 的四个细节足以反转方法排名：修正后 TIS 在 verl 上追平 SAN，在单 GPU trainer 中 SAN 仍保持领先。作者提出 PTH 检查清单，让被日志掩盖的对比量可见。
Motivation: 用重要性校正基线评判陈旧样本 RL 方法时，harness 细节会悄悄改变被比较的量，而日志看起来一切正常，导致方法排名不可复现。
Method: 提出 PTH (Probe The Harness) 检查集，逐项核对 PPO ratio 是否取自 learner 自身重算概率、数据 seed 是否到达 TIS 分支、replay queue 是否重复使用首批数据、以及两个 loss normaliser 与描述是否一致；对比对象为 SAN 与 truncated importance sampling (TIS)，在 verl 与单 GPU trainer 两套栈中运行。
Result: 四个 harness 细节各自改变对比：replay 首批数据被复用 33 次更新；修正后 TIS 在 verl 上追平 SAN，trainer 中 TIS 稳定学习而 SAN 保持领先；同时给出 sampler lag 下 TIS 与未校正 GRPO 的参考结果。
Conclusion: 陈旧样本 RL 的方法排名取决于 harness 细节而非方法本身，应先按 PTH 清单核对被比较的量再下结论。

papers.title: Frequency Is Not Sensitivity Identifying Safety-Sensitive Experts in Sparse MoE LLM
papers.abstract_en: Suppressing a small set of routed experts can weaken the safety behavior of a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model without retraining. Which experts to suppress is therefore a security question, and the usual answer is activation frequency, but frequency measures use, not influence. We test an alternative: router-gradient sensitivity, the sensitivity of the sequence loss to the gate weights that select an expert. Across five MoE architectures, we rank experts by each signal on 500 benign and 500 malicious prompts and measure refusal on 100 held-out malicious prompts under two budgets: equal expert counts and equal nominal malicious routing traffic (1%-5%). Under each of the two budgets, router-gradient selection reduces refusals more than activation in 24 of 25 conditions, and more than a ten-trial random mean in all 25. The largest effect is in OLMoE, where refusals fall from 34 to 9 of 100 prompts (73.53% relative) with no degraded outputs, indicating substantive compliance rather than broken generation. After matching expert counts in every layer, gradient selection still produces greater refusal reduction than activation in 23 of 25 conditions, with two ties. An exploratory cross-model analysis links larger malicious-versus-benign concentration gaps to greater peak gradient effects (rho = 0.90; exact two-sided p = 0.083, n = 5). Together, the results support gradient selection under the tested budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在稀疏 MoE LLM 中，按 router-gradient sensitivity（序列损失对门控权重的梯度）挑选要压制的专家，比按激活频率挑选更能削弱安全拒绝行为。在五种 MoE 架构、两种预算（等专家数与等名义恶意路由流量 1%–5%）下，梯度法在 25 个条件中的 24 个比激活频率降低更多拒绝，全部 25 个条件都超过十次随机均值；OLMoE 上拒绝从 100 条中的 34 降到 9（相对下降 73.53%）。
Motivation: 压制少量路由专家即可在不重训的前提下削弱 MoE 模型的安全行为，选哪些专家是安全问题；常用答案是激活频率，但频率衡量的是使用量而非影响力。
Method: 提出 router-gradient sensitivity：计算序列损失对选择专家的门控权重的梯度，据此对专家排序；在五种 MoE 架构上用 500 条良性与 500 条恶意 prompt 排序，在 100 条留出恶意 prompt 上测拒绝率，预算分等专家数与等名义恶意路由流量（1%–5%）两种，并与激活频率及十次随机基线对比。
Result: 两种预算下梯度选择在 25 个条件中 24 个比激活频率降低更多拒绝，25 个全部优于十次随机均值；OLMoE 拒绝由 100 条中 34 降至 9（相对 73.53%），且无 degraded 输出。逐层匹配专家数后，梯度选择仍在 25 个条件中 23 个优于激活频率、2 个持平。跨模型探索性分析中，恶意与良性集中度差越大峰值梯度效应越强（rho = 0.90，双侧精确 p = 0.083，n = 5）。
Conclusion: 在所测预算下，作者支持用梯度敏感度而非激活频率来挑选要压制的专家；频率衡量使用而非影响。

papers.title: Constraint-Aware Training
papers.abstract_en: When generating programs with language models, constrained decoding can apply program analyses to exclude tokens that violate syntax, scope, or typing rules. However, there is a duplication: standard training already teaches the model to suppress the tokens rejected by these analyses. This duplication leads to the question: if we will perform some analysis to filter a set tokens out during inference anyways, can we avoid teaching the model the said analysis altogether during training, and does this externalization lead to more efficient models? This paper defines a general constraint-aware objective satisfying this externalization desideratum and formalizes the benefits of externalization into three concrete theorems about model size and data efficiency. We show, through a controlled synthetic experiment, that the theorems survive training dynamics: constraint-aware training yields lower prediction loss at a matched parameter count and data compared to ordinary cross-entropy training, motivating training objectives that incorporate the analyses used during generation.
papers.comment: Accepted at Neurips 2026 workshop AI for Verifiable Coding
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 受约束解码 (constrained decoding) 已在推理时用程序分析剔除违反语法、作用域、类型规则的 token，而标准训练又让模型重复学会同一套抑制。本文提出满足“外化”要求的 constraint-aware 目标，把该分析从训练中移除，并给出三条关于模型规模与数据效率的定理；受控合成实验显示，在相同参数量与数据下其预测损失低于普通交叉熵训练。
Motivation: 推理时的程序分析与训练时的 token 抑制存在重复：既然推理反正要过滤，训练是否还需教模型同一套分析，外化能否换来更高效的模型。
Method: 定义一个通用的 constraint-aware 训练目标，使模型不必在训练中学习推理时由程序分析承担的约束；将外化的收益形式化为三条关于模型规模与数据效率的定理，并用受控合成实验检验定理在训练动力学下是否成立。
Result: 在受控合成实验中，constraint-aware training 在匹配参数量与数据量下取得比普通交叉熵训练更低的预测损失；外化的收益由三条关于模型规模与数据效率的定理给出。
Conclusion: 训练目标应纳入生成时使用的那些分析，把约束外化给解码期的程序分析即可在同等参数与数据下降低损失。

papers.title: Do ResNets Route? Sparse Interaction Experts in Residual Networks
papers.abstract_en: Residual networks execute every block for every input, yet their functional contributions need not be input independent. We formulate a trained ResNet as a set function over binary residual-branch masks and apply Möbius inversion to decompose its output exactly into individual residual corrections and higher-order interactions. For smooth residual stacks, we show that each fixed $k$-way interaction scales as $\mathcal{O}(λ^k)$ under residual scaling. Exhaustive analysis of ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-18 and ResNet-34 reveals that interaction mass peaks at orders five and ten, respectively, rather than at low orders. Reducing the residual scale shifts both spectra toward lower orders, but also changes model predictions. The interaction coefficients are concentrated in magnitude but not hard sparse, and prediction-preserving sparsity weakens with depth. Crucially, the dominant interactions vary across inputs and predicted classes around a shared global core, while their overall complexity changes little with sample difficulty. These results show that dense ResNets implement an implicit form of soft routing: every block is executed, but different inputs rely on different residual interaction experts. Routing can therefore emerge at the level of functional contribution without an explicit router or sparse execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把训练好的 ResNet 写成残差分支二值掩码上的集合函数，用 Möbius 反演把输出精确分解为单支残差修正与高阶交互，证明平滑残差栈中固定 k 阶交互随残差缩放按 O(λ^k) 衰减。ImageNet 预训练 ResNet-18/34 的交互质量峰值分别落在五阶和十阶而非低阶，且主导交互随输入与预测类别变化，说明稠密 ResNet 已隐式实现 soft routing：每个块都执行，但不同输入依赖不同的残差交互专家。
Motivation: ResNet 对每个输入都执行全部残差块，但各块的功能贡献未必与输入无关；缺少一种把已训练网络的输出精确拆成单支贡献与高阶交互的框架，因而无法判断路由是否在没有显式 router 的情况下自发出现。
Method: 将训练好的 ResNet 表述为残差分支二值掩码上的集合函数，用 Möbius inversion 精确分解输出为个体残差修正与高阶交互项；对平滑残差栈推导固定 k 阶交互在残差缩放下的 O(λ^k) 标度，并对 ImageNet 预训练 ResNet-18 与 ResNet-34 做穷举分析，考察交互谱、幅值集中度与预测保持稀疏性。
Result: 交互质量峰值出现在五阶（ResNet-18）与十阶（ResNet-34）而非低阶；减小残差缩放使两个谱都向低阶移动，但同时改变模型预测；交互系数幅值集中但并非硬稀疏，且预测保持稀疏性随深度减弱；主导交互随输入与预测类别变化、围绕共享全局核心，其整体复杂度几乎不随样本难度变化。

papers.title: Tangent Schrödinger Bridge Matching: Learning Stochastic Transport with Mechanistic Sensitivities
papers.abstract_en: Predicting how stochastic systems respond to changes in viscosity, reaction rates, or external forces requires costly simulations, motivating reusable learned models. Yet matching observed outcome distributions does not ensure accurate intervention responses. We introduce Tangent Schrödinger Bridge Matching (Tangent-SBM), which learns stochastic transports from endpoint observations and mechanistic sensitivities. It propagates parameter derivatives alongside trajectories and supervises them against supplied targets. For average-response targets, single-rollout squared error also penalizes response variability; our objective uses two independent rollouts to match the mean without this additional penalty. We establish conditions under which sensitivity accuracy bounds finite-change prediction error and decision regret. Across Gaussian, stochastic double-well, PDEBench reaction--diffusion, and stochastic Navier--Stokes systems, Tangent-SBM improves sensitivity and finite-change prediction over matched conditional-bridge baselines while maintaining comparable endpoint and distributional accuracy. Controls examine target correctness, response objectives, and simulator-budget allocation. To test decision usefulness, we evaluate calibrated viscosity selection in Navier--Stokes: Tangent-SBM reduces tracking error relative to taking no action on every evaluated task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Tangent-SBM 从端点观测加机理灵敏度学习随机输运，沿轨迹一起传播参数导数并用给定目标监督，从而在不牺牲端点与分布精度的前提下改进干预响应预测。在 Gaussian、stochastic double-well、PDEBench reaction–diffusion 与 stochastic Navier–Stokes 上，其灵敏度与有限变化预测优于匹配的 conditional-bridge 基线；在 Navier–Stokes 粘度选择任务中，相对不采取行动在每个评估任务上都降低跟踪误差。
Motivation: 随机系统对粘度、反应速率、外力等参数变化的响应只能靠昂贵仿真获得，而只匹配观测结果分布的模型并不保证干预响应正确，导致学到的模型难以复用于参数调优决策。
Method: Tangent-SBM 从端点观测与机理灵敏度学习随机输运，在传播轨迹的同时传播参数导数并对照给定目标监督；针对平均响应目标，用两次独立 rollout 匹配均值，避免单次 rollout 平方误差额外惩罚响应变异性；并给出灵敏度精度约束有限变化预测误差与决策 regret 的条件。
Result: 在 Gaussian、stochastic double-well、PDEBench reaction–diffusion、stochastic Navier–Stokes 四类系统上，Tangent-SBM 的灵敏度与有限变化预测优于匹配的 conditional-bridge 基线，同时端点与分布精度相当；控制实验考察目标正确性、响应目标与仿真预算分配。在 Navier–Stokes 校准粘度选择上，相对不采取行动在每个评估任务上都降低跟踪误差。
Conclusion: 把机理灵敏度作为监督信号并显式传播参数导数，可以在保持分布匹配质量的同时学到可信的干预响应，使随机系统模型可直接支撑参数选择决策。
