papers.title: ViTok: Improving Dense Semantics in AM-RADIO-Style Multi-Teacher Distillation with PHI-S and Masked Image Modelling
papers.abstract_en: We study how to consolidate the current VITOK progress into a single multi-teacher distillation recipe that jointly preserves global recognition and dense semantics. Our starting point is an AM-RADIO-style student distilled from SigLIP2 and DINOv3-L, where SigLIP2 supplies strong global semantics and DINOv3-L supplies stronger dense features. The central empirical issue is that the same recipe does not optimize all objectives equally well: changes that improve ImageNet-1K kNN accuracy can still degrade ADE20K segmentation. We summarize a progression of modifications that make this trade-off more explicit and more manageable: split adaptor heads for CLS and patch tokens, asymmetric cosine/MSE losses, initialization from a DINOv3-L checkpoint, teacher reweighting, masked image modeling (MIM), and PHI-S feature balancing. The resulting model reaches 83.2 patch kNN and 85.2 CLS kNN, slightly surpassing the DINOv3-L teacher on ImageNet-1K kNN classification, while PHI-S restores ADE20K performance from 46.5/58.1 to 48.5/61.0 mIoU/mAcc, matching the teacher on this dense benchmark. We also summarize negative results: scaling distillation from ImageNet-1K to ImageNet22K does not consistently help, and naively adding extra teachers such as SAM3 or HOG features introduces interference. Rather than claiming a final recipe, this paper distills the current project state into a compact empirical story and a concrete set of lessons for future iterations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ViTok 把 AM-RADIO 式多教师蒸馏（教师为 SigLIP2 与 DINOv3-L）整理成一份兼顾全局识别与稠密语义的配方：拆分 CLS/patch 两套 adaptor head、用非对称 cosine/MSE 损失、从 DINOv3-L checkpoint 初始化、教师重加权、加入 masked image modelling (MIM) 与 PHI-S 特征平衡。结果 ImageNet-1K kNN 达 83.2 patch / 85.2 CLS，略超 DINOv3-L 教师；PHI-S 把 ADE20K 从 46.5/58.1 mIoU/mAcc 拉回 48.5/61.0，追平教师。
Motivation: 同一套蒸馏配方无法同时优化各目标：能提高 ImageNet-1K kNN 精度的改动可能反而拉低 ADE20K 分割，全局语义与稠密语义的权衡需要被显式管理。
Method: 在 AM-RADIO 式学生模型上做多教师蒸馏，教师为提供全局语义的 SigLIP2 与提供稠密特征的 DINOv3-L；改动包括 CLS 与 patch token 的 split adaptor heads、非对称 cosine/MSE 损失、DINOv3-L checkpoint 初始化、教师重加权、masked image modelling (MIM) 与 PHI-S 特征平衡。
Result: ImageNet-1K kNN：83.2 patch kNN、85.2 CLS kNN，略超 DINOv3-L 教师；ADE20K 经 PHI-S 从 46.5/58.1 恢复到 48.5/61.0 mIoU/mAcc，与教师持平。负结果：把蒸馏数据从 ImageNet-1K 扩到 ImageNet22K 并不稳定带来收益，直接加入 SAM3 或 HOG 特征等额外教师会引入干扰。
Conclusion: 论文不主张最终配方，而是把当前项目状态浓缩为一条经验叙事与一组可复用的教训：稠密语义要靠 PHI-S 这类特征平衡单独救回，而扩数据与堆教师都不保证有效。

papers.title: LUMOS: Tracing Parametric Knowledge from Training Data to Behavioral Outputs in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Current analyses of LLMs' parametric knowledge are largely output-centric, drawing conclusions about what a model knows without verifying what it was actually trained on. This leaves fundamental questions, such as whether a correct response reflects genuine generalization or rote memorization, grounded in speculation rather than evidence. To resolve these ambiguities, we introduce LUMOS, a diagnostic framework that traces knowledge along the causal chain from training-data exposure to behavioral output, leveraging OLMo 2 with its fully transparent training corpus. By grounding analysis in verified exposure, we reveal that models internally encode rare facts with high separability (84%) yet fail to express them behaviorally (54%), though this retrieval gap narrows with scale. Furthermore, when models are asked to self-reflect on their own answers, they perform reliably on trained content (83%) but drop to random-baseline levels (49%) on unseen content. This collapse persists even under chain-of-thought prompting, which inflates confidence signals rather than improving calibration. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that incorporating the training-data axis into LLM evaluation transforms speculative diagnoses into verifiable claims, and we advocate that this axis should be a standard component of knowledge assessment in LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LUMOS 是一个把 LLM 参数化知识沿“训练数据暴露→行为输出”因果链追溯的诊断框架，依托 OLMo 2 完全透明的训练语料核实模型是否真的见过某事实。结果显示罕见事实在内部以 84% 可分性编码却只有 54% 被行为表达，自反思在已训练内容上达 83%、在未见内容上跌到随机基线 49%，且 CoT 提示只抬高置信信号而不改善校准。作者主张把训练数据轴作为 LLM 知识评估的标准组件。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 参数化知识分析以输出为中心，无法区分正确回答来自真正泛化还是死记硬背，诊断结论停留在推测而非证据。
Method: 提出诊断框架 LUMOS，沿训练数据暴露到行为输出的因果链追踪知识，依托 OLMo 2 的完全透明训练语料核实暴露情况；并考察模型自反思与其在 chain-of-thought 提示下的表现。
Result: 罕见事实内部编码可分性 84%，行为表达仅 54%，该检索差距随模型规模缩小；自反思在已训练内容上 83%，在未见内容上降至随机基线水平 49%；CoT 提示使置信信号膨胀但未改善校准。
Conclusion: 把训练数据轴纳入 LLM 评估能把推测性诊断转为可验证结论，作者主张将其作为知识评估的标准组件。

papers.title: Interpreting at Write Time: A Policy Ablation for Multi-Goal Agent Memory
papers.abstract_en: A long-running assistant cannot keep everything it has seen, so it summarises. Summarising is not neutral: what is kept is chosen against some notion of what the record is for, and that choice is made once, before anyone knows which of the user's standing goals will ask. Goals rarely disagree about what happened. They disagree about which parts of it were worth the space. Once the history is too long to re-read, the summary replaces the stream, and whatever it left out is gone. We ask what a memory should summarise for when it serves several standing goals at once. Three policies answer differently: summarise with no goal in view, write one summary covering every goal, or write one summary per goal and read them together. We compare them across several models and event streams, holding the read step fixed so that only the write differs. The goals do pull apart: summaries written for different goals overlap each other less than a summary overlaps a rewrite of itself. Per-goal summaries win on relevance, completeness and accuracy, and the all-goal summary loses even to the neutral one written at a fraction of its budget. Interpreting at write pays off, but only for the goal that later asks.
papers.comment: Accepted to PALM workshop at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对多目标助手的记忆压缩，比较三种写入策略：无目标的中性摘要、覆盖全部目标的单一摘要、以及每个目标各写一份再合并读取。读取步骤固定后，按目标分别写入的摘要在 relevance、completeness、accuracy 上胜出，全目标摘要甚至输给预算只有其一小部分的中性摘要。
Motivation: 长期助手的历史超出可重读长度后，摘要即取代原始记录，被丢弃的信息不可恢复；而多个常驻目标对'哪些内容值得占空间'的分歧，要求在写入时就决定保留什么。
Method: 在多个模型与事件流上对比三种写入策略（中性摘要 / 单一全目标摘要 / 按目标各写一份），固定读取步骤使唯一变量是写入方式；按目标摘要在读取时合并使用。
Result: 不同目标所写的摘要之间的重叠度，低于一份摘要与其自身改写的重叠度；按目标摘要在 relevance、completeness、accuracy 三项上胜出，全目标摘要输给仅占其一小部分预算的中性摘要。
Conclusion: Interpreting at write（写入时按目标解读）有效，但收益只归于后来真正提问的那个目标；摘要的取舍本质上取决于它为谁而写。

papers.title: When Can We Trust the Matching Principle? Robust Deployment Geometry Under Finite-Sample and Model Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Match only geometry you can identify; otherwise spread the penalty. We quantify that decision by the trust ratio tau = epsilon / gamma (estimation uncertainty over spectral separation). Under the linear-quadratic Matching response, oracle-relative drift between estimated and oracle projector matching scales as tau^2 for probes in the chosen top-r deployment subspace -- O(tau^2) in the Davis-Kahan separation region tau < 1/2, with practical usefulness depending on constants. Confidence-Calibrated Matching (CCM) turns tau into a policy -- directional when tau is small, progressively isotropic when not -- with thresholds from calibration, not from the theorem (match sits in the separation region; soft is mostly heuristic). Experiments show both regimes, including UCI HAR embeddings where always-match is worse than abstain on every cell.
papers.comment: 14 pages. Companion to arXiv:2604.21395 and arXiv:2605.22800
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出信任比 tau = epsilon/gamma（估计不确定性除以谱间隔）来判定匹配原则何时可信：在 linear-quadratic Matching 响应下，top-r 部署子空间内估计投影与 oracle 投影的 oracle-relative 漂移按 tau^2 缩放，且 O(tau^2) 结论只在 Davis-Kahan 分离区 tau < 1/2 内成立。据此 Confidence-Calibrated Matching (CCM) 把 tau 变成策略——tau 小时定向匹配，tau 大时逐步转向各向同性，阈值由校准而非定理给出；UCI HAR embeddings 上 always-match 在每个 cell 都差于 abstain。
Motivation: 匹配原则（matching principle）在谱间隔不足或估计误差大时会把不可辨识的几何强行匹配，造成部署子空间漂移；缺少一个可量化的信任判据来决定何时该匹配、何时该摊平惩罚。
Method: 定义 trust ratio tau = epsilon/gamma，在 linear-quadratic Matching 响应下推导 top-r 部署子空间的 oracle-relative 投影漂移随 tau^2 缩放，并限定在 Davis-Kahan 分离区 tau < 1/2；据此构造 Confidence-Calibrated Matching (CCM)，用校准得到阈值在定向匹配与各向同性之间切换（match 处于分离区，soft 多为启发式）。
Result: 漂移标度为 O(tau^2)（tau < 1/2 的分离区，实际可用性取决于常数）；实验呈现定向与各向同性两个 regime，其中 UCI HAR embeddings 上 always-match 在每个 cell 都比 abstain 更差。
Conclusion: 只有能辨识的几何才该匹配，否则应摊平惩罚；tau 是可操作的部署判据，阈值须由校准确定而非由定理直接给出。

papers.title: A Residual Tree Gaussian Process Modeling Framework for High-Dimensional Data
papers.abstract_en: With the advance of measurement technologies and increasing computing power, large spatial data with heterogeneous structures are often collected over high-dimensional domains. Existing Gaussian process (GP) models and computational strategies are often inadequate for analyzing such datasets in multi-dimensional domains. To address these challenges, we develop a Bayesian residual tree GP methodology called ResTGP for large spatial data with potentially heterogeneous structures in multi-dimensional domains. The key idea is to decompose a Gaussian process at a cascade of resolutions along a dyadic tree through iteratively computing predictive and residual processes so that the residual process on each tree node, both interior and leaf, becomes sufficient for the finer-level dependency within that node. This allows characterization of the underlying covariance structure in a flexible, multi-scale manner while achieving divide-and-conquer on the data domain, which leads to computational efficiency. To allow efficient tree inference, we introduce a computational strategy for Bayesian inference based on recursive message passing, which scales linearly with the sample size given the tree. This paper also proves posterior consistency of the model for estimating continuous functions in a nonparametric regression framework. Extensive numerical examples and the storm surge application confirm the advantages of the proposed method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向高维多维域大空间数据的贝叶斯残差树高斯过程 ResTGP：沿二叉树在级联分辨率上分解 GP，逐节点迭代计算预测过程与残差过程，使每个节点的残差足以刻画该节点内的细尺度依赖。给定树时用递归消息传递做贝叶斯推断，计算量随样本量线性增长，并证明了非参数回归框架下估计连续函数的后验一致性；数值例子与风暴潮 (storm surge) 应用显示该方法具有优势。
Motivation: 测量技术与算力进步使高维域上采集的大型空间数据常带异质结构，现有 GP 模型与计算策略难以处理多维域上的此类数据集。
Method: ResTGP 沿二叉树在级联分辨率上分解高斯过程，迭代计算预测过程与残差过程，让内部节点与叶节点的残差对节点内细尺度依赖充分；由此以多尺度方式刻画协方差结构并对数据域做分治。推断采用基于递归消息传递 (recursive message passing) 的贝叶斯计算策略，并在非参数回归框架下证明后验一致性。
Result: 给定树时递归消息传递的计算复杂度随样本量线性增长；证明了对连续函数估计的后验一致性；大量数值例子与风暴潮应用确认了所提方法的优势。
Conclusion: 把 GP 沿二叉树做残差分解加递归消息传递，可在多维域上以线性于样本量的代价灵活刻画异质、多尺度空间协方差，并具备后验一致性保证。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: Revealing Epistemic Uncertainty in MLLMs via Causal-Invariant Masking
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) suffer from hallucinations, creating a critical need for Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) to ensure reliable deployment. However, existing approaches struggle to detect uncertainty caused by superficial associations, especially when the query-relevant signal is weak. We mainly attribute this issue to their bias toward aleatoric uncertainty arising from data ambiguity, overlooking epistemic uncertainty stemming from model limitations. To further decompose uncertainty types for a comprehensive UQ, we propose Causal-Invariant Masking (CIM), which measures the semantic shift between the original predictions and those conditioned on a causally-focused view. Based on this framework, we introduce Semantic Divergence as our core metric for UQ and provide theoretical evidence that it converges to the variance of model's sensitivity to non-causal correlations, establishing its ability to capture MLLM's limitation. To accelerate UQ in MLLMs, we further propose Expected Embedding Drift (EED), a fast geometric proxy metric that estimates semantic shift directly within the hyperspherical embedding space. Experiments show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on various benchmarks, while the proposed EED accelerates by nearly 50% with comparable performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Causal-Invariant Masking (CIM)，用原始预测与因果聚焦视图下预测之间的语义偏移度量 MLLM 的认知不确定性 (epistemic uncertainty)，并给出理论证据表明该 Semantic Divergence 收敛到模型对非因果关联敏感度的方差。配套的 Expected Embedding Drift (EED) 在超球嵌入空间内直接估计语义偏移，加速近 50% 且性能相当，整体在多个基准上达到 SOTA。
Motivation: MLLM 幻觉使部署可靠性受损，而现有 UQ 方法偏向数据歧义带来的偶然不确定性 (aleatoric uncertainty)，在查询相关信号弱时难以检测由表面关联造成的不确定性。
Method: CIM 框架比较原始预测与因果聚焦视图条件下的预测，提出核心指标 Semantic Divergence，并证明其收敛到模型对非因果关联敏感度的方差；再提出 EED 作为快速几何代理，在超球嵌入空间内直接估计语义偏移以加速 UQ。
Result: 在多个基准上达到 state-of-the-art 性能；EED 加速近 50% 且性能相当 (comparable performance)。
Conclusion: 把 MLLM 的不确定性拆成偶然与认知两类、用因果不变掩码捕捉对非因果关联的敏感度，是可行的 UQ 路径；嵌入空间的几何代理可以在几乎不损失性能的前提下大幅降低 UQ 开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Misinformation Without Triggers: From Factual Answers to Downstream Decisions
papers.abstract_en: Language models learn from web documents, some of them false, and false content can reach a model's answer to a factual question and the summaries and decisions that use it. Most data-poisoning studies add a trigger to the training data and activate it in the prompt. False documents can also change factual responses without any trigger, but we do not know whether the direct answer predicts the decision. In this work, we follow false content past the answer and find an \emph{audit gap} between what a direct probe reports and what the model then does, comparing false training with matched truthful controls in a controlled decision task, \emph{Guess the Capital}, where a fixed decoder turns factual answers into a scored card choice, and on a misleading claim from Facebook posts about the 2019--20 Australian bushfires. Across eight models at dose 1,000, direct injected-choice rates reach 95.8--100\%, while injected game choices increase by 1.7--14.4 percentage points over matched truthful training. The gap runs the other way too. Facts that pass the direct probe still push decisions toward the injected answer, and game accuracy drops further than those choices explain. Truthful correction brings the fact back but not the decisions built on it. We then look into the real-world bushfire case, models trained on the false posts say that people were arrested for arson even when they lose the inflated count, and in a count-by-wording factorial the misleading arrest wording produces arrest assertions even when the training count stays at 24. In simpler terms, \textbf{a correct factual answer does not guarantee a correct decision, and losing the injected number does not remove the misleading story}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 无触发器的数据投毒研究发现「审计缺口」：直接事实探针的正确回答并不保证下游决策正确。在 Guess the Capital 决策任务中，八个模型在剂量 1,000 下直接注入选择率达 95.8–100%，但注入的游戏选择仅比对照高 1.7–14.4 个百分点；事实通过直接探针后仍把决策推向注入答案，纠正训练能恢复事实却恢复不了基于它的决策。
Motivation: 多数数据投毒研究依赖触发器激活，而无触发器的虚假文档如何从直接事实回答传导到摘要与下游决策尚不清楚，直接探针能否预测模型实际行为未知。
Method: 将虚假训练与匹配的真实对照比较：在受控决策任务 Guess the Capital 中用固定解码器把事实回答转成计分卡牌选择，并分析 2019–20 澳洲丛林大火 Facebook 帖子的误导性说法，含计数×措辞的因子实验。
Result: 八个模型在剂量 1,000 下直接注入选择率达 95.8–100%，注入游戏选择比匹配真实训练高 1.7–14.4 个百分点；通过直接探针的事实仍把决策推向注入答案，游戏准确率下降幅度超出这些选择的解释；计数固定为 24 时误导性逮捕措辞仍产生逮捕断言。
Conclusion: 正确的事实回答不保证正确的决策，丢掉注入的数字也不会移除误导性叙事；纠正训练能恢复事实，但恢复不了建立在该事实之上的决策。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: PsyEvo: A Personalized Counseling Agent That Self-Evolves at Test Time
papers.abstract_en: Mental health disorders affect a substantial proportion of the global population, yet a persistent shortage of trained practitioners leaves the majority without adequate care. Large language model (LLM)-based counselors present a promising direction for delivering scalable conversational psychological support. Offline model training alone leaves limited room to adapt to individual clients or to learn from ongoing therapeutic interaction at test time. We introduce PsyEvo, an LLM-based counseling framework that enables both client-specific personalization and response-policy improvement at test time through three components: Hierarchical Bayesian Skill Policy (HBSP) personalizes what intervention to apply by maintaining a per-client skill posterior updated from session feedback; Inter-session Listwise Preference Optimization (LiPO) improves how the selected skill is expressed by updating a shared response adapter from cross-client preference evidence; and State-conditioned Ordinal Credit Assignment (SOCA) supplies candidate preferences and trajectory credit to the two components through consistency-checked comparisons and ordinal projection. In simulated-client evaluation with shared online cohort adaptation, PsyEvo obtains 7.684 Overall on PsychEval and exceeds every component variant in each of three matched runs. Removing individual components lowers mean overall score by 0.138--0.171 under the shared configuration, supporting conditional contributions within the complete scaffold. Our code is available at https://github.com/Lingxi-mental-health/PsyEvo
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PsyEvo 让 LLM 心理咨询智能体在测试时同时做个性化与策略改进：HBSP 用会话反馈维护每位来访者的技能后验来决定用哪种干预，LiPO 用跨来访者偏好证据更新共享 response adapter 来改进表达，SOCA 通过一致性校验的比较与序数投影为两者提供候选偏好和轨迹信用。在模拟来访者评测中 PsyEvo 的 PsychEval Overall 得 7.684，三次匹配运行均超过每个组件消融变体。
Motivation: 仅靠离线训练的 LLM 咨询模型难以适配个体来访者，也无法从持续的治疗互动中在测试时学习，而全球受训心理从业者短缺使多数人得不到充分照护。
Method: 三个组件协同：Hierarchical Bayesian Skill Policy (HBSP) 按会话反馈更新 per-client 技能后验，决定施加哪种干预；Inter-session Listwise Preference Optimization (LiPO) 从跨来访者偏好证据更新共享 response adapter；State-conditioned Ordinal Credit Assignment (SOCA) 用一致性校验比较与序数投影 (ordinal projection) 为前两者供给候选偏好与轨迹信用。评测采用模拟来访者与共享在线队列适配 (shared online cohort adaptation)。
Result: 在模拟来访者评测、共享在线队列适配设置下，PsyEvo 取得 PsychEval Overall 7.684，并在三次匹配运行 (matched runs) 中均超过每个组件变体；在共享配置下移除任一组件使平均 Overall 下降 0.138–0.171。
Conclusion: 三个组件在完整框架内各自带来条件性贡献，测试时的个性化与响应策略改进可以同时进行；代码已在 GitHub 开源。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: PsyEvo 让 LLM 心理咨询智能体在测试时同时做个性化与策略改进：HBSP 用会话反馈维护每位来访者的技能后验来决定用哪种干预，LiPO 用跨来访者偏好证据更新共享 response adapter 来改进表达，SOCA 通过一致性校验的比较与序数投影为两者提供候选偏好和轨迹信用。在模拟来访者评测中 PsyEvo 的 PsychEval Overall 得 7.684，三次匹配运行均超过每个组件消融变体。

papers.title: DyRA: Dynamic Residual Approximation for Efficient Matrix Multiplication in DNNs
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale foundation models achieve strong performance across diverse tasks, but their size makes inference costly, largely due to dense matrix multiplications. Prior work reduces this cost by replacing dense weight matrices with efficient structured forms such as low-rank factorizations. However, these methods approximate weights rather than the output activations that determine inference accuracy. Consequently, small weight-space errors can be amplified by input activations, producing large output errors. In this work, we propose DyRA, an input-adaptive method that improves structured matrix multiplication approximation by correcting residual output errors during inference. We show that matrix multiplication can be approximated more effectively by directly optimizing low-rank factors of the output. DyRA builds on this insight by dynamically approximating and correcting the output error introduced by structured weight approximations. This combines efficient structured computation with input-dependent correction, yielding a more faithful approximation of full matrix multiplication under the same computational budget. Across vision, speech, and language models, DyRA consistently improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off over structured weight approximations alone. Notably, DyRA achieves a 1.5$\times$ end-to-end GPU speedup for DINOv3 while reducing accuracy degradation by more than 3$\times$ relative to weight-only baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DyRA 在推理时对结构化权重近似造成的输出残差做输入自适应校正，直接优化输出的低秩因子而非权重本身。在视觉、语音与语言模型上一致改善精度-效率权衡，DINOv3 端到端 GPU 加速 1.5×，同时相对仅做权重近似的基线把精度损失降低 3 倍以上。
Motivation: 基础模型推理开销主要来自稠密矩阵乘，低秩等结构化替换只逼近权重，权重空间的小误差会被输入激活放大成大的输出误差，直接损害推理精度。
Method: DyRA 在推理阶段动态近似并校正结构化权重近似引入的输出误差：对输出而非权重直接优化低秩因子，把高效结构化计算与输入依赖的残差校正结合，在相同计算预算下逼近完整矩阵乘。
Result: 在视觉、语音与语言模型上，DyRA 相对仅做结构化权重近似一致改善精度-效率权衡；DINOv3 取得 1.5× 端到端 GPU 加速，精度下降相对 weight-only 基线减少 3 倍以上。
Conclusion: 结构化矩阵乘近似应直接校正输出残差而非只逼近权重，输入自适应的输出低秩校正能在同一计算预算下给出更忠实的矩阵乘近似。

papers.title: Toward Omni Multimodal Graph Foundation Model: A Topology-Driven Binding Approach
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal graph foundation models (MGFMs) seek to learn generalizable representations from large-scale graphs with heterogeneous node modalities. However, real-world Multimodal-Attributed Graphs (MAGs) often contain incomplete node attributes, limiting the scale and diversity of available pretraining corpora. Besides, existing MGFMs primarily incorporate graph topology as structural context, overlooking its role in guiding multimodal binding and shaping a unified representation space. To address these challenges, we propose GraphBind, a topology-driven approach that uses graph topology to bind rich modality information into a unified shared space. GraphBind is motivated by the stability of graph topology, which provides structural references and complementary semantic information for multimodal binding. Concretely, GraphBind uses topology to organize self semantics and reliable neighborhood semantics into a global shared space that integrates structure and semantics, and adapts this space to discriminative and generative tasks through lightweight interfaces. Extensive experiments against 11 representative baselines demonstrate that GraphBind achieves leading performance on both discriminative and generative tasks, with relative improvements of up to 28.1% over the strongest baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GraphBind 用图拓扑作为绑定线索，把节点自身语义与可靠邻居语义组织进一个统一全局共享空间，再经轻量接口适配判别与生成任务，以应对 Multimodal-Attributed Graph 节点属性缺失导致预训练语料受限的问题。在对 11 个代表性基线的实验中，判别与生成任务均取得领先表现，相对最强基线提升最高达 28.1%。
Motivation: 真实 Multimodal-Attributed Graph 常有节点属性缺失，限制了可用预训练语料的规模与多样性；现有 MGFM 只把拓扑当结构上下文，未用它引导多模态绑定与统一表示空间。
Method: GraphBind 以拓扑稳定性为出发点，用拓扑把自身语义与可靠邻居语义组织到融合结构与语义的全局共享空间，再通过轻量接口把该空间适配到判别与生成两类任务。
Result: 在对 11 个代表性基线的广泛实验中，GraphBind 在判别与生成任务上均取得领先表现，相对最强基线的提升最高达 28.1%。
Conclusion: 把图拓扑从结构上下文升级为多模态绑定的组织者，可以在属性不完整的 MAG 上同时支撑判别与生成任务并取得领先性能。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Found but Not Read: When Extracted Text Closes the Retrieval-Reading Gap in Document Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented document question answering assumes that once the right page is found, a vision-language model (VLM) can read it. We show that this assumption often fails, leaving a retrieval-reading gap: evidence found but not used. A paired protocol isolates this gap by comparing answers from the retrieved page images alone with answers from the same images plus their extracted text. On FoveDoc-Bench, our benchmark with traceable evidence, retrieval finds nearly every evidence page, yet adding CPU-OCR text raises strict accuracy by 13 to 16 points. An exact text layer roughly doubles the gain, which appears across six VLMs from three families and, within one family, narrows with scale without closing. The reader can read this evidence but cannot find it: crops of it recover most of the text gain, boxes around it on the page none. The same protocol identifies two boundaries. Extracted text helps on textual evidence but is neutral or harmful on charts and figures. Its advantage shrinks as retrieval degrades, and unrelated text of the same form adds nothing detectable. Extracted text is an amplifier of retrieval that works, not a substitute for retrieval that does not. Our code is available at https://github.com/atoz03/fovedoc-sup.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出配对协议量化检索增强文档问答中的检索-阅读落差：同一检索页面只给图像 vs 图像加提取文本，发现证据页几乎全被检出，但加 CPU-OCR 文本使 FoveDoc-Bench 严格准确率提升 13 到 16 个百分点，精确文本层约再翻倍该增益。提取文本只在文本型证据上有效、对图表中性或有害，且随检索退化而失效，因此它是检索成功时的放大器而非检索失败时的替代品。
Motivation: 检索增强文档 QA 默认检索到正确页面后 VLM 就能读它，但该假设常不成立，形成证据已找到却未被使用的检索-阅读落差，此前缺少隔离这一落差的评测手段。
Method: 提出配对协议：对同一检索页面分别用纯图像与图像加提取文本提问并比较答案；配套发布带可追溯证据的 FoveDoc-Bench，覆盖六个来自三个家族的 VLM，并用证据裁剪与页面框标注区分读与找。
Result: FoveDoc-Bench 上检索几乎找到全部证据页，加 CPU-OCR 文本使严格准确率提升 13 到 16 个百分点，精确文本层使增益约翻倍；增益跨三个家族六个 VLM 出现，同一家族内随模型规模增大而收窄但不消失；证据裁剪可恢复大部分文本增益，页面上画框则不能；文本型证据受益，图表与图形上中性或有害；检索退化时优势缩小，同形式的无关文本无可检测增益。
Conclusion: 落差主要在阅读端的证据定位而非读能力，提取文本只放大已成功的检索，不能替代失效的检索。

papers.title: Seeing, Saying, but Not Using: From Reportable Spatial Facts to Usable States in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: A multimodal large language model that correctly reports a spatial fact does not necessarily use that fact in subsequent reasoning. To study this distinction, we introduce \textsc{SpaceConflict}, a benchmark of 23{,}196 inputs for the construction and use of spatial state. Under a unified Supported/Contradictory/Unknown judgment interface, it covers local fact binding (L1), relational composition (L2), cross-observation consistency (L3), and state judgment under transformation (L4). Posing a direct-state query, a full-transformation query, and an explicit-initial-state query on the same world reveals an availability--utilization gap: models recover the initial state from visual evidence yet fail when that state must drive a transformation. For Qwen3.5-9B, 50 of 100 sequences with a correctly recovered initial state fail the full transformation, and supplying the state explicitly repairs all 50; the gap narrows with scale but does not close. We therefore propose Operational State Supervision (OSS), which supervises task-relevant spatial states and their transformation trajectories and aligns shared facts across contexts. OSS improves paired accuracy on matched judgments most on L3 and L4, the levels that depend on organizing and using state. Evaluating multimodal spatial reasoning thus requires asking not only whether a model can see and state a spatial fact, but whether that fact becomes a usable state in subsequent computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SpaceConflict 基准（23,196 条输入），在 Supported/Contradictory/Unknown 统一判定接口下区分多模态大模型「能报告空间事实」与「能在后续推理中使用该事实」。Qwen3.5-9B 在 100 条已正确恢复初始状态的序列中有 50 条无法完成完整变换，显式给出状态后 50 条全部修复；提出的 Operational State Supervision (OSS) 在依赖状态组织与使用的 L3、L4 层级上对配对判定准确率提升最大。
Motivation: 多模态大模型能正确报告空间事实，却未必在后续推理中使用该事实；现有评测只问「看没看到、说没说出」，无法暴露这种可用性—利用性差距 (availability–utilization gap)。
Method: 构建 SpaceConflict 基准，含 23,196 条输入，统一 Supported/Contradictory/Unknown 判定接口，覆盖四层：L1 局部事实绑定、L2 关系组合、L3 跨观测一致性、L4 变换下的状态判定；对同一世界分别提出直接状态查询、完整变换查询与显式初始状态查询。另提出 Operational State Supervision (OSS)，监督任务相关空间状态及其变换轨迹，并跨上下文对齐共享事实。
Result: Qwen3.5-9B 在 100 条已正确恢复初始状态的序列中 50 条完整变换失败，显式提供状态后 50 条全部修复；差距随模型规模增大而缩小但未闭合。OSS 在配对判定准确率上提升最大的是 L3 与 L4 两个依赖组织与使用状态的层级。
Conclusion: 评测多模态空间推理不能只问模型能否看见并陈述空间事实，还要问该事实是否成为后续计算中可用的状态；规模扩大缩小但不消除这一差距。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Query-aware routing for Cross-lingual performance gains in Encoders
papers.abstract_en: Multilingual encoders can exhibit reduced retrieval effectiveness when queries and relevant documents differ in language, despite strong same-language performance. We investigate whether Finnish and Swedish cross-lingual retrieval can improve while preserving an encoder's existing same-language performance and document index. We combine a query-only low-rank adapter, trained against frozen document embeddings, with deterministic routing based on query and index languages. Cross-language queries use the adapter, while same-language queries use the original encoder. SampoTron, our fine-tuned low-rank (LoRA) adapter alongwith the Nemotron-3-Embed-1B model, improves average retrieval quality across six English, Finnish, and Swedish directions from 0.241 to 0.291 in normalized discounted cumulative gain (nDCG) at rank ten, a 20.9% relative gain on a sampled financial benchmark. All six cross-lingual directions improve, and routing preserves the original same-language performance, including two full-corpus Finnish evaluations. The approach enables selective cross-language specialization with reusable document embedding vectors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SampoTron 用查询侧低秩适配器 (LoRA) 加基于查询语言与索引语言的确定性路由，只改跨语言查询路径、不动文档索引，使跨语言检索提升而同语言性能保持不变。在英/芬/瑞六个方向的抽样金融基准上 nDCG@10 从 0.241 升到 0.291，相对提升 20.9%，六个跨语言方向全部改善。
Motivation: 多语言编码器在查询与相关文档语言不同时检索效果下降，而同语言表现已经很强；改模型往往要重建文档索引，代价高。
Method: 训练一个只作用于查询的低秩适配器，目标是冻结的文档嵌入；再按查询语言与索引语言做确定性路由，跨语言查询走适配器，同语言查询走原始编码器 Nemotron-3-Embed-1B，文档嵌入向量保持可复用。

papers.title: ConvoDrift: A Multi-Turn Conversational Dataset for Modeling Stylistic Tone Evolution
papers.abstract_en: The evolution of linguistic style in conversations is an underexplored issue in NLP. Most style-control datasets focus on sentences or assume a static style throughout, missing the dynamic shifts that occur as user preferences change during interactions. We introduce ConvoDrift, a dataset designed to model progressive stylistic conversational tone drift under fixed semantic intent. It is built on 15,727 shared multi-turn conversational structures for adaptation and persona-conditioned alignment methods. It consists of six prompt-response pairs per conversation, each with the annotation of style drift and style direction labels. These pairs cover a range of communication genres. We further derive a complementary pairwise dataset by pairing semantically equivalent but stylistically distinct responses and annotating persona-conditioned preferences using five distinct style communication personas, enabling the controlled study of personalisation and pluralistic alignment in language tone. In addition to dataset construction, we conduct a comprehensive evaluation involving human validation, LLM-as-judge assessment, and automatic lexical and semantic evaluations. Across seven Likert criteria annotated by three human annotators, the average Krippendorff's alpha is 0.88, and our lexical and semantic analyses show that drift events induce lexical changes while preserving semantic similarity.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 14 figures, 7 tables, Accepted paper at the 13th Conference on Computational Linguistics and Speech Processing (ROCLING) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ConvoDrift 是一个刻画多轮对话中语气风格漂移 (style drift) 的数据集：在固定语义意图下，每段对话含六组 prompt-response 对并标注漂移事件与方向，另有语义等价、风格相异的成对响应供五种 persona 偏好标注。三位标注者在七项 Likert 标准上的平均 Krippendorff's alpha 为 0.88，词法与语义分析显示漂移事件带来词汇变化而语义相似度保持。
Motivation: 现有风格控制数据集多以单句为单位或假设整段对话风格静态，无法刻画用户偏好在交互过程中逐步变化的动态漂移。
Method: 基于 15,727 条共享多轮对话结构，配合 persona 条件对齐方法构建；每段对话六组 prompt-response 对，标注 style drift 与 style direction；另派生成对数据集，把语义等价但风格相异的响应配对，用五种风格沟通 persona 标注条件偏好。评测结合人工校验、LLM-as-judge 以及自动词法与语义评估。
Result: 七项 Likert 标准、三位标注者的平均 Krippendorff's alpha 为 0.88；词法与语义分析显示 drift 事件诱发词汇层面变化，同时保持语义相似；数据集含 15,727 条多轮对话结构、每对话六组标注对、五种 persona。
Conclusion: 在固定语义意图下，对话语气的渐进漂移可以被显式标注并区分词汇与语义两个层面，且标注一致性高，可用于受控研究个性化与 pluralistic alignment。

papers.title: Peer Effects in Signed Networks: Separating Influence Through Positive and Negative Ties
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating network interventions requires understanding how treatment affects people through their social relationships. Counting treated neighbors without distinguishing supportive and antagonistic ties can conceal opposing influences. We define effects through positive and negative ties, their interaction, and a sign-composition effect of reallocating treatment between the two types at a fixed total, and give their identification formulas. Under sign-blind assignment, we show how ignoring signs mixes the effects of the two tie types. We propose SiDE (Signed-exposure Doubly robust Estimator), which combines sign-specific outcome models with exposure probabilities induced by individual treatment assignment. We establish double robustness of its score and assess approximate intervals that account for overlapping neighborhoods. Semi-synthetic experiments on six real signed networks demonstrate accurate effect estimation and examine the limits of interval coverage. An exploratory reanalysis of published school-experiment data yields a positive estimate of the peer effect through spend-time ties on wristband wearing, but the intervals for all four effects include zero after adjustment for multiple comparisons. This framework can inform network intervention design by showing when influences through the two tie types reinforce or offset one another.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在带符号社交网络的干预评估中，只数被处理邻居而不区分正/负联系会把方向相反的影响混在一起。论文定义了经正联系、经负联系、二者交互以及固定总量下在两类联系间重新分配处理的符号构成效应，给出识别公式，并提出 SiDE（Signed-exposure Doubly robust Estimator）把符号特异的结果模型与个体处理分配诱导的暴露概率结合，其得分具有双重稳健性。
Motivation: 网络干预评估若不区分支持性与对抗性联系，两类相反影响会相互抵消或被掩盖，导致经由社交关系的处理效应被错误估计。
Method: 定义四类效应（经正联系、经负联系、交互、符号构成效应）并给出识别公式；提出 SiDE，将符号特异 outcome model 与个体处理分配诱导的暴露概率结合，证明其得分的双重稳健性，并构造考虑邻域重叠的近似区间。
Result: 在六个真实带符号网络上的半合成实验中，效应估计准确，并检验了区间覆盖率的极限；对已发表校园实验数据的探索性再分析给出经 spend-time 联系对戴腕表的正向同伴效应估计，但在多重比较校正后四类效应的区间均包含零。
Conclusion: 区分正负联系能揭示两类联系的影响何时相互加强或相互抵消，从而指导网络干预设计；但在多重比较校正后，真实数据中的四类效应估计都不显著。

papers.title: AgentTrap: Stateful Feedback Deception against Autonomous Penetration Testing Agents
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous penetration testing agents conduct multi-step attacks by continuously adapting their plans and actions to target responses. As a common defense, honeypots can be deployed to divert these agents from real assets by presenting decoy services, while also supporting attack tracing and active counterattacks. However, conventional honeypots rely primarily on static artifacts and predefined responses, leaving them unable to adapt to the evolving attack strategies of autonomous penetration testing agents. To this end, we present AgentTrap, the first closed-loop honeypot tailored for autonomous penetration testing agents. AgentTrap uses sentinel endpoints to avoid benign interference, stateful deception grounded in the protected application, and behavior-guided escalation to sustain engagement and collect agent-side behavioral evidence with controlled disclosures. We evaluate AgentTrap against eight autonomous penetration-testing agents in a deployed web application containing a real application endpoint and a separate honeypot endpoint configured under three defense strategies. Compared with no defense, AgentTrap reduces the aggregate real-target attack success rate from 95.8% to 79.2% and successfully elicits attacker API keys in 18.8% of the runs, outperforming static deception and fixed escalation. Furthermore, trace analysis shows that resistance to such counterattacks depends jointly on model-level recognition of deceptive requests and architecture-level isolation of sensitive resources.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentTrap 是面向自主渗透测试 agent 的闭环蜜罐：用哨兵端点隔离良性流量，以受保护应用为依据做有状态欺骗 (stateful deception)，再用行为引导的升级策略持续套取 agent 侧行为证据。在部署的 Web 应用上对 8 个自主渗透测试 agent、3 种防御策略评估，真实目标攻击成功率从无防御的 95.8% 降到 79.2%，并在 18.8% 的运行中成功诱导出攻击者 API key，优于静态欺骗与固定升级。
Motivation: 传统蜜罐依赖静态伪造与预定义响应，无法跟随自主渗透测试 agent 不断演化的多步攻击策略，既难持续牵制也难拿到 agent 侧行为证据。
Method: AgentTrap 由三部分组成：sentinel endpoints 过滤良性干扰；以被保护应用为蓝本的 stateful deception 生成可信的有状态响应；behavior-guided escalation 根据 agent 行为受控披露信息以延长交互并收集证据。评估在部署的 Web 应用上进行，含一个真实应用端点与一个蜜罐端点，配置三种防御策略，对手为 8 个自主渗透测试 agent。
Result: 相对无防御，AgentTrap 把聚合真实目标攻击成功率从 95.8% 降到 79.2%，并在 18.8% 的运行中成功套出攻击者 API key，两项均优于静态欺骗与固定升级基线；trace 分析显示抵抗此类反击取决于模型层面对欺骗请求的识别与架构层面对敏感资源的隔离。
Conclusion: 有状态、行为引导的闭环蜜罐能把自主渗透测试 agent 从真实资产引开并采集其行为证据，而防御效果由模型识别能力与敏感资源隔离共同决定。

papers.title: Distributionally Robust Survival Models under Subpopulation Shift and Outlier Contamination
papers.abstract_en: Learning robust survival models under distribution shift is an important but challenging problem in many applications. In heterogeneous populations, a model that performs well on average may still perform poorly on certain subpopulations, and this issue becomes even more severe when the training data are contaminated by outliers. In this paper, we propose a novel distributionally robust framework for survival analysis that jointly addresses latent subpopulation shift and outlier contamination. The proposed method combines an outer minimization that selects a refined nominal distribution by reducing the influence of contaminated samples and an inner maximization that focuses on the most challenging subpopulation. This formulation directly accommodates non-decomposable survival losses while preserving interactions across samples, including the risk-set structure of the Cox negative partial log-likelihood. We develop an alternating gradient-based algorithm with outer updates derived from the KKT conditions of the inner maximization. Experiments on simulated data and two survival benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed method remains robust when subpopulation shift and outlier contamination occur simultaneously. It stabilizes training in contaminated settings and substantially improves worst-group performance across both linear and nonlinear survival models, while maintaining competitive and sometimes superior overall performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个分布鲁棒 (distributionally robust) 生存分析框架，同时处理潜在子群体偏移与离群点污染：外层最小化挑选削弱污染样本影响的名义分布，内层最大化聚焦最难子群体，且能直接容纳 Cox 负偏似然风险集这类不可分解损失。在模拟数据与两个生存基准上，子群体偏移与离群污染同时出现时方法仍保持鲁棒，稳定训练并显著改善最差组性能，整体性能有竞争力、有时更优。
Motivation: 异质人群中平均表现好的生存模型可能在某些子群体上很差，训练数据再混入离群点时问题更严重；现有鲁棒方法难以同时处理这两种偏移并保留样本间交互。
Method: 外层最小化通过降低污染样本影响来选择精炼的名义分布，内层最大化针对最难子群体；该形式直接适配不可分解的生存损失并保留样本交互，包括 Cox 负偏对数似然的风险集结构。求解用交替梯度算法，外层更新由内层最大化的 KKT 条件导出。
Result: 在模拟数据和两个生存基准上，子群体偏移与离群污染同时发生时方法保持鲁棒；在污染设定下稳定训练，并在线性与非线性生存模型上都显著改善最差组 (worst-group) 性能，同时整体性能保持有竞争力、有时更优。
Conclusion: 把子群体偏移与离群污染放进同一个分布鲁棒的内外层博弈，可以在不牺牲整体性能的前提下专门抬高最差组表现，且适用于线性与非线性生存模型。

papers.title: TACD: Distilling Efficient Text-to-Motion Models via Terminal Amplification Control
papers.abstract_en: Recent text-to-motion models have improved motion quality and instruction following, yet many-step denoising and large model components make deployment slow and memory-intensive. We present Terminal-Amplification-Controlled Distillation (TACD), an on-policy approach for training efficient motion generators from text prompts and pretrained teachers, without real-motion training data. Building on segmented on-policy flow distillation, we supervise clean-motion predictions along student-generated trajectories. We identify a failure mode in which velocity matching on a fixed supervision grid repeatedly overweights errors near the denoising endpoint, degrading few-step generation. TACD ties the latest teacher query to the student's step size, bounding the effective loss weights in clean-motion space without changing inference. Experiments on HumanML3D and KIT-ML demonstrate improved few-step generation, including a 58% reduction in eight-step HY-Motion student FID relative to distillation without this bound. For diffusion teachers, the endpoint-matching form of TACD yields four-step students with lower FID and matched or improved text-motion retrieval relative to their 50-step teachers on HumanML3D. On HY-Motion and Kimodo, eight-step students with compact components achieve 7.7-11.9x end-to-end speedups and reduce peak GPU memory by 3.8-6.7x relative to their teachers. Project page: https://vkgo.github.io/TACD/

papers.title: DIVINE: Simple Cross-Market Stock Pretraining via Diverse Indicator Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Financial time-series pretraining typically learns from masked observations, contrastive relations, or future outcomes---yet existing objectives struggle to simultaneously avoid future-supervision uncertainty and maintain return-prediction alignment. We propose DIVINE (DIVerse INdicator rEconstruction), a simple cross-market pretraining framework that reconstructs technical indicators from raw OHLCV history. Computed from observed price-volume history, technical indicators provide consistently defined supervision across markets while summarizing diverse market dynamics with established relevance to return prediction. Pretrained jointly on six-equity market datasets, DIVINE reconstructs 77 targets derived from 16 standard indicators and transfers only the learned encoder to downstream stock ranking. Across all six markets, DIVINE achieves the strongest average portfolio performance with a lightweight 0.05M-parameter encoder, outperforming pretraining baselines and matching or exceeding substantially larger financial foundation models, while remaining robust and data-efficient. Systematic analyses show that indicator diversity and market diversity provide complementary gains in transfer. Together, these results suggest that supervision design and cross-market diversity---rather than model scale---are the key drivers of strong, transferable financial representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DIVINE 用跨市场技术指标重建做股票时序预训练：从原始 OHLCV 历史重建 16 个标准指标导出的 77 个目标，只把学到的编码器迁移到下游股票排序。在六个股票市场数据集上，0.05M 参数的轻量编码器取得最强平均组合表现，超过预训练基线并匹配或超过更大的金融基础模型。
Motivation: 金融时序预训练的现有目标（掩码观测、对比关系、未来收益）难以同时避开未来监督的不确定性并保持与收益预测的对齐。
Method: 以由观测价量历史计算的技术指标作为跨市场一致的监督，重建 77 个由 16 个标准指标导出的目标；在六个股票市场数据集上联合预训练，仅将编码器迁移到下游股票排序任务。
Result: 在全部六个市场上取得最强平均组合表现，编码器仅 0.05M 参数；优于预训练基线，并匹配或超过体量大得多的金融基础模型，且保持稳健与数据高效。系统分析显示指标多样性与市场多样性在迁移中带来互补增益。
Conclusion: 监督设计与跨市场多样性（而非模型规模）是强可迁移金融表征的关键驱动因素。

papers.title: On Unlearning for Time-series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Time-series forecasting is widely used in sensitive domains. Models in these settings are often trained on longitudinal user- or entity-level records, which may later require removal because they contain sensitive or proprietary information or have been corrupted by sensor failures. To address such deletion requests without costly retraining, machine unlearning has been widely studied as a practical mechanism for privacy protection and data governance. However, the application of machine unlearning to time series prediction has not yet been well realized; this is mainly due to the following unique challenges: Gradient-based unlearning can be unstable because a deleted observation participates in multiple causally connected forecasting windows, causing parameter updates to propagate beyond the requested interval and degrade retained forecasting utility. Label-guided updating offers a more controlled alternative, but continuous and context-dependent forecasts lack a suitable replacement target, while the exact-retrained output is unavailable during unlearning. Moreover, the remaining support for a deleted temporal pattern is highly non-uniform. Some affected windows retain structurally similar counterparts in the retained data, whereas others become underrepresented or isolated. We present RDTU, a Residual Diffusion framework for time-series unlearning. RDTU first uses a retained-set neural tangent kernel predictor to obtain a deletion-compatible base forecast. Then it quantifies the global and local structural support of each affected window using the volume contribution of the retained-reference data. Then a diffusion model generates a residual correction that estimates the counterfactual forecast, yielding a pseudo-label field that guides a lightweight model update. Experiments show that RDTU consistently produces unlearned models that most closely match exact retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RDTU 用保留集 NTK 预测器给出删除兼容的基预报，再以保留参考数据的体积贡献度量每个受影响窗口的全局与局部结构支撑，最后由 diffusion 模型生成残差修正来估计反事实预报，形成伪标签场引导轻量模型更新。实验显示 RDTU 得到的遗忘模型在所有被测情形下都最接近精确重训练。
Motivation: 时间序列预测模型常按用户或实体级纵向记录训练，删除请求要求移除这些记录；梯度式遗忘会因一条被删观测跨越多个因果相连的预报窗口而让参数更新外溢到请求区间之外，损害保留数据的预报效用，而连续且依赖上下文的预报又缺少可用的替代标签。
Method: RDTU（Residual Diffusion framework for time-series unlearning）分三步：保留集神经正切核 (NTK) 预测器产生删除兼容基预报；用保留参考数据的体积贡献 (volume contribution) 量化每个受影响窗口的全局与局部结构支撑；diffusion 模型生成残差修正以估计反事实预报，得到伪标签场来引导一次轻量模型更新。
Result: 实验表明 RDTU 产生的遗忘模型在与精确重训练 (exact retraining) 的匹配上始终最接近，即在被评估的各设置中一致性地优于对照方法。
Conclusion: 对时间序列的删除请求，用「保留集基预报 + 结构支撑度量 + 残差 diffusion 反事实伪标签」替代梯度式或标签引导式遗忘，可以把遗忘结果拉到最接近精确重训练的水平。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: NeuroLens: Learning Latent Embeddings of Neural Semantics from Chronic Recordings
papers.abstract_en: Understanding how neural activity represents higher-order cognition and how these representations evolve over time has long been a central pursuit in neuroscience. However, current analytical tools cannot easily distinguish representational plasticity from recording instability in chronic neural recordings. Here, we introduce NeuroLens (Latent Embeddings of Neural Semantics), a self-supervised model based on the Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) framework that learns denoised, semantically informative latents from chronic neural recordings. An adaptive encoder maps changing neural populations into a common latent space, while a temporal predictor learns structure that supports prediction of future latent states. By predicting in latent space, NeuroLens captures temporally predictable structure and reduces sensitivity to transient, recording-specific variability. Across chronic intracortical data in mice and humans, the learned representations improve decoding of decision-making and semantic task variables. Multi-day pretraining enables generalization to future sessions, rapid few-shot adaptation to unseen neural populations, and more stable decoding over time than state-of-the-art baselines. Together, these results establish NeuroLens as a new paradigm for studying how neural representations change during learning and over long timescales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NeuroLens 用 JEPA 框架的自监督潜空间预测，把慢性神经记录中变化的神经群体映射到统一 latent 空间，从而把表征可塑性与记录不稳定分开。在小鼠与人类慢性皮层内数据上，学到的表征改善决策与语义任务变量解码，多日预训练带来对未来 session 的泛化、对未见神经群体的快速 few-shot 适配，以及比 SOTA 基线更稳定的时间解码。
Motivation: 慢性神经记录中，表征可塑性与记录不稳定（电极漂移、群体变化）在现有分析工具下难以区分，导致跨天、跨群体的解码与学习研究不可靠。
Method: 自监督模型，基于 Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA)：自适应编码器 (adaptive encoder) 把变化的神经群体映射到共同 latent 空间，时间预测器 (temporal predictor) 在 latent 空间预测未来状态，从而捕捉时间上可预测的结构并降低对瞬时、记录特异变异的敏感度。
Result: 在小鼠与人类慢性皮层内数据上学到的表征改善决策与语义任务变量的解码；多日预训练实现对未来 session 的泛化、对未见神经群体的快速 few-shot 适配，且随时间的解码稳定性优于 state-of-the-art 基线。
Conclusion: 在 latent 空间做预测的自监督表征可以同时对抗记录不稳定并保留语义信息，使 NeuroLens 成为研究学习过程与长时程神经表征变化的新范式。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Counterfactual Action Evaluation, Observation Bottlenecks, and Representation Geometry in Joint-Embedding Predictive World Models
papers.abstract_en: Low latent prediction error does not establish that a world model distinguishes the consequences of its actions. We introduce an evaluation protocol that traces the same intervention through simulator state, raster observations, target embeddings, and predictor outputs. Exact simulator-state forks in a controlled deformable-physics testbed reveal distinct bottlenecks. Changed commands alter particle motion, yet 41.5% of one-step raster pairs are identical. Observation loss is not the whole explanation: among 579 high-visibility counterfactuals, median predictor-to-target response is 0.0051 and 0.0217 across two seeds, falling to 0.0027 and 0.0116 after variance normalization. An isotropic state perturbation matched to the target counterfactual embedding shift produces 190x and 53x larger predictor changes on the same visible pairs, isolating action-path under-use rather than a dead or globally shrunk predictor. MSE-only training gives 8.36x lower 10-step latent error in matched seeds, but in spectrally concentrated spaces; one VICReg target encoder is also strongly concentrated, so neither error nor rank alone certifies physical state. Finally, stiffness remains near chance even from full-resolution rasters and mechanical state while privileged material parameters decode perfectly, indicating weak identifiability under this excitation rather than encoder discard. These results motivate auditing physical effect, observation visibility, representation geometry, and action dependence separately.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 7 figures. Published in the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026), Workshop on Physical World AI: Geometry, Characteristics, and Multimodal Sensing. Replication Package: https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/T432P
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一套反事实动作评估协议，把同一干预从模拟器状态、栅格观测、目标嵌入一路追踪到预测器输出，用于判定世界模型是否真的区分自身动作的后果。在可控形变物理测试床的精确状态分叉上，改变指令会改变粒子运动，但 41.5% 的一步栅格对完全相同；579 个高可见性反事实中，预测器对目标的响应中位数仅 0.0051 与 0.0217（两个种子），方差归一化后降到 0.0027 与 0.0116，而与目标反事实嵌入位移等幅的各向同性状态扰动却引起 190 倍与 53 倍更大的预测器变化，说明瓶颈在动作路径被欠用而非预测器失效。
Motivation: 低潜空间预测误差并不能证明世界模型区分了动作的后果，误差、秩与可辨识性各自掩盖不同的失效模式，需要把物理效应、观测可见性、表示几何与动作依赖分开审计。
Method: 在受控形变物理测试床中做精确模拟器状态分叉 (exact simulator-state forks)，把同一干预沿模拟器状态、栅格观测、目标嵌入、预测器输出四层追踪；用与目标反事实嵌入位移匹配的各向同性状态扰动作对照，并比较 MSE-only 训练与 VICReg 目标编码器的表示几何。
Result: 改变指令后 41.5% 的一步栅格对完全相同；579 个高可见性反事实中预测器对目标响应中位数为 0.0051 与 0.0217（两个种子），方差归一化后为 0.0027 与 0.0116；等幅各向同性扰动产生 190 倍与 53 倍更大的预测器变化。MSE-only 训练在匹配种子下 10 步潜空间误差低 8.36 倍，但集中在谱能量集中的空间，其中一个 VICReg 目标编码器也强集中。刚度 (stiffness) 即便从全分辨率栅格与力学状态出发仍接近随机水平，而特权材料参数可完美解码。
Conclusion: 误差低或秩高都不足以证明模型编码了物理状态：动作路径欠用与表示几何集中是独立失效模式，物理效应、观测可见性、表示几何和动作依赖必须分开审计；刚度的弱可辨识性源于激励不足而非编码器丢弃。

summary_sections.motivation: 低潜空间预测误差并不能证明世界模型区分了动作的后果，误差、秩与可辨识性各自掩盖不同的失效模式，需要把物理效应、观测可见性、表示几何与动作依赖分开审计。
summary_sections.method: 在受控形变物理测试床中做精确模拟器状态分叉 (exact simulator-state forks)，把同一干预沿模拟器状态、栅格观测、目标嵌入、预测器输出四层追踪；用与目标反事实嵌入位移匹配的各向同性状态扰动作对照，并比较 MSE-only 训练与 VICReg 目标编码器的表示几何。
summary_sections.result: 改变指令后 41.5% 的一步栅格对完全相同；579 个高可见性反事实中预测器对目标响应中位数为 0.0051 与 0.0217（两个种子），方差归一化后为 0.0027 与 0.0116；等幅各向同性扰动产生 190 倍与 53 倍更大的预测器变化。MSE-only 训练在匹配种子下 10 步潜空间误差低 8.36 倍，但集中在谱能量集中的空间，其中一个 VICReg 目标编码器也强集中。刚度 (stiffness) 即便从全分辨率栅格与力学状态出发仍接近随机水平，而特权材料参数可完美解码。

papers.title: Harness-Aware Distillation for Small Language Model Agents
papers.abstract_en: Language model agents are deployed with a harness, the software around the model that manages its context, tools, and feedback. When such an agent is distilled into a smaller one, the harness stays in place, so the student mainly needs the teacher-specific abilities that the harness cannot provide, such as acting correctly on harness information. Standard distillation, however, imitates the teacher's full outputs and treats the harness as part of the input. We propose Harness-Aware Distillation (HAD), which focuses distillation on what the teacher adds beyond the harness. HAD complements on-policy distillation with two components: an action preference that contrasts the same teacher's actions with and without the harness information, scored after the student's own reasoning, and a validity check that drops preference pairs whose preferred action contradicts the harness records. We show that the contrast gives the student information that imitating the teacher alone cannot provide, and HAD needs no task rewards, success labels, or future information. Across multiple long-horizon agent benchmarks and models, HAD outperforms on-policy distillation baselines with the same fixed harness. Our analysis shows that HAD enters fewer unproductive loops and recovers from errors more often than the baselines, and suggests that it adaptively keeps learnable feedback in its weights while reading state information from the harness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Harness-Aware Distillation (HAD)：把小模型 agent 蒸馏的重心从模仿教师全部输出转向教师超出 harness 的那部分能力，即在学生自身推理之后，用同一教师带/不带 harness 信息的动作偏好对比来构造训练信号，并用 harness 记录校验剔除与记录矛盾的偏好对。在多个长时程 agent benchmark 上，HAD 在相同固定 harness 下优于 on-policy 蒸馏基线，进入无效循环更少、从错误中恢复更频繁，且不需要任务奖励、成功标签或未来信息。
Motivation: agent 部署时 harness 负责管理上下文、工具与反馈，蒸馏到小模型后 harness 仍在原位，学生真正缺的只是 harness 无法提供的教师特有能力；标准蒸馏模仿教师全部输出并把 harness 当作输入的一部分，浪费了这部分差距。
Method: HAD 在 on-policy 蒸馏之上加两个组件：一是动作偏好 (action preference)，对同一教师在有/无 harness 信息下的动作做对比，且在学生自己的推理之后打分；二是有效性检查 (validity check)，丢弃首选动作与 harness 记录相矛盾的偏好对。训练不需要任务奖励、成功标签或未来信息。
Result: 在多个长时程 agent benchmark 与多种模型上，HAD 在相同固定 harness 下超过 on-policy 蒸馏基线；分析显示 HAD 进入无效循环 (unproductive loops) 更少、从错误中恢复的次数更多。
Conclusion: 作者认为对比信号提供了单纯模仿教师拿不到的信息，并推断 HAD 会自适应地把可学习的反馈固化进权重、把状态信息留给 harness 读取。

papers.title: Bounded Reachability & Jailbreak Detection via Contraction-Constrained State Space Models
papers.abstract_en: Safety heads are lightweight classifiers attached to pretrained language models for flagging harmful inputs before generation. Their empirical detection performance has been studied, but their formal robustness properties remain largely unexplored. We ask when a State Space Model (SSM)-based safety head can be certified to produce the same prediction for all inputs within a bounded embedding-space perturbation. We prove that the answer turns on a single condition: the $l_\infty$ norm of the state transition matrix must satisfy $\norm{A}_\infty<1$ (the \emph{contraction condition}), which enables exact interval bound propagation (IBP) certification for linear time-invariant classifiers. When the contraction condition holds, the reachable output interval has bounded steady-state width and examples can be certified as robustly classified. When it fails, the interval grows exponentially with sequence length and certification is impossible at any practical perturbation radius. We enforce contraction with a hinge penalty and show on toxic comment data that certified fraction improves from 41\% to 59\%, with a sharp empirical phase transition at $\norm{A}_\infty=1$ matching the theory. Applying a contraction-regularized S4 head to jailbreak detection on JailbreakBench, we achieve a zero-shot transfer to AdvBench (DR=0.994) and HarmBench (DR=0.988). A logistic regression on mean-pooled Mamba-130M embeddings matches or exceeds the S4 head on every detection metric, confirming that harmful intent is already linearly separable in the embedding space. The S4 safety head's contribution is not superior discrimination but the formal certification that no probe-based approach provides.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把基于 State Space Model 的安全头 (safety head) 的形式化鲁棒性归结为一个条件：状态转移矩阵的 l∞ 范数 ‖A‖∞<1（收缩条件），此时可用区间界传播 (IBP) 对线性时不变分类器做精确认证，输出区间稳态宽度有界；条件不满足时区间随序列长度指数增长，任何实际扰动半径下都无法认证。用 hinge 惩罚强制收缩后，毒评论数据上的 certified fraction 从 41% 提到 59%，且在 ‖A‖∞=1 处出现与理论一致的经验相变。
Motivation: 安全头这类挂在预生成阶段的轻量分类器只被研究过经验检测性能，其形式化鲁棒性——即有界嵌入空间扰动内能否保证预测不变——基本没有被刻画。
Method: 对基于 SSM 的安全头推导收缩条件 ‖A‖∞<1，使线性时不变分类器可做精确 IBP 认证；用 hinge 惩罚在训练中强制该条件。随后把收缩正则化的 S4 头用于 JailbreakBench 的越狱检测，并与 mean-pooled Mamba-130M 嵌入上的 logistic regression 对比。
Result: 毒评论数据上 certified fraction 由 41% 提升至 59%，且在 ‖A‖∞=1 处出现与理论吻合的尖锐经验相变。S4 头在 JailbreakBench 上训练后零样本迁移到 AdvBench DR=0.994、HarmBench DR=0.988。Mamba-130M 嵌入上的 logistic regression 在每一项检测指标上都追平或超过 S4 头。
Conclusion: 有害意图在嵌入空间中本就线性可分，S4 安全头的价值不在判别力，而在于提供探针类方法给不出的形式化认证；收缩条件是能否认证的分界。

papers.title: Permutation Robustness Is Not Enough: Action Collapse in Multi-Agent Transformer Policies
papers.abstract_en: Transformer policies are attractive for multi-agent robot learning because self-attention can model interactions among agents. However, multi-agent teams are unordered, while transformers typically process agents as ordered token sequences. We study how this mismatch affects cooperative navigation policies under agent-order permutations. Our results show that low permutation error alone can be misleading: policies may appear robust simply because all agents choose the same action. We therefore evaluate policies using both permutation-consistency metrics and action-collapse diagnostics, including action diversity, same-action fraction, and maximum action frequency. A PPO-ID baseline yields non-collapsed behavior but remains order-sensitive, while strong equivariance regularization can still induce homogeneous behavior. A weak equivariance penalty improves the robustness while preserving more diverse actions for teams with \(N=3\) agents, whereas teams with \(N=4\) agents require substantially smaller regularization weights. These findings suggest that multi-agent transformer policies should be evaluated not only by return and permutation robustness, but also by whether they maintain non-collapsed, differentiated multi-agent behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多-agent Transformer 策略的低置换误差可能是假象：所有 agent 选同一动作也能让策略看起来对 agent 排列鲁棒。论文在协作导航中同时用置换一致性指标与动作坍缩诊断（action diversity、same-action fraction、maximum action frequency）评估，发现弱等变正则在 N=3 时在提升鲁棒性的同时保留更多样动作，而 N=4 需要显著更小的正则权重。
Motivation: 多-agent 团队是无序集合，而 Transformer 把 agent 当作有序 token 序列；仅看置换误差会把「全员同动作」的坍缩策略误判为鲁棒，协作导航策略因此可能被错误评估。
Method: 在协作导航任务上研究 agent 排列置换对 Transformer 策略的影响，提出同时报告置换一致性指标与动作坍缩诊断（action diversity、same-action fraction、maximum action frequency）；对比 PPO-ID 基线与不同强度的等变正则 (equivariance regularization)，并按 N=3 与 N=4 团队规模调节正则权重。
Result: PPO-ID 基线行为不坍缩但对顺序敏感；强等变正则仍会诱导同质化动作；弱等变正则在 N=3 团队上提升鲁棒性同时保留更多样的动作，而 N=4 团队需要显著更小的正则权重。
Conclusion: 评估多-agent Transformer 策略不能只看回报和置换鲁棒性，还必须检查其是否维持非坍缩、有区分度的多 agent 行为；正则强度需随团队规模调整。

papers.title: Turnover-Orthogonal Credit Assignment for Open-Team Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Open-team multi-agent reinforcement learning studies cooperative systems in which agents may join, leave, or be replaced during an episode. In such settings, the team return changes both because agents choose useful actions and because the active population itself changes. Standard centralized critics and shared advantages often mix these two effects into one scalar credit signal, allowing surviving agents to be rewarded or penalized for exogenous turnover events outside their control. We introduce turnover-orthogonal credit assignment (TOCA), a value decomposition for open teams that separates action effects, pure turnover effects, and action--turnover interactions. Under exogenous turnover, the event-conditioned value admits a centered decomposition whose event-conditioned baseline removes the pure turnover component while preserving credit for actions that make the team robust to future replacements. We instantiate this idea with a permutation-invariant centralized critic over variable-size agent sets and event tokens, and derive both a counterfactual per-agent credit signal and a softly weighted interaction variant, TOCA-$β$, for high-variance control environments. Controlled diagnostic experiments show that TOCA improves return over event-aware MAPPO-style critics and that removing interaction credit substantially hurts performance. In a replacement-only Dynamic Spread benchmark, TOCA-$β$ achieves the best mean return at high turnover rates and improves over its no-interaction ablation. These results suggest that explicitly separating turnover from action credit is a useful principle for robust learning in dynamic cooperative teams.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 开放团队多智能体强化学习中，团队回报同时受动作选择与成员进出影响，标准 centralized critic 把两者混成一个标量信用信号。TOCA 用事件条件基线把纯 turnover 效应从信用中剥离，保留使团队对未来替换更稳健的动作信用；在 replacement-only Dynamic Spread 上 TOCA-β 在高 turnover 率取得最高平均回报。
Motivation: 开放团队中 agent 可中途加入、离开或被替换，标准 centralized critic 与 shared advantage 把动作效应和 turnover 效应混为一个标量，使存活 agent 因自身无法控制的外生替换事件被奖励或惩罚。
Method: 提出 turnover-orthogonal credit assignment (TOCA)：一种值分解 (value decomposition)，把动作效应、纯 turnover 效应与动作-交互项分开；在外生 turnover 下给出事件条件值的中心化分解，用事件条件基线去除纯 turnover 分量。实现为作用在可变规模 agent 集合与 event token 上的 permutation-invariant centralized critic，并导出反事实 per-agent 信用信号及其软加权交互变体 TOCA-β，用于高方差控制环境。
Result: 受控诊断实验显示 TOCA 相对 event-aware MAPPO 风格 critic 提升回报，且去掉交互信用会显著损害性能；在 replacement-only Dynamic Spread 基准上，TOCA-β 在高 turnover 率取得最佳平均回报，并优于其无交互消融版本。
Conclusion: 把 turnover 信用与动作信用显式分离，是动态协作团队稳健学习的有效原则；交互信用项在高方差、高替换率环境下不可省略。

papers.title: Understanding Enrichment in Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: When rewards are sparse, reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) often uses hints or intermediate guidance to generate more successful rollouts. This enrichment biases policy-gradient updates unless corrected via importance weights, but existing methods omit correction or truncate importance weights in order to avoid the high variance of correction. It thus remains unclear what exactly is gained or lost in RLVR by correcting enriched rollouts. We show, mathematically, that omitted or truncated correction implicitly reweights the defined reward, and we decompose the resulting gradient error into scale, rotation, and variance to explain their distinct effects on learning. To make correction practical, we develop a novel sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) weight correction mechanism that, under stability and particle-order assumptions, tempers the exponential compounding of standard correction variance over the length of a sample to an additive accumulation. We then apply our analysis of enrichment to interpreting the results of a fine-tune of Qwen3-1.7B on a sparse band of OpenMathReasoning, establishing a concrete mechanism of how enrichment, both corrected and uncorrected, helps avoid collapse in sparse domains. Our main contribution is to understand, in general, how enrichment and correction can affect training, as opposed to claiming that either mode of operation is superior to unenriched RL.

papers.title: DNAlign: Dynamic Null-Space Safe Alignment for LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Ensuring the safe and reliable deployment of large language models (LLMs) remains a fundamental challenge. Existing safety alignment approaches either incur high computational cost or unintentionally disrupt the model's core knowledge, leading to degraded fluency and factual accuracy on benign tasks. This reveals a persistent trade-off between safety and utility. We propose DNAlign, a lightweight alignment framework that integrates control-theoretic optimization with null-space projection. By treating the LLM as a dynamic system, the proposed framework introduces controllable perturbations to steer generation toward safe behavior. A key component is the projection module, which restricts these perturbations to the harmful-related subspace derived from neutral hidden states, thereby preserving general knowledge and response quality. A value function trained on human preference data adaptively optimizes the control signals to align with human safety preferences. Extensive evaluations across multiple LLM backbones demonstrate that our framework consistently reduces harmful outputs while maintaining fluency, coherence, and factual utility. It achieves superior overall performance compared to prior alignment baselines without sacrificing generation diversity. These results indicate that the proposed framework provides an effective and practically deployable solution for safe LLM alignment. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DNAlign.
papers.comment: Regular Paper; 13 pages, 8 figures, and 1 table
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DNAlign 把 LLM 安全对齐建模为动态系统控制问题，用控制论优化加零空间投影 (null-space projection) 把扰动限制在由中性隐状态导出的有害相关子空间内，从而在压低有害输出的同时保住良性任务上的流畅度与事实性。在多个 LLM backbone 上的评测显示其整体表现优于既有对齐基线，且不牺牲生成多样性。
Motivation: 现有安全对齐方法要么计算开销高，要么在压有害输出时破坏模型核心知识，导致良性任务上流畅度与事实准确率下降，安全与效用之间存在持续权衡。
Method: 将 LLM 视为动态系统，引入可控扰动引导生成走向安全行为；投影模块把扰动限制在由中性 hidden states 导出的有害相关子空间，以保护通用知识与回答质量；再用在 human preference data 上训练的 value function 自适应优化控制信号，使其对齐人类安全偏好。
Result: 在多个 LLM backbone 上的广泛评测中，该框架持续减少有害输出，同时保持流畅度、连贯性与事实效用；整体表现优于先前对齐基线，且不牺牲生成多样性。
Conclusion: 把扰动约束在有害相关零空间内，可以在不牺牲良性任务质量与生成多样性的前提下实现安全对齐，作者称其为有效且可实际部署的方案。

papers.title: PointWAM: 3D World Action Modeling for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: World action models jointly learn to forecast world dynamics and predict robot actions, such that the learned internal world dynamics guide accurate actions. Existing approaches typically represent the world as RGB frames or latent counterparts while predicting actions as end-effector poses or joint angles, but they often struggle to capture the 3D spatial structure and contact geometry central to dexterous manipulation. We introduce Point World Action Model (PointWAM), a 3D world action model that decomposes the world into a scene (i.e., environment) and hands (i.e., actor), and jointly forecasts both as 3D point trajectories within a shared space-time coordinate frame. This explicit, disentangled representation enables effective pre-training on large-scale human demonstration videos without requiring any task-specific object or keypoint selection. Given a colored point cloud and a language instruction, PointWAM predicts how the scene and hands co-evolve in 3D space over time, then retargets the forecast hand motion to robot actions. Pre-training on human videos improves average DexJoCo success by 56.9 percentage points, and scene-trajectory supervision adds 10.9 points over forecasting the hands alone. With both, PointWAM surpasses the prior state of the art on ten DexJoCo tasks by 11.7 points and outperforms strong VLAs on a real robot.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PointWAM 把世界拆成场景与手两部分，在共享时空坐标系里联合预报二者的 3D 点轨迹，再把预报的手部运动重定向为机器人动作。在人类演示视频上预训练使 DexJoCo 平均成功率提升 56.9 个百分点，加入场景轨迹监督比只预报手再多 10.9 个百分点，两项合用在十个 DexJoCo 任务上超过先前 SOTA 11.7 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有 world action model 用 RGB 帧或隐空间表示世界、用末端位姿或关节角预测动作，难以刻画灵巧操作关键的 3D 空间结构与接触几何。
Method: PointWAM 输入彩色点云与语言指令，将世界解耦为 scene（环境）与 hands（actor），在统一时空坐标系中联合预报两者的 3D 点轨迹，随后把预报的手部运动 retarget 成机器人动作；无需任务特定的物体或关键点选择即可在大规模人类演示视频上预训练。
Result: 人类演示视频预训练使 DexJoCo 平均成功率提升 56.9 个百分点；场景轨迹监督相对仅预报手部再加 10.9 个百分点；两者结合在十个 DexJoCo 任务上超过先前 SOTA 11.7 个百分点，并在真实机器人上优于强 VLA。
Conclusion: 显式解耦的 3D 场景-手联合轨迹预报配合人类视频预训练，是提升灵巧操作动作准确性的有效路径，且可迁移到真实机器人。

papers.title: To Explore The Strange New World Beyond Data Distribution: System Behavior, Causality Tax, and Non-causal Base Model
papers.abstract_en: We show that the causality of language models (LMs) may not be necessary nor optimal. This is the case when system behavior (denoted as $S$) is incorporated as a first-principle Bayesian feature. Here, $S$ refers to extra dominant factors beyond the data space, and they involve coupled effects. Despite being the de facto foundation of modern architecture, recent studies indicate persistent mismatches and contradictions with causality. These issues largely stem from system behavior rather than the data distribution. We therefore propose the SBD framework, which incorporates $S$ as an irreducible component of the evidence lower bound (ELBO). SBD theoretically reveals a counter-intuitive Causality Tax phenomenon, where causality emerges as a suboptimal approximation with an additional structural error, due to the obliviousness to $S$. To address the challenge of latent variable analysis, we validate the SBD-predicted impact of $S$ via implicit measurements, theoretical-bound-guided controls, and Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) evaluations. In particular, we construct Green Shell (GSH) to show the possibility of reducing Causality Tax. GSH is a non-causal variational family, and it replaces the sequential dependency chain of $S$ components with a divide-and-conquer partition. NTK spectra in the lazy-training regime confirm that GSH always achieves significantly tighter error bounds than causality, with $7dB+$ improvement in signal-to-noise ratio. In the relatively later stage of lazy-training, GSH further leads to superior generalization (up to $20\%$ richer multi-scale fitting capabilities). Taken together, SBD establishes system behavior as a complementary theoretical abstraction besides causality and distribution fitting, opening new research avenues such as designing and optimizing LM base models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 SBD 框架，把系统行为 S（数据空间之外的主导耦合因素）作为第一性贝叶斯特征写入 ELBO，理论上给出 Causality Tax 现象：因忽略 S，因果性只是带额外结构误差的次优近似。其构造的非因果变分族 Green Shell (GSH) 用分治划分替换 S 分量的顺序依赖链，在 lazy-training 的 NTK 谱评估中误差界显著更紧、信噪比提升 7dB+，训练后期多尺度拟合能力最多丰富 20%。
Motivation: 现代架构以因果性（顺序依赖链）为事实基础，但近期研究显示它与系统行为 S 存在持续的不匹配与矛盾，且问题根源在 S 而非数据分布。
Method: SBD 把 S 作为 ELBO 中不可约的证据分量；通过隐式测量、理论界引导的对照与 Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) 评估验证 S 的影响。GSH 作为非因果变分族，用分治划分取代 S 分量的顺序依赖链。
Result: NTK 谱在 lazy-training regime 下确认 GSH 的误差界始终显著紧于因果性，信噪比改善 7dB+；在 lazy-training 相对后期，GSH 带来更优泛化，多尺度拟合能力最多丰富 20%。
Conclusion: 因果性对语言模型既非必要也非最优，系统行为应作为因果与分布拟合之外的互补理论抽象，用于设计与优化 LM base model。

papers.title: All Work And No Play Makes Jack a Dull Boy: Understanding and Preventing Catastrophic Strategy Collapse in RLVR
papers.abstract_en: During post-training of large language models (LLMs) with Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), GRPO-style algorithms can exhibit severe late-stage collapse. Prompt-based probing reveals that this is not benign strategic pruning, but a harmful contraction of effective strategy capacity that makes distinct reasoning strategies increasingly inaccessible. To characterize this phenomenon, we define strategies through trajectory-level policy-update interactions and develop a unified theoretical framework combining optimization dynamics and information theory. We prove that major RLVR objectives progressively concentrate probability mass onto a single strategy, while sustaining nontrivial task accuracy requires a minimum strategy capacity. The conflict between these two results provides a mechanistic explanation for catastrophic collapse. We further derive the {Mirrored Entanglement Index (MEI)} as a lightweight online warning signal. To prevent collapse, we propose \textbf{Mesh Learning}, which exposes multiple reasoning strategies and prevents any single strategy from dominating optimization. Across AIME26, AIME25, MATH-500, GPQA, and LiveCodeBench, Mesh Learning consistently outperforms strong baselines across Qwen and Phi model families, with gains of up to 13.4 pp and 11.5 pp, respectively. These results establish strategy preservation as a key principle for stable RLVR. Code is available at https://github.com/Ayanami-0123/Open-Mesh-Learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RLVR 后训练中 GRPO 类算法会出现晚期策略坍缩：有效策略容量被压缩，不同推理策略变得不可访问，而非良性剪枝。作者用优化动力学加信息论证明主要 RLVR 目标会把概率质量集中到单一策略，而维持非平凡任务精度需要最低策略容量，二者冲突即坍缩机制；提出的 Mesh Learning 同时暴露多种推理策略、防止单一策略主导优化，在 Qwen 与 Phi 上最高带来 13.4 pp 与 11.5 pp 提升。
Motivation: RLVR 后训练的晚期坍缩被误认为良性策略剪枝，实际是有效策略容量的有害收缩；缺少对坍缩的机理解释与在线预警手段。
Method: 在轨迹级策略更新交互上定义策略，构建融合优化动力学与信息论的统一理论框架；推导 Mirrored Entanglement Index (MEI) 作为轻量在线预警信号；提出 Mesh Learning，暴露多种推理策略并防止单一策略主导优化。
Result: 证明主要 RLVR 目标逐步把概率质量集中到单一策略，而维持非平凡任务精度需要最低策略容量；在 AIME26、AIME25、MATH-500、GPQA、LiveCodeBench 上，Mesh Learning 在 Qwen 与 Phi 模型族上一致优于强基线，提升最高分别达 13.4 pp 与 11.5 pp。
Conclusion: 策略保留 (strategy preservation) 是 RLVR 稳定训练的关键原则，MEI 可作为坍缩的在线预警信号。

papers.title: FastOPD: On-Policy Distillation for Lightweight VLA Deployment
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation models have scaled rapidly to enhance manipulation performance and generalizability, but this scaling incurs high computational costs that render real-world deployment increasingly challenging. Existing approaches typically mitigate this issue by designing smaller architectures or reducing the iterative denoising steps in flow-based policies. In this work, we propose FastOPD, a foundation-to-lightweight VLA framework that enables the practical deployment of large-scale VLAs through efficient on-policy distillation. Specifically, FastOPD adapts a flow map for single-state teacher supervision and combines it with a self-consistency objective to construct a compact student that learns the teacher dynamics. Furthermore, we theoretically demonstrate that minimizing this objective allows the distilled student to recover a distribution on par with that induced by an ideal few-step teacher model. We evaluate FastOPD across diverse foundation policies in simulation and real-world experiments. On LIBERO, FastOPD retains 84% of the performance of $π_{0.5}$ with only two inference steps, reducing inference latency by 78.1% while outperforming existing few-step distillation baselines in average success rate. With LingBot-VLA as the teacher, FastOPD improves the single-step success rate over the base student by 15.9 percentage points on RoboTwin 2.0. We further demonstrate its applicability to a World Action Model (WAM) and deploy a compact student distilled from MolmoAct2 on a real robot.

TL;DR: FastOPD 用 on-policy 蒸馏把大规模 VLA 压到少步推理的学生模型：改造 flow map 以接受单状态教师监督，配合 self-consistency 目标让学生复现教师动力学。在 LIBERO 上仅用 2 步推理即保留 π0.5 性能的 84%，推理延迟降低 78.1%，平均成功率超过现有少步蒸馏基线；RoboTwin 2.0 上以 LingBot-VLA 为教师，单步成功率比 base student 提高 15.9 个百分点。
Motivation: VLA 基础模型规模膨胀带来高昂计算成本，使真机部署困难；现有做法靠缩小架构或削减 flow-based policy 的去噪步数，但少步化往往牺牲成功率。
Method: FastOPD 是 foundation-to-lightweight 蒸馏框架：改造 flow map 使其支持单状态教师监督，再叠加 self-consistency 目标训练紧凑学生以学习教师动力学；作者给出理论论证，最小化该目标可使学生恢复出与理想 few-step 教师模型所诱导分布相当的分布。

Conclusion: 单状态教师监督加 self-consistency 的 on-policy 蒸馏，可在极少推理步数下让紧凑学生逼近大教师的分布与成功率，从而把大规模 VLA 变成可实际部署的形态。

papers.title: AMBER: Multi-View Adaptive Budget Allocation for Listwise Vision-Language Reranking
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are powerful listwise rerankers for multimodal retrieval, but high inference costs restrict them to evaluating small local candidate views. Existing multi-call strategies rely on fixed schedules, wasting expensive VLM calls on uninformative candidate pairs and easy queries. To address this, we propose Adaptive Multi-view Budgeted Elo Reranking (AMBER), an online, budgeted multi-view reranking framework that dynamically optimizes global resource allocation. AMBER treats fragmented listwise VLM outputs as local tournaments, using continuous Elo updates to maintain a lightweight global ranking state. Building on this, it allocates computation at two levels: dynamically constructing candidate views with high score ambiguity, and scheduling queries to maximize expected information gain. We show that each Elo update corresponds to a stochastic gradient ascent step on the Bradley-Terry log-likelihood, and provide a submodular information-theoretic motivation for the query-level allocation strategy. Experiments on CIRR, CIRCO, and PhotoBench demonstrate that AMBER achieves the strongest overall performance among the compared multi-call VLM reranking methods under comparable VLM-call budgets, while remaining effective in lower-budget settings. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/wnlfc/AMBER.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AMBER 把多调用 VLM listwise 重排的碎片化输出当作局部 tournament，用连续 Elo 更新维护轻量全局排序状态，并在候选视图与查询两个层级按分数歧义和期望信息增益动态分配 VLM 调用预算。在 CIRR、CIRCO、PhotoBench 上，同等 VLM 调用预算下取得所比较多调用重排方法中最强的总体性能，低预算设置下依然有效。
Motivation: VLM 作为 listwise 重排器推理开销高，只能覆盖小的局部候选视图；现有 multi-call 策略用固定调度，把昂贵调用浪费在无信息的候选对和简单查询上。
Method: AMBER 是在线的预算化多视图重排框架：用连续 Elo 更新把碎片化 listwise 输出聚合成全局排序状态；候选视图层按分数歧义动态构造视图，查询层按期望信息增益调度查询。作者证明每次 Elo 更新等价于 Bradley-Terry 对数似然上的随机梯度上升步，并为查询级分配给出次模 (submodular) 信息论动机。
Result: 在 CIRR、CIRCO、PhotoBench 三个基准上，AMBER 在可比 VLM 调用预算下取得所比较 multi-call VLM 重排方法中最强的总体性能，并在更低预算设置下仍保持有效。
Conclusion: 把 VLM 调用当作可调度的信息增益预算、用 Elo 状态承载全局排序，可以在不增加调用数的前提下提升 listwise 多模态重排效果；代码已公开于 github.com/wnlfc/AMBER。

papers.title: Clinical Concept Centers in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly used in clinical settings. However, research into the reliability and performance of these models has focused almost entirely on the language substrate, scoring what the model says. Mechanistic interpretability has found that the latent space carries a higher fidelity of representation than the text: internal representations not only encode substantially more than the output verbalizes, but the stated reasoning also systematically omits features that causally drive the answer. An evaluation of model behavior in terms of mechanistic interpretability has not been explored in clinical decision support. In this work, we extend behavioral evaluation into the latent space and ask whether clinical concepts exist as locatable, causally used representations inside open-weight LLMs. We find dedicated clinical concept centers in the latent space of all eleven open models we test. These concept centers are interpretable, firing only on their aligned clinical narratives, and meaningfully and causally drive model behavior in both constrained and open-ended settings. They are not just analytical representations, but circuits that can be utilized in clinical practice, and we explore their use from the perspective of both evaluation and performance. From the evaluation standpoint, models stay internally coherent and keep using the relevant concept centers even under adversarial role-based priming, while aligned priming improves downstream clinical performance. From a performance perspective, we simulate realistic deployment settings and find that steering models along these centers leads to meaningful downstream improvements. Finally, we conduct a blinded clinician validation and find the activation and usage of these concept centers predicts clinicians preferences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 11 个开源 LLM 的潜空间中定位到专一的临床概念中心 (clinical concept centers)，这些中心只在对齐的临床叙事上激活，并因果驱动模型行为；沿这些中心做 steering 可带来下游临床任务的实质提升，且概念中心的激活与使用能预测盲评临床医生的偏好。
Motivation: 临床 LLM 的可靠性评估几乎只看文本输出，而机制可解释性表明潜空间表征保真度更高、且文本中的推理系统性遗漏了因果驱动答案的特征；临床决策支持尚无基于机制可解释性的评估。
Method: 把行为评估扩展到潜空间，检验临床概念是否作为可定位、被因果使用的表征存在于开源 LLM 内部；从评估与性能两个视角使用这些中心——在对抗性角色引导 (role-based priming) 下检验内部一致性与概念中心使用，并沿概念中心做 steering 模拟真实部署，最后做盲法临床医生验证。
Result: 在全部 11 个受测开源模型中都找到专一的临床概念中心；对抗性角色引导下模型保持内部一致并继续使用相关概念中心，对齐引导提升下游临床表现；沿概念中心 steering 带来下游改进；概念中心的激活与使用可预测临床医生偏好。
Conclusion: 临床概念中心是可定位、可解释且因果有效的回路，既可作为临床 LLM 的评估对象，也可直接用于 steering 以提升部署表现。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: FSPO: Policy-Consistent Risk and Pareto-Feasible Control for Budgeted LLM RL Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive LLM reinforcement-learning post-training changes multiple training actuators online, including rollout temperature, group size, clipping, KL regularization, verifier allocation, and update budget. Three coupled issues remain unresolved. A future-risk model trained from behavior trajectories need not estimate the risk induced by the controller that will be deployed; a score calibrated on logged state-action pairs can become miscalibrated after selective action choice; and independent per-resource minimum costs do not in general certify a feasible multi-resource continuation. We introduce FSPO, a feedback-state controller for budgeted LLM RL post-training that addresses these issues jointly. FSPO learns a policy-consistent risk-to-go model whose Bellman target follows the same frozen controller used for future decisions, together with a long-horizon utility model. Decision-conditioned trajectory calibration (DCTC) calibrates risk on cross-fitted trajectories generated by actions selected by provisional controllers. A Pareto resource continuation certificate (PRCC) admits an action only when a non-dominated cumulative reservation remains feasible over the residual horizon. Under a matched GRPO resource envelope, FSPO reaches 66.11% held-out and 59.43% OOD accuracy, compared with 64.47% and 57.03% for PB2, the strongest evaluated adaptive baseline. Three paired training seeds give gains of +2.42 and +3.19 percentage points over the contextual bandit on held-out and OOD evaluation. Under high behavior-deployment mismatch, policy-consistent risk lowers selected-decision ECE from 0.108 to 0.053; DCTC lowers it from 0.039 to 0.022 at matched acceptance; PRCC removes false-feasible admissions on an 18-action catalog ($0.197\rightarrow0.000$); and enabling all three components reduces trajectory failure from 0.181 to 0.083 in a factorial ablation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FSPO 把预算约束下的 LLM RL 后训练当作反馈状态控制问题：学一个与部署时冻结控制器一致的 risk-to-go 模型，用决策条件轨迹校准 (DCTC) 修正选择性动作带来的校准漂移，再用 Pareto 资源续行证书 (PRCC) 只放行残余时域内仍可行的动作。在匹配的 GRPO 资源包络下 held-out 准确率 66.11%、OOD 59.43%，均高于最强自适应基线 PB2 的 64.47% 与 57.03%；三组件全开把轨迹失败率从 0.181 降到 0.083。
Motivation: 自适应 LLM RL 后训练在线调节 rollout 温度、组大小、裁剪、KL 正则、验证器分配与更新预算等多个执行器，但行为轨迹上训练的风险模型不等于部署控制器诱导的风险，日志状态-动作对上的校准在选择性动作后会失效，各资源独立的最小成本也无法保证多资源续行可行。
Method: FSPO 是一个反馈状态控制器：学习 policy-consistent risk-to-go 模型，其 Bellman target 与未来决策所用的冻结控制器一致，并配一个长时程效用模型；DCTC 在由临时控制器选出动作生成的 cross-fitted 轨迹上校准风险；PRCC 仅当非支配累计预留在残余时域仍可行时才放行动作。
Result: 匹配 GRPO 资源包络下，FSPO held-out 准确率 66.11%、OOD 59.43%，PB2 为 64.47% 与 57.03%；三个配对训练种子相对 contextual bandit 分别提升 2.42 与 3.19 个百分点。高行为-部署失配下，policy-consistent risk 把所选决策 ECE 从 0.108 降到 0.053，DCTC 在相同接受率下把 ECE 从 0.039 降到 0.022，PRCC 在 18 动作目录上把 false-feasible 放行从 0.197 降到 0.000，三组件全开在因子消融中把轨迹失败率从 0.181 降到 0.083。
Conclusion: 让风险估计与实际部署控制器一致、在决策条件轨迹上重新校准、并用 Pareto 证书约束多资源续行，可以在同一资源预算下同时提高 LLM RL 后训练的 held-out/OOD 准确率并压低校准误差与失败率。
