papers.title: MLCommons Jailbreak Benchmark v1.0
papers.abstract_en: Modern AI systems are designed to refuse hazardous requests. A jailbreak is a prompt crafted to bypass those safeguards and elicit outputs that the system would normally refuse to provide. The MLCommons Jailbreak Benchmark v1.0 provides an end-to-end methodology for evaluating the robustness of large language models to single-turn, text-based jailbreak attacks. It combines criteria-driven system and attack selection, paired baseline and adversarial evaluation, human annotation, automated evaluator calibration, scoring, grading, and risk-calibrated disclosure within a single benchmarking pipeline. The benchmark evaluates eight open-weight systems using 264 seed prompts spanning eleven hazard categories and representative attacks drawn from the MLCommons Jailbreak Taxonomy. Responses are assessed using the AILuminate Assessment Standard v1.4, and robustness is measured through the Resilience Gap: the change in safety performance between baseline and adversarial conditions. Across all evaluated systems and attacks, the unsafe-response rate increased from 11.08% under baseline conditions to 18.65% under jailbreak conditions, producing an average Resilience Gap of 7.57%. Accessible systems showed a larger mean gap, while attack effectiveness varied substantially across attack categories and hazards. The benchmark also examines evaluator reliability and sources of measurement error. Beyond reporting results, Jailbreak Benchmark v1.0 establishes a reproducible methodological foundation for comparative jailbreak evaluation and for future expansion across systems, attacks, hazards, and evaluation methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MLCommons Jailbreak Benchmark v1.0 给出单轮文本越狱攻击的端到端评测流程：8 个开放权重系统、264 条种子提示、11 类危害，按 AILuminate Assessment Standard v1.4 打分，用 Resilience Gap（基线与对抗条件下安全性能之差）度量鲁棒性。全部系统与攻击下不安全回复率从基线 11.08% 升到越狱条件下 18.65%，平均 Resilience Gap 为 7.57%。
Motivation: 现有越狱评测缺少统一、可复现的流程，把系统选择、对抗评测、人工标注、自动评估器校准与风险披露割裂开，难以横向比较不同 LLM 的抗越狱能力。
Method: 流水线包含准则驱动的系统与攻击选择、基线与对抗配对评测、人工标注、自动评估器校准、打分分级与风险校准披露；评测 8 个开放权重系统、264 条种子提示、11 类危害，攻击取自 MLCommons Jailbreak Taxonomy，安全性按 AILuminate Assessment Standard v1.4 判定，鲁棒性用 Resilience Gap 度量。
Result: 全部系统与攻击下，不安全回复率由基线 11.08% 升至越狱条件 18.65%，平均 Resilience Gap 7.57%；可访问（accessible）系统的平均 gap 更大，攻击有效性在攻击类别与危害类别间差异明显；摘要还考察了评估器可靠性与测量误差来源。
Conclusion: 配对基线/对抗评测加校准过的自动评估器，可为越狱鲁棒性给出可复现的比较基准，并可扩展到更多系统、攻击、危害与评测方法。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Scaling Trajectories for Complex Tasks through Recursive Self-Rewrite
papers.abstract_en: Successful trajectories on difficult tasks provide valuable supervision for model improvement, but specialized harnesses introduce interventions that may be unavailable during deployment. We propose Recursive Self-Rewrite (RSR), a framework that uses one base model, Qwen-3.8-27B, to discover successful solutions under diverse harnesses and reconstruct them as training trajectories under a general harness. A planner extracts procedures into runbooks, a critic screens for verifier and solution leakage and guides recursive revision, and an executor follows qualified runbooks in fresh sandboxes. Across approximately 3K self-curated terminal tasks, three harnesses jointly solve 759 tasks, 34.3% more than the strongest individual harness in the recorded pool. RSR expands 2,001 successful source trajectories into 11,094 rewritten trajectories for supervised finetuning. Training on these trajectories outperforms both the base model and direct trajectory SFT. Compared with the base model, pass@3 increases from 57.0% to 74.2% on Terminal-Bench 2, from 1.5% to 9.1% on Terminal-Bench 4, from 39.0% to 63.0% on our self-curated Terminal-Bench Hard, and from 3.0% to 6.0% on our Software Terminal-Bench. Process reward on Long-Horizon Terminal-Bench rises from 0.21 to 0.29. These results show how diverse harness-assisted experiences can be reconstructed into reusable capabilities for a model operating under a general harness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Recursive Self-Rewrite (RSR)：用同一个基座模型 Qwen-3.8-27B 在多种 harness 下发现成功解，再重写成通用 harness 下的训练轨迹。三种 harness 在约 3K 个终端任务上合计解出 759 个，比记录池中最强单个 harness 多 34.3%；用 11,094 条重写轨迹做 SFT 后，Terminal-Bench 2 pass@3 从 57.0% 升到 74.2%。
Motivation: 困难任务上的成功轨迹往往依赖部署时拿不到的专用 harness 干预，直接拿来训练会把 harness 依赖固化进模型。
Method: RSR 三组件：planner 把解题过程抽成 runbook，critic 筛查 verifier 与 solution 泄漏并驱动递归修订，executor 在全新 sandbox 中按合格 runbook 执行；把 2,001 条成功源轨迹扩写为 11,094 条重写轨迹做监督微调 (SFT)。
Result: 约 3K 个自建终端任务上三种 harness 合计解出 759 个，比最强单个 harness 多 34.3%。对比基座模型 pass@3：Terminal-Bench 2 由 57.0% 升至 74.2%，Terminal-Bench 4 由 1.5% 升至 9.1%，自建 Terminal-Bench Hard 由 39.0% 升至 63.0%，Software Terminal-Bench 由 3.0% 升至 6.0%；Long-Horizon Terminal-Bench 过程奖励 (process reward) 由 0.21 升至 0.29，且优于直接轨迹 SFT。
Conclusion: 多 harness 下获得的经验可以被重写成通用 harness 下可复用的能力，且递归重写比直接用原始轨迹 SFT 更有效。

papers.title: TerrainForge: Physics-Grounded road geometry Editing for Counterfactual Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Road geometry (e.g., crests, sags, and speed humps) and surface conditions (e.g., wet or icy pavement) affect how vehicles move, what drivers and onboard cameras observe, and how much clearance remains between vehicles. Editing these properties in a driving scene therefore requires corresponding changes in vehicle motion. Capturing these differences in a driving video requires a road edit to propagate to vehicle motion, camera viewpoint, and the clearance between vehicles. We present TerrainForge, a framework for generating road geometry-focused counterfactuals from reconstructed multi-vehicle driving episodes. A unified road model connects scene deformation with four-wheel vehicle dynamics, allowing crests, sags, speed humps, and friction changes to propagate through vehicle motion, camera viewpoint, and inter-vehicle clearance. Vehicle dynamics are evaluated against CarSim, and prescribed road geometry is verified in reconstructed Waymo scenes. Across 18 episodes, leaving surrounding vehicles on their recorded trajectories instead of recomputing their responses produces median peak differences in predicted ego-lead distance of 1.52 m for crests and 1.41 m for sags. We further simulate the ego response to 15,758 road edits across 983 braking episodes, pairing each edit with its safety outcomes relative to an unedited replay. These pairs train a first-stage screening surrogate that takes the original driving context and candidate road-edit parameters as input and predicts the resulting change in the ego's terminal gap. On held-out scenes, this prediction achieves 22-40% lower mean absolute error than predicting no change, so candidates can be screened cheaply before the full multi-vehicle rollout.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TerrainForge 用统一道路模型把路面几何与摩擦编辑同时传播到四轮车辆动力学、相机视角和车距，从而生成反事实自动驾驶场景。若沿用录制轨迹而不重算周围车辆响应，预测的自车-前车距离中位峰值差在 crest 处为 1.52 m、sag 处为 1.41 m；先用代理模型筛候选编辑可把 MAE 相对“无变化”预测降低 22–40%。
Motivation: 编辑路面几何或摩擦会改变车辆运动、相机所见与车距，但直接做全多车 rollout 成本高，需要先廉价筛掉无效的道路编辑候选。
Method: TerrainForge 从重建的多车驾驶片段生成以路面几何为中心的反事实：统一道路模型把 crest、sag、减速带与摩擦变化耦合到四轮车辆动力学；车辆动力学对照 CarSim 评估，规定几何在重建的 Waymo 场景中校验；再用 15,758 次道路编辑（覆盖 983 段制动片段）与未编辑回放的安全结果配对，训练一阶段筛选代理，输入原始上下文与候选编辑参数，预测自车终态车距变化。
Result: 在 18 个片段上，让周围车辆留在录制轨迹而非重算响应，预测的自车-前车距离中位峰值差为 crest 1.52 m、sag 1.41 m；共模拟 15,758 次道路编辑、983 段制动片段；在留出场景上，代理预测的 MAE 比“预测无变化”低 22–40%。
Conclusion: 道路编辑必须连带重算周围车辆响应，否则车距预测偏差可达米级；用一阶段代理先筛候选编辑，可在完整多车 rollout 之前低成本剔除无效编辑。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MetaRubric: Learning to Reward for Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Rubric-based reinforcement learning extends reward-driven optimization to open-ended tasks by assigning partial credit to individual response requirements. However, rubric judges can assign a high criterion score even when the information or action it requires is absent from the response, a failure mode we term Vacuous Credit. Such awards persist after the required information is removed and can reverse the sign of a response's GRPO advantage. To address this problem, we introduce MetaRubric, which alternates evidence-aware policy optimization with response-guided rubric adaptation. We construct counterfactual counterparts by changing one task-relevant fact in each prompt. During policy optimization, credit is assigned only when the response contains sufficient evidence to satisfy the required rubric criterion. After each policy-optimization stage, current policy responses guide revisions to original and counterfactual criteria while preserving the meaning of the original prompt's initial rubric as interpreted under each prompt's facts. We also adapt criterion weights at stage boundaries to better address observed policy errors. Across multiple backbones, MetaRubric improves PubMedQA accuracy by 6.00--20.40 percentage points over static-judge GRPO, with further gains on HealthBench-Hard and two multimodal medical benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MetaRubric 针对 rubric 式强化学习中的 Vacuous Credit（评分标准所需信息在回答中缺失仍得高分，甚至反转 GRPO advantage 符号），交替做证据感知的策略优化与响应引导的 rubric 适配：用改写单个任务事实构造的 counterfactual prompt 约束评分，只在回答含足够证据时才给该 criterion 记分，并在阶段边界调整 criterion 权重。在多个 backbone 上，PubMedQA 准确率相对 static-judge GRPO 提升 6.00–20.40 个百分点，HealthBench-Hard 与两个多模态医学基准上还有进一步增益。
Motivation: rubric 评审会在回答完全不含所需信息或动作时仍给该 criterion 高分，这种 Vacuous Credit 在删掉所需信息后依然存在，并会把回答的 GRPO advantage 符号翻转，污染开放任务的部分信用分配。
Method: MetaRubric 交替执行证据感知策略优化与响应引导的 rubric 适配：对每个 prompt 改动一个任务相关事实生成 counterfactual 对照；策略优化阶段仅当回答含足以满足该 criterion 的证据时才记分；每阶段结束后用当前策略的回答修订原始与 counterfactual criterion，同时保持原始 prompt 初始 rubric 在各自事实下的含义，并在阶段边界适配 criterion 权重以对应观察到的策略错误。
Result: 在多个 backbone 上，MetaRubric 使 PubMedQA 准确率相对 static-judge GRPO 提升 6.00–20.40 个百分点；在 HealthBench-Hard 以及两个多模态医学基准上还有进一步增益。
Conclusion: 把证据充分性作为记分前提并用 counterfactual prompt 约束 rubric 含义，可以消除 Vacuous Credit 带来的错误信用，从而在 rubric 式 RL 中稳定并提升开放与医学问答任务的表现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Adaptive Spectral-Koopman Dynamics Modeling for Temporal Domain Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Temporal Domain Generalization (TDG) has emerged to address real-world streaming data with distribution shifts over time. However, existing methods are either prone to overfitting to domain-specific noise in the data space or become overly complex and less interpretable in the parameter space. To bridge these gaps, we propose \textbf{AdaSpecK}, a spectral-Koopman framework with adaptive context extraction for TDG. To mitigate noise fitting to irregularly sampled domains, we introduce spectral-regularized Koopman dynamics modeling, which applies spectral-aware filtering in the latent space to extract denoised low-frequency trajectories and learn a Koopman operator to model the system dynamics in a linearized space. To model complex historical environments under non-stationarity, we design a context-informed heterogeneous pattern extraction mechanism. Specifically, we employ a target-conditioned attention module to attend to distinct past windows, producing a dynamic, target-specific historical summary. By constructing an environmental signature from the current evolutionary pattern, our model adaptively perceives which aspects of the past context are most informative for future prediction via a learned router. Extensive experiments on eight diverse classification and regression benchmarks demonstrate that AdaSpecK achieves state-of-the-art performance. The code and datasets are available at \href{}{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Ada-Spec-K}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdaSpecK 用谱正则化的 Koopman 动力学加自适应上下文提取做时域泛化 (TDG)：在隐空间做谱感知滤波提取去噪低频轨迹并学习线性化 Koopman 算子，再用目标条件注意力与学习到的 router 从历史窗口中挑出对未来预测最有信息的环境特征。在八个分类与回归基准上达到 SOTA 表现。
Motivation: 时域泛化中现有方法要么在数据空间过拟合域特异噪声，要么在参数空间过于复杂、可解释性差；不规则采样域上的噪声拟合与非平稳历史环境是两个具体痛点。
Method: 提出 AdaSpecK：谱正则化 Koopman 动力学建模在隐空间做谱感知滤波，抽取去噪低频轨迹并学习 Koopman 算子在线性化空间刻画系统动态；配合 context-informed 异质模式抽取，用 target-conditioned attention 关注不同历史窗口生成动态的、目标特定的历史摘要，并基于当前演化模式构造 environmental signature，由学习到的 router 自适应选择历史上下文。
Result: 在八个涵盖分类与回归的多样基准上取得 state-of-the-art 表现；代码与数据集已在 anonymous.4open.science/r/Ada-Spec-K 公开。
Conclusion: 在隐空间做谱滤波加线性 Koopman 建模、并让 router 自适应挑选历史上下文，可以在时域泛化上同时避开数据空间噪声过拟合与参数空间过度复杂。
Relevance: 36

summary_sections.method: 提出 AdaSpecK：谱正则化 Koopman 动力学建模在隐空间做谱感知滤波，抽取去噪低频轨迹并学习 Koopman 算子在线性化空间刻画系统动态；配合 context-informed 异质模式抽取，用 target-conditioned attention 关注不同历史窗口生成动态的、目标特定的历史摘要，并基于当前演化模式构造 environmental signature，由学习到的 router 自适应选择历史上下文。
summary_sections.result: 在八个涵盖分类与回归的多样基准上取得 state-of-the-art 表现；代码与数据集已在 anonymous.4open.science/r/Ada-Spec-K 公开。
summary_sections.conclusion: 在隐空间做谱滤波加线性 Koopman 建模、并让 router 自适应挑选历史上下文，可以在时域泛化上同时避开数据空间噪声过拟合与参数空间过度复杂。

papers.title: RMCW: A Deletion-Robust Watermark Based on Reed--Muller Codes for Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) watermarking provides a lightweight mechanism for identifying text generated by a specific model, but its robustness remains fragile under post-processing attacks. Deletion attacks are particularly challenging because they shift token positions and break the alignment between observed tokens and their original watermark positions. We propose Reed--Muller Code Watermarking (RMCW), an LLM watermarking method based on Reed--Muller codes. In contrast to global codeword recovery, RMCW searches for surviving local algebraic structure, leveraging the Reed--Solomon consistency induced by affine-line restrictions of Reed--Muller codewords. During generation, RMCW injects a Reed--Muller structure into the sequence via a secret-keyed vocabulary partition. During detection, it maps the given text to keyed vocabulary bins and tests local subsequences for low-degree Reed--Solomon consistency using Berlekamp--Welch tests. Experiments on C4 and ELI5 datasets with OPT-1.3B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct show that RMCW preserves strong clean-text detectability and outperforms or matches the baseline methods under several deletion and rewriting attacks. Our code is available at https://github.com/BaichengDanny/RMCW.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RMCW 用 Reed–Muller 码给 LLM 文本加水印：生成时按密钥划分词表注入 RM 结构，检测时把文本映射到密钥词表分箱，用 Berlekamp–Welch 检验局部子序列的低次 Reed–Solomon 一致性，从而在删除攻击导致 token 错位后仍能存活。在 C4 与 ELI5 上用 OPT-1.3B 和 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 测试，干净文本可检测性强，且在多种删除与改写攻击下优于或持平基线。
Motivation: LLM 水印在后处理攻击下很脆弱，删除攻击会平移 token 位置、破坏观测序列与原水印位置的对齐，使依赖全局码字恢复的检测方法失效。
Method: 生成阶段用密钥控制的词表划分 (secret-keyed vocabulary partition) 把 Reed–Muller 结构注入 token 序列；检测阶段把文本映射到密钥词表分箱，利用 RM 码字经仿射线限制 (affine-line restriction) 诱导的 Reed–Solomon 一致性，对局部子序列做低次 Berlekamp–Welch 检验，绕开全局码字恢复。
Result: 在 C4 与 ELI5 数据集、OPT-1.3B 与 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 模型上，RMCW 保持强的干净文本可检测性，并在多种删除攻击与改写攻击下优于或匹配基线方法。
Conclusion: 放弃全局码字恢复、转而搜索删除后仍存活的局部代数结构，可让 LLM 水印在删除与改写攻击下保持可用的检测能力。

papers.title: Gated Slot Attention-2: Two-Sided Associative Memory Correction in Linear Attention
papers.abstract_en: Linear attention models have emerged as efficient alternatives to standard attention, but effectively managing their fixed-size recurrent memory remains challenging. To improve memory, recent work has explored two distinct directions: delta-rule variants for precise correction of values associated with keys, and slot-based architectures such as Gated Slot Attention for modeling key and value memories in two stages. We observe that these directions are complementary--the delta rule provides effective memory correction, while the two-stage structure provides a natural way to operate on both sides of an association. Building on this insight, we introduce a new Gated Oja Rule for key-side correction and extend it with decoupled erase and write control to obtain Gated Oja Rule-2. We then introduce Gated Slot Attention-2 (GSA2), which combines Gated Oja Rule-2 for key-side correction with Gated Delta Rule-2 for value-side correction through shared latent slots. We further derive a hardware-efficient chunkwise algorithm for parallel training. Experiments demonstrate that GSA2 consistently improves over strong linear-attention baselines across benchmarks while retaining linear-time sequence modeling and constant-memory recurrent decoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GSA2 把 delta rule 的精确记忆修正与 slot 架构的两阶段键值记忆结合起来：用 Gated Oja Rule-2 做键侧修正、Gated Delta Rule-2 做值侧修正，二者通过共享 latent slots 耦合，并配一个硬件高效的 chunkwise 并行算法。在多个 benchmark 上一致优于强 linear-attention 基线，同时保持线性时间序列建模与常数内存递归解码。
Motivation: linear attention 的固定大小循环记忆难以有效管理：delta rule 只修值侧、slot 架构只提供两阶段结构，两条路线各自受限。
Method: 提出 Gated Oja Rule 做键侧修正，加入解耦的 erase 与 write 控制得到 Gated Oja Rule-2；GSA2 将其与 Gated Delta Rule-2 的值侧修正通过共享 latent slots 组合，并推导硬件高效的 chunkwise 并行训练算法。
Result: 实验显示 GSA2 在多个 benchmark 上一致优于强 linear-attention 基线，同时保留线性时间序列建模与常数内存递归解码；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 键侧与值侧的记忆修正互补，经共享 latent slots 结合后可在不牺牲线性复杂度的前提下提升 linear attention 的记忆质量。

papers.title: iS-KV: Online Low-Rank KV Cache Compression via Block-Incremental SVD
papers.abstract_en: Long chain-of-thought reasoning substantially increases KV-cache memory during autoregressive decoding, as every generated token introduces new key and value states and causes the cache to grow linearly with decoding length. Existing KV-cache compression methods typically control this growth through token eviction, but irreversible deletion can remove historical states that later reasoning may need to revisit. SVD-based low-rank compression provides an alternative by retaining all positions with a more compact representation. However, extending it from a fixed prompt cache to online decoding is non-trivial. Through our investigation, we find that if the basis is updated for new tokens while old tokens keep their coordinates in the old basis, the stored history drifts substantially. Based on this observation, we propose iS-KV, an online low-rank KV-cache compression method for long-horizon reasoning. iS-KV keeps a recent window exact while incrementally folding older states into bounded-rank representations. As the low-rank basis evolves, it synchronizes historical coordinates with the updated basis to maintain representation consistency. On DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B, iS-KV achieves 82.6% accuracy at 4.06-fold persistent-KV compression, close to the original model's 83.6%. On Qwen3-8B, it achieves 89.2% accuracy at 5.64-fold compression. Under matched memory budgets, iS-KV consistently outperforms token-eviction baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: iS-KV 在线低秩压缩长链推理的 KV cache：保留近期窗口精确存储，把更旧状态增量折入有界秩表示，并在基演化时同步历史坐标以避免表示漂移。在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B 上以 4.06 倍持久 KV 压缩达到 82.6% 准确率（原模型 83.6%），Qwen3-8B 上 5.64 倍压缩达 89.2%；同等内存预算下稳定优于 token-eviction 基线。
Motivation: 长链思维推理中每个新 token 都写入 key/value，KV cache 随解码长度线性增长；现有 token 驱逐会不可逆删除后续推理可能需要回看的历史状态，而 SVD 低秩压缩从固定 prompt 缓存推广到在线解码并不平凡。
Method: iS-KV 保留一个近期窗口为精确缓存，将更旧 token 状态增量折叠进有界秩的低秩表示；当低秩基随新 token 更新时，同步历史 token 在新基下的坐标以保持表示一致性，避免旧 token 沿用旧基坐标导致的存储历史漂移。
Result: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B 上 4.06 倍持久 KV 压缩下准确率 82.6%，接近原模型 83.6%；Qwen3-8B 上 5.64 倍压缩下准确率 89.2%；在匹配内存预算下持续优于 token-eviction 基线。
Conclusion: 在线低秩 KV 压缩要可行，关键是让历史坐标随基演化同步更新，从而在远高于驱逐法的压缩比下把长链推理准确率保持在接近无压缩模型的水平。

papers.title: ROUTEAUDIT: Interaction-Aware Identification for Budgeted Multi-Verifier Routing
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive multi-verifier systems are commonly compared through endpoint quality-cost gaps, even when the verifier catalog, availability, accounting, information filtration, or scorer changes with the policy. We formulate verifier routing as a contract-conditioned identification problem. The contract records request support, verifier catalog, realized availability, resource accounting, online filtration, and post-trace scoring; a matched route contrast changes only the policy coordinate. ROUTEAUDIT adds three measurable objects to this contract. A contract lattice averages coordinate increments over every admissible bridge order and reports the resulting attribution together with its path sensitivity. A policy-independent response tape identifies paired sequential contrasts when adaptive policies reveal different observations. For incomplete matching, request-level bounds use whichever potential outcome remains observed and give a sharp finite-population interval. The protocol commits paid observations and ledger events before the oracle join and returns an attribution certificate for each comparison. On two held-out raw-tail caches, matched static SF+SA equals the cascade, assigning the apparent gains of 0.1797 and 0.1250 over full static to the verifier-set edge. On 1,319 held-out task requests, the learned and RLVR studies report quality 0.9522 and 0.9553 versus 0.9484 for matched static; the RLVR-static paired difference is +0.0068 with a request-paired interval $[0.0015,0.0122]$ and a training-seed-by-request hierarchical interval $[0.0006,0.0131]$. Controlled attribution recovery yields route mean absolute error 0.0011 and endpoint reconstruction error 0.0004. Factorial, bridge-order, and stochastic-provider studies evaluate the certificate interface; RLVR supplies a learned-policy stress test under the same identification contract.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ROUTEAUDIT 把自适应多验证器路由写成 contract-conditioned identification 问题：契约固定请求支撑、验证器目录、可用性、资源记账、在线过滤与打分，只允许策略坐标变化，再用 contract lattice、policy-independent response tape 与请求级有限总体区间给出可归因的对比。在 1,319 条留出任务请求上，RLVR 相对 matched static 的配对差为 +0.0068，区间 [0.0015, 0.0122]；两个 raw-tail 缓存上 matched static SF+SA 追平 cascade，把 0.1797 与 0.1250 的表观增益归到 verifier-set 边。
Motivation: 自适应多验证器系统常按端点质量-成本差距比较，但验证器目录、可用性、记账、信息过滤与打分会随策略变化，端点差异无法归因到策略本身。
Method: 契约记录请求支撑、验证器目录、实现可用性、资源记账、在线过滤与事后打分，matched route contrast 只改策略坐标；其上加三个对象：对所有可接受桥序取坐标增量均值的 contract lattice（附路径敏感度）、识别自适应策略暴露不同观测时成对序贯对比的 policy-independent response tape，以及匹配不全时用仍被观测的潜在结果给出尖锐有限总体区间的请求级界。协议在 oracle join 前提交付费观测与 ledger 事件，并为每次比较返回 attribution certificate。
Result: 两个留出 raw-tail 缓存上 matched static SF+SA 等于 cascade，把相对 full static 的 0.1797 与 0.1250 表观增益归给 verifier-set 边。1,319 条留出任务请求上，learned 与 RLVR 质量分别为 0.9522 与 0.9553，matched static 为 0.9484；RLVR-static 配对差 +0.0068，请求配对区间 [0.0015, 0.0122]，训练种子×请求分层区间 [0.0006, 0.0131]。受控归因恢复的 route MAE 为 0.0011，端点重构误差 0.0004。
Conclusion: 端点质量-成本差距在验证器目录与过滤随策略变化时会把增益错记给策略；按只改策略坐标的契约做归因后，cascade 的表观优势消失，RLVR 相对 matched static 只剩 +0.0068 的小幅提升。

papers.title: VIGOR: Zero-Shot Visual Generalization via Latent-Space Consistency in Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) achieves strong sample efficiency by planning within learned latent dynamics, yet its performance degrades substantially under unseen visual distractions such as background variations, lighting changes, or camera shifts. Unlike model-free RL, where encoder perturbations affect only single-step predictions, MBRL suffers from a two-level vulnerability: visual distractions first push encoder outputs out of distribution, and these errors then compound through recursive latent rollouts over the planning horizon. We propose visual generalization via latent-space consistency in model-based RL (VIGOR), a framework that enables zero-shot generalization to unseen visual distractions while retaining the sample efficiency of its MBRL backbone. VIGOR integrates three interdependent components: (i) asymmetric weak-to-strong augmentation, which pairs weak-only and weak-to-strong latent views within a single batch; (ii) dynamics-level consistency, which enforces augmentation-invariant transition predictions through direct latent regression; and (iii) encoder-level stabilization, which prevents encoder drift under the cross-augmentation supervision imposed by dynamics-level consistency. Evaluations on the DeepMind Control Suite (DMC) and Robosuite show that VIGOR outperforms state-of-the-art model-free and model-based baselines, surpassing the second-best baseline by 3.4% on DMC and 43.6% on Robosuite. Ablations further show that VIGOR's robustness is augmentation-agnostic: replacing the default augmentation with alternatives from distinct perturbation families preserves strong generalization, confirming that latent-space consistency, not the augmentation choice, drives robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VIGOR 用潜空间一致性 (latent-space consistency) 让基于模型的强化学习 (MBRL) 在未见过的视觉干扰下零样本泛化：非对称弱到强增强配对同一 batch 内的弱视图与弱到强视图，动力学级一致性用直接潜回归约束增广不变的转移预测，编码器级稳定抑制跨增广监督导致的编码器漂移。在 DeepMind Control Suite (DMC) 与 Robosuite 上分别超出次优基线 3.4% 与 43.6%，且换用不同扰动族的增广仍保持强泛化。
Motivation: MBRL 在学到的潜动力学内规划换来样本效率，但背景、光照、相机位移等未见视觉干扰会先把编码器输出推离分布，再经规划时域上的递归潜 rollout 复合放大；这比 model-free RL 只影响单步预测的脆弱性多一层。
Method: VIGOR 含三个相互依赖的组件：(i) 非对称弱到强增强 (asymmetric weak-to-strong augmentation)，在单个 batch 内配对 weak-only 与 weak-to-strong 潜视图；(ii) 动力学级一致性 (dynamics-level consistency)，通过直接潜回归强制增广不变的转移预测；(iii) 编码器级稳定 (encoder-level stabilization)，抑制动力学级一致性所施加的跨增广监督引起的编码器漂移。
Result: 在 DeepMind Control Suite (DMC) 与 Robosuite 上，VIGOR 超过 state-of-the-art 的 model-free 与 model-based 基线，比次优基线分别高 3.4%（DMC）与 43.6%（Robosuite）。消融显示其鲁棒性与增广选择无关：换成来自不同扰动族的替代增广仍保持强泛化。
Conclusion: 驱动鲁棒性的是潜空间一致性本身而非具体增广选择，因此 VIGOR 能在保留 MBRL 样本效率的同时对未见视觉干扰做零样本泛化。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: BitNest: Bit-Nested Speculative Decoding for Memory-Efficient LLM Inference Acceleration
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by using a lightweight draft to propose multiple tokens for parallel verification. However, existing methods often require an additional draft model or weight representation, introducing non-negligible memory overhead on resource-constrained devices. Self-speculative approaches reduce this overhead, yet still face trade-offs between draft quality, target quality, and storage efficiency. We propose BitNest, a bit-nested speculative decoding framework that embeds a low-precision draft directly into the higher-precision target representation. Instead of deriving a draft from a predefined target, BitNest first constructs a strong low-precision base and then recovers the higher-precision target through residual refinement, enabling both models to share a single physical weight representation. BitNest further extends this progressive-precision design to the KV cache for long-context inference. Across multiple 7B--8B edge-friendly LLMs and diverse workloads, BitNest achieves an average speculative acceptance rate of 95.2% while closely preserving higher-precision model quality, and delivers 1.48--1.61x end-to-end speedup over FP16 autoregressive decoding. On the LLaMA models supported by all representative self-speculative baselines, BitNest also achieves consistently competitive or higher decoding speedup.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BitNest 把低精度草稿模型直接嵌进高精度目标模型的同一份物理权重里，先构造强低精度 base，再用残差精化恢复高精度目标，并把这套渐进精度设计扩展到 KV cache。在多个 7B–8B 边缘 LLM 上平均投机接受率 95.2%，端到端加速 1.48–1.61×（对比 FP16 自回归解码）。
Motivation: 投机解码通常要额外的草稿模型或权重副本，在资源受限设备上带来不可忽略的内存开销；自投机方案虽减轻开销，却仍在草稿质量、目标质量与存储效率之间取舍。
Method: BitNest 采用 bit-nested 框架：不从预定义目标派生草稿，而是先构建强低精度 base，再通过残差精化 (residual refinement) 恢复高精度目标，使两个模型共享单一物理权重表示；同一渐进精度设计进一步用于长上下文推理的 KV cache。
Result: 在多个 7B–8B 边缘友好 LLM 与多样负载上，平均投机接受率 95.2%，同时紧密保持高精度模型质量；相对 FP16 自回归解码端到端加速 1.48–1.61×。在所有代表性自投机基线都支持的 LLaMA 模型上，解码加速持续持平或更高。
Conclusion: 把草稿与目标压进同一份权重表示（外加 KV cache 的渐进精度化）可以在不牺牲高精度质量的前提下同时降低内存开销并获得 1.48–1.61× 加速。

papers.title: FUSEye: Training-Light Fisheye Detection with Overlapping Views and Zero-Initialized Adapters
papers.abstract_en: Fisheye cameras give mobile robots a single-sensor, low-cost view of their surroundings, yet the COCO-pretrained detectors that practitioners routinely reuse fail on them: strong radial distortion warps local image structure, while boundary compression shrinks objects to near-invisible sizes. Full fine-tuning closes much of the gap but requires abundant fisheye labels and compute. We present FUSEye, a training-light framework that turns a frozen-backbone COCO-pretrained extra-large YOLO26 detector (YOLO26-x) into a fisheye detector. FUSEye adds roughly 227k new parameters while updating the inserted modules and the pretrained detection head. It addresses the transfer gap at three causally linked levels. At the input level, overlapping grid view generation and box remapping (GridViews) enlarge compressed boundary regions. At the feature level, zero-initialized residual adapters (Z-Adapters) correct distortion-induced feature misalignment. At the decision level, learned cross-projection agreement fusion (AgreeFusion) promotes low-confidence detections only when they are supported by consistent evidence across multiple views. On the WoodScape surround-view fisheye benchmark, FUSEye raises YOLO26-x from 0.148 to 0.266 mAP50 and retains 84.3% fully fine-tuned accuracy. Moreover, randomly using only 25% of the labeled training images, FUSEye achieves 0.2597 mAP50, retaining 97.6% of its full-label performance. FUSEye also consistently improves YOLOv8-11 detectors, showing that the recipe is architecture-agnostic. Source code will be available at https://github.com/Su-wenya/FUSEye.
papers.comment: Source code will be available at https://github.com/Su-wenya/FUSEye
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FUSEye 用冻结 backbone 的 COCO 预训练 YOLO26-x 做鱼眼检测，只加约 227k 新参数：GridViews 重叠网格视图放大边界压缩区域，零初始化残差适配器 (Z-Adapters) 修正畸变导致的特征错位，AgreeFusion 仅在多视图证据一致时提升低置信检测。在 WoodScape 环视鱼眼基准上 mAP50 从 0.148 提到 0.266，保留全量微调精度的 84.3%；随机只用 25% 标注图像仍达 0.2597 mAP50，即全标注性能的 97.6%。
Motivation: COCO 预训练检测器直接用在鱼眼图像上会因径向畸变与边界压缩失效，而全量微调需要大量鱼眼标注与算力，移动机器人场景难以负担。
Method: 冻结 YOLO26-x backbone，只训练插入模块与预检测头，共约 227k 新参数；输入层用 GridViews 重叠网格视图生成与框重映射，特征层用零初始化残差适配器 (Z-Adapters)，决策层用跨投影一致性融合 (AgreeFusion) 只在多视图证据一致时提升低置信检测。
Result: WoodScape 环视鱼眼基准上 YOLO26-x mAP50 由 0.148 升至 0.266，保留全量微调精度的 84.3%；随机取 25% 标注训练图像时 mAP50 为 0.2597，为全标注性能的 97.6%；同一配方在 YOLOv8-11 系列检测器上也一致提升。
Conclusion: 训练轻量的三层适配配方能把通用 COCO 检测器转成鱼眼检测器，且与具体检测架构无关，标注可削减到四分之一而几乎不掉点。

papers.title: Muon Learns Facts Better: Understanding the Role of Spectral Orthogonalization
papers.abstract_en: The Muon optimizer applies spectral orthogonalization to matrix-valued updates and has shown strong performance in large-scale neural network training, yet the mechanisms of this transformation in feature learning remain poorly understood. In this work, we investigate this question through a tractable factual-recall model, where a fact maps each subject-relation pair to an answer, and a linear transformer learns the subject- and relation-dependent information required to recover this mapping. The transformer is optimized with gradient flow (GF), spectral GF, or Sign GF, which are continuous-time limits of gradient descent, Muon, and Adam, respectively. Prior studies (Nichani et al., 2025) have shown that when the number of subjects exceeds the number of relations, GF learns relation-dependent information before subject-dependent information, producing a feature-separation phase during training. We characterize this separation with the learning times when the subject- and relation-dependent components of the prediction reach a target accuracy. With $S$ subjects and $R$ relations, GF has a learning-time ratio of $\widetildeΘ(\sqrt{S/R})$, whereas Spectral GF reduces this ratio to $\widetildeΘ(1)$. In addition, for fixed $S$ and $R$, the subject- and relation-dependent errors decay as $1/(T\log T)$ in training time $T$ under GF, but as $\exp(-\mathrm{poly}(T))$ under spectral GF. Finally, we show that GF and spectral GF are equivariant under orthogonal transformations of the token embeddings, whereas Sign GF is not: Different orthonormal embeddings can potentially produce no feature separation, a large feature-separation phase, or even a reversed learning order. These results provide a mechanistic view of how spectral orthogonalization can fundamentally reshape feature-learning dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在可解的事实召回 (factual recall) 线性 transformer 模型中，谱正交化 (spectral orthogonalization) 把梯度流下主体先于关系学习的特征分离相位压缩掉：GF 的主体/关系学习时间比为 Θ̃(√(S/R))，谱 GF 降到 Θ̃(1)，且分量误差从 1/(T log T) 加快到 exp(−poly(T))。
Motivation: Muon 对矩阵更新做谱正交化在大规模训练中有效，但该变换如何重塑特征学习动力学缺乏机理解释；已有工作 (Nichani et al., 2025) 只刻画了 GF 在主体数多于关系数时先学关系、后学主体的特征分离现象。
Method: 构造一个事实召回可解模型：每个 subject-relation 对映射到一个答案，linear transformer 学习主体与关系相关的信息以恢复该映射；分别用 gradient flow (GF)、spectral GF、Sign GF（即 GD、Muon、Adam 的连续时间极限）优化，以达到目标精度的学习时间刻画主体与关系分量的分离。
Result: S 个主体、R 个关系下，GF 的学习时间比为 Θ̃(√(S/R))，spectral GF 降至 Θ̃(1)；固定 S、R 时主体与关系相关误差在 GF 下按 1/(T log T) 衰减，在 spectral GF 下按 exp(−poly(T)) 衰减；GF 与 spectral GF 对 token embedding 的正交变换等变，Sign GF 不等变——不同正交 embedding 可能导致无特征分离、大特征分离相位甚至反转学习次序。
Conclusion: 谱正交化不只是优化技巧，而是从根本上重塑特征学习动力学：它消除主体-关系学习次序的分离并指数级加快分量误差衰减，而 Adam 式符号更新对表示选择不具等变性。

papers.title: Modeling Shared and Individual Structure for Cross-Subject Continuous Affect Regression from EEG-fNIRS
papers.abstract_en: Continuous, second-by-second valence-arousal estimation from physiological signals is typically studied in a subject-dependent setting, where the model sees labeled data from the same person it is later evaluated on. We study the harder zero-shot cross-subject variant on a synchronized EEG-fNIRS dataset: predict raw-scale ([1, 255]) valence and arousal trajectories for subjects whose labels the model never observes, given only their unlabeled EEG/fNIRS recordings while watching the same video stimuli as a disjoint set of training subjects. We decompose the affect trajectory into a structure shared across subjects who watch the same stimuli and an individual structure estimated for each test subject from a label-free EEG marker (alpha-band cross-channel synchrony), which rescales the shared trajectory around the scale midpoint. We validate the per-subject calibration mechanism on four independent axes: leave-one-subject-out correlation between the marker and each subject's true optimal gain, a functional-form comparison against non-linear alternatives, a repeated leave-4-out component ablation isolating each part of the pipeline's contribution, and a ceiling analysis bounding the remaining headroom for per-subject scaling. On held-out subjects, the model reaches an overall MAE of 25.96 / 22.80 across two evaluation batches (valence 21.94 / 19.6, arousal 29.98 / 26.0), well below EEGNet and ASAC-Net baselines reported for the same subject-independent split (raw scale score 60.6 and 55.0 respectively). We further report a systematic negative-result search across model architectures, feature representations, and prediction targets that found no signal able to improve on the single alpha-synchrony marker.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 EEG-fNIRS 跨被试零样本情感回归中，把逐秒 valence-arousal 轨迹拆成共享刺激结构与个体结构，后者用无标签的 alpha 波跨通道同步度 (alpha-band cross-channel synchrony) 估计增益、围绕量表中点缩放共享轨迹。在留出被试上总体 MAE 为 25.96 / 22.80（valence 21.94 / 19.6，arousal 29.98 / 26.0），远低于同一 subject-independent 划分上 EEGNet 与 ASAC-Net 的 60.6 与 55.0（raw scale）。
Motivation: 连续逐秒 valence-arousal 估计几乎都在 subject-dependent 设定下做，模型见过被评估者的标签；跨被试且测试者标签从未出现的零样本设定更贴近真实部署，但更难。
Method: 在同步 EEG-fNIRS 数据集上预测 raw-scale [1, 255] 的 valence/arousal 轨迹：把情感轨迹分解为同一视频刺激下跨被试共享的结构，加上由无标签 EEG 标记（alpha 波跨通道同步度）为每个测试被试估计的个体结构，用它围绕量表中点重标共享轨迹。校准机制沿四条独立轴验证：leave-one-subject-out 下标记与真实最优增益的相关、与非线性替代的功能形式比较、repeated leave-4-out 组件消融、以及界定逐被试缩放剩余空间的 ceiling 分析。
Result: 留出被试上总体 MAE 25.96 / 22.80（两个评估批次），其中 valence 21.94 / 19.6、arousal 29.98 / 26.0；同一 subject-independent 划分上 EEGNet 与 ASAC-Net 基线的 raw scale 分数分别为 60.6 与 55.0。另在模型架构、特征表示与预测目标上做了系统性负结果搜索，未发现任何信号能超越单一 alpha-synchrony 标记。

papers.title: Efficient Memory Crystallization for Graph Learning under Non-Stationary Distribution Shifts
papers.abstract_en: Deep graph learning models deployed in real-world systems often need to cope with non-stationary environments, where the underlying graph distribution drifts continually over time. Prevailing solutions rely on training auxiliary generative modules to synthesize memory graphs for cross-domain adaptation, which incurs substantial computational overhead and scales poorly under prolonged distribution shifts. We argue that a more economical path exists: rather than generating memory, one can crystallize it. To this end, we propose Efficient Memory Crystallization (EMC), a training-free test-time framework that distills each incoming graph domain into a compact, semantically faithful memory through a closed-form solution to a memory-oriented distribution-matching objective, thereby eliminating redundant domain information under continual covariate shifts. To preserve both generalizability and adaptability as the model traverses a long sequence of target domains, EMC further models inter-domain dependencies through state-evolving memories and admits a theoretically grounded, tighter generalization error bound than direct adaptation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance of EMC over state-of-the-art baselines on graphs under non-stationary distribution shifts, while reducing average runtime by 87.4% and GPU memory consumption by 92.4% relative to the recent competitor, making continual graph adaptation practical at scale.
papers.comment: Accepted by the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EMC 是一个免训练的测试时图域适应框架：把每个到来的图域用记忆导向分布匹配目标的闭式解压缩成紧凑记忆，而不是训练生成模块来合成记忆。在非平稳分布漂移的图序列上，它相对最近的竞争对手平均运行时间降低 87.4%、GPU 显存降低 92.4%，并给出比直接适应更紧的泛化误差界。
Motivation: 真实系统中的深度图学习面临图分布随时间持续漂移；现有方案靠训练辅助生成模块合成记忆图做跨域适应，计算开销大，在长期分布漂移下扩展性差。
Method: EMC 用记忆导向分布匹配目标的闭式解，把每个输入图域蒸馏成语义忠实的紧凑记忆，消除协变量漂移中的冗余域信息；再用状态演化记忆 (state-evolving memories) 建模域间依赖，全程免训练、测试时运行。
Result: 在非平稳分布漂移的图上，EMC 性能优于 SOTA 基线；相对最近的竞争对手，平均运行时间减少 87.4%，GPU 显存占用减少 92.4%；并给出理论上更紧的泛化误差界。
Conclusion: 记忆可以被结晶而非生成：闭式解加状态演化记忆足以支撑长期图域连续适应，同时把运行时与显存开销压到可扩展水平。

papers.title: PAPER2LLM++: Continual Self-Evolution of LLMs from Research Papers
papers.abstract_en: Research on LLMs continually uncovers model limitations, their causes, and potential solutions. Yet these human discoveries remain largely disconnected from model evolution: an LLM does not automatically learn from new research about its own failures. We introduce PAPER2LLM++, a framework for continual self-evolution of LLMs from research papers. Rather than treating papers merely as knowledge to retrieve, PAPER2LLM++ uses the growing literature as a stream of evidence and supervision for model improvement. For each incoming paper, it extracts evidence-grounded findings, tests whether the reported limitation persists in the current model, and, when needed, converts the findings into candidate learning signals. A try-evaluate-commit procedure integrates an update only when it improves the targeted behavior without substantially forgetting prior improvements or degrading general capabilities. Across a sequential stream of research-discovered LLM failures, we show that models can progressively incorporate new findings while retaining earlier gains. PAPER2LLM++ thus takes a step toward closing the loop between human discovery and model evolution, enabling models to continually learn from research about their own limitations and improvements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PAPER2LLM++ 把论文文献当作持续证据与监督流：对每篇新论文抽取有据可依的发现，检验该缺陷在当前模型上是否仍存在，再把发现转成候选学习信号，用 try-evaluate-commit 流程仅在目标行为改善、且不明显遗忘先前改进或损害通用能力时才提交更新。在一串按序到来的研究发现的 LLM 失败案例上，模型能逐步吸收新发现并保留早期收益。
Motivation: 研究不断揭示 LLM 的缺陷、成因与对策，但这些人类发现与模型演进脱节：LLM 不会自动从关于自身失败的新研究中学习。
Method: 对每篇进入的论文抽取 evidence-grounded findings，在当前模型上测试所报告的缺陷是否仍然存在，必要时把发现转为候选学习信号；用 try-evaluate-commit 过程决定是否并入更新，判据是目标行为改善且不显著遗忘先前改进、不损害通用能力。
Result: 在按序到来的研究发现的 LLM 失败流上，模型能逐步纳入新发现并保留先前收益；论文含 20 页、5 幅图、12 张表。
Conclusion: 把文献当作证据与监督流并以 try-evaluate-commit 把关更新，可以在不牺牲既有收益的前提下让 LLM 从关于自身局限的研究中持续自我进化，闭合人类发现与模型演进之间的回路。

papers.title: Law And Order: Tax Law Autoformalization
papers.abstract_en: Legal systems are increasingly implemented through software, yet scalable methods for translating legal texts into accurate symbolic representations remain underdeveloped. We study this problem through tax law, where forms and filing instructions define large computational structures involving arithmetic, branching, recursion, and tabular reasoning. We propose Law&Order, a neuro-symbolic framework for automatically formalizing tax forms and instructions into executable symbolic programs. Our approach establishes two forms of correspondence between law and logic: structural correspondence, which aligns legal and symbolic components such as cells and schedules, and denotational correspondence, which requires symbolic components to implement the computations specified by their legal counterparts. We combine large language model synthesis with cell-level verification and iterative localized error repair using human-written OpenTaxSolver tax returns. We then evaluate the resulting formalizations on independently authored, held-out TaxCalcBench returns, that are never exposed during generation or repair. Although the most advanced LLM achieves only 66% accuracy, Law&Order achieves 100% cell-level and form-level accuracy on 51 held-out returns, demonstrating the effectiveness of combining LLM-based synthesis with symbolic verification for scalable and verifiable large-scale legal autoformalization compared with using an LLM alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Law&Order 用神经-符号框架把税法表格与填报说明自动形式化为可执行符号程序：LLM 合成后做 cell 级验证与迭代局部修复，对照人类编写的 OpenTaxSolver 报税结果。在生成与修复阶段从未见过的 TaxCalcBench 51 份独立报税单上，cell 级与表级准确率均达 100%，而最强 LLM 单独使用仅 66%。
Motivation: 法律文本到符号表示的可扩展翻译方法仍不成熟；税法表格与填报说明包含算术、分支、递归与表格推理，纯 LLM 形式化准确率只有 66%，难以验证。
Method: 提出 Law&Order 神经-符号框架，建立结构对应（legal 与 symbolic 组件如 cells、schedules 对齐）与指称对应（符号组件实现法律规定的计算）；结合 LLM 合成、cell 级验证、迭代局部错误修复，修复参照人类编写的 OpenTaxSolver 报税单。
Result: 在独立撰写、生成与修复阶段完全未暴露的 TaxCalcBench 报税单上，Law&Order 在 51 份 held-out returns 上取得 100% 的 cell 级与表级准确率；最强 LLM 单独使用仅 66% 准确率。
Conclusion: LLM 合成与符号验证结合，可在大规模法律自动形式化上做到可扩展且可验证，优于单用 LLM。

papers.title: Hold-Out Scoring for Efficient Gaussian DAG Learning
papers.abstract_en: High-dimensional Gaussian DAG learning faces a statistical-computational gap: methods with sharp sample complexity rely on computationally expensive subset search and a supplied indegree bound, whereas polynomial-time alternatives have less favorable sample complexity. We introduce HOST, an efficient DAG learning algorithm that replaces subset search with nodewise hold-out scoring and convex regression, without requiring a supplied indegree bound. Our key insight is that recovering a correct ordering does not require uniformly small estimation errors in ordering scores but only one-sided control of those errors. In the ordering step, HOST exploits the fact that score estimation using hold-out samples inflates ordering scores in expectation, which is the favorable direction for candidates that should not yet be selected. Given the ordering, HOST recovers parents by recursively removing indirect effects from total effects between two nodes. Under suitable conditions, HOST exactly recovers a $p$-node DAG of maximum indegree $d$ with sample complexity of order $d\log p$ in polynomial time. Experiments show that HOST achieves competitive graph recovery while exhibiting favorable runtime scaling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出高维高斯 DAG 结构学习算法 HOST：用 nodewise hold-out scoring 加凸回归替代子集搜索，且不需给定入度上界。关键在于排序分数只需单侧误差控制，hold-out 估计在期望上抬高排序分数恰好有利于暂不该选的候选；给定排序后递归剥离间接效应恢复父节点。在合适条件下以 d log p 样本复杂度、多项式时间精确恢复最大入度 d 的 p 节点 DAG，实验中图恢复竞争力强且运行时间标度更优。
Motivation: 高维高斯 DAG 存在统计-计算鸿沟：样本复杂度尖锐的方法依赖昂贵的子集搜索并需给定入度上界，而多项式时间方法的样本复杂度较差。
Method: HOST 用 nodewise hold-out scoring 与凸回归替代子集搜索，不需入度上界；排序阶段利用 hold-out 样本使排序分数期望上抬高的性质（对暂不该选的候选是有利方向），只需单侧误差控制；给定排序后，通过在两节点总效应中递归剥离间接效应恢复父节点。
Result: 在合适条件下以 d log p 量级样本复杂度、多项式时间精确恢复最大入度 d 的 p 节点 DAG；实验显示图恢复竞争力相当，且运行时间标度表现良好。
Conclusion: 排序恢复只需排序分数的单侧误差控制而非一致小误差，据此可用 hold-out scoring 与凸回归绕开子集搜索，同时保住尖锐样本复杂度与多项式时间。

papers.title: OPD Before RL: Warm-Starting Rubric-Based RL with On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Many useful language-model tasks cannot be evaluated by exact outcome verification. Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) addresses this issue by scoring open-ended responses against explicit criteria. However, because the reward is assigned after the complete response, the training signal does not directly identify which individual decisions contributed to the final score. We propose a two-stage training framework that uses rubrics first as privileged teacher context for dense token-level supervision, then as rewards for further RL. In the first stage, rubric-privileged on-policy distillation (RP-OPD), a student without access to the rubric matches a rubric-aware teacher's next-token distributions at student-generated prefixes. In the second stage, RL directly optimizes the rubric reward and improves beyond the observed distillation plateau. We evaluate the framework on health and science tasks using open-weight models. Across HealthBench, ResearchQA, and RubricHub Science, we compare post-training methods and vary the amount of SFT or RP-OPD training before RL, finding that our two-stage framework achieves the highest scores among the methods evaluated. RP-OPD + RL shows limited signs of reward hacking on RubricHub Science, whereas the SFT + RL baseline increasingly receives high rewards for claims of rubric compliance without providing the required content. These findings support using rubrics to guide on-policy distillation before applying rubric-based RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出两阶段训练框架：先用 rubric 作为特权教师上下文做 token 级稠密监督的 on-policy 蒸馏 (RP-OPD)，再以同一 rubric 作为奖励做 RL。在 HealthBench、ResearchQA、RubricHub Science 上，该两阶段组合取得所评估方法中的最高分，且在 RubricHub Science 上奖励作弊迹象有限，而 SFT + RL 基线会越来越多地靠声称符合 rubric、不给必需内容来拿高奖励。
Motivation: 开放式回答无法用精确结果验证打分，rubric-based RL 虽给出显式评分标准，但奖励只在整段回答结束后产生，训练信号无法指出是哪些个体决策贡献了最终分数。
Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段 RP-OPD 让看不到 rubric 的 student 在自己生成的前缀上匹配 rubric-aware teacher 的 next-token 分布，把 rubric 当特权上下文换取 token 级稠密监督；第二阶段直接以 rubric 奖励做 RL，越过蒸馏平台期。用 open-weight 模型在 health 与 science 任务上评测，并改变 RL 之前的 SFT 或 RP-OPD 训练量。
Result: 在 HealthBench、ResearchQA、RubricHub Science 上比较多种后训练方法并变化 RL 前的 SFT/RP-OPD 训练量，两阶段框架取得所评估方法中的最高分；RP-OPD + RL 在 RubricHub Science 上奖励作弊迹象有限，而 SFT + RL 基线越来越多地因声称符合 rubric 而获高奖励、却不提供要求的内容。
Conclusion: 作者主张在做 rubric-based RL 之前先用 rubric 引导 on-policy 蒸馏：rubric 既当稠密监督的特权信息又当后续 RL 的奖励，可越过蒸馏平台期并抑制只声称合规的奖励作弊。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Controlling Polar Exposure to Delay Memorization in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models can reach useful sample quality before copying training examples, but fast optimization can compress this generalization window by accelerating sample-specific fitting. We investigate this effect through update geometry and propose Quality-Gated De-whitening (QGD), a controller that retains a fast polar-update prefix and progressively restores fixed-gain momentum. Our random-feature analysis separates covariance-controlled, curvature-equalized and amplitude-controlled memorization clocks. Under aligned spectral assumptions, it establishes a finite-exposure condition under which a fixed-gain tail recovers a delay proportional to dataset size. QGD implements this principle with a confirmed quality gate, a bounded decay envelope and causal copy feedback. Immediate switching is the conservative limit; gradual control balances delayed copying against continued quality improvement. We pair QGD with Copy-Budgeted Selection (CBS), which applies simultaneous binomial calibration to a frozen checkpoint family, followed by a fresh evaluation of the released checkpoint. On 2,000-image CIFAR-10 subsets, QGD preserves the polar baseline's quality-arrival time while expanding its useful interval by 8.32x and reducing common-checkpoint copying by 75.9%. With identical calibration and independent quality evaluation, QGD achieves FID 75.56 versus 79.37 for SGD with the same selector. Exposure-matched controls, independent detector audits and transfer to flow matching and dance generation support adaptive exposure control as a practical way to improve the quality-copying tradeoff.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 扩散模型在快速优化下会过早复制训练样本，压缩可用泛化窗口；提出 Quality-Gated De-whitening (QGD) 控制器，先保留快速极向更新前缀、再逐步恢复固定增益动量，以延迟复制。在 2,000 张 CIFAR-10 子集上，QGD 保持极向基线的质量到达时间，同时把可用区间扩大 8.32 倍、公共 checkpoint 复制率降低 75.9%，FID 75.56 对比同选择器下 SGD 的 79.37。
Motivation: 扩散模型在达到可用样本质量前就可能复制训练样本，快速优化会加速样本级拟合、压缩这一泛化窗口，需要在质量与复制之间做可控权衡。
Method: QGD 通过更新几何控制：保留快速极向更新前缀，用确认式 quality gate、有界衰减包络与因果复制反馈逐步恢复固定增益动量；随机特征分析区分 covariance-controlled、curvature-equalized、amplitude-controlled 三种 memorization 时钟，并给出固定增益尾部可恢复与数据集规模成正比延迟的有限曝光条件。配套 Copy-Budgeted Selection (CBS) 对冻结 checkpoint 族做同步二项校准，再对发布 checkpoint 重新评估质量。
Result: 在 2,000-image CIFAR-10 子集上，QGD 保持极向基线的质量到达时间，可用区间扩大 8.32x，公共 checkpoint 复制率下降 75.9%；在相同校准与独立质量评估下，QGD FID 75.56 对比同一选择器下 SGD 的 79.37。曝光匹配对照、独立检测器审计，并迁移到 flow matching 与舞蹈生成。
Conclusion: 自适应曝光控制（立即切换为保守极限，渐进控制在延迟复制与持续质量提升之间平衡）是改善质量-复制权衡的实用手段，且可迁移到 flow matching 等其他生成范式。

papers.title: TRAC: Trajectory-aware Reuse and Adaptive Correction for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we present trajectory-aware reuse and adaptive correction (TRAC), a training-free framework for efficient autoregressive (AR) video generation. Existing acceleration methods mainly target single-trajectory generation with bidirectional attention. AR video generation, by contrast, sequentially couples chunk-level denoising trajectories. Consequently, approximation errors accumulate and propagate through the generation process. TRAC addresses this challenge with three components, including robust cumulative scheduling (RCS), autoregressive trajectory-aware guidance scheduling (ATGS), and spectral structure correction (SSC). RCS selects cache reuse schedules by cumulative rollout error and cross-chunk/prompt variation. ATGS coordinates CFG refreshes along the global AR trajectory. SSC restores low-frequency structure of the first chunk to correct long-term structural loss. Experiments on SkyReels-V2 and FramePack-F1 show that, compared with existing methods, TRAC achieves both the highest inference efficiency and the best generation quality for AR video generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRAC 是一个免训练的自回归 (AR) 视频生成加速框架，用累积调度 (RCS) 按累积 rollout 误差与跨 chunk/提示词变化选择 cache 复用，用 ATGS 沿全局 AR 轨迹协调 CFG 刷新，用 SSC 恢复首 chunk 的低频结构以纠正长程结构损失。在 SkyReels-V2 与 FramePack-F1 上，相比现有方法同时取得最高推理效率与最佳生成质量。
Motivation: 现有加速方法主要面向双向注意力的单轨迹生成，而 AR 视频生成顺序耦合各 chunk 的去噪轨迹，近似误差会沿生成过程累积传播，导致效率与质量难以兼顾。
Method: 三个组件：robust cumulative scheduling (RCS) 依据累积 rollout 误差与跨 chunk/提示词变化选择 cache 复用调度；autoregressive trajectory-aware guidance scheduling (ATGS) 沿全局 AR 轨迹协调 CFG 刷新；spectral structure correction (SSC) 恢复首 chunk 的低频结构以纠正长程结构损失。整体为 training-free 框架。
Result: 在 SkyReels-V2 与 FramePack-F1 上的实验显示，与现有方法相比，TRAC 同时取得最高的推理效率和最好的 AR 视频生成质量。
Conclusion: 自回归视频生成的加速需要按轨迹误差调度 cache 复用、按全局轨迹协调 CFG，并主动修补长程低频结构，才能同时拿到效率与质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LatticeSMC: Where to Spend Inference-Time Compute in Chunked Sequence Generators
papers.abstract_en: Long-form generators for music, motion and video produce sequences chunk by chunk, with each chunk generated by iterative denoising while rewards are defined over the full sequence. Existing inference-time steering methods typically act on one axis at a time: best-of-N at the end, Feynman-Kac steering across denoising steps, or streaming pruning across chunks, and are often compared under unmatched compute or different return rules. We introduce budget-matched chunked steering and propose LatticeSMC, a sampler derived from a Feynman-Kac model on the two-dimensional lattice of chunk index and denoising step. Two telescoping results make its design exact: for chunk-additive rewards, the two axes induce identical weights, so resampling should occur where lookahead is cheapest; for terminal rewards, any prefix score defines an exact intermediate potential, making prefix-evaluable rewards twists with no estimation or extra denoiser calls. LatticeSMC resamples on these potentials at chunk boundaries and, when scoring is free, within chunks, returning either a weighted draw or the best particle. Under matched compute, on music-to-dance diffusion and 40-second text-to-music generation, it raises beat alignment from 0.234 to 0.441 (best-of-N: 0.354) and prompt adherence from 0.470 to 0.560 at 32 particles, while preserving held-out quality. It also retains its advantage on long-range rewards and is preferred by human raters in 60-77 percent of pairwise comparisons. Finally, we show that commitment strength should follow the information in the current potential, while the value of lookahead is predicted by the within-set predictability of future reward.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LatticeSMC 把分块序列生成的推理时控制统一到 chunk×去噪步的二维格上做 Feynman-Kac 采样：对 chunk 可加奖励，两轴权重等价，重采样应放在前瞻最便宜处；对终端奖励，任意前缀分数给出精确中间势，无需估计或额外 denoiser 调用。在计算量对齐下，music-to-dance 的 beat alignment 从 0.234 提到 0.441（best-of-N 0.354），40 秒 text-to-music 的 prompt adherence 从 0.470 提到 0.560（32 粒子）。
Motivation: 长序列生成（音乐、动作、视频）奖励定义在整条序列上，而生成是逐 chunk 迭代去噪；现有推理时控制方法各占一条轴（末端 best-of-N、去噪步上的 Feynman-Kac、跨 chunk 的流式剪枝），且常在不匹配的计算量或不同返回规则下比较。
Method: 提出 budget-matched chunked steering 作为评测协议，并给出 LatticeSMC：在 chunk 索引与去噪步构成的二维格上从 Feynman-Kac 模型导出采样器，用两个 telescoping 结果确定设计——chunk 可加奖励下两轴诱导相同权重，终端奖励下前缀分数即精确中间势（twist，无额外 denoiser 调用）；在 chunk 边界按势重采样，打分免费时在 chunk 内也重采样，返回加权抽样或最优粒子。
Result: 在计算量对齐条件下，music-to-dance diffusion 上 beat alignment 由 0.234 升至 0.441（best-of-N 为 0.354），40 秒 text-to-music 上 prompt adherence 由 0.470 升至 0.560，粒子数 32，同时保持 held-out 质量；在长程奖励上仍保持优势，人工评分在成对比较中 60–77% 偏好其输出。
Conclusion: 两条轴在可加奖励下可互换、在终端奖励下可精确换势，因此重采样位置应由前瞻成本与当前势的信息量决定：承诺强度跟随当前势所含信息，前瞻价值由集合内未来奖励的可预测性预测。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Improving Atomic-Fact Recall via Focused Views in Unstructured Knowledge Editing
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly serve as general-purpose interfaces to factual knowledge, but their parameters do not automatically reflect information that changes after pretraining. Knowledge editing (KE) provides a targeted alternative to costly retraining by modifying selected knowledge and preserving unrelated knowledge and general capabilities. Conventional KE uses structured factual triples, whereas unstructured KE (UKE) uses free-form passages containing multiple facts. Nonetheless, existing UKE editors exhibit a failure mode known as context reliance: edited LLMs can often reproduce the editing passage but fail to reliably recall its individual facts without the original passage context. We identify context-induced difficulty underestimation under the standard passage-level editing objective: later facts receive increasingly rich ground-truth context and consequently incur lower initial losses, making them appear easier to learn. In response, we propose FOVEATED, a plug-and-play framework that constructs focused views of each sentence by randomly shifting the Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) positions assigned to the keys of its preceding context. The perturbation is applied during editing and removed afterward, leaving the model's native positional encoding unchanged at inference time. We instantiate FOVEATED for both direct-optimization and locate-then-edit editors. We theoretically analyze how FOVEATED counteracts context-induced difficulty underestimation and empirically demonstrate consistent improvements across five KE editors, two LLM backbones, and three benchmarks.
papers.comment: The first two authors contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 非结构化知识编辑 (UKE) 中被编辑的 LLM 能复述编辑段落却无法脱离上下文回忆其中单条事实，作者把这一 context reliance 归因于段落级目标下的 context-induced difficulty underestimation。FOVEATED 在编辑阶段随机平移每句前文 key 的 RoPE 位置来构造 focused views，编辑结束后移除扰动，推理时保留原生位置编码；在五个 KE 编辑器、两个 LLM backbone、三个 benchmark 上一致提升原子事实回忆。
Motivation: UKE 用含多条事实的自由文本做编辑，但现有编辑器出现 context reliance：模型能复述编辑段落却不能脱离原文回忆其中各条事实。根因是段落级编辑目标下后出现的事实拿到更丰富的 ground-truth 上下文、初始损失更低，被系统性低估难度。
Method: 提出即插即用的 FOVEATED：编辑时随机平移每句前文 context 的 key 所分配的 RoPE 位置，构造该句的 focused views，编辑完成后移除扰动，推理时位置编码不变。框架同时实例化到 direct-optimization 与 locate-then-edit 两类编辑器，并给出 FOVEATED 抵消 context-induced difficulty underestimation 的理论分析。
Result: 在五个 KE 编辑器、两个 LLM backbone、三个 benchmark 上取得一致改进 (consistent improvements)；理论分析表明该扰动能抵消 context-induced difficulty underestimation。
Conclusion: 原子事实回忆失败源于编辑目标对后出现事实的难度低估，编辑期对前文位置编码加扰动、推理期还原，可在不改动原生位置编码的前提下跨编辑器与 backbone 提升 UKE 的事实召回。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Nearly Optimal Fixed-Confidence Best-Arm Identification with 1-Bit Feedback
papers.abstract_en: We study fixed-confidence best-arm identification under strict 1-bit feedback constraints. At each round, the learner selects an arm and a query set, and receives only a single bit indicating whether the sampled reward belongs to that set. We consider a distribution-free finite-variance setting with arm-wise localization, where direct empirical mean estimation is no longer available and clipping becomes unavoidable. We first formulate a time-uniform 1-bit mean-estimation primitive based on randomized threshold queries and a clipped tail-integral identity. We then embed this primitive into candidate-challenger best-arm identification algorithms. A fixed-clipping algorithm gives a simple anytime $(ε,δ)$-PAC guarantee, while a phased adaptive-clipping algorithm matches the clipping level to the current resolution and yields a gap-adaptive sample complexity. We also prove a $K$-arm worst-case information-theoretic lower bound showing that the logarithmic penalty caused by finite-variance 1-bit feedback is intrinsic. This bound matches the leading dependence of the phased algorithm up to lower-order $\log\log$ factors.
papers.comment: To appear in Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 39 (NeurIPS 2026, Spotlight)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在每轮只返回 1 bit（采样奖励是否落在所选查询集内）的严格反馈下做固定置信度 best-arm identification，提出基于随机阈值查询与截断尾积分恒等式 (clipped tail-integral identity) 的时间一致 1-bit 均值估计原语，并嵌入 candidate-challenger 框架。分阶段自适应截断算法给出 gap-adaptive 样本复杂度，其主项与 K-arm 信息论下界仅差低阶 log log 因子，说明有限方差 1-bit 反馈带来的对数惩罚是固有的。
Motivation: 1-bit 反馈下直接经验均值估计不可用，必须截断，而有限方差分布中截断引入的对数代价是否不可避免缺少下界刻画。
Method: 先构造基于随机阈值查询与截断尾积分恒等式的时间一致 (time-uniform) 1-bit 均值估计原语，再嵌入 candidate-challenger best-arm identification：固定截断版本给出 anytime (ε,δ)-PAC 保证，分阶段自适应截断版本让截断水平匹配当前分辨率；并证明 K-arm 最坏情况信息论下界。设定为 distribution-free、finite-variance、arm-wise localization。
Result: 分阶段自适应截断算法的样本复杂度对 gap 自适应；所证 K-arm 最坏情况下界与该算法的主项依赖在低阶 log log 因子之外相匹配，表明有限方差 1-bit 反馈的对数惩罚是信息论固有的。
Conclusion: 1-bit 反馈下的 best-arm identification 存在固有的对数样本代价，而分阶段自适应截断在忽略 log log 因子的意义下已接近最优。

papers.title: When History Fails to Become Experience: Action Calibration in Language Agents
papers.abstract_en: Language agents should draw on prior attempts and environmental feedback to improve subsequent decisions within the same task. However, providing additional interaction history can sometimes reduce task success, suggesting that agents do not consistently use this information effectively. To investigate this limitation, we examine how agents use history. We find that history improves task completion overall, yet much of this benefit persists even when past actions are shuffled. Disrupting the correspondence between actions and observations causes only a modest decline in task success. We therefore hypothesize that agents do not reliably connect past actions with their outcomes when deciding how to proceed. To test this hypothesis, we explicitly label each returned observation as the outcome of the preceding action. This simple annotation improves task success and reduces next-action repetition without introducing new environmental information. Building on this insight, we introduce a learned calibrator that explicitly reassesses past actions and selectively records experience to guide subsequent decisions, improving task success beyond outcome labeling alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 语言智能体在同一任务内加入交互历史有时反而降低成功率，作者发现打乱历史动作后收益基本保留、破坏动作与观测对应关系只让成功率小幅下降，说明智能体并未可靠地把动作与其结果关联。给每条返回观测显式标注为前一动作的结果即可提升任务成功率并减少下一动作重复，再叠加一个学习式 calibrator 重估过去动作、选择性记录经验，效果超过单纯标注。
Motivation: 给语言智能体追加交互历史并不稳定地提升任务表现，甚至会降低成功率；需要弄清智能体到底如何使用历史，以及动作与结果的对应关系是否被真正利用。
Method: 先做消融诊断：打乱历史动作、破坏动作与观测的对应关系，观察任务成功率变化；再给每条返回观测显式标注为前一动作的结果（不引入新环境信息）；最后提出学习式 calibrator，重估过去动作并选择性记录经验以指导后续决策。
Result: 历史整体上改善任务完成，但打乱过去动作后大部分收益仍然保留；破坏动作与观测的对应关系只造成任务成功率 modest 下降；显式结果标注提升任务成功率并减少 next-action repetition；learned calibrator 在结果标注之上进一步提升任务成功率。
Conclusion: 历史之所以有用，主要不在于动作—结果的因果对应，而显式标注结果加上选择性经验记录能更有效地把历史变成可用经验。

papers.title: No-Free-Graph: Learning When Multimodal Data Should Be Graphified
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal graph learning has recently emerged as an effective paradigm for in corporating inter-entity relationships into multimodal representations. Existing studies have made substantial progress on how to construct and optimize graphs, but rarely consider a more fundamental question: whether additional relational structures should be introduced for a given dataset and task. Through empirical studies across diverse datasets, tasks, and graph constructors, we reveal that graphification is not consistently beneficial: introducing relational structures can provide substantial improvements in some cases, while offering limited or even negative gains. This observation motivates a new perspective that graph construction should be treated as a selective decision based on its expected utility rather than a default preprocessing step. To address this issue, we propose MAG-SCOUT, a pre-construction graph assessment framework that estimates whether introducing graph structures is beneficial before generating the complete topology. MAG-SCOUT collects limited relational evidence, analyzes its potential taskspecific contribution, and estimates the expected utility of graphification together with construction cost to make a build-or-skip decision. Extensive experiments across six multimodal datasets, three downstream tasks, and diverse graph constructors demonstrate that MAG-SCOUT effectively identifies when graph structures should be introduced, saving 33.1% of task-macro graph work while retaining 96.7% of held-out positive-gain mass under the pre-registered floor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多模态图学习里，把数据图化 (graphification) 并非总是有益：在部分数据集与任务上带来明显提升，在另一些上收益有限甚至为负。作者提出 MAG-SCOUT，一个建图前的评估框架，先收集有限的关系证据、估计图化的预期效用与构建成本，再做 build-or-skip 决策。在六个多模态数据集、三类下游任务与多种图构造器上，它省下 33.1% 的 task-macro 图构建工作，同时在预注册门槛下保留 96.7% 的 held-out 正增益质量。
Motivation: 现有工作集中在如何构建与优化图，却回避更前置的问题：给定数据集与任务到底该不该引入关系结构。把图化当默认预处理会在无收益甚至负收益的场景白付构建成本。
Method: MAG-SCOUT 是 pre-construction graph assessment 框架：先采集有限的关系证据 (relational evidence)，分析其对目标任务的潜在贡献，再把图化的预期效用与构建成本一起估计，输出 build-or-skip 决策，之后才生成完整拓扑。
Result: 在六个多模态数据集、三类下游任务和多种图构造器上的实验中，MAG-SCOUT 省下 33.1% 的 task-macro graph work，同时在预注册 floor 下保留 96.7% 的 held-out positive-gain mass；经验研究本身显示图化收益在不同情形间从显著提升到有限乃至负增益不等。
Conclusion: 图构建应被当作基于预期效用的选择性决策，而非默认预处理步骤；先评估再建图可以在几乎不损失正增益的前提下砍掉三分之一的图构建开销。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Exact Memory-Time Optimization for Prefix-Cached Language Model Serving
papers.abstract_en: Retaining language-model prefix states trades recomputation against storage time. Optimizing each cached block independently can overcount savings: a resident block is usable only when the required preceding prefix is also available. We introduce Prefix-Certificate Retention (PCR), an exact finite-trace formulation for static, grouped, reset-on-access timeouts. Usable-prefix rewards become nodes whose prerequisites are timeout thresholds and preceding hit certificates. The resulting maximum-weight closure reduces to one minimum cut, with graph size linear in the number of block lookups and timeout choices. A breakpoint theorem extends the construction to all nonnegative timeouts without discretization error. We also derive a linear-time-in-grid-size dynamic program for ordered timeouts and bounds that certify the cost of this restriction. Exhaustive small-instance checks and chronological replay of 39,632 public Mooncake requests validate the formulation. On the fixed grid, ordered timeouts attain the unrestricted training optimum in 118 of 120 trace-grouping-price cases. Heterogeneous retention improves several held-out memory-time tradeoffs, but finer training optimization does not uniformly improve transfer. The contribution is a tractable optimization model and an auditable benchmark for retention policies; the experiments measure usable prefix blocks and storage time, not GPU latency.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 5 figures. Code and reproducibility artifacts: https://github.com/shi1720/prefix-certificate-retention
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 前缀缓存的保留策略若逐块独立优化会高估收益，因为一个缓存块只有在其前置前缀也保留时才可用。本文提出 Prefix-Certificate Retention (PCR)，把可用前缀奖励建成带超时阈值前置条件的节点，最大权闭包化归为一次最小割，图规模随块查找与超时选择数线性增长。在 39,632 条 Mooncake 公开请求的时间顺序回放中，固定网格上有序超时在 120 个 trace-grouping-price 案例里的 118 个达到无约束训练最优。
Motivation: 语言模型服务中前缀状态保留要在重算与存储时间之间取舍，逐块独立优化会重复计算收益，因为驻留块只有在所需前置前缀也可用时才真正可用。
Method: 提出 Prefix-Certificate Retention (PCR)：把可用前缀奖励建为节点，其前置条件是超时阈值与前置命中证书，最大权闭包 (maximum-weight closure) 化归为一次最小割，图大小对块查找数与超时选择数线性；breakpoint 定理把构造推广到任意非负超时而无离散化误差；另给出对有序超时的网格规模线性时间动态规划及其限制代价的界。
Result: 在固定网格上，有序超时在 120 个 trace-grouping-price 案例中的 118 个达到无约束训练最优；异质保留改进了若干留出的 memory-time 权衡，但更细的训练优化并不一致地迁移到留出集。验证方式为小实例穷举检查与 39,632 条 Mooncake 公开请求的时间顺序回放，度量为可用前缀块数与存储时间，不含 GPU 延迟。
Conclusion: 前缀保留策略可以写成一个可解的精确优化模型（一次最小割加有序超时动态规划），并配可审计基准；但更细粒度的训练优化不保证在留出请求上更好。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Localized Conformal Safety Monitoring with Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Monitoring planned driving trajectories requires accurately estimating the collision likelihood with actors whose motion is itself impacted by the ego motion. Existing classical approaches are often limited by the quality of their forecasting model. Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown promise in reasoning about the consequences of high-level actions, yet their approximate predictions are unsuitable for safety-critical applications such as autonomous driving. Conformal prediction (CP) has emerged as a data-driven framework for quantifying the uncertainty of black-box model predictions. We propose Split Label-Localized Conformal Prediction (SLLCP), a post-hoc calibration layer over frozen VLMs that transforms their unreliable predictions into probabilistically calibrated safety prediction sets. We consider how the ability to estimate safety can depend on the observed driving scene and introduce a localized procedure that upweights relevant past experience when calculating uncertainty thresholds. We provide label-conditional finite-sample distribution-free coverage under exchangeability. Evaluated over 15k CARLA trajectories from unseen scenarios, SLLCP correctly flags 89.6% of collision-causing trajectories with a Qwen backbone and 88.4% with a Cosmos backbone, while the base VLMs only flagged 4.6% and 39.1% of the collision-causing trajectories, respectively. These results indicate that local, label-conditional calibration can reduce missed unsafe trajectories.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Split Label-Localized Conformal Prediction (SLLCP)，在冻结的 VLM 之上做后验校准，把不可靠的碰撞预测转成有概率保证的安全预测集，并按场景对相关历史样本加权来定不确定性阈值。在 15k 条 CARLA 未见场景轨迹上，Qwen 骨干正确标记 89.6% 的致碰撞轨迹（原 VLM 仅 4.6%），Cosmos 骨干 88.4%（原 39.1%）。
Motivation: 监控规划轨迹需要估计与交互演员的碰撞概率，而经典方法受限于预测模型质量；VLM 能推理高层动作后果但输出近似、不可直接用于安全关键场景。
Method: SLLCP 作为冻结 VLM 之上的后验校准层：用 split 方式做 label-conditional 校准，并引入 localized 程序，在计算不确定性阈值时对相关历史经验加权；在可交换性假设下给出 label-conditional、有限样本、无分布的 coverage 保证。
Result: 在 15k 条 CARLA 未见场景轨迹上，SLLCP 正确标记致碰撞轨迹的比例为 Qwen 骨干 89.6%、Cosmos 骨干 88.4%，而基础 VLM 分别只有 4.6% 与 39.1%。
Conclusion: 局部的 label-conditional 校准能显著减少漏掉的不安全轨迹，把 VLM 的近似预测变成可用于自动驾驶安全监控的校准预测集。

papers.title: A Controlled Audit of Personal AI Memory for Rating Prediction
papers.abstract_en: In structured rating prediction, does a personal AI use historical item-rating associations, or mainly the user's rating tendencies? We audit this distinction by permuting historical ratings within each user while preserving the exact rating distribution, item support, and metadata. We combine this control with full history, native memory extraction, and matched numerical readers in a publicly frozen evaluation of 400 held-out user profiles and 6,160 target ratings across Coat and MovieLens. On Coat, the tested Qwen-written Mem0 pipeline increases user-macro mean absolute error relative to full history by 0.084 for Qwen and 0.149 for Phi; both family-adjusted bootstrap intervals exclude zero. Correct historical assignments help both readers on Coat, but the corresponding MovieLens effects are smaller and inconclusive after adjustment. A history-only ridge reader outperforms Qwen in both domains and Phi on MovieLens, while the Coat Phi comparison is unresolved. All 2,800 reader calls, including 150 invalid outputs, are retained under a fixed fallback rule. A separate implementation verifies inputs, metrics, and all ten primary contrasts. The contribution is a reproducible diagnostic study showing why extraction, association use, output reliability, and reader choice require separate evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对个人 AI 记忆在评分预测中是否真的利用「物品-评分」历史关联做受控审计：在保持每用户评分分布、物品支持与元数据完全不变的前提下置换历史评分。结果显示 Mem0 记忆管线在 Coat 上相对全历史使 user-macro MAE 恶化 0.084（Qwen）与 0.149（Phi），且历史关联的正确性只在 Coat 上对两个 reader 有帮助，MovieLens 上效应更小且经校正后不确定。
Motivation: 个人 AI 的记忆管线被宣称能利用用户历史偏好，但无法区分它是在用物品-评分关联还是只在套用用户的整体评分倾向，评分预测任务上缺少能拆开这两者的受控检验。
Method: 对每个用户置换历史评分、同时精确保留评分分布、物品支持与元数据，构成对照；与全历史、原生记忆抽取 (Mem0)、匹配的数值 reader 一起在冻结评测中运行，覆盖 400 个留出用户档案与 6,160 个目标评分，数据集为 Coat 与 MovieLens；另用一个独立实现核验输入、指标与全部十个主对比，2,800 次 reader 调用（含 150 次无效输出）按固定 fallback 规则全部保留。
Result: Coat 上 Qwen 写的 Mem0 管线相对全历史使 user-macro MAE 上升 0.084（Qwen）与 0.149（Phi），两个 family-adjusted bootstrap 区间均不含零；Coat 上正确历史赋值对两个 reader 都有帮助，MovieLens 上对应效应更小且校正后不确定；history-only ridge reader 在两个域上都优于 Qwen、在 MovieLens 上优于 Phi，Coat 上与 Phi 的对比未定；共 2,800 次 reader 调用含 150 次无效输出。
Conclusion: 记忆抽取、关联使用、输出可靠性与 reader 选择必须分开评估：该 Mem0 管线在 Coat 上反而比直接用全历史更差，而一个只读历史的 ridge reader 就能超过 Qwen。

papers.title: A Two-Stage Cascade for Near-Real-Time Forest Anomaly Detection from Sentinel-1 SAR Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Tropical forest monitoring is essential for global climate stability and biodiversity preservation. To address the urgent need for rapid, reliable detection of forest loss which is essential for timely intervention against illegal logging, supply chain transparency, land-use governance and carbon market standards, we introduce a two-stage statistics-encoder cascade for near-real-time anomaly detection using Sentinel-1 time series. Our system is designed to overcome two fundamental challenges in remote sensing: the cloud-cover limitations that restrict optical monitoring and seasonal backscatter variation that causes SAR systems to mistake natural moisture changes for forest loss. The architecture integrates two distinct analytical engines to ensure high-fidelity detection: (1) an adaptive, robust-statistics z-score test on co-registered Sentinel-1 VH backscatter, same-season historical baseline and (2) a learned confirmation gate based on the latent-space structural similarity (SSIM) of a convolutional autoencoder trained on stable-forest patches. A candidate disturbance is confirmed as an alert only when both stages agree, and is assigned a confidence score and a Low/Medium/High risk tier from its repeat-occurrence history. The system produces per-alert auditable confidence scores and area-in-hectares estimates directly compatible with Monitoring, Reporting and Verification (MRV) workflows, sustainable forestry management, operational field checks and environmental risk assessments. Beyond its primary application, the model's flexibility allows for critical environmental applications ranging from selective logging to large-scale agricultural encroachment mapping, flood mapping and so on.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 两阶段级联在 Sentinel-1 VH 后向散射时序上做近实时森林异常检测：先用同季节历史基线的稳健统计 z-score 检验筛候选，再由卷积自编码器潜在空间 SSIM 的学习确认门把关，两阶段一致才发警报，并按重复出现历史给出置信度与 Low/Medium/High 风险分级。系统直接输出可审计置信度与公顷面积估计，对接 MRV 流程。
Motivation: 光学监测受云覆盖限制，而 SAR 的季节性后向散射变化会让系统把自然湿度变化误判为森林损失，快速可靠的毁林检测因此既慢又易误报。
Method: 第一阶段对配准后的 Sentinel-1 VH 后向散射与同季节历史基线做自适应稳健统计 z-score 检验；第二阶段用在稳定森林图块上训练的卷积自编码器，按潜在空间结构相似性 (SSIM) 判定候选；两阶段一致才确认为警报，并结合重复出现历史赋置信度与风险分级。
Result: 输出每条警报的可审计置信度分数与公顷面积估计，可直接接入 Monitoring, Reporting and Verification (MRV) 工作流；模型还可扩展到选择性采伐、大规模农业侵占制图与洪水制图等应用。
Conclusion: 把稳健统计检验与学习型确认门串联，可以在克服云覆盖与季节后向散射干扰的前提下做近实时森林异常检测，且产出满足 MRV 与现场核查的可审计警报。

papers.title: Dynamic LLM Routers are Often Misguided
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic LLM routers promise to cut inference costs by sending each query to the cheapest model that can answer it correctly. We analyze six commercial routers across 14 settings on a diverse benchmark spanning eight task categories, finding that none of them outperforms a router that randomly selects between two well-chosen models at matched cost. Some underperform by more than 10 percentage points. We trace this gap to four patterns prevalent across routers: difficulty blindness, length reversal, semantic matching, and roster suboptimality. We show that the first three are what the standard objective rewards: cost-accuracy Pareto efficiency on realized costs favors escalating moderately hard queries over the hardest ones, shorter queries over longer ones, and routing by a query's source over its difficulty. We also argue that the two assumptions that would justify large rosters, model granularity and model specialization, do not hold empirically. We propose an alternative evaluation methodology that does not reward these patterns, and as a proof of concept, we design a simple two-model router that avoids all four. Nevertheless, its gain over random routing is limited, because a well-chosen roster leaves little to route.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 15 figures, under review at NAACL
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对六个商业动态 LLM 路由器在覆盖八类任务的基准上做 14 种设置的对照，没有一个在同等成本下胜过「在两个精选模型间随机选择」的路由器，部分落后超过 10 个百分点。差距来自四种模式：难度盲视、长度反转、语义匹配、候选集次优，而前三种正是标准目标（成本-准确率 Pareto 效率）所奖励的。作者据此提出不奖励这些模式的评估方法，并给出一个避开四者的双模型路由器原型，但其相对随机路由的增益有限，因为精选候选集本身已无多少可路由空间。
Motivation: 动态路由号称能把每个查询送给能答对的最便宜模型，但缺少公平的成本匹配评估，无法判断它是否真的优于简单策略，以及标准目标是否在奖励错误行为。
Method: 在横跨八个任务类别的多样化基准上评测六个商业路由器的 14 种设置，成本匹配下与「两个精选模型间随机选择」对照；把差距归因并形式化为四种模式，论证成本-准确率 Pareto 效率目标会奖励难度盲视、长度反转与语义匹配；再提出不奖励这些模式的替代评估方法，并设计避开四者的双模型路由器作为概念验证。
Result: 六个商业路由器无一在匹配成本下胜过随机双模型路由，部分落后超过 10 个百分点；识别出难度盲视、长度反转、语义匹配、候选集次优四种普遍模式；论证模型粒度与模型专业化这两条支撑大候选集的假设在经验上不成立；所提双模型路由器避开全部四种模式，但相对随机路由增益有限。
Conclusion: 在精选候选集下，动态路由的可得空间很小，标准成本-准确率目标反而系统性奖励错误路由行为，因此大候选集与复杂路由器缺乏依据，评估方法本身需要更换。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: FiberGeoText: A Vision-Language Model for Population- Level Organization of Superficial White Matter
papers.abstract_en: The superficial white matter (SWM), a critical brain region for cognition across the lifespan and brain disease, contains abundant short-range association fibers whose organization remains incompletely characterized, in part because the short trajectories and highly variable cortical folding make correspondence across individuals challenging. Anatomically corresponding connections may vary in spatial location across individuals and therefore may not be adequately defined by geometric proximity alone. We introduce FiberGeoText (FGT), a vision-language model (VLM) for organizing short-range superficial white matter (SWM) streamlines reconstructed from ultra-high-resolution diffusion MRI into population-level clusters. FGT jointly represents three complementary properties of each streamline: its three-dimensional trajectory, its cortical anatomical context, and its shape. Cortical endpoint information from multiple parcellation schemes is expressed as text and encoded using a pretrained large language model (LLM), enabling heterogeneous anatomical descriptions to contribute to a common continuous representation. We evaluated FGT on acquired submillimeter 0.76 mm diffusion MRI data. Compared with state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods, FGT produced substantially greater cortical parcel coherence, within-cluster shape consistency, cluster-size consistency, and cross-subject correspondence. The trained model also generalizes well to unseen subjects with an average of 96.7% of the 5,000 learned clusters recovered, and high consistency of cluster structure between training and testing data. Together, these findings demonstrate that integrating geometric, anatomical, and shape information by learning multimodal deep embeddings with a VLM model enables robust learning of population-consistent SWM organization despite interindividual anatomical variability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FiberGeoText (FGT) 用视觉-语言模型把浅表白质 (SWM) 纤维束的三维轨迹、皮层解剖语境与形状三者联合嵌入，把皮层端点在多种 parcellation 方案下的描述转成文本经预训练 LLM 编码，从而在人群层面聚类短程纤维。在 0.76 mm 亚毫米扩散 MRI 上，FGT 的皮层 parcel 一致性、簇内形状一致性、簇大小一致性与跨被试对应均显著优于 SOTA；对未见被试平均恢复 96.7% 的 5,000 个已学簇。
Motivation: 浅表白质短程纤维轨迹短、皮层折叠个体差异大，几何邻近不足以定义跨个体的解剖对应，人群层面的组织方式长期刻画不完整。
Method: FGT 为每条纤维联合表示三维轨迹、皮层解剖语境与形状；皮层端点信息用多种 parcellation 方案转写为文本，经预训练 LLM 编码进统一连续表示，再以多模态深度嵌入做人群聚类，训练数据为 0.76 mm 亚毫米扩散 MRI 重建的 streamline。
Result: 在 0.76 mm 扩散 MRI 数据上，与 SOTA 方法相比，FGT 在 cortical parcel coherence、簇内形状一致性、簇大小一致性与跨被试对应上均明显更好；训练后的模型在未见被试上平均恢复 96.7% 的 5,000 个已学簇，训练与测试间簇结构高度一致。
Conclusion: 把几何、解剖与形状信息经 VLM 多模态嵌入联合学习，可以在个体解剖差异下稳健学出人群一致的 SWM 组织。

papers.title: Jumping up and down: Denoiser diffusion models for discrete ordinal data
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models are highly developed in continuous spaces for image and video domains. Recently, major advances have been made for discrete diffusion models for categorical data, specifically in the language domain. In contrast, diffusion models for discrete integer-valued data are less developed, despite the prevalence of this modality, ranging from images and music to gene counts. We introduce Jumping Up and Down (JUD)---a new family of denoiser-based diffusion models for discrete ordinal data. This is the first family of diffusion models for ordinal data which centers around training denoisers, which at the same time allows for bi-directional (up and down) perturbations of the data. The simplicity of the training objective, combined with the flexibility of bi-directional perturbations, leads us to obtain competitive results across different data modalities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Jumping Up and Down (JUD)：首个以训练 denoiser 为核心的离散序数 (discrete ordinal) 扩散模型族，允许数据在双向（上/下）扰动下加噪与去噪。训练目标简单，配合双向扰动的灵活性，在图像、音乐、基因计数等不同数据模态上取得有竞争力的结果。
Motivation: 连续空间与类别数据的扩散模型已很成熟，但离散整数值（序数）数据的扩散模型发展不足，而这类模态从图像、音乐到基因计数都很普遍。
Method: JUD 是面向离散序数数据的 denoiser-based 扩散模型族，训练时学习 denoiser，并在加噪过程中允许双向（up and down）扰动数据；训练目标设计得简单，以兼顾灵活性。
Result: 在图像、音乐、基因计数等不同数据模态上获得有竞争力的结果（competitive results），摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 以 denoiser 训练配合双向扰动，是离散序数数据扩散建模的一个可行且有竞争力的通用框架，可覆盖多类整数值模态。
