papers.title: Correcting Guided Diffusion Trajectories with Spectral Alignment
papers.abstract_en: The practical success of conditional image generation hinges on fine-grained differences in condition alignment and visual fidelity. Classifier-free guidance (CFG) is central to this success, but its lack of an explicit criterion makes it difficult to assess whether the guided trajectory is progressing as intended. To address this gap, we show that spectral alignment provides a principled criterion for understanding guidance behavior and improving guided diffusion sampling through adaptive correction. Our analysis identifies the spectra of intermediate states as an indicator of consistency with the expected spectral evolution of the forward process. Based on this observation, we introduce Spectral Correction Guidance, a method that corrects deviations from an analytic reference spectrum during sampling. The proposed method is training-free and applicable across diffusion backbones and conditional generation tasks without modifying the underlying model. Experiments demonstrate consistent gains in preference-based metrics over baseline guidance methods in text-to-image generation and improved generation quality over CFG on ImageNet. These improvements persist across a range of guidance scales and with fewer denoising steps. Our analyses and ablations provide insight into guidance behavior and how the proposed method affects generation quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Spectral Correction Guidance：把引导扩散采样中中间状态的功率谱与前向过程的解析参考谱对齐，偏离参考谱时在线校正，训练-free 且不改动底层模型。在文本到图像生成上偏好类指标一致优于基线引导方法，ImageNet 上生成质量优于 CFG，且在多种 guidance scale 与更少去噪步数下仍保持增益。
Motivation: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) 缺少显式判据，无法判断引导轨迹是否按预期演化，条件对齐与视觉保真度的细微差异难以量化。
Method: 以中间状态谱与前向过程解析参考谱的一致性作为引导行为判据，采样时对偏离参考谱的部分做自适应校正（Spectral Correction Guidance）；训练-free，跨扩散 backbone 与条件生成任务通用，不修改底层模型。
Result: 文本到图像生成上偏好类指标 (preference-based metrics) 相对基线引导方法一致提升；ImageNet 上生成质量优于 CFG；增益在一系列 guidance scale 下以及更少去噪步数时仍然保持。
Conclusion: 谱对齐可作为引导扩散轨迹的显式判据，用在线谱校正即可在不重训模型的前提下改善 CFG 的生成质量与采样效率。

papers.title: Learning Query Encoders Can Be Hard Even When Vector Retrieval Is Geometrically Easy
papers.abstract_en: Efficient vector retrieval requires both a corpus geometry that supports retrieving the right documents through vector similarity, and a query encoder that can embed queries near their desired documents in the embedding space. Recent work has studied geometric capacity through the lens of the minimum embedding dimension needed to realize all top-$k$ answer sets of $n$ documents. We study a different notion of geometric capacity--the maximum recall achievable for a frozen document index--and explore whether learned query encoders can reach this ceiling. On several real-world retrieval benchmarks, we show that retrieval quality of single-vector query encoders often lies far below what the document indices can support. Motivated by this observation, we give theoretical evidence that learning query encoders can be computationally hard. In particular, we construct a retrieval task that (1) admits a query encoder with perfect recall which is representable by a small one-hidden-layer ReLU network, but (2) any statistical-query learner (a class capturing learners that access training data through aggregate statistics) provably requires exponentially many statistical queries to achieve non-trivial recall advantage over the random baseline $k/n$. Taken together, our results suggest substantial unrealized geometric capacity in retrieval benchmarks and establish query encoder learnability as a possible barrier in embedding-based retrieval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把向量检索的几何容量重新定义为「冻结文档索引下可达到的最大召回」，发现真实检索基准上单向量 query encoder 的召回远低于索引本身能支撑的上限，并给出理论证据说明学出这个 encoder 可能是计算上困难的：构造的检索任务存在一个单隐层小 ReLU 网络即可达到完美召回的 encoder，但任何 statistical-query 学习者要获得超过随机基线 k/n 的非平凡召回优势都需要指数多的统计查询。
Motivation: 已有工作用实现全部 top-k 答案集所需的最小嵌入维度衡量几何容量，但忽略了学习 query encoder 这一环节；若 encoder 学不出来，索引几何再好也用不上，检索质量的瓶颈可能在学习而非几何。
Method: 先在若干真实检索基准上比较单向量 query encoder 的实际检索质量与冻结文档索引可支撑的最大召回（几何容量），再构造一个理论检索任务：给出可达完美召回的小型单隐层 ReLU encoder，并证明 statistical-query 学习模型下达到非平凡召回优势需要指数多查询。
Result: 在多个真实检索基准上，单向量 query encoder 的检索质量往往远低于文档索引所能支撑的上限；理论上构造的任务中，完美召回可由小型单隐层 ReLU 网络表示的 encoder 实现，而任何 statistical-query 学习者要超过随机基线 k/n 的非平凡召回优势都需指数多统计查询。
Conclusion: 检索基准中存在大量未被利用的几何容量，query encoder 的可学习性本身可能是嵌入式检索的一个根本性障碍。

papers.title: On the Chain-of-Thought Monitorability of Looped Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring provides a promising approach for detecting undesirable model behavior. Looped language models (LoopLMs) repeatedly apply shared transformer layers, increasing effective computational depth and enabling additional latent computation without increasing model size. However, the effect of looped architectures on CoT monitorability remains largely unexplored. In this work, we provide the first systematic evaluation of CoT monitorability in LoopLMs. We study two complementary settings: (1) varying the loop depth within the same LoopLM family to isolate the effect of additional recurrent computation, and (2) comparing LoopLMs with non-looped language models matched by parameter size, transformer-layer count, or effective depth to study whether LoopLMs are less monitorable. Across eight tasks from MonitorBench and both standard and stress-test settings, we observe task-dependent reductions in CoT monitorability under stress tests on specific Logic/Science/Engineering \texttt{Cue Answer} tasks, while other tasks exhibit weaker or qualitatively different trends. Our diagnosis suggests that these declines are not fully explained by task difficulty, verification pass rate, or generated token length; qualitative examples further suggest changes in how deeper-loop models explicitly use or attribute provided cues. Our cross-model comparison finds no evidence that LoopLMs are systematically less monitorable than non-looped language models matched on size or depth. Overall, our results suggest that deeper loop depth can reduce CoT monitorability in some tasks under stress tests, but looped transformer architecture alone does not necessarily imply lower monitorability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 首次系统评估循环语言模型 (LoopLM) 的思维链可监控性：在同一 LoopLM 家族内改变循环深度，并与按参数量、层数或有效深度对齐的非循环模型对比。在 MonitorBench 八项任务的标准与压力测试下，压力测试使部分 Logic/Science/Engineering 的 Cue Answer 任务可监控性下降，且不能由任务难度、验证通过率或生成长度解释；但按规模或深度匹配后，LoopLM 并不系统性地比非循环模型更难监控。
Motivation: 循环架构通过重复共享 Transformer 层增加有效计算深度，但这种结构对 CoT 可监控性的影响基本未被研究，缺少针对 LoopLM 的系统评测。
Method: 两个互补设置：一是同一 LoopLM 家族内改变 loop depth 以分离循环计算的作用；二是与按参数量、Transformer 层数或有效深度匹配的非循环模型对比。评测覆盖 MonitorBench 的八项任务，含标准与压力测试两种设定，并用诊断分析区分任务难度、验证 pass rate 与生成 token 长度的影响。
Result: 在 MonitorBench 八项任务上，压力测试下部分 Logic/Science/Engineering Cue Answer 任务的 CoT 可监控性出现任务相关的下降，其余任务趋势更弱或性质不同；诊断显示这些下降不能被任务难度、验证 pass rate 或生成 token 长度完全解释。跨模型比较未发现 LoopLM 在按规模或深度匹配后系统性地更不可监控。
Conclusion: 更深的循环深度在压力测试下会降低部分任务的 CoT 可监控性，但循环 Transformer 架构本身并不必然意味着更低的可监控性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Prospective Hindsight: Self-Calibrating Reinforcement Learning via Prediction-Reality Gaps
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning for long-horizon agents relies on purely retrospective training signals: credit is assigned only after observing environmental consequences, leaving the agent's belief at action time invisible to the gradient. We introduce Prospective Hindsight (PH), a self-calibrating training principle that augments any retrospective base method with a signal derived from the gap between the agent's prospective prediction (before feedback) and the retrospective evaluation (after feedback). This per-rollout surprise identifies samples where the agent's self-model is most inaccurate and amplifies their gradient contribution through a stop-gradient surprise-weighted advantage. Since the prospective predictor shares parameters with the policy, the two co-evolve, progressively shifting focus to the agent's remaining blind spots. We connect this principle to a privileged-information gap and show that minimizing the surprise residual provides a descent pathway on the agent's miscalibration rate; calibration thus emerges as a byproduct of optimization rather than from an added objective. On single-turn verifiable tasks and a multi-turn personal-agent task (under GRPO, on-policy distillation, and their combination), PH improves both task performance and calibration, with consistent gains across model scales. Notably, the dominant miscalibration mode shifts structurally between regimes, overconfident failures in single-turn, underconfident successes in multi-turn, yet the same training principle addresses both successfully.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Prospective Hindsight (PH) 给任何回顾式 RL 训练信号加上「行动前预测 vs 反馈后评估」的逐 rollout 惊讶度，用 stop-gradient 惊讶加权优势放大自模型最不准的样本梯度。预测器与策略共享参数共同演化，在单轮可验证任务与多轮 personal-agent 任务上（GRPO、on-policy distillation 及其组合）同时提升任务性能与校准度，且跨模型规模一致。
Motivation: 长程 agent 的训练信号纯回顾式：信用只在观察到环境后果后分配，行动时刻 agent 的信念对梯度不可见，自校准无从发生。
Method: PH 作为通用增强原则：用行动前 prospective prediction 与反馈后 retrospective evaluation 之差构造逐 rollout 惊讶度，经 stop-gradient 惊讶加权优势放大高惊讶样本的梯度贡献；prospective predictor 与策略共享参数共同演化。作者把该原则连到 privileged-information gap，并证明最小化惊讶残差给出 agent 失准率的下降路径。
Result: 在单轮可验证任务与多轮 personal-agent 任务上，PH 在 GRPO、on-policy distillation 及二者组合下同时改善任务性能与校准度，增益跨模型规模一致。主导失准模式在两种 regime 间结构性切换：单轮为 overconfident failures，多轮为 underconfident successes，同一训练原则对两者都有效。
Conclusion: 校准是优化的副产物而非额外目标：最小化预测-现实惊讶残差即可同时压低失准率并抬升任务性能，且该原则对回顾式基方法与失准模式都是通用的。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: PH 作为通用增强原则：用行动前 prospective prediction 与反馈后 retrospective evaluation 之差构造逐 rollout 惊讶度，经 stop-gradient 惊讶加权优势放大高惊讶样本的梯度贡献；prospective predictor 与策略共享参数共同演化。作者把该原则连到 privileged-information gap，并证明最小化惊讶残差给出 agent 失准率的下降路径。
summary_sections.result: 在单轮可验证任务与多轮 personal-agent 任务上，PH 在 GRPO、on-policy distillation 及二者组合下同时改善任务性能与校准度，增益跨模型规模一致。主导失准模式在两种 regime 间结构性切换：单轮为 overconfident failures，多轮为 underconfident successes，同一训练原则对两者都有效。
summary_sections.conclusion: 校准是优化的副产物而非额外目标：最小化预测-现实惊讶残差即可同时压低失准率并抬升任务性能，且该原则对回顾式基方法与失准模式都是通用的。

papers.title: Inner Momentum for Differentially Private Muon
papers.abstract_en: Differentially private training clips each per-example gradient before adding noise. This clipping is radial for each example, yet unequal clipping factors can distort the relative singular-vector geometry of their average. Muon is particularly exposed to this effect, since its update is an approximate polar factor UV^T that depends only on the singular vectors that clipping can shift. To curb this degradation, we propose averaging each sampled example's Muon gradient over the current model and a short history of recent models before clipping. The clipped batch matrix then separates into a common rescaling and a covariance residual R between sampled gradients and clipping values, with ||R||_F <= sigma_lambda sigma_G, bounding the clipping-induced distortion directly. We further show that a finite Newton-Schulz iteration preserves the polar factor of its input under these spectral conditions, confirming that our correction survives orthogonalization. In private GPT-2 fine-tuning on E2E and DART at epsilon in {1, 2, 4, 8}, DP-Muon-IM improves BLEU and ROUGE-L over DP-Muon in every seed-matched comparison, and non-private diagnostics show 2-4% lower pre-noise polar error.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DP 训练中逐样本径向裁剪会扭曲平均梯度的奇异向量几何，而 Muon 更新只依赖奇异向量，因此受损最重。作者提出 Inner Momentum：裁剪前先把每个样本的 Muon 梯度在当前模型与近期模型短历史上做平均，使裁剪后的批矩阵分解为公共重缩放加协方差残差 R，且 ||R||_F ≤ σ_λ σ_G，直接约束裁剪失真。在 ε∈{1,2,4,8} 的 GPT-2 私有微调上，DP-Muon-IM 在每个 seed-matched 对比中 BLEU 与 ROUGE-L 均高于 DP-Muon，非私有诊断显示裁剪前极误差低 2–4%。
Motivation: 差分隐私逐样本裁剪对每个样本的裁剪系数不同，会扭曲它们平均后的奇异向量几何；Muon 的更新是近似极分解 UV^T，只依赖可被裁剪移动的奇异向量，因此对这种失真特别敏感。
Method: 提出 Inner Momentum：裁剪前将每个采样样本的 Muon 梯度在当前模型与一段近期模型历史上平均；证明裁剪后的批矩阵可分解为公共重缩放与样本梯度和裁剪值之间的协方差残差 R，并给出 ||R||_F ≤ σ_λ σ_G 的界；另证在相应谱条件下有限次 Newton-Schulz 迭代保持输入的极因子，说明修正能经受正交化。
Result: 在 E2E 与 DART 上做 GPT-2 私有微调，ε 取 1、2、4、8：DP-Muon-IM 在每个 seed-matched 对比中 BLEU 与 ROUGE-L 都优于 DP-Muon；非私有诊断中裁剪前极误差 (pre-noise polar error) 低 2–4%。理论上给出 ||R||_F ≤ σ_λ σ_G 的失真界，并证明有限 Newton-Schulz 迭代在该谱条件下保持极因子。
Conclusion: 把裁剪推迟到跨近期模型的梯度平均之后，可以抑制 DP-Muon 中裁剪引起的奇异向量失真，且该修正在 Newton-Schulz 正交化后仍然保留，从而在私有 GPT-2 微调上稳定提升 BLEU 与 ROUGE-L。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TPBench: A Turning-Point Benchmark for Dialogue Compression
papers.abstract_en: A compressor can keep the facts of a dialogue and still drop the turn that changed them. A user corrects a price, reverses a choice, or adds a constraint. We call this failure turning-point eviction. One overall retention score hides it, because that score mixes what the user first wanted with what the user wants now. We introduce TPBench, which evaluates three complementary information targets at shared nominal retention budgets. P1 asks for the user's initial goal. P2 asks for the current value of a slot the user revised. P3 asks for both, in dialogues with a late annotated slot update. The current-value answers come from the human dialogue-state annotations of MultiWOZ and SGD. The initial-goal answer is the first sentence of the first user turn. Neither requires new crowdsourcing. The probe-specific evaluations rank compression methods differently. On the joint probe at a retained fraction of 0.30, every tested compressed method remains below full context with the main Llama reader. Deleting the turn that carries the update sharply lowers current-value accuracy, while deleting one matched irrelevant turn leaves it unchanged. A Mistral reader repeats the P2/P3 rankings and the joint-probe gap. Current-value recovery is tested on an additional corpus, LongMemEval-KU, and on Chinese RiSAWOZ: full context has the highest accuracy, and recency has the highest compressed-method mean in both evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TPBench 指出对话压缩的 turning-point eviction：压缩器保住了事实却丢掉改变事实的那一轮，整体保留率分数会掩盖这一失败。它在相同名义保留预算下评测三个探针（P1 初始目标、P2 被修改槽位的当前值、P3 两者），用 MultiWOZ 与 SGD 的人工对话状态标注作答；在保留比例 0.30 的联合探针上，所有被测压缩方法都低于完整上下文，删除携带更新的那一轮会大幅拉低当前值准确率，删除一条匹配的无关轮则不变。
Motivation: 单一整体保留分数把用户最初想要的和现在想要的混在一起，掩盖了压缩器丢掉关键更新轮这一失败模式。
Method: 在共享名义保留预算下评测三个互补信息目标：P1 取首轮第一句作为初始目标答案，P2 取被修改槽位的当前值，P3 要求两者，且对话含晚期标注的槽位更新；当前值答案来自 MultiWOZ 与 SGD 的人工 dialogue-state 标注，无需新众包。另在 LongMemEval-KU 与中文 RiSAWOZ 上测试当前值恢复。
Result: 在保留比例 0.30 的联合探针上，所有被测压缩方法都低于以 Llama 为主 reader 的完整上下文；删除携带更新的那一轮使当前值准确率大幅下降，删除一条匹配的无关轮则保持不变。Mistral reader 复现了 P2/P3 排名与联合探针差距。当前值恢复在 LongMemEval-KU 与中文 RiSAWOZ 上均为完整上下文准确率最高、recency 在压缩方法中均值最高。不同探针会把压缩方法排成不同名次。
Conclusion: 整体保留分数不足以衡量对话压缩，须按探针分别评测；即便压缩后，完整上下文在该基准上仍是准确率上限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Bellman Error Minimization Via Linear Programming Normalization
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a new functional approximation approach to reduce Bellman error in high-dimensional dynamic programming and Reinforcement Learning problems. Using a classic dynamic programming problem (network capacity control in revenue management) as the motivational example, the paper illustrates that deep neural networks and linear programming approximation algorithms can be combined to derive approximate solutions to dynamic programming problems. Simulation results show the proposed approximation algorithms achieves competitive performance when compared with benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用线性规划归一化 (linear programming normalization) 约束函数逼近来降低高维动态规划与强化学习中的 Bellman 误差：以收益管理中的网络容量控制问题为例，把深度神经网络与线性规划逼近算法结合求近似解。仿真显示该逼近算法相对 benchmark 取得有竞争力的表现。
Motivation: 高维动态规划中 Bellman 误差难以直接最小化，收益管理的网络容量控制这类经典问题需要在函数逼近与约束求解之间建立可行的结合方式。
Method: 以网络容量控制 (network capacity control in revenue management) 为动机问题，将深度神经网络与线性规划 (LP) 近似算法组合，用 LP 归一化约束函数逼近以导出动态规划问题的近似解。
Result: 仿真结果中，所提逼近算法相对 benchmark 达到有竞争力的性能 (competitive performance)。
Conclusion: 神经网络与线性规划归一化结合可以作为降低 Bellman 误差、求解高维动态规划问题的一条可行路径。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: SymRegFlow: Symmetry-Regularized Flow Matching for Video World Models
papers.abstract_en: Flow-matching-based multi-view world models generate realistic videos, but are commonly restricted to fixed camera rigs. Extending them to continuously varying camera poses requires paired pose--video observations with dense pose coverage, which are costly to acquire. We introduce \emph{SymRegFlow}, a symmetry-regularized flow-matching framework for multi-view-consistent video generation across continuous viewpoints without ground-truth novel-view RGB supervision. For each target pose, SymRegFlow geometrically warps source views into noisy anchors and combines masked dual-anchor supervision with cross-anchor denoising-output consistency to mitigate anchor-specific errors. Under an affine Gaussian surrogate, we prove that suitable consistency regularization recovers the clean-reference optimum at fixed noise levels, strictly outperforming single- and merged-anchor baselines. Experiments on Cosmos-Drive-Dreams and nuScenes demonstrate high-quality, multi-view-consistent autonomous-driving video generation: on nuScenes, SymRegFlow achieves the lowest FVD and FVMD among the evaluated baselines, reducing FVD by over 31\% relative to the best baseline, and source-conditioned inference also attains the best FID and instance preservation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SymRegFlow 用对称正则化的 flow matching 在没有真值新视角 RGB 监督下生成跨连续视角多视一致的自动驾驶视频：把源视图几何 warp 成带噪锚点，用掩码双锚点监督加跨锚点去噪输出一致性约束锚点特有误差。在 nuScenes 上 FVD 与 FVMD 均为所评基线中最低，相对最优基线 FVD 降低超过 31%，源条件推理的 FID 与实例保持也最好。
Motivation: 基于 flow matching 的多视世界模型通常只能绑定固定相机架，扩展到连续变化的相机位姿需要密集位姿覆盖的位姿-视频配对数据，而这类数据采集成本很高。
Method: 对每个目标位姿，将源视图几何 warp 成带噪锚点 (noisy anchors)，结合掩码双锚点监督 (masked dual-anchor supervision) 与跨锚点去噪输出一致性 (cross-anchor denoising-output consistency)；在 affine Gaussian surrogate 下证明合适的一致性正则在固定噪声水平能恢复 clean-reference 最优解。
Result: 在 Cosmos-Drive-Dreams 与 nuScenes 上生成高质量、多视一致的自动驾驶视频；nuScenes 上 SymRegFlow 取得所评基线中最低的 FVD 与 FVMD，FVD 相对最优基线降低超过 31%，源条件推理取得最佳 FID 与实例保持；理论上严格优于单锚点与合并锚点基线。
Conclusion: 无需真值新视角 RGB 监督，靠几何 warp 锚点加一致性正则即可在连续视角上恢复干净参考最优并超过单锚点/合并锚点方案，实现多视一致的驾驶视频生成。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Structural-Functional Brain Connectivity Generation via Multimodal Hypergraph-based Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Structural connectivity (SC) and functional connectivity (FC) provide complementary information on interactions between brain regions and are widely used in neuroimaging studies of neuropsychiatric disorders. Generative modelling can alleviate the scarcity of large-scale paired SC-FC data, but existing approaches typically use pairwise graphs that capture only dyadic interactions and often generate SC and FC independently, limiting preservation of higher-order structure-function relationships. We propose a Multimodal Hypergraph Flow Matching (MHG-FM) framework for joint SC-FC connectivity generation and cross-modal translation. MHG-FM constructs modality-specific hypergraphs, learns higher-order representations with Hypergraph Neural Network (HGNN) encoders, and performs bidirectional cross-modal fusion using Dual Cross-Attention (DCA). A variational autoencoder maps the fused representations to a compact latent space, where conditional flow matching enables connectivity synthesis and multimodal translation via latent transport. Experiments on the Human Connectome Project Young Adult (HCP-YA) dataset show that MHG-FM outperforms several state-of-the-art baselines in reconstruction quality, topology preservation, distributional similarity, and SC-FC coupling, while achieving approximately 8x faster sampling than a matched diffusion backbone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出多模态超图流匹配 (MHG-FM) 联合生成脑结构连接 (SC) 与功能连接 (FC) 并做跨模态翻译：用超图神经网络编码高阶结构-功能关系，Dual Cross-Attention 双向融合，再在 VAE 潜空间中用条件流匹配做潜变量传输。在 HCP-YA 上重建质量、拓扑保持、分布相似度和 SC-FC 耦合均优于若干 SOTA 基线，采样比匹配的 diffusion 骨干快约 8 倍。
Motivation: 大规模配对 SC-FC 数据稀缺，而现有生成方法只用成对图、且 SC 与 FC 分开生成，无法保留高阶结构-功能关系。
Method: MHG-FM 先为每种模态构造 modality-specific hypergraph，用 Hypergraph Neural Network (HGNN) 编码器学习高阶表示，再用 Dual Cross-Attention (DCA) 做双向跨模态融合；融合表示经 VAE 映射到紧凑潜空间，在其中用 conditional flow matching 通过 latent transport 实现连接合成与多模态翻译。

papers.title: Revisiting Visual Representation Enhancement of VLMs via Kernel Canonical Correlation Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models such as CLIP exhibit strong semantic generalization, but remain limited in fine-grained visual perception. A recent work named KUEA presents a natural remedy by finetuning the image encoder under the supervision of the vision-centric DINOv2 to align their kernel matrices element-wisely, while regularizing the embeddings to remain close to the pretrained visual encoder for preserving image-text semantics in CLIP. However, we show that diminishing the role of the alignment loss to DINOv2 does not necessarily degrade its fine-grained visual performance, suggesting that the kernel-matrix discrepancy may be insufficient for further visual representation enhancement, motivating us to revisit the alignment formulation. In this work, we present a novel perspective to characterize representation alignment on feature subspaces through Kernel Canonical Correlation Analysis (KCCA), which maximizes the projection correlations. In optimization, we derive an efficient end-to-end training scheme upon KKT conditions, avoiding the eigenvalue problem in KCCA. Further, we extend our method into a 3-view formulation, i.e., 3vKCCA, in which the projections from the pretrained text encoder are also incorporated under a unified optimization framework for joint alignment. With CLIP ViT-L/14 on ImageNet-1K, our 3vKCCA improves the MMVP-VLM accuracy from 17.8 to 25.9, substantially outperforming the existing methods, and meanwhile maintains zero-shot image--text retrieval performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 指出 KUEA 逐元素对齐 CLIP 与 DINOv2 核矩阵的监督其实不是细粒度视觉提升的来源：削弱该对齐损失并不必然降低细粒度性能。改用核典型相关分析 (KCCA) 在特征子空间上最大化投影相关，并由 KKT 条件推出免特征值分解的端到端训练，再扩展为含预训练文本编码器投影的 3vKCCA 联合对齐。CLIP ViT-L/14 在 ImageNet-1K 上，MMVP-VLM 准确率从 17.8 提到 25.9，同时保持零样本图文检索性能。
Motivation: KUEA 用 DINOv2 监督微调图像编码器以对齐核矩阵，但核矩阵差异不足以刻画表征增强，对齐目标本身需要重新表述。
Method: 用 KCCA 刻画特征子空间上的表征对齐，最大化投影相关；在优化中基于 KKT 条件推导高效端到端训练方案，避开 KCCA 的特征值问题；再扩展为 3vKCCA，把预训练文本编码器的投影纳入统一优化框架做联合对齐。
Result: CLIP ViT-L/14 在 ImageNet-1K 上，3vKCCA 将 MMVP-VLM 准确率从 17.8 提升到 25.9，显著超过现有方法，同时维持零样本图文检索性能。
Conclusion: 核矩阵差异不足以支撑进一步的视觉表征增强，改在子空间上最大化投影相关并联合文本投影，可在提升细粒度视觉感知的同时保住 CLIP 的图文语义。

papers.title: Differential Privacy of Gradient Descent on Perturbed Objectives
papers.abstract_en: Objective perturbation adds a random linear term to a regularized empirical risk and releases the exact perturbed minimizer. We study the finite computation obtained by releasing the $N$-th iterate of deterministic gradient descent on $w\mapsto F(w;S)+\langle z,w\rangle$, where $z\sim\mathcal N(0,σ^2I_d)$ is drawn once before optimization. For strongly convex and smooth objectives with Lipschitz Hessian, we prove an explicit condition under which the map $z\mapsto w_N$ is a $C^1$-diffeomorphism on the bounded domains used in the privacy argument, with a quantitative lower bound on the smallest singular value of its Jacobian. This permits a direct change-of-variables analysis of the finite iterate. For generalized linear models, the resulting privacy-profile bound has no explicit ambient-dimension factor once the iteration condition holds, and its finite-iteration correction decreases geometrically. By letting the free truncation parameter grow slowly with $N$, we recover the corresponding exact-minimizer certificate in the limit. We also bound the expected excess empirical risk by $dσ^2/(2μ)$ plus a geometrically decreasing optimization term, and transfer the result to population risk without an additional multiplicative condition-number factor in the leading statistical terms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究目标扰动 (objective perturbation) 下确定性梯度下降第 N 次迭代的差分隐私：对强凸光滑且 Hessian Lipschitz 的目标，证明 z↦w_N 在隐私论证所用有界域上是 C1 微分同胚并给出 Jacobian 最小奇异值下界，从而可直接做变量替换分析。广义线性模型下隐私剖面界在迭代条件成立时不含显式环境维数因子，有限迭代修正按几何速度衰减；期望超额经验风险为 dσ²/(2μ) 加几何衰减的优化项。
Motivation: 目标扰动通常释放精确的扰动极小化点，而实际只跑有限步梯度下降；有限迭代映射未必可逆，标准变量替换的隐私论证失效，且常引入环境维数因子。
Method: 在 w↦F(w;S)+⟨z,w⟩ 上对一次性抽取的 z∼N(0,σ²I_d) 跑确定性梯度下降并释放第 N 次迭代 w_N；对强凸、光滑且 Hessian Lipschitz 的目标证明 z↦w_N 在有界域上为 C1 微分同胚并给出 Jacobian 最小奇异值的量化下界，据此做直接变量替换分析；让自由截断参数随 N 缓慢增长以逼近精确极小化点证书。
Result: 广义线性模型的隐私剖面界在迭代条件成立后不含显式环境维数因子，有限迭代修正按几何速度下降；期望超额经验风险上界为 dσ²/(2μ) 加几何衰减的优化项，且转移到 population risk 时主导统计项不额外乘条件数因子。
Conclusion: 只要迭代步数条件满足，有限步梯度下降的目标扰动可继承精确极小化点的隐私证书，且统计项不付出额外维数或条件数代价。

papers.title: Ego2World: Compiling Egocentric Cooking Videos into Executable Worlds for Belief-State Planning
papers.abstract_en: Egocentric videos capture how people carry out everyday activities, yet testing an agent requires evaluating the consequences of actions it chooses itself. We introduce Ego2World, a benchmark that turns annotated cooking activities into executable planning environments under partial observation. Its compiler links source steps and objects to symbolic action rules, persistent world states, and explicit task conditions, so researchers can execute an agent's proposed actions and check their outcomes. World state and agent belief are maintained separately, enabling controlled studies of planning and information reuse across continuing tasks. Evaluating six planners on 105 tasks shows that accepted operations often leave task goals unmet. Execution traces and condition checks distinguish interrupted runs, partial attainment, and completed execution without goal attainment. In a separate paired Qwen-Plus study, persistent belief improves action validity by 4.15 percentage points and reduces visual-query attempts by 90.27%, with higher token use and no detected completion gain. Ego2World provides a reusable testbed for tracing how planning and memory choices affect execution, observation demand, and task attainment, connecting recorded human activity to the development and evaluation of interactive agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Ego2World 把标注过的第一人称烹饪视频编译成部分可观测的可执行规划环境，用编译器把源步骤与物体绑定到符号动作规则、持久世界状态和显式任务条件，从而真正执行智能体提出的动作并核对结果。六个规划器在 105 个任务上，动作被接受却未达成目标的情况常见；配对 Qwen-Plus 实验中持久信念 (persistent belief) 使动作有效率提高 4.15 个百分点、视觉查询次数下降 90.27%，但 token 消耗更高且未检测到完成率提升。
Motivation: 第一人称视频只记录人做了什么，无法检验智能体自己选的动作会产生什么后果；缺少可执行环境，规划与记忆策略对执行、观测需求和任务达成的影响难以受控研究。
Method: 编译器把标注的烹饪活动链接到符号动作规则、持久世界状态与显式任务条件，世界状态与智能体信念分开维护；在该测试床上评测六个规划器，并另做配对 Qwen-Plus 实验比较有无持久信念。
Result: 六个规划器在 105 个任务上评测，被接受的操作常使目标仍未达成，执行轨迹与条件检查可区分中断、部分达成与执行完成但目标未达成；配对 Qwen-Plus 实验中持久信念使动作有效性提高 4.15 个百分点、视觉查询尝试减少 90.27%，token 使用更高，完成率无检测到的提升。
Conclusion: 持久信念以更高 token 成本换取更有效的动作和大幅更少的视觉查询，但不带来完成率提升；接受动作不等于达成目标，需用执行轨迹与条件检查分开度量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: WakeKV: Reactive, Reversible KV Residency for Heads That Change Their Minds
papers.abstract_en: Most KV-cache compression methods classify attention heads once, either offline or during prefill, and keep this classification fixed throughout generation. Across three models (1.5B-8B) and three regimes (needle retrieval, long chain-of-thought, and multi-turn recall), we measure head behavior on four model-regime combinations and find that most heads change their reading behavior at least once during generation. We introduce WakeKV, a reactive residency policy that moves cooling heads to a recoverable CPU reservoir rather than freezing or permanently evicting their state. At matched memory or budget, WakeKV consistently improves miss rate over frozen classification and destructive eviction, evaluated across five model-regime combinations and over three cited baselines (SnapKV, uniform R-KV, and ReasonAlloc) across four eligible combinations. A FlexiCache/vLLM implementation on Mistral-7B confirms the benefit on real hardware, improving throughput while retaining LongBench quality.
papers.comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on ML for Systems. 2 figures, 4 tables, appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WakeKV 发现注意力头的读取行为在生成过程中会至少改变一次，因此不再一次性固定头分类，而是把“降温”的头移到可恢复的 CPU reservoir，按需唤醒其 KV 状态。在三个模型（1.5B–8B）与 needle retrieval、long chain-of-thought、multi-turn recall 三种设定上，匹配内存或预算时 miss rate 相对冻结分类与破坏性驱逐持续改善；Mistral-7B 上的 FlexiCache/vLLM 实现在保留 LongBench 质量的同时提升吞吐。
Motivation: 多数 KV-cache 压缩方法在离线或 prefill 阶段对注意力头做一次性分类并全程固定，但实测表明大多数头在生成中至少改变一次读取行为，固定分类与破坏性驱逐因此会误伤仍在使用的头。
Method: WakeKV 提出反应式驻留策略 (reactive residency policy)：对“降温”的头不做冻结或永久驱逐，而是把其 KV 状态移入可恢复的 CPU reservoir，随头行为变化再唤醒；并在 FlexiCache/vLLM 上实现，部署于 Mistral-7B。
Result: 在三个模型（1.5B–8B）与三种设定（needle retrieval、long chain-ofthought、multi-turn recall）上测得大多数头在生成中至少改变一次读取行为；匹配内存或预算下，WakeKV 在五个 model-regime 组合上相对冻结分类与破坏性驱逐持续改善 miss rate，并在四个可比组合上对比 SnapKV、uniform R-KV、ReasonAlloc 三个被引基线；Mistral-7B 实机实现提升吞吐且保留 LongBench 质量。
Conclusion: 头分类应当是可逆、随生成过程反应式更新的，把降温头放进可恢复的 CPU reservoir 而非冻结或驱逐，能在同内存预算下降低 miss rate 并在真实硬件上换取吞吐。

papers.title: Characterizing the Performance Gap in Human Activity Recognition for Older Adults
papers.abstract_en: Human activity recognition (HAR) from wrist-worn accelerometers is increasingly used for health and behavioral tracking. Yet, most wearable HAR models are developed and evaluated on datasets dominated by younger adults, leaving it unclear whether benchmark progress generalizes across age groups. In this work, we leverage MyMove, our carefully annotated, free-living older-adult HAR dataset (mean age 71), to evaluate deep-learning architectures and training regimes under both leave-one-subject-out and cross-dataset transfer. We find that improvements on younger-adult benchmarks fail to transfer equally to data collected from older adults, resulting in a persistent and often widening performance gap. However, richer representations, particularly frozen self-supervised features pretrained on the age-diverse UK Biobank dataset, substantially improve performance on data from older adults and consistently narrow the performance gap, at modest cost to younger-adult performance, though disparities remain. These findings suggest that benchmark gains and architectural scaling alone provide an incomplete picture of progress in wearable HAR, and broader advances may require representations that better capture population diversity, alongside personalized adaptation to individual movement patterns and routines.

papers.title: Self-Supervised Scaling of Terminal Environments for Scientific Domains
papers.abstract_en: Terminal agents are increasingly deployed beyond software engineering in science and other specialized domains. Constructing training environments requires executable reference behavior and a domain-specific verifier that distinguishes semantic correctness from superficially plausible artifacts. Authoring these components for each task requires repeated engineering and limits reuse. We introduce software-in-the-loop reconstruction, a self-supervised framework that obtains reference outputs and verification targets from existing software workflows, executable programs mapping structured inputs to outputs. For each workflow, we execute multiple input configurations and partition cases into public observations and hidden evaluations. Given the instruction, input schema, and public input--output observations, an agent constructs an editable program without access to the source workflow. The candidate is evaluated on hidden configurations against workflow outputs. A hierarchical verifier combines domain-specific semantic comparison, structural validity, and anti-shortcut checks, while public feedback supports iterative revision. The construction admits additional workflows and configurations without authoring a reference solution for each task. We instantiate SWR with 500 workflows and 46 software families across six domains. Across three attempts per task, Qwen3.8-Max solves 838 tasks and produces 1,422 verified trajectories, which we oversample to 3,000 reconstruction-only training examples. Supervised fine-tuning of Qwen3.8-27B improves mean Terminal-Bench 2 performance from 47.94% to 53.56% across three seeds and achieves the highest mean among four matched-token corpus controls on all four reported evaluations. These results indicate that existing scientific software can provide scalable, behaviorally verified supervision for terminal agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 software-in-the-loop reconstruction (SWR)：把已有科学软件工作流当作监督源，用多组输入配置切分公开观测与隐藏评测，让 agent 在看不到源码的情况下重建可编辑程序，再由分层 verifier 在隐藏配置上核验。SWR 实例化 500 个工作流、46 个软件家族、六个领域；用其生成的 3,000 条 reconstruction-only 样本微调 Qwen3.8-27B，Terminal-Bench 2 平均分从 47.94% 升到 53.56%（三个种子），并在全部四项评测上取得四个等 token 对照语料中的最高均值。
Motivation: 终端 agent 走出软件工程进入科学等领域时，训练环境需要可执行参考行为和能区分语义正确与表面像样的 verifier，逐任务人工编写这两者成本高、难以复用。
Method: SWR 对每个工作流执行多组输入配置，切成 public observations 与 hidden evaluations；agent 只拿到指令、输入 schema 和公开输入输出对，重建一个可编辑程序，在隐藏配置上与工作流输出比对。分层 verifier 结合领域语义比较、结构有效性与 anti-shortcut 检查，公开反馈支持迭代修订；新增工作流无需为每个任务另写参考解。
Result: SWR 覆盖 500 个工作流、46 个软件家族、六个领域；每题三次尝试中 Qwen3.8-Max 解出 838 题、产出 1,422 条 verified trajectories，过采样为 3,000 条 reconstruction-only 训练样本。对 Qwen3.8-27B 做监督微调，Terminal-Bench 2 平均成绩由 47.94% 提升到 53.56%（三个种子），并在四项已报告评测中的全部四项上取得四个等 token 语料对照的最高均值。
Conclusion: 现有科学软件本身可以充当可扩展、带行为验证的终端 agent 监督来源，不必逐任务人工编写参考解与 verifier。

papers.title: MuonIO: Principled Norm-Aware Descent for Embedding Tables and Language Model Heads
papers.abstract_en: The Muon optimizer derives its update rule for hidden linear layers by solving a local linearization of the loss penalized by the spectral norm, motivated by an RMS-stability argument for dense linear layers. Standard Muon implementations, however, exclude the input (embedding table) and output (language model head) layers from this principled treatment, for which they use AdamW instead. We present MuonIO, a single Muon-style update for both of these layers. For the language model head $\mathbf{L} \in \mathbb{R}^{V \times d}$, we motivate the use of the $2\to\infty$ operator norm, due to the Lipschitz continuity of the softmax output geometry, while for the embedding table $\mathbf{E} \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times V}$, we draw on the $1 \to 2$ operator norm, based on the one-hot input geometry identified by Bernstein & Newhouse (2025). The identity $\lVert\mathbf{L}\rVert_{2\to\infty}=\lVert\mathbf{L}^\top\rVert_{1\to2}$ then puts both matrices in the same vocabulary-oriented geometry: MuonIO applies a single normalized-vector rule, which appears as column normalization for $\mathbf{E}$ and row normalization for $\mathbf{L}$. Empirical evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, with MuonIO reducing I/O optimizer state memory by 50% and I/O update FLOPs by $\sim$46% compared to Muon for 1B LLaMA pretraining on C4, while also improving validation perplexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MuonIO 把标准 Muon 中被排除在外的 embedding 表与语言模型头统一到同一个 Muon 式更新：对 LM head 用 2→∞ 算子范数（源于 softmax 输出几何的 Lipschitz 连续性），对 embedding 用 1→2 范数（源于 one-hot 输入几何），恒等式 ‖L‖_{2→∞}=‖Lᵀ‖_{1→2} 使两者落入同一 vocabulary 几何，最终退化为对 E 做列归一化、对 L 做行归一化的单条归一化向量规则。在 1B LLaMA 的 C4 预训练上，相比 Muon 把 I/O 优化器状态内存降 50%、I/O 更新 FLOPs 降约 46%，同时改善验证 perplexity。
Motivation: 标准 Muon 只对隐藏线性层给出谱范数正则的原理性更新，输入 embedding 表与输出 LM head 被排除、退回 AdamW，这两层的几何与隐藏层不同，缺少对应的 principled 处理。
Method: 从 Muon 的局部线性化加谱范数惩罚与 RMS 稳定性论证出发，为 LM head L∈R^{V×d} 选 2→∞ 算子范数、为 embedding E∈R^{d×V} 选 1→2 算子范数（依据 Bernstein & Newhouse (2025) 的 one-hot 输入几何），利用 ‖L‖_{2→∞}=‖Lᵀ‖_{1→2} 把两层统一成一条归一化向量更新规则，即对 E 列归一化、对 L 行归一化。
Result: 在 1B LLaMA 的 C4 预训练上，相比 Muon，MuonIO 将 I/O 优化器状态内存减少 50%，I/O 更新 FLOPs 减少约 46%，并改善验证 perplexity。
Conclusion: embedding 表与 LM head 可以共用一条基于各自输入/输出几何的 Muon 式归一化更新，而不必退回 AdamW，同时省掉一半 I/O 优化器状态内存与约 46% 的 I/O 更新 FLOPs。

papers.title: Label-Efficient Time Series Classification at Scale: A Dual-Stream OSSE-LSTM with Counterfactual Attribution
papers.abstract_en: Time series are produced continuously at enormous scale by industrial equipment, wearables, power grids, and clinical monitors, yet annotation remains manual, expensive, and expert-dependent. The binding constraint in large-scale time series analytics is therefore not data volume but label volume, and the question facing a practitioner is concrete: how many examples per class must be labeled before a classifier becomes usable? We study this question directly, in a regime where the label space is fixed and known in advance and the decision rule must be constructed from only K labeled examples per class. We propose Dual-Stream OSSE-LSTM, an episodic metric-learning framework that pairs an Omni-Scale CNN with Squeeze-and-Excitation recalibration, for multi-scale motif extraction without per-dataset kernel tuning, with a Bidirectional LSTM for global temporal context. The two streams are independently normalized and fused into a prototype-oriented embedding. Because decisions taken from a few labels must also be explainable, we introduce Counterfactual Integrated Gradients (C-IG), which attributes the prototype margin between target and opposing classes rather than an isolated classifier logit, and reuses the resulting maps as soft masks for test-time prototype refinement without updating the encoder. On 19 univariate UCR datasets, OSSE-LSTM attains the highest average accuracy and per-dataset win count at every support size, and its accuracy remains within a 0.36-point band (96.36-96.72%) across that range. Its weakest configuration still exceeding the best result any compared baseline achieves at any K (93.99%).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对工业设备、可穿戴、电网与临床监护等场景标注昂贵的问题，提出 Dual-Stream OSSE-LSTM：以 episodic metric learning 在每类仅 K 个标签下构造分类器，OSSE-CNN（Omni-Scale CNN + Squeeze-and-Excitation）提多尺度 motif、BiLSTM 提全局时序上下文，融合为 prototype-oriented embedding。在 19 个单变量 UCR 数据集上，各 support size 均取得最高平均精度与逐数据集胜场，且精度稳定在 96.36–96.72%（0.36 个百分点带宽），最差配置仍超过所有对比基线在任意 K 下的最好结果 93.99%。
Motivation: 大规模时序分析的瓶颈不是数据量而是标注量：标注依赖人工与专家，且实践中需要知道每类标注多少例分类器才可用。
Method: Episodic metric-learning 框架：Omni-Scale CNN 叠 Squeeze-and-Excitation 重标定做多尺度 motif 提取（免逐数据集 kernel 调参），Bidirectional LSTM 提供全局时序上下文；两流独立归一化后融合为 prototype-oriented embedding。另提出 Counterfactual Integrated Gradients (C-IG)，对 target 与 opposing 类之间的 prototype margin 归因，并把归因图作为 soft mask 在测试期 refine prototype，不更新 encoder。
Result: 在 19 个单变量 UCR 数据集上，OSSE-LSTM 在每个 support size K 都取得最高平均精度与最高逐数据集胜场数；精度在该 K 范围内保持 96.36–96.72%（0.36 个百分点带宽）。其最弱配置仍高于任一对比基线在任意 K 下取得的最好结果 93.99%。
Conclusion: 少标签时序分类的精度可以对 K 相当不敏感：OSSE-LSTM 在每类极少标注下即可达到可用精度，且 C-IG 归因可在不重训 encoder 的前提下用于测试期原型修正。

papers.title: Learning to Revise Reasoning with Segment-wise On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves large language model reasoning by training students on their own rollouts with dense token-wise supervision from the teacher. However, token-wise OPD does not explicitly provide a coherent alternative reasoning step showing how the student's step could be revised to improve subsequent reasoning. Furthermore, this paradigm can become less effective when the student produces a degenerate reasoning prefix, as subsequent teacher supervision remains conditioned on that prefix and may reinforce poor reasoning patterns. In this work, we focus on learning reasoning revision with segment-wise OPD to rework intermediate reasoning steps and better support subsequent reasoning. Through controlled reasoning interventions, we find that replacing student segments with teacher redrafts improves subsequent reasoning accuracy. Therefore, we address the problem of turning teacher redrafts into explicit supervision for learning to revise reasoning. We propose Segment-wise On-Policy Distillation (Seg-OPD), which selects student segments based on an uncertainty metric and obtains corresponding teacher redrafts. Seg-OPD trains the student to prefer teacher redrafts over their paired student segments while retaining dense token-wise OPD supervision. Extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning and competitive programming tasks show that Seg-OPD-trained students achieve higher revision success rates than baselines. Seg-OPD consistently outperforms the compared state-of-the-art baselines in reasoning accuracy with an average relative improvement of 5.22% across diverse models and tasks. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Seg-OPD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Seg-OPD 把 on-policy 蒸馏从 token 级提升到推理片段级：按不确定性指标选中学生的推理片段，让教师重写 (redraft)，再训练学生偏好这些重写片段，同时保留原有 token 级稠密监督。在数学推理与竞赛编程任务上，其修订成功率高于基线，跨模型与任务的推理准确率平均相对提升 5.22%。
Motivation: token 级 OPD 只给逐 token 监督，不提供连贯的替代推理步骤；当学生给出退化推理前缀时，教师监督仍以该前缀为条件，反而可能强化不良推理模式。
Method: Seg-OPD 先用不确定性指标选中学生的推理片段，获取教师对应的 redraft；训练时让学生偏好教师 redraft 而非配对的学生片段，并保留 token 级 OPD 稠密监督；前置的受控推理干预实验用于验证替换片段能改善后续推理。
Result: 受控推理干预显示，用教师 redraft 替换学生片段能提升后续推理准确率；在数学推理与竞赛编程任务上，Seg-OPD 学生的修订成功率高于基线，跨多种模型与任务的推理准确率平均相对提升 5.22%，并持续优于所比较的 state-of-the-art 基线。
Conclusion: 把教师 redraft 转成显式修订监督，比只做 token 级 OPD 更能修复退化的中间推理步骤，从而提高后续推理准确率。

papers.title: Conditional Capacity and Routing in Mixture-of-Experts Particle Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models can increase parameter capacity without proportionally increasing active computation, but it is unclear how this trade-off behaves in particle-physics transformers. We study dense and MoE Particle Transformers on 188-class JetClass-II, varying expert count, routing capacity, top-K, and auxiliary loss. We find that, when token dropping is avoided, top-1 MoE models improve over the dense baseline at nearly unchanged nominal forward compute, while further increasing the number of stored experts produces little additional accuracy gain. Activating multiple experts per token yields additional predictive improvements at higher computational cost. Routing analyses show that expert assignments become more strongly associated with particle identity and kinematics in some configurations, but this structure does not increase monotonically with classification performance. These results highlight the need to distinguish stored parameter capacity, active computation, routing capacity, and routing organization when evaluating sparse expert models for jet classification. Code and experiment configurations are available at https://github.com/kpendiyala/MPT.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to the ML4PS 2026 workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在粒子物理的 JetClass-II 188 类喷注分类上系统比较 dense 与 MoE Particle Transformer，发现只要不发生 token dropping，top-1 MoE 在名义前向计算量几乎不变时优于 dense 基线；继续增加存储专家数带来的精度增益很小，而每 token 激活多个专家能在更高计算成本下再提升预测。路由分析显示专家分配与粒子身份、运动学的关联在部分配置下增强，但这种结构并不随分类性能单调上升。
Motivation: MoE 能在不等比例增加活跃计算的前提下扩大参数容量，但这一权衡在 particle-physics transformer 中如何表现尚不清楚，且存储容量、活跃计算、路由容量与路由组织常被混为一谈。
Method: 在 188 类 JetClass-II 上训练 dense 与 MoE Particle Transformer，系统改变专家数、路由容量 (routing capacity)、top-K 与辅助损失 (auxiliary loss)，并做路由分配与粒子身份、运动学的关联分析；代码与实验配置见 github.com/kpendiyala/MPT。
Result: 避免 token dropping 时，top-1 MoE 在名义前向计算量几乎不变下超过 dense 基线；继续增加存储专家数精度增益很小；每 token 激活多个专家 (top-K>1) 在更高计算成本下带来额外预测提升；专家分配与粒子身份、运动学的关联在部分配置下更强，但不随分类性能单调增加。
Conclusion: 评估稀疏专家模型做喷注分类时，必须把存储参数容量、活跃计算、路由容量与路由组织四个量分开讨论，单看其中任何一个都会误判 MoE 的收益。

papers.title: Learning from Evolving Errors: Adaptive Iterative Repair for On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) supplies dense token-level feedback on trajectories sampled from the student's own policy, a richer training signal than the outcome-level rewards of reinforcement learning. This feedback comes from a teacher conditioned on a full reference solution unavailable to the student. The reference solution specifies the target but not how to move from the student's current error toward it, creating a solution-conditioned shortcut risk. We introduce AIR-OPD, an adaptive iterative repair framework for on-policy distillation that provides error-to-repair supervision. Given a failed response, a guidance generator synthesizes repair guidance for the current error. The student samples an on-policy retry with this guidance. If the retry remains incorrect, the generator produces new repair guidance for the newly observed error. At each round, a fixed teacher receives the guidance as privileged context and supervises the student on an error-aligned region of its latest failed response. Outcome-aware stage weighting favors early repair stages and credits stages whose immediate retry passes verification. We train AIR-OPD on the DAPO-Math-17K dataset and evaluate on AIME24, AIME25, and HMMT25, alongside out-of-distribution tests on MMLU-Pro and GPQA. We examine two guidance sources, self-guidance from the current student policy and external guidance from a larger model. For both Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, AIR-OPD attains the best mathematical-reasoning averages, improving over the strongest baseline by up to 3.6 points, while preserving base-model performance on the out-of-distribution benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AIR-OPD 把 on-policy 蒸馏的 token 级反馈改成“错误到修复”的迭代监督：对失败回答由 guidance generator 生成修复指引，学生带着指引重采样，仍错则针对新错误再生成指引，固定 teacher 把指引当特权上下文、只在最新失败回答的错误对齐区域上监督，并用 outcome-aware stage weighting 偏重早期修复阶段。在 DAPO-Math-17K 上训练，Qwen3-4B 与 Qwen3-8B 在 AIME24、AIME25、HMMT25 的数学推理平均分比最强基线最多高 3.6 分，同时在 MMLU-Pro 与 GPQA 上保持基座性能。
Motivation: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) 的稠密 token 级反馈来自能看到完整参考解的 teacher，而学生看不到；参考解只规定目标、不说明如何从当前错误走向目标，因而存在 solution-conditioned shortcut 风险。
Method: 对每个失败回答，guidance generator 合成针对当前错误的修复指引，学生据此做一次 on-policy 重试；若仍错，再针对新观察到的错误生成新指引。每轮固定 teacher 把指引作为 privileged context，在最新失败回答的错误对齐区域上监督学生；outcome-aware stage weighting 偏重早期修复阶段，并给即时重试通过验证的阶段记分。训练数据为 DAPO-Math-17K，指引来源比较 self-guidance（当前学生策略）与 external guidance（更大模型）两种。
Result: 在 AIME24、AIME25、HMMT25 的数学推理平均分上，AIR-OPD 对 Qwen3-4B 与 Qwen3-8B 均取得最佳，比最强基线最多提高 3.6 分；在分布外的 MMLU-Pro 与 GPQA 上保持基座模型性能。
Conclusion: 把参考解条件的蒸馏信号换成按错误迭代生成的修复监督，可以在提升数学推理的同时不牺牲分布外通用能力；指引既可来自学生自身策略也可来自更大模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GeoScaffold: Learning Compact Geometric Latents via Reconstruction for Efficient Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Recent vision-and-language navigation (VLN) systems increasingly adopt streaming Video-LLM policies that map egocentric RGB observations and instructions directly to low-level actions. Yet these policies inherit weak 3D geometric priors from 2D pretraining. Existing geometry-aware extensions charge a persistent inference-time price: depth sensors, 3D encoders, or per-step perception tool calls. We propose GeoScaffold, a geometric supervision framework that pays this price once, at training time, by internalizing geometry into the policy itself. It first learns a compact depth tokenizer on depth maps from the training trajectories and freezes it. It then fine-tunes the policy with a handful of learnable geometry query tokens, training their hidden states to reconstruct navigation-critical geometry such as depth, connectivity, and traversability. This supervision turns the query states into compact geometric latents for action decoding, and through the shared weights also internalizes geometry into the backbone's own representations. Like a scaffold, the tokenizer, target generators, and reconstruction heads are discarded after training, leaving the backbone and action interface unchanged. Extensive experiments show that GeoScaffold consistently outperforms leading vision-only navigators on continuous VLN benchmarks, offering a practical paradigm for lightweight edge deployment of spatially aware embodied navigation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoScaffold 把 3D 几何监督一次性付在训练期而非推理期：先在训练轨迹深度图上学一个紧凑 depth tokenizer 并冻结，再用少量可学习 geometry query token 微调策略，让其隐状态重建深度、连通性与可通行性，训练后丢弃 tokenizer、目标生成器与重建头，只留骨干与动作接口。在连续 VLN 基准上持续优于领先的纯视觉导航器，推理期无需深度传感器、3D 编码器或逐步感知工具调用。
Motivation: 流式 Video-LLM 导航策略从 2D 预训练继承的 3D 几何先验薄弱，而现有几何增强方案要在推理期持续付出深度传感器、3D 编码器或逐步工具调用的代价。
Method: 先在训练轨迹的深度图上学习一个紧凑 depth tokenizer 并冻结；随后用少量可学习 geometry query token 微调策略，以重建深度、连通性、可通行性等导航关键几何作为监督，使 query 隐状态成为动作解码用的几何 latent，并经共享权重把几何内化进骨干表征；tokenizer、目标生成器与重建头训练后全部丢弃。
Result: 在连续 VLN 基准上持续优于领先的纯视觉导航器 (vision-only navigators)，且推理期不引入深度传感器、3D 编码器或逐步感知工具调用。
Conclusion: 几何监督可以只在训练期支付一次并内化进策略权重，从而在保持骨干与动作接口不变的前提下得到适合边缘部署的空间感知具身导航模型。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Test-time Calibration Learning for Large Language Model Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Reliable large language models (LLMs) must not only produce accurate answers but also express confidence that faithfully reflects their probability of being correct. Such calibration is essential for identifying uncertain predictions and supporting reliable decision-making in real-world deployment. Recent studies incorporate calibration learning into reinforcement learning (RL), jointly optimizing answer correctness and verbalized confidence using ground-truth correctness supervision. However, their reliance on labeled data limits their applicability in practical test-time settings, where ground-truth labels are unavailable and calibration may need to adapt to newly encountered target tasks. To address this challenge, we propose Test-Time Calibration Learning (TTCL), a label-free framework that jointly adapts reasoning accuracy and verbalized confidence directly on unlabeled target-task data. Specifically, TTCL derives self-supervision signals for both correctness and calibration from multiple model-generated responses, enabling calibration learning at test time without ground-truth labels. Theoretical analysis further establishes TTCL as a bounded surrogate for the ideal calibration objective. Extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning and factual question answering demonstrate that TTCL consistently improves both accuracy and calibration across diverse models and tasks. On base models, TTCL achieves an average relative accuracy improvement of +40.13% and an ECE reduction of +70.80% across eight benchmarks. Moreover, TTCL can further improve both accuracy and calibration for already calibrated models under domain shift, particularly when source-domain calibration transfers poorly to target tasks. In the math-to-factQA setting, TTCL achieves an average relative accuracy gain of +20.35% and reduces ECE by +53.83%. The source code is released at https://github.com/tmlr-group/TTCL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出免标签的测试时校准学习 (TTCL)，从同一提示的多条模型采样响应中同时自监督答案正确性与口头化置信度，在无 ground-truth 的目标任务上联合适配推理精度与校准。理论上 TTCL 是理想校准目标的有界代理；在八个基准上 base 模型平均相对精度提升 +40.13%、ECE 降低 +70.80%，math→factQA 域偏移下精度 +20.35%、ECE 降低 +53.83%。
Motivation: 现有把校准学习并入 RL 的做法依赖 ground-truth 正确性标签，无法用于测试时无标签、且需向新目标任务适配的部署场景。
Method: TTCL 在测试时对同一输入采样多条模型响应，从中构造正确性与校准两路自监督信号，联合优化推理准确率与 verbalized confidence，全程不用真值标签；并给出理论分析，证明 TTCL 是理想校准目标的有界代理 (bounded surrogate)。
Result: 在数学推理与事实问答共八个基准上，base 模型平均相对精度提升 +40.13%、ECE 降低 +70.80%；对已校准模型在域偏移下仍有增益，math-to-factQA 设定平均相对精度 +20.35%、ECE 降低 +53.83%。
Conclusion: 正确性与校准都能从多响应自监督中在测试时学到，因此无标签校准适配在源域校准向目标任务迁移失效时尤其有用。

summary_sections.result: 在数学推理与事实问答共八个基准上，base 模型平均相对精度提升 +40.13%、ECE 降低 +70.80%；对已校准模型在域偏移下仍有增益，math-to-factQA 设定平均相对精度 +20.35%、ECE 降低 +53.83%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 正确性与校准都能从多响应自监督中在测试时学到，因此无标签校准适配在源域校准向目标任务迁移失效时尤其有用。

papers.title: Decoupling Memory from Context: Structured Memory for Token-Efficient Test-Time Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in enterprise, scientific, and medical applications, where agents must incorporate domain-specific knowledge and adapt from experience. Context engineering offers a practical alternative to weight updates by improving model behavior through instructions, strategies, and evidence supplied at inference time. However, adapting context online typically requires a costly trial-and-error process, while queries are often processed independently, preventing useful experience from carrying forward. Memory systems address this limitation by retaining information across interactions, but approaches that continually append information to a shared context face increasing token costs, context-window limits, and performance degradation as the context expands. We introduce a unified formulation of context optimization and show that an agent memory system update can be interpreted as an optimization update procedure over the model's context. This perspective attempts to provide a principled framework for studying memory design and its efficiency. We then propose GraphMemory, a lightweight graph-based memory that accumulates, refines, organizes, and connects reusable strategies. For each query, GraphMemory retrieves only the relevant subgraph, enabling online context adaptation without exposing the model to the entire memory. Under bounded retrieval, the amount of retrieved memory remains constant as the number of processed examples grows. Experiments show that GraphMemory achieves competitive downstream performance while using approximately 81-85% fewer memory-construction tokens than our baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GraphMemory 把 LLM 的记忆系统更新统一表述为对模型 context 的优化更新，用轻量图结构积累、精炼、组织并连接可复用策略，每条 query 只检索相关子图。在有界检索下，检索到的记忆量不随处理样本数增长；实验中下游性能有竞争力，同时比基线少用约 81–85% 的记忆构建 token。
Motivation: 在线调整 context 需要反复试错且各 query 独立处理，经验无法延续；而把信息不断追加进共享 context 会带来 token 成本上升、context 窗口受限和性能随 context 扩张而退化。
Method: 先给出 context 优化的统一形式化，把记忆系统的一次更新解释为对模型 context 的一次优化更新；再提出 GraphMemory，按 query 只检索相关子图，实现不暴露全部记忆的在线 context 适应，并保证有界检索量。
Result: 下游性能与基线相当（competitive），记忆构建 token 消耗比基线少约 81–85%；在有界检索设定下，检索记忆量随处理样本数增长保持恒定。
Conclusion: 把记忆与 context 解耦、按需检索子图，可以在保持下游表现的同时把记忆构建的 token 成本压到基线的约 1/6，且成本不随交互次数累积。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Large language models exhibit unreliable updating of clinical judgment as patient evidence evolves
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly explored for clinical reasoning, but whether they appropriately revise judgments as patient evidence evolves remains unclear. We evaluated longitudinal belief updating using matched intensive-care trajectories from electronic health records. Across diverse LLMs, conditioning on a preceding judgment more often increased than reduced prediction error when estimates changed, replicated for a second endpoint. Controlled interventions revealed two failure modes. First, with preceding assessment fixed, models responded more strongly to worsening than matched improving respiratory evidence; this asymmetry persisted after headroom normalization at moderate and strong evidence levels. Second, with current evidence fixed, increasing prior risk from 10% to 90% shifted estimates by 26.2 percentage points, demonstrating causal influence of prior model beliefs. Prompting did not restore reliable updating. Evidence-Validated Longitudinal Update (EVLU) identified fewer, more reliable revisions, revealing a reliability-coverage trade-off. These findings establish longitudinal belief updating as a distinct dimension of LLM reliability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 ICU 电子病历配对轨迹评测 LLM 随患者证据演化的纵向信念更新，发现条件在前一次判断上通常增大而非减小预测误差，且模型对恶化的呼吸证据反应强于同等改善的证据；把先验风险从 10% 提到 90% 会让估计偏移 26.2 个百分点，提示词无法修复。EVLU 只保留更少但更可靠的修订，呈现可靠性-覆盖率权衡。
Motivation: LLM 用于临床推理时，随新证据修正判断的能力尚不清楚；若更新不可靠，纵向临床决策会系统性地被先验信念和证据方向的不对称所左右。
Method: 在 ICU 电子病历的配对纵向轨迹上评测多种 LLM 的信念更新，用受控干预分离两个失败模式：固定前次评估只改变当前呼吸证据的恶化/改善方向，并做 headroom 归一化；固定当前证据只改变先验风险水平；另测试提示词干预与 Evidence-Validated Longitudinal Update (EVLU)。
Result: 条件在前次判断上，估计变化时预测误差增加的情形多于减少，并在第二个终点上复现；固定前次评估时，对恶化证据的反应强于匹配的改善证据，且在中等与强证据水平经 headroom 归一化后仍存在；固定当前证据时，先验风险从 10% 升到 90% 使估计偏移 26.2 个百分点；提示词未能恢复可靠更新；EVLU 选出更少但更可靠的修订，呈现可靠性-覆盖率权衡。
Conclusion: 纵向信念更新是 LLM 可靠性的一个独立维度，先验信念与证据方向的不对称会造成因果性偏移，需要像 EVLU 这样以牺牲覆盖率为代价换取更新可靠性。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: RAOA: Alternating-Operator Neural Computation with Programmable Radio Propagation
papers.abstract_en: Can programmable radio propagation serve as computational depth rather than only as a communication channel or one-shot analog transform? We introduce the Radio Alternating Operator Ansatz (RAOA), a recurrent computing architecture that alternates an energy-derived problem update with a mixing update over a persistent latent state. Recomputing the problem field after each mix makes repeated passes compositional even when the same learned controls are reused across depth. We evaluate this idea through exact discrete optimization, constrained programmable-propagation simulation, and pretrained-model adaptation. On discrete objectives, repeated execution can improve solution quality without increasing the learned-control count, and the same formulation handles higher-order interactions directly. A passive phase-only free-space model further shows that the required operators can be approximated by programmable propagation while retaining useful downstream behavior despite realization error. When inserted as a zero-initialized residual adapter, RAOA adapts pretrained language models with WikiText performance close to a matched shallow MLP across three model families, while reasoning-task transfer remains model-dependent. Together, these results connect alternating-operator computation, programmable radio propagation, and neural adaptation within one recurrent framework. The RF realization evidence is simulation-based rather than a hardware demonstration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RAOA 把可编程无线电传播当作计算深度而非通信信道，用「能量导出的问题更新 + 混合更新」交替作用于持久隐状态，使复用同一组学习控制的多次迭代仍具组合性。在离散优化上重复执行可在不增加学习控制数的前提下提升解质量；作为零初始化残差适配器插入时，WikiText 表现接近同规模浅层 MLP，但推理任务迁移随模型而异。
Motivation: 可编程传播通常只被当作一次性模拟变换或通信链路，缺少让同一组学习控制在多次迭代中累积计算深度的机制。
Method: RAOA 为循环架构：每轮先按能量导出的问题更新重算问题场，再做混合更新，二者交替作用于持久隐状态；评估走三条路径——精确离散优化、含约束的可编程传播仿真（被动相位-only 自由空间模型）、以及作为零初始化残差适配器对预训练语言模型的适配。
Result: 离散目标上重复执行在不增加学习控制数时提升解质量，同一形式化可直接处理高阶交互；相位-only 自由空间仿真显示所需算子可被可编程传播近似且在实现误差下保留有用的下游行为；零初始化残差适配器在三个模型族上使 WikiText 表现接近匹配的浅层 MLP，推理任务迁移则依模型而定。
Conclusion: 交替算子计算、可编程无线电传播与神经适配可在同一循环框架内统一；RF 实现证据来自仿真而非硬件演示，推理迁移不具模型无关性。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: DataWeave: Deploying Human-LLM Analytics for Exploratory Structured Data Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Data journalism, the practice of using data analysis to surface newsworthy stories, depends increasingly on the ability of reporters and investigative journalists to uncover trends, disparities, and accountability narratives. In practice, exploring large structured datasets remains slow and brittle: journalists must navigate hundreds of variables across many datasets over years, understand data coding conventions, and write non-trivial analysis code while hypotheses evolve. Although LLMs are often touted as "ask in English, get SQL/answers," real newsroom workflows expose recurring failures, e.g., schema mismatches and drift, misread domain semantics and units, and silent assumptions. We present DataWeave, a system that addresses these needs by combining conversational interaction, schema grounding, analytical planning, and executable query generation to support exploratory analysis over structured data. Rather than treating LLMs as autonomous answer engines, DataWeave frames them as interactive partners whose outputs can be inspected, corrected, and steered as hypotheses shift. We present a case study with professional journalists using our system to analyze the U.S. Department of Education's Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS), a high-stakes public dataset with substantial domain semantics and frequent schema updates. We also report how deployment experience and iterative refinement shaped the current DataWeave architecture and its analytical workflow. Our findings distill design principles and deployment lessons for trustworthy human-LLM collaboration in structured data analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DataWeave 把 LLM 定位为可被检查、纠正和转向的交互伙伴，而非自主答题引擎，通过对话交互、schema grounding、分析规划与可执行查询生成支撑结构化数据的探索式分析。在专业记者用美国教育部 IPEDS 数据集的案例研究中，系统暴露并应对 schema 漂移、领域语义与单位误读、静默假设等新闻室常见失败，最终沉淀出可信人机协作的设计原则与部署经验。
Motivation: 记者要在数百变量、多数据集、跨年份的数据上随假设演化持续探索，还要理解编码规范并写分析代码；现有 LLM 的“英文问、SQL 答”在真实新闻室反复因 schema 不匹配与漂移、语义单位误读、静默假设而失败。
Method: 组合对话交互、schema grounding、分析规划 (analytical planning) 与可执行查询生成，支持对结构化数据的探索式分析；把 LLM 输出设计为可检查、可纠正、可随假设转向的交互对象，并通过部署迭代反塑系统架构与分析工作流。
Result: 以专业记者分析美国教育部 IPEDS 这一高风险、语义复杂且频繁更新的公共数据集为案例研究，报告部署经验与迭代改进如何塑造当前架构；摘要给出的是定性发现与设计原则，无定量指标。
Conclusion: 可信的人机结构化数据分析应把 LLM 当作可审查的协作伙伴而非自动答案机，其架构需由真实新闻室部署与迭代打磨而成。

papers.title: Spend Teacher Tokens Where They Matter: Success-Referenced On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) combines student-generated rollouts with dense token-level supervision from a teacher, but providing such supervision for every rollout requires substantial teacher computation. We introduce Success-Referenced On-Policy Distillation (SR-OPD), which reduces this cost by selecting which prompts and rollouts receive teacher supervision. When the student produces both successful and failed rollouts for the same prompt, a successful rollout can serve as a natural reference for selecting failed rollouts. SR-OPD therefore focuses on such prompts and prioritizes failed rollouts whose hidden-state trajectories show sustained divergence from a successful reference, while accounting for estimated teacher-input cost. Across three teacher-student pairs and six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, SR-OPD uses only 3.46-5.02% of the teacher-input tokens required by Vanilla OPD in the one-pass setting while maintaining comparable reasoning performance. Under a controlled setting matched to 5% of Vanilla OPD's teacher-input budget, further experiments support both key design choices: focusing supervision on prompts with both successful and failed rollouts, and using successful rollouts to guide failure selection. These results indicate that a student's own successful behavior can serve as a useful reference for allocating teacher supervision under a fixed teacher-input budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SR-OPD 在 on-policy distillation 中按“同一 prompt 下成功 rollout 作为参考”来挑选需要教师监督的样本：只对同时产生成功与失败 rollout 的 prompt 施加监督，并优先选隐藏状态轨迹相对成功参考持续发散的失败 rollout，同时计入估计的教师输入成本。在三组师生对、六个数学推理基准上，只用 Vanilla OPD 教师输入 token 的 3.46–5.02%（单遍设置）即保持可比的推理性能。
Motivation: On-policy distillation 要对每条 rollout 都给 token 级教师监督，教师计算开销大；固定教师输入预算下，该把监督花在哪条 rollout 上缺少依据。
Method: SR-OPD 先筛出同一 prompt 下既有成功又有失败 rollout 的样本，以成功 rollout 为参考，按失败 rollout 隐藏状态轨迹相对参考的持续发散程度排序，再结合估计的教师输入成本分配监督预算；在受控的 5% Vanilla OPD 教师输入预算下分别检验“聚焦双结果 prompt”和“用成功 rollout 指导失败选择”两个设计选择。
Result: 在三组 teacher-student 对、六个数学推理基准上，单遍设置下 SR-OPD 仅用 Vanilla OPD 所需教师输入 token 的 3.46–5.02%，同时保持可比的推理性能；在匹配 Vanilla OPD 教师输入预算 5% 的受控设置下，追加实验支持聚焦双结果 prompt 与用成功 rollout 指导失败选择这两个设计选择。

papers.title: One Photon, Many Worlds: Posteriors and Predictions with Single-Photon Cameras
papers.abstract_en: Single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD) cameras operate fundamentally differently from conventional cameras due to their photon-counting nature. Each frame produces a binary image: pixels report zero if no photons arrived during exposure, and one if one or more photons arrived. Reconstructing a scene or inferring its properties from a single binary frame is difficult because many different images could produce the same measurement; thus, the inverse problem is fundamentally one-to-many. As we gather more binary measurements, the inherent uncertainty associated with the inverse problem and any associated inference diminishes. With sufficient photon counts, photon noise becomes negligible relative to the signal mean, enabling near-deterministic scene recovery and inference. This work characterizes the transition from stochastic to near-deterministic scene understanding as photon budget increases, analyzing how the stochasticity in photon arrival affects downstream inference tasks. Technically, we develop a conditional generative framework based on a Hypergeometric frame-thinning process for accumulated binary SPAD measurements. Generative models capture the one-to-many nature of photon-starved inverse problems, enabling empirical characterization of how this ambiguity diminishes with increasing measurements and its impact on downstream tasks like character recognition, QR code decoding, and facial analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 单光子雪崩二极管 (SPAD) 相机每帧只输出二值图（0=无光子、1=有光子），单帧反演本质上一对多。作者提出基于超几何帧稀疏化 (Hypergeometric frame-thinning) 的条件生成框架，刻画光子预算增加时随机性向近确定性恢复的转变，并检验其对字符识别、QR 解码、人脸分析等下游推断的影响。
Motivation: 光子匮乏下 SPAD 单帧测量一对多，反演不确定性大；需要刻画这种随机性如何随光子计数增加而消退，以及它对下游推断任务的实际影响。
Method: 针对累积的二值 SPAD 测量，构建以超几何帧稀疏化过程为条件的条件生成框架 (conditional generative framework)，用生成模型表达一对多的逆问题，并随测量数增加经验刻画歧义衰减及其对下游任务的作用。
Result: 给出从随机到近确定性场景理解随光子预算增加的转变刻画：光子计数足够时光子噪声相对信号均值可忽略，恢复与推断趋于近确定；在字符识别、QR 码解码、人脸分析上经验刻画歧义随测量数增加而减小。
Conclusion: 光子匮乏 SPAD 逆问题的不确定性由光子预算决定，生成模型可把一对多歧义显式表示出来并随测量累积收敛到近确定性推断。

papers.title: LEAP: Learning Efficient Action Proposals For LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are known to be slow in rollouts. An agent completes a task one step at a time. At each step, it reasons and then chooses an action to execute. The next step and action cannot start until the previous one has finished. Speculative decoding accelerates the rollouts at the reason phase by drafting and verifying the inference tokens. Recent works have also started to apply similar ideas at the action phase. These works use off-the-shelf models, usually large, to draft action proposals for target model to verify. Large drafters match the target more often but take longer to propose, while small off-the-shelf models are fast but rarely make the same decision as the target. We ask a more general question: what determines the end-to-end speedup of action speculation? To answer it, we develop a latency framework for the speculative round. The framework compares what a round gains with what it costs. The gain depends on how well the drafter predicts the target and on how many steps the task can take before it ends. The cost comes from drafting, from waiting for target verification and from executing tools. Guided by the framework, we introduce LEAP (Learning Efficient Action Proposals) which keeps the drafter small and makes it accurate by training it on the target actions sequences. With a small 0.6B model, LEAP agrees with the target on most decisions and makes agents up to 60% faster in end-to-end wall clock time, with no systematic change in task success. Across various datasets, target models and draft models, the framework accounts for most of the measured speedups. We also show the draft model can be online trained with no prior trace collection and match the performance of offline training, making LEAP practical to deploy in the real world.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LEAP 用一个延迟框架刻画 LLM agent 动作阶段推测执行的端到端收益与代价，据此把 drafter 保持在 0.6B 小模型、只在目标模型的动作序列上训练，使 agent 端到端墙钟时间最多加快 60%，任务成功率无系统性变化。
Motivation: LLM agent 逐步推理再执行动作，串行 rollout 很慢；现有动作推测工作直接拿现成大模型当 drafter，命中率高但提议慢，小模型快却很少与目标模型决策一致，端到端加速由什么决定并不清楚。
Method: 先为一个推测轮建立延迟框架，把收益（drafter 对目标的预测准确度、任务在结束前可走的步数）与代价（起草、等待目标验证、工具执行）对比；再据此训练 LEAP：保留小 drafter，用目标模型的动作序列监督它，并支持无需预先收集 trace 的在线训练。
Result: 0.6B drafter 在多数决策上与目标模型一致，agent 端到端墙钟时间最多快 60%，任务成功率无系统性变化；在多种数据集、目标模型与 drafter 组合上，该框架能解释实测加速的大部分；在线训练不逊于离线训练。
Conclusion: 动作推测的端到端加速由命中率、任务剩余步数与起草/验证/工具代价共同决定，因此小而准、在目标动作序列上训练的 drafter 比现成大 drafter 更划算，且可在线训练直接部署。

papers.title: CHASE-VLA: Post-Training Quantization Framework for Vision-Language-Action Models with Chunk-Aware Scale Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map visual observations and language instructions to continuous robot actions, but a diffusion-based action expert (AE) poses a key challenge for low-bit post-training quantization (PTQ). The AE is repeatedly invoked across denoising steps and policy queries, where fixed calibration scales can be mismatched with activation ranges that vary with denoising progress and intended motion. We propose CHASE-VLA, a chunk-aware PTQ method that exploits a VLA-specific signal readily available from the policy: the generated action chunk, including its unexecuted future suffix. Rather than relying only on static scale matching for AE layers, CHASE-VLA combines the previously generated chunk as causal action context with denoising step group information to adapt AE activation scales. This enables W4A4 quantization of both MLP and attention projections in the repeated AE without modifying the pretrained policy. On LIBERO, CHASE-VLA achieves 97.3% average success rate on $π_{0.5}$ when both MLP and attention projections in the AE are quantized to W4A4, restoring FP16-level performance. CHASE-VLA also reduces the weight storage of the quantized AE linear layers by 73.4% and their single-chunk memory traffic by 70.9% and 71.2% on $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.6, respectively, with a predictor overhead of at most 1.26% of the saved storage.
papers.comment: Accepted at ACCV 2026. 22 pages, including references and supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CHASE-VLA 针对扩散式 action expert 在低比特后训练量化 (PTQ) 中校准尺度与去噪进度不匹配的问题，用策略已生成的 action chunk（含未执行后缀）作为因果动作上下文，配合去噪步分组信息动态调整 AE 激活尺度，实现 MLP 与 attention 投影的 W4A4 量化且不改动预训练策略。在 LIBERO 上 π0.5 平均成功率 97.3%，达到 FP16 水平。
Motivation: 扩散式 action expert 在去噪步与策略查询中被反复调用，激活范围随去噪进度和目标动作变化，固定校准尺度失配，导致低比特 PTQ 困难。
Method: CHASE-VLA 利用策略侧现成的生成 action chunk（含未执行未来后缀）作为因果动作上下文，结合去噪步分组信息自适应调整 AE 激活尺度，对 AE 的 MLP 与 attention 投影做 W4A4 量化，不修改预训练策略。
Result: 在 LIBERO 上，π0.5 的 AE 中 MLP 与 attention 投影均量化到 W4A4 时平均成功率 97.3%，恢复 FP16 水平；量化 AE 线性层权重存储减少 73.4%，单 chunk 内存流量在 π0.5 与 GR00T N1.6 上分别减少 70.9% 与 71.2%，预测器开销至多为所省存储的 1.26%。
Conclusion: 利用 action chunk 与去噪步分组这类 VLA 特有信号来定标，可在不改预训练策略的前提下把扩散式 AE 压到 W4A4 并保住 FP16 级成功率，同时大幅降低存储与内存流量。

papers.title: Large Language Continuous Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Despite the success of discrete diffusion language models (dLMs) for fast parallel decoding, their non-smooth, high-dimensional space hinders trajectory steering for reasoning and inference acceleration. To overcome this, we present Sigma, the first large-scale (3B/8B) continuous dLM built on steerable, low-dimensional ODE/SDE latent trajectories. Trained blockwise via likelihood optimization, Sigma jointly denoises Gaussian-corrupted token embeddings while learning an optimal embedding geometry. To accelerate training, Sigma leverages pre-trained weights from autoregressive (AR) models for warm-starting. During inference, we identify classifier-free guidance and score temperature as essential for high-fidelity reasoning and coding. Across comprehensive math reasoning and coding evaluations against state-of-the-art discrete counterparts (masked dLMs and AR baselines), Sigma achieves competitive performance with discrete models on standard benchmarks (e.g., GSM8K, Minerva, HumanEval, MBPP) after pre-training and on challenging reasoning tasks (e.g., MATH-500, AIME) after supervised fine-tuning. Beyond performance parity, we uncover key structural properties unique to continuous dLMs: (i) embedding-space steering effectively governs the quality-diversity trade-off, yielding strong pass@k performance and (ii) continuous trajectories enable graceful degradation for low NFEs and efficient distillation. These establish continuous dLMs as a promising paradigm for efficient language generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Sigma 是首个 3B/8B 规模的连续扩散语言模型 (continuous dLM)，把 token 嵌入加高斯噪声后联合去噪并学习嵌入几何，推理时走可操控的低维 ODE/SDE 轨迹。在 GSM8K、Minerva、HumanEval、MBPP 上与离散 dLM 和 AR 基线打平，SFT 后在 MATH-500、AIME 等难推理任务上同样具竞争力；嵌入空间操控可调节质量-多样性权衡并带来强 pass@k，低 NFE 下优雅退化且便于蒸馏。
Motivation: 离散扩散语言模型的非光滑高维空间难以做轨迹操控，限制了推理加速与推理 (reasoning) 调控。
Method: Sigma 用预训练 AR 模型权重热启动，按块 (blockwise) 做似然优化训练，联合去噪被高斯破坏的 token 嵌入并同时学习最优嵌入几何；推理阶段引入 classifier-free guidance 与 score temperature 控制生成。
Result: 在标准基准 GSM8K、Minerva、HumanEval、MBPP 上预训练后即与离散模型 (masked dLM 与 AR 基线) 性能相当；SFT 后在 MATH-500、AIME 等挑战性推理任务上仍具竞争力。结构性发现：嵌入空间操控主导质量-多样性权衡并带来强 pass@k，连续轨迹在低 NFE 下优雅退化且支持高效蒸馏。
Conclusion: 连续扩散语言模型凭借可操控的 ODE/SDE 轨迹，在保持与离散模型相当性能的同时提供质量-多样性调节、低 NFE 退化与蒸馏效率，是高效语言生成的有前景范式。

papers.title: A GHOST in Long-Horizon Agents: Governance Hazard from Overlooked Safety Constraints across Turns
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon agents are now playing an increasingly significant role in assisting humans with complex problem-solving. However, it is exactly their extended interaction history that introduces an underexplored execution-safety concern. Under benign interaction conditions, an agent may execute an action that violates a safety constraint specified many turns earlier. We term this failure mode Governance Hazard from Overlooked Safety Constraints across Turns (GHOST), which may cause irreversible damage. Our experiments reveal that GHOST events are not isolated cases: this failure mode, occurring precisely under benign interaction conditions, yields an occurrence rate of 11.5% on GPT-5.5. Furthermore, we theoretically show that if the residual conditional violation hazard along each safe prefix is bounded below by a non-summable sequence, the execution enters the hazard region almost surely. Leveraging this theoretical insight, we further propose STAR-Guard, a two-layer defense coupling historical semantic safety constraint restoration with pre-execution audit. STAR-Guard restores applicable safety constraints to reduce unsafe proposals, while its deterministic audit layer prevents residual violations from reaching the environment. Consistent with this two-layer design, we observe no GHOST events in our experiments under the GPT-5.5 setup.

papers.title: Generalization Properties of Score-matching Diffusion Models for Intrinsically Low-dimensional Data
papers.abstract_en: Despite the remarkable empirical success of flow-matching models, their statistical generalization guarantees remain underdeveloped. Existing analyses often impose restrictive assumptions on the estimated velocity field and yield convergence rates that fail to reflect the intrinsic low-dimensional structure common in real data, such as natural images and molecular geometries. In this work, we study the statistical generalization of flow-matching models for learning an unknown distribution $P_{\mathrm{data}}$ from finitely many samples. We derive finite-sample error bounds on the learned generative distribution, measured in the Wasserstein-$p$ distance, for all $p\geq 1$. Specifically, given $n$ i.i.d. samples from $P_{\mathrm{data}}$, we show that, for every $d>d_p^\ast(P_{\mathrm{data}})$ and appropriately chosen network architectures and hyperparameters, the learned distribution $\widehat{P}^{\mathrm{FM}}$ satisfies $ \mathbb{W}_p(\widehat{P}^{\mathrm{FM}},P_{\mathrm{data}}) \lesssim n^{-1/d}+n^{-1/(2p)}\bigl(\log(1/ξ)\bigr)^{1/(2p)}$ with probability at least $1-ξ$, where $d_p^\ast(P_{\mathrm{data}})$ denotes the Wasserstein-$p$ dimension of the target measure. Our results demonstrate that flow matching naturally adapts to the intrinsic geometry of data and mitigates the curse of dimensionality, as the convergence exponent depends on the intrinsic rather than ambient dimension. These guarantees remain meaningful in high-dimensional regimes and provide a theoretical explanation for the empirical success of flow matching on structured data distributions under substantially more relaxed assumptions than those in existing analyses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 给出 flow-matching 生成模型的有限样本泛化界：在 Wasserstein-p 距离下，n 个独立样本学到的分布满足 W_p ≲ n^{-1/d} + n^{-1/(2p)}(log(1/ξ))^{1/(2p)}，概率至少 1-ξ，且指数中的 d 可取目标测度的 Wasserstein-p 维数 d_p^*(P_data) 而非环境维数。收敛指数依赖内在维数，因此 flow matching 在结构化高维数据上自然缓解维数灾难。
Motivation: flow-matching 模型经验上成功，但统计泛化保证不成熟：已有分析对估计的速度场施加限制性假设，且收敛速率反映不出自然图像、分子几何这类数据的内在低维结构。
Method: 研究从有限 i.i.d. 样本学习未知分布 P_data 的 flow matching，对学习到的生成分布推导以 Wasserstein-p 距离（p≥1）度量的有限样本误差界；结论对任意 d > d_p^*(P_data) 成立，只需适当选择网络架构与超参数，假设比现有分析更宽松。
Result: 对任意 d > d_p^*(P_data)，以至少 1-ξ 的概率有 W_p(\hat{P}^FM, P_data) ≲ n^{-1/d} + n^{-1/(2p)}(log(1/ξ))^{1/(2p)}，对所有 p≥1 成立；收敛指数由内在维数而非环境维数决定，界在高维体制下仍有意义。
Conclusion: flow matching 自适应于数据的内在几何、缓解维数灾难，为结构化数据分布上的经验成功提供理论解释；这是理论保证而非实验结果。

papers.title: Mind the Refinement Gap: When Safe High-Level Robot Plans Produce Unsafe Executions
papers.abstract_en: Language-enabled robot systems increasingly combine semantic-graph planning with temporal-logic safety monitors. We investigate a trace-completeness assumption in these systems: whether the high-level action sequence checked by a monitor represents the navigation and implicit action effects induced during execution. We audit this assumption in RoboGuard by comparing its verdict on a surface plan with its verdict on a graph-refined trace under the same Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) specification. Our evaluation comprises 28 controlled cases spanning five action-abstraction families and 14 end-to-end cases in which SPINE [1] generates plans from natural-language instructions while RoboGuard generates scene-grounded safety specifications. In the controlled evaluation, all 12 targeted abstraction cases exhibit the predicted surface-versus-refined discrepancy while all 16 controls behave as expected, motivating graph-based trace refinement as a lightweight mitigation and a diagnostic tool for physical-AI safety monitors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RoboGuard 这类 LTL 安全监视器默认高层计划轨迹与执行轨迹一致，该假设在动作抽象下会失效：同一 LTL 规格下，表层计划的判定与图细化 (graph-refined) 后轨迹的判定出现分歧。28 个受控案例中 12 个目标抽象案例全部呈现预测的分歧、16 个对照案例全部符合预期，另有 14 个 SPINE 端到端案例；作者据此主张用基于图的轨迹细化作为轻量缓解手段与安全监视器诊断工具。
Motivation: 语义图规划加时序逻辑安全监视器的机器人系统依赖 trace-completeness 假设，即监视器检查的高层动作序列能代表执行期的导航与隐式动作效果；该假设一旦不成立，安全判定就与真实执行脱节。
Method: 在 RoboGuard 中审计该假设：对同一 LTL 规格，比较监视器对表层计划的判定与对图细化轨迹的判定。评测含 28 个受控案例（覆盖五类动作抽象族）与 14 个端到端案例，后者由 SPINE 从自然语言指令生成计划、RoboGuard 生成场景落地的安全规格。
Result: 受控评测中全部 12 个目标抽象案例都呈现预测的表层与细化轨迹判定分歧，全部 16 个对照案例行为符合预期；另有 14 个 SPINE 加 RoboGuard 的端到端案例。
Conclusion: 高层计划的监视器判定不能代表执行轨迹，基于图的轨迹细化可作为物理 AI 安全监视器的轻量缓解与诊断工具。

papers.title: AIGS: Adaptive Incremental Gating System for Online Representation Learning in Non-Stationary Data Streams
papers.abstract_en: Real-time data streams in Web of Things (WoT) and edge computing environments often evolve through latent regime changes. For online representation learning under strict computational constraints, the central problem is resolving the stability-plasticity dilemma: keeping useful historical knowledge while rapidly reacting to concept drift. Existing methods employ fixed update schedules or rolling windows. However, they suffer from parameter ossification during sudden shifts and waste computational resources when the stream remains stable. This paper proposes the Adaptive Incremental Gating System (AIGS), a lightweight closed-loop state-aware adaptation framework. AIGS introduces the Shock Ratio, an endogenous residual feedback mechanism that normalizes current reconstruction error against recent variation. This signal drives a Continuous Plasticity Controller that smoothly interpolates between learning plasticity and memory retention. By treating representation learning as a closed-loop control mechanism, AIGS avoids catastrophic forgetting and maintains a strictly linear $\mathcal{O}\left(k\cdot d\right)$ per-step complexity suitable for latency-sensitive edge devices. Experiments on real-world smart city dynamic streams-spanning traffic networks, meteorological systems, and industrial infrastructure-demonstrate distinct domain-dependent advantages. On Electricity Transformer Temperature datasets, AIGS achieves preventative early-warning lead times of 8.31 (ETTm1) and 9.88 (ETTm2) steps under gradual degradation. On Performance Measurement System traffic datasets, it shows significantly faster post-shift recovery after abrupt mutations. On the highly noisy Weather dataset, it improves anomaly recall while resisting stochastic noise overfitting. These findings establish AIGS as a practical, plug-and-play adapter for resource-constrained edge monitoring systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AIGS 用 Shock Ratio（当前重构误差对近期变异的归一化）作为内生残差反馈，驱动 Continuous Plasticity Controller 在可塑性与记忆保持之间平滑插值，把在线表征学习做成闭环控制，从而在概念漂移时避免灾难性遗忘、稳定期不浪费算力。在 ETTm1/ETTm2 上给出 8.31 与 9.88 步的渐变退化预警提前量，交通数据集上突变后恢复更快，Weather 数据集上提高异常召回并抵抗随机噪声过拟合。
Motivation: WoT 与边缘计算的数据流存在潜在机制切换，现有方法用固定更新计划或滚动窗口，在突变时参数固化、在稳定期浪费算力，无法同时满足稳定性与可塑性。
Method: 提出轻量闭环框架 AIGS：Shock Ratio 归一化当前重构误差与近期变异，作为反馈信号输入 Continuous Plasticity Controller，在学习可塑性与记忆保持之间连续插值；每步复杂度严格为 O(k·d)，面向延迟敏感的边缘设备。
Result: 在 Electricity Transformer Temperature 数据集上，渐变退化条件下给出 8.31 步（ETTm1）与 9.88 步（ETTm2）的预防性预警提前量；在 Performance Measurement System 交通数据集上，突变后恢复显著更快；在高噪声 Weather 数据集上提高异常召回并抵抗随机噪声过拟合。
Conclusion: 把在线表征学习当作闭环控制问题、用内生残差信号调度可塑性，可在资源受限边缘监控中兼顾抗灾难性遗忘与线性每步开销，且优势随领域而异。
