papers.title: SpectralCache: Accelerating Diffusion-Based World Models via Spectral Feature Caching
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based world models enable high-quality interactive environment generation but suffer from substantial inference overhead due to repeated Transformer evaluations during denoising. Existing caching methods mainly exploit temporal redundancy at the feature or token level, leaving the underlying mathematical structure of diffusion features largely unexplored. In this work, we reveal that world-model features exhibit highly stable singular subspaces across nearby denoising steps, while their singular values follow predictable evolution patterns. Building on this observation, we propose SpectralCache, a training-free spectral caching framework that reuses stable singular subspaces and estimates only low-dimensional singular values through linear extrapolation. We further exploit the spectral consistency between neighboring full-computation features to skip selected expensive backbone evaluations via singular value scaling. Extensive experiments on representative world models demonstrate that SpectralCache consistently improves inference efficiency while preserving generation quality. On HunyuanWorld-Voyager-13B, SpectralCache achieves 5.22x acceleration while maintaining a WorldScore of 65.90 for static scenes, substantially outperforming existing training-free caching methods in inference efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpectralCache 发现扩散世界模型的特征在相邻去噪步之间奇异子空间高度稳定、奇异值演化可预测，据此免训练地复用稳定子空间并用线性外推只算低维奇异值，再借奇异值缩放跳过部分骨干网络前向。在 HunyuanWorld-Voyager-13B 上静态场景 WorldScore 保持 65.90 的同时实现 5.22 倍加速，推理效率显著超过已有免训练缓存方法。
Motivation: 扩散式世界模型在去噪过程中反复调用 Transformer，推理开销巨大；现有缓存方法只利用特征或 token 级的时间冗余，未触及扩散特征本身的数学结构。
Method: SpectralCache 是免训练的谱缓存框架：复用相邻去噪步间稳定的奇异子空间，仅对低维奇异值做线性外推；再利用相邻全计算特征之间的谱一致性，通过奇异值缩放 (singular value scaling) 跳过部分昂贵的骨干网络评估。
Result: 在 HunyuanWorld-Voyager-13B 上取得 5.22 倍加速，静态场景 WorldScore 保持 65.90；在多个代表性世界模型上一致提升推理效率同时保持生成质量，推理效率大幅超过已有免训练缓存方法。
Conclusion: 扩散世界模型的去噪特征具有可复用的谱结构，按奇异子空间缓存加奇异值外推即可在不训练的前提下同时换取加速与生成质量。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.conclusion: 扩散世界模型的去噪特征具有可复用的谱结构，按奇异子空间缓存加奇异值外推即可在不训练的前提下同时换取加速与生成质量。

papers.title: Distributed Learning with Selective State Space Models: Architecture-Aware Convergence Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Modern state space models (SSMs), such as Mamba2, provide a compelling alternative to transformers by combining linear-time sequence modeling with recurrent state-space dynamics. However, the behavior of SSMs in distributed learning settings remains poorly understood. In particular, the existing standard federated learning methods are largely architecture-agnostic, and do not account for the stability, selectivity, and state-space parameterization that characterize modern selective SSMs. To address this, we derive architecture-aware gradient and smoothness bounds for single- and multi-layer selective SSMs, and convergence bounds for FedAvg and FedProx, characterizing how recurrent stability, input-dependent discretization, and state projection norms affect federated optimization. We then numerically validate the single-layer bounds on sequences generated by a teacher SSM, using a learner that follows the analyzed recurrence. We use this analysis to formulate expectations about the effects of local training and client heterogeneity, and examine these expectations by comparing nine federated learning algorithms on Mamba2 language modeling across six text domains. These experiments illustrate how SSM-specific bounds can provide a basis for interpreting the behavior of practical federated learning algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为选择性状态空间模型 (selective SSM, Mamba2) 的联邦学习推导架构感知的梯度与光滑性界，以及 FedAvg/FedProx 的收敛界，指出循环稳定性、输入依赖离散化与状态投影范数直接决定联邦优化行为。在 Mamba2 语言建模、六个文本域上比较九种联邦学习算法，验证了由界导出的关于本地训练与客户端异质性的预期。
Motivation: 现有联邦学习方法基本是架构无关的，未考虑选择性 SSM 的稳定性、选择性与状态空间参数化，导致 SSM 在分布式训练下的收敛行为缺乏理论刻画。
Method: 推导单层与多层选择性 SSM 的架构感知梯度界和光滑性界，并给出 FedAvg 与 FedProx 的收敛界，显式刻画循环稳定性、输入依赖离散化、状态投影范数的作用；再用 teacher SSM 生成序列、learner 遵循所分析递推来数值验证单层界。
Result: 在 Mamba2 语言建模上跨六个文本域比较九种联邦学习算法，检验由界导出的关于本地训练与客户端异质性的预期；单层界在 teacher SSM 生成序列上得到数值验证。
Conclusion: SSM 特有的收敛界可以作为解释实际联邦学习算法行为的依据，架构感知的稳定性与参数化项是联邦优化分析中不可省略的部分。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Context-Tower Conversion Preserves Generation While Freezing Retains Knowledge: Low-Budget AR-to-Diffusion Conversion of MoE LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Converting a pretrained autoregressive (AR) model to a diffusion language model (dLLM) enables parallel generation without pretraining a new model. Published conversion methods differ by roughly three orders of magnitude in training data and have not been compared under a common protocol. We compare two conversions of the same 30B Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) parent, holding the corpus, supervised-token budget, trainable parameter set and evaluation harness fixed, each under its own training recipe. The in-place model updates a subset of the parent's weights using denoising and representation-alignment losses; the frozen-tower model instead conditions through cross-attention on a frozen causal copy of the parent. With 1B training tokens, the frozen-tower model scores 71.60 on HumanEval pass@10 against 6.19 for the in-place model, an 11.6x improvement. At the same budget it also keeps 95% of the parent's GSM8K score and 99% of its MMLU-Pro score. A dense-parent experiment reproduces the HumanEval separation. Within the two-tower design at about 500M tokens, freezing the context tower retains substantially more MMLU-Pro performance than training it, while both give similar observed HumanEval scores. Our theoretical analysis establishes that both conversion classes contain an exact sampler for the AR parent under a hard attention mask and left-to-right commitment of one position per round. Under a shared loss, freezing removes the gradient contribution through the context states. Furthermore, evaluation protocol substantially affects a published 500B-token conversion's scores in both directions across tasks, while its AR parent's scores vary by less than three points, so comparing dLLMs needs a common protocol. These results show that, in the tested low-budget regime, the frozen-tower configuration retains substantially more of the parent's generation performance than in-place conversion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在同一 30B MoE 父模型上以固定语料、监督 token 预算与评测协议比较两类 AR→扩散语言模型 (dLLM) 转换：就地更新父权重的 in-place，与经 cross-attention 条件于冻结因果副本的 frozen-tower。1B token 预算下 frozen-tower HumanEval pass@10 达 71.60，in-place 仅 6.19（11.6 倍），并保住父模型 GSM8K 的 95%、MMLU-Pro 的 99%；低预算下应选冻结上下文塔的转换。
Motivation: 已发表的 AR→dLLM 转换方法在训练数据量上相差约三个数量级，且没有在统一协议下比较过，无法判断差异来自方法还是预算与评测口径。
Method: 固定同一 30B MoE 父模型、语料、监督 token 预算、可训练参数集与评测 harness，各用自身训练配方对比两条路线：in-place 用去噪损失与表示对齐损失更新父权重子集；frozen-tower 经 cross-attention 条件于冻结的因果父模型副本。另做 dense 父模型复现实验与约 500M token 下冻结 vs 训练上下文塔的消融，并给出理论分析：两类转换在 hard attention mask 与每轮左到右承诺一个位置下都含 AR 父模型的精确采样器，共享损失下冻结会去掉经上下文状态的梯度贡献。
Result: 1B token 下 frozen-tower HumanEval pass@10 为 71.60，in-place 为 6.19，提升 11.6 倍；同预算保留父模型 GSM8K 分数的 95%、MMLU-Pro 的 99%。dense 父模型实验复现了 HumanEval 上的分离。约 500M token 的双塔内部消融中，冻结上下文塔比训练它保留多得多的 MMLU-Pro 性能，而两者 HumanEval 观测分数相近。评测协议会双向改变某个已发表的 500B token 转换方法在不同任务上的分数，其 AR 父模型分数变动不足 3 分。
Conclusion: 在所测试的低预算区间，frozen-tower 配置比 in-place 转换保留多得多的父模型生成性能；dLLM 之间的比较必须在统一评测协议下进行。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Coherence-Driven Belief Formation and Population Dynamics of Contagion in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Models of social contagion usually assume how individuals adopt beliefs and derive population behavior from it. We instead empirically measure belief adoption in language model agents, quantifying the probability an agent adopts a claim given how many peers endorse it. We find this adoption kernel to be sigmoid, a characteristic of complex contagion, with a threshold that is sensitive to three sources: the claim's plausibility, the source's reliability, and the agent's disposition. These three dimensions are well approximated by a single effective dimension which we propose can be understood as the coherence of the incoming belief with the LLM agent's prior beliefs. Further, we observe a characteristic of complex contagion in the collective dynamics of belief adoption in a system of AI agents: further spread on clustered than random networks. These systems also exhibit a bifurcating cascade window, and self-sustaining hysteretic consensus which lead to consensus being far harder to remove than to establish.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundations of Agentic Systems Theory (FAST)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 LLM agent 群体上实测信念采纳率，发现采纳核为 sigmoid（复杂传染特征），阈值由主张可信度、来源可靠性与 agent 性格三个维度决定，且可压缩为单一“与先验信念的一致性 (coherence)”维度。群体动力学上，聚类网络比随机网络扩散更远，并出现分岔的级联窗口与自持的滞后共识，使共识一旦建立就远难移除。
Motivation: 社会传染模型通常先假设个体如何采纳信念、再推群体行为；本文反过来在语言 agent 上直接测量采纳概率，检验标准社会传染假设在 LLM 群体中是否成立。
Method: 对 LLM agent 实测“给定多少同伴背书时采纳某主张”的概率，拟合采纳核并检验其形状；把主张可信度、来源可靠性、agent 性格三维度压缩为单一 coherence 维度；再在聚类与随机网络上观察群体信念采纳动力学。
Result: 采纳核为 sigmoid，符合复杂传染；阈值对主张可信度、来源可靠性、agent 性格三者敏感，且三者可由单一 coherence 维度近似。群体层面在聚类网络上扩散比随机网络更远，并出现分岔的级联窗口与自持滞后共识。
Conclusion: LLM agent 的信念采纳呈复杂传染而非简单传染，其阈值可由与先验的 coherence 统一刻画；由此产生的滞后共识使共识远难移除而非建立。

papers.title: Equivariant Flow Matching for Electron Density Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning surrogates for density functional theory (DFT) have been increasingly used to reduce the cost of first-principles calculations. In this arena, predicting real-space electron densities offers a scalable and transferable initialization for self-consistent field (SCF) procedures. However, current methods face a clear dilemma. That is, grid-based architectures incur a high computational cost, while basis-set methods fail to capture the structural correlations inherent in the coefficient space. Here, we develop OrbFlow, an $\mathrm{SE}(3)$-equivariant generative model that predicts Gaussian-type orbital (GTO) coefficients via flow matching. OrbFlow retains the efficiency of a compact atom-centered basis while replacing pointwise regression with a learned probability path over the full coefficient space. It is trained through a two-phase trajectory curriculum that mitigates discretization drift during numerical integration. OrbFlow achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on QM9, reducing density error by 13.6% relative to the previous best model, and reduces error by 51% to 63% on every molecule of the MD benchmark relative to the strongest prior method sharing its basis. The predicted density also cuts SCF iterations by up to 68% with zero-shot transfer to unseen exchange-correlation functionals and recovers dipole and quadrupole moments to within a few percent of DFT references without any SCF calculation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OrbFlow 用 SE(3) 等变生成模型以 flow matching 预测 Gaussian-type orbital (GTO) 系数，把逐点回归换成全系数空间上的学习概率路径，并用两阶段轨迹课程抑制数值积分漂移。在 QM9 上密度误差较此前最佳模型降低 13.6%，MD benchmark 每个分子上较共享同一基组的最强前作降低 51%–63%；预测密度使 SCF 迭代次数最多减少 68%，且对未见交换关联泛函零样本迁移。
Motivation: DFT 代理模型中，网格类架构计算开销大，基组方法又抓不住系数空间的结构相关性，实空间电子密度预测缺少既高效又准确的方案。
Method: OrbFlow 是 SE(3) 等变生成模型，用 flow matching 在原子中心 GTO 基组的全系数空间上学概率路径，替代点式回归；训练采用两阶段轨迹课程 (two-phase trajectory curriculum) 以缓解数值积分中的离散化漂移。
Result: QM9 上达到 state-of-the-art，密度误差较此前最佳模型降低 13.6%；MD benchmark 上每个分子相对共享同一基组的最强前作误差降低 51%–63%。预测密度作 SCF 初始化使迭代次数最多减少 68%，对未见交换关联泛函零样本迁移；不做 SCF 即可把偶极与四极矩恢复到距 DFT 参考几个百分点以内。
Conclusion: 在紧凑原子中心基组上用生成式 flow matching 建模系数分布，可同时保住效率并拿到可跨泛函迁移的 SCF 初始化与多极矩精度。

papers.title: Capturing Dynamics: The 4D Facial Expression Intensity Dataset
papers.abstract_en: The estimation and analysis of facial expression intensity play a crucial role in affective communication and human-computer interaction. Previous research has primarily focused on detecting and estimating facial expression intensity from frame-level 2D representations. However, this limitation restricts a comprehensive understanding of real-world facial expressions, as they are inherently 3D and temporally continuous. This paper investigates the perception of facial expression intensity by introducing the 4D Facial Expression Intensity Dataset (4DFEID). We employ a parametric face model and compile a total of 2,869 mesh sequences with controlled geometric variations, generating 4D data instances with diverse peak intensities and identity attributes. Using a Likert scale, we collect more than 90,000 subjective intensity perception ratings via a crowdsourcing platform. We explore various architectures and aggregation methods to establish baselines for episode intensity estimation on the new dataset, revealing that spatial-temporal graph models consistently outperform traditional frame-aggregation methods. In contrast to existing datasets that rely on 2D static imagery, the proposed 4D-FEID dataset provides the community with a unique and vital resource for investigating the perception of facial expression intensity through the use of dynamic 3D stimuli. By offering high-fidelity, spatio-temporally coherent facial data, 4D-FEID establishes a new foundation for research into more nuanced and naturalistic expression analysis, thereby addressing a gap in the current landscape of affective computing and human-computer interaction studies. The dataset is available at link.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 4D 表情强度数据集 (4DFEID)：用参数化人脸模型生成 2,869 条受控几何变化的 mesh 序列，配众包 Likert 强度评分，建立 episode 级表情强度估计基线。时空图模型 (spatial-temporal graph model) 在该数据集上一致优于传统逐帧聚合方法。
Motivation: 现有表情强度估计多停留在帧级 2D 表示，而真实表情本身是 3D 且时间连续的，缺少可用的动态 3D 刺激数据集。
Method: 用参数化人脸模型 (parametric face model) 生成 2,869 条 mesh 序列，控制几何变化以产生不同峰值强度与身份属性；通过众包平台用 Likert 量表收集超过 90,000 条主观强度评分；探索多种架构与聚合方法，为 episode 级强度估计建立基线。
Result: 数据集含 2,869 条 mesh 序列与超过 90,000 条众包 Likert 主观强度评分；基线对比显示时空图模型在 episode 强度估计上一致优于传统逐帧聚合方法。
Conclusion: 表情强度感知需要 4D 动态 3D 刺激而非 2D 静态图像，时空图建模是该任务上更合适的基线范式。

papers.title: When Normalization Selects the Sign: Auditing Robustness Ablations in Quantum Attention
papers.abstract_en: Removing an input-scaling module changes both a classifier and the perturbations reaching its encoder. A robustness difference can therefore reflect the comparison rule as well as the module. We demonstrate this problem in a four-qubit quantum-attention detector on generated power-grid trajectories. A learned scaling module appears beneficial at a fixed physical attack budget, but matching an upper bound on perturbations at the encoder reverses the ordering. Neither comparison alone establishes a robustness benefit caused by the module. The initial test also perturbs clean examples into attacked examples while retaining their original labels; tests restricted to already attacked examples do not establish a benefit. Replacing a trained model's input scales disrupts detection. Retraining its linear classification layer restores the detection rate, but changes individual predictions, leaving the comparison descriptive rather than causal. Two further design checks explain why the input quantum Fisher information regularizer cannot train this model's query parameters, and why removing confidence bounds does not establish a larger certified radius. The evidence is limited to ten seeds, exact simulation, synthetic data, and a restricted set of attacks; classical baselines achieve better clean prediction. The practical lesson is to specify which perturbation budget is fixed, check that attacks preserve labels and interventions preserve predictions, and distinguish exploratory controls from confirmatory evidence.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在四量子比特量子注意力 (quantum attention) 检测器上演示：移除输入缩放模块会同时改变分类器与到达编码器的扰动，从而让鲁棒性排序随比较规则翻转——固定物理攻击预算时学到的缩放模块看似有益，改为在编码器处匹配扰动上界后排序反转。作者据此给出的实践结论是：必须写明固定的是哪个扰动预算，并检查攻击是否保持标签、干预是否保持预测。
Motivation: 鲁棒性消融 (robustness ablation) 的差异可能来自比较规则而非被移除的模块本身，导致对某个组件是否带来鲁棒收益的结论不可靠。
Method: 在生成的电网轨迹 (power-grid trajectories) 上用四量子比特量子注意力检测器做消融审计：分别以固定物理攻击预算和在编码器处匹配扰动上界两种比较规则对照；另做替换输入尺度后重训线性分类层的干预，以及关于输入量子 Fisher 信息正则化器与置信界的设计检查。
Result: 固定物理攻击预算时学到的缩放模块看似有益，匹配编码器处扰动上界后排序反转；把干净样本扰动成攻击样本却保留原标签的初始测试不成立，仅限已攻击样本的测试也不能确立收益；替换输入尺度破坏检测，重训线性分类层可恢复检测率但改变个体预测；量子 Fisher 信息正则化器无法训练该模型的 query 参数，去掉置信界也不构成更大 certified radius 的证据。证据限于十个随机种子、精确模拟、合成数据与受限攻击集，且经典基线的干净预测更好。
Conclusion: 鲁棒性收益必须在固定扰动预算、标签保持的攻击与预测保持的干预下才可作因果解读，否则该比较只是描述性的；应区分探索性对照与确证性证据。

papers.title: Batched Speech Decisions Without Decoding: Single-Token Supervision Lets a Frozen LLM Hear Beyond the Transcript
papers.abstract_en: Full-duplex voice agents make many small, closed decisions, which current systems answer by slow autoregressive decoding. We propose DuplexJev, which feeds ASR-encoder hidden states through a small connector into a frozen LLM and reads each question as a single-token distribution over its options. Nothing is decoded, and an 8-GPU node answers 80 decisions about eight utterances in about 0.1 s. With a last-layer connector, spoken QA stays close to reading the transcript (90% vs. 91%). DuplexJev also hears the speaker: gender and emotion accuracy both reach 90% (from 55% and 28%) with a cross-attention connector, whose spoken QA drops by only 1 point (83% to 82%). We train decisions with cross-entropy on the read-out answer token, instead of the usual transcript distillation, whose teacher never hears the voice, and keep distillation for content. Encoders and LLMs are interchangeable; we release weights, training recipe, a batched-inference pipeline for full-duplex serving and a bilingual spoken-QA set.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027. Code and weights: https://github.com/adventists-ai/duplexjev
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DuplexJev 用小 connector 把 ASR encoder 隐状态送入冻结 LLM，把全双工语音 agent 的每个小决策读成选项上的单 token 分布，完全不自回归解码：8 GPU 节点对 8 条语句的 80 个决策约 0.1 秒答完。last-layer connector 下 spoken QA 90%（读转写本 91%），cross-attention connector 让性别与情绪识别都到 90%（原 55% 与 28%），spoken QA 仅从 83% 降到 82%。
Motivation: 全双工语音 agent 需要频繁做性别、情绪、内容问答这类小的封闭决策，逐 token 自回归解码延迟高；而常规 transcript 蒸馏的 teacher 根本听不到声音，无法监督声音属性。
Method: ASR encoder 隐状态经轻量 connector（last-layer 或 cross-attention 两种）注入冻结 LLM，每个问题直接读出选项上的单 token 分布，不做解码；声音属性决策用 read-out answer token 上的交叉熵训练，内容部分仍保留 transcript 蒸馏；encoder 与 LLM 可互换。
Result: 8 GPU 节点对 8 条语句的 80 个决策约 0.1 秒完成；last-layer connector 下 spoken QA 90% 对读转写本的 91%；cross-attention connector 下性别与情绪准确率均达 90%（此前 55% 与 28%），spoken QA 由 83% 仅降至 82%。
Conclusion: 单 token 监督加 connector 可以让冻结 LLM 直接从语音读出决策而不牺牲多少问答精度，同时把说话人属性识别从 55%/28% 拉到 90%；作者据此发布权重、训练配方、全双工批量推理管线与双语 spoken-QA 集。

papers.title: Where Quantum Fourier Sampling Stops Short: A Three-Gate Audit Protocol for Delay-PUF Security Models
papers.abstract_en: Quantum Fourier sampling may help audit the spectral learnability of delay-based physical unclonable functions (PUFs). We ask whether that promise survives access matching, a strong classical comparator, and oracle synthesis. Three gates structure the evaluation. Structure: low degree is not small support at reachable challenge lengths; for 4-XOR at $n=14$, degree $\le d_f(0.1)$ admits $91\%$ of all $2^n$ characters and the median $90\%$-mass set spans a third of the spectrum. Algorithmics: constructing the phase oracle logically implies classical membership access, making Kushilevitz--Mansour the correct baseline; across 45 tasks it exhausts each finite domain, and no 4-XOR ideal-sampling case reaches $90\%$ mass within $2^n$ calls. A quantum-kernel diagnostic appears more favorable, with geometric difference rising to $2.151$ at $N=512$ challenges, but it correlates $0.991$ with $1/\sqrt{λ_{\min}(K_C)}$ for the classical Gram matrix $K_C$, and the 4-XOR label-complexity ratio does not exceed a balance-preserving permutation null ($p=0.930$). Trace-normalized geometric difference can therefore grow through classical ill-conditioning alone, without task-label alignment. Implementation: a simulator-validated fixed-point phase oracle based on the quantum Fourier transform admits an $18.9\%$ routed-depth reduction, yet the least certified precisions have estimated durations of $1.18$--$1.55\times$ the median dephasing time $T_2$ of the mapped qubits on a static backend snapshot, without hardware execution. We find no end-to-end advantage in the evaluated regime, although ideal sampling does use fewer coherent calls on the thresholded task. The contribution is the Three-Gate Quantum Audit Protocol: a reproducible procedure separating an ideal query advantage from a realizable security benefit. This is not a claim about deployed silicon and not an impossibility result.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 delay-PUF 谱可学习性的量子 Fourier 采样承诺，提出三门审计协议 (Three-Gate Quantum Audit Protocol)，在结构、算法、实现三层逐一检验其是否转化为真实安全收益。结论是在所评估范围内没有端到端优势：4-XOR 在 n=14 时低度函数仍覆盖 91% 字符，Kushilevitz–Mansour 经典基线在 45 个任务上穷尽有限域，几何差 2.151 与经典 Gram 矩阵条件数相关 0.991，固定点相位 oracle 虽省 18.9% 路由深度但估计门时长达 T2 的 1.18–1.55 倍。
Motivation: 量子 Fourier 采样被寄望于审计基于延迟的物理不可克隆函数 (delay-PUF) 的谱可学习性，但访问匹配、强经典对照与 oracle 合成这三重约束可能吞掉其查询优势，需要可复现的判别程序。
Method: 三门协议：结构门检验低度是否等于小支撑（4-XOR、n=14、阈值 d_f(0.1)）；算法门指出构造相位 oracle 即隐含经典成员访问，故以 Kushilevitz–Mansour 为正确基线，跨 45 个任务比较，并用保平衡置换零假设检验标签复杂度比；实现门用 QFT 的固定点相位 oracle 在模拟器验证并映射到静态后端快照估计门时长与 T2 比值。
Result: 4-XOR 在 n=14 时度 ≤ d_f(0.1) 覆盖全部 2^n 字符的 91%，中位 90% 质量集横跨三分之一谱；45 个任务上 Kushilevitz–Mansour 穷尽各自有限域，无 4-XOR 理想采样情形在 2^n 次调用内达到 90% 质量；量子核诊断在 N=512 挑战时几何差升至 2.151，但与 1/√λ_min(K_C) 相关 0.991，4-XOR 标签复杂度比不超过保平衡置换零假设 (p=0.930)；固定点相位 oracle 带来 18.9% 路由深度下降，但最低认证精度的估计门时长为映射比特中位退相干时间 T2 的 1.18–1.55 倍（静态后端快照，无硬件执行）。
Conclusion: 在所评估范围内没有端到端量子优势，尽管理想采样在阈值任务上确实用更少相干调用；三门协议把理想查询优势与可实现安全收益分开，作者明确这不是关于已部署芯片的论断，也不是不可能性结果。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A hybrid CNN-adjoint optimization framework for reconstruction of viscoelastic tissue properties in magnetic resonance elastography
papers.abstract_en: Magnetic resonance elastography (MRE) is a noninvasive imaging modality for quantifying the viscoelastic properties of soft tissues from shear wave propagation. Recovering the complex-valued shear modulus from measured displacement fields leads to a severely ill-posed inverse problem, particularly in the presence of noise and limited boundary excitations. We investigate adjoint-based optimization, convolutional neural network (CNN) reconstruction, and a hybrid framework combining both approaches. The forward model is based on a scalar form of the modified stationary Stokes system with a complex shear modulus. We establish well-posedness of the forward problem, existence of minimizers, and first-order optimality conditions for the adjoint-based formulation, and implement a nonlinear conjugate-gradient method with Armijo line search. While PDE-constrained optimization can accurately refine coefficient reconstructions, its performance depends strongly on initialization. We therefore construct a two-dimensional CNN that maps complex-valued displacement measurements to spatially varying complex shear modulus fields and provides rapid, informative initial reconstructions. The proposed hybrid method uses the CNN reconstruction to initialize the adjoint-based optimization, yielding faster convergence and improved accuracy. The CNN is trained on coefficient fields containing individual perturbations and tested on both individual and previously unseen combined configurations. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the CNN generalizes to these more challenging configurations, while subsequent PDE-constrained optimization further refines the reconstructed coefficient. These results demonstrate the potential of combining data-driven initialization with physics-based optimization for efficient and accurate MRE reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 MRE 复剪切模量反演这一严重不适定问题上，用二维 CNN 把复位移测量直接映射为复剪切模量场，再以其结果初始化基于伴随的 PDE 约束优化。CNN 在含单扰动的系数场上训练，能泛化到未见过的组合构型，混合框架比纯伴随优化收敛更快、精度更高。
Motivation: 从位移场反演复剪切模量是严重不适定的逆问题，噪声与有限边界激励下尤其困难；伴随优化精度高但强依赖初值，纯 CNN 反演精度有限。
Method: 前向模型为带复剪切模量的修正稳态 Stokes 标量形式；建立适定性、极小值存在性与一阶最优性条件，用非线性共轭梯度加 Armijo 线搜索求解；另训一个二维 CNN 将复位移测量映射为空间变化的复剪切模量场，作为伴随优化的初值。
Result: 数值实验显示 CNN 能泛化到训练中未见的组合构型，随后 PDE 约束优化进一步细化系数；混合方法比纯伴随优化收敛更快、精度更高，而纯 PDE 约束优化虽能准确细化系数但强依赖初值。

papers.title: Online Verification of Language Model Responses Under Cost Constraints
papers.abstract_en: As large language models are increasingly deployed for multi-step reasoning, verifying the correctness of their outputs has become essential for maintaining reliability at scale. Verifying the correctness of large language model outputs is often done by querying a costly ground-truth oracle, which is impractical to invoke at every step in an online setting. Prior work addresses this by querying a single weak verifier on every step, and using its score to decide whether the costly strong verifier needs to be queried as well, reserving strong verification for only a small fraction of the steps. However, a single fixed weak verifier may not perform consistently well as the subject matter or difficulty of incoming queries changes over time, and committing to one in advance risks either overly costly or inaccurate verification. We introduce OMVV (Online Multi-Verifier Verification), an algorithm that maintains a pool of $K$ candidate weak verifiers with differing cost and verification performance, and adaptively routes each round's decision to a verifier selected via an online score combiner and an exponential-weights routing policy. OMVV provides a distribution-free, finite-time guarantee on false-accept and false-reject rates across the full pool of verifiers, and further achieves sublinear regret against the best fixed verifier in hindsight under a combined cost and consistency objective. Experiments on reasoning dataset benchmarks show that OMVV achieves higher accuracy at lower verification cost than any single fixed verifier, across a range of operating budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 OMVV（Online Multi-Verifier Verification）：维护 K 个成本与验证性能各异的弱验证器池，用在线分数组合器加 exponential-weights 路由逐轮挑选验证器，只在必要时才调用昂贵的强 oracle。对全池给出 false-accept/false-reject 的 distribution-free 有限时保证，并在组合成本-一致性目标下对事后最优固定验证器取得次线性 regret；在推理数据集基准上，OMVV 在多种操作预算下都比任何单一固定验证器精度更高且验证成本更低。
Motivation: 多步推理中每步都调用昂贵 ground-truth oracle 不现实；而预先固定一个弱验证器会随查询主题与难度变化而失准，导致成本过高或精度不足。
Method: OMVV 维护 K 个成本与验证表现不同的候选弱验证器，每轮由在线分数组合器 (online score combiner) 与 exponential-weights 路由策略选择验证器，决定是否追加强 oracle 查询；理论部分给出全池 false-accept/false-reject 的 distribution-free 有限时保证，以及相对事后最优固定验证器在成本与一致性加权目标下的次线性 regret。
Result: 在推理数据集基准 (reasoning dataset benchmarks) 上，OMVV 在一系列操作预算下均以低于任何单一固定验证器的验证成本取得更高准确率；并给出 false-accept 与 false-reject 率的 distribution-free 有限时保证和次线性 regret 结果。
Conclusion: 在线自适应地在多个弱验证器间路由，可以在成本受限的在线验证中同时压低验证开销并提高正确性判定精度，优于事先固定单一验证器的做法。

papers.title: Designing the Future of User Feedback for Generative AI
papers.abstract_en: Post-deployment feedback from users can be a cost-effective, scalable, and representative means to monitor and improve generative AI systems and features. When implemented effectively, giving such feedback can increase users' engagement with and trust in GenAI systems. Government regulations and industry guidelines call for post-deployment user engagement, but there is little guidance on designing mechanisms that are usable for consumers and provide actionable input for product teams. We conducted a multi-phase study as a collaboration between academic researchers and eBay. Our benchmark evaluation of current industry approaches identified common issues including lack of discoverability, unclear terminology, and inattention to user value. Based on these findings, we developed best-practice recommendations and designed and tested a prototype feedback-collection tool. The tool aimed to provide users with an efficient, flexible, and positive feedback-giving experience, and provide product teams with rich data on performance and potential problems in a usable format.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文指出生成式 AI 的部署后用户反馈机制普遍难被发现、术语不清、忽视用户价值，因而既不能有效收集反馈也难给产品团队可行动的输入。作者与 eBay 合作做多阶段研究，先评测现有业界做法，再据此产出最佳实践建议并设计、测试一个原型反馈收集工具，目标是让用户高效、灵活、正向地给反馈，同时给产品团队可用格式的丰富数据。
Motivation: 政府监管与行业指南都要求部署后用户参与，但缺少面向消费者可用、且能给产品团队可行动输入的反馈机制设计指引。
Method: 学术研究者与 eBay 合作的多阶段研究：先对当前业界反馈做法做 benchmark 评测，识别共性问题，再据此制定最佳实践建议，并设计与测试一个原型反馈收集工具。
Result: benchmark 评测发现业界常见问题为可发现性缺失 (lack of discoverability)、术语不清晰 (unclear terminology)、忽视用户价值 (inattention to user value)；原型工具以高效、灵活、正向的反馈体验和可用格式的丰富数据为设计目标。
Conclusion: 生成式 AI 的用户反馈机制要同时服务消费者端的可用性和产品团队端的可行动性，按最佳实践设计的原型工具是可行路径。

papers.title: Lost in the Request: How Communication Variation Disrupts Retrieval and Action in Email Agents
papers.abstract_en: An email assistant should not complete less work simply because a user phrases the same request differently. Yet most benchmarks test each task with only one canonical request, leaving this form of robustness largely unmeasured. We test whether email assistants remain reliable when the requested information, available evidence, and expected outcome stay fixed, but the communication style or English variety changes. We construct validated variants along five communication-style axes and four rule-based dialect conditions, and evaluate them on three benchmarks: a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline and two tool-using agents. Indirect requests reduce performance on all three benchmarks, while formal requests reduce performance on both agentic benchmarks. Examining the systems more closely shows that these failures have different causes. Verbose requests mainly hurt a lexical retriever by making the relevant email harder to find. By contrast, indirect and dialect variants remain harmful even when the relevant email is retrieved. In the agentic setting, indirect and formal requests mainly cause the agents to omit required actions, not to take more unsupported actions. These results show that a successful response is not enough to establish robustness: evaluations should vary how requests are expressed and separately measure whether agents complete the requested work.
papers.comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Evaluation of Interactive Agents
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在信息、证据与预期结果固定的前提下，只改变请求的表达方式，邮件助手的可靠性就会下降：间接请求在全部三个基准上都掉分，正式请求在两个 agent 基准上掉分。冗余请求主要拖垮词法检索器，而间接与方言变体即使相关邮件已被检索到仍然有害；agent 场景下失败表现为漏做要求的动作而非多做无依据动作。作者主张评测必须改变请求表达方式，并把「是否完成所要求的工作」与「回答是否成功」分开度量。
Motivation: 现有助手基准每个任务只用一条规范请求，表达层面的鲁棒性基本未被度量，无法判断同一任务换个说法是否还能完成。
Method: 构造经验证的变体：五条 communication-style 轴向加四类基于规则的方言 (dialect) 条件，在三个基准上评测——一个 RAG pipeline 与两个 tool-using agent，并区分检索是否命中与动作是否执行。
Result: 间接请求使三个基准性能全部下降，正式请求使两个 agent 基准下降；冗余 (verbose) 请求主要伤害词法检索器，因为相关邮件更难找到；间接与方言变体在相关邮件已被检索到时仍有害；agent 场景中间接与正式请求主要导致漏掉必需动作，而非增加无依据动作。
Conclusion: 回答成功不等于鲁棒：评测必须改变请求的表达方式，并把「是否完成所要求的工作」作为独立于回答质量的度量。

papers.title: Imagine the Future, Internalize the Gist: Efficient VLA Reasoning via Internalized Spatiotemporal Imagination
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly incorporate intermediate reasoning to improve robotic manipulation, yet existing approaches primarily reason about observed states without explicitly anticipating future scene evolution. Extending such reasoning to explicit future rollouts at every inference step, however, introduces substantial computational overhead. We propose IG-VLA, a VLA reasoning framework that enables models to imagine the future and internalize the gist. Our Latent Spatiotemporal Reasoning learns to imagine task-relevant future scene evolution directly in visual representation space, guiding action prediction without costly pixel-level video generation. To further reduce inference overhead, we introduce Scene Gist Memory, which internalizes reasoning-derived scene-behavior associations into a compact Scene Gist Token, preserving the benefits of future reasoning while bypassing explicit future imagination at inference. Extensive experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and VLABench demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of IG-VLA. On the LIBERO-Plus Language suite, both the reasoning and gist policies outperform the strongest baseline by nearly 6% in success rate. The gist policy also achieves up to 6.38x speedup over baselines, reducing inference latency from 1081ms to 169.5ms per action chunk on a single NVIDIA A6000 GPU. These results demonstrate that future spatiotemporal reasoning can be effectively internalized for efficient VLA deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IG-VLA 让 VLA 模型在视觉表征空间直接想象任务相关的未来场景演化来引导动作预测，再把推理得到的场景-行为关联压缩成 Scene Gist Token，推理时跳过显式想象。在 LIBERO-Plus Language 上推理策略与 gist 策略成功率均比最强基线高近 6%，gist 策略在单张 NVIDIA A6000 上把每 action chunk 推理延迟从 1081ms 降到 169.5ms，最高 6.38x 加速。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 中间推理只针对已观测状态，不显式预判场景未来演化；而每步都做显式未来 rollout 又带来很大计算开销。
Method: IG-VLA 含两个组件：Latent Spatiotemporal Reasoning 在视觉表征空间想象任务相关未来场景演化以指导动作预测，避免像素级视频生成；Scene Gist Memory 把推理得到的场景-行为关联固化为紧凑的 Scene Gist Token，推理时绕过显式想象。
Result: 在 LIBERO-Plus Language 套件上，推理策略与 gist 策略成功率均比最强基线高近 6%；gist 策略最高 6.38x 加速，单张 NVIDIA A6000 GPU 上每 action chunk 推理延迟由 1081ms 降至 169.5ms；实验覆盖 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 与 VLABench。
Conclusion: 未来时空推理可以被有效内化，在保留未来推理收益的同时实现高效的 VLA 部署。

papers.title: CuBEs: Culturally-Situated Behavioral Evaluations and the Limitations of Culture-Blind LLM Judges
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating the occurrence and triggers of large language model (LLM) behaviors - such as sycophancy, self-preference, or over-confidence - is critical for predicting real-world model deployment risks. However, existing situated behavioral evaluations typically ignore cultural context, limiting their generalizability across an increasingly global user base. To address this gap, we propose CuBEs - Culturally-situated Behavior Evaluations that probe for response patterns across diverse user cultures. We first extend an automated testing pipeline to inject cultural context into behavioral test scenarios and subsequent evaluation. We assess the cultural adaptability of this pipeline by building a human-labeled dataset that captures nuanced dimensions of behavior understanding across 12 distinct cultures. Our dataset reveals significant cross-cultural variations that one-size-fits all judgments fail to capture. Through evaluating 13 open- and closed-source LLMs, we find that introducing cultural situatedness in the evaluation scenario creates significant variation in the presence of a behavior. For example, while our baseline experiments testing for political bias capture localized Western political dimensions like the American conservative-progressive divide, non-Western culturally situated evaluations surface entirely different axes of bias such as religious and colonial political issues. Our findings demonstrate that standard, culturally-agnostic evaluations fail to capture these shifts, highlighting the necessity of culturally situated behavioral testing for global deployments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CuBEs 把文化语境注入 LLM 行为测试场景与评判环节，并在 12 种文化上构建人工标注数据集、评测 13 个开源与闭源 LLM。结果显示引入文化情境会让同一行为的出现程度显著变化：基线政治偏误测试只捕捉美国保守—自由派轴线，非西方情境化评测则浮出宗教与殖民议题等完全不同的偏误轴。
Motivation: 现有情境化行为评测忽略文化语境，导致对 sycophancy、self-preference、over-confidence 等部署风险的判断无法推广到全球用户群。
Method: 扩展自动化测试流水线，把文化上下文注入行为测试场景及其后续评判；构建覆盖 12 种不同文化的人工标注数据集，刻画行为理解的细粒度维度；用该流水线评测 13 个开源与闭源 LLM。
Result: 数据集显示显著跨文化差异，一刀切的评判无法捕捉；在 13 个 LLM 上，加入文化情境使行为出现程度产生显著变化：基线政治偏误测试捕捉到美国保守—进步派这类西方本地化维度，非西方文化情境化评测则呈现宗教、殖民政治议题等不同偏误轴。

papers.title: WebUIProof: Benchmarking WebUI Code Generators with UI-Agent Execution Harness
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating WebUI code generation at scale is difficult: outputs may compile and look plausible yet fail under user interaction, and prior benchmarks largely rely on free-form prompts with static checks (build success, screenshots) that miss functional correctness. We introduce WebUIProof, an execution-oriented benchmark that provides structured specifications and dense, executable interaction tests for WebUI generation across two task families: general WebUIs (e.g., dashboards, game, interactive tools) and 3D interactive simulation (e.g., particle/galaxy systems, physics dynamics). WebUIProof includes a UI-agent harness that runs executable interaction tests in a headless browser using an iterative plan--act--observe loop: it locates DOM elements, performs actions, observes resulting UI/DOM changes, and checks the specified assertions. We evaluate across eight commercial LLMs and observe frequent failures on interaction-based requirements even when pages render successfully, especially on 3D simulation interfaces. Finally, we show the UI-agent harness can provide outcome-level training signals. Training compact models (e.g., Qwen2.5 14B and MIMO 7B) with RL rewards derived from executable interaction tests improves functional completion while reducing build failures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WebUIProof 是面向 WebUI 代码生成的执行型基准：给出结构化规格与可执行交互测试，用 UI-agent harness 在无头浏览器里以 plan–act–observe 循环定位 DOM、执行动作并核对断言。八个商业 LLM 即使页面渲染成功也频繁在交互需求上失败，3D 仿真界面尤甚；用可执行交互测试导出的 RL 奖励训练 Qwen2.5 14B 与 MIMO 7B，可提升功能完成度并降低构建失败。
Motivation: 现有 WebUI 生成基准多用自由格式提示加静态检查（构建成功、截图），能编译且看起来合理的输出在真实用户交互下可能失效，功能正确性无从判定。
Method: 提供结构化规格与稠密可执行交互测试，覆盖通用 WebUI（仪表盘、游戏、交互工具）与 3D 交互仿真（粒子/星系系统、物理动力学）两类任务；UI-agent harness 在无头浏览器中以 plan–act–observe 迭代循环定位 DOM 元素、执行动作、观察 UI/DOM 变化并检查断言；再把交互测试转成 RL 奖励训练紧凑模型。
Result: 在八个商业 LLM 上评测，页面渲染成功时交互类需求仍频繁失败，3D 仿真界面尤为突出；以可执行交互测试导出的 RL 奖励训练 Qwen2.5 14B 与 MIMO 7B，功能完成度提升且构建失败减少。
Conclusion: 静态检查不足以判定 WebUI 功能正确性，可执行交互测试既可作评测判据，也可直接充当 UI 生成的 outcome-level 训练信号。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: VERSE: Verified Self-Evolving Optimizer for Agent Harnesses
papers.abstract_en: Harness evolution improves an LLM agent's prompts, tools, and workflow, while the optimizer's own tools and procedures often remain fixed. We study whether an optimizer can improve another agent more effectively by also improving how it diagnoses failures, develops edits, and tests their effects. Two observations guide our design. In a controlled study, optimizer self-evolution fails to improve performance without execution-based verification, but achieves the best result of that study when verification is available. Across five executors, self-evolving optimizers build their own tools for failure analysis, verification, training audits, and workflow control. Motivated by these findings, we introduce VERSE, a Verified Self-Evolving optimizer for agent harnesses. VERSE lets the optimizer test draft edits, replay failures, and perturb suspected steps before submission, while tracking fixes and regressions across rounds. Using this feedback, the optimizer revises both the executor harness and its own prompts, skills, tools, hooks, and notes, while the weights of the optimizer and executor models stay fixed. Under a shared protocol with disjoint training, validation, and test tasks, VERSE improves all four evaluated harness optimizers on held-out SWE-rebench tasks and newer out-of-distribution tasks in five languages. Its best validation-selected harness reaches 42.3% and 37.7% accuracy, respectively, against 39.2% and 29.3% for the strongest baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/wzekai/VERSE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VERSE 让 LLM agent 的 harness 优化器也自我进化：在执行反馈下测试草稿编辑、回放失败、扰动可疑步骤，并同时改写被优化 agent 的 harness 与优化器自己的 prompts、skills、tools、hooks、notes，模型权重保持固定。在共享协议（训练/验证/测试任务不相交）下，其验证集选出的最优 harness 在 held-out SWE-rebench 与更新的分布外五语言任务上分别达到 42.3% 与 37.7% 准确率，强基线为 39.2% 与 29.3%。
Motivation: Harness 进化只改进 LLM agent 的 prompts、tools 和 workflow，优化器自身的诊断、编辑与测试流程却固定不动；受控研究显示没有执行验证时优化器自我进化无法提升性能。
Method: VERSE 引入执行式验证闭环：提交前测试草稿编辑、回放失败、扰动疑似步骤，并跨轮次跟踪 fixes 与 regressions；据此同时修订 executor harness 与优化器自身的 prompts、skills、tools、hooks、notes，优化器与 executor 模型权重保持冻结，采用训练/验证/测试任务不相交的共享协议。
Result: 受控研究中，无执行验证时优化器自我进化不提升性能，有验证时取得该研究最佳结果；跨五个 executors，自进化优化器自行构建用于失败分析、验证、训练审计与 workflow 控制的工具。在 held-out SWE-rebench 与更新的分布外五语言任务上，验证集选出的最优 harness 准确率分别为 42.3% 与 37.7%，最强基线为 39.2% 与 29.3%，且四个被评估的 harness 优化器均获提升。
Conclusion: 优化器要更有效地改进另一个 agent，就必须连同自身的诊断、编辑与测试方式一起进化，而执行式验证是这种自我进化起效的前提。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Quantifying the Value of Constructive Induction, Knowledge, and Noise Filtering on Inductive Learning
papers.abstract_en: Learning research, as one of its central goals, tries to measure, model, and understand how learning-problem properties affect average-case learning performance. For example, we would like to quantify the value of constructive induction, noise filtering, and background knowledge. This paper describes the effective dimension, a new learning measure that helps link problem properties to learning performance. Like the Vapnik-Chervonenkis (VC) dimension, the effective dimension is often in a simple linear relation with problem properties. Unlike the VC dimension, the effective dimension can be estimated empirically and makes average-case predictions. It is therefore more widely applicable to machine and human learning research. The measure is demonstrated on several learning systems including Backpropagation. Finally, the measure is used to precisely predict the benefit of using FRINGE, a feature construction system. The benefit is found to decrease as the complexity of the target concept increases.
papers.comment: 12 pages, including a modern cover note and the unchanged 11-page author manuscript from 1991. Extended author version of a paper published in Machine Learning Proceedings 1991 (ICML 1991), pp. 153-157. Deposited in arXiv in 2026
papers.journal_ref: Machine Learning Proceedings 1991, Morgan Kaufmann, pp. 153-157 (1991)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 effective dimension（有效维度）这一平均情形学习度量，用于量化 constructive induction、背景知识与噪声过滤对归纳学习性能的影响；它像 VC dimension 一样常与问题属性呈简单线性关系，但可经验估计并给出 average-case 预测。在包括 Backpropagation 在内的多个学习系统上示范后，该度量精确预测了特征构造系统 FRINGE 的收益，且收益随目标概念复杂度上升而下降。
Motivation: 学习研究需要量化问题属性（如 constructive induction、噪声过滤、背景知识）如何影响平均情形学习性能，而 VC dimension 只给最坏情形界、无法经验估计平均情形收益。
Method: 定义 effective dimension：与 VC dimension 类似地和问题属性呈简单线性关系，但可经验估计并作 average-case 预测；在包括 Backpropagation 在内的多个学习系统上示范该度量，并用它预测 FRINGE 特征构造系统的收益。
Result: 在多个学习系统（含 Backpropagation）上示范 effective dimension 可估计并与问题属性线性关联；用它精确预测 FRINGE 的收益，该收益随目标概念复杂度增加而减小。
Conclusion: effective dimension 把问题属性与平均情形学习性能用可经验估计的线性关系连起来，因而比 VC dimension 更广泛适用于机器与人类学习研究，并能定量预测特征构造方法的收益边界。

papers.title: What Is Lost in Post-Training? Default Collapse and the Loss of In-Context Steerability Across Diverse Perspectives
papers.abstract_en: AI models serving a heterogeneous population must act on the principles appropriate to each user and context. While post-training has been shown to narrow the views large language models express, prior work has focused on default behavior rather than the ability to adapt to in-context information. We show that post-training also degrades a model's ability to be steered in-context toward perspectives it was not trained to favor. In controlled experiments, we fine-tune models toward one side of cultural-value disagreements and evaluate checkpoints throughout training. The trained side becomes increasingly dominant in ordinary use, while the ability to recognize and faithfully enact the opposing view declines. These findings point to a tension between prioritizing a single set of values and preserving the technical capacity needed to serve diverse stakeholders. Finally, we propose and analyze an alternative objective that maximizes reward subject to a prescribed distribution over expressed perspectives, and present stance-distribution matching as a practical implementation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM 后训练推向文化价值分歧的某一方，会同时抬高该立场的默认表达、压低模型在上下文中被引导到对立立场的能力；作者提出在给定立场分布约束下最大化 reward 的替代目标，并给出 stance-distribution matching 实现。
Motivation: 已有工作只关注后训练收窄模型默认表达的观点，忽略了模型能否依据上下文信息适配到不同用户与场景，而服务异构人群正依赖这种 in-context 可引导性。
Method: 在受控实验中把模型微调到文化价值分歧的一侧，并在训练全程评估各 checkpoint，比较默认立场占比与识别、忠实执行对立立场的能力；随后提出并分析一个在规定立场分布下最大化 reward 的替代目标，以 stance-distribution matching 作为可操作实现。
Result: 训练所偏好的立场在普通使用中占比随训练推进上升，而识别并忠实执行对立立场的能力下降；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 优先单一价值集合与保留服务多元利益相关者所需的可引导能力之间存在张力，需用约束立场分布的目标来替代单纯最大化单一 reward。

papers.title: Scale-Recursive Rectified Flows for Few-Step Precipitation Ensembles
papers.abstract_en: Fine-resolution precipitation estimates support flood risk assessment and water management, but coarse satellite products cannot resolve rainfall within each grid cell. Generative models address this ambiguity by producing ensembles of plausible high-resolution rainfall fields. Among these models, rectified flows generate samples by iteratively transforming random noise into rainfall fields. Reducing the number of sampling steps accelerates generation but can make ensemble members too similar, understating uncertainty. We propose a scale-recursive rectified flow that generates broad patterns before local details and guides sampling-step allocation by comparing ensemble variability with prediction error across spatial scales. Validation scores and rainfall power spectra constrain the allocation to avoid excessive amplification. In satellite-to-radar downscaling over the contiguous United States, our analysis identified broad rainfall patterns as the main source of insufficient ensemble variability under reduced sampling budgets. Allocating more steps to the coarse flow improved probabilistic accuracy and rain detection across training seeds at fixed architecture and computational cost. The proposed model also achieved better probabilistic accuracy with shorter sampling time than a nonrecursive flow using more steps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对少步采样下降水集合成员过于相似、不确定性被低估的问题，提出尺度递归 rectified flow：先生成大尺度雨型再补局部细节，并用各空间尺度上集合变率与预报误差的比较来分配采样步数，同时用验证评分与降水功率谱约束分配以防方差被过度放大。在美国本土 (CONUS) 卫星到雷达降尺度中，粗尺度流分到更多步数可在固定架构与计算成本下跨训练种子提升概率精度与降雨检测，且比用更多步数的非递归流用更短采样时间取得更好的概率精度。
Motivation: 粗分辨率卫星产品无法分辨网格内降水，生成式模型靠少步采样加速但会使集合成员趋同、低估不确定性，需要在固定计算预算下决定步数如何按尺度分配。
Method: 尺度递归 rectified flow 分阶段生成：先大尺度雨型后局部细节；用各空间尺度上集合变率与预报误差的比较指导采样步数分配，并以验证评分和降水功率谱作为约束限制方差放大；在 CONUS 的卫星到雷达降尺度任务上验证。
Result: 在 CONUS 卫星到雷达降尺度中，分析识别出大尺度雨型是采样预算受限时集合变率不足的主要来源；在固定架构与计算成本下，把更多步数分给粗尺度流可跨训练种子提升概率精度与降雨检测；相比使用更多步数的非递归流，所提模型以更短采样时间取得更好的概率精度。
Conclusion: 少步降水集合的不确定性缺口主要来自大尺度模式，按尺度递归地把采样预算倾斜到粗尺度流，可在同等计算成本下同时改善概率精度、降雨检测与采样时间。
Relevance: 93

papers.title: Seer: Maximum Likelihood Regression for Learning-Speed Curves
papers.abstract_en: The research presented here focuses on modeling machine-learning performance. The thesis introduces Seer, a system that generates empirical observations of classification-learning performance and then uses those observations to create statistical models. The models can be used to predict the number of training examples needed to achieve a desired level and the maximum accuracy possible given an unlimited number of training examples. Seer advances the state of the art with 1) models that embody the best constraints for classification learning and most useful parameters, 2) algorithms that efficiently find maximum-likelihood models, and 3) a demonstration on real-world data from three domains of a practicable application of such modeling. The first part of the thesis gives an overview of the requirements for a good maximum-likelihood model of classification-learning performance. Next, reasonable design choices for such models are explored. Selection among such models is a task of nonlinear programming, but by exploiting appropriate problem constraints, the task is reduced to a nonlinear regression task that can be solved with an efficient iterative algorithm. The latter part of the thesis describes almost 100 experiments in the domains of soybean disease, heart disease, and audiological problems. The tests show that Seer is excellent at characterizing learning-performance and that it seems to be as good as possible at predicting learning performance. Finally, recommendations for choosing a regression model for a particular situation are made and directions for further research are identified.
papers.comment: 104 pages. Ph.D. dissertation, Department of Computer Science, University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, 1995. Original dissertation deposited in arXiv in 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Seer 是一个对分类学习性能曲线做最大似然建模的系统：先生成学习性能的经验观测，再用带分类学习约束的非线性回归（由非线性规划约化而来）拟合统计模型，从而预测达到目标精度所需训练样本数与无限样本下的最大精度。在 soybean disease、heart disease、audiological 三个真实领域近 100 个实验中，Seer 对学习性能的刻画与预测表现被评价为“尽可能好”。
Motivation: 机器学习性能预测需要回答“还要多少数据”和“天花板在哪”，但把带约束的最大似然模型选择当作一般非线性规划求解代价高，缺少在真实数据上可操作的建模流程。
Method: Seer 先生成分类学习性能的经验观测，再构建体现分类学习约束与有用参数的候选最大似然模型；利用问题约束把模型选择从非线性规划约化为非线性回归，用高效迭代算法求解；最后在三个真实领域做应用演示并给出回归模型选择建议。
Result: 在 soybean disease、heart disease、audiological 三个领域描述了近 100 个实验；测试显示 Seer 在刻画学习性能上表现优异，且在预测学习性能上“似乎与可能达到的最好水平相当”。
Conclusion: 带合适约束的最大似然回归可以高效求解并实用化地预测分类学习曲线，包括所需训练样本数与无限数据下的精度上限；论文同时给出按场景选择回归模型的建议与后续研究方向。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Time Series Forecasting Benchmarks Need Scenario-Grounded Stress Testing
papers.abstract_en: Time series forecasting (TSF) increasingly drives decisions in transportation, energy, finance, healthcare, and infrastructure, yet current evaluation remains overly narrow: standard benchmarks reward low held-out error, while robustness studies typically reduce failure to Gaussian noise, random masking, or bounded adversarial perturbations. This obscures the real failure modes of deployed forecasting systems. Input-side anomalies are not merely noisier inputs: they often reflect structured events that alter temporal dynamics, break cross-variable dependencies, induce regime shifts, or propagate from faulty sensors to downstream decisions. These semantic, causal, and system-level failures cannot be faithfully captured by i.i.d. perturbations alone. The rise of TSF foundation models makes this evaluation gap more urgent, as unauditable pretraining corpora make held-out generalization increasingly unreliable. We therefore advocate scenario-grounded stress testing. Each test instance should include historical inputs and future targets, together with a semantic scenario, an explicit failure operator, and a measurable difficulty level. This shift makes evaluation interpretable, attributable, and deployment-relevant and friendly, enabling the community to ask not only which model is accurate, but under what conditions it fails and why.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文主张时间序列预报评测要从「留出集误差 + 高斯噪声/随机掩码/有界对抗扰动」转向场景锚定的压力测试 (scenario-grounded stress testing)：每个测试样例须同时给出历史输入与未来目标、一个语义场景、一个显式失效算子 (failure operator) 和可度量的难度等级。这样评测才能回答模型在什么条件下、因何失效，而不只是哪个模型更准。
Motivation: 标准基准只奖励低留出误差，鲁棒性研究把失效简化为 i.i.d. 扰动，掩盖了部署系统的真实失效模式——结构化事件改变时序动态、破坏跨变量依赖、造成 regime shift、并从故障传感器传播到下游决策；TSF foundation model 的预训练语料不可审计，使留出集泛化愈发不可靠。
Method: 提出倡导性评测框架：测试实例由四元组构成——历史输入与未来目标、语义场景、显式失效算子、可度量难度等级，用以替代高斯噪声、随机掩码与有界对抗扰动这类 i.i.d. 扰动协议。
Result: 论文为立场/评测倡议性质，给出的量化主张是评测协议的构成要素（四元组：历史输入、未来目标、语义场景、显式失效算子、可度量难度），并指出该框架使评测可解释、可归因、与部署相关。
Conclusion: 作者主张社区把评测问题从「哪个模型准确」改为「在什么条件下失败、为什么」，认为这是应对 foundation model 不可审计预训练语料的必要转向。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Learning Skills from Historical Action Trajectories: Action Experience Dictionary for World Action Models
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) couple visual dynamics prediction with action generation, yet they do not explicitly support the reuse of action experience across manipulation tasks. Furthermore, existing WAMs struggle to capture underlying cross-task semantic relationships that could guide target action prediction, as redundant background elements interfere with the extraction of key visual information. To address these challenges, we develop a novel Action Experience Dictionary (AED) that encodes historical physical action trajectories into shared action embeddings to support skill reuse and model cross-task relationships. Specifically, we first aggregate historical actions to align with visual observations and retrieve action embeddings from the AED using a pretrained action tokenizer. Subsequently, we visually condition the pooled embeddings through cross-attention and prepend them to noisy action tokens, providing interaction context and action intent for prediction. To model action-related motion and reduce reliance on irrelevant background cues, we introduce a motion-aware transition loss that supervises visual feature change prediction over random temporal intervals. Experiments on simulation benchmarks and in real-world cross-embodiment settings verify the effectiveness of our AED. The project code is available at https://github.com/JiahuaDong/AED .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向 World Action Models (WAM) 提出 Action Experience Dictionary (AED)，把历史物理动作轨迹编码为共享 action embedding，用预训练 action tokenizer 检索后经 cross-attention 视觉条件化并前置到噪声动作 token 上，再以 motion-aware transition loss 在随机时间间隔上监督视觉特征变化，以支持跨操作任务的技能复用并削弱背景干扰。仿真基准与真实世界跨具身 (cross-embodiment) 实验验证了 AED 的有效性。
Motivation: 现有 WAM 不显式支持跨操作任务复用动作经验，且冗余背景元素干扰关键视觉信息提取，难以刻画可指导目标动作预测的跨任务语义关系。
Method: 先聚合历史动作并与视觉观测对齐，用预训练 action tokenizer 从 AED 中检索 action embedding；再通过 cross-attention 用视觉对池化 embedding 条件化，前置到噪声动作 token 前提供交互上下文与动作意图；同时引入 motion-aware transition loss，在随机时间间隔上监督视觉特征变化预测，以建模动作相关运动并降低对无关背景的依赖。
Result: 在仿真基准与真实世界跨具身设置上的实验验证了 AED 的有效性；代码发布于 github.com/JiahuaDong/AED。
Conclusion: 把历史动作轨迹沉淀为可检索的共享字典并配合运动感知监督，可让 WAM 复用技能、建模跨任务关系并抵抗背景干扰。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Tactile Curiosity Drives Robot Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Mastering robot manipulation skills via reinforcement learning (RL) remains largely sample-inefficient. The most common RL algorithms rely on random action sampling to discover new strategies, resulting in agents that allocate most of their training budget to motions in free space, away from the contacts from which manipulation skills emerge. Existing intrinsic motivation methods based on model disagreement or epistemic uncertainty improve on isotropic noise, but they can also reward uncertainty in functionally irrelevant transitions, such as erratic motions in free space. In this work, we argue that tactile feedback provides a natural signal for exploration, and introduce TacEx, a framework that incorporates touch into epistemic uncertainty-driven exploration by decomposing model uncertainty across sensory modalities and directing curiosity toward the tactile channel. By anchoring curiosity to the sense of touch, TacEx drives the robot to discover complex contact dynamics, learning to manipulate and grasp objects without task rewards or expert demonstrations during exploration. The interaction-dense dataset collected through this tactile-driven curiosity supports offline learning of downstream pick-and-place policies without additional environment interaction. We further use tactile-driven exploration to post-train vision-language-action (VLA) models. Although the VLAs are initially pre-trained without tactile feedback, post-training with TacEx substantially improves downstream performance while remaining highly sample-efficient.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 6 figures, 1 table. Preprint, under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TacEx 把基于认知不确定性的探索好奇心得按感官模态分解，定向到触觉通道，使机器人在无任务奖励、无专家示范的探索中主动发现接触动力学并学会抓取与操作。触觉驱动探索收集的高接触密度数据集可直接用于离线训练下游 pick-and-place 策略，无需再与环境交互；用 TacEx 后训练视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型在保持高样本效率的同时显著提升下游表现。
Motivation: RL 机器人操作技能学习样本效率极低：随机动作采样把大部分训练预算花在远离接触的自由空间运动上，而现有基于模型分歧或认知不确定性的内在动机又会奖励自由空间乱动这类功能无关的不确定转移。
Method: TacEx 框架把模型不确定性按感官模态分解，将认知不确定性驱动的探索好奇心定向到触觉通道；触觉驱动探索收集 interaction-dense 数据集，用于离线训练下游 pick-and-place 策略，并用于对预训练时未接触触觉的 VLA 模型做后训练 (post-training)。
Result: 探索阶段无需任务奖励或专家示范即可学到操作与抓取；所得数据集支持无需额外环境交互的离线 pick-and-place 策略学习；对未用触觉预训练的 VLA 做 TacEx 后训练，下游性能显著提升且保持高样本效率。
Conclusion: 把探索好奇心锚定在触觉上，可以让机器人把训练预算投向真正产生操作技能的接触转移，同时为离线学习和 VLA 后训练提供高价值数据。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: 探索阶段无需任务奖励或专家示范即可学到操作与抓取；所得数据集支持无需额外环境交互的离线 pick-and-place 策略学习；对未用触觉预训练的 VLA 做 TacEx 后训练，下游性能显著提升且保持高样本效率。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把探索好奇心锚定在触觉上，可以让机器人把训练预算投向真正产生操作技能的接触转移，同时为离线学习和 VLA 后训练提供高价值数据。

papers.title: Accelerated Algorithm for Sparse Regularized Partial Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: Partial Optimal Transport (POT) extends the classical optimal transport problem by relaxing the strict mass conservation constraint, enabling its use in a wide range of real-world applications. In many of these settings, sparse transport plans are preferred for their interpretability and computational benefits. While smooth and strongly convex regularizers - such as quadratic or elastic net - have been vastly used in various machine learning applications to induce sparsity and accelerate computation, they have received less algorithmic attention compared to entropic approaches for computational POT. In this paper, we propose a new optimization framework that leverages these regularizers through a penalty-based reformulation, enabling efficient gradient-based updates while preserving the structure of the original problem. Our method accommodates a broad class of regularizers that promote structured and sparse transport plans. Building on this formulation, we design an accelerated first-order algorithm that alternates between smooth updates and simple projection steps. Through empirical benchmarks on color transfer, domain adaptation, and point cloud registration, our approach consistently outperforms established baselines - achieving lower transport cost, higher sparsity, and faster convergence - making it a practical and scalable solution for modern transport problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对稀疏正则化的 partial optimal transport (POT)，提出基于惩罚重构的优化框架，让二次或 elastic net 等光滑强凸正则子可用高效梯度更新，再设计在光滑更新与简单投影步之间交替的加速一阶算法。在 color transfer、domain adaptation、point cloud registration 三类基准上，该方法相对既有基线取得更低 transport cost、更高稀疏度与更快收敛。
Motivation: POT 中稀疏 transport plan 兼具可解释性与计算优势，但能诱导稀疏并加速计算的光滑强凸正则子（如 quadratic、elastic net）在计算型 POT 上得到的算法关注远少于 entropic 路线。
Method: 用惩罚式重构 (penalty-based reformulation) 把光滑强凸正则子纳入 POT，保留原问题结构并支持高效梯度更新；在此之上设计加速一阶算法，在光滑更新步与简单投影步之间交替，可容纳一大类诱导结构化稀疏 transport plan 的正则子。
Result: 在 color transfer、domain adaptation、point cloud registration 三类经验基准上，该方法相对既有基线 consistently 取得更低 transport cost、更高 sparsity 与更快 convergence。
Conclusion: 惩罚重构加交替投影的加速一阶算法，可把 quadratic/elastic net 类正则子变成计算型 POT 的实用且可扩展的稀疏求解方案。

papers.title: A PyTorch Library for Hyperspectral Image Models: Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: Hyperspectral remote sensing has advanced across diverse deep learning paradigms, including spectral spatial CNNs, Vision Transformers, Mamba, graph neural networks, Kolmogorov Arnold networks, and self supervised masked autoencoding. Yet progress remains hindered by fragmented repositories, incompatible tensor conventions, and non standardized evaluation. Hyperspectral Image Models addresses these challenges through a modular framework unifying 55 representative models across six paradigms with a common registry, automatic 4D/5D tensor adaptation, and standardized constructors. It integrates 24 benchmark scenes from Airborne, Spaceborne, UAV, and Mars CRISM sensors, with caching, label remapping, PCA, explicit band selection or raw spectra, optional spatial max pooling, and arbitrary PxP patch extraction. To prevent inflated accuracy from overlapping windows, it supports class balanced random partitioning and spatially disjoint regional blocking with Chebyshev guard bands that eliminate train test pixel overlap. Experiments use a single config with deterministic seeds and complete provenance, generating LaTeX benchmark tables and classification maps. Across 1,320 model scene evaluations and 6,600 seeded runs, scene difficulty dominates architecture, with mean accuracy ranging from 96.40% on Botswana to 56.70% on Houston 2018, versus a 15 point spread across paradigm means. No paradigm universally dominates, while sub 1 M parameter models can match architectures two orders of magnitude larger. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/Tanishq251/Hyperspectral-Image-Models.
papers.comment: Documentation and benchmark library for hyperspectral image models
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Hyperspectral Image Models 是一个高光谱图像分类的 PyTorch 库，用统一 registry、自动 4D/5D 张量适配和标准化构造器打通 55 个模型、六大范式，并用带 Chebyshev 隔离带的空间不相交分块杜绝训练测试像素重叠导致的精度虚高。在 1,320 次模型-场景评测、6,600 次固定种子运行中，场景难度压过架构选择：平均精度从 Botswana 的 96.40% 到 Houston 2018 的 56.70%，而各范式均值只差 15 个百分点。
Motivation: 高光谱深度学习进展被碎片化仓库、互不兼容的张量约定和非标准化评测拖住；重叠滑窗切 patch 会让训练测试像素重叠，把分类精度算虚高。
Method: 统一 registry 支撑 55 个代表性模型（spectral-spatial CNN、Vision Transformer、Mamba、graph neural network、Kolmogorov Arnold network、自监督 masked autoencoding），自动做 4D/5D 张量适配与标准化构造器；集成 24 个来自 Airborne、Spaceborne、UAV、Mars CRISM 的基准场景，支持缓存、标签重映射、PCA、显式波段选择或原始光谱、可选空间 max pooling、任意 PxP patch 提取；划分上提供类别平衡随机划分与带 Chebyshev guard band 的空间不相交 regional blocking；实验用单一 config、确定性种子与完整 provenance，自动生成 LaTeX 基准表与分类图。
Result: 共 1,320 次模型-场景评测、6,600 次种子运行：场景难度主导架构，平均精度从 Botswana 96.40% 到 Houston 2018 56.70%，跨范式均值仅 15 个百分点的差距；没有哪个范式普遍占优，参数量低于 1M 的模型可以匹配大两个数量级的架构。
Conclusion: 高光谱分类的性能差异主要由数据集场景决定而非网络范式，评测应在统一划分与防泄漏协议下做；小模型在该任务上足以比肩百倍参数的架构。

papers.title: CATCH: A Controllable Analysis Testbed for Reward Hacking in Coding RL
papers.abstract_en: During reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), large language models (LLMs) can exploit loopholes in their environments to obtain high rewards without improving the intended capabilities, i.e., reward hacking. Despite its risks to training efficiency and safety, monitoring and mitigating reward hacking during training remain challenging, which is limited by a lack of testbeds that reproduce hacking and reliably identify it. We introduce CATCH, a controllable testbed for studying reward hacking in coding RL. CATCH deliberately exposes environmental loopholes and provides execution-based gold labels by comparing success under a vulnerable evaluator with task correctness under an independent audit. It also can control the model's initial hacking tendency through supervised fine-tuning data mixtures and the difficulty of earning rewards through reward designing, enabling systematic comparisons of hacking dynamics and interventions. Experiments show that CATCH can produce diverse RL training trajectories with clear reward hacking, and analyses demonstrate that both initial models and reward difficulties shape the emergence of reward hacking. We further evaluate the effectiveness of different reward hacking detection and mitigation methods. A key finding is that a chain-of-thought monitor initially suppresses hacking, but this protection erodes as the policy model learn to mislead the monitor with code comments. This highlights the need to evaluate hacking mitigations throughout training with CATCH. The source code and resources are publicly released at https://github.com/THUAIS-Lab/CATCH.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CATCH 是一个可控的编码 RL 奖励黑客 (reward hacking) 测试台：故意暴露环境漏洞，用脆弱评估器下的成功与独立审计下的任务正确性比对给出基于执行的 gold label，并可通过 SFT 数据混合控制模型初始黑客倾向、通过奖励设计控制获酬难度。实验显示它能产生带明显 reward hacking 的多样化 RL 训练轨迹，且 chain-of-thought 监控器初期抑制黑客、但随策略模型学会用代码注释误导监控器而失效。
Motivation: RLVR 中 LLM 会钻环境漏洞拿高奖励而不提升目标能力，但训练中监控与缓解 reward hacking 很难，缺能复现黑客行为并可靠识别它的测试台。
Method: CATCH 主动暴露环境漏洞，以脆弱评估器 (vulnerable evaluator) 的成功对比独立审计 (independent audit) 的任务正确性生成基于执行的 gold label；用监督微调数据混合控制模型初始黑客倾向，用奖励设计控制获酬难度，从而系统比较黑客动力学与干预手段。
Result: 实验中 CATCH 产生多样化的 RL 训练轨迹并带有清晰的 reward hacking；分析表明初始模型与奖励难度共同塑造 reward hacking 的出现；chain-of-thought 监控器初期抑制黑客，但保护随训练侵蚀，策略模型学会用代码注释误导监控器。
Conclusion: 缓解手段必须在整个训练过程中用 CATCH 这类测试台持续评估，因为静态或初期有效的监控会随策略演化而失效；初始模型与奖励难度是黑客涌现的两个决定因素。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: EgoTools: Towards Tool-Centric Reasoning in Real-World Egocentric Videos
papers.abstract_en: Real-world embodied tasks, from everyday activities to professional procedures, require agents to act under physical constraints while tracking evolving object and task states. Tool use sits at the heart of such tasks, as many everyday and professional activities are tool-mediated. Understanding them requires reasoning about affordances, hand-tool-object geometry, procedural progress, and causal effects on target objects. Yet despite strong performance on perception-oriented video tasks such as captioning and general video QA, current multimodal video models remain limited in this form of tool-centric embodied reasoning. Progress in this direction has been limited by the lack of real-world egocentric data and diagnostic benchmarks. To address this gap, we introduce EgoTools, the first comprehensive suite for egocentric tool-use understanding. It consists of two complementary components: EgoTools-Data, a large-scale corpus of 100 hours of tool-centric egocentric recordings with synchronized audio, dense captions, reasoning-heavy narrations, and supplementary 3D information; and EgoTools-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,000 QA pairs across four tracks that cover tool-use understanding from perception and geometry to procedure and causal reasoning. Experimental results show that current models still struggle to ground tool use in visual evidence: Gemini-3.1-Pro achieves 66.9% overall accuracy but only 51.7% on Perception & Grounding. Beyond evaluation, we validate EgoTools-Data as a training resource. On the full 1,000-question benchmark, full supervised fine-tuning improves Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct from 50.0% to 60.9%, under strict source-video separation. Together, these results establish EgoTools as a unified resource for both training and diagnostic evaluation of real-world egocentric tool-use understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EgoTools 是首个面向第一人称视频工具使用理解的数据与评测套件：100 小时带同步音频、稠密字幕与 3E 信息的语料，加 1,000 道四赛道 QA 诊断基准。Gemini-3.1-Pro 总体 66.9% 但感知与定位仅 51.7%；用该语料做全监督微调可把 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 从 50.0% 提到 60.9%。
Motivation: 多模态视频模型在字幕与通用视频 QA 上表现强，但在工具介导的具身推理（可供性、手-工具-物体几何、流程进度、因果效应）上受限，缺真实第一人称数据与诊断基准。
Method: EgoTools-Data：100 小时工具中心第一人称录像，配同步音频、稠密字幕、重推理旁白与补充 3D 信息；EgoTools-Bench：1,000 道 QA，分四赛道覆盖感知、几何、流程与因果推理。训练验证用全监督微调 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct，并严格分离源视频。
Result: Gemini-3.1-Pro 在完整基准上总体准确率 66.9%，其中 Perception & Grounding 仅 51.7%；全监督微调使 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 在全部 1,000 题上从 50.0% 提升到 60.9%（严格源视频分离）。
Conclusion: 当前模型难以把工具使用落到视觉证据上，而 EgoTools-Data 既可作诊断评测也可作训练资源，同时提升第一人称工具使用理解的评测与训练。

papers.title: A Width-Matched Comparison of Hybrid Quantum-Classical Self-Supervised Learning for Fingerprint Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Fingerprint recognition is a widely deployed biometric, but supervised training requires large labeled enrollment sets. Self-supervised learning (SSL) removes this requirement, and hybrid quantum-classical models have been proposed to enrich the learned representations. Prior quantum SSL studies consider a single contrastive objective, so it is unclear whether reported benefits depend on the objective or can be attributed to the quantum circuit. We insert the QuFeX quantum feature-extraction module into three SSL frameworks, the contrastive SimCLR and MoCo v2 and the non-contrastive BYOL, and compare each hybrid with its classical counterpart at matched representation width (8 features, equal to 8 qubits) on the SOCOFing fingerprint dataset, with a CIFAR-10 control, using k-nearest-neighbor identification on encoder features. In single-run experiments the hybrid scores clearly higher for both contrastive objectives, whereas for BYOL a multi-seed analysis shows no reliable difference, suggesting that any benefit depends on the SSL objective. A hardware-efficient circuit (QNet) does not show the same gain. We examine whether the gains can be attributed to the quantum circuit, considering circuit architecture, trainable parameter count, nonlinearity, and the classical simulability of 8-qubit circuits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 QuFeX 量子特征提取模块插入 SimCLR、MoCo v2、BYOL 三种自监督框架，在表示宽度对齐（8 维特征 = 8 qubits）下与经典对应模型比较指纹识别效果。两个对比式目标上混合模型明显更高，而 BYOL 的多种子分析显示无可靠差异，说明收益取决于 SSL 目标而非量子电路本身；硬件高效电路 QNet 未复现该增益。
Motivation: 指纹识别的监督训练依赖大规模标注注册集，自监督可去掉该需求；但既有量子 SSL 研究只用单一对比目标，无法判断报告的收益是来自目标函数还是量子电路本身。
Method: 将 QuFeX 量子特征提取模块分别嵌入对比式 SimCLR 与 MoCo v2 和非对比式 BYOL，每个混合模型与表示宽度对齐的经典模型（8 特征 = 8 qubits）配对；在 SOCOFing 指纹数据集上训练，CIFAR-10 作对照，用编码器特征上的 k 近邻 (k-NN) 做识别评测，并对 BYOL 做多种子分析，同时考察电路架构、可训练参数量、非线性与 8-qubit 电路的经典可模拟性。
Result: 单次运行下混合模型在 SimCLR 与 MoCo v2 两个对比目标上均明显高于经典对应模型；BYOL 上多种子分析显示无可靠差异；硬件高效电路 QNet 未呈现同样增益。评测设置为 SOCOFing 上的 k-NN 识别，CIFAR-10 为对照。
Conclusion: 量子 SSL 的收益依赖于所用自监督目标：对比式目标下可见提升，非对比式 BYOL 下不成立，因此不能把增益归因于量子电路本身。

papers.title: CRAFT: Causal Responsibility and Failure Tracing in Medical Vision Language Models
papers.abstract_en: As vision language models are increasingly deployed in clinical diagnosis, under standing how they internally resolve competing visual and textual signals becomes a safety imperative. Existing mechanistic analyses remain confined to unimodal text and offer no explanation for why a single misleading sentence can override a correct image based diagnosis, or why a model commits to a confident answer despite insufficient visual evidence. We find that these two safety risks, arbitra tion failure where textual context overrides visual grounding and brake failure where the model commits without adequate evidence, are mediated by spatially disjoint attention head populations: arbitration heads form a mid-to-deep wideband reflecting cross-layer evidence competition, while brake heads concentrate in a narrow middle-to-late layer band that regulates evidence sufficiency and abstention behavior. To ground these observations in causal circuitry, we introduce CRAFT, which localizes each failure mode to a minimal causal head set via dual criteria and verifies necessity and sufficiency through temporal probes and Tuned Lens trajectory analysis. Excising arbitration heads sharply reduces conflict following with negligible degradation on clean inputs, while excising brake heads restores ap propriate abstention under degraded visual evidence. The two interventions target spatially disjoint head sets and produce distinct corrective effects, underscoring the mechanistic separability of the failure modes. Experiments across multiple medical VQA benchmarks and VLM architectures validate both the localization and inter ventions, demonstrating that the identified heads causally drive each failure mode and that targeted modulation generalises without retraining. The code is available at https://github.com/zhcz328/CRAFT.
papers.comment: NeurIPS 2026 Spotlight, Medical VLM Failure Analysis
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CRAFT 把医学视觉语言模型的两类安全失效定位到空间上互不重叠的注意力头群：仲裁头 (arbitration heads) 让文本压过图像，刹车头 (brake heads) 让模型在证据不足时仍强行作答。切除仲裁头可在干净输入几乎无损的前提下大幅降低冲突顺从，切除刹车头则在视觉证据退化时恢复恰当弃答，且无需重训即可泛化。
Motivation: 现有机制可解释性分析局限于单模态文本，无法解释为何一句误导文本能推翻正确的图像诊断、或模型在视觉证据不足时为何仍给出高置信答案。
Method: 用双准则把每类失效定位到最小因果头集合 (minimal causal head set)，再用时间探针 (temporal probes) 与 Tuned Lens 轨迹分析验证必要性与充分性；随后对仲裁头和刹车头分别做切除干预，并在多个医学 VQA benchmark 与多种 VLM 架构上检验定位与干预效果。
Result: 仲裁头分布于中到深层的宽带、反映跨层证据竞争，刹车头集中在中后段窄带并调控证据充分性与弃答行为；切除仲裁头显著降低冲突顺从且对干净输入影响可忽略，切除刹车头在视觉证据退化时恢复恰当弃答，两组头空间不重叠、干预效果各异；实验跨多个医学 VQA benchmark 与多种 VLM 架构验证了定位与干预。
Conclusion: 两类失效由因果上可分离的头群驱动，针对性调制这些头即可在不重训的情况下纠正失效并泛化到不同架构。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: JARQ: Joint Alternating Refinement for Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Group-wise post-training quantizers for large language models round weights onto a grid that is not refit to the resulting integer codes. We show that this leaves accuracy on the table: the best grid depends on the codes, input correlations couple the errors of different groups, and useful code changes often involve many codes at once. We propose JARQ , a plug-in refinement that starts from any group-wise quantizer and alternates a joint least-squares fit of all group scales with bounded Babai proposals that move many codes of a group together on the current grid. The problem is a bilinear box-constrained mixed-integer least-squares problem; the solver is backpropagation-free, does not increase the layer-wise objective under exact scale solves, and keeps the host's bit width, groups, zero points, and inference cost. Across Llama-2, Llama-3, and Qwen models with RTN, GPTQ, OmniQuant, and AWQ hosts, JARQ lowers perplexity in 90 of 96 comparisons, cuts three-bit RTN perplexity by up to 36%, raises mean multiple-choice accuracy in 23 of 24 configurations, and improves QEP, QuaRot, and OJBKQ outputs, at under a minute per 7B block.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JARQ 是面向 LLM 分组后训练量化的即插即用精化模块：交替做所有组 scale 的联合最小二乘拟合与当前网格上的有界 Babai 提案，一次移动整组多个码字。在 Llama-2、Llama-3、Qwen 上配合 RTN、GPTQ、OmniQuant、AWQ 宿主，96 组对比中 90 组困惑度下降，3-bit RTN 困惑度最多降 36%，24 个配置中 23 个多项选择平均准确率上升，7B block 每块耗时不到一分钟。
Motivation: 分组后训练量化把权重量到固定网格上，但该网格没有针对实际得到的整数码字重新拟合：最优网格依赖码字本身，输入相关性又把不同组的误差耦合在一起，而有用的码字改动往往需要同时改很多码。
Method: JARQ 从任意分组量化器出发，交替执行两步：对所有组 scale 做联合最小二乘拟合，以及在当前网格上用有界 Babai 提案成组移动码字。整体是双线性、盒约束的混合整数最小二乘问题，求解不依赖反向传播，在精确 scale 求解下不增大逐层目标，并保留宿主的比特宽度、分组、zero point 与推理开销。
Result: 在 Llama-2、Llama-3、Qwen 上以 RTN、GPTQ、OmniQuant、AWQ 为宿主，96 组对比中 90 组困惑度下降；3-bit RTN 困惑度最多降低 36%；24 个配置中 23 个多项选择平均准确率提升；同时改善 QEP、QuaRot、OJBKQ 的输出；每个 7B block 耗时不到一分钟。
Conclusion: 把网格拟合与码字搜索交替进行，可以在不改变宿主比特宽度、分组与推理成本的前提下，从现有分组量化器中再挤出精度，且逐层目标在精确 scale 求解下不恶化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: It Takes Little to Rewrite Perception: Targeted Semantic Substitution in Vision-Language Models at $ε\leq 4/255$
papers.abstract_en: Vision Language Models (VLMs) are widely deployed in safety-critical scenarios, and understanding to which extent they can be controlled by adversarial perturbation is a prerequisite for evaluating their trustworthiness. Existing representation-alignment attacks, which make a VLM perceive a target image, achieve limited success at $\varepsilon \leq 4/255$. Therefore, VLMs seems robust to perturbations in this range. We show that this robustness does not hold, as targeted semantic substitution succeeds within the same range. Specifically, we align each stream of the source image with its counterpart in the target image in the victim VLM's post-merger token space, operating under a white-box threat model. We evaluate under a strict success criterion, requiring the model to simultaneously name the target, confirm its presence, and deny the source. In images, target semantics appear at $\varepsilon = 2/255$ and complete replacement reaches 38% at $\varepsilon = 4/255$. On video, complete replacement reaches 35.9% at $\varepsilon = 1/255$. We also observe a phenomenon of semantic fusion, where Large Language Model (LLM) rationalizes contradictory visual signals into a coherent narrative.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 ε≤4/255 的扰动预算内，针对 VLM 的后融合 token 空间做目标语义替换 (targeted semantic substitution)，把源图每个流与目标图对应流对齐，可在白盒威胁模型下让模型同时说出目标、确认其存在并否认源图。图像上目标语义在 ε=2/255 即出现，ε=4/255 时完全替换达 38%；视频在 ε=1/255 下完全替换达 35.9%。这说明此前认为 VLM 在该扰动范围内稳健的结论不成立。
Motivation: 现有表征对齐攻击在 ε≤4/255 下成功率有限，使 VLM 在该范围内看似对对抗扰动稳健，其可信度评估因此被低估。
Method: 白盒威胁模型下，在受害 VLM 的后融合 token 空间 (post-merger token space) 中把源图像的每个流与目标图像对应流对齐；评测采用严格成功判据，要求模型同时命名目标、确认目标存在并否认源图，覆盖图像与视频两种模态。
Result: 图像上目标语义在 ε=2/255 出现，ε=4/255 时完全替换成功率 38%；视频上 ε=1/255 时完全替换成功率 35.9%。另观察到语义融合 (semantic fusion)：LLM 把矛盾的视觉信号合理化为连贯叙述。
Conclusion: VLM 在 ε≤4/255 范围内的对抗稳健性并不成立，只需在后融合 token 空间做定向语义替换即可在极小扰动下完成图像与视频的完全语义替换。

papers.title: Auditing Long-Term Memory Evaluation: Repeated Judging, Reader Variation, and Negative Controls
papers.abstract_en: This report audits evaluation of a long-term-memory retrieval chain on the 500 LongMemEval-S development questions. Its strongest historical reader lane scores 479 and 475 under an adapted GPT-4o rubric; re-judging the same pass-1 answers changes three labels and yields 478. Fixed-answer knowledge-update re-scoring gives 70/72 under the upstream template and 69/72 under the modified template. Reader lanes span 93 to 479 on fixed packets; paired tests between the two strongest historical lanes establish neither superiority nor equivalence. A different-family reader, configured without client tools or operator files, scores 474, 1.0 percentage point below the headline pass (paired 95% interval [-3.0,+1.0]). Live reader request bodies were not retained. With the same requested reader label, route and judge snapshot, the full package scores 474 versus 454 for baseline sessions, a difference of +4.0 percentage points [95% interval +2.2,+6.0]. Eighteen of the 23 gains, and no losses, occur where baseline packets lacked listed evidence; this post-hoc split does not identify a component effect. In recovered LoCoMo data, token-F1 gains do not survive answer-line extraction. A negative control rejects a verifier that repairs three wrong drafts but breaks eleven correct ones. All questions were used to develop the components; no untouched holdout was evaluated. These findings do not establish a new leaderboard leader or transferable memory advantage. The A/D comparison has one pass per arm, including six reused identical-prompt outcomes, with no pinned reader snapshot; B/C and repeats remain unrun. Original headline requests cannot be reconstructed and stages 1--4 remain closed. Released artifacts support packet inspection and saved-verdict recounting and re-scoring; they do not reconstruct the method.
papers.comment: 23 pages. Evaluation-audit revision; adds fixed-answer KU re-scoring, a one-pass full-package versus baseline reader comparison, and post-hoc evidence coverage. Includes ancillary data and an offline recount script. Method sources remain held; all 500 questions were used for development
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 LongMemEval-S 500 道开发题上的长期记忆检索链评测做审计：最强历史 reader lane 得 479/475，同一批 pass-1 答案重判只改 3 个标签得 478；不同家族 reader 得 474，与 headline pass 差 1.0 个百分点（配对 95% 区间 [-3.0,+1.0]）。同 reader 标签、路由与 judge 快照下 full package 474 对 baseline 454，差 +4.0 个百分点 [+2.2,+6.0]，但 23 项增益中 18 项、且无一项损失出现在 baseline 缺列证据的包上，该事后切分不能识别组件效应；作者明确结论是这些结果不构成新的榜单领先或可迁移的记忆优势。
Motivation: 长期记忆检索链的评测高度依赖 reader、rubric 与判分流程，历史分数之间缺乏可比性与可复现性；需要审计判分稳定性、reader 差异与负对照，判断既有 headline 数字是否可信。
Method: 在 LongMemEval-S 全部 500 道开发题上做评测审计：用适配的 GPT-4o rubric 重判同一批 pass-1 答案，做 fixed-answer knowledge-update 重打分（上游模板与修改模板各一版），比较不同 reader lane 在固定 packet 上的分数并做配对检验，加入一个不带 client tools 与 operator files 的异家族 reader，以及一个检验 verifier 的负对照；发布 packet 检查与 saved-verdict 重数/重打分脚本。

papers.title: WISE-ATTA: When to Ask for Labels in Budgeted Active Test-Time Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Active test-time adaptation (ATTA) improves robustness under distribution shift by updating a deployed model during inference while selectively querying supervision. However, most existing ATTA methods implicitly assume that supervision can be requested for every incoming test batch, which can incur substantial annotation cost over long test streams. In this work, we introduce budgeted ATTA in which labels are available for only a fraction of test batches. This formulation shifts the central challenge from deciding what to label within a batch to deciding when supervision should be applied over time. To address this challenge, we propose a budget-aware approach WISE-ATTA that allocates supervision over the test stream based on lightweight signals computed online, prioritizing periods where supervision is likely to be most useful. When a batch is selected for supervision, we further employ a drift-based sample selection criterion that targets samples exhibiting ongoing, unconverged adaptation dynamics, enabling effective updates from a single labeled example. We evaluate this approach on synthetic corruptions (ImageNet-C) and natural distribution shifts (ImageNet-R/K/A). Across settings, WISE-ATTA achieves competitive or improved performance compared to recent ATTA methods while requiring substantially fewer labels. Overall, we find that the timing of supervision is a key, yet underexplored, aspect of active test-time adaptation. Code: https://github.com/Muhammad-Huzaifaa/WISE-ATTA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WISE-ATTA 把主动测试时适应 (active test-time adaptation) 重定义为预算受限问题：标签只覆盖一小部分测试批次，核心从「批内选哪些样本标注」变成「何时申请监督」。它用在线计算的轻量信号在测试流上分配标注预算，选中批次后再用基于漂移的样本选择准则挑出仍在未收敛适应动态中的样本，使单个标注样本即可有效更新；在 ImageNet-C 与 ImageNet-R/K/A 上以显著更少的标签取得与近期 ATTA 方法相当或更好的性能。
Motivation: 现有 ATTA 方法隐含假设每个测试批次都能请求监督，在长测试流上标注成本很高；预算受限时挑战从批内选样转移到跨时间决定何时监督，这一时机问题尚未被充分研究。
Method: 提出预算感知的 WISE-ATTA：依据在线计算的轻量信号在测试流上分配监督预算，优先标注监督最可能起作用的时段；批次被选中后，用基于漂移 (drift-based) 的样本选择准则锁定表现出未收敛适应动态的样本，从而用单个标注样本完成更新。
Result: 在合成腐蚀 ImageNet-C 与自然分布偏移 ImageNet-R/K/A 上评测，WISE-ATTA 在多种设置下相对近期 ATTA 方法取得相当或更好的性能，同时所需标签数量显著更少。
Conclusion: 监督的时机是主动测试时适应中关键但被低估的维度：按预算在线选择何时标注、再配合漂移准则选样本，可以在极少标签下维持分布偏移下的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 12
