papers.title: TomoTransformer: Towards a Foundation Model for CT Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Supervised deep learning has advanced sparse-view tomographic reconstruction. However, conventional models, which typically map filtered back-projection (FBP) images or sinograms to clean reconstructions, are brittle under distribution shifts. Because they require retraining whenever projection counts and angles, detector resolutions, or data distributions change, their deployment in real-world applications remains limited. To address this, we introduce TomoTransformer, a transformer-based architecture that treats each \textit{local} filtered projection as an individual token and predicts missing views via self-attention. Crucially, TomoTransformer operates in a \emph{back-projection space} that separates projections across spatial locations, making view interpolation geometrically well-posed and invariant to detector size. This design yields a single foundation model that can process any number of input projections, at arbitrary angular locations and detector dimensions, and query any number of target angles without retraining. Trained on a large-scale dataset spanning diverse medical CT anatomies and natural images, TomoTransformer generalizes effectively across anatomies, materials, and resolutions. Extensive evaluations on several benchmark sparse-view datasets show that TomoTransformer significantly outperforms concurrent multi-purpose models like ViewTrans and matches or exceeds strong protocol-specific baselines, while remaining fully agnostic to the number of input and target projections. Furthermore, the model demonstrates robust zero-shot generalization on real experimental nanoscale brain data collected from an X-ray synchrotron, showcasing its practical utility for real-world applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TomoTransformer 把每条局部滤波投影当作一个 token，用 self-attention 在 back-projection 空间直接预测缺失视角，从而用单一模型处理任意输入投影数、任意角度与探测器尺寸而无需重训。在多个稀疏视角 CT benchmark 上显著优于 ViewTrans 这类多用途模型、匹配或超过 protocol-specific 基线，并在同步辐射 X 射线采集的真实纳米尺度脑数据上实现 zero-shot 泛化。
Motivation: 监督式稀疏视角重建模型把 FBP 图或 sinogram 映射到干净重建，一旦投影数、角度、探测器分辨率或数据分布改变就失效，每次都要重训，实际部署受限。
Method: Transformer 架构将每条 local filtered projection 视为独立 token，用 self-attention 预测缺失视角；在 back-projection 空间操作，把不同空间位置的投影分开，使视角插值几何上适定且对探测器尺寸不变。在覆盖多种医学 CT 解剖与自然图像的大规模数据集上训练。
Result: 在多个 benchmark 稀疏视角数据集上显著优于 ViewTrans 等并发多用途模型，并匹配或超过强 protocol-specific 基线，同时对输入与目标投影数完全无关；在同步辐射 X 射线采集的真实实验纳米尺度脑数据上展示 robust zero-shot 泛化。
Conclusion: 把投影当作 token 并在 back-projection 空间做视角插值，可得到一个跨解剖、材料与分辨率通用、无需重训的 CT 重建 foundation model。

papers.title: Graph-Conditioned On-Policy Agent Distillation from Off-the-Shelf Teachers
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains compact language agents with teacher feedback on student-generated trajectories. In multi-turn tasks, compounding errors can move students beyond the teacher's effective supervision. We introduce Graph-Conditioned On-Policy Agent Distillation (GC-OPD), which enriches an off-the-shelf teacher's scoring context with execution evidence. A graph indexes repeated teacher executions by shared states while preserving complete successful and failed histories. After each student episode, GC-OPD retrieves current-state references or historical alternatives and combines them with student hindsight to score the original thought-action tokens. Using the same original teachers, GC-OPD improves mean success over vanilla OPD from 24.70% to 48.78% on ScienceWorld (4B student), from 53.36% to 85.26% on ALFWorld Unseen, and from 29.10% to 37.65% on WebShop. At matched student sizes, it also achieves higher mean success than every evaluated OPD baseline using GRPO-trained teachers on ScienceWorld and ALFWorld; the strongest such ScienceWorld 4B baseline reaches 46.66%. GC-OPD requires no task-specific teacher optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GC-OPD 用一张按共享状态索引教师执行记录的图，把执行证据（成功与失败历史）注入 off-the-shelf 教师的打分上下文，对学生生成轨迹上的原始 thought-action token 重新打分。在相同教师下，ScienceWorld 4B 学生平均成功率从 vanilla OPD 的 24.70% 提到 48.78%，ALFWorld Unseen 从 53.36% 到 85.26%，WebShop 从 29.10% 到 37.65%。
Motivation: 多轮任务中误差会累积，学生轨迹可能走出教师的有效监督范围，vanilla on-policy distillation 的教师反馈因此失真。
Method: 构建按共享状态索引教师执行的图，保留完整成功与失败历史；每个学生 episode 结束后检索当前状态参考或历史替代方案，与学生 hindsight 结合，对原始 thought-action token 打分，无需针对任务优化教师。
Result: 同一教师下平均成功率：ScienceWorld（4B 学生）24.70% → 48.78%，ALFWorld Unseen 53.36% → 85.26%，WebShop 29.10% → 37.65%；在相同学生规模下高于所有用 GRPO 训练教师的已评估 OPD 基线（ScienceWorld 上该类最强基线 46.66%）。
Conclusion: 把执行证据按状态组织后回灌教师打分，可在不重新优化教师的前提下大幅抬高多轮 agent 蒸馏的成功率。

papers.title: From Learner Behavior to Reusable Skills for Effective and Efficient Learner Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Learner simulation aims to reproduce how a particular learner behaves on new tasks. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate increasingly fine-grained learning behaviors, existing approaches often need to repeatedly process a growing interaction history to reconstruct the learner. This introduces additional context and inference costs and makes the acquired learner-specific simulation capability difficult to reuse across different LLMs. We therefore propose Learner2Skill, which externalizes the simulation capability acquired from historical interactions into a persistent and reusable Simulation Skill. The Skill captures the learner's current learning state and recurring response patterns, evolves as new real interactions arrive, and can be adapted to a new LLM through lightweight executor calibration without reconstructing the learner from scratch. Experiments show that Learner2Skill more faithfully reproduces fine-grained learner behavior while reducing overall token cost, and that the same constructed Skills can be effectively reused across different LLM executors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Learner2Skill，把历史交互中学到的模拟能力外化为持久可复用的 Simulation Skill，记录学习者当前学习状态与反复出现的响应模式，随新真实交互演化，并通过轻量 executor calibration 迁移到新 LLM，无需从零重建学习者。实验显示其更忠实复现细粒度学习者行为并降低总体 token 成本，同一 Skill 可跨不同 LLM executor 复用。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 学习者模拟需反复处理不断增长的交互历史来重建学习者，带来额外上下文与推理成本，且学到的模拟能力难以跨不同 LLM 复用。
Method: Learner2Skill 将模拟能力外化为持久的 Simulation Skill，捕获学习者当前学习状态与反复出现的响应模式；Skill 随新真实交互演化，迁移新 LLM 时只做轻量 executor calibration，而不从零重建学习者。
Result: 实验表明该方法更忠实复现细粒度学习者行为，同时降低总体 token 成本；所构建的同一 Skill 可在不同 LLM executor 之间有效复用。
Conclusion: 把学习者模拟能力外化为可演化、可跨 executor 校准复用的 Skill，是同时改善行为复现保真度与成本效率的路径。

papers.title: ARGOS: Reinforcement Learning-Driven Multidimensional Elasticity for Service Orchestration in the Computing Continuum
papers.abstract_en: Data-intensive services in the Computing Continuum must balance analytics quality, resource usage, and cost across heterogeneous nodes with limited and uneven capacity. This balance becomes especially difficult when resource scaling reaches capacity limits, because changes in demand and cluster pressure must then be absorbed without violating client-defined quality ranges. Existing orchestrators mainly adapt resources, placements, or replicas, while analytics requirements such as coverage, sample, and freshness remain fixed. This article presents ARGOS, the Adaptive Reinforcement Learning-Driven Governance for Orchestrated Services, an end-to-end controller that formulates multidimensional elasticity as a per-request Markov decision process over analytics quality and cluster pressure, supported by capacity-aware admission. ARGOS is evaluated under controlled workloads and time-varying multi-tenant arrivals on a heterogeneous cluster. Across the controlled scenarios, the deep reinforcement learning policies consistently outperform the non-learning baselines and approach the independently tuned best-fixed reference. A separate live evaluation reports improvements over the static midpoint under realistic and saturated arrivals, with no recorded CPU or memory violations but remaining coverage violations. These results support deep reinforcement learning as an adaptive mechanism for multidimensional elasticity when resource scaling alone is insufficient.

papers.title: Embedded Bi-Temporal Building Damage Assessment for On-Board Data Reduction
papers.abstract_en: Rapid assessment of building damage after natural disasters is essential to support emergency response. Earth Observation satellites can acquire relevant imagery shortly after an event, but exploitation is limited by uplink and downlink capacity and by ground-processing latency. We address this with a bi-temporal building damage assessment pipeline built on a siamese detector derived from YOLOX, designed to compress information at both ends of the ground/space link. On the ground, pre-disaster reference images are encoded into a compact latent space -- compressed by up to a factor of 64 -- and uplinked to the satellite. On board, this reference is compared with a fresh post-disaster acquisition so that the downlink carries only actionable object-level products, bounding boxes and damage classes, instead of full scenes. This cuts the data exchanged in both directions, while on xBD the strongly compressed reference still preserves most of the detection performance. Because on-board acquisitions suffer from residual pre/post co-registration errors, we introduce a latent-space shift estimation and correction module that regresses the global offset from the coarse feature level and realigns the post-disaster features before fusion. It substantially improves robustness to de-registration -- especially under large shifts, where fusion-only variants collapse -- while also raising nominal accuracy and remaining compatible with the strongest compression. We finally port the pipeline to two embedded targets, a Xilinx Versal VCK190 and an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, and report hardware performance (latency, throughput, power efficiency). The core detector and its compression port cleanly to both, but the operators needed for long-range robustness survive only on the Jetson GPU, whereas the Versal DPU does not.
papers.comment: 8 pages. Accepted at OBPDC 2026 (International Workshop on On-Board Payload Data Compression), Barcelona, October 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向星地链路的建筑损毁评估流水线：地面把灾前参考影像压进最高 64 倍的紧凑 latent 空间上行，星上用源自 YOLOX 的 siamese 检测器与灾后影像比对，只下传目标框与损毁类别。latent 空间位移估计与校正模块从粗特征层回归全局偏移并在融合前重对齐，显著提升对配准误差的鲁棒性——大偏移下纯融合版本会崩溃——同时抬高标称精度并兼容最强压缩。移植到 Xilinx Versal VCK190 与 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 后，长程鲁棒所需算子只在 Jetson GPU 上存活，Versal DPU 不行。
Motivation: 灾害后建筑损毁快速评估受限于星地上下行带宽与地面处理时延：整景影像上下行代价高，而星上获取又带有残余的灾前/灾后配准误差。
Method: 基于 YOLOX 的 siamese 检测器，两端压缩：地面把灾前参考影像编码进紧凑 latent 空间（最高 64 倍压缩）上行；星上将该参考与灾后新影像比对，只输出目标级 bounding boxes 与损毁类别。新增 latent 空间位移估计与校正模块，从粗特征层回归全局偏移并在融合前重对齐灾后特征；随后移植到 Xilinx Versal VCK190 与 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 并报告时延、吞吐与能效。
Result: 在 xBD 上，强压缩后的参考影像仍保留大部分检测性能；位移校正模块在大偏移下大幅改善鲁棒性（纯融合变体在此崩溃），并同时提高标称精度、兼容最强压缩。硬件移植报告了 latency、throughput、power efficiency：核心检测器与压缩在两块嵌入式目标上都干净移植，长程鲁棒所需算子仅在 Jetson GPU 上存活，Versal DPU 不行。
Conclusion: 把压缩同时做到链路两端并把配准校正放进 latent 空间，可在大幅削减上下行数据的同时保住损毁检测能力；但长程鲁棒算子的部署可行性取决于嵌入式后端，Versal DPU 目前不支持。

papers.title: SafeCoEvo: Co-Evolving Safety Harnesses and Guards for LLM Agents at Test-Time
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents deployed in real-world environments continually encounter new tasks and safety risks, while execution feedback typically becomes available only after each task is completed. However, existing self-evolving approaches commonly rely on multiple rounds of optimization over fixed and repeatedly accessible task distributions, fundamentally differing from test-time adaptation in real-world deployment, where only experience accumulated from past tasks can be used to improve safety decisions on future unseen tasks. To address this limitation, we propose SafeCoEvo, a test-time Harness-Guard co-evolution framework for LLM agent safety that enables the external safety system to continually adapt from accumulated runtime experience. SafeCoEvo jointly improves two complementary safety capabilities at different timescales: S-Harness rapidly externalizes recent runtime experience into updatable explicit safety knowledge that can promptly influence subsequent tasks, while GuardVPO internalizes accumulated runtime safety experience over a longer timescale into parametric risk-judgment capabilities. By combining short-term rapid adaptation with long-term capability consolidation, SafeCoEvo continually improves the agent's safety capabilities, reducing the unsafe outcome rate by 10.05% while improving the task success rate by 12.15% over the strongest baseline, thereby achieving simultaneous gains in safety and task utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SafeCoEvo 提出测试时 Harness-Guard 共同演化框架，让 LLM agent 的外部安全系统只凭过往任务的运行时经验持续适应新任务：S-Harness 把近期经验快速外显为可更新的显式安全知识，GuardVPO 把累积经验长期内化为参数化风险判断能力。相对最强基线，不安全结果率下降 10.05%，任务成功率提升 12.15%，安全与任务效用同时改善。
Motivation: 现有自演化方法依赖对固定、可反复访问的任务分布做多轮优化，与真实部署中只能用过去任务经验改进未来未见任务的测试时适应不符。
Method: 双时间尺度协同：S-Harness 将近期运行时经验外显为可更新的显式安全知识，即时影响后续任务；GuardVPO 在更长尺度上把累积运行时安全经验内化为参数化风险判断能力；两者结合实现快速适应与长期能力固化。
Result: 相对最强基线，unsafe outcome rate 下降 10.05%，task success rate 提升 12.15%，安全与任务效用同时提升。
Conclusion: 把短期经验外显与长期能力内化分工到不同时间尺度，可在测试时同时改善 LLM agent 的安全性和任务成功率，无需对固定任务分布多轮优化。

papers.title: Unifying Distributional Training for One-Step Visual Generation
papers.abstract_en: Distributional training provides collective supervision for one-step visual generation by matching real and generated features in frozen representation spaces. We introduce a unified theoretical framework that separates distribution modeling from matching discrepancy and connects global objectives to pointwise feature updates through Wasserstein gradient flow. Under this framework, FD-Loss and Gaussian-kernel Drifting are recovered through Gaussian optimal transport and kernel-density-based KL matching, respectively. The framework motivates MGFlow, which models feature distributions with Gaussian mixtures at an adjustable granularity between global moments and sample-based representations. MGFlow supports both optimal transport and score-based matching, and couples mass-constrained sample assignment with paired component updates to address mode collapse that mixture expressivity alone does not resolve. On ImageNet $256\times256$, MGFlow substantially surpasses the FD-Loss baseline, achieving state-of-the-art results with 1.45 $\mathrm{FDr}^6$ on pMF-H and 1.64 on JiT-H. For text-to-image generation, MGFlow post-trains FLUX.2 [klein] 4B into a one-step generator that outperforms the original four-step model on both GenEval and PickScore.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出统一分布训练框架，用 Wasserstein gradient flow 把全局分布目标与逐点特征更新打通，并在该框架下恢复 FD-Loss 与 Gaussian-kernel Drifting。由此导出的 MGFlow 用可调粒度的 Gaussian mixture 建模特征分布，配合质量约束的样本分配与成对分量更新来抑制 mode collapse，在 ImageNet 256×256 上以 1.45 FDr⁶ (pMF-H) 和 1.64 (JiT-H) 取得 SOTA。
Motivation: 一步视觉生成的分布训练缺少统一理论：全局分布目标如何转成逐点特征更新不清晰，且 mixture 表达力本身不足以解决 mode collapse。
Method: 框架把分布建模与匹配差异分离，经 Wasserstein gradient flow 连接全局目标与逐点特征更新；据此恢复 FD-Loss（Gaussian optimal transport）与 Gaussian-kernel Drifting（kernel-density KL matching），并提出 MGFlow——用可调粒度 Gaussian mixture 建模特征分布，支持 optimal transport 与 score-based matching 两种匹配，以质量约束样本分配加成对分量更新处理 mode collapse。
Result: ImageNet 256×256 上 MGFlow 大幅超过 FD-Loss 基线，取得 SOTA：pMF-H 1.45 FDr⁶，JiT-H 1.64 FDr⁶。文生图方向将 FLUX.2 [klein] 4B 后训练为一步生成器，在 GenEval 与 PickScore 上均超过原四步模型。
Conclusion: 把分布建模与匹配差异解耦并用 gradient flow 统一，可在一步生成上同时超过 FD-Loss 基线并把多步模型压到单步；mode collapse 需要显式的分配与更新约束，而非只靠 mixture 表达力。

papers.title: Provable Benefits of Regularization: Fast Rates for Adversarial Imitation Learning
papers.abstract_en: We study adversarial imitation learning (AIL), in which an agent learns to imitate expert demonstrations by optimizing a policy against an adversarial reward that distinguishes expert and learner behavior. Historically, reward regularization and entropy-based policy regularization are key components of empirically successful methods such as GAIL and LS-IQ, yet their finite-sample benefits remain underexplored. We establish fast rates for jointly regularized AIL in finite-horizon Markov decision processes with general function approximation. Our model-free algorithm, Dually Regularized AIL, combines KL policy regularization with a quadratic reward penalty weighted by expert and learner occupancies. With K online episodes and N expert trajectories, we prove a $\widetilde{O}\left(\frac{1}{K}+\frac{1}{N}\right)$ bound on the regularized imitation gap for fixed regularization parameters. Our analysis combines an online mirror descent construction for general convex reward classes to control estimation error from finite expert data and stochastic learner feedback, with a sharp analysis of optimistic KL-regularized policy learning. To the best of our knowledge, Dually Regularized AIL is the first algorithm to simultaneously achieve $\widetilde{O}\left(\frac{1}ε\right)$ sample complexity in both expert demonstrations and online interactions for this regularized AIL objective, even with stochastic experts. These results provide a rigorous characterization of the complementary statistical benefits of reward and policy regularization in AIL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在有限时域 MDP 与一般函数逼近下，对对抗模仿学习 (AIL) 同时施加 KL 策略正则与按专家/学习者占用测度加权的二次奖励惩罚，提出免模型算法 Dually Regularized AIL。固定正则参数时，正则化模仿间隙随在线回合数 K 与专家轨迹数 N 呈 Õ(1/K + 1/N) 增长，且是首个在专家演示与在线交互两侧同时达到 Õ(1/ε) 样本复杂度的该类正则化 AIL 算法。
Motivation: GAIL、LS-IQ 等经验上成功的 AIL 方法长期依赖奖励正则与基于熵的策略正则，但它们的有限样本收益缺乏理论刻画，尤其在一般函数逼近与随机专家设定下。
Method: 提出免模型的 Dually Regularized AIL：对策略加 KL 正则，对奖励加按专家与学习者占用测度加权的二次惩罚；分析上用面向一般凸奖励类的在线镜像 descent (online mirror descent) 控制有限专家数据与随机学习者反馈带来的估计误差，再配合对乐观 KL 正则策略学习的精细分析。
Result: 固定正则参数下，正则化模仿间隙的界为 Õ(1/K + 1/N)，K 为在线回合数、N 为专家轨迹数；由此得到在专家演示与在线交互两侧同时 Õ(1/ε) 的样本复杂度，即使专家是随机的也成立。
Conclusion: 奖励正则与策略正则在 AIL 中提供互补的统计收益，联合正则化可在一般函数逼近的有限时域 MDP 中得到快速收敛率。

summary_sections.motivation: GAIL、LS-IQ 等经验上成功的 AIL 方法长期依赖奖励正则与基于熵的策略正则，但它们的有限样本收益缺乏理论刻画，尤其在一般函数逼近与随机专家设定下。
summary_sections.method: 提出免模型的 Dually Regularized AIL：对策略加 KL 正则，对奖励加按专家与学习者占用测度加权的二次惩罚；分析上用面向一般凸奖励类的在线镜像 descent (online mirror descent) 控制有限专家数据与随机学习者反馈带来的估计误差，再配合对乐观 KL 正则策略学习的精细分析。
summary_sections.result: 固定正则参数下，正则化模仿间隙的界为 Õ(1/K + 1/N)，K 为在线回合数、N 为专家轨迹数；由此得到在专家演示与在线交互两侧同时 Õ(1/ε) 的样本复杂度，即使专家是随机的也成立。
summary_sections.conclusion: 奖励正则与策略正则在 AIL 中提供互补的统计收益，联合正则化可在一般函数逼近的有限时域 MDP 中得到快速收敛率。

papers.title: From Migration to Calibration: Preserving Agent Capabilities across Models, Jurisdictions, and Scale
papers.abstract_en: Deploying, migrating, or scaling an agent can change its model, harness, infrastructure, application, and intended users. We formulate agent calibration as standards-first adaptation: define basic-capability, technical-environment, and user-context standards; diagnose gaps; generate and apply revisions; and recheck the same standards within fixed budgets. These standard families interact across information, harness, and user-acceptance layers. Source behavior is diagnostic, not a perfect reference or capability ceiling: model replacement can turn correct answers into errors or errors into correct answers. Qualification requires all mandatory known tests, actual end-to-end deployment paths, hard predicates, and declared task/user minimums to pass; aggregate gains cannot erase hard failures. Revisions may change tools or harnesses, add demonstrations and task descriptions, or use validated target-native trajectories to train a policy, controller, or compact skill model served through the harness. Semantic checkpoints validate executed artifacts, localize repair, and revalidate dependencies. The loop exports reusable configuration or training artifacts with a qualification record, while final task outputs undergo their own checks. Independent factual evidence precedes relative preference judgment; DPO and GRPO optimize policies rather than establish truth. Frozen held-out evaluation tests generalization and compares equal-budget target-native optimization. We specify an automatic calibration tool using limited authorized user trajectories and tests as future work. The framework and tool remain proposals; confirmatory empirical validation is pending.
papers.comment: 40 pages, 8 figures. Methodological proposal; no confirmatory empirical results reported. CPU controller update/export example is implemented on synthetic data only; the integrated automatic RL calibration tool, consultant workflow, trajectory-distilled skill service, and manufacturing experiments remain future work
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 agent 迁移/扩容后的校准重写为 standards-first adaptation：先定义基本能力、技术环境、用户上下文三类标准，再诊断差距、生成并应用修订、在固定预算内复检同一套标准。核心论断是源模型行为只作诊断信号而非能力上限，资格认定必须让全部强制已知测试、真实端到端部署路径、硬谓词与声明的任务/用户下限同时通过，聚合增益不能抵消硬失败。
Motivation: 部署、迁移或扩容 agent 会同时更换模型、harness、基础设施、应用与目标用户，源模型的正确行为可能变错、错误行为可能变对，缺少以标准为准绳的校准流程就无法判定迁移后是否仍合格。
Method: 框架按标准族分层（information、harness、user-acceptance），修订手段包括改工具或 harness、补演示与任务描述、用验证过的 target-native 轨迹训练 policy/controller/紧凑 skill model 并经 harness 提供；以 semantic checkpoints 校验已执行产物、定位修复并复验依赖，导出可复用配置或训练产物加 qualification record；主张独立事实证据先于相对偏好判断（DPO、GRPO 只优化 policy 不确立真值），并用 frozen held-out 评估检验泛化、在等预算 target-native 优化间比较。
Result: 这是方法性提案，作者明示尚无确证性实证结果；CPU controller 更新/导出示例仅在合成数据上实现，自动 RL 校准工具、顾问工作流、trajectory-distilled skill service 与制造实验均列为后续工作，框架与工具仍属提案、确证性验证待完成。
Conclusion: agent 校准应以标准为先、以硬谓词和端到端路径的全通过为资格门槛，而不是看聚合指标提升；该主张目前只有形式化描述与合成示例支撑，尚待实证验证。

papers.title: Automated Feature Engineering, AutoML, and Decision-Focused Learning for Improved Energy Consumption Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: The rising cost and demand for energy, together with environmental sustainability goals, create major challenges for energy management. Energy Consumption Forecasting (ECF) supports planning by predicting future consumption, but Machine Learning (ML) models for ECF often depend on expert-driven Feature Engineering (FE). This thesis addresses that dependence through three contributions. First, it establishes and evaluates a comprehensive FE pipeline for ECF and investigates domain-specific features. Second, it introduces AutoEnergy, a domain-tailored automated FE algorithm that generates interpretable features from timestamps and lagged consumption and integrates with AutoML for end-to-end ECF modelling. Across eighteen real-world energy datasets spanning residential, commercial, industrial, renewable, and grid domains, AutoEnergy reduces forecasting error by 19.52%-84.72% relative to baseline AutoML and established automated FE methods, while running 1.31-4.41 times faster, with gains varying by dataset. Third, AutoEnergy is integrated with Decision-Focused Learning (DFL) for a Battery Energy Storage System problem, jointly forecasting electricity prices and demand while optimising charging and discharging decisions. On a real-world UK property dataset, this approach reduces operating costs by 22.9%-56.5% compared with the same DFL models without automated FE. Overall, the results show that domain-specific automated FE can reduce reliance on manual feature design, improve forecasting accuracy, and translate predictive gains into measurable operational benefits in energy management.
papers.comment: PhD thesis, School of Computer Science, University of Nottingha, United Kingdom
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AutoEnergy 是面向能耗预测 (ECF) 的领域定制自动特征工程算法，从时间戳与滞后用电量生成可解释特征并接入 AutoML 端到端建模。在 18 个真实能源数据集上，相对基线 AutoML 与已有自动 FE 方法，预测误差降低 19.52%–84.72%，运行快 1.31–4.41 倍；与 Decision-Focused Learning 结合后，英国真实物业数据集的运行成本降低 22.9%–56.5%。
Motivation: 能耗预测的机器学习模型长期依赖专家手工设计特征，人工成本高且难以跨住宅、商业、工业、可再生与电网等域复用。
Method: 三部分贡献：建立并评估 ECF 的完整 FE 流水线并考察领域特定特征；提出 AutoEnergy，从时间戳与滞后消费量生成可解释特征，与 AutoML 集成做端到端建模；再把 AutoEnergy 接入 Decision-Focused Learning，对电池储能系统联合预测电价与需求并优化充放电决策。
Result: 在 18 个覆盖住宅、商业、工业、可再生与电网的真实数据集上，AutoEnergy 相对基线 AutoML 和已有自动 FE 方法降低预测误差 19.52%–84.72%，速度快 1.31–4.41 倍，增益随数据集而异；在真实英国物业数据集上，AutoEnergy + DFL 相对不含自动 FE 的同款 DFL 模型降低运行成本 22.9%–56.5%。
Conclusion: 领域定制的自动特征工程可以替代大量手工特征设计，把预测精度提升转化为能耗管理中可度量的运行成本收益。

papers.title: Transform-Aligned Learned Features for Lossy Point Cloud Attribute Compression
papers.abstract_en: Transform-based methods provide an effective framework for point cloud attribute compression by representing attributes as transform coefficients. Introducing learned spatial context into this framework requires mapping spatial representations to the transform domain, but this known basis change is often left for the network to learn implicitly. We propose Transform-Aligned Learned Features (TALF) by applying the attribute transform to learned spatial representations, explicitly aligning them with the coding targets. Our analysis shows that the resulting features exactly represent the first-order prediction term of a smooth nonlinear model, with a bounded Taylor remainder. We integrate TALF into a transform-based attribute codec with explicit coefficient prediction and conditional residual entropy modeling under a unified coefficient-domain rate--distortion objective, while retaining explicit quantization-step control. Extensive experiments across three benchmark datasets and multiple transform bases demonstrate that TALF improves rate--distortion performance over conventional and learned baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TALF 把属性变换直接作用在学到的空间表示上，使特征与变换域编码目标显式对齐；分析表明该特征精确对应光滑非线性模型的一阶预测项，Taylor 余项有界。在三个基准数据集与多种变换基上，TALF 相对传统与学习型基线改善率失真性能。
Motivation: 变换类点云属性编码中，把空间表示映射到变换域这一已知基变换常被留给网络隐式学习，导致学到的上下文与编码目标不对齐。
Method: 提出 Transform-Aligned Learned Features (TALF)：对学到的空间表示施加属性变换使其与编码目标对齐；集成进变换类属性编解码器，含显式系数预测与条件残差熵建模，统一在 coefficient-domain 率失真目标下优化，并保留显式量化步长控制。
Result: 在三个 benchmark 数据集与多种变换基上的实验显示，TALF 相对传统与学习型基线提升率失真性能；理论分析给出特征精确表示光滑非线性模型的一阶预测项且 Taylor 余项有界。
Conclusion: 把基变换显式施加于学习特征而非让网络隐式学习，可使上下文与编码目标对齐并改善点云属性压缩的率失真权衡。

papers.title: MASCIT: A Mask-Aware State Space Classifier for Naturally Irregular Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Naturally irregular time series combine asynchronous observations, missing values, unequal lengths, and nonuniform sampling, while dense adapters can discard temporal structure. We propose a mask-aware state space classifier for irregular time series (MASCIT), which supplies observation masks to the encoder and excludes invalid steps from gated temporal aggregation. Across 34 irregular time series datasets, MASCIT yielded the strongest aggregate point estimate and was the only evaluated neural model with three-seed results on every dataset. MASCIT retained the lowest point rank across six overlapping irregularity indicators, while factorial ablations favored partial over full selectivity. These results support selective state space models as effective, executable backbones for naturally irregular time series classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MASCIT 把观测掩码直接喂给状态空间编码器，并在门控时间聚合中剔除无效时间步，用于天然不规则时间序列分类。在 34 个不规则时间序列数据集上取得最强聚合点估计，且是唯一在全部数据集上都有三种子结果的被评估神经模型，在六个重叠不规则性指标上保持最低点排序。
Motivation: 天然不规则时间序列同时包含异步观测、缺失值、不等长与非均匀采样，稠密适配器 (dense adapter) 会丢掉时间结构，需要能显式处理无效时间步的骨干网络。
Method: MASCIT 将观测掩码输入状态空间编码器，并在门控时间聚合 (gated temporal aggregation) 中排除无效步；用因子消融 (factorial ablations) 比较选择性 (selectivity) 的部分设置与全设置，并以三种子重复在 34 个数据集上评测。
Result: 在 34 个不规则时间序列数据集上，MASCIT 的聚合点估计最强，且是唯一在每个数据集上都有三种子结果的被评估神经模型；在六个重叠不规则性指标上保持最低点排序；因子消融支持部分选择性优于完全选择性。
Conclusion: 选择性状态空间模型 (selective state space model) 可作为天然不规则时间序列分类的有效且可执行的骨干，掩码感知的聚合比稠密适配更合适。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: MaskCoFT: Masked Co-Adaptive Fine-Tuning for Memory-Efficient MoE Inference
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models often exceed the memory of a single GPU. Expert offloading keeps most experts in host memory and loads them on demand, so decoding speed depends on how many experts each token must fetch. Caching and prefetching reduce this cost only as far as the routing allows. Router-only fine-tuning can reshape the routing to reuse experts, but it keeps the experts frozen, so they cannot adapt to the tokens the new routing sends them. We propose MaskCoFT, a masked co-adaptive fine-tuning method that trains routers and experts together with the cross-entropy loss alone. During fine-tuning, a learnable binary mask restricts the Top-K routing of each layer to a subset of experts, and the experts adapt to the tokens redirected to them. At inference, the learned mask becomes a soft prior that re-ranks experts, so every expert remains selectable. We simulate a GPU cache of 4 experts per layer for Mixtral-8x7B and 12 for DeepSeek-V2-Lite. MaskCoFT cuts expert fetches per token by 23.7% and 10.1% relative to the base model. In real offloading system serving, it lowers the time per output token by up to 16.4% and 5.5%, respectively. Its average accuracy over nine benchmarks stays above the base model by 0.92 and 0.53 points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MaskCoFT 用可学习二值掩码把 MoE 每层 Top-K 路由限制到专家子集，同时微调 router 与 expert，推理时掩码退化为对全部专家的软先验重排。在模拟每层 4 专家 GPU 缓存的 Mixtral-8x7B 上，每 token 专家取数相对基座降 23.7%，真实 offloading 服务中每输出 token 时间最多降 16.4%，九基准平均精度反升 0.92 分。
Motivation: MoE 语言模型显存超出单卡，专家 offloading 下解码速度取决于每 token 需取的专家数；只调 router 能让路由复用专家，但专家被冻结，无法适应新路由送来的 token。
Method: 微调时用可学习二值掩码约束每层 Top-K 路由只在专家子集内选择，router 与 expert 联合训练，损失只用交叉熵；推理时掩码转为对全部专家的软先验重排，保证每个专家仍可被选中。
Result: 模拟每层 4 专家（Mixtral-8x7B）与 12 专家（DeepSeek-V2-Lite）GPU 缓存：每 token 专家取数相对基座分别降 23.7% 与 10.1%；真实 offloading 系统服务中每输出 token 时间最多降 16.4% 与 5.5%；九个基准上平均精度分别高出基座 0.92 与 0.53 分。
Conclusion: 让 router 与 expert 在掩码约束下共同微调，可以在不牺牲平均精度的前提下减少专家取数并缩短 offloading 解码时间。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Unlocking Geodesic Gromov-Wasserstein Distances for 3D Modeling
papers.abstract_en: \textit{Gromov-Wasserstein Distances} (GWDs) provide quantitative ways of comparing probabilistic distributions defined on different metric spaces by applying techniques from the optimal transport theory. As such, GWD can be potentially useful in a large variety of applications ranging from graph matching problems to 3D object detection. However its practical use at scale is significantly limited by cubic time complexity computations involving dense intra-space distance matrices. Even though in the Euclidean metric spaces several techniques (e.g. involving scalable kernel methods) were proposed to address it, to the best of our knowledge, analogous techniques for general geodesic distances on manifolds, or shortest-path distance on graphs in their discretized variants, were not developed. In this paper, we present \textbf{E}fficient \textbf{G}eodesic \textbf{Gro}mov-\textbf{W}asserstein methods (EGGroW), a new class of efficient algorithms designed to calculate geodesic Gromov-Wasserstein distances with entropic Sinkhorn-like approaches, leveraging recently introduced \textit{GenusSink} methods \citep{genussink} and the theory of random features. We provide important downstream applications, namely: 3D pose estimation and 3D template detection. In the latter setting, we formulate a partial 3D template recovery as a staged problem: capacity-constrained scene selection is followed by semi-relaxed recovery of template visibility and correspondence. Our empirical findings show that EGGroW provides accurate solutions when standard Euclidean-based techniques fail and is characterized by light computational footprint, as our theoretical analysis predicts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 EGGroW：用 entropic Sinkhorn 类算法与随机特征 (random features) 高效计算流形测地线与图最短路径上的 Gromov-Wasserstein 距离，绕开稠密距离矩阵带来的三次复杂度。在 3D 姿态估计与 3D 模板检测上给出准确解，计算开销轻，与理论分析一致。
Motivation: Gromov-Wasserstein 距离可用于图匹配到 3D 目标检测，但其计算依赖稠密空间内距离矩阵、复杂度为三次，难以规模化；欧氏空间已有可扩展核方法，而一般流形测地线与图最短路径的离散版本此前没有对应技术。
Method: 提出 Efficient Geodesic Gromov-Wasserstein 方法 (EGGroW)，用 entropic Sinkhorn 类算法计算测地 GWD，结合 GenusSink 方法与随机特征理论；下游任务为 3D 姿态估计与 3D 模板检测，后者把部分 3D 模板恢复拆成两阶段：容量受限的场景选择，再对模板可见性与对应关系做半松弛恢复。
Result: 经验结果显示 EGGroW 在标准欧氏技术失效的场景仍给出准确解，且计算开销轻，与论文的理论分析预测一致。
Conclusion: 测地 GWD 可以用 Sinkhorn 加随机特征的方式算得又快又准，从而把 GWD 扩展到流形与图上的 3D 姿态估计和模板检测任务。

papers.title: $T^5$: Twin-Critic Training for Token-Level Thoughts in Reinforcement Mid-Training
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement mid-training lets language models learn internal thoughts from unlabeled text, but efficient token-level credit assignment remains challenging. Existing group-relative methods require costly repeated generation. Learned critics offer single-rollout feedback, but accurate return prediction alone does not ensure reliable policy updates. Our analysis shows how training--inference mismatch and PPO clipping prevent a common offset in advantage estimates from cancelling out, introducing additional update drift. We propose \tfour{}, a twin-critic method that calibrates token-level advantages from a single generated trajectory. After warmup and held-out qualification, the critics provide two advantage estimates, combined using action-dependent weights learned through a conditional-moment saddle-point objective. This objective brings the average advantage at each prefix toward zero, while a signal-retention constraint prevents the correction from erasing the learning signal. Sharing information across text positions avoids repeated sampling of each prefix. Theoretically, we characterize optimal mixing under the signal-retention constraint and establish an upper bound on residual mean-induced drift. Experiments show that, compared with the state-of-the-art critic-free method, \tfour{} improves mean benchmark performance by 7.8\% and reduces mean training-step time by up to 63.4\%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: T$^5$ (Twin-Critic Training) 用两个 critic 从单条生成轨迹校准 token 级 advantage：经 warmup 与 held-out qualification 后，两路估计按条件矩鞍点目标学到的动作相关权重混合，把每个 prefix 的平均 advantage 拉向零，同时用 signal-retention 约束保住学习信号。相比 SOTA 的 critic-free 方法，平均基准性能提升 7.8%，平均训练步时间最多降低 63.4%。
Motivation: 强化中训练里 token 级 credit assignment 昂贵：group-relative 方法需重复采样，单 critic 虽能单轨迹反馈，但训练-推理失配与 PPO clipping 使 advantage 的公共偏移无法抵消，引入额外更新漂移。
Method: T$^5$ 训练两个 critic，经 warmup 与 held-out qualification 后各给出一路 advantage 估计，用条件矩鞍点目标 (conditional-moment saddle-point objective) 学出动作相关权重进行混合，使每个 prefix 的平均 advantage 趋于零；辅以 signal-retention 约束防止修正抹掉学习信号，并跨文本位置共享信息以避免对每个 prefix 重复采样。
Result: 理论上刻画了 signal-retaining 约束下的最优混合并给出残余均值诱导漂移的上界；实验中相对 SOTA critic-free 方法平均基准性能提升 7.8%，平均训练步时间最多降低 63.4%。
Conclusion: 准确的 return 预测本身不足以保证可靠策略更新，用双 critic 校准 advantage 的公共偏移即可同时提升性能并大幅压缩训练步耗时。

papers.title: What Does a ProcGen Generalization Gap Measure? Action Rules, Residual Entropy, and the Missing Random Floor
papers.abstract_en: A generalization gap in reinforcement learning, return on training levels minus return on held-out levels, is usually reported without a reference point. We argue that it should be read against a measured random floor: the return of a uniform-random policy on the same levels under the same evaluation harness. On eight ProcGen environments with PPO at a compute-limited budget (8M steps, 16 parallel environments; three games extended to 25M), the floor changes what standard numbers mean. The test-time action rule decides which policy is measured: in miner, the sampled policy scores 5.1x the floor on held-out levels while its argmax scores below it in every run, and greedy evaluation places two environments significantly below the floor. Used as a convergence diagnostic, raw policy entropy flags six of eight environments, but 32-66% of that entropy lies on actions with identical effects; against the floor, five of eight sampled policies are clearly above it on held-out levels and heist's is not distinguishable from it. An audit of twelve ProcGen codebases finds that nine sample test-time actions with no explicit choice at the evaluation call site. We recommend that every reported gap state its action rule, seed its evaluation and specify its tests before analysis, and report the floor on both level sets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ProcGen 泛化差距必须对照同一评测框架下均匀随机策略的实测随机地板 (random floor) 来读，否则数字没有参照点。测试时动作规则决定被测的是哪个策略：miner 中采样策略在留出关卡上得分为地板的 5.1 倍，而其 argmax 每次运行都低于地板；贪心评测让两个环境显著低于地板。作者建议报告差距时写明动作规则、预先固定评测种子与检验，并在训练/留出两套关卡上都报告地板。
Motivation: RL 论文报告的泛化差距（训练关卡回报减留出关卡回报）通常没有参照点，读者无法判断留出关卡上的回报是高于还是低于随机策略水平，而测试时动作规则的差异会让同一策略得到完全不同的读数。
Method: 在 8 个 ProcGen 环境上用 PPO、算力受限预算（8M 步、16 个并行环境，其中 3 个游戏延长到 25M）测量均匀随机策略在同一关卡与同一评测框架下的回报作为随机地板；对比采样与 argmax 两种测试时动作规则，用原始策略熵作收敛诊断并扣除动作效果等价部分，另审计 12 个 ProcGen 代码库的评测调用点。
Result: miner 中采样策略在留出关卡上得分为地板的 5.1 倍，其 argmax 在每次运行中都低于地板；贪心评测使两个环境显著低于地板。原始策略熵在 8 个环境中点亮 6 个，但其中 32–66% 的熵落在动作效果相同的动作上；对照地板，8 个采样策略中 5 个在留出关卡上明确高于地板，heist 的与地板无法区分。12 个 ProcGen 代码库中 9 个在评测调用点直接采样测试时动作且无显式选择。
Conclusion: 泛化差距只有对照随机地板并写明测试时动作规则才有意义；评测应预先固定种子与检验，并在两套关卡上同时报告地板，否则 argmax 与采样的差异足以颠倒结论。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: AECSF: Adaptive Ensemble Conditional Score Filtering for High-Dimensional Nonlinear Data Assimilation
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian state estimation for high-dimensional nonlinear dynamical systems entails a fundamental tension between statistical fidelity and computational tractability, as particle weights can collapse, while Gaussian ensemble updates can miss non-Gaussian posterior structure. Score-based diffusion filters offer a sampling-based alternative, but existing training-free score filters often rely on heuristic likelihood corrections, which can compromise posterior accuracy by neglecting uncertainty about the system state associated with each noisy reverse particle. To address these issues, we propose AECSF, a training-free adaptive ensemble conditional score filter. AECSF constructs an analytically tractable score estimator from the conditional Tweedie identity, which recasts noisy posterior score estimation as estimating the conditional mean of the system state given a noisy reverse particle and the observation. To estimate these conditional means efficiently, AECSF employs a shared adaptive weighted proposal ensemble, while particle-specific conditional weights yield an estimate for each noisy reverse particle without separate proposal sampling. The proposal ensemble is updated using reverse-particle information within the same reverse-diffusion run to improve conditional-mean estimation. Theoretically, we characterize when a fixed weighted proposal measure yields the exact noisy posterior score. Under stated assumptions, we establish a bound relating conditional-mean estimation errors to reverse-sampling endpoint error. Numerical experiments demonstrate that AECSF improves the accuracy of posterior sampling and nonlinear filtering in high-dimensional problems with limited forecast ensembles.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AECSF 是免训练的自适应集合条件分数滤波器，用条件 Tweedie 恒等式把含噪后验 score 估计改写为「给定含噪反向粒子与观测时系统状态的条件均值」估计，并用共享的自适应加权提议集合一次性为每个反向粒子算出粒子专属条件权重。理论上给出加权提议测度给出精确含噪后验 score 的条件，并在给定假设下建立条件均值估计误差到反向采样端点误差的界；数值实验显示它在预报集合受限的高维问题上提高后验采样与非线性滤波精度。
Motivation: 高维非线性动力系统的贝叶斯状态估计中，粒子权重会塌缩，而高斯集合更新会漏掉非高斯后验结构；已有免训练 score filter 依赖启发式似然修正，忽略每个含噪反向粒子对应的系统状态不确定性，损害后验精度。
Method: AECSF 由条件 Tweedie 恒等式构造解析可处理的 score 估计器，把含噪后验 score 估计转为条件均值估计；用共享的自适应加权提议集合高效估计这些条件均值，粒子专属条件权重使每个含噪反向粒子无需单独采样提议即可得到估计；提议集合在同一轮反向扩散内用反向粒子信息更新以改进条件均值估计。
Result: 理论刻画了固定加权提议测度何时给出精确含噪后验 score，并在给定假设下建立条件均值估计误差与反向采样端点误差之间的界；数值实验表明 AECSF 在预报集合受限的高维问题上提升后验采样与非线性滤波精度。
Conclusion: 免训练的 score filter 可以靠解析的条件 Tweedie score 估计与共享自适应提议集合，绕开启发式似然修正，同时保住高维非线性滤波的后验精度。

papers.title: Efficient Support Recovery of Mixtures of Sparse Linear Classifiers with Fewer Measurements
papers.abstract_en: The support recovery problem in mixture of linear classifiers aims to identify the features relevant to the underlying decision rules when data is generated by a mixture of several linear decision rules. In particular, the goal is to recover the support (nonzero coordinates) of $l$ unknown $k$-sparse vectors from sign measurements. Each measurement is generated by selecting one of the $l$ vectors uniformly at random, and returning the sign of its inner product with a chosen measurement vector. In this paper, we propose adaptive and non-adaptive schemes that significantly improve upon prior results by simultaneously reducing the number of measurements and achieving sublinear decoding time. In particular, our adaptive constructions substantially reduce measurements compared to existing approaches, while also lowering decoding complexity from super-quadratic to sublinear in the ambient dimension. We further provide a non-adaptive scheme that improves previous measurement bounds while maintaining efficient decoding. Overall, our approach yields a more efficient trade-off between sample complexity and decoding time for support recovery in mixture models compared to previously known methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线性分类器混合模型的符号测量下做支撑恢复（support recovery），提出自适应与非自适应方案，同时减少测量数并把解码时间从环境维度的超二次降到次线性。自适应构造相较已有方法大幅降低测量数，非自适应方案在保持高效解码的同时改进测量界，整体给出样本复杂度与解码时间之间更优的折中。
Motivation: 数据由若干线性决策规则混合生成时，要从符号测量中恢复 l 个未知 k 稀疏向量的支撑；已有方法测量数偏多且解码复杂度随环境维度超二次增长，样本与时间开销都不划算。
Method: 提出自适应与非自适应两套测量方案：每次测量随机选取 l 个向量之一，返回其与所选测量向量内积的符号，据此恢复各向量的非零坐标；解码算法设计为环境维度次线性时间。
Result: 自适应构造相较现有方法显著减少测量数，并把解码复杂度从环境维度的超二次降到次线性；非自适应方案在保持高效解码的同时改进了先前的测量界。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 混合稀疏线性分类器的支撑恢复可以在更少测量与次线性解码时间下完成，样本复杂度与解码时间的折中优于已知方法。

papers.title: ADATEX4D: adaptive texture capacity allocation for 4D gaussian splatting
papers.abstract_en: Textured Gaussians improve local appearance capacity, but assigning the same texture resolution to every primitive wastes storage on low-detail or weakly visible regions. We introduce AdaTex4D, an adaptive texture-capacity module for deformation-based 4D Gaussian Splatting. Each Gaussian carries packed RGBA triplanes whose two axes grow independently according to visibility normalized screen-space gradients and deformed local scales. Experiments on N3DV and PanopticSports show that AdaTex4D reduces texture storage by more than half while preserving reconstruction quality. Under fixed memory budgets, adaptive allocation also improves quality over uniform texture assignment and reduces overall model and peak memory. These results show that dynamic, anisotropic texture allocation provides a more efficient way to distribute local appearance capacity in 4D Gaussian representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdaTex4D 为基于形变的 4D Gaussian Splatting 引入自适应纹理容量分配：每个 Gaussian 携带打包的 RGBA triplanes，两条轴依据可见性归一化的屏幕空间梯度与形变局部尺度独立增长。在 N3DV 与 PanopticSports 上纹理存储减少一半以上且保持重建质量，固定内存预算下优于均匀纹理分配并降低整体模型与峰值内存。
Motivation: 对所有 primitive 统一分配相同纹理分辨率会在低细节或弱可见区域浪费存储，使 4D Gaussian 表示的局部外观容量分配低效。
Method: AdaTex4D 是面向 deformation-based 4D Gaussian Splatting 的自适应纹理容量模块：每个 Gaussian 携带 packed RGBA triplanes，其两条轴按可见性归一化的屏幕空间梯度 (visibility normalized screen-space gradients) 和形变局部尺度 (deformed local scales) 独立增长，在固定内存预算下替代均匀纹理分配。
Result: 在 N3DV 与 PanopticSports 上，AdaTex4D 使纹理存储减少一半以上 (more than half) 同时保持重建质量；在固定内存预算下，自适应分配相比均匀纹理分配提升质量，并降低整体模型与峰值内存。
Conclusion: 动态、各向异性的纹理分配是 4D Gaussian 表示中更高效的局部外观容量分配方式，可在同等内存下换取更高质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Repurposing Pre-trained LLMs as High Fidelity Continuous Text Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Next-token prediction has enabled highly fluent autoregressive language models, but it represents global structure only indirectly through sequential factorization. In contrast, high-fidelity autoencoders have become a standard primitive in image generation, enabling generative models to operate over continuous latent spaces; text lacks a comparably faithful continuous representation. We propose LLMAE, a method for repurposing a pretrained decoder-only language model as a continuous text autoencoder by exposing the activations of an intermediate layer as a fixed-length latent bottleneck. LLMAE achieves this interface with structured attention masks and LoRA adaptation, leveraging the generative prior of the original LLM. Across two backbones (270M Gemma 3 and 0.5B Qwen2.5), LLMAE reconstructs sequences up to 1024 tokens with high accuracy, reproducing up to 97% of documents verbatim. We demonstrate downstream utility by training a lightweight diffusion model that generates detailed image captions directly in the frozen LLMAE latent space. By mapping text into a fixed-length continuous latent space, our approach provides an effective substrate for downstream adaptation while benefiting from the fluency of the original LLM. Code and models are available at https://github.com/arkanath/LLMAE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLMAE 把预训练 decoder-only LLM 改造成连续文本自编码器：暴露中间层激活作为定长 latent bottleneck，用结构化 attention mask 与 LoRA 适配，在 270M Gemma 3 与 0.5B Qwen2.5 上重建最长 1024 token 的序列，最高 97% 文档逐字复现，并在冻结 latent 空间上训练轻量扩散模型生成详细图像描述。
Motivation: 图像生成已有高保真自编码器提供连续 latent 空间，文本却缺少同等保真的连续表示，next-token prediction 只通过序列分解间接编码全局结构。
Method: 复用预训练 decoder-only LLM，暴露中间层激活作为定长 latent bottleneck，配合结构化 attention mask 与 LoRA 适配，保留原 LLM 的生成先验；下游在冻结的 LLMAE latent 空间训练轻量扩散模型生成图像描述。
Result: 在 270M Gemma 3 与 0.5B Qwen2.5 两个 backbone 上，重建序列最长 1024 token，最高 97% 文档逐字 (verbatim) 复现；扩散模型直接在冻结 LLMAE latent 空间生成详细图像描述。
Conclusion: 把文本映射到定长连续 latent 空间，可以在保留原 LLM 流畅性的同时为下游适配提供有效基底，代码与模型已开源。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Penalized Nonreversible Langevin for Constrained Sampling
papers.abstract_en: We propose penalized nonreversible Langevin algorithms for sampling from $π(x)\propto e^{-f(x)}\mathbf 1_{\mathcal C}(x)$, where $\mathcal C\subset\mathbb R^d$ is a compact convex set. The algorithms combine a squared distance penalty with constant or compatible state dependent skew symmetric perturbations that preserve the penalized Gibbs distribution. For smooth, possibly nonconvex $f$, we derive nonasymptotic total variation bounds for the full gradient algorithm under a log Sobolev inequality. When unbiased stochastic gradients are available, we establish $2$-Wasserstein bounds under global contraction and Lipschitz conditions on the full drift in an adapted quadratic metric. For a fixed penalty parameter, the error relative to the penalized Gibbs distribution decays exponentially to an $\mathcal{O}(\sqrtη)$ neighborhood, where $η$ is the stepsize. We also bound the discrepancy between the penalized Gibbs distribution and the constrained target. In a two dimensional quadratic model, we establish nonreversible acceleration by tuning the skew perturbation to the curvature imbalance induced by penalization. With the target accuracy and smaller curvature fixed and initial Wasserstein distances uniformly bounded, tuning the skew perturbation improves the sufficient Euler iteration bound from linear to logarithmic in the curvature ratio. Numerical experiments evaluate the algorithms on constrained Bayesian regression, classification, neural networks, and truncated sampling, and examine the acceleration mechanism in a stochastic quadratic model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出带惩罚的非可逆 Langevin 算法，在紧凸约束集 C 上采样 π(x)∝e^{-f(x)}1_C(x)：用平方距离惩罚加常数或状态依赖的斜对称扰动保持惩罚 Gibbs 分布不变。固定惩罚参数时误差相对惩罚 Gibbs 分布指数衰减到 O(√η) 邻域；二维二次模型中把斜对称扰动调到惩罚引起的曲率失衡上，充分 Euler 迭代界从关于曲率比的线性降为对数。
Motivation: 紧凸约束下的采样中，直接投影或截断会破坏非可逆 Langevin 的加速机制，而惩罚引入的曲率失衡又会拖慢收敛，缺少同时处理约束与非可逆加速的收敛理论。
Method: 对 π(x)∝e^{-f(x)}1_C(x) 施加平方距离惩罚，叠加常数或状态依赖的斜对称 (skew symmetric) 扰动以保持惩罚 Gibbs 分布；在 log Sobolev 不等式下对全梯度算法给出非渐近全变差界，在全局收缩与 full drift 的 Lipschitz 条件下对随机梯度给出 2-Wasserstein 界，并界定惩罚 Gibbs 分布与约束目标的差异。
Result: 固定惩罚参数时相对惩罚 Gibbs 分布的误差指数衰减到 O(√η) 邻域（η 为步长）；二维二次模型中，在目标精度、较小曲率与初始 Wasserstein 距离一致有界的前提下，调节斜对称扰动把充分 Euler 迭代界由关于曲率比的线性改善为对数。数值实验覆盖约束贝叶斯回归、分类、神经网络与截断采样，并检验随机二次模型中的加速机制。
Conclusion: 把斜对称扰动对准惩罚造成的曲率失衡，可在紧凸约束采样中把非可逆 Langevin 的迭代复杂度从线性降到对数（关于曲率比），且惩罚 Gibbs 与约束目标之间的偏差可单独界定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning from the Gap Between Pass@K and Pass@1
papers.abstract_en: Sampling many responses and keeping one that passes a verifier lets large language models solve problems beyond their single-response ability, but this search must be paid again for every query, while many deployments answer with a single response. Post-training on verified responses can transfer the benefit of search into the model. With a fixed budget, selecting by correctness alone spends slots on problems the model already answers correctly, leaving fewer to correct its failures. To address this imbalance, we propose GapFT, which trains on the gap between Pass@K and Pass@1: problems that the source model fails with one response but solves within K samples. GapFT keeps the objective and training budget fixed and changes only which verified responses enter training; an exact decomposition splits the resulting Pass@1 change into corrected failures and regressions on problems the source model already solved. On LogiQA 2.0 and ReClor with three model families, GapFT is above budget-matched uniform rejection-sampling fine-tuning (RFT) in every setting, with a positive pooled effect, and on Llama-3.1-8B and Mistral-7B it recovers about two thirds to four fifths of the gain of fine-tuning on the entire verified pool with 11-34% of its problems. Further analyses reveal that the gain comes from failures that the first few search samples recover, while failures found only by deeper search displace replay and add no net gain, that filling the same budget with gold-labeled failures search cannot reach lowers accuracy, and that the gain is bounded by how many transferable failures search exposes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GapFT 只用「单次采样失败、但 K 次采样内能被验证器通过」的题目（即 Pass@K 与 Pass@1 之间的 gap）做后训练，在目标函数与训练预算不变的前提下替换进入训练的已验证响应。在 LogiQA 2.0 与 ReClor、三个模型族上，它在每一种设定中都高于预算对齐的 uniform rejection-sampling fine-tuning (RFT)，且合并效应为正；在 Llama-3.1-8B 与 Mistral-7B 上，用全量已验证池 11–34% 的题目就追回了全量微调收益的约三分之二到五分之四。
Motivation: 采样 K 次再靠验证器挑一个能解超出单次能力的题，但每次查询都要重付这份搜索开销，而多数部署只出一个响应；按正确性挑训练样本会把预算浪费在模型本已答对的题上，留给纠正失败的名额变少。
Method: GapFT 固定目标函数与训练预算，只改变哪些已验证响应进入训练，按 Pass@K 与 Pass@1 的 gap 选题；用一个精确分解把 Pass@1 的变化拆成「被纠正的失败」与「在原本答对的题上的回退」两部分。
Result: 在 LogiQA 2.0 与 ReClor、三个模型族上，GapFT 在每个设定中都高于预算对齐的 uniform RFT，合并效应为正；在 Llama-3.1-8B 与 Mistral-7B 上，用全量已验证池 11–34% 的题目追回约三分之二到五分之四的全量微调收益。分析显示收益来自前几次搜索样本就能救回的失败，只有更深搜索才能找到的失败会挤占 replay、净收益为零；用搜索够不到的 gold-labeled 失败填同样预算反而降低准确率。
Conclusion: 把搜索的收益搬进单响应模型的关键是选对失败样本：收益来自浅层搜索可及且可迁移的失败，其上限由搜索能暴露多少这类失败决定，更深搜索找到的失败与搜索不可及的失败都不该占预算。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.result: 在 LogiQA 2.0 与 ReClor、三个模型族上，GapFT 在每个设定中都高于预算对齐的 uniform RFT，合并效应为正；在 Llama-3.1-8B 与 Mistral-7B 上，用全量已验证池 11–34% 的题目追回约三分之二到五分之四的全量微调收益。分析显示收益来自前几次搜索样本就能救回的失败，只有更深搜索才能找到的失败会挤占 replay、净收益为零；用搜索够不到的 gold-labeled 失败填同样预算反而降低准确率。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把搜索的收益搬进单响应模型的关键是选对失败样本：收益来自浅层搜索可及且可迁移的失败，其上限由搜索能暴露多少这类失败决定，更深搜索找到的失败与搜索不可及的失败都不该占预算。

papers.title: Coding Agents with Harness for Safe Robot Control
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents have emerged as a promising paradigm for robot manipulation: a language model writes the robot controller as a program, and agents built in this way now operate robots without robot-specific training. Whether this paradigm is also safe, however, has not been asked. We evaluate coding agents under a safety constraint, where each task pairs a manipulation goal with an obstacle the robot must not touch. The agent pursues the goal but collides with the obstacle in most cases, treating task completion as its sole objective. The agent reasons about the obstacle in its traces, and the prompt already forbids touching it, so neither perception nor instruction is at fault; the fault lies in the planning, where the stated constraint never becomes a priority. By decomposing manipulation into a route phase and a contact-rich moment, we locate the source of the failure. Along the route, the model cannot prioritize the safety constraint, having no notion of a clearing route and none of replanning once a chosen route becomes infeasible. At the contact, it is unaware that contact execution is bounded by the same constraint. To close this gap, we present SafeHarness, which equips the model with two obstacle-aware harnesses. Obstacle-aware route planning grounds the objects as bounding boxes and draws candidate routes over them as sequences of waypoints. The agent then plans a route in advance, verifies it, replans when necessary, and only then executes it. Obstacle-aware contact execution instead selects the contact position so that the contact itself avoids the obstacle. SafeHarness attains 81.2% task success and 91.9% collision avoidance with GPT-6-Astra, surpassing the previous SOTA by 13.7 and 23.0 points, and the same agent without harnesses by 31.2 and 57.5 points, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在机器人操作的安全约束评测中，coding agent 把任务完成当唯一目标，多数情况下会撞上障碍物；失败出在规划而非感知或指令。SafeHarness 用障碍感知的路线规划（bounding box + waypoint 候选路线，先规划、验证、必要时重规划再执行）与障碍感知接触执行两个 harness，配合 GPT-6-Astra 达到 81.2% 任务成功率与 91.9% 避障率。
Motivation: 语言模型直接写机器人控制程序的范式没有机器人专用训练，但其安全性此前无人检验；在带障碍物的操作任务中，agent 多数情况下为完成目标而碰撞，约束在规划阶段没有变成优先级。
Method: 把操作分解为路线阶段与接触密集阶段定位失败源；提出 SafeHarness，含两个障碍感知 harness：路线规划把物体表示为 bounding box、在之上生成 waypoint 序列候选路线，先规划、验证、必要时重规划再执行；接触执行则选择本身避开障碍物的接触位置。评测设定为每个任务配对一个操作目标与一个不可触碰的障碍物。
Result: SafeHarness 配合 GPT-6-Astra 取得 81.2% 任务成功率与 91.9% 碰撞避免率，较此前 SOTA 分别高 13.7 与 23.0 个百分点，较同一 agent 不加 harness 分别高 31.2 与 57.5 个百分点；未加 harness 的 agent 在多数情况下与障碍物相撞。
Conclusion: 安全约束失效的根因在规划而非感知或指令，因此把障碍物显式接地为几何路线并强制先验证后执行，能同时显著提升操作成功率与避障率。

papers.title: Video DeltaNet: A Video-Native Hybrid Attention for Livestream Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Video diffusion models repeatedly process long spatiotemporal token sequences during denoising, making attention a major computational bottleneck. Linear attention offers an appealing alternative and has been widely adopted in recent large language models, but directly applying it to video models often fails to preserve the fine-grained interactions required for high-quality generation. We present Video DeltaNet (VDN), which combines local Softmax attention with bidirectional linear memory for long-range video context. Its linear branch introduces Video Delta Attention (VDA), which updates memory once per frame by jointly incorporating its spatial tokens. Separate output projections and learnable gates calibrate the two branches, while a staged teacher-alignment recipe progressively introduces the new pathway into pretrained models. We instantiate VDN on MiniMax H3, applying the hybrid to video-to-video interactions while retaining Softmax for interactions involving text or audio. With eight-step distillation and an optimized SGLang serving stack, VDN-H3 completes DiT denoising for a 14.3-second, 768p video in 6.70 seconds on eight NVIDIA B200 GPUs, corresponding to a 14.5x speedup over the 50-step dense H3 baseline on the same GPU count. GitHub code available at: https://github.com/OpenVDN/vdn-minimax-h3. Weights available at: https://huggingface.co/OpenVDN/vdn-minimax-h3
papers.comment: GitHub code available at: https://github.com/OpenVDN/vdn-minimax-h3. Weights available at: https://huggingface.co/OpenVDN/vdn-minimax-h3
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Video DeltaNet (VDN) 把局部 Softmax 注意力与双向线性记忆结合，用 Video Delta Attention (VDA) 每帧一次地把空间 token 一起写入长程记忆，缓解视频扩散去噪中长时空序列注意力的计算瓶颈。在 MiniMax H3 上配合八步蒸馏与 SGLang 服务栈，14.3 秒 768p 视频的 DiT 去噪在八张 B200 上耗时 6.70 秒，相对 50 步稠密 H3 基线加速 14.5 倍。
Motivation: 视频扩散去噪反复处理长时空 token 序列，注意力成为主要算力瓶颈；而直接把 LLM 的线性注意力搬到视频模型上难以保留高质量生成所需的细粒度交互。
Method: VDN 混合局部 Softmax 注意力与双向线性记忆：线性分支的 Video Delta Attention (VDA) 每帧更新一次记忆并联合纳入该帧空间 token，两分支用独立输出投影与可学习门控校准；以分阶段 teacher-alignment 配方把新通路逐步引入预训练模型。实例化在 MiniMax H3 上，视频到视频交互走该混合注意力，涉及文本或音频的交互仍用 Softmax。
Result: 配合八步蒸馏与优化的 SGLang 服务栈，VDN-H3 在八张 NVIDIA B200 GPU 上完成 14.3 秒、768p 视频的 DiT 去噪耗时 6.70 秒，相对同 GPU 数量的 50 步稠密 H3 基线加速 14.5 倍。
Conclusion: 局部 Softmax 加双向线性记忆的混合注意力可在保留细粒度交互的同时把视频扩散去噪的注意力开销大幅压低，配合少步蒸馏与服务优化即可在生产级视频生成上取得数量级加速。

papers.title: Reach or Solve? Deep Diving into Agentic RL Gains with Checkpoint Handoffs
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) is widely used to improve language-model agents, and its gains are usually measured by final task success. However, an agent's earlier actions shape the states in which its later decisions are made, so final task success conflates the ability to reach useful states with the ability to complete the task once there. Comparing agents only on the states each one reaches does not separate the two, since each agent is then scored on states selected by its own actions. To address this conflation, we introduce checkpoint handoff, an evaluation protocol that decouples reaching from completing without retraining. One checkpoint acts as a reacher up to a handoff point, and another continues as the solver from the same replayed history. In detail, (1) Reach measures how often a reacher arrives at states that a replayable environment verifies to be a fixed number of actions from success, and (2) Solve measures how often a solver completes the task from identical cloned copies of those states. Crossing supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and RL checkpoints in both roles across two benchmarks and two independently released training pipelines, we find that the gain from switching the solver from SFT to RL is consistently larger when RL is the reacher, at all three model scales on TravelPlanner and on both ALFWorld splits. Further analyses on ALFWorld show that RL improves both Reach and Solve. The solver gain is larger under an RL reacher because RL reaches solvable states more often, and separately measured Reach and Solve gaps recover most of this difference. Because handoff only requires replaying one checkpoint's history under another, agentic RL evaluations can report arrival and completion alongside final success.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 checkpoint handoff 评测协议：让一个 checkpoint 作为 reacher 走到交接点，另一个从同一段可回放历史继续作 solver，把「到达有用状态」与「到达后完成任务」解耦，且无需重训练。在 TravelPlanner 与 ALFWorld 两个 benchmark、两套独立发布训练管线、三个模型规模上，把 solver 从 SFT 换成 RL 的增益在 RL 作 reacher 时始终更大；ALFWorld 上 RL 同时提升 Reach 与 Solve，且分别测得的 Reach/Solve 差距可解释该增益的大部分。
Motivation: agentic RL 的收益只用最终任务成功率衡量，把「到达有用状态的能力」与「到达后完成任务的能力」混在一起；而只比较各 agent 自己到达的状态，又会因状态由各自动作选出而无法分离两者。
Method: checkpoint handoff：一个 checkpoint 作为 reacher 执行到 handoff 点，另一个从同一段回放历史继续作 solver；Reach 定义为 reacher 到达被可回放环境验证为距成功固定步数的状态的频率，Solve 定义为 solver 从这些状态的克隆副本完成任务的频率。将 SFT 与 RL checkpoint 在两种角色上交叉组合，在两个 benchmark、两套独立训练管线、三个模型规模上评测，并在 ALFWorld 上做进一步分析。
Result: 在 TravelPlanner 的三个模型规模以及 ALFWorld 的两个 split 上，当 reacher 为 RL 时，把 solver 从 SFT 换成 RL 的增益始终更大。ALFWorld 上 RL 同时提升 Reach 与 Solve；solver 增益在 RL reacher 下更大是因为 RL 更常到达可解状态，且分开测量的 Reach 与 Solve 差距可恢复（解释）这一差异的大部分。
Conclusion: 最终成功率混合了到达与完成两种能力，handoff 只需在另一个 checkpoint 下回放历史即可分离二者，因此 agentic RL 评测应在最终成功率之外同时报告 arrival 与 completion。

papers.title: Bayesian Optimization with Rich Auxiliary Information via LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian Optimization (BO) is widely used for optimizing expensive black-box functions, yet it typically reduces each expensive experiment to an input and its objective value, discarding much of the information the experiment produces. Such auxiliary information can include training curves in hyperparameter optimization, expert notes and images in scientific experimentation, or known facts about the specific optimization problem. Leveraging the ability of large language models (LLMs) to process diverse and unstructured information, we introduce two methods: AuxBO-Evolve, which uses auxiliary information to evolve beliefs over the location of the optimum, and AuxBO-Vicinity, which uses it to locally guide the acquisition function. Across synthetic tasks, hyperparameter optimization benchmarks, and a nuclear fusion task with unstructured scientist-written logs, our methods consistently improve optimization performance and outperform standard BO and existing LLM-based approaches. We further find that LLMs provide more effective probabilistic guidance when modeling likely maximizer locations rather than objective values pointwise. Overall, our results demonstrate that exploiting rich information beyond standard $(\mathbf{x}, y)$ interactions can substantially improve BO performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM 用作贝叶斯优化的辅助信息解释器，提出 AuxBO-Evolve（用文本、图像、日志等非结构化信息演化最优点位置的信念）与 AuxBO-Vicinity（用这些信息局部引导采集函数），在合成任务、超参优化基准和带科学家手写日志的核聚变任务上均稳定优于标准 BO 与已有 LLM-based 方法。作者还发现 LLM 对「最可能取最大值的位置」建模比逐点预测目标值更有效。
Motivation: 标准 BO 每次昂贵实验只保留 (x, y)，把训练曲线、专家笔记、图像、领域已知事实等实验副产物全部丢弃，浪费了可用于缩小搜索空间的信息。
Method: 提出两种方法：AuxBO-Evolve 用 LLM 处理非结构化辅助信息来演化关于最优点位置的信念；AuxBO-Vicinity 用辅助信息对采集函数 (acquisition function) 做局部引导。评测覆盖合成任务、超参优化基准，以及一个含科学家手写非结构化日志的核聚变任务。
Result: 在合成任务、超参优化基准与核聚变任务上，两种方法持续提升优化性能，优于标准 BO 和已有 LLM-based 方法；消融式发现是 LLM 对最可能取最大值位置建模比逐点建模目标值给出更有效的概率引导。
Conclusion: 超出 (x, y) 交互的丰富辅助信息能实质性提升 BO 性能，且 LLM 更适合作为位置层面的概率引导器而非逐点目标值回归器。

papers.title: BusMA: A Bus Communication Substrate for Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Multi-Agent (MA) systems are effective at solving complex tasks that demand planning, tool use, and the synthesis of evidence from multiple sources. Existing systems typically adopt Hierarchical Manager-Worker (HMW) or Router-based Message Passing (RMP) structures as their communication protocol. However, these designs restrict agent autonomy: Worker agents cannot directly consult specific "peers", and misrouted messages can propagate errors. Inspired by bus architectures in computer systems, we propose BusMA, a communication framework that allows any agent to address other agents through a shared channel, i.e., the Bus. It consists of agent registration, message routing, and shared memory management components. Worker agents, each equipped with tools, have their own local memory and can reason, act (tool usage), and communicate by posting shared messages with specific intents. We introduce four intents: discussion, challenge, guidance, and request for explanation, which support fine-grained communication among agents. A Chair agent monitors the shared memory to coordinate interactions and facilitate convergence among Workers. To evaluate the effectiveness of BusMA, we conduct extensive experiments with two frontier LLMs across 13 tasks spanning visual reasoning, mathematical reasoning, and knowledge retrieval. The results demonstrate that BusMA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art HMW and RMP methods.

papers.title: Towards Identifying the Dataset Biases Causing Phantom Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Recent work has shown that a teacher model can transfer a bias to a student through a dataset from which every explicit reference to that bias has been filtered out, and that none of the tested data-level defenses reliably removes or detects such a bias, even when the defender knows what to look for. To shed light on the hidden traces these biases leave, we embed a dataset's completions with Sentence-BERT, subtract the embeddings of clean reference completions, and compare the result to an open vocabulary of candidate topics. This simple signature identifies the topic of the bias with a Matthews correlation coefficient of 0.83 when the attacker's teacher model is known, and 0.46 when it is not. We also observe that different teacher models appear to express the same bias through different vocabulary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对教师模型经数据集向学生隐性迁移偏置（phantom transfer）且现有数据级防御无法可靠检出的问题，提出一种偏置主题签名方法：用 Sentence-BERT 嵌入数据集补全，减去干净参考补全的嵌入，再与开放词表候选主题比对。当攻击者教师模型已知时，识别偏置主题的 Matthews 相关系数 (MCC) 为 0.83，未知时降至 0.46；不同教师模型会用不同词汇表达同一偏置。
Motivation: 教师模型可把偏置经过滤掉全部显式引用的数据集传给学生，且已测试的数据级防御即使在防御者知道要找什么的情况下也无法可靠移除或检出，因此需要能定位这些偏置留下的隐藏痕迹。
Method: 用 Sentence-BERT 对数据集补全做嵌入，减去干净参考补全的嵌入得到差向量，再与开放词表的候选主题逐一比较，从而识别偏置主题；在攻击者教师模型已知与未知两种设定下检验。
Result: 偏置主题识别的 Matthews 相关系数 (MCC) 在教师模型已知时为 0.83，未知时为 0.46；并观察到不同教师模型通过不同词汇表达同一偏置。
Conclusion: 偏置在嵌入空间中留下可识别的主题签名，且该签名的可检出性依赖于是否知道攻击者的教师模型。

papers.title: LPA-CWM: A Learned Physical Adjudicator for Motion Reasoning with Counterfactual World Models
papers.abstract_en: Counterfactual world models (CWM) extract motion from pretrained video predictors by comparing factual and intervened predictions, but uniform aggregation weights responses equally without explicitly incorporating physical priors. Our key insight is to incorporate physical priors into candidate reliability learning, motivating LPA-CWM with a lightweight Learned Physical Adjudicator (LPA). Trained on dense MOVi-F trajectories, the 3.0M-parameter LPA compares visual context and response structure across an unordered candidate set to predict relative weights; windowed localization and one paired re-evaluation recover motion with the CWM frozen. Existing video-level benchmarks do not directly assess motion correspondence, where low localization error can conceal missing trajectory segments. We introduce Completeness-aware Motion Correspondence (CMC), a ground-truth-anchored protocol jointly measuring localization, completeness, visibility, and continuity, counting missing predictions as failures on visible dynamic points. Across DAVIS, Kinetics, and RoboTAP, LPA-CWM improves all main CMC measures over Uniform CWM, with relative gains of 18.1%--60.0% in average Dynamic Correspondence Accuracy ($\mathrm{DCA}_{\mathrm{avg}}$), and improves TAP-Vid First tracking accuracy (overview: https://LPA-CWM.github.io).
papers.comment: A quick overview is available at https://LPA-CWM.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LPA-CWM 用一个 3.0M 参数的 Learned Physical Adjudicator (LPA) 替代反事实世界模型 (CWM) 中均匀聚合权重，依据视觉上下文与响应结构给候选集分配相对权重，在 CWM 冻结下恢复运动对应。作者同时提出以真值为锚的 CMC 协议，把可见动态点上缺失的预测直接计为失败。在 DAVIS、Kinetics、RoboTAP 上相对 Uniform CWM 的 DCA_avg 提升 18.1%–60.0%，并改善 TAP-Vid First 跟踪精度。
Motivation: 反事实世界模型对候选响应做均匀聚合，等于不带物理先验地等权对待所有响应；而现有视频级基准不直接度量运动对应，低定位误差会掩盖缺失的轨迹段。
Method: 在冻结的 CWM 上加一个轻量 LPA：在稠密 MOVi-F 轨迹上训练，比较视觉上下文与无序候选集的响应结构输出相对权重，配合窗口化定位与一次成对再评估恢复运动。评测用新提出的 Completeness-aware Motion Correspondence (CMC) 协议，联合度量定位、完整性、可见性与连续性。
Result: LPA-CWM 在 DAVIS、Kinetics、RoboTAP 上的全部 CMC 主指标均优于 Uniform CWM，DCA_avg 相对提升 18.1%–60.0%，并提升 TAP-Vid First 跟踪精度；LPA 参数量 3.0M，训练数据为 MOVi-F 稠密轨迹。
Conclusion: 把物理先验学成候选可靠性权重、并在评测中显式惩罚缺失轨迹段，可以在不改动预训练视频预测器的前提下改善运动对应质量。

papers.title: Suan: Rectifying Direct Preference Safety Alignment in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Integrating robust safety guardrails into Large Language Models (LLMs) is essential for delivering helpful yet harmless responses. While proprietary systems exhibit reliable safety controls, their underlying methodologies and trade-offs remain largely undisclosed. Achieving comparable security in open-weight models remains a persistent challenge, as post-trained variants frequently suffer from over-refusal and degraded general quality. To overcome these drawbacks, we introduce Suan, a novel preference optimization algorithm. Unlike existing methods, we formulate the optimization objective directly at the gradient level, bypassing the standard variational derivation. As a result, we obtain more interpretable and robust training dynamics. Extensive evaluations across a diverse suite of competitive baselines and benchmarks demonstrate that Suan achieves superior safety alignment while fully preserving response utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Suan 是面向 LLM 安全对齐的偏好优化算法，把优化目标直接写在梯度层面、绕开标准变分推导，从而得到更可解释、更稳健的训练动态。在多组竞争性基线与 benchmark 上评测，Suan 在保持响应可用性的同时取得更优的安全对齐。
Motivation: 开源权重模型的后训练安全对齐常在安全与有用性之间失衡：要么过度拒答 (over-refusal)，要么通用质量下降；专有系统的安全方法与权衡又不公开。
Method: 提出偏好优化算法 Suan，与既有方法不同之处在于直接在梯度层面构造优化目标，跳过标准变分推导 (variational derivation)，以获得更可解释、更稳健的训练动态。
Result: 在一组多样的竞争性基线与 benchmark 上进行广泛评测，Suan 取得更优的安全对齐，同时完全保留响应可用性 (response utility)。
Conclusion: 绕过变分推导、直接在梯度层面做偏好优化，可以在不牺牲通用质量的前提下缓解开源模型的过度拒答问题。

papers.title: Learning transferable human physiology from two million hours of sleep with SleepFM-2
papers.abstract_en: Sleep provides a nightly window into health by capturing coordinated activity across the brain, heart, muscles and respiratory system. We introduce SleepFM-2, a sleep foundation model developed and evaluated on 282,511 polysomnography recordings from 26 cohorts, including 235,865 used for pretraining. These data span more than two million hours of multimodal physiology. Compared with SleepFM, SleepFM-2 improves disease prediction and sleep scoring, supports arousal, limb movement and respiratory event detection, and transfers to wearable sensing and subjective sleep phenotypes. A model combining its PSG representation with age, sex and BMI met a prespecified discrimination and significance criterion for 188 subsequently recorded EHR phenotypes in two held-out cohorts, including one health system unseen during pretraining. SleepFM-2 also outperformed a 480-feature baseline derived from the same recordings. Its disease scores revealed a reproducible principal component associated with reduced sigma-band spatial coupling and increased hypnodensity entropy. The frozen encoder performed within the observed range of expert scorers for sleep events and transferred to wakeful EEG, headband and in-ear EEG, wrist PPG and wrist accelerometry. It improved sleep staging across six accelerometry cohorts and achieved disease-prediction performance in UK Biobank similar to models pretrained directly on accelerometry. Finally, SleepFM-2 captured aspects of subjective sleep not recovered by conventional PSG summaries, particularly reports of the recorded night. These results show that multimodal sleep physiology can provide a transferable representation of human health across diseases, clinical tasks, sensors and subjective experience.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SleepFM-2 是在 282,511 段多导睡眠图 (PSG)、26 个队列、逾两百万小时多模态生理信号上预训练的睡眠基础模型，其中 235,865 段用于预训练。其表征与年龄、性别、BMI 组合后，在两个留出队列（含一个预训练未见的医疗系统）的 188 个 EHR 表型上达到预设的判别与显著性标准，并优于同源录音派生的 480 特征基线。冻结编码器可迁移到清醒 EEG、头带与耳内 EEG、腕部 PPG 与加速度计。
Motivation: 睡眠横跨脑、心、肌、呼吸多系统，但既有模型局限于单一任务或单一传感器，缺少能跨疾病、临床任务、可穿戴设备与主观体验迁移的通用生理表征。
Method: 在 26 个队列的 282,511 段 PSG（235,865 段预训练，逾两百万小时多模态生理）上训练睡眠基础模型 SleepFM-2；下游用其 PSG 表征结合年龄、性别、BMI 预测 EHR 表型，并与同源录音派生的 480 特征基线对比；冻结编码器直接迁移到加速度计、PPG、耳内/头带 EEG 与清醒 EEG。
Result: 相对 SleepFM-2 前作 SleepFM，疾病预测与睡眠评分改善，并支持觉醒、肢体运动与呼吸事件检测；在两个留出队列的 188 个 EHR 表型上满足预设判别与显著性标准（含一个预训练未见的医疗系统），且优于 480 特征基线；疾病分数揭示一个可复现主成分，对应 sigma 波段空间耦合下降与 hypnodensity 熵升高；冻结编码器在睡眠事件上落在专家评分者观测区间内；在 6 个加速度计队列上提升睡眠分期，并在 UK Biobank 上取得与直接用加速度计预训练的模型相当的疾病预测性能。
Conclusion: 多模态睡眠生理可提供跨疾病、临床任务、传感器与主观体验的可迁移人体健康表征，且冻结编码器无需微调即可对接多种可穿戴与清醒态信号。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Branch-Centric Tokenization and Test-Time Augmentation for Skeleton Generation
papers.abstract_en: Automatic skeleton generation involves predicting both joint positions and skeletal connectivity. However, existing approaches struggle to encode branch structures into token sequences and do not use test-time computation effectively. We study these choices within a unified autoregressive framework. First, we introduce branch-centric tokenization, a branch-aware representation that places structurally related elements next to each other and encodes connectivity directly in the sequence. Compared with standard BFS-style serialization, this representation yields more compact sequences. Second, we introduce view-augmented generation, a test-time augmentation procedure that applies axis-aligned rotations to the input mesh, maps all predictions back to a common frame, and selects the final skeleton based on mesh coverage and consistency among predictions from different views. Experiments show that our method achieves better skeleton prediction accuracy than state-of-the-art methods. In particular, our method reduces the CD-J2B error by 16.9% on the Articulation-XL2.0 dataset compared to the strongest directly comparable baseline, Auto-Connect. Qualitative results on in-the-wild meshes further demonstrate generalization across diverse inputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在自回归骨架生成框架中提出 branch-centric tokenization，把分支结构相邻排布并直接把连通性编码进序列，比 BFS 式序列化更紧凑；再用 view-augmented generation 对输入网格做轴对齐旋转、把各视角预测映射回统一坐标系，按网格覆盖度与预测一致性选最终骨架。在 Articulation-XL2.0 上相对最强可直接比较的基线 Auto-Connect 将 CD-J2B 误差降低 16.9%。
Motivation: 现有骨架生成方法难以把分支结构编码进 token 序列，且没有有效利用测试时计算，关节位置与骨骼连通性两部分预测因此受限。
Method: 统一自回归框架下两个改动：branch-centric tokenization 用分支感知表示让结构相关元素相邻、直接编码连通性；view-augmented generation 对输入网格施加轴对齐旋转，把各视角预测映射回公共坐标系，依据 mesh coverage 与预测间一致性挑选最终骨架。
Result: 在 Articulation-XL2.0 上 CD-J2B 误差相对最强直接可比基线 Auto-Connect 降低 16.9%，骨架预测精度优于现有 SOTA 方法；in-the-wild 网格上的定性结果展示跨多样输入的泛化。
Conclusion: 把连通性直接写进 token 序列并用多视角测试时增强做选择，能同时提升自回归骨架生成的紧凑性与预测精度，且可泛化到野外网格。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LayerRoute: Action-Conditioned Mixture-of-Layers Routing for Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies leverage pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) to guide action generation for robot control. VLMs provide hierarchical visual-semantic representations that evolve across layers, from local visual geometry to abstract, language-aligned semantics; different manipulation tasks may therefore require different mixtures of layer representations. Meanwhile, the action module maintains intermediate representations that evolve throughout action computation and may provide useful information for subsequent decisions. However, existing VLA interfaces offer limited flexibility in representation access: VLM information is exposed through fixed layer assignments for each action layer, while intermediate action states are only propagated implicitly through residual streams without explicit reuse. We introduce LayerRoute, an action-conditioned representation routing interface that enables adaptive access to VLM layers and action representations. The Layer Mixture Router dynamically forms mixtures of cached VLM representations, while Action-State Reread reuses earlier action representations. Across diverse simulation and real-world benchmarks, LayerRoute consistently improves StarVLA-$π$ and $π_{0.5}$, achieving up to 7.2 gains on LIBERO Long with only 0.31% / 3.87% additional parameters. Ablation studies validate the benefit of action-conditioned layer routing, while routing analyses reveal structured allocation patterns across action layers and task settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LayerRoute 为 VLA 策略提供动作条件化的表征路由接口：Layer Mixture Router 按当前动作动态混合缓存的 VLM 各层表征，Action-State Reread 显式复用早期动作中间状态，从而取代固定层分配与仅靠残差流的隐式传播。在仿真与真机基准上一致提升 StarVLA-π 与 π0.5，LIBERO Long 最多提升 7.2，额外参数仅 0.31% / 3.87%。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 接口对表征访问过于僵化：VLM 信息按固定层分配给各动作层，动作模块的中间状态只能经残差流隐式传递，无法按任务差异调用不同层级的视觉-语义混合。
Method: LayerRoute 含两个组件：Layer Mixture Router 依据动作条件动态构造缓存 VLM 层表征的混合，Action-State Reread 显式回读早期动作表征；作为接口接入 StarVLA-π 与 π0.5，并配合消融与路由分配分析。
Result: 在多样仿真与真机基准上一致改善 StarVLA-π 与 π0.5，LIBERO Long 上最高提升 7.2，额外参数开销仅 0.31% / 3.87%；消融验证动作条件化层路由的收益，路由分析显示各动作层与任务设定间存在结构化的分配模式。
Conclusion: 把 VLM 层访问与动作中间状态改成动作条件化的显式路由，可以在极小参数增量下稳定提升 VLA 策略，且学到的层分配随动作层与任务而有结构。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Stochastic Optimization of Tree Tensor Networks
papers.abstract_en: Tensor networks, originally developed for quantum many-body physics, are promising models for machine learning. We derive stochastic Riemannian optimizers for tree tensor networks (TTNs) on both their parameter and quotient manifolds, including adaptive and learning-rate-free schemes suitable for minibatch training. Using a hybrid CNN-TTN architecture, we evaluate the methods on Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR10, and Imagenette. The proposed optimizers achieve predictive performance comparable to unconstrained optimization while enabling numerically stable downstream compression.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 12 figures, 5 pseudo-code algorithms; Submission to SciPost
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为树张量网络 (tree tensor networks, TTN) 推导了定义在参数流形与商流形 (quotient manifold) 上的随机黎曼优化器，含自适应与免学习率方案，可直接用于 minibatch 训练。在 CNN-TTN 混合架构上，这些优化器在 Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR10、Imagenette 上达到与无约束优化相当的预测性能，同时使下游张量压缩在数值上更稳定。
Motivation: TTN 作为机器学习模型需要随机/小批量训练，但其流形结构（参数化冗余带来的商流形）缺少适配 minibatch 的随机黎曼优化器，且直接优化常导致后续压缩数值不稳。
Method: 在 TTN 的参数流形与商流形上分别推导随机黎曼优化器，包含自适应步长与免学习率 (learning-rate-free) 方案，适配 minibatch 训练；用 CNN-TTN 混合架构在图像分类上验证，论文给出 5 个伪代码算法。
Result: 在 Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR10、Imagenette 三个数据集上，所提优化器的预测性能与无约束优化 (unconstrained optimization) 相当，并支持数值稳定的下游压缩；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把 TTN 的流形几何显式纳入随机优化，可以在不牺牲预测精度的前提下换取训练稳定性与可压缩性。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Fractal dimension predicts quantum kernel collapse in angle-encoded data
papers.abstract_en: Angle-encoded quantum kernels on tabular data collapse when the feature map is wider than the intrinsic dimension of the data. We propose the correlation fractal dimension D2 as an a priori qubit budget: encode D2 coordinates chosen by FD-ASE instead of the PCA-95% width or all E attributes. On nine data sets and a statevector simulator (n= 32), a one-layer ZZ fidelity kernel at q=D2 stays geometrically alive while the same kernel at the PCA-95% width has already collapsed. The budget is map-dependent: product-state and IQP maps overshoot it; a second ZZ layer undershoots it. Packed dense-angle and re-uploading encodings still live at the fractal q, but not when PCA-95% features are stacked onto those qubits. Shrinking the angle bandwidth moves the ZZ knee later; stretching it kills the kernel earlier. On IBM Quantum (ibm_fez, 256 shots, n=8) the one-layer ZZ kernel at the fractal width matches the exact kernel (MAE 0.021); past that width both hardware and simulator have collapsed. The ceiling is a property of the map-data pair at a stated bandwidth, not of the classical table alone.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 12 figures. Submitted to Quantum Machine Intelligence
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 角度编码量子核在特征映射宽度超过数据内在维数时会几何坍缩，作者提出用相关分形维数 D2 作为先验 qubit 预算，按 FD-ASE 选出 D2 个坐标编码，替代 PCA-95% 宽度或全部 E 个属性。九个数据集、n=32 statevector 模拟显示一层 ZZ fidelity 核在 q=D2 处仍保持几何存活，而同核在 PCA-95% 宽度已坍缩；IBM Quantum ibm_fez（256 shots，n=8）上分形宽度的 ZZ 核与精确核 MAE 为 0.021。
Motivation: 角度编码量子核在表格数据上一旦特征映射宽度超过数据内在维数就坍缩，而常用的 PCA-95% 宽度或全属性编码并不对应数据的真实维数，导致核在训练前就失去可分性。
Method: 用相关分形维数 D2 作为先验 qubit 预算，坐标由 FD-ASE 选择；在九个数据集上比较一层 ZZ fidelity 核、product-state 与 IQP 映射、第二层 ZZ、packed dense-angle 与 re-uploading 编码，并在 statevector 模拟（n=32）与 IBM Quantum ibm_fez（256 shots，n=8）上检验，同时扫描角度带宽。
Result: q=D2 时一层 ZZ 核保持几何存活，PCA-95% 宽度下同核已坍缩；product-state 与 IQP 映射超出该预算，第二层 ZZ 低于该预算；packed dense-angle 与 re-uploading 在分形 q 处存活，但把 PCA-95% 特征堆到这些 qubit 上即失效；缩小角度带宽使 ZZ 坍缩拐点后移，拉宽带宽使核更早死亡；ibm_fez 上分形宽度 ZZ 核与精确核 MAE 0.021，超过该宽度后硬件与模拟均坍缩。
Conclusion: 核的存活上限是给定带宽下映射-数据对的性质，而非经典表格本身的性质，因此应按 D2 而非 PCA-95% 宽度设定 qubit 预算。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Will the User Ever Know? Covert Indirect Prompt Injection Attacks on Tool-Using LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: As LLM agents take real-world actions through tools, indirect prompt injection (IPI) has emerged as a serious threat. The standard metric, Attack Success Rate (ASR), counts whether an injection succeeds but ignores what the user notices in the agent's final response. Looking at successful injection traces, we find two distinct outcomes: the agent executes the injection while returning an otherwise normal response, or reports the injected action in its final response, giving the user a chance to notice. We call these covert and overt successes. From the user's perspective, we decompose ASR into the Covert Success Rate (CSR), counting successes leaving no trace in the final response, and the Overt Success Rate (OSR), counting successes the user can detect. To understand what drives the gap, we analyze successful trajectories and find that the agent's behavior after the injection separates covert from overt: covert traces hand control back to the user task before ending, while overt traces end at the attack itself. This split follows from the ReAct format, where the final response summarizes the most recent action. Building on this observation, we propose ICoA (Induced Covert Attack), an IPI attack designed to induce covert outcomes by steering the agent back to the user task after executing the injection. Across four target models on AgentDojo, ICoA achieves the highest CSR, with gains of 3.79-12.01 percentage points over the strongest baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对工具调用 LLM agent 的间接提示注入 (IPI)，指出只用 Attack Success Rate (ASR) 会把「用户看得见」和「看不见」的成功混为一谈，并据此提出诱导隐蔽攻击 ICoA：执行注入后把 agent 引回用户任务，使最终回复看似正常。在 AgentDojo 上对四个目标模型，ICoA 取得最高 Covert Success Rate，比最强基线高 3.79–12.01 个百分点。
Motivation: ASR 只统计注入是否成功，不计用户能否在最终回复中察觉，因而无法区分隐蔽 (covert) 与显性 (overt) 两类后果，也掩盖了攻击的真实风险。
Method: 从用户视角把 ASR 分解为 Covert Success Rate (CSR，最终回复不留痕迹) 与 Overt Success Rate (OSR，用户可察觉)；分析成功轨迹发现注入后行为决定分野——隐蔽轨迹在结束前把控制权交回用户任务，显性轨迹停在攻击本身，这一分野源于 ReAct 格式中最终回复只总结最近一次动作；据此提出 ICoA，在执行注入后将 agent 引回用户任务。
Result: 在 AgentDojo 上对四个目标模型，ICoA 取得最高 CSR，比最强基线高 3.79–12.01 个百分点。
Conclusion: IPI 的隐蔽性由注入后 agent 是否回到用户任务决定，因此评估应把 ASR 拆成 CSR 与 OSR，而按 ReAct 回复机制设计的诱导策略能系统性制造隐蔽成功。
Relevance: 0
