papers.title: Exact Recovery Thresholds for Weighted Data Selection in Vector-Valued Linear Regression
papers.abstract_en: We resolve the threshold part of Question 4 of the COLT 2025 open problem "Data Selection for Regression Tasks" of Hanneke, Moran, Shlimovich and Yehudayoff. We study vector-valued linear regression with square loss $\ell_{(x,y)}(W)=\lVert Wx-y\rVert_2^2$, where $x\in\mathbb{R}^d$ and $y\in\mathbb{R}^m$. The learner returns the minimum-Frobenius-norm empirical risk minimizer. We prove that the minimal budget of weighted examples for recovering the full-data loss on every finite dataset is exactly $n^{\star}(d,m)=(m+1)d$. We determine the weighted selection profile $F_{\mathrm{weighted}}(d,m,n)$ at the near-threshold budget: $F_{\mathrm{weighted}}(d,m,(m+1)d-1)=1+1/(dm^2)$. We recover the known spanning-budget value $F_{\mathrm{weighted}}(d,m,d)=d+1$ for every $m$, and $F_{\mathrm{weighted}}(d,m,n)=\infty$ for $n<d$. For the smallest open intermediate cell $(d,m)=(2,2)$ we prove $F_{\mathrm{weighted}}(2,2,3)\in[13/8,15/8]$ and $F_{\mathrm{weighted}}(2,2,4)\in[5/4,3/2]$. We reduce the conjectured exact values $13/8$ and $5/4$ to a finite moment problem on the circle with at most seven atoms and assemble structural evidence for it. The upper bounds use a fixed-basis conic compression lemma, a determinant--facet rigidity theorem for maximal certificates, and sharp sparsification lemmas for zero-mean weighted point systems. These tools may be of independent interest. We also exhibit an explicit six-point integer dataset with $d=m=2$ on which no weighted selection of $2d$ points recovers the optimal loss. Thus the scalar sufficient budget $2d$ does not extend to vector-valued outputs. Our new regression-profile results for $m\ge2$ extend the scalar theory for $m=1$.

papers.title: trajectory-judge: What Outcome-Only LLM Judges Miss on Agent Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: A direct test of an LLM judge of agent trajectories injects faults into correct runs and reports recall, per fault type or by whether the fault broke the environment outcome (loud) or not (silent). Such recall can credit a judge with detection it does not have; paired discrimination, its flag rate on the faults minus its rate on the clean runs they came from, exposes this. Our testbed, a deterministic support desk with a scripted oracle and a one-step fault injector, labels all 400 trajectories exactly. A 14B judge shown only the request and final reply scores 34% to 76% recall on four fault types that leave the reply unchanged. There its input is the clean run's, so its paired discrimination is zero and that recall is its flag rate on clean runs. Splitting by outcome survival does not fix this: its loud recall of 84% is a paired +0.393 and its silent recall of 45% a paired +0.048, all from the two fault types that change the reply. Told to check each step, the same model flags every fault of those four types and 0 of 100 clean runs (95% CI up to 3.6%). It does not reliably check the reply: of four invented promises it flags one every time and the other three once in 42 faults. Shown every step but asked only about the reply, it still reaches a paired +0.69 on reply-unchanged faults, against +1.00 when told to check each step. We recommend reporting paired discrimination against clean parents, split by whether the fault reaches the judge's input and by outcome survival, and release the testbed, raw verdicts and analysis pipeline.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development (poster). Camera-ready version. 22 pages, 5 figures, 14 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/mohammadi-hadi/trajectory-judge
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 agent 轨迹 LLM 评审器做故障注入直测，提出 paired discrimination（在注入故障上的标记率减去其来源干净运行上的标记率）来拆穿只看 recall 的虚高。在 400 条确定性 support desk 轨迹上，只看请求与最终回复的 14B 评审器对回复未变的四类故障 recall 34%–76%，但其输入与干净运行相同，paired discrimination 为零；逐步检查后四类故障全检出且 100 条干净运行 0 误报（95% CI 上限 3.6%）。
Motivation: 只报 recall 会给评审器记上它并不具备的检出能力：当故障不改变评审器所见输入时，高 recall 只是它对干净运行同样高发的标记率，按 loud/silent 拆分也掩盖不了这一点。
Method: 构建确定性 support desk 测试台，配 scripted oracle 与 one-step fault injector，对 400 条轨迹做精确标注；对比只给 request+final reply、被告知逐步检查、以及看全部步骤但只问回复三种评审提示，按故障类型、故障是否到达评审器输入、以及是否破坏 outcome 分层统计 recall 与 paired discrimination。
Result: 只看请求与回复的 14B 评审器对回复未变的四类故障 recall 34%–76%，paired discrimination 为 0；loud recall 84% 对应 paired +0.393，silent recall 45% 对应 paired +0.048，且全部来自改变回复的两类故障。被告知逐步检查后，四类故障全部标记、100 条干净运行 0 误报（95% CI 上限 3.6%），但对四个虚构承诺其中一个每次标记、另三个在 42 次故障中各只标记一次。看全部步骤却只问回复时，回复未变故障上 paired 仍达 +0.69，逐步检查提示下为 +1.00。
Conclusion: 评审指标应报告相对干净父运行的 paired discrimination，并按故障是否到达评审器输入与 outcome 是否存活分层；单看 recall 或按 outcome 存活拆分会系统性高估检出能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Exact Risk Ratios for Weighted Data Selection in Linear Regression
papers.abstract_en: How much data must a fixed learner retain? Hanneke, Moran, Shlimovich and Yehudayoff (COLT 2025) posed this question for linear regression with the minimum-norm empirical risk minimizer. A selector sees a finite dataset $D\subseteq R^d\times R$, keeps at most $n$ examples with nonnegative weights, and $F_w(d,n)$ is the worst-case ratio between the full-data loss of the trained predictor and the optimal loss. The value is $\infty$ for $n<d$, $d+1$ at $n=d$ and $1$ for $n\ge2d$, and the regime $d<n<2d$ was left open. We settle several cases. For every $d$ we prove $F_w(d,2d-1)=1+1/d$, which confirms a claim stated without proof in the original note. We also prove $F_w(3,4)=5/3$, $F_w(4,5)=2$ and $F_w(4,6)=3/2$, the three smallest cells not covered by that formula. For every intermediate budget $n=d+k$ we prove the lower bound $F_w(d,d+k)\ge1+Γ_{d,k}$, where $Γ_{d,k}$ is an explicit harmonic quantity over balanced partitions of $d$. This bound is the exact minimax value on the class of datasets whose whitened systems split into orthogonal circuit blocks. All proved values equal $1+Γ_{d,k}$, and we conjecture that this holds throughout the open regime. Our upper bounds combine a rigidity theorem for positive spanning configurations of loss gradients with normal forms of the small positive bases in $R^3$ and $R^4$. These forms are special cases of the classification of Cornaz, Kerleau and Royer; we also control all gradients outside the basis. A dimension-free extremal-basis argument converts sign-cone geometry into selections of $d+1$ points. Explicit counterexamples rule out several shorter routes. Every upper bound is constructive, with selection procedures polynomial in the number of points for fixed dimension. Every numerical claim about a specific instance is an exact rational or algebraic identity, recomputed in exact arithmetic in the supplementary material.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇理论论文把线性回归中最小范数 ERM 的加权数据选择最坏情形风险 F_w(d,n) 在此前未解的 d<n<2d 区间推进到若干精确值：证明 F_w(d,2d-1)=1+1/d，并给出 F_w(3,4)=5/3、F_w(4,5)=2、F_w(4,6)=3/2，同时对 n=d+k 给出下界 1+Γ_{d,k}，并猜想它在整个未解区间成立。
Motivation: Hanneke 等 (COLT 2025) 提出固定学习器最少保留多少数据的问题，已知 n<d 时值为 ∞、n=d 时为 d+1、n≥2d 时为 1，但中间区间 d<n<2d 一直未解。
Method: 对每个中间预算 n=d+k 证明下界 F_w(d,d+k)≥1+Γ_{d,k}，Γ_{d,k} 是 d 的平衡划分上的显式调和量，并证明它在白化系统分解为正交回路块的数据集类上是精确极小极大值；上界结合损失梯度正张成构型的刚性定理与 R^3、R^4 中小正基的范式（Cornaz、Kerleau、Royer 分类的特例），再用与维数无关的极值基论证把符号锥几何转成 d+1 个点的选择，并构造显式反例排除若干更短的路线。
Result: 证明 F_w(d,2d-1)=1+1/d（确认原注记中无证明的论断）；F_w(3,4)=5/3、F_w(4,5)=2、F_w(4,6)=3/2，即公式未覆盖的三个最小格点；所有已证值都等于 1+Γ_{d,k}，且该下界在正交回路块数据集类上是精确的。每个上界都是构造性的，固定维数下选择算法关于点数是多项式时间；所有关于具体实例的数值断言都是精确有理或代数恒等式，在补充材料中以精确算术复算。
Conclusion: 作者猜想 1+Γ_{d,k} 在整个 d<n<2d 未解区间都是精确值，且上界可构造、可多项式实现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: UniFLM: United Segmentation and Measurement on Fetal Limb Ultrasonic Image
papers.abstract_en: Prenatal ultrasound examination is crucial for assessing fetal limb development and detecting congenital anomalies. However, existing artificial intelligence models often overlook fetal lethal skeletal dysplasias due to the lack of high-quality annotated data and a unified framework for multiple long bones. Moreover, generic segmentation models struggle with the inherent noise and semantic gaps in ultrasound images. To address these challenges, we construct the Fetal Limb Bones (FLB) dataset, comprising high-quality annotations for the humerus, femur, tibia-fibula, and radius-ulna. Furthermore, we propose UniFLM (United Segmentation and Measurement on Fetal Limb Ultrasonic Image), a unified framework for automatic cross-plane segmentation and measurement. UniFLM incorporates a Semantic Alignment Skip Connection (SASC) module to bridge the semantic gap between encoder and decoder features, and a Positive Sampling (PoSamp) strategy to filter noise and extract essential semantic information. Finally, a Point Regression Mapping (PRM) module is introduced to learn clinician annotation patterns for precise bone length measurement. Extensive experiments conducted on the FLB dataset and the public FetalP5 benchmark demonstrate that UniFLM achieves competitive performance with consistent generalization across four bone categories and external multi-center data, supported by comprehensive statistical validation including Bland-Altman agreement analysis and bootstrap confidence intervals. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/chosen1203/UniFLM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniFLM 把胎儿长骨的跨切面分割与骨长测量统一到一个框架：SASC 模块弥合编解码器语义鸿沟，PoSamp 策略过滤超声噪声，PRM 模块学习医生标注模式直接回归骨长。在自建 FLB 数据集与公开 FetalP5 基准上，四类长骨（肱骨、股骨、胫腓骨、桡尺骨）均取得竞争性表现，并在外部队列上保持一致泛化。
Motivation: 高质量标注缺乏且没有统一的多长骨框架，导致 AI 模型常漏检胎儿致死性骨发育不良；通用分割模型又难以应对超声固有噪声与编解码器语义断层。
Method: 构建 Fetal Limb Bones (FLB) 数据集，覆盖肱骨、股骨、胫腓骨、桡尺骨四类长骨的高质量标注；UniFLM 含 Semantic Alignment Skip Connection (SASC) 模块对齐编码器与解码器特征、Positive Sampling (PoSamp) 策略滤除噪声并提取关键语义、Point Regression Mapping (PRM) 模块学习医生标注模式以回归骨长。
Result: 在 FLB 与公开 FetalP5 上实验，四类骨分割与测量表现具竞争力，并在外部多中心数据上保持一致泛化；统计验证包括 Bland-Altman 一致性分析与 bootstrap 置信区间。
Conclusion: 统一的分割加测量框架配合语义对齐与噪声过滤，可在四类胎儿长骨上跨切面、跨中心稳定输出骨长，代码已开源。

papers.title: ConfAL-WM: Confidence-Guided Active Learning for Action-Conditioned World Models
papers.abstract_en: Action-conditioned world models have become an important foundation for embodied prediction, planning, and synthetic data generation, but their errors under new task and scene distributions are often concentrated in localized spatiotemporal regions such as robot arms, manipulated objects, contact areas, and occluded objects. This paper presents ConfAL-WM, a confidence-guided active learning framework for post-training embodied world models. Building upon EnerVerse-AC (EVAC), we attach a lightweight confidence probe to UNet decoder features and predict dense confidence maps in the latent space. These maps are aggregated into task-, frame-, and patch-level scores, enabling data-budget allocation and localized training enhancement. Our pipeline trains the probe and warms up EVAC on a small target-domain subset. EVAC-v1 then supplies task-level acquisition and optional frame/patch weighting signals; all selected-data models are initialized from the original pretrained EVAC checkpoint for retraining. Experiments on RoboTwin2.0 at the default 40% data budget show that confidence-guided selection improves post-training quality, while dense frame and patch weighting offers complementary reconstruction and semantic gains compared with scalar reward, progress, and judge-based scoring baselines. A quick visual overview of this work is available at https://ConfAL-WM.github.io.

papers.title: Steering Recurrent Reasoners at Inference Time with Readout Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Recurrent models, which repeatedly update latent states with shared computation blocks, have emerged as powerful architectures for solving complex reasoning tasks. Existing inference-time methods scale computation by running more steps or sampling more trajectories, but ignore information revealed within each trajectory. Here we show that recurrent models can be improved at inference time by using their own readout probabilities to steer latent dynamics without retraining. We introduce Readout Feedback (RoFB), a test-time intervention that converts intermediate predictions into token-wise pairwise coupling forces injected into the latent dynamics. Across three recurrent models (AKOrN, ItrSA++, TRM) on Sudoku and Maze, RoFB yields clear gains in four of six model-task pairs and a small gain in one. The four positive pairs achieve performance unattainable by merely running more steps or selecting from multiple trajectories, at comparable or lower computational cost. These results suggest that closed-loop steering of latent dynamics can serve as a complementary inference-time control mechanism for recurrent reasoning models.
papers.comment: 44 pages, 14 figures. Expanded analysis and experiments
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Readout Feedback (RoFB)：在推理时把循环推理模型自身的中间读出概率转成 token 级成对耦合力，注入隐状态动力学，从而在不重训的情况下引导推理轨迹。在 AKOrN、ItrSA++、TRM 三个模型 × Sudoku 与 Maze 的六组配对中四组明显提升、一组小幅提升，且达到单纯增加步数或多轨迹采样选择无法达到的性能，计算成本相当或更低。
Motivation: 现有推理时扩展手段只是加步数或采样更多轨迹，丢弃了单条轨迹内部逐步揭示的信息，无法在不重训的前提下引导循环模型的隐状态演化。
Method: RoFB 是一种 test-time intervention：把中间预测（readout probabilities）转换为 token 级成对耦合力 (pairwise coupling forces)，注入共享计算块迭代更新的隐状态动力学；无需任何再训练，在三个循环模型 AKOrN、ItrSA++、TRM 上实施。
Result: 在 Sudoku 与 Maze 上共六个模型-任务配对，RoFB 在四组取得明显增益、一组小幅增益；这四组正向配对达到仅靠增加运行步数或多轨迹采样选择无法达到的性能，且计算成本相当或更低。
Conclusion: 闭环引导隐状态动力学可以作为循环推理模型的一种互补性推理时控制机制，与加步数、多轨迹采样正交而非替代。

papers.title: EXAM2: Extending Audio Understanding in Multilingual and Multimodal Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Recent large audio language models (LALMs) have achieved impressive progress in audio understanding. However, existing evaluations remain largely constrained to English and narrow audio domains. Prior benchmarks typically focus on a single audio modality, i.e., speech, sound, or music, limiting the systematic investigation into how these models generalize across diverse visual scenarios. In this paper, we introduce EXAM$^2$, a benchmark for multilingual and multimodal audio understanding spanning six languages and multiple modalities, including speech, sound, music, mixed-audio settings, and visual images. By incorporating visual information alongside heterogeneous audio inputs, EXAM$^2$ enables more realistic evaluation of scene-aware audio reasoning and cross-modal comprehension. EXAM$^2$ comprises $5,667$ multiple-choice questions, $22,614$ image instances, and $135,684$ multilingual translations. We evaluate state-of-the-art open-source and proprietary LALMs as well as multimodal LLMs, revealing substantial performance gaps in multilingual and cross-modal understanding. Furthermore, we propose Gemma3n-EXAM$^2$, a lightweight fusion-model fine-tuned on EXAM$^2$-train, achieves up to $15.8\%$ improvement in multilingual settings and $16.5\%$ gains in multimodal evaluation over a strong baseline. Empirical results establish EXAM$^2$ as a challenging benchmark and pioneer future multilingual and multimodal audio intelligence research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EXAM² 提出多语言多模态音频理解基准，覆盖六种语言与 speech、sound、music、mixed-audio、视觉图像等模态，含 5,667 道选择题、22,614 个图像实例与 135,684 条多语言翻译。评测显示现有 LALM 与多模态 LLM 在多语言和跨模态理解上存在明显差距；在 EXAM²-train 上微调的轻量融合模型 Gemma3n-EXAM² 相对强基线最高提升 15.8%（多语言）与 16.5%（多模态）。
Motivation: 现有大音频语言模型评测多局限于英语和单一音频模态（语音、声音或音乐之一），无法系统检验模型跨语言与跨视觉场景的泛化能力。
Method: 构建 EXAM² 基准：六语言、多模态（speech/sound/music/mixed-audio 加视觉图像）的场景感知音频推理与跨模态理解选择题，配 EXAM²-train 训练划分；评测开源与闭源 LALM 及多模态 LLM，并在其上微调轻量融合模型 Gemma3n-EXAM²。
Result: 基准规模为 5,667 道多选题、22,614 个图像实例、135,684 条多语言翻译；评测揭示 SOTA LALM 与多模态 LLM 在多语言和跨模态理解上的显著性能差距；Gemma3n-EXAM² 相对强基线在多语言设置最高提升 15.8%，多模态评测提升 16.5%。
Conclusion: EXAM² 是一个具有挑战性的多语言多模态音频理解基准，可作为后续多语言与多模态音频智能研究的评测与训练平台。

papers.title: Llama-Mobile: Efficient 2.7-Bit Quantization of VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Deploying vision-language models (VLMs) on mobile devices is challenging due to their significant memory and compute requirements. We present a framework for quantizing VLMs for efficient inference on resource-constrained hardware. Our approach combines a quantization pipeline that uses the model itself to generate training data and does not require access to the training setup, with a novel 2.7-bit-per-parameter format supporting efficient execution on Arm CPUs. We validate our approach by compressing the Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct model to 3.7 GB with 8-bit activations, preserving strong performance on a set of standard visual question answering tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Llama-Mobile：用模型自身生成量化校准数据（无需原始训练配置）的量化流水线，配合面向 Arm CPU 高效执行的 2.7-bit-per-parameter 权重格式。将 Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct 压缩到 3.7 GB（8-bit 激活），在标准视觉问答任务上保持强性能。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型 (VLM) 内存与算力开销大，难以部署到资源受限的移动设备；且量化通常拿不到原始训练数据与训练配置。
Method: 量化流水线用模型自身生成训练/校准数据，不依赖原始训练环境；权重采用新提出的 2.7-bit-per-parameter 格式，针对 Arm CPU 设计高效执行内核，激活保持 8-bit。
Result: Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct 被压缩至 3.7 GB（8-bit 激活，2.7 bit/参数权重），并在一组标准视觉问答 (VQA) 任务上保持强性能。
Conclusion: 无需训练数据与训练配置、仅靠模型自生成数据的 2.7-bit 量化即可把 11B 级 VLM 塞进移动设备内存并保住 VQA 能力。

papers.title: An Irreducible Quantum Advantage in Aligning World Models with Reality
papers.abstract_en: World models provide digital simulacra of the true world, allowing agents to be trained and tested before costly real-world deployment. At each time step, they receive an action and generate an observation and reward matching the statistics of the true world. In complex environments where present outcomes depend on events far in the past, this requires memory. One might expect that, by increasing memory, we can always build a model accurately enough to align the optimal agent policies of the real and virtual worlds. We show that this is false for classical world models, even when the true world itself is classical. We construct true worlds for which every finite classical model fails along the same possible trajectory: it either loses the ability to distinguish actions when the true world clearly prefers one, or repeatedly assigns the highest expected reward to suboptimal actions. Its expected-reward estimates also retain a nonvanishing average error. In contrast, each such true world admits a quantum world model using a single qutrit that reproduces it exactly: its reward estimates and preferred actions always match those of the true world, ensuring that the optimal policies of the real and virtual worlds remain perfectly aligned.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明经典 world model 存在不可约的对齐失败：对构造出的真世界，任意有限经典模型沿同一条可能轨迹要么无法区分真世界明确偏好的动作，要么反复把最高期望奖励判给次优动作，且期望奖励估计保留非零平均误差；而同一个真世界只需一个 qutrit 的量子 world model 即可精确复现，奖励估计与偏好动作始终与真世界一致，最优策略完全对齐。
Motivation: world model 靠加长记忆来逼近真世界统计，从而对齐真实与虚拟中的最优策略；本文指出在结果依赖遥远过去的复杂环境中，这条经典路线存在原理性上限，即使真世界本身是经典的。
Method: 构造一类真世界（结果依赖遥远过去事件），证明所有有限经典 world model 在同一条可能轨迹上必然失败，并给出失败的两种模式（无法区分动作、把最高期望奖励判给次优动作）；对每个这样的真世界给出用单个 qutrit 实现的量子 world model，使其奖励与偏好动作精确复现。
Result: 经典侧：任意有限经典模型沿同一条可能轨迹失败，期望奖励估计保留非零平均误差；量子侧：单个 qutrit 的量子 world model 精确复现该真世界，奖励估计与偏好的动作始终与真世界一致，真实与虚拟世界的最优策略完全对齐。
Conclusion: 经典 world model 对齐最优策略的失败是不可约的，加长记忆无法消除；量子模型可用单 qutrit 达到完美对齐，构成对齐世界模型上的不可约量子优势。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: RetiWave-Mamba: A Dual-Stream Network for Retinal Disease Detection based on Multi-scale Context and Feature-Adaptive Mamba Projection
papers.abstract_en: Retinal diseases are a leading cause of irreversible vision impairment, making early and accurate diagnosis essential for effective treatment. Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) serves as a critical imaging modality for this purpose, yet its automated analysis is hindered by inherent speckle noise, varying lesion scales, and subtle inter-class similarities. To address these challenges, we propose a novel framework, RetiWave-Mamba, which integrates spatial-frequency domain learning with state-of-the-art state space models. The framework utilizes Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) to decompose OCT images into low- and high-frequency streams, enabling decoupled processing of structural context and fine-grained details. For the low-frequency branch, we design a Multi-scale Contextual Localization Module (MCLM), which synergizes multi-scale dilation with spatial attention to expand the global receptive field and precisely localize lesion regions. For the high-frequency branch, we introduce an Attention-Guided High-Resolution Network (AG-HRNet) equipped with an intelligent gating mechanism to suppress noise propagation during multi-scale interactions. Furthermore, a Feature-Adaptive Mamba Projector (FAMP) is incorporated to form complementary channel-wise feature paths and adaptively reweight them using Mamba-generated gates. Extensive experiments on the OCT-C8 dataset demonstrate that our approach achieves a state-of-the-art (SOTA) classification accuracy of 98.38, surpassing existing methods. These results highlight the effectiveness of RetiWave-Mamba in identifying retinal pathologies and support its potential for computer-aided OCT image analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RetiWave-Mamba 用 DWT 把 OCT 图像拆成低频结构流与高频细节流，分别经 MCLM 与 AG-HRNet 处理，再由 Feature-Adaptive Mamba Projector 生成通道门控做互补融合。在 OCT-C8 数据集上分类准确率 98.38，超过已有方法。
Motivation: OCT 自动分析受斑点噪声、病灶尺度差异和类间细微差异干扰，单一尺度的特征提取难以同时保留全局结构与细节。
Method: 先用 Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) 将 OCT 图像分解为低频与高频两路；低频分支用 Multi-scale Contextual Localization Module (MCLM) 结合多尺度空洞卷积与空间注意力扩大感受野并定位病灶，高频分支用 Attention-Guided High-Resolution Network (AG-HRNet) 的门控机制抑制噪声在多尺度交互中传播；最后 Feature-Adaptive Mamba Projector (FAMP) 构造互补通道路径并用 Mamba 生成的门自适应重加权。
Result: 在 OCT-C8 数据集上取得 98.38 的分类准确率，达到 state-of-the-art，超过现有方法。
Conclusion: 空间-频率解耦学习结合 Mamba 状态空间模型的通道门控，足以让 OCT 病灶分类达到 SOTA 水平，支持其用于计算机辅助 OCT 图像分析。

papers.title: LightLoc++: Sensor-Robust Representation Learning for Efficient Outdoor LiDAR Localization
papers.abstract_en: Scene coordinate regression (SCR) achieves strong performance in outdoor LiDAR localization, but it usually requires scene-specific training that can take days, limiting practical deployment. Recent works improve training efficiency by decoupling SCR into a scene-agnostic backbone and scene-specific prediction heads, where the backbone is pretrained on source datasets and frozen for new scenes, and only lightweight heads are optimized. However, we find that this paradigm heavily depends on the pretrained backbone. Existing decoupled methods can match conventional SCR methods fully optimized for each new scene when LiDAR configurations are similar to those used during backbone pretraining, but their accuracy drops noticeably on datasets collected with different LiDAR sensors. This suggests that efficient LiDAR localization requires representations that capture stable scene geometry across LiDAR configurations. Motivated by this observation, we propose LightLoc++, a sensor-robust and efficient outdoor LiDAR localization framework. To support sensor-robust representation learning, we introduce SULID, a synchronized urban multi-LiDAR dataset with representative 32-, 64-, and 128-beam rotating LiDARs, extensive cross-sensor overlap, and diverse urban scenes. Using SULID, we pretrain a sensor-robust backbone through cross-sensor consistency learning. LightLoc++ further preserves efficient new-scene learning by incorporating sample classification guidance and redundant sample downsampling, which reduce regression ambiguity and computational redundancy in large-scale outdoor scenes. Extensive experiments on multiple outdoor LiDAR localization benchmarks demonstrate that LightLoc++ achieves state-of-the-art localization performance with the lowest new-scene training cost among compared methods. Code and dataset will be made available at https://github.com/liw95/LightLoc-PlusPlus.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LightLoc++ 针对解耦式 SCR 在换 LiDAR 传感器后精度明显下降的问题，用同步多激光雷达数据集 SULID（32/64/128 线）做跨传感器一致性预训练，得到传感器鲁棒的 backbone，再配合样本分类引导与冗余样本下采样实现低成本新场景训练。在多个室外 LiDAR 定位基准上达到 SOTA，且新场景训练开销在对比方法中最低。
Motivation: 解耦式 SCR 依赖预训练 backbone，当新数据的 LiDAR 配置与预训练所用传感器不同时精度明显下降，而逐场景全量训练又需数天，制约部署。
Method: 构建同步城市多 LiDAR 数据集 SULID（32、64、128 线旋转 LiDAR，跨传感器重叠充分），用跨传感器一致性学习 (cross-sensor consistency learning) 预训练传感器鲁棒 backbone；新场景侧加入样本分类引导与冗余样本下采样，降低回归歧义与大规模室外场景的计算冗余。
Result: 在多个室外 LiDAR 定位基准上取得 state-of-the-art 定位性能，且在对比方法中新场景训练开销最低；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 跨传感器一致性预训练得到的稳定场景几何表示，是解耦式 LiDAR SCR 在不同传感器配置下保持精度同时压低新场景训练成本的关键。

papers.title: Safe and Robust Neural Policy Learning with Statistical Verification for Sim-to-Real Deployment in Robotics
papers.abstract_en: Synthesizing safe and robust neural controllers in simulation for reliable sim-to-real deployment remains a critical challenge in robotics. Existing learning-based methods typically lack safety and performance guarantees over an explicitly defined operating region, while post-training verification techniques provide no mechanism to refine controllers when safety violations are detected. To bridge this gap, we propose a curriculum-driven framework that tightly integrates scenario-based Evolution Strategy with Statistical Model Checking-based verification in a closed-loop procedure. Starting from a candidate region, our approach co-optimizes policy performance while progressively enlarging its safe operating boundaries. Upon termination, it yields a neural controller together with a region over which safety and performance are statistically verified. Extensive evaluations on Cartpole and 3D Quadrotor benchmarks, showing 6.14x and 224.04x expansions, respectively, of the safe operating region over mathematically certified ones, together with physical experiments under both nominal conditions and severe dynamic perturbations, demonstrate that our learned controllers consistently outperform established control-theoretic and learning-based baselines. Furthermore, we show that the size of the verified region serves as a quantitative indicator of policy quality before deployment. These results establish our framework as an automated pipeline for learning, assessing and deploying safe and robust neural controllers from simulation to reality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出课程驱动的闭环框架，把基于场景的 Evolution Strategy 与 Statistical Model Checking (SMC) 验证耦合，在训练中共同优化策略性能并逐步扩大可验证的安全工作区。在 Cartpole 与 3D Quadrotor 上，安全区相对数学认证方法分别扩大 6.14 倍与 224.04 倍，实体实验在标称与强动态扰动下均优于控制论与学习类基线。
Motivation: 仿真中合成的神经控制器缺少在显式工作区上的安全与性能保证，而事后验证技术发现违规后又无法反向修正控制器。
Method: 从候选区域出发，用课程驱动的 scenario-based Evolution Strategy 与 SMC 验证组成闭环：共同优化策略性能并逐步扩大安全工作边界，终止时输出神经控制器及其被统计验证的区域；并把验证区域大小作为部署前的策略质量指标。
Result: Cartpole 与 3D Quadrotor 基准上安全工作区相对数学认证结果分别扩大 6.14 倍与 224.04 倍；实体实验在标称条件与严重动态扰动下，所学控制器持续优于既有控制论与学习类基线；验证区域大小可作为部署前策略质量的定量指标。
Conclusion: 把统计验证嵌入训练闭环可以同时给出性能与可验证安全区，验证区域尺寸可直接当作部署前的策略质量指标，形成从仿真到实机的自动化学习、评估与部署流水线。

papers.title: Learning to Rank Tensor Network Contraction Plans for GPU-Accelerated Quantum Circuit Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Classical simulation remains essential for developing and validating quantum algorithms, but its cost grows rapidly with circuit size. Tensor-network contraction can reduce this cost by exploiting circuit structure, although its efficiency depends strongly on the chosen contraction plan. On GPUs, plans with similar theoretical complexity may perform very differently because execution also depends on parallelism, reduction structure, memory traffic, and contraction geometry. We present a learning-to-rank framework for selecting efficient contraction plans before executing them. Each plan is represented by structural features derived directly from its sequence of pairwise contractions, and gradient-boosted rankers are trained from GPU measurements using listwise and pairwise objectives. We evaluate the resulting models on diverse circuit families, using separate in-distribution and circuit-family-shift test sets, and compare them with random and MinFill-based baselines. The learned rankers generally identify better plans, with the listwise model providing the strongest overall decision quality. We also study backend shift by comparing empirical plan orderings on two GPU architectures and evaluating the source-trained models on the second device without retraining. The rankings remain substantially, though not perfectly, stable across GPUs, and the models retain useful decision quality. These results support Learning to Rank as a practical way to reduce contraction-plan search, while showing that performance remains partly backend dependent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 GPU 量子线路张量网络收缩中，用 learning-to-rank 在执行前挑选收缩计划：以成对收缩序列的结构特征为输入，用梯度提升排序器（listwise 与 pairwise 目标）从 GPU 实测数据训练。在多类线路族的分布内与线路族偏移测试集上，学习排序器普遍找到更好的计划，listwise 模型决策质量最强；跨 GPU 架构不重训时排序仍大体稳定但非完全不变。
Motivation: 张量网络收缩的成本高度依赖所选收缩计划，而在 GPU 上理论复杂度相近的计划会因并行度、归约结构、内存访问与收缩几何而表现迥异，穷举搜索代价高。
Method: 每个计划由其成对收缩序列直接导出的结构特征表示，梯度提升排序器分别用 listwise 与 pairwise 目标从 GPU 实测计时训练；在多样线路族上划分分布内与 circuit-family-shift 测试集，并与随机和 MinFill 基线比较，另在两种 GPU 架构上比较经验计划排序并把源设备训练的模型直接用于第二设备。
Result: 学习排序器普遍识别出更好的计划，其中 listwise 模型整体决策质量最强，优于随机与 MinFill 基线；跨 GPU 的经验计划排序保持大体（但非完全）稳定，源端训练模型在第二设备上不重训仍保留有用决策质量。
Conclusion: Learning to Rank 可作为削减收缩计划搜索空间的实用手段，但所选计划的性能仍部分依赖 GPU 后端，跨设备迁移需考虑这一依赖。

papers.title: World-to-Wrist: Task-Conditioned Future Wrist Modeling for Fine-Grained Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models often treat main-view and wrist-view observations as parallel visual inputs, overlooking their distinct roles in robot manipulation. Fine-grained manipulation, however, benefits from anticipating how wrist-local interactions may evolve under the global task context. To address this limitation, we present World-to-Wrist VLA (W2-VLA), a VLA model for fine-grained robot manipulation with task-conditioned future wrist modeling. Given current multi-view observations and a task instruction, W2-VLA contextualizes a set of latent modeling tokens as a compact interface between the vision-language model and the wrist predictor. Conditioned on this interface and the observed wrist history, the predictor forecasts future wrist latents, which are transformed into future-aware context for action prediction. In addition, we introduce W2-CoT, a synthesis pipeline that produces structured annotations describing manipulation progress, physical transition cues, and wrist-local evidence. These annotations provide auxiliary supervision that shapes the task-conditioned latent interface. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate improved fine-grained and contact-sensitive manipulation across single-arm and bimanual settings, while maintaining real-time action generation above $80$~Hz.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: W2-VLA 把主视角与腕部视角从并行视觉输入改为条件化的未来腕部潜变量预测：用一组 latent modeling tokens 作为视觉语言模型与腕部预测器之间的紧凑接口，预测未来腕部潜变量并转成 future-aware context 供动作生成。在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 2.0 与真实操作任务上改善细粒度与接触敏感操作，同时保持 80 Hz 以上的实时动作生成。
Motivation: VLA 模型把主视角和腕部视角当作平行视觉输入，忽略两者在操作中的不同角色；细粒度操作需要在全局任务语境下预判腕部局部交互如何演化。
Method: W2-VLA 用 latent modeling tokens 作为视觉语言模型与腕部预测器的接口，预测器以该接口和观测到的腕部历史为条件预报未来腕部潜变量，再变换为 future-aware context 参与动作预测；另提出 W2-CoT 合成流水线，生成描述操作进度、物理转变线索与腕部局部证据的结构化标注作为辅助监督。
Result: 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 2.0 及真实操作任务上，单臂与双臂设置均改善细粒度与接触敏感操作，动作生成实时性保持在 80 Hz 以上。
Conclusion: 把腕部视角当作可预测的任务条件未来量而非平行观测，能在不牺牲实时性的前提下提升细粒度、接触敏感的机器人操作。

papers.title: Escaping Oversquashing: Addressable and Support-Aware Global Memory for Message Passing Networks
papers.abstract_en: Virtual nodes are a natural tool against oversquashing: they replace long message-passing paths by a two-hop global route. But when many nodes share one global state, that shortcut can become a bottleneck itself. We study two properties of this global memory. First, addressability: under constant-margin address codes and a nonlinearity that amplifies this margin, multiplicative write/read maps provide $M$ selectable memory rows with only $O(\log M)$ address-code dimensions. Cross-attention slots and a constrained $ELU+1$ bilinear memory both satisfy these conditions. Second, support awareness: normalized cross-attention has no self-key for a latent query to use as a reference. A learned private anchor supplies this reference, keeps the read bounded, and exposes the strength of the matching source mass. We demonstrate the merits of such properties on several instances of Two-Radius and Tree-NeighborsMatch: both addressable realizations solve the controlled tasks through depth $5$, where pooled VNs of comparable or larger size reach about $10.6\%$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 虚拟节点 (virtual nodes) 用两跳全局通路缓解过压缩，但多节点共享同一全局态会把捷径变成新瓶颈。论文提出全局记忆的两个性质：地址化 (addressability) 用常数裕度地址码加放大非线性，让乘性写读映射以 O(log M) 维地址码提供 M 行可选记忆；支撑感知 (support awareness) 用学习出的私有锚点给隐查询提供参照，使读取有界并暴露匹配源质量。在 Two-Radius 与 Tree-NeighborsMatch 上，两种地址化实现都通过深度 5，而同等或更大规模的池化 VN 只达到约 10.6%。
Motivation: 虚拟节点把长消息传递路径压成两跳全局通路，但当大量节点共享一个全局状态时，这个捷径本身成为瓶颈，池化 VN 在受控任务上很快失效。
Method: 定义并检验全局记忆的两个性质：其一为地址化，采用常数裕度地址码与放大该裕度的非线性，使乘性写读映射以 O(log M) 维地址码提供 M 行可选记忆，cross-attention slots 与受约束的 ELU+1 双线性记忆均满足条件；其二为支撑感知，针对归一化 cross-attention 缺少可供隐查询参照的 self-key，引入学习出的私有锚点 (private anchor) 作为参照，约束读取有界并暴露匹配源质量。
Result: 在 Two-Radius 与 Tree-NeighborsMatch 的若干实例上，两种地址化实现均通过深度 5 解出受控任务，而同等或更大规模的池化 VN 只达到约 10.6%。
Conclusion: 全局记忆要同时具备地址化与支撑感知，才能让虚拟节点的两跳捷径真正可用；按 O(log M) 地址码组织记忆行并给读取加私有锚点参照，是在这些受控任务上越过池化 VN 瓶颈的具体做法。

papers.title: World Action Planner: Generalizable Robot Decision-Making with Action-Conditioned World Models
papers.abstract_en: Building generalizable robot agents for diverse applications remains a fundamental challenge. While imitation learning-based policies can perform well in familiar training environments, they often struggle to generalize to novel scenes, layouts, and task compositions. To this end, we present World Action Planner, an agentic robot planning system in which the agent searches for and composes executable action plans through imagination with an action-conditioned world model. The search proceeds in a coarse-to-fine manner. First, the agent performs global action optimization by reasoning over imagined world-model rollouts to identify potential failures and refine the proposed action plan. It then performs local action search, comparing the imagined future outcomes of neighboring candidates to select the best action for execution. Across compositional long-horizon tasks, novel object layouts, and real-robot planning on novel tasks without expert demonstrations, World Action Planner consistently outperforms state-of-the-art end-to-end generalist policy models and VLM planners, demonstrating the effectiveness of world-model-based action search for generalizable robot decision making. Qualitative results and videos are available at https://worldactionplanner.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: World Action Planner 是一个基于动作条件世界模型 (action-conditioned world model) 的机器人规划系统：先在想象的 rollout 上做全局动作优化以发现并修正计划中的失败点，再对相邻候选动作的想象结果做局部搜索选出执行动作。在组合式长时程任务、新物体布局以及无专家演示的新任务真机规划上，它持续优于端到端通用策略模型与 VLM 规划器。
Motivation: 模仿学习策略在训练环境里表现好，但换到新场景、新布局和新任务组合时泛化失败，需要一种不依赖专家演示也能规划出可执行动作序列的机制。
Method: 智能体用动作条件世界模型想象 rollout，按 coarse-to-fine 两阶段搜索：全局动作优化在想象轨迹上推理以识别潜在失败并改进动作计划，局部动作搜索比较相邻候选的想象未来结果来选定执行动作。
Result: 在组合式长时程任务、新物体布局、以及无专家演示的新任务真机规划三类设置上，World Action Planner 持续优于 SOTA 的端到端通用策略模型 (generalist policy) 与 VLM 规划器；摘要以定性对比呈现，未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 基于世界模型的动作搜索是实现可泛化机器人决策的有效路径，即使没有专家演示也能在新任务上规划出可执行方案。

papers.title: Using large language models to probe the limits of atom-centered structural descriptors
papers.abstract_en: Mapping an atomic structure to a compact set of geometric descriptors is an essential step in any machine-learning application to atomic-scale modeling. A powerful and widely-used approach can be understood as a discretization of the histogram of pair distances, triangles, etc., that results in a hierarchy of symmetry-invariant atom-centered descriptors. Unfortunately, the lower rungs on this hierarchy (two, three, four-neighbor clusters) were found to be incomplete, with symmetry-unrelated pairs of structures having exactly the same descriptors. However, all the ``degeneracies'' reported so far are resolved by considering larger clusters of neighbors to build the descriptors. We report examples of 3D structures that are indistinguishable even if one considers clusters of up to seven neighbors, and to arbitrary order when considering a practical level of discretization of the descriptors, discovered with the assistance of large language models. The key ingredients in their construction can be traced to results that have been known for decades in different communities: the model was able to find the references and recognize their significance for the problem at hand. We believe this experiment exposes an extremely fruitful usage pattern for AI in science: translating results between different communities and application domains, accelerating the process by which serendipitous discoveries in a field become breakthroughs in another.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用大语言模型 (LLM) 检索跨领域文献，构造出在原子中心结构描述符 (atom-centered structural descriptors) 上完全简并的 3D 结构：即使把邻居簇扩到 7 个、并在实际离散化精度下到任意阶，两组对称性不同的结构仍给出相同描述符。作者据此主张 LLM 的一种高效用法是把一个领域里早已熟知的结果翻译到另一个领域，加速跨域的偶发发现变成突破。
Motivation: 基于距离、三角形直方图离散化的对称不变描述符层级中，低阶（2、3、4 邻居簇）已被证明不完备，但此前报告的简并都能靠更大邻居簇解决；需要检验该不完备性在实用精度下是否根本无法靠加阶消除。
Method: 以 LLM 辅助检索与识别不同学术共同体中数十年前的已知结果，将其意义映射到当前问题，据此构造 3D 结构反例；考察对象是直方图离散化得到的对称不变原子中心描述符层级，逐级增加邻居簇规模与离散化阶数。
Result: 给出在邻居簇多达 7 个时仍不可区分的 3D 结构对，且在实际离散化精度下对任意阶都简并；此前文献中 2、3、4 邻居簇的简并均可由更大簇化解，而新反例不能。
Conclusion: 该描述符层级在实用离散化下即便到 7 邻居、任意阶仍不完备，加阶不能根治简并；LLM 跨领域搬运既有结果是科学发现中可行且高效的用法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Early Detection of Distributed Backdoors in Multi-Agent LLM Systems: A Characterization Study
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM systems can be attacked by a payload that no single agent ever holds in full: several poisoned tools each hide one encrypted fragment, spreading them across several agents, and an external step reassembles and executes them after the run. Per-step safety checks that judge each action in isolation may fail to recognize the complete distributed payload. We investigate how early such an attack can be detected while the run is still unfolding, and how robustly it can be caught once its most obvious cues are stripped away. We build a working instance on a hierarchical multi-agent system, run it under benign and attacked conditions across five language models and two tool environments, and record when each fragment is injected and when the payload is assembled and executed. Almost no run is flagged before its first fragment is injected; once injection begins, a prefix detector flags $99.5\%$ of successful attacks with a median of twelve steps remaining and an out-of-fold false-alarm rate of about $1\%$ on uninjected runs, higher on runs that carried fragments but never assembled. Because assembly occurs only after the run, these alarms could enable an abort before assembly on nearly every successful attack. We also test a detector that sees only the current observation, to ask whether earlier steps are needed. When the current observation carries an obvious clue, one observation is often enough; when that clue is removed, using earlier steps can help. Generic zero-shot and behavior-trained detectors fail to separate unsafe from safe runs; the detectors that do work lean in part on removable surface cues, chiefly the ciphertext's length and entropy. Take those cues away and the detector fires later, and carrying it from one tool environment to the other becomes much harder. A model fine-tuned on the raw text recovers part of the loss.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对多智能体 LLM 系统中分散在多个被投毒工具里的加密分片式分布式后门，构建层级多智能体实例，在 5 个语言模型与 2 个工具环境下记录分片注入与重组执行时点。前缀检测器 (prefix detector) 在注入开始后检出 99.5% 的成功攻击，中位剩余 12 步，未注入运行的 out-of-fold 误报率约 1%；去掉密文长度与熵等表面线索后检测变晚且跨工具环境迁移困难。
Motivation: 分布式载荷的加密分片分散在多个智能体中，任何单个智能体都不持有完整载荷，逐步孤立的安全检查无法识别组装后的完整攻击，因此需要在运行尚未结束时尽早发现。
Method: 在层级多智能体系统上构建可运行的分布式后门实例，在良性与受攻击条件下横跨 5 个语言模型和 2 个工具环境运行，记录每个分片注入及载荷重组执行的时点；对比前缀检测器、仅看当前观测的检测器、零样本与行为训练检测器，并做去除表面线索与跨工具环境迁移测试。
Result: 首次分片注入前几乎没有任何运行被标记；注入开始后，前缀检测器标记 99.5% 的成功攻击，中位剩余 12 步，未注入运行的 out-of-fold 误报率约 1%，在携带分片但从未重组的运行上误报更高。当前观测含明显线索时常一步即可检出，去掉线索后依赖更早步骤有帮助；零样本与行为训练检测器无法区分不安全与安全运行，有效检测器部分依赖密文长度与熵，去掉线索后触发更晚、跨工具环境迁移更难，在原始文本上微调的模型可恢复部分损失。
Conclusion: 由于组装只发生在运行结束后，注入开始后的告警可在几乎每个成功攻击上支持组装前中止；但这类检测器部分依赖可移除的表面线索，鲁棒性与跨环境迁移是主要脆弱点。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Interrupting the Chain: Human Perception of AI-Generated Disinformation Through a Kill Chain Lens
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI enables customized misinformation at scale, yet defenses remain largely reactive. We present empirical findings from a human-subject study (n=504 participants, n=2,438 judgments) in which users classified news fragments by origin (human vs. machine) and veracity (real vs. fake). We organize results using an adapted cybersecurity kill chain as a taxonomy for intervention, mapping perception data onto stages of a cognitive attack lifecycle. Three key findings emerge: (1) a perception-accuracy gap where heightened suspicion does not improve detection; (2) modern LLMs frequently produce human-indistinguishable text; and (3) an asymmetric cognitive fatigue effect where fake-news detection degrades by 10.2 percentage points under sustained exposure while AI-origin detection remains stable. These findings identify candidate intervention points for proactive defense against AI-driven disinformation.
papers.journal_ref: INFORMATIK 2026, LNI P-384, pp. 321-330
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 一项 504 人、2,438 次判断的人机实验显示：提高怀疑程度并不能提升对 AI 生成虚假新闻的识别；现代 LLM 文本常与人类写作无法区分；持续暴露下，假新闻识别率下降 10.2 个百分点，而判断文本来源（人/机）的能力保持稳定。作者据此用改造后的网络安全 kill chain 定位认知攻击生命周期上的主动干预点。
Motivation: 生成式 AI 使定制化虚假信息可规模化生产，现有防御基本是事后反应式；缺少对人类感知环节的实证刻画，无法确定应在认知攻击链的哪一阶段插入主动防御。
Method: 对 504 名受试者做人类被试实验，共收集 2,438 次判断，让参与者对新闻片段分别判定来源（人类 vs. 机器）与真伪（真实 vs. 虚假）；再用改造后的网络安全 kill chain 作为干预分类法，把感知数据映射到认知攻击生命周期的各阶段。
Result: 三项发现：感知-准确率落差，即怀疑程度升高并不改善检测；现代 LLM 生成的文本常与人类写作无法区分；非对称认知疲劳效应，持续暴露下假新闻检测下降 10.2 个百分点，而 AI 来源检测保持稳定。
Conclusion: 对 AI 虚假信息的防御应从反应式转向主动式，把干预点放在 kill chain 中识别能力退化（真伪判断）而非来源判断的环节。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DriftWorld: Fast World Modeling through Drifting
papers.abstract_en: Predictive world models enable robots to simulate the visual outcomes of their actions, but state-of-the-art diffusion-based models remain costly because generating each rollout requires multi-step iterative denoising. We introduce DriftWorld, an action-conditioned world model based on drifting generative models. DriftWorld learns a conditional drift during training, enabling it to generate future observations for a given action sequence in a single forward pass during inference. Across Bridge-V2, RT-1, Language Table, Push-T, and Robomimic, DriftWorld runs at over 40 fps and is 12+ times faster than diffusion-based baselines, while matching or improving their visual generation quality. This makes DriftWorld an efficient world model for robot simulation and further enables downstream applications including inference-time action search and offline policy evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DriftWorld 是动作条件化的机器人世界模型，用 drifting generative model 在训练时学条件漂移，使给定动作序列的未来观测生成只需一次前向传播。在 Bridge-V2、RT-1、Language Table、Push-T、Robomimic 上运行超过 40 fps，比 diffusion 基线快 12 倍以上，视觉生成质量持平或更好。
Motivation: diffusion 类世界模型每次 rollout 都要多步迭代去噪，仿真成本高，限制了机器人动作搜索与离线策略评估等下游用途。
Method: 基于 drifting generative models 构建动作条件化世界模型，训练阶段学习给定动作序列的条件漂移，推理时单次前向传播直接生成未来观测，替代多步去噪。
Result: 在 Bridge-V2、RT-1、Language Table、Push-T、Robomimic 五个基准上运行速度超过 40 fps，比 diffusion 基线快 12 倍以上，视觉生成质量与基线持平或更好。
Conclusion: 单次前向的条件漂移生成可以把机器人世界模型的速度提高一个数量级而不牺牲视觉质量，从而支撑推理时动作搜索与离线策略评估。

papers.title: How Artificial Intelligence LLM Engines Shape the Global Conflict Information Environment
papers.abstract_en: Artificial Intelligence (AI) answer engines now field a growing share of the questions that analysts, scholars, and the public ask about issues of peace and conflict. Large Language Models (LLMs) are known to hallucinate under certain conditions, but do these errors have discernible patterns when they are asked about conflicts, and if so what can that teach us about the changing global conflict information environment? To answer, we first asked a battery of questions about 28 conflicts to five leading answer engines and scored their 5,460 answers against documented evidence. We found that the thinner the retrievable record around a given conflict, the more the engines invent, misattribute, and miscount. Thin records don't just encourage hallucination, but create structural exposure to mis- and disinformation, because they are the easiest records to warp through Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) to bias engine responses. Through an analysis of 1,048 websites that the AI LLMs pulled conflict facts from, we found that GEO source optimization is already happening, and while state-partisan digital capture remains incipient it is rapidly growing. We explain what these findings mean for scholarship with the rise of GEO information warfare, and for policy argue for a return to the deep local monitoring and translation-based research that AI tools cannot replicate, closing with a discussion of future research opportunities and challenges in this fast-moving space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 28 场冲突向五个主流 AI 答案引擎提问并按证据打分 5,460 条回答，发现可检索记录越薄，引擎越倾向编造、错引与错数；薄记录同时最易被生成式引擎优化 (GEO) 操纵，因而构成结构性的错误与虚假信息暴露。作者主张政策上回归 AI 无法复制的深度本地监测与翻译型研究。
Motivation: LLM 在冲突议题上开始承接大量提问，但其幻觉是否在和平与冲突领域呈现可辨识的模式、以及这如何改变全球冲突信息环境，此前不清楚。
Method: 围绕 28 场冲突设计一组问题，向五个领先答案引擎提问，将 5,460 条回答对照有据可查的证据打分；再分析 LLM 引用冲突事实的 1,048 个网站，检验 GEO 来源优化是否已发生。
Result: 5,460 条回答的打分显示：可检索记录越薄，编造、错引、错数越多；对 1,048 个网站的分析发现 GEO 来源优化已在发生，国家派系式数字捕获 (state-partisan digital capture) 尚处初期但增长迅速。
Conclusion: 薄记录不只是诱发幻觉，而是通过 GEO 操纵形成对错误与虚假信息的结构性暴露；应对路径是 AI 无法复制的深度本地监测与翻译型研究。

papers.title: DAGR: State-Conditioned Goal Representations via Difference-Aware Goal Cross-Attention
papers.abstract_en: Goal-conditioned reinforcement learning hinges on how the goal is encoded. Contrastive, metric, temporal-distance and information-theoretic encoders disagree on the objective. They agree on one thing. None of them sees the current state, so the embedding cannot mark which part of the goal still needs action, and the policy must recover that cue by inverting both encoders. We propose DAGR, which refines the static embedding of any late-fusion encoder into a state-conditioned one through multi-scale gated cross-attention. A gated residual holds the refinement near the base, and a difference-aware attention rule biases the scores by a per-token state-goal mismatch. A single condition decides what such a refinement can guarantee, namely whether the block returns its input at closed gates. We prove that the usual post-norm placement violates it, measure the consequence on frozen checkpoints, and recover part of the resulting loss by restoring the condition. On OGBench DAGR improves navigation and matches or trails the base elsewhere. Our ablations trace the gain to the gated residual rather than to the difference bias that names the method. Code is available at https://github.com/leixingxing1/DAGR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DAGR 用多尺度门控交叉注意力把任意 late-fusion 目标编码器的静态嵌入改写成状态条件化嵌入，门控残差保证关闭门时块返回输入。证明常规 post-norm 违反该条件，在冻结 checkpoint 上量化其损失并部分恢复；OGBench 上导航任务提升，其余任务持平或略逊，消融显示增益来自门控残差而非命名方法的 difference bias。
Motivation: 目标条件强化学习的目标编码器都不看当前状态，嵌入无法标出目标中仍需行动的部分，策略只能靠反演两个编码器自行恢复该线索。
Method: DAGR 对任意 late-fusion 编码器的静态嵌入做多尺度门控交叉注意力 (gated cross-attention) 精炼：门控残差把精炼结果约束在基嵌入附近，difference-aware 注意力按逐 token 的状态-目标失配偏置分数；以“关闭门时块返回输入”为可保证条件，证明 post-norm 违反该条件并在冻结 checkpoint 上测量后果。
Result: 在 OGBench 上 DAGR 改善导航任务，其余任务持平或落后于基编码器；消融把增益归因于门控残差而非 difference bias；恢复该条件后收回部分损失。
Conclusion: 状态条件化精炼的保证来自门控残差这一结构条件，而非命名方法的失配偏置；post-norm 位置会破坏该保证。

papers.title: Autoregressive latent diffusion for 3D molecule generation
papers.abstract_en: Three-dimensional (3D) molecule generation has been dominated by diffusion models, which achieve strong generation quality but typically require molecular size to be specified (or predicted) separately before generation. This can be limiting for fragment-based molecule generation, central to drug discovery, where the size of the generated structure is itself part of the design problem. Autoregressive models determine size during generation and naturally support partial-structure conditioning, but balancing unconditional and fragment-conditioned generation remains challenging. We introduce KRONOS, a latent autoregressive diffusion framework that generates molecules in the latent space of a Unified AutoEncoder (UAE), jointly modeling molecular graph topology and geometry, while retaining the flexibility of autoregressive generation. We further introduce a mixed training strategy inspired by the Fill-in-the-Middle (FIM) paradigm, enabling a single left-to-right autoregressive model to support both unconditional and fragment-conditioned generation. Experiments on QM9 and GEOM-Drugs demonstrate strong unconditional generation performance and competitive fragment-conditioned generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KRONOS 把 3D 分子生成做成 Unified AutoEncoder (UAE) 潜空间里的自回归扩散，联合建模分子图拓扑与几何，分子大小在生成过程中自行确定，无需像扩散模型那样事先指定。借鉴 Fill-in-the-Middle (FIM) 的混合训练策略让同一个从左到右的自回归模型同时支持无条件生成与片段条件生成，在 QM9 与 GEOM-Drugs 上无条件生成表现强、片段条件生成具竞争力。
Motivation: 主流 3D 分子扩散模型要求先指定或预测分子大小，而基于片段的药物发现中生成结构的大小本身就是设计问题；自回归模型能边生成边定大小，但无条件与片段条件生成的平衡一直难做。
Method: KRONOS 是潜空间自回归扩散框架：在 Unified AutoEncoder (UAE) 的潜空间中生成，联合建模分子图拓扑与几何；训练上引入受 Fill-in-the-Middle (FIM) 启发的混合训练策略，使单一从左到右的自回归模型兼顾无条件与片段条件生成。
Result: 在 QM9 与 GEOM-Drugs 上的实验显示无条件生成性能强，片段条件生成具有竞争力（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 自回归潜空间扩散加上 FIM 式混合训练，可以在不预先指定分子大小的前提下同时覆盖无条件与片段条件的 3D 分子生成。

papers.title: A Multi-Timescale Recursive Self-Improvement Engine for Open-Ended Persona Growth
papers.abstract_en: Role-playing AI personas today do not grow: they hold a fixed character, so the relationship a user builds with them has nothing to accumulate on. We introduce AutoPersonas, a multi-timescale engine that applies recursive self-improvement (RSI) to persona growth: rather than improving its intelligence, the persona recursively revises the State, evidence, and life-environment that shape its own future. We identify self-locking as the runtime failure mode of this recursion: locally plausible events keep appearing while the generated life collapses toward familiar environments, weak relationships, suspended decisions, and stale life stages. We trace it to model-level convergence toward high-probability behavioral channels and system-level context gravity from State, memory, history, and environment summaries. A three-year compressed simulation exposed environment watermark shells, occurrence-hardening gaps, slow-change accumulation failures, recursive indecision, and weak relationship persistence. An eight-model 40-day stress test generated 1,600 events and found mean rolling 5-day action-category repetition of 95.2%-97.6%, with all models crossing 90% by day 11; semantic re-keeping found 79.0%-88.0% macro-theme repetition. The primary contribution is the definition and measurement of self-locking. We also report a mitigation as a black-box result, with internals withheld for commercial reasons: in a same-runtime 40-day A/B, our production divergence configuration reduced macro-theme repetition from 61.8% to 39.4% and nearly doubled cumulative theme count, and a juvenile-goblin fictional-world run reproduced this regime without hard real-world intrusions.
papers.comment: 52 pages, 13 figures/tables, ancillary public-safe evaluation artifacts included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AutoPersonas 把递归自我改进 (RSI) 用在人格成长而非智力提升上，并把反复出现的自锁 (self-locking) 定义为可测量的运行时失效模式：八模型 40 天压测中动作类别 5 天滚动重复率均值 95.2%–97.6%，全部模型在第 11 天越过 90%。同运行时 40 天 A/B 中，其生产发散配置把宏观主题重复率从 61.8% 降到 39.4%，累计主题数接近翻倍。
Motivation: 现有人格扮演 AI 角色固定不变，用户与之建立的关系无处累积；递归自我改进在该场景下会退化为自锁——局部看似合理的事件不断生成，但生活塌缩到熟悉环境、薄弱关系、悬置决策与停滞人生阶段。
Method: 提出 AutoPersonas：多时间尺度引擎让人格递归修订塑造其未来的 State、证据与生活环境；先用三年压缩仿真暴露环境水印壳、occurrence-hardening 缺口、慢变化累积失败、递归犹豫与关系持续性弱等问题，再做八模型 40 天压测（生成 1,600 个事件）并用语义 re-keeping 统计宏观主题重复。
Result: 八模型 40 天压测共 1,600 个事件，动作类别 5 天滚动重复率均值 95.2%–97.6%，所有模型第 11 天即超过 90%；语义 re-keeping 测得宏观主题重复 79.0%–88.0%。同运行时 40 天 A/B 中生产发散配置把宏观主题重复从 61.8% 降至 39.4%，累计主题数接近翻倍；一个 juvenile-goblin 虚构世界运行复现了该区间且无硬性现实侵入。
Conclusion: 自锁是人格递归的核心失效模式，其根源在模型层向高概率行为通道收敛与系统层来自 State、记忆、历史和环境摘要的 context gravity；发散配置可作为黑盒缓解手段（内部细节因商业原因未公开）。

summary_sections.tldr: AutoPersonas 把递归自我改进 (RSI) 用在人格成长而非智力提升上，并把反复出现的自锁 (self-locking) 定义为可测量的运行时失效模式：八模型 40 天压测中动作类别 5 天滚动重复率均值 95.2%–97.6%，全部模型在第 11 天越过 90%。同运行时 40 天 A/B 中，其生产发散配置把宏观主题重复率从 61.8% 降到 39.4%，累计主题数接近翻倍。

summary_sections.method: 提出 AutoPersonas：多时间尺度引擎让人格递归修订塑造其未来的 State、证据与生活环境；先用三年压缩仿真暴露环境水印壳、occurrence-hardening 缺口、慢变化累积失败、递归犹豫与关系持续性弱等问题，再做八模型 40 天压测（生成 1,600 个事件）并用语义 re-keeping 统计宏观主题重复。
summary_sections.result: 八模型 40 天压测共 1,600 个事件，动作类别 5 天滚动重复率均值 95.2%–97.6%，所有模型第 11 天即超过 90%；语义 re-keeping 测得宏观主题重复 79.0%–88.0%。同运行时 40 天 A/B 中生产发散配置把宏观主题重复从 61.8% 降至 39.4%，累计主题数接近翻倍；一个 juvenile-goblin 虚构世界运行复现了该区间且无硬性现实侵入。
summary_sections.conclusion: 自锁是人格递归的核心失效模式，其根源在模型层向高概率行为通道收敛与系统层来自 State、记忆、历史和环境摘要的 context gravity；发散配置可作为黑盒缓解手段（内部细节因商业原因未公开）。

papers.title: Reliable mechanistic operator recovery with biologically-informed neural networks: principles for architecture and optimisation design
papers.abstract_en: Many biological processes are governed by complex dynamical mechanisms that remain incompletely understood despite increasing volumes of experimental data. Biologically-informed neural networks (BINNs) seek to address this challenge by embedding differential equations into neural network training, enabling constitutive operators to be recovered directly from sparse and noisy observations. However, the extent to which operator recovery depends on architectural design, optimisation strategy and the information within the data is not yet well understood. We present an empirical study of how these factors influence mechanistic inference using BINNs applied to one-dimensional advection-diffusion-reaction partial differential equations. Across a suite of problems, we investigate how network expressivity, learning rate, loss weighting and batch size influence optimisation behaviour, reconstruction accuracy and operator recovery. We show that mechanistic inference is governed by balancing competing objectives rather than maximising any single aspect. Moderately expressive architectures outperform complex networks, intermediate learning rates balance efficient exploration with optimisation stability, accurate operator recovery requires a balance between data-fitting and PDE residual losses and intermediate batch sizes provide the best compromise between efficient parameter space exploration, computational efficiency and reproducibility. We further identify practical diagnostics for recognising common failure modes, including over-fitting, unstable optimisation and poor mechanistic recovery. These findings establish guidelines for deploying BINNs as credible tools for biological model discovery and demonstrate that reliable mechanistic inference is achieved by appropriately balancing model expressivity, optimisation, physical consistency and data informativeness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对生物启发神经网络 (BINN) 做系统消融，结论是机制算子恢复靠平衡竞争目标而非单项拉满：中等表达力网络优于复杂网络，中等学习率兼顾探索与稳定，数据拟合损失与 PDE 残差损失需权衡，中等 batch size 在参数空间探索、计算效率与可复现性之间折中最好。
Motivation: BINN 能从稀疏含噪观测中恢复构成算子，但算子恢复对网络结构、优化策略与数据信息量的依赖尚不清楚，缺少可操作的设计与诊断依据。
Method: 在一维平流-扩散-反应 (advection-diffusion-reaction) PDE 上做经验研究，把微分方程嵌入神经网络训练，系统考察网络表达力、学习率、损失权重与 batch size 对优化行为、重构精度和算子恢复的影响，并归纳识别过拟合、优化不稳、机制恢复差等失效模式的实用诊断。
Result: 中等表达力架构胜过复杂网络；中等学习率在高效探索与优化稳定间取得平衡；准确的算子恢复要求数据拟合损失与 PDE 残差损失之间的平衡；中等 batch size 在参数空间探索、计算效率与可复现性之间提供最佳折中。
Conclusion: 可靠的机制推断来自恰当平衡模型表达力、优化、物理一致性与数据信息量，而非最大化任一单项；据此给出部署 BINN 做生物模型发现的设计准则与失效诊断。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Sentence-Level Context Sensitivity as a Training-Free Detector of Unsupported Content, Evaluated Against Trained Verifiers
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) assistants summarize records in clinical and legal work, where one unsupported sentence can mislead a reader. The contrast between an output's likelihood with and without its source is an established faithfulness score for whole summaries and answers, but it has not been measured as a detector of the individual unsupported sentence in multi-passage RAG answers, against trained verifiers, or for its cost. We implement it as a training-free detector that re-scores a fixed answer under the full context, no context, and each chunk removed, and returns the chunk whose removal lowers a sentence's likelihood most as a candidate supporting passage. We evaluate it on RAGTruth, TofuEval, and RAGBench with six scorers and against five verifiers, up to a large language model (LLM) judge, on identical inputs under a source-level split. Scoring per sentence ranks unsupported sentences better than the answer-level form of the same signal on all three benchmarks, by 0.033 to 0.071 in the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC). On RAGTruth the training-free score reaches an AUC of 0.717 to 0.745 across scorers and 0.773 with a classifier, above entailment and attribution baselines and level with per-chunk fact-checkers, at about one forty-seventh of the LLM judge's compute on a 1.5B scorer, while a full-context fact-checker and the judge are more accurate and are not improved by it. The signal is weakest on short-answer question answering, where the scorer can answer from memory.
papers.comment: 12 pages. Major revision and retitle of v1 (GASP, arXiv:2607.04223): recast as a controlled evaluation of a known with/without-context likelihood signal; results regenerated under a source-level split with identical inputs; adds an answer-level baseline, a cost analysis, and an annotator study. Code: https://github.com/drbouke/GASP
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把「有源/无源上下文的似然差」从摘要级下沉到句子级，做成免训练的 RAG 不支持内容检测器：对固定答案分别在全上下文、无上下文、逐块删除下重打分，取删除后句子似然降幅最大的块作为候选支撑段。在 RAGTruth 上 AUC 0.717–0.745（分类器版 0.773），超过 entailment 与 attribution 基线、与逐块 fact-checker 持平，计算量约为 LLM judge 的 1/47（1.5B scorer）。
Motivation: 临床与法律 RAG 助手中一句无支撑的话就会误导读者；with/without-context 似然差已是摘要与答案级的 faithfulness 分数，但从未被当作多段落答案中单句无支撑内容的检测器来测，也没和训练过的 verifier 比过精度与成本。
Method: 免训练检测器对固定答案做三种重打分（全上下文、无上下文、逐 chunk 删除），返回使某句似然下降最多的 chunk 作为候选支撑段；用六个 scorer、对照五个 verifier（最高到 LLM judge），在 source-level split 下以完全相同输入评测 RAGTruth、TofuEval、RAGBench，并加入答案级同信号基线、成本分析与标注者研究。
Result: 句子级打分在三个基准上均优于同一信号的答案级形式，AUC 高 0.033–0.071。RAGTruth 上免训练分数跨 scorer AUC 0.717–0.745，加分类器达 0.773，高于 entailment 与 attribution 基线、与逐块 fact-checker 持平；在 1.5B scorer 上计算量约为 LLM judge 的 1/47。全上下文 fact-checker 与 judge 更准且不被该信号改进；信号在短答案 QA 上最弱，因为 scorer 可凭记忆作答。
Conclusion: 句子级上下文敏感度是免训练、低成本的无支撑句检测信号，在 RAGTruth 上可比肩逐块 fact-checker，但精度上限低于全上下文 fact-checker 与 LLM judge，且在 scorer 能记忆答案的短问答场景失效。

papers.title: Assessing Rule Adherence of LLM Adjudicators in Call of Cthulhu TRPG
papers.abstract_en: As LLMs are increasingly deployed as autonomous adjudicators in games such as Call of Cthulhu (CoC), robust rule adherence becomes critical when user intent conflicts with system rules. However, as these models are trained to be helpful and compliant, they may be vulnerable to a class of manipulations we term Rhetorical Injection, where adversarial users exploit narrative framing techniques such as pseudo-logical reasoning and authoritative coercion to bypass adjudication logic. We present CoC-Seduce, a multi-agent adversarial benchmark built on CoC, a Tabletop Role-Playing Game (TRPG) in which rules are explicit about which risky actions require adjudication, yet interaction remains entirely in natural language. Three LLMs, i.e., GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 3.5 Flash, serve as adversarial generators producing 5,376 samples across 4 world settings and 16 skill categories. We then benchmark 22 target adjudicators against this corpus. Evaluation across 22 models reveals that neither newer releases nor explicit reasoning reliably confer adjudication robustness, that Pseudo-Logic framing is the most effective rhetorical style, and that the world setting, including culturally distant ones, has only a modest effect. Project page: https://github.com/answerrtx/CoC-Seduce.
papers.comment: corrected errors, added evaluations of new models, and revised the scope of the paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CoC-Seduce：以《克苏鲁的呼唤》(CoC) TRPG 为场景的多智能体对抗基准，用 GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Gemini 3.5 Flash 生成 5,376 条 Rhetorical Injection 样本，测试 22 个 LLM 裁判的规则坚守能力。结果显示更新版本与显式推理都不能可靠提升裁决稳健性，Pseudo-Logic 框架最有效，世界观（含文化距离远的设定）影响仅中等。
Motivation: LLM 作为游戏自主裁判时，用户意图与系统规则冲突；被训练为乐于助人、顺从的模型易被叙事框架操纵绕过裁决逻辑，而 CoC 规则明确要求对高风险行动做裁判、交互又全在自然语言中，正是检验该漏洞的场景。
Method: 构建多智能体对抗基准 CoC-Seduce：三个 LLM（GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Gemini 3.5 Flash）作为对抗生成器，产出覆盖 4 个世界观、16 个技能类别的 5,376 条样本，再用该语料库对 22 个目标裁判模型做评测。
Result: 语料含 5,376 条样本、4 个世界观、16 个技能类别；22 个目标裁决模型受评。发现更新版本与显式推理都不能可靠带来裁决稳健性，Pseudo-Logic 框架是最有效的修辞风格，世界观（含文化距离远的设定）只有中等影响。
Conclusion: LLM 裁判的规则坚守不能靠换更新模型或加显式推理来保证，伪逻辑式叙事框架是最需要防的操纵通道。

papers.title: Denser $\neq$ Better: Limits of On-Policy Self-Distillation for Continual Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Continual post-training enables foundation models to acquire new knowledge while preserving existing capabilities. Recent work suggests that on-policy learning can mitigate forgetting, with self-distillation as a particularly attractive approach. We revisit this optimistic claim through self-distillation policy optimization (SDPO). Our experiments show that SDPO accelerates in-domain specialization when teacher signals are stable and well aligned, but struggles to generalize out of distribution. In continual post-training, SDPO exhibits greater forgetting and can even collapse, whereas GRPO, the more established on-policy reinforcement learning method, adapts more conservatively and better preserves prior capabilities. Further analyses link these failures to increased drift in parameter and response space, and to amplification of high-frequency artifacts through a self-reinforcing teacher-student loop. Thus, on-policy data alone is insufficient for continual learning. Self-distillation is effective when teacher targets are stable and token-level supervision is reliable, but should not be treated as a default stabilizer for continual post-training. Our code is available at https://github.com/Moenupa/SDPO-CL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 以自蒸馏策略优化 (SDPO) 复检 on-policy 自蒸馏能缓解遗忘的乐观结论：教师信号稳定且对齐时 SDPO 加速领域内专化，但在持续后训练中遗忘更重甚至崩溃，GRPO 更保守地保住既有能力。结论是 on-policy 数据本身不足以支撑持续学习，自蒸馏不应被当作持续后训练的默认稳定器。
Motivation: 持续后训练要让基础模型学新知识又不丢旧能力，近期工作主张 on-policy 学习加自蒸馏可缓解遗忘，但该主张在分布外泛化与持续场景下是否成立缺少复检。
Method: 以 SDPO 为对象复检该主张，并与更成熟的 on-policy 强化学习方法 GRPO 对照；进一步从参数空间与响应空间的漂移，以及师生自强化回路放大高频伪影两条线索定位失败机制。
Result: 教师信号稳定且对齐时 SDPO 加速领域内专化，但分布外泛化差；在持续后训练中 SDPO 遗忘更重并可崩溃，GRPO 适应更保守、更好保留既有能力；分析将失败归因于参数与响应空间漂移增大，以及师生自强化回路放大高频伪影。
Conclusion: on-policy 数据单独不足以支撑持续学习；自蒸馏只在教师目标稳定、token 级监督可靠时有效，不应作为持续后训练的默认稳定器。

papers.title: Decision-Aware Training for Sample-Based Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: Sample-based generative models are increasingly used for probabilistic forecasting in high-stakes decision settings, yet their training objectives are blind to the decision maker's cost structure. These models are commonly trained with strictly proper scoring rules, such as the energy score, which allocate their training signal in proportion to data density, with no awareness of where forecast errors are most costly for downstream decisions. We therefore propose decision-aware training for sample-based generative models, augmenting the energy score objective with a differentiable decision loss that directly penalises the cost incurred by acting on the model's forecast. This combined loss is theoretically grounded, as the decision loss is itself a proper scoring rule. We compute the decision loss via a differentiable optimisation layer. Its gradient concentrates in cost-sensitive regions of the output space, making the method's effects interpretable and predictable from the cost structure. We validate the method on one synthetic and two real-world tasks. In the synthetic task, the method corrects the mode weights of a learned bimodal distribution; in a wind power dispatch task, it concentrates improvements in the rare but costly tail region, and in a frost protection task, it improves how well the decision costs are anticipated. Our method yields generative models that retain full probabilistic forecasts while being better aligned with the decision maker's specific cost structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把可微决策损失加进 energy score，让样本式生成模型的训练信号按下游成本而非数据密度分配。在合成双峰分布上纠正模式权重，在风电调度中把改进集中在罕见但昂贵的尾部，在防霜任务中提升对决策成本的预判；模型仍保留完整概率预报。
Motivation: 样本式生成模型常用严格 proper 的 energy score 训练，其信号按数据密度分配，对下游决策中误差最贵的区域完全不敏感。
Method: 在 energy score 目标上叠加一个可微决策损失，直接惩罚依据预报行动产生的成本；该损失本身是 proper scoring rule，通过可微优化层 (differentiable optimisation layer) 计算，其梯度集中在输出空间的成本敏感区域。
Result: 在一个合成任务和两个真实任务上验证：合成任务中纠正了学到的双峰分布的模式权重；风电调度任务中改进集中在罕见但成本高的尾部区域；防霜任务中提升了决策成本被预判的程度。
Conclusion: 叠加可微决策损失后，生成模型既保留完整概率预报，又与决策者的具体成本结构更好对齐，且其作用可由成本结构解释和预判。
Relevance: 37

papers.title: Learning the structure of open quantum systems
papers.abstract_en: We design an algorithm for learning the coefficients of an $n$-qubit constant-local Lindbladian to $\varepsilon$ error with $O(g d^2 \log(n) / \varepsilon^2)$ total evolution time, where $g$ is the single-site energy and $d$ is the (approximate) degree of the interaction graph. Though Lindbladians present new challenges not present in the special case of Hamiltonians, our algorithm achieves the suite of desiderata attained by state-of-the-art Hamiltonian learning algorithms: (1) it uses non-adaptive, ancilla-free randomized Pauli measurement circuits with a time resolution of only $Θ(1/g)$; (2) it works without knowledge of the structure of the unknown Lindbladian; (3) it depends on a smooth form of degree, thereby supporting the learning of quasi-local and power-law Lindbladians. Moreover, we prove a lower bound showing that our algorithm is optimal in each parameter up to logarithmic factors. Our algorithm is a simple iterative method, where the objective function consists of Fourier coefficients of the Lindbladian restricted to few-site regions. Its analysis identifies the difficulty unique to open systems, which we call "confusing" terms. For settings where the "confusion" is limited, the performance of the algorithm improves. We demonstrate this for the case of structure learning of Hamiltonians from access to real-time evolution, where we obtain a new algorithm that is significantly simpler than previous work. In addition, using the same iterative method, we design the first efficient algorithm for structure learning Hamiltonians from high-temperature Gibbs states.
papers.comment: 74 pages, 1 figure; v2 improved classical runtime, added lower bound
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 给出学习 n 比特常数局域 Lindbladian 系数的算法，总演化时间 O(g d² log n / ε²)，用非自适应、无辅助比特的随机 Pauli 测量，时间分辨率仅 Θ(1/g)，且不需预先知道未知 Lindbladian 的结构。算法是迭代法，目标函数取 Lindbladian 限制在少比特区域上的 Fourier 系数；分析中识别出开放系统特有的 confusing 项，confusion 受限时性能进一步改善。证明了下界，说明算法在各参数上除对数因子外最优。
Motivation: 开放量子系统的 Lindbladian 学习比 Hamiltonian 学习多出新的困难（confusing 项），需要在不知道结构、测量资源受限的条件下达到与最优 Hamiltonian 学习算法相当的指标。
Method: 迭代算法：目标函数为限制在少比特区域上的 Lindbladian Fourier 系数；测量用非自适应、无 ancilla 的随机 Pauli 电路，时间分辨率 Θ(1/g)；依赖平滑形式的相互作用图度数 d，以支持 quasi-local 与 power-law Lindbladian。同一迭代方法还用于从实时间演化做 Hamiltonian 结构学习，以及从高温 Gibbs 态做结构学习。
Result: 总演化时间 O(g d² log(n) / ε²) 达到 ε 误差；下界证明该算法在每个参数上除对数因子外最优；时间分辨率 Θ(1/g)。在 confusion 受限的设定下算法性能改善，并据此得到比先前工作显著更简单的 Hamiltonian 结构学习算法，以及首个从高温 Gibbs 态高效做 Hamiltonian 结构学习的算法。
Conclusion: Lindbladian 学习可以达到与最先进 Hamiltonian 学习算法相同的一系列指标且在各参数上近最优；开放系统的难点可归结为 confusing 项，其受限时迭代法性能更好。

papers.title: Uncertainty Estimation in Pathology Foundation Models via Deep Mutual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Pathology foundation models (PFMs) offer generalizable representations for whole-slide image (WSI) analysis, yet their clinical adoption remains limited. Specifically, their predictions lack reliable confidence estimates, and no single PFM is universally best across tasks, which severely undermines trust in medical settings. To overcome this, we propose DICE, a plug-and-play framework that ensembles $K$ frozen PFMs and estimates uncertainty based on their consensus. We align the ensemble members via deep mutual learning and theoretically show that this objective controls an upper bound on epistemic uncertainty. Additionally, we demonstrate that the ensemble localizes abnormalities at the patch level without any explicit supervision. We evaluate DICE on three challenging WSI benchmarks. Notably, our framework provides reliable uncertainty estimates that accurately flag failure-prone cases under in- and out-of-distribution settings, while matching or outperforming SOTA baselines in classification, calibration, and localization. Overall, DICE takes a crucial step toward translating PFMs into uncertainty-aware decision-support systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DICE：把 K 个冻结的病理基础模型 (PFM) 用深度互学习 (deep mutual learning) 对齐成集成，用成员间共识估计不确定性，并从理论上证明该目标控制认知不确定性 (epistemic uncertainty) 的上界。在三个 WSI 基准上，它在分布内与分布外设置下都能标出易失败样本，分类、校准与定位上匹配或超过 SOTA 基线，且无需显式监督即可在 patch 级定位异常。
Motivation: 病理基础模型的预测缺少可靠置信度，且没有单一 PFM 在所有任务上普遍最好，这直接阻碍其进入临床决策支持。
Method: DICE 是即插即用框架：冻结 K 个 PFM 组成集成，用深度互学习对齐成员，基于共识估计不确定性，并给出该互学习目标控制认知不确定性上界的理论结果；异常定位在 patch 级、无显式监督完成。
Result: 在三个 WSI 基准上评测：不确定性估计在分布内 (in-distribution) 与分布外 (out-of-distribution) 设置下可靠标出易失败样本，分类、校准 (calibration) 与定位 (localization) 指标匹配或优于 SOTA 基线；patch 级异常定位无需显式监督。
Conclusion: 共识驱动的互学习集成能把冻结 PFM 变成带可靠不确定性估计的决策支持系统，同时不牺牲分类与定位性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: How Far Can You Get Without a GPU? A Systematic Benchmark of Lightweight Hallucination Detection Across Question Answering, Dialogue, and Summarisation
papers.abstract_en: Hallucination detection has become a pressing requirement for trustworthy AI deployment at scale. The most accurate detection methods depend on GPU-intensive inference, proprietary API calls, or white-box access to the generating model, putting them out of reach for resource-constrained researchers and practitioners. We explore a practical alternative: how well can hallucination detection perform using only lightweight, CPU-feasible methods built on public models? We benchmark four such detectors, ROUGE-L, semantic similarity, BERTScore, and a Natural Language Inference (NLI) detector based on a FEVER-trained DeBERTa model, together with a score-level ensemble of similarity and NLI. We evaluate them across all three tasks of the HaluEval benchmark: question answering (QA), dialogue, and summarisation. We calibrate on a held-out validation split, evaluate on 2,000 test instances per task, and report bootstrap confidence intervals. The similarity-NLI ensemble is the most consistent method, but absolute performance is highly task-dependent. It ranks best on QA (F1 = 0.792, AUC-ROC = 0.873) and on dialogue (F1 = 0.694, AUC-ROC = 0.749), where NLI is the strongest standalone method; on summarisation every method performs near chance (AUC-ROC between 0.469 and 0.574). We then ask whether that failure is intrinsic to lightweight detection or an artifact of our single-pass design, and find it is largely the latter. Raising the premise budget from 800 to 1600 characters lifts summarisation AUC-ROC from 0.567 to 0.629, and replacing single-pass scoring with sentence-level chunk aggregation reaches 0.683, still on CPU with the same model, though at roughly twenty times the NLI inference. Summarisation remains by far the hardest task, but our results do not support treating lightweight detection as intrinsically unsuited to it.
papers.comment: Camera-ready version. Accepted to the Findings track of GroundLM 2026 (EMNLP 2026 workshop). Code: https://github.com/fkriti/hallucination-detection-nli
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在纯 CPU、只用公开模型的条件下系统基准了四种轻量幻觉检测器及其相似度-NLI 分数级集成，在 HaluEval 的 QA、dialogue、summarisation 三任务上各用 2,000 条测试样本评测。集成在 QA 上 F1=0.792、AUC-ROC=0.873，在 dialogue 上 F1=0.694、AUC-ROC=0.749；summarisation 上所有方法接近随机（AUC-ROC 0.469–0.574），但把 premise 预算从 800 提到 1600 字符并改用句子级分块聚合可把 AUC-ROC 推到 0.683，说明该失败主要是单遍设计的产物而非轻量方法的固有极限。
Motivation: 最准的幻觉检测依赖 GPU 推理、专有 API 或白盒访问，资源受限的研究者与实践者用不起；需要回答仅靠 CPU 可行的公开模型检测器能做到什么程度。
Method: 基准四种 CPU 可行检测器：ROUGE-L、语义相似度、BERTScore，以及基于 FEVER 训练的 DeBERTa 的 NLI 检测器，外加相似度与 NLI 的分数级集成；在 HaluEval 三个任务上用 held-out 验证集校准，报告 bootstrap 置信区间，并对比单遍打分与句子级分块聚合两种推理设计。
Result: 每任务 2,000 条测试样本：相似度-NLI 集成在 QA 上 F1=0.792、AUC-ROC=0.873，在 dialogue 上 F1=0.694、AUC-ROC=0.749（该任务 NLI 单独最强）；summarisation 上全部方法接近随机，AUC-ROC 介于 0.469 与 0.574。把 premise 预算从 800 提到 1600 字符使 summarisation AUC-ROC 从 0.567 升到 0.629，句子级分块聚合进一步到 0.683，代价约为 NLI 推理量的二十倍，仍跑在同一 CPU 与同一模型上。
Conclusion: 轻量 CPU 检测在 QA 与 dialogue 上可用、集成最稳，summarisation 仍是最难任务，但其接近随机的表现主要来自单遍设计而非轻量方法本身不适用。

papers.title: PerturbCellRL: Aligning Distributions and Grounding Biology via Post-Training Perturbation Generators
papers.abstract_en: Single-cell perturbation models can reduce costly wet-lab screening by predicting how cells respond transcriptionally to interventions. Recent advances in flow-matching have enabled population-level prediction of cellular responses. However, flow-matching training can fail to recover certain target distributions even within the model family, limiting its ability to capture cellular heterogeneity. We first prove that post-training can recover these distributions, then introduce PerturbCellRL, a reinforcement learning framework that post-trains single-cell perturbation generators using per-cell rewards. The central component is a gene-expression energy witness that translates population-level discrepancies into per-cell feedback. We further prove that this reward's policy gradient points toward better distributional alignment. Two complementary rewards, calibrated on real cells, penalize atypical expression profiles and insufficient pathway-level responses to perturbations. Across genetic and chemical perturbation benchmarks, PerturbCellRL substantially improves distributional alignment and recovers pathway enrichment patterns more faithfully. These results establish reward-guided post-training as an effective strategy for improving both distributional accuracy and biological fidelity in perturbation prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PerturbCellRL 用强化学习后训练单细胞扰动生成器：以基因表达能量见证 (gene-expression energy witness) 把群体级分布差异转成逐细胞奖励，再加两个在真实细胞上校准的奖励惩罚非典型表达谱与通路响应不足。作者先证明后训练可恢复 flow matching 训练无法恢复的目标分布，并证明该奖励的策略梯度指向更好的分布对齐；在遗传与化学扰动基准上分布对齐显著改善、通路富集模式恢复更忠实。
Motivation: flow-matching 训练即使在模型族内也可能无法恢复某些目标分布，限制了对细胞异质性的刻画，从而削弱单细胞扰动模型替代昂贵湿实验筛选的能力。
Method: 提出 PerturbCellRL：对单细胞扰动生成器做 RL 后训练，核心组件是 gene-expression energy witness，把群体级分布差异翻译为逐细胞反馈奖励；另加两个在真实细胞上校准的奖励，分别惩罚非典型表达谱和对扰动的通路级响应不足。理论上先证明后训练可恢复这些分布，再证明该奖励的策略梯度指向更好的分布对齐。
Result: 在遗传与化学扰动基准上，PerturbCellRL 显著改善分布对齐，并更忠实地恢复通路富集模式；摘要给出的是定性结论，未列具体数值。
Conclusion: 奖励引导的后训练是同时提升扰动预测分布准确性与生物学保真度的有效策略，且其梯度方向有理论保证指向更好的分布对齐。

summary_sections.motivation: flow-matching 训练即使在模型族内也可能无法恢复某些目标分布，限制了对细胞异质性的刻画，从而削弱单细胞扰动模型替代昂贵湿实验筛选的能力。
summary_sections.method: 提出 PerturbCellRL：对单细胞扰动生成器做 RL 后训练，核心组件是 gene-expression energy witness，把群体级分布差异翻译为逐细胞反馈奖励；另加两个在真实细胞上校准的奖励，分别惩罚非典型表达谱和对扰动的通路级响应不足。理论上先证明后训练可恢复这些分布，再证明该奖励的策略梯度指向更好的分布对齐。
summary_sections.result: 在遗传与化学扰动基准上，PerturbCellRL 显著改善分布对齐，并更忠实地恢复通路富集模式；摘要给出的是定性结论，未列具体数值。
summary_sections.conclusion: 奖励引导的后训练是同时提升扰动预测分布准确性与生物学保真度的有效策略，且其梯度方向有理论保证指向更好的分布对齐。

papers.title: Beyond Global Divergences: A Local-Mass Perspective on Bayesian Inference
papers.abstract_en: Global objectives, such as KL divergence and ELBO, are widely used in Bayesian inference for measuring distributional discrepancy. This paper studies distributional ``local-mass behaviours'' that are not directly captured by such global objectives. We introduce and use two mathematical tools: (1) Mass Index for recording the polynomial and logarithmic decay scales of local mass, and (2) regularised extended KL (RE-KL), a set-localised divergence that can be formulated in the presence of singular components. Mass Indices help characterise how Bayesian updating changes local mass: (1) power-log likelihood factors shift it explicitly, and (2) parameter-dependent supports, or their smooth softenings, may change the local scale through the amount of mass that remains near the parameter value. Using local RE-KL, we prove absolute, relative, and directional inequalities for comparing local small-ball masses under the two KL directions. Together, these results provide a local theoretical account of local mass behaviour. Experiments provide controlled illustrations of the local behaviour, and show that the directional comparison remains visible in the variational posteriors of Bayesian neural networks up to ResNet-50 on ImageNet. Code is available at https://github.com/Forsythia0604/Local-Mass-Framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 指出 KL/ELBO 这类全局目标看不到分布的局部质量 (local-mass) 行为，提出 Mass Index 与正则化扩展 KL (RE-KL) 两个工具刻画贝叶斯更新如何改变局部质量，并证明两种 KL 方向下局部小球质量的绝对、相对与方向性不等式。方向性比较在直至 ResNet-50/ImageNet 的变分后验中仍然可见。
Motivation: KL 散度与 ELBO 作为全局目标只度量整体分布差异，无法直接刻画参数值附近的局部质量衰减尺度，而贝叶斯更新与变分后验恰恰在这些局部区域表现不同。
Method: 提出两个数学工具：Mass Index 记录局部质量的多项式与对数衰减尺度，RE-KL 是可在奇异分量存在时定义的局域化散度。用它们分析幂-对数似然因子与参数依赖支撑（及其光滑软化）如何改变局部质量，并证明两种 KL 方向下局部小球质量的绝对、相对与方向性不等式。
Result: 实验证明提供局部行为的受控示例，并显示方向性比较在直至 ResNet-50、在 ImageNet 上训练的贝叶斯神经网络变分后验中仍然可见；论文含 9 幅图、4 张表（含附录）。
Conclusion: 局部质量行为需要 Mass Index 与 RE-KL 这类局部工具而非全局散度来刻画，且两种 KL 方向的局部比较差异在实际深度网络的变分后验中真实存在。
