papers.title: GB-LSR: Local Spectral Decoding with a Learned Global Bandwidth for Arbitrary-Scale Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: We present GB-LSR (Global-Bandwidth Local Spectral Representation), a fixed-grid local spectral representation for continuous image decoding. The image domain is partitioned into non-overlapping square patches. Each patch carries coefficients for a truncated Fourier basis, predicted by a single linear projection from shared convolutional-encoder features, and one trainable scalar bandwidth is shared across every patch and every image. As in earlier local spectral decoders, decoding at a continuous coordinate is a fixed-size basis contraction whose cost is set by the spectral cutoff; GB-LSR learns the bandwidth of that basis instead of fixing it. We evaluate an arbitrary-scale super-resolution extension, GB-LSR-Scalar-ASR, against the authors' released LIIF, LTE, and SRNO checkpoints on the same RDN encoder, with every method scored under one protocol and timed in one session per scale, each on one GPU. It runs 1.25x faster than LIIF-RDN at x4 and as fast as SRNO-RDN, whose released code uses 15 times as much peak memory on Urban100. It trails the three encoder-matched baselines by 0.07 to 0.79 dB PSNR-Y in distribution, SRNO-RDN by 0.35 dB on average. Removing the local ensemble raises the speedup to 2.41x over LIIF-RDN and 1.95x over SRNO-RDN at x4, and to 3.00x and 2.41x at x8, without changing PSNR-Y beyond seed variation, at the cost of value jumps at cell boundaries of 0.22 gray levels (of 255) on average at x4. Against the EDSR-baseline checkpoints of five recent methods at x4, GB-LSR-Scalar-ASR scores above or within 0.17 dB on PSNR-Y of LMF, SRNO-EDSR, and OPE-SR-EDSR (1.39 to 6.43 million parameters against 22.02) and 0.14 to 0.57 dB below GSASR and Thera (20.44 and 5.85 million), and has a higher mean LPIPS at x4 than every baseline.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 11 figures, 16 tables; v2: substantially revised and retitled; the main evaluation is now arbitrary-scale super-resolution against released checkpoints, and the native-reconstruction experiments are a design study of GB-LSR variants
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GB-LSR 用固定网格 patch 上的截断 Fourier 基做连续图像解码，带宽由单一可训练标量全局共享，并扩展出任意尺度超分 GB-LSR-Scalar-ASR。在与 LIIF、LTE、SRNO 同一 RDN 编码器的统一对比中，x4 时比 LIIF-RDN 快 1.25 倍、峰值内存远低于 SRNO-RDN，但 PSNR-Y 落后 0.07–0.79 dB；去掉 local ensemble 后 x4 加速达 2.41 倍，代价是边界 0.22 灰阶跳变。
Motivation: 连续图像解码器的谱截断带宽通常人工固定，难以在速度、内存与重建质量之间灵活权衡；任意尺度超分需要在统一协议下同时比较精度与开销。
Method: 图像域切成不重叠方形 patch，每个 patch 携带截断 Fourier 基系数，由共享卷积编码器特征经单一线性投影预测，一个可训练标量带宽全局共享；任意尺度扩展 GB-LSR-Scalar-ASR 在同一 RDN 编码器上与作者发布的 LIIF、LTE、SRNO checkpoint 对比，每尺度单会话计时、单 GPU。
Result: x4 时比 LIIF-RDN 快 1.25 倍、与 SRNO-RDN 相当，后者在 Urban100 上峰值内存高 15 倍；分布内 PSNR-Y 落后三个同编码器基线 0.07–0.79 dB，平均落后 SRNO-RDN 0.35 dB。去掉 local ensemble 后 x4 加速 2.41 倍（对 SRNO-RDN 1.95 倍）、x8 达 3.00 倍与 2.41 倍，PSNR-Y 变化在种子波动内，但 x4 平均边界跳变 0.22 灰阶（255 中）。对五个近期方法的 EDSR-baseline checkpoint，x4 时高于或在 LMF、SRNO-EDSR、OPE-SR-EDSR 的 0.17 dB 内（参数 1.39–6.43M 对 22.02M），低于 GSASR 与 Thera 0.14–0.57 dB（20.44M 与 5.85M），且 x4 平均 LPIPS 高于全部基线。
Conclusion: 把谱带宽学成全局共享标量可在任意尺度超分上换取显著速度与内存优势，但精度与 LPIPS 仍落后于同编码器基线；去掉 local ensemble 是纯速度换边界连续性的取舍。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Morpheus: A Morphology-Aware Neural Tokenizer and Word Embedder for Turkish
papers.abstract_en: Turkish is agglutinative: meaning is carried by morphemes, yet the subword tokenizers that drive modern language models split words by corpus statistics, fragmenting semantically loaded suffixes and -- in the case of WordPiece and rule-based analyzers -- failing to decode their output back to the original text. This paper presents \textbf{Morpheus}, a neural morpheme-boundary model for Turkish that is at once a lossless, morphology-aware tokenizer and a word-embedding producer. A differentiable Poisson-binomial dynamic program turns per-character boundary probabilities into soft morpheme memberships during training and exact segments at inference, with no string normalization, so $\mathrm{decode}(\mathrm{encode}(w)) = w$ holds by construction. Because the model is neural, the same forward pass that tokenizes also emits a structured word embedding. Among reversible tokenizers -- the only ones valid for generation -- Morpheus attains the lowest bits-per-character ($1.425$), roughly doubles the gold morphological alignment of the subword family (MorphScore macro-F1 $0.61$ vs.\ ${\sim}0.32$), and uses ${\sim}19\%$ less GPU memory than 64K-vocabulary subword tokenizers. As an embedder, frozen Morpheus vectors lead on lexical retrieval (root-family MAP $0.85$) and same-root verification (ROC-AUC $1.00$), surpassing the multilingual retriever BGE-M3 and BERTurk; on context- and inflection-dependent tasks (NER, case/number probing) the heavier contextual encoders remain ahead -- a trade-off we attribute to Morpheus's root-centric geometry. Code: https://github.com/lonewolf-rd/TurkishMorpheus; model: https://huggingface.co/lonewolflab/Morpheus-TR-50K; interactive demo: https://huggingface.co/spaces/lonewolflab/morpheus-tr-demo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Morpheus 是土耳其语的神经词素边界模型，同时充当无损分词器与词嵌入生成器：可微 Poisson-binomial 动态规划把逐字符边界概率在训练时转为软词素归属、推理时转为精确切分，且不做字符串归一化，使 decode(encode(w))=w 按构造成立。在可逆分词器中它取得最低 bits-per-character 1.425，MorphScore macro-F1 0.61 对 subword 家族约 0.32，GPU 显存比 64K 词表 subword 少约 19%；冻结向量在词根族检索 MAP 0.85、同根验证 ROC-AUC 1.00 上超过 BGE-M3 与 BERTurk，但在 NER 与格/数探测等上下文相关任务上仍落后于上下文编码器。
Motivation: 土耳其语是黏着语，意义承载在词素上，而语料统计驱动的 subword 分词器会切碎带语义的后缀；WordPiece 与基于规则的分析器还无法把自己的输出解码回原文，生成任务中不可用。
Method: 训练一个逐字符的神经词素边界模型，用可微 Poisson-binomial 动态规划把边界概率聚合成软词素归属，推理时取精确切分，全程不做字符串归一化以保证可逆；同一次前向同时输出结构化词嵌入，作为冻结 embedder 用于词根族检索与同根验证。
Result: 在可逆分词器中 bits-per-character 最低，为 1.425；MorphScore macro-F1 0.61，约为 subword 家族 0.32 的两倍；相比 64K 词表 subword 分词器 GPU 显存少约 19%。冻结 Morpheus 向量在词根族检索 root-family MAP 0.85、同根验证 ROC-AUC 1.00，超过多语言检索器 BGE-M3 与 BERTurk；在 NER 与格/数探测等上下文和屈折相关任务上，较重的上下文编码器仍领先。
Conclusion: 可逆性与词素对齐可以同时拿到，代价是上下文相关任务上的表现：作者把这一取舍归因于 Morpheus 以词根为中心的几何结构。

papers.title: Do as the Romans Do: Learning Universal Behaviors from Heterogeneous Agents
papers.abstract_en: Humans often acquire new skills by observing others, since observed behaviors implicitly reveal how to act reasonably in an environment. However, observations drawn from a heterogeneous population introduce conflicting behavioral signals, making it difficult to determine which behaviors are worth imitating. We address this challenge with General Reward Inference and Disentanglement (GRID), a social learning method that extracts universally useful behaviors from a heterogeneous population of demonstrators pursuing different goals. GRID decomposes per-agent reward functions into a general reward, capturing behaviors shared across all agents, and specific rewards, capturing individual preferences and objectives, through an information bottleneck. Training exclusively on the general reward provides a new paradigm of generalist pretraining. It yields a generalist agent that internalizes universal environmental competencies, such as safety and basic task proficiency, without the mode-averaging bias that afflicts standard learning from demonstration techniques. This generalist serves as a strong prior for fine-tuning to downstream tasks, including preferences unseen during training. Experiments across a synthetic basis function decomposition, multi-agent Craftax, continuous control tasks (MuJoCo Gym) and an autonomous driving simulator (Highway-Env) confirm that GRID successfully disentangles reward structure in a semantically meaningful way, outperforms standard learning from demonstration baselines, and enables more efficient and stable specialization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出社会学习方法 GRID（General Reward Inference and Disentanglement），通过信息瓶颈把异质示范群体的逐智能体奖励函数分解为跨所有智能体共享的 general reward 与体现个体偏好的 specific reward，只用 general reward 训练即可得到无模式平均偏差的通才智能体。在合成基函数分解、多智能体 Craftax、MuJoCo Gym 连续控制与 Highway-Env 自动驾驶模拟上，GRID 语义化地解出奖励结构，优于标准示范学习基线，并使下游微调更高效稳定。
Motivation: 从目标各异的异质示范群体观察学习时，行为信号相互冲突，难以判断哪些行为值得模仿；标准示范学习（LfD）还会出现模式平均偏差。
Method: GRID 用信息瓶颈将每个智能体的奖励函数分解为 general reward（跨全体共享的行为）与 specific reward（个体偏好与目标）；仅以 general reward 训练通才智能体，再把它作为先验微调到下游任务（含训练中未见的偏好）。
Result: 在合成基函数分解、multi-agent Craftax、MuJoCo Gym 连续控制与 Highway-Env 自动驾驶模拟四类实验中，GRID 以语义上有意义的方式解耦奖励结构，优于标准示范学习基线，并带来更高效、更稳定的 specialization。
Conclusion: 只从异质群体中提取共享的 general reward 做预训练，可得到内化安全与基本任务能力的通才先验，且避开标准 LfD 的模式平均偏差，适合作为下游微调的起点。

summary_sections.motivation: 从目标各异的异质示范群体观察学习时，行为信号相互冲突，难以判断哪些行为值得模仿；标准示范学习（LfD）还会出现模式平均偏差。
summary_sections.method: GRID 用信息瓶颈将每个智能体的奖励函数分解为 general reward（跨全体共享的行为）与 specific reward（个体偏好与目标）；仅以 general reward 训练通才智能体，再把它作为先验微调到下游任务（含训练中未见的偏好）。
summary_sections.result: 在合成基函数分解、multi-agent Craftax、MuJoCo Gym 连续控制与 Highway-Env 自动驾驶模拟四类实验中，GRID 以语义上有意义的方式解耦奖励结构，优于标准示范学习基线，并带来更高效、更稳定的 specialization。
summary_sections.conclusion: 只从异质群体中提取共享的 general reward 做预训练，可得到内化安全与基本任务能力的通才先验，且避开标准 LfD 的模式平均偏差，适合作为下游微调的起点。

papers.title: Uncertainty Quantification for Flow-Based Generalist Robot Policies
papers.abstract_en: Generalist robot policies, such as vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world-action models (WAMs), combine powerful pretrained backbones with expressive generative action heads trained via flow matching on large-scale robotic datasets. Despite their strong empirical performance in robotic manipulation, these policies lack mechanisms to quantify confidence in their predictions and to detect when their actions may be unreliable. This presents a critical limitation for real-world deployment in non-stationary environments, where models inevitably encounter scenarios outside their pretraining distribution and may fail without warning. To address this, we derive an efficient method to quantify epistemic uncertainty in flow-matching models by leveraging velocity-field disagreement (VFD) across a small ensemble. We successfully use this uncertainty estimate for detecting failures during deployment and active fine-tuning of flow-based generalist policies. For the latter, we propose SAVE, a simple yet effective method for uncertainty-guided active multitask fine-tuning that reduces the number of costly expert demonstrations required to adapt generalist policies to new tasks. We conduct experiments in simulation and the real world, across VLAs and a WAM. VFD yields better-calibrated uncertainty estimates predictive of downstream performance and detects failures with 8 pp higher overall accuracy than existing methods. Across three real-world tasks, SAVE improves final average success from 39 % to 47 % with a fixed demonstration budget. Our results show that measuring epistemic uncertainty with VFD enhances both failure awareness and adaptation of generalist robot policies. Project website: tum-lsy.github.io/uq_generalist_policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为基于 flow matching 的通用机器人策略 (VLA/WAM) 推导出用小规模集成的 velocity-field disagreement (VFD) 量化认知不确定性的高效方法，并据此做部署期失败检测与不确定性引导的主动多任务微调 SAVE。VFD 的不确定性估计校准更好、能预测下游表现，失败检测总体准确率比现有方法高 8 个百分点；在三个真实任务上 SAVE 在固定演示预算下把平均成功率从 39% 提到 47%。
Motivation: VLA/WAM 等通用机器人策略用大规模数据训练、经验表现强，但没有量化预测置信度的机制，无法判断动作何时不可靠；在非平稳真实部署中遇到预训练分布外场景会无预警失败。
Method: 对 flow-matching 模型推导认知不确定性估计：训练一个小规模集成，用速度场分歧 (velocity-field disagreement, VFD) 度量不确定性；再提出 SAVE，用该不确定性引导主动多任务微调，只在高不确定性处索取专家演示。实验覆盖仿真与真实世界，跨 VLA 与 WAM。
Result: VFD 给出校准更好、可预测下游表现的不确定性估计，失败检测总体准确率比现有方法高 8 pp；三个真实任务上 SAVE 在固定演示预算下把最终平均成功率从 39% 提升到 47%。
Conclusion: 用 VFD 度量认知不确定性可以同时提升通用机器人策略的失败感知与自适应能力，且能减少适配新任务所需的专家演示数量。

papers.title: ROVE: Unlocking Human Interventions for Humanoid Manipulation via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Human interventions provide crucial corrective signals for post-training Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. However, enabling seamless humanoid interventions is a formidable systems challenge due to complex whole-body kinematics and dexterous-hand control. Consequently, the collected intervention trajectories are often suboptimal, and methods that rely on human interventions as expert supervision can absorb hesitant, inefficient, or even erroneous behaviors. To address both the system and algorithmic challenges, we propose ROVE, a reinforcement learning framework for humanoid VLA post-training with imperfect human interventions. First, ROVE introduces a human-in-the-loop pipeline capable of collecting deployment and intervention data for humanoid manipulation. Second, it utilizes Optimistic Value Estimation (OVE) to prioritize high-value behaviors from mixed-quality trajectories. To further robustify value estimation, we incorporate cross-embodiment human experience videos to provide rich supervision for long-tailed failure and recovery modes. The resulting critic yields informative advantage signals, steering the VLA actor to focus on high-value behaviors rather than indiscriminately imitating all actions. On challenging real-world contact-rich and fine-grained humanoid manipulation tasks, ROVE outperforms experience-learning baselines and consistently improves across multiple rollout-intervention iterations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ROVE 是面向人形机器人 VLA 后训练的强化学习框架，用乐观价值估计 (Optimistic Value Estimation, OVE) 从质量混杂的人类干预轨迹中挑出高价值行为，并引入跨具身人类经验视频补足长尾失败与恢复模式的监督，使 critic 给出有信息量的 advantage 信号，引导 actor 只学高价值动作而非盲目模仿全部干预。在真实世界接触密集、细粒度人形操作任务上，ROVE 超越经验学习类基线，并在多轮 rollout-intervention 迭代中持续改进。
Motivation: 人形机器人全身运动学与灵巧手控制让人类干预难以流畅实施，采集到的干预轨迹常犹豫、低效甚至出错；把干预当专家监督的后训练方法会把这些劣质行为一并吸收。
Method: ROVE 包含三部分：人机在环 (human-in-the-loop) 流水线采集部署与干预数据；OVE 价值估计从混合质量轨迹中优先高价值行为；加入跨具身人类经验视频为长尾失败与恢复模式提供额外监督以稳住价值估计，最终 critic 输出 advantage 信号驱动 VLA actor。
Result: 在真实世界的接触密集与细粒度人形操作任务上，ROVE 超过 experience-learning 基线，并在多轮 rollout-intervention 迭代中保持一致提升。
Conclusion: 人类干预不必当作完美专家：用乐观价值估计加跨具身视频监督筛选干预信号，就能把不完美人形干预变成可反复迭代改进的 VLA 后训练信号。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Diffusion Flow Matching: Dimension-Improved KL Bounds and Wasserstein Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Flow Matching (DFM) has recently emerged as a versatile framework for generative modeling, yet its theoretical convergence properties remain only partially understood. In this work, we provide refined and novel convergence guarantees for Brownian motion based DFMs, focusing on the discretization error. Our analysis is conducted under the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence and the 2-Wasserstein distance. Under finite-moment conditions and a mild score integrability assumption, we derive KL convergence bounds with improved dimensional dependence compared to prior work, achieving, up to our knowledge, state-of-the-art scaling under minimal conditions. We further extend the analysis to the 2-Wasserstein distance: under an additional first-order score integrability assumption and a weak log-concavity condition, we obtain convergence guarantees with dimensional dependence consistent with the KL case.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对基于 Brownian motion 的 Diffusion Flow Matching (DFM) 给出离散化误差的收敛保证：在 KL 散度下，有限矩条件加温和的 score 可积性假设即可得到维度依赖改进的界，作者称在最小条件下达到已知最优 scaling；再加一阶 score 可积与弱 log-concavity，2-Wasserstein 距离下得到与 KL 情形维度依赖一致的保证。
Motivation: DFM 作为生成建模框架其理论收敛性质仍只被部分理解，已有 KL 界的维度依赖偏松，且 Wasserstein 距离下的保证缺失。
Method: 针对 Brownian motion 基 DFM 的离散化误差做理论分析，先在有限矩与温和 score 可积假设下推导 KL 收敛界，再在一阶 score 可积与弱 log-concavity 条件下把分析扩展到 2-Wasserstein 距离。
Result: 得到维度依赖相较先前工作改进的 KL 收敛界，作者称在最小条件下达到 state-of-the-art scaling；2-Wasserstein 下的收敛保证具有与 KL 情形一致的维度依赖。
Conclusion: DFM 的离散化误差在 KL 与 2-Wasserstein 下都能给出维度依赖更优的收敛保证，代价是 Wasserstein 情形需额外的一阶 score 可积与弱 log-concavity 假设。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Operator Calculus for Population-Based Optimization: Modular Convergence and Finite-Population Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: Population-based optimizers combine update rules such as mutation, selection, and recombination. When one rule changes, it is often unclear which convergence guarantees survive or how the new combination should be assessed. We develop an operator calculus: an operator is a population-update rule, and the calculus specifies how separately checked effects can be combined. Under explicit regularity and small-step conditions, the leading changes caused by the updates add, yielding reusable building blocks for convergence analysis. The framework distinguishes finding and retaining a good solution, reducing the population's mean objective, and concentrating candidates near an optimizer, and identifies the extra approximation conditions needed for finite evaluation-budget guarantees. Applications include distribution adaptation, recombinative evolution, and consensus dynamics, with verified nonconvex cases. Controlled experiments on a common nonconvex problem collection show how component effects change with population geometry and the performance measure: a rule can worsen the mean objective yet produce better candidates.
papers.comment: Substantially revised version: finite-population evaluation-complexity guarantees, verified CMA-ES-type, recombinative-ES and CBO instances, a numerical study of operator assemblies, and a practitioner's guide. 8 pages main text plus appendices (52 pages), 10 figures, 13 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把种群优化器的更新规则（变异、选择、重组）抽象为算子，给出可组合的收敛分析演算：在显式正则性与小步长条件下，各更新引起的主导变化可相加，从而把单独验证的组件效应拼成整体收敛结论，并区分找到并保留好解、降低种群均值目标、把候选集中到最优点三类性能度量，另指出有限评估预算保证所需的额外逼近条件。在共同的非凸问题集合上的受控实验显示，组件效应随种群几何与所选度量变化：某条规则可能恶化均值目标却产生更好的候选。
Motivation: 种群优化器由多条更新规则拼装，改动其中一条后原有收敛保证是否仍然成立、新组合如何评估往往不清楚，缺少可复用的组合式分析框架。
Method: 提出 operator calculus：把算子定义为种群更新规则，规定分别验证过的效应如何组合；在正则性与小步长条件下证明主导变化可加，给出模块化收敛结论与有限评估预算保证所需的逼近条件。框架应用于分布适应 (distribution adaptation)、重组进化 (recombinative evolution) 与共识动力学 (consensus dynamics)，并验证了 CMA-ES 型、recombinative-ES 与 CBO 实例及非凸情形。
Result: 在共同的非凸问题集合上的受控实验表明，组件效应随种群几何与性能度量而变：一条规则可以恶化种群均值目标同时产生更好的候选。arXiv comment 记载全文含 10 幅图、13 张表，正文 8 页加附录共 52 页，并含有限种群评估复杂度保证与数值研究。
Conclusion: 种群优化器的收敛分析可以按算子模块化拼装，但结论依赖于所选性能度量与种群几何，均值目标变差不等于候选质量变差，评估时必须先声明度量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Rethinking RAG in Long Videos: What to Retrieve and How to Use It?
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation is extending beyond text to long videos, where query-relevant chunks can be represented across multiple modalities and temporal granularities. Progress in this setting, VideoRAG, is limited by two gaps: existing benchmarks allow queries to be answered without the video, obscuring retrieval errors, and prior methods apply a single modality-granularity configuration per query, ignoring chunk-level variability. We address both by introducing V-RAGBench, a benchmark of $\langle$query, evidence chunk, answer$\rangle$ triplets over hour-scale videos, in which each answer depends on a unique evidence chunk, enabling decoupled evaluation of retrieval and generation, and CARVE, a training-free method that runs parallel retrievers across configurations and uses chunk-adaptive reranking to select a winning configuration for each chunk, which is then carried into generation. On V-RAGBench, CARVE outperforms eight recent VideoRAG baselines on both stages, with the evidence it supplies to the generator interleaving multiple configurations rather than sharing one. Its gains hold across egocentric and third-person long videos and extend to an expanded configuration space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 V-RAGBench，用小时级视频的〈query, evidence chunk, answer〉三元组让每个答案只依赖唯一证据块，从而把检索与生成两阶段解耦评测；并提出免训练方法 CARVE，对每个 chunk 并行跑多模态-多粒度检索配置并做 chunk 自适应重排，选出该块的胜出配置再带入生成。在 V-RAGBench 上 CARVE 两阶段均超过八个近期 VideoRAG 基线，且优势在第一人称与第三人称长视频上都成立。
Motivation: 现有 VideoRAG 基准允许不看视频就答对，掩盖了检索错误；先前方法对每个 query 只用单一模态-粒度配置，忽略 chunk 之间的差异。
Method: V-RAGBench：小时级视频上的〈query, evidence chunk, answer〉三元组，每个答案依赖唯一证据块，支持检索与生成解耦评测。CARVE：免训练，跨多种模态-粒度配置并行运行检索器，用 chunk 自适应重排为每个 chunk 选出胜出配置，再把该配置带入生成。
Result: 在 V-RAGBench 上，CARVE 在检索与生成两个阶段均超过八个近期 VideoRAG 基线；提供给生成器的证据交错多个配置而非共享单一配置；增益在第一人称与第三人称长视频上均成立，并可扩展到更大的配置空间。

papers.title: Reliability of Probabilistic Emulation of Physical Systems
papers.abstract_en: Two dominant approaches have emerged for generating probabilistic forecasts of physical systems: generative models, such as diffusion or flow matching; and ensembles of deterministic models with stochasticity injected, trained using the continuous ranked probability score (CRPS) loss. While both approaches have demonstrated strong predictive accuracy, the reliability of their uncertainties has not been systematically assessed. We address this gap by developing a framework to evaluate both approaches across diverse 2D spatiotemporal physical systems, under matched model size and computational budget. We assess the reliability of probabilistic emulation by inspecting the empirical coverage of predictive intervals, while also considering accuracy and computational efficiency metrics. CRPS-trained ensembles typically achieve more reliable uncertainties on both single-step prediction and autoregressive rollouts, demonstrating better coverage than the standard alternative of training generative models in a latent space. Moreover, the CRPS approach offers significantly faster inference. When generative models are trained in ambient rather than a compressed latent space, which is often infeasible for high-dimensional problems, they exhibit comparable coverage to CRPS-trained ensembles, though with substantially larger inference latency. In contrast, when CRPS-trained ensembles are trained in latent space they do not show a marked degradation in coverage with respect to ambient space. Both generative models and CRPS-trained ensembles demonstrate good predictive accuracy. To facilitate future research and application, we release AutoCast, a modular framework implementing both generative models and CRPS-trained ensembles, alongside AutoSim, a flexible dataset generation package for rapid prototyping.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在模型规模与算力预算对齐的条件下系统比较两类概率仿真器——扩散/流匹配生成模型与 CRPS 损失训练的确定性模型集成——发现 CRPS 集成在单步预报和自回归滚动 (autoregressive rollout) 上的预测区间经验覆盖 (empirical coverage) 更可靠，且推理显著更快。生成模型只有在 ambient 空间（而非压缩 latent 空间）训练时才能达到相当覆盖，但推理延迟大得多；反之 CRPS 集成放进 latent 空间后覆盖没有明显退化。
Motivation: 生成模型与注入随机性的确定性集成是概率物理仿真两条主流路线，预测精度都已验证，但两者不确定性的可靠性 (reliability) 从未被系统评估，且缺少在匹配模型规模与算力预算下的公平比较框架。
Method: 构建一个跨多种 2D 时空物理系统的评估框架，在匹配模型规模与计算预算下比较两类方法：扩散/流匹配生成模型（分别在 ambient 与压缩 latent 空间训练）与以连续排序概率评分 (CRPS) 为损失的确定性模型集成（同样在 ambient 与 latent 空间训练）。指标为预测区间的经验覆盖 (coverage)，并同时考察精度与计算效率；配套发布模块化框架 AutoCast 与数据集生成包 AutoSim。
Result: CRPS 训练的集成在单步预报与自回归滚动上通常给出更可靠的不确定性，覆盖优于在 latent 空间训练生成模型这一标准做法，且推理显著更快。ambient 空间训练的生成模型覆盖与 CRPS 集成相当，但推理延迟大得多；latent 空间训练的 CRPS 集成相对 ambient 空间覆盖无明显退化。两类方法的预测精度都良好。
Conclusion: 在匹配预算下，CRPS 训练的集成是更可靠且更高效的概率仿真默认选择；生成模型要达到同等覆盖必须在 ambient 空间训练，而这在高维问题上往往不可行。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Last But Not Least: Boundary Attention CalibratiON for Multimodal KV Cache Compression
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve strong vision-language reasoning but incur large KV caches and high decoding latency with long visual contexts. Existing compression methods rely on observation window attention for stable token importance estimation, yet this aggregation can dilute sparse critical evidence and discard answer-relevant tokens under aggressive compression. We identify last query attention as a complementary signal for recovering such evidence, though its irrelevant signals may introduce additional noise. We propose BACON, a plug-and-play method that calibrates observation window attention with last query evidence while suppressing noise through intra-layer coherence and inter-layer persistence. Across diverse benchmarks, models, budgets, and compression methods, BACON improves multimodal KV-cache compression by 7.5% on average under the most aggressive budget, with gains up to 30.9%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BACON 用 last query attention 补偿观测窗注意力在激进 KV cache 压缩下稀释关键证据的问题，再用层内一致性与层间持续性抑制其噪声，作为即插即用模块校准 token 重要性估计。在多种 benchmark、模型、预算与压缩方法上，最激进预算下平均提升 7.5%，最高达 30.9%。
Motivation: MLLM 长视觉上下文带来巨大 KV cache 与解码延迟；现有压缩方法依赖观测窗注意力估计 token 重要性，聚合会稀释稀疏关键证据，在激进压缩下丢掉与答案相关的 token。
Method: 提出即插即用的 BACON：以 last query attention 作为补充信号恢复被稀释的证据，并通过 intra-layer coherence 与 inter-layer persistence 抑制其引入的噪声，从而校准观测窗注意力的重要性估计，可叠加在既有压缩方法上。
Result: 在多样 benchmark、模型、预算与压缩方法上，BACON 在最激进预算下平均提升 7.5%，单点最高提升 30.9%。
Conclusion: last query attention 是恢复被观测窗聚合稀释的关键证据的有效互补信号，配合层内/层间一致性约束即可在激进压缩预算下稳定增益，且可即插即用地叠加到现有压缩方法。

papers.title: Min-Cost Flow Routing for Evidence Assembly in Long Multimodal Documents
papers.abstract_en: Answering questions about long multimodal documents requires distributing a fixed evidence budget across relevant facets in text, tables, figures, and slides while avoiding near-duplicates. We present \flowreader, which formulates evidence selection as a single minimum-cost flow problem with capacity limits over a multimodal content graph. Spectral decomposition identifies latent aspects of query-relevant content and allocates the budget among them in proportion to their spectral energy. These capacity limits enforce aspect coverage during routing without requiring a language-model planning call. Query-conditioned costs prioritize chains of relevant, mutually consistent evidence. Decomposing the optimal flow produces short evidence chains, which a vision-language model reads in parallel and a reasoner reconciles. On VisDoMBench with Qwen3-VL-32B, \flowreader\ achieves the highest macro accuracy ($68.9$), surpassing the strongest prior system by $2.7$ points, leading on three of five subsets and attaining the highest worst-subset accuracy. It uses a measured $17.5$ content nodes per query and maintains its lead at $12.9$. Ablation studies with a fixed graph, scorer, reader, and judge show that cost design drives accuracy, capacity limits preserve it while using about three-quarters of the reader tokens required by shortest-path routing without these limits on the same network, and spectral aspects align with LLM-generated sub-questions without a planning call.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlowReader 把长多模态文档的证据选择写成一个带容量约束的最小费用流问题：在多模态内容图上用谱分解划分查询相关的潜在方面并按谱能量分配证据预算，查询条件化的费用保证证据链彼此一致。在 VisDoMBench 上用 Qwen3-VL-32B 取得 68.9 的宏准确率，比最强既有系统高 2.7 个百分点，且只需约四分之三的 reader token。
Motivation: 长多模态文档问答要在固定证据预算内覆盖文本、表格、图、幻灯片中的多个相关方面并避开近重复，而依赖语言模型规划调用来分配预算的做法成本高且不透明。
Method: FlowReader 在多模态内容图上构建单一最小费用流问题：谱分解识别查询相关潜在方面并按谱能量分配容量，容量约束在路由阶段强制方面覆盖；查询条件化的费用优先选择相关且互相一致的证据链，最优流分解出的短证据链由 vision-language model 并行读取、再由 reasoner 归纳。
Result: 在 VisDoMBench 上用 Qwen3-VL-32B，宏准确率 68.9，比最强既有系统高 2.7 个百分点，在五个子集中的三个领先并取得最高的最差子集准确率；每查询实测使用 17.5 个内容节点，在 12.9 个节点时仍保持领先。固定图、scorer、reader、judge 的消融显示：费用设计驱动准确率，容量约束在同等网络上以约为 shortest-path routing 三倍之四分之三的 reader token 维持准确率，谱方面与 LLM 生成的子问题对齐且无需规划调用。
Conclusion: 证据装配可以完全交给一个带容量约束的最小费用流求解器，用谱方面替代语言模型规划调用，同时保住准确率并显著压缩 reader token 开销。

papers.title: PatchScene: Patch-based Voxel Diffusion for Large-Scale Scene Completion
papers.abstract_en: We propose PatchScene, a novel diffusion-based framework for large-scale LiDAR scene completion. Unlike existing methods that rely on global latent representations or dense voxel grids, PatchScene adopts a patch-based voxel diffusion paradigm that explicitly generates fine-grained geometry within localized 3D regions. To ensure coherent reconstruction at both spatial and temporal scales, we introduce a confidence-guided spatio-temporal fusion mechanism that integrates overlapping patches and adjacent frames in a unified generative process. Furthermore, we design an Annular-Flow diffusion strategy that leverages the radial density pattern of LiDAR scans to progressively propagate high-fidelity information from near-range to far-range regions, enabling spatially unbounded scene completion. Extensive experiments on the SemanticKITTI benchmark demonstrate that PatchScene achieves state-of-the-art performance across all standard metrics, surpassing previous approaches in both geometric accuracy and temporal consistency. Remarkably, the model trained on 20 m LiDAR ranges generalizes effectively to 50 m scenes without retraining, highlighting its strong scalability and generalization capability for real-world autonomous driving applications. Project page: https://patchscene.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PatchScene 用 patch 级体素扩散做大规模 LiDAR 场景补全，配合置信度引导的时空融合与 Annular-Flow 径向扩散，把高保真信息从近距推向远距，实现空间无界补全。在 SemanticKITTI 上达到全部标准指标的 SOTA，且 20 m 训练的模型免重训直接泛化到 50 m 场景。
Motivation: 现有 LiDAR 场景补全依赖全局隐表示或稠密体素网格，难以在局部区域生成细粒度几何，也难以覆盖远距与跨帧一致性。
Method: patch-based voxel diffusion 在局部 3D 区域内显式生成几何；confidence-guided spatio-temporal fusion 在统一生成过程中融合重叠 patch 与相邻帧；Annular-Flow diffusion 利用 LiDAR 扫描的径向密度模式，由近及远逐级传播高保真信息。
Result: 在 SemanticKITTI benchmark 上全部标准指标达到 state-of-the-art，在几何精度与时间一致性两方面均超过先前方法；20 m LiDAR 距离训练的模型无需重训即可有效泛化到 50 m 场景。
Conclusion: patch 级生成加径向由近及远的扩散策略，可同时换取大规模场景补全的精度、时间一致性与跨距离泛化，适用于真实世界自动驾驶。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Low-Frequency Shortcuts in Texture-Driven Visual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks suffer from shortcut learning, where learned features generalize well to the training set but not to in-distribution (ID) or out-of-distribution (OOD) test sets. Existing studies are all based on a few standard benchmarks, which are shape-driven. Numerous application domains, however, are texture-driven. In this work, we present shortcut learning analysis for texture-driven domains and compare it with that of a standard benchmark. We show that texture-driven domains suffer from low-frequency shortcuts. They make the majority of their decisions based on a few low-frequency components (LFCs) with a skewed spectral behavior, despite that higher-frequency components (HFCs) have higher predictive power. Pruning LFCs from training and test sets mitigates the shortcut and provides a more balanced spectral behavior, improving the ID accuracy by up to 10% and OOD accuracy by up to 40% under algorithmic and real-world domain shifts. We show that general-purpose and domain-specific foundation models can also suffer from low-frequency shortcuts. While large models can mitigate the shortcuts, they incur a high computational cost and may result in a significantly lower accuracy than shortcut-pruned from-scratch trained small models. We show that reduced image resolutions amplify the degree of shortcuts; large frequency-transformation block sizes capture low-frequency shortcuts better than small block sizes; and, low-frequency shortcuts persist across different color spaces. Our findings provide valuable insights, which we hope will be useful for practitioners working on new, understudied domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 纹理驱动视觉域的神经网络把决策建立在少数低频分量 (LFCs) 上，尽管高频分量 (HFCs) 预测力更强，形成低频捷径。训练与测试时剪掉 LFCs 可缓解该捷径，在算法与真实域偏移下把 ID 精度最多提高 10%、OOD 精度最多提高 40%。基础模型同样有此捷径，大模型能缓解但计算开销高，且可能显著低于剪枝后从头训练的小模型。
Motivation: 现有捷径学习研究都基于少数几个 shape-driven 标准基准，而大量应用域是 texture-driven，其捷径形态与缓解方式未知。
Method: 对纹理驱动域做捷径学习分析并与标准基准对比，按频谱分解统计模型对 LFCs 与 HFCs 的依赖；在训练集与测试集上剪除 LFCs 作为缓解手段，并检验通用与领域专用基础模型、不同图像分辨率、不同 frequency-transformation block size 与不同色彩空间下的捷径程度。

Conclusion: 纹理驱动域的捷径本质是低频依赖，剪枝 LFCs 比单纯扩大模型更省算力地改善 OOD 泛化；分辨率、block size 与色彩空间都不消除该捷径。

papers.title: A Language Model from 1913: Pretraining on Historical Text
papers.abstract_en: While modern language models increasingly rely on ever-larger web corpora, we show that pretraining on historical text (e.g., pre-1913 text) in a data-constrained setting can produce a temporally grounded language model that still shows reasonable performance on language understanding. However, developing History LMs requires addressing challenges in data quality, preventing temporal leakage in post-training, and constructing temporally aligned evaluations. We address these challenges and pretrain TypewriterLM, a 7.24B-parameter model with a 1913 knowledge cutoff. We construct TypewriterCorpus, a 54B-token historical corpus with extensive temporal filtering, propose lexically grounded instruction tuning that constrains all responses to vocabulary from historical source documents, and introduce History-Event, a benchmark of 2,344 events for evaluating both competence and cutoff adherence. We release TypewriterLM and all associated resources to support future research on History LMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在数据受限条件下用 1913 年前历史文本预训练出 TypewriterLM（7.24B 参数、知识截止 1913），配合 54B token 的 TypewriterCorpus、词汇受限的 lexically grounded instruction tuning，以及含 2,344 个事件的 History-Event 基准，同时检验语言理解能力与时间截止遵循度。结论是历史文本预训练可产出时间锚定且语言理解表现合理的模型，并需在后训练中防止时间泄漏。
Motivation: 现代语言模型依赖不断膨胀的网络语料，而构建 History LM 面临数据质量、后训练中的时间泄漏 (temporal leakage) 以及时间对齐评测三重障碍，缺少可复现的语料与基准。
Method: 预训练 TypewriterLM（7.24B 参数，1913 知识截止）；构建带时间过滤的 54B token 历史语料 TypewriterCorpus；提出 lexically grounded instruction tuning，将回答约束在历史源文档词汇内；发布 History-Event 基准评测能力与截止遵循。
Result: 产出 TypewriterLM（7.24B 参数、1913 知识截止）、TypewriterCorpus（54B token，含广泛时间过滤）与 History-Event（2,344 个事件）；摘要称该模型在语言理解上仍表现合理，并释放全部资源。
Conclusion: 数据受限下用历史文本预训练可得到时间锚定且语言理解可用的模型，前提是同时处理数据质量、时间泄漏与时间对齐评测；作者公开模型与全部资源供后续 History LM 研究。

papers.title: Planning Takes More Than Token Prediction: Causal Plan for Benchmarking and Building Physically Grounded Embodied Reasoners
papers.abstract_en: Current benchmarks for embodied vision-language planning inadvertently favor linguistic next-token prediction over physically grounded next-state reasoning. This rewards models that mimic statistical language priors rather than track true causal dependencies, reducing complex physical planning to shallow sequence modeling. Hence, achieving genuine physical autonomy requires a fundamental shift from linguistically grounded token prediction toward physically grounded causal reasoning. To this end, we introduce Causal-Plan-Bench, a high-fidelity diagnostic suite spanning four causal dimensions, curated via multi-stage verification. To endow models with this capability, a four-stage annotation pipeline extracts structured interaction records from egocentric videos to construct Causal-Plan-1M, a dense million-scale corpus of explicit causal reasoning traces. Extensive evaluation reveals a striking gap: leading models struggle to demonstrate genuine physical agency -- even GPT-6-astra scores only 43.04. In contrast, our tailored training recipe enables Causal Planner to internalize the complex physical logic required for accurate next-state estimation. Built upon Qwen3-VL-8B, Causal Planner raises its backbone's score from 33.23 to 45.28, a 36.3% relative gain, and improves on three external benchmarks without benchmark-specific adaptation. We further observe an empirical Causal-Supervision Scaling Trend. Paired no-vision controls also reveal substantial visual dependence, while cross-judge comparisons and human scoring assess the reliability of automated evaluation. More importantly, we initiate the first effort to turn agents from superficial token predictors into physically grounded causal reasoners, bridging language modeling and world modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 现有具身视觉语言规划基准偏向语言学 next-token 预测而非物理因果的 next-state 推理，作者提出 Causal-Plan-Bench 诊断套件与 Causal-Plan-1M 百万级因果推理轨迹语料，并给出针对性训练配方使 Causal Planner（基于 Qwen3-VL-8B）把骨干分数从 33.23 提到 45.28（相对提升 36.3%），且在三个外部基准上无需基准特定适配即有改善。
Motivation: 现有具身规划基准奖励模仿语言统计先验而非追踪真实因果依赖，把复杂物理规划退化为浅层序列建模，无法衡量真正的物理自主性。
Method: 提出 Causal-Plan-Bench：跨四个因果维度、经多阶段验证整理的高保真诊断套件；四阶段标注管线从第一人称视频抽取结构化交互记录，构建 Causal-Plan-1M 百万级显式因果推理轨迹语料；配套针对性训练配方训练 Causal Planner（构建于 Qwen3-VL-8B），并用配对去视觉对照、跨评判者比较与人工打分检验自动评估可靠性。
Result: 评测显示领先模型普遍难以展现真正的物理能动性，GPT-6-astra 仅得 43.04；Causal Planner 把骨干 Qwen3-VL-8B 的分数从 33.23 提升到 45.28（相对提升 36.3%），并在三个外部基准上改善且无需基准特定适配；观察到经验性的 Causal-Supervision Scaling Trend，配对去视觉对照显示显著的视觉依赖。
Conclusion: 作者主张从语言学 token 预测转向物理接地的因果推理是实现真正物理自主的关键路径，并称其工作是把 agent 从浅层 token 预测者转变为物理接地因果推理者的首个尝试，以打通语言建模与世界建模。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: Everywhere Learning: Artificial Intelligence with Pointwise Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Everywhere learning is a new paradigm whereby Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems are trained to satisfy loss constraints with probability one over the data distribution. This is in contrast to the standard paradigm of training AI systems to minimize average losses. We develop an approximate duality theory to substantiate a generalization analysis that establishes the proximity between solutions of empirical and statistical everywhere learning problems. Our results show that dual variables reweigh the data distribution towards points in which loss constraints are more difficult to satisfy and that generalization is controlled by the mismatch between the concentration of mass of the data distribution and the concentration of mass on points where constraints are more difficult to satisfy. We further show that we can control generalization with a sparse L1 penalty on constraint relaxations. We illustrate the merits of everywhere learning with an experiment in agentic classification for language model tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 everywhere learning：把训练目标从最小化平均损失改为以概率一满足逐点损失约束，并给出近似对偶理论支撑的经验—统计解接近性分析。对偶变量把数据分布重新加权到约束更难满足的点上，泛化由数据质量集中与难满足点质量集中的错配程度控制；对约束松弛加稀疏 L1 惩罚即可控制泛化，并在语言模型任务的 agentic 分类实验中展示其效果。
Motivation: 标准训练只最小化平均损失，允许在分布的一部分点上系统性违反约束；需要一种让约束在数据分布上以概率一成立的训练范式及其泛化理论。
Method: 构建近似对偶理论 (approximate duality theory) 来分析经验 everywhere learning 问题与统计 everywhere learning 问题解的接近性；对偶变量对数据分布做重加权，指向约束难满足的点；并引入对约束松弛的稀疏 L1 惩罚作为泛化控制手段。
Result: 泛化由数据分布质量集中与难满足约束点上质量集中的错配 (mismatch) 决定；稀疏 L1 惩罚可控制泛化；在语言模型任务的 agentic 分类实验中说明该范式的有效性（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把平均损失换成以概率一满足的逐点约束，配合对偶重加权与 L1 松弛惩罚，可给出可分析的泛化保证；适用面目前由语言模型 agentic 分类实验展示。

papers.title: Efficient Exploration for Iterative Nash Preference Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Preference alignment is central to improving large language models (LLMs), but reward-based formulations can be restrictive when human preferences are non-transitive. Nash learning from human feedback (NLHF) addresses this limitation by modeling alignment as a preference game and seeking a Nash equilibrium. However, the learning-theoretic foundations of scalable NLHF remain limited: existing regret guarantees rely on explicit preference-model estimation and minimax oracles, whereas simpler iterative methods lack such guarantees. We study online iterative NLHF and identify exploration as a key obstacle. First, we show that standard iterative NLHF can incur an exponential dependence on the inverse KL-regularization parameter, demonstrating that implicit exploration through policy updates can be insufficient. We then propose Exploratory Nash Preference Optimization (ENPO), which combines a SFT-type regularization with adversarial policy exploration. ENPO eliminates this exponential dependence without requiring minimax oracles or explicit preference-model estimation. We further introduce Bonus-Explorer ENPO (BENPO), which uses additional oracles to achieve an $O(\log T)$ regret bound. Finally, we develop Direct ENPO (DENPO), a practical variant of ENPO for fine-tuning LLMs. Experiments with Llama-3-8B-Instruct demonstrate consistent improvements over the evaluated RLHF and NLHF baselines across multiple benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线迭代 Nash 偏好学习 (NLHF) 中，标准方法的遗憾界对 KL 正则化参数的倒数呈指数依赖，隐式探索不足。提出 ENPO（SFT 正则 + 对抗策略探索）消除该指数依赖，BENPO 借助额外 oracle 达到 O(log T) 遗憾界，DENPO 作为可落地的 LLM 微调变体；Llama-3-8B-Instruct 实验在多个 benchmark 上一致优于所评估的 RLHF 与 NLHF 基线。
Motivation: 非传递偏好下基于奖励的对齐公式受限，NLHF 用偏好博弈建模，但现有遗憾保证依赖显式偏好模型估计与 minimax oracle，更简单的迭代方法缺少此类保证，且探索是关键障碍。
Method: 研究在线迭代 NLHF，先证明标准迭代方法对 KL 正则化参数倒数有指数依赖；提出 ENPO，将 SFT 式正则与对抗策略探索 (adversarial policy exploration) 结合，无需 minimax oracle 或显式偏好模型估计；再提出 BENPO 用额外 oracle 换取 O(log T) 遗憾界，并给出面向 LLM 微调的实用变体 DENPO。
Result: 标准迭代 NLHF 的遗憾对 KL 正则化参数倒数呈指数依赖；ENPO 消除该指数依赖；BENPO 达到 O(log T) 遗憾界；在 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 上，实验相对所评估的 RLHF 与 NLHF 基线在多个 benchmark 上一致改进。
Conclusion: 迭代 NLHF 的瓶颈是探索而非偏好建模本身：SFT 正则加对抗策略探索即可去掉指数依赖，加 oracle 可进一步压到对数遗憾，且不必估计偏好模型或解 minimax oracle。

summary_sections.result: 标准迭代 NLHF 的遗憾对 KL 正则化参数倒数呈指数依赖；ENPO 消除该指数依赖；BENPO 达到 O(log T) 遗憾界；在 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 上，实验相对所评估的 RLHF 与 NLHF 基线在多个 benchmark 上一致改进。
summary_sections.conclusion: 迭代 NLHF 的瓶颈是探索而非偏好建模本身：SFT 正则加对抗策略探索即可去掉指数依赖，加 oracle 可进一步压到对数遗憾，且不必估计偏好模型或解 minimax oracle。

papers.title: HakushoBench: A Japanese Chart and Table VQA Benchmark from Governmental White Papers
papers.abstract_en: Understanding chart and table images is essential for applying vision-language models (VLMs) to real-world document understanding. While English benchmarks have advanced rapidly, non-English counterparts remain scarce, leaving it unclear whether this progress generalizes across languages. A key obstacle is the difficulty of collecting realistic and diverse non-English chart and table images at scale. To address this, we leverage governmental white papers as a source for benchmark construction, as they contain naturally occurring charts and tables across diverse formats and domains and are freely accessible in many countries. As a first instantiation, we introduce HakushoBench, a Japanese chart and table VQA benchmark built from 33 governmental white papers. HakushoBench contains 2,053 images spanning over 10 image types, with manually annotated and independently verified QA pairs designed to assess holistic understanding of charts and tables rather than local visual cues alone. Experiments across a broad range of VLMs show that HakushoBench is substantially harder than the existing Japanese benchmark and remains challenging for open-weight models: sub-10B open-weight models reach at most 58.6% accuracy, and even the flagship open-weight model Qwen3.5-397B-A17B trails Gemini~3~Pro by 8.1 points (85.8% vs. 93.9%), highlighting substantial room for improvement in complex chart and table understanding. We release our dataset and code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HakushoBench 用 33 份日本政府白皮书构建日文图表 VQA 基准，含 2,053 张图、10 余种图像类型与人工标注并独立复核的 QA 对，考察对图表的整体理解而非局部视觉线索。在广泛 VLM 测试中它明显难于现有日文基准：sub-10B 开源模型最高仅 58.6% 准确率，旗舰开源 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 为 85.8%，落后 Gemini 3 Pro 的 93.9% 共 8.1 个百分点。
Motivation: 英文图表/表格基准快速推进，但非英文对应物稀缺，且大规模收集真实多样的非英文图表图像本身困难，导致跨语言泛化能力不清楚。
Method: 以各国免费可得的政府白皮书为基准构建来源，取其中自然出现、格式与领域多样的图表；从 33 份白皮书抽取 2,053 张图、覆盖 10 余种图像类型，人工标注并独立复核 QA 对，设计为考察图表整体理解；在多种 VLM 上做实验。
Result: HakushoBench 含 2,053 张图像、10 余种图像类型，源自 33 份白皮书；sub-10B 开源模型准确率至多 58.6%；旗舰开源 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 为 85.8%，Gemini 3 Pro 为 93.9%，相差 8.1 个百分点；整体明显难于现有日文基准。
Conclusion: 复杂图表与表格的整体理解对当前 VLM（包括旗舰开源模型）仍是明显短板，数据集与代码已公开。

papers.title: Counterfactual Evidence Audits Predict LLM-Agent Susceptibility to Ranked Context
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly decide from evidence assembled by upstream systems: retrievers choose documents, recommenders choose posts, and memory systems choose prior events. Existing evaluations usually hold this evidence fixed, missing failures in which individually ordinary items form a systematically one-sided context. We introduce a counterfactual evidence audit: expose an agent to two mirrored sets of five documents, measure the difference in six downstream decisions, and use that contrast to predict its response to disjoint 45-document contexts. The protocol was frozen before testing three held-out open-weight model families. Across 18 held-out model-task cells, five-document effects predict full-context effects with Spearman rho=.855 (p<.001), reduce mean absolute prediction error by 62% relative to a zero-effect predictor, and recover the direction of 12 of 13 material effects. A reviewer-requested post-hoc task-mean baseline is also substantially weaker (MAE .369 versus .167). Matched controls show that selecting one-sided ordinary items, rather than merely reordering identical items, causes the shift in a susceptible model. Across seven open-weight families, susceptibility transfers from an interactive feed to a static RAG dossier (rho=.750, exact p=.033), while a provenance warning does not reliably mitigate it. A separate study of three deployed Codex agent tiers finds strong audit-to-full ranking (rho=.951, p<.001) but no individually significant full-context effect after correction. Within this single synthetic remote-work domain, the result supports a domain-specific triage procedure, not a universal steering claim: evidence selection must be evaluated as part of the composed agent system.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 1 figure. Accepted at FLMSec 2026 (NeurIPS 2026 Workshop). Substantially revised after peer review with new preregistered audits, matched controls, held-out validation, RAG transfer, and Codex boundary tests
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出反事实证据审计 (counterfactual evidence audit)：给 LLM agent 暴露两组镜像的 5 篇文档，测 6 项下游决策的差异，用该对比预测其在互不重叠的 45 文档上下文中的响应。协议在测试三个 held-out 开源模型族前冻结，18 个 held-out 模型-任务格上 5 文档效应预测全上下文效应 Spearman rho=.855 (p<.001)，MAE 相对零效应预测器降 62%，13 个实质效应中恢复 12 个方向。
Motivation: 现有评测把检索器、推荐器、记忆系统选出的证据固定不变，漏掉单看普通、合起来却系统性一边倒的上下文所导致的失效。
Method: 反事实证据审计：镜像的两组各 5 篇文档暴露给 agent，量 6 项下游决策的差，再预测互不重叠的 45 文档上下文响应；协议在三个 held-out 开源模型族测试前冻结，并配 matched controls 区分“选一边倒的普通条目”与“重排相同条目”，另有 RAG 迁移与 Codex 边界测试。
Result: 18 个 held-out 模型-任务格上 5 文档效应预测全上下文效应 Spearman rho=.855 (p<.001)，MAE 相对零效应预测器降 62%，13 个实质效应恢复 12 个方向；审稿人要求的事后 task-mean 基线 MAE .369 对 .167。matched controls 显示是选取一边倒条目而非重排相同条目导致偏移。7 个开源模型族中易感性从交互 feed 迁移到静态 RAG dossier (rho=.750, exact p=.033)，provenance warning 不能可靠缓解。三个部署 Codex 层级审计到全上下文排序 rho=.951 (p<.001)，但校正后无单项显著的全上下文效应。
Conclusion: 在单一合成远程办公域内，结果支持域特定的 triage 流程而非普适操纵主张：证据选择必须作为组合 agent 系统的一部分来评估。

papers.title: On the Limits of LLM Adaptability: Impact of Model-Internalized Priors on Annotation Task Performance
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for zero-shot annotation and LLM-as-a-judge tasks, yet their reliability hinges on how model-internalized priors interact with user-provided instructions. We investigate three dimensions of this interaction: (1) how an LLM's familiarity with data and task definitions relates to performance, (2) whether additional information in prompts can correct zero-shot errors ("decision stickiness"), and (3) model susceptibility to misaligned task definitions. We introduce Definition-Specific Familiarity (DSF), which measures alignment between a model's elicited concept and the target definition. Across nine LLMs and six toxicity datasets (five primary datasets plus an additional robustness dataset), DSF predicts annotation performance after controlling for dataset identity (partial $r=+0.41$). This association remains positive across all prompting conditions tested. In contrast, three common text-memorization metrics show no positive association. We show that prompting has limited corrective power: only 34.8% of zero-shot errors are corrected by additional instructions or examples, with high-confidence errors especially persistent. Misaligned definitions systematically shift predictions without reducing reported confidence, making confidence unreliable for detecting definition-policy mismatch. Together, these findings establish definition alignment as a practical model-selection criterion and show that better prompting alone cannot substitute for validating model-policy fit.
papers.comment: Updated based on camera-ready from ICML 2026 (Oral & Spotlight); PMLR vol. 306. 9 pages, 5 figures
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 43 rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea. PMLR 306, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Definition-Specific Familiarity (DSF) 度量 LLM 被引出的概念与目标标注定义的对齐程度，在 9 个 LLM、6 个毒性数据集上，控制数据集身份后 DSF 与标注性能偏相关 r=+0.41，而三种文本记忆指标无正相关。补提示只能纠正 34.8% 的 zero-shot 错误，错配定义会系统性移动预测却不降低置信度，因此单靠更好的提示无法替代对模型-策略匹配的验证。
Motivation: LLM 常被用作 zero-shot 标注器与 LLM-as-a-judge，但其可靠性取决于模型内化先验与用户指令的交互；现有做法默认补提示能纠正错误，而高置信错误与定义错配难以靠置信度察觉。
Method: 定义 DSF 度量模型被引出的概念与目标定义的对齐，考察三个维度：模型对数据与任务定义的熟悉度与性能的关系、提示中额外信息能否纠正 zero-shot 错误（decision stickiness）、模型对错配任务定义的敏感性；在 9 个 LLM、6 个毒性数据集（5 个主数据集加 1 个鲁棒性数据集）上做受控提示实验，并与三种文本记忆指标对照。
Result: 控制数据集身份后 DSF 与标注性能偏相关 partial r=+0.41，且在所有测试的提示条件下均为正；三种常见文本记忆指标无正相关。仅 34.8% 的 zero-shot 错误被额外指令或示例纠正，高置信错误尤其顽固；错配定义系统性移动预测却不降低报告的置信度。
Conclusion: 定义对齐可作为实用的模型选择标准，置信度无法可靠检测定义-策略错配，更好的提示本身不能替代对模型-策略匹配的验证。

papers.title: A Pre-Training Analogue of Grokking in Language Models: Tracing Delayed Grammatical Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Grokking, the phenomenon in which neural networks generalize long after fitting their training data, has been studied in supervised settings on many epochs. LLM pre-training instead involves next-token prediction over an unlabeled corpus, with limited data repetition and no explicit train/validation split. To address this, we propose an exposure-based framework that enables the study of grokking-like dynamics during LLM pre-training. We ground our evaluation in BLiMP minimal pairs, which provide controlled grammatical contrasts. For every BLiMP minimal pair, we identify a critical phrase, the smallest continuous span that captures the grammatical contrast and the phenomenon-relevant context. Examples whose critical phrase appears in the pre-training window are assigned to the proxy-train split; the remaining examples are assigned to the proxy-validation split. Across five grammatical phenomena, we observe delayed generalization. Analyzing pre-training checkpoints before and after generalization shows that grammatical concept vectors become more predictive of grammatical acceptability and occupy a higher-dimensional subspace after generalization. We also find that attention from the critical token to the relevant context token is concentrated in a small number of heads.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 10 figures, 9 tables; Accepted to AACL-IJCNLP 2026 Main Conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把监督学习中的 grokking 迁移到 LLM 预训练场景：按 BLiMP 最小对中 critical phrase 是否落在预训练窗口内划分 proxy-train/proxy-validation，在五类语法现象上观察到延迟泛化。泛化前后 checkpoint 对比显示，语法概念向量对可接受性 (acceptability) 的预测力变强、占据更高维子空间，且 critical token 到相关 context token 的注意力集中在少数几个 head。
Motivation: Grokking 此前只在有显式 train/validation 划分、数据多轮重复的监督设定下研究，而 LLM 预训练是无标注语料上的 next-token prediction，数据重复有限且没有验证集，无法直接套用原有分析框架。
Method: 提出 exposure-based 框架：对每条 BLiMP minimal pair 定位 critical phrase（承载语法对比的最小连续片段），凡其出现在预训练窗口内的样例归入 proxy-train，其余归入 proxy-validation；再对比泛化前后的预训练 checkpoint，检查语法概念向量与注意力头的分布。
Result: 在五类语法现象上均观察到延迟泛化；泛化后语法概念向量对 grammatical acceptability 更具预测性并占据更高维子空间；critical token 到相关 context token 的注意力集中在少量 attention heads 上。
Conclusion: 即使没有显式验证集，用暴露窗口构造的 proxy 划分也能在 LLM 预训练中复现 grokking 式延迟泛化，且泛化伴随概念向量几何与注意力头集中度的可测变化。

papers.title: SurGe: Improved Surface Geometry in Point Maps
papers.abstract_en: Recent feedforward 3D reconstruction methods predict point maps and estimate global 3D geometry remarkably well. However, their predictions still exhibit inaccurate local surface geometry, which is clearly visible qualitatively but only weakly reflected in common metrics. To make these errors more explicit in evaluation, we introduce a point map normal metric that evaluates the local surface orientation induced by neighboring 3D predictions. To reduce these errors, we propose two complementary components: a point gradient matching loss that supervises depth-normalized 3D finite differences, and a Neighborhood Attention Decoder (NAD) that progressively upsamples features and uses Neighborhood Attention for local feature mixing. Across eight zero-shot monocular geometry benchmarks, our model, SurGe, achieves the best average rank for global point map AbsRel and consistently improves local point map and point map normal evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SurGe 针对前馈 3D 重建中点图 (point map) 局部表面几何不准、且被常用指标弱化的问题，提出点图法线度量 (point map normal metric) 显式度量邻域诱导的局部表面朝向，并用点梯度匹配损失 (point gradient matching loss) 监督深度归一化的 3D 有限差分，配合 Neighborhood Attention Decoder (NAD) 逐级上采样并做局部特征混合。在八个零样本单目几何基准上，SurGe 的全局点图 AbsRel 平均排名最佳，局部点图与法线评价一致改善。
Motivation: 前馈 3D 重建方法预测的全局几何已较好，但局部表面几何仍不准确：定性上明显，常用指标却几乎反映不出来，评估与改进都缺少能显式暴露这类误差的手段。
Method: 三部分互补：一是点图法线度量，评估相邻 3D 预测所诱导的局部表面朝向；二是点梯度匹配损失，对深度归一化的 3D 有限差分做监督；三是 Neighborhood Attention Decoder (NAD)，逐级上采样特征并用 Neighborhood Attention 做局部特征混合。
Result: 在八个零样本单目几何基准 (zero-shot monocular geometry benchmarks) 上，SurGe 取得全局点图 AbsRel 的最佳平均排名，并在局部点图与点图法线评价上一致改善。
Conclusion: 把局部表面朝向直接写进度量与损失，可以在不牺牲全局点图精度的前提下系统性改善前馈单目重建的局部几何。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: One Hypothesis Is Not Enough: Abductive Reasoning with Agentic Hypothesis Refinement over Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Abductive reasoning over knowledge graphs (KGs) seeks a first-order logic hypothesis whose answer set explains a given set of observed entities. Since many hypotheses can explain the same observations, controllable hypothesis generators condition generation on entities, relations, or logical patterns, but they treat generation as a single step. A generated hypothesis may be well-formed and satisfy the given conditions yet still fail to explain the observations, and the model has no mechanism to detect or correct this mismatch. Closing the abductive cycle requires revising a discrete, structured hypothesis, which large language models cannot do reliably, even though they iterate readily in natural language. We propose HypoAgent, an agentic hypothesis refinement framework that treats condition signals not only as expressions of user intent but also as operators that steer generation. A Hypothesis Proposal Agent calls a small trained generator to propose a hypothesis. Root-cause analysis then uses fragment-level coverage to locate branches worth inspecting and gathers neighborhood evidence from the training graph. A Hypothesis Refiner Agent combines this diagnosis with previously generated hypotheses to produce updated conditions and directly revised hypotheses. HypoAgent outperforms one-shot generation in single-turn and multi-turn settings on BioKG, PharmKG8k, and DBpedia50, and in the unconditional setting on DBpedia50. Our code is available at https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/HypoAgent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HypoAgent 把知识图谱上的溯因推理 (abductive reasoning) 从单步生成改成多轮 agent 精修：提案 agent 调用小型生成器产出一阶逻辑假设，根因分析用片段级覆盖定位可疑分支并收集训练图邻域证据，精修 agent 据此更新条件信号并直接改写假设。在 BioKG、PharmKG8k、DBpedia50 的单轮与多轮设定以及 DBpedia50 的无条件设定上均超过 one-shot 生成。
Motivation: 同一组观测实体可被多个假设解释，现有可控生成器把生成当单步：假设可能形式良好、满足条件却仍解释不了观测，而模型没有检测与纠正这种失配的机制。LLM 能在自然语言里迭代，却无法可靠地修订离散结构化假设。
Method: HypoAgent 由 Hypothesis Proposal Agent 与 Hypothesis Refiner Agent 组成：前者调用小型训练生成器提出假设，随后做根因分析，用 fragment-level coverage 找出值得检查的分支并从训练图收集邻域证据；后者把该诊断与已生成假设结合，产出更新的条件信号和被直接改写的假设，条件信号同时充当用户意图表达与引导生成的算子。
Result: 在 BioKG、PharmKG8k、DBpedia50 上的单轮与多轮设定中均优于 one-shot 生成，并在 DBpedia50 的无条件设定上同样超过 one-shot；代码发布于 github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/HypoAgent。
Conclusion: 把条件信号当作可更新的算子、用根因分析驱动多轮精修，能闭合知识图谱溯因推理的循环，使离散结构化假设在迭代中被真正修订而非重新采样。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Escaping the Capacity Ceiling: Routing on the Stiefel Manifold for Bilinear SPD Layers
papers.abstract_en: Deep networks on the symmetric positive-definite (SPD) manifold promise expressive representations by encoding data geometry as an inductive bias, but stacking BiMap layers with the standard ReEig nonlinearity often adds no capacity: on real, preconditioned EEG data, ReEig rarely activates, so the stack behaves as a single layer at any depth. In the worst case, when domains share no discriminative directions, we prove a single filter has a capacity ceiling, so it cannot fully align every domain at once. To overcome that, we propose SCAP (Stiefel Cross-Attention Pool), a layer implementing a family of Stiefel filters by combining a pool of $K$ experts into a sample-specific bilinear map via cross-attention. We show that it matches a per-domain filter bank to first order with fewer experts than domains when domain-optimal filters span few directions near a shared tangent-space basepoint; in the worst case, its alignment empirically stays nearly flat as domains grow, escaping the fixed-filter ceiling. Naively trained, however, this routing can collapse to a fixed filter; we diagnose why and adapt three mechanisms to mitigate it. SCAP significantly improves balanced accuracy over fixed-filter SPDNet on all five cross-domain EEG motor-imagery datasets, and matches or exceeds three domain-adaptive baselines on four out of five.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPD 流形上堆叠 BiMap+ReEig 在真实预处理 EEG 上几乎不增加容量，作者证明单个滤波器存在容量上限，无法同时对齐所有域。提出 SCAP (Stiefel Cross-Attention Pool)：用交叉注意力把 K 个专家池组合成样本特定的双线性映射，在域最优滤波器只占共享切空间基点附近少数方向时，用少于域数的专家即达到一阶匹配逐域滤波器组。在五个跨域 EEG 运动想象数据集上，SCAP 的 balanced accuracy 显著高于固定滤波器 SPDNet，并在其中四个上追平或超过三个域自适应基线。
Motivation: BiMap 层与 ReEig 非线性堆叠在真实预处理 EEG 上 ReEig 几乎不激活，网络在任意深度都退化为单层；且当各域没有共享判别方向时，单个滤波器存在容量上限，无法一次对齐全部域。
Method: SCAP 通过 cross-attention 将 K 个专家池组合为样本特定的双线性映射，实现一族 Stiefel 滤波器；针对朴素训练导致路由塌缩为固定滤波器的问题，诊断成因并改造三种缓解机制。
Result: 在五个跨域 EEG 运动想象数据集上，SCAP 的 balanced accuracy 显著优于固定滤波器 SPDNet，并在五个中的四个上匹配或超过三个域自适应基线；域数增长时其对齐表现近乎持平，而固定滤波器受容量上限约束。
Conclusion: 用交叉注意力在 Stiefel 流形上做专家路由可以绕开单滤波器的容量上限，但必须配合抗塌缩机制，否则路由会退化回固定滤波器。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FRUC: Feedforward Dynamic Scene Reconstruction from Uncalibrated Collaborative Driving Views
papers.abstract_en: We present FRUC, a feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting framework for dynamic scene reconstruction from uncalibrated collaborative driving views. Existing multi-agent reconstruction frameworks are often hindered by rigid prerequisites, demanding precise spatial calibration and slow per-scene optimization. In this paper, we rethink this task by conceptualizing a distributed multi-vehicle network as a spatio-temporally unstructured ego-centric multi-camera system, where the core challenge lies in enhancing ego-centric occluded geometry through collaboration without degrading the ego's accurately observed visible geometry, while preserving reconstruction efficiency. For efficient reconstruction, FRUC is built upon a visual grounded geometric Transformer backbone to enable one-shot, calibration-free inference from a flexible number of multi-vehicle views. To achieve non-destructive geometric supplementation under uncalibrated cross-agent misalignment, FRUC first introduces an ego-centric causal occlusion field that explicitly derives occlusion evolution as latent priors by modeling agent-wise spatio-temporal correlations. Guided by these occlusion priors, it further formulates cross-agent integration as a deterministic residual denoising process via zero-initialized injection, turning challenging cross-agent fusion into bounded residual learning for robust collaborative blind-spot completion. Through extensive evaluations on real-world V2X-Real and UrbanIng-V2X datasets, FRUC is shown to be a new state-of-the-art for the scene reconstruction of dynamic collaborative driving environments, significantly outperforming existing methods in both rendering quality and efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/yihangtao/FRUC.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FRUC 把多车协同驾驶的分布式视角当作时空无结构的 ego-centric 多相机系统，用视觉接地的几何 Transformer backbone 实现一次前向、免标定的 3D Gaussian Splatting 重建。它先用 ego-centric causal occlusion field 把遮挡演化作为隐先验建模，再以零初始化注入把跨车融合写成确定性残差去噪，在补全盲区的同时不破坏 ego 已准确观测的可见几何。在 V2X-Real 与 UrbanIng-V2X 上达到动态协同驾驶场景重建的新 SOTA，渲染质量与效率均显著超过现有方法。
Motivation: 现有多智能体重建框架被刚性前提卡住：要求精确空间标定，且依赖逐场景的慢速优化，无法灵活接入任意数量的协同车辆视角。
Method: 以 visual grounded geometric Transformer 为 backbone，支持从可变数量多车视角做 one-shot、calibration-free 推理；先引入 ego-centric causal occlusion field，通过建模 agent-wise 时空相关性把遮挡演化推导为隐先验；再以 zero-initialized injection 将跨 agent 融合表述为确定性残差去噪过程，把未标定错位下的融合化为有界残差学习，完成盲区补全。
Result: 在真实世界 V2X-Real 与 UrbanIng-V2X 数据集上评测，FRUC 在动态协同驾驶环境的场景重建上取得新 SOTA，在渲染质量与效率两方面均显著优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 把多车网络重构为无标定的 ego-centric 多相机系统、并用遮挡先验引导有界残差融合，可以在不牺牲 ego 可见几何与效率的前提下完成协同盲区补全。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Where Do Apparent LLM Clinical Triage Failures Arise? Localizing the Multiple-Choice Format Effect
papers.abstract_en: LLM evaluations using clinician-authored triage vignettes have reported substantial under-triage under constrained multiple-choice testing. Yet model performance on the same clinical cases can change when responses are generated in free text. We test whether this format effect appears while the case is processed or when clinical information is mapped to the final answer. Using sparse-autoencoder (SAE) features in Gemma 3 4B/12B IT and Qwen3-8B, we find that medical features fire on the shared clinical narrative under both formats but are inactive at the multiple-choice decision token. Emergency-tier information is linearly decodable from vignette representations with ROC-AUC $0.95$--$1.00$ under both formats, with no significant format difference, but is attenuated at the decision token. Natural-language autoencoder verbalization and top-feature characterization associate that token with the multiple-choice scaffold. In a direct linear projection, the identified medical features contribute zero, whereas scaffold-peaking features account for over $91\%$ of unsigned attribution in both Gemma models. Behaviorally, whether multiple choice improves or worsens performance depends on the model. Option-order shuffles rule out simple positional bias, and cases that differ between formats are usually one severity tier apart. Together, these findings place the strongest correlates of the format effect at answer selection while leaving open whether unmeasured clinical representations also differ. Code and data to reproduce experiments are available in the study repository. https://github.com/dafraile/SAE_mad
papers.comment: 9 pages main text, 29 pages total including appendices; 7 figures, 25 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用稀疏自编码器 (SAE) 特征定位 LLM 临床分诊中多选题格式效应的来源：Gemma 3 4B/12B IT 与 Qwen3-8B 上，急诊分级信息在病例叙述表征中线性可解码（ROC-AUC 0.95–1.00，两种格式无显著差异），但到多选决策 token 处被削弱；该 token 的归因超过 91% 来自与多选脚手架 (scaffold) 相关的特征，医学特征贡献为零。
Motivation: 临床医生撰写的分诊情景 (triage vignettes) 在受限多选测试下报告大量低分级 (under-triage)，但同一病例改成自由文本作答时表现会变；需要判定格式效应发生在病例处理阶段还是临床信息映射到最终答案的阶段。
Method: 在 Gemma 3 4B/12B IT 与 Qwen3-8B 上提取 SAE 特征，比较共享临床叙述与多选决策 token 两处的特征激活；用自然语言 autoencoder verbalization 与 top-feature characterization 刻画该 token，并做直接线性投影分解医学特征与 scaffold-peaking 特征的归因占比；行为侧做选项顺序打乱 (option-order shuffles) 与跨格式病例对比。
Result: 急诊分级信息在两种格式下均可从情景表征线性解码，ROC-AUC 0.95–1.00 且格式间无显著差异，但在决策 token 处衰减；直接线性投影中医学特征贡献为零，scaffold-peaking 特征在两个 Gemma 模型中占无符号归因的 91% 以上；多选对表现是提升还是下降取决于具体模型；选项顺序打乱排除了简单位置偏置，跨格式不一致的病例通常只差一个严重度层级。
Conclusion: 格式效应最强的相关信号位于答案选择阶段而非病例理解阶段，但未测量的临床表征差异仍不能排除；多选格式的影响方向是模型相关的。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.method: 在 Gemma 3 4B/12B IT 与 Qwen3-8B 上提取 SAE 特征，比较共享临床叙述与多选决策 token 两处的特征激活；用自然语言 autoencoder verbalization 与 top-feature characterization 刻画该 token，并做直接线性投影分解医学特征与 scaffold-peaking 特征的归因占比；行为侧做选项顺序打乱 (option-order shuffles) 与跨格式病例对比。
summary_sections.result: 急诊分级信息在两种格式下均可从情景表征线性解码，ROC-AUC 0.95–1.00 且格式间无显著差异，但在决策 token 处衰减；直接线性投影中医学特征贡献为零，scaffold-peaking 特征在两个 Gemma 模型中占无符号归因的 91% 以上；多选对表现是提升还是下降取决于具体模型；选项顺序打乱排除了简单位置偏置，跨格式不一致的病例通常只差一个严重度层级。
summary_sections.conclusion: 格式效应最强的相关信号位于答案选择阶段而非病例理解阶段，但未测量的临床表征差异仍不能排除；多选格式的影响方向是模型相关的。

papers.title: GUI Agents for Continual Game Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generating a game is not the same as making one playable. Existing code-generation approaches often translate a prompt directly into an artifact, leaving interaction-level failures undetected. We argue that game generation requires a player and study two roles for graphical user interface (GUI) agents. First, we introduce \textbf{PlaytestArena}, an evaluation environment containing 200 browser-based game-generation tasks across eight genres, each paired with rubrics of expected in-play behaviors. An independent GUI judge loads and plays each build to adjudicate these rubrics. Second, we propose \textbf{Play2Code}, in which a game agent and a rubric-blind GUI playtester iteratively generate, play, and refine games through shared memory. The playtester provides gameplay traces and actionable feedback, while a separate GPT-5.5 judge assigns final benchmark scores. Across three frontier backbones, Play2Code achieves a 66.8\% rubric pass rate, outperforming single-pass and agentic-coding baselines by 37.1 and 14.6 points, respectively. Its scores also improve monotonically across refinement rounds. Further analysis shows that GUI-agent feedback is fully logged and traceable, while its priorities vary substantially across model backbones. These results establish GUI playtesting as an evaluation and refinement signal for interactive code generation. Our project website is available at https://continual-game-generation.vercel.app/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Play2Code：让游戏生成 agent 与盲于评分细则 (rubric-blind) 的 GUI playtester agent 通过共享记忆迭代生成、试玩并改进游戏，把「可玩性」变成可判定的评测信号。在 PlaytestArena 的 200 个浏览器游戏生成任务上，GPT-5.5 judge 打分的 rubric 通过率达 66.8%，比单次生成与 agentic-coding 基线分别高 37.1 和 14.6 分，且分数随迭代轮次单调上升。
Motivation: 现有代码生成把 prompt 直接翻成产物，交互层面的失败（游戏跑不起来、玩法不成立）不会被发现，游戏生成缺少「玩家」这一环的评测与改进信号。
Method: PlaytestArena：200 个浏览器游戏生成任务、覆盖八个类型，每个任务配期望游玩行为的 rubric，由独立 GUI judge 加载并试玩判定。Play2Code：游戏 agent 与 rubric-blind GUI playtester 经共享记忆迭代生成-试玩-改进，playtester 输出游玩轨迹与可执行反馈，另设 GPT-5.5 judge 给最终分数；在三个 frontier backbone 上比较。
Result: Play2Code rubric 通过率 66.8%，高于单次生成基线 37.1 个点、高于 agentic-coding 基线 14.6 个点；分数随改进轮次单调上升。GUI-agent 反馈全程可日志追溯，其优先级在不同 backbone 间差异显著。
Conclusion: GUI 试玩可以同时充当交互式代码生成的评测信号与改进信号，迭代试玩比单次生成更能把 prompt 变成真正可玩的游戏。

papers.title: Stimulus symmetries can confound representational similarity analyses
papers.abstract_en: What can representational similarity matrices (RSMs) tell us about a neural code? As the popularity of these summary statistics grows, so too does the need for a more complete characterization of their properties. Here, we show that symmetries in network inputs can confound RSM-based analyses. Stimulus symmetries render many representations functionally equivalent, but these different configurations can lead to different RSMs. These different RSMs reflect qualitatively different representational geometries, ranging from disentangled to maximally-mixed codes. We show that stochastic gradient descent or energetic regularization can generate sparse, drifting codes, leading in turn to drifting RSMs. Moreover, we demonstrate that these phenomena are present in networks trained to encode image data, where the symmetry is latent. Our results illustrate the challenges inherent in comparing nonlinear neural codes, when functionally-equivalent representations are not related by a simple rotation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 输入刺激的对称性会让功能等价的神经表征产生不同的表征相似性矩阵 (RSM)，从而把基于 RSM 的分析带偏：同一函数可对应从解耦 (disentangled) 到完全混合 (maximally-mixed) 的不同表征几何。SGD 或能量正则化还会产生稀疏且漂移的码，进而使 RSM 随训练漂移；在对称性隐含的图像编码网络中同样出现这些现象。
Motivation: RSM 作为摘要统计量被广泛用于比较神经码，但当功能等价的表征之间不是简单旋转关系时，跨模型或跨训练阶段比较 RSM 会得出误导性的几何结论。
Method: 在具有输入对称性的网络中分析 RSM 的等价类：刻画对称性导致的功能等价表征如何映射到不同 RSM，并考察 SGD 与能量正则化 (energetic regularization) 训练出的稀疏漂移码；再在对称性为隐变量的图像编码网络上检验同样现象。
Result: 对称性使功能等价的表征产生定性不同的 RSM，对应从 disentangled 到 maximally-mixed 的表征几何；SGD 或能量正则化生成稀疏、漂移的码并导致 RSM 漂移；这些现象在训练来做图像编码的网络中同样存在。
Conclusion: 比较非线性神经码存在固有挑战：功能等价的表征若非由简单旋转相联系，RSM 差异不能直接解读为表征几何差异。

papers.title: HINT-SD: Targeted Hindsight Self-Distillation for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract_en: Training long-horizon LLM agents with reinforcement learning is challenging because sparse outcome rewards reveal whether a task succeeds, but not which intermediate actions caused the outcome or how they should be corrected. Recent methods alleviate this issue by generating rewards or textual hints from turn-level action-output signals, or by using feedback-conditioned self-distillation. However, generating feedback at every turn is inefficient when many intermediate turns are already successful or neutral, and applying feedback at a fixed or misaligned turn often fails to supervise the actions that contributed to the failure. To bridge this gap, we propose HINT-SD, a targeted self-distillation framework that uses full-trajectory hindsight to select failure-relevant actions and applies feedback-conditioned distillation only to targeted action spans. Experiments on BFCL v3 and AppWorld show that our method outperforms the dense per-turn feedback baseline by up to 13.60 percentage points on average while achieving a 2.26$\times$ reduction in time per training step, suggesting that selecting where to distill is key to effective and efficient long-horizon agent training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HINT-SD 用全轨迹 hindsight 选出与失败相关的动作，只在这些目标动作片段上施加 feedback-conditioned self-distillation，而非每轮生成反馈。在 BFCL v3 与 AppWorld 上，相比 dense per-turn feedback 基线平均最高提升 13.60 个百分点，同时每步训练时间降低 2.26 倍。
Motivation: 长时程 LLM agent 的 RL 训练只有稀疏结果奖励，无法指出哪些中间动作导致失败；而每轮生成反馈在多数轮次已成功或中性时开销大，固定或错位的反馈轮次又监督不到真正致败的动作。
Method: 提出 HINT-SD：用全轨迹 hindsight 选择 failure-relevant 的动作，仅对这些目标动作片段施加 feedback-conditioned self-distillation，避免逐轮生成反馈。
Result: 在 BFCL v3 与 AppWorld 上，相比 dense per-turn feedback 基线平均最高提升 13.60 个百分点，每步训练时间降低 2.26 倍。
Conclusion: 选择在何处做 distillation 是长时程 agent 训练既有效又高效的关键，而非对每轮都施加反馈。

papers.title: Assistant or Actor? Student Trust, Control, and Delegation Regret When Using a General-Purpose AI Agent
papers.abstract_en: When AI agents shift from answering questions to taking actions, users face a new problem: deciding what to delegate, to a system whose action space they cannot fully anticipate. We call the resulting dissatisfaction delegation regret, a pattern in which users regret not that the agent erred, but that it acted beyond what they would have authorized. In a controlled study, 20 university students completed five common daily tasks using OpenClaw, a general-purpose AI agent, across tasks chosen to vary in privacy, stakes, and reversibility. For each task we measured trust, perceived control, transparency, supervision burden, and approval preference on 5-point Likert scales, and collected free-text reflections analyzed through thematic coding. Three findings emerged. First, participants calibrated trust per task rather than per agent: they granted wide autonomy for advisory and low-stakes tasks but demanded confirmation for irreversible, externally visible actions. Second, irreversibility combined with external visibility, rather than stakes alone, appeared to drive trust withdrawal: the moderate-stakes email task triggered the sharpest drop in trust (M = 3.10) and the highest demand for approval (M = 4.65), whereas a high-stakes but verifiable task did not produce the same response. Third, delegation regret appeared consistently when the agent executed actions without preview, even when the output was rated as successful. We discuss implications for agent designs that expose action boundaries, support per-task autonomy policies, and separate advisory output from agentic execution.
papers.comment: Presented at the 2026 IEEE Symposium on Visual Languages and Human-Centric Computing (VL/HCC). 10 pages, 3 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 一项 20 名大学生、5 项日常任务的受控研究显示，用户对通用 AI agent（OpenClaw）的信任是按任务而非按 agent 校准的：低风险咨询任务给高自主权，不可逆且对外可见的动作要求确认。不可逆性叠加外部可见性（而非风险高低本身）驱动信任撤回——中等风险的邮件任务信任均值跌到 3.10、审批要求升到 4.65，而高风险但可验证的任务没有同样反应；agent 无预览直接执行会稳定触发 delegation regret，即使产出被评为成功。
Motivation: AI agent 从答题转向执行动作后，用户面对的是一个动作空间无法预期的系统，需要决定委托边界；现有工作缺少对“委托后悔”（delegation regret）这一新型不满的刻画。
Method: 受控研究：20 名大学生用 OpenClaw 完成 5 项按隐私、风险、可逆性区分的日常任务，用 5 点 Likert 量表测量信任、感知控制、透明度、监督负担与审批偏好，并对自由文本反思做主题编码 (thematic coding)。
Result: 三项发现：信任按任务而非按 agent 校准；不可逆 + 对外可见驱动信任撤回，中风险邮件任务信任 M=3.10、审批要求 M=4.65，而高风险可验证任务无此反应；agent 无预览执行动作时 delegation regret 稳定出现，即便产出被评为成功。
Conclusion: agent 设计应暴露动作边界、支持按任务的自主性策略，并把咨询性输出与实际执行分开，否则用户会在产出成功时仍后悔委托。

papers.title: KGPFN: Unlocking the Potential of Knowledge Graph Foundation Model via In-Context Learning
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge graph (KG) foundation models aim to generalize to graphs with unseen entities and relations by learning transferable relational structure. Most existing methods, however, focus on relation-level universality, leaving in-context learning, the other pillar of foundation models, largely unexplored for KG reasoning. Context in KGs is structured and heterogeneous: accurate prediction requires conditioning both on the local neighborhood of the query entities and on global context that summarizes how the query relation behaves across many instances. We propose KGPFN, a KG foundation model built on a Prior-Data Fitted Network (PFN) that combines transferable relational representations with inference-time in-context learning over structured context. KGPFN learns relation representations by message passing on relation graphs and extracts multi-scale local context from the intermediate head representations of a multi-layer NBFNet. It then builds relation-specific global context from positive and negative examples of the query relation, together with their local structural representations, and aggregates this context with feature-level and sample-level attention. Through multi-graph pretraining, KGPFN learns to combine structural representations with labeled contextual evidence without inference-time parameter updates. On 57 knowledge graphs, KGPFN achieves the best average MRR both without and with fine-tuning, and context sensitivity analyses highlight the value of negative context examples. Our code is available at https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/KGPFN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KGPFN 把 Prior-Data Fitted Network (PFN) 引入知识图谱基础模型，用推理时上下文学习同时利用查询实体的局部邻域与查询关系的全局正负例证据，无需推理期参数更新即可完成链接预测。在 57 个知识图谱上，KGPFN 在不微调与微调两种设定下都取得最佳平均 MRR，上下文敏感性分析显示负例上下文样本有实际价值。
Motivation: 现有 KG 基础模型只追求关系层面的普适性，作为基础模型另一支柱的 in-context learning 在 KG 推理上基本未被探索；而 KG 预测既需要查询实体的局部邻域，也需要查询关系在大量实例上的全局行为。
Method: KGPFN 基于 Prior-Data Fitted Network：在 relation graph 上做消息传递学习关系表示，从多层 NBFNet 的中间 head 表示抽取多尺度局部上下文；再用查询关系的正例与负例及其局部结构表示构建关系级全局上下文，通过 feature-level 与 sample-level attention 聚合，经 multi-graph pretraining 学会结构表示与带标签上下文证据的融合，推理时不更新参数。
Result: 在 57 个知识图谱上，KGPFN 在不微调和微调两种设定下均取得最佳平均 MRR；上下文敏感性分析表明负例上下文样本对预测有价值。
Conclusion: 把 in-context learning 与可迁移关系表示一起放进 KG 基础模型，能在不改参数的情况下用正负例证据提升链接预测，负例上下文是有效信号。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有 KG 基础模型只追求关系层面的普适性，作为基础模型另一支柱的 in-context learning 在 KG 推理上基本未被探索；而 KG 预测既需要查询实体的局部邻域，也需要查询关系在大量实例上的全局行为。

papers.title: Embodied Neurocomputation: A Framework for Interfacing Biological Neural Cultures with Scaled Task-Driven Validation
papers.abstract_en: Biological neural networks (BNNs) have been established as a powerful and adaptive substrate that offer the potential for incredibly energy and data efficient information processing with distinct learning mechanisms. Yet a core challenge to utilizing BNN for neurocomputation is determining the optimal encoding and decoding mechanisms between the traditional silicon computing interface and the living biology. Here, we propose an Embodied Neurocomputation framework as a systems-level approach to this multi-variable optimization encoding/decoding problem. We operationalize this approach through the first large-scale parameter optimization of encoding configurations for a BNN agent performing closed-loop navigation along an odor-style gradient in a simulated grid-world. Despite the relative simplicity of the task, the biological interactions gave rise to a massive multi-combinatorial search space for optimal parameters. By considering how the components of the system are interconnected and parameterized, we evaluated approximately 1,300 parameter combinations, over 4,000 hours of real-time agent-environment interactions, to identify 12 configurations that consistently demonstrated learning across multiple episodes. These configurations achieved significantly higher task performances than optimized silicon-based DQN agents under the same interaction budget. These findings represent an initial step toward robust and scalable goal-oriented learning using BNNs. Our framework establishes a foundation for applying task-driven neurocomputing and supports the development of field-wide benchmarks. In the long term, this work supports the development of hybrid bio-silicon architectures capable of efficient, adaptive and real-time computation, including the potential for robotic control applications.
papers.comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Embodied Neurocomputation 框架，把生物神经网络 (BNN) 与硅计算之间的编码/解码当作系统级多变量优化问题处理，并在模拟 grid-world 中沿气味梯度做闭环导航。约 1,300 组参数、逾 4,000 小时实时交互筛出 12 个跨多个 episode 稳定学习的配置，其任务表现显著优于同等交互预算下优化过的硅基 DQN。
Motivation: 用活体生物神经网络做计算的核心瓶颈是硅—生物接口的编码/解码机制选择：生物交互带来巨大的多组合搜索空间，缺少系统级的优化与验证路径。
Method: 以系统级框架把各组件的互联与参数化纳入统一优化，对 BNN agent 在模拟 grid-world 沿气味式梯度的闭环导航做大规模编码配置搜索；共评估约 1,300 组参数组合、累计逾 4,000 小时实时 agent—环境交互，按跨多个 episode 的一致性筛出配置。
Result: 评估约 1,300 组参数组合、超过 4,000 小时实时交互，得到 12 个在多个 episode 上持续表现学习的配置；这些配置的任务表现显著高于在相同交互预算下优化的硅基 DQN agent。
Conclusion: BNN 可通过系统级编码/解码参数优化实现稳健、可扩展的目标导向学习，该框架可作为任务驱动神经计算与领域基准的起点，并指向混合生物—硅架构（含机器人控制）方向。

papers.title: Gaze Attention: Query-Adaptive Visual Routing for Efficient Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: When humans describe a visual scene, they do not process the entire image uniformly; instead, they selectively fixate on regions relevant to their intended description. In contrast, current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) attend to all visual tokens, leading to diluted focus and unnecessary computational overhead. Existing efficiency methods often compress or discard visual information before generation, potentially losing details needed for later predictions. In this work, we introduce Gaze Attention, a mechanism that enables MLLMs to select visual regions according to the needs of each generation step. By grouping visual tokens into spatial regions and selecting those relevant to the current prediction, Gaze Attention reduces attention computation while focusing on relevant visual content. We further introduce learnable context tokens that summarize images or video frames, preserving global context under selective attention. Experiments on 13 image and 6 video understanding benchmarks demonstrate that Gaze Attention matches or surpasses dense-attention baselines while using up to 90% fewer visual KV entries. It also achieves higher average performance than KV-cache eviction baselines under matched visual KV budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Gaze Attention 让多模态大模型按每个生成步的需要选择视觉区域：把视觉 token 分组为空间区域并只选与当前预测相关的那些，同时用可学习的 context token 摘要整图或视频帧以保住全局上下文。在 13 个图像与 6 个视频理解基准上，它在最多减少 90% 视觉 KV 条目的情况下匹配或超过 dense-attention 基线，并在相同视觉 KV 预算下平均性能高于 KV-cache eviction 基线。
Motivation: MLLM 对全部视觉 token 均匀注意力导致焦点稀释与计算浪费，而现有压缩方法在生成前丢弃视觉信息，可能损失后续预测需要的细节。
Method: 按生成步自适应选择视觉区域：将视觉 token 分组为空间区域，只保留与当前预测相关的区域以削减注意力计算；另加可学习的 context token 汇总图像或视频帧，在选择性注意力下维持全局上下文。
Result: 在 13 个图像理解与 6 个视频理解基准上，Gaze Attention 匹配或超越 dense-attention 基线，视觉 KV 条目最多减少 90%；在匹配的视觉 KV 预算下，平均性能高于 KV-cache eviction 基线。
Conclusion: 按生成步选择视觉区域而非预先压缩，可以在大幅削减视觉 KV 的同时保持甚至提升 MLLM 的图像与视频理解表现。
