papers.title: NARA: Anchor-Conditioned Representation Learning for Heterogeneous Vector Geoentities
papers.abstract_en: Vector geospatial data represent the world as discrete geoentities, such as roads, buildings, and points of interest, each with semantic attributes, geometry, and spatial relations to other geoentities, including metric proximity and topology. Existing methods for learning geoentity representations typically support a single geometry type or model only a subset of these relations, limiting their ability to capture spatial context across heterogeneous geoentities and support diverse downstream tasks. We propose NARA (Neural Anchor-conditioned Relation-Aware representation learning), a novel self-supervised representation framework for heterogeneous vector geoentities. NARA contextualizes geoentities through spatial-context-aware attention that models spatial autocorrelation using geometry distance modulated by topological relations across surrounding points, polylines, and polygons. NARA introduces masked geoentity semantic modeling and geometry-aware spatial relation modeling, as well as relation-conditioned regularization that encourages similar representations for geoentities sharing the same spatial relation to a common reference entity, while accounting for spatial autocorrelation. NARA's frozen, task-agnostic encoder outperforms state-of-the-art methods, each with an architecture tailored to its respective task, across traffic-speed prediction for polylines, building-function classification for polygons, and next point-of-interest prediction for points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NARA 用空间上下文感知注意力把点、线、面异构矢量地理实体统一编码，几何距离经拓扑关系调制来建模空间自相关，再配合掩码语义建模与关系条件正则。冻结的通用编码器在折线交通速度预测、面状建筑功能分类、点状下一 POI 预测三个任务上均超过各自为单一任务定制的 SOTA 方法。
Motivation: 现有地理实体表示学习方法通常只支持单一几何类型，或只建模度量邻近、拓扑等关系中的一部分，无法跨异构实体捕捉空间上下文，也难以支撑多样化下游任务。
Method: 自监督框架 NARA (Neural Anchor-conditioned Relation-Aware representation learning)：空间上下文感知注意力用几何距离经拓扑关系调制来建模空间自相关，覆盖周边 points、polylines、polygons；组件包括掩码地理实体语义建模 (masked geoentity semantic modeling)、几何感知空间关系建模，以及关系条件正则 (relation-conditioned regularization)，鼓励共享同一空间关系（相对共同参考实体）的实体表示相近。编码器冻结、与任务无关。
Result: 在三个下游任务上，冻结的 NARA 编码器均超过各为该任务定制架构的 SOTA 方法：折线 (polyline) 的交通速度预测、多边形 (polygon) 的建筑功能分类、点 (point) 的下一兴趣点 (next point-of-interest) 预测。
Conclusion: 一个任务无关、可冻结的异构矢量地理实体编码器，配合关系条件正则，可以在几何类型各异的多个下游任务上胜过逐任务定制的模型。

papers.title: EchoDistill: Robust Large Audio Language Models via Noisy-to-Clean Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) remain vulnerable to acoustic noise, which can obscure task-relevant evidence and produce unreliable responses. We propose EchoDistill, a noisy-to-clean self-distillation framework that uses clean audio as privileged information during post-training. A noisy-input student samples candidate responses reflecting its inference-time behavior, while a frozen copy of the same backbone processes the corresponding clean audio. EchoDistill combines masked response-token distillation, task-gated consistency shaping, and teacher-referenced group-relative optimization to align noisy-input generation with clean-conditioned semantics. Only the student is retained at inference time, introducing no additional inference cost. Across three LALM backbones and three audio domains at -10dB, EchoDistill improves average noisy-input accuracy by 1.63 percentage points over the strongest baseline. On Qwen2.5-Omni, it raises noisy-input accuracy from 59.33% to 62.94%, while clean-audio accuracy increases from 76.56% to 77.56%. Replacing matched audio with random, shuffled, or silent inputs reduces accuracy by 3.08-6.42 points, confirming that matched acoustic evidence contributes to its predictions. Additional evaluations show improvements on held-out additive noises and external benchmarks, while revealing that these gains do not reliably extend to non-additive distortions. These results demonstrate robust post-training improvements under severe additive noise without sacrificing clean-audio capability across diverse tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EchoDistill 用干净音频作特权信息做嘈杂到干净的自蒸馏后训练，让 LALM 在 -10dB 噪声下对齐干净条件语义：三个 LALM 骨干、三个音频域上平均嘈杂输入准确率比最强基线高 1.63 个百分点，Qwen2.5-Omni 从 59.33% 升到 62.94%，且干净音频准确率不降反升（76.56%→77.56%）。增益可迁移到留出加性噪声与外部基准，但不外推到非加性失真。
Motivation: 声学噪声会掩盖任务相关证据，使 Large Audio Language Models (LALM) 给出不可靠回答；需要在不增加推理成本、不牺牲干净音频能力的前提下提升抗噪性。
Method: 嘈杂输入的学生采样反映其推理期行为的候选回答，冻结的同骨干副本处理对应干净音频；三部分结合：masked response-token distillation、task-gated consistency shaping、teacher-referenced group-relative optimization。推理期只保留学生，无额外开销。
Result: 在三个 LALM 骨干、三个音频域、-10dB 条件下，平均嘈杂输入准确率比最强基线高 1.63 个百分点；Qwen2.5-Omni 嘈杂输入准确率 59.33%→62.94%，干净音频 76.56%→77.56%。把匹配音频换成随机、打乱或静音输入使准确率下降 3.08–6.42 点。留出加性噪声与外部基准也有提升，但增益不外推到非加性失真。
Conclusion: 严重加性噪声下的鲁棒后训练可以在不牺牲干净音频能力、不增加推理成本的前提下取得稳定增益，但该收益依赖匹配的声学证据，且不覆盖非加性失真。

papers.title: How Far Does a Shared Linear Map Go? Probing Feature-Space Manipulability for Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: Understanding how image-space transformations manifest in a model's internal representations is a longstanding goal in representation analysis. Prior work has shown that geometric transformations can often be captured by learned linear operators between feature maps, but it remains unclear whether this extends to photometric, local, and semantically defined edits. We train probes of increasing capacity from a spatially shared linear map to nonlinear per-vector, receptive-field, and global transformer models to predict feature-space changes induced by geometric transforms, photometric edits, occlusions, and diffusion-generated semantic edits. Across ConvNeXt, SwinV2, and DINOv3, a single shared linear map often predicts held-out manipulation outcomes nearly as well as substantially more expressive probes for the supervised backbones, with sufficiency generally increasing with depth; this pattern is less consistent for DINOv3. These results suggest that a simple spatially shared linear operator is often sufficient to represent diverse image manipulations, while its leading singular components capture semantic content and higher-rank components primarily refine image details. We frame these findings as predictive representational sufficiency rather than evidence of intrinsic linear feature-space geometry.
papers.comment: 46 pages, 40 figures, 3 tables, Code is available at https://github.com/AI4HealthUOL/FeatMap
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 ConvNeXt、SwinV2、DINOv3 上训练容量递增的探针（空间共享线性映射 → 非线性逐向量、感受野、全局 transformer）预测几何变换、光度编辑、遮挡与扩散生成语义编辑引起的特征空间变化，发现单个共享线性映射在有监督骨干上对留出操纵结果的预测几乎与更强探针相当，且充分性随深度增加，DINOv3 上该规律较不一致。
Motivation: 已有工作表明几何变换常可由特征图之间的学习线性算子捕获，但尚不清楚这是否能推广到光度、局部与语义定义的编辑。
Method: 训练容量递增的探针，从空间共享线性映射到非线性逐向量、感受野与全局 transformer 模型，用于预测几何变换、光度编辑、遮挡与扩散生成语义编辑诱导的特征空间变化；在 ConvNeXt、SwinV2、DINOv3 三类骨干上比较，并分析奇异分量（主分量捕获语义内容、高秩分量主要细化图像细节）。
Result: 在 ConvNeXt、SwinV2 与 DINOv3 上，单个共享线性映射对留出操纵结果的预测通常与表达力强得多的探针几乎一样好（有监督骨干上），充分性一般随深度增加，而 DINOv3 上该模式较不一致；主奇异分量捕获语义内容，高秩分量主要细化图像细节。

papers.title: Teaching LLMs to See Graphs: Unifying Text and Structural Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Applying Large Language Models (LLMs) to graph-structured data usually involves multi-step pipelines in which textual node attributes are compressed into single tokens and further processed by GNNs, discarding most of their semantic content. We introduce the Graph Transformer Language Model (GTLM), which enables a pretrained LLM to process graph topology natively and removes this bottleneck entirely. GTLM injects graph-aware attention biases directly into the LLM's attention modules, adding only 0.015\% structure-related parameters relative to the base model. Training updates only the structural parameters together with a LoRA adapter on the base model. We prove that our bidirectional attention prefix is permutation-equivariant over nodes and that GTLM reduces exactly to the pretrained model when no graph is present. Having no global node ordering, GTLM shows no positional degradation and does not \textit{get lost in the middle}: needle-in-a-graph accuracy stays flat from 1k to 64k tokens and 4x past the training length, while an identically trained flat-text baseline collapses. Comprehensive evaluations show that a GTLM matches or exceeds domain-specific state-of-the-art models on text-attributed graph benchmarks, GraphRAG on WebQSP, and molecular benchmarks, while meaningfully improving over strong baselines on GraphQA. We further show that GTLM's attention heads implicitly learn to simulate message passing, explaining its strength on algorithmic tasks. Together, these results suggest that a minimally adapted pretrained LLM can serve as a general backbone for graph learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GTLM 把图结构以注意力偏置形式直接注入预训练 LLM，只训练 0.015% 的结构参数加 LoRA，使模型原生处理图拓扑而不把节点文本压成单 token。needle-in-a-graph 精度从 1k 到 64k token 保持平坦（达训练长度 4 倍），而同法训练的平文本基线崩溃；在文本属性图、WebQSP GraphRAG、分子与 GraphQA 基准上匹配或超过领域专用 SOTA。
Motivation: 把 LLM 用于图结构数据通常要走多步流水线：节点文本被压成单 token 再交给 GNN，语义信息大量丢失，且长上下文下模型会 get lost in the middle。
Method: GTLM 在 LLM 各注意力模块中注入 graph-aware attention bias，仅新增 0.015% 结构相关参数；训练只更新这些结构参数与基座上的 LoRA adapter。证明双向注意力前缀对节点置换等变，且无图时严格退化为原预训练模型。
Result: needle-in-a-graph 精度在 1k 到 64k token（训练长度 4 倍）保持平坦，同法训练的平文本基线崩溃；在文本属性图基准、WebQSP 上的 GraphRAG、分子基准上匹配或超过领域专用 SOTA，并在 GraphQA 上明显优于强基线；注意力头隐式学到模拟 message passing。
Conclusion: 经过最小改造的预训练 LLM 可以作为图学习的通用骨干，前提是结构信息通过注意力偏置而非 token 压缩进入模型。

papers.title: System-Prompt Anchoring with Cross-Attention Layers
papers.abstract_en: Cross-attention provides a dedicated route from a selected information source into a model's computation, but the effect of where that route is inserted remains underexplored. We study this question when the source is a privileged system-prompt span. We insert Cross-Attention Layer (CAL) blocks between the system prompt and text while keeping the causal-decoder backbone frozen. A ten-configuration sweep on a 1.5B backbone shows that performance is task-dependent and strongly affected by placement: later placements are generally more effective and parameter-efficient. In an 8B scaling study, we train only the overall best configuration and compare it with parameter-matched adaptation baselines. Across the evaluated benchmarks, the effects remain task-dependent: cross-attention changes instruction-following and security behavior while largely preserving general-task performance. Together, these experiments characterize placement as an important design variable when injecting system-prompt information through cross-attention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在冻结的 causal decoder 上，把 Cross-Attention Layer (CAL) 插在 system prompt 与文本之间注入特权信息，位置是关键设计变量：十组配置的 1.5B 扫描显示越靠后的插入位置通常更有效且参数效率更高。8B 上只训练最优配置并与参数量匹配的适配基线比较，效果随任务而变——指令遵循与安全行为被改变，通用任务性能基本保持。
Motivation: cross-attention 提供了从选定信息源进入模型计算的专用通道，但这条通道插在什么位置的影响研究不足；本文在 system-prompt 这一特权信息源的场景下追问该问题。
Method: 在 system prompt 与文本之间插入 CAL block，主干 causal decoder 保持冻结；先在 1.5B backbone 上做十种配置的位置扫描，再在 8B 上只训练整体最优配置，与参数量匹配的适配 (parameter-matched adaptation) 基线对比。
Result: 1.5B 十配置扫描：表现依赖任务且强烈受插入位置影响，较晚的位置通常更有效、参数效率更高。8B 缩放实验：跨所评测的 benchmark，效果仍随任务而变，cross-attention 改变指令遵循与安全行为，同时基本保持通用任务性能。
Conclusion: 通过 cross-attention 注入 system-prompt 信息时，插入位置本身就是一个重要的设计变量，且其收益是任务相关的而非全面增益。

papers.title: Offline Policy Optimization with Posterior Sampling
papers.abstract_en: A fundamental challenge in model-based offline reinforcement learning (RL) lies in the trade-off between generalization and robustness against exploitation errors in out-of-distribution (OOD) regions. The key to resolving this trade-off lies in enabling the model to explore OOD regions that remain consistent with underlying physical dynamics. However, achieving this is challenging because limited data cannot uniquely identify the dynamics model, and unconstrained exploration is risky. Existing methods often overlook this nuance, addressing the risk through excessive pessimistic regularization, which ensures robustness but sacrifices generalization. To address this, we propose PSPO, which treats the dynamics model as a random variable rather than a point estimate. This formulation inherently allows for controlled exploration of OOD regions. By alternately updating the posterior distribution and the policy, we design a regularized optimization algorithm with convergence guarantees. Experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that PSPO achieves superior performance compared to state-of-the-art baselines. Further analysis confirms that our method attains the desired pessimism-free property while maintaining robustness, and ablation studies verify the effectiveness of each proposed module.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PSPO 把离线强化学习的动力学模型当作随机变量而非点估计，交替更新后验分布与策略，在受控探索 OOD 区域的同时避免过度悲观正则。标准基准上性能优于 SOTA 基线，并保持无悲观 (pessimism-free) 性质与鲁棒性。
Motivation: 离线 RL 中泛化与对抗 OOD 利用错误的鲁棒性存在权衡：有限数据无法唯一辨识动力学模型，无约束探索有风险，而现有方法用过强的悲观正则换鲁棒性却牺牲泛化。
Method: PSPO 将动力学模型建模为随机变量（后验分布）而非点估计，交替更新后验分布与策略，设计带收敛保证的正则化优化算法。
Result: 在标准基准上性能优于 SOTA 基线；进一步分析确认方法达到期望的无悲观性质并保持鲁棒性；消融研究验证各提出模块的有效性（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把动力学模型当作后验分布而非点估计，可以在不依赖过度悲观正则的前提下同时获得 OOD 探索的受控性、泛化与鲁棒性。

papers.title: Recursive Agent Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Recursive Agent Optimization (RAO), a reinforcement learning approach for training recursive agents: agents that can spawn and delegate sub-tasks to new instantiations of themselves recursively. Recursive agents implement an inference-time scaling algorithm that naturally allows agents to scale to longer contexts and generalize to more difficult problems via divide-and-conquer. RAO provides a method to train models to best take advantage of such recursive inference, teaching agents when and how to delegate and communicate. We find that recursive agents trained in this way enjoy better training efficiency, can scale to tasks that go beyond the model's context window, generalize to tasks much harder than the ones the agent was trained on, and can enjoy reduced wall-clock time compared to single-agent systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RAO 用强化学习训练能递归生成自身实例并下放子任务的 agent，教它何时、如何委派与通信，使分治式推理时扩展真正可用。训练后的递归 agent 训练效率更高、能处理超出自身上下文窗口的任务、泛化到远难于训练分布的问题，并可比单 agent 系统缩短墙钟时间。
Motivation: 单 agent 受上下文窗口与任务难度上限约束，递归分治虽能在推理时扩展，但缺少训练方法让 agent 学会何时委派、如何通信，导致递归推理的潜力用不上。
Method: 提出 Recursive Agent Optimization (RAO)：一种针对递归 agent 的强化学习训练方法，agent 可递归 spawn 自身新实例并下放子任务；训练目标是让模型学会委派时机、委派方式与实例间通信，从而配合推理时的分治扩展算法。
Result: 训练后的递归 agent 在训练效率上更优，可扩展到超出模型上下文窗口的任务，能泛化到远难于训练任务的问题，并相对单 agent 系统获得更短的 wall-clock time；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把递归委派与通信本身作为 RL 的学习对象，可以让推理时的分治扩展转化为训练效率、上下文长度与泛化难度上的实际收益。

papers.title: Trade-off Functions for DP-SGD with Subsampling based on Random Allocation: Tight Upper and Lower Bounds
papers.abstract_en: Within the $f$-DP framework, we derive a tight analysis of the trade-off function for Differentially Private Stochastic Gradient Descent (DP-SGD) with subsampling based on random allocation in which each sample is independently assigned to exactly one of $M$ minibatches per epoch, each minibatch corresponding to one of the $M$ SGD rounds within a single epoch. Our analysis holds under an explicit validity condition, whose hypotheses together force $σ\geq \sqrt{3/\ln M}$, where $σ$ is the DP noise multiplier. Unlike $f$-DP analyses for Poisson subsampling, which yield non-closed implicit formulas that can be machine computed but are non-transparent, random allocation admits a tight analysis yielding transparent and interpretable closed-form bounds. For a single epoch, our concrete bounds, derived via the Berry-Esseen theorem, are tight up to constant factors. We demonstrate worked parameter settings for a single epoch ($E=1$) with a corresponding trade-off function $\geq 1-a-δ$, that is, only $δ$ below the ideal random guessing diagonal $1-a$. For $δ= 1/100$ and $σ= 1$, roughly $M \approx 1.14\times 10^6$ rounds and $N \approx 1.14\times 10^7$ training samples suffice to achieve meaningful differential privacy. This is in contrast to recent negative results for the regime $σ\leq 1/\sqrt{2 \ln M}$ for which no significant DP guarantee can exist.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 f-DP 框架下给出基于随机分配 (random allocation) 子采样的 DP-SGD trade-off 函数的紧致闭式上下界：每个样本每 epoch 独立分到 M 个 minibatch 之一，经 Berry-Esseen 定理得到单 epoch 下差常数因子的紧界。有效性条件强制 σ ≥ √(3/ln M)；当 δ=1/100、σ=1 时约需 M≈1.14×10^6 轮与 N≈1.14×10^7 训练样本即可达到有意义的差分隐私，trade-off 函数 ≥ 1−a−δ，仅比理想随机猜测对角线 1−a 低 δ。
Motivation: Poisson 子采样的 f-DP 分析只给出非封闭的隐式公式，可机器计算但不透明；而 σ ≤ 1/√(2 ln M) 的近期负面结果表明该区间不存在显著 DP 保证，需要一个可解释且紧的刻画。
Method: 对随机分配子采样（每个样本独立指派到一个 epoch 内 M 个 minibatch 之一，对应 M 个 SGD 轮次）推导 f-DP trade-off 函数的显式上下界；单 epoch 界用 Berry-Esseen 定理导出，并给出有效性条件（假设强制噪声乘子 σ ≥ √(3/ln M)），并展示 E=1 的具体参数设置。
Result: 单 epoch 界差常数因子即紧；trade-off 函数 ≥ 1−a−δ，仅比理想对角线 1−a 低 δ。取 δ=1/100、σ=1，约 M≈1.14×10^6 轮、N≈1.14×10^7 训练样本即可达到有意义的差分隐私；对照 σ ≤ 1/√(2 ln M) 区间不存在显著 DP 保证的负面结果。
Conclusion: 随机分配子采样让 DP-SGD 的 f-DP trade-off 拥有透明可解释的闭式紧界，且在 σ=1、δ=1/100 下以百万级轮次与千万级样本达到有意义的隐私保证，而更低噪声区间则不可能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CoMemNet: A Continual Memory Network with Drift-Aware Sampling for Traffic Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Traffic sensor networks evolve as sensors are added and traffic distributions change, whereas most forecasting models assume a fixed node set and repeatedly retrain on all available data. We propose CoMemNet, a Continual Memory Network for efficient prediction over evolving traffic sensor networks. CoMemNet uses an Online branch to adapt to the current period and an exponential-moving-average Target branch as a stable feature reference. A Wasserstein-based Drift Sampler compares node-wise Online-Target feature distributions and selects a limited set of drift-sensitive nodes for updating. A lightweight Node-Adaptive Temporal Memory Replay Buffer (TMRB-N) retains compact temporal states without repeatedly traversing all historical training data. The prediction backbone does not consume an adjacency matrix; sensor adjacency is used only to construct data and optionally expand the selected update set to a limited neighborhood. Experiments on three multi-period PeMS datasets include three-seed evaluation, strong static retraining and continual baselines, controlled sampling strategies, continual-learning metrics, robustness tests, and resource accounting. The results show that CoMemNet maintains stable prediction accuracy and efficient adaptation under bounded shared-node selection, achieving a better balance between historical knowledge preservation and current-period prediction performance. Meanwhile, as the evolving network expands, CoMemNet shows clearer accuracy and cumulative training-time advantages over current-period retraining baselines. The code is available at:https://meiwu5.github.io/CoMemNet.
papers.comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Computational Social Systems (TCSS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoMemNet 面向节点集不断扩张、分布漂移的交通传感器网络做持续预测：在线分支适应当前时段，EMA Target 分支作稳定参考，用 Wasserstein 漂移采样只挑少量漂移敏感节点更新，配 TMRB-N 轻量回放缓存历史时序状态。在三个多时段 PeMS 数据集上，它在有界共享节点选择下保持稳定精度与高效适应，且网络扩张时相对当期重训练基线呈现更清晰的精度与累计训练时间优势。
Motivation: 交通传感器网络会新增传感器且分布漂移，而多数预测模型假定固定节点集并反复在全部历史数据上重训练，导致更新代价随数据累积增长。
Method: Online 分支适应当前时段，exponential-moving-average Target 分支提供稳定特征参考；Wasserstein-based Drift Sampler 比较节点级 Online-Target 特征分布，选出有限的漂移敏感节点更新，可选地用传感器邻接把更新集扩到有限邻域；Node-Adaptive Temporal Memory Replay Buffer (TMRB-N) 保存紧凑时序状态而不遍历全部历史数据，预测骨干不消费邻接矩阵。
Result: 在三个多时段 PeMS 数据集上做三 seed 评测，对比强静态重训练与持续学习基线、受控采样策略、持续学习指标、鲁棒性测试与资源核算：CoMemNet 在有界共享节点选择下保持稳定预测精度与高效适应，在历史知识保持与当期预测性能之间取得更好平衡；随演化网络扩张，相对当期重训练基线的精度与累计训练时间优势更清晰。
Conclusion: 只对漂移敏感节点做有界更新并用紧凑记忆回放，可以在不重训全部历史数据的前提下同时守住历史知识与当期精度，且网络越大训练时间收益越明显。

papers.title: Dual Certified White-Box Inference for Input Convex Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Input convex neural networks (ICNNs) are used to learn convex objectives whose minimizers define decisions, making efficient and reliable optimization central to inference. At nonsmooth inputs, automatic differentiation returns a single derivative rather than the full subdifferential governing optimality and descent. Second-order cone ICNNs (SOC-ICNNs) admit an exact representation as value functions of parametric second-order cone programs, providing a white-box approach to recovering their full subdifferentials from optimal dual multipliers and deriving explicit Hessians on smooth regions. Building on this representation, we develop dual-certified inference (DCI), which combines the network and feasible set geometries to obtain exact stationarity certificates and tangent common descent directions. DCI uses local curvature for Newton acceleration and an exact proximal safeguard. We establish global convergence and, under standard regularity conditions, local quadratic convergence near structurally nondegenerate interior minimizers. Numerical experiments validate the recovered geometry and demonstrate the reliability and efficiency of DCI. Code is avaliable at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DCI-ICNN-507D/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 ICNN 用凸目标的极小点做推理时，非光滑点上自动微分只返回单个导数而非完整次微分的问题，提出 dual-certified inference (DCI)：把 SOC-ICNN 精确表示为参数化二阶锥规划 (SOCP) 的值函数，从最优对偶乘子恢复完整次微分与光滑区 Hessian，再结合网络与可行集几何给出精确驻点证书和公共下降方向。方法带全局收敛性与非退化内点极小点附近的局部二次收敛保证，数值实验验证了恢复的几何与 DCI 的可靠性和效率。
Motivation: ICNN 把凸目标的极小点当作决策输出，推理本质是优化；但非光滑输入处自动微分只给单个导数，无法给出决定最优性与下降的完整次微分，证书与下降方向都不可靠。
Method: 将 SOC-ICNN 精确表示为参数化 SOCP 的值函数（white-box 表示），从最优对偶乘子恢复完整次微分、在光滑区域导出显式 Hessian；DCI 融合网络几何与可行集几何得到精确驻点证书与 tangent common descent direction，用局部曲率做 Newton 加速并配 exact proximal safeguard。
Result: 建立全局收敛性，以及在标准正则条件下结构非退化内点极小点附近的局部二次收敛；数值实验验证恢复的几何并展示 DCI 的可靠性与效率。
Conclusion: 把 SOC-ICNN 视作 SOCP 值函数、用对偶乘子做证书，可以让 ICNN 推理在非光滑点也拿到精确次微分与下降方向，并在正则条件下二次收敛。

papers.title: Useful Features, Backward Scores: OOD in Language-Model Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detectors prioritize inputs for closer inspection. Yet features that distinguish input groups need not yield a useful anomaly ranking. We analyze this gap in language-model trajectories under text-length control and fixed score directions. On Spam development data, an input adaptation of D^2HScore falls from raw AUROC 0.919 to 0.530 after length matching. On length-matched, held-out HateSpeech inputs, the same features yield AUROC 0.644 for a labeled linear classifier but 0.444 for an ID-fitted distance score. ToxicChat shows the same contrast. Feature-selection and backbone controls retain the main reversal pattern. Frozen Civil Comments and TweetEval irony tests also reverse (0.467 and 0.435), extending the finding beyond toxicity. In these contrasts, anomalous groups have farther centers but tighter spread. A labeled, fixed-center feature-space intervention changes rankings: equalizing spread helps some tasks and harms others. OOD evaluation must check the chosen score's ranking even when its features distinguish the classes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在语言模型轨迹的 OOD 检测中，能区分输入类别的特征并不保证给出有用的异常排序：Spam 上 D^2HScore 的原始 AUROC 0.919 在长度匹配后跌到 0.530，长度匹配的 HateSpeech 上有标签线性分类器 0.644 而 ID 拟合的距离分数只有 0.444。作者据此主张 OOD 评估必须单独检验所选分数的排序能力，即使其特征确实区分类别。
Motivation: OOD 检测器用打分给输入排序以供复查，但区分输入组的特征未必产生可用的异常排序；文本长度这一混杂因素即可让排序失效。
Method: 在文本长度受控与分数方向固定的条件下分析语言模型轨迹上的 OOD 打分：对 D^2HScore 做输入侧适配并做长度匹配，对照有标签线性分类器与 ID 拟合的距离分数，另加特征选择与 backbone 控制实验，以及一个有标签、固定中心的特征空间干预（均衡 spread）。
Result: Spam 开发集上 D^2HScore 原始 AUROC 0.919，长度匹配后降至 0.530；长度匹配的留出 HateSpeech 上同一组特征给有标签线性分类器 AUROC 0.644，而 ID 拟合距离分数仅 0.444，ToxicChat 呈现相同反差；冻结的 Civil Comments 与 TweetEval irony 测试同样反转（0.467 与 0.435）。这些对比中异常组中心更远但 spread 更紧；固定中心干预改变排序，均衡 spread 对部分任务有益、对另一些有害。
Conclusion: 特征能区分类别不等于分数能排好异常序，OOD 评估必须独立检查所选分数的排序；均衡 spread 这类干预的效果随任务而异。

papers.title: Who Guards the Benchmarks? Automated Auditing of LLM Agent Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: As benchmarks grow in complexity, many apparent agent failures are not failures of the agent at all---they are failures of the benchmark itself: broken specifications, implicit assumptions, and rigid evaluation scripts that penalize valid alternative approaches. We propose employing frontier LLMs as systematic auditors of evaluation infrastructure, and realize this vision through BenchGuard, the first framework explicitly designed for joint cross-artifact auditing of execution-based agent benchmarks. BenchGuard cross-verifies all benchmark artifacts via structured LLM protocols, optionally incorporating agent solutions or execution traces as additional diagnostic evidence. Deployed on two prominent scientific benchmarks, BenchGuard identified 12 author-confirmed issues in ScienceAgentBench---including fatal errors rendering tasks unsolvable---and exactly matched 83.3% of expert-identified issues on the BIXBench Verified-50 subset, catching defects that prior human review missed entirely. A full audit of 50 complex bioinformatics tasks costs under USD 15, making automated benchmark auditing a practical and valuable complement to human review. A preliminary native-format audit of ProgramBench further demonstrates cross-format applicability. These findings point toward AI-assisted benchmark development, where frontier models serve not only as subjects of evaluation but as active participants in validating the evaluation infrastructure itself.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 BenchGuard，用前沿 LLM 按结构化协议交叉核验执行类 agent benchmark 的全部工件（规格、隐式假设、评测脚本），可选接入 agent 解答或执行轨迹作诊断证据。在 ScienceAgentBench 上发现 12 个作者确认的问题（含使任务不可解的致命错误），在 BIXBench Verified-50 子集上与专家问题完全匹配 83.3%，抓到此前人工审查漏掉的缺陷。
Motivation: agent benchmark 日益复杂，许多表面失败其实来自破损规格、隐式假设和僵化评测脚本，人工审查既慢又会漏检，导致有效解法被误判为失败。
Method: BenchGuard 以结构化 LLM 协议对 benchmark 的各工件做联合交叉核验 (cross-artifact auditing)，可选把 agent 解答或执行轨迹作为额外诊断证据；先在两个科学 benchmark 上部署，并对 ProgramBench 做原生格式的初步审计。
Result: ScienceAgentBench 上识别出 12 个作者确认的问题，包括令任务不可解的致命错误；BIXBench Verified-50 子集上与专家识别问题完全匹配 83.3%，并抓到此前人工审查完全遗漏的缺陷；50 个复杂生物信息学任务的完整审计成本低于 15 美元。
Conclusion: 前沿模型可以作为评测基础设施的主动验证者，自动化 benchmark 审计是人工审查的实用且有价值的补充，指向 AI 辅助的 benchmark 开发流程。

papers.title: How Do AI Agents Spend Your Money? Analyzing and Predicting Token Consumption in Agentic Coding Tasks
papers.abstract_en: The wide adoption of AI agents in complex human workflows is driving rapid growth in LLM token consumption. When agents are deployed on tasks that require a significant amount of tokens, three questions naturally arise: (1) Where do AI agents spend the tokens? (2) Which models are more token-efficient? and (3) Can agents predict their token usage before task execution? In this paper, we present the first systematic study of token consumption patterns in agentic coding tasks. We analyze trajectories from eight frontier LLMs on SWE-bench Verified and evaluate models' ability to predict their own token costs before task execution. We find that: (1) agentic tasks are uniquely expensive, consuming 1000x more tokens than code reasoning and code chat, with input tokens rather than output tokens driving the overall cost; (2) token usage is highly variable and inherently stochastic: runs on the same task can differ by up to 30x in total tokens, and higher token usage does not translate into higher accuracy; instead, accuracy often peaks at intermediate cost and saturates at higher costs; (3) models vary substantially in token efficiency: on the same tasks, Kimi-K2 and Claude-Sonnet-4.5, on average, consume over 1.5 million more tokens than GPT-5; (4) task difficulty rated by human experts only weakly aligns with actual token costs, revealing a fundamental gap between human-perceived complexity and the computational effort agents actually expend; and (5) frontier models fail to accurately predict their own token usage (with weak-to-moderate correlations, up to 0.39) and systematically underestimate real token costs. Our study offers new insights into the economics of AI agents and can inspire future research in this direction.

papers.title: Timescale Separation Enables Deep Reinforcement Learning Control of Rotating Detonation Engine Mode Transitions
papers.abstract_en: Rotating detonation engines (RDEs) are a promising propulsion concept that may offer higher thermodynamic efficiency and specific impulse than conventional systems, but nonlinear phenomena, including transitions to oscillatory or chaotic propagation modes, can hinder practical operation. Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) has emerged as a promising method for controlling complex nonlinear dynamics such as those observed in RDEs. However, the multi-timescale nature of the RDE system makes direct application of DRL challenging. We address this challenge by reformulating the DRL problem in a moving reference frame that follows the detonation-wave pattern, making the wave structure appear quasi-steady to the agent. This reformulation enables scale separation between fast detonation propagation and slower operating-mode dynamics. We train DRL controllers to modulate spatially segmented injection pressure in a one-dimensional reduced-order RDE model and induce rapid transitions between different mode-locked states. Across a range of actuation periods, initial states, and target modes, controllers trained in the moving frame learn more reliably than those trained in a stationary frame and remain effective over a broader range of actuation periods. These results suggest that symmetry-aware moving reference frame formulations may be useful for related multiscale flow-control problems and that scale separation should be exploited whenever possible to enable DRL control of multi-timescale systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把旋转爆震发动机 (RDE) 的 DRL 控制问题改写到随爆震波移动的参考系中，使波结构对智能体准定常，从而把快的爆震传播与慢的运行模式动力学分离开。在一维降阶 RDE 模型上训练 DRL 控制器调制分段注入压力以触发模式锁定态之间的快速切换，移动参考系下训练比静止参考系更可靠，且在更宽的执行周期范围内保持有效。
Motivation: RDE 存在向振荡或混沌传播模式的非线性转变，且系统跨多个时间尺度，直接套用 DRL 难以训练出能诱导模式切换的控制器。
Method: 将 DRL 问题重构到跟随爆震波图案的移动参考系，实现快慢尺度分离；在一维降阶 RDE 模型上训练 DRL 控制器，通过空间分段的注入压力调制，在一系列执行周期、初始状态与目标模式下诱导不同 mode-locked 态之间的快速转变，并与静止参考系训练的控制器对比。
Result: 在所考察的执行周期、初始状态与目标模式范围内，移动参考系训练的控制器学习更可靠，并在比静止参考系更宽的执行周期区间内保持有效。
Conclusion: 对称性感知的移动参考系重构可用于相关的多尺度流动控制问题；只要可能就应利用尺度分离来实现 DRL 对多时间尺度系统的控制。

papers.title: Rhetorical Questions in LLM Representations: A Linear Probing Study
papers.abstract_en: Rhetorical questions are asked not to seek information but to persuade or signal stance. How large language models internally represent them remains unclear. We analyze rhetorical questions in LLM representations using linear probes on two social-media datasets with different discourse contexts, and find that rhetorical signals emerge early and are most stably captured by last-token representations. Rhetorical questions are linearly separable from information-seeking questions within datasets, and remain detectable under cross-dataset transfer, reaching AUROC around 0.7-0.8. However, we demonstrate that transferability does not simply imply a shared representation. Probes trained on different datasets produce different rankings when applied to the same target corpus, with overlap among the top-ranked instances often below 0.2. Qualitative analysis shows that these divergences correspond to distinct rhetorical phenomena: some probes capture discourse-level rhetorical stance embedded in extended argumentation, while others emphasize localized, syntax-driven interrogative acts. Together, these findings suggest that rhetorical questions in LLM representations are encoded by multiple linear directions emphasizing different cues, rather than a single shared direction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用线性探针 (linear probing) 检验 LLM 如何内部表征反问句 (rhetorical question)：在两个语境不同的社交媒体数据集上，反问信号在早期层即出现且以 last-token 表征最稳定，与求信息问句线性可分，跨数据集迁移 AUROC 约 0.7–0.8。但不同数据集训练的探针对同一目标语料的排序重叠常低于 0.2，说明反问由多条强调不同线索的线性方向编码，而非单一共享方向。
Motivation: LLM 内部如何区分不求信息、只用于说服或表明立场的反问句尚不清楚；且探针跨数据集可迁移是否意味着存在共享表征，此前没有直接检验。
Method: 在两个语境不同的社交媒体数据集上训练线性探针，比较不同层与 last-token 表征对反问的捕获稳定性；做数据集内分类与跨数据集迁移，并把不同探针在同一目标语料上的 top-ranked 实例排序重叠作为共享表征的检验，辅以定性分析区分修辞现象。
Result: 反问信号早期出现、last-token 表征最稳定；数据集内反问与信息寻求问句线性可分，跨数据集迁移 AUROC 约 0.7–0.8；但不同数据集探针在同一目标语料上的 top 实例重叠常低于 0.2，定性上分别对应长论证中的话语层修辞立场与局部句法驱动的疑问行为。
Conclusion: 跨数据集可迁移并不等于共享表征：反问在 LLM 中由多条强调不同线索（话语立场 vs. 局部句法）的线性方向共同编码，而非单一共享方向。

papers.title: Gradient Descent's Last Iterate is Often (slightly) Suboptimal
papers.abstract_en: We consider the well-studied setting of minimizing a convex Lipschitz function using either gradient descent (GD) or its stochastic variant (SGD), and examine the last iterate convergence. By now, it is known that standard stepsize choices lead to a last iterate convergence rate of $\log T/\sqrt{T}$ after $T$ steps. A breakthrough result of Jain et al. [2019] recovered the optimal $1/\sqrt{T}$ rate by constructing a non-standard stepsize sequence. However, this sequence requires choosing $T$ in advance, as opposed to common stepsize schedules which apply for any time horizon. Moreover, Jain et al. conjectured that without prior knowledge of $T$, no stepsize sequence can ensure the optimal error for SGD's last iterate, a claim which so far remained unproven. We prove this conjecture, and in fact show that even in the noiseless case of GD, it is impossible to avoid an excess poly-log factor in $T$ when considering an anytime last iterate guarantee.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在凸 Lipschitz 函数的 GD/SGD 最后一轮迭代 (last iterate) 收敛问题上，证明了 Jain et al. [2019] 的猜想：不知道总步数 T 时，任何步长序列都无法让 SGD 最后迭代达到最优误差；即便在无噪声的纯 GD 情形，anytime（不预知 T）的最后迭代保证也必然多出 T 的 poly-log 因子。
Motivation: 标准步长下最后迭代速率是 logT/√T；Jain et al. [2019] 用非标准步长序列恢复最优 1/√T，但该序列必须预先知道 T，而常见步长调度希望对任意时间 horizon 通用。若不预知 T 是否仍可达最优，此前一直未被证明。
Method: 在凸 Lipschitz 设定下对 GD 与 SGD 的最后迭代做下界分析：先证明 Jain et al. 关于 SGD 的猜想，再把结论加强到无噪声的 GD 情形，说明任何 anytime 步长序列都躲不开 T 的 poly-log 额外因子。
Result: 已知结果为：标准步长给出 logT/√T 的最后迭代速率，Jain et al. [2019] 的非标准步长序列在预知 T 时达到最优 1/√T。本文证明该猜想成立，且在无噪声 GD 的 anytime 保证下也必须付出 poly-log 因子。
Conclusion: 最优 1/√T 的最后迭代速率与不预知 T 的 anytime 步长调度不可兼得，这一不可能性在无噪声 GD 中同样成立。

papers.title: Multimodal Ambivalence/Hesitancy Recognition in Videos for Personalized Digital Health Interventions
papers.abstract_en: Using behavioural science, health interventions focus on behaviour change by providing a framework to help patients acquire and maintain healthy habits that improve medical outcomes. In-person interventions are costly and difficult to scale, especially in resource-limited regions. Digital health interventions offer a cost-effective approach, potentially supporting independent living and self-management. Automating such interventions, especially through machine learning, has recently gained considerable attention. Ambivalence and hesitancy (A/H) play a primary role for individuals to delay, avoid, or abandon health interventions. A/H are subtle and conflicting emotions that place a person in a state between positive and negative evaluations of a behaviour, or between acceptance and refusal to engage in it. They manifest as affective inconsistency across modalities or within a modality, such as language, facial, vocal expressions, and body language. While experts can be trained to recognize A/H, integrating them into digital health interventions is costly and less effective. Automatic A/H recognition is therefore critical for the personalization and cost-effectiveness of digital health interventions. Here, we explore the application of deep learning models for A/H recognition in videos, a multi-modal task by nature. In particular, this paper covers three learning setups: supervised learning, unsupervised domain adaptation for personalization, and zero-shot inference via large language models (LLMs). Our experiments are conducted on the unique and recently published BAH video dataset for A/H recognition. Our results show limited performance, suggesting that more adapted multi-modal models are required for accurate A/H recognition. Better methods for modeling spatio-temporal and multimodal fusion are necessary to leverage conflicts within/across modalities.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, ACII 2026. arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2505.19328
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向数字健康干预的视频中矛盾/犹豫 (ambivalence/hesitancy, A/H) 识别，比较监督学习、面向个性化的无监督域适应 (unsupervised domain adaptation) 以及基于大语言模型 (LLM) 的零样本推理三种学习设置，在 BAH 视频数据集上实验。结果性能有限，作者据此判断需要更适配的多模态模型，以及更好的时空建模与跨模态融合方法来刻画模态内/模态间的冲突。
Motivation: 面对面行为干预成本高、难以规模化，而 A/H 是患者拖延或放弃健康行为的关键原因；专家识别成本高且整合进数字干预效果有限，因此需要自动识别以支持个性化与成本效益。
Method: 用深度学习模型做视频 A/H 识别这一天然多模态任务，覆盖三种学习设置：监督学习、用于个性化的无监督域适应、以及 LLM 零样本推理；实验在近期发布的 BAH 视频数据集上进行。
Result: 在 BAH 视频数据集上的三种学习设置实验显示性能有限，表明现有模型不足以准确识别 A/H；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 准确的 A/H 识别需要更适配的多模态模型，重点是更好的时空建模与多模态融合，以利用模态内和模态间的冲突信号。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.conclusion: 准确的 A/H 识别需要更适配的多模态模型，重点是更好的时空建模与多模态融合，以利用模态内和模态间的冲突信号。

papers.title: Verify Before You Fix: Agentic Execution Grounding for Trustworthy Cross-Language Code Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Learned classifiers deployed in agentic pipelines face a fundamental reliability problem: predictions are probabilistic inferences, not verified conclusions, and acting on them without grounding in observable evidence leads to compounding failures across downstream stages. Software vulnerability analysis makes this cost concrete and measurable. We address this through a unified cross-language vulnerability lifecycle framework built around three LLM-driven reasoning stages-hybrid structural-semantic detection, execution-grounded agentic validation, and validation-aware iterative repair-governed by a strict invariant: no repair action is taken without execution-based confirmation of exploitability. Cross-language generalization is achieved via a Universal Abstract Syntax Tree (uAST) normalizing Java, Python, and C++ into a shared structural schema, combined with a hybrid fusion of GraphSAGE and Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B embeddings through learned two-way gating, whose per-sample weights provide intrinsic explainability at no additional cost. The framework achieves 89.84-92.02% intra-language detection accuracy and 74.43-80.12% zero-shot cross-language F1, resolving 69.74% of vulnerabilities end-to-end at a 12.27% total failure rate. Ablations establish necessity: removing uAST degrades cross-language F1 by 23.42%, while disabling validation increases unnecessary repairs by 131.7%. These results demonstrate that execution-grounded closed-loop reasoning is a principled and practically deployable mechanism for trustworthy LLM-driven agentic AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向 agentic 流水线中学习型分类器的可靠性问题，提出跨语言漏洞分析闭环框架：混合结构-语义检测、执行验证驱动的 agentic 校验、验证感知的迭代修复，并强制“未经执行确认可利用性不得修复”。Java/Python/C++ 上语言内检测准确率 89.84–92.02%，零样本跨语言 F1 74.43–80.12%，端到端解决 69.74% 漏洞，总失败率 12.27%。
Motivation: agentic 流水线中学习型分类器的预测是概率推断而非已验证结论，直接据此行动会让错误在下游阶段累积；软件漏洞分析让这一代价可量化。
Method: 三阶段 LLM 推理：混合结构-语义检测、execution-grounded agentic 校验、验证感知迭代修复，受“无执行确认可利用性即不修复”不变式约束。用 Universal AST (uAST) 把 Java/Python/C++ 归一到统一结构 schema，GraphSAGE 与 Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B 嵌入经学习式双向门控融合，逐样本权重提供内在可解释性。
Result: 语言内检测准确率 89.84–92.02%，零样本跨语言 F1 74.43–80.12%，端到端解决 69.74% 漏洞，总失败率 12.27%。消融：去掉 uAST 使跨语言 F1 下降 23.42%，关闭校验使不必要修复增加 131.7%。
Conclusion: 执行验证的闭环推理是可信 LLM agentic AI 的可部署机制；uAST 与执行校验对跨语言 F1 和修复必要性均不可或缺。

papers.title: What do your logits know?
papers.abstract_en: Recent work has shown that probing model internals can reveal a wealth of information not apparent from the model generations. This poses a risk of unintentional or malicious information leakage, where model users are able to learn information that the model owner assumed was inaccessible. Using vision-language models as a testbed, we present the first systematic comparison of information retained at different representational levels as it is compressed from the rich information encoded in the residual stream through two natural bottlenecks: low-dimensional projections of the residual stream obtained using tuned lens, and the final top-k logits most likely to impact model's answer. We show that even easily accessible bottlenecks defined by the model's top logit values can leak task-irrelevant information present in an image-based query, in some cases revealing as much information as direct projections of the full residual stream.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在视觉-语言模型上系统比较不同表征层级保留的信息：从残差流 (residual stream) 经 tuned lens 的低维投影，再到最终 top-k logits 这两个天然瓶颈。结果显示，即便只用模型 top logit 这类极易访问的瓶颈，也会泄漏图像查询中与任务无关的信息，某些情况下泄漏量与直接投影完整残差流相当。
Motivation: 探针可以从模型内部读出生成文本中看不到的信息，构成无意或恶意的信息泄漏风险；模型所有者原以为不可访问的内容可能被用户获取。
Method: 以视觉-语言模型为测试平台，对信息在不同表征层级做首次系统比较：残差流的丰富编码，经 tuned lens 得到的低维投影，以及最可能影响模型回答的最终 top-k logits。
Result: 由模型 top logit 定义的易访问瓶颈即可泄漏图像查询中任务无关的信息，在某些情况下泄漏量与直接投影完整残差流相当。
Conclusion: 信息泄漏不只存在于需访问内部激活的探针，最终 logits 这一层表面输出也足以暴露任务无关内容，因此仅限制对残差流的访问不足以防止泄漏。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What's Missing in Screen-to-Action? Towards a UI-in-the-Loop Paradigm for Multimodal GUI Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Existing Graphical User Interface (GUI) reasoning tasks remain challenging, particularly in UI understanding. Current methods typically rely on direct screen-based decision-making, which lacks interpretability and overlooks a comprehensive understanding of UI elements, ultimately leading to task failure. To enhance the understanding and interaction with UIs, we propose an innovative GUI reasoning paradigm called UI-in-the-Loop (UILoop). Our approach treats the GUI reasoning task as a cyclic Screen-UI elements-Action process. By enabling Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to explicitly learn the localization, semantic functions, and practical usage of key UI elements, UILoop achieves precise element discovery and performs interpretable reasoning. Furthermore, we introduce a more challenging UI Comprehension task centered on UI elements with three evaluation metrics. Correspondingly, we contribute a benchmark of 26K samples (UI Comprehension-Bench) to comprehensively evaluate existing methods' mastery of UI elements. Extensive experiments demonstrate that UILoop achieves state-of-the-art UI understanding performance while yielding superior results in GUI reasoning tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 GUI 推理重构为 Screen-UI elements-Action 循环范式 UILoop，让多模态大模型 (MLLMs) 显式学习关键 UI 元素的定位、语义功能与实际用法，从而做可解释的元素发现与推理。同时提出以 UI 元素为中心的 UI Comprehension 任务、三项评测指标与 26K 样本基准 UI Comprehension-Bench，实验显示 UILoop 在 UI 理解上达到 SOTA 并在 GUI 推理任务上取得更优结果。
Motivation: 现有 screen-to-action 方法直接从整屏做决策，可解释性差且缺乏对 UI 元素的系统理解，导致任务失败；也没有专门衡量模型是否真正掌握 UI 元素的评测。
Method: 提出 UI-in-the-Loop (UILoop) 范式，将 GUI 推理建模为 Screen-UI elements-Action 的循环过程，训练 MLLM 显式输出元素定位、语义功能与用法；并构建 UI Comprehension 任务（三项指标）与 26K 样本的 UI Comprehension-Bench 基准。
Result: 在 UI Comprehension-Bench（26K 样本、三项指标）及 GUI 推理任务上，UILoop 达到 state-of-the-art 的 UI 理解表现，并在 GUI 推理任务上取得更优结果。
Conclusion: 把 UI 元素作为显式中间表示纳入推理循环，可同时提升 UI 理解的可解释性与 GUI 任务完成效果；元素级理解应与端到端整屏决策一起评测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Is a Picture Worth a Thousand Words? Adaptive Multimodal Fact-Checking with Visual Evidence Necessity
papers.abstract_en: Automated fact-checking is a crucial task that supports a responsible information ecosystem. While recent research has progressed from text-only to multimodal fact-checking, a prevailing assumption is that incorporating visual evidence universally improves verification accuracy. In this work, we challenge this assumption and show that the indiscriminate use of visual evidence can reduce accuracy. Building on this finding, we propose AMuFC, a modular fact-checking framework that employs two collaborative vision-language models with distinct roles to enable the adaptive use of visual evidence. Experimental results on three datasets, including WebFC, introduced in this study, demonstrate the effectiveness of adaptive visual evidence use in fact-checking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AMuFC 挑战「加入视觉证据总能提升验证准确率」这一默认假设，指出不加区分地使用视觉证据反而会降低自动事实核查的准确率。为此提出模块化框架，用两个分工不同的视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 协作，按需自适应地使用视觉证据；在含本文新提出的 WebFC 在内的三个数据集上验证了自适应使用视觉证据的有效性。
Motivation: 多模态事实核查普遍默认视觉证据能普遍提升验证准确率，但该假设未经检验，且盲目使用视觉证据会损害准确率。
Method: 提出模块化框架 AMuFC，由两个角色不同的视觉-语言模型协作，实现视觉证据的自适应使用（即按需决定是否使用视觉证据），并新提出数据集 WebFC。
Result: 在三个数据集（含本文提出的 WebFC）上的实验结果表明自适应使用视觉证据对事实核查有效；核心发现是不加区分地使用视觉证据会降低准确率。
Conclusion: 视觉证据并非越多越好，事实核查应按需自适应地使用视觉证据，而非默认全部纳入。

papers.title: Learning an Interpretable Risk Scoring System for Maximizing Decision Net Benefit
papers.abstract_en: Risk scoring systems are widely used in high-stakes domains to assist decision-making. However, existing approaches often focus on optimizing predictive accuracy or likelihood-based criteria, which may not align with the main goal of maximizing utility. In this paper, we propose a novel risk scoring system that directly optimizes net benefit over a range of decision thresholds. The model is formulated as a sparse integer linear programming problem which enables the construction of a transparent scoring system with integer coefficients, and hence, facilitates interpretation and practical application. We also establish fundamental relationships among net benefit, discrimination, and calibration. Specifically, we derive bounds relating the area under the net benefit curve to a ROC functional, both evaluated on a fixed threshold grid, and show that post-processing can achieve moderate calibration on the training data without decreasing the area under the net benefit curve on that grid. We evaluated our method on multiple public datasets as well as on a large-scale credit risk dataset. This computational study demonstrated that our interpretable method can effectively achieve high net benefit while maintaining competitive discrimination and calibration performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出直接以净收益 (net benefit) 为目标的可解释风险评分系统：把模型写成稀疏整数线性规划，输出整数系数的透明评分卡，并在固定阈值网格上给出净收益曲线下面积与 ROC 泛函的界。在多个公开数据集与大规模信用风险数据集上，该方法取得高净收益，同时保持有竞争力的判别与校准表现。
Motivation: 高风险决策场景的评分系统多按预测精度或似然准则优化，与最大化效用的真正目标不一致；透明、可直接落地的整数评分卡更难兼顾净收益。
Method: 将风险评分系统表述为稀疏整数线性编程问题，直接在一段决策阈值上优化 net benefit，得到整数系数的透明评分；并推导净收益、判别与校准三者关系，包括净收益曲线下面积与 ROC 泛函在固定阈值网格上的界，以及训练数据上后处理可实现适度校准而不降低该网格上的曲线下面积。
Result: 在多个公开数据集和一个大规模信用风险数据集上的计算研究显示，该可解释方法在保持有竞争力的判别与校准的同时有效取得高净收益；arXiv comment 记录 53 页、9 图、18 表、6 个算法。
Conclusion: 把净收益而非预测精度直接写进稀疏整数规划，可以在透明整数评分卡上同时拿到高净收益与可用的判别、校准，且校准后处理不必牺牲阈值网格上的净收益面积。

papers.title: Spectral Alignment in Forward-Backward Representations via Temporal Abstraction
papers.abstract_en: Forward-backward (FB) representations provide a powerful framework for learning the successor representation (SR) in continuous spaces by enforcing a low-rank factorization. However, a fundamental spectral mismatch often exists between the high-rank transition dynamics of continuous environments and the low-rank bottleneck of the FB architecture, making accurate low-rank representation learning difficult. In this work, we analyze temporal abstraction as a mechanism to mitigate this mismatch. By characterizing the spectral properties of the transition operator, we show that temporal abstraction acts analogously to a low-pass filter that suppresses high-frequency spectral components. This suppression reduces the effective rank of the induced SR while preserving a formal bound on the resulting value function error. Empirically, we show that this alignment is a key factor for stable FB learning, particularly at high discount factors where bootstrapping becomes error-prone. Our results identify temporal abstraction as a principled mechanism for shaping the spectral structure of the underlying MDP and enabling effective long-horizon representations in continuous control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 连续环境的转移算子高秩与 forward-backward (FB) 架构的低秩瓶颈存在谱失配，本文证明时间抽象 (temporal abstraction) 相当于低通滤波，压制高频谱分量、降低诱导 successor representation 的有效秩，同时保留值函数误差的形式化上界。实证上这种谱对齐是 FB 稳定学习的关键，尤其在高折扣因子下 bootstrap 易出错时。
Motivation: 连续空间中转移动力学的高秩与 FB 表示的低秩分解瓶颈不匹配，导致低秩表示难以准确学习，长时程表示在高折扣因子下尤其不稳。
Method: 刻画转移算子的谱性质，把时间抽象形式化为抑制高频分量的低通滤波机制，并证明其在降低诱导 SR 有效秩的同时保持值函数误差的形式化界；随后在连续控制设定下实证检验谱对齐对 FB 学习稳定性的作用。
Result: 时间抽象降低诱导 SR 的有效秩并保留值函数误差的形式化上界；实证显示谱对齐是 FB 稳定学习的关键因素，在高折扣因子、bootstrap 易出错的区间尤其明显。
Conclusion: 时间抽象是塑造底层 MDP 谱结构、支撑连续控制中长时程有效表示的有原则机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Locally Penalized Cross-Estimate Federated Method with Guarantees for Constrained Personalized Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) is a communication-efficient framework for solving distributed optimization problems. Standard FL methods aggregate local updates into a single global model that is shared by all agents, effectively imposing consensus. Under heterogeneous local constraints, however, a common feasible model may be overly restrictive or may not exist. Existing constrained FL methods largely retain this shared-model structure and therefore do not directly address personalization under heterogeneous agent-specific feasible sets. We study a constrained personalized FL problem that assigns a distinct feasible model to each agent while coupling the models through a collaborative objective. We propose Locally Penalized Cross-Estimate Federated Averaging (PCE-FedAvg), where each agent maintains a multi-block vector containing its own model and estimates of the other agents' models while applying the feasibility penalty only locally to its own block. The server aggregates corresponding blocks separately, thereby preserving personalization without requiring agents to explicitly disclose their local constraint sets. For any $ε>0$, we establish finite-time upper and lower suboptimality bounds and agent-wise squared infeasibility bounds, yielding communication complexities of $\mathcal{O}(ε^{-2})$ and $\mathcal{O}(ε^{-1})$, respectively. Experiments on MNIST and CIFAR-10 support our theoretical results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出联邦学习个性化约束优化方法 PCE-FedAvg：每个 agent 维护含自身模型与其他 agent 模型估计的多块向量，只对自己的块施加可行性惩罚，服务器分块聚合对应块，从而在异构约束下保留个性化且无需公开本地约束集。给出 ε>0 的有限时间次优性与逐 agent 平方不可行度上下界，通信复杂度分别为 O(ε⁻²) 与 O(ε⁻¹)，MNIST 与 CIFAR-10 实验支持理论结果。
Motivation: 标准 FL 把局部更新聚合成单一全局模型，等于强加一致性；在各 agent 可行集异构时，公共可行模型可能过严甚至不存在，现有约束 FL 方法仍保留共享模型结构，未直接处理个性化。
Method: PCE-FedAvg：每个 agent 维护多块向量（自身模型 + 对其他 agent 模型的估计），可行性惩罚只作用于自身块；服务器按块分别聚合对应块，保留个性化且不要求 agent 显式披露本地约束集。
Result: 对任意 ε>0 建立有限时间次优性上下界与逐 agent 平方不可行度界，对应通信复杂度 O(ε⁻²) 与 O(ε⁻¹)；MNIST 与 CIFAR-10 实验支持理论结果。
Conclusion: 在异构约束下，用本地惩罚加跨估计分块聚合的联邦平均可以同时保证个性化与可证的通信复杂度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Controllable Accent Normalization via Discrete Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Existing accent normalization methods do not typically offer control over accent strength, yet many applications-such as language learning and dubbing-require tunable accent retention. We propose DLM-AN, a controllable accent normalization system built on masked discrete diffusion over self-supervised speech tokens. A Common Token Predictor identifies source tokens that likely encode native pronunciation; these tokens are selectively reused to initialize the reverse diffusion process. This provides a simple yet effective mechanism for controlling accent strength: reusing more tokens preserves more of the original accent. DLM-AN further incorporates a flow-matching Duration Ratio Predictor that automatically adjusts the total duration to better match the native rhythm. Experiments on multi-accent English data show that DLM-AN achieves the lowest word error rate among all compared systems while delivering competitive accent reduction and smooth, interpretable accent strength control. The implementation is available at https://github.com/P1ping/DLM-AN
papers.comment: Accepted to Interspeech 2026 as a long paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DLM-AN 用带掩码的离散扩散 (masked discrete diffusion) 在自监督语音 token 上做口音归一化，通过 Common Token Predictor 挑出可能编码母语发音的源 token 并选择性复用来初始化反向扩散：复用越多，保留的原口音越强，从而把口音强度变成可调旋钮。多口音英语数据上它在所有对比系统中取得最低词错率 (WER)，同时口音削减有竞争力、强度控制平滑可解释。
Motivation: 现有口音归一化方法通常不能调节口音强度，而语言学习和配音等应用需要可调的口音保留量。
Method: 在自监督语音 token 上做掩码离散扩散；Common Token Predictor 识别可能编码母语发音的源 token，选择性复用以初始化反向扩散，复用比例即强度控制；另加 flow-matching 的 Duration Ratio Predictor 自动调整总时长以贴合母语节奏。
Result: 在多口音英语数据实验中，DLM-AN 在所有对比系统中取得最低词错率 (WER)，口音削减表现有竞争力，并实现平滑、可解释的口音强度控制。
Conclusion: 用复用母语 token 的比例来初始化扩散，即可同时拿到低 WER、有效的口音削减和连续可调的口音强度；实现已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On the Tip of the Tongue: Why LLMs Hallucinate Answers They Can Decode
papers.abstract_en: A language model can give the wrong answer even when the correct answer is decodable from its intermediate states. To study this gap between decodability and selection, we distinguish \textit{read} from \textit{write} at the first answer token. Read asks whether the gold token can be decoded from intermediate residual states under same-relation decoy controls. Write asks whether the final readout ranks that token first among content tokens. Under three different readers, with a randomized-label control, a substantial fraction of failures remain readable while another content token is selected. We explain this through the selection margin at the final readout, the difference between the answer logit and the logit of its strongest alternative, which is answer support minus alternative support, and can also be split into a context-averaged baseline linked to token frequency and an item-specific term. Setting the answer support to the level typical of successful generations is sufficient to recover first-token selection for the majority of failures in most of the models we study; the original alternative remains ahead in most remaining failures under this edit, and this outcome follows directly from the readout geometry. Removing the frequency direction alone shifts selection but rarely recovers the answer. Prompt variants of the same fact that succeed supply support that transfers to failing variants through the residual stream and through late MLP outputs, with less consistent effects through late attention. First-token recovery leaves most full answers wrong, which limits the recovery achieved by these edits and separates three things that are easily conflated, decodability, recoverability, and generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把 LLM 在首个答案 token 上的失败拆成 read（中间残差态能否解码出 gold token）与 write（最终 readout 是否把它排在内容词首位）两类，发现大量失败属于可解码但未被选中。把答案 support 抬到成功生成的典型水平，就能在多数模型的多数失败中恢复首 token 选择；单独移除频率方向只改变选择、很少恢复答案。
Motivation: LLM 会给出正确答案本可从中间态解码出来的错误回答，decodability 与 selection 之间的差距缺少可操作的分解框架。
Method: 在首个答案 token 上定义 read/write 两类测试：read 用同关系 decoy 对照从中间残差态解码 gold token，write 检查最终 readout 是否在内容词中把它排第一；用三种 reader 加随机标签对照，并把 selection margin（答案 logit 减最强替代 logit）拆成与词频相关的 context-averaged baseline 和 item-specific 项。
Result: 三种 reader 加随机标签对照下，相当比例的失败仍可读出而另一个内容词被选中；把 answer support 设到成功生成的典型水平，可在所研究多数模型的多数失败中恢复首 token 选择，其余失败中原始替代项仍居前；单独移除频率方向只移动选择、很少恢复答案；同事实的成功 prompt 变体经残差流与晚期 MLP 输出把 support 传递给失败变体，晚期 attention 的效果较不一致；首 token 恢复后多数完整答案仍错。
Conclusion: decodability、recoverability 与 generation 是三件被混为一谈的事：失败主要出在 readout 几何的选择边距而非知识缺失，但首 token 级别的恢复不足以让完整答案变对。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Can AI Understand the Language of Origami?
papers.abstract_en: Building AI systems that can plan, act, and create in the physical world requires more than pattern recognition. Such systems must reason about the generative mechanisms and constraints governing physical processes, using structured representations that connect observations, actions, and their effects. Yet, many existing benchmarks study these capabilities separately, focusing either on visual recognition or on abstract symbolic or programmatic reasoning. Origami provides a natural testbed that integrates these abilities: constructing shapes through folds requires visual perception, reasoning about geometric and physical constraints, and sequential planning, while remaining sufficiently structured for systematic evaluation. We introduce OrigamiBench, a benchmark for evaluating programmatic understanding of the mechanisms underlying origami synthesis through a high-level language of physically grounded fold actions. Experiments with modern vision-language models reveal that scaling model size alone does not reliably improve reasoning about physical transformations. Moreover, models struggle to ground programmatic information in visual observations, suggesting that visual and language representations remain weakly integrated.
papers.comment: This version: "Can AI Understand the Language of Origami?" - different paper from v1 with different authors - NeurIPS LP4FM (Outstanding Runner-Up Award) v1: OrigamiBench: An Interactive Environment to Synthesize Flat-Foldable Origamis ICML LM4Plan (Oral)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 OrigamiBench：用一套物理接地的高层折纸动作语言评测 VLM 对折纸合成机制的程序性理解，把视觉感知、几何与物理约束、序贯规划放进同一可系统评测的环境。实验显示单纯放大模型规模并不能可靠提升对物理变换的推理，且模型难以把程序信息接地到视觉观测上，说明视觉与语言表征仍弱耦合。
Motivation: 现有基准把视觉识别与抽象符号/程序推理分开考察，缺少能同时度量观察、动作与效果之间结构化对应关系的评测环境。
Method: OrigamiBench 以一套高层、物理接地的折纸动作语言描述折纸合成机制，要求模型在折纸构造这一结构化任务上做程序性理解；评测对象为现代 vision-language models，并比较不同模型规模下的表现。
Result: 对现代 VLM 的实验显示：单纯扩大模型规模并不能可靠改善对物理变换的推理；模型在把程序性信息接地到视觉观测上普遍吃力，表明视觉与语言表征仍弱整合。
Conclusion: 物理机制推理不能靠参数规模自然获得，视觉与语言表征的整合是当前 VLM 的主要瓶颈；折纸这类受约束的物理构造任务可作为联合评测这些能力的基准。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Exploring Subnetwork Interactions in Heterogeneous Brain Network via Prior-Informed Graph Learning
papers.abstract_en: Modeling the complex interactions among functional subnetworks is crucial for the diagnosis of mental disorders and the identification of functional pathways. However, learning the interactions of the underlying subnetworks remains a significant challenge for existing Transformer-based methods due to the limited number of training samples. To address these challenges, we propose KD-Brain, a Prior-Informed Graph Learning framework for explicitly encoding prior knowledge to guide the learning process. Specifically, we design a Semantic-Conditioned Interaction mechanism that injects semantic priors into the attention query, explicitly navigating the subnetwork interactions based on their functional identities. Furthermore, we introduce a Pathology-Consistent Constraint, which regularizes the model optimization by aligning the learned interaction distributions with clinical priors. Additionally, KD-Brain leads to state-of-the-art performance on a wide range of disorder diagnosis tasks and identifies interpretable biomarkers consistent with psychiatric pathophysiology. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/KDBrain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KD-Brain 用先验注入的图学习显式建模脑功能子网络间交互：把语义先验注入 attention query 以按功能身份引导子网络交互，再用 Pathology-Consistent Constraint 把学到的交互分布对齐临床先验。在多个精神障碍诊断任务上达到 state-of-the-art，并给出与精神病理生理一致的可解释生物标志物。
Motivation: 精神障碍诊断与功能通路识别需要建模功能子网络交互，但训练样本极少，现有 Transformer 类方法难以学出底层子网络间的真实交互。
Method: 提出 KD-Brain（Prior-Informed Graph Learning 框架）：Semantic-Conditioned Interaction 机制把语义先验注入 attention query，按子网络功能身份显式引导交互；Pathology-Consistent Constraint 将学到的交互分布与临床先验对齐以正则化优化。
Result: 在一系列精神障碍诊断任务上取得 state-of-the-art 表现，并识别出与精神病理生理一致的可解释生物标志物；代码发布于 anonymous.4open.science/r/KDBrain。
Conclusion: 把语义与临床先验显式编码进图交互学习，可在小样本脑网络数据上同时提升诊断性能与生物标志物可解释性。

papers.title: Evaluation format, not model capability, drives measured triage failure in the assessment of consumer health AI
papers.abstract_en: A recent Nature Medicine study reported that ChatGPT Health under-triages 51.6% of emergencies and concluded that consumer-facing AI triage poses safety risks. Its protocol, however, was an exam-style scaffold (forced A/B/C/D output, knowledge suppression, no clarifying questions) unlike how consumers use health chatbots. We ask whether the headline error rate is a property of the models or of the measurement. In a first, mechanistic study, five frontier LLMs on a 17-scenario bank scored 6.4 points higher under naturalistic patient-style messages than under the constrained scaffold (p=0.015), and on one vignette three models went from 0-24% with forced choice to 100% with free text. In a second, faithful replication we ran the authors' own 60 released vignettes through six frontier models under four matched formats, with clinician validation of the rewrites and a blinded clinician audit of the LLM adjudicators. Here the direction reversed: free-text rewrites scored slightly below the exact structured prompt (78.7% vs 81.8%, p=0.020), removing only the answer scaffold changed little (80.6% vs 81.4%, p=0.81), and naturalistic input with a forced categorical answer beat both the exact prompt (84.4%, p=0.023) and free text (p=0.0001). On the four vignettes defining the original emergency rate, under-triage was 17% with the exact scaffold, 50% in free text, and 21% when the same message was answered with a forced letter; every free-text "under-triage" was a same-day recommendation scored C rather than D, and 60% made escalation conditional on information the patient was asked to check, behavior a single-turn benchmark cannot score. The headline rate is therefore largely a property of output format and of mapping prose onto a four-point scale. Benchmark scaffolds are behaviorally active instruments; safety claims should report sensitivity to input wording, output format and adjudication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 Nature Medicine 报告的 ChatGPT Health 急症欠分诊率 51.6%，本文用两个研究证明该数字主要由评测格式而非模型能力决定：17 个场景上自然式患者消息比受约束 scaffold 高 6.4 分（p=0.015），复现 60 个 vignette 时自由文本反而略低于结构化 prompt（78.7% vs 81.8%，p=0.020）。在定义原急症率的四个 vignette 上，欠分诊率随输出格式在 17%、50%、21% 之间摆动，作者主张安全结论必须报告对输入措辞、输出格式与评分方式的敏感性。
Motivation: Nature Medicine 的 51.6% 欠分诊率被当作消费级健康 AI 的安全风险证据，但其协议是考试式 scaffold（强制 A/B/C/D、抑制知识、不许澄清），与真实消费者使用方式不符；需要判定该错误率是模型属性还是测量属性。
Method: 第一项机制研究让五个前沿 LLM 在 17 个场景上分别以自然式患者消息与受约束 scaffold 作答；第二项忠实复现把原作者公开的 60 个 vignette 交给六个前沿 LLM，在四种匹配格式下运行，改写经临床医生验证，LLM 裁判另做盲法临床审计。
Result: 第一项研究：自然式消息比受约束 scaffold 高 6.4 分（p=0.015），单个 vignette 上三个模型从强制选择的 0-24% 升到自由文本的 100%。第二项复现：自由文本 78.7% vs 精确结构化 prompt 81.8%（p=0.020），仅去掉答案 scaffold 变化不大（80.6% vs 81.4%，p=0.81），自然式输入加强制分类答案 84.4%，高于精确 prompt（p=0.023）与自由文本（p=0.0001）。定义原急症率的四个 vignette 上欠分诊率为精确 scaffold 17%、自由文本 50%、同一消息强制字母 21%；自由文本的欠分诊全部是把当日建议判为 C 而非 D，60% 的升级取决于患者被要求自查的信息。
Conclusion: 头条欠分诊率主要是输出格式与把散文映射到四级量表的产物，benchmark scaffold 是行为上活跃的测量工具；安全声明应报告对输入措辞、输出格式和评分方式的敏感性。

papers.title: Novelty Adaptation Through Hybrid Large Language Model (LLM)-Symbolic Planning and LLM-guided Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: In dynamic open-world environments, autonomous agents often encounter novelties that hinder their ability to find plans to achieve their goals. Specifically, traditional symbolic planners fail to generate plans when the robot's planning domain lacks the operators that enable it to interact appropriately with novel objects in the environment. We propose a neuro-symbolic architecture that integrates symbolic planning, reinforcement learning, and a large language model (LLM) to learn how to handle novel objects. In particular, we leverage the common sense reasoning capability of the LLM to identify missing operators, generate plans with the symbolic AI planner, and write reward functions to guide the reinforcement learning agent in learning control policies for newly identified operators. Our method outperforms the state-of-the-art methods in operator discovery as well as operator learning in continuous robotic domains.Our webpage and code can be access here: https://helenlu66.github.io/hybridLLMguided/
papers.comment: Accepted at IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots & Systems (IROS) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出混合 LLM-符号规划与 LLM 引导强化学习的神经符号架构，用 LLM 的常识推理识别缺失的规划算子、调用符号规划器生成计划，并为新算子编写奖励函数引导 RL 学习连续控制策略。在开放世界新颖性场景下，该方法在算子发现 (operator discovery) 与连续机器人域的算子学习上均超过现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 开放世界中机器人规划域缺少与新颖对象交互所需的算子时，传统符号规划器直接无法生成计划，需要自动发现并学会这些算子。
Method: 神经符号架构整合三部分：LLM 用常识推理识别缺失算子并调用符号 AI 规划器生成计划，同时由 LLM 为新识别的算子编写奖励函数，引导强化学习智能体学习对应控制策略。
Result: 在连续机器人域 (continuous robotic domains) 上，该方法在算子发现与算子学习两方面均优于 state-of-the-art 方法；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把 LLM 常识、符号规划与 RL 控制拼成一条链，可以让机器人在缺算子的开放世界里自行补上算子并学出可用策略。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Sensory-Aware Sequential Recommendation via Review-Distilled Representations
papers.abstract_en: Sequential recommenders learn behavioral patterns from item identifiers, while the experiential properties that users describe in reviews, such as how products look, feel, smell, taste, or sound, rarely enter item representations in a controlled, auditable form. We present ASER (Attribute-based Sensory-Enhanced Representation), an offline pipeline that fine-tunes a large language model to extract evidence-grounded sensory attribute-value records, such as color: matte black or scent: vanilla, from review text and distills them into a compact student encoder that produces a frozen five-facet sensory bank for each item catalog. At recommendation time the pretrained backbone stays frozen: a lightweight relational metric between the user history and each candidate is learned over the bank, and its correction is applied within a validation-selected magnitude bound. Across five Amazon domains and four backbones, trained within a common experimental pipeline and evaluated by full-catalog leave-one-out ranking without sampled negatives, this integration improves HR@10 and NDCG@10 in all 20 domain-backbone pairs, with average relative gains of 6.1% and 6.4%. A matched non-sensory control channel, built with the same seed model, schema, and pipeline, separates the sources of the gain: the hit-rate improvement follows from structured, evidence-grounded extraction as such, whereas the sensory vocabulary yields a ranking-quality advantage in eight of nine matched comparisons. An audit of the Beauty evaluation catalog finds that 94.8% of retained records are supported by their cited evidence spans, so the extracted signal remains inspectable against its source text.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in Knowledge-Based Systems. The Version of Record is available at https://doi.org/10.1016/j.knosys.2026.117071
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ASER 用 LLM 从商品评论中抽取有证据支撑的感官属性-值记录（如 color: matte black），蒸馏成冻结的五维感官表征库，再在其上学一个轻量关系度量并以验证集选定的幅度界做修正。在 5 个 Amazon 域、4 个 backbone、全目录 leave-one-out 排序（不用采样负例）下，20 个域-骨干组合的 HR@10 与 NDCG@10 全部提升，平均相对增益 6.1% 与 6.4%；Beauty 目录审计显示 94.8% 的记录被引用证据片段支撑。
Motivation: 序列推荐只从 item ID 学行为模式，评论里描述的外观、手感、气味、味道、声音等体验属性几乎不会以可控、可审计的形式进入 item 表征。
Method: ASER 离线管线：先微调 LLM 从评论文本抽取证据锚定的感官属性-值记录，再蒸馏进一个紧凑 student encoder，为每个 item 目录生成冻结的五维感官库；推荐时 backbone 保持冻结，只在库上学用户历史与候选之间的轻量关系度量，修正量受验证集选定的幅度界约束。对照组用同一种子模型、schema 与管线构建非感官通道，以分离增益来源。
Result: 在 5 个 Amazon 域 × 4 个 backbone 共 20 个组合上，统一实验管线、全目录 leave-one-out 排序（无采样负例）下 HR@10 与 NDCG@10 全部提升，平均相对增益分别为 6.1% 与 6.4%。匹配的非感官对照显示：命中率提升来自结构化证据抽取本身，感官词汇在 9 次匹配比较中的 8 次带来排序质量优势。Beauty 评测目录审计中 94.8% 的保留记录有其引用证据片段支撑。
Conclusion: 把评论中的感官属性以证据锚定、可审计的形式注入冻结表征，能在不改动 backbone 的前提下稳定抬高全目录排序指标；命中率收益归于结构化抽取，排序质量收益才归于感官词汇。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Theoretical Lower Bounds on the Robustness of Deep ReLU Networks
papers.abstract_en: We present a theoretical study of the robustness of parameterized neural networks to random input perturbations. Specifically, we analyze local robustness by quantifying the probability that a random L_2-perturbation of a given input results in a correct classification. For deep ReLU networks, we derive lower bounds on local robustness by combining tools from high-dimensional geometry, in particular concentration of measure, with a new characterization of the geometric structure induced by their input-output functions. We prove that each convex polyhedral region in the partition of the input space induced by a ReLU network has at most as many faces as there are network units, regardless of the network depth or architecture. This geometric property serves as the key ingredient in our robustness analysis. Finally, we analyze how local robustness scales with input dimension and characterize the sets of inputs whose neighborhoods are most likely to contain adversarial examples. We show that the width of decision-boundary neighborhoods containing vulnerable points shrinks rapidly as dimension increases and grows only logarithmically with the number of network units. We also discuss the volume of a set of vulnerable points in terms of approximately space-filling shapes of decision boundaries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对深度 ReLU 网络在随机 L2 扰动下的局部鲁棒性给出理论下界：把高维几何的测度集中 (concentration of measure) 与 ReLU 输入输出函数诱导的几何刻画结合，证明输入空间被划分出的每个凸多面体区域的面数不超过网络单元数，与深度和结构无关。由此得出脆弱点邻域宽度随输入维度升高而迅速收缩、且只随网络单元数呈对数增长。
Motivation: 随机扰动下分类正确概率的下界缺少可计算的几何刻画，而高维输入中对抗样本邻域的宽度如何随维度与网络规模缩放并不清楚。
Method: 用测度集中工具结合 ReLU 网络输入输出函数诱导的几何结构新刻画，推导局部鲁棒性下界；关键引理是每个凸多面体区域的面数至多等于网络单元数；再分析鲁棒性随输入维度的标度，并用近似空间填充形状刻画决策边界体积。
Result: 证明每个凸多面体区域的面数不超过网络单元数，与网络深度或结构无关；脆弱点所在决策边界邻域的宽度随维度增加迅速收缩，且仅随网络单元数呈对数增长；并给出脆弱点集合体积与近似空间填充形状的表述。
Conclusion: ReLU 网络的鲁棒性下界由单元数而非深度决定，高维下脆弱邻域极窄，对抗样本易出现在这些窄邻域中。

summary_sections.result: 证明每个凸多面体区域的面数不超过网络单元数，与网络深度或结构无关；脆弱点所在决策边界邻域的宽度随维度增加迅速收缩，且仅随网络单元数呈对数增长；并给出脆弱点集合体积与近似空间填充形状的表述。
summary_sections.conclusion: ReLU 网络的鲁棒性下界由单元数而非深度决定，高维下脆弱邻域极窄，对抗样本易出现在这些窄邻域中。

papers.title: Demonstration-Guided Observation Attacks on Black-Box Safe Reinforcement Learning Controllers for Robotic Systems
papers.abstract_en: Safe reinforcement learning (Safe RL) learns robotic controllers that optimize task rewards under safety constraints, yet observation perturbations can induce safety violations. Existing safety-directed attacks often require access to victim networks, gradients, critics, or explicit specifications -- assumptions rarely met once a controller is deployed as a black box. We propose a demonstration-guided observation attack for analyzing unknown Safe RL controllers. The framework recovers a state constraint and a surrogate policy through inverse constrained reinforcement learning, and learns dynamics from demonstration transitions. Their composed gradient generates bounded observation perturbations without victim parameters, gradients, or queries; demonstrations are the only victim-specific information. Across four Bullet tasks and one MetaDrive map with three budgets per victim, the attack exceeds every same-access baseline in 12 of 15 environment-budget conditions, and in 7 of those 12 it also exceeds the privileged reference attacks with access to the victim's reward and cost critics. Demonstrations released to support safe learning thus provide an attack surface for deployed black-box controllers. A defense study shows that state-adversarial regularization reduces attack cost, whereas the tested adversarial-training and demonstration-contamination schemes provide inconsistent protection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对部署为黑盒的安全强化学习 (Safe RL) 机器人控制器，提出演示引导的观测攻击：用逆约束强化学习恢复状态约束与代理策略、从演示转移学动力学，其合成梯度在无需受害者参数、梯度或查询的条件下生成有界观测扰动。在 4 个 Bullet 任务加 1 张 MetaDrive 地图、每受害者 3 个预算共 15 个环境-预算条件中，12 个超过同访问权限基线，其中 7 个还超过能访问 reward/cost critic 的特权参考攻击。
Motivation: 已有的安全导向攻击大多需要受害者网络、梯度、critic 或显式约束，而部署后的控制器往往以黑盒形式提供，这些假设不成立。
Method: 框架通过逆约束强化学习 (inverse constrained RL) 恢复一个状态约束和一个代理策略，并从演示转移中学习动力学；三者合成的梯度生成有界观测扰动，演示是唯一的受害者特有信息。
Result: 在 4 个 Bullet 任务和 1 张 MetaDrive 地图、每个受害者 3 个预算的 15 个环境-预算条件下，攻击在 12 个条件下超过所有同访问权限基线，其中 7 个还超过可访问受害者 reward 与 cost critic 的特权参考攻击。防御实验中 state-adversarial regularization 降低攻击代价，而所测的对抗训练与演示污染方案保护效果不一致。
Conclusion: 为安全学习而发布的演示本身构成已部署黑盒控制器的攻击面；有效的防御方向是 state-adversarial regularization，而非所测的对抗训练或演示污染。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Goldilocks RL: Tuning Task Difficulty to Escape Sparse Rewards for Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has emerged as a powerful paradigm for unlocking reasoning capabilities in language models. However, relying on sparse rewards makes this process highly sample-inefficient, as models must navigate vast search spaces with minimal feedback. While classic curriculum learning aims to mitigate this by ordering data based on complexity, prior works have primarily targeted small datasets and do not directly transfer to the large-scale settings typical of modern language model training. Furthermore, the right ordering for a specific model is often unclear. To address this, we propose Goldilocks, an adaptive data-selection strategy that uses a Selector network to predict the standard deviation of rewards across the model's rollouts for each candidate question. The Selector prioritizes questions with high predicted reward variability, corresponding to questions that are neither too easy nor too hard for the model's current capabilities (Goldilocks principle), while training the model with GRPO. By leveraging the model's performance on seen samples, the Selector continuously adapts to the model's evolving abilities. Across the OpenMathReasoning and Polaris datasets, Goldilocks consistently improves over standard GRPO, requiring up to 78% fewer optimization steps to reach the corresponding GRPO performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Goldilocks 用 Selector 网络预测每个候选问题在模型多次 rollout 上奖励的标准差，优先选预测奖励波动大的题（既不太易也不太难），并配合 GRPO 训练。在 OpenMathReasoning 与 Polaris 数据集上，相比标准 GRPO 达到同等性能最多只需少 78% 的优化步数。
Motivation: 稀疏奖励让基于 RL 的语言模型推理训练样本效率极低，而经典 curriculum learning 只针对小数据集、无法迁移到现代大模型训练规模，且对特定模型该用什么顺序本身不清楚。
Method: 提出自适应数据选择策略 Goldilocks：Selector 网络对每个候选问题预测模型多条 rollout 奖励的标准差，优先选取预测波动高的问题；模型侧用 GRPO 训练，Selector 依据模型在已见样本上的表现持续自适应更新。
Result: 在 OpenMathReasoning 与 Polaris 两个数据集上，Goldilocks 一致优于标准 GRPO，达到对应 GRPO 性能最多只需少 78% 的优化步数。
Conclusion: 以奖励方差（而非题目静态难度）做在线数据选择，可以在稀疏奖励的 RL 推理训练中显著加速收敛，且选择标准随模型能力演化自动更新。

papers.title: Power-SMC: Low-Latency Sequence-Level Power Sampling for Training-Free LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning ability in large language models is often attributed to \emph{distribution sharpening}: concentrating output probability on high-likelihood sequences. Recent works show that this sharpening effect can be obtained at inference time, without modifying model parameters, and can elicit strong reasoning performance. A natural formalization is the \emph{sequence-level power distribution}, which is proportional to the model's probability raised to an exponent $α>1$. Prior work leveraged Metropolis--Hastings (MH) sampling to draw samples from this distribution and achieves strong results, however, at order-of-magnitude inference slowdowns. We introduce \textbf{Power-SMC}, a \textit{`training-free'} sampling method that targets the same power distribution yielding close to standard decoding latency. Power-SMC maintains multiple candidate sequences in parallel. Each candidate sequence is assigned a score, namely the \emph{importance weight}, that measures how well it matches the power distribution. It then periodically prunes low-scoring candidate sequences in favor of high-scoring ones. We further provide a theoretical justification for the design choices in Power-SMC. Among all next-token sampling strategies that do not rely on future tokens, we prove that sampling temperature $τ{=}1/α$ uniquely eliminates per-step weight variance. Finally, we characterize the remaining source of weight instability and introduce a gradual sharpening schedule to reduce weight collapse, while targeting the same power distribution. Extensive evaluations on MATH500, GSM8K, GPQA, and HumanEval show that Power-SMC matches or exceeds MH sampling in accuracy, preserves output diversity unlike RL-finetuned models, while \textbf{accelerating inference speed by up to} {$\mathbf{17.6}\times$}. The code is available at https://github.com/ArminAzizi98/Power-SMC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Power-SMC 是一种 training-free 的序列级 power 分布采样方法：并行维护多条候选序列，用 importance weight 衡量其与目标分布的匹配度，再周期性剪枝低分候选，以接近标准解码的延迟实现分布锐化。理论上证明在不依赖未来 token 的采样策略中温度 τ=1/α 唯一消除逐步权重方差，并用渐进锐化调度抑制权重坍缩；在 MATH500、GSM8K、GPQA、HumanEval 上精度匹配或超过 Metropolis–Hastings 采样，推理最高加速 17.6×。
Motivation: 推理时的分布锐化可用 MH 采样从序列级 power 分布（概率的 α>1 次幂）中抽样并带来强推理表现，但 MH 会造成数量级的推理变慢，限制其实际使用。
Method: Power-SMC 并行维护多条候选序列，每条按与 power 分布的匹配程度赋 importance weight，周期性剪掉低分候选并保留高分候选；理论上证明在不看未来 token 的下一 token 策略中 τ=1/α 唯一消除每步权重方差，并针对剩余的权重不稳定来源引入 gradual sharpening schedule，同时仍瞄准同一 power 分布。
Result: 在 MATH500、GSM8K、GPQA、HumanEval 上，Power-SMC 精度匹配或超过 MH 采样，保留输出多样性（不同于 RL 微调模型），推理加速最高达 17.6×；理论结果为 τ=1/α 在不依赖未来 token 的策略中唯一消除逐步权重方差。
Conclusion: 不改参数、以接近标准解码延迟的 SMC 式剪枝即可达到 MH 级锐化推理精度，并把 MH 的数量级减速换成最高 17.6× 加速，同时保住 RL 微调所失去的多样性。

papers.title: The Effective Depth Paradox: Topology and Trainability in Deep CNNs
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a controlled comparative study of convolutional neural network (CNN) topology and image classification performance across the architectural families VGG, ResNet, and GoogLeNet, evaluated on CIFAR-10 under a unified training protocol. We formalize the distinction between nominal depth ($D_{\mathrm{nom}}$), the physical count of weight-bearing layers, and effective depth ($D_{\mathrm{eff}}$), an operational metric quantifying the expected length of forward information paths, extending the path-ensemble interpretation of residual networks introduced by Veit et al. (2016) into closed-form, pre-training proxies spanning sequential, residual, and multi-branch topologies. We validate this proxy against a gradient-weighted variant computed from observed backpropagation signal. Across eight representative models (VGG-11/13/16/19, ResNet-18/34/50, GoogLeNet), plain VGG-style stacks show early accuracy saturation as $D_{\mathrm{eff}}$ increases, whereas ResNet and GoogLeNet continue to benefit from added depth by keeping $D_{\mathrm{eff}}$ low relative to $D_{\mathrm{nom}}$ - a pattern we term the "Effective Depth Paradox". A pooled correlation analysis shows both $D_{\mathrm{nom}}$ and $D_{\mathrm{eff}}$ are strongly, significantly associated with accuracy (r = 0.94 and r = 0.93; both p < 0.01); given the small family-clustered sample, this alone cannot cleanly separate the two metrics, so we treat gradient-norm evidence as complementary mechanistic support rather than decisive statistical proof. We conclude that architectural topology, not layer count alone, governs trainability and scaling efficiency in deep CNNs. All claims are scoped to CIFAR-10-scale training of the three families studied; we do not claim validation at ImageNet scale or generalization to modern architectures such as EfficientNet, ConvNeXt, or Vision Transformers, which we identify as necessary future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 CIFAR-10 统一训练协议下比较 VGG、ResNet、GoogLeNet 八个模型，提出有效深度 D_eff（前向信息路径期望长度）作为训练前可算的拓扑指标。plain VGG 随 D_eff 增加精度早饱和，而 ResNet 与 GoogLeNet 靠把 D_eff 压在 D_nom 之下继续从加深度获益，即“有效深度悖论”。
Motivation: 名义层数无法解释为何 plain 堆叠加深失效而残差与多分支结构仍能受益，需要一个训练前可算、跨拓扑统一的深度度量来区分层数与可训练性。
Method: 把 Veit et al. (2016) 的残差路径系综解释扩展为覆盖 sequential、residual、multi-branch 三种拓扑的闭式训练前代理 D_eff，并用基于反传信号的梯度加权变体做验证；八个模型（VGG-11/13/16/19、ResNet-18/34/50、GoogLeNet）在统一训练协议下于 CIFAR-10 上评估。
Result: 合并相关分析中 D_nom 与 D_eff 均与精度强显著相关（r = 0.94 与 r = 0.93，均 p < 0.01）；plain VGG 随 D_eff 增加出现精度早饱和，ResNet 与 GoogLeNet 则在 D_eff 相对 D_nom 较低时继续从深度获益。作者指出样本按族聚类且量小，该相关本身无法干净区分两个指标，梯度范数证据只作互补机制支持。
Conclusion: 决定深层 CNN 可训练性与扩展效率的是架构拓扑而非层数本身；全部论断限定在 CIFAR-10 规模与这三个族，未声称 ImageNet 规模验证或对 EfficientNet、ConvNeXt、ViT 的泛化。
Relevance: 2
