papers.title: LPS-Bench: Benchmarking Safety Awareness of Computer-Use Agents in Long-Horizon Planning under Benign and Adversarial Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents (CUAs) execute multi-stage tasks through tools, where an early unsafe decision can propagate to consequential actions. Evaluating only final outcomes can miss such decisions, while constructing executable environments for new tasks can make benchmark expansion costly. We present LPS-Bench, a benchmark of long-horizon planning safety in MCP-style tool workflows under benign requests and adversarial steering. A template-guided multi-agent pipeline generates user instructions, simulated toolkits, and case-specific safety criteria, followed by human review. This design supports scalable case expansion without building a separate application environment for every test case. LPS-Bench comprises 570 cases derived from 65 scenarios across 7 task domains and 9 planning-risk types, with representative cases additionally adapted to reusable skills. An LLM-based evaluator applies case-specific criteria to complete interaction records, examining tool choices, arguments, and responses to environmental feedback throughout execution. Evaluations of 13 LLM agents reveal persistent failures in both benign and adversarial settings. Prompt-based interventions yield model-dependent gains, but substantial safety failures remain.
papers.comment: 50 pages. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations and Datasets Track. Revised benchmark description, skill-augmented evaluation, evaluator validation, and appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LPS-Bench 是面向计算机使用智能体 (computer-use agents) 长程规划安全性的基准：在 MCP 式工具工作流中同时考察良性请求与对抗引导，用模板驱动的多智能体流水线生成指令、模拟工具集与逐案例安全准则，并由 LLM 评测器按完整交互记录审查工具选择、参数与对环境反馈的响应。对 13 个 LLM 智能体的评测显示良性与对抗设置下均存在持续性安全失败，基于提示的干预只带来依赖模型的增益，大量安全失败仍然保留。
Motivation: 只看最终结果会漏掉长程任务早期的不安全决策，而为每个新任务搭建可执行环境又使基准扩展成本过高。
Method: 模板引导的多智能体流水线生成用户指令、模拟工具集与逐案例安全准则，再经人工审核，无需为每个测试案例单独构建应用环境；代表性案例进一步改写为可复用 skill。LLM 评测器依据逐案例准则审查完整交互记录中的工具选择、参数与对环境反馈的响应。
Result: 基准含 570 个案例，源自 65 个场景、7 个任务领域与 9 种规划风险类型；对 13 个 LLM 智能体的评测显示良性与对抗设置下均存在持续性安全失败，提示式干预带来依赖模型的增益但大量失败仍在。
Conclusion: 长程工具调用的安全性必须按执行全程的工具选择与参数逐条评估，仅看最终结果不足以暴露早期不安全决策；提示式干预不足以消除这些失败。

papers.title: ChronoSpike: An Adaptive Spiking Graph Neural Network for Dynamic Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic graph representation learning requires capturing both structural relations and temporal evolution, yet existing approaches face a core trade-off: attention-based methods offer expressiveness at O(T^2) complexity, while recurrent architectures suffer from gradient pathologies and dense state storage. Spiking neural networks provide event-driven efficiency but are constrained by sequential propagation, binary information loss, and local aggregation that lacks global context. We propose ChronoSpike, an adaptive spiking graph neural network that integrates learnable LIF neurons with per-channel membrane dynamics, multi-head spatially-attentive aggregation over continuous features, and a lightweight Transformer temporal encoder. This design enables fine-grained local modeling and long-range dependency capture with O(T.d) activation/state memory and an additional O(T^2) per-node attention term that remains small for the horizons evaluated here. ChronoSpike outperforms twelve state-of-the-art baselines on three large benchmarks by 2.0%~Macro-F1 and 2.4%~Micro-F1 on average while achieving 3-10 times faster training than recurrent methods with a constant 105K-parameter budget independent of graph size. We provide theoretical guarantees for membrane potential boundedness, gradient flow stability under contraction factor \r{ho}<1, and BIBO stability; interpretability analyses reveal heterogeneous temporal receptive fields and a learned primacy effect with 83-88% sparsity. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/Abrar2652/ChronoSpike
papers.comment: Accepted at the Fifth Learning on Graphs Conference (LoG 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ChronoSpike 把可学习 LIF 神经元（per-channel 膜动力学）、多头空间注意力聚合与轻量 Transformer 时序编码器拼成脉冲图神经网络，用于动态图表示学习。在三个大型基准上平均比 12 个 SOTA 基线高 2.0% Macro-F1、2.4% Micro-F1，训练比循环方法快 3–10 倍，参数量恒为 105K 且不随图规模增长，稀疏度 83–88%。
Motivation: 动态图学习卡在表达力与效率的权衡：注意力方法复杂度 O(T^2)，循环架构有梯度病理与稠密状态存储；脉冲网络虽事件驱动高效，却受顺序传播、二值信息丢失与缺全局上下文的局部聚合限制。
Method: ChronoSpike 融合可学习 LIF 神经元（per-channel 膜动力学）、在连续特征上的多头空间注意力聚合 (multi-head spatially-attentive aggregation)，以及轻量 Transformer 时序编码器；激活/状态内存为 O(T·d)，另加每节点 O(T^2) 注意力项。附带膜电位有界、收缩因子 ρ<1 下梯度流稳定与 BIBO 稳定性的理论保证。
Result: 在三个大型基准上平均超过 12 个 SOTA 基线 2.0% Macro-F1、2.4% Micro-F1；训练比循环方法快 3–10 倍，参数预算恒为 105K 且与图规模无关。可解释性分析显示异质时序感受野与学到的 primacy effect，稀疏度 83–88%。
Conclusion: 把空间注意力放进脉冲图网络可以在固定小参数预算下同时拿到表达力、训练速度与事件驱动稀疏性，且稳定性有理论条件（ρ<1 收缩）支撑。

papers.title: Recoverability Has a Law: The ERR Measure for Tool-Augmented Agents
papers.abstract_en: Language model agents often appear capable of self-recovery after failing tool call executions, yet this behavior lacks a formal explanation. We present a predictive theory that resolves this gap by showing that recoverability follows a measurable law. To elaborate, we formalize recoverability through Expected Recovery Regret (ERR), which quantifies the deviation of a recovery policy from the optimal one under stochastic execution noise, and derive a first-order relationship between ERR and an empirical observable quantity, the Efficiency Score (ES). This yields a falsifiable first-order quantitative law of recovery dynamics in tool-using agents. We empirically validate the law across five tool-use benchmarks spanning controlled perturbations, diagnostic reasoning, and real-world APIs. Across model scales, perturbation regimes, and recovery horizons, predicted regret under the ERR-ES law closely matched observed post-failure regret measured from Monte Carlo rollouts, within delta less than or equal to 0.05. Our results reveal that recoverability is not an artifact of model scale or architecture, but a governed property of interaction dynamics, providing a theoretical foundation for execution-level robustness in language agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为工具调用失败后的语言模型 agent 自恢复给出可测度量 Expected Recovery Regret (ERR)，并推导出 ERR 与经验可观测量 Efficiency Score (ES) 的一阶关系式，形成可证伪的恢复动力学定量律。在五个工具使用基准上，该律预测的 regret 与 Monte Carlo rollouts 观测到的失败后 regret 相差 delta ≤ 0.05，且跨模型规模、扰动机制与恢复时域均成立。
Motivation: LLM agent 在工具执行失败后常表现出自恢复能力，但缺乏形式化解释，无法判断这种恢复是模型规模的偶然产物还是可预测的交互动力学性质。
Method: 把 recoverability 形式化为 ERR（随机执行噪声下恢复策略相对最优策略的 regret 偏差），推导 ERR 与经验可观测量 ES 的一阶关系，得到恢复动力学的定量律；再用 Monte Carlo rollouts 测量失败后 regret 来检验预测值。
Result: 在五个工具使用基准（涵盖受控扰动、诊断推理与真实世界 API）上，ERR-ES 律预测的 regret 与观测到的失败后 regret 高度吻合，delta ≤ 0.05；该吻合跨模型规模、扰动机制与恢复时域均保持。
Conclusion: recoverability 不是模型规模或架构的偶然产物，而是由交互动力学支配的可测性质，可为语言 agent 的执行级鲁棒性提供理论基础。

papers.title: Understanding Affective Adaptation in Multimodal Foundation Models: Emergent Functional Specialization
papers.abstract_en: Despite rapid progress in multimodal affective foundation models, how affective capabilities emerge within their internal architectures remains poorly understood. A critical open question is whether affective fine-tuning induces diffuse changes across the model or organizes computation into functionally specialized pathways. We systematically investigate this question through a broad module-level analysis of 13 affective model instances spanning nine model designs, multiple scales, tasks, and training paradigms, complemented by controlled functional analyses on representative models. We find that affective adaptation exhibits a consistent yet non-exclusive functional organization. Under matched trainable-parameter budgets, adapting only the feed-forward network (FFN) consistently outperforms adapting only the attention modules across all evaluated settings and, on average, nearly matches the performance obtained by tuning all major Transformer projections, identifying the FFN as a particularly efficient adaptation substrate. More strikingly, although the gate, up, and down projections exhibit comparable standalone adaptation capacity, their learned functional contributions become differentiated after joint optimization. Module recovery and targeted interventions identify \texttt{gate\_proj} as a particularly prominent pathway, while checkpoint analysis shows that this differentiation develops over the course of training. We characterize this phenomenon as emergent functional specialization: distinct pathway-level roles are not fully explained by standalone adaptation capacity, but arise through joint affective adaptation. Building on this finding, Gate-Focused Efficient Tuning (GET) retains 96.2-98.0\% of the performance obtained by tuning all major Transformer projections while using only 19.3-24.5\% as many trainable parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 13 个情感多模态基础模型实例（覆盖 9 种模型设计）做模块级分析，发现情感微调并非弥散改变，而是涌现功能特化：在同等可训练参数预算下只调 FFN 在全部设定中优于只调 attention，且平均而言接近调全部 Transformer 投影；gate/up/down 投影单独适配能力相当，联合优化后 gate_proj 被识别为突出通路。据此提出的 Gate-Focused Efficient Tuning (GET) 只用 19.3-24.5% 的可训练参数即保留全投影微调 96.2-98.0% 的性能。
Motivation: 情感微调究竟让模型内部产生弥散变化，还是组织成功能特化的通路，此前缺乏系统性的模块级证据；这直接决定高效微调该把参数放在哪里。
Method: 对 13 个情感模型实例（9 种设计、多尺度、多任务、多训练范式）做模块级分析，并在代表性模型上做受控功能分析：在匹配的可训练参数预算下分别只调 FFN、只调 attention 与全部主要 Transformer 投影，再用模块恢复 (module recovery)、定向干预 (targeted interventions) 与 checkpoint 分析定位通路。
Result: 匹配可训练参数预算下，只调 FFN 在所有评估设定中优于只调 attention，平均而言接近调全部主要 Transformer 投影；gate、up、down 投影单独适配能力相当，但联合优化后功能贡献分化，gate_proj 被识别为突出通路，且 checkpoint 分析显示这种分化随训练推进而形成。GET 保留全投影微调 96.2-98.0% 的性能，只用 19.3-24.5% 的可训练参数。
Conclusion: 通路级角色无法由单独适配能力解释，而是由联合情感适配涌现，因此把微调集中到 gate_proj 一类的特化通路可在大幅省参数的同时基本保住性能。

papers.title: Demystifying LLM-as-a-Judge: Analytically Tractable Model for Inference-Time Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Recent developments in large language models have shown advantages in reallocating a notable share of computational resource from training time to inference time. However, the principles behind inference time scaling are not well understood. In this paper, we introduce an analytically tractable model of inference-time scaling: Bayesian linear regression with a reward-weighted sampler, where the reward is determined from a linear model, modeling LLM-as-a-judge scenario. We study this problem in the high-dimensional regime, where the deterministic equivalents dictate a closed-form expression for the posterior predictive mean and variance. We analyze the generalization error when training data are sampled from a teacher model. We draw $k$ inference-time samples and select via softmax at a temperature applied to a quadratic reward. When the reward is not too different from the teacher, the generalization error decreases monotonically with increasing inference time samples $k$. However, the specific reward that optimizes inference-time selection generally differs from the teacher. In contrast, substantial reward misspecification induces a finite optimal $k$ beyond which more sampling can increase the generalization error. For fixed $k$, there exists an optimal sampling temperature. We experimentally verify these facts in large language model inference with an additional large language model as a judge. In the "best-of-$k$" limit with the teacher as reward, we theoretically show that the generalization error decays as $Θ(1/k^2)$ and determine the leading coefficient via extreme value theory. These formulas delineate domains where scaling inference-time computation is provably preferable to collecting more data. Finally, we demonstrate that when task difficulty increases, the previously mentioned advantage of inference-time compute degrades.
papers.comment: Published at International Conference on Machine Learning 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用可解析的推理时扩展模型（贝叶斯线性回归 + 奖励加权采样器，奖励由线性模型给出以刻画 LLM-as-a-judge）证明：奖励与 teacher 接近时泛化误差随采样数 k 单调下降，best-of-k 极限下按 Θ(1/k²) 衰减；奖励严重错设时存在有限最优 k，超过后继续采样反而抬高误差，且固定 k 下存在最优采样温度。任务难度上升会削弱推理时算力的这一优势。
Motivation: 算力从训练时向推理时再分配的收益缺乏原理性解释：何时多采样优于多收集数据、奖励错设会怎样翻转结论，都没有可判定的条件。
Method: 构造贝叶斯线性回归 + 奖励加权采样器的可解析模型，奖励取线性模型以模拟 LLM-as-a-judge；在高维体制下用 deterministic equivalents 给出后验预测均值与方差的闭式解，分析训练数据由 teacher 模型采样时的泛化误差；推理时抽 k 个样本并按作用于二次奖励的 softmax 温度选择，另用大语言模型充当 judge 做实验验证。
Result: 奖励与 teacher 差别不大时泛化误差随 k 单调下降；奖励严重错设时出现有限最优 k，超过后采样增多会增大泛化误差；固定 k 存在最优采样温度。best-of-k 且奖励为 teacher 时，理论上泛化误差按 Θ(1/k²) 衰减，首项系数由 extreme value theory 确定。任务难度上升时上述推理时算力优势退化。
Conclusion: 推理时扩展何时优于收集更多数据可由奖励错设程度与任务难度划定：错设小则 k 越大越好，错设大则存在最优 k，难度升高会压缩这一优势区间。

summary_sections.motivation: 算力从训练时向推理时再分配的收益缺乏原理性解释：何时多采样优于多收集数据、奖励错设会怎样翻转结论，都没有可判定的条件。
summary_sections.method: 构造贝叶斯线性回归 + 奖励加权采样器的可解析模型，奖励取线性模型以模拟 LLM-as-a-judge；在高维体制下用 deterministic equivalents 给出后验预测均值与方差的闭式解，分析训练数据由 teacher 模型采样时的泛化误差；推理时抽 k 个样本并按作用于二次奖励的 softmax 温度选择，另用大语言模型充当 judge 做实验验证。
summary_sections.result: 奖励与 teacher 差别不大时泛化误差随 k 单调下降；奖励严重错设时出现有限最优 k，超过后采样增多会增大泛化误差；固定 k 存在最优采样温度。best-of-k 且奖励为 teacher 时，理论上泛化误差按 Θ(1/k²) 衰减，首项系数由 extreme value theory 确定。任务难度上升时上述推理时算力优势退化。
summary_sections.conclusion: 推理时扩展何时优于收集更多数据可由奖励错设程度与任务难度划定：错设小则 k 越大越好，错设大则存在最优 k，难度升高会压缩这一优势区间。

papers.title: OpenBox: Annotate Any Bounding Boxes in 3D
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised and open-vocabulary 3D object detection have recently gained attention, particularly in autonomous driving, where reducing annotation costs and recognizing unseen objects are critical for both safety and scalability. However, most existing approaches uniformly annotate 3D bounding boxes, ignoring objects' physical states, and require multiple self-training iterations for annotation refinement, resulting in suboptimal quality and substantial computational overhead. To address these challenges, we propose OpenBox, a two-stage automatic annotation pipeline that leverages a 2D vision foundation model. In the first stage, OpenBox associates instance-level cues from 2D images processed by a vision foundation model with the corresponding 3D point clouds via cross-modal instance alignment. In the second stage, it categorizes instances by rigidity and motion state, then generates adaptive bounding boxes with class-specific size statistics. As a result, OpenBox produces high-quality 3D bounding box annotations without requiring self-training. Experiments on the Waymo Open Dataset (WOD), the Lyft Level 5 Perception dataset, and the nuScenes dataset demonstrate improved accuracy and efficiency over baselines. Our project page is available at: https://oliver0922.github.io/OpenBox/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OpenBox 是两阶段自动 3D 框标注流水线：用 2D 视觉基础模型的实例线索与 3D 点云做跨模态实例对齐，再按刚体性与运动状态分类并用类别尺寸统计生成自适应框，无需自训练迭代即可产出高质量标注。在 Waymo Open Dataset、Lyft Level 5 Perception 与 nuScenes 上相对基线提升了精度与效率。
Motivation: 现有无监督与开放词汇 3D 检测的自动标注统一生成框、忽略物体物理状态，且需多轮自训练迭代精修，导致标注质量次优并带来可观的计算开销。
Method: 两阶段流水线：第一阶段把 2D 视觉基础模型处理图像得到的实例级线索，通过跨模态实例对齐 (cross-modal instance alignment) 关联到对应 3D 点云；第二阶段按刚体性与运动状态对实例分类，用类别特定的尺寸统计生成自适应 3D bounding box，全程不依赖自训练。
Result: 在 Waymo Open Dataset (WOD)、Lyft Level 5 Perception dataset 与 nuScenes 上的实验显示，OpenBox 相对基线在标注精度与效率两方面均有提升。
Conclusion: 借助 2D 基础模型的跨模态对齐加物理状态感知的自适应框生成，可以在不进行自训练的前提下取代多轮迭代精修，得到更高质量且开销更低的 3D 框自动标注。

papers.title: A Unified BERT-CNN-BiLSTM Framework for Simultaneous Headline Classification and Sentiment Analysis of Bangla News
papers.abstract_en: In our daily lives, newspapers are an essential information source that impacts how the public talks about present-day issues. However, effectively navigating the vast amount of news content from different newspapers and online news portals can be challenging. Newspaper headlines with sentiment analysis tell us what the news is about (e.g., politics, sports) and how the news makes us feel (positive, negative, neutral). This helps us quickly understand the emotional tone of the news. This research presents a state-of-the-art approach to Bangla news headline classification combined with sentiment analysis applying Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques, particularly the hybrid transfer learning model BERT-CNN-BiLSTM. We have explored a dataset called BAN-ABSA of 9014 news headlines, which is the first time that has been experimented with simultaneously in the headline and sentiment categorization in Bengali newspapers. Over this imbalanced dataset, we applied two experimental strategies: technique-1, where undersampling and oversampling are applied before splitting, and technique-2, where undersampling and oversampling are applied after splitting on the In technique-1 oversampling provided the strongest performance, both headline and sentiment, that is 78.57\% and 73.43\% respectively, while technique-2 delivered the highest result when trained directly on the original imbalanced dataset, both headline and sentiment, that is 81.37\% and 64.46\% respectively. The proposed model BERT-CNN-BiLSTM significantly outperforms all baseline models in classification tasks, and achieves new state-of-the-art results for Bangla news headline classification and sentiment analysis. These results demonstrate the importance of leveraging both the headline and sentiment datasets, and provide a strong baseline for Bangla text classification in low-resource.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用混合迁移模型 BERT-CNN-BiLSTM 在 BAN-ABSA（9014 条孟加拉语新闻标题）上同时做标题分类与情感分析。划分前重采样（technique-1）中 oversampling 表现最好，标题 78.57%、情感 73.43%；划分后重采样（technique-2）在原始不平衡数据上直接训练时标题最高 81.37%，但情感降至 64.46%。
Motivation: 孟加拉语新闻标题量大且类别不平衡，标题主题与情感两个任务此前未在同一数据集上联合实验，低资源语言缺少可用基线。
Method: 采用 BERT-CNN-BiLSTM 混合迁移学习模型，在 BAN-ABSA 的 9014 条标题上做标题分类与情感分析的联合建模；对比两种重采样策略：technique-1 在划分数据集前做 undersampling/oversampling，technique-2 在划分之后做。
Result: technique-1 中 oversampling 最强，标题分类 78.57%、情感分析 73.43%；technique-2 在原始不平衡数据上直接训练取得最高标题分类 81.37%，情感分析 64.46%。摘要称该模型在分类任务上显著优于全部基线模型，并为孟加拉语文本分类给出强基线。
Conclusion: 重采样时机决定任务间的取舍：划分前 oversampling 抬高情感分析，划分后直接在原始不平衡数据上训练抬高标题分类但牺牲情感表现；作者主张联合利用标题与情感数据作为低资源孟加拉语文本分类的基线。

papers.title: Science Is Falling Behind the Frontier: Foundation Model Adoption Across Half a Million Papers
papers.abstract_en: We present the first large-scale analysis of AI foundation model usage in science -- not just citations or keywords. We find that adoption has grown rapidly, at nearly-exponential rates, with the highest uptake in Linguistics, Computer Science, and Engineering. Vision models are the most used foundation models in science, although language models' share is growing. Open-weight models dominate. As AI builders increase the parameter counts of their models, scientists have followed suit but at a much slower rate: in 2015, the mean foundation model adopted in science was 5.4x larger than the mean model being built; by 2024 that relationship had reversed, with the mean model built 6.9x larger than the mean model adopted. We also present suggestive evidence that scientists' use of these smaller models may be limiting them from getting the full benefits of AI-enabled science, as papers that use larger models appear in higher-impact journals and accrue more citations.
papers.comment: 22 pages (8 main text), 6 figures, 3 tables. Accepted to the AI for Meta-Science (AI4MetaScience) Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对约五十万篇科学论文做基础模型使用检测，发现科学界采用 AI 基础模型的速度接近指数增长，但采用的模型规模相对产业界从领先转为落后：2015 年科学界平均采用的模型比产业界正在构建的大 5.4 倍，到 2024 年反转为产业界构建的模型大 6.9 倍。使用更大模型的论文出现在更高影响力期刊并获得更多引用，作者据此认为科学界偏小的模型选择可能正在限制其获得 AI 赋能科学的全部收益。
Motivation: 此前对科学中 AI 影响的度量停留在引用或关键词层面，无法回答科学家实际用了哪些基础模型、规模多大，以及这是否限制了科学产出。
Method: 在约五十万篇论文上做超越引用与关键词的大规模基础模型使用检测，按学科统计采用率与模型规模，并把科学界采用的模型参数量与产业界正在构建的模型参数量逐年对比（2015 与 2024 两个端点），再关联期刊影响力与引用数。
Result: 采用率接近指数增长，Linguistics、Computer Science、Engineering 最高；视觉模型是科学中使用最多的 foundation model，语言模型份额在增长；open-weight 模型占主导。平均模型规模对比从 2015 年科学采用的模型大 5.4 倍反转为 2024 年产业构建的模型大 6.9 倍；使用更大模型的论文 appear in higher-impact journals 并 accrue more citations（作者称为 suggestive evidence）。
Conclusion: 科学界在模型规模上已落后于 AI 前沿，且这种偏小的采用选择可能与更低的期刊影响力和引用数相关。

papers.title: When Does Pooling Pay? Credibility and Resolution under Forgetting in Intermittent-Demand Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Forecasting many sparse series requires two choices: how much of each series' own past to retain, and how much to borrow from other series. We show that when one exponential recency operator is applied to item- and group-level statistics alike in a hierarchical empirical-Bayes hurdle model, the two become one decision: forgetting preserves the leverage of a shared prior while raising the noise floor against which fine cross-series structure must be resolved. We formalize this two-sided effect as a fitting-window diagnostic, a credibility bound and a resolution condition for candidate pools, and derive from it an ex ante screen for regimes where refinement cannot pay. On five public intermittent-demand panels comprising over 19,000 series, where item-level evidence is sparsest, the diagnostic is right in both directions. Where truncation lowers credibility the shared prior pays: switching it off costs $5\%$ and $12\%$ at the shortest histories on the two panels it helps most, against about $1\%$ at full length, and the gain sits in the occurrence block. On four panels the diagnostic reports at most $0.6\%$ of room for refinement and realized gains are no larger; on the one panel with room the learned mixture does not collect it, which locates the open problem in the partition objective. The resulting forecaster, EBB, stays within about $3\%$ of a per-series Gaussian-process specialist at fixed origin and within $1\%$ under walk-forward evaluation where both run, at two to three orders of magnitude lower cost.
papers.comment: Preprint. 52 pages, 15 figures. Equal contribution by the two authors. v3: Retitled and substantially revised; reframes the work around forgetting and pooling, with credibility/resolution theory and expanded experiments
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在稀疏间歇需求序列上，把同一个指数遗忘算子同时作用于 item 级与 group 级统计量，使「保留自身历史」与「借用他人信息」合并为一个决策：遗忘会保住共享先验的杠杆、同时抬高区分细粒度跨序列结构的噪声底。由此导出的 credibility bound 与 resolution condition 在五个公开面板（逾 19,000 条序列）上双向判对——缩短历史时关闭共享先验代价 5% 与 12%，全长时约 1%；四个面板的 refinement 空间至多 0.6%，实际增益也不超过它。
Motivation: 预测大量稀疏序列时，保留多少自身历史与从其他序列借多少信息是两个独立旋钮，缺少一个可事前判定「细分池子不值得」的准则，导致在证据最稀疏处要么丢掉共享先验的收益、要么做无回报的 refinement。
Method: 在分层经验贝叶斯 hurdle 模型中对 item 级与 group 级统计量施加同一个指数遗忘算子，把两个选择化为单一决策；形式化为 fitting-window 诊断、credibility bound 与候选池的 resolution condition，并据此给出事前筛选 refinement 不可能盈利的 regime 的 ex ante screen；产出的 forecaster 命名为 EBB。
Result: 在五个公开间歇需求面板、逾 19,000 条序列上，诊断双向判对：在 credibility 被截断拉低处共享先验盈利，最短历史处关闭它在最有帮助的两个面板上分别损失 5% 与 12%，全长时约 1%，增益集中在 occurrence block；四个面板诊断给出的 refinement 空间至多 0.6%，实际增益不超过该值，唯一有空间的面板上学习到的 mixture 未能兑现；EBB 在固定起点下与逐序列 Gaussian-process 专家相差约 3%，walk-forward 评估下在两者都运行处相差 1% 以内，成本低两到三个数量级。
Conclusion: 遗忘同时决定先验杠杆与可分辨的跨序列结构，credibility/resolution 诊断可事前判定 refinement 是否可能盈利；剩余开放问题被定位在 partition objective——有空间的面板上学习式 mixture 没有把空间兑现。

papers.title: High-Dimensional Asymptotics of Differentially Private PCA
papers.abstract_en: In differential privacy, random noise is introduced to privatize summary statistics of a sensitive dataset before releasing them. The noise level determines the privacy loss, which quantifies how easily an adversary can detect a target individual's presence in the dataset using the published statistic. Most privacy analyses provide non-asymptotic upper bounds on the privacy loss which hold uniformly across all datasets. Sometimes, these bounds can be pessimistic on a given dataset. In such cases, it can be useful to complement these privacy bounds with sharp privacy characterizations that quantify a mechanism's exact privacy loss on a given dataset. With this goal, we study differentially private principal component analysis (PCA), where the goal is to privatize the leading principal components of a dataset with $n$ samples and $p$ features. We analyze the exponential mechanism and provide sharp asymptotic characterizations of its utility and privacy loss in the high-dimensional limit ($p \rightarrow \infty$). We show that in this limit, detecting a target individual's presence using privatized principal components is asymptotically equivalent to distinguishing between two Gaussians with different means, where the mean difference depends on certain spectral properties of the dataset. Our analysis combines the hypothesis-testing formulation of privacy guarantees proposed by Dong, Roth, and Su (2022) with Le Cam's contiguity arguments.

papers.title: LLM-Guided Reinforcement Learning with Representative Agents for Traffic Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as behavioral proxies for self-interested travelers in agent-based traffic models. Although more flexible and generalizable than conventional models, the practical use of these approaches remains limited by scalability due to the cost of calling one LLM for every traveler. Moreover, it has been found that LLM agents often make opaque choices and produce unstable day-to-day dynamics. To address these challenges, we propose to model each homogeneous traveler group facing the same decision context with a single representative LLM agent who behaves like the population's average, maintaining and updating a mixed strategy over routes that coincides with the group's aggregate flow proportions. Each day, the LLM reviews the travel experience and flags routes with positive reinforcement that they hope to use more often, and an interpretable update rule then converts this judgment into strategy adjustments using a tunable (progressively decaying) step size. The representative-agent design improves scalability, while the separation of reasoning from updating clarifies the decision logic while stabilizing learning. In classic traffic assignment settings, we find that the proposed approach converges rapidly to the user equilibrium. In richer settings with income heterogeneity, multi-criteria costs, and multi-modal choices, the generated dynamics remain stable and interpretable, reproducing plausible behavioral patterns well-documented in psychology and economics, for example, the decoy effect in toll versus non-toll road selection, and higher willingness-to-pay for convenience among higher-income travelers when choosing between driving, transit, and park-and-ride options.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用单个代表性 LLM agent 代替每个出行者各调一次 LLM，把同质出行者组的路径选择表示为与组流量比例一致的混合策略，由 LLM 每日标记正强化路径、再经可解释更新规则（步长逐步衰减）调整策略。在经典交通分配中该方法快速收敛到 user equilibrium，在收入异质、多准则成本与多模式选择场景下动态保持稳定可解释，并复现 toll/非 toll 选择中的 decoy effect 等行为模式。
Motivation: LLM agent 作为出行者行为代理虽灵活，但逐人调用 LLM 成本高导致可扩展性受限，且 LLM 决策不透明、逐日动态不稳定。
Method: 每个面临相同决策情境的同质出行者组只用一个代表性 LLM agent，维护与组聚合流量比例一致的路径混合策略；每日 LLM 复盘出行体验并标记希望增加使用量的正强化路径，再由可解释更新规则以可调（逐步衰减）步长把该判断转成策略调整，将推理与更新分离。
Result: 在经典交通分配设定中快速收敛到 user equilibrium；在含收入异质、多准则成本、多模式选择的更丰富设定中动态保持稳定与可解释，并复现心理学与经济学中 well-documented 的行为模式，例如 toll 与非 toll 道路选择中的 decoy effect，以及高收入者在 driving、transit、park-and-ride 之间对便利性有更高支付意愿。
Conclusion: 代表性 agent 加推理与更新分离的设计能同时提升 LLM 交通模型的可扩展性、决策透明度与逐日学习稳定性，并生成符合已知行为规律的交通动态。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Interpretable Discovery from Unstructured Data: A High-Dimensional Approach
papers.abstract_en: We propose an automatic, general-purpose framework for making discoveries from unstructured data (e.g., text data from open-ended surveys of economic beliefs). The framework leverages recent methods from the literature on AI interpretability to transform unstructured datasets into high-dimensional, structured datasets of interpretable concept measurements; specifies concept-level parameters and null hypotheses based on this transformed dataset; tests these hypotheses using algorithms validated by new results in high-dimensional multiple testing, producing a selected set ("discoveries"); and both generates and evaluates human-interpretable natural language descriptions of these discoveries. The proposed framework has few researcher degrees of freedom, is robust to data snooping, mitigates under-exploration, and facilitates fast and inexpensive sensitivity analysis and replication. We revisit applications to recent descriptive and causal analyses of unstructured data in empirical economics, and find this framework is able to automatically replicate existing discoveries, add nuance to others, and make entirely new discoveries as well.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个从非结构化数据自动做可解释发现的通用框架：用 AI 可解释性方法把开放文本（如经济信念问卷）转成概念测量的高维结构化数据，再在概念层面设定参数与零假设，用高维多重检验算法做检验并产出“发现集”，最后自动生成并评估自然语言描述。框架研究者自由度少、抗 data snooping、缓解欠探索，可快速低成本做敏感性分析与复现；在经验经济学近期描述性与因果分析的复核中，它能自动复现既有发现、为部分发现增添细节，并做出全新发现。
Motivation: 开放文本类非结构化数据难以系统地做统计推断：人工编码自由度大、易 data snooping、探索不充分，复现与敏感性分析成本高。
Method: 四步流水线：先用 AI 可解释性 (AI interpretability) 方法把非结构化数据集转为高维、结构化的可解释概念测量；再基于该数据集指定概念级参数与零假设；用由高维多重检验 (high-dimensional multiple testing) 新结果验证的算法检验假设，得到被选择的“发现”集合；最后生成并评估关于这些发现的、人类可理解的自然语言描述。
Result: 在经验经济学近期对非结构化数据的描述性与因果分析上复核：该框架能自动复现既有发现、为另一些发现增添细微差别 (add nuance)，并做出完全新的发现；框架被描述为研究者自由度少、抗 data snooping、缓解欠探索，且支持快速低成本的敏感性分析与复现。
Conclusion: 把非结构化数据先映射为概念级测量、再走高维多重检验的推断流程，可以让发现过程自动化、可复现且自由度受限，同时仍产出人类可读的结论。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Differential Privacy as a Perk: Federated Learning over Multiple-Access Fading Channels with a Multi-Antenna Base Station
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) is a distributed learning paradigm that preserves privacy by eliminating the need to exchange raw data during training. In its prototypical edge instantiation with underlying wireless transmissions enabled by analog over-the-air computing (AirComp), referred to as \emph{over-the-air FL (AirFL)}, the inherent channel noise plays a unique role of \emph{frenemy} in the sense that it degrades training due to noisy global aggregation while providing a natural source of randomness for privacy-preserving mechanisms, formally quantified by \emph{differential privacy (DP)}. It remains, nevertheless, challenging to effectively harness such channel impairments, as prior arts, under assumptions of either simple channel models or restricted types of loss functions, mostly considering (local) DP enhancement with a single-round or non-convergent bound on privacy loss. In this paper, we study AirFL over multiple-access fading channels with a multi-antenna base station (BS) subject to user-level DP requirements. Despite a recent study, which claimed in similar settings that artificial noise (AN) must be injected to ensure DP in general, we demonstrate, on the contrary, that DP can be gained as a \emph{perk} even \emph{without} employing any AN. Specifically, we derive a novel bound on DP that converges under general bounded-domain assumptions on model parameters, along with a convergence bound with general smooth and non-convex loss functions. Next, we optimize over receive beamforming and power allocations to characterize the optimal convergence-privacy trade-offs, which also reveal explicit conditions in which DP is achievable without compromising training. Finally, our theoretical findings are validated by extensive numerical results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多天线基站、多址衰落信道的 over-the-air 联邦学习 (AirFL) 中，证明信道噪声本身即可在不注入人工噪声 (AN) 的情况下满足用户级差分隐私 (DP)。推导出在一般有界域模型参数下收敛的 DP 界与一般光滑非凸损失下的收敛界，并通过接收波束成形与功率分配优化刻画最优收敛-隐私权衡，给出 DP 可达且不损害训练的显式条件。
Motivation: 既有 AirFL 隐私工作多依赖简单信道模型或受限损失类型，且只给出单轮或不收敛的隐私损失界；另有研究声称在类似设置下必须注入 AN 才能保证 DP。
Method: 在多址衰落信道 + 多天线基站设置下研究用户级 DP 的 AirFL：推导一般有界域假设下收敛的 DP 界与一般光滑非凸损失下的收敛界，再对接收波束成形和功率分配做优化，刻画最优收敛-隐私权衡并给出无需 AN 即可满足 DP 的显式条件。
Result: 给出两类理论界：在一般有界域模型参数假设下收敛的 DP 界，以及针对一般光滑非凸损失函数的收敛界；优化接收波束成形与功率分配后得到显式条件，说明不注入 AN 也能达到 DP 且不牺牲训练；理论结论由大量数值结果验证。
Conclusion: 信道噪声可作为 DP 的免费来源（perk），无需人工噪声注入即可在多址衰落 AirFL 中同时满足用户级 DP 与训练收敛，直接反驳了必须注入 AN 的先前主张。

papers.title: WAON: A Large-Scale Japanese Image-Text Dataset for Cultural Adaptation in Contrastive Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Contrastive vision-language models have achieved remarkable progress through large-scale pretraining. Recent work has shown that removing English-only caption filters and pretraining on global data is effective for improving multicultural performance. We study whether such global pretraining is sufficient for culture-specific understanding, or whether further adaptation with natively sourced data can boost performance beyond what global pretraining alone achieves. To enable this investigation, we present WAON, the largest publicly available native Japanese image-text dataset constructed from native Japanese web content in Common Crawl, containing approximately 155 million examples. We also introduce WAON-Bench, a manually curated Japanese cultural benchmark spanning 374 classes. Through comparative fine-tuning experiments on multiple Japanese image-text datasets, we observe that models fine-tuned on WAON consistently achieve stronger performance on Japanese cultural benchmarks than those fine-tuned on English-to-Japanese translated data. Controlled experiments at matched scale, filtering, and training budget across two model families further indicate that native web origin is the primary driver of this gain. We release our dataset, benchmark, model, and code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WAON 是从 Common Crawl 日语原生网页构建的大规模日语图像-文本数据集，约 1.55 亿条样本，并配套 374 类人工整理的日语文化基准 WAON-Bench。在多个日语图像-文本数据集上的对比微调显示，用 WAON 微调的模型在日本文化基准上一致强于用英译日数据微调的模型；在规模、过滤与训练预算对齐的受控实验中，原生网页来源被认定为增益的主因。
Motivation: 已有工作表明去掉英文-only caption 过滤、用全球数据预训练能提升多元文化表现，但全球预训练是否足以支撑文化特定理解、还是仍需原生数据进一步适配，尚无定论。
Method: 构建 WAON：从 Common Crawl 的日语原生网页内容抽取约 1.55 亿条图像-文本对；人工整理 WAON-Bench，覆盖 374 个日本文化类别；在多个日语图像-文本数据集上做对比微调实验，并在两个模型家族上以匹配的规模、过滤与训练预算做受控实验，区分数据来源与规模的影响。
Result: WAON 约 1.55 亿条样本，是最大的公开可用日语原生图像-文本数据集；WAON-Bench 覆盖 374 类。用 WAON 微调的模型在日本文化基准上一致优于用英译日数据微调的模型；匹配规模、过滤与训练预算的受控实验（两个模型家族）指向原生网页来源是增益主因。
Conclusion: 全球预训练不足以替代原生数据适配：在同等训练预算下，原生日语网页来源本身（而非数据规模或过滤）驱动了日本文化理解的提升；数据集、基准、模型与代码均已发布。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 构建 WAON：从 Common Crawl 的日语原生网页内容抽取约 1.55 亿条图像-文本对；人工整理 WAON-Bench，覆盖 374 个日本文化类别；在多个日语图像-文本数据集上做对比微调实验，并在两个模型家族上以匹配的规模、过滤与训练预算做受控实验，区分数据来源与规模的影响。
summary_sections.result: WAON 约 1.55 亿条样本，是最大的公开可用日语原生图像-文本数据集；WAON-Bench 覆盖 374 类。用 WAON 微调的模型在日本文化基准上一致优于用英译日数据微调的模型；匹配规模、过滤与训练预算的受控实验（两个模型家族）指向原生网页来源是增益主因。
summary_sections.conclusion: 全球预训练不足以替代原生数据适配：在同等训练预算下，原生日语网页来源本身（而非数据规模或过滤）驱动了日本文化理解的提升；数据集、基准、模型与代码均已发布。

papers.title: Performance Evaluation of Ising and QUBO Variable Encodings in Boltzmann Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: We compare Ising ({-1, +1}) and QUBO ({0, 1}) encodings for Boltzmann machine learning under controlled protocols that fix the sampler, optimizer, and learning-rate design within each comparison. Exploiting the identity that the Fisher information matrix (FIM) equals the covariance of sufficient statistics, we visualize empirical moments from model samples and reveal systematic, representation-dependent differences. QUBO induces larger cross terms between first- and second-order statistics, creating more small-eigenvalue directions in the FIM and lowering spectral entropy. This ill-conditioning explains slower convergence under stochastic gradient descent (SGD). In contrast, full-FIM natural gradient descent (NGD), which rescales updates by the FIM metric, achieves similar convergence across encodings, whereas diagonal-FIM approximation can reintroduce representation-dependent differences. Practically, for SGD-based training, the Ising encoding provides more isotropic curvature and faster convergence; for QUBO, centering/scaling or NGD-style preconditioning mitigates curvature pathologies. These results clarify how representation shapes information geometry and finite-time learning dynamics in Boltzmann machines and yield actionable guidelines for variable encoding and preprocessing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在固定采样器、优化器与学习率的对照协议下比较 Ising {-1,+1} 与 QUBO {0,1} 编码的 Boltzmann 机学习：QUBO 使一阶与二阶统计量之间的交叉项更大，在 Fisher 信息矩阵 (FIM) 中制造更多小特征值方向、降低谱熵，病态条件导致 SGD 收敛更慢。结论是 SGD 训练选 Ising 编码以获得更各向同性的曲率，QUBO 则需中心化/缩放或 NGD 式预条件来缓解曲率病态。
Motivation: 变量编码如何改变 Boltzmann 机的信息几何与有限时间学习动力学尚不清楚，而 SGD 训练中出现的收敛差异需要一个可解释的几何机制。
Method: 在固定采样器、优化器与学习率设计的对照协议下比较两种编码；利用 FIM 等于充分统计量协方差这一恒等式，从模型样本可视化经验矩，并对比 SGD、full-FIM natural gradient descent (NGD) 与 diagonal-FIM 近似三种训练方式。
Result: QUBO 编码产生更大的一阶与二阶统计量交叉项，在 FIM 中形成更多小特征值方向并降低谱熵，对应 SGD 下更慢的收敛；full-FIM NGD 在两种编码上收敛相近，而 diagonal-FIM 近似会重新引入依赖表示的差异。
Conclusion: 表示形式通过 FIM 曲率决定 Boltzmann 机的收敛快慢：SGD 场景应选 Ising 编码，QUBO 需配合中心化/缩放或 NGD 式预条件。

papers.title: Error Propagation in Dynamic Programming: From Stochastic Control to American Option Pricing
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates theoretical and methodological foundations for stochastic optimal control (SOC) in discrete time. We start formulating the control problem in a general dynamic programming framework, introducing the mathematical structure needed for a detailed convergence analysis. The associate value function is estimated through a sequence of approximations combining nonparametric regression methods and Monte Carlo subsampling. The regression step is performed within reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces (RKHSs), exploiting the classical KRR algorithm, while Monte Carlo sampling methods are introduced to estimate the continuation value. To assess the accuracy of our value function estimator, we propose a natural error decomposition and rigorously control the resulting error terms at each time step. We then analyze how this error propagates backward in time-from maturity to the initial stage-a relatively underexplored aspect of the SOC literature. Finally, we illustrate how our analysis naturally applies to a key financial application: the pricing of American options.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在离散时间随机最优控制 (SOC) 的动态规划框架下，用 RKHS 非参数回归 (KRR) 加 Monte Carlo 子采样估计值函数，并给出逐步误差分解，证明误差从到期日向初始阶段反向传播的可控性，最后把该分析应用到美式期权定价。
Motivation: 随机最优控制的值函数估计误差如何随时间步反向传播，在 SOC 文献中较少被系统研究，缺少逐步误差分解与严格控制手段。
Method: 在一般动态规划框架中形式化控制问题；值函数用非参数回归与 Monte Carlo 子采样交替逼近，回归步骤在再生核 Hilbert 空间 (RKHS) 中用经典 KRR 算法，续值 (continuation value) 由 Monte Carlo 采样估计；提出自然的误差分解并逐步严格控制各误差项，再分析其从到期日到初始阶段的反向传播。
Result: 给出值函数估计器的误差分解并逐步严格控制各误差项，刻画误差从 maturity 到初始阶段的反向传播；分析应用于美式期权定价。
Conclusion: 值函数估计的误差可以在每个时间步被分解并严格控制，其反向传播规律可直接迁移到美式期权定价这一随机控制问题。

papers.title: The Percept-V Challenge: Can Multimodal LLMs Crack Simple Perception Problems?
papers.abstract_en: Cognitive science research treats visual perception, the ability to understand and make sense of a visual input, as one of the early developmental signs of intelligence. Its TVPS-4 framework categorizes and tests human perception into seven skills such as visual discrimination, and form constancy. Do Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) match up to humans in basic perception? Even though many benchmarks evaluate MLLMs on advanced reasoning and knowledge skills, there is limited research that focuses evaluation on simple perception. In response, we introduce Percept-V, a dataset containing 6000 program-generated uncontaminated images divided into 30 domains, where each domain tests one or more TVPS-4 skills. Our focus is on perception, so we make our domains quite simple and the reasoning and knowledge required for solving them are minimal. Since modern-day MLLMs can solve much more complex tasks, our a-priori expectation is that they will solve these domains very easily. Contrary to our belief, our experiments show a weak performance of SoTA proprietary and open-source MLLMs compared to very high human performance on Percept-V. We find that as the number of objects in the image increases, performance goes down rather fast. Our experiments also identify the perception skills that are considerably harder for all models. Fine-tuning an open-source MLLM shows considerable gains in performance, though the gains only marginally carry over to other related datasets, pointing to limitation in generalization abilities of the learned representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Percept-V 是一个由程序生成、无污染的 6000 张图像基准，按 TVPS-4 的七项知觉技能划分 30 个领域，专门测多模态大模型 (MLLM) 的基础视觉知觉而非推理。实验显示 SoTA 专有与开源模型表现远低于人类，且物体数量增加时性能快速下降；对开源模型微调虽有明显提升，但收益几乎不能迁移到相关数据集。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 基准集中在高阶推理与知识，缺少对简单知觉的评测，而认知科学视视觉知觉为智力的早期发展标志，因此无法判断模型是否具备人类水平的基础知觉能力。
Method: 构建 Percept-V：程序生成的 6000 张无污染图像，分 30 个领域，每个领域对应 TVPS-4 的一项或多项技能（如 visual discrimination、form constancy），刻意把推理与知识需求降到最低；对 SoTA 专有与开源 MLLM 做实验，并对一个开源 MLLM 做微调以检验泛化。
Result: SoTA 专有与开源 MLLM 在 Percept-V 上表现很弱，而人类表现非常高；图像中物体数量增加时模型性能下降相当快；实验识别出对所有模型都明显更难的知觉技能；微调开源 MLLM 带来可观性能提升，但收益仅小幅迁移到其他相关数据集。
Conclusion: 现代 MLLM 即使在推理与知识任务上很强，也未匹配人类的基础视觉知觉，且微调学到的表征泛化能力有限。

papers.title: EEGDM: Learning EEG Representation with Latent Diffusion Model
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in self-supervised learning for EEG representation have largely relied on masked reconstruction, where models are trained to recover randomly masked signal segments. While effective at modeling local dependencies, the training objective of masked reconstruction does not compel the model to capture global generative constraints essential for characterizing neural activity. To address this limitation, we propose EEGDM, a novel self-supervised framework that leverages latent diffusion models to generate EEG signals as an objective. Unlike masked reconstruction, diffusion-based generation progressively denoises signals from noise to realism, compelling the model to capture holistic temporal patterns and cross-channel relationships. Specifically, EEGDM incorporates an EEG encoder that distills raw signals and their channel augmentations into a compact representation, which serves as conditional information to guide the diffusion denoising process, thereby enabling the encoder and diffusion model to be jointly optimized through the generative objective. This design endows EEGDM with a compact latent space, which not only offers ample control over the generative process but also can be leveraged for downstream tasks. Experimental results show that EEGDM (1) reconstructs high-quality EEG signals, (2) learns robust representations, and (3) achieves competitive performance across diverse downstream tasks, thus exploring a new direction for self-supervised EEG representation learning.
papers.comment: This paper was accepted by IEEE Transactions on Biomedical Engineering
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Biomedical Engineering, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EEGDM 用潜空间扩散模型 (latent diffusion) 的生成目标替代掩码重建来学 EEG 表示：编码器把原始信号与通道增强蒸馏成紧凑表征，作为条件引导扩散去噪，两者联合优化。摘要报告其能重建高质量 EEG、学到鲁棒表示，并在多种下游任务上取得有竞争力的表现。
Motivation: 自监督 EEG 表示学习多依赖掩码重建，只建模局部依赖，训练目标不强迫模型捕捉刻画神经活动所需的全局生成约束。
Method: EEGDM 包含一个 EEG 编码器，将原始信号及其通道增强 (channel augmentations) 蒸馏为紧凑表征，该表征作为条件信息引导扩散去噪过程，使编码器与扩散模型通过生成目标联合优化，得到可用于下游任务的紧凑 latent space。
Result: 实验结果显示 EEGDM 能重建高质量 EEG 信号、学到鲁棒的表示，并在多种下游任务上取得有竞争力的性能；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 以扩散生成作为自监督目标是 EEG 表示学习的一个新方向，可同时得到可控的生成过程与可迁移的下游表征。

papers.title: A Sobel-Gradient MLP Baseline for Handwritten Character Recognition
papers.abstract_en: This study examines how much handwritten-character information is retained by a deliberately simple first-order edge representation. Instead of learning spatial filters, each input image is transformed by the fixed Sobel-Feldman operator into signed horizontal and vertical derivative maps, which are independently normalized, flattened, and classified by a multilayer perceptron (MLP). The resulting model therefore separates fixed edge extraction from learned classification and provides a controlled baseline for evaluating the sufficiency of first-order image gradients. In the executed experiments, the Sobel-gradient MLP achieves 98.54 percent test accuracy on MNIST and 92.50 percent on the TensorFlow Datasets (TFDS) EMNIST Letters configuration. Macro F1 scores are 0.9853 and 0.9265, respectively. One-vs-rest ROC analysis further yields micro/macro AUC values of 0.9998/0.9998 on MNIST and 0.9987/0.9982 on EMNIST Letters. Confusion-matrix analysis shows that the remaining errors are concentrated among geometrically similar classes, especially 3/8 and 4/9 for MNIST and I/L and G/Q for EMNIST Letters. These results show that fixed first-order gradients preserve substantial class-discriminative structure, while also revealing the specific ambiguities that remain when recognition is driven by edge geometry alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 固定 Sobel-Feldman 算子提取有符号水平/垂直一阶导数图，独立归一化后展平送入 MLP 分类，MNIST 测试准确率 98.54%、EMNIST Letters 92.50%。误差集中在几何相似类（MNIST 的 3/8、4/9，EMNIST 的 I/L、G/Q），说明仅靠边缘几何仍留下这些歧义。
Motivation: 需要一个受控基线来判断一阶图像梯度本身保留了多少类别判别信息，把固定边缘提取与可学习分类分开评估。
Method: 每张输入图先经固定 Sobel-Feldman 算子转成有符号水平与垂直导数图，分别独立归一化后展平，再由多层 perceptron (MLP) 分类；不学习空间滤波器。
Result: MNIST 测试准确率 98.54%，TFDS EMNIST Letters 92.50%；Macro F1 分别为 0.9853 与 0.9265；one-vs-rest ROC 的 micro/macro AUC 在 MNIST 为 0.9998/0.9998，在 EMNIST Letters 为 0.9987/0.9982。混淆矩阵显示错误集中在几何相似类：MNIST 的 3/8、4/9，EMNIST 的 I/L、G/Q。
Conclusion: 固定一阶梯度保留了大量类别判别结构，可作为评估边缘几何充分性的受控基线；仅靠边缘几何时几何相似类的歧义仍然存在。

papers.title: Can SGD Handle Heavy-Tailed Noise?
papers.abstract_en: Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) is a cornerstone of large-scale optimization, yet its theoretical behavior under heavy-tailed noise -- common in modern machine learning and reinforcement learning -- remains poorly understood. In this work, we rigorously investigate whether vanilla SGD, devoid of any adaptive modifications, can provably succeed under such adverse stochastic conditions. Assuming only that stochastic gradients have bounded $p$-th moments for some $p \in (1, 2]$, we establish sharp convergence guarantees for (projected) SGD across convex, strongly convex, and non-convex problem classes. In particular, we show that SGD achieves minimax optimal sample complexity under minimal assumptions in the convex and strongly convex regimes: $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-\frac{p}{p-1}})$ and $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-\frac{p}{2(p-1)}})$, respectively. For non-convex objectives, under standard smoothness and a bounded central $p$-th moment, we prove convergence to a stationary point with $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-\frac{2p}{p-1}})$ complexity, and complement this with a matching SGD-specific lower bound, showing that this rate cannot be improved by any deterministic positive non-increasing step-size schedule. These results challenge the prevailing view that heavy-tailed noise renders SGD ineffective, and establish vanilla SGD as a robust and theoretically principled baseline -- even in regimes where the variance is unbounded.
papers.comment: 40 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Extended version of a paper accepted for publication in the SIAM Journal on Optimization
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在随机梯度仅有有界 p 阶矩（p∈(1,2]，方差可无穷）的重尾噪声下，原版 SGD 仍可证明收敛：凸与强凸问题分别达到极小极大最优样本复杂度 O(ε^{-p/(p-1)}) 与 O(ε^{-p/(2(p-1))})，非凸在光滑性加有界中心 p 阶矩下以 O(ε^{-2p/(p-1)}) 收敛到驻点。非凸速率有匹配的 SGD 特定下界，任何确定性非增步长调度都无法改进，从而反驳“重尾噪声使 SGD 失效”的流行看法。
Motivation: 现代机器学习与强化学习中梯度噪声常呈重尾、方差无界，而 SGD 在此条件下的理论行为长期不清楚，主流观点认为必须改用自适应或鲁棒化变体才有效。
Method: 仅假设随机梯度存在有界 p 阶矩（p∈(1,2]），对（投影）SGD 在凸、强凸、非凸三类问题上推导收敛保证；非凸情形额外要求标准光滑性与有界中心 p 阶矩，并构造 SGD 特定的匹配下界。
Result: 凸情形样本复杂度 O(ε^{-p/(p-1)})、强凸 O(ε^{-p/(2(p-1))})，均为极小极大最优；非凸情形收敛到驻点的复杂度为 O(ε^{-2p/(p-1)})，且该速率不能被任何确定性非增步长调度改进。
Conclusion: 无需任何自适应修改的原版 SGD 在方差无界的重尾体制下仍是稳健且有理论依据的基线，重尾噪声并不使 SGD 失效。

papers.title: Mitigating Watermark Forgery in Generative Models via Randomized Key Selection
papers.abstract_en: Watermarking enables GenAI providers to verify whether content was generated by their models. A watermark is a hidden signal in the content, whose presence can be detected using a secret watermark key. A core security threat are forgery attacks, where adversaries insert the provider's watermark into content \emph{not} produced by the provider, potentially damaging their reputation and undermining trust. Existing defenses resist forgery by embedding many watermarks with multiple keys into the same content, which can degrade model utility. However, forgery remains a threat when attackers can collect sufficiently many watermarked samples. We propose a defense with a sample-count-independent upper bound on forgery success for blind attackers, conditional on key-symmetric, independent detector outcomes. Our scheme does not further degrade model utility. We randomize the watermark key selection for each query and accept content as genuine only if a watermark is detected by \emph{exactly} one key. Unlike cryptographic watermarks that rely on computational hardness assumptions and require designing new watermarking schemes from scratch, our method can be applied to any existing watermarking method to improve its forgery resistance. We focus on text watermarking, but our defense is modality-agnostic, since it treats the underlying watermarking method as a black-box. To show this, we include a preliminary study on image watermarking using Tree-Ring. Separately from this conditional guarantee, we empirically observe that, at $r=4$ keys, harmful-text forgery success drops from as high as $87\%$ with a single key to as low as $1\%$ against the adaptive blind attackers that we evaluate, at negligible computational overhead; a preliminary image study shows a reduction from $100\%$ to $2\%$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对生成模型水印的伪造攻击，提出每次查询随机选择水印密钥、且仅当恰好一个密钥检出时才判为真内容的防御；在密钥对称、检测结果独立的条件下，对盲攻击者的伪造成功率给出与采样次数无关的上界，且不进一步损害模型效用。在所评估的自适应盲攻击者下，r=4 个密钥使有害文本伪造成功率从单密钥最高 87% 降到最低 1%，图像（Tree-Ring）初步研究从 100% 降到 2%，计算开销可忽略。
Motivation: 伪造者可把提供方水印插入非本方生成的内容以损害声誉；现有防御靠同一内容嵌入多密钥水印，会降低模型效用，且攻击者收集足够多带水印样本后伪造仍然可行。
Method: 每次查询随机选择水印密钥，仅当恰好一个密钥检出水印时才接受为真内容；该方案把底层水印方法当黑盒，可叠加到任意现有文本水印上，也无需依赖计算困难假设。给出条件化保证：密钥对称且检测结果独立时，对盲攻击者存在与样本数无关的伪造成功率上界。
Result: 在所评估的自适应盲攻击者下，r=4 时有害文本伪造成功率从单密钥的最高 87% 降至最低 1%，计算开销可忽略；图像水印（Tree-Ring）初步研究中伪造成功率从 100% 降至 2%。
Conclusion: 随机密钥选择加“恰好一个密钥检出”的判定，可在不牺牲模型效用的前提下提升对盲攻击者的伪造抗性，且作为黑盒防御适用于任意现有水印方法与不同模态。

papers.title: Estimating prevalence with precision and accuracy
papers.abstract_en: Unlike classification, whose goal is to estimate the class of each data point, quantification (or prevalence estimation) aims to estimate the distribution of classes in a dataset. An important task in prevalence estimation is to quantify the uncertainty in prevalence estimates. In this paper, we introduce Precise Quantifier (PQ), a Bayesian aggregative quantifier that achieves narrow prediction intervals with sufficient coverage (i.e., sufficient proportion of intervals containing the true prevalence). We find that PQ produces more precise prevalence estimates than existing methods as the discriminative power of the underlying classifier increases and as the validation-to-test size ratio increases. These empirical results suggest that PQ uses validation information more effectively to quantify uncertainty in prevalence estimates than existing approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Bayesian 聚合式量化器 Precise Quantifier (PQ)，用于在分类器输出之上估计数据集的类别分布（prevalence）并给出带覆盖率保证的窄预测区间。随着底层分类器判别力增强、验证集与测试集规模比增大，PQ 的 prevalence 估计比现有方法更精确，说明它更有效地利用验证集信息量化不确定性。
Motivation: 分类只给每个样本贴标签，quantification（prevalence estimation）要估计整体类别分布，而其核心难点是给估计量配上既窄又有足够覆盖率的不确定性区间；现有方法对验证集信息利用不足。
Method: PQ 是 Bayesian aggregative quantifier：把底层分类器的判别输出与验证集信息做贝叶斯聚合，输出 prevalence 点估计与预测区间，并以覆盖率（区间包含真实 prevalence 的比例）作为区间质量判据。
Result: 经验结果显示 PQ 比现有方法给出更精确的 prevalence 估计，且精度随底层分类器判别力提升、随 validation-to-test size 比提升而提高；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为 PQ 比现有方法更有效地利用验证集信息来量化 prevalence 估计的不确定性，其优势在分类器更强、验证集相对更大时更明显。

papers.title: Coupled reaction and diffusion governing interface evolution in solid-state batteries
papers.abstract_en: Understanding and controlling the atomistic-level reactions governing the formation of the solid-electrolyte interphase (SEI) is crucial for the viability of next-generation solid state batteries. However, challenges persist due to difficulties in experimentally characterizing buried interfaces and limits in simulation speed and accuracy. We conduct large-scale explicit reactive simulations with quantum accuracy for a symmetric battery cell, {\symcell}, enabled by active learning and deep equivariant neural network interatomic potentials. To automatically characterize the coupled reactions and interdiffusion at the interface, we formulate and use unsupervised classification techniques based on clustering in the space of local atomic environments. Our analysis reveals the formation of a previously unreported crystalline disordered phase, Li$_2$S$_{0.72}$P$_{0.14}$Cl$_{0.14}$, in the SEI, that evaded previous predictions based purely on thermodynamics, underscoring the importance of explicit modeling of full reaction and transport kinetics. Our simulations agree with and explain experimental observations of the SEI formations and elucidate the Li creep mechanisms, critical to dendrite initiation, characterized by significant Li motion along the interface. Our approach is to crease a digital twin from first principles, without adjustable parameters fitted to experiment. As such, it offers capabilities to gain insights into atomistic dynamics governing complex heterogeneous processes in solid-state synthesis and electrochemistry.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用主动学习训练的深度等变神经网络势做固态电池对称电池的大规模显式反应分子动力学，发现 SEI 中出现此前未报道的结晶无序相 Li2S0.72P0.14Cl0.14，纯热力学预测漏掉了它。基于局域原子环境聚类的无监督分类自动刻画界面耦合反应与互扩散，并复现实验观测到的 SEI 形成与 Li 蠕变（枝晶起始关键的界面 Li 运动）。
Motivation: 埋藏界面难以实验表征，模拟速度与精度受限，使 SEI 形成的原子级反应难以被刻画；纯热力学判据会漏掉动力学驱动的新相。
Method: 对对称电池单元做大规模显式反应模拟，精度对齐量子力学，靠主动学习与深度等变神经网络原子间势 (deep equivariant neural network interatomic potentials) 加速；用基于局域原子环境聚类的无监督分类自动识别界面耦合反应与互扩散，全程不拟合实验可调参数，构建第一性原理数字孪生。
Result: 发现 SEI 中新结晶无序相 Li2S0.72P0.14Cl0.14，纯热力学预测未给出；模拟结果与实验观测到的 SEI 形成一致，并刻画出枝晶起始关键的 Li 沿界面显著运动（Li creep 机制）。
Conclusion: 显式建模完整反应与输运动力学（而非仅热力学）才能预测固态电池界面新相并解释实验，第一性原理数字孪生可不依赖实验拟合参数给出可解释的原子级机制。

papers.title: Robust Adversarial Quantification via Conflict-Aware Evidential Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reliability of deep learning models is critical for deployment in high-stakes applications, where out-of-distribution or adversarial inputs may lead to detrimental outcomes. Evidential Deep Learning, an efficient paradigm for uncertainty quantification, models predictions as Dirichlet distributions of a single forward pass. However, EDL is particularly vulnerable to adversarially perturbed inputs, making overconfident errors. Conflict-aware Evidential Deep Learning~\mbox{(C-EDL)} is a lightweight post-hoc uncertainty quantification approach that mitigates these issues, enhancing adversarial and OOD robustness without retraining. C-EDL generates diverse, task-preserving transformations per input and quantifies representational disagreement to calibrate uncertainty estimates when needed. C-EDL's conflict-aware prediction adjustment improves detection of OOD and adversarial inputs, maintaining high in-distribution accuracy and low computational overhead. Our experimental evaluation shows that C-EDL significantly outperforms state-of-the-art EDL variants and competitive baselines, achieving substantial reductions in coverage for OOD data (up to $\approx55\%$) and adversarial data (up to $\approx90\%$), across a range of datasets, attack types, and uncertainty metrics.
papers.comment: Updated to the published ICLR 2026 version, including revised title. Published version: https://iclr.cc/virtual/2026/poster/10011775
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出冲突感知证据深度学习 (C-EDL)：对每个输入生成保持任务语义的多样化变换，量化表征分歧，在需要时校准不确定性，并做冲突感知的预测调整，从而在不重训的前提下缓解 EDL 在对抗与 OOD 输入上的过度自信。实验中 OOD 数据 coverage 降低约 55%，对抗数据降低约 90%，同时保持高 in-distribution 精度与低计算开销。
Motivation: 高风险部署中模型面对 OOD 或对抗输入会给出过度自信的错误；Evidential Deep Learning 虽只需一次前向即得 Dirichlet 分布，却对对抗扰动特别脆弱。
Method: C-EDL 是轻量的 post-hoc 不确定性量化方法：为每个输入生成多样且保持任务的变换，量化表征分歧以在需要时校准不确定性估计，再用冲突感知的预测调整改进 OOD 与对抗输入检测，全程无需重训。
Result: 在多数据集、多种攻击类型与多种不确定性指标上，OOD 数据 coverage 降低约 55%，对抗数据 coverage 降低约 90%；同时保持高 in-distribution 精度与低计算开销，并显著优于 state-of-the-art EDL 变体与竞争性基线。
Conclusion: 不重训的冲突感知后处理即可同时提升 EDL 的对抗与 OOD 鲁棒性，并维持 in-distribution 精度与低开销。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.tldr: 提出冲突感知证据深度学习 (C-EDL)：对每个输入生成保持任务语义的多样化变换，量化表征分歧，在需要时校准不确定性，并做冲突感知的预测调整，从而在不重训的前提下缓解 EDL 在对抗与 OOD 输入上的过度自信。实验中 OOD 数据 coverage 降低约 55%，对抗数据降低约 90%，同时保持高 in-distribution 精度与低计算开销。

papers.title: Evaluating the Retrieval Robustness of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) generally enhances large language models' (LLMs) ability to solve knowledge-intensive tasks. But RAG could also lead to performance degradation due to imperfect retrieval and the model's limited ability to leverage retrieved content. In this work, we evaluate the robustness of LLMs in practical RAG setups (henceforth retrieval robustness). We focus on three research questions: (1) whether RAG is always better than non-RAG; (2) whether more retrieved documents always lead to better performance; and (3) whether document order impacts results. To facilitate this study, we establish a benchmark of 1,891 samples spanning five datasets across three task categories, each with documents retrieved using both sparse and dense retrievers. We introduce three robustness metrics, each corresponding to one research question. Our experiments across 11 LLMs show that models achieve generally high retrieval robustness, but robustness varies substantially across tasks, suggesting that the decision to adopt RAG remains a case-by-case consideration. We further examine four additional prompting strategies that vary how models interact with retrieved documents. We find that Qwen and GPT models suffer notable robustness declines when reasoning is disabled, even on single-hop QA tasks, and that providing retrieved documents as tool responses improves Claude models but hurts Qwen and GPT models, highlighting potential issues of the GPT models regardless of their best overall robustness under vanilla prompting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该工作建立 RAG 检索鲁棒性基准（1,891 样本、5 数据集、3 任务类别，稀疏与稠密检索各一份），提出三个鲁棒性指标分别回答 RAG 是否总优于非 RAG、文档数是否越多越好、文档顺序是否影响结果。在 11 个 LLM 上实验显示整体鲁棒性较高但任务间差异明显，RAG 采纳仍需逐任务判断；关闭推理会让 Qwen 与 GPT 在单跳 QA 上鲁棒性明显下降，把检索文档作为 tool response 提供能改善 Claude 却损害 Qwen 与 GPT。
Motivation: RAG 因检索不完美和模型利用能力有限反而可能让性能变差，而实践中缺少系统证据回答 RAG 是否总是更好、文档数量与顺序是否影响结果。
Method: 构建覆盖 5 个数据集、3 个任务类别的 1,891 样本基准，每个样本分别用稀疏与稠密 retriever 取文档；针对三个研究问题各定义一个鲁棒性指标，在 11 个 LLM 上实验，并额外考察 4 种改变模型与检索文档交互方式的 prompting 策略。
Result: 11 个 LLM 上模型整体检索鲁棒性较高，但鲁棒性在任务间差异显著；Qwen 与 GPT 在关闭 reasoning 时鲁棒性明显下降，即使在单跳 QA 上也是如此；以 tool response 形式提供检索文档改善 Claude，却损害 Qwen 与 GPT，而 GPT 在 vanilla prompting 下整体鲁棒性最好。
Conclusion: 是否采用 RAG 是逐任务的判断，且模型与检索文档的交互方式（是否推理、是否以 tool response 呈现）会显著改变鲁棒性，GPT 系列在这些交互路径上存在隐患。

papers.title: Asymptotic Performance of Time-Varying Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Time-Varying Bayesian Optimization (TVBO) is the go-to framework for optimizing a time-varying black-box objective function that may be noisy and expensive to evaluate, but its excellent empirical performance remains to be understood theoretically. Is it possible for the instantaneous regret of a TVBO algorithm to vanish asymptotically, and if so, when? We answer this question of great importance by providing upper bounds and algorithm-independent lower bounds for the cumulative regret of TVBO algorithms. In doing so, we provide important insights about the TVBO framework and derive sufficient conditions for a TVBO algorithm to have the no-regret property. To the best of our knowledge, our analysis is the first to cover all major classes of stationary kernel functions used in practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对时变黑箱目标的 Time-Varying Bayesian Optimization (TVBO) 给出累积 regret 的上界与算法无关的下界，并导出瞬时 regret 渐近消失（no-regret）的充分条件。分析覆盖实践中使用的全部主要平稳 kernel 函数类别，是该框架下首个做到这一点的理论结果。
Motivation: TVBO 在时变、含噪且评估昂贵的黑箱优化中经验表现好，但其理论性质不清楚：瞬时 regret 能否渐近消失、在什么条件下消失，此前缺少答案。
Method: 为 TVBO 算法推导累积 regret 的上界，并给出不依赖具体算法的下界；由此归纳出保证 no-regret 性质的充分条件，覆盖实践中全部主要平稳 kernel 类别。
Result: 给出 TVBO 累积 regret 的上界与算法无关的下界，以及瞬时 regret 渐近为零的充分条件；分析范围为全部主要平稳 kernel 函数类别，属首个覆盖该范围的理论工作。
Conclusion: TVBO 的 no-regret 可以在明确的充分条件下成立，且这些条件对主要平稳 kernel 普遍适用，为理解该框架的经验表现提供理论依据。

papers.title: Hybrid Reasoning Systems That Prioritize and Enhance Human Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: In a world of accelerating change, there is a need for wise and adaptive human reasoning. Integrating AI capabilities with human guidance offers promise, though human reasoning itself is often hasty, shortsighted, and error-prone, and no clear framework exists for combining human reasoning strategies with AI across diverse tasks. This article proposes a framework for human-centered hybrid reasoning systems that engage and enhance human reasoning abilities ranging from granular data analysis to high-level reflection and wisdom. The framework was developed through a conceptual synthesis combining: (1) established strategies for enhancing human reasoning, (2) AI design approaches that favor pre-conclusive engagement over the generation of conclusions, and (3) the treatment of reasoning as a collection of distinct, individually supportable modes. This synthesis produced a distinctive framework for broad-spectrum reasoning enhancement from which a typology of reasoning modes, a system architecture, and a high-level research agenda were derived.
papers.comment: 20 pages; 6 figures; 2 tables. This paper underwent significant extension and revision from prior archived version
papers.journal_ref: International Journal of Human Computer Interaction, Page 1 to 19 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出以人为中心的混合推理系统框架，把推理拆成可单独支撑的模式类型，用偏向「先参与再下结论」而非直接给结论的 AI 设计来增强人的判断。框架由三条线索的概念综合导出：增强人类推理的既有策略、偏好 pre-conclusive engagement 的 AI 设计、以及把推理视为多种可独立支撑模式的处理方式，最终产出推理模式类型学、系统架构与研究议程。
Motivation: 人类推理常显仓促、短视且易错，AI 与人的结合又缺少跨任务的清晰组合框架，需要一个能从细粒度数据分析一直覆盖到高层反思与智慧的组织方式。
Method: 通过概念综合 (conceptual synthesis) 构建框架：整合增强人类推理的既有策略、强调 pre-conclusive engagement 而非直接生成结论的 AI 设计取向、以及将推理视为一组可独立支撑模式的观点；再由此推导推理模式类型学 (typology)、系统架构与高层研究议程。
Result: 产出为概念性成果：一套覆盖从细粒度数据分析到高层反思与智慧的广谱推理增强框架，以及由其派生的推理模式类型学、系统架构和研究议程；论文为 20 页、6 图、2 表，发表于 International Journal of Human Computer Interaction (2026)。
Conclusion: 把推理显式拆成可分别支撑的模式、并让 AI 优先促成人的参与而非代出结论，是跨任务组织人机混合推理的可行框架。

papers.title: A Polynomial-Time Algorithm for Variational Inequalities under the Minty Condition
papers.abstract_en: Solving (Stampacchia) variational inequalities (SVIs) is a foundational problem at the heart of optimization. However, this expressivity comes at the cost of computational hardness. As a result, most research has focused on carving out specific subclasses that elude those intractability barriers. A classical property that goes back to the 1960s is the Minty condition, which postulates that the Minty VI (MVI) problem admits a solution. In this paper, we establish the first polynomial-time algorithm -- with complexity growing polynomially in the dimension $d$ and $\log(1/ε)$ -- for solving $ε$-SVIs for Lipschitz continuous mappings under the Minty condition. Prior approaches either incurred an exponentially worse dependence on $1/ε$ (and other natural parameters of the problem) or made more restrictive assumptions, such as monotonicity. To do so, we introduce a new variant of the ellipsoid algorithm whereby separating hyperplanes are obtained after taking a descent step from the center of the ellipsoid. It succeeds even though the set of SVIs can be nonconvex and not fully dimensional. Moreover, when our algorithm is applied to an instance with no MVI solution and fails to identify an SVI solution, it produces a succinct certificate of MVI infeasibility. We also show that deciding whether the Minty condition holds is $\mathsf{coNP}$-complete, thereby establishing that the disjunction of those two problems is polynomial-time solvable even though each problem is individually intractable. We provide several extensions and new applications of our main results. Most notably, we obtain the first polynomial-time algorithms for computing Nash equilibria in multi-player harmonic games. Finally, in two-player general-sum concave games, we give the first polynomial-time algorithm that outputs either a Nash equilibrium or a strict coarse correlated equilibrium.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Minty 条件下，Lipschitz 映射的 ε-Stampacchia 变分不等式 (SVI) 首次获得多项式时间算法，复杂度对维数 d 和 log(1/ε) 多项式增长。算法是改进的椭球法：分离超平面取自椭球中心的下降步，即使 SVI 解集非凸、非满维也成立；若实例无 MVI 解则输出 MVI 不可行的简短证书。判定 Minty 条件是否成立是 coNP-完全的，但两者的析取问题仍可在多项式时间内求解。
Motivation: SVI 表达力强但计算上难解，既有工作只能在单调性等更强假设下或以对 1/ε 指数级的复杂度求解，Minty 条件这一经典情形长期缺少多项式算法。
Method: 提出椭球算法的新变体：从椭球中心做一步下降后再取分离超平面，从而在 SVI 解集可能非凸、非满维时仍能推进；算法成功则给出 ε-SVI 解，失败则产出 MVI 不可行的简短证书。
Result: 首个对 Lipschitz 映射在 Minty 条件下求解 ε-SVI 的多项式时间算法，复杂度对 d 与 log(1/ε) 多项式；此前方法对 1/ε 及其他参数指数级更差或要求单调性。判定 Minty 条件成立为 coNP-完全。应用包括多玩家 harmonic games 求 Nash 均衡的首个多项式算法，以及两人一般和凹博弈中输出 Nash 均衡或严格 coarse correlated 均衡的首个多项式算法。
Conclusion: Minty 条件下的 SVI 虽然单个判定问题各自难解，但「求解或给出不可行证书」的析取形式是多项式可解的，并可直接转化为博弈论中 Nash 均衡计算的多项式算法。

papers.title: Towards Unified Music Emotion Recognition across Dimensional and Categorical Models
papers.abstract_en: One of the most significant challenges in Music Emotion Recognition (MER) comes from the fact that emotion labels can be heterogeneous across datasets with regard to the emotion representation, including categorical (e.g., happy, sad) versus dimensional labels (e.g., valence-arousal). In this paper, we present a unified multitask learning framework that combines these two types of labels and is thus able to be trained on multiple datasets. This framework uses an effective input representation that combines musical features (i.e., key and chords) and MERT embeddings. Moreover, knowledge distillation is employed to transfer the knowledge of teacher models trained on individual datasets to a student model, enhancing its ability to generalize across multiple tasks. To validate our proposed framework, we conducted extensive experiments on a variety of datasets, including MTG-Jamendo, DEAM, PMEmo, and EmoMusic. According to our experimental results, the inclusion of musical features, multitask learning, and knowledge distillation significantly enhances performance. In particular, our model outperforms the state-of-the-art models, including the best-performing model from the MediaEval 2021 competition on the MTG-Jamendo dataset. Our work makes a significant contribution to MER by allowing the combination of categorical and dimensional emotion labels in one unified framework, thus enabling training across datasets.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of ICPR, 2026, Lyon, France
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出统一的多任务学习框架，把分类标签（happy/sad）与维度标签（valence-arousal）放进同一模型跨数据集训练：输入融合音乐特征（key、chords）与 MERT embedding，再用知识蒸馏把各数据集上单独训练的教师模型迁移到学生模型。在 MTG-Jamendo、DEAM、PMEmo、EmoMusic 上，加入音乐特征、多任务学习与知识蒸馏均显著提升性能，MTG-Jamendo 上超过 MediaEval 2021 竞赛的最佳模型。
Motivation: 音乐情感识别 (MER) 的核心障碍是各数据集的情感标签异构：有的用分类标签，有的用 valence-arousal 维度标签，导致模型难以跨数据集联合训练与泛化。
Method: 统一多任务学习框架同时建模分类与维度两类标签；输入表示把音乐特征（key、chords）与 MERT embedding 结合；用知识蒸馏把在单个数据集上训练的教师模型知识转移到学生模型，以增强跨任务泛化能力。
Result: 在 MTG-Jamendo、DEAM、PMEmo、EmoMusic 多个数据集上的实验表明，加入音乐特征、多任务学习与知识蒸馏均显著提升性能；在 MTG-Jamendo 上超过包括 MediaEval 2021 竞赛最佳模型在内的 state-of-the-art 模型。
Conclusion: 分类与维度情感标签可以在一个统一框架内合并，从而支持跨数据集训练，并在 MER 任务上取得优于现有模型的表现。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.tldr: 提出统一的多任务学习框架，把分类标签（happy/sad）与维度标签（valence-arousal）放进同一模型跨数据集训练：输入融合音乐特征（key、chords）与 MERT embedding，再用知识蒸馏把各数据集上单独训练的教师模型迁移到学生模型。在 MTG-Jamendo、DEAM、PMEmo、EmoMusic 上，加入音乐特征、多任务学习与知识蒸馏均显著提升性能，MTG-Jamendo 上超过 MediaEval 2021 竞赛的最佳模型。

papers.title: Geodesic vortex detection on curved surfaces: Analyzing the 2002 austral stratospheric polar vortex warming event
papers.abstract_en: Geodesic vortex detection is a tool in nonlinear dynamical systems to objectively identify transient vortices with flow-invariant boundaries that defy the typical deformation found in 2-d turbulence. Initially formulated for flows on the Euclidean plane with Cartesian coordinates, we have extended this technique to flows on 2-d Riemannian manifolds with arbitrary coordinates. This extension required the further formulation of the concept of objectivity on manifolds. Moreover, a recently proposed birth-and-death vortex framing algorithm, based on geodesic detection, has been adapted to address the limited temporal validity of 2-d motion in otherwise 3-d flows, like those found in the Earth's stratosphere. With these adaptations, we focused on the Lagrangian, i.e., kinematic, aspects of the austral stratospheric polar vortex during the exceptional sudden warming event of 2002, which resulted in the vortex splitting. This study involved applying geodesic vortex detection to isentropic winds from reanalysis data. We provide a detailed analysis of the vortex's life cycle, covering its birth, the splitting process, and its eventual death. In addition, we offer new kinematic insights into ozone depletion within the vortex.
papers.comment: This version clarifies the geometric interpretation of the map $\varphi$ and corrects typos introduced in the published version, particularly in Eqs. (17)--(18)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把平面的测地线涡旋检测 (geodesic vortex detection) 推广到任意坐标的二维 Riemannian 流形，并改造 birth-and-death 涡旋框架以适配三维大气中二维运动时间有效性受限的问题，用于 2002 年南极平流层极地涡旋突然增温分裂事件。基于再分析资料的等熵风场，给出涡旋从生成、分裂到消亡的完整拉格朗日生命史，并给出涡旋内臭氧损耗的新运动学认识。
Motivation: 客观涡旋识别原本只在欧氏平面笛卡尔坐标下成立，无法直接用于球面等弯曲流形上的大气流动；而二维运动判据在三维平流层中时间有效性有限，使极地涡旋这类瞬变结构的客观追踪困难。
Method: 将测地线涡旋检测从欧氏平面扩展到任意坐标的二维 Riemannian 流形，并在流形上重新定义 objectivity 概念；把近期提出的基于测地检测的 birth-and-death 涡旋框架改造为可处理三维流动中二维运动的有限时间有效性；随后应用于再分析资料的等熵 (isentropic) 风场。
Result: 在 2002 年异常突然增温事件中完整重建南极平流层极地涡旋的生成、分裂与消亡生命史；该事件导致涡旋分裂，并给出涡旋内部臭氧损耗的新运动学见解。
Conclusion: 测地线涡旋检测连同 birth-and-death 框架可迁移到弯曲流形坐标系，用于客观刻画平流层极地涡旋的拉格朗日生命史及其与臭氧损耗的运动学联系。

papers.title: Textualized and Feature-based Models for Compound Multimodal Emotion Recognition in the Wild
papers.abstract_en: Systems for multimodal emotion recognition (ER) are commonly trained to extract features from different modalities (e.g., visual, audio, and textual) that are combined to predict individual basic emotions. However, compound emotions often occur in real-world scenarios, and the uncertainty of recognizing such complex emotions over diverse modalities is challenging for feature-based models. As an alternative, emerging large language models (LLMs) like BERT and LLaMA can rely on explicit non-verbal cues that may be translated from different non-textual modalities (e.g., audio and visual) into text. Textualization of modalities augments data with emotional cues to help the LLM encode the interconnections between all modalities in a shared text space. In such text-based models, prior knowledge of ER tasks is leveraged to textualize relevant non-verbal cues such as audio tone from vocal expressions, and action unit intensity from facial expressions. Since the pre-trained weights are publicly available for many LLMs, training on large-scale datasets is unnecessary, allowing to fine-tune for downstream tasks such as compound ER (CER). This paper compares the potential of text- and feature-based approaches for compound multimodal ER in videos. Experiments were conducted on the challenging C-EXPR-DB dataset in the wild for CER, and contrasted with results on the MELD dataset for basic ER. Our results indicate that multimodal textualization provides lower accuracy than feature-based models on C-EXPR-DB, where text transcripts are captured in the wild. However, higher accuracy can be achieved when the video data has rich transcripts. Our code is available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把音频语调、面部动作单元强度等非语言线索转写成文本，交给 BERT/LLaMA 类 LLM 在共享文本空间做复合情绪识别 (CER)，并与传统特征融合模型对比。在野外 C-EXPR-DB 上文本化方法准确率低于特征基线，只有当视频文本转录本身丰富时文本化才取得更高准确率。
Motivation: 复合情绪在真实场景中常见，多模态不确定性使特征融合模型难以识别；需检验把非文本模态文本化后交给 LLM 是否可行。
Method: 将音频语调、面部动作单元强度等非语言线索文本化，用公开预训练权重的 BERT/LLaMA 微调做复合情绪识别，与特征融合模型对比；在 C-EXPR-DB（野外 CER）与 MELD（基础 ER）上实验。
Result: C-EXPR-DB 上多模态文本化准确率低于特征基线（该数据集转录为野外采集）；当视频数据转录丰富时文本化可取得更高准确率；MELD 用于基础 ER 结果对照。
Conclusion: 文本化对复合情绪识别的收益取决于转录质量：野外稀疏转录下不如特征融合，转录丰富时可反超。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Token Space: A Category Theory Framework for AI Computations
papers.abstract_en: Token Space is a categorical framework and mathematical language for AI computations. It connects internal relations, program descriptions, execution states and observations, locating questions about structure, behavior and cost at their appropriate levels. Five guiding positions concern structural interiors, categorical self-description, interfaces, occurrence identity and extensible computation. Tokens are finite records of carrier elements and fixed symbols; Token maps preserve selected heaps. The elementary category is a quasitopos, hence locally cartesian closed, but not a topos. Algebraic tokenization is fully faithful for fixed finitary signatures. Represented finite mappings admit concurrent graph execution, gluing, functorial frontiers and exact state migration characterized by kernel inclusion. Transformers are one implementation family. Coherent occurrence prefixes yield natural numerical maps, and a cache invariant proves agreement with full-prefix evaluation. A prescribed access policy determines the least retained index set under a no-reconstruction discipline. Parameterised state expresses changing interfaces. For a specified future-observation heap, structural indiscernibility is behavioral equivalence. An encoding admits exact incremental execution precisely when its kernel is a right congruence contained in that equivalence; every reachable exact realization maps uniquely onto the behavioral quotient. Teacher-induced heaps and declared readouts connect these constructions to distillation and explicit knowledge. The definitions, examples and theorems demonstrate how the language joins lines of reasoning while distinguishing representation, execution and observation. Effective implementations and quantitative performance remain further questions.
papers.comment: 125 pages, 25 figures, 17 tables. Expanded framework and computing-machine foundations, including compact evaluable representations (CERs), concurrent and elastic execution, exact retained-state compression, and LLM learning protocols and causal structure. Finite validation code and results included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Token Space 把 AI 计算写成范畴语言：token 是载体元素与固定符号的有限记录，token map 保持选定 heap，基本范畴是 quasitopos（局部笛卡尔闭但非 topos），代数 tokenization 对固定有限签名完全忠实。核心定理是：一个编码当且仅当其 kernel 是包含于行为等价的右同余时才允许精确增量执行，且每个可达精确实现唯一映射到行为商；缓存不变量保证前缀缓存与全前缀求值一致。作者明确把有效实现与定量性能留作后续问题。
Motivation: AI 计算中内部关系、程序描述、执行状态与观测混在同一层面，结构、行为与代价的问题无处安放；Transformer 等实现缺少刻画精确增量执行与状态迁移的数学条件。
Method: 以 token（有限记录）与保持 heap 的 token map 为对象，构造 quasitopos 基本范畴；对固定有限签名给出完全忠实的代数 tokenization；用 kernel inclusion 刻画精确状态迁移，用访问策略在 no-reconstruction 约束下求最小保留索引集；以 teacher-induced heap 与声明的 readout 连接蒸馏与显式知识。
Result: 给出的刻画性结论包括：精确增量执行当且仅当编码 kernel 是包含于结构不可分辨（行为等价）的右同余，且每个可达精确实现唯一映射到行为商；缓存不变量证明前缀缓存与全前缀求值一致；表示的有限映射支持并发图执行、gluing、functorial frontiers 与由 kernel inclusion 刻画的精确状态迁移。摘要未给出定量性能数字，作者称有效实现与定量性能是进一步的问题。
Conclusion: Token Space 提供一套区分表示、执行与观察三层的数学语言，把 Transformer 视为其中一个实现族；其主张是精确增量执行可由 kernel 的右同余条件完全刻画，而性能验证尚待后续工作。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Flexible Nonparametric Inference for Causal Effects under the Front-Door Model
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating causal treatment effects in observational studies requires addressing confounding. While the back-door criterion enables identification through adjustment for observed covariates, it fails in the presence of unmeasured confounding. The front-door criterion offers an alternative by leveraging variables that fully mediate the treatment effect and are unaffected by unmeasured confounders of the treatment-outcome pair. We develop novel one-step and targeted minimum loss-based estimators for both the average treatment effect and the average treatment effect on the treated under front-door assumptions. Our estimators are built on multiple parameterizations of the observed data distribution, including approaches that avoid modeling the mediator density entirely, and are compatible with flexible, machine learning-based nuisance estimation. We establish conditions for root-n consistency and asymptotic linearity by deriving second-order remainder bounds. We also develop flexible tests for assessing identification assumptions, including a doubly robust testing procedure, within a semiparametric extension of the front-door model that encodes generalized (Verma) independence constraints. We further show how these constraints can be leveraged to improve the efficiency of causal effect estimators. Simulation studies confirm favorable finite-sample performance, and real-data applications in education and emergency medicine illustrate the practical utility of our methods.
papers.journal_ref: Journal of the Royal Statistical Society Series B: Statistical Methodology, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在前门 (front-door) 因果模型下提出一步 (one-step) 与基于目标最小损失 (TMLE) 的估计量，用于观测性研究中存在未测混杂时的 ATE 与 ATT。估计量建立在观测数据分布的多种参数化之上（含完全避开中介密度建模的方案），兼容机器学习 nuisance 估计，并给出 root-n 一致性与渐近线性的二阶余项界。
Motivation: back-door 准则依赖观测协变量调整，遇到未测混杂即失效；前门准则虽可识别，但缺少能配合灵活机器学习 nuisance 估计、且带理论保证的高效估计与假设检验方法。
Method: 在前门假设下构造 one-step 与 TMLE 估计量，覆盖 ATE 与 ATT，并采用观测数据分布的多种参数化（部分完全不建模中介密度）；通过推导二阶余项界给出 root-n 一致性与渐近线性条件；在编码广义 (Verma) 独立约束的半参数前门模型扩展中，提出含双重稳健 (doubly robust) 检验的识别假设检验，并利用这些约束提升因果效应估计的效率。
Result: 模拟研究确认有限样本表现良好；教育与急诊医学两个真实数据应用展示了方法的实用价值。
Conclusion: 前门模型下可借助多参数化与灵活 nuisance 估计得到有理论保证的因果效应估计，且 Verma 独立约束既能检验识别假设又能反过来提高估计效率。

papers.title: VIDiff: Translating Videos via Multi-Modal Instructions with Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have achieved significant success in image and video generation. This motivates a growing interest in video editing tasks, where videos are edited according to provided text descriptions. However, most existing approaches only focus on video editing for short clips and rely on time-consuming tuning or inference. We are the first to propose Video Instruction Diffusion (VIDiff), a unified foundation model designed for a wide range of video tasks. These tasks encompass both understanding tasks (such as language-guided video object segmentation) and generative tasks (video editing and enhancement). Our model can edit and translate the desired results within seconds based on user instructions. Moreover, we design an iterative auto-regressive method to ensure consistency in editing and enhancing long videos. We provide convincing generative results for diverse input videos and written instructions, both qualitatively and quantitatively. More examples can be found at our website https://ChenHsing.github.io/VIDiff.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VIDiff 提出统一的视频指令扩散基础模型，用多模态指令同时驱动理解类任务（语言引导的视频目标分割）与生成类任务（视频编辑、增强），并以迭代自回归方式保持长视频编辑的一致性，可在数秒内按指令产出结果，无需耗时的逐视频调参。
Motivation: 现有视频编辑方法多局限于短片段，且依赖耗时的调参或推理过程，难以覆盖长视频与多样化的理解、生成任务。
Method: Video Instruction Diffusion (VIDiff) 以扩散模型为骨干，将文本等多模态指令作为条件统一处理分割、编辑、增强任务；另设计迭代自回归 (iterative auto-regressive) 方法逐段生成以保证长视频的编辑与增强一致性。
Result: 在多种输入视频与书面指令上给出定性与定量两方面的生成结果；相比依赖耗时调参或推理的既有方法，VIDiff 可在数秒内完成编辑与转换。
Conclusion: 视频编辑与理解可由单一指令驱动的扩散基础模型统一承担，并通过迭代自回归扩展到长视频，摆脱逐片段调参的代价。
