papers.title: KL Convergence Guarantees for Score diffusion models under minimal data assumptions
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models are a new class of generative models that revolve around the estimation of the score function associated with a stochastic differential equation. Subsequent to its acquisition, the approximated score function is then harnessed to simulate the corresponding time-reversal process, ultimately enabling the generation of approximate data samples. Despite their evident practical significance these models carry, a notable challenge persists in the form of a lack of comprehensive quantitative results, especially in scenarios involving non-regular scores and estimators. In almost all reported bounds in Kullback Leibler (KL) divergence, it is assumed that either the score function or its approximation is Lipschitz uniformly in time. However, this condition is very restrictive in practice or appears to be difficult to establish. To circumvent this issue, previous works mainly focused on establishing convergence bounds in KL for an early stopped version of the diffusion model and a smoothed version of the data distribution, or assuming that the data distribution is supported on a compact manifold. These explorations have led to interesting bounds in either Wasserstein or Fortet-Mourier metrics. However, the question remains about the relevance of such early-stopping procedure or compactness conditions. In particular, if there exist a natural and mild condition ensuring explicit and sharp convergence bounds in KL. In this article, we tackle the aforementioned limitations by focusing on score diffusion models with fixed step size stemming from the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck semigroup and its kinetic counterpart. Our study provides a rigorous analysis, yielding simple, improved and sharp convergence bounds in KL applicable to any data distribution with finite Fisher information with respect to the standard Gaussian distribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在固定步长、由 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 半群及其 kinetic 版本驱动的 score diffusion 模型上，证明 KL 收敛只需数据分布对标准高斯具有有限 Fisher 信息，无需 score 或其估计一致 Lipschitz、early-stopping 或支撑在紧流形上。给出显式且 sharp 的 KL 界，适用于任意满足该温和条件的数据分布。
Motivation: 已有 KL 收敛界普遍假设 score 或其近似关于时间一致 Lipschitz，该条件在实践中过强或难以验证；替代方案依赖 early stopping、平滑后的数据分布或紧流形支撑，其必要性存疑。
Method: 研究固定步长的 score diffusion，生成过程取自 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 半群及其 kinetic 对应形式；在仅假设数据分布对标准高斯有限 Fisher 信息的条件下做严格误差分析，绕开 Lipschitz、early-stopping 与紧性条件。
Result: 得到显式、改进且 sharp 的 KL 收敛界，适用于任意对标准高斯具有有限 Fisher 信息的数据分布，覆盖非正则 score 与估计器的情形。
Conclusion: 有限 Fisher 信息这一自然且温和的条件足以保证 score diffusion 模型的显式 sharp KL 收敛界，early stopping 与紧流形假设并非必需。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: ETHER: Aligning Emergent Communication for Hindsight Experience Replay
papers.abstract_en: Hindsight Experience Replay (HER) enhances sample efficiency in goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (RL) by relabelling failed trajectories with goals that were actually achieved. However, HER implicitly assumes access to a goal relabelling function and a predicate function that determines whether a goal has been satisfied. These assumptions break down in instruction-following tasks, where goals are expressed in natural language and differ from the state space. We formalize this as the Hindsight Reinforcement Learning problem, which shows the need to jointly learn these functions alongside the RL policy. To address it, we propose ETHER (Emergent Textual Hindsight Experience Replay), an agent that leverages Emergent Communication to learn the goal-relabelling and predicate functions. ETHER uses a referential game (RG) to train a speaker and a listener to develop a grounded, artificial language describing environment states. It partially aligns this emergent language with instruction language using co-occurrence patterns between task instructions and RL observations. We prove that the relabelling and predicate functions that ETHER derives from the RG avoid the degenerate solutions of the Hindsight RL problem, namely trivial predicates and collapsed relabelling functions. Experiments on BabyAI's PickupDist task show that ETHER's learned RG speaker and listener can function as the goal relabelling and predicate functions of HER, improving sample efficiency despite imperfect language alignment. Our work bridges Emergent Communication and goal-conditioned RL, opening the door to wider applications of HER.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ETHER 用指称游戏 (referential game) 训练的说话者与听者充当 HER 的目标重标注与谓词函数，解决自然语言指令下这两个函数无法预先给定的问题。作者证明由此导出的函数避开平凡谓词与坍缩重标注两类退化解，并在 BabyAI PickupDist 上提升样本效率。
Motivation: HER 默认可访问目标重标注函数与判定目标是否达成的谓词函数，但指令跟随任务中目标以自然语言表达、与状态空间不同构，这两个假设失效，需要与策略联合学习。
Method: 提出 ETHER (Emergent Textual Hindsight Experience Replay)：用指称游戏训练 speaker 与 listener 生成描述环境状态的人工语言，再借助任务指令与 RL 观测的共现模式把该涌现语言与指令语言部分对齐，从中导出重标注与谓词函数供 HER 使用。
Result: 证明 ETHER 从指称游戏导出的重标注与谓词函数避免 Hindsight RL 的退化解（trivial predicates 与 collapsed relabelling functions）；在 BabyAI 的 PickupDist 任务上，学到的 speaker/listener 可充当 HER 的重标注与谓词函数，在语言对齐不完美的情况下仍提升样本效率。
Conclusion: Emergent Communication 可以补上 HER 在自然语言指令场景缺失的重标注与谓词函数，把 HER 桥接到更广的目标条件 RL 应用。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Variance-reduced accelerated methods for decentralized stochastic double-regularized nonconvex strongly-concave minimax problems
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we consider the decentralized, stochastic nonconvex strongly-concave (NCSC) minimax problem with nonsmooth regularization terms on both primal and dual variables, wherein a network of $m$ computing agents collaborate via peer-to-peer communications. We consider when the coupling function is in expectation or finite-sum form and the double regularizers are convex functions, applied separately to the primal and dual variables. Our algorithmic framework introduces a Lagrangian multiplier to eliminate the consensus constraint on the dual variable. Coupling this with variance-reduction (VR) techniques, our proposed method, entitled VRLM, by a single neighbor communication per iteration, is able to achieve an $\mathcal{O}(κ^3\varepsilon^{-3})$ sample complexity under the general stochastic setting, with either a big-batch or small-batch VR option, where $κ$ is the condition number of the problem and $\varepsilon$ is the desired solution accuracy. With a big-batch VR, we can additionally achieve $\mathcal{O}(κ^2\varepsilon^{-2})$ communication complexity. Under the special finite-sum setting, our method with a big-batch VR can achieve an $\mathcal{O}(n + \sqrt{n} κ^2\varepsilon^{-2})$ sample complexity and $\mathcal{O}(κ^2\varepsilon^{-2})$ communication complexity, where $n$ is the number of components in the finite sum. All complexity results match the best-known results achieved by a few existing methods for solving special cases of the problem we consider. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work which provides convergence guarantees for NCSC minimax problems with general convex nonsmooth regularizers applied to both the primal and dual variables in the decentralized stochastic setting. Numerical experiments are conducted on two machine learning problems. Our code is downloadable from https://github.com/RPI-OPT/VRLM.
papers.comment: Updated to include second author Muhammad Khan who contributed during the rebuttal phase of the submission
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出去中心化随机非凸强凹 (NCSC) 双正则 minimax 问题的方差缩减算法 VRLM：用拉格朗日乘子消去对偶变量的 consensus 约束，配合方差缩减 (VR) 每次迭代仅需一次邻居通信。一般随机设定下样本复杂度 O(κ³ε⁻³)，big-batch VR 另加通信复杂度 O(κ²ε⁻²)；有限和设定下为 O(n+√nκ²ε⁻²) 样本与 O(κ²ε⁻²) 通信。
Motivation: 去中心化网络中求解带原始与对偶两侧非光滑凸正则的 NCSC minimax 问题时，对偶变量的 consensus 约束与随机梯度方差共同拖慢收敛，此前缺少针对该一般正则设定的收敛保证。
Method: 算法框架引入拉格朗日乘子消除对偶变量的 consensus 约束，耦合方差缩减 (VR) 技术得到 VRLM，支持 big-batch 与 small-batch 两种 VR 选项，每次迭代仅一次邻居通信；耦合函数可为期望形式或有限和形式，正则为凸函数。
Result: 一般随机设定样本复杂度 O(κ³ε⁻³)（big-batch 或 small-batch VR 均可）；big-batch VR 额外给出通信复杂度 O(κ²ε⁻²)。有限和设定下 big-batch VR 达到样本复杂度 O(n+√nκ²ε⁻²) 与通信复杂度 O(κ²ε⁻²)，n 为有限和分量数。复杂度与已有方法在特例上的最好已知结果持平，并在两个机器学习问题上做了数值实验。
Conclusion: 作者称这是首个在去中心化随机设定下，对原始与对偶两侧均施加一般凸非光滑正则的 NCSC minimax 问题给出收敛保证的工作；代码发布于 github.com/RPI-OPT/VRLM。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Low-Frequency Motion Control for Robust and Dynamic Robot Locomotion
papers.abstract_en: Robotic locomotion is often approached with the goal of maximizing robustness and reactivity by increasing motion control frequency. We challenge this intuitive notion by demonstrating robust and dynamic locomotion with a learned motion controller executing at as low as 8 Hz on a real ANYmal C quadruped. The robot is able to robustly and repeatably achieve a high heading velocity of 1.5 m/s, traverse uneven terrain, and resist unexpected external perturbations. We further present a comparative analysis of deep reinforcement learning (RL) based motion control policies trained and executed at frequencies ranging from 5 Hz to 200 Hz. We show that low-frequency policies are less sensitive to actuation latencies and variations in system dynamics. This is to the extent that a successful sim-to-real transfer can be performed even without any dynamics randomization or actuation modeling. We support this claim through a set of rigorous empirical evaluations. Moreover, to assist reproducibility, we provide the training and deployment code along with an extended analysis at https://articulated.robots.ox.ac.uk/lfmc/.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA) 2023
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 挑战“提高控制频率才能更鲁棒”的直觉：在真实 ANYmal C 四足上，学到的运动控制器以低至 8 Hz 运行仍能稳健重复地达到 1.5 m/s 航向速度、穿越不平地形并抵抗意外外力扰动。对比 5 Hz 到 200 Hz 训练与执行的深度强化学习策略后发现，低频策略对执行延迟和系统动力学变化更不敏感，因此 sim-to-real 迁移可以完全不做 dynamics randomization 也不建模执行器延迟。
Motivation: 机器人运动控制普遍靠提高控制频率换取鲁棒性与反应性，但高频带来对执行延迟和动力学变化的敏感性，也抬高 sim-to-real 迁移的建模成本。
Method: 用深度强化学习 (RL) 训练运动控制策略，系统对比 5 Hz 至 200 Hz 的训练与执行频率组合，把学到的低频控制器部署到真实 ANYmal C 四足，并通过一组实证评估检验低频对延迟与动力学变化的敏感性；同时公开训练与部署代码。
Result: 低至 8 Hz 的学习控制器在真实 ANYmal C 上稳健且可重复地达到 1.5 m/s 航向速度，能穿越不平地形并抵抗意外外部扰动；5–200 Hz 的对比显示低频策略对执行延迟与系统动力学变化更不敏感，使 sim-to-real 迁移在不做任何 dynamics randomization、不建模执行的情况下成功。
Conclusion: 运动控制频率不必高：低频策略以对延迟和动力学变化的低敏感性换来无需随机化与执行建模的 sim-to-real 迁移，鲁棒动态 locomotion 可以在 8 Hz 量级实现。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: TasteBench: Multimodal Benchmark for Sensory Prediction, from Molecules to Sustainable Foods
papers.abstract_en: Sustainable protein discovery lacks the fast computational proxies, analogous to molecular docking or density functional theory, that accelerate drug and materials discovery. Evaluating whether a novel food tastes like its animal-based target requires expensive human sensory panels, bottlenecking the design-build-test loop. We introduce TasteBench, a multimodal benchmark and privacy-preserving competition for sensory prediction, spanning two tasks: a food-level ranking task built on 21K+ human evaluations across 215 plant-based foods in 24 product categories, yielding 935 within-category ranking pairs, and a supporting molecular-level taste classification task over 15K flavor molecules. To enable rigorous interpretation of model performance, we characterize the ground truth: inter-rater agreement among panelists is low (Krippendorff's $α= .077$), and the split-half reliability ceiling of panel-aggregated rankings is .825, establishing the range within which ML systems on this benchmark should be assessed. We evaluate baselines across four input modalities; on the same pairs panelists rated, the best model achieves .661 pairwise accuracy, competitive with the median individual panelist (.650), and .683 across all within-category pairs. TasteBench provides the evaluation infrastructure and baselines for measuring progress on computational screening for sustainable protein discovery.
papers.comment: First two authors contributed equally. Accepted to NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations & Datasets track. Code available at https://github.com/Food-Intelligence-Lab/tastebench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TasteBench 提出面向可持续蛋白感官预测的多模态基准与隐私保护竞赛，含食物级排序（215 种植物基食品、24 个品类、21K+ 人类评价、935 个品类内排序对）与分子级味觉分类（15K 风味分子）两个任务。四类输入模态基线中最佳模型在评委打分的同一批排序对上 pairwise accuracy 达 .661，与单个评委中位数 .650 相当，全品类内对上为 .683；同时刻画真值噪声：评委间一致性 Krippendorff's α 仅 .077，聚合排序的 split-half 可靠性上限 .825。
Motivation: 可持续蛋白发现缺少类似分子对接或 DFT 的快速计算代理，判断新型食品是否接近动物基目标口味依赖昂贵的人类感官专家组，拖慢 design-build-test 循环。
Method: 构建 TasteBench 多模态基准与隐私保护竞赛，含食物级排序任务（基于 215 种植物基食品、24 个品类的 21K+ 人类评价，产生 935 个品类内排序对）与分子级味觉分类任务（15K 风味分子）；先刻画真值质量（评委间一致性与 split-half 可靠性上限），再在四种输入模态上评测基线。
Result: 评委间一致性 Krippendorff's α = .077，评委聚合排序的 split-half 可靠性上限为 .825；四类输入模态中最佳模型在评委打分的同一批排序对上 pairwise accuracy 为 .661，与单个评委中位数 .650 相当，在全部品类内排序对上为 .683。
Conclusion: 计算模型在该基准上已可与中位数人类评委相当，但性能应在 .077 到 .825 划定的真值噪声区间内解读；TasteBench 提供衡量可持续蛋白计算筛选进展的评测基础设施与基线。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Activation Sparsity with Weight Approximation for Faster LLM Decoding on Offloaded Weights
papers.abstract_en: Deploying LLMs on consumer-grade GPUs with insufficient memory to hold their weights can result in prohibitively slow inference, because decoding repeatedly transfers offloaded weights from system RAM or flash storage into GPU at much lower bandwidth than local GPU-memory access. Activation sparsity reduces these transfers by skipping weights associated with zero or near-zero activations. However, as more activation contributions are omitted, model quality eventually degrades rapidly, indicating that weights associated with small-magnitude activations collectively influence model quality sharply. In this work, we improve the trade-off between model quality and decoding performance when exploiting activation sparsity. Our key idea is to replace the binary choice of whether or not to read a weight with three options: fully retain it, approximate it using a compressed weight representation, or omit it entirely. SpAx skips weights associated with activations closest to zero, reads approximate weights for smaller-magnitude activations, and reads original weights for the largest-magnitude activations. Smaller-magnitude activations attenuate the errors introduced by approximate weights, while compressed weight representations require fewer bytes to be transferred. With weights offloaded to CPU memory, SpAx speeds up decoding by 3.86X on average (up to 5.57X) with 16-bit weights and 2.06X (up to 2.74X) with 4-bit weights, at a WikiText-2 perplexity increase of at most 10%. With weights offloaded to flash storage, the speedups are 3.31X on average (up to 4.81X) and 1.54X (up to 2.03X).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpAx 把激活稀疏里的权重读取从二值（读/不读）改成三档：激活接近零的权重直接跳过，小幅值激活对应的权重用压缩表示近似读取，大幅值激活才读原始权重。权重卸载到 CPU 内存时，16-bit 平均加速 3.86X（最高 5.57X）、4-bit 平均 2.06X（最高 2.74X），WikiText-2 perplexity 上升不超过 10%；卸载到 flash 时对应为 3.31X（最高 4.81X）与 1.54X（最高 2.03X）。
Motivation: 消费级 GPU 显存放不下 LLM 权重时，解码要反复从系统 RAM 或 flash 搬权重进 GPU，带宽远低于显存本地访问，推理慢得难以部署；而纯激活稀疏一旦丢掉更多激活贡献，模型质量会迅速崩掉。
Method: SpAx 按激活幅值把权重分成三档处理：最接近零的跳过不读，小幅值的用压缩权重表示近似读取，最大幅值的读原始权重。原理是小幅值激活会削弱近似权重引入的误差，同时压缩表示需要传输的字节更少；评测在权重分别卸载到 CPU 内存与 flash 存储的设定下进行。
Result: 权重卸载到 CPU 内存：16-bit 平均加速 3.86X、最高 5.57X，4-bit 平均 2.06X、最高 2.74X，WikiText-2 perplexity 增幅至多 10%。权重卸载到 flash 存储：16-bit 平均 3.31X、最高 4.81X，4-bit 平均 1.54X、最高 2.03X。
Conclusion: 把权重读取从二值决策扩展为跳过、近似、全读三档，可以在可接受的 perplexity 代价内显著加速卸载权重下的 LLM 解码，且 16-bit 权重的加速幅度明显高于 4-bit。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: GRAFT: Growing Agglomerative Foundation Models via Continual Teacher Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Vision foundation models such as DINOv2, SigLIP2, and MASt3R develop complementary capabilities from different pretraining objectives, yet their knowledge remains distributed across separate, specialized models. Multi-teacher knowledge distillation offers a path toward consolidating these capabilities into a single agglomerative backbone, but existing approaches assume a fixed set of teachers, and incorporating a new teacher requires repeating expensive joint distillation over the entire teacher set. We introduce GRAFT, a continual multi-teacher distillation framework that enables a unified backbone to progressively acquire capabilities from an open-ended sequence of foundation models. When a new teacher arrives, GRAFT treats the previously distilled model as a teacher for preserving learned capabilities, while the current student jointly learns from both the previous model and the incoming teacher. Furthermore, to reconcile the incompatible representation geometries of heterogeneous teachers, we introduce Teacher Specific Readout Tokens, which grant each teacher an independent read-out of the shared encoder, together with Geometry Agnostic Relational Loss that aligns a vision-language teacher by matching image-text similarity structures rather than raw feature values. We provide GRAFT model, which is a single, continually extensible backbone that unifies five domains, including image understanding, 2D dense prediction, 3D human pose estimation, 3D vision, and vision-language, delivering strong performance across all of them while acquiring each new capability at the cost of a single distillation rather than a full re-distillation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GRAFT 把多教师知识蒸馏改成可持续扩展的形式：新教师到来时，把已蒸馏的模型也当教师，学生同时向旧模型和新教师学习，从而避免对全体教师集重做联合蒸馏。配合 Teacher Specific Readout Tokens 与 Geometry Agnostic Relational Loss 调和异构教师的表征几何，最终得到统一五个领域（图像理解、2D 稠密预测、3D 人体姿态、3D 视觉、视觉语言）的单一 backbone，每新增一个能力只需一次蒸馏。
Motivation: DINOv2、SigLIP2、MASt3R 等视觉基础模型因预训练目标不同而能力互补但彼此割裂；现有 multi-teacher distillation 假设教师集固定，加入新教师需对全体教师重做昂贵的联合蒸馏。
Method: 持续多教师蒸馏框架：新教师到达时把先前蒸馏出的模型作为保能力的教师，学生同时从旧模型与新教师学习；用 Teacher Specific Readout Tokens 给每个教师独立读出共享 encoder，用 Geometry Agnostic Relational Loss 通过匹配图像-文本相似度结构（而非原始特征值）对齐视觉-语言教师。
Result: 产出 GRAFT 模型：单一、可持续扩展的 backbone，统一图像理解、2D 稠密预测、3D 人体姿态估计、3D 视觉与视觉语言五个领域，在全部领域上表现强劲，且每获得一个新能力只需一次蒸馏而非完整重蒸馏。
Conclusion: 把旧学生当作遗忘约束的教师，可以让异构视觉基础模型的能力按开放序列持续聚合到一个 backbone，而不必重跑全体教师的联合蒸馏。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: How Causality Bridges the Semantic Gap
papers.abstract_en: Numerical measurements capture how a system behaves, but often leave the meanings of its variables unspecified. Some variables are measured but never labeled, and others are never measured at all. Existing methods assign semantics to such variables by consulting general human knowledge, but this inherits its biases where that knowledge exists and offers nothing where it does not. We bridge this gap between measurements and their meanings with causal structure instead, reading a variable's semantics from how it acts on other variables. We formalize this as structure-constrained semantic alignment, in which the embedding of each unnamed variable is solved under the dependence relations implied by the causal graph, with the embeddings of a few known names as anchors. Accordingly, we build CausalBridge, a framework that discovers the causal graph from the measurements, latent variables included, solves for the embeddings under those relations, and expresses them as names through a language model. The causal structure reflects the mechanism that generated the measurements and is recovered from the measurements alone, which may make it the one source of information free of bias from human knowledge. We evaluate CausalBridge on five questionnaires and three robotics scenarios, with 20 to 90% of the variable names masked. It recovers the semantics of observed and latent variables more accurately than existing methods that rely on association, and its lead widens as less of the system is documented. The graph it discovers names variables as accurately as the documented one, and a new system is named in minutes and at a fraction of the cost of sampling methods. Once the semantic gap is bridged faithfully, machines can understand the world and take actions causally.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CausalBridge 用因果结构而非通用人类知识给无名变量赋语义：从测量（含潜变量）中发现因果图，把每个无名变量的嵌入在图蕴含的依赖关系下求解，以少量已知名称为锚，再由语言模型输出名字。在五份问卷与三个机器人场景、20%–90% 变量名被遮蔽的设置下，其语义恢复比依赖关联的方法更准，且系统被记录得越少领先越大。
Motivation: 数值测量只给出变量如何表现，不给含义：有的变量测了却无标签，有的根本没测。现有方法靠通用人类知识赋语义，在知识有偏处继承偏见、无知识处无能为力。
Method: CausalBridge 分三步：仅从测量（含潜变量）中发现因果图；在因果图蕴含的依赖关系下求解各无名变量的嵌入，以少数已知名称作锚（structure-constrained semantic alignment）；用语言模型把嵌入表达为名称。
Result: 在五份问卷与三个机器人场景、20% 到 90% 变量名被遮蔽的条件下，恢复观测变量与潜变量语义比依赖关联 (association) 的现有方法更准确，且被记录系统越少领先越大；其发现的图给变量命名的准确度与文档化图相当；新系统可在数分钟内完成命名，成本只是采样方法的一小部分。
Conclusion: 因果结构反映生成测量的机制且可仅从测量中恢复，因此可作为免人类知识偏见的语义来源；语义鸿沟被忠实桥接后，机器才能以因果方式理解世界并行动。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Fisher-Guided Submodular Data Selection for Continual Pre-Training of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Data selection is already a central bottleneck in large-language-model training, where web-scale corpora are noisy and token budgets are finite. In continual pre-training (CPT), it becomes a forgetting-control problem: a poorly chosen target-domain corpus can overwrite capabilities encoded in the pretrained checkpoint. Existing CPT practice either scores candidates with parameter-agnostic scalars such as perplexity, or mitigates forgetting by spending many extra general-domain replay tokens. Neither strategy directly asks how training on a candidate will move the model parameters. We show that loss-based selection causes the post-CPT Fisher diagonal to drift downward on exactly the high-Fisher coordinates the pretrained model had committed to, while leaving low-Fisher coordinates largely untouched. This asymmetry exposes a parameter-space mechanism for catastrophic forgetting. Motivated by this observation, we propose a Fisher-aware CPT selector that decomposes each candidate's gradient into an anchor component, which measures perturbation along committed parameter directions, and a frontier component, which measures update capacity in unconstrained low-Fisher subspaces. We aggregate these signals with a log-determinant submodular objective and optimize it in a single pass using a scalable streaming data selection pipeline. On TinyLlama-1.1B and Llama-3.1-8B CPT over medical data, our selector improves target-domain quality while bounding forgetting on held-out pretraining benchmarks. Most importantly, it is substantially more token-efficient than forgetting-aware replay. 1B selected tokens already outperform the replay strategy trained with 10B tokens on both adaptation and forgetting, giving a 10x token-efficiency advantage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Fisher-aware CPT 数据选择器：把候选语料梯度分解为 anchor（沿已承诺参数方向的扰动）与 frontier（低 Fisher 子空间的更新能力）两个分量，用 log-determinant 次模目标聚合，单遍流式优化。在 TinyLlama-1.1B 与 Llama-3.1-8B 的医疗语料持续预训练上，1B 选中 token 在适配与遗忘两方面均超过用 10B token 训练的 replay 策略，token 效率约 10 倍。
Motivation: 持续预训练 (CPT) 中候选语料选错会覆盖预训练 checkpoint 已编码的能力；现有做法要么用与参数无关的困惑度打分，要么靠大量通用域 replay token 抑制遗忘，都不直接刻画训练如何移动参数。
Method: 先刻画 loss-based 选择使 post-CPT Fisher 对角线恰在预训练模型已承诺的高 Fisher 坐标上向下漂移、低 Fisher 坐标基本不动的不对称性；据此把每个候选的梯度分解为 anchor 分量与 frontier 分量，用 log-determinant 次模目标聚合，并以可扩展的流式数据选择管线单遍优化。
Result: 在 TinyLlama-1.1B 与 Llama-3.1-8B 的医疗数据 CPT 上，选择器在提升目标域质量的同时在 held-out 预训练 benchmark 上约束遗忘；1B 选中 token 在适配与遗忘两方面均超过用 10B token 训练的 replay 策略，token 效率优势约 10 倍。
Conclusion: 灾难遗忘存在参数空间机制：loss 选择压低高 Fisher 坐标；按 anchor/frontier 分解并以次模目标选数据，可以在远少于 replay 的 token 预算下同时改善适配与遗忘控制。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Open-Endedness Bench: Measuring Epistemic Process from Agent Records
papers.abstract_en: Agents are increasingly given open-ended research tasks: discovering an empirical law from self-designed experiments, improving a heuristic whose optimum nobody knows, or beating a standing record. Their execution logs record every step of this research, yet the runs are still judged by their outcome score. That score alone does not establish whether an agent's claims follow from executed experiments, and a reference answer may be unavailable. We evaluate the agent's epistemic process: how it forms hypotheses, tests them, and revises them in response to evidence. We introduce OEB (Open-Endedness Bench), a benchmark-agnostic methodology that reads only the agent's execution record and never a reference answer or an outcome score. OEB compiles the record into a unified epistemic event graph whose edges connect the propositions the agent states to the executed actions that test them; each node carries an exact excerpt that code verifies against the record. One principle governs scoring: prose can state a proposition, but only evidence returned by an executed action can support or refute it, so OEB checks what the agent writes against what it actually ran. From the graph, OEB scores four competence axes (evidence, experiment, revision, and no reward hacking), mostly as the share of opportunities for sound research that the agent took, and profiles six subjective persona traits that describe the agent's research habits. We score 119 existing runs over 12 tasks from three benchmarks: LLM post-training, chip design, and a training-speed record. Against logged results, only 16-29% of the improvements agents claim are real. On 9 of 10 tasks, the best run tries more new ideas in its second half than the worst run. The persona readings follow the model: for every trait, the model that ran explains more of its variance across runs than the task (a median of 43% against 7%).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OEB 只读 agent 的执行记录、不看参考答案与结果分数，把记录编译成认识论事件图，用「命题必须由已执行动作返回的证据支撑」这一条原则给 agent 的研究过程打分。对 3 个基准 12 个任务的 119 条已有 run 评分后发现，agent 声称的改进中只有 16–29% 是真实的；10 个任务里有 9 个任务的最佳 run 在后半程尝试的新想法多于最差 run。
Motivation: 开放式研究任务的执行日志记录了完整推理过程，却仍只按结果分数评判；结果分数无法证明 agent 的结论确实由已执行实验支撑，而且参考答案常常拿不到。
Method: OEB 是 benchmark-agnostic 的方法：把执行记录编译为统一的认识论事件图 (epistemic event graph)，边连接 agent 陈述的命题与检验它的已执行动作，每个节点携带经代码核验的原文摘录；按证据、实验、修订、无 reward hacking 四条能力轴打分（多以「agent 把握了多大比例的可靠研究机会」计），另给出六项主观 persona 特质画像。
Result: 在来自 LLM post-training、芯片设计、训练速度纪录三个基准的 12 个任务上评了 119 条已有 run：对照日志结果，agent 声称的改进只有 16–29% 是真实的；10 个任务中有 9 个，最佳 run 在后半程尝试的新想法多于最差 run；六项 persona 特质的方差均由跑该 run 的模型解释得比任务更多（中位 43% 对 7%）。
Conclusion: 只看执行记录就能判定 agent 的主张是否被已执行实验证据支撑，而按结果分数评判会放行大部分虚假改进；agent 的研究习惯差异主要由模型而非任务决定。

papers.title: Labels Override Definitions in Jev-Style Typed Decision Models
papers.abstract_en: A typed decision model answers a fixed question about an input by returning a probability for each of several caller-defined options. Each option carries a short label and a written definition, which is where a developer states the rule the model should apply. Jev introduced this interface for routing, moderation and triage, open implementations followed, and the same operation occurs whenever a language model is used as a classifier by scoring label strings. We study the open implementations, whose weights we can inspect and patch, and ask whether the probability follows the definitions or the labels. A preference for the label we call option-label bias. Across four open-weight typed decision models, three ways of reading an answer from a Qwen2.5 backbone, eleven classification tasks and PolicyBench, a synthetic routing suite we introduce in which the rule appears only in the definitions, the answer is mostly the labels. Deleting every definition leaves accuracy unchanged (laya-td: 0.8559 against 0.8487), although those definitions support 0.7971 on their own, and renaming the options to A and B raises accuracy by +0.1511 [+0.1377, +0.1646]. One system, von, is unaffected, and the two code bases differ in one expression: laya writes each option as "{label}: {definition}", while von writes only the definition. Changing that expression in both directions, with no weight changed, makes all three laya checkpoints exactly invariant (+0.0000 [+0.0000, +0.0000]) and creates the effect in von, whose accuracy falls from 0.8511 to 0.2281 when a label contradicts its definition. Earlier work attributed this failure to the constrained decision head these models use in place of a text decoder; our results locate it in the prompt rendering. We give a two-call test that tells a practitioner which case applies to their model, and measure what four mitigations are worth.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Jev 式 typed decision model 中，模型给出的概率主要跟随选项标签 (label) 而非开发者写的定义，作者称之为 option-label bias。跨 4 个开源权重模型、Qwen2.5 backbone 的 3 种读答案方式、11 个分类任务与自建 PolicyBench，删光定义准确率几乎不变 (laya-td 0.8559 vs 0.8487)，把选项改名为 A/B 反而提升 +0.1511 [+0.1377, +0.1646]；偏差根源在 prompt 渲染表达式而非受限决策头。
Motivation: typed decision model 靠 written definition 声明规则，但开发者无法知道模型究竟执行了定义还是只看了标签；此前把该失败归因于受限决策头，缺少可定位、可检验的解释。
Method: 检查并 patch 4 个开源权重 typed decision model，比较 laya 与 von 两个代码库的 prompt 渲染表达式（"{label}: {definition}" 对仅 definition），在不改权重的情况下双向改写该表达式；引入 PolicyBench 合成路由套件，其中规则只出现在定义里；并给出一个 two-call 测试与 4 种缓解手段的度量。
Result: 删除全部定义准确率不变 (laya-td 0.8559 vs 0.8487)，而仅靠定义单独支持 0.7971；选项改名 A/B 提升 +0.1511 [+0.1377, +0.1646]；von 不受影响，改写渲染表达式后 laya 三个 checkpoint 完全不变 (+0.0000 [+0.0000, +0.0000])，并在 von 中制造出该效应——标签与定义矛盾时准确率从 0.8511 跌到 0.2281。
Conclusion: option-label bias 定位在 prompt 渲染表达式而非 constrained decision head；实践者可用 two-call 测试判定自己的模型属于哪种情况，并据此选择缓解手段。

papers.title: Dense Mixture-of-Experts as a Reparameterized Wide FFN: A Granularity Sweep at Fixed Compute
papers.abstract_en: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models combine learned routing with selection from a large expert pool. We isolate the contribution of dynamic expert combination using a dense analogue: $K$ SwiGLU experts, all active for every token and combined by a softmax gate, at fixed total FFN width. With no larger pool or discrete selection, the dense baseline is the $K=1$ case. Validation loss varies non-monotonically with $K$: $K=2$ improves over the baseline by $0.0048$, whereas $K=4$ and $K=6$ worsen it by $0.0053$ and $0.0197$, respectively. Routing generally remains soft and expert usage balanced, except in the first layer of the $K=4$ model, where routing is nearly one-hot. Forcing this gate to uniform increases loss by $2.4$ nats on a diagnostic subset, indicating that its concentrated routing is functionally important. We further show that the architecture is exactly a dense SwiGLU with token-dependent, simplex-constrained group scaling and contains the dense baseline in its function class. These single-run results suggest a granularity sweet spot for always-active, softly gated FFNs at fixed width, with $K=2$ performing best among the configurations tested.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在固定 FFN 总宽度下把 SwiGLU 拆成 K 个全激活专家并用 softmax 门控组合，验证损失随 K 非单调：K=2 比 K=1 基线低 0.0048，K=4 与 K=6 反而恶化 0.0053 与 0.0197。该架构等价于带 token 依赖、单纯形约束分组缩放的稠密 SwiGLU，且函数类包含 K=1 基线；单次运行结果提示固定宽度下存在粒度甜点，K=2 最优。
Motivation: 稀疏 MoE 把学到的路由与大专家池的离散选择混在一起，难以分辨动态专家组合本身贡献了什么；需要在不引入更大池与离散选择的条件下单独隔离这一因素。
Method: 构造稠密 MoE 类比：K 个 SwiGLU 专家全部对每个 token 激活，由 softmax 门控加权，总 FFN 宽度固定，K=1 即稠密基线；在固定算力下扫描 K=1/2/4/6，并对路由做诊断（把某层门控强制为均匀分布观察损失变化），同时给出架构等价性刻画。
Result: 验证损失随 K 非单调：K=2 相对基线改善 0.0048，K=4 恶化 0.0053，K=6 恶化 0.0197。路由总体保持软且专家使用均衡，唯 K=4 模型第一层接近 one-hot；在诊断子集上把该层门控强制为均匀使损失上升 2.4 nats。
Conclusion: 固定宽度、全激活、软门控的 FFN 存在粒度甜点，K=2 在所测配置中最好；K=4 第一层的集中路由具有功能性作用，而该架构是含 token 依赖分组缩放的稠密 SwiGLU 并包含稠密基线。

papers.title: Physical AI Smart Spaces: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Multi-Camera 3D Perception in Smart Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Physical AI Smart Spaces is, to the best of our knowledge, the first benchmark to simultaneously provide large-scale, multi-class, and multi-camera 3D perception data for indoor smart spaces. It contains over 280 hours of synchronized 1080p footage captured by nearly 1,800 cameras in warehouses, hospitals, retail venues, and similar settings, together with automatic annotations for multi-camera identities, 2D bounding boxes, 3D bounding boxes, camera calibration, and depth where available. The benchmark spans Isaac Sim synthetic generation, Cosmos Transfer appearance augmentation, and real-world Sim2Real evaluation. For the real-world target, we include two warehouse deployments with time-synchronized streams, automatic VGGT-based calibration, and a 3D labeling interface that projects world-frame 3D boxes into each view for cross-camera verification. We describe the dataset scope, annotation and calibration schema, generation workflow, benchmark protocols, and official evaluation system, which standardizes submission format, and leaderboard reporting. A central contribution is a 3D instantiation of Higher Order Tracking Accuracy (HOTA), extending the usual 2D box-based tracking evaluation to 3D locations and 3D boxes. We further report empirical baselines from the AI City Challenge leaderboards, showing how methods evolve from person-only 3D location tracking to multi-class 3D box tracking under realistic smart-space constraints. The release is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/PhysicalAI-SmartSpaces.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations & Datasets Track (poster)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 发布 Physical AI Smart Spaces：室内多相机 3D 感知基准，含 280 小时以上、近 1,800 台相机同步 1080p 画面，覆盖仓库、医院、零售等场景，附多相机身份、2D/3D 框、标定与深度的自动标注。核心贡献是把 HOTA 扩展到 3D（3D 框与 3D 位置跟踪评测），并给出 AI City Challenge 排行榜基线，显示方法从仅人的 3D 定位跟踪演进到真实场景约束下的多类别 3D 框跟踪。
Motivation: 室内智能空间缺少同时具备大规模、多类别、多相机的 3D 感知基准，跟踪评测长期停留在 2D 框层面，无法衡量跨相机 3D 定位与 3D 框跟踪。
Method: 数据管线横跨 Isaac Sim 合成生成、Cosmos Transfer 外观增强与真实 Sim2Real 评估；真实侧含两个仓库部署，用基于 VGGT 的自动标定与将世界系 3D 框投影到各视角的 3D 标注界面做跨相机核验；评测上提出 HOTA 的 3D 实例化，并配套标准化提交格式与排行榜的官方评测系统。
Result: 基准含 280 小时以上同步 1080p 画面、近 1,800 台相机，场景为仓库、医院、零售等；标注覆盖多相机身份、2D 框、3D 框、相机标定与可用处的深度。报告 AI City Challenge 排行榜经验基线，展示方法从仅人的 3D 位置跟踪演进到多类别 3D 框跟踪。
Conclusion: 把 HOTA 扩到 3D 并配合合成到真实的多相机数据与标准化评测系统，可在真实智能空间约束下统一比较 3D 跟踪方法；数据集已在 Hugging Face 发布。

summary_sections.result: 基准含 280 小时以上同步 1080p 画面、近 1,800 台相机，场景为仓库、医院、零售等；标注覆盖多相机身份、2D 框、3D 框、相机标定与可用处的深度。报告 AI City Challenge 排行榜经验基线，展示方法从仅人的 3D 位置跟踪演进到多类别 3D 框跟踪。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把 HOTA 扩到 3D 并配合合成到真实的多相机数据与标准化评测系统，可在真实智能空间约束下统一比较 3D 跟踪方法；数据集已在 Hugging Face 发布。

papers.title: High-Dimensional Asymptotics and Dataset Selection for Private Transfer Learning
papers.abstract_en: To commit to buying external data or participate in collaborative learning, one must decide whether the additional data will improve prediction enough to justify the cost. This comes with several challenges: (i) the decision often relies only on aggregated statistics available publicly, rather than individual-level data; (ii) covariate and model shifts can induce negative transfer, so the additional data deteriorates rather than improves performance; (iii) if the data is sensitive, its privatization requires the injection of noise, which can also offset the benefit of a larger sample size. In this paper, we model the problem of dataset selection through high-dimensional regression with multiple heterogeneous sources and a weighted ridge estimator. Our approach uses only summary statistics and it gives privacy guarantees either on labels only or jointly on features and labels, in terms of $ρ$-zero-concentrated differential privacy. The main technical contribution is a deterministic equivalent of the test error, which captures the interactions between sample size, covariance structure, model shift, regularization and privacy noise. Our theory allows to optimize hyperparameters (weights and ridge regularizers) and, more broadly, to decide when private external datasets are useful without accessing the data itself but only relying on population-level quantities. This provides a theoretically tractable foundation for private transfer learning, which we support via experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在只拿到汇总统计量、无法访问个体数据的条件下，用高维回归加权 ridge 估计器做数据集选择，并给出测试误差的确定性等价式，把样本量、协方差结构、模型偏移、正则化与隐私噪声的相互作用写进同一个闭式表达。该式可在 ρ-zCDP 隐私保证下直接优化权重与 ridge 正则，并判定私有外部数据何时真正有用，作者用合成与真实数据集实验支撑这一理论。
Motivation: 购买外部数据或参与协作学习时，决策只能依赖公开的汇总统计量；协变量与模型偏移会带来负迁移，而为保护敏感数据注入的噪声又可能抵消样本量增益，缺少在不接触数据本身的情况下判断外部数据是否有用的准则。
Method: 把数据集选择建模为含多个异质源的高维回归，采用加权 ridge 估计器，仅使用 summary statistics；隐私保证以 ρ-zero-concentrated differential privacy 给出，可只保护标签或同时保护特征与标签；核心推导是测试误差的确定性等价 (deterministic equivalent)，据此优化权重与 ridge 正则等超参数。
Result: 得到测试误差的确定性等价式，显式刻画样本量、协方差结构、模型偏移、正则化与隐私噪声的交互；据此可在不访问数据、仅依赖 population-level quantities 的情况下判定私有外部数据集何时有用，并在合成数据集与真实数据集实验中获得支持。
Conclusion: 私有迁移学习可以建立在可解析处理的理论基础上：仅凭汇总统计量与高维渐近等价式即可选择外部数据并调超参，无需接触个体数据。

papers.title: Answering clinicians' questions over trial evidence tables with verifiable, feedback-driven language models
papers.abstract_en: Systematic reviews condense clinical trials into evidence tables, yet clinicians can interrogate these tables only through database queries, and many questions concern attributes that the table does not record, such as a drug's target class or a harmonised endpoint. Here we introduce FD-SCoPE, a language-model framework that answers both kinds of question, exposes the query, the selected trials and the derivation rule behind every answer, and learns from expert corrections. On an oncology evidence table of 159 immune checkpoint inhibitor trial records, FD-SCoPE completed all 140 clinician-style tasks (alternatives, 90.7-97.9%). For questions needing derived attributes it retrieved 99.3% of relevant trial records at a positive predictive value of 89.8% and outperformed four alternative approaches (derived-value F1 77.7% versus 64.8-73.4%). Corrections on 299 questions, simulated from reference answers, raised F1 on 1,201 unseen questions from 77.9% to 84.9%. Language models coupled with executable queries, verified programs and expert feedback can give clinicians auditable access to trial evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FD-SCoPE 用可执行查询、可验证程序与专家反馈驱动的语言模型回答临床医生对试验循证表的提问，每个答案都暴露查询、所选试验与推导规则。在 159 条免疫检查点抑制剂试验记录上完成全部 140 项临床任务（alternatives 90.7–97.9%），派生属性检索召回 99.3%、PPV 89.8%，derived-value F1 77.7% 对四个替代方法的 64.8–73.4%；299 条专家纠正使 1,201 条未见问题 F1 从 77.9% 升到 84.9%。
Motivation: 系统综述把临床试验压缩成循证表，但医生只能用数据库查询提问，而大量问题涉及表中未记录的属性（如药物靶点类别、统一终点），现有方式无法回答且不可审计。
Method: FD-SCoPE 框架让语言模型生成可执行查询与可验证程序，对每条答案暴露查询、选中的试验记录和推导规则，并从专家纠正中学习；评测基于一张含 159 条免疫检查点抑制剂 (ICI) 试验记录的肿瘤学循证表，含 140 项临床医生式任务与 299 条由参考答案模拟的纠正。
Result: 完成全部 140 项任务，alternatives 类 90.7–97.9%；派生属性问题检索召回 99.3%、PPV 89.8%；derived-value F1 77.7%，四个替代方法为 64.8–73.4%；299 条纠正后，1,201 条未见问题 F1 由 77.9% 升至 84.9%。
Conclusion: 语言模型与可执行查询、可验证程序和专家反馈结合，能给临床医生提供可审计的循证表访问，且专家纠正能进一步抬高未见问题上的 F1。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: DISSOLVR: An Interpretable and Fast Framework for Aqueous and Organic Solubility Prediction
papers.abstract_en: High-fidelity solubility prediction is fundamental to pharmaceutical development and environmental partitioning, where accurate modeling must couple molecular structure with thermodynamic behavior across diverse chemical environments. However, recent advancements have been dominated by deep learning architectures that often sacrifice physical interpretability for predictive power. We challenge this trend by showing that state-of-the-art performance does not require such non-transparent architectures. To address this, we introduce DISSOLVR, a transparent framework for molecular solubility prediction. In addition, we perform a comprehensive literature review and a benchmarking study against various methods. We show that DISSOLVR approaches the aleatoric limit of experimental uncertainty and achieves OOD generalization through structural invariance, derived by mapping molecules to physically-grounded descriptors. Then, we present an LLM-assisted post-hoc explanation pipeline that bridges the gap between symbolic model artifacts and chemically grounded narratives. Finally, a comparative benchmark of a survey involving 22 expert chemists reveals that expert evaluators provide deep insights.
papers.comment: 48 pages, 19 tables, 6 figures. Accepted to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea. PMLR 306, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DISSOLVR 用可解释的物理接地描述符替代黑箱深度网络做水溶性与有机溶剂溶解度预测，性能逼近实验不确定性的 aleatoric 极限，并靠结构不变性获得 OOD 泛化；配套 LLM 辅助事后解释管线把符号模型输出转成化学叙事，22 位专家化学家的对比调查显示专家评估能给出更深入的洞见。
Motivation: 溶解度预测对药物开发与环境分配至关重要，但近年进展被牺牲物理可解释性的深度学习架构主导，预测力与透明度被当成取舍。
Method: DISSOLVR 把分子映射到物理接地描述符并据此导出结构不变性，作为透明的溶解度预测框架；同时做系统文献综述与多方法 benchmarking，并接一条 LLM 辅助的事后解释管线，把符号模型产物转写为化学上站得住的叙述，再以专家化学家调查做比较评估。
Result: DISSOLVR 接近实验不确定性的 aleatoric 极限，并通过结构不变性实现 OOD 泛化；对比 benchmark 涵盖多种已有方法；涉及 22 位专家化学家的调查显示专家评估者提供深入洞见。论文为 ICML 2026 接收，48 页、19 张表、6 幅图。
Conclusion: SOTA 级溶解度预测不必依赖不透明的深度架构：把分子映射到物理接地描述符即可同时拿到预测精度、OOD 泛化与可解释性，再用 LLM 解释管线把符号产物接到化学叙事上。

papers.title: Improving the Energy-Efficiency of the Code Generated by LLMs through Effective Prompting
papers.abstract_en: As AI-assisted programming becomes increasingly mainstream, the environmental impact of AI-generated software has emerged as an important consideration. This motivates evaluating LLM-generated code beyond functional correctness by considering execution efficiency and energy consumption. However, despite substantial advances in code generation, frontier LLMs are rarely evaluated based on the energy efficiency of the code they produce. In this work, we conduct a comprehensive evaluation of 21 prompting strategies for energy-efficient code generation and identify 8 strategies for evaluation across 10 widely used open-weight and proprietary LLMs. We evaluate their effectiveness for both Python and C++ code generation relative to a baseline prompt. Across the evaluated models, the selected prompting strategies achieved energy reductions of up to 25% for Python and 17% for C++ code generation. At the model level, Python energy reductions reached up to 50% for Granite-4.0-H-Small, 39% for Claude 4.5 Haiku, and 28% for MiniMax M3, while C++ reductions reached up to 56% for Granite-4.0-H-Small and 7% for Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct. These results demonstrate that prompting strategies can substantially influence the energy consumption of LLM-generated code, although their effectiveness varies across models and programming languages. Our findings highlight the importance of incorporating energy efficiency into the evaluation and optimization of LLM-based code generation and provide practical insights into designing prompts for more sustainable AI-assisted programming.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 21 种提示策略做能耗评测，筛出 8 种在 10 个开源与闭源 LLM 上对比基线提示，生成 Python 与 C++ 代码。所选策略相对基线最高降低 25%（Python）与 17%（C++）能耗；按模型看，Python 最高降 50%（Granite-4.0-H-Small）、39%（Claude 4.5 Haiku）、28%（MiniMax M3），C++ 最高降 56%（Granite-4.0-H-Small）、7%（Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct）。
Motivation: LLM 代码生成的评测长期只看功能正确性，生成代码的执行能耗几乎不被度量，而 AI 辅助编程的环境影响已成为现实问题。
Method: 系统评测 21 种面向能效的提示策略，从中选出 8 种，在 10 个广泛使用的开源与专有 LLM 上，以基线提示为对照，分别对 Python 与 C++ 代码生成做能耗对比。
Result: 所选提示策略相对基线提示的能耗降幅：跨模型最高 Python 25%、C++ 17%；按模型，Python 最高 50%（Granite-4.0-H-Small）、39%（Claude 4.5 Haiku）、28%（MiniMax M3），C++ 最高 56%（Granite-4.0-H-Small）、7%（Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct）。
Conclusion: 提示策略能显著改变 LLM 生成代码的能耗，但效果随模型与编程语言而异，因此能效应纳入 LLM 代码生成的评测与优化指标。

papers.title: Pincer: Resource Authorization for Agents using a Digital Twin
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents have become increasingly long-horizon, autonomous, reliant on general-purpose shell and maintain their own persistent memory for self-improvement. While these capabilities have made the agents powerful, they have also made them harder to defend against external adversaries. Defenses that restrict this architecture --- typed tools, information-flow control, or policy prediction engines --- give up too much functionality to be adopted. Agents deployed today (e.g. Claude, Codex) rely on a combination of user-mediated and automode sandboxing as their primary defense. In user-mediated sandboxing, user-maintained policies decay over time and repeated permission requests cause user fatigue, while auto mode's tool-call classifiers learn no user-specific policy and are not meant to defend against adversarial setups. Pincer is a new defense that operates at the resource layer and works alongside existing defenses at the tool-call layer like the auto mode. At the core of Pincer lies a digital twin, an isolated-context model that automatically learns and enforces dynamic user-specific least-privilege policies. The digital twin keeps continually learning the user's preferences allowing it to act as the user's proxy for the agent's permission requests. To emulate the learning phase, we propose a new usercentric dataset with examples following a multi-day transcript of user-agent interaction. Our evaluation shows that Pincer performs strongly on both security and utility in comparison to several baselines which includes variants of LLM judges and adaptations of Conseca (HotOS '25). We highlight attack types where Pincer's design leads to a significant security improvement compared to all other baselines, while outperforming the baselines even for other types of attacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Pincer 在资源层为编码 agent 做权限授权：用一个隔离上下文的 digital twin 持续学习用户特有的最小权限策略，代替会随时间衰减的人工策略与不针对对抗场景的 auto mode 分类器。评测显示它在安全与效用两方面都强于多个基线（含 LLM judge 变体与 Conseca (HotOS '25) 的改造版），并在若干攻击类型上取得相对全部基线的显著安全提升。
Motivation: 长时程、自主、带持久记忆的编码 agent 难以防御外部对手：typed tools、信息流控制、策略预测引擎等功能损失太大，而现有人工维护策略会衰减、反复授权导致用户疲劳，auto mode 的工具调用分类器又不学用户特有策略、不面向对抗场景。
Method: 在资源层（而非工具调用层）部署 defense，与 auto mode 等现有工具层防御并行工作；核心是 digital twin——一个隔离上下文模型，持续学习用户偏好并作为 agent 权限请求的用户代理，动态执行最小权限策略。为模拟学习阶段，作者提出一个 usercentric 数据集，样例按用户-agent 多天交互 transcript 组织。
Result: 评测中 Pincer 在安全与效用上均强于多个基线，基线包括 LLM judge 的若干变体与 Conseca (HotOS '25) 的改造版；在部分攻击类型上相对所有其他基线有显著安全提升，其余攻击类型上也优于基线。
Conclusion: 把授权下沉到资源层并用 digital twin 学习用户特有最小权限策略，可以在不牺牲功能的前提下同时守住安全与效用，作为工具调用层防御的补充而非替代。

papers.title: Mitigating Social Sycophancy via Pluralistic Preference Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Personal advice, including relationship advice, now ranks among the most common uses of generative AI. But language models (LMs) exhibit sycophancy: they affirm users much more often than humans do, which can make people overconfident and less willing to repair their relationships after a conflict. Prior work on mitigating sycophancy has focused on factual settings where a response can be checked against a ground truth answer, while mitigations for social sycophancy (e.g., personal advice, where there is no ground truth) have relied on simple prompting and post-training methods with limited effectiveness. Our insight is that social sycophancy occurs in part because LMs overly center on the user and fail to consider the perspectives of other stakeholders impacted by the user's behavior. To address this problem we propose Pluralistic Preference Optimization (PlurPO): given inputs describing interpersonal conflicts, the LM identifies and simulates the relevant stakeholders, and is then trained to prefer and generate responses acceptable to all stakeholders. PlurPO uses only signals the model produces about its own outputs, without ground-truth labels. PlurPO substantially reduces social sycophancy across four datasets and four model families compared to prior methods. For example, on statements of intent to cause harm, where the users' actions should not be endorsed, PlurPO reduces the endorsement rate by 89% on average across four models. On general advice questions, where the target is to match the endorsement rate of human responses, it closes the gap by more than half, from 17.8% to 8.0% on average. The preference dataset constructed by PlurPO for an 8B model also effectively transfers to mitigating sycophancy in a larger (32B) model. Our results indicate that social sycophancy can be reduced by leveraging a model's own capabilities to simulate a plurality of relevant perspectives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Pluralistic Preference Optimization (PlurPO)：让模型先识别并模拟人际冲突中的相关利益方，再用模型自身对输出的偏好信号（无 ground-truth 标签）训练其生成各方都能接受的回答，从而压低社会性谄媚 (social sycophancy)。在四个数据集、四个模型家族上，伤害意图陈述的认同率平均下降 89%，一般建议题与人类认同率的差距从 17.8% 收窄到 8.0%。
Motivation: 既有的谄媚缓解工作集中在可对照 ground truth 的事实性场景，而个人建议这类无标准答案的社会性场景只能靠简单 prompting 和后训练手段，效果有限；模型过度围绕用户、忽略其他受影响方的视角。
Method: PlurPO 分两步：给定人际冲突输入，模型先识别并模拟相关 stakeholder，再被训练为偏好并生成对所有 stakeholder 都可接受的回答；训练信号完全来自模型对自身输出的判断，不使用人工标注标签。
Result: 在四个数据集、四个模型家族上均比先前方法更大幅度降低社会性谄媚：伤害意图陈述（不应被认同的用户行为）认同率平均下降 89%；一般建议题（目标是匹配人类认同率）差距缩小一半以上，从 17.8% 降到 8.0%；为 8B 模型构建的偏好数据集可迁移到 32B 模型上缓解谄媚。
Conclusion: 社会性谄媚可以通过调用模型自身模拟多元视角的能力来降低，且无需外部真值标签；为较小模型构造的偏好数据对更大模型同样有效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DAGS: Disentangled Appearance-and-Geometry Steering of a Frozen Image DiT for Temporally Stabilized Generative Rendering
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion transformers (DiTs) generate high-fidelity images from text and image conditions, but their outputs carry large variance and their faithfulness to a desired target depends heavily on how the condition is supplied. We present DAGS, a lightweight, attention-free, disentangled appearance and geometry conditioning scheme that steers a frozen image DiT to produce high-fidelity, highly faithful, and independently controllable renders. Two small convolutional encoders compute conditioning features once per frame and inject them as a learned, per-layer, element-wise residual into the image tokens, avoiding the quadratic cost of stacking conditions through attention. Because control and temporal handling live outside the frozen backbone, we retain its vast pretrained prior and eliminate backbone-overfitting risk. We further add a small recurrent lighting stabilizer and a training-free temporal guidance term that, coupled with our conditioning, elevate a per-frame image model into a streaming renderer. DAGS produces controllable, high-quality renders at a fraction of the compute of path tracing; it is not real-time, trading compute for controllability and quality. On a matched 1-spp + G-buffer input, per-frame DAGS reconstructs +8.6 dB / +10.1 dB PSNR over the real-time denoiser Intel OIDN and the diffusion renderer RGB<->X while being 2.5-8x more temporally stable perceptually (temporal-LPIPS flicker).
papers.comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Technical Communications
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DAGS 用两个小型卷积编码器把外观与几何条件解耦，以逐层逐元素残差注入冻结图像 DiT 的 token，配合循环光照稳定器和免训练时序引导项，把逐帧图像模型变成流式可控渲染器。在 1-spp + G-buffer 输入下，逐帧 PSNR 比 Intel OIDN 高 8.6 dB、比 RGB<->X 高 10.1 dB，temporal-LPIPS 闪烁感知稳定性好 2.5–8 倍；代价是非实时。
Motivation: DiT 输出方差大，且对目标的忠实度高度依赖条件注入方式；通过 attention 堆叠条件有二次代价，直接微调骨干又会过拟合。
Method: 两个小型卷积编码器每帧计算一次条件特征，以学习到的逐层逐元素残差注入图像 token，绕开 attention 的二次开销；控制与时序处理全部置于冻结骨干之外，另加一个小型循环光照稳定器和免训练的时序引导项。
Result: 在匹配的 1-spp + G-buffer 输入上，逐帧 DAGS 相对实时去噪器 Intel OIDN 提升 +8.6 dB PSNR，相对扩散渲染器 RGB<->X 提升 +10.1 dB PSNR；temporal-LPIPS 闪烁指标上感知时序稳定性好 2.5–8 倍。计算量仅为路径追踪的一小部分，但非实时。
Conclusion: 把解耦条件与时序处理放在冻结 DiT 之外，可以在保留预训练先验、规避骨干过拟合的同时得到高质量、可独立控制且时序稳定的渲染；用算换可控性与质量，不追求实时。

papers.title: Learning Closure of Dynamical Systems with Kernel Ridge Regression
papers.abstract_en: We develop a closure modeling framework for identifying missing components of dynamical systems using Kernel Ridge Regression (KRR). The framework addresses two classes of closure problems: difference-equation closures arising in ODE and PDE settings, and algebraic closures arising from moment closure in kinetic equations. For the first class, we derive an error bound in an ODE setting that quantifies contributions from time integration, approximation of unresolved scales, and interpolation required to couple unresolved-scale effects to the resolved solver. Numerical experiments on the Lorenz-63 system and the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation demonstrate accurate long-horizon predictions and substantial improvements over an LSTM-based closure model. For the second class, we consider moment closure for a one-dimensional kinetic equation by modeling discrepancies between kinetic and macroscopic fluxes as a function of the resolved macroscopic variables. We compare global KRR models based on PCA coordinates with spatially local models. While the global model performs well for unimodal initial conditions, its accuracy deteriorates for bimodal initial conditions. Spatially local models with appropriate modeling inputs improve robustness and achieve higher predictive accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 Kernel Ridge Regression (KRR) 学动力系统的闭合项 (closure)，覆盖 ODE/PDE 的差分方程闭合与动理学方程矩闭合两类问题。在 Lorenz-63 与 Kuramoto-Sivashinsky 上，KRR 闭合给出准确的长时程预报并显著优于 LSTM 闭合；一维动理学方程中，基于 PCA 全局坐标的整体 KRR 在双峰初值下精度下降，而带合适输入的空间局部模型更稳健、精度更高。
Motivation: 未解析尺度与矩闭合缺失项使粗分辨率求解器长期积分失准：差分方程闭合要同时承担时间积分、未解析尺度近似与耦合插值三重误差，动理学矩闭合则需在宏观变量上重建动理学与宏观通量之差，全局参数化在多峰分布下失效。
Method: 以 KRR 识别缺失闭合项：第一类在 ODE 设定下推导误差界，分解时间积分、未解析尺度近似与耦合插值三项贡献；第二类把一维动理学方程中动理学通量与宏观通量的差建模为已解析宏观变量的函数，比较基于 PCA 坐标的整体 KRR 与空间局部 KRR 模型。
Result: Lorenz-63 与 Kuramoto-Sivashinsky 数值实验显示 KRR 闭合能做准确的长时程预报，并相对基于 LSTM 的闭合模型有大幅改进；一维动理学方程中整体 KRR 在单峰初值下表现良好，但在双峰初值下精度变差，空间局部模型配合合适的建模输入则提升稳健性并取得更高预测精度。
Conclusion: KRR 可作为统一的闭合学习框架同时处理差分方程与代数（矩）闭合两类问题；闭合模型的坐标选择决定鲁棒性——动理学矩闭合在多峰分布下应改用空间局部模型而非全局 PCA 参数化。

papers.title: OpenGameEval: Benchmarking Agentic Programming and Exploration in a Stateful Game Engine
papers.abstract_en: We present OpenGameEval, a benchmark and evaluation framework for agentic game development inside Roblox Studio. It runs language models as agents in reproducible, stateful game-engine sessions and scores each run with executable checks, both on the edited scene and in a simulated play session. Most agentic coding benchmarks require exploration but score only final task success. OpenGameEval separates observation tools from editing tools in its eight-tool action space, so exploration can be measured directly. We measure the pass rates and exploration behavior of 13 frontier models on 84 human-curated core tasks, with 16 attempts per task. The tasks are hard for current models. The best model solves 51.7% of tasks on a single attempt and 39.4% five times out of five, and no tested model solves six of the tasks. Models at the frontier reach similar pass rates by solving different tasks: splitting tasks by the kind of work they require spreads the top five by 5.0pp on script-authoring tasks and 12.5pp on scene-change tasks. Exploration behavior predicts whether a run succeeds. Holding task and model fixed, a run that inspects every object a reference solution touches before acting on it passes 13.4pp more often than a run that inspects none of them on scene-only tasks, and 9.8pp more often on script-only tasks. We release the task suite, its place files, the per-task annotations, a plugin that runs the tasks inside Roblox Studio, and an updated leaderboard under the MIT license at https://github.com/Roblox/open-game-eval.
papers.comment: A shorter version appears at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Evaluation of Interactive Agents
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OpenGameEval 是在 Roblox Studio 有状态游戏引擎里评测 agentic 编程的基准：把观察工具与编辑工具在八工具动作空间中分离，使探索行为可直接度量，并用可执行检查同时对编辑后的场景和模拟游玩会话打分。13 个前沿模型在 84 个人工整理核心任务上各试 16 次，最强模型单次通过 51.7%、五次全过 39.4%，且在动手前检视参考解触及的每个对象的运行，在纯场景任务上通过率高 13.4pp、纯脚本任务高 9.8pp。
Motivation: 多数 agentic coding 基准要求模型先探索环境，却只按最终任务成功打分，探索过程本身无法被度量，因此无法区分“碰巧做对”与“先看后改”。
Method: 在 Roblox Studio 内以可复现、有状态的游戏引擎会话运行语言模型 agent，八工具动作空间把观察工具与编辑工具分开；每次运行用可执行检查打分，既查编辑后的场景也查模拟游玩会话。评测 13 个前沿模型 × 84 个人工整理核心任务 × 每任务 16 次尝试，并按任务所需工作类型（script-authoring、scene-change、scene-only、script-only）分组分析。
Result: 最强模型单次尝试解决 51.7% 任务，五次全过 39.4%；没有任何被测模型解决其中 6 个任务。按工作类型拆分后，前五名在 script-authoring 任务上拉开 5.0pp、在 scene-change 任务上拉开 12.5pp。固定任务与模型，动手前检视参考解触及的全部对象的运行比一个都不检视的运行：纯场景任务通过率高 13.4pp，纯脚本任务高 9.8pp。
Conclusion: 前沿模型在该基准上仍偏难，且彼此通过率相近却解的是不同任务；探索行为可预测运行是否成功，先检视相关对象再动手是与通过率正相关的具体行为。任务集、place 文件、逐任务标注、Roblox Studio 插件与排行榜以 MIT 许可发布。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Oracle headroom without signal: null-calibrated evaluation of candidate selection for thermal heart rate estimation
papers.abstract_en: Camera-based physiological monitoring can produce multiple estimates from several facial regions, extraction methods, and processing settings. Signal quality indices aim to select reliable estimates without a physiological reference, and their potential is often assessed with an oracle that selects the estimate closest to the reference in each window. This retrospective selection can reward chance agreement. We model the effect with order statistics. For K independent candidates unrelated to the reference, the expected oracle error decreases approximately as 1/K. We analyze thermal heart rate estimation on 96 iBVP recordings with 168 candidates per 10 s window. The oracle achieves a mean absolute error of 0.91 bpm, compared with 10.74 bpm for the best fixed configuration, 18.03 bpm for the best quality index, and 8.61 bpm for a constant predictor. With K = 24, a forehead signal from another recording matches the correct one, with 4.62 against 4.61 bpm. Oracle evaluations should report candidate count, valid coverage, and matched null controls.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用次序统计量 (order statistics) 证明：当 K 个候选与参考信号无关时，逐窗挑选最接近参考的 oracle 选择其期望误差按约 1/K 下降，因此 oracle headroom 会奖励偶然一致。在 96 段 iBVP 热成像心率数据、每 10 秒窗 168 个候选上，oracle MAE 达 0.91 bpm，而最佳固定配置 10.74 bpm、最佳信号质量指数 18.03 bpm、常数预测器 8.61 bpm；K=24 时用另一段录制的额头信号即可匹配正确信号（4.62 对 4.61 bpm）。作者要求 oracle 评估必须报告候选数、有效覆盖率与匹配的空对照 (matched null controls)。
Motivation: 相机生理监测可从多个面部区域、提取方法与处理设置产生大量候选估计，常用 oracle 逐窗挑最接近参考者来评估信号质量指数 (SQI) 的潜力，但这种回顾性选择会奖励偶然一致，使 SQI 的可达成上限被系统性高估。
Method: 用次序统计量对无关候选的 oracle 误差建模，推出 K 个独立且与参考无关的候选下期望 oracle 误差约按 1/K 下降；在 96 段 iBVP 录制、每 10 秒窗 168 个候选的热成像心率估计上做回顾性分析，并引入匹配的空对照（如把另一段录制的额头信号当作候选）。
Result: oracle 平均绝对误差 0.91 bpm，最佳固定配置 10.74 bpm，最佳质量指数 18.03 bpm，常数预测器 8.61 bpm；K=24 时空额头信号（来自另一段录制）与正确信号匹配，4.62 对 4.61 bpm。
Conclusion: oracle headroom 主要由候选数量驱动而非信号质量，因此候选选择类评估必须同时报告候选数、有效覆盖率和匹配的空对照，否则 SQI 上限不可信。

papers.title: Neuron merging via inverse-activation regression for post-training compression of sigmoid neural networks
papers.abstract_en: As neural networks continue to grow in scale, model compression is becoming increasingly important for efficient inference under limited computational resources. Structured pruning methods remove neurons or channels that are estimated to be less important, but the removed units may still contain useful information. From the viewpoint of coarse-graining a trained network, it is valuable to ask which information should be retained when multiple neuronal degrees of freedom are consolidated. In this paper, we discuss cluster-based merging methods for compression of trained neural networks. In addition to a data-free contribution-weighted averaging method, we propose neuron-merging methods in which neuron responses are mapped back to the pre-activation space via the inverse activation function, and the weights and biases of each representative neuron are estimated using the least-squares method. We also examine both a data-assisted strategy with actual training inputs and a data-free strategy using randomly generated inputs. The comparisons provide empirical evidence, in the tested sigmoid networks, that weight information is particularly useful for clustering whereas activation information is useful for representative-neuron reconstruction in the merging process.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于逆激活回归的神经元合并压缩方法：用逆激活函数把神经元响应映射回 pre-activation 空间，再以最小二乘估计代表神经元的权重与偏置，并对比 data-free 与 data-assisted 两种策略。在所测试的 sigmoid 网络上，经验表明权重信息对聚类更有用，而激活信息对合并中的代表神经元重建更有用。
Motivation: 结构化剪枝直接删除被估计为不重要的神经元或通道，但被删单元可能仍含有效信息；从粗粒化训练网络的角度，需要回答合并多个神经元自由度时应保留哪些信息。
Method: 基于聚类的神经元合并：除 data-free 的贡献加权平均外，用逆激活函数 (inverse activation function) 将神经元响应映射回 pre-activation 空间，再用最小二乘法估计每个代表神经元的权重与偏置；同时考察使用真实训练输入的 data-assisted 策略与使用随机生成输入的 data-free 策略。
Result: 在所测试的 sigmoid 网络上的比较给出经验证据：权重信息对聚类特别有用，而激活信息对合并过程中的代表神经元重建有用。
Conclusion: 神经元合并中聚类与重建应使用不同信息源——聚类用权重、重建用激活，且该结论在测试的 sigmoid 网络上成立。

papers.title: How to Have a Sensitive Debate: An Instance-Optimal Protocol for AI Debate
papers.abstract_en: As powerful AI systems reach and sometimes surpass the abilities of human experts across a range of cognitively demanding tasks, the problem of accurate oversight and supervision of these systems has become increasingly urgent. One promising approach is AI debate, which seeks to leverage a debate between two powerful AIs to break complex questions down into simpler claims that can be easily judged directly. Theoretical work on debate has formalized this intuition in the language of computational complexity theory, where the goal is to design protocols (i.e., rules of the debate game) that provide rigorous guarantees on correctness for judging solutions to complex problems with limited supervision. Specifically, the current best protocol has been shown to work for all problems that have sufficiently stable decompositions into subproblems. In this paper, we design a new protocol for this same class of problems that improves on the prior work in several ways. First, correctness holds in a worst-case rather than an average-case sense. Second, being honest and correct is a dominant-strategy equilibrium for both debaters, rather than a Stackelberg equilibrium. Finally, we prove black-box lower bounds, showing that our new protocol is instance-wise optimal. That is, no protocol for this class of problems can outperform ours while making only black-box queries to human judgments. We obtain these results by relating the notion of stable problem decompositions to the concept of fractional block sensitivity from query complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对具有稳定分解 (stable decompositions) 的复杂问题，提出新的 AI debate 协议：正确性从平均情形加强为最坏情形，诚实且正确成为双方辩手的占优策略均衡 (dominant-strategy equilibrium) 而非 Stackelberg 均衡，并证明黑盒下界说明该协议在只查询人类判断的黑盒模型下 instance-wise 最优。
Motivation: AI 系统在高认知难度任务上已达到甚至超过人类专家，准确监督变得紧迫；此前最好的 debate 协议只对有足够稳定分解的问题有效，且正确性是平均情形、均衡为 Stackelberg，缺少黑盒最优性保证。
Method: 设计新的 debate 协议，把稳定问题分解与查询复杂度中的 fractional block sensitivity 联系起来；在此基础上证明最坏情形正确性、占优策略均衡性质，并给出黑盒下界。
Result: 证明了三点：正确性在最坏情形（而非平均情形）下成立；诚实且正确对两名辩手都是占优策略均衡（而非 Stackelberg 均衡）；黑盒下界表明没有协议能在仅做黑盒人类判断查询的条件下超越该协议，即 instance-wise 最优。
Conclusion: 对具有稳定分解的问题类，该协议在正确性强度、均衡稳健性和黑盒最优性上同时优于先前工作，其保证来自把稳定分解归约为 fractional block sensitivity。

papers.title: Test-time Multi-agent Coordination by Decomposed Value Gradient Flow
papers.abstract_en: Offline multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) faces a persistent trade-off. Expressive generative policies can represent multi-modal coordination in the data, but cannot distinguish high-value regions, while value-optimized policies exploit the learned Q-function but collapse the multi-modal into a single dominant mode. A single agent's mode collapse can break joint coordination, and simultaneous drift across agents can push the joint policy into unseen regions of the action space. We propose scalable coordination via optimal unified transport (SCOUT), the first offline MARL framework to combine a generative foundation model with a learned value function through test-time action refinement. SCOUT trains two decoupled components: a flow-matching behavioral prior and a decomposed value function. At test-time, it transports behavioral samples toward high-value regions via Stein variational gradient descent. The number of transport steps controls adaptive test-time scaling, replacing a fixed regularization coefficient. Under the individual-global-max (IGM) principle, we prove a single-term KL bound on the joint soft-value gap that vanishes as transport converges, with an irreducible additive residual proportional to the IGM violation. Empirically, SCOUT achieves the best average performance across discrete and continuous offline MARL benchmarks and yields performance improvements in all offline-to-online configurations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SCOUT 把离线多智能体强化学习的生成先验与价值函数解耦：flow-matching 行为先验保留多模态协调，分解价值函数在测试时用 Stein 变分梯度下降 (SVGD) 把样本运到高价值区，运输步数替代固定正则系数做自适应 test-time scaling。在 IGM 原则下证明联合 soft-value gap 的单一项 KL 界随运输收敛而消失、残差正比于 IGM 违背量，并在离散与连续离线 MARL benchmark 上取得最佳平均性能。
Motivation: 离线 MARL 中生成式策略能表示数据里的多模态协调却分不出高价值区，价值优化策略能利用 Q 函数却把多模态压成单一主模态；单个智能体的模态坍缩会破坏联合协调，多智能体同时漂移还会把联合策略推入动作空间未见区域。
Method: 提出 SCOUT：训练两个解耦组件——flow-matching 行为先验与分解价值函数 (decomposed value function)；测试时用 Stein 变分梯度下降把行为样本向高价值区运输，运输步数控制自适应 test-time scaling 以取代固定正则系数；在 individual-global-max (IGM) 原则下给出联合 soft-value gap 的单一项 KL 界。
Result: 理论上得到随运输收敛而消失的单一项 KL 界，外加正比于 IGM 违背量的不可约加性残差；实验上 SCOUT 在离散与连续离线 MARL benchmark 上取得最佳平均性能，并在所有 offline-to-online 配置中带来性能提升。
Conclusion: 生成先验与价值函数解耦、再在测试时做价值引导的运输，可以同时保住多模态协调与高价值利用；联合价值 gap 的界由 IGM 违背量决定残差下限。

papers.title: Dependence of the precipitation intensity distribution on spatial and temporal resolution in observations
papers.abstract_en: Precipitation intensity varies with both spatial and temporal resolution, with broad implications across climate science, yet the nature of this dependence is poorly characterized. We investigate how precipitation intensity distributions change with spatial and temporal resolutions and introduce a framework that approximates these changes between resolutions. Using merged satellite-gauge data regridded to various grid sizes, we construct precipitation amount distributions for spatial resolutions ranging from a base resolution of 0.1$^\circ$ for IMERG and 1$^\circ$ for the FROGS database to a coarse 10$^\circ$. Similarly, we use gauge observations coarsened to temporal resolutions ranging from 1-minute to 24-hours to construct precipitation amount distributions. This approach allows us to remove physical differences in order to isolate the effect of resolution on precipitation. Results show that the precipitation intensity distribution varies across spatial and temporal resolutions even without changes in physical processes. We demonstrate that these resolution-dependent changes in the precipitation amount distribution can be effectively characterized by shifting the distribution in logarithmic space without changing its shape, called the shift mode. Our findings emphasize the need to account for the effects of scale on precipitation when comparing and interpreting differences in gridded precipitation from models or observations.
papers.comment: 38 pages, 10 figures, plus supplementary material (3 pages, 2 figures). Submitted to Journal of Climate
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 IMERG（基准 0.1°）与 FROGS（基准 1°）卫星-雨量合并资料重网格到最粗 10°，以及雨量站观测从 1 分钟粗化到 24 小时，证明降水强度分布即使在物理过程不变时也随空间与时间分辨率系统变化，且这种变化可在对数空间中用整体平移（shift mode）刻画——分布形状不变、只发生位移。
Motivation: 降水强度分布随分辨率的变化在气候研究中影响广泛但性质刻画不清，导致跨模式或跨观测资料比较格点降水时无法区分物理差异与分辨率效应。
Method: 把合并卫星-雨量资料重网格化到一系列网格尺度（IMERG 从 0.1°、FROGS 从 1° 到 10°），并把雨量站观测粗化到 1 分钟至 24 小时的时间分辨率，分别构建降水量分布；通过固定物理过程只改变分辨率来分离纯分辨率效应，并提出在对数空间平移分布的近似框架。
Result: 在不改变物理过程的条件下，降水强度分布仍随空间与时间分辨率变化；该变化可由对数空间中的整体平移（shift mode）有效刻画，即分布形状保持不变。
Conclusion: 比较或解释模式与观测的格点降水差异时必须先扣除尺度效应，因为分辨率本身就能在对数空间平移降水分布而不改变其形状。
Relevance: 72

papers.title: Out of Sync, Out of Sight: Phantom State Attacks against IIoT Intrusion Detection
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning-based intrusion detection systems (IDS) are critical for securing Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) environments. Most adversarial research against them perturbs the feature vector or the traffic that produces it, and depends on gradient access, repeated model queries, or a learned model of benign traffic. A smaller line of work reshapes packet timing without querying the detector, but makes malicious traffic mimic a learned model of benign timing. Across these approaches, one assumption of industrial monitoring pipelines has received little attention: temporal synchronization. An IDS reconstructs operational state by aggregating telemetry into sliding or tumbling windows, so its view depends not only on what is observed but on when each observation falls relative to a window boundary. We introduce the Phantom State Attack (PSA), which exploits that dependence under a passive, zero-query threat model. Rather than modifying packets, perturbing features, querying the classifier, or fitting any model of benign traffic, PSA injects bounded timing drift calibrated to the attack flow's own inter-arrival variability, moving observations across the nearest window boundary by the minimal shift needed. The IDS then reconstructs a phantom state that diverges from the true process state. We evaluate PSA on ToN-IoT and CIC IIoT 2025 (DataSense), against Random Forest, MLP and XGBoost, measuring detection degradation, synchronization distortion, stealth, and attacker cost. PSA degrades detection on flows carrying enough packets for window-boundary redistribution, and leaves others almost unchanged, so its effect is conditional. A query-based baseline reaches higher raw success but needs many queries per window, while PSA needs none. The results identify temporal aggregation as an attack surface reachable under weaker assumptions than prior evasion techniques.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Phantom State Attack (PSA)：在被动零查询威胁模型下，按攻击流自身的到达间隔方差注入有界时延漂移，把观测推过最近的滑动/翻转窗口边界，使 IDS 重建出与真实过程状态不符的幻影状态。在 ToN-IoT 与 CIC IIoT 2025 (DataSense) 上对 Random Forest、MLP、XGBoost 的检测造成退化，但只对包数足以触发窗口边界重分布的流有效，其余流几乎不变。
Motivation: 针对 ML 入侵检测的对抗研究多依赖梯度、反复查询或学习良性流量模型，而工业监控管道的时间同步假设——观测落在窗口边界的哪一侧——几乎未被当作攻击面。
Method: PSA 不改包、不扰动特征、不查询分类器、不拟合良性流量模型，只注入以攻击流自身 inter-arrival 变异性标定的有界 timing drift，用最小位移跨过最近窗口边界；在 ToN-IoT 与 CIC IIoT 2025 (DataSense) 上评估 Random Forest、MLP、XGBoost，度量检测退化、同步失真、隐蔽性与攻击者代价。
Result: PSA 在包数足以进行窗口边界重分布的流上降低检测，对其他流几乎无影响，效果是条件性的；基于查询的基线原始成功率更高但每个窗口需要大量查询，PSA 查询数为零。
Conclusion: 时间聚合本身是可在比既有规避技术更弱假设下触达的攻击面，其效果取决于流是否跨越窗口边界。

papers.title: Reward Inflation: A Healthy Stimulus for Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reward serves as the primary learning signal in reinforcement learning (RL). However, while reward magnitudes are typically held fixed throughout training, their temporal modulation remains underexplored. In this paper, we propose reward inflation, a gradual scaling of rewards over the course of training, and show that it can act as a healthy stimulus for RL. Theoretically, reward inflation induces an implicit recency weighting that upweights recent transitions during policy updates, enabling faster adaptation. We further show that, by sustaining gradient signals as the policy saturates, reward inflation suppresses the emergence of dormant neurons and helps preserve plasticity. Empirical results on ALE games and MuJoCo tasks corroborate these findings, showing that an appropriate level of reward inflation benefits a broad range of tasks. Finally, we introduce Fed, an adaptive variant that adjusts the inflation level on the fly, and find that it often improves upon fixed inflation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 reward inflation：训练过程中逐步放大奖励幅度，理论上等价于对近期 transition 加权，从而加快策略更新的适应速度；同时在策略饱和时维持梯度信号，抑制 dormant neuron 出现并保持策略网络的 plasticity。ALE 与 MuJoCo 上适当强度的 inflation 普遍有益，自适应变体 Fed 在线调节膨胀程度，通常优于固定膨胀。
Motivation: RL 中奖励幅度通常全程固定，其时间维度上的调制尚未被充分研究；策略饱和后梯度信号衰减、神经元休眠导致 plasticity 丢失。
Method: 提出 reward inflation（随训练进程逐步缩放奖励），给出其诱导隐式 recency weighting 的理论分析；再提出自适应变体 Fed，在线调整 inflation 强度。
Result: ALE 游戏与 MuJoCo 任务上的实验表明适当程度的 reward inflation 对大范围任务有益；Fed 自适应变体通常优于固定 inflation。
Conclusion: 奖励的时间调制是可行的训练信号：适度膨胀既加速适应又维持 plasticity，自适应控制膨胀量比固定值更稳。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: How To Train Your World Model: Fine-tuning vs RAG for LM-based World Modeling
papers.abstract_en: World models (WMs) simulate the transition dynamics of environments, enabling agents to plan over the consequences of their actions. In text-based environments, fine-tuning a Language Model (LM) to serve as a WM has emerged as a dominant paradigm. However, despite the widespread success of non-parametric approaches such as Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), retrieval for LM-based world modelling remains underexplored. We conduct a systematic evaluation across five diverse environments spanning embodied, web navigation and social settings, comparing fine-tuning and RAG-based approaches for LM-based world modelling. Our study reveals that fine-tuning often outperforms RAG, with fine-tuned WMs enabling agents to obtain higher rewards on 15/20 settings. While both construction paradigms benefit from additional and more diverse exploration, RAG-based approaches prove more data-efficient, and fine-tuning approaches disproportionately benefit from scaling the amount of experience collected. With a focus on RAG-based WMs, we devise a procedure that uses counterfactual intervention to estimate the error rate of the retrieval stage, and show that retrievers consistently surface suboptimal transitions from the experience buffer. Hoping to address this failing, we study a variety of query reformulation strategies, demonstrating that a hierarchical approach outperforms the traditional retrieval pipeline. Finally, we compose our findings into a hybrid world modelling system that parametrically captures core environment dynamics, while learning to rely on retrieval from an actively maintained memory store. Our hybrid system consistently outperforms other methods across multiple environments and models, showcasing the robustness of the approach and the applicability of our findings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在文本环境的世界模型 (world model) 构建中，微调 LM 通常胜过 RAG：20 个设置里微调世界模型让智能体拿到更高奖励的有 15 个。但 RAG 更数据高效，微调则随经验量增长收益更大；针对检索阶段的反事实干预 (counterfactual intervention) 估计出检索器持续从经验缓冲中取出次优转移，层级式查询重构 (hierarchical query reformulation) 优于传统检索管线，最终混合系统在多个环境与模型上一致领先。
Motivation: 文本环境中用微调 LM 作世界模型已是主流，而 RAG 这类非参数方法在世界建模中的检索路径研究不足，两者在数据效率与经验规模上的取舍没有系统比较。
Method: 在覆盖具身、网页导航与社交设定的五个环境上系统对比微调与 RAG 两种世界模型构建范式；对 RAG 世界模型用反事实干预估计检索阶段错误率，并测试多种查询重构策略，最后组合成混合系统：参数化捕获核心环境动力学，同时学会依赖主动维护的记忆库检索。
Result: 微调世界模型在 15/20 个设置上让智能体获得更高奖励；两种范式都受益于更多更多样化的探索，但 RAG 更数据高效，微调则不成比例地受益于经验量扩展；检索器持续返回次优转移，层级式查询重构优于传统检索管线；混合系统在多个环境与模型上一致优于其他方法。
Conclusion: 微调在奖励上占优但吃经验量，RAG 走数据高效路线且瓶颈在检索质量；把参数化动力学与主动维护的记忆库检索组合起来，比单一范式更稳健。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: ENCORE: Exact Non-equilibrium COntrol with Replica Exchange for Diffusion Generation
papers.abstract_en: Inference-time control steers a pretrained generative model towards a target distribution without retraining. We study tilted targets $π_0\propto G_0\,p_0$, where $p_0$ is the sampler output distribution and $G_0$ is an evaluable reweighting function. Existing approaches rely on sequential annealing with sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) or parallel annealing with replica exchange (RE). Sequential control is exact but needs large particle populations, whereas no exact parallel control method exists: existing RE corrections approximate an intractable time reversal and are biased. We propose Exact Non-equilibrium COntrol with Replica Exchange (ENCORE), the first exact parallel control method. Each replica stores its generation trajectory, so the upward move is a truncation and the intractable time reversal is never simulated. We prove target invariance and show that the resulting dynamics are those of non-equilibrium replica exchange with the exact time reversal as forward proposal. Under regularity conditions, our diffusion analysis shows that both sequential and parallel control become unstable under refinement of the time discretisation without guidance, whereas guided proposals remain stable and yield diagnostics for tuning the schedule and the computational budget. Across synthetic targets, Boltzmann sampling of biomolecules, and image generation, ENCORE achieves competitive accuracy and diversity, remains robust to sampler perturbations, and applies to distilled samplers where existing RE corrections are unavailable.
papers.comment: A shorter version of this work was accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 PriGM Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出首个精确的并行推理时控制方法 ENCORE：每个 replica 保存生成轨迹，使上行移动退化为截断，从而完全不模拟不可解的时间反演。证明了目标分布不变性，并给出扩散分析表明无引导的顺序与并行控制在时间离散细化下都会失稳，而引导提议保持稳定。
Motivation: 倾斜目标 π0∝G0p0 的推理时控制中，顺序 SMC 精确但需大粒子群，现有 replica exchange 并行修正近似不可解的时间反演因而有偏，缺少精确的并行控制方法。
Method: ENCORE 让每个 replica 存储完整生成轨迹，上行移动做成截断操作，避免模拟时间反演；证明目标不变性，并把动力学刻画为以精确时间反演为前向提议的非平衡 replica exchange；用扩散分析给出时间离散细化下的稳定性条件，用于调调度与计算预算。
Result: 在合成目标、生物分子的 Boltzmann 采样与图像生成三类设定上，ENCORE 达到有竞争力的精度与多样性，对 sampler 扰动保持稳健，并可用于现有 RE 修正无法适用的 distilled samplers；理论结果为无引导的顺序与并行控制在时间离散细化下失稳、引导提议稳定。
Conclusion: 精确的并行推理时控制是可行的：靠保存轨迹绕开不可解时间反演即可保持目标不变，且引导提议是离散细化下稳定的必要条件。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Autoregressive Differentiable Method for Integer Programming
papers.abstract_en: We introduce an autoregressive differentiable method to solve 0-1 integer programs. We fix an arbitrary order of the binary variables and we train a transformer to predict the next bit while remaining in the feasible set. Our method is first trained on feasible incumbents provided by any solver, thus allowing us to initialize the transformer in the feasible set. Our procedure then implements a Lagrangian penalty to penalize infeasible solutions, and the transformer is further trained to explore the feasible set using Gumbel-softmax activations on the relaxed objective. We have tested our method on non-convex instances of quadratic knapsack problem and demonstrated consistent improvement upon state-of-the-art open-source solvers for dense problems up to 10,000 binary variables. In particular, we empirically demonstrate a phenomenon akin to a tunneling effect where the effective change of variables from binary variable to the continuous weights of the transformer that the method implements enables crossing barriers in the relaxed objective landscape.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: CriticHack: Evaluating Visual Rewards Under Robot Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Learned visual reward models are increasingly used to optimize robot policies, yet a reward model can score an execution that acts on the wrong object as highly as one that completes the task. We show that optimizing such a reward can amplify these wrong-object failures while reward and task success both rise, so the signals a practitioner would normally monitor look healthy. We fine-tune every denoiser parameter of a diffusion policy against Robometer on a drawer task. Starting from a supervised policy with no prior reward exposure, five training runs raise task success by 10.2 percentage points and wrong-object failures by 10.9 points on 512 evaluation seeds, whereas five runs trained on the simulator's task-completion signal raise success without amplifying wrong-object failures (difference 9.2 points, 95% CI 5.6 to 13.0). The amplification recurs from a policy previously optimized against learned rewards, under the policy's native diffusion sampler, at matched distance from the initial policy, and across constrained-policy experiments with two critics and two optimizers. A tilt model explains when it occurs: under KL-regularized optimization, an outcome becomes more frequent whenever its expected reward under the initial policy exceeds the population average. Robometer separates successes from failures well overall (AUROC .81) but scores wrong-object failures slightly above successes (AUROC .37), so optimization raises both. The same model predicts the outcome shifts across 26 constrained settings (Spearman .89), including those in which task success falls, and Robometer's own published success-termination recipe inherits the error. A frozen outcome verifier redirects the same optimization toward the requested task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用学习到的视觉奖励模型优化机器人策略会放大“操作错物体”失败：对 Robometer 在抽屉任务上微调扩散策略的全部去噪参数，五次训练在 512 个评测种子上把任务成功率抬高 10.2 个百分点的同时，错物体失败也抬高 10.9 个百分点，而奖励与成功率两个监控信号都在上升。tilt model 解释机制：KL 正则优化下，只要某结果在初始策略下的期望奖励高于总体平均，其出现频率就会上升；Robometer 整体区分成败（AUROC .81）却把错物体失败打分略高于成功（AUROC .37）。改用冻结的结果验证器 (frozen outcome verifier) 可把同一优化重定向到所请求的任务上。
Motivation: 学习到的视觉奖励模型可能给“作用在错误物体上”的执行打高分，实践者通常监控的奖励与任务成功率会同时上升，掩盖这类失败被优化放大的事实。
Method: 在 Robometer 抽屉任务上，从无奖励暴露的监督策略出发，对 diffusion policy 的全部去噪参数做奖励优化；对照组用模拟器的任务完成信号训练，每组五次运行，512 个评测种子。另在原生 diffusion 采样器、与初始策略等距离、以及两种 critic 与两种优化器的受约束策略实验中复现，并用 tilt model 与冻结的结果验证器做解释与纠正。
Result: 五次奖励优化运行使任务成功率 +10.2 个百分点、错物体失败 +10.9 个百分点（512 评测种子）；五次模拟器完成信号运行提升成功率但不放大错物体失败，两者差 9.2 个百分点，95% CI 5.6 到 13.0。Robometer 整体 AUROC .81，但对错物体失败的 AUROC .37（略高于成功）；tilt model 对 26 个受约束设置的结果偏移预测 Spearman .89，含成功率下降的设置。
Conclusion: 奖励模型对失败模式的排序错误会被 KL 正则优化系统性放大，因此监控奖励与成功率不足以发现；用冻结的结果验证器重定向同一优化即可指向所请求的任务，Robometer 自己发布的成功终止配方也继承该错误。
Relevance: 2
