papers.title: Learning What to Investigate Next: Meta-Reasoning for Long-Horizon Research Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon research agents must decide both how to investigate and what to investigate next as evidence accumulates. This is hard to learn because such decisions are sparse in long execution traces, and their consequences may emerge several investigations later. We introduce Meta-reasoning for Iterative Research Agents (MIRA), a hierarchical architecture separating research allocation from execution. An outer-loop meta-reasoner curates context from a persistent research record, then writes a work order for the next investigation or ends the episode. A fresh inner-loop executor carries out each work order, making execution part of the transition between meta-reasoning actions. Without policy training, MIRA improves long-horizon inference and allocates additional compute more effectively in theorem proving and open-ended neural-architecture research. Its decision boundaries also provide natural units for credit assignment. At each boundary, we train a generative critic to forecast expected remaining return from partial states, outperforming token-level alternatives. Cross-environment pretraining improves forecasting and adaptation, yielding a transferable prior for valuing partial progress. We use this prior to initialize MIRA-AC, a generative actor-critic jointly trained to forecast remaining return and choose the next investigation, without a separate critic model. MIRA-AC concentrates policy optimization on meta-reasoning decisions, enabling efficient long-horizon reinforcement learning without directly optimizing the longer execution traces they initiate. Training MIRA-AC on the model's own proxy hill-climbing signals improves gold performance across four autoresearch environments; the actor transfers with cross-environment value initialization. Together, these results show that meta-reasoning can be learned as an explicit policy for directing long-horizon autonomous research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出分层架构 MIRA，把长程研究 agent 的「研究分配」与「执行」分开：外环 meta-reasoner 从持久研究记录中整理上下文并写下一份 work order（或结束 episode），全新内环 executor 执行该 work order。无需策略训练即可在定理证明与开放式神经架构搜索中改善长程推理与算力分配；其决策边界作为 credit assignment 单元，训练生成式 critic 预测剩余回报并优于 token 级替代，再据此初始化 MIRA-AC，在四个 autoresearch 环境上用模型自身的 proxy hill-climbing 信号提升 gold 表现。
Motivation: 长程研究 agent 的「下一步查什么」决策在长执行轨迹中极稀疏，且后果要到若干次调查之后才显现，难以学习。
Method: MIRA 分层架构：外环 meta-reasoner 从 persistent research record 整理上下文、写下下一调查的 work order 或终止 episode；全新内环 executor 执行，使执行成为 meta-reasoning 动作之间的 transition。在每个决策边界训练生成式 critic 从部分状态预测剩余回报，跨环境预训练得到可迁移的价值先验，再用它初始化 MIRA-AC——一个同时预测剩余回报与选择下一调查的生成式 actor-critic，无需独立 critic 模型。
Result: 无需策略训练时 MIRA 在定理证明与开放式神经架构研究上改善长程推理并更有效地分配额外算力；生成式 critic 在决策边界预测剩余回报优于 token 级替代；跨环境预训练改善预测与适应；在四个 autoresearch 环境上，用模型自身 proxy hill-climbing 信号训练 MIRA-AC 提升 gold 表现，且 actor 借助跨环境价值初始化可迁移。
Conclusion: meta-reasoning 可以作为显式策略来学习，用于指挥长程自主研究；把策略优化集中在 meta-reasoning 决策上，即可高效做长程强化学习，而不必直接优化它们发起的更长执行轨迹。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BaCP: Backbone Contrastive Pruning for Preserving Representations in Extremely Sparse Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Unstructured pruning at extreme sparsity often suffers from representational collapse, causing sharp drops in accuracy. To address this, we study Backbone Contrastive Pruning (BaCP), which regularizes the sparse network's embedding space by aligning it with pretrained, fine-tuned, and historical snapshot models. Building on the contrastive decomposition of the CAP framework (Xu et al., 2022), we provide a rigorous matched-budget characterization of this approach across multiple pruning criteria. Evaluated across 90 settings, BaCP improves accuracy substantially in extreme sparsity regimes where standard pruning fails, and is close to baseline where representations remain intact.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BaCP 通过对比正则把极稀疏网络的嵌入空间对齐到预训练、微调与历史快照模型，抑制非结构化剪枝在极端稀疏度下的表征坍塌。在 90 个设置的匹配预算评测中，标准剪枝失效的极端稀疏区间精度大幅提升，而表征完好的区间则接近未剪枝基线。
Motivation: 非结构化剪枝推到极端稀疏度时会出现表征坍塌，精度骤降，标准剪枝准则在此区间失效。
Method: 提出 Backbone Contrastive Pruning (BaCP)，用对比损失把稀疏网络嵌入空间与预训练模型、微调模型及历史快照模型对齐；建立在 CAP 框架 (Xu et al., 2022) 的对比分解之上，并在多种剪枝准则下做匹配预算 (matched-budget) 对比刻画。
Result: 在 90 个设置上评测：极端稀疏区间（标准剪枝失效处）精度显著提升，表征仍完好的区间则接近基线精度。
Conclusion: 对齐多参考模型的对比正则可在极端稀疏下保住表征，从而在标准剪枝崩溃的区间恢复精度。

papers.title: Hypothesis-guided discovery of cognitive algorithms via program refinement
papers.abstract_en: Developing cognitive models of algorithmic reasoning from behavioral data is a central problem in cognitive science that challenges current methods. Traditional approaches to cognitive modeling are interpretable and benefit from human expertise, but lack flexibility and scalability. Emerging techniques using large language models (LLMs) for de novo generation of cognitive models are scalable and flexible, but lack a role for human expertise and have mostly been applied to simpler tasks than algorithm recovery. We propose a hybrid system that treats discovery of cognitive algorithms as a program refinement problem. Human-created cognitive models are expressed as probabilistic programs and provided to a system of LLM agents with a mandate to: identify mismatches between model and behavior; propose code-level modifications within researcher-specified constraints; and verify structural fidelity. Revisions propagate to a probabilistic inference module that performs inference for latent variables and data likelihood computations. We evaluate the pipeline on human behavior in a problem-solving paradigm that exposes a variety of cognitive algorithms. Revised models consistently improve model fit relative to ancestral models and reveal a small set of recurring innovations that capture meaningful behavioral variability in this task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把认知算法发现改写成程序精修 (program refinement) 问题：人写的认知模型以概率程序形式交给 LLM agent 系统，由其定位模型与行为的失配、在研究者约束内提出代码级修改并校验结构保真，修改回流到概率推断模块重算隐变量与似然。在暴露多种认知算法的问题解决范式上，精修后的模型相对祖先模型一致提升拟合，并浮现出一小撮反复出现的创新点，刻画了有意义的行为变异。
Motivation: 传统认知建模可解释、依赖人类专家但缺乏灵活性与可扩展性；LLM 从零生成认知模型可扩展灵活，却把人类专业知识排除在外，且多用于比算法恢复更简单的任务。
Method: 混合系统将认知算法发现视为程序精修：人类模型写成概率程序，交给 LLM agent 系统执行三步——识别模型与行为失配、在研究者指定约束内提出代码级修改、验证结构保真；修改传播到概率推断模块做隐变量推断与数据似然计算。
Result: 在暴露多种认知算法的问题解决范式的人类行为上评估，精修后的模型相对祖先模型一致改善模型拟合，并揭示出一小撮反复出现的创新点，捕捉该任务中有意义的行为变异性。

papers.title: Spatial Memory Intelligence: Endowing World Models with Understanding-Driven Long-Term Memory
papers.abstract_en: Long-video generation and world models have shown strong potential for interactive entertainment and embodied simulation by predicting future observations conditioned on user actions and historical memory. However, as memory sequences grow longer and their structures become increasingly complex, managing long-range spatial context becomes increasingly challenging, calling for a more intelligent and systematic memory-management strategy. Building on the advancing spatial reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and the broader vision of unified models, we propose Spatial Memory Intelligence (SMI), the first framework to systematically employ an understanding model for spatial-memory management in long-video world models. SMI introduces four coordinated atomic operations: spatial clustering, within-cluster sparsification, action-aware retrieval, and reliability-aware filtering. Extensive experiments across multiple baselines, benchmarks, and world-model backbones demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of SMI, achieving comprehensive improvements in memory sparsity, generation stability, and spatial consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SMI 用多模态大模型 (MLLM) 作为理解器来管理长视频世界模型的空间记忆，提出四个协同原子操作：空间聚类、簇内稀疏化、动作感知检索、可靠性感知过滤。在多个基线、benchmark 与世界模型 backbone 上实验，记忆稀疏度、生成稳定性与空间一致性均获综合提升。
Motivation: 长视频生成与世界模型中记忆序列越来越长、结构越来越复杂，长程空间上下文难以管理，需要更智能、系统化的记忆管理策略。
Method: 提出 Spatial Memory Intelligence (SMI)，以理解模型驱动空间记忆管理，包含四个原子操作：spatial clustering、within-cluster sparsification、action-aware retrieval、reliability-aware filtering，作用于按用户动作与历史记忆条件生成未来观测的长视频世界模型。
Result: 在多个基线、多个 benchmark 与多个世界模型 backbone 上实验，SMI 在记忆稀疏度 (memory sparsity)、生成稳定性 (generation stability) 与空间一致性 (spatial consistency) 三方面均取得综合提升。
Conclusion: 用理解模型统一管理空间记忆是长视频世界模型可行且可跨 backbone 泛化的方案，能同时改善稀疏度、稳定性与空间一致性。

papers.title: Instance-Dependent Regret for CMDPs with Step-Wise Constraints
papers.abstract_en: We study online learning in episodic tabular constrained Markov decision processes with step-wise safety constraints. In such a setting, the constraints induce a safe subgraph that shapes the variance of cumulative rewards under feasible policies and, consequently, the difficulty of learning. Exploiting this structure, however, requires learning which actions are safe while controlling constraint violations. We propose Safe Variance-Adaptive Exploration (SVAE), an efficient algorithm that learns candidate safe subgraphs and performs variance-adaptive optimistic planning within them. With high probability, SVAE achieves cumulative regret of order $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{SAH\min\{\mathbb{V}_Σ,K\mathrm{Var}^{\star}\}}+S\sqrt{AH^3\min\{K,\mathcal{C}\}}+S^2AH^2)$ over $K$ episodes, where $H$ is the horizon of a single episode, while $S$ and $A$ are the numbers of states and actions, respectively. Here, $\mathrm{Var}^{\star}$ is the maximum return variance among safe policies, $\mathbb{V}_Σ$ is the variance accumulated before the first unsafe action is encountered, and $\mathcal{C}$ captures the statistical complexity of eliminating actions incorrectly considered potentially safe. SVAE additionally attains $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(H\sqrt{SAK}+S^2AH^2)$ step-wise constraint violation and a gap-dependent violation bound that is polylogarithmic in $K$. Finally, we establish a lower bound showing that dependence on these instance-specific quantities is unavoidable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在带逐步安全约束的回合制表格 CMDP 中，提出 SVAE：先学习候选安全子图，再在子图内做方差自适应的乐观规划。高概率下 K 回合累计 regret 为 Õ(√(SAH min{V_Σ, K Var*}) + S√(AH³ min{K, C}) + S²AH²)，逐步约束违反量为 Õ(H√(SAK) + S²AH²)，并给出 gap-dependent、对 K 仅多项式对数的违反界；下界证明对这些实例相关量的依赖不可避免。
Motivation: 逐步安全约束在 CMDP 中诱导出安全子图，它决定可行策略下累计回报的方差、进而决定学习难度；但利用这一结构必须在学习哪些动作安全的同时控制约束违反，二者难以兼顾。
Method: 提出 Safe Variance-Adaptive Exploration (SVAE)：学习候选安全子图，并在其中执行方差自适应的乐观规划 (variance-adaptive optimistic planning)，在回合制表格 CMDP 上以高概率给出 regret 与违反界。
Result: K 回合累计 regret Õ(√(SAH min{V_Σ, K Var*}) + S√(AH³ min{K, C}) + S²AH²)，其中 Var* 为安全策略最大回报方差、V_Σ 为首次遇到不安全动作前累积的方差、C 刻画排除误判为潜在安全动作的统计复杂度；逐步约束违反量 Õ(H√(SAK) + S²AH²)，另有对 K 多项式对数的 gap-dependent 违反界；并建立下界表明对这些实例相关量的依赖不可避免。
Conclusion: CMDP 中的 regret 与约束违反应按安全子图诱导的实例相关量（方差与统计复杂度）来刻画，且这种依赖在下界意义上不可去掉。

papers.title: Learning the Latent Structure: A Feature-Centric Approach to Graph Data Augmentation
papers.abstract_en: Graph-structured data plays a pivotal role in modeling complex relationships. However, real-world graphs are often incomplete due to data collection and observational constraints, severely limiting the effectiveness of modern graph learning pipelines. While existing Graph Data Augmentation (GDA) methods attempt to refine graph structures for improved downstream performance, they are typically label-dependent, computationally expensive, and inherently transductive, limiting their applicability in practical scenarios. In this work, we present a novel feature-centric graph data augmentation framework that bypasses explicit structure modeling by operating directly in the embedding space. Through a self-supervised inverse masking process, our method captures latent ties between observed and complete graphs, enabling recovery of unobserved structural signals through refined node representations. To enhance robustness under noisy and sparse supervision, we introduce a message regularizer and a bootstrap strategy for effective training and generalization. Evaluated on ten graph datasets spanning multiple domains, our approach, SelfAug, consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both accuracy and efficiency across inductive and cold-start settings, highlighting its potential as a scalable and generalizable solution for real-world graph learning scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SelfAug 把图数据增强 (GDA) 从显式结构建模移到嵌入空间，用自监督 inverse masking 恢复未观测结构信号，并以 message regularizer 和 bootstrap 策略应对噪声与稀疏监督。在覆盖多领域的十个图数据集上，它在 inductive 与 cold-start 设定下的准确率和效率均持续超过现有 SOTA 方法。
Motivation: 真实图因采集与观测约束而不完整，现有 GDA 方法依赖标签、计算昂贵且是 transductive 的，难以用于无标签的归纳与冷启动场景。
Method: 特征中心的 GDA 框架 SelfAug：绕开显式结构建模，直接在嵌入空间操作，通过自监督 inverse masking 建立观测图与完整图之间的隐含关联来恢复未观测结构信号；另加 message regularizer 与 bootstrap 策略提升噪声、稀疏监督下的鲁棒性与泛化。
Result: 在跨多领域的十个图数据集上，SelfAug 在 inductive 与 cold-start 两种设定下于准确率和效率两方面均持续优于 state-of-the-art 方法。
Conclusion: 在嵌入空间做特征中心的自监督增强，可以替代依赖标签的显式结构增强，成为真实场景图学习的可扩展方案。

papers.title: Student-Guided Teacher Distillation for Efficient LLM Task Routing: Positioning Against Jev-Style System-1 Classifiers
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot classifiers are useful for routing user requests to specialized LLM tasks, but scoring every request against a large candidate set is expensive: a zero-shot NLI classifier must evaluate one premise-hypothesis pair per label, so cost scales linearly with taxonomy size. We study a student-guided teacher distillation pipeline for a fixed taxonomy of 60 LLM task categories: a compact ModernBERT classifier predicts the full category distribution in one forward pass and retrieves a small top-k candidate set, and a larger DeBERTa-v3 zero-shot NLI classifier reranks only those candidates rather than all 60 labels; the resulting teacher labels iteratively improve the student, which produces sharper candidates for the next round. Unlike generic embedding retrieval or clustering-derived shortlists used in extreme multi-label classification, our candidate generator is trained end-to-end on the target taxonomy and is the same model serving production traffic, distinguishing it from LLM-routing work that routes between candidate models, and from concurrent System-1 encoder-classifier proposals (e.g. TypeSafe AI's Jev and the open-source Laya project) whose training methodology is undocumented or RL-based. Our best student checkpoint reaches 77.5% teacher agreement on a 200-example evaluation set, and preliminary coverage measurements show Coverage@16 of 91-100%, suggesting top-k sets retain most of the teacher's decision-relevant information. We further show truncated top-k teacher scores should not be treated as full 60-class soft targets for KL distillation: zeroing untruncated classes destroys the dark knowledge soft-label distillation depends on, introducing systematic bias rather than a harmless sparse approximation. A complete evaluation, including coverage at multiple k on a held-out set, an embedding-retrieval baseline, and a larger human-reviewed test set, remains in progress.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 LLM 任务路由中零样本 NLI 分类器需对每个标签各算一对 premise-hypothesis、代价随 taxonomy 规模线性增长的问题，提出学生引导的教师蒸馏管线：紧凑 ModernBERT 一次前向给出全类分布并取 top-k，DeBERTa-v3 零样本 NLI 只对这 k 个候选重排，教师标签再迭代改进学生。在 60 类固定 taxonomy 上最佳学生 checkpoint 达到 77.5% 教师一致率（200 例评测集），Coverage@16 为 91–100%。
Motivation: 零样本分类器做请求路由时，每个请求都要与全部标签逐一打分，代价随 taxonomy 规模线性上升；极端多标签检索的通用 embedding 或聚类短名单又未针对目标 taxonomy 端到端训练。
Method: 两阶段蒸馏：ModernBERT 学生一次前向预测 60 类完整分布并取 top-k 候选，DeBERTa-v3 零样本 NLI 教师仅对候选重排；教师标签迭代回训学生，使下一轮候选更锐利。候选生成器在目标 taxonomy 上端到端训练，且与生产流量使用同一模型。另给出截断 top-k 教师分数不可当作 60 类软标签做 KL 蒸馏的分析。
Result: 在 60 类 LLM 任务 taxonomy 上，最佳学生 checkpoint 于 200 例评测集达到 77.5% 教师一致率；初步 coverage 测量给出 Coverage@16 为 91–100%，表明 top-k 集保留了教师决策相关的大部分信息。将未截断类置零会破坏软标签蒸馏依赖的 dark knowledge，引入系统性偏差而非无害稀疏近似。
Conclusion: top-k 学生加教师重排的迭代蒸馏能以远低于全标签打分的代价逼近零样本教师的路由决策；但截断分数不能直接当 KL 蒸馏的全类软目标，完整评测（多 k 覆盖率、embedding 检索基线、更大人工评测集）仍在进行中。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: IGNITE Tokamak World Model Architecture
papers.abstract_en: We introduce IGNITE, a generative world foundation model for fusion plasma behavior simulation trained in a self-supervised manner from over a decade of unlabeled experimental data at the DIII-D National Fusion Facility. The core of IGNITE is a dynamics model that can simulate DIII-D discharges from a given set of actuator trajectories. These trajectories can be supplied or generated on-the-fly from a textual prompt or from desired experimental outcomes. The model architecture consists of several spatio-temporal tokenizers that embed the different input modalities, including time-series like spatio-temporal measurement data, image sequences, and high-resolution spectrograms, each of which collected at vastly different time scales. The backbone is composed of an auto-regressive dynamics model that has the capacity to predict entire DIII-D discharges given initial latent plasma states and actuator trajectories over a theoretical infinite horizon. IGNITE paves the way towards efficient AI-driven experimental planning and world modeling for nuclear fusion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IGNITE 是面向托卡马克等离子体的生成式世界基础模型，用 DIII-D 十余年无标签实验数据自监督训练，由多模态时空 tokenizer 加自回归动力学骨干构成，可从初始等离子体潜态与执行器轨迹模拟整段放电，执行器轨迹还能由文本提示或期望实验结果在线生成。
Motivation: 托卡马克实验数据量大但无标签，放电模拟与实验规划依赖昂贵的物理模型或人工试错，缺少能直接从历史实验数据学出、可按目标反向生成控制轨迹的通用模型。
Method: 多个时空 tokenizer 分别嵌入不同时间尺度的输入模态：时空测量时序、图像序列、高分辨率频谱图；骨干是自回归动力学模型，以初始潜态和执行器轨迹为条件预测整段 DIII-D 放电，理论无限时域展开；执行器轨迹可外部给定，也可由文本提示或期望实验结果在线生成。
Result: 在 DIII-D National Fusion Facility 超过十年的无标签实验数据上以自监督方式训练，模型可从给定执行器轨迹模拟 DIII-D 放电并预测整段放电。
Conclusion: 融合等离子体行为可以做成自监督训练的生成式世界模型，支撑 AI 驱动的实验规划与 world modeling；该主张基于架构与训练设定提出，摘要未给出定量评估。

papers.title: From Fragments to Global Maps: Learning Vectorized Map Aggregation with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale vectorized HD maps provide structured road information that is essential for perception, localization, and planning in autonomous driving. Constructing such maps requires aggregating noisy, fragmented, and overlapping local predictions collected along a vehicle trajectory into a coherent global map. Existing aggregation methods typically rely on hand-crafted rules for fragment association and refinement. However, a fixed set of thresholds cannot effectively handle variations in road structures and prediction errors, often requiring detector-specific tuning or manual adjustment. To address this limitation, we propose MapMergeLLM, a data-driven framework that formulates vectorized map aggregation as conditional sequence generation with a large language model. Given serialized local vectorized maps, our model directly predicts the aggregated global map polylines. To reduce dependence on any particular upstream detector, we train the model on synthetic local maps generated from clean vector maps using corruptions that simulate representative prediction errors. We further introduce a coordinate tokenizer with geometry-aware pretraining to precisely represent map coordinates. In addition, we propose a line-level association loss that explicitly supervises correspondences between local observations of the same map element. Experiments on Argoverse2 and nuScenes using multiple recent upstream detectors demonstrate that MapMergeLLM substantially outperforms heuristic and optimization-based aggregation baselines without detector-specific retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MapMergeLLM 把矢量化 HD 地图聚合改写成条件序列生成：输入序列化的局部地图，LLM 直接输出聚合后的全局地图折线，并用几何感知预训练的坐标 tokenizer 与线级关联损失约束同一地图要素的局部观测对应。在 Argoverse2 与 nuScenes 上配合多个近期上游检测器，明显优于启发式与优化类聚合基线，且无需针对检测器重训。
Motivation: 自动驾驶的全局矢量地图需把沿车轨迹采集的含噪、碎片化、重叠局部预测拼成一致地图，而现有方法依赖手工阈值做片段关联与精修，固定阈值难以适应不同道路结构与预测误差，常需按检测器调参或人工调整。
Method: 将聚合建模为以序列化局部矢量地图为条件的序列生成，由 LLM 直接预测全局地图折线；训练数据用干净矢量地图加模拟代表性预测误差的 corruption 生成合成局部地图，以降低对特定上游检测器的依赖；另引入几何感知预训练的坐标 tokenizer 与显式监督同一地图要素局部观测对应的线级关联损失 (line-level association loss)。
Result: 在 Argoverse2 与 nuScenes 上、配合多个近期上游检测器的实验中，MapMergeLLM 明显优于启发式与基于优化的聚合基线，且无需针对检测器的重训练。
Conclusion: 数据驱动的序列生成式聚合可替代手工阈值规则，在不按检测器重训的条件下完成跨检测器的矢量地图聚合。

papers.title: Post-Training Quantization of Autoregressive Weather Models
papers.abstract_en: Advancements in high-resolution numerical weather prediction (NWP) and data assimilation (DA) have shaped the developments in deep learning (DL) architectures emulating atmospheric dynamics. Emulators for weather forecasting exhibit forecast quality comparable to physics based models at forecast horizon scaling from few days to subseasonal time scales. The emulators are driven by hardware-accelerated matrix multiplication in autoregressive inferences, significantly reducing the computation time and resources required for NWP. Optimization of the matrix multiplication processes in GPU architectures provides opportunities to scale towards high-resolution domain, and offers implementation of out of the box solutions. Post-training quantization (PTQ) has been demonstrated across multiple DL architectures to accelerate and increase the number of computations in unit time while consuming less power, enabling applications on edge hardware. In this study, we investigate the effect of PTQ on pre-trained AI emulators for global-scale weather forecasting. We implement PTQ algorithms in Deep Learning Weather Prediction (DLWP) and FourCastNet (FCN) models as a proof of concept for geophysical fluid dynamics applications. We systematically investigate the effect of PTQ on emulator inferences over short-range forecast horizons. Evaluation of PTQ configurations using simulated quantization hints at qualitatively meaningful forecasts over short-time horizons. These results provide a first benchmark of PTQ for autoregressive weather emulators and a basis for quantization-based optimization of DL models for dynamical systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对自回归天气仿真器 DLWP 与 FourCastNet (FCN) 做训练后量化 (PTQ)，在短预报时效上系统考察量化配置对推理的影响。基于模拟量化的评估显示短时预报仍具定性可用的预报形态，构成自回归天气仿真器 PTQ 的首个基准。
Motivation: 深度学习天气仿真器靠自回归推理中的 GPU 矩阵乘加速 NWP，但要走向高分辨率域与边缘硬件部署，需要在不明显损失预报质量的前提下压缩计算与功耗。
Method: 在预训练的 DLWP 与 FourCastNet 全球天气仿真器上实现 PTQ 算法，作为地球物理流体动力学的 proof of concept；用模拟量化 (simulated quantization) 评估多种 PTQ 配置，系统考察短预报时效上的推理表现。
Result: 模拟量化评估显示 PTQ 配置在短时预报时效上给出定性有意义 (qualitatively meaningful) 的预报；摘要未给出具体精度数值或基线对比。
Conclusion: PTQ 可作为自回归天气仿真器的量化优化起点，为动力系统 DL 模型的量化压缩提供首个基准，适用范围限于短预报时效。

papers.title: On-Premises Multi-Course RAG Tutoring for Business Education: Hardware-Software Trade-offs in a Campus AI Tutor
papers.abstract_en: Campus AI tutors based on retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) must ground answers in assigned course materials while keeping textbooks and student dialogue on institutional infrastructure. We present CourseChat, an on-premises, multi-course RAG tutor for undergraduate business education, deployed behind a campus web gateway and intended for use embedded in Moodle. Six isolated course offerings, each keyed by its own course reference number (CRN), share twin-edge AI hosts running a FastAPI service, a local vector database, and a local large language model (LLM) served by Ollama. We report two generation-model bake-off rounds, a separate fixed-evidence source-fidelity comparison, and conversation and quiz audits. Several larger models failed the classroom speed gate, but a 12B model and a 7B alternative passed. A separate mixture-of-experts candidate improved some corrections while introducing new factual and continuity errors. We therefore retain the 8B production model pending a demonstrated overall improvement, rather than claiming that 8B is universally optimal. Software changes improved follow-up topic resolution while preserving course scope; 435 prebuilt questions across 65 modules decouple practice from live generation. The results support treating model choice, evidence selection, serving compatibility, and product design as a joint engineering decision. They do not establish learning gains: faculty ratings, peak-load capacity, and complete public-gateway acceptance remain separate evaluation needs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CourseChat 是面向商科本科的本地部署多课程 RAG 导师，六个按 CRN 隔离的课程共享双机 AI 主机上的 FastAPI、本地向量库与 Ollama 本地 LLM，全部置于校园网关后并拟嵌入 Moodle。两轮选型中多个更大模型未过课堂速度门槛，12B 与 7B 通过，MoE 候选虽修正部分错误却引入新的事实与连续性错误，因此保留 8B 生产模型；435 道预置题覆盖 65 个模块，使练习脱离实时生成。
Motivation: 校园 RAG 导师必须把教材与学生对话留在机构内部设施上，同时在课堂延迟、证据忠实度与多课程隔离之间做取舍，而模型选择、证据选择与服务兼容性此前被当作彼此独立的问题。
Method: 报告两轮生成模型 bake-off、一次独立的固定证据源忠实度 (source-fidelity) 对比，以及对话与测验审计；系统用 FastAPI 服务、本地向量数据库和 Ollama 提供本地 LLM，六个课程各以 CRN 隔离共享主机，并以 435 道预构建题目（65 个模块）替代实时生成出题。
Result: 多个更大模型未通过课堂速度门槛，12B 与 7B 备选通过；MoE 候选改进了部分修正却引入新的事实与连续性错误；软件改动改善了后续话题解析 (follow-up topic resolution) 同时保持课程范围；435 道预构建题目覆盖 65 个模块。
Conclusion: 模型选择、证据选择、服务兼容性与产品设计应作为联合工程决策，8B 仅在出现可证明的整体改进前保留为生产模型；教师评分、峰值负载容量与公共网关验收仍是待补的评估项，现有结果不构成学习增益的证据。

papers.title: World Action Modeling with Progressive Visual Planning
papers.abstract_en: World action models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for robotic control by jointly predicting future visual dynamics and actions from an initial observation and instruction. However, existing WAMs struggle with long-horizon prediction, as generating dense video rollouts is highly inefficient. Some recent WAMs address this by predicting a single future frame without generating the full video, but this approach neglects how to progress toward the goal. We present ProWAM, a progressive world action model that jointly predicts actions and an ordered sequence of sparse visual sub-goals, providing explicit visual guidance to anchor action generation throughout task execution. This design scales naturally, as sub-goal prediction can be learned from large-scale action-free videos, allowing the video backbone to offload complex visual planning from the action policy. For efficient action generation, ProWAM executes a single video-backbone forward pass to cache sparse sub-goal features, eliminating iterative full-video generation and requiring only lightweight action denoising during replanning. Across extensive evaluations, ProWAM achieves superior out-of-distribution robustness. On simulation benchmarks, it sets new state-of-the-art results on LIBERO-Plus (85.8%) and randomized RoboTwin (75.7%), outperforming the strongest baseline with relative gains of up to +35.9%. On RoboCasa365, ProWAM achieves a 48.1% success rate and 18.2% on the challenging Composite-Unseen split, ranking 4th overall. Crucially, in zero-shot real-world experiments, ProWAM achieves 70.0% success, outperforming the strongest baseline by +15.0 (from 55.0% to 70.0%, a +27.3% relative gain) in novel scenes. These results demonstrate the value of progress-indexed visual foresight for closed-loop control. Our program is in https://sii-ferenas.github.io/ProWAM-page.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ProWAM 把机器人世界动作模型 (WAM) 的稠密视频 rollout 换成有序稀疏视觉子目标序列，用单次视频骨干前向缓存子目标特征，重规划时只做轻量 action denoising。在 LIBERO-Plus 达 85.8%、随机化 RoboTwin 75.7%、RoboCasa365 48.1%（Composite-Unseen 18.2%），零样本真实场景 70.0%，比最强基线高 15.0 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有 WAM 靠生成稠密视频做长程预测，效率极低；只预测单帧的做法又丢掉了如何逐步走向目标的进度信息。
Method: ProWAM 联合预测动作与有序稀疏视觉子目标，子目标预测可从大规模无动作视频学习，把视觉规划从动作策略中卸载到视频骨干；推理时单次骨干前向缓存子目标特征，重规划仅需轻量 action denoising。
Result: LIBERO-Plus 85.8%、随机化 RoboTwin 75.7%，相对最强基线增益最高 +35.9%；RoboCasa365 48.1%，Composite-Unseen 18.2%，总排名第 4；零样本真实场景 70.0%，较最强基线 55.0% 提升 15.0 个百分点（相对 +27.3%）。
Conclusion: 以进度索引的视觉前瞻 (progress-indexed visual foresight) 做闭环控制，可在消除迭代全视频生成的同时取得更强的分布外鲁棒性。

papers.title: MeshQuery: Agentic Seam Planning for UV Parametrization
papers.abstract_en: We present MeshQuery, a training-free agentic approach to automatic UV unwrapping of production-grade quad meshes. A Vision-Language Model (VLM) plans artist-aligned seams using a set of edge-selection tools, conditioned on domain-specific UV-unwrapping knowledge expressed in natural language and refined with a feedback loop. We design a queryable mesh representation together with a domain-specific language (DSL) that enables the agent to retrieve mesh information on demand, express a seam plan as a compact program of edge-selection operators over topological, geometric, and semantic mesh attributes, and iteratively refine it from UV quality feedback. On Adobe Substance 3D and Toys4K meshes, MeshQuery produces 2.9x/4.29x fewer charts and 1.63x/1.7x shorter seams than the strongest baseline, and professional artists prefer its results in 80.9% of comparisons. Ultimately, decoupling high-level intent planning from low-level edge selection and compact mesh representation lets MeshQuery run on different backend VLMs and scale to meshes an order of magnitude larger than autoregressive seam prediction

papers.title: Multi-Fidelity Policy Gradients Stabilize Data-Scarce Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Policy gradient methods for on-policy reinforcement learning (RL) can become unstable when expensive, scarce target-domain data yield noisy gradient estimates. We address this challenge by complementing limited high-fidelity (HF) target-domain data with abundant, cheap, but biased low-fidelity (LF) data, e.g., from a simplified simulator. Most existing methods directly optimize biased objectives based on LF data. In contrast, the recently introduced multi-fidelity policy gradient (MFPG) framework uses LF data solely to construct a control variate that reduces variance and improves HF data efficiency without biasing the policy gradient estimator. However, published work on MFPG is limited to REINFORCE on small-scale simulation tasks. We develop MFPG for modern actor-critic learning in GPU-parallel simulation and on a physical robot. Our analysis and experiments show that naive extensions to proximal policy optimization (PPO) can lose cross-fidelity correlation or inflate variance. Our MFPG-PPO addresses these failures by redesigning the sampling, advantage estimation, and control variate construction to preserve cross-fidelity correlation, and by monitoring estimator uncertainty to prevent variance inflation. We also introduce a budget-aware MFPG-PPO to divide a fixed sampling budget among high- and low-fidelity data sources. Across simulated robot locomotion tasks of varying LF-to-HF transfer difficulty and HF data budgets, MFPG-PPO improves upon PPO trained on HF data alone in nearly all settings, and consistently matches the performance of PPO trained with 16x more HF data on the hardest task at the smallest HF budgets. In contrast, most baselines that use LF data perform well only where direct LF-to-HF transfer succeeds. MFPG-PPO enables stable learning on a physical Franka arm using only 4 real-robot episodes per update and no human demonstrations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把低保真 (LF) 数据只用来构造控制变量 (control variate) 而非直接优化其有偏目标，MFPG-PPO 在高保真 (HF) 数据稀缺时保持策略梯度无偏并降方差。在仿真机器人运动任务上，它几乎在所有设置中超过仅用 HF 训练的 PPO，并在最难任务、最小 HF 预算下稳定追平用 16 倍 HF 数据训练的 PPO；物理 Franka 机械臂上每次更新只需 4 个真实 episode。
Motivation: 昂贵稀缺的目标域数据使 on-policy RL 的梯度估计噪声大、训练不稳；现有方法直接优化基于 LF 数据的有偏目标，而已有 MFPG 工作只限于小规模仿真上的 REINFORCE。
Method: 把 MFPG 扩展到 GPU 并行仿真与实体机器人上的 actor-critic：MFPG-PPO 重新设计采样、优势估计与控制变量构造以保留跨保真相关性，并监控估计器不确定性以防方差膨胀；另提出 budget-aware MFPG-PPO 在固定采样预算下分配 HF 与 LF 数据。
Result: 在 LF-to-HF 迁移难度与 HF 预算各异的仿真机器人运动任务上，MFPG-PPO 在几乎所有设置中优于仅用 HF 训练的 PPO，并在最难任务的最小 HF 预算下持续追平用 16 倍 HF 数据训练的 PPO；朴素移植到 PPO 会丢失跨保真相关性或放大方差。物理 Franka 机械臂上每次更新仅用 4 个真实 episode、无人类演示即可稳定学习。
Conclusion: LF 数据作为控制变量而非优化目标，能在 HF 数据极稀缺时把 PPO 训练稳定到与 16 倍 HF 数据相当的水平；直接使用 LF 数据的基线只在 LF 到 HF 能直接迁移时才有效。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: HXAI: Hierarchical Privacy-Preserving Explainable AI in Distributed Energy Systems
papers.abstract_en: Balancing electricity demand and supply is increasingly difficult due to the inherent intermittency of renewable power generation and the stochastic power consumption. Grid operators require fine-grained, decision-relevant insights into household energy consumption to manage peak loads and design responsive tariffs, but increased transparency at this level raises significant privacy concerns. Traditional methods for explainable AI (XAI) can reveal sensitive information, while standard privacy techniques often reduce the usefulness of explanations. To address this issue, we introduce HXAI, a hierarchical framework that preserves privacy while enabling reasonable explainable analysis for grid-level demand management. HXAI consists of two main components: (1) a local model that generates fine-grained explanations within a secure, private environment, and (2) a zonal model that aggregates these explanations to support grid-level analysis while enforcing privacy through flexible privacy-budget management. We explicitly limit cumulative privacy exposure under repeated operator queries and show that the proposed framework preserves decision-relevant information without compromising household privacy. Experiments on both simulated and real-world energy datasets demonstrate that HXAI provides useful insights for zonal load management while ensuring that appliance-level consumption remains local and is never transmitted to grid operators. Our results show that preserving the semantic structure of explanations, rather than minimizing numerical error, is the key to XAI under differential privacy. This framework provides a way to achieve both privacy and explainability in energy management.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HXAI 把家庭用电的可解释分析拆成两层：本地模型在私有环境内生成细粒度解释，区域模型只聚合这些解释并用可调隐私预算 (privacy budget) 支撑电网侧负荷管理。在模拟与真实用电数据集上，它在反复查询下限制累积隐私暴露，同时保住决策相关信息，且电器级用电始终留在本地、不上传给电网运营商。
Motivation: 电网运营商需要家庭级细粒度用电洞察来管理峰值负荷与设计响应式电价，但这种透明度带来隐私风险：传统 XAI 会泄露敏感信息，而标准隐私技术又会削弱解释的可用性。
Method: 分层框架含两个组件：本地模型在安全私有环境内生成细粒度解释；区域模型聚合这些解释以支持电网级分析，并通过灵活的隐私预算管理强制执行隐私，显式限制反复查询下的累积隐私暴露。核心设计取向是保留解释的语义结构，而非最小化数值误差。
Result: 在模拟与真实用电数据集上的实验表明，HXAI 为区域负荷管理提供有用洞察，同时保证电器级消耗保持本地、从不传输给电网运营商；反复查询下的累积隐私暴露被显式限制，决策相关信息得以保留。
Conclusion: 在差分隐私下做 XAI，保住解释的语义结构比最小化数值误差更关键；分层的本地-区域分工可以让电网侧分析与家庭隐私同时成立。

papers.title: Compound AI System Reliability: A Failure Taxonomy and Resilience Pattern Catalog from 150 Production Incidents
papers.abstract_en: Deploying compound AI systems reliably and safely requires understanding failure modes that emerge at component boundaries, not within individual models. Cascading errors propagate across component boundaries, silent quality degradation evades standard monitoring, and coordination failures yield incorrect collective behavior from individually correct parts. We analyze 150 production incident reports from open-source compound AI projects and anonymized enterprise deployments to construct a taxonomy of 23 failure modes organized into five categories: retrieval failures, generation failures, tool failures, orchestration failures, and integration failures. For each category, we propose resilience patterns with measured effectiveness from controlled fault injection experiments. Circuit breakers reduce cascade propagation by 89%, output quality gates catch 73% of silent degradation before user impact, and component isolation reduces blast radius by 64%. Systems implementing three or more resilience patterns from our catalog reduce mean-time-to-recovery (MTTR) by 71% compared to unstructured monitoring baselines. We release the incident taxonomy and pattern catalog as a practitioner resource.
papers.comment: Accepted at the AIWILD Workshop, ICML 2026. Camera-ready version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 150 起开源与企业 compound AI 生产事故做失效分类，得到 23 种失效模式、归入检索/生成/工具/编排/集成五类，并配套给出韧性模式目录。受控故障注入中 circuit breaker 使级联传播降 89%，输出质量门在影响用户前捕获 73% 的静默质量退化，组件隔离把爆炸半径降 64%；采用三种以上模式的系统 MTTR 相比无结构监控基线降 71%。
Motivation: compound AI 的失效发生在组件边界而非单模型内部：级联错误跨组件传播、静默质量退化绕过常规监控、各部分各自正确却组合出错误行为，现有监控手段抓不住这类问题。
Method: 分析 150 份生产事故报告（来自开源 compound AI 项目与匿名企业部署），归纳出 23 种失效模式的五类分类法；对每类提出韧性模式，并用受控故障注入实验 (controlled fault injection) 测量其有效性。
Result: circuit breaker 使级联传播减少 89%；输出质量门在触及用户前捕获 73% 的静默退化；组件隔离使爆炸半径减少 64%；实施目录中三种及以上韧性模式的系统，相比无结构监控基线 MTTR 降低 71%。
Conclusion: 跨组件边界的失效可以被系统分类并用具体韧性模式缓解，且模式叠加（≥3 种）对恢复时间的收益最大；事故分类法与模式目录作为从业者资源发布。

papers.title: LiteEMG-FM: An Efficient and Deployable Foundation Model for Robust EMG Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Electromyography (EMG) signals vary substantially across individuals, body regions, recording sessions, and sensing hardware, limiting the generalization of models for assistive devices and human-computer interaction. Existing time-series foundation models are also computationally expensive for real-time wearable deployment and often fail to capture EMG-specific time-frequency characteristics. We present LiteEMG-FM, an efficient hybrid CNN-Transformer foundation model for practical EMG sensing. Pretrained on 16 diverse upper- and lower-limb EMG datasets, LiteEMG-FM learns representations that generalize across users and datasets. For resource-constrained deployment, we implement a hierarchical wake-up architecture in which a lightweight, always-on 1D-CNN filters rest and non-target activity and activates LiteEMG-FM only for valid gestures. We evaluate full inference offloading, split inference, and full on-device processing, characterizing their trade-offs in latency, power consumption, and memory footprint. Across diverse evaluation settings, LiteEMG-FM outperforms state-of-the-art time-series foundation models and supervised baselines, particularly under zero-calibration cross-participant and data-scarce conditions. These results demonstrate that LiteEMG-FM is an effective, efficient, and deployable foundation model for EMG applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LiteEMG-FM 是面向 EMG 的高效混合 CNN-Transformer 基础模型，在 16 个上下肢 EMG 数据集上预训练，并配一层常开 1D-CNN 分级唤醒架构，只在有效手势时才启动主模型。在零校准跨被试与数据稀缺条件下，它在延迟、功耗、内存权衡下优于现有时间序列基础模型与监督基线。
Motivation: EMG 信号在个体、部位、录制会话与硬件间差异大，模型难以跨人泛化；现有时间序列基础模型算力开销大、不适合实时可穿戴部署，也抓不住 EMG 特有的时频特性。
Method: 混合 CNN-Transformer 主干在 16 个上/下肢 EMG 数据集上预学习跨用户、跨数据集表征；分级唤醒架构用常开轻量 1D-CNN 过滤静息与非目标活动，仅对有效手势激活主模型；并对比全推理卸载、split inference 与全端侧三种部署方式的延迟、功耗与内存。
Result: 在多种评估设置下，LiteEMG-FM 优于 SOTA 时间序列基础模型与监督基线，优势在零校准跨被试 (zero-calibration cross-participant) 和数据稀缺条件下最明显；同时给出全卸载、split inference、全端侧三种方案在延迟、功耗、内存占用上的权衡刻画。
Conclusion: EMG 基础模型要兼顾跨人泛化与可穿戴实时部署，靠的是高效主干加分层唤醒，而非单纯加大模型。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 混合 CNN-Transformer 主干在 16 个上/下肢 EMG 数据集上预学习跨用户、跨数据集表征；分级唤醒架构用常开轻量 1D-CNN 过滤静息与非目标活动，仅对有效手势激活主模型；并对比全推理卸载、split inference 与全端侧三种部署方式的延迟、功耗与内存。
summary_sections.result: 在多种评估设置下，LiteEMG-FM 优于 SOTA 时间序列基础模型与监督基线，优势在零校准跨被试 (zero-calibration cross-participant) 和数据稀缺条件下最明显；同时给出全卸载、split inference、全端侧三种方案在延迟、功耗、内存占用上的权衡刻画。
summary_sections.conclusion: EMG 基础模型要兼顾跨人泛化与可穿戴实时部署，靠的是高效主干加分层唤醒，而非单纯加大模型。

papers.title: "I just assumed that it would translate": examining MT risk awareness among healthcare staff with abbreviations as a use case
papers.abstract_en: In the UK, public healthcare staff report turning to machine translation (MT) - predominantly Google Translate (GT) - to communicate with patients across language barriers. Though intended to support their duty of care, potentially uninformed reliance on MT in such contexts could have serious consequences for patient safety. Research nonetheless remains limited on staff awareness of the possible risks posed by higher-stakes MT use in general and with patient medical records in particular, most existing literature instead examining its use in interpersonal situations or with patient-oriented documentation. Moreover, medical abbreviations are well-documented as increasing patient risk even monolingually, with outcomes from their misuse and/or misinterpretation ranging from temporary harm to the death of the patient. Abbreviations were therefore selected as a use case for identifying the potential risks posed by their translation with MT. Contextualised French and Spanish data examples drawn from authoritative clinical corpora and translated via GT were presented during semi-structured interviews to 21 healthcare staff participants in diverse roles and specialties. The results were then subject to qualitative analysis and cross-analysis.
papers.comment: To appear in the proceedings of Convergence 2026 conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 以医学缩略语为用例，考察英国公共医疗人员对机器翻译 (MT) 风险的认知：21 名跨岗位医护在半结构化访谈中看到取自权威临床语料的法语、西语例句经 Google Translate 翻译的结果，再做质性分析与交叉分析。核心关切是医护可能在不知情的情况下依赖 MT 处理患者医疗记录类高风险文本。
Motivation: 英国公共医疗人员普遍用 Google Translate 与患者沟通，但针对高风险 MT 使用、尤其是患者医疗记录场景的风险认知研究有限；现有文献多聚焦人际交流或面向患者的文档，而缩略语本身即使单语使用也会抬高患者风险。
Method: 选取医学缩略语作为用例，从权威临床语料中抽取法语与西语语境化例句，用 Google Translate 翻译后在半结构化访谈中呈现给 21 名来自不同岗位与专科的医护参与者，对结果做质性分析与交叉分析 (cross-analysis)。
Result: 研究在 21 名英国医护参与者上完成半结构化访谈与质性、交叉分析，用例为权威临床语料中的法语和西语医学缩略语经 Google Translate 的翻译结果。
Conclusion: 医护对 MT 的依赖可能未经风险评估，医学缩略语的跨语言翻译是识别高风险 MT 使用隐患的合适切入点。

papers.title: DeepStratNet: A Context-Aware Coordinate Regression Framework for Seismic Horizon Tracking under Sparse Labels
papers.abstract_en: Automatic horizon tracking is a foundational task in 3D seismic interpretation. Most existing deep learning approaches formulate it as dense semantic segmentation, typically using U-Net-based architectures. The model produces a probability map over all pixels that must be post-processed to extract precise horizon coordinates, while horizon picks in time/depth must be converted into dense masks for training. Unpicked seismic traces are consequently treated as background, which can hinder convergence, and both pre- and post-processing can introduce errors into the final interpretation. Moreover, 2D segmentation models do not inherently capture inter-slice context, while 3D models are often computationally prohibitive. We instead formulate horizon tracking as a bounded coordinate regression problem, where the model directly predicts the time/depth coordinate of the target horizon at each lateral position. We propose a lightweight regression head compatible with any pretrained vision backbone, coupled with an LSTM module to model inter-slice context and produce a continuous horizon surface across the volume. A combination of L1 and L2 losses supervises predictions at valid horizon picks, while a geology-informed regularization enforces lateral continuity between successive traces. Under controlled experimental conditions, we evaluate four pretrained vision backbones under both segmentation and regression configurations on a seismic volume from New Zealand. The proposed approach consistently outperforms its segmentation counterparts quantitatively, using metrics including RMSE and PCC, and qualitatively, while also demonstrating greater robustness to increasing sparsity of training picks. Finally, we show that prediction variation across successive traces captures local variations in geological complexity, providing an automated quality control measure for downstream seismic interpretation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeepStratNet 把 3D 地震层位追踪从稠密语义分割改写为有界坐标回归：轻量回归头直接预测每个横向位置的层位时间/深度坐标，LSTM 建模跨切片上下文，L1+L2 损失只在有效层位拾取点上监督，并用地质先验正则约束相邻道的横向连续性。在新西兰地震工区上，该回归配置在四种预训练视觉 backbone 上的 RMSE 与 PCC 均稳定优于对应分割配置，且随训练拾取点变稀疏更稳健。
Motivation: 现有方法把层位追踪做成 U-Net 式稠密分割：未拾取道被当作背景干扰收敛，概率图后处理与掩码转换引入误差，2D 模型缺跨切片上下文而 3D 模型算力代价过高。
Method: 将层位追踪表述为有界坐标回归，直接回归每个横向位置的层位时间/深度；提出可挂在任意预训练视觉 backbone 上的轻量回归头，配合 LSTM 建模 inter-slice context 以输出连续层位面；用 L1 与 L2 组合损失在有效 horizon picks 上监督，并加入地质信息正则强制相邻道横向连续。
Result: 在受控实验条件下，用四种预训练视觉 backbone 分别以分割与回归两种配置，在新西兰一个地震 volume 上评测：回归配置在 RMSE 与 PCC 上定量且定性地一致优于对应分割配置，并在训练拾取点稀疏度上升时表现出更强稳健性；跨相邻道的预测变化可刻画局部地质复杂度变化，作为下游解释的自动质量控制指标。
Conclusion: 层位追踪按坐标回归而非分割来建模，配合跨切片上下文与地质正则，可在稀疏标注下取得更准更稳的层位面，且道间预测波动本身可当作解释质量的 QC 信号。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Right Order, Wrong Scale: Auditing LLM Judges for Occupational AI Measurement
papers.abstract_en: LLM judges are increasingly used to assess whether AI outputs meet workplace requirements, but agreement on response rankings does not establish agreement on acceptance rates or occupational aggregates. We introduce O*NET-BENCH, an audit suite derived from an existing survey of 45,796 worker ratings, and evaluate 33 pre-existing judge configurations across six model families on 4,501 test ratings. Twenty-five configurations achieve tie-aware pair accuracy of at least 0.60, although a train-fitted response-only TF-IDF baseline nearly matches the strongest judge. Despite this ordering agreement, judges estimate that 3.0%-97.9% of responses are acceptable, compared with 61.1% for occupation-matched workers. In one fine-tuned lineage, changing from pointwise scoring to a bundled few-shot/listwise protocol improves response ordering while reducing agreement with worker means at the task and occupation levels; this reversal replicates on a task- and worker-disjoint validation split under prespecified criteria. Cross-validated calibration largely removes mean bias, but calibrated scores explain at most 8.5% of individual worker-rating variance. Prediction-assisted estimation yields at most small precision gains at the studied label budgets. These results show that ranking agreement alone is insufficient for occupational measurement. Judges should be validated against the acceptance rates and aggregates their scores will be used to estimate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: O*NET-BENCH 审计显示：LLM judge 在响应排序上一致并不等于在可接受率与职业层聚合上一致。33 个 judge 配置中 25 个 tie-aware pair accuracy ≥0.60，但它们估计的可接受率横跨 3.0%–97.9%，而职业匹配的真实工人给 61.1%；排序更好的协议反而降低与工人均值的一致性。作者主张 judge 必须按其分数将要估计的可接受率与聚合量来验证。
Motivation: LLM judge 被用来判定 AI 输出是否满足职场要求，但排序一致性无法保证可接受率与职业聚合量的准确性，而这些聚合量正是下游测量真正依赖的量。
Method: 构建审计套件 O*NET-BENCH，源自一项 45,796 名工人评分的既有调查；在 4,501 条测试评分上评测来自六个模型家族的 33 个既有 judge 配置，并与训练集拟合的 response-only TF-IDF 基线对照；在任务与工人双重不相交的验证划分上按预设标准复现排序反转，并做交叉验证校准与不同标签预算下的 prediction-assisted estimation。
Result: 25/33 个配置的 tie-aware pair accuracy ≥0.60，但训练集拟合的 response-only TF-IDF 基线几乎追平最强 judge；judge 估计的可接受率为 3.0%–97.9%，职业匹配工人为 61.1%。在一条 fine-tuned lineage 中，从 pointwise scoring 换成 bundled few-shot/listwise 协议会改善响应排序、却降低与任务级和职业级工人均值的一致性，该反转在任务与工人不相交的验证划分上复现。交叉验证校准基本消除均值偏差，但校准后分数最多只能解释个体工人评分方差的 8.5%；prediction-assisted estimation 在所研究的标签预算下最多只有小幅精度提升。
Conclusion: 排序一致性本身不足以支撑职业层 AI 测量，judge 必须针对其分数将被用于估计的可接受率与聚合量做验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What Does a Token Cost? A Mixture-of-Agents Measurement of Sufficient Per-Token Compute
papers.abstract_en: Large language models spend the same amount of computation on every token they generate, regardless of how difficult each token is to produce. Methods such as speculative decoding and model routing are built on the premise that much of this computation is unnecessary, yet the computation an individual token actually requires has not been measured. We measure it through a Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) lens: a panel of fifteen language models of increasing capacity, drawn from three families, in which every agent attempts to reproduce a reference sequence token by token, conditioned on the correct preceding tokens. We define the inference cost of the smallest agent that succeeds as the token's sufficient compute, which upper-bounds what the token requires. On three core benchmarks, a 0.5B agent reproduces 92--95\% of reference tokens. Across Qwen, OLMo, and R1-distilled panels, the most expensive 10\% account for 64--80\% of estimated FLOPs. On all 500 MATH-500 problems, the MoA-derived map helps model routing reduce projected latency from 7.59 to 5.12 seconds while slightly improving accuracy, relative to the best confidence-routing baseline. The MoA-map helps drafting use 32.6\% fewer draft tokens and approximately 20\% lower projected latency than fixed-window drafting at similar accuracy. These comparisons reveal remaining allocation headroom, motivating controllers that exploit sufficient-compute structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 15 个递增容量的语言模型组成 Mixture-of-Agents 面板，逐 token 复现参考序列，把能成功复现的最小 agent 的推理开销定义为该 token 的 sufficient compute（上界）。结果显示 0.5B agent 就能复现 92–95% 的参考 token，最贵的 10% token 占估计 FLOPs 的 64–80%；据此得到的 MoA-map 让路由把 MATH-500 投影延迟从 7.59 秒降到 5.12 秒，drafting 少用 32.6% draft token。
Motivation: LLM 对每个 token 花费相同算力，而 speculative decoding 与 model routing 都默认其中大量算力是多余的，但单个 token 实际需要多少算力从未被测量。
Method: 构建 15 个按容量递增、来自 Qwen、OLMo、R1-distill 三个家族的 agent 面板，每个 agent 在给定正确前文的条件下逐 token 复现参考序列；把成功复现的最小 agent 的推理开销定义为该 token 的 sufficient compute（上界），并在 MATH-500 等三个核心 benchmark 上生成 MoA-map 用于路由与 drafting。
Result: 在三个核心 benchmark 上 0.5B agent 复现 92–95% 的参考 token；在 Qwen、OLMo、R1-distilled 面板中最贵的 10% token 占估计 FLOPs 的 64–80%；在全部 500 道 MATH-500 题上，MoA-map 辅助的 model routing 相对最佳 confidence-routing 基线把投影延迟从 7.59 秒降到 5.12 秒且精度略升；辅助 drafting 比 fixed-window drafting 少用 32.6% draft token、投影延迟低约 20%，精度相当。
Conclusion: token 级算力需求高度不均，最贵的 10% token 吃掉大部分 FLOPs，按 sufficient-compute 结构做分配仍有可观空间，值得据此设计新的 controller。

papers.title: Harnessing LLMs as Agents: What Does It Cost?
papers.abstract_en: Language-model agents increasingly rely on harnesses that manage bounded context, persistent memory, tools, verification, and repeated execution, yet existing notions of model capability do not quantify the computational resources these mechanisms consume. We introduce the Language Model Agent Machine (LAM), a resource-bounded abstraction that fixes the underlying semantic model while explicitly charging harness-level resources. We establish four classes of results. Communication: LAM execution is instancewise equivalent to red--blue pebbling under simultaneous call--transfer budgets, transferring classical I/O lower bounds to context--memory traffic. Access: memory interfaces induce asymptotic separations, including a $Θ(n)$ gap between random and non-speculative sequential access on pointer chasing. Recomputation: bit-reversal DAGs require $Θ(n^2/(C+S)+n)$ model calls with context capacity $C$ and persistent-memory capacity $S$, quantifying when stored intermediate state avoids repeated semantic computation. Reliability: we derive tight stage-local sampling bounds, exact imperfect-verification costs, and a Young--Daly-type checkpoint law with a closed-form optimal verification interval. Controlled and held-out experiments on GPT-6 Astra test communication and reliability predictions, including checkpoint optima, policy selection under programmatic checking, and tradeoffs among call granularity, logical input traffic, and reliability on chained MATH tasks. Together, these results provide a resource theory for the computational cost of language-model agent harnesses.

Conclusion: LAM 为语言模型 agent harness 的计算成本提供一套资源理论：存储中间状态可避免重复语义计算，而校验间隔存在可闭式求解的最优值。

papers.title: Threshold-Aware Conformal Routing
papers.abstract_en: High-fidelity simulations are essential to scientific and engineering design, but can be expensive to run repeatedly. Learned surrogates offer a faster alternative, yet their higher errors may alter downstream decisions. This accuracy-speed tradeoff creates a need to determine whether a surrogate can be used or the full simulator remains necessary. We study decisions determined by whether a scalar quantity of interest lies above or below a fixed threshold. For each input, we use the surrogate when its conformal interval lies entirely on one side of the threshold and route the input to simulation when the interval intersects it. Standard conformal prediction constructs intervals without reference to the downstream decision threshold: even a narrow interval near the threshold can cross it and trigger simulation, whereas a wider interval farther away can remain entirely on one side and require no simulation. We introduce Threshold-Aware Conformal Routing (TACR), which learns an input-dependent scale using a threshold-aware objective that concentrates interval tightness near the decision boundary. Exact split-conformal calibration on held-out data preserves distribution-free marginal coverage, which also upper-bounds the probability of an incorrect threshold decision that is not routed. Across various scientific and engineering datasets, TACR reduces simulator deferrals by 14-75% relative to standard conformal prediction at the same coverage target. Against a variant without threshold-local weighting but with similar predictor accuracy, TACR further reduces deferrals by 10-24% on four datasets. These results show that optimizing interval allocation for routing can reduce simulator calls without weakening the standard conformal guarantee.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TACR（Threshold-Aware Conformal Routing）为阈值型判定学习输入相关的区间缩放，把区间收紧集中在决策边界附近：区间完全落在阈值一侧就用代理模型，跨阈值才回退到全量模拟。在多个科学与工程数据集上，同等 coverage 目标下比标准 conformal prediction 减少 14–75% 的模拟回退；去掉阈值局部加权但预测精度相当的变体，TACR 在四个数据集上再减 10–24%。
Motivation: 高保真模拟反复调用代价高，学习代理虽快但误差可能改变下游阈值判定；标准 conformal prediction 构造区间时不考虑判定阈值，阈值附近的窄区间也会跨阈值而触发不必要的模拟回退。
Method: TACR 用 threshold-aware 目标学习输入相关的区间缩放，把区间紧度集中到判定边界附近；在留出数据上做精确 split-conformal 校准，保持 distribution-free 的边际 coverage，该 coverage 同时给出未被回退的错误阈值判定概率的上界。路由规则为：区间完全在阈值一侧用代理，否则送回模拟器。
Result: 在多个科学与工程数据集上，相同 coverage 目标下 TACR 相对标准 conformal prediction 减少 14–75% 的模拟回退；相对无阈值局部加权但预测精度相近的变体，在四个数据集上进一步减少 10–24% 的回退。
Conclusion: 为路由而优化区间分配可以在不削弱标准 conformal 保证的前提下减少模拟器调用；错误阈值判定概率由边际 coverage 上界控制。

papers.title: From Retrieval to Typed Decisions: Calibrated System One Models from Biomedical Sentence Encoders
papers.abstract_en: Typed decision models answer schema-constrained questions about a text in one forward pass and return probabilities meant to be thresholded. We ask whether biomedical sentence encoders trained for retrieval are good starting points for such models. We present SBERT2S1, which converts Sentence-Transformers encoders into bi-encoder, cross-head (C) and prior-fused residual (PFR) decision models, together with BIODECIDE, a biomedical typed-decision suite, and MEDLINE-S1, 243k training decisions derived from NLM indexing. Across six parent-retriever pairs, retrieval training improves zero-shot matching of content-bearing options. After fine-tuning, its effect depends on the head: across five pairs and three training-set sizes, retrieval training significantly helps PFR, which keeps the retrieval prior, in 10 of 15 comparisons, but helps C in one and hurts it in five. A matched grid of two heads and five training objectives shows that C outperforms PFR under every objective, and that the released RLCD recipe of open System One models trails cross-entropy by 2.5-3.0 points. The deficit stems mainly from its reward normalisation, which inflates the noisy score-function term 3.6-15-fold; an unbiased leave-one-out estimator recovers most of the gap. After temperature scaling, no objective is clearly better calibrated than cross-entropy. We release the code, the MEDLINE-S1 labels and a model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SBERT2S1 把用于检索的 Sentence-Transformers 编码器改造成一次前向即可输出可阈值化概率的 typed decision 模型（cross-head C 与 prior-fused residual PFR），并配套发布 BIODECIDE 套件与 MEDLINE-S1（243k 条来自 NLM indexing 的训练决策）。检索训练对 PFR 在 15 组对比中显著帮助 10 组、对 C 仅帮助 1 组且伤害 5 组；但同网格下 C 在每种目标函数下都优于 PFR，RLCD 配方落后交叉熵 2.5–3.0 分，主因是奖励归一化把噪声 score-function 项放大 3.6–15 倍。
Motivation: 检索式句编码器是否适合作为可阈值化概率的 typed decision 模型起点尚不清楚；同时开放 System One 模型常用的 RLCD 训练配方存在校准与方差问题。
Method: 提出 SBERT2S1：把 Sentence-Transformers 编码器转为 bi-encoder 的 cross-head (C) 与 prior-fused residual (PFR) 两种决策头；构建 BIODECIDE 生物医学 typed-decision 套件与 MEDLINE-S1（243k 条 NLM indexing 决策）；用两头 × 五目标函数的匹配网格比较，并做温度缩放校准。
Result: 检索训练在零样本下改善含内容选项的匹配；微调后 PFR 在 5 组配对 × 3 种训练集规模共 15 组对比中显著受益 10 组，C 仅受益 1 组、受损 5 组；匹配网格中 C 在全部目标函数下优于 PFR；开放 RLCD 配方落后交叉熵 2.5–3.0 分，其奖励归一化使 score-function 项膨胀 3.6–15 倍，leave-one-out 无偏估计可挽回大部分差距；温度缩放后无目标函数在校准上明显优于交叉熵。
Conclusion: 检索先验只对保留该先验的 PFR 头稳定有效，而 C 头整体更强；RLCD 的劣势来自奖励归一化引入的方差而非目标本身，校准上交叉熵已足够。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: MEA: A Reward-Driven Multi-Agent System for Faithful Model Explanations
papers.abstract_en: Recent years have seen the employment of a plethora of machine learning (ML) models in high-stakes domains, but they remain largely opaque to the practitioners who act on their predictions. While post-hoc explanation methods offer a lens into this model behavior, wielding them effectively demands expertise most domain experts lack: navigating high-dimensional outputs, selecting the best explanations, and synthesizing evidence across disparate tools. To this end, we present MEA, a multi-agent framework that removes the explanation knowledge barrier entirely: a Proposer agent selects and configures explanation tools based on the question and modality, while an Actor agent is optimized end-to-end against faithfulness, transforming the outputs into natural language explanations grounded in model behavior across tabular, text, and vision modalities. Further, we introduce diverse question types spanning feature attribution, counterfactual reasoning, and spurious feature detection, each paired with a perturbation-based faithfulness metric. We find that frontier LLMs systematically produce unfaithful explanations. By optimizing against faithfulness rewards augmented with a modality-adaptive penalty, MEA consistently outperforms post hoc explainers, agentic, and closed-source baselines across six datasets, with reward-driven optimization yielding faithfulness gains of +28% (tabular), +21% (text), and +34% (vision) over the untrained backbone. More broadly, our findings suggest that AI agents themselves can serve as a scalable, adaptable interface to ML explainability, opening a path toward natural-language explainability that generalizes beyond the fixed, single-purpose tools that have long defined the field.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MEA 用 Proposer 选配解释工具、Actor 在基于扰动的 faithfulness 奖励下端到端优化，把模型输出转成自然语言解释。在六个数据集上相对未训练 backbone 的 faithfulness 提升为表格 +28%、文本 +21%、视觉 +34%，一致超过事后解释器、agentic 与闭源基线。
Motivation: 高风险领域的 ML 模型对从业者不透明，而事后解释方法需要驾驭高维输出、挑选解释、跨工具综合证据的专业知识，多数领域专家不具备。
Method: MEA 是多智能体框架：Proposer 依据问题与模态选择并配置解释工具，Actor 端到端针对 faithfulness 奖励优化，把工具输出转成扎根于模型行为的自然语言解释；引入覆盖特征归因、反事实推理、虚假特征检测的问题类型，各配一个基于扰动的 faithfulness 度量，奖励上再加模态自适应惩罚。
Result: 在六个数据集上，MEA 一致超过 post hoc explainer、agentic 与闭源基线；相对未训练 backbone 的 faithfulness 增益为表格 +28%、文本 +21%、视觉 +34%。同时发现前沿 LLM 系统性地给出不忠实的解释。
Conclusion: AI 智能体本身可以充当可扩展、可适配的 ML 可解释性接口，使自然语言解释超越长期主导该领域的固定单用途工具。

papers.title: Tropical Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning for large language models typically maximizes expected return, adding up the probabilities of all successful trajectories. However, the classical sum formulation can only report how often the model policy succeeds, not which solution actually worked, and because probabilities sum to one, reinforcing one solution can make the model forget another that was never shown to be wrong. This makes expected return a poor fit for compositional reasoning, where a solution must be assembled from reasoning steps that the model produces in separate, often failed, attempts but rarely produces together. To address this, we propose Tropical Reinforcement Learning, which rests on a simple change of algebra: instead of adding the probabilities of alternative solutions, we take their maximum, which yields the tropical semiring. The value of a state then becomes the log-probability of its most likely verified solution, together with an explicit path that can be replayed and reused. This enables true composition, since the best prefix and the best suffix meeting at a shared state can be joined even when they come from different rollouts. To put this into practice, we introduce TROPIC, a training algorithm for deterministic, resettable environments with verifiable outcomes. On four agentic tasks (Sokoban, Countdown, FrozenLake, WebShop), TROPIC outperforms the strongest on-policy baselines by up to 16 percentage points. Changing the algebra of reinforcement learning, not just its estimators, can thus substantially improve compositional reasoning in language models
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 RL 的加法半环换成 tropical semiring（取最大而非求和），状态价值定义为最可能的已验证解的对数概率及其可回放路径，使不同 rollout 的最优前缀与最优后缀能在共享状态拼接。由此提出的 TROPIC 算法在 Sokoban、Countdown、FrozenLake、WebShop 四个可验证任务上比最强 on-policy 基线高出最多 16 个百分点。
Motivation: 期望回报把所有成功轨迹的概率相加，只能反映成功率而不能指出哪条解有效；概率归一还使强化一条解会遗忘从未被判错的另一条解，这对需要跨失败尝试拼接推理步骤的组合推理尤其不利。
Method: 提出 Tropical Reinforcement Learning：以 tropical semiring 的取最大替代概率求和，状态价值取最可能的已验证解的对数概率并保留显式路径；据此设计 TROPIC 训练算法，面向确定性、可重置、结果可验证的环境。
Result: 在四个 agentic 任务（Sokoban、Countdown、FrozenLake、WebShop）上，TROPIC 比最强的 on-policy 基线高出最多 16 个百分点。
Conclusion: 改变强化学习的代数结构本身（而不只是改估计器）就能显著提升语言模型的组合推理能力。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 把 RL 的加法半环换成 tropical semiring（取最大而非求和），状态价值定义为最可能的已验证解的对数概率及其可回放路径，使不同 rollout 的最优前缀与最优后缀能在共享状态拼接。由此提出的 TROPIC 算法在 Sokoban、Countdown、FrozenLake、WebShop 四个可验证任务上比最强 on-policy 基线高出最多 16 个百分点。
summary_sections.motivation: 期望回报把所有成功轨迹的概率相加，只能反映成功率而不能指出哪条解有效；概率归一还使强化一条解会遗忘从未被判错的另一条解，这对需要跨失败尝试拼接推理步骤的组合推理尤其不利。
summary_sections.method: 提出 Tropical Reinforcement Learning：以 tropical semiring 的取最大替代概率求和，状态价值取最可能的已验证解的对数概率并保留显式路径；据此设计 TROPIC 训练算法，面向确定性、可重置、结果可验证的环境。
summary_sections.result: 在四个 agentic 任务（Sokoban、Countdown、FrozenLake、WebShop）上，TROPIC 比最强的 on-policy 基线高出最多 16 个百分点。
summary_sections.conclusion: 改变强化学习的代数结构本身（而不只是改估计器）就能显著提升语言模型的组合推理能力。

papers.title: APDMem: Agent-Controlled Progressive Disclosure for Query-Adaptive Long-Term Memory
papers.abstract_en: Personalized LLM assistants must recover sparse evidence from long conversation histories across queries of varying complexity. We introduce APDMem (Agent-controlled Progressive Disclosure Memory), a hierarchical long-term memory architecture that applies progressive disclosure to memory retrieval. Rather than relying on a flat memory store or fixed retrieval granularity, APDMem represents conversation history as four progressively detailed layers: thematic summaries, personalized key facts, turn-level evidence notes, and raw messages. At inference time, a controller applies progressive disclosure to the memory hierarchy: it first reads high-level summaries and drills into finer evidence only when needed. This creates an adaptive cost-fidelity trade-off: simple queries can terminate early, while complex temporal, multi-hop, or exact-evidence queries trigger deeper inspection. A note synthesizer converts retrieved evidence into a query-focused structure that consolidates facts, orders events, and flags contradictions before final answer generation. Experiments on LongMemEval show that APDMem achieves strong performance for long-context memory reasoning while accessing only 8% of the total conversations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: APDMem 把长对话历史组织成四层渐进细化的记忆（主题摘要、个性化关键事实、轮次级证据笔记、原始消息），由控制器按查询复杂度逐层下钻，简单查询提前终止，时间性、多跳或精确取证查询才深入检索。在 LongMemEval 上以仅访问 8% 对话内容的开销取得长上下文记忆推理的强表现。
Motivation: 个性化 LLM 助手需从长对话历史中按不同复杂度的查询检索稀疏证据，扁平记忆库或固定检索粒度无法在成本与保真度之间自适应权衡。
Method: APDMem（Agent-controlled Progressive Disclosure Memory）采用分层记忆架构：四层渐进细化表示对话历史，推理时由 controller 执行 progressive disclosure，先读高层摘要、按需下钻到更细证据；note synthesizer 将检索到的证据整合为面向查询的结构，归并事实、排序事件并标出矛盾，再生成最终回答。
Result: 在 LongMemEval 上，APDMem 在长上下文记忆推理中取得强表现，同时仅访问全部对话的 8%。
Conclusion: 把渐进式披露 (progressive disclosure) 交给控制器驱动的分层记忆，可以在极低的证据访问比例下支撑长对话的查询自适应检索与回答。

papers.title: Windfoil: Closed-Form Coverage for Real-Time and Differentiable Vector Graphics
papers.abstract_en: We present Windfoil, a GPU-friendly algorithm that treats rasterisation and differentiable vector graphics as two sides of the same problem by evaluating the box-filtered winding number of quadratic Bézier contours in closed form. We implement this in WebGPU, allowing it to run across a range of environments, including a web browser on a consumer laptop, and apply the system to real-time 2D rendering, high-resolution rasterisation for print media, and a differentiable renderer. We compare our renderer against Skia, a production-grade engine, and Slug, a popular GPU rasterisation algorithm for games and real-time applications, measuring fidelity to a reference box-filtered coverage. Our renderer matches the reference more closely than either, at performance comparable to Slug. We also compare our optimiser against DiffVG and Bézier Splatting, where it reaches equivalent or better reconstruction quality at a fraction of the per-step cost, scaling to tens of thousands of shapes at interactive rates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Windfoil 用闭式解直接计算二次 Bézier 轮廓的盒滤波卷绕数 (box-filtered winding number)，把栅格化与可微矢量图形统一成同一问题，并在 WebGPU 上实现实时渲染与可微渲染。对参考盒滤波覆盖度的保真度优于 Skia 与 Slug，性能与 Slug 相当；优化器相对 DiffVG 与 Bézier Splatting 以每步成本的一小部分达到同等或更好的重建质量，可交互速率处理数万图形。
Motivation: 矢量图形的栅格化与可微渲染通常被当作两套管线，且高质量抗锯齿覆盖度计算在 GPU 上成本高，难以同时满足实时与可微需求。
Method: 对二次 Bézier 轮廓的盒滤波卷绕数给出闭式求值，作为栅格化与可微渲染的共同内核；用 WebGPU 实现，覆盖实时 2D 渲染、印刷级高分辨率栅格化与可微渲染器三种用途。
Result: 对参考盒滤波覆盖度的保真度高于 Skia 与 Slug，性能与 Slug 相当；优化器相对 DiffVG 与 Bézier Splatting 达到同等或更好的重建质量且每步成本仅为一小部分，可扩展到数万图形的交互速率。
Conclusion: 闭式覆盖度求值能让栅格化与可微矢量渲染共用一个 GPU 友好的内核，在保真度、每步成本与规模上同时占优。

papers.title: SD-DPC: Sparse Dictionary Differentiable Predictive Control
papers.abstract_en: We present sparse dictionary differentiable predictive control (SD-DPC), a framework for learning sparse, interpretable feedback policies for nonlinear systems from data. A prediction model is first identified by rollout-based sparse identification of nonlinear dynamics (SINDy), building on gradient-based and multistep formulations. The policy is then parameterized as a sparse combination of dictionary functions and trained by differentiating a constrained finite-horizon predictive-control objective through this model, so that its terms are selected by closed-loop performance rather than by imitating a previously trained controller. The result is an explicit feedback law with only a handful of terms. Across three benchmark control problems, SD-DPC satisfies the constraints in all test scenarios, outperforms a policy distilled onto the same terms by up to an order of magnitude, and requires orders of magnitude less memory and online computation than an optimization benchmark, while admitting explicit sensitivity bounds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SD-DPC 用 rollout 式 SINDy 先辨识非线性系统预测模型，再把反馈策略参数化为稀疏字典函数组合，通过对约束有限时域预测控制目标求导来训练，使项的选择由闭环性能而非模仿既有控制器决定。在三个基准控制问题上，SD-DPC 在全部测试场景满足约束，比蒸馏到相同项的策略好最多一个数量级，内存与在线计算量比优化基准少数个数量级，并给出显式灵敏度界。
Motivation: 从数据学习非线性系统的反馈策略时，稀疏可解释的显式控制律通常要靠模仿已有控制器或在线求解优化，前者项的选择与闭环性能脱钩，后者内存与在线计算开销大。
Method: 先用基于梯度与多步 rollout 的 SINDy 辨识预测模型；再把策略参数化为稀疏字典函数组合，对约束有限时域预测控制目标关于该模型求导来训练策略参数，项的取舍由闭环性能决定，最终得到只含少数项的显式反馈律。
Result: 在三个基准控制问题上，SD-DPC 在所有测试场景都满足约束；相对蒸馏到相同项的策略，性能提升最多一个数量级 (order of magnitude)；相对优化基准，内存与在线计算量减少数个数量级，并给出显式灵敏度界 (sensitivity bounds)。
Conclusion: 把稀疏字典策略的项选择放进闭环预测控制目标里优化，可以得到既满足约束、又比蒸馏策略和在线优化更省资源的显式反馈律。

papers.title: Capability Scaling-Down Laws for LLM Compression
papers.abstract_en: LLM compression reduces inference costs and memory requirements, but selecting a method and configuration remains largely empirical because comparable resource reductions can produce different capability losses. We systematically investigate capability scaling-down laws for LLM compression across pruning, quantization, and distillation. Our framework measures capability loss in mathematics, code generation, and question answering, and relates these measurements to model size, training stage, compression settings, data availability, and training exposure. We develop simple predictive relations and evaluate their accuracy, measurement efficiency, and generalization to unseen configurations and model states. Sharing the density response across pruning levels halves the configuration measurements needed to fit a pruning predictor: on new Pythia states, on pre-registered OLMo-2 test states and under Wanda pruning, the compact relation matches a regression fitted with all measurements on math and code to within 0.020 nats per token, with coefficients refitted for each setting. Controlled distillation experiments show that the cost of heavy data reuse recurs across question-answering distributions, while the net benefit depends on the evaluation distribution. We further evaluate the decision value of these predictions by comparing numerical selection with configuration medians and fixed method priorities. Independent evaluations across two model families show that selection captures most of the available cross-method benefit for question answering within the tested candidate sets, where a fixed method priority attains the same regret, with smaller opportunities for mathematics and code. These results clarify the predictive scope of capability scaling-down laws and their use in compression method selection. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/LabRAI/scaling_down_law.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LLM 压缩的能力缩放-下调律 (capability scaling-down laws)：把剪枝、量化、蒸馏三类压缩造成的数学、代码、问答能力损失，与模型规模、训练阶段、压缩配置、数据量和训练曝光量关联成简单预测式。跨剪枝层级共享密度响应后，拟合剪枝预测器所需配置测量减半，在 Pythia 新状态与预注册 OLMo-2 测试状态 (Wanda 剪枝) 上，紧凑关系式在数学与代码上与用全部测量拟合的回归相差不超过 0.020 nats/token。
Motivation: LLM 压缩选方法与配置基本靠经验：相同的资源削减幅度可能带来不同的能力损失，缺少可预测的定量关系。
Method: 框架在数学、代码生成、问答三类任务上度量能力损失，并将其与模型规模、训练阶段、压缩设置、数据可得性和训练曝光量关联，导出简单预测式并检验其精度、测量效率以及对未见配置和模型状态的泛化；另用受控蒸馏实验与数值选择 vs 配置中位数、固定方法优先级的对比评估预测的决策价值。
Result: 共享剪枝层级的密度响应使拟合剪枝预测器所需配置测量减半；在新 Pythia 状态、预注册 OLMo-2 测试状态与 Wanda 剪枝下，紧凑关系式在数学与代码上与用全部测量拟合的回归相差不超过 0.020 nats/token（系数按设置重拟合）。受控蒸馏显示重度数据复用的代价在多个问答分布上重复出现，净收益取决于评测分布；跨两个模型家族的独立评估显示，在所测候选集内数值选择捕获了问答上大部分跨方法收益，而固定方法优先级达到相同 regret，数学与代码上的可得收益更小。
Conclusion: 能力下调律在所测配置范围内足以支撑压缩方法与配置的数值选择，问答上收益最大、数学与代码上机会较小；代码见 github.com/LabRAI/scaling_down_law。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Composable AI-Accelerated Iterative Solver for 3D-IC Thermal Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Accurate thermal analysis of heterogeneous 2.5D/3D-IC packages is essential yet computationally prohibitive. A single full-package FEM simulation can take hours, while AI-based surrogates treat the entire stack as a monolithic prediction target and must be retrained whenever the die count or topology changes. To address this limitation, this work proposes Domain-Decomposed AI-Accelerated Iterative Solver for Thermal Analysis (DAIST), a composable thermal solver that decomposes the global package simulation into block-level subdomain problems, replaces subdomain solvers with neural operators, and couples them through iterative exchanges of interfacial temperature and heat flux. This local-to-global architecture eliminates the topology lock-in of monolithic models: block-level neural operators can be directly reused in unseen package assemblies without retraining. The iterative coupling strategy further provides a controllable accuracy-runtime tradeoff, where the iteration budget can be adjusted to trade accuracy for runtime. Evaluated on a multi-chiplet system and an advanced packaging system, DAIST achieves up to $178\times$ speedup over traditional FEM solvers with mean temperature errors of 0.068% and 0.323%, respectively, while demonstrating cross-topology reuse of block-level models across structurally distinct package assemblies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DAIST：把 3D-IC 封装整体热仿真按块分解为子域问题，用神经算子替代子域求解器，再通过界面温度与热流的迭代交换耦合回全局，从而摆脱整体代理模型的拓扑锁定。在多 chiplet 系统与先进封装系统上，相对传统 FEM 最高 178× 加速，平均温度误差分别为 0.068% 和 0.323%，且块级模型可跨结构不同的封装直接复用、无需重训。
Motivation: 异构 2.5D/3D-IC 封装的单次全封装 FEM 热仿真耗时数小时，而现有 AI 代理把整个堆叠当作单一预测目标，一旦 die 数量或拓扑改变就必须重训。
Method: DAIST 将全局封装仿真分解为块级子域问题，用神经算子替换子域求解器，并以界面温度与热流的迭代交换做局部到全局耦合；迭代预算可调，用于在精度与运行时间之间取舍。
Result: 在多 chiplet 系统与先进封装系统两个评测对象上，DAIST 相对传统 FEM 求解器最高达到 178× 加速，平均温度误差分别为 0.068% 与 0.323%，并展示了块级模型跨结构不同的封装装配复用。

papers.title: SideKernel: A Usable microVM Sandbox for AI Coding Agents on macOS
papers.abstract_en: AI coding agents are untrusted system components, yet they require autonomy on the developer machines they run on. This contradiction is a security problem. Sandboxes provide an isolated environment, but for local macOS development, the existing local, open-source options for AI coding agents are few in number and cumbersome to use. I conducted a formative online user survey which indicates that fewer than 40% of AI coding agent users run their agents in a sandbox and identifies the top usability barriers hindering AI coding agent sandbox adoption. These findings are used to develop SideKernel: an open-source, local, microVM-based macOS sandbox for AI coding agents designed for usability. To evaluate SideKernel, I compiled a list of sandboxes available on the market and filtered it against five inclusion criteria. Then I performed a comparative analysis between SideKernel and the sandboxes that satisfy these criteria, across 23 capability tests derived from the usability barriers revealed by the user survey. I discovered that only a few sandboxes are similar to SideKernel, and that among those, Docker Sandboxes and SideKernel score highest on capability features related to usability. A secondary contribution of this paper is a survey of the existing solution space for local, open-source, microVM-based macOS sandboxes for AI coding agents.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Georgia Tech M.S. Cybersecurity practicum project

TL;DR: SideKernel 是面向 macOS 本地 AI coding agent 的开源 microVM 沙箱，以可用性为设计目标。形成性在线调查显示不到 40% 的 AI coding agent 用户在沙箱中运行 agent；在按 5 条纳入标准筛选后，用源自用户调研可用性障碍的 23 项能力测试做对比，Docker Sandboxes 与 SideKernel 在可用性相关能力上得分最高。

papers.title: FinDialogLens: Event Extraction over Multi-Party Dialogue for Missed-Trade Identification in Financial Chatrooms
papers.abstract_en: Multi-party financial chatrooms are vital for sales-and-trading professionals, but their complexity makes manual recovery of missed trades infeasible: each Request for Quote (RFQ) is an event whose final price and trade outcome appear many messages after the RFQ-trigger message (the inquiry message), interleaved with concurrent RFQs from other participants. We cast this as event extraction (EE) over multi-party dialogue and present FinDialogLens, a hybrid LLM pipeline in which compact fine-tuned classifiers act as inference-time scaffolds: they detect RFQ-triggers and price/trade outcome metadata, an RFQ-Level Module segments per-event RFQ windows, and a Trade Engine fills argument roles. With GPT-4o, FinDialogLens reaches 92.1% and 94.3% accuracy on final price and trade outcome, respectively, outperforming full-chatroom CoT prompting methods; fine-tuned open-source LLMs with as few as 3B parameters achieve comparable performance with modest in-domain data. To make the LLM-based solution practical at scale, a difficulty-aware router balances cost and accuracy by allocating RFQs between a low-cost rule-based engine and the higher-performing LLM-powered Trade Engine, cutting LLM calls by 85% on final price while recovering half of the accuracy gap to FinDialogLens (GPT-4o), saving over $300/day at our 70,000-RFQ/day scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FinDialogLens 把金融聊天室里的漏单识别建模为多方对话事件抽取：微调小模型作为推理期脚手架检测 RFQ 触发与价格/成交元数据，RFQ-Level Module 切分事件窗口，Trade Engine 填充论元角色。GPT-4o 版本在最终价格与成交结果上分别达到 92.1% 与 94.3% 准确率，超过全聊天室 CoT 提示；难度感知路由器把 85% 的 RFQ 分给规则引擎，LLM 调用减少 85%，每日节省 300 美元以上。
Motivation: 多方金融聊天室中每条 RFQ 的最终价格与成交结果出现在触发消息之后很多条消息，且与其他参与者的并发 RFQ 交织，人工找回漏单不可行。
Method: 混合 LLM 流水线：紧凑微调分类器检测 RFQ-trigger 与价格/成交元数据，RFQ-Level Module 按事件切分 RFQ 窗口，Trade Engine 填充论元角色；另加难度感知路由器在低成本规则引擎与 LLM Trade Engine 之间分配 RFQ，权衡成本与准确率。
Result: GPT-4o 版 FinDialogLens 在最终价格与成交结果上准确率分别为 92.1% 与 94.3%，优于全聊天room CoT 提示方法；微调开源 LLM 低至 3B 参数即可在少量域内数据下取得相当性能；路由器在最终价格上削减 85% 的 LLM 调用，挽回与 FinDialogLens (GPT-4o) 之间一半的准确率差距，在 70,000 RFQ/天规模下每日节省超过 300 美元。
Conclusion: 小模型脚手架加难度感知路由可以让 LLM 事件抽取在金融聊天室规模上以可控成本运行，规则引擎与 LLM 的分工是成本-准确率的实际折中点。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning Techniques for the Optimization of Target Polarization in Nuclear Physics Scattering Experiments
papers.abstract_en: The operation of dynamically polarized targets in nuclear physics experiments relies on continuous tuning of the microwave frequency to compensate for radiation damage and evolving material properties, a task that is traditionally performed through manual trial-and-error by expert operators. This work presents a data-driven control framework that combines surrogate modeling with reinforcement learning to optimize the target polarization. Using operational data from the APOLLO cryogenic target system, we train and evaluate multilayer perceptron and Gaussian process regression models to predict polarization as a function of microwave frequency, beam current, and accumulated radiation dose. We show that Gaussian process-based models provide calibrated uncertainty estimates and reliably identify regions outside the training distribution, while MLPs exhibit limited sensitivity to distributional shift. To enable learning and control across multiple target samples, we introduce a Gaussian process approximation and embed the surrogate model within a standardized simulation environment. A reinforcement learning agent is trained using a lower-confidence-bound reward formulation that balances performance maximization against uncertainty. We are able to show an almost 2x improvement on the operators actions utilizing our RL agent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对核物理散射实验中动态极化靶微波频率的人工试错调参，提出代理模型加强化学习的控制框架：用 APOLLO 低温靶系统运行数据训练 MLP 与高斯过程回归预测极化，再把高斯过程代理嵌入标准化仿真环境，以 lower-confidence-bound 奖励训练 RL 智能体。RL 智能体相对操作员的操作取得接近 2 倍的提升。
Motivation: 动态极化靶需随辐射损伤与材料性质演化持续微调微波频率，目前靠专家操作员手工试错，效率低且难以跨靶样复用。
Method: 用 APOLLO cryogenic target system 运行数据训练 MLP 与 Gaussian process regression，输入为微波频率、束流电流与累积辐射剂量，输出极化预测；高斯过程提供校准不确定性并识别训练分布外区域。引入高斯过程近似，把代理嵌入标准化仿真环境，再用 lower-confidence-bound 奖励（平衡性能最大化与不确定性）训练 RL 智能体，以支持跨多个靶样学习与控制。
Result: 高斯过程模型给出校准的不确定性估计并可靠识别训练分布外区域，MLP 对分布偏移敏感性有限；RL 智能体相对操作员操作取得接近 2 倍 (almost 2x) 的提升。
Conclusion: 带不确定性感知奖励的 RL 加高斯过程代理可以替代人工试错来调微波频率，且跨靶样的标准化仿真环境是可行的控制路径。

papers.title: A Simulation-Grounded Agentic VLM Framework for Wildfire Monitoring and Reporting
papers.abstract_en: Effective wildfire monitoring requires relating visual evidence to physical fire dynamics, yet real videos with synchronized physical annotations are scarce and high-fidelity 3D simulation is costly. We present a simulation-grounded vision-language model (VLM) framework that automatically converts 2D wildfire simulations into labeled video episodes. A fixed Blender mapping produces low-detail 3D proxies aligned with simulator terrain, fuel layout, fire activity, and wind cues; controllable video generation supplies richer appearance. The proxies are intermediate representations rather than finely rendered final scenes. Generated videos and simulator labels form reusable multimodal memory for a training-free multi-agent VLM system that retrieves reference episodes, reconciles visual and memory-based predictions, and produces structured wildfire reports. On held-out generated episodes, video memory achieves 51.5% exact four-tag accuracy, compared with 22.6% for direct VLM querying and 16-17% for text-only memory; the complete system achieves 77.3% accuracy on six simulator-derived report fields. Component ablations, cross-generator tests, and three real-UAV evaluations assess retrieval, reporting, generator changes, and observable monitoring tasks. The framework connects automatic simulation-to-proxy conversion with memory-based VLM reasoning under scarce real-world physical annotations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出以仿真为底座的智能体 VLM 框架：把 2D 野火仿真自动转成带标签的视频片段，作为免训练多智能体系统的多模态记忆，用于野火监测与结构化报告。在留出生成片段上，视频记忆的四标签完全准确率达 51.5%，直接查询 VLM 为 22.6%、纯文本记忆为 16–17%；完整系统在六个仿真派生报告字段上达 77.3%。
Motivation: 真实野火视频缺少同步的物理标注，而高保真 3D 仿真成本高，导致视觉证据难以与火场物理动态对应。
Method: 用固定 Blender 映射把 2D 野火仿真转成与地形、燃料布局、火活动和风场对齐的低保真 3D proxy，再由可控视频生成补充外观；生成视频与仿真标签构成多模态记忆，供免训练多智能体 VLM 检索参考片段、调和视觉与记忆预测并产出结构化野火报告。
Result: 留出生成片段上四标签完全准确率：视频记忆 51.5%，直接 VLM 查询 22.6%，纯文本记忆 16–17%；完整系统在六个仿真派生报告字段上准确率 77.3%。另做组件消融、跨生成器测试与三次真实 UAV 评估，检验检索、报告、生成器更换与可观测监测任务。
Conclusion: 在真实物理标注稀缺时，仿真到 proxy 的自动转换加上基于记忆的 VLM 推理可以支撑野火监测与报告，且 proxy 是中间表示而非精细渲染的最终场景。
