papers.title: Counterexample Generation via Per-Theorem Symbolic Verifiers: When Imitation Hurts and Reinforcement Repairs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models often solve a theorem forward yet fail to disprove a closely related false one: a falsification gap that supervised fine-tuning does not close and can actively worsen. We frame counterexample generation as constrained witness emission against a deterministic per-theorem Python verifier, and release SymCE, a corpus of 4,707 false undergraduate-algebra and real-analysis conjectures, each paired with executable verifiers. The verifier also serves as the reward function, making SymCE a training environment. Training Qwen3-4B with SFT followed by GRPO under this oracle reveals an imitation trap: counterexample-only SFT collapses true-theorem recognition from 0.27 to 0.00, while RLVR with a sparse outcome-only reward repairs this and exceeds the base, to 0.66. The collapse replicates across four seeds and on Gemma-3-4B. Sparse and dense rewards yield statistically indistinguishable in-domain success yet diverge by 33 points on a held-out calibration probe, a dissociation we trace to the partial-credit term. Our 4B model outperforms every evaluated 7B open-weights math specialist, remains competitive with six frontier commercial APIs, and transfers under unchanged prompting to GSM8K, MATH-500 and MMLU-college-math. A human audit of 177 verifier decisions finds 97.7% accuracy. Code, data, verifier modules and annotations: https://github.com/ce-rlvr/SymCE.

Motivation: LLM 能正向解题却无法证伪相邻的假命题，这个 falsification gap 是监督微调关不上、甚至会被 SFT 恶化的缺口。
Method: 以 SymCE（4,707 条假命题 + 可执行 per-theorem Python verifier）为训练环境，先对 Qwen3-4B 做 counterexample-only SFT，再用 verifier 作为奖励做 GRPO（RLVR）；另比较稀疏与稠密奖励，并在四个 seed 与 Gemma-3-4B 上复现。
Result: counterexample-only SFT 使真命题识别从 0.27 崩到 0.00，SFT+GRPO（稀疏 outcome-only 奖励）修复到 0.66 并超过 base；该崩溃在四个 seed 与 Gemma-3-4B 上复现。稀疏与稠密奖励在域内成功率上统计不可区分，但在 held-out calibration probe 上相差 33 个百分点，差异可归因于 partial-credit 项。4B 模型胜过所有被评估的 7B 开源数学专家模型，与六个前沿商业 API 保持竞争力，并在不改 prompt 的情况下迁移到 GSM8K、MATH-500、MMLU-college-math。对 177 条 verifier 判定的人工审核准确率为 97.7%。
Conclusion: 模仿式微调会伤害证伪能力，而以 per-theorem verifier 为奖励的稀疏 RLVR 能修复它；稠密奖励的 partial-credit 项在域外校准上与稀疏奖励分道扬镳。

papers.title: AI-driven Thermal-aware Data Center Capacity Planning
papers.abstract_en: The emerging of large language models (LLMs) has posed significant challenges to the thermal management of data center. Intense GPU computation for LLMs results in localized hotspots. Moreover, spiking thermal loads during training and inference bursts make real-time cooling response more difficult to predict and control. Thermal-aware capacity planning of data center requires massive expensive high-fidelity CFD simulations. AI models can perform real-time prediction for unseen designs. However, existing works either have large prediction error, or have over-simplified assumptions for data center operations. This work presents an AI-driven framework that can perform thermal-aware capacity planning for a real-world data center in seconds. The embedded AI model learns from numerous key parameters (rack power, server power, server placement, HVAC settings etc.), and provides temperature prediction within milliseconds. This AI model is tested against high-fidelity CFD simulations, and results show that for unseen data center designs, model can achieve high accuracy with 10000X speedup. Driven by the AI model, the authors design the thermal-aware capacity planning framework. This framework can help data center designers and operators instantaneously optimize both workload distribution and HVAC cooling efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向真实数据中心的 AI 驱动热感知容量规划框架：内嵌模型从机架功率、服务器功率、服务器布置、HVAC 设定等关键参数学习，毫秒级给出温度预测，替代昂贵的高保真 CFD。在未见过的数据中心设计上对照 CFD 检验达到高精度并实现 10000 倍加速，整套规划流程可在秒级完成，用于即时优化工作负载分布与 HVAC 制冷效率。
Motivation: LLM 训练与推理突发造成 GPU 局部热点和剧烈波动的热负荷，冷却响应难以实时预测控制；热感知容量规划依赖大量昂贵的高保真 CFD 仿真，已有工作要么预测误差大、要么对数据中心运行做了过度简化假设。
Method: AI 驱动框架内嵌一个从机架功率、服务器功率、服务器布置、HVAC 设定等关键参数学习的温度预测模型，对未见过的设计做毫秒级推理；以该模型为核心构建热感知容量规划流程，联合优化工作负载分布与 HVAC 制冷效率，并用高保真 CFD 仿真做对照测试。
Result: 在未见过的数据中心设计上，模型相对高保真 CFD 达到高精度并取得 10000X 加速；温度预测在毫秒级完成，整套容量规划在秒级完成。
Conclusion: 学习式温度预测足以在秒级支撑真实数据中心的热感知容量规划，让设计者与运维即时权衡工作负载分布和 HVAC 制冷效率，而不必每次跑 CFD。

papers.title: Bandits via Additive Quantized Representations
papers.abstract_en: Contextual bandits require balancing nonlinear reward modeling with online efficiency. Tree ensembles and neural methods capture nonlinearities but require periodic retraining and large replay buffers. Linear models update efficiently per observation with O(1) memory, but are fundamentally restricted to linear reward structures. We propose Residual Quantization (RQ) as a representation layer to bridge this gap. An offline-trained RQ codebook maps continuous contexts into discrete centroid assignments across multiple levels, set dynamically through a shadow mechanism. This enables a spectrum of additive bandit algorithms that achieve nonlinear expressivity with strictly bounded memory. Across 13 datasets, RQ variants beat their non-RQ counterparts on 11 of 13 datasets, often by wide margins, while matching doubling-retrain XGBoost and neural baselines using up to 1000 times less memory.
papers.comment: 40 pages, 16 figures, 12 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把离线训练的残差量化 (Residual Quantization, RQ) codebook 作为 contextual bandit 的表示层，把连续 context 映射为多层离散质心分配，从而在严格有界内存下获得非线性表达力。在 13 个数据集上，RQ 变体在 11 个上胜过各自的非 RQ 对应算法，且用最多 1000 倍更少的内存追平 doubling-retrain XGBoost 与神经基线。
Motivation: Contextual bandit 需要在非线性 reward 建模与在线效率之间取舍：树集成与神经方法非线性强但要周期性重训、依赖大 replay buffer，线性模型可 O(1) 内存逐样本更新却只能表达线性 reward 结构。
Method: 离线训练的 RQ codebook 将连续 context 映射为多层离散质心分配，层数通过 shadow mechanism 动态设定；在此表示上构造一族 additive bandit 算法，内存严格有界。
Result: 在 13 个数据集上，RQ 变体在 11 个上优于其非 RQ 对应版本，且常有较大差距；同时以最多 1000 倍更少的内存匹配 doubling-retrain XGBoost 与神经基线。
Conclusion: 用离线量化 codebook 做表示层，可以让 bandit 算法同时拿到非线性表达力与有界内存，替代周期性重训与大 replay buffer 的做法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Generative Model of Complex Networks Using Graphons and Neural Inverse Operators
papers.abstract_en: Generative graph models are central to understanding and simulating complex networks. However, existing approaches have complementary strengths and limitations. Mechanistic models offer interpretability but rely on instance-specific estimation methods. Deep generative models, on the other hand, offer amortized inference at the cost of interpretability and are largely limited to graph sizes seen during training. Scientific applications motivate a framework that retains the strengths of both paradigms. We bridge them by formulating both the generative model and parameter recovery in function space. A multifractal step graphon extends standard step graphons with a recursive construction that compactly parameterizes complex networks. This formulation admits a neural inverse operator to recover its parameters, enabling inference on unseen graph sizes. We evaluate our model, trained only on synthetic multifractal step graphon realizations, against both paradigms. Against a graph foundation model pretrained on empirical networks, our method achieves the best average performance on three of four metrics in a zero-shot graph-generation benchmark, indicating that the model transfers to real-world graphs. We also apply our method to single-observation networks, a regime largely inaccessible to deep models that require training corpora, where it performs comparably to an instance-specific method that optimizes on each graph. In a multi-subject EEG case study, the inferred parameters track a reversible change in brain state more sensitively than traditional network statistics. Together, these results indicate that mechanistic interpretability and amortized inference can be effectively unified in a generative graph model to enhance our understanding of complex networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把生成模型与参数恢复都放到函数空间，用多重分形阶梯 graphon（multifractal step graphon）递归地紧致参数化复杂网络，并配一个神经逆算子 (neural inverse operator) 恢复其参数，从而对训练中未见的图规模做推断。在零样本图生成基准上，对预训练于经验网络的 graph foundation model，本方法在四项指标中的三项取得最佳平均表现；在单观测网络上表现与逐图优化的实例特定方法相当，EEG 多被试案例中推断参数比传统网络统计量更敏感地跟踪可逆脑状态变化。
Motivation: 机理图模型可解释但依赖逐实例估计，深度生成模型可摊销推断却缺乏可解释性且受限于训练时见过的图规模；科学应用需要同时保留两者优势的框架。
Method: 在函数空间中同时形式化生成模型与参数恢复：以多重分形阶梯 graphon 扩展标准 step graphon，用递归构造紧致参数化网络；该形式化引入神经逆算子恢复 graphon 参数，支持对未见图规模推断。模型仅在合成的多重分形阶梯 graphon 实现上训练，并与两类范式对比评估。
Result: 在零样本图生成基准上，对预训练于经验网络的 graph foundation model，本方法在四项指标中的三项取得最佳平均表现，表明可迁移到真实图。在单观测网络（深度模型缺乏训练语料的场景）上，其表现与逐图优化的实例特定方法相当。在多被试 EEG 案例研究中，推断参数比传统网络统计量更敏感地跟踪一次可逆的脑状态变化。
Conclusion: 机理可解释性与摊销推断可以在一个生成图模型中有效统一，从而增强对复杂网络的理解；参数化与逆算子的函数空间形式化是实现跨规模、零样本推断的关键。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Are you Synthesizing or Recalling? Evaluating LLMs on Algorithmic Code Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in code generation, where success depends on both recalling relevant algorithmic knowledge and reasoning about how to apply it. However, existing LLM pipelines are opaque, with no explicit separation between these two components. We argue that for well-known algorithms whose canonical implementations are widely accessible in pretraining corpora, code generation is better measured as \textit{parametric code retrieval}: reproducing a named algorithm from internalised knowledge rather than synthesizing a novel one. We introduce AlgoREval, a benchmark of 599 problems spanning classical 77 algorithms across 14 domains, 7 programming languages, and 4 graph-input representations to evaluate this capability in isolation, and assess 15 models (7B--34B parameters) in a zero-shot setting. We find substantial variation in retrieval accuracy across languages and input representations, even for widely documented algorithms and show that prompt augmentation with retrieved code snippets or structured algorithmic hints improve accuracy on complex algorithms, while SFT achieves broader language gains and GRPO achieves larger per-language gains on specific languages. Together, our results establish parametric code retrieval as a distinct, measurable capability and caution against deploying AI-generated algorithmic code without systematic validation.\footnote{Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Nickil21/AlgoREval
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 AlgoREval 基准，把知名算法的代码生成重新定义为「参数化代码检索」(parametric code retrieval)：从内部记忆复现具名算法而非合成新算法。在 599 道题、77 个经典算法、14 个领域、7 种语言、4 种图输入表示上零样本测 15 个模型（7B–34B），检索准确率随语言与输入表示显著波动；检索片段或结构化算法提示的 prompt 增强能提升复杂算法准确率，SFT 带来更广的语言覆盖，GRPO 在特定语言上单语言增益更大。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 代码生成流水线不区分「回忆算法知识」与「推理如何应用」，对预训练语料中广泛存在的经典算法，用合成能力来衡量并不对路。
Method: 构建 AlgoREval：599 道题覆盖 77 个经典算法、14 个领域、7 种编程语言、4 种图输入表示，零样本评估 15 个 7B–34B 模型；并测试检索代码片段与结构化算法提示的 prompt 增强，以及 SFT 与 GRPO 两种微调路径。
Result: 检索准确率在语言与输入表示之间存在显著差异，即便对文档充分的算法也是如此；prompt 增强（检索片段或结构化提示）提升复杂算法准确率；SFT 获得更广的语言层面收益，GRPO 在特定语言上单语言增益更大。
Conclusion: 参数化代码检索是可独立测量的能力，AI 生成的算法代码在缺乏系统性验证时不应直接部署。

summary_sections.result: 检索准确率在语言与输入表示之间存在显著差异，即便对文档充分的算法也是如此；prompt 增强（检索片段或结构化提示）提升复杂算法准确率；SFT 获得更广的语言层面收益，GRPO 在特定语言上单语言增益更大。
summary_sections.conclusion: 参数化代码检索是可独立测量的能力，AI 生成的算法代码在缺乏系统性验证时不应直接部署。

papers.title: Learning Style, Forgetting Semantics: A Case Study of SFT and RFT on Classification Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Why does supervised fine-tuning (SFT) lead to more forgetting than reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT), even when all teacher demonstrations are semantically correct? We study this question on classification tasks where tokens within each semantic class express the same semantic answer in different styles. The tasks share an underlying semantic rule but differ in their prompt distributions and teachers' stylistic preferences. Using a tractable linear-softmax policy, we derive an exact decomposition of the updates into semantic and style components. We show that, at a common policy and prompt, SFT and RFT have parallel semantic updates but differ in their style dynamics. Starting from a policy with no within-class style preference, RFT with exact policy gradients preserves this symmetry, whereas SFT with a nonuniform teacher develops off-axis style drift along a nonzero task mean under population updates. We use this drift to establish a separation under explicit conditions: for population updates from a common perfectly fitted checkpoint, SFT forgetting admits a strictly positive lower bound over a finite training interval, while RFT retains zero semantic error. Simulations over task sequences support these theoretical predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在分类任务上，SFT 与 RFT 的遗忘差异来自风格而非语义：线性-softmax 策略下更新可精确分解为语义与风格两部分，SFT 与 RFT 的语义更新平行，但风格动力学不同。从无类内风格偏好的策略出发，精确策略梯度的 RFT 保持该对称性，非均匀教师的 SFT 则沿非零任务均值产生离轴风格漂移；由此在共同完美拟合检查点的总体更新下，SFT 遗忘在有限训练区间上有严格正下界，RFT 保持零语义误差。
Motivation: 即使教师示范语义全部正确，SFT 仍比 RFT 遗忘更多，这一差异缺少可刻画的机制；需要区分遗忘究竟来自语义更新还是风格更新。
Method: 在可解的 linear-softmax 策略上把参数更新精确分解为语义分量与风格分量，比较 SFT 与 RFT 在共同策略与提示下的更新方向；从无类内风格偏好的初始策略出发分析总体更新的风格漂移，并在任务序列上做模拟检验理论预测。
Result: SFT 与 RFT 的语义更新平行、风格动力学不同；RFT（精确策略梯度）保持类内风格对称，SFT（非均匀教师）沿非零任务均值产生离轴风格漂移；在共同完美拟合检查点的总体更新下，SFT 遗忘在有限训练区间上具有严格正下界，RFT 保持零语义误差；任务序列模拟支持这些理论预测。
Conclusion: SFT 的额外遗忘由风格漂移驱动而非语义更新本身，在给定条件下 SFT 遗忘有正下界而 RFT 可保持零语义误差。

papers.title: Evaluating and Improving the Robustness of Large Language Models to Input Sequence Variations
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) in production systems face prompt injections, trojans (backdoors), and manipulation of automatic quality metrics. This thesis develops models, methods, and algorithms for evaluating and improving LLM robustness to adversarial input sequence variations. We propose R_stab(f), a generative robustness metric based on the Jensen-Shannon divergence between per-step output distributions under small input perturbations. For localized attacks we prove V(h) <= 1 - R_class(h), where R_class(h) is the probability that a decision operator h keeps its decision under small perturbations. For non-localized attacks we propose a calibrated empirical model. For LLM-as-a-Judge systems we develop ASA, an adaptive evolutionary black-box attack that reaches an attack success rate (ASR) of up to 73.8%, with transfer between open models up to 62.6%. On Trojan Detection Challenge 2023 data (Pythia-1.4B), surrogate triggers reach REASR ~0.99 while recall of the true triggers is ~0.17 against a baseline of ~0.14. On SaTML CTF 2024 we systematize four classes of bypasses of multi-layer defenses, which reduce the ASR from 90% to 15-25%. Committees of 5-7 heterogeneous models reduce the ASR for Gemma-3-4B by 47-55 percentage points, to 19.3% with 7 models. For agentic systems based on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), we propose AttestMCP, which attests tool calls with HMAC-protected packets at under 0.1 ms per call, and the Commit Boundary isolation pattern. On the MCPBench benchmark of 847 scenarios they reduce the average ASR from 53.7% to 12.4%. The methods are implemented in the JudgeGuard and TrojanArmor software suites and the MCPSec module.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇 LLM 安全博士论文用生成式鲁棒性度量 R_stab(f)、进化黑盒攻击 ASA、模型委员会与 MCP 工具调用证明 AttestMCP，系统性评估并降低大模型对对抗性输入序列变化的脆弱性。ASA 对 LLM-as-a-Judge 的攻击成功率 (ASR) 达 73.8%，5–7 个异构模型委员会把 Gemma-3-4B 的 ASR 压到 19.3%，AttestMCP 与 Commit Boundary 在 MCPBench 上把平均 ASR 从 53.7% 降到 12.4%。
Motivation: 生产环境中的 LLM 面临 prompt injection、trojan 后门与自动质量指标操纵，缺少可度量的鲁棒性定义和可落地的防御手段。
Method: 提出基于逐步输出分布 Jensen-Shannon 散度的生成式度量 R_stab(f)；对局部攻击证明 V(h) <= 1 - R_class(h)，对非局部攻击给出校准经验模型；开发自适应进化黑盒攻击 ASA、模型委员会、HMAC 工具调用证明 AttestMCP 与 Commit Boundary 隔离模式，落地为 JudgeGuard、TrojanArmor 与 MCPSec。
Result: ASA 对 LLM-as-a-Judge 的 ASR 最高 73.8%，跨开源模型迁移最高 62.6%；Trojan Detection Challenge 2023 (Pythia-1.4B) 上代理触发器 REASR 约 0.99、真实触发器召回约 0.17（基线约 0.14）；SaTML CTF 2024 上四类多层防御绕过把 ASR 从 90% 降到 15–25%；5–7 模型委员会使 Gemma-3-4B 的 ASR 降 47–55 个百分点至 19.3%；AttestMCP 每次调用开销低于 0.1 ms，在 847 个场景的 MCPBench 上把平均 ASR 从 53.7% 降到 12.4%。
Conclusion: 鲁棒性既可用 R_stab 这类可证明上界的度量刻画，也能靠异构模型委员会与工具调用证明这类系统级机制把实际攻击成功率压到 20% 以下。

papers.title: CRISP: A Framework for Clause-Reconstructed Interpretable NeuroSymbolic Propositions
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks achieve high accuracy through layered numerical transformations, yet their decisions remain difficult to audit because decision evidence is encoded in hidden activations rather than explicit rules. This paper introduces CRISP, a framework that reconstructs the last-layer activation vector (LLAV) of binary neural teachers as Tsetlin Machine (TM) clauses. CRISP sign-binarizes the teacher's penultimate pre-logit activations, and assigns one Individual TM (ITM) to each LLAV neuron. Each reconstructed hidden bit is represented by propositional clauses over Booleanized input features, which gives a direct symbolic trace from named input thresholds to a named teacher neuron. CRISP is evaluated on MNIST, KMNIST, FashionMNIST (FMNIST), SVHN, and CIFAR10 using a BinaryConnect convolutional neural network (BCCNN) teacher and a fully binary neural network (BNN) teacher, with an additional study on binary thresholding, thermometer encoding, and quartile binning at multiple bit depths. The results show that LLAV sign-binarization does not reduce teacher-head accuracy in the tested BNN setting, while ITM reconstruction error is the main limiting factor. Quartile one-bit Booleanization gives the strongest reconstruction fidelity on SVHN at 87.52% test fidelity and is competitive on CIFAR10, and the reconstructed LLAV preserves 78.41% teacher-head accuracy on FMNIST. Pooled clause-evidence visualizations show that the learned ITM literals concentrate on the object region in centered benchmarks. CRISP therefore provides a clause-level route for inspecting the final hidden representation of binary neural teachers.
papers.comment: Preprint for an accepted paper at International Symposium of the Tsetlin Machine (ISTM) 2026 Conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CRISP 把二值神经教师的最后一层激活向量 (LLAV) 重建成 Tsetlin Machine 子句：对 penultimate pre-logit 激活做 sign-binarization，每个 LLAV 神经元配一个 Individual TM，用布尔化输入特征上的命题子句表示每个隐层位，从而给出从命名输入阈值到命名教师神经元的符号化证据链。在 SVHN 上 quartile 一位布尔化重建保真度达 87.52% test fidelity，重建后的 LLAV 在 FMNIST 上保留 78.41% 的 teacher-head accuracy。
Motivation: 深度网络的决策证据藏在隐层激活里而非显式规则，难以审计；需要把二值教师的最后隐表示还原成可逐条检查的符号子句。
Method: CRISP 对教师 penultimate pre-logit 激活做 sign-binarization，为每个 LLAV 神经元分配一个 Individual TM (ITM)，用覆盖布尔化输入特征的命题子句表示每个重建隐位；对比 binary thresholding、thermometer encoding、quartile binning 在多种 bit depth 下的方案，教师为 BinaryConnect CNN (BCCNN) 与全二值网络 (BNN)。
Result: 在 MNIST、KMNIST、FashionMNIST、SVHN、CIFAR10 上评测：所测 BNN 设定中 LLAV sign-binarization 不降低 teacher-head accuracy，主要瓶颈是 ITM 重建误差；quartile 一位 Booleanization 在 SVHN 上给出最强重建保真度 87.52% test fidelity，在 CIFAR10 上有竞争力；重建 LLAV 在 FMNIST 上保留 78.41% teacher-head accuracy；pooled clause-evidence 可视化显示 ITM literals 在居中类数据集上集中于目标区域。
Conclusion: CRISP 提供了一条在子句层面检视二值神经教师最后隐表示的路径，且在测试设定中精度损失主要来自 ITM 重建而非 sign-binarization 本身。

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Time Reparameterization for Flow-Map Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Flow-map distillation enables one- and few-step generation by learning finite-time transitions of a pretrained generative ODE. We investigate whether changing the teacher's time parameterization can make these transitions easier to learn. Motivated by the hypothesis that trajectory segments with large normal acceleration are harder to distill, we propose a geometry-aware time reparameterization that allocates more student time to these regions while preserving the teacher's geometric paths and terminal distribution. We derive a shared clock that equalizes a population normal-acceleration statistic under suitable assumptions, and construct a practical approximation from robust, regularized estimates across teacher trajectories. We incorporate this clock into Lagrangian flow-map distillation, using the transformed time coordinate to condition the student. The clock is estimated once before distillation and requires neither teacher retraining nor additional student parameters or inference-time network evaluations. Experiments on synthetic data, CIFAR-10, and CelebA-64 show improved sample quality over identity-time distillation at matched inference budgets, including improvements in one- and two-step image generation. The gains in one-step generation, where no intermediate sampling times can be adjusted, highlight the benefits of time reparameterization during distillation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 flow-map 蒸馏中引入几何感知的时间重参数化 (geometry-aware time reparameterization)：按法向加速度大的轨迹段分配更多学生时间，导出可均衡群体法向加速度统计量的共享时钟 (shared clock)，并用其变换后的时间坐标条件化学生网络。在合成数据、CIFAR-10 与 CelebA-64 上，相同推理预算下样本质量优于 identity-time 蒸馏，一步与两步生成均有提升。
Motivation: flow-map 蒸馏要学习预训练生成 ODE 的有限时间转移，法向加速度大的轨迹段更难蒸馏，而固定的时间参数化把学生时间平均分配在这些困难区段上。
Method: 在合适假设下推导共享时钟，使群体法向加速度统计量均衡；用跨教师轨迹的稳健正则化估计构造可实践的近似，并把该时钟并入 Lagrangian flow-map distillation，以变换后的时间坐标条件化学生。时钟在蒸馏前估计一次，不需要教师重训、不增加学生参数，也不增加推理时网络评估。
Result: 在合成数据、CIFAR-10 与 CelebA-64 上，相同推理预算下样本质量优于 identity-time 蒸馏，一步与两步图像生成均有提升；一步生成中没有可调的中间采样时间，其增益直接来自蒸馏阶段的时间重参数化。
Conclusion: 调整教师的时间参数化、把更多学生时间投给难蒸馏的高法向加速度区段，可以在不增加推理开销的前提下改善少步生成质量。

papers.title: An AI-Based Multi-Stage Approach for Androgenetic Alopecia Assessment from Low-Magnification Scalp Images
papers.abstract_en: Androgenetic alopecia (AGA) is characterized by patterned follicular miniaturization, increased single-hair follicular units, and altered hair-shaft diameter. We present an automated quantitative scalp-analysis and clinical decision-support framework combining FU localization, ordinal visible-shaft counting, calibrated shaft-width estimation, regional aggregation, and an interpretable rule layer. The clinical cohort comprised 243 patients (127 AGA, 116 non-AGA), while the computer-vision experiments used 160 expert-annotated patients, 2,400 trichoscopic images, and approximately 158,000 FU annotations. Under patientdisjoint evaluation, YOLOv8m achieved test mAP@0.5=0.920 and recall=0.860; EfficientNet-B5 with a support-map channel achieved 87.0% expert-box count accuracy (macro F1=0.85). A separate 500-image set was processed end-to-end with detector-generated boxes, yielding MAE of 6.56 for follicle detection and 16.59 for follicle classification relative to human-expert annotations. The system is intended to assist, rather than replace, dermatologist interpretation.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Mitigating Private Data Leakage in LLMs with Whiteout
papers.abstract_en: Modern large language models (LLMs) are trained on massive, largely unfiltered datasets, including content scraped from nearly every accessible website and user inputs. As a result, LLMs often memorize and reproduce personally sensitive information (PSI) such as birth dates, phone numbers, and home addresses. This leads to significant privacy risks, particularly for high-profile individuals such as executives, politicians, and judges. Existing mitigations largely rely on machine unlearning. However, these methods often remove more information than needed, degrade model utility and safety, and are highly vulnerable to attacks. This paper presents Whiteout, a practical tool that, upon requests by individuals, prevents LLMs from regurgitating their genuine PSIs, by overwriting them using precise and carefully designed obfuscation samples. We evaluate Whiteout on modern LLMs of varying sizes and makers, including a widely-used OpenAI model. Results show that Whiteout effectively prevents disclosure of the targeted PSIs, has negligible impact on model utility and safety, and outperforms existing alternatives. We also test Whiteout against a wide range of countermeasures, from black-box attacks like jailbreaking to white-box adaptive attacks like relearning and quantization. Finally, we conclude with a discussion on the security and ethical implications of Whiteout.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Whiteout 用精心设计的混淆样本覆写 LLM 记忆的真实个人敏感信息 (PSI)，阻止模型复述出生日期、电话、住址等，而非用机器遗忘删除信息。在不同规模与厂商的现代 LLM（含一个广泛使用的 OpenAI 模型）上，它有效阻止目标 PSI 泄露，对模型效用与安全影响可忽略，并优于既有方案；面对越狱等黑盒攻击与重学习、量化等白盒自适应攻击仍有效。
Motivation: LLM 在大规模未过滤语料上训练后会记忆并复述个人敏感信息，对高管、政要、法官等构成隐私风险；现有机器遗忘方法删信息过多、损害效用与安全，且易被攻击绕过。
Method: Whiteout 作为按个人请求触发的工具，用精确设计的混淆样本 (obfuscation samples) 覆写目标 PSI，而非删除；在多个规模与厂商的 LLM 上评估，并测试黑盒越狱与白盒自适应攻击（relearning、quantization）。
Result: 在现代 LLM（含广泛使用的 OpenAI 模型）上，Whiteout 有效阻止目标 PSI 泄露，对模型效用与安全影响可忽略，且优于既有替代方案；在越狱、重学习、量化等一系列对抗措施下仍被测试有效。
Conclusion: 用覆写而非遗忘来消除 PSI 泄露，可以在保住模型效用与安全的同时抵御黑盒与白盒自适应攻击；作者同时讨论其安全与伦理影响。

papers.title: The AI Theorist reveals excitonic structure in $α$-RuCl$_3$
papers.abstract_en: Advances in experimental instrumentation and automation generate increasingly rich datasets, but turning experimental observations into microscopic understanding remains a bottleneck in scientific discovery. To accelerate this process, we introduce AI Theorist, a system of artificial intelligence (AI) agents for autonomous discovery of physical models through hypothesis generation, first-principles calculations and evidence-driven refinement. We apply the framework to $α$-RuCl$_3$, a leading candidate material for realizing a Kitaev quantum spin liquid, to investigate its electronic structure through optical spectra. AI Theorist develops a new interpretation of the optical and photocurrent observations, identifying distinct excitonic states with contrasting optical selection rules and real-space distributions. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of an AI system autonomously developing a physical model to explain previously unpublished experimental observations in a quantum material, utilizing first-principles electronic-structure and many-body calculations. Our results establish a route to autonomous theoretical discovery in materials science, in which AI agents use first-principles calculations to turn experimental observations into physical models and testable predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AI Theorist 用一组 AI agent 自主完成物理模型发现：生成假设、做第一性原理计算、再按证据迭代修正，把 α-RuCl₃ 的光学谱与光电流观测解释为具有不同光学选择定则和实空间分布的激子态。据作者所知，这是首个由 AI 系统自主建立物理模型、解释尚未发表的量子材料实验观测的演示，依托第一性原理电子结构与多体计算。
Motivation: 实验仪器与自动化产出的数据越来越丰富，但把实验观测转化为微观理解仍是科学发现的瓶颈，量子材料中未发表观测尤其缺少可解释的物理模型。
Method: AI Theorist 由多个 AI agent 组成，流程为假设生成、第一性原理计算、证据驱动的迭代修正；对 α-RuCl₃ 的光学谱与光电流数据建模，并结合第一性原理电子结构与多体计算检验所得模型。
Result: 对 α-RuCl₃ 的光学与光电流观测给出新解释，识别出光学选择定则与实空间分布相互对照的不同激子态；据作者所知为首个 AI 系统自主建立物理模型解释未发表量子材料实验观测的演示。
Conclusion: AI agent 借助第一性原理计算可以把实验观测直接转成物理模型与可检验预言，为材料科学中的自主理论发现提供一条路径。

papers.title: Prompted to Discriminate: Generalizing Malicious-Input Probes in the Wild
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly rely on activation probes as runtime monitors for prompt injection, jailbreaks, and unsafe requests, reading the model's own hidden state to catch a harmful input before the agent acts on it. A cheap, increasingly common move, borrowed from LLM-as-judge prompting, is to append a short classification instruction after the user's turn and read the probe at that point, to sharpen it: the instruction asks the model to represent the incoming request as a class, concentrating the signal the probe must separate, at negligible serving cost. But does the wording of that suffix matter, and does its benefit hold in the wild, on attack types the probe never saw in training, the regime a deployed monitor faces? We test this with a controlled ladder of post-user suffixes under strict leave-one-dataset-out (LODO) evaluation across 13 safety benchmarks (jailbreak, injection, and benign chat) and three open-weight model families (Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma-4-12B). On a single-position probe, a classification suffix consistently improves out-of-distribution detection over no suffix (up to ~4 AUC points); yet which suffix matters: prompting the model to classify the input, even into content-free labels, reliably wins; an off-topic or merely-attentive suffix helps little. The gain comes from the classification format, not the named criterion: a content-free suffix matches the real malicious/benign one, with the criterion adding precision only at strict thresholds. This is not an artifact of the single-position read: the benefit carries to the multi-position pooling probes used in production (attention, multi-max, MLP), though the best-performing suffix there is readout-dependent. Served through a KV-cache fork, it is a cheap drop-in for any activation-probe monitor, though not an automatic win: which suffix helps, and by how much, depends on the model and the readout.
papers.comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 LLM agent 的激活探针 (activation probe) 监控里，用户轮次后追加一句分类指令作为后缀，能在从未见过的攻击类型上提升 OOD 检测：LODO 跨 13 个安全基准、三个开源模型上，单位置探针的 AUC 最多提升约 4 个点。起作用的是分类格式而非标签语义——无内容标签的后缀即可匹配真实 malicious/benign 后缀，判据只在严格阈值下增加精度；收益可迁移到生产用的多位置池化探针 (attention、multi-max、MLP)，但最佳后缀依赖模型与读出方式。
Motivation: 部署中的 agent 监控要在训练时没见过的攻击类型 (prompt injection、jailbreak) 上工作，而常见的后缀锐化做法是否有效、措辞是否要紧，此前缺少受控的分布外检验。
Method: 构造一组受控的 post-user 后缀阶梯，采用严格 leave-one-dataset-out (LODO) 评测，覆盖 13 个安全基准 (jailbreak、injection、benign chat) 与三个开源模型族 Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma-4-12B；探针读取单位置与多位置池化 (attention、multi-max、MLP) 激活，经 KV-cache fork 提供服务。
Result: 单位置探针上分类后缀相对无后缀一致提升 OOD 检测，AUC 最多约 +4 个点；要求分类输入的后缀（即便用无内容标签）稳定胜出，off-topic 或仅提示注意的后缀帮助很小；无内容后缀与真实 malicious/benign 后缀持平，判据仅在严格阈值下增加精度；收益延续到多位置池化探针，但那里最佳后缀依赖读出方式。
Conclusion: 后缀措辞确实要紧，收益来自分类格式而非命名判据，因此可作为任意激活探针监控的低成本即插即用改动，但并非自动有效——哪个后缀有用、幅度多大取决于模型与读出方式。

papers.title: Efficient Neural Field Learning via Adaptive Coverage and Focused Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Implicit neural representations (INRs) provide a flexible framework for modeling high-dimensional continuous fields, but their training is often inefficient due to uniform subsampling that ignores spatial heterogeneity. Existing adaptive sampling methods partially address this issue by prioritizing high-error samples, but typically operate at the point level, often leading to redundant sampling in localized regions and insufficient coverage of the domain. We propose ACES (Adaptive Coverage-aware Efficient Sampling), a structured sampling framework that improves training efficiency by decoupling coverage and importance. ACES constructs adaptive spatial partitions to ensure domain coverage and reduce redundancy, and applies region-level importance weighting to prioritize informative regions during training. We provide a theoretical analysis showing that adaptive partitioning reduces gradient variance by increasing within-region homogeneity, and that controlled bias in region-level weighting may improve optimization efficiency relative to standard unbiased estimators. Experiments on scientific field learning tasks demonstrate that ACES achieves faster convergence and lower error than uniform and pointwise adaptive sampling baselines, with the largest gains in fields with highly localized complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ACES 把 INR 训练中的采样拆成覆盖与重要性两路：自适应空间划分保证全域覆盖并消除局部冗余，区域级重要性加权聚焦信息量大的区域。理论分析给出自适应划分通过提高区域内同质性降低梯度方差、区域级加权的受控偏差相对无偏估计器可提升优化效率；在科学场学习任务上比均匀采样与点级自适应采样收敛更快、误差更低，局部复杂度高的场收益最大。
Motivation: INR 训练普遍依赖均匀子采样，忽略空间异质性；现有自适应采样只在点级优先高误差样本，造成局部重复采样而全域覆盖不足。
Method: ACES 构造自适应空间分区保证域覆盖并降低冗余，再做区域级重要性加权在训练中优先处理信息量大的区域，把覆盖与重要性解耦；配套给出梯度方差与受控偏差的理论分析。
Result: 在科学场学习任务上，ACES 比均匀采样与点级自适应采样基线收敛更快、误差更低，且在具有高度局部复杂性的场中收益最大；理论结论为自适应划分提高区域内同质性从而降低梯度方差，区域级加权的受控偏差相对标准无偏估计器可能提升优化效率。
Conclusion: 把采样决策从点级提升到区域级并显式解耦覆盖与重要性，是提升 INR 训练效率的有效路径，收益集中在局部复杂度高的场。
Relevance: 35

summary_sections.method: ACES 构造自适应空间分区保证域覆盖并降低冗余，再做区域级重要性加权在训练中优先处理信息量大的区域，把覆盖与重要性解耦；配套给出梯度方差与受控偏差的理论分析。
summary_sections.result: 在科学场学习任务上，ACES 比均匀采样与点级自适应采样基线收敛更快、误差更低，且在具有高度局部复杂性的场中收益最大；理论结论为自适应划分提高区域内同质性从而降低梯度方差，区域级加权的受控偏差相对标准无偏估计器可能提升优化效率。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把采样决策从点级提升到区域级并显式解耦覆盖与重要性，是提升 INR 训练效率的有效路径，收益集中在局部复杂度高的场。

papers.title: When Terminal-Agent Training Stalls: Demystifying Data Generation and Verification Challenge
papers.abstract_en: Using a frontier model like Claude Opus as a meta-agent to generate terminal tasks and verifiers for RL training is increasingly common. Yet a runnable Docker image and executable test suite do not guarantee a faithful end-to-end pipeline for terminal agent training. We present a meta-agent pipeline motivated by this gap, diagnosing three classes of failure: benchmark invalidity, harness brittleness, and reward misalignment. Prompt redesign and context extension raise baseline solvability 5.6 times, but a 9B model saturates at 81.3% mean pass@2 within 20 steps on Claude Opus-generated tasks. Adding hard tasks reduces mean pass@2 to 20.6% without changing the training configuration, a strong evidence that the solvability band is model-specific. These findings demonstrate that meta-agent reliability requires solvability-band calibration, verifier audits, and infrastructure error accounting as first-class evaluation criteria, not post-hoc diagnost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对用 Claude Opus 作 meta-agent 生成终端任务与验证器的 RL 训练管线，诊断出三类失败：benchmark 无效性、harness 脆弱性、奖励错位。重写 prompt 并扩展上下文把基线可解率提升 5.6 倍，但 9B 模型在 Claude Opus 生成的任务上 20 步内 mean pass@2 饱和于 81.3%；加入难题后在训练配置不变时 mean pass@2 降到 20.6%，说明可解率区间是模型特定的，必须按模型标定。
Motivation: 有可运行的 Docker 镜像和测试套件并不等于端到端终端 agent 训练管线忠实可用，管线失败会掩盖真实训练信号。
Method: 提出一个 meta-agent 管线，把失败分为 benchmark 无效性、harness 脆弱性、奖励错位三类；用 prompt redesign 与 context extension 改善基线可解率，并通过在不改训练配置的前提下加入难题来检验可解率区间是否随模型变化。
Result: prompt redesign 与 context extension 使基线可解率提升 5.6 倍；9B 模型在 Claude Opus 生成的任务上 20 步内 mean pass@2 达到 81.3% 后饱和；加入 hard tasks 后 mean pass@2 降至 20.6%，训练配置未变。
Conclusion: meta-agent 可靠性需要把可解率区间标定 (solvability-band calibration)、verifier 审计与基础设施错误核算当作一等评估标准，而非事后诊断。

papers.title: Trained Agentic Context Management
papers.abstract_en: We study long context language models. Instead of training long context natively, or designing a long context harness, we train a model over the simplest possible harness: a tool to call itself with any specified prompt and a tool to read tokens in a range from the input context. We finetune Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on a diverse synthetic dataset using this harness. With only 8,000 tokens of context, our small model is as strong as GPT-5.4 with 1M tokens of context on the OOLONG-synth benchmark when document length exceeds 40K tokens.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Code: https://github.com/brycesandlund/infinite-context. Under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 不原生长上下文训练，也不做复杂 harness，而是让模型学会用两个工具管理上下文：以任意 prompt 调用自身、按区间读取输入 token。在 OOLONG-synth 上，仅用 8,000 token 上下文微调的 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B，当文档长度超过 40K token 时与用 1M 上下文的 GPT-5.4 打平。
Motivation: 长上下文要么靠原生长窗口训练、要么靠外部 harness，成本高；本文要检验用极小上下文窗口加自调用/读取工具能否替代大窗口。
Method: 在最简 harness（自调用工具 + 按区间读输入 token 的工具）上对 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 做微调，训练数据为多样合成数据集，上下文仅 8,000 token。
Result: 在 OOLONG-synth 基准上，当文档长度超过 40K token 时，8,000 token 上下文的微调小模型与 1M token 上下文的 GPT-5.4 表现相当。
Conclusion: 上下文管理可以交给训练出来的工具调用能力，用极小窗口加自调用/读取工具即可在超长文档上匹配百万级上下文的强模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Energy Saving in 5G and Beyond Networks: A Quantum Reinforcement Learning Approach
papers.abstract_en: Energy saving has become a critical challenge in 5G and beyond networks. The rapid growth of connected devices has increased the overall network energy demand, driving operational expenditure to unsustainable heights. The Base Station (BS) accounts for the largest share of energy usage, typically consuming around 60-70\% of the Radio Access Network (RAN)'s total energy. Therefore, to address this issue, this article optimizes the BS's energy usage while accounting for the dynamic behavior of User Equipment (UE). Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) is a natural candidate for determining effective energy saving policies, such as automatically switching BSs on or off when user density is low or adjusting transmission power to balance energy efficiency and Quality of Service (QoS). However, its heavy training burden and the exponential growth of state and action spaces in dense 5G environments make exploration increasingly difficult. To overcome these limitations, we introduce a novel Quantum Reinforcement Learning (QRL) algorithm that leverages quantum principles, including superposition and entanglement, through parameterized quantum circuits, enabling significantly faster convergence than DRL, which relies on conventional deep neural networks. Extensive simulations demonstrate that the proposed QRL can substantially reduce energy consumption while maintaining QoS, even when UEs are highly dynamic and frequently switch their association with BS antennas. Additionally, QRL consistently outperforms DRL and Q-Learning in both convergence speed and learning complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 5G 基站 (BS) 能耗问题，提出基于参数化量子电路 (parameterized quantum circuits) 的量子强化学习 (QRL) 算法，利用叠加与纠缠在 UE 高度动态、频繁切换 BS 天线关联时仍能大幅降低能耗并维持 QoS。仿真中 QRL 在收敛速度与学习复杂度上持续优于 DRL 和 Q-Learning。
Motivation: 基站占 RAN 总能耗约 60-70%，密集 5G 环境中状态与动作空间指数增长、DRL 训练负担重，探索困难。
Method: 用参数化量子电路替代传统深度神经网络作为 QRL 的策略/值表示，借助量子叠加与 entanglement 加速探索；优化 BS 开关与发射功率，同时考虑 UE 动态行为与 QoS 约束。
Result: 仿真显示 QRL 在保持 QoS 前提下大幅降低能耗，即使 UE 高度动态并频繁切换与 BS 天线的关联；在收敛速度与学习复杂度两个维度上持续优于 DRL 与 Q-Learning。
Conclusion: 量子强化学习可缓解密集 5G 中 DRL 的训练负担与状态空间爆炸，在 UE 动态场景下实现节能与 QoS 的平衡。

papers.title: VisAudit: Evaluating Multimodal Agents for Visual Diagnosis and Repair
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal agents are increasingly used for data visualization tasks but remain limited in autonomous review. Unlike humans, they may fail to recognize when a visualization is incorrect, determine what to change, repair it without disrupting correct content, and verify whether the intervention succeeded. Existing benchmarks largely evaluate predefined individual capabilities such as chart generation, instruction-guided editing, or defect detection, and therefore do not capture this gap in autonomous review. We introduce VisAudit, a benchmark for evaluating visualization diagnosis, repair, and verification. Given a rendered chart and configurable auxiliary evidence, including its source data table, intended text summary, and visualization code, an agent iteratively diagnoses potential defects, modifies and executes visualization code, inspects execution and visual feedback, and determines when no further intervention is needed. VisAudit defines three tracks spanning diagnosed repair, autonomous repair, and open-world verification, and contains 1,900 flawed instances across 21 chart types and 10 flaw categories, together with 300 initially correct charts. We construct the benchmark through controlled perturbations of validated source visualizations, with systematic verification and human-aligned quality control to ensure that injected defects are well-defined and recoverable from the available evidence. Experiments with leading multimodal models reveal a substantial gap from reliable autonomous review: the strongest evaluated model fully recovers only $47.4\%$ of flawed charts in the autonomous-repair setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VisAudit 是评测多模态智能体对可视化图表做诊断、修复与验证的 benchmark：给定渲染图与源数据表、预期文本摘要、可视化代码等可配置证据，智能体迭代定位缺陷、修改并执行代码、检查执行与视觉反馈，再自行判断何时停止干预。含 1,900 个缺陷实例（21 种图表类型、10 类缺陷）与 300 张初始正确图表，分诊断修复、自主修复、开放世界验证三条赛道；最强被测模型在自主修复设定下仅完整修复 47.4% 的缺陷图表，显示自主审阅能力存在明显差距。
Motivation: 多模态智能体做数据可视化时缺乏自主审阅能力：识别不出图表何时出错、不知改什么、修复时可能破坏正确内容，也难判断干预是否成功；现有 benchmark 只测图表生成、指令编辑、缺陷检测等预定义单项能力，覆盖不到这一差距。
Method: 以受控扰动方式在已验证的源可视化上注入缺陷，经系统化核验与人工对齐的质量控制，保证缺陷定义明确且可由现有证据恢复；输入为渲染图表加可配置辅助证据（源数据表、预期文本摘要、可视化代码），智能体迭代诊断、修改并执行代码、检查执行与视觉反馈，自主决定何时停止干预；评测分 diagnosed repair、autonomous repair、open-world verification 三条赛道。
Result: benchmark 含 1,900 个缺陷实例、覆盖 21 种图表类型与 10 类缺陷，另有 300 张初始正确图表；在 leading multimodal models 上的实验中，最强被测模型在 autonomous-repair 设定下仅完整修复 47.4% 的缺陷图表。
Conclusion: 现有最强多模态模型距离可靠的可视化自主审阅仍有实质差距，自主修复是当前瓶颈；benchmark 通过受控扰动与质量控制使缺陷可从给定证据中恢复，从而可衡量这一能力。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Validated Data Onboarding for AI Demand Forecasting on U.S. Building Meter Data: Design, Controlled Evaluation, and a Corrected Negative Result
papers.abstract_en: Electric utilities and grid operators increasingly rely on machine-learning models to forecast next-day demand, and those models learn from meter data that is routinely defective: readings go missing, sensors freeze, buildings read zero for hours, and units change by a factor of 100. This report presents a data-onboarding pipeline that detects and repairs such defects before a model is trained, using only information available at forecast time, and a controlled experiment that measures whether the pipeline protects a 24-hour-ahead forecast. On hourly electricity data for twelve U.S. buildings from the public Building Data Genome 2 dataset (210,528 rows, 2016-2017), seeded, hash-logged defects touching 0.10% of the training period raised the error of a gradient-boosting forecaster by 86%; after detection and past-only repair the error returned to the clean-data level (mean absolute scaled error 0.760 clean, 1.415 corrupted, 0.729 repaired) while 93% of training targets were retained. At a defect prevalence calibrated to published field studies (1.6% of training rows) the unprotected forecaster's error reached 4.4 times that of a seasonal-naive rule, and the repaired forecaster again matched the clean baseline. The same pattern held for ridge regression and a random forest and across horizons of 1 to 24 hours. A first version of the pipeline over-cleaned natural data and made forecasts 25% worse; that result is retained, its cause is traced in the published artifacts, and the per-building calibration that corrects it is documented as a dated amendment. Every number is reproducible from pinned public inputs with SHA-256 verification, 84 automated tests and continuous integration.
papers.comment: Technical report; 8 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Code, data manifests, and reproducibility artifacts: https://github.com/LIANGYIXUAN3335/energy-data-onboarding-forecasting . Preprint; not peer reviewed
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对美国建筑电表数据的缺陷（缺读、传感器冻结、连续零值、单位差 100 倍），提出只用预报时刻可得信息的检测与 past-only 修复流水线，并用受控注入实验检验其对 24 小时负荷预报的保护作用。在 Building Data Genome 2 的 12 栋建筑（210,528 行，2016–2017）上，0.10% 训练期缺陷使梯度提升模型误差上升 86%，修复后 MASE 回到 0.729（干净 0.760、污染 1.415）且保留 93% 训练目标；缺陷率升到 1.6% 时未保护模型误差达季节朴素基线的 4.4 倍。
Motivation: 电力公司用 ML 做次日负荷预报，但训练用的电表数据普遍带缺陷，缺陷会直接放大预报误差，而修复又不能用到未来信息。
Method: 数据接入流水线在训练前检测并修复缺陷，只使用预报时刻可得信息、修复仅基于过去；受控实验对训练期注入带哈希日志的缺陷，用梯度提升、岭回归、随机森林三种模型在 1–24 小时多种预报步长上对照，并保留首版过度清洗导致变差的结果与按建筑校准的修订。
Result: 0.10% 注入缺陷使梯度提升预报误差上升 86%，修复后 MASE 0.729（干净 0.760、污染 1.415），保留 93% 训练目标；缺陷率 1.6%（对标已发表现场研究）时未保护模型误差为季节朴素规则的 4.4 倍，修复后再次匹配干净基线；同一模式在岭回归、随机森林及 1–24 小时各步长上成立；首版流水线过度清洗使预报变差 25%。
Conclusion: 只用过去信息的缺陷修复能在不泄漏未来的前提下把被污染的负荷预报恢复到干净数据水平，但清洗强度必须按建筑校准，否则会把自然数据洗坏。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.tldr: 针对美国建筑电表数据的缺陷（缺读、传感器冻结、连续零值、单位差 100 倍），提出只用预报时刻可得信息的检测与 past-only 修复流水线，并用受控注入实验检验其对 24 小时负荷预报的保护作用。在 Building Data Genome 2 的 12 栋建筑（210,528 行，2016–2017）上，0.10% 训练期缺陷使梯度提升模型误差上升 86%，修复后 MASE 回到 0.729（干净 0.760、污染 1.415）且保留 93% 训练目标；缺陷率升到 1.6% 时未保护模型误差达季节朴素基线的 4.4 倍。
summary_sections.motivation: 电力公司用 ML 做次日负荷预报，但训练用的电表数据普遍带缺陷，缺陷会直接放大预报误差，而修复又不能用到未来信息。
summary_sections.method: 数据接入流水线在训练前检测并修复缺陷，只使用预报时刻可得信息、修复仅基于过去；受控实验对训练期注入带哈希日志的缺陷，用梯度提升、岭回归、随机森林三种模型在 1–24 小时多种预报步长上对照，并保留首版过度清洗导致变差的结果与按建筑校准的修订。

papers.title: Inherit-MAS: Test-Time Evolution of Multi-Agent Systems through Workflow and Execution Inheritance
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems (MAS) built from large language models coordinate specialized agents to tackle complex tasks, but effective workflows are difficult to design in advance. Test-time evolution refines workflows using execution feedback, yet broad revisions can disturb useful components, while re-executing unchanged requests can incur redundant computation. Inspired by the interplay of inheritance and selection in biological evolution, we introduce Inherit-MAS, which makes inheritance explicit at the workflow and execution levels. A meta-model first synthesizes a workflow of worker agents with declared roles, communication inputs, and tool permissions, and a separately prompted judge scores each executed candidate and diagnoses its deficiencies. In ordinary refinement rounds, \emph{workflow inheritance} starts from the latest completed candidate, may discard removable nodes judged unhelpful, and applies a validated edit to address the diagnosed deficiency. When the new candidate executes, \emph{execution inheritance} inherits eligible stored results only if the complete resolved request and execution context match, avoiding redundant model and tool calls. With GPT-4o-mini workers, Inherit-MAS achieves 55.4\% completion on WorkBench and 49.7\% joint F1 on HotpotQA FullWiki, outperforming EvoAgent, EvoMAS, and TacoMAS. With Qwen3-32B workers, it also exceeds these evolving-MAS baselines on both benchmarks. Compared with rerunning the same controller with execution inheritance disabled, execution inheritance reduces worker-token usage by 29.1\% on WorkBench and 34.6\% on HotpotQA, and total token usage by 5.3\% and 18.1\%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Inherit-MAS 把生物进化中的继承与选择显式搬进多智能体系统 (MAS) 的测试时演化：工作流继承从最近完成的候选出发、按 judge 诊断删掉无用节点并施加一次已验证的编辑，执行继承只在完整解析请求与执行上下文都匹配时复用已存结果，从而避免重复的模型与工具调用。GPT-4o-mini 下在 WorkBench 达 55.4% completion、HotpotQA FullWiki 达 49.7% joint F1，超过 EvoAgent、EvoMAS、TacoMAS；关掉执行继承后 token 消耗在 WorkBench/HotpotQA 上分别多出 29.1%/34.6%（worker-token）与 5.3%/18.1%（总 token）。
Motivation: 用执行反馈演化 LLM 多智能体工作流时，大范围改写会破坏本来有效的组件，而不变请求的重复执行又带来冗余计算，工作流难以事先设计好。
Method: meta-model 先合成带角色声明、通信输入与工具权限的 worker 工作流，独立 prompt 的 judge 对每个执行候选打分并诊断缺陷；普通精炼轮做工作流继承（基于最近完成候选、可丢弃被判无用的节点、施加一次已验证编辑），执行时做执行继承（仅当完整解析请求与执行上下文匹配才复用已存结果）。
Result: GPT-4o-mini workers 下 WorkBench completion 55.4%、HotpotQA FullWiki joint F1 49.7%，优于 EvoAgent、EvoMAS、TacoMAS；Qwen3-32B workers 下在这两个基准上同样超过这些 evolving-MAS 基线。与关闭执行继承相比，执行继承使 WorkBench 与 HotpotQA 的 worker-token 用量分别下降 29.1% 与 34.6%，总 token 用量分别下降 5.3% 与 18.1%。
Conclusion: 把继承拆成工作流层与执行层两个显式机制，可以在不牺牲基准表现的前提下削减重复执行开销，token 节省在 HotpotQA 上明显大于 WorkBench。

papers.title: FlashSinkhorn 2: Block-Sparse Entropic Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: Streaming GPU solvers for entropic optimal transport (EOT), such as FlashSinkhorn, avoid storing the dense kernel but still evaluate all $n\times m$ point pairs in every Sinkhorn iteration. We present \textbf{FlashSinkhorn~2} (FS2), a solver for squared-Euclidean cost on low-dimensional point clouds that solves large discrete EOT problems to a prescribed marginal residual on a single GPU by coupling two stages. A coarse stage solves on cell centroids, lifts the potentials to every point and, when a sampled marginal check rejects the lift, continues on the centroids, replacing most point-level updates. A block-sparse fine stage then removes the centroid error that coarse updates cannot. Its Morton-ordered blocks support screening and fused tensor-core execution, and a threshold set by the block masses bounds each omitted tile's contribution to every row and column. On synthetic benchmarks, FS2 reaches the target residual on all 32 problems and GeomLoss multiscale on 10. On one A100, FS2 solves discrete EOT between two $1.34\times10^8$-particle measures from a cosmological $N$-body simulation, at an entropic blur equal to the mean interparticle distance, to an all-particle marginal residual below 0.01 in under 2.5 hours. To our knowledge, it is the largest discrete EOT problem solved to this accuracy within hours. For reproducibility, we release an open-source implementation at https://github.com/ot-triton-lab/flash-sinkhorn
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlashSinkhorn 2 (FS2) 用「粗阶段在 cell centroid 上解并把势函数提升到全体点、采样边际检查拒绝提升则继续在 centroid 上迭代」加「Morton 序 block-sparse 细阶段」两级耦合，在单张 A100 上把大规模离散熵正则最优传输 (EOT) 解到指定边际残差。合成基准 32 题全部达标（GeomLoss multiscale 10 题），并把宇宙学 N-body 两组各 1.34×10^8 粒子的测度在模糊半径等于平均粒子间距下解到全粒子边际残差低于 0.01，用时不到 2.5 小时。
Motivation: 现有流式 GPU Sinkhorn 求解器虽不存稠密核，但每次迭代仍要评估全部 n×m 点对，大规模离散 EOT 在单卡上算不动。
Method: 两级耦合：粗阶段在 cell centroid 上求解，把势函数提升到每个点，采样边际检查若拒绝提升则回到 centroid 继续，替换掉大部分点级更新；细阶段用 Morton 序 block-sparse 块做 screening 与 tensor-core 融合执行，块质量阈值给出被省略 tile 对每行每列贡献的上界，用于消除粗阶段无法消除的 centroid 误差。目标为平方欧氏代价、低维点云。
Result: 合成基准上 FS2 在全部 32 个问题达到目标残差，GeomLoss multiscale 达到 10 个；单张 A100 上解宇宙学 N-body 模拟两组 1.34×10^8 粒子测度间的离散 EOT，熵模糊等于平均粒子间距，全粒子边际残差低于 0.01，用时不到 2.5 小时。
Conclusion: 作者称据其所知这是在数小时内解到该精度的最大离散 EOT 问题，并开源实现于 github.com/ot-triton-lab/flash-sinkhorn。

papers.title: Hesitation Has a Geometry: Entropy-Trained Hyperbolic Probes for Sparse Activation Steering
papers.abstract_en: When a large language model solves a mathematical problem, its reasoning is largely hierarchical, and the solution often branches at a few tokens where the next-token entropy is high. Such tree-like structure embeds in hyperbolic space with far lower distortion than in Euclidean space. Activation steering, however, usually edits the hidden states of a pretrained model by adding one fixed Euclidean vector at every token, even though most tokens of a solution are already determined by the context. We propose Hyperbolic Entropy Steering (HEST), which embeds the hidden states in the Poincaré ball with a lightweight probe whose only label is the model's own next-token entropy. Where this entropy exceeds a threshold, HEST moves the embedded state along the geodesic of steepest descent of a readout of the probe and maps the change back to the hidden state. For the Busemann readout of a learned ideal point, we prove that a step of fixed length lowers it by the same amount at every state. On three instruction-tuned models from the Qwen2.5-Math and Llama-3.1 families, HEST with the Busemann readout improves greedy accuracy on MATH-500 and GSM8K in five of six settings, by up to 1.8 points, whereas a contrastive steering vector added at every token lowers accuracy. With a Euclidean probe trained in the same way, this gain disappears on Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct. The gains are largest on problems where the model hesitates often, and accuracy on the remaining problems is almost unchanged.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HEST (Hyperbolic Entropy Steering) 用以 next-token 熵为唯一标签的轻量探针把 LLM 隐状态嵌入 Poincaré 球，只在熵超过阈值的分叉 token 上沿探针读出的最陡下降测地线移动状态并映射回隐空间。在 Qwen2.5-Math 与 Llama-3.1 三个指令微调模型的六种设置中，Busemann 读出在五种设置上把 MATH-500 与 GSM8K 贪心精度最多提高 1.8 个点，而逐 token 加固定对比 steering 向量反而降精度。
Motivation: 数学推理的解在少数高熵 token 上分叉、呈树状层级，但常规 activation steering 在每个 token 上加同一个固定欧氏向量，对已被上下文决定的多数 token 属于无效干预。
Method: HEST 用只以模型自身 next-token 熵为标签的轻量探针，把隐状态嵌入 Poincaré 球；熵超阈值时沿探针读出的最陡下降测地线走固定步长，再映射回隐空间。对学习到的理想点的 Busemann 读出，作者证明固定长度一步在任意状态上使其下降相同幅度。
Result: 在 Qwen2.5-Math 与 Llama-3.1 家族三个指令微调模型上，Busemann 读出的 HEST 在六种设置中的五种提升 MATH-500 与 GSM8K 贪心精度，最高 +1.8 个点；对比 steering 向量逐 token 加入会降低精度。同样方式训练的欧氏探针在 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct 上增益消失。增益集中在模型频繁犹豫的题目上，其余题目精度几乎不变。
Conclusion: 把干预门控在高熵分叉 token 并在双曲几何中沿测地线移动，比逐 token 固定向量的欧氏 steering 更能提升数学推理精度；几何与熵门控缺一不可。

papers.title: Octrees as an Explicit 3D Language
papers.abstract_en: Existing 3D large language models (LLMs) compromise on two fronts: they compress shapes into latent codebook indices or coordinate text, which removes spatial structure from what the model observes, and they acquire the 3D modality by fine-tuning the backbone, which overwrites its general language ability. We present OctLLM, which addresses both limitations. Geometry enters as an explicit 3D sequence of octree occupancy tokens. However, full octree sequences grow rapidly with depth; OctLLM therefore randomly empties penultimate-level nodes and omits descendants while preserving shape, yielding a shorter coordinate- and depth-anchored Sparse Octree (S-Octree) for position-aware mask-modeling generation and 3D understanding. On the other front, existing methods introduce a new modality with full fine-tuning or LoRA, but full fine-tuning is costly, LoRA limits 3D capacity, and both modify the language pathway. OctLLM instead adds 3D capacity in parameters separate from the pretrained ones: mesh tokens are routed through independent trainable branches in a subset of blocks while text and image tokens retain the frozen vision-language pathway, and the two streams interact through shared self-attention. It trains far fewer parameters than full fine-tuning, yet sets a new state of the art among unified multimodal LLMs, lowering image-to-3D FID by $17.4\%$ and raising render-grounded captioning by $28.7$ points over ShapeLLM-Omni, while matching the backbone on general language benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OctLLM 把几何以八叉树占据 token 的显式 3D 序列喂给 LLM，并用随机清空倒数第二层节点、省略其后代的 Sparse Octree (S-Octree) 压短序列，做位置感知的掩码建模生成与 3D 理解。3D 能力走与预训练参数分离的独立分支（部分 block 中 mesh token 走可训练分支，文本与图像保留冻结的视觉-语言通路，两流通过共享 self-attention 交互），在图像到 3D 上把 FID 降低 17.4%、render-grounded captioning 比 ShapeLLM-Omni 高 28.7 点，同时在通用语言基准上与 backbone 持平。
Motivation: 现有 3D LLM 两头妥协：把形状压成 latent codebook 索引或坐标文本，丢掉了模型可见的空间结构；又靠微调 backbone 引入 3D 模态，覆写了通用语言能力。
Method: 几何以八叉树占据 token 构成显式 3D 序列；S-Octree 随机清空倒数第二层节点并省略其后代（保持形状），得到坐标与深度锚定的更短序列，用于位置感知的掩码建模生成与 3D 理解。3D 容量加在与预训练参数分离的独立分支上：mesh token 在部分 block 中走独立可训练分支，文本与图像 token 保留冻结的视觉-语言通路，两流通过共享 self-attention 交互；训练参数远少于全量微调。
Result: 在统一多模态 LLM 中达到新的 state of the art：image-to-3D FID 相对 ShapeLLM-Omni 降低 17.4%，render-grounded captioning 提升 28.7 点，同时在通用语言基准上与 backbone 持平。
Conclusion: 显式 3D 序列加参数隔离的分支可以在不牺牲通用语言能力的前提下引入 3D 模态，且比全量微调训练参数更少；对比对象是全量微调与 LoRA（后者限制 3D 容量）。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: The Surprising Effectiveness of Shared Memory in Looped Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Looped Transformers apply the same layers several times per token, adding compute to improve quality without more parameters. Each recursion, however, writes its own key-value cache, so memory still grows with compute. Inference-time techniques can shrink this cache at a cost in quality. We pretrain looped language models to share memory: only the first recursion writes a cache, and later recursions read it while keeping a short window of their own. Surprisingly, we find that sharing memory does not cost quality and instead improves it. At 150M-1B parameters, our Looped Prediction Transformer (LPT) and its hybrid variant set a new quality-memory frontier for looped models: with five recursions, the hybrid lowers validation perplexity on FineWeb-Edu by 1.12-1.82 relative to a same-size standard Transformer while using 76-79% less context memory. Through an extensive analysis, we investigate why memory sharing helps. Shared and local memory develop different representations, and later recursions attend mostly to the shared memory, which also acts as a gradient highway to the first recursion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 预训练循环 Transformer (looped transformer) 让各次递归共享 KV cache：只有第一次递归写入缓存，后续递归读取它并保留自己的短窗口。在 150M–1B 参数规模上，五次递归的 LPT 混合变体相对同规模标准 Transformer 把 FineWeb-Edu 验证困惑度再降 1.12–1.82，同时上下文内存少用 76–79%。
Motivation: 循环 Transformer 用重复层数换质量而不加参数，但每次递归都写自己的 key-value cache，内存随计算量增长；推理期压缩缓存的做法要以质量为代价。
Method: 提出 Looped Prediction Transformer (LPT) 及其 hybrid 变体的预训练方案：仅第一次递归写 cache，后续递归读共享 cache 并保留短的本地窗口；训练在 150M–1B 参数规模上进行，并对共享与本地记忆的表征差异及梯度通路做分析。
Result: 五次递归下，hybrid 变体相对同规模标准 Transformer 在 FineWeb-Edu 上验证困惑度降低 1.12–1.82，上下文内存减少 76–79%；分析显示共享与本地记忆形成不同表征，后续递归主要注意共享记忆，且共享记忆充当通往第一次递归的 gradient highway。
Conclusion: 共享记忆在循环 Transformer 中不损失质量反而提升质量，并建立循环模型新的质量-内存前沿；其收益来自共享记忆的独立表征与梯度通路。

papers.title: FactorSplat: Appearance-Controllable Gaussian Proxies for Medical Volume Rendering
papers.abstract_en: Transfer functions (TFs) control color and visibility in medical volume rendering, but image-trained Gaussian proxies typically bake one transfer function into their appearance. We present FactorSplat, a per-scene N-dimensional Gaussian splatting (N-DGS) proxy that accepts region-specific intensity-to-RGBA curves at inference. A local lookup applies the authored color and opacity change, while a shared functional encoder and low-rank per-Gaussian factors learn the residual appearance response. Geometry and directional appearance remain shared across presets, with visibility control and TF-aware pruning preserving the ability to hide and reveal structures. On seven CT and MR scans, FactorSplat improves mean PSNR and changed-region error over region-aware VEG across validation, interpolation, unseen composition, and out-of-distribution (OOD) edits. Across these four splits, seven-scan mean PSNR gains over VEG range from 1.10 to 1.52 dB. One checkpoint per scan supports unseen edits without retraining. At $1600^2$, the cached fast renderer averages 524 FPS with 1.17 ms TF switches. Project page: https://gaozhongpai.github.io/FactorSplat/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FactorSplat 把传输函数 (TF) 从医学体渲染的 Gaussian proxy 中解耦：推理时可输入区域级 intensity-to-RGBA 曲线，用局部查表施加颜色与不透明度改动，再由共享 functional encoder 与逐 Gaussian 低秩因子学习残差外观响应。在七个 CT/MR 扫描上，四个划分（验证、插值、未见组合、OOD 编辑）的七扫描平均 PSNR 相对 region-aware VEG 提升 1.10–1.52 dB，单检查点支持未见编辑免重训，1600² 下缓存快速渲染器平均 524 FPS、TF 切换 1.17 ms。
Motivation: 医学体渲染中传输函数控制颜色与可见性，但图像训练出的 Gaussian proxy 通常把单一 TF 烧进外观，改 TF 就得重训，无法在推理时按区域交互式改色、隐藏或显示结构。
Method: 提出 per-scene N 维 Gaussian splatting (N-DGS) proxy：推理时接收区域级 intensity-to-RGBA 曲线，局部查表施加作者指定的颜色/不透明度变化，共享 functional encoder 加逐 Gaussian 低秩 (low-rank) 因子学习残差外观响应；几何与方向性外观跨 preset 共享，并用可见性控制与 TF-aware pruning 保留隐藏/显示结构的能力。
Result: 在七个 CT 与 MR 扫描上，相对 region-aware VEG，FactorSplat 在验证、插值、未见组合、OOD 编辑四个划分上均改善 mean PSNR 与 changed-region error；四个划分的七扫描平均 PSNR 增益为 1.10 至 1.52 dB。每扫描单检查点支持未见编辑且无需重训；在 1600² 分辨率下缓存快速渲染器平均 524 FPS，TF 切换耗时 1.17 ms。
Conclusion: 把 TF 作为推理期输入、只对残差外观做低秩建模，可在不重训的前提下实现外观可控且快速切换的医学体渲染。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Latent-MOPD: Latent Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on the responses it generates. Existing LLM multi-teacher OPD transfers what specialists predict through their output distributions. We introduce Latent-MOPD, to our knowledge the first representation-level multi-teacher OPD method for LLMs. It integrates existing specialists through both their predictions and the hidden states used to compute them, without additional teacher training. To coordinate representation supervision from multiple specialists, we select late-layer targets according to the teacher-student relationship, bridge unequal hidden widths with a shared projection, and group updates by domain. Each teacher's supervision gradually shifts from hidden states to token predictions, with both channels using the same routed specialist. In our main same-family setting, Latent-MOPD outperforms the token-only, representation-only and uniform-averaging baselines on all nine benchmarks across math, code and logic. With the same parameter count as each teacher, the student also surpasses the per-benchmark best teacher on a majority of these benchmarks. With larger, separately developed cross-family teachers, Latent-MOPD outperforms both single-channel baselines on all benchmarks. A same-family all-layer representation-only control remains stable with domain-pure updates but collapses when teacher domains are interleaved within an update. Our results show that a single student can integrate capabilities from several specialists through both their output distributions and internal representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Latent-MOPD 是首个面向 LLM 的表示级多教师 on-policy distillation：除输出分布外还直接蒸馏教师计算预测所用的 hidden states，按师生关系选 late-layer 目标、用共享投影对齐不同 hidden width、按 domain 分组更新，且每个教师的监督从 hidden states 逐步转向 token 预测。在 math、code、logic 共九个 benchmark 上，同族设定中同时超过 token-only、representation-only 与均匀平均基线，学生以与单个教师相同的参数量在多数 benchmark 上超过逐项最强教师；跨族更大教师时在全部 benchmark 上超过两个单通道基线。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 多教师 OPD 只迁移教师输出分布所预测的内容，丢掉了产生这些预测的内部表示；而直接做表示蒸馏又面临多教师 hidden states 难以协调的问题。
Method: Latent-MOPD 同时利用教师的预测与 hidden states，无需额外教师训练：按 teacher-student 关系选择 late-layer 监督目标，用共享 projection 桥接不等的 hidden width，按 domain 分组更新；每个教师的监督权重从 hidden states 逐渐转移到 token 预测，两条通道使用同一个 routed specialist。
Result: 同族主设定下，在 math、code、logic 的全部九个 benchmark 上优于 token-only、representation-only 与 uniform-averaging 基线；学生参数量与单个教师相同，却在多数 benchmark 上超过逐 benchmark 最强教师。换用更大的异构开发的跨族教师时，在全部 benchmark 上超过两个单通道基线。同族 all-layer representation-only 对照在 domain-pure 更新下保持稳定，但当教师 domain 在同一次更新内交错时崩溃。
Conclusion: 单个学生可以同时通过输出分布与内部表示整合多个专家的能力，而多教师表示监督必须按 domain 分组更新，否则交错更新会导致训练崩溃。

papers.title: THPL: A Vision-to-Language Decision Support Framework for Rainbow Trout Feeding Management in RAS
papers.abstract_en: In Recirculating Aquaculture Systems (RAS), precision feeding is critical for minimizing costs and improving fish welfare. However, existing methods lack cognitive alignment between fish behaviors and management knowledge, impeding translation into executable, interpretable feeding decisions. To address this, we propose THPL, a generative feeding decision framework tailored for rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) in RAS. First, Fishsort extracts trajectories to establish an Activity Coefficient (AC) quantifying feeding intensity. Second, a Hierarchical Behavior Encoder (HBE) models individual temporal progression and collective dynamics using Temporal and Set Transformers, transforming trajectory tensors into dual-evidence representations of explicit physical and implicit soft tokens. Finally, these tokens are integrated with environmental parameters, metadata, and expert rules to fine-tune an LLM via LoRA, followed by counterfactual multimodal Direct Preference Optimization (mDPO) to reinforce causal reasoning. Results show that AC exhibits a statistically significant monotonic positive correlation with expert-annotated feeding intensity (Spearman $ρ= 0.925$, $p < 0.001$). Ablations indicate that decision accuracy improves from 33.33% (text-only baseline) to 93.33% with dual-evidence tokens, confirming that continuous spatiotemporal tokens provide necessary physical grounding for LLMs. Compared with standard LoRA, counterfactual mDPO elevates decision accuracy from 93.33% to 96.67%, advances METEOR from 58.10% to 85.30%, reduces Self-BLEU-2 from 58.79% to 52.88%, and increases Distinct-3 from 6.68% to 7.81%, suppressing templating and actuation biases while reinforcing causal consistency and operational safety. Overall, by integrating continuous kinematics with LLM reasoning, this study provides a novel decision support paradigm for precision aquaculture.
papers.comment: Meng Liang and Guanbo Feng contributed equally. Corresponding authors: Zhihong Ma and Ying Liu. 50 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables. Supplementary video: https://youtu.be/Tg2Qk7m46-A
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: THPL 把 RAS 循环水养殖中虹鳟的轨迹与环境信息转成可被 LLM 消费的双证据 token，再用 LoRA 微调加反事实 mDPO 输出投喂决策。活动系数 AC 与专家标注投喂强度 Spearman ρ=0.925（p<0.001），决策准确率从纯文本基线 33.33% 升到 93.33%，加反事实 mDPO 后到 96.67%。
Motivation: RAS 精准投喂中，鱼类行为与管理知识之间缺少认知对齐，已有方法难以把行为观察转成可执行、可解释的投喂决策。
Method: Fishsort 先从视频提取轨迹并计算活动系数 (Activity Coefficient, AC)；Hierarchical Behavior Encoder (HBE) 用 Temporal Transformer 与 Set Transformer 分别建模个体时序与群体动态，把轨迹张量转成显式物理与隐式软两类 token；这些 token 与环境参数、元数据、专家规则一起经 LoRA 微调 LLM，再用反事实多模态 Direct Preference Optimization (mDPO) 强化因果推理。
Result: AC 与专家标注投喂强度呈单调正相关，Spearman ρ=0.925、p<0.001。消融显示决策准确率从纯文本基线 33.33% 提到双证据 token 的 93.33%；相对标准 LoRA，反事实 mDPO 把准确率 93.33%→96.67%，METEOR 58.10%→85.30%，Self-BLEU-2 58.79%→52.88%，Distinct-3 6.68%→7.81%。
Conclusion: 连续运动学 token 为 LLM 决策提供必要的物理锚定，叠加反事实 mDPO 可抑制模板化与执行偏差、提升因果一致性与操作安全性，构成精准水产的决策支持范式。

papers.title: Flow Matching for Fast Posterior Sampling in Bayesian Inverse Problems
papers.abstract_en: Sampling from the posterior is the central task of computational Bayesian inverse problems. The standard workhorse in Bayesian inference - Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) - is sequential, yields correlated samples, and must be rerun for each observation. Conditional flow matching offers an amortized alternative: a transport map, trained once on joint samples of parameter and data, that yields independent approximate posterior samples for any observation at negligible online cost, without new likelihood evaluations. We give a careful, MCMC-literate assessment of flow matching for PDE-based inverse problems with function-valued parameters. Exploiting the flow's tractable density, we derive computable accuracy estimates of the underlying approximate posterior in total-variation distance and Kullback-Leibler divergence and, moreover, propose a hybrid sampler that is asymptotically exact by Metropolization. We validate the accuracy estimates and demonstrate the amortization in several numerical examples, including electrical impedance tomography and a likelihood-free Lotka-Volterra model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 PDE 型贝叶斯反问题的后验采样，用 conditional flow matching 训练一次传输映射，替代逐次重跑的 MCMC，实现任意观测下的免似然评估摊销采样。借助 flow 的可解析密度推导全变差与 KL 距离的可计算精度估计，并提出经 Metropolization 后渐近精确的混合采样器；在电阻抗断层成像 (EIT) 与无似然 Lotka-Volterra 模型等数值例子中验证精度估计并展示摊销效果。
Motivation: MCMC 是贝叶斯反问题后验采样的主力，但串行、样本相关，且每换一次观测都要重跑、反复调用似然；对函数值参数的 PDE 反问题代价尤其高。
Method: 用 conditional flow matching 在参数与数据的联合样本上训练一次传输映射，得到可解析的 flow 密度；据此推导近似后验在全变差距离与 KL 散度上的可计算精度估计，再提出经 Metropolization 校正而渐近精确的混合采样器。
Result: 在多个数值例子中验证了精度估计本身，并展示了对任意观测的摊销采样，例子包括电阻抗断层成像 (EIT) 和无似然 (likelihood-free) Lotka-Volterra 模型。
Conclusion: flow matching 可作为 MCMC 的摊销替代：一次训练、在线零似然评估即可给出独立近似后验样本，而可解析密度带来的精度估计加 Metropolization 能把近似后验校正到渐近精确。

papers.title: Coco: An Agentic Copilot for the Hardware--Software Co-Design Lifecycle
papers.abstract_en: Co-designing ML models and the accelerators that run them is an unusual reasoning task: architects must draw confident, high-stakes conclusions about systems that do not yet exist, and the pace of both model evolution and hardware cadence means the analysis burden grows every quarter. The evidence behind each decision--hundreds of gigabytes of fresh simulation sweeps over novel design points--is by construction absent from any LLM's pretraining corpus, and there is no external literature to retrieve; naive "chat-with-your-data" approaches hallucinate exactly where correctness matters most. We present Coco (Copilot for Codesign), an agentic platform deployed with TPU architects that accelerates the co-design lifecycle of setting up experiments, sweeping simulators, and deriving insights. Coco is built as four layers: (i) a datastore that automatically registers every simulation sweep into a normalized relational schema, so agents ground every number in a SQL query rather than scraping heterogeneous files; (ii) a library of tools with typed APIs that agents compose without human orchestration; (iii) agents that encode recurring analysis workflows--most notably iso-execution analysis, which compares systems at matched execution configurations, including swept-but-dominated points off the Pareto frontier; and (iv) a platform UX whose navigation state doubles as agent context. We report early deployment experience toward a reduction in time-to-simulation and time-to-insight, and argue that co-design is a distinct agentic domain: its data must be retrieved rather than memorized, its workflows are recurring but context-dependent, and expert adoption hinges on UX that balances IDE-style control with interactive exploration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Coco 是面向 ML 模型与加速器协同设计 (co-design) 生命周期的 agentic copilot，已与 TPU 架构师团队部署。它把每次仿真扫描 (simulation sweep) 自动注册进规范化关系型 schema，让 agent 用 SQL 落实每个数字，再由带类型 API 的工具库与编码固定分析工作流（尤其是 iso-execution analysis，含 Pareto 前沿之外被支配的扫描点）组合执行，导航状态同时充当 agent 上下文。作者主张协同设计是一个独立的 agentic 领域：其数据必须检索而非记忆，工作流反复出现但依赖上下文，专家采用取决于 IDE 式控制与交互探索平衡的 UX。
Motivation: 协同设计要对尚不存在的系统下高风险结论，支撑决策的证据是数百 GB 的新仿真扫描，按构造不在任何 LLM 预训练语料中，也没有外部文献可检索，朴素的 chat-with-your-data 方案恰好在最需要正确性的地方产生幻觉。
Method: 四层架构：自动把每次仿真扫描登记进规范化关系 schema 的 datastore；agent 无需人工编排即可组合的带类型 API 工具库；编码反复出现的分析工作流的 agents，核心是 iso-execution analysis（在匹配执行配置下比较系统，纳入 Pareto 前沿之外被支配的扫描点）；以及导航状态兼作 agent 上下文的平台 UX。
Result: 报告了与 TPU 架构师团队的早期部署经验，方向是缩短 time-to-simulation 与 time-to-insight；摘要给出的量化证据是每个决策背后的仿真扫描达数百 GB 量级。
Conclusion: 协同设计应被当作独立的 agentic 领域来做：数据靠检索而非预训练记忆，工作流反复但依赖上下文，专家是否采用取决于 IDE 式控制与交互探索相平衡的 UX。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: EviDent-CBCT: Evidence-Bottlenecked Report Generation from Dental CBCT under Non-Exhaustive Report Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Dento-maxillofacial cone-beam CT (CBCT) reports may contain dozens of tooth-specific, anatomical, and spatial findings from a single 3D scan. Learning to generate such reports from limited clinical data is challenging because routine reports may not exhaustively document image findings, and a non-mention may reflect either absence or non-reporting. We present EviDent-CBCT, an evidence-bottlenecked framework designed for this incomplete supervision. An anatomy-aware network maps each CBCT scan to a discrete record of tooth-level, global, and tooth-IAC evidence. A dental-logic consistency projection reconciles incompatible evidence before a deterministic renderer and an image-blind local language model generate the report using only this record. For tooth-level evidence, reliability-aware training uses eligible non-mentions as reduced-weight negatives, while unreported global and tooth-IAC labels remain unknown. A metal-sensitive input channel preserves intensity cues from dental materials. Across three validation runs, EviDent-CBCT achieves $0.666\pm0.006$ merged evidence set-F1 and $0.402\pm0.003$ RadFact-Lite-Dental logical-F1, versus $0.371\pm0.018$ for the strongest controlled direct baseline. In the ODIN 2026 challenge, it ranked second in automated evaluation and third in blinded clinical Arena comparison on the hidden test set. These results support the discrete evidence record as an effective and auditable interface for CBCT report generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 EviDent-CBCT：用证据瓶颈把牙科 CBCT 报告生成拆成解剖感知的离散证据记录、牙科逻辑一致性投影与确定性渲染器加 image-blind 局部语言模型，在非穷尽报告监督下把未提及当作降权负例而非阴性。三次验证运行中 merged evidence set-F1 达 0.666±0.006、RadFact-Lite-Dental logical-F1 达 0.402±0.003，对照最强受控直接生成基线的 0.371±0.018。
Motivation: 常规 CBCT 报告不穷尽记录影像所见，未提及既可能是真阴性也可能是漏报，直接在这样的不完整监督上训练报告生成模型会把漏报学成阴性。
Method: 解剖感知网络把每份 CBCT 映射为牙位级、全局与牙位-IAC 三类离散证据；牙科逻辑一致性投影先调和互斥证据，再由确定性渲染器与只读该记录的 image-blind 局部语言模型成文。牙位级证据用 reliability-aware training，把合格的非提及当作降权负例，全局与牙位-IAC 标签保持未知；另加金属敏感输入通道保留牙科材料的强度线索。
Result: 三次验证运行：merged evidence set-F1 0.666±0.006，RadFact-Lite-Dental logical-F1 0.402±0.003，最强受控直接基线为 0.371±0.018。在 ODIN 2026 挑战赛隐藏测试集上，自动评测排名第二，盲法临床 Arena 对比排名第三。
Conclusion: 离散证据记录可作为 CBCT 报告生成的有效且可审计的接口，前提是用可靠性加权区分真阴性与漏报。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Hop-Decayed Influence: New Vulnerabilities of Structural Auxiliary Indexing in GraphRAG Pipelines with LLM
papers.abstract_en: GraphRAG pipelines construct auxiliary structures during offline indexing--semantic summaries, hierarchical edges, and pre-computed scores--that determine how retrieval is prioritised at query time. Prior attacks target only instance-level components (nodes, edges, triples), overlooking these schema-level structures. We formalise Auxiliary Schema-Level Entity as a novel attack surface and propose the 3S Framework (Semantics, Structure, Scoring) for its systematic exploitation. Our Hop-Decayed Influence (HDI) attack identifies high-impact targets through query-aware influence propagation and corrupts their auxiliary structures post-indexing. Across two benchmarks (HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA) and two architectures (Microsoft GraphRAG, HippoRAG2), HDI achieves 88-94% attack success rate while modifying as few as 0.016% of auxiliary structures. Each modification affects up to 6.00 queries (Schema Leverage Ratio), demonstrating 1:N amplification unavailable to instance-level attacks. Manipulated structures evade perplexity and paraphrase defenses with over 99% evasion rate, as they remain linguistically coherent system-generated artifacts. These results reveal that auxiliary schema-level entities receive implicit trust without runtime validation, constituting a structural blind spot in current GraphRAG defenses. https://github.com/Jisung-Pacific/HDI-GraphRAG-Attack.
papers.comment: 14 pages. Published in IFIP SEC 2026. Best Paper Award
papers.journal_ref: ICT Systems Security and Privacy Protection (SEC 2026), IFIP Advances in Information and Communication Technology, vol. 787, pp. 345-358, Springer (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 GraphRAG 离线索引期生成的 schema 级辅助结构（语义摘要、层级边、预计算分数），提出 3S 框架与 Hop-Decayed Influence (HDI) 攻击：用查询感知的影响力传播定位高影响目标，索引后篡改其辅助结构。在 HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA 与 Microsoft GraphRAG、HippoRAG2 上攻击成功率 88–94%，仅改动 0.016% 辅助结构，且对困惑度与改写防御的规避率超过 99%。
Motivation: 既有 GraphRAG 攻击只针对实例级组件（节点、边、三元组），忽略索引期生成、查询时决定检索优先级的 schema 级结构；这些结构缺乏运行时校验，形成防御盲区。
Method: 将 Auxiliary Schema-Level Entity 形式化为新攻击面，提出 3S 框架（Semantics、Structure、Scoring）；HDI 攻击通过 query-aware influence propagation 识别高影响目标，并在索引完成后篡改其辅助结构。
Result: 在 HotpotQA 与 2WikiMultiHopQA 两个基准、Microsoft GraphRAG 与 HippoRAG2 两种架构上，HDI 攻击成功率 88–94%，仅修改低至 0.016% 的辅助结构；单次修改最多影响 6.00 条查询（Schema Leverage Ratio），呈现 1:N 放大；对 perplexity 与 paraphrase 防御规避率超过 99%。
Conclusion: GraphRAG 的 schema 级辅助实体在无运行时校验下被隐式信任，构成当前 GraphRAG 防御的结构性盲点，且具备实例级攻击没有的 1:N 放大能力。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Traversing the Satisfaction-Diversity Frontier in Text-to-Image Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image generation enables users to explore several images generated from the same prompt. For these generated images to be useful, each one must reflect the user's preferences, measured by a learned reward, and differ visually from the others to maintain diversity. Existing methods are limited: they either address reward and diversity separately or combine them in one aggregate score, enabling high diversity to offset low rewards. In this paper, we address these limitations by formulating generation as satisficing: every image (candidate) must satisfy a reward floor and the batch of images must satisfy a diversity cutoff. The reward floor controls the balance between worst-candidate reward and batch diversity; we show that varying this floor defines a Pareto frontier. To traverse this frontier, we introduce SatisDive, a training-free inference-time method. SatisDive uses a batch-relative reward cutoff to distinguish lower- from higher-reward candidates, emphasizing reward improvement for candidates below the cutoff and diversity among candidates above it. On Pick-a-Pic, at matched DreamSim, SatisDive improves worst-candidate reward over FK steering by up to 0.43 with FLUX.1-dev as the base model and HPSv3 as the reward, and by up to 0.70 with SANA-1.6B as the base model and ImageReward as the reward. More broadly, across their overlapping DreamSim ranges, SatisDive's satisfaction-diversity curve Pareto-dominates FK steering's curve in each setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SatisDive 把文生图多样本生成改写成 satisficing：每张图必须过奖励下限，整批图必须过多样性阈值，且训练无关、仅在推理时用批内相对奖励截断区分低奖励与高奖励候选，对前者推奖励、对后者推多样性。在 Pick-a-Pic 上、匹配 DreamSim 时，最差候选奖励比 FK steering 最多高 0.43（FLUX.1-dev + HPSv3）与 0.70（SANA-1.6B + ImageReward），且各设定的 satisfaction-diversity 曲线在重叠 DreamSim 区间上 Pareto 支配 FK steering。
Motivation: 现有文生图多样本方法要么分别处理奖励与多样性，要么把两者合成单一聚合分数，导致高多样性可以抵消低奖励，最差候选质量失控。
Method: 将生成形式化为 satisficing：奖励下限约束单个候选、多样性阈值约束整批，改变该下限即扫出 Pareto 前沿；SatisDive 是训练无关的推理时方法，用批内相对奖励截断把候选分为低于与高于截断两组，前者强调奖励提升、后者强调多样性。
Result: 在 Pick-a-Pic 上、匹配 DreamSim：以 FLUX.1-dev 为基座、HPSv3 为奖励时，最差候选奖励比 FK steering 最多提高 0.43；以 SANA-1.6B 为基座、ImageReward 为奖励时最多提高 0.70。在各自重叠的 DreamSim 区间内，SatisDive 的 satisfaction-diversity 曲线在每种设定下都 Pareto 支配 FK steering 的曲线。
Conclusion: 奖励与多样性应作为两个独立约束而非加权总分来处理，用可调奖励下限即可沿 Pareto 前沿移动并在匹配多样性下抬高最差候选奖励。

papers.title: Network-in-the-Loop at Scale: GPU-Batched 5G Simulation for Massively Parallel Robot Learning
papers.abstract_en: Massively parallel GPU simulators train multi-robot policies in thousands of environments, and many fleets use private Fifth-Generation (5G) networks, where each robot's delay depends on its teammates' traffic. Network-in-the-loop training places a simulated 5G network inside this loop. However, GPU robot simulators reduce the network to an independent delay per message, while packet-level simulators run one scenario per CPU process and cannot keep pace with thousands of parallel environments. To bridge this gap, we present Isaac-Net, a GPU-batched 5G New Radio (NR) module that advances the uplink of thousands of environments in lockstep with Isaac Lab physics. Isaac-Net simulates every slot, the 0.5~ms interval in which the base station decides which robots transmit, for all environments at once. Extensive experiments confirm that its NR engine reproduces the median delay of ns-3 5G-LENA across loads, with a median delay 5--10\% low on an unseen carrier and 9\% high at 32 robots per environment in closed loop. The engine also reproduces the Age of Information (AoI), the age of each robot's newest delivered report, while an independent delay per message leaves the AoI tail about three times too light. In a configuration validated against 5G-LENA, Isaac-Net keeps the network in the loop for about one million robots on one GPU at 83\% of the Isaac Lab rate without the network, measured under a random policy. Isaac-Net is open source at https://github.com/ZzZTripleZzZ/isaac-net
papers.comment: It is open source at https://github.com/ZzZTripleZzZ/isaac-net
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Isaac-Net 把 5G New Radio 逐 slot（0.5 ms）的上行调度做成 GPU 批处理模块，与 Isaac Lab 物理在数千个并行环境中同步推进，使 network-in-the-loop 多机器人训练成为可能。其 NR 引擎复现 ns-3 5G-LENA 的中位时延（未见载波上偏低 5–10%，闭环 32 机器人/环境偏高 9%）与 Age of Information，而逐消息独立时延把 AoI 尾部做轻约 3 倍；单卡可支撑约一百万机器人，保持 Isaac Lab 无网络速率的 83%。
Motivation: GPU 机器人模拟器把网络简化为逐消息独立时延，丢掉队友流量耦合与调度结构；包级模拟器又只能单 CPU 进程跑一个场景，跟不上数千并行环境。
Method: Isaac-Net 是 GPU-batched 5G NR 模块，对所有环境同时推进每个 0.5 ms slot 的上行调度，与 Isaac Lab 物理 lockstep 同步；用 ns-3 5G-LENA 校验中位时延与 AoI，并在随机策略下测吞吐开销。
Result: 中位时延复现 ns-3 5G-LENA：未见载波上偏低 5–10%，闭环 32 机器人/环境偏高 9%；AoI 同样被复现，而逐消息独立时延使 AoI 尾部约轻 3 倍；在对 5G-LENA 校验过的配置下，单 GPU 保持约一百万机器人 network-in-the-loop，速率为无网络 Isaac Lab 的 83%（随机策略下测得）。
Conclusion: 逐 slot 的 GPU 批处理 5G 仿真可在不显著牺牲模拟速率的前提下把真实网络调度放进大规模并行机器人训练闭环，而逐消息独立时延会系统性做轻 AoI 尾部。

papers.title: Automating the Application of HCI Principles: Skills for On-Demand UI Construction, the Human-AI Space to Think, and the Future of HCI
papers.abstract_en: Human-computer interaction (HCI) is in the middle of a transition: large language models can now generate functional user interfaces (UIs) on demand from natural-language task descriptions. A user explains what they are trying to accomplish, and the system materializes a working interface to support it. This capability already exists in systems such as Claude and ChatGPT and continues to grow in fidelity as the underlying models improve. The next step along this trajectory is to move from interfaces that are merely generated to interfaces that are generated well. We propose a framework in which the dialogue between user and artificial intelligence (AI) becomes a Space to Think: a shared, structured cognitive workspace in which task decomposition produces an on-demand user interface as an extension of the user's thinking rather than as a separate artifact. Within this paradigm, classical HCI design knowledge (Nielsen's heuristics, Norman's affordance prescriptions, Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) success criteria, cognitive-load constraints, and mixed-initiative principles) is encoded as skills: machine-readable skill.md files that the generating agent loads at runtime as software engineering tools. Skills turn HCI design knowledge into declarative, inspectable, version-controlled, and editable artifacts owned by the HCI community itself so that accessibility, learnability, and consistency become properties of a generative process rather than properties of a finished product. We outline a research agenda depicting a future where the HCI field transitions from today's design and knowledge heuristic checklist towards a future where the craft becomes machine-readable, executable, and open.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出把 Nielsen 启发式、Norman 示能、WCAG 成功准则、认知负荷与 mixed-initiative 原则编码为运行时可加载的 skill.md 文件，让 LLM 按需生成的 UI 把可访问性、可学习性、一致性变成生成过程的属性而非成品属性，并把用户与 AI 的对话变成任务分解驱动的 Space to Think。
Motivation: LLM 已能从自然语言任务描述按需生成可用 UI，但生成的界面只是被生成而非生成得好；经典 HCI 设计知识停留在人工检查清单，无法约束生成过程本身。
Method: 提出 Space to Think 框架：用户与 AI 的结构化共享认知工作区中，任务分解直接产出按需 UI；把 Nielsen 启发式、Norman 示能规范、WCAG 成功准则、认知负荷约束和 mixed-initiative 原则写成 skill.md，作为软件工程工具由生成 agent 在运行时加载，使设计知识成为可声明、可检查、可版本控制、可编辑的工件。
Result: 给出框架与研究议程的纲领性论述，主张 HCI 设计知识从启发式清单转向机器可读、可执行、开放的形态；摘要未含实验、数据集或指标数字。
Conclusion: 作者主张 HCI 的手艺应从人工检查清单转为社区自有的机器可读 skill 工件，使可访问性与一致性由生成过程保证，并以此勾勒该领域的研究议程。
