papers.title: Co-design Gym: A Unified Benchmark for Embodiment-Policy Co-optimization
papers.abstract_en: Finding an optimal behaviour policy within a given environment is a widely studied problem in domains as diverse as games, robotics, energy infrastructure, communication networks, and multi-agent systems. Numerous benchmarks have been developed to support such research, but the vast majority assume that the agent's embodiment (design) is fixed, focusing instead on policy learning alone. Lifting this assumption gives rise to a broader class of problems in which optimizing embodiment and policy separately is highly suboptimal. An agent's embodiment strongly shapes which control policies can be discovered, while the optimal embodiment is in turn defined by the policies it admits. To help the research community study this class of problems explicitly and systematically, we introduce Co-Design Gym - a suite of benchmark environments for jointly optimizing embodiment and policy. Our environments span domains such as robotic manipulation and locomotion, multi-robot cooperation, deformable and soft dynamics, video games, electricity grids, wireless networks, F1 racing, multi-agent warehouses, and optimal control, offering 20 environment families (domains), with over 85 distinct co-design presets in total. We further contribute a systematic evaluation of representative co-design algorithms, characterizing the current state of the art. Together, these contributions lay the groundwork for cumulative, comparable progress in co-design.
papers.comment: Aviraj Newatia and Yordan Tsvetkov contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Co-design Gym 把机器人形态 (embodiment) 与策略联合优化做成统一基准，覆盖 20 个环境族、85 余个 co-design 预设，并对代表性 co-design 算法做了系统评测。核心论断是：固定形态只学策略会系统性次优，因为形态决定哪些策略可被发现，而最优形态又由它所允许的策略定义。
Motivation: 现有基准几乎都假设 agent 形态固定、只做策略学习，而形态与策略分开优化是高度次优的，这类问题此前缺少可系统比较的研究平台。
Method: 构建 Co-design Gym 基准套件，环境横跨机器人操作与运动、多机器人协作、可变形/软体动力学、视频游戏、电网、无线网络、F1 赛车、多智能体仓库与最优控制；提供 20 个环境族、85 余个 co-design 预设，并对代表性 co-design 算法做系统评测以刻画当前 SOTA。
Result: 提供 20 个环境族 (domains)、超过 85 个不同的 co-design 预设；给出对代表性 co-design 算法的系统评测，刻画当前算法状态。
Conclusion: 形态与策略必须联合优化，统一基准是让 co-design 研究能够累积、可比地推进的前提。

papers.title: Confidence-Controlled XAI Auditing for Pedestrian Detection under Domain Shift
papers.abstract_en: Explainability is increasingly required for perception models in intelligent vehicles, yet whether explanations remain faithful under driving domain shift is still poorly understood. This work audits post-hoc explanations of a fixed YOLOv8s pedestrian detector across PIE and JAAD using ROI-based D-Deletion, frozen confidence terciles, rank-based tests, bootstrap intervals, and Holm correction. The audit shows that deletion-based faithfulness is strongly coupled to detection strength at explanation time, with Spearman correlations between 0.70 and 0.82 for D-RISE, making naive confidence-stratified comparisons unreliable. After controlling for detection strength within fixed f0 bins, D-RISE faithfulness remains domain-dependent in the central f0 range, with PIE showing higher D-Deletion than JAAD and Holm-adjusted significance. A non-perturbative EigenCAM baseline is less faithful than D-RISE but also exhibits score coupling, suggesting that the effect is not specific to D-RISE and is related to the deletion-based evaluation setup. These results motivate confidence-controlled XAI audits for safety-critical perception under domain shift.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Vehicular Electronics and Safety (ICVES 2026). 6 pages, 4 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 PIE 与 JAAD 两个驾驶数据集上审计固定 YOLOv8s 行人检测器的后验解释忠实度，发现 D-RISE 的 D-Deletion 分数与解释时检测置信度强耦合（Spearman 0.70–0.82），因此按置信度分层的朴素比较不可靠；在固定 f0 分箱内控制检测强度后，D-RISE 忠实度仍呈域依赖，PIE 高于 JAAD 且经 Holm 校正显著。
Motivation: 智能车辆感知模型的可解释性要求日益普遍，但解释在驾驶域偏移下是否仍然忠实仍不清楚，且朴素的置信度分层比较会被检测强度混淆。
Method: 对固定 YOLOv8s 行人检测器在 PIE 与 JAAD 上做基于 ROI 的 D-Deletion 审计，配合冻结的置信度三分位 (frozen confidence terciles)、秩检验 (rank-based tests)、bootstrap 置信区间与 Holm 多重比较校正，并在固定 f0 分箱内控制检测强度。
Result: D-RISE 的 D-Deletion 与检测置信度 Spearman 相关在 0.70–0.82 之间；控制检测强度后中央 f0 区间内 PIE 的 D-Deletion 高于 JAAD 且 Holm 校正后显著；非扰动基线 EigenCAM 忠实度低于 D-RISE 但同样表现出分数耦合。
Conclusion: 分数耦合源于 deletion 类评估设置本身而非 D-RISE 特有，安全关键感知在域偏移下的 XAI 审计必须先控制检测置信度再比较。

papers.title: ArrivalBench: Agent-Generated Data Pipelines Are Correct Once and Wrong Under Time
papers.abstract_en: Benchmarks for agent-generated data work grade a pipeline by running it once against a fixed snapshot. ArrivalBench instead re-executes the pipeline an agent leaves behind under adversarial but replayable delivery schedules (late, duplicated, out-of-order and retried records) and requires its final state to equal a batch recomputation of the complete log. Because the oracle recomputes rather than classifies, a wrong table and a crash are distinct verdicts: a crash is visible to monitoring a team already runs, and a wrong table is not. On 40 tasks we built, our reimplementation of single-execution grading certifies 86-100% of the pipelines eleven models produce; re-executing the same artifacts finds 7.0-79.2% of the certified ones silently wrong. The gap is not produced by the repair loop: within the same model and task, pipelines repaired against the snapshot test fail replay about as often as those that passed it first time. In every model, idempotency hazards fail more often than ordering hazards. Separating a wrong answer from a crash also changes how interventions read: a hazard warning cuts one model's silent failure from 48.2% to 10.5% while raising its crash rate from 9.0% to 37.0%, so all-in failure moves only from 51.0% to 44.0%. All eleven arms were independently re-run, and rates moved by at most 5.9 points.
papers.comment: Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop "Who Verifies the Agents?". 20 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ArrivalBench 不再一次性跑通就给 agent 生成的数据管道打分，而是在可重放的对抗投递调度（迟到、重复、乱序、重试）下反复重放管道，要求其最终状态等于对完整日志的批式重算。在 40 个任务上，单次执行评分认证了 11 个模型产出管道的 86–100%，重放后发现其中 7.0–79.2% 静默出错；每个模型里幂等性 (idempotency) 危害都比排序危害更常失败。
Motivation: 对 agent 生成的数据管道只按固定快照跑一次就打分，无法暴露投递调度变化下的状态错误；而错误表与崩溃不同，崩溃会被现有监控看见，静默错误表不会。
Method: 在 40 个任务上重实现单次执行评分作为对照，把 agent 留下的管道在可重放的对抗投递调度（迟到、重复、乱序、重试记录）下重放，oracle 通过重算完整日志的批式结果而非分类来判定，从而区分错误表与崩溃；并对比快照测试修复过的管道与一次通过的管道、以及加危害警告前后的表现，全部 11 组独立重跑。
Result: 单次执行评分认证 11 个模型产出管道的 86–100%；重放同一产物发现其中 7.0–79.2% 静默出错。差距不由修复循环造成：同一模型同一任务内，按快照测试修复的管道与首次通过的管道重放失败率相近。每个模型中幂等性危害失败都多于排序危害。危害警告把某模型静默失败率从 48.2% 降到 10.5%，崩溃率从 9.0% 升到 37.0%，总失败仅从 51.0% 降到 44.0%。11 组独立重跑，比率变动最多 5.9 个百分点。
Conclusion: 单次快照评分给出的认证不可靠：重放会暴露大量静默错误，且把错误与崩溃分开才读得懂干预的真实效果——警告只是把静默失败换成了可见的崩溃。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Lexicographic Multi-Objective On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) usually optimizes answer correctness, yet useful language-model behavior also requires high-quality reasoning and concise responses. Existing multi-reward post-training methods typically scalarize rewards or combine specialists without explicitly protecting a reward priority order. This is problematic when trade-offs are asymmetric: conciseness, for example, should not improve at the cost of correctness. We introduce Lexicographic Multi-Objective On-Policy Distillation (LMOPD), a multi-teacher method for integrating reward-specialized policies under explicit priorities. For each student rollout, LMOPD selects the specialist for the first objective whose gate detects a deficiency, then locally projects its centered log-policy correction to remove components that oppose higher-priority specialists. We evaluate 30B-A3B mixture-of-experts transformer models in two- and four-expert settings on three math benchmarks, measuring retained specialist gains. With two experts, LMOPD's point estimates fully retain the accuracy and reasoning-quality gains while acquiring $46.9\%$ of the conciseness gain. With four experts, it retains $\approx90\%$ of both the accuracy gain and reasoning-correctness gain, compared to only $\approx57\%$ by the next best evaluated baseline. Matched four-expertablations show that lexicographic routing outperforms random routing and that projection further strengthens both top-priority capabilities. Across both scales, LMOPD preserves the highest-priority capabilities more effectively than the existing baselines we evaluate, demonstrating the value of explicit priorities for specialist integration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出词典序多目标 on-policy 蒸馏 (LMOPD)：多教师场景下按显式优先级排序目标，学生每条 rollout 先由 gate 检测首个不足的目标、选中对应专家，再把其中心化 log-policy 修正局部投影掉与更高优先级专家相冲突的分量。在 30B-A3B MoE 上两专家设置完全保留准确率与推理质量增益并拿到 46.9% 的简洁性增益；四专家设置保留约 90% 的准确率与推理正确性增益，而次优基线仅约 57%。
Motivation: RLVR 只优化答案正确性，而有用行为还需高质量推理与简洁回答；现有后训练多用标量化奖励或简单组合专家，不保护奖励优先级，导致简洁性可能以牺牲正确性为代价。
Method: LMOPD 是多教师方法：对每条学生 rollout，按优先级顺序用各目标的 gate 找到首个不足的目标并选中其专家，随后把该专家的中心化 log-policy 修正做局部投影，剔除与更高优先级专家方向相反的分量；在 30B-A3B mixture-of-experts transformer 上做两专家与四专家设置，并做匹配的四专家消融（词典序路由 vs 随机路由，加/不加投影）。
Result: 在三个数学 benchmark 上测保留的专家增益：两专家时 LMOPD 点估计完全保留准确率与推理质量增益，并获得 46.9% 的简洁性增益；四专家时保留约 90% 的准确率增益与推理正确性增益，次优被评估基线仅约 57%；匹配的四专家消融显示词典序路由优于随机路由，投影进一步增强两项最高优先级能力。
Conclusion: 显式保护奖励优先级能让专家整合在不牺牲最高优先级能力（正确性与推理质量）的前提下吸收次级目标（简洁性）的增益，且路由与投影两个部件各自都有贡献。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Conformal Prediction for Time Series with Deep Sequence Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in deep learning for time series prediction have amplified the need for reliable uncertainty quantification. Conformal prediction has gained attention as a distribution-free framework for constructing prediction intervals with coverage guarantees. However, its coverage guarantees rely on data exchangeability, an assumption generally violated in time series. Active research has focused on developing conformal prediction methods for time series that overcome this limitation. While deep sequence models, such as recurrent neural networks and Transformers, have often been used in conformal prediction for time series, limited work has systematically studied how deep sequence models can be utilized in conformal prediction for time series. In this work, we systematically investigate the use of deep sequence models in conformal prediction for time series through three approaches: conditional quantile regression, conditional quantile function estimation, and localized conformal prediction. We provide a theoretical analysis establishing asymptotic conditional coverage guarantees for all three approaches under suitable assumptions. Through comprehensive experiments on real-world datasets, we demonstrate the effectiveness of leveraging deep sequence models into conformal prediction for time series.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 系统研究如何把 RNN、Transformer 等深度序列模型嵌入时间序列的保形预测 (conformal prediction)，走条件分位数回归、条件分位数函数估计、局部化保形预测三条路线，并给出三者在适当假设下的渐近条件覆盖保证。在真实数据集上验证了引入深度序列模型后区间构造的有效性。
Motivation: 保形预测的覆盖保证依赖数据可交换性，而时间序列一般不满足该假设；深度序列模型虽常被用于时间序列保形预测，但缺少对其用法的系统研究。
Method: 三条路线：条件分位数回归 (conditional quantile regression)、条件分位数函数估计 (conditional quantile function estimation)、局部化保形预测 (localized conformal prediction)，底层序列模型为 RNN 与 Transformer；并对三者给出渐近条件覆盖的理论分析，并在真实数据集上做实验。
Result: 为三种方法分别建立适当假设下的渐近条件覆盖保证 (asymptotic conditional coverage)；在多个真实世界数据集的综合实验中展示了把深度序列模型纳入时间序列保形预测的有效性。
Conclusion: 深度序列模型可通过分位数回归、分位数函数估计与局部化三条途径进入时间序列保形预测，并在合适假设下仍能拿到条件覆盖保证。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Why Does Adaptive Batching Help LLM Pretraining? A Perspective from Unbounded Variance
papers.abstract_en: Increasing the batch size during training is a common practice in large language model (LLM) pretraining, yet the theoretical justification behind its success is not well understood. Analyses of stochastic optimization often assume uniformly bounded stochastic gradient variance, yet recent evidence suggests that this assumption fails in many practical nonconvex problems. The Blum--Gladyshev (BG-$0$) noise model relaxes this assumption by allowing the variance to grow quadratically with the distance from initialization, suggesting that batch size schedulers can help by controlling the variance growth during training. However, this growth can be overly conservative in practice. We empirically investigate variance growth in LLM pretraining and observe that a generalized BG model with a tunable growth exponent provides a tighter description of practical noise behavior. Motivated by this observation, we introduce the generalized BG-$a$ noise model, which interpolates between bounded variance ($a=0$) and BG-$0$ noise ($a=2$). Under $L$-smoothness, we derive an information-theoretic lower bound with growth-dependent oracle complexity $Ω(ε^{-(4+a)})$ and establish a matching upper bound in $ε$-dependence by increasing the batch size as the iterates move away from initialization. Finally, we propose an adaptive batch scheduler that controls variance growth through dynamic batch size adjustments during training. In pretraining OLMo2 models of up to 1B parameters on C4, our scheduler achieves a lower validation loss than both small and large batch training under matched token budgets, while using less than 10\% of the iterations of small batch training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 预训练中梯度方差随离初始化距离增长，作者提出广义 BG-a 噪声模型（a=0 为有界方差，a=2 为 BG-0），据此设计随迭代动态增大批量的调度器。在 C4 上预训练最大 1B 参数的 OLMo2 时，该调度器在匹配 token 预算下验证损失低于小批量与大批量训练，且迭代数不到小批量训练的 10%。
Motivation: 增大 batch size 是 LLM 预训练常见做法，但随机优化理论普遍假设梯度方差一致有界，该假设在许多非凸问题中失效，导致批量增长调度的成功缺乏理论依据。
Method: 先在 LLM 预训练中实证观察方差增长，提出可调增长指数 a 的广义 BG-a 噪声模型；在 L-smoothness 下推导信息论下界 Ω(ε^{-(4+a)})，并用随迭代远离初始化而增大的批量给出 ε 依赖匹配的上界；据此提出通过动态调整批量控制方差增长的自适应批量调度器。
Result: 下界 Ω(ε^{-(4+a)}) 与上界在 ε 依赖上匹配；在 C4 上预训练最大 1B 参数 OLMo2、匹配 token 预算下，调度器验证损失低于小批量与大批量训练，迭代数少于小批量训练的 10%。
Conclusion: 批量增长的价值在于控制方差随离初始化距离的增长，广义 BG-a 模型比有界方差与 BG-0 更贴合实际噪声行为，自适应批量调度可用更少迭代达到更低验证损失。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Does Every User Need a Private LoRA? Decoupling Personalization from Per-User Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Personalized large language models often require a complete adaptation state for each user. However, this paradigm scales poorly as the user population grows. We revisit this design through the lens of personalization capacity allocation: how much adaptation capacity can be shared across users, how the shared capacity should be composed, and how much must remain user-specific. We answer them through three complementary empirical analyses. We find that independent user adapters contain substantial cross-user reusable structure, that the utility of reusable directions reflects both user relevance and variation across queries, and that user histories provide transferable signals for compact individual correction. Motivated by these findings, we propose LINEUP. It learns a bank of reusable low-rank personalization factors, composes them through user-conditioned recall and query-dependent calibration, and restricts target-user adaptation to a tiny user code over a shared correction space. This design decouples expressive personalization capacity from per-user trainable state. Each target user optimizes only eight scalars, while all shared components remain fixed. By comparison, the evaluated private-LoRA configuration uses 4.19 million per-user parameters. Our theoretical analysis gives a finite-step, finite-history risk bound and sufficient conditions for user-code refinement to improve on history initialization. Across six tasks spanning personalized classification, prediction, and generation, LINEUP leads on all 12 metrics, each averaged over three independent runs (e.g., reducing LaMP-3 RMSE by 11.4% relative to the strongest baseline). It maintains advantages under limited history. These results show that rich personalization can be supported primarily by reusable, conditionally composed shared capacity, while independent user adaptation remains confined to a tiny correction state.
papers.comment: 10 pages main content, 36 pages total including appendix, 7 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LINEUP 把个性化 LLM 的每用户适配状态压缩到共享低秩因子库加 8 个标量的 user code：可复用的个性化容量由用户条件召回与查询依赖校准组合，目标用户只优化这 8 个标量，共享部分全部冻结。对比私有 LoRA 配置的每用户 419 万参数，在六个覆盖个性化分类、预测与生成的任务上 12 项指标全部领先（如 LaMP-3 RMSE 相对最强基线降低 11.4%），且在历史有限时优势保持。
Motivation: 个性化 LLM 通常给每个用户存一份完整适配状态，用户规模一大就无法扩展；需要弄清多少适配容量可跨用户共享、共享部分如何组合、多少必须用户私有。
Method: 先做三组互补实证分析（独立用户 adapter 的跨用户可复用结构、可复用方向的价值由用户相关性与查询间变化共同决定、用户历史可迁移为紧凑个体校正信号），据此提出 LINEUP：可复用低秩个性化因子库 + 用户条件召回 (user-conditioned recall) + 查询依赖校准 (query-dependent calibration)，目标用户只在共享校正空间上训练 8 个标量的 user code；另给出有限步有限历史的风险界与 user code 优于历史初始化的充分条件。
Result: 每用户可训练参数 8 个标量，对比私有 LoRA 配置的 419 万 (4.19M) 每用户参数；在六个任务（个性化分类、预测、生成）上 12 项指标全部领先，每项为 3 次独立运行平均，LaMP-3 RMSE 相对最强基线降低 11.4%，历史有限时优势保持。
Conclusion: 丰富的个性化主要可由可复用、按条件组合的共享容量支撑，独立的每用户适配应压缩到极小的校正状态；理论分析给出 user code 在何种条件下优于历史初始化。

papers.title: DeReAct: Decomposed Reasoning and Acting for Reliable AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: ReAct-based agents typically rely on a single LLM policy to propose actions, interact with the environment, and decide when a task is complete. This coupling makes action authorization and completion control difficult to enforce independently, allowing errors to propagate and unsupported completion claims to terminate execution. We introduce DeReAct, a modular agent architecture that externalizes two gating policies: a Critic that validates proposed actions before execution, and a Context Manager that reconstructs an environment-supported \textsc{State} and certifies task completion. Across GAIA and SWE-bench Verified, DeReAct improves Pass@1 most for weaker Brain models, with gains of 6.5--7.0 points for Qwen3-Coder-480B and 4.2--5.2 points for Claude Sonnet~4.5; gains diminish as Brain capability increases. Trajectory and ablation analyses show that external gating is effective when targeted failures are sufficiently prevalent and the gating policy is itself sufficient. With Claude Opus~4.5, Pass@1 remains comparable to ReAct, while DeReAct produces more evidence-complete and constraint-satisfying trajectories, indicating that completion control can trade earlier termination for stronger grounding. Overall, DeReAct improves weaker agents while retaining grounding benefits as models strengthen.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeReAct 把 ReAct 单一 LLM 策略拆成两个外置门控：Critic 在执行前校验动作，Context Manager 重建有环境证据支撑的 State 并认证任务完成。在 GAIA 与 SWE-bench Verified 上，弱模型收益最大：Qwen3-Coder-480B 的 Pass@1 提升 6.5–7.0 点，Claude Sonnet 4.5 提升 4.2–5.2 点，随 Brain 能力增强收益递减。
Motivation: ReAct 类 agent 由单一策略同时提动作、交互和判定完成，动作授权与完成控制无法独立约束，错误会传播，缺乏证据的完成声明可提前终止执行。
Method: 模块化架构外置两个 gating policy：Critic 在动作执行前校验，Context Manager 重建环境支撑的 State 并认证完成；在 GAIA 与 SWE-bench Verified 上做轨迹分析与消融，比较不同 Brain 模型（Qwen3-Coder-480B、Claude Sonnet 4.5、Claude Opus 4.5）。
Result: GAIA 与 SWE-bench Verified 上 Pass@1 提升：Qwen3-Coder-480B 6.5–7.0 点，Claude Sonnet 4.5 4.2–5.2 点，Brain 越强增益越小；Claude Opus 4.5 上 Pass@1 与 ReAct 相当，但轨迹更完整满足证据与约束。消融显示外置门控仅在目标失败足够普遍且门控策略本身足够强时有效。
Conclusion: 外置门控主要补足弱 agent，模型变强后完成控制转为以更早终止换取更强 grounding，而非继续抬高 Pass@1。

papers.title: MIRROR: Multipath Quorum Integrity for LLM Multi-Agent Communication
papers.abstract_en: Inter-agent communication is central to Large Language Model Multi-Agent Systems (LLM-MAS), but it introduces an underexplored vulnerability: Agent-in-the-Middle (AiTM) attacks that manipulate messages in transit without compromising the agents themselves. Prior work reports Attack Success Rates (ASR) approaching 100% on structured tasks. Existing defenses rely on semantic validation, which requires additional inference and can block benign outputs, or on transport-layer encryption, which does not help when an intermediary legitimately terminates TLS. We present MIRROR, a communication-layer integrity primitive that replicates a single canonicalized payload across k logical routes and accepts a message only when a strict majority of routes report the same digest. MIRROR uses unkeyed hashing and so authenticates nothing on its own, since an active on-path adversary can always recompute a digest over a payload it has modified. All integrity derives from the assumption that honest routes form a majority. The digest serves only to make witness routes constant-size and to bind the recovered payload to the quorum-agreed value under second-preimage resistance. We give the guarantee under a route-compromise bound alpha < 0.5, and extend it to correlated routes, where the quantity that matters is the size of the largest shared-failure group and not the route count. We further show that availability and integrity degrade at the same threshold: below alpha = 0.5, quorum-denial and message-dropping adversaries cannot block honest traffic. Across MMLU, HumanEval, and MBPP on two frameworks and four communication topologies, and in a MetaGPT deployment against a production API, MIRROR reduces ASR to 0% below the threshold at 1x LLM token cost. LLM-as-a-Judge costs 35x in the same deployment, and blocks up to 44.2% of benign outputs in the topology sweep.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundations of Language Model Security (FLMSec). 12 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MIRROR 是面向 LLM 多智能体通信的完整性原语：把同一份规范化 payload 复制到 k 条逻辑路由，仅当严格多数路由报告相同 digest 才接受消息。在路由被攻陷比例 alpha < 0.5 时 ASR 降为 0%，token 成本 1x；相关路由下起作用的是最大共享失效组规模而非路由数。
Motivation: Agent-in-the-Middle (AiTM) 攻击在不攻破智能体本身的情况下篡改传输中的消息，结构化任务上 ASR 接近 100%；现有语义校验需额外推理且会误拦良性输出，传输层加密在中间人合法终止 TLS 时失效。
Method: 在通信层复制单个规范化 payload 到 k 条逻辑路由，用无密钥哈希计算 digest，仅当严格多数路由报告相同 digest 才接受；digest 只用于让见证路由保持常数大小，并在 second-preimage 抗性下把恢复的 payload 绑定到 quorum 一致值，全部完整性来自诚实路由占多数的假设。
Result: 在 MMLU、HumanEval、MBPP 上跨两个框架与四种通信拓扑，以及 MetaGPT 对生产 API 的部署中，alpha < 0.5 时 MIRROR 将 ASR 降至 0%，成本为 1x LLM token；同一部署中 LLM-as-a-Judge 成本 35x，且在拓扑扫描中最多拦截 44.2% 的良性输出。alpha = 0.5 以下 quorum-denial 与丢包对手无法阻断诚实流量，可用性与完整性在同一阈值退化。
Conclusion: 只要诚实路由构成多数（alpha < 0.5），多数投票加 digest 就足以把 AiTM 的 ASR 压到 0 且不增加推理开销；相关路由下安全性由最大共享失效组规模决定，而非路由总数。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Behavior to Provenance: Attributing Tabular Foundation Models to Synthetic Pretraining Data
papers.abstract_en: Training-data attribution aims to identify which training examples shape model behavior, yet validating such claims is difficult because causal training influence is rarely observable. We argue that controlled synthetic pretraining makes attribution experimentally testable. Using O'PRIOR, a provenance-rich synthetic task generator for tabular foundation models, we construct a testbed in which every pretraining task carries explicit lineage over structural mechanisms, missingness, confounding, shortcuts, and distribution shift. We combine behavior-conditioned attribution with counterfactual retraining and provenance-aware interventions to test both task-level faithfulness and mechanism-level consistency. On held-out real tasks, removing the top-attributed 5% of synthetic tasks decreases mean ROC-AUC by 0.013, compared with 0.002$\pm$0.004 under random removal, while removing bottom-attributed tasks improves performance by 0.003. Within shortcut-provenance tasks, targeted removal yields an effect of 0.043 versus 0.016 for matched random removal. Provenance discrimination is more modest by ranking AUROC (0.55-0.62), despite substantial top-k enrichment, revealing that provenance association and interventional faithfulness need not coincide. Our results establish synthetic provenance as a controlled setting for verifiable contributive attribution
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文主张：受控合成预训练能让训练数据归因 (training-data attribution) 变成可实验检验的命题——用带完整血缘标注的 O'PRIOR 合成任务做反事实重训，按归因移除任务确实改变真实任务上的 ROC-AUC，但血缘判别与干预忠实性并不重合。移除归因最高的 5% 合成任务使平均 ROC-AUC 下降 0.013（随机移除仅 0.002±0.004），移除最低归因任务反而提升 0.003；而按排名的血缘判别 AUROC 只有 0.55–0.62。
Motivation: 训练数据归因的因果影响通常不可观测，导致归因主张难以验证；作者认为受控合成预训练提供了可检验的实验场。
Method: 用 O'PRIOR（面向表格基础模型的带血缘合成任务生成器）构造每个预训练任务都标注结构机制、缺失、混杂、捷径与分布偏移血缘的测试床，结合行为条件化归因 (behavior-conditioned attribution)、反事实重训与血缘感知干预，检验任务级忠实性与机制级一致性。
Result: 在留出的真实任务上，移除归因最高的 5% 合成任务使平均 ROC-AUC 下降 0.013，随机移除为 0.002±0.004，移除最低归因任务则提升 0.003；在捷径血缘任务中定向移除效应为 0.043，匹配随机移除为 0.016；血缘判别按排名 AUROC 为 0.55–0.62，但 top-k 富集显著。
Conclusion: 合成血缘是可验证的贡献性归因 (contributive attribution) 受控场景，但血缘关联与干预忠实性可以不一致，二者不能互相替代。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mitigating Convergence Collapse in Fixed-Target Anomaly Detectors via Kernel-Anchored Locality Regularization
papers.abstract_en: A family of tabular anomaly detectors trains a neural map toward a fixed target under squared-error loss and scores anomalies by the test-time residual; contraction matching, one-step rectified flow, and reconstruction autoencoders all fit this template. We characterize a convergence collapse: better optimization makes the detector worse. At convergence, the learned map tracks the target even off-distribution, so the residual signal vanishes on anomalies as well as on normal data. These detectors therefore rely on implicit non-convergence (early stopping, capacity caps) to retain signal. We argue this is structural: effective anomaly detection requires a locality constraint that blocks unconstrained extrapolation. Classical detectors (kNN, KDE, isolation forests, LOF) enforce locality explicitly; fixed-target neural detectors do not. We formalize the connection by showing that the kernel-regression analog of a fixed-target detector is a finite-bandwidth Nadaraya-Watson smoother, which we call Kernel Contraction Matching (KCM). KCM is closed-form, training-free, and CPU-efficient, yet matches established neural baselines on ADBench. Building on this bridge, we introduce the Kernel-Anchored Regularizer (KAR), which penalizes deviation of the neural prediction from a kernel-weighted average of training targets. Across collapse-prone ADBench datasets and three backbones, KAR mitigates collapse and improves AUROC under prolonged training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 固定目标异常检测器（平方误差训练、测试时看残差）存在收敛坍缩：优化越好检测越差，因为收敛后映射在分布外也贴住目标，异常残差信号消失。作者把这类检测器形式化为有限带宽的 Nadaraya-Watson 平滑器（Kernel Contraction Matching, KCM），并提出 Kernel-Anchored Regularizer (KAR) 惩罚神经预测偏离核加权训练目标，在 ADBench 坍缩数据集与三种 backbone 上缓解坍缩、提升延长训练下的 AUROC。
Motivation: 固定目标神经异常检测器依赖早停、容量上限这类隐式非收敛来保留残差信号，优化与检测质量相互矛盾；缺少显式 locality 约束时，模型会做无约束外推。
Method: 先证明固定目标检测器的核回归类比是有限带宽 Nadaraya-Watson 平滑器，得到闭式、免训练的 Kernel Contraction Matching (KCM)；再引入 Kernel-Anchored Regularizer (KAR)，惩罚神经预测与核加权训练目标均值的偏离，作为 locality 约束加到训练中。
Result: KCM 闭式免训练、CPU 高效，在 ADBench 上匹配既有神经基线；KAR 在 ADBench 的坍缩易发数据集与三种 backbone 上缓解收敛坍缩，并在延长训练下提升 AUROC。
Conclusion: 有效异常检测需要显式 locality 约束来阻止分布外外推，收敛坍缩是固定目标模板的结构性问题而非调参问题。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: 先证明固定目标检测器的核回归类比是有限带宽 Nadaraya-Watson 平滑器，得到闭式、免训练的 Kernel Contraction Matching (KCM)；再引入 Kernel-Anchored Regularizer (KAR)，惩罚神经预测与核加权训练目标均值的偏离，作为 locality 约束加到训练中。
summary_sections.result: KCM 闭式免训练、CPU 高效，在 ADBench 上匹配既有神经基线；KAR 在 ADBench 的坍缩易发数据集与三种 backbone 上缓解收敛坍缩，并在延长训练下提升 AUROC。
summary_sections.conclusion: 有效异常检测需要显式 locality 约束来阻止分布外外推，收敛坍缩是固定目标模板的结构性问题而非调参问题。

papers.title: Drive vs. Decay: On the Training Dynamics of Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures
papers.abstract_en: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) are prone to representation collapse, typically mitigated through empirical heuristics. We develop an early-training stability theory that unifies these heuristics. Linearising the coupled JEPA gradient flow around the trivial fixed point reveals two competing effects: a driving force ($γ$) and a decay effect ($σ$). Under approximate spectral decoupling, a per-mode stability ratio $μ_i = γ_i / σ_i$ factorises into independent data-side and predictor-side terms and the count of unstable modes tracks the rank of representations that can emerge. The framework predicts a phase boundary, which we confirm empirically across more than 800 Tabular-JEPA configurations. It also unifies predictor scaling, masking ratio, and EMA as distinct mechanisms for shifting $μ$. Guided by this analysis, we introduce ResidualPred, a transformer predictor whose attention is biased toward the identity at initialisation; it improves both effective rank and downstream accuracy on tabular benchmarks and in I-JEPA pretraining on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, STL-10, and ImageNet. Our framework connects empirical collapse-avoidance heuristics to an explicit dynamical picture, yielding theory-driven stabilizers. Code is available at https://github.com/jose-melo/drive-vs-decay.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Main Track). 57 pages, 10 pages of main text; appendices and the NeurIPS paper checklist included. Code: https://github.com/jose-melo/drive-vs-decay
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 JEPA 表示坍缩的早期训练稳定性写成线性化梯度流理论：驱动项 γ 与衰减项 σ 竞争，逐模态比值 μ_i=γ_i/σ_i 在近似谱解耦下分解为数据侧与预测器侧两部分，不稳定模态数决定可涌现的表示秩。相变边界在 800 多个 Tabular-JEPA 配置上得到验证，并统一解释 predictor scaling、masking ratio 与 EMA 三种启发式；据此提出的 ResidualPred（初始化时注意力偏向恒等映射）同时提升有效秩与下游精度。
Motivation: JEPA 的表示坍缩长期靠经验启发式缓解，缺少把 predictor scaling、masking ratio、EMA 统一起来的显式动力学解释，也无法预判何时会坍缩。
Method: 在平凡不动点附近线性化耦合 JEPA 梯度流，导出驱动 γ 与衰减 σ 两个竞争效应；近似谱解耦下逐模态稳定比 μ_i=γ_i/σ_i 分解为数据侧与预测器侧独立因子，由不稳定模态数刻画表示秩。基于该分析提出 ResidualPred：transformer 预测器在初始化时注意力偏向恒等映射。
Result: 理论预测的相变边界在超过 800 个 Tabular-JEPA 配置上被实证确认；框架把 predictor scaling、masking ratio、EMA 统一为移动 μ 的不同机制。ResidualPred 在 tabular 基准以及 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、STL-10 与 ImageNet 的 I-JEPA 预训练上同时改善有效秩与下游精度。
Conclusion: 经验性坍缩规避启发式可归结为一个显式动力学图景，理论驱动的稳定器（如初始化偏向恒等的预测器）能同时改善表示秩与下游表现。

papers.title: SCOPE-4D: Endoscopic 4D Geometry Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Geometric understanding supports endoscopic navigation and robotic assistance, but learning reliable endoscopic geometry faces two challenges: scarce geometric annotations and ambiguity between camera motion and tissue deformation. We present SCOPE-4D, an endoscopic 4D geometry foundation model that jointly predicts camera parameters, dense geometry, and 3D tissue trajectories from monocular RGB video in a single forward pass. Our curation and annotation pipeline constructs SCOPE-5K, a collection of approximately 5,000 clips spanning real and synthetic gastrointestinal endoscopy and laparoscopy. The collection provides rich geometric supervision and includes newly collected phantom and real-colonoscopy evaluation sets. Geometric supervised fine-tuning on SCOPE-5K learns endoscopic priors that improve camera and depth estimation. Common--Residual Motion (CRM) further constrains local deformation relative to common tissue movement. Together with geometric supervision, CRM and trajectory supervision further improve camera and depth estimation over geometric fine-tuning alone while enabling dense 3D tissue tracking. Evaluations on public and newly collected benchmarks demonstrate strong in-domain and out-of-domain geometry, superior 3D tracking, and more stable long-sequence colon reconstruction. A blinded user study further supports the perceived reconstruction quality on real clinical video. Together, these results demonstrate the value of large-scale endoscopic supervision and motion constraints for joint geometry estimation and tissue tracking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SCOPE-4D 是内窥镜 4D 几何基础模型，单次前向从单目 RGB 视频同时预测相机参数、稠密几何与 3D 组织轨迹。用约 5,000 条真实与合成胃肠内镜/腹腔镜片段构成的 SCOPE-5K 做几何监督微调，再叠加 Common–Residual Motion (CRM) 约束局部形变相对共同组织运动，相机与深度估计在几何微调基础上进一步改善，并获得稠密 3D 跟踪与更稳定的长序列结肠重建。
Motivation: 内窥镜几何学习受几何标注稀缺制约，且相机运动与组织形变在单目观测中互相混淆，难以同时恢复相机、深度与组织运动。
Method: 构建并标注 SCOPE-5K（约 5,000 条片段，覆盖真实与合成胃肠内镜和腹腔镜，含新采集的 phantom 与真实结肠镜评估集），在其上做几何监督微调学习内窥镜先验；再引入 Common–Residual Motion (CRM) 约束局部形变相对共同组织运动，并加入轨迹监督，联合输出相机参数、稠密几何与 3D 组织轨迹，单次前向完成。
Result: 在公开与新采集基准上展示强的 in-domain 与 out-of-domain 几何、更优的 3D 跟踪，以及更稳定的长序列结肠重建；CRM 加轨迹监督在几何微调之上进一步改善相机与深度估计并支持稠密 3D 组织跟踪；一项盲法用户研究支持真实临床视频上的重建质量感知更佳。
Conclusion: 大规模内窥镜监督加运动约束（CRM 与轨迹监督）能同时提升联合几何估计与组织跟踪，使单目内窥镜视频可在单次前向中输出相机、深度与 3D 轨迹。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: A Multi Method Importance and Performance Efficiency Analysis of Topological Metrics for Natural Visibility Graph Based Cyber Attack Detection
papers.abstract_en: Natural Visibility Graph (NVG) based analysis characterizes network traffic through topological descriptors reflecting different structural properties. However, not all descriptors contribute equally to cyber-attack classification, and extracting a large metric set can increase computational cost. This study evaluates 21 NVG derived topological metrics and investigates whether a compact subset can preserve classification capability while improving computational efficiency. Four importance analysis methods SHAP, grouped Permutation Importance, Boruta, and Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE) are integrated through a Consensus Ranking strategy. Based on this ranking, Full21, Top15, Top10, Top7, Top5, and Top3 configurations are evaluated using the CICIDS2018 dataset, a CNN classifier, and stratified 5 fold cross validation. The three highest ranked metrics are avg_clustering_coeff_median, avg_clustering_coeff_std, and avg_clustering_coeff_mean. Top3 achieved the highest observed mean performance, with 97.148% accuracy, 97.055% weighted F1 score, and an MCC of 0.9675, compared with 95.999%, 95.521%, and 0.9549 for Full21, respectively. It also reduced total runtime from 14,961.39 s to 589.22 s (96.06%). These results indicate that importance guided metric reduction can provide a compact NVG representation with higher observed mean predictive performance and substantially lower computational cost under the evaluated setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在网络流量的 Natural Visibility Graph (NVG) 表征上，用 SHAP、grouped Permutation Importance、Boruta、RFE 四种重要性方法的 Consensus Ranking 筛选 21 个拓扑指标，只保留前 3 个聚类系数类指标即可在 CICIDS2018 + CNN 上取得最高平均性能：准确率 97.148%、weighted F1 97.055%、MCC 0.9675，均高于 Full21 的 95.999%/95.521%/0.9549，总运行时间从 14,961.39 s 降到 589.22 s（降 96.06%）。
Motivation: NVG 拓扑描述符对攻击分类的贡献不均，提取大指标集会推高计算成本，需要判断紧凑子集能否保住分类能力。
Method: 评估 21 个 NVG 拓扑指标，用 SHAP、grouped Permutation Importance、Boruta、RFE 四种重要性分析经 Consensus Ranking 融合排序，据此构造 Full21、Top15、Top10、Top7、Top5、Top3 六种配置，在 CICIDS2018 上用 CNN 分类器与 stratified 5-fold 交叉验证评测。
Result: 排名前三的指标为 avg_clustering_coeff_median、avg_clustering_coeff_std、avg_clustering_coeff_mean。Top3 平均准确率 97.148%、weighted F1 97.055%、MCC 0.9675，对比 Full21 的 95.999%、95.521%、0.9549；总运行时间由 14,961.39 s 降至 589.22 s，减少 96.06%。
Conclusion: 在该评测设置下，重要性引导的指标裁剪能给出更紧凑的 NVG 表征，同时获得更高的观测平均预测性能与大幅更低的计算成本。

papers.title: NEEDLEWORK: Offline Rewriting of Robot Data with Verified Local Stitches
papers.abstract_en: Robot demonstrations may contain useful behavior even when individual episodes are inefficient or unsuccessful. Trajectory stitching offers a way to compose these behaviors into improved training data, but identifying useful connections and verifying their feasibility is difficult in high-dimensional robot data, where many prior methods rely on low-dimensional state representations. We introduce NEEDLE, an offline dataset-augmentation algorithm that addresses these challenges by adding short, verified action bridges between recorded observations in high-dimensional robot demonstrations. First, NEEDLE identifies and creates connections that bypass suboptimal detours, broaden action coverage, and augment the original dataset with failed trajectories, using only RGB images, proprioception, and episode-level outcomes, without new environment interaction or privileged object state. Next, we present a sampling technique that incorporates accepted bridges into policy training without synthesizing intermediate images or discarding the original demonstrations, allowing policies to learn alternative actions while retaining the original dataset's coverage. On real-robot tasks, NEEDLE improves success rate over the strongest baseline on each task by an average of 21 percentage points. Videos and supplementary materials are on https://needle-work.github.io/.
papers.comment: Submitted to ICLR 2027. Project page: https://needle-work.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NEEDLE 是面向机器人演示数据的离线数据增广算法：在高维观测之间插入经过验证的短动作桥 (action bridge)，绕开低效绕路并补入失败轨迹，再用采样技术把被接受的桥接进策略训练，全程只用 RGB 图像、本体感知和 episode 级结果、不与环境交互。在真实机器人任务上，相对每个任务最强基线平均提升 21 个百分点成功率。
Motivation: 机器人演示中单条 episode 可能低效或失败，轨迹拼接 (trajectory stitching) 能重组出更好的训练数据，但在高维机器人数据里识别有用连接并验证可行性很困难，既有方法多依赖低维状态表征。
Method: NEEDLE 在记录的观测之间生成并验证短动作桥，用于绕过次优绕路、扩大动作覆盖并把失败轨迹增广进数据集；输入仅限 RGB 图像、本体感知与 episode 级结果，不做新的环境交互、不用特权物体状态。随后用一种采样技术把被接受的桥纳入策略训练，既不合成中间图像也不丢弃原始演示。
Result: 在真实机器人任务上，NEEDLE 相对每个任务的最强基线平均提升 21 个百分点成功率。
Conclusion: 在高维机器人演示上，用经过验证的短动作桥做离线数据增广，可以在保留原始数据覆盖的同时让策略学到替代动作并提高成功率。

papers.title: SoTa: Soft Tactile Skins for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: A growing body of work suggests that tactile sensing gives robot policies contact information that complements vision in dexterous manipulation. However, visuo-tactile robot data remains scarce: dexterous demonstrations require teleoperating robots, which limits dataset scale. Human demonstrations are far cheaper to collect and offer a path to scale this data, but only if human and robot hands carry tactile sensors with corresponding signals. This requires sensors that conform to different hand geometries, cover the full hand, and share a common layout across embodiments. We present SoTa, a low-cost capacitive tactile skin that provides full-hand coverage on humans and robots while preserving a shared layout of 202 taxels across corresponding finger and palm regions. Our multilayer design with fabric electrodes enables in-house fabrication of thin, soft skins with customizable geometry for under $10 in materials per skin. The sensor retains over 97% of its initial response span after 10,000 loading-unloading cycles with traces retaining continuity through 1,280 tight-fist folding cycles. The shared taxel layout supports human-robot co-training with a common tactile encoder and no learned cross-sensor mapping. Across three contact-rich manipulation tasks, tactile observations improve in-distribution success over vision-only policies. With a fixed robot demonstration budget, adding human demonstrations more than doubles mean success across eight evaluation conditions, from 22.8% to 45.9%, improving success in all five out-of-distribution conditions. We plan to open-source the resources needed to fabricate and operate these skins.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SoTa 是一种低成本电容式柔性触觉皮肤，人手与机器人手全覆盖且共享 202 个 taxel 的对应布局，使人类示教与机器人示教可用同一触觉编码器直接 co-training、无需学习跨传感器映射。在三个接触密集操作任务上，触觉观测提升分布内成功率；固定机器人示教预算下加入人类示教使八个评测条件的平均成功率从 22.8% 升到 45.9%，五个分布外条件全部改善。
Motivation: 灵巧操作的视触觉数据稀缺：机器人示教依赖遥操作，难以扩大数据集规模，而人类示教要可用，前提是人手与机器人手的触觉传感器能贴合不同手型、全覆盖且布局对应。
Method: SoTa 用织物电极的多层设计，在内部制造薄软、几何可定制的电容式触觉皮肤，材料成本每片低于 10 美元；人手与机器人手在对应手指和手掌区域保持共享的 202 taxel 布局，co-training 时共用一个触觉编码器，不做跨传感器映射学习。
Result: 传感器在 10,000 次加载-卸载循环后保留超过 97% 的初始响应范围，导线在 1,280 次紧握拳折叠循环后保持导通。在三个接触密集操作任务上，触觉观测相对纯视觉策略提升分布内成功率；固定机器人示教预算下加入人类示教，八个评测条件的平均成功率从 22.8% 提高到 45.9%（翻倍以上），五个分布外条件的成功率全部提升。
Conclusion: 共享 taxel 布局让人类示教成为机器人触觉数据的可扩展来源：在机器人示教预算固定时，加入人类示教能同时抬高分布内与分布外成功率。作者计划开源制造与运行这些皮肤所需的资源。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Joint Movement and Compression Ratio Design for Mobile Embodied AI Networks (MEAN)
papers.abstract_en: Mobile embodied AI networks (MEAN) enable embodied agents to perceive, reason, communicate, and act in wireless environments. In such networks, agent mobility can improve channel conditions, while semantic compression can reduce transmission payloads. However, movement consumes energy, and stronger compression incurs additional computational cost. This paper studies joint movement, semantic compression, and transmit power design for an uplink MEAN system. We formulate a max-min energy efficiency (EE) problem by jointly optimizing transmit power, movement distance, and semantic compression ratio under controllable power constraints. The problem is non-convex due to the coupled signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR), mobility-dependent channel gains, and fractional EE objective. To solve it, we propose an alternating optimization (AO)-Dinkelbach algorithm, where the fractional objective is handled by the Dinkelbach transformation, transmit power is updated via successive convex approximation (SCA), and movement distance is updated by coordinate-wise grid search. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme outperforms no-mobility and no-compression baselines, demonstrating the benefit of jointly exploiting mobility control, semantic compression, and power allocation in MEAN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在移动具身 AI 网络 (MEAN) 上行链路中，联合优化发射功率、移动距离与语义压缩比可提升最大最小能效 (EE)：移动改善信道但耗能，压缩减小载荷但增加计算开销，两者需在功率约束下折中。所提 AO-Dinkelbach 方案在仿真中优于无移动与无压缩基线。
Motivation: MEAN 中移动改善信道却消耗能量，语义压缩降低传输载荷却带来计算开销，单独优化任一项都会在能效上失衡，需要在可控功率约束下联合设计。
Method: 建立上行 MEAN 的最大最小能效优化问题，联合优化发射功率、移动距离与语义压缩比；用 Dinkelbach 变换处理分式目标，SCA 更新发射功率，坐标网格搜索更新移动距离，构成交替优化 (AO)-Dinkelbach 算法。
Result: 仿真结果显示所提方案在能效上优于无移动 (no-mobility) 与无压缩 (no-compression) 两个基线，验证了联合利用移动控制、语义压缩与功率分配的收益。
Conclusion: 移动控制、语义压缩与功率分配必须联合优化才能在 MEAN 上行链路中取得更高能效，单独依赖移动或压缩都不划算。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: World Editing: Intervening on Executable Worlds at Increasing Depth
papers.abstract_en: Interactive world models are increasingly capable of generating environments and acting within them, yet deliberately editing an existing executable world remains underexplored. We formulate world editing as intervening on an existing world while preserving properties that should remain unchanged, and introduce intervention depth as an axis describing how strongly an edit couples world entities, dynamics, and systems. We instantiate this capability through industry-grade game modding and introduce IGMWorld, together with IGMBench, a benchmark of 110 tasks and over 1.1K executable state and behavioral criteria across Minecraft and Terraria. The tasks span property, entity, dynamics, and system interventions and are evaluated through deterministic executability, behavioral, preservation, and visual checks. Frontier coding agents already exhibit substantial world-editing capability: the strongest configuration solves 78.2% of tasks under a strict task-level criterion, while criterion-level performance reaches 94.8%. Reliability generally decreases with intervention depth, and this pattern persists even among tasks with similar numbers of evaluation criteria. Most failed edits still build and load successfully, suggesting that the main difficulty is making the edited world behave as requested. Visual consistency remains a separate weakness, with all evaluated configurations below 50% joint visual pass rate. These results show that world editing is a distinct capability from world generation and interaction, and that executable games provide a practical testbed for studying it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把可执行游戏世界的编辑形式化为带保持约束的干预，并按干预深度 (intervention depth) 划分实体、动力学与系统的耦合强度；提出 IGMWorld 与 IGMBench（110 个任务、1.1K+ 条可执行状态与行为判据，覆盖 Minecraft 与 Terraria）。最强 coding agent 配置在严格任务级标准下解出 78.2%、判据级 94.8%，但性能随干预深度增加而下降，且所有配置的联合视觉通过率低于 50%。
Motivation: 交互式世界模型擅长生成环境与在其中行动，但对既有可执行世界做有意编辑这一能力缺乏形式化定义与评测基准。
Method: 将 world editing 定义为在保持应不变性质的前提下干预既有世界，并提出干预深度作为刻画编辑耦合实体、动力学与系统强度的轴；以工业级游戏 modding 实例化，构建 IGMBench，用确定性可执行性、行为、保持与视觉四类检查评测 coding agent。
Result: IGMBench 含 110 个任务与超过 1.1K 条可执行状态/行为判据，跨 Minecraft 与 Terraria；最强配置任务级严格标准解出 78.2%，判据级 94.8%；可靠性随干预深度增加而下降，且在评价判据数量相近的任务中该模式依然成立；多数失败编辑仍能成功构建与加载；所有被评测配置的联合视觉通过率低于 50%。
Conclusion: 世界编辑是与世界生成、世界交互不同的独立能力，其主要难点在于让编辑后的世界按要求表现而非通过构建加载，视觉一致性是单独的短板；可执行游戏可作为研究该能力的实用测试床。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Choosing Before Acting: Comparative Value Estimation for Long-Horizon Tool-Use Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) rely on long-horizon tool invocation sequences for complex tasks, where each invocation can alter the task state and condition subsequent decisions. In long-horizon tool use, final-outcome rewards provide weak credit assignment over long interaction traces. Step-level rewards can offer more targeted feedback, but obtaining reliable step supervision often requires human or LLM judgment, or additional rollouts to estimate the downstream effect of an intermediate decision. In this paper, we argue that effective tool-use agents should estimate the long-horizon value of a possible next tool invocation before executing it. This objective requires comparative supervision over alternative invocations under the same context, while logged trajectories only contain the invocation that was actually taken. Therefore, we propose Comparative Inference for Tool-use Agents (CITA). CITA trains a Comparative Inference Model (CIM) from paired signals that combine observed tool behavior, scalable supervision from a Bayesian tool-graph simulator, and semantic judgments from LLM-based comparison. The resulting CIM learns to estimate how likely a possible next tool invocation is to support final task success under the current context. Across three tool-use benchmarks and multiple backbone LLMs, CITA consistently improves Tool F1 and task success. Additional analysis shows that CIM learns accurate step-level value estimates for comparative tool choices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CITA 让工具调用 agent 在执行前先比较候选下一步的长期价值：用成对信号训练 Comparative Inference Model (CIM)，估计每个候选调用在当前上下文下支撑最终任务成功的可能性。在三个工具使用 benchmark 与多个 backbone LLM 上，CITA 一致提升 Tool F1 与任务成功率。
Motivation: 长程工具调用里最终结果奖励对长交互轨迹的信用分配太弱，而步级监督需要人工/LLM 判断或额外 rollout；日志轨迹又只含实际执行的那一步，缺少对同一上下文下备选调用的比较监督。
Method: 提出 Comparative Inference for Tool-use Agents (CITA)，训练 Comparative Inference Model (CIM)：输入来自观测到的工具行为、Bayesian tool-graph simulator 提供的可扩展监督，以及 LLM-based comparison 给出的语义判断，三者合成的成对 (paired) 信号作为训练目标。
Result: 在三个 tool-use benchmark 和多个 backbone LLM 上，CITA 一致提升 Tool F1 与 task success；附加分析显示 CIM 学到的步级价值估计对比较式工具选择是准确的。
Conclusion: 在执行前对候选下一步做比较式价值估计，比只靠最终结果奖励或事后步级监督更能支撑长程工具调用决策。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Slow-Fast Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Capability Preservation
papers.abstract_en: Foundation multimodal large language models are designed to support a broad spectrum of capabilities across diverse domains. Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) provides an effective framework for consolidating domain-specific expertise into a single student model. However, MOPD training gradually drives the student away from its initialization model, and general capabilities decline as the displacement grows, resulting in capability interference. A direct remedy is constraining the student toward its initialization, but this suppresses the acquisition of domain expertise as well. We propose Slow-Fast Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (SF-MOPD), which couples a fast model, the current student updated directly by each teacher, with a slow model, an exponential moving average of the student. The slow model absorbs the learning signal gradually, serving as a moving capability reference that fuses the general foundation with confirmed domain expertise. For each teacher, SF-MOPD computes the teacher-induced update in log-probability space and removes only the component that pushes the fast model further away from the slow model, while retaining aligned and orthogonal components. Experiments across multiple model scales demonstrate that SF-MOPD effectively mitigates capability interference, enhances specialized multimodal capabilities, and reduces the average degradation on general-capability benchmarks, consistently outperforming vanilla MOPD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多教师在线蒸馏 (MOPD) 训练会让学生逐渐偏离初始化模型、通用能力随之下降。SF-MOPD 用 EMA 慢模型作移动能力参照，对每个教师在 log-probability 空间计算更新，只剔除把快模型推离慢模型的分量、保留对齐与正交分量，从而在保住通用能力的同时吸收领域专长，多个模型规模上平均通用能力退化低于 vanilla MOPD。
Motivation: MOPD 把领域专长整合进单一学生模型时，学生随位移增大而偏离初始化，通用能力下降形成 capability interference；直接把学生约束回初始化又会同时压制领域专长的获取。
Method: SF-MOPD 耦合快慢两个模型：快模型由各教师直接更新，慢模型是学生的指数滑动平均 (EMA)，作为融合通用基础与已确认领域专长的移动能力参照。对每个教师，在 log-probability 空间计算其诱导的更新，只移除把快模型进一步推离慢模型的分量，保留对齐分量与正交分量。
Result: 在多个模型规模上的实验中，SF-MOPD 缓解了 capability interference、提升了多模态领域能力，并降低了通用能力 benchmark 上的平均退化，持续优于 vanilla MOPD。
Conclusion: 以 EMA 慢模型为参照、按与慢模型的方向分解并选择性剔除教师更新，可以在不牺牲领域专长的前提下抑制通用能力退化，优于直接约束学生靠近初始化的做法。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: World-Calibrated Proposal-to-Action Flow for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Flow-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies generate action chunks by transporting samples from a task-agnostic isotropic Gaussian source. As this source is conditioned on neither recent execution nor predicted future evolution, (i) it discards the local continuity established by recently executed motion. (ii) Even when predictive world representations are introduced, they often only condition the transport dynamics rather than determine where generation starts, how far it may deviate, or along which action directions it may expand. Building on this observation, we introduce ProAct, a world-calibrated proposal-to-action framework that makes the generative source itself predictable. (i) To preserve motion continuity, a lightweight Proposal Expert converts recent actions into a scene-aware hypothesis via one motion-anchored endpoint flow-matching step, initializing generation near the demonstrated action manifold. (ii) To jointly capture intended scene evolution and proposal-future compatibility, a prospective World Expert treats the hypothesis as a soft motion prior while predicting the task-consistent latent future. (iii) From this compatibility, the model calibrates a proposal-centered anisotropic source, where a bounded per-step extent controls the allowed deviation and a trace-normalized low-rank geometry under a condition-number budget allocates refinement over coupled translation, rotation, and gripper directions. Compared with $π_{0.5}$, ProAct improves performance across simulation and real-world tasks while reducing denoising steps by 50%, inference latency by up to 25.8%, and increasing throughput by up to 34.8%.

papers.title: SCION: Scene Composition with Instanced Neural Primitives
papers.abstract_en: Real-world scenes are compositional: bricks, blades of grass, pebbles, and tree leaves recur across human-built and natural environments. Existing neural scene representations model these elements independently. Most 3D Gaussian Splatting and follow-up abstraction and compression methods treat each element as unique, fitting millions of independent Gaussians per scene. Prior methods like Splat and Replace fit template objects, but they require mostly manual selection of repeated elements. As a result, these representations store redundant parameters and provide weak manipulation handles for downstream tasks. We introduce SCION, a hier- archical compositional scene representation that replaces independent Gaussians with a compact vocabulary of reusable primitives and lightweight world-space instances that place transformed copies throughout the scene. We fit this represen- tation to multi-view captures via a joint optimization over discrete and continuous scene parameters, combining two-level densification over splats and instances with an adversarial loss that preserves detail across shared primitives. The recovered structure yields a compact, controllable representation while maintaining high quality even at 1.2 MB. SCION achieves rate-distortion favorable to existing Gaussian compression methods, and it enables instance-level scene editing and animation without retraining. Our results show that neural scene representations need not memorize scenes as independent primitives; they can discover reusable parts. Project webpage: https://light.princeton.edu/SCION
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SCION 用可复用基元词表加世界空间实例替换逐元素独立的 3D Gaussian，通过离散与连续参数的联合优化从多视角拍摄中恢复场景。在 1.2 MB 体积下仍保持高质量，率失真优于现有 Gaussian 压缩方法，并支持无需重训的实例级编辑与动画。
Motivation: 现有 3D Gaussian Splatting 及其压缩方法把每个重复元素当作独立个体，单场景拟合数百万个 Gaussian，参数冗余且缺少可操控的下游编辑接口；Splat and Replace 一类模板方法又依赖人工挑选重复元素。
Method: SCION 提出分层组合场景表示：用紧凑的可复用基元 (primitives) 词表替代独立 Gaussian，配合轻量世界空间实例放置变换副本；对多视角拍摄做离散与连续场景参数的联合优化，结合 splats 与 instances 两级 densification，以及一个保护共享基元细节的 adversarial loss。
Result: 在 1.2 MB 的紧凑体积下保持高质量，率失真 (rate-distortion) 优于现有 Gaussian 压缩方法；恢复的结构支持无需重训的实例级场景编辑与动画。
Conclusion: 神经场景表示不必把场景记忆成彼此独立的基元，可以自行发现可复用部件，同时得到更紧凑、可控的表示。

papers.title: DeskForge: Dense Supervision from Desktop Environments for Computer-Use Agents
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents need to reliably ground action targets in complex desktop scenes, where multiple applications, overlapping windows, and visually similar controls compete for attention. Existing training data rarely pair such scenes with dense annotations or vary them in a controlled way. We introduce DeskForge, a controllable desktop environment that composes and explores real applications to generate large-scale supervision for computer-use agents. It varies application states, content, window layout, appearance, and resolution, and fuses screenshots, accessibility trees, and window geometry into dense element annotations while recording the outcome of each executed action. Using this environment, we construct DeskForge-1M, a corpus of 1.2M annotated desktop observations containing 159.7M element instances. We fine-tune four vision-language models on 200K grounding examples drawn from DeskForge-1M. All four improve across held-out desktop conditions and on all five external GUI grounding benchmarks; for Qwen3.5-4B, accuracy increases by 11.51 percentage points on ScreenSpot-Pro and 10.11 points on OSWorld-G. The gains also translate to long-horizon task completion: under a fixed planner, the fine-tuned action models solve more WebArena-Infinity and OpenApps tasks, with Qwen3.5-4B increasing from 31 to 50 of 119 tasks and from 3 to 15 of 100 tasks, respectively. These results show that controllable composition of real desktop environments provides a scalable source of supervision for improving both GUI grounding and long-horizon computer use. The framework code, the dataset, and the fine-tuned model are available from the project page: https://saidgurbuz.github.io/deskforge/
papers.comment: 37 pages, 15 figures, 12 tables. Project page: https://saidgurbuz.github.io/deskforge/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeskForge 用可控桌面环境组合真实应用，把截图、无障碍树与窗口几何融合成稠密元素标注，产出 1.2M 观测、159.7M 元素实例的 DeskForge-1M。用其中 200K grounding 样本微调四个 VLM 后，Qwen3.5-4B 在 ScreenSpot-Pro 上准确率提升 11.51 个百分点、OSWorld-G 提升 10.11 点，长程任务从 31/119 增至 50/119。
Motivation: computer-use agent 需要在多应用、窗口重叠、控件视觉相似的复杂桌面场景中定位动作目标，但现有训练数据很少配稠密标注，也无法受控地改变场景条件。
Method: 可控桌面环境 DeskForge 组合并探索真实应用，变化应用状态、内容、窗口布局、外观与分辨率，把截图、accessibility tree 和窗口几何融合为稠密元素标注，同时记录每个已执行动作的结果；再用 DeskForge-1M 中 200K grounding 样本微调四个 vision-language model。
Result: DeskForge-1M 含 1.2M 标注桌面观测、159.7M 元素实例。四个 VLM 在留出桌面条件与全部五个外部 GUI grounding benchmark 上均提升；Qwen3.5-4B 在 ScreenSpot-Pro 准确率 +11.51 个百分点、OSWorld-G +10.11 点。固定 planner 下微调动作模型解出更多任务：WebArena-Infinity 从 31/119 升到 50/119，OpenApps 从 3/100 升到 15/100。
Conclusion: 可控地组合真实桌面环境可作为可扩展的监督来源，同时改善 GUI grounding 与长程 computer use；框架代码、数据集与微调模型随项目页发布。

papers.title: SimuVerity: Benchmarking Agents for Engineering-Grade Simulink Model Generation
papers.abstract_en: Existing Simulink benchmarks mainly evaluate whether generated models compile, execute, or resemble a reference model. These criteria do not establish whether a model satisfies its engineering requirements. We introduce SimuVerity, a benchmark of 101 text-to-executable Simulink model-generation tasks across ten engineering domains. For each task, executable-system profiles ground the engineering specification and four families of native simulation scenarios. A hierarchical evaluator first checks artifact delivery, native executability, and engineering qualification, then scores qualified models across six dimensions covering accuracy, output quality, mechanistic fidelity, control and causal integrity, operating-domain robustness, and dynamic response. We evaluate six agent systems with SimuVerity. The best system achieves an overall score of only 42.86. The results show that structural similarity is a poor proxy for engineering performance: capability bottlenecks arise both in producing qualified implementations and in satisfying multidimensional requirements after qualification. Meanwhile, some high-scoring models still exhibit severe visual-layout disorder. SimuVerity provides a systematic basis for assessing agents' engineering capabilities and diagnosing failures in executable Simulink model generation.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 12 figures. Code and data are available at https://github.com/SimuVerity/SimuVerity
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SimuVerity 提出 101 个文本到可执行 Simulink 模型生成任务、覆盖十个工程领域的基准，用分层评估器先查交付与原生可执行性、再按六个工程维度打分。评测六个 agent 系统后最佳总分仅 42.86，说明结构相似度无法代表工程性能，瓶颈同时出在产出合格实现和合格后满足多维要求两处。
Motivation: 现有 Simulink 基准只看模型能否编译、执行或与参考模型相似，无法判定模型是否满足工程需求，agent 的真实工程能力无从度量。
Method: 每个任务用 executable-system profiles 锚定工程规格并给出四类原生仿真场景；分层评估器先检查 artifact 交付、原生可执行性与工程合格性，再对合格模型按 accuracy、output quality、mechanistic fidelity、control and causal integrity、operating-domain robustness、dynamic response 六维打分；用该基准评测六个 agent 系统。
Result: 基准含 101 个任务、十个工程领域；六个受评 agent 中最佳系统总分仅 42.86；部分高分模型仍存在严重的视觉布局混乱。
Conclusion: 结构相似度是工程性能的差代理，评估 agent 必须同时覆盖合格实现的产出能力和合格后的多维需求满足能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PowerBench: Measuring Language Model Bias in Power-shifting Requests
papers.abstract_en: Language models increasingly assist people with power-related requests, so systematic differences in whom they help could shift the distribution of power at scale, or be exploited by users who learn which identities are refused less. We introduce PowerBench, an evaluation of power-shifting requests that distinguishes self-empowerment, disempowerment, and power grabbing, plus a control of refusal-inducing requests that shift no power. We build, curate, and open-source a dataset of such requests varying the power domain, the context, the scale of the affected party, and the prior power standing of the user, and evaluate 24 models (12 from US and 12 from Chinese developers) under three experimental conditions: reciprocal nationalities of user and affected party, an AI agent as the user, and 8 request languages. Models refuse power grabbing more than disempowerment, and disempowerment more than self-empowerment. Refusal of power grabbing rises with the scale of the affected party, from an individual to a society. Models are biased toward helping others take power from the US and against helping US users take power from others, but favor the US when it gains power and nobody loses it. When the user is an AI agent, refusal of power-shifting requests increases, especially in power grabbing against an individual. Finally, language biases refusal, but in model-specific ways that largely cancel on average. We release PowerBench to make these asymmetries measurable in current and future models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PowerBench 把「权力转移类请求」拆成自我赋权、去权与夺权三类并配一个不转移权力的拒答对照，开源数据集在权力领域、情境、受影响方规模与用户既有地位上变化，评测 24 个模型（美中各 12）在用户与受影响方国籍互换、AI agent 作为用户、8 种请求语言三种条件下。模型对夺权的拒答高于去权、去权高于自我赋权，且夺权拒答随受影响方从个人扩大到社会而上升。
Motivation: 语言模型在权力相关请求上对不同身份的协助差异会在规模上改变权力分布，或被用户利用来试探哪些身份更少被拒；此前缺少能区分自我赋权、去权与夺权的系统评测。
Method: 构建并开源 PowerBench 数据集，按权力领域、情境、受影响方规模、用户既有地位变化生成请求，含不转移权力的拒答对照；评测 24 个模型（美国与中国开发者各 12 个），三种实验条件为用户与受影响方国籍互换、AI agent 充当用户、8 种请求语言。
Result: 夺权拒答 > 去权拒答 > 自我赋权拒答；夺权拒答随受影响方规模（个人到社会）上升。模型偏向帮助他人从美国夺权、反对帮助美国用户从他处夺权，但在美国获益且无人受损时偏向美国。AI agent 作用户时权力转移请求拒答上升，对个人的夺权尤其明显；语言影响拒答但呈模型特异性，平均上大体相互抵消。
Conclusion: 当前模型在权力转移请求上存在可测的系统性不对称：拒答随夺权程度与受影响方规模递增，并带有国籍方向性偏置与 AI agent 用户效应，PowerBench 用于在现有与未来模型上量化这些不对称。

summary_sections.result: 夺权拒答 > 去权拒答 > 自我赋权拒答；夺权拒答随受影响方规模（个人到社会）上升。模型偏向帮助他人从美国夺权、反对帮助美国用户从他处夺权，但在美国获益且无人受损时偏向美国。AI agent 作用户时权力转移请求拒答上升，对个人的夺权尤其明显；语言影响拒答但呈模型特异性，平均上大体相互抵消。
summary_sections.conclusion: 当前模型在权力转移请求上存在可测的系统性不对称：拒答随夺权程度与受影响方规模递增，并带有国籍方向性偏置与 AI agent 用户效应，PowerBench 用于在现有与未来模型上量化这些不对称。

papers.title: Intent-Hiding Jailbreaks: An Information-Theoretic Framework for Compositional Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Recent work has shown that large language models (LLMs) can be vulnerable to jailbreak attacks in which harmful intent is obscured through composition with benign tasks. A harmful request refused in isolation may elicit a different response when embedded within a larger, seemingly benign query. We study these compositional intent-hiding jailbreaks from an information-theoretic perspective. Our formulation associates each task with an estimated probability of being judged harmful: the average over the full task collection defines the prior probability of harmful intent, while the average over a selected bundle containing the target defines the posterior. Selecting auxiliary tasks so that these averages agree, which we call prior-posterior matching, leaves the estimated intent unchanged even though the harmful target remains in the bundle. We study two settings that differ in whether query construction is part of the optimization. In the query-independent setting, tasks are selected without regard to how they will be expressed in the final query. We show that exact prior-posterior matching under a bundle-size constraint is computationally hard, derive an optimal water-filling solution for fractional weights, and characterize the smallest bundle satisfying a prescribed safety threshold. In the query-dependent setting, task selection and query construction are considered jointly, and intent concealment and target preservation are evaluated on the resulting query. We evaluate jailbreak effectiveness and preservation of the target behavior across bundle sizes, query generators, and several open-source models. These results show that compositional queries can elicit target behaviors beyond the direct-request baseline under the evaluated search budgets, while revealing a trade-off: as bundle size increases, response-level target preservation tends to decrease for several models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把组合式意图隐藏越狱 (compositional intent-hiding jailbreak) 形式化为信息论问题：用任务集合上被判为有害的平均概率作先验、含目标任务的子包平均作后验，通过先验-后验匹配 (prior-posterior matching) 让估计意图不变而有害目标仍在包内。在给定搜索预算下组合查询能诱出超出直接请求基线的目标行为，但随 bundle 增大多个模型的响应级目标保持度下降。
Motivation: 单独会被拒绝的有害请求嵌进更大的看似无害查询后可能得到不同回答，这类组合越狱缺少可计算的形式化，其计算复杂度与安全阈值下的最小包大小均未知。
Method: 将每个任务关联一个被判有害的概率估计，以全集均值为先验、含目标的选中 bundle 均值为后验；分 query-independent（选任务时不看最终表述）与 query-dependent（任务选择与查询构造联合优化）两种设定。前者证明在 bundle 大小约束下精确先验-后验匹配计算困难，对分数权重给出最优 water-filling 解，并刻画满足给定安全阈值的最小 bundle；后者在生成的查询上评估意图隐蔽与目标保持。
Result: 在多个开源模型、不同 bundle 大小与 query generator 上评估：所评估搜索预算内组合查询诱出的目标行为超出直接请求基线；同时存在权衡，bundle 增大时若干模型的响应级目标保持度趋于下降。
Conclusion: 先验-后验匹配可让有害意图在估计层面保持不变，但隐蔽性与目标保持度随 bundle 增大相互制约，安全阈值下的最小 bundle 大小是判定越狱可行性的关键量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Keep It CALM: Analyzing the Limits of Global Unsafety in Text-to-Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Training-free safeguards for text-to-image generation often rely on a reusable safety signal, such as an unsafe direction or global toxic subspace, applied broadly across prompts. We provide a controlled geometric analysis of this global-unsafety assumption and reveal a consistent coverage-selectivity trade-off: compact unsafe subspaces fail to cover heterogeneous unsafe semantics, whereas broader aggregation increasingly distorts safety-adjacent benign prompts. Motivated by this finding, we propose CALM (Counterfactual Adaptive Local Modulation), a training-free safeguard that replaces uniform global removal with prompt-local counterfactual correction. Using matched unsafe-benign anchors, CALM routes each prompt to active unsafe categories, minimally edits only violating token representations toward the safe side, and suppresses positively aligned unsafe residual components. Across broad evaluation, CALM significantly improves unsafe content suppression while preserving benign utility, demonstrating that local counterfactual correction provides a more selective alternative to global unsafe signal removal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CALM 用 prompt 局部的反事实修正取代全局统一移除不安全方向：借助匹配的 unsafe-benign anchors 把每个 prompt 路由到活跃不安全类别，只对违规 token 表示做最小向安全侧的编辑，并抑制正对齐的不安全残差分量。在广泛评测中它显著提升不安全内容抑制，同时保住良性效用，说明局部反事实修正是比全局移除更具选择性的免训练安全方案。
Motivation: 免训练文生图安全机制普遍复用一个全局不安全信号（unsafe direction 或 global toxic subspace），但紧凑子空间覆盖不了异质的不安全语义，扩大聚合又会扭曲安全相邻的良性 prompt。
Method: 提出 CALM (Counterfactual Adaptive Local Modulation)：用匹配的 unsafe-benign anchors 建立参照，按 prompt 路由到活跃不安全类别，仅对违规 token 表示做最小的安全侧编辑，并抑制正对齐的不安全残差分量，全程免训练。
Result: 在广泛评测中，CALM 显著提升 unsafe content suppression，同时保持 benign utility；几何分析给出一致的 coverage-selectivity 权衡：紧凑 unsafe 子空间覆盖不足，更宽的聚合会扭曲安全相邻的良性 prompt。
Conclusion: 全局不安全信号移除存在覆盖与选择性的固有权衡，按 prompt 局部做反事实修正是更选择性的替代路径。

papers.title: $Ψ$-Resilience: Model-Free Feature Importance from 1D Topological Signals
papers.abstract_en: We introduce $Ψ$-Resilience, a model-free feature importance method that derives explanations directly from the data itself via 1D topological signals. Our method constructs a class-disagreement landscape by estimating class-conditional densities and taking their pointwise absolute difference along the feature axis. Then, the 0-dimensional persistence of this 1D signal defines a resilience functional that aggregates only those topological features that survive perturbations up to a robustness scale which is set by the user. This gives us a context-robust importance score that is inherently auditable via the underlying 1D landscapes and their persistence. We evaluate our method on both synthetic and real datasets. On synthetic generators with specified ground-truth importance, $Ψ$-Resilience recovers the ranking of features with high fidelity, achieving Spearman rank correlations up to 0.8 and performing competitively with multiple feature importance methods, including SHAP and mutual information. On real datasets with no known ground truth, our technique agrees with these methods, with correlations up to 0.9. These results show that $Ψ$-Resilience is a stable explanation method that enables rigorous, distribution-level auditing of feature importance without relying on a predictive model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Ψ-Resilience 是一种不依赖预测模型的特征重要性方法：沿特征轴估计类条件密度并取逐点绝对差，得到一维 class-disagreement landscape，再用该信号的 0 维持久同调定义只聚合在用户设定鲁棒尺度下扰动后仍存活的拓扑特征的 resilience functional。在含真值重要性的合成生成器上，特征排序的 Spearman 相关最高达 0.8，与 SHAP、互信息等方法相当；在无真值的真实数据集上与这些方法的相关最高达 0.9。
Motivation: 多数特征重要性方法依赖训练好的预测模型，解释与模型耦合，难以对分布层面做可审计的核验；需要一种直接从数据本身出发、可由一维景观与持久性直接审查的重要性度量。
Method: 沿特征轴估计类条件密度并取逐点绝对差，构造 class-disagreement 一维信号；对该信号取 0 维持久同调 (0-dimensional persistence)，得到只聚合在用户设定鲁棒尺度 (robustness scale) 下经受住扰动的拓扑特征的 resilience functional，输出 context-robust 重要性分数，全程不训练预测模型。
Result: 在带指定真值重要性的合成生成器上，特征排序恢复的 Spearman 相关最高达 0.8，并与包括 SHAP 和 mutual information 在内的多种特征重要性方法表现相当；在无已知真值的真实数据集上，与这些方法的相关最高达 0.9。
Conclusion: 仅凭一维拓扑信号与持久性即可给出稳定、可审计的特征重要性，无需依赖预测模型，并能在合成与真实数据上与 SHAP、互信息等主流方法对齐。

papers.title: EditHero: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Part-Level 3D Editing and Vibe Modeling
papers.abstract_en: 3D editing methods are usually tested on a single edit, yet an asset is built through a long sequence of revisions, each of which must implement the requested change while leaving everything else unchanged. We introduce EditHero, to our knowledge the first benchmark for long-horizon, part-level 3D editing, with natural-language instructions and target images for both geometry and texture. A deterministic assembly engine produces the exact target after every edit, and every sequence is reviewed by hand. We use EditHero to compare 2 opposite approaches to 3D editing. Non-agentic methods operate top down, regenerating the object from a learned 3D representation and inferring what to keep. In contrast, LLM/VLM agents operate bottom up, editing through code that inspects the mesh and rewrites only the parts required by instructions. The non-agentic methods often miss the requested change and disturb regions that should stay fixed. Most LLMs follow instructions more closely, and all of them preserve the unedited parts better, but each of their edits takes minutes. We will release the engine and the edit sequences to support research on reliable iterative 3D editing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EditHero 是首个长时程、部件级 3D 编辑基准：用自然语言指令加目标图像驱动连续多次几何与纹理编辑，由确定性装配引擎在每次编辑后生成精确目标并人工复核。对比两类路线，非 agentic 的自顶向下方法常漏掉要求的改动并破坏本应不变的区域；LLM/VLM agent 自底向上改写网格代码，指令遵循与未编辑区域保持都更好，但每次编辑耗时数分钟。
Motivation: 现有 3D 编辑方法几乎只测单次编辑，而真实资产靠长串修订建成，每次既要落实新改动又要保持其余部分不变，缺少能检验这种长时程部件级一致性的评测。
Method: 构建带自然语言指令与目标图像的几何+纹理编辑序列基准，用确定性装配引擎在每次编辑后产出精确目标，序列逐条人工审核；据此对比两类方法：非 agentic 的自顶向下表示再生成，与 LLM/VLM agent 自底向上检查 mesh、按指令改写对应部件代码。
Result: 非 agentic 方法常漏掉请求的改动并扰动应保持不变的区域；多数 LLM 指令遵循更好，全部 LLM 对未编辑部分的保持优于非 agentic 方法，但每次编辑耗时数分钟。
Conclusion: 长时程部件级编辑中，自底向上的 LLM/VLM 代码编辑在指令遵循与区域保持上胜过表示再生成，代价是每次编辑数分钟；作者将开源装配引擎与编辑序列。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Diffusion-Based Synthetic Data Pretraining for Enhancing Activity Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Human activity recognition (HAR) is increasingly important for healthcare, well-being, and daily monitoring ap- plications, for which detecting alimentary activities such as eating and drinking can provide actionable insight into dietary habits and chronic disease management. HAR systems, however, often underperform on subtle and underrepresented classes, limiting their utility in real-world dietary monitoring. This work builds upon CABiGRU, a convolutional architecture with Bidirectional GRU layers, multi-head attention, and residual connections, designed to capture discriminative temporal patterns from smart- watch accelerometer, gyroscope, and magnetometer data. To improve CaBiGRU's generalization and reduce underfitting in the minority class, we leverage synthetic sensor data windows using a diffusion model and adopt a two-stage training strategy: pre-training CABiGRU on synthetic data, followed by fine-tuning on the real-world data. On the DEO (drinking/eating/other) dataset, the proposed pipeline achieves a balanced accuracy of 90.6%, improving over a strong supervised baseline and showing the benefits of diffusion-based synthetic pre-training for recognizing alimentary activities and representing a step forward dealing with unbalanced classes. These results suggest that combining diffusion-generated data with targeted fine-tuning enhances robust recognition of dietary behaviors, supporting more reliable deployment in healthcare and nutrition-monitoring settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用扩散模型生成传感器数据窗口，先在合成数据上预训练 CABiGRU（卷积 + 双向 GRU + 多头注意力 + 残差），再在真实数据上微调，以缓解饮食类少数类欠拟合。在 DEO（drinking/eating/other）数据集上该两阶段流程取得 90.6% balanced accuracy，优于强监督基线。
Motivation: HAR 在细微且样本稀少的类别上表现差，饮食相关动作（吃、喝）的识别因此不可靠，限制了其在真实饮食监测中的可用性。
Method: 以 CABiGRU 为骨干（卷积层、双向 GRU、多头注意力、残差连接，输入智能手表加速度计、陀螺仪、磁力计序列），用扩散模型合成传感器数据窗口，采用两阶段训练：先在合成数据上预训练，再在真实数据上微调。
Result: 在 DEO（drinking/eating/other）数据集上，该流程取得 90.6% balanced accuracy，超过一个强监督基线。
Conclusion: 扩散生成数据配合定向微调能提升少数饮食类的识别稳健性，是处理类别不平衡、支持医疗与营养监测部署的一条路径。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 以 CABiGRU 为骨干（卷积层、双向 GRU、多头注意力、残差连接，输入智能手表加速度计、陀螺仪、磁力计序列），用扩散模型合成传感器数据窗口，采用两阶段训练：先在合成数据上预训练，再在真实数据上微调。
summary_sections.result: 在 DEO（drinking/eating/other）数据集上，该流程取得 90.6% balanced accuracy，超过一个强监督基线。
summary_sections.conclusion: 扩散生成数据配合定向微调能提升少数饮食类的识别稳健性，是处理类别不平衡、支持医疗与营养监测部署的一条路径。

papers.title: Expected Utility Regret Rule: Minimax and Bayes Optimal Portfolio Choice
papers.abstract_en: This study considers the problem of portfolio choice, where we recommend a portfolio to an investor to maximize the expected utility of their wealth. Our goal is to construct an asymptotically optimal portfolio choice rule in terms of expected utility regret, the difference between the expected utility of an oracle investor and that achieved by a portfolio chosen from data. We propose the Expected Utility Regret (EUR) rule, which jointly selects a portfolio class and estimates its weights. In a regular parametric return model, a single EUR rule attains both the minimax and the Bayes lower bounds, including their leading constants, without using the prior distribution that defines the Bayes criterion. We then derive the mean--variance and risk-parity portfolios as special cases of this framework. Under smooth increasing and concave utility, the EUR rule and the sample mean--variance portfolio attain the same leading expected regret when expected excess returns approach zero sufficiently fast. When the returns divided by their volatilities have a joint distribution that does not depend on the order of the assets, the EUR rule and the risk-parity portfolio coincide.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Expected Utility Regret (EUR) 规则，联合选择投资组合类别并估计权重，以最小化与 oracle 投资者之间的期望效用遗憾。在正则参数化收益模型中，单条 EUR 规则同时达到 minimax 与 Bayes 下界（含首项常数），且无需使用定义 Bayes 准则的先验分布；当预期超额收益足够快趋于零时，其首项遗憾与样本均值-方差组合相同，当标准化收益的联合分布与资产顺序无关时与 risk-parity 组合重合。
Motivation: 组合选择需要在不事先指定先验的前提下构造渐近最优规则，同时兼顾 minimax 与 Bayes 两类准则，并统一均值-方差与风险平价等常见组合。
Method: 提出 EUR 规则：以期望效用遗憾（oracle 期望效用减去数据选择组合的期望效用）为目标，联合完成组合类别的选择与权重估计；在正则参数化收益模型下分析其极小极大与贝叶斯风险，并把均值-方差、risk-parity 组合作为特例纳入框架，效用设定为光滑递增凹函数。
Result: 在正则参数化收益模型中，单条 EUR 规则同时达到 minimax 与 Bayes 下界且包含首项常数，无需使用先验分布；在光滑递增凹效用下，当预期超额收益足够快趋于零时，EUR 与样本均值-方差组合的首项期望遗憾相同；当收益除以波动率后的联合分布与资产顺序无关时，EUR 与 risk-parity 组合重合。
Conclusion: 一条不依赖先验的 EUR 规则即可同时最优于 minimax 与 Bayes 两类准则，并把均值-方差与风险平价组合统一为该框架的特例。

papers.title: Effects of interpulse-interval variation on deep-learning classification of bat vocalizations
papers.abstract_en: Temporal context may aid automated bat-species classification, but the contribution of specific features remains unclear. We investigated whether variation in the interpulse interval (IPI)-the time between consecutive call onsets-provides species-discriminative information and whether transformer-based models are more sensitive to this information than convolutional neural networks. We created two matched datasets from European bat recordings: a natural-IPI condition retaining the original call timing and a normalized-IPI condition in which call onsets were spaced at 50-ms intervals. EfficientNet-B0 and PaSST were fine-tuned and evaluated within each condition. In an additional experiment, each architecture was trained separately on natural-IPI and normalized-IPI recordings, and evaluated on the same natural-IPI test set. Finally, the pretrained classifiers BatDetect2 and BAT were evaluated on both conditions. Within-condition IPI normalization had model-dependent effects. PaSST accuracy differed little between the natural-IPI ($71 \pm 2.3\%$) and normalized-IPI ($70 \pm 6.3\%$) conditions, whereas EfficientNet accuracy increased from $47 \pm 4.7\%$ to $57 \pm 3.9\%$. PaSST exceeded EfficientNet under both conditions. In the cross-condition evaluation, models trained on natural-IPI recordings outperformed those trained on normalized-IPI recordings on the natural-IPI test set: accuracy decreased from 54% to 50% for EfficientNet and from 65% to 57% for PaSST. BatDetect2 and BAT differed little between IPI conditions. Overall, we found limited support for the hypotheses that natural IPI variation contributes substantially to bat-species classification and that it is used more effectively by transformer-based than CNN-based models. Nevertheless, the cross-condition performance decrease shows that results obtained under normalized conditions may not transfer fully to natural recordings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 检验蝙蝠叫声的脉冲间隔 (IPI) 变化是否携带物种判别信息、以及 transformer 是否比 CNN 更依赖它。在欧洲蝙蝠录音构造的自然 IPI 与归一化 IPI（起始间隔固定 50 ms）配对数据集上，PaSST 准确率几乎不变（71±2.3% vs 70±6.3%），EfficientNet-B0 反而从 47±4.7% 升到 57±3.9%；跨条件评测中自然 IPI 训练的模型在自然 IPI 测试集上更高（EfficientNet 54% vs 50%，PaSST 65% vs 57%）。结论是自然 IPI 对分类贡献有限，但归一化条件下的结果不能完全迁移到自然录音。
Motivation: 时间上下文对自动蝙蝠物种分类可能有用，但具体哪些特征起作用尚不清楚；若 IPI 确有判别信息且模型对其敏感，归一化时序的预处理就会损失信息。
Method: 从欧洲蝙蝠录音构造两个配对数据集：保留原始时序的 natural-IPI 条件与把叫声起始固定为 50 ms 间隔的 normalized-IPI 条件；在各条件内微调并评测 EfficientNet-B0（CNN）与 PaSST（transformer），另做跨条件实验（分别在两条件训练、统一在 natural-IPI 测试集评测），并评测预训练模型 BatDetect2 与 BAT。
Result: 条件内：PaSST 71±2.3%（natural）vs 70±6.3%（normalized），EfficientNet 47±4.7% → 57±3.9%，PaSST 在两条件下均高于 EfficientNet。跨条件（natural-IPI 测试集）：EfficientNet 从 54% 降到 50%，PaSST 从 65% 降到 57%。BatDetect2 与 BAT 在两条件间差异很小。
Conclusion: 自然 IPI 变化对蝙蝠物种分类的贡献有限，且没有证据表明 transformer 比 CNN 更有效地利用它；但归一化条件下的性能不能完全迁移到自然录音，跨条件下降 4–8 个百分点。

papers.title: MuLoRA: Spectrally Balanced Low-Rank Adaptation for Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) provides a parameter-efficient approach to continual learning, but its nominal rank can conceal a loss of effective adaptation capacity. We identify \emph{spectral plasticity collapse}: during sequential adaptation, update energy becomes concentrated in a small subset of singular modes, leaving much of the available low-rank space underutilized. This exposes a limitation of interference avoidance alone: protecting historical representations does not ensure that the remaining adaptation capacity is responsive to new tasks or effectively utilized. To address this problem, we propose \texttt{MuLoRA}, which jointly controls capacity allocation and utilization. First, historical whitening identifies input directions with strong current-task response relative to accumulated historical response, yielding a task-adaptive basis that remains fixed during training. Second, approximate polar orthogonalization of momentum updates reduces spectral concentration within theselected space. An orthonormal basis connects these mechanisms by transferring the factor-update spectrum exactly tothe induced weight update. We establish a max--min characterization of exact subspace selection and derive cumulative spectral bounds under controlled cross-step anisotropy. Across five class-incremental benchmarks and eight incremental settings, \texttt{MuLoRA} achieves the highest mean accuracy in 15 of 16 reported metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MuLoRA 指出 LoRA 持续学习中存在谱可塑性坍缩 (spectral plasticity collapse)：更新能量集中到少数奇异模态，名义 rank 虽在但有效适配容量被浪费。它用历史白化选出任务自适应且训练中固定的基，再对动量更新做近似极正交化以压低谱集中，并以正交基把因子更新谱精确传递到权重更新。在五个类增量基准、八个增量设置的 16 项报告指标中，MuLoRA 在 15 项上取得最高平均准确率。
Motivation: LoRA 做持续学习时名义 rank 会掩盖有效适配容量的丢失：更新能量集中于少数奇异模态，低秩空间大部分闲置；只规避干扰、保护历史表示并不能保证剩余容量对新任务可用。
Method: MuLoRA 同时控制容量分配与利用：历史白化 (historical whitening) 挑出当前任务响应相对累积历史响应强的输入方向，形成训练期间固定的自适应基；对动量更新做近似极正交化 (approximate polar orthogonalization) 以降低所选空间内的谱集中；正交基把因子更新谱精确转移到诱导的权重更新。理论上给出精确子空间选择的 max–min 刻画，并在受控跨步各向异性下推导累积谱界。
Result: 在五个类增量基准、八个增量设置上，MuLoRA 在 16 项报告指标中的 15 项取得最高平均准确率。
Conclusion: 仅规避干扰不足以维持 LoRA 的持续适配能力，必须同时约束容量分配与谱利用；谱平衡的低秩适配在类增量设置下能稳定拿到最高平均准确率。
Relevance: 0
