papers.title: The AI Risk Observatory: What Can We Learn from AI Disclosures in Annual Reports About Societal Resilience?
papers.abstract_en: Societal resilience research relies on access to useful and actionable data, which motivates our main research question: Can annual reports, processed at scale with LLMs, provide a useful signal about how companies disclose their response to AI? We test this by applying a reproducible two-stage classification pipeline to 9,821 annual reports from 1,362 UK listed companies (2020-2025, with partial 2026 data). We first validate the method against 474 human-annotated passages, finding high recall and moderate label-level agreement. We then report three empirical patterns: (i) between 2020 and 2025, the share of reports mentioning AI risk rose from 2.8% to 41.2%, while AI adoption disclosure also rose, from 13.8% to 45.2%, and named vendor mentions cluster around a small set of major providers led by Microsoft; (ii) disclosure varies substantially by Critical National Infrastructure sector and market segment: AIM reports disclose AI risk at far lower rates than Main Market reports, and sectors such as Energy and Data Infrastructure lag behind the rest in AI risk disclosure; and (iii) harm disclosures are near-absent (seven reports across the entire corpus). We develop a substantiveness classification to assess the quality of the disclosure and find that most AI risk disclosure is not substantive: in 2025, 41.2% of all reports mention AI as a risk, but only 4.3% contain AI risk disclosure we classify as substantive.
papers.comment: 22 pages (9 main text + appendices), 12 figures, 7 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/84rt/AI-Risk-Observatory (release dataset-v1.1)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用可复现的两阶段 LLM 分类流水线处理 1,362 家英国上市公司 2020–2025 年的 9,821 份年报，测出 AI 风险披露从 2.8% 升到 41.2%，但其中绝大多数不具实质性：2025 年 41.2% 的年报提到 AI 风险，仅 4.3% 含实质性披露，全语料只有 7 份提到危害。AIM 板块与 Energy、Data Infrastructure 等关键国家基础设施行业披露率明显落后。
Motivation: 社会韧性研究需要可行动的数据，而企业如何披露对 AI 的应对缺乏大规模、可复现的度量手段。
Method: 两阶段可复现分类流水线（reproducible two-stage classification pipeline）用 LLM 处理 9,821 份年报（1,362 家英国上市公司，2020–2025，含部分 2026 数据），先用 474 段人工标注文本验证方法，再按 Critical National Infrastructure 行业与市场板块分层统计，并设计实质性 (substantiveness) 分类评估披露质量。
Result: 2020→2025 提及 AI 风险的年报占比 2.8%→41.2%，AI 采用披露 13.8%→45.2%；474 段人工标注验证显示高召回、标签级中等一致性；AIM 板块 AI 风险披露率远低于 Main Market，Energy 与 Data Infrastructure 落后；全语料仅 7 份含危害披露；2025 年 41.2% 提及 AI 风险但仅 4.3% 属实质性披露；供应商提及集中于以 Microsoft 为首的少数厂商。
Conclusion: 年报经 LLM 规模化处理确实能给出 AI 应对披露的信号，但披露量的大幅上升掩盖了质量空洞——多数 AI 风险披露不具实质性，危害披露几乎不存在。

papers.title: CLEAN: Psychometrically Consistent Incremental Cognitive Diagnosis under Concept-Space Expansion via Architectural Isolation
papers.abstract_en: Cognitive diagnosis (CD) is a fundamental task in intelligent education that profiles learner proficiency over knowledge concepts. In real-world learning platforms, newly added items continually introduce previously unseen concepts, necessitating dynamic expansion of the underlying concept space. Yet existing incremental CD models assume a fixed concept space, allowing gradients from new items to overwrite historical pathways and induce catastrophic forgetting. More critically, these methods rely solely on soft constraints to preserve historical diagnoses. Such constraints may fail to satisfy the requirement of diagnostic invariance after incremental updates, a requirement known as psychometric consistency in cognitive diagnosis. Therefore, we propose CLEAN (Continual Learning with Expandable and Architecturally Isolated Networks), a novel incremental CD framework supporting concept-space expansion while providing structural guarantees for pointwise invariance of historical diagnoses. Specifically, CLEAN first introduces a strict topological bipartition protocol, freezes historical diagnostic functions and applies deterministic orthogonal column masking to sever gradient interference. Second, to accommodate concept expansion, expandable full-rank branches with micro-variance initialization are deployed to learn novel concepts. Finally, to verify that this architectural design achieves invariance by construction, we formalize Representation Drift (RD) to quantify the perturbation of historical traits. Extensive experiments on three large-scale educational datasets demonstrate that CLEAN achieves zero RD, preserving old-item metrics identically to static anchors through architectural isolation while remaining competitive with or superior to strong continual-learning baselines on new items.

papers.title: Reliability Stress Tests and Decision-Time Routing for Chest X-ray Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Medical vision-language model (VLM) evaluation is sensitive to workflow design, prompting strategy, and benchmark construction, yet most studies treat these factors in isolation. We introduce a reliability stress test for chest X-ray interpretation built on two balanced datasets (a private report-backed set and a curated MIMIC subset). Three medical VLMs (CheXagent, MedGemma-4B, and MedGemma-27B) are evaluated across three prompt styles and two workflows (single-VLM and multi-agent), producing 36 configurations. We show that exact-match accuracy alone can overstate the effectiveness of conservative models that default to "Normal" predictions. Diagnostic reliability also depends heavily on model family and scale: multi-agent reasoning helps some configurations but hurts others. Building on these observations, we propose a decision-time routing framework that selectively escalates to multi-agent inference only when beneficial, improving the cost-quality trade-off over fixed workflows. Our results highlight the need for evaluation protocols that jointly consider prompt sensitivity, failure-mode diversity, and workflow choice before clinical deployment.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Accepted version of a workshop paper presented orally at the 2026 IEEE/ACM Conference on Connected Health: Applications, Systems and Engineering Technologies (CHASE). Code and per-case MIMIC-CXR results: https://github.com/Yangxinyee/cxr-vlm-routing
papers.journal_ref: 2026 IEEE/ACM Conference on Connected Health: Applications, Systems and Engineering Technologies (CHASE), pp. 428-433
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对胸片 VLM 评测中工作流、提示与基准被割裂考察的问题，提出可靠性压力测试：3 个医学 VLM × 3 种提示风格 × 单/多智能体两种工作流共 36 种配置，并在其上做决策时路由，仅在有益时才升级到多智能体推理。发现仅看 exact-match accuracy 会高估总是默认输出 Normal 的保守模型，且多智能体推理对部分配置有益、对另一些有害。
Motivation: 胸片 VLM 的评测结果对提示策略、工作流设计和基准构造高度敏感，但既有研究把三者分开考察，无法判断配置选择对临床部署可靠性的真实影响。
Method: 在两个平衡数据集（私有报告支撑集与精选 MIMIC 子集）上，对 CheXagent、MedGemma-4B、MedGemma-27B 三个医学 VLM，跨三种提示风格与单 VLM、多智能体两种工作流共 36 种配置做可靠性压力测试；据此提出决策时路由框架，按配置收益选择性升级到多智能体推理。
Result: 共 36 种配置的评测显示：仅用 exact-match accuracy 会高估默认输出 Normal 的保守模型；诊断可靠性强烈依赖模型家族与规模，多智能体推理在部分配置上提升、在另一些上反而变差；决策时路由相对固定工作流改善了 cost-quality 权衡。
Conclusion: 临床部署前的评测协议必须联合考虑提示敏感性、失败模式多样性与工作流选择，且按配置收益做决策时路由优于固定单/多智能体工作流。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Confidence-Gated Cloud-Edge Cascade Triage via Variational Risk Minimization for Medical Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Emergency chest X-ray (CXR) triage has a structural modality gap: reports arrive after triage decisions, yet multimodal foundation models require image-text inputs. We present Variational Risk Minimization (VRM), a distillation framework that treats LVLM-generated report variants as Monte Carlo samples of latent clinical interpretations. Rather than distilling from a single teacher target, VRM learns from a variationally marginalized teacher distribution, enabling uncertainty-aware supervision under missing-modality constraints. Under matched encoder families, VRM outperforms direct fine-tuning baselines and improves calibration with strong recovery from hallucinated supervision. Marginalized supervision reduces report-selection instability. In our compact edge-student instantiation, a confidence-gated cascade reaches AUC 0.941 at 103ms average latency with 20.3% cloud escalation, yielding an explicit reliability-latency operating point for cloud-edge clinical workflows.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 6 figures, 14 tables. Accepted manuscript of the article published in Smart Health 41 (2026) 100689. Presented as an oral at IEEE/ACM CHASE 2026. Code: https://github.com/Yangxinyee/vrm-edge-triage
papers.journal_ref: Smart Health 41 (2026) 100689
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对急诊胸片 (CXR) 分诊中报告滞后于决策的模态缺失问题，提出变分风险最小化 (Variational Risk Minimization, VRM) 蒸馏框架，把 LVLM 生成的多份报告变体当作潜在临床解读的 Monte Carlo 样本，从边缘化后的教师分布而非单一目标学习。置信度门控的云边级联在 103ms 平均延迟、20.3% 云上传率下达到 AUC 0.941，给出显式的可靠性-延迟工作点。
Motivation: 急诊胸片分诊里结构化报告在分诊决策之后才到，而多模态基础模型需要图文成对输入；直接微调又受幻觉监督与报告选择不稳定影响。
Method: VRM 以 LVLM 生成的报告变体作为潜在临床解读的 Monte Carlo 采样，对教师分布做变分边缘化，得到缺失模态下的不确定性感知监督；推理端用紧凑 edge-student 加置信度门控级联，决定本地处理还是上传云端。
Result: 在匹配编码器族下，VRM 优于直接微调基线，校准改善并对幻觉监督有强恢复能力，边缘化监督降低了报告选择不稳定性；紧凑 edge-student 实例的置信度门控级联达到 AUC 0.941、平均延迟 103ms、云上传率 20.3%。
Conclusion: 把教师输出当作分布而非单一标签来蒸馏，可以在模态缺失的急诊胸片分诊中同时拿到可用的校准与一个可显式调节的可靠性-延迟工作点。

papers.title: From Mathematical to Executable Certificates for Machine Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning is needed when data must be removed because of deletion requests, outdated records, or data-quality concerns, while retraining from scratch can be costly. Certified machine unlearning methods provide mathematical guarantees, while deployed systems release concrete finite-precision artifacts produced by software. To bridge the gap between mathematical guarantees and practical deployment, we introduce Executable Release Certification (ExecCert), a release-time layer that certifies the candidate artifact considered for release. ExecCert either closes a method's native certificate for the executed candidate or applies Retraining-Reference Release Verification (RRV) to certify fidelity to current retain-set retraining. Sequential deletion makes the latter nontrivial because the exact retain-set reference and the stored numerical state evolve separately. For frozen representations with a mutable ridge head, we develop an incremental realization of RRV that maintains certified evidence across deletion requests rather than reconstructing it at each release. On four published unlearning implementations, ExecCert preserves valid certificates, changes release decisions, tightens conservative bounds, and identifies the retraining-reference fidelity supported by concrete outputs. In sequential-service experiments, RRV eliminates false releases caused by stored-equation verification while closely tracking realized error, and incremental certification remains cheaper than both fresh and maintained verified-factor alternatives once release checks become sufficiently frequent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出发布时机器遗忘认证层 ExecCert，对拟发布的有限精度工件本身做认证：能闭合原生证书就闭合，否则用 Retraining-Reference Release Verification (RRV) 认证其对当前 retain-set 重训练的保真度，并为冻结表示+可变 ridge 头给出增量式 RRV。在四个已发表的遗忘实现上，ExecCert 保留有效证书、改变发布判定并收紧保守界；顺序删除实验中 RRV 消除了存储方程验证导致的误发布，且当发布检查足够频繁时增量认证比 fresh 与 maintained verified-factor 两种替代方案更便宜。
Motivation: 认证遗忘给出的是数学保证，而部署系统发布的是软件产出的有限精度工件，两者之间存在缺口；顺序删除下 retain-set 参考与存储数值状态各自演化，使按存储方程做验证会误判可发布性。
Method: ExecCert 是发布时层，对候选工件二选一：闭合方法的原生证书，或用 RRV 认证对当前 retain-set 重训练的保真度；针对冻结表示加可变 ridge 头，维护跨删除请求的认证证据而非每次发布重建（增量式 RRV）。
Result: 在四个已发表的遗忘实现上，ExecCert 保留有效证书、改变发布判定、收紧保守界，并识别出具体输出所支持的重训练参考保真度；顺序删除服务实验中 RRV 消除了存储方程验证造成的误发布并紧密跟踪实际误差，且发布检查足够频繁时增量认证成本低于 fresh 与 maintained verified-factor 两种替代方案。
Conclusion: 认证应针对实际发布的有限精度工件而非抽象方法，顺序删除下用增量 RRV 维护证据可在更低成本下避免误发布。

papers.title: Fast Models, Slow Evidence: A Paired and Self-Audited Evaluation of System-1 Decision Models for LLM Agent Harnesses
papers.abstract_en: Agent harnesses make many small, typed decisions per task: which model to call, which tool to use, whether retrieved text is relevant, whether an input carries an injection. System-1 decision models answer such questions in a single forward pass with class probabilities, promising large cost and latency savings over LLM calls. We present a paired evaluation of an open-weight (Laya) and a hosted (Jev) System-1 model on 11 agent decision points built from 18 public sources: 7,283 base cases plus 6,640 robustness variants, with byte-identical inputs, paired tests, and cross-hardware and cross-day reproducibility checks. Jev is significantly more accurate on 9 of 11 decision points (+10.8 to +46.0 pp). Neither model beats chance on zero-shot model routing, and they tie on RAG relevance gating. Laya changes 30% of its answers when the option order is reversed and degrades sharply with many or similar candidates (31% at 50 nearest-neighbour tools, vs. 98% for Jev on items with a unique correct tool). We also audit our own pipeline. Three analysis errors and one design confound distorted headline deployment claims: an omitted pre-screen cost (reported 23.9% saving, actual 4.3%), gate accuracy reported as end-to-end quality (58% vs. 98%), in-sample thresholds (5% target, up to 17% held-out misses), and a "channel effect" on injection false positives that vanishes with channel-native content. Two other suspected confounds did not change the conclusions. All cases, raw outputs and analysis code are available at https://github.com/David-DL-Space/sys1-eval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对两个 System-1 决策模型（开源 Laya 与托管 Jev）做配对评测：11 个 agent 决策点、7,283 个基础案例加 6,640 个鲁棒性变体，字节相同输入、配对检验与跨硬件/跨日复现。Jev 在 11 个决策点中 9 个显著更准（+10.8 到 +46.0 pp），但两者零样本模型路由都不及随机、RAG 相关性门控打平；作者自查还纠正了三处分析错误与一处设计混淆，使宣称的部署节省从 23.9% 缩到 4.3%。
Motivation: Agent harness 每个任务要做大量小型类型化决策（选模型、选工具、判检索相关性、判注入），System-1 模型单次前向即可给出类别概率，声称能大幅省成本与延迟，但缺少配对、可复现且自审的评测。
Method: 在 11 个 agent 决策点上配对评测开源 Laya 与托管 Jev，案例来自 18 个公开来源，共 7,283 个基础案例加 6,640 个鲁棒性变体；采用字节相同输入、配对检验、跨硬件与跨日复现检查，并对自身分析流水线做审计（含预筛成本、门控准确率与端到端质量、样本内阈值、注入假阳性的通道效应）。

papers.title: Event-guided Neural Video Compression
papers.abstract_en: Neural video codecs derive motion and temporal contexts mainly from RGB frames, leaving room for cross-modal guidance from complementary temporal observations. Event streams can provide such observations by recording brightness changes between frames. In this work, we propose an Event-guided Neural Video Codec (ENVC) that uses events shared by the encoder and decoder to improve RGB compression efficiency. For motion coding, ENVC forms an event-guided motion prior and codes the remaining motion residual. For frame coding, an event-conditioned predictor supplies multi-scale features for gated temporal context refinement. To support training and evaluation on standard video datasets, we synthesize paired RGB-event data and assess its predictive utility through comparisons with real events. Across six benchmarks, ENVC achieves average BD-rate savings of 39.13% using PSNR-RGB and 67.63% using LPIPS relative to DCMVC. Further analyses show that our gains persist on large-motion sequences and that ENVC effectively learns to integrate event information. These results demonstrate the potential of events as a complementary modality for reducing the RGB coding rate. Our model and code are available at https://github.com/kjungwoo03/ENVC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ENVC 把事件流 (event stream) 作为编码器与解码器共享的辅助模态引入神经视频编码：用事件引导的运动先验编码运动、只对残差编码，再用事件条件预测器提供多尺度特征来细化时序上下文。在六个基准上相对 DCMVC 平均节省 BD-rate 39.13%（PSNR-RGB）与 67.63%（LPIPS），且在大运动序列上增益保持。
Motivation: 神经视频编解码器的运动与时序上下文几乎全部来自 RGB 帧，帧间亮度变化这类互补时序观测没有被利用，RGB 压缩效率仍有空间。
Method: 提出 Event-guided Neural Video Codec (ENVC)：运动编码阶段构造 event-guided motion prior 并只编码剩余 motion residual；帧编码阶段由 event-conditioned predictor 输出多尺度特征，经门控细化时序上下文 (gated temporal context refinement)。为在标准视频数据集上训练与评测，作者合成配对 RGB-event 数据，并与真实事件对比检验其预测可用性。
Result: 在六个基准上，相对 DCMVC 平均 BD-rate 节省 39.13%（以 PSNR-RGB 计）与 67.63%（以 LPIPS 计）；进一步分析显示增益在大运动序列上保持，且模型确实学到了对事件信息的整合。
Conclusion: 事件作为与 RGB 互补的模态可以切实降低 RGB 编码码率，且该做法在大运动场景下依然有效；模型与代码已在 GitHub 开源。

papers.title: ZAGNet: Zone-Aware Graph Aggregation Network for Patient-Level Lung Ultrasound Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Patient-level lung ultrasound (LUS) diagnosis requires integrating findings acquired across multiple anatomical zones, yet clinical examinations frequently involve variable and incomplete scanning protocols with missing zones. Existing diagnostic AI methods primarily analyze individual frames or video loops, relying on heuristic aggregation strategies such as max or mean pooling that ignore inter-zone relationships for patient-level inference. This paper presents ZAGNet, a Zone- Aware Graph Neural Network that represents temporally tracked pathology findings as graph nodes connected by anatomical zone adjacency. A graph transformer network propagates contextual information across neighboring lung regions, while a virtual global node aggregates graph-level features to predict patientlevel consolidation and pleural effusion using only patient-level supervision. ZAGNet accommodates missing zones by computing on a graph structure without fixed input format or size. We evaluate ZAGNet on a multicenter dataset of 714 subjects (20,256 LUS video loops) with exams varying from 4 to 16 zones across anterior, posterior, and lateral thoracic regions. For consolidation diagnosis, ZAGNet achieved an AUC of 0.803 compared to 0.677 (max pooling) and 0.674 (mean pooling). For pleural effusion, AUC increased to 0.893 from 0.804 (max pooling) and 0.815 (mean pooling). These represent improvements of up to 19% and 11% for consolidation and pleural effusion respectively. The results demonstrate that graph-based inter-zone reasoning provides an effective and clinically consistent framework for automated patient-level LUS assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ZAGNet 把时序追踪到的肺超声 (LUS) 病灶作为节点、按解剖分区邻接连边，用 graph transformer 跨区传播信息并由虚拟全局节点做患者级预测，可在缺失分区、输入尺寸不固定的情况下工作。在 714 例、20,256 段视频的多中心数据上，实变 AUC 0.803（max pooling 0.677、mean pooling 0.674），胸腔积液 AUC 0.893（0.804、0.815），分别最高提升 19% 与 11%。
Motivation: 现有 LUS 诊断 AI 多停留在单帧或单段视频，用 max/mean pooling 做患者级聚合，忽略区间关系；而临床检查分区常不完整、缺失分区，固定输入格式的方法难以适配。
Method: ZAGNet 将时序追踪的病灶发现表示为图节点，按解剖分区邻接建边；graph transformer 在相邻肺区间传播上下文，虚拟全局节点聚合图级特征，仅用患者级监督预测实变与胸腔积液；图结构不设固定输入格式与尺寸以容纳缺失分区。
Result: 在 714 名受试者、20,256 段 LUS 视频、每次检查 4–16 个分区（前/后/侧胸壁）的多中心数据集上：实变诊断 AUC 0.803，对比 max pooling 0.677、mean pooling 0.674；胸腔积液 AUC 0.893，对比 0.804 与 0.815；对应提升最高达 19%（实变）与 11%（积液）。
Conclusion: 基于图的跨分区推理为患者级 LUS 自动评估提供了有效且与临床一致的框架，其可变图结构使缺失分区的检查也能完成推理。

papers.title: CONTRA: Discovering and Qualifying Behavior-Changing Questions for Selective Clarification in LLM Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents can generate code that appears correct but implements behavior the user never intended. This mismatch can arise when an agent silently resolves underspecified requirements through its own assumptions. As subsequent development builds on these assumptions, correcting the resulting behavior can become increasingly costly. Early clarification can help prevent such mismatches, but unnecessary questions can interrupt developers and slow down development. Existing methods struggle to identify key clarification questions while avoiding unnecessary ones. Therefore, we propose CONTRA, a training-free method that combines broad question discovery with semantic and execution-based question qualification. CONTRA first generates candidate questions and filters out those unrelated to required behavior or already resolved by the requirement. For each remaining question, it generates programs conditioned on two plausible answers and checks for stable behavioral differences on shared inputs. It then uses the interaction history to select among qualified questions or stop asking. Experiments on ClarifyCodeBench show that CONTRA achieves the highest F1 with all four coding agents, exceeding the best baseline macro-average F1 by 13.88 percentage points. With the same LLM and evaluation protocol, CONTRA also achieves higher clarification recall and F1 than the coding harnesses Claude Code and OpenHands. To support practical use, we also implement CONTRA as a Claude Code plugin that integrates selective clarification into everyday development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CONTRA 是一个免训练的选择性澄清方法：先广撒网生成候选澄清问题并过滤与需求无关或已被需求回答的问题，再对每个问题用两个合理答案分别生成程序、在共享输入上检验行为差异是否稳定，最后结合交互历史决定继续提问还是停止。在 ClarifyCodeBench 上对全部四种 coding agent 取得最高 F1，比最优基线的 macro-average F1 高 13.88 个百分点。
Motivation: Coding agent 会用自身假设悄悄补全欠规范需求，生成看似正确但违背用户意图的代码，且后续开发建立在这些假设上使修正成本递增；现有方法难以在找出关键澄清问题的同时避免不必要的打断。
Method: CONTRA 为 training-free 流程：候选问题生成后先按语义过滤（与所需行为无关、或已被需求解决的剔除），对剩余问题用两个 plausible answer 分别条件生成程序并在共享输入上检查稳定的行为差异（execution-based qualification），最后用交互历史在合格问题中选择或停止提问。
Result: 在 ClarifyCodeBench 上，CONTRA 对全部四个 coding agent 均取得最高 F1，超过最优基线的 macro-average F1 达 13.88 个百分点；在相同 LLM 与评测协议下，其 clarification recall 与 F1 也高于 coding harness Claude Code 和 OpenHands。
Conclusion: 把广撒网的问题发现与语义加执行的双重资格判定结合，可以在不训练的前提下同时提高澄清问题的召回与精度，并已实现为 Claude Code 插件用于日常开发。

papers.title: Cogentic: Multi-Agent Orchestration for Automated Proof Discovery
papers.abstract_en: We present Cogentic, a multi-agent harness for automated proof discovery on open research problems. While frontier language models can generate strong mathematical ideas in a single shot, single-shot generation is often insufficient for open problems that require exploring multiple competing conjectures, overcoming subtle technical obstructions, and retaining intermediate progress over a long horizon. Cogentic addresses these challenges through an iterative prove-verify loop in which an orchestrator allocates a population of independent provers across distinct proof directions, subjects their output to adversarial verification by several specialized components, and promotes confirmed intermediate results into a persistent verified ledger that later rounds build on. The harness is designed to be able to solve research-level math and theoretical computer science problems. Using either Gemini 3.1 Pro or an early version of Gemini 4 Argon as the base model, Cogentic produced novel results on open problems across online learning, auction theory, and mechanism design. Each result was independently verified by domain experts and is developed in full in companion papers. We list these results, and new ones as they are verified, at https://sites.google.com/view/cogentic .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Cogentic 是面向开放研究问题的自动定理证明多智能体框架：orchestrator 把独立 prover 分派到不同证明方向，经多个专门组件对抗式验证后，把确认的中间结果写入持久化 verified ledger 供后续轮次继续推进。以 Gemini 3.1 Pro 或 Gemini 4 Argon 早期版为基座，在 online learning、auction theory、mechanism design 的开放问题上产出经领域专家独立验证的新结果。
Motivation: 开放问题需要在多个竞争性猜想间探索、绕过技术障碍并在长程中保留中间进展，单次生成 (single-shot generation) 即使是前沿模型也往往不够。
Method: iterative prove-verify 循环：orchestrator 在不同证明方向上分配独立 prover 群体，输出交由多个专门组件做对抗式验证 (adversarial verification)，确认的中间结果提升进持久化 verified ledger，后续轮次在其上继续构建；基座模型为 Gemini 3.1 Pro 或 Gemini 4 Argon 早期版。
Result: 在 online learning、auction theory、mechanism design 的开放问题上产出新结果，每项结果均由领域专家独立验证，并在配套论文中完整展开；结果清单发布于 https://sites.google.com/view/cogentic 。
Conclusion: 多智能体编排加持久化验证账本可以让前沿语言模型在研究级数学与理论计算机科学问题上产出经专家确认的新结果，而非仅复述已有证明。

papers.title: PTNO: Training Neural Operators with Noisy Monte Carlo Estimates for Particle Transport Problems
papers.abstract_en: Particle transport under multiple scattering is central to radiative transfer and plasma physics, yet high-fidelity Monte Carlo (MC) simulations must trace prohibitively many particles. Learning-based surrogates can amortize this cost, but typically train on expensive, well-converged MC solutions. We propose the Particle Transport Neural Operator (PTNO), a neural operator that learns particle transport surrogates directly from noisy, low-cost MC labels. Such labels pose two challenges: (1) high variance, which destabilizes standard supervised learning, and (2) a high dynamic range (HDR) spanning many orders of magnitude. For the first, we learn the solution operator from noisy labels of many configurations, amortizing MC cost and generalizing to unseen configurations. Because MC labels are unbiased, we show that the squared loss on them shares its minimizer with the loss on converged solutions, and our budget-allocation study over training scenes $M$, MC samples per render $N$, and independent renders per scene $K$ shows that many noisy scenes beat fewer converged ones. For the second, a nonlinear transform such as the logarithm biases noisy supervision. Instead, PTNO keeps labels in physical space and enforces positivity with a softplus output layer that represents small values effectively. We further train with a pointwise relative $L_2$ loss (PRelL2), the stop-gradient relative loss of HDR denoising and neural rendering, which normalizes each residual by the stop-gradient prediction instead of the noisy label. We demonstrate PTNO on neutron transport in fusion reactors and radiative transfer in participating media. On the two neutronics tasks, PTNO is $10^4$-$10^5\times$ faster than converged MC on the same CPU and $10^3$-$10^5\times$ cheaper than MC at matched accuracy; on the two radiative-transfer tasks, MC at matched accuracy costs $0.8$-$11\times$ as much as PTNO.
papers.comment: 41 pages, 15 figures, 35 tables. v2: Yubo Cao and Xi Deng are co-first authors with equal contribution; corrected the author footnote
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PTNO 直接用高噪声、低成本的 Monte Carlo 标签训练粒子输运神经算子：利用 MC 无偏性保证平方损失与收敛解损失同解，用 softplus 输出层在物理空间保持正值，并以 PRelL2（按 stop-gradient 预测归一化残差）处理高动态范围。在聚变堆中子输运与参与介质辐射传输任务上，两个中子学任务比同 CPU 收敛 MC 快 10^4–10^5 倍、同精度下便宜 10^3–10^5 倍，两个辐射传输任务中同精度 MC 成本为 PTNO 的 0.8–11 倍。
Motivation: 多散射粒子输运的高保真 MC 需追踪海量粒子，学习型代理通常只能依赖昂贵且已收敛的 MC 解作为训练标签，成本高且覆盖的构型有限。
Method: PTNO 从大量构型的含噪低成 MC 标签直接学习解算子：因 MC 标签无偏，含噪标签上的平方损失与收敛解损失共享极小点；预算分配研究在训练场景数 M、每次渲染 MC 样本数 N、每场景独立渲染数 K 之间权衡。标签保留在物理空间，用 softplus 输出层保证正值并有效表示小值，避免对数变换引入偏差；损失用点对点相对 L2（PRelL2），残差按 stop-gradient 的预测而非含噪标签归一化。
Result: 在聚变堆中子输运与参与介质辐射传输两类任务上：两个中子学任务 PTNO 比同 CPU 上收敛 MC 快 10^4–10^5 倍，同精度下成本低 10^3–10^5 倍；两个辐射传输任务中，同精度 MC 的成本是 PTNO 的 0.8–11 倍。预算分配研究显示许多含噪场景优于较少的收敛场景。
Conclusion: 只要标签无偏，用大量含噪 MC 场景加相对损失训练的神经算子即可替代收敛 MC 解，同时避开对数变换对含噪监督的偏差。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Autoresearch in Mixed-Integer Linear and Nonlinear Programming
papers.abstract_en: Despite recent progress in autoresearch, applying it to practical operations research problems, typically formulated as NP-hard mixed-integer linear or nonlinear programs (MILPs or MINLPs), remains challenging because effective research requires systematically managing competing ideas and long-horizon experimental trajectories. We introduce AutoMIP, a reusable agent skill for organizing long-horizon autoresearch in mixed-integer programming through idea pooling and algorithm tree search. AutoMIP maintains a persistent pool of complementary candidate ideas while organizing executable experiments into an algorithm tree, enabling the agent to preserve unexplored hypotheses, refine promising algorithms, and switch to alternative methodological directions based on historical states. On MILP and MINLP benchmark cohorts, AutoMIP achieves the highest final success rates among the evaluated autoresearch frameworks. On MIPLib, AutoMIP discovers new best solutions for 31 of 60 instances, surpassing existing autoresearch frameworks. On MINLPLib, it achieves new best solutions for 52 of 60 instances. Ablation studies further demonstrate the complementary contributions of idea pooling and algorithm tree search, highlighting the importance of jointly maintaining diverse research ideas and structured experimental trajectories for long-horizon autoresearch.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AutoMIP 把长程 autoresearch 拆成 idea pooling 与 algorithm tree search 两部分：持久维护互补候选想法池，并把可执行实验组织成算法树，让 agent 保留未探索假设、按历史状态切换方法方向。在 MILP/MINLP 基准上它取得所评测 autoresearch 框架中最高的最终成功率，MIPLib 60 个实例中 31 个刷新最优解，MINLPLib 60 个中 52 个刷新最优解。
Motivation: NP-hard 的 MILP/MINLP 实际运筹问题上，有效研究需要系统管理竞争想法与长程实验轨迹，现有 autoresearch 难以兼顾两者。
Method: AutoMIP 作为可复用 agent skill：持久 idea pool 保存互补候选想法，algorithm tree search 把可执行实验组织成树，agent 依据历史状态保留未探索假设、精化有前景算法并切换方法方向；配消融实验分离两组件贡献。
Result: 在 MILP 与 MINLP benchmark cohorts 上取得所评测 autoresearch 框架中最高最终成功率；MIPLib 60 个实例中 31 个得到新最优解，MINLPLib 60 个中 52 个得到新最优解，均超过既有 autoresearch 框架；消融显示 idea pooling 与 algorithm tree search 贡献互补。
Conclusion: 长程 autoresearch 要同时维护多样想法与结构化实验轨迹，二者缺一都会削弱在 MILP/MINLP 上的最终成功率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning to Route in Visual Space via Multi-Step Embedding Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents rely on retrieval tools to access external knowledge, yet visual agentic search remains severely bottlenecked by standard single-step retrievers. In current pipelines, the agent must issue text queries for every intermediate step, struggling when visual clues are difficult to describe or when the retriever fails to surface necessary intermediate evidence within its top results. We hypothesize that offloading multi-step navigation across the entire embedding space directly to the retrieval tool resolves this performance bottleneck. To study this systematically, we introduce VHOP, a flexible data generation framework and benchmark with five core difficulty levels testing both visual matching and search planning. Using this framework, we develop VHOP-Router, an end-to-end training pipeline---combining supervised fine-tuning, online imitation learning, and reinforcement learning---that transforms a standard embedding model into an autoregressive multi-step retriever. Operating directly in the visual latent space, VHOP-Router retrieves linked image chains in a single tool call without requiring the agent to formulate intermediate text queries. Experiments show VHOP-Router boosts retrieval performance from under 5\% to 76.3\%. In agentic search, it improves task success rates by 52.7\% and reduces the average token length by 61\% from 1886 to 728, whereas upgrading the agent yields only a 3.7\% gain. Compared to a strong baseline where the agent retrieves the top 50 results per step, VHOP-Router maintains superior performance while reducing in-context images by $23\times$ and cutting the cumulative API payload by $35\times$. The models also generalize robustly to unseen difficulty levels and realistic test sets. Ultimately, VHOP and VHOP-Router provide an efficient and effective solution for visual agentic search that leaves native LLM capabilities entirely intact.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VHOP-Router 把标准 embedding 模型端到端训练成自回归多步检索器，直接在视觉 latent space 里走完整条图像链，一次工具调用替代 agent 逐步写文本查询。检索性能从不足 5% 提到 76.3%，agentic search 任务成功率提升 52.7%，平均 token 从 1886 降到 728（降 61%），而升级 agent 只带来 3.7% 提升。
Motivation: LLM agent 的视觉检索被单步 retriever 卡住：视觉线索难以用文字描述、或 top 结果里没有中间证据时，agent 必须为每个中间步骤手写文本查询，性能瓶颈明显。
Method: 先用 VHOP 数据生成框架构造五档核心难度的 benchmark，同时考察视觉匹配与搜索规划；再用 VHOP-Router 管线把标准 embedding 模型改造为自回归多步检索器，训练组合为 supervised fine-tuning + online imitation learning + reinforcement learning，直接在视觉 latent space 中输出 linked image chains。
Result: 检索性能从 under 5% 提升到 76.3%；agentic search 任务成功率提升 52.7%，平均 token 长度从 1886 降到 728（减少 61%），而升级 agent 仅得 3.7% 提升；对比每步取 top 50 的强基线，保持更优性能的同时 in-context images 减少 23 倍、累计 API payload 减少 35 倍；模型在未见难度档与真实测试集上仍稳健泛化。
Conclusion: 把多步导航下放给检索工具、在视觉 embedding 空间内自回归检索，比让 agent 自己逐步查询或单纯升级 agent 更高效，且不改动原生 LLM 能力。

papers.title: From Solo to Social Learning: Characterizing Recursive Social Improvement in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can now improve themselves by revising the instructions they follow, and LLM agents are increasingly orchestrated to work together on complex problems. However, self-improvement methods typically optimize one system at a time, and multi-agent frameworks often have every model work toward a shared goal. We ask a different question. When each agent pursues its own reward, can self-improving LLMs learn from one another well enough to improve the whole population? We call this capability recursive social improvement. We study populations that revise skill files and choose whether, when, and whom to copy from. Independent search, learning from peers, and acting all share one token budget. In controlled environments, established social-learning algorithms benefit from peers, but three LLMs do not. They earn less reward per token than solo learners, and explore too narrowly or run out of tokens before acting. We then let the models write and revise their own skills. Observing peers changes how they improve, helping one model find useful skills sooner and another spend less on private search. Neither, however, outperforms independent learners at the same cost. Skills are copied, revised, and passed on, so one discovery can seed further search. Yet these exchanges concentrate the population around fewer independent discoveries. Together, these results show that LLMs can make learning more efficient by copying from peers, but not yet more effective.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 recursive social improvement 这一能力：各自追求自身奖励的自改进 LLM 能否通过互相复制与修改 skill 文件让整个群体变好。在共享 token 预算的受控环境中，三个 LLM 的社会学习每 token 奖励低于 solo 学习者，观察同伴虽能加快找到有用 skill、减少私有搜索开销，但在同等成本下仍不优于独立学习者，且群体收敛到更少的独立发现上。
Motivation: 现有自改进方法一次只优化一个系统，多智能体框架又让所有模型朝同一目标工作；当每个 agent 有自己的 reward 时，缺少对群体能否通过互相学习整体变好的刻画。
Method: 定义并刻画 recursive social improvement：群体中的 agent 修改自己遵循的 skill 文件，并决定是否、何时、向谁复制；独立搜索、向同伴学习与行动共用同一 token 预算。先在受控环境中对照既有社会学习算法，再让模型自行撰写并修订 skill，观察同伴对其改进方式的影响。
Result: 受控环境中既有社会学习算法能从同伴获益，但三个 LLM 不能：每 token 奖励低于 solo 学习者，原因是探索过窄或 token 耗尽才行动。让模型自写 skill 后，观察同伴帮助一个模型更快找到有用 skill、让另一个减少私有搜索开销，但两者在同等成本下都不优于独立学习者；发现被复制、修订并传递，却使群体集中在更少的独立发现上。
Conclusion: LLM 能通过复制同伴让学习更高效（efficient），但尚未更有效（effective）；社会学习带来的交换会减少群体中独立发现的多样性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Weights Read and Write Features: Scalable Parameter Decomposition Grounded in Activation Space
papers.abstract_en: Activation space and parameter space provide complementary views of model computation. Activations represent information, while weights read, transform, and write that information. Yet existing interpretability methods largely study the two spaces separately, leaving the connection between represented information and parameter-level computation underexplored. We introduce Activation-Supported Parameter Decomposition (ASPD), which jointly decomposes activation and parameter spaces and grounds each learned weight component in the activation features it reads or writes. This grounding constrains otherwise non-unique parameter decompositions using the model's internal activations, while an internal reconstruction objective provides a local learning signal at the weight matrix being analyzed. Together, these properties enable scalable, interpretable, and causally editable parameter decomposition in pretrained large language models, demonstrated on Qwen-3-8B. The learned read--write components can also be composed into parameter-level mechanism circuits. We use ASPD to recover mechanisms underlying the classic IOI circuit and trace semantic transformations through model weights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Activation-Supported Parameter Decomposition (ASPD)，把激活空间与参数空间联合分解，用模型内部激活为每个学到的权重分量指定它读取或写入的特征，从而约束本不唯一的参数分解，并用内部重建目标提供局部学习信号。在 Qwen-3-8B 上得到可扩展、可解释且可因果编辑的权重分解，read-write 分量可组合成参数级机制电路，复现了经典 IOI 电路并追踪语义变换。
Motivation: 现有可解释性方法把激活空间与参数空间分开研究，被表示的信息与参数级计算之间的联系基本未被打通，参数分解本身又存在不唯一性。
Method: ASPD 联合分解激活空间与参数空间，把每个学到的权重分量锚定到它读取或写入的激活特征上，用这种 grounding 约束非唯一的参数分解；同时在被分析的权重矩阵上加内部重建目标作为局部学习信号，read-write 分量可组合为参数级机制电路。
Result: 在预训练大语言模型 Qwen-3-8B 上展示了可扩展、可解释且可因果编辑的参数分解；用 ASPD 复现了经典 IOI 电路背后的机制，并通过模型权重追踪语义变换。
Conclusion: 把激活特征作为权重分量的读写锚点，可以让参数分解既受约束又可因果编辑，并把学到的分量拼成参数级机制电路。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: SCOPE: Observation-Conditioned Full-Target Prediction for Sparse PDE Inference
papers.abstract_en: Recovering complete physical fields from sparse observations is challenging because the measurements may not uniquely determine the underlying state. Diffusion-based PDE solvers address this problem through iterative sampling whereas neural operators provide deterministic one-pass predictions. We propose SCOPE (Sparse-Context Observability-aware Predictive Embeddings) to recover complete PDE fields from sparse observations by coupling full-field latent prediction with physical reconstruction. A shared decoder reconstructs fields from both predicted and complete-view representations so that representation learning is guided by both physical recovery and latent matching. We derive a quadratic risk decomposition at fixed teacher-decoder pairs showing why optimal latent prediction need not yield optimal field reconstruction. We also establish sufficient conditions for decoder improvements on complete inputs to transfer to recovery from partial observations. Experiments across five PDE settings show that SCOPE outperforms mask-aware neural operators on all ten forward and inverse tasks and achieves lower errors than those reported for diffusion-based solvers including DiffusionPDE and FunDPS. Decoder-only adaptation further improves recovery without retraining the backbone while retaining deterministic single-pass inference.
papers.comment: 34 pages, including supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/ru1ch3n/SCOPE. Author affiliation updated. Updated future-work discussion
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SCOPE 把稀疏观测下的完整 PDE 场恢复拆成全目标潜表示预测加物理重建：共享解码器同时从预测表示与完整视图重建场，使表示学习同时受物理恢复和潜匹配约束。在五个 PDE 设定的十个正/逆问题上，它在全部任务上超过 mask-aware neural operator，并取得低于 DiffusionPDE、FunDPS 等扩散式求解器的误差，同时保持确定性单次前向推理。
Motivation: 稀疏观测往往不能唯一确定底层物理状态，扩散式 PDE 求解器靠迭代采样补全但代价高，神经算子单次预测却缺少对部分观测恢复的针对性设计。
Method: SCOPE (Sparse-Context Observability-aware Predictive Embeddings) 耦合全目标潜预测与物理重建：共享解码器从预测表示和完整视图两路重建场，训练同时受物理恢复损失与潜匹配约束；在固定 teacher-decoder 对下推导二次风险分解，说明最优潜预测未必对应最优场重建，并给出解码器在完整输入上的改进可迁移到部分观测恢复的充分条件；另用 decoder-only adaptation 只调解码器、不重训 backbone。
Result: 在五个 PDE 设定上，SCOPE 在全部十个 forward 与 inverse 任务中超过 mask-aware neural operator，并取得低于扩散式求解器（含 DiffusionPDE 与 FunDPS）的误差；decoder-only adaptation 在不重训 backbone 的情况下进一步降低恢复误差，且保持确定性单次推理。
Conclusion: 全目标潜预测加共享解码器的物理重建可以在保持单次前向推理的同时，把稀疏观测的 PDE 场恢复做到优于 mask-aware 神经算子与扩散式求解器；风险分解指出改进解码器是把完整输入上的收益传到部分观测恢复的路径。

papers.title: Copula Active Subspaces I: A Score-Covariance Method for Reduced-Order Non-Gaussian Density Estimation
papers.abstract_en: In Bayesian inference problems with non-Gaussian observation noise, the posterior is only as accurate as the noise density, and gradient-based samplers need that density and its gradient evaluable pointwise, whether from an explicit expression or from code, and without an inner solve. We propose Copula Active Subspaces (CAS) to represent this noise density. A componentwise rank transform isolates the noise law's dependence in its copula, and a rank-$r$ reduction keeps only the directions along which that dependence varies. These directions are the leading eigenvectors of the copula score covariance $\boldsymbol{C} := \mathrm{Cov}_{π_{\boldsymbol{Z}}}(\nabla\log c^{Z})$, which is what makes the reduction a copula active subspace. Because $\boldsymbol{C}$ vanishes when the coordinates are independent, these are directions of dependence, which the covariance of the data need not identify. From this construction follow a Gaussian-reference KL divergence bound with the explicit constant $\tfrac{1}{2}$, minimized over all rank-$r$ reductions by exactly this eigenspace; a diagnostic for the error the reduction leaves behind, computable from the samples alone; and, from Hermite score matching, a reduced log-density and gradient in closed form, with the truncation orders and the Stage-2 regularization constants chosen on validation samples. The reduction replaces a $d$-dimensional density estimation problem by an $r$-dimensional one. On a $d=20$ noise law and a Bayesian inference problem with that noise, CAS lowers noise KL divergence more than fivefold and posterior KL divergence more than sevenfold against Gaussian-copula, product-of-marginals, and PCA-subspace baselines, and lowers noise KL divergence by factors of about $3.5$ and $2.7$ on two further $d=20$ examples.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 5 figures; supplementary materials 15 pages. Submitted to the SIAM/ASA Journal on Uncertainty Quantification. Code: https://github.com/joshuawchen/copula_active_subspaces (tag v1.0-part1). v2: Theorem 2.2 stated as the bound of Zahm et al. with a short proof, relation of Stage 1 to score ratio matching, corrected normalizer range in Appendix G
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Copula Active Subspaces (CAS)：用逐分量秩变换把噪声密度的边缘与依赖分离，再取 copula score 协方差 C := Cov(∇log c^Z) 的前 r 个特征向量做降维，在 r 维上用 Hermite score matching 闭式给出对数密度与梯度。在 d=20 的噪声律与相应贝叶斯推断问题上，相对 Gaussian-copula、product-of-marginals 与 PCA-subspace 基线，噪声 KL 降低五倍以上、后验 KL 降低七倍以上，另两个 d=20 例子上噪声 KL 分别降约 3.5 与 2.7 倍。
Motivation: 非高斯观测噪声下贝叶斯后验精度受噪声密度本身限制，而梯度采样器要求该密度及其梯度可逐点求值、且不需内层求解；直接在 d 维上估计非高斯密度代价高，且数据协方差识别不出纯依赖方向。
Method: CAS 先做逐分量 rank transform 把依赖隔离进 copula，再取 copula score 协方差 C 的前 r 个特征向量做 rank-r 降维（坐标独立时 C 为零，故这些方向只承载依赖）；由 Hermite score matching 在 r 维上给出闭式约化对数密度与梯度，截断阶数与 Stage-2 正则常数在验证样本上选定。理论部分给出高斯参考 KL 上界（显式常数 1/2，且被该特征子空间在所有 rank-r 降维中最小化）与仅由样本即可计算的残余误差诊断。
Result: 在 d=20 噪声律及其贝叶斯推断问题上，CAS 相对 Gaussian-copula、product-of-marginals、PCA-subspace 三条基线使噪声 KL 降低五倍以上、后验 KL 降低七倍以上；另两个 d=20 例子上噪声 KL 分别降低约 3.5 倍与 2.7 倍。
Conclusion: 把非高斯噪声密度估计压到 copula score 依赖方向构成的 r 维子空间，既保住逐点可求值的密度与梯度，又显著压低噪声与后验 KL；依赖方向应由 score 协方差而非数据协方差确定。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Why Backdooring Neural Networks is so Easy?
papers.abstract_en: Securing modern AI systems against backdoor attacks remains an open challenge and requires fundamentally principled estimates of the adversary's budget -- the poison fraction $π$ and trigger strength $α$ needed to construct successful yet stealthy attacks. Motivated by recent empirical evidence that poisoning large language models can require a nearly constant number of malicious samples even as clean datasets grow, we derive an exact closed-form analysis of a quadratic neuron trained on a poisoned Gaussian mixture. We show, perhaps counterintuitively, that the same feature-learning dynamics that make neural networks powerful can also make them more vulnerable to backdoors. Specifically, with clean accuracy preserved to first order, $O(π)$, we demonstrate that lazy learning imposes the inverse-square-root scaling $α\propto π^{-1/2}$ for a successful attack, while feature learning induces a quadratic detector whose loss margin scales as $O(α^4)$, improving the attack budget to $α\propto π^{-1/4}$. Consequently, nonlinear feature learning substantially reduces the trigger strength required at small poison fractions, thereby in a sense making feature learners more backdoor vulnerable. These results provide a theoretical mechanism consistent with large-scale empirical observations and demonstrate that security audits based on linear heuristics can systematically underestimate backdoor vulnerability in the widely adopted feature-learning regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 poisoned Gaussian mixture 上训练的二次神经元闭式分析表明：lazy learning 下成功后门需要触发强度 α ∝ π^{-1/2}，而 feature learning 诱导出损失余量为 O(α⁴) 的二次检测器，把预算改善到 α ∝ π^{-1/4}。因此在小投毒比例下非线性 feature learning 大幅降低所需触发强度，基于线性启发式的安全审计会系统性低估后门脆弱性。
Motivation: 防御方需要对对手预算（投毒比例 π 与触发强度 α）做有原则的估计，但现有审计多基于线性启发式；同时经验观察显示 LLM 投毒所需恶意样本数近似恒定，缺少与之对应的理论机制。
Method: 对在 poisoned Gaussian mixture 上训练的 quadratic neuron 推导精确闭式解，刻画特征学习动力学下的 clean accuracy、检测器损失余量与攻击预算标度，并把结果与大规模经验观察对照。
Result: clean accuracy 保持到一阶 O(π)；lazy learning 给出 α ∝ π^{-1/2}，feature learning 诱导的二次检测器损失余量为 O(α⁴)，对应攻击预算改善为 α ∝ π^{-1/4}。
Conclusion: 让网络强大的同一套特征学习动力学也会让其更易被后门攻击，线性启发式审计在广泛采用的 feature-learning 体制下会系统性低估脆弱性。

papers.title: HERO: Histology Encoder for Robust Representation in Oncology
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models trained on large pathology image corpora now provide strong, transferable representations for computational pathology. Over the past few years a series of such models has been released, each trained on more slides than the last; on standard classification and segmentation benchmarks, the leading models are now separated by small margins. In clinical use, however, the foundation model is applied to images from hospitals, scanners, and staining protocols outside its training data. Encoders generally embed these acquisition factors alongside biological information, which may introduce downstream errors and hinder safe clinical adoption. A pathology foundation model should therefore be robust to acquisition shift without giving up representation quality, yet robustness is seldom the axis along which models are compared. In this report, we introduce HERO (Histology Encoder for Robust Representation in Oncology), a ViT-G/14 pathology foundation model trained with the DINO and iBOT objectives and refined with high-resolution Gram anchoring on a morphology-balanced corpus of 500 million tiles from approximately 575,000 clinical whole-slide images. Across the evaluated public benchmarks, HERO shows the strongest robustness to center, scanner, and stain variation among the compared state-of-the-art foundation models, performs comparably on tile-level classification, segmentation, and gene-expression prediction, ranks first on average across 39 evaluated slide-level clinical tasks, and, under an equal-weighted framework-level analysis, has the best average rank across the six benchmark frameworks.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 4 figures, 13 tables; author information updated; scientific content unchanged
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HERO 是一个 ViT-G/14 病理基础模型，用 DINO 与 iBOT 目标在 500 万 tile、约 575,000 张临床全切片的形态学均衡语料上训练，再以高分辨率 Gram anchoring 精修，把中心、扫描仪、染色等采集域偏移从生物表征中剥离。在所评测的公开基准上，它在对比的 SOTA 基础模型中对中心/扫描仪/染色变化鲁棒性最强，tile 级分类、分割与基因表达预测表现相当，39 项切片级临床任务平均排名第一，六套基准框架的等权框架级分析中平均排名最佳。
Motivation: 病理基础模型在标准分类与分割基准上已彼此接近，但临床部署时会遇到训练数据之外的医院、扫描仪与染色协议；编码器通常把采集因素与生物信息一起嵌入，带来下游误差并阻碍安全的临床采用，而鲁棒性很少是比较轴。
Method: HERO 采用 ViT-G/14 架构，以 DINO 与 iBOT 目标在形态学均衡语料（500 million tiles，约 575,000 张临床 whole-slide images）上训练，并用高分辨率 Gram anchoring 精修；评测覆盖公开的 tile 级分类、分割、基因表达预测基准与 39 项切片级临床任务、六套基准框架。
Result: 在所评测的公开基准上，HERO 对 center、scanner、stain 变化的鲁棒性在对比的 SOTA 基础模型中最强；tile 级分类、分割、基因表达预测表现相当（comparable）；在 39 项切片级临床任务上平均排名第一；在等权框架级分析中，六套基准框架的平均排名最佳。
Conclusion: 病理基础模型可以在不牺牲表征质量的前提下对采集域偏移更鲁棒，鲁棒性应作为与精度并列的比较轴；HERO 在该轴上领先对比模型。

summary_sections.result: 在所评测的公开基准上，HERO 对 center、scanner、stain 变化的鲁棒性在对比的 SOTA 基础模型中最强；tile 级分类、分割、基因表达预测表现相当（comparable）；在 39 项切片级临床任务上平均排名第一；在等权框架级分析中，六套基准框架的平均排名最佳。
summary_sections.conclusion: 病理基础模型可以在不牺牲表征质量的前提下对采集域偏移更鲁棒，鲁棒性应作为与精度并列的比较轴；HERO 在该轴上领先对比模型。

papers.title: CipherGenome: Homomorphic Inference for Genomic Mixture-of-Experts
papers.abstract_en: Genome foundation models are growing into sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) networks whose expert weights no longer fit on the machines that hold the sequences, yet sending a private genome to rented accelerators exposes it: we show that a single server hosting one expert recovers the input nucleotides with 99.8% top-1 accuracy. We present CipherGenome, a protocol that keeps the embedding, attention and router of a 15.1B-parameter MoE genome model on a trusted thin client and outsources every expert projection, 95.8% of the parameters, to untrusted and possibly colluding GPU servers under module-LWE encryption. The design exploits three structural facts: expert layers are linear between two SwiGLU gates, expert weights are public, and GPU integer tensor cores can evaluate a ciphertext-weight product exactly modulo $2^{48}$ in a single GEMM. The client evaluates the nonlinearity exactly and re-encrypts with fresh secrets, so no polynomial approximation or bootstrapping is ever needed. On 72 windows from 12 bacterial genomes, encryption adds $2.54 \times 10^{-4}$ nats per token of KL divergence (95% CI upper bound $3.95 \times 10^{-4}$), below a pre-registered non-inferiority margin and indistinguishable from bf16 inference, while the same inversion attack falls to chance level. A reusable public hint cuts end-to-end latency by 3.54 times, wire compression reduces traffic 6.8 times, per-layer padding reduces routing leakage from 54.9% to 8.9% accuracy, and HE-compatible int4 experts remain non-inferior to their plaintext counterparts. Per expert and token, the server-side cost is more than six orders of magnitude below a CKKS baseline.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CipherGenome 把 15.1B 参数 MoE 基因组模型的 embedding、attention 与 router 留在可信瘦客户端，只把占参数 95.8% 的 expert 投影在 module-LWE 加密下外包给不可信 GPU 服务器，全程无需多项式近似或 bootstrapping。在 12 个细菌基因组的 72 个窗口上，加密相对明文推理的 KL 散度仅 2.54×10⁻⁴ nats/token（95% CI 上界 3.95×10⁻⁴），低于预注册的非劣界；单 expert 服务器的核苷酸反演攻击从 99.8% top-1 准确率降到随机水平，per-layer padding 把路由泄漏从 54.9% 压到 8.9%。
Motivation: 基因组基础模型转向稀疏 MoE 后 expert 权重放不进持有序列的机器，把私有基因组送到租来的加速器上会泄露输入：单个托管一个 expert 的服务器即可 99.8% top-1 准确率恢复核苷酸。

papers.title: GenomeOcean Anywhere: Private WebGPU Inference for Genome MoEs
papers.abstract_en: Genome foundation models are most useful where sequences are generated, yet the largest models need datacenter accelerators and a place to send private DNA. We ask whether a 15-billion-parameter genome mixture-of-experts (MoE) model can instead run on volunteers' web browsers, with the experts spread across many untrusted devices, without changing its predictions and without revealing the sequence to any single device. We build a system in which a trusted coordinator runs attention and routing while browser workers run every expert feed-forward network through hand-written WebGPU kernels, and we protect the expert inputs with real-valued Lagrange coded computing: each worker receives only a Gaussian-padded share, computes the expert's linear maps, and the coordinator decodes from any two of three workers. On GenomeOcean-MoE (8 experts, top-2 routing, 24 layers), the browser path matches native llama.cpp at every quantization level, the distributed path stays at the BF16 numerical noise floor (KL 0.0036 nats per token), and an unfitted latency model predicts decode time within 0.74% (median) under emulated wide-area links. We first show that plaintext expert inputs are not private: a probe recovers the token from a single vector at every depth, and one worker can identify the source genome from 300 unordered tokens with 92% accuracy. With coded experts, an adaptive attacker trained on shares falls to the most-frequent-token baseline, one worker's information about each token is bounded below one bit per forward pass, and the fidelity cost stays below the BF16 noise floor; in Chrome, coded decoding runs at 220 to 376 ms per token, depending on how much of the routing is hidden, and continues without replicas when a worker fails.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 150 亿参数的 genome MoE（GenomeOcean-MoE，8 专家、top-2 路由、24 层）搬到志愿者浏览器里跑：可信协调器负责 attention 与路由，浏览器 worker 用 WebGPU 手写 kernel 执行专家 FFN，专家输入用实值 Lagrange coded computing 保护（每 worker 只拿 Gaussian-padded share，任意 2/3 可解码）。浏览器路径在各量化级别与原生 llama.cpp 一致，分布式路径保持在 BF16 数值噪声底（KL 0.0036 nats/token），coded 解码在 Chrome 中每 token 220–376 ms。
Motivation: 基因组基础模型要在有序列生成的地方才最有用，但最大模型需要数据中心加速器，还得把私有 DNA 送出去；明文专家输入并不隐私——单个向量上的 probe 在每一深度都能恢复 token，一个 worker 能从 300 个无序 token 以 92% 准确率识别来源基因组。
Method: 可信协调器运行 attention 与 routing，浏览器 worker 通过手写 WebGPU kernel 运行每个专家 FFN；专家输入用实值 Lagrange coded computing（Gaussian padding 的 share，任意 2/3 解码）。另建一个未拟合的延迟模型，在模拟广域链路上预测解码时间。
Result: 浏览器路径在每个量化级别上匹配原生 llama.cpp；分布式路径保持在 BF16 数值噪声底，KL 0.0036 nats/token；未拟合延迟模型预测解码时间中位误差 0.74%。明文专家输入下 probe 每深度可恢复 token，单 worker 从 300 个无序 token 识别来源基因组准确率 92%；改用 coded experts 后自适应攻击者退化到 most-frequent-token 基线，单 worker 每次 forward 对每个 token 的信息量低于 1 bit，保真代价低于 BF16 噪声底；Chrome 中 coded 解码 220–376 ms/token（取决于隐藏多少路由），worker 失败时无需副本即可继续。
Conclusion: 在不改变预测、也不向任何单一设备暴露序列的前提下，15B genome MoE 可以在不可信的浏览器设备群上以 coded computing 运行；论文已被作者撤回，等待机构知识产权审查。

papers.title: GenoTrace: Inheritable Watermarks for Genome Foundation Model Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Can a genome model retain a detectable record of the synthetic sequences used to train it? We study watermark inheritance through distillation with GenoTrace, a codon-aware extension of green-list watermarking. Two token-level factors modulate the teacher's generation bias using codon position and organism-specific codon usage. The resulting sequences train a smaller student, whose outputs are audited without an active watermark processor. In a three-seed GenomeOcean-500M-to-100M experiment, the joint configuration achieves a mean audit score of 17.88 and 94.5% detection at a fixed threshold. It retains 49.0% detection after key-aware token substitution, compared with 0% for the available single-seed plain-watermark comparator, and 47.0% after combined mechanism-targeted nucleotide edits. Additional experiments establish inherited signal across five organism-conditioned datasets and teacher-student size ratios up to 40. Component ablations and computational sequence-quality assays reveal distinct operating points for detection strength and coding coverage. GenoTrace provides a practical token-level construction and an empirical account of how genomic structure shapes inherited watermark signals. The findings concern shared-tokenizer distillation and the tested editing procedures, with calibration and biological utility treated as separate evaluation requirements.
papers.comment: Withdrawn by the authors pending an institutional intellectual property review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GenoTrace 是面向基因组基础模型蒸馏的可继承水印：用密码子位置与物种特异密码子使用偏好两个 token 级因子调制 teacher 的生成偏置，学生模型输出在无主动水印处理器下仍可审计。三 seed 的 GenomeOcean-500M→100M 实验中联合配置平均审计分 17.88、固定阈值下检测率 94.5%，经 key-aware token 替换后仍保留 49.0% 检测（单 seed plain-watermark 对照为 0%），叠加机制定向核苷酸编辑后为 47.0%。
Motivation: 合成训练序列的来源在模型蒸馏后难以追溯：普通绿名单水印在学生模型上经 token 替换即完全失效，且基因组序列的密码子结构未被水印设计利用。
Method: GenoTrace 是 green-list watermarking 的密码子感知扩展，用 codon position 与 organism-specific codon usage 两个 token 级因子调制 teacher 生成偏置；所得序列训练更小的学生模型，审计阶段不使用主动水印处理器，并配合 component ablation 与计算性序列质量检测。
Result: 三 seed GenomeOcean-500M→100M 实验中联合配置平均审计分 17.88、固定阈值检测率 94.5%；key-aware token 替换后保留 49.0% 检测（可用的单 seed plain-watermark 对照为 0%），机制定向核苷酸编辑叠加后 47.0%；继承信号在五个 organism-conditioned 数据集上成立，teacher-student 规模比最高到 40。
Conclusion: 密码子结构可以塑造可继承的水印信号，使共享 tokenizer 的蒸馏模型在无主动处理器下仍可审计；结论范围限于 shared-tokenizer 蒸馏与所测编辑流程，校准与生物学效用被作为独立的评估要求。

papers.title: TACTICS: Taxonomy-Aware Intelligent Corpus Sampling for Machine Translation
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale machine-translation (MT) systems are typically evaluated on random samples from a corpus whose distributional composition is an artifact of how it was assembled. Such a sample inherits the phenomena the collection happens to contain rather than the full space a system must handle, spanning rule-governed conventions (terminology, punctuation, currency formatting) and context-dependent phenomena (tone, honorifics, document-level coherence), and thus provides no coverage guarantee for assessing robustness. We propose TACTICS (Taxonomy-Aware Coverage-opTimized Intelligent Corpus Sampling), which recasts coverage as an explicit objective. TACTICS induces a hierarchical taxonomy from a locale style guide, classifies segments against it, and selects a fixed-budget subset jointly optimizing coverage of rare categories, document-level coherence, and distributional fidelity to the full corpus. Applied to MT evaluation across four translation directions, TACTICS improves coverage of rare categories over lexical and embedding-based selection. By targeting the phenomena that separate systems, TACTICS makes a fixed evaluation budget go further, recovering the true system ranking from far fewer segments than random sampling wherever a real quality gap exists and never signaling a difference where none exists.
papers.comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026 (The Eleventh Conference in Machine Translation 2026 - WMT2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TACTICS 把 MT 评测语料的覆盖度写成显式优化目标：从 locale style guide 归纳层级分类体系，给片段分类后在固定预算下联合优化稀有类别覆盖、文档级连贯性与对全语料的分布保真。在四个翻译方向上，它比词面与 embedding 选择更好地覆盖稀有类别，能用远少于随机采样的片段恢复真实系统排序，且在无真实质量差距时不会误报差异。
Motivation: 大规模 MT 系统通常用语料随机抽样评测，样本分布是语料构建过程的副产物，只覆盖恰好被收进来的现象，对术语、标点、货币格式等规则性约定与语气、敬语、文档级连贯等上下文现象都没有覆盖保证，无法支撑鲁棒性评估。
Method: TACTICS (Taxonomy-Aware Coverage-opTimized Intelligent Corpus Sampling) 从 locale style guide 归纳层级 taxonomy，对语料片段做分类，然后在固定评测预算下联合优化三个目标：稀有类别覆盖、文档级连贯性、对完整语料的分布保真，选出子集替代随机抽样。
Result: 在四个翻译方向的 MT 评测上，TACTICS 对稀有类别的覆盖优于词面 (lexical) 与 embedding 基础的选择方法；在存在真实质量差距处，它用远少于随机采样的片段即可恢复真实系统排序，在不存在差距时从不发出差异信号。
Conclusion: 把评测覆盖度当作显式优化目标，固定评测预算就能更高效地区分 MT 系统：该方法在有真实差距时更快给出正确排序，在无差距时不误报。

summary_sections.method: TACTICS (Taxonomy-Aware Coverage-opTimized Intelligent Corpus Sampling) 从 locale style guide 归纳层级 taxonomy，对语料片段做分类，然后在固定评测预算下联合优化三个目标：稀有类别覆盖、文档级连贯性、对完整语料的分布保真，选出子集替代随机抽样。
summary_sections.result: 在四个翻译方向的 MT 评测上，TACTICS 对稀有类别的覆盖优于词面 (lexical) 与 embedding 基础的选择方法；在存在真实质量差距处，它用远少于随机采样的片段即可恢复真实系统排序，在不存在差距时从不发出差异信号。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把评测覆盖度当作显式优化目标，固定评测预算就能更高效地区分 MT 系统：该方法在有真实差距时更快给出正确排序，在无差距时不误报。

papers.title: Predicting Collision Cross Sections with GRACE: Geometric Residual Adduct Conditioning via Early-fusion
papers.abstract_en: Collision cross section (CCS), derived from ion mobility mass spectrometry, is a common descriptor for molecular annotation. Prediction is challenging for machine learning models because it reflects the size, shape, and ionization state of a gas-phase molecular ion. Most predictors either ignore explicit 3D structure or treat adduct identity as a late categorical feature, which limits their ability to capture adduct-dependent geometric effects. We present GRACE (Geometric Residual Adduct Conditioning via Early-fusion), a 3D CCS predictor that adapts a pretrained molecular geometry encoder using geometric residual adduct conditioning via early fusion. GRACE combines two inductive biases: a residual objective relative to an adduct-aware physical descriptor baseline and adduct conditioning within the encoder via a learned adduct token and low-rank attention adapters. We evaluate the model on a curated set of over 9,000 experimental molecule-adduct CCS records with random, scaffold, and adduct-sensitive splits designed to separate interpolation, scaffold generalization, and adduct-driven generalization. GRACE achieves the best mean percentage difference among the evaluated learned models on all three splits: 1.67% on the random split, 2.11% on the scaffold split, and 2.36% on the adduct-sensitive split. Diagnostic analyses suggest that residual learning stabilizes training by removing the dominant mass-CCS trend, while early fusion improves adduct-sensitive prediction relative to late fusion. Across four independent external test sets, GRACE shows consistently lower error than the other evaluated models. On a held-out set, GRACE also attains the lowest mean percent difference when compared with four previously reported physics-based workflows. These results support residual learning and encoder-level adduct conditioning as practical inductive biases for fast, accurate CCS prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GRACE 是一个 3D 碰撞截面 (CCS) 预测器，用早期融合把 adduct 身份注入预训练分子几何编码器（learned adduct token + 低秩 attention adapter），并以 adduct 感知的物理描述符基线为残差目标。在 9,000+ 条实验 molecule-adduct CCS 记录上，随机/scaffold/adduct-sensitive 三种划分的平均百分比误差分别为 1.67%、2.11%、2.36%，均为所评估学习模型中最优。
Motivation: CCS 反映气相离子的尺寸、形状与电离态，现有预测器要么忽略显式 3D 结构，要么把 adduct 身份当作晚期类别特征，无法捕捉 adduct 依赖的几何效应。
Method: GRACE 在预训练分子几何编码器上做几何残差 adduct 条件化：一是相对 adduct 感知物理描述符基线的残差目标，二是编码器内通过 learned adduct token 与低秩 attention adapters 实现的早期融合 adduct 条件化；在 9,000+ 条实验 CCS 记录上用 random、scaffold、adduct-sensitive 三种划分评测。
Result: 在三种划分上 GRACE 均取得所评估学习模型中最低平均百分比误差：random 1.67%、scaffold 2.11%、adduct-sensitive 2.36%；诊断分析显示残差学习通过去除主导的 mass-CCS 趋势稳定训练，早期融合相对晚期融合改善 adduct 敏感预测；在四个独立外部测试集上误差一致低于其他所评估模型，且在留出集上相对四个已报道的 physics-based workflows 平均百分比误差最低。
Conclusion: 残差学习与编码器级 adduct 条件化是快速准确 CCS 预测的实用归纳偏置，adduct 身份应在编码器内早期融合而非作为晚期类别特征。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: [DeepGOF] Where Does a Logistic Risk Model Fail? An Audited Neural Goodness-of-Fit Test for Model Development and External Validation
papers.abstract_en: Goodness-of-fit tests for logistic regression are routine in clinical risk modelling, yet the classical tests say whether a model misfits, not where. A pretrained network is not a test until its level, power and blind spots are established. We audit DeepGOF-1, which renders the residuals of a fitted logistic model as a map over the ranks of two covariates, scores the map with a frozen convolutional network, and calibrates the score by the analyst's parametric bootstrap. The level is first-order valid under standard bootstrap regularity and two conditions, consistency against a named alternative is decided by one forward pass, and local power has an explicit limit. In simulation the level holds from 20 patients to 8,873; the network adds power over a chi-square statistic of the same map when misfit is sparse among many covariates; the map finds a missed interaction that one-covariate diagnostics cannot see; and, applied to a published risk model on new patients, it is an exactly valid test of calibration within patient subgroups, where the calibration belt has little power. In the SUPPORT study of 8,873 inpatients, DeepGOF-1 rejects a linear in-hospital mortality model, its map shows the U-shaped risks of blood pressure and respiratory rate that a calibration curve hides, and it guides the repairs. It ran in 13 seconds; the projection test, the strongest omnibus rival, took 9 hours 53 minutes and 4.5 GB on the same data, too slow for routine use. The test is deepgof1() in the R package ebrahim.gof.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 7 figures, 8 tables; supplement 47 pages. Code, network weights and every per-replicate result: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23078640. R package ebrahim.gof on CRAN
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeepGOF-1 把逻辑回归残差映射到两个协变量秩上的图，用冻结卷积网络打分并以参数自助法 (parametric bootstrap) 校准，从而不仅判定失配、还定位失配。在 SUPPORT 8,873 名住院患者数据上它拒绝线性院内死亡模型，图中显示血压与呼吸频率的 U 形风险（校准曲线看不出来），运行仅 13 秒，而最强的 omnibus 对手 projection test 需 9 小时 53 分、4.5 GB。
Motivation: 临床风险模型常用的逻辑回归拟合优度检验只回答模型是否失配，不回答失配在哪里；预训练网络在确立水平、功效与盲区之前不能当作检验使用。
Method: DeepGOF-1 将已拟合逻辑模型的残差渲染为两个协变量秩上的二维图，用冻结的卷积网络对图打分，再用分析者的参数自助法校准分数；其一阶有效性依赖标准自助正则性与两个条件，对指定备择的一致性由一次前向传播判定，局部功效有显式极限。
Result: 模拟中水平 (level) 在 20 到 8,873 名患者的样本量上均保持；当失配在众多协变量中稀疏时，网络比同一张图的卡方统计量更有功效；该图能找到单协变量诊断看不到的交互项。SUPPORT 8,873 名住院患者上 DeepGOF-1 拒绝线性院内死亡模型，图示血压与呼吸频率的 U 形风险，运行 13 秒；projection test 在同一数据上耗时 9 小时 53 分、4.5 GB。
Conclusion: 经审计的神经拟合优度检验可以既给出有效水平又定位失配，且速度足以进入常规临床风险模型的开发与外部验证流程；实现为 R 包 ebrahim.gof 的 deepgof1()。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WAM-OPD: Joint Video-Action Supervision for World Action Model Post-Training with On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) generate both future video and robot actions, offering two connected outputs for post-training supervision. How can a pretrained WAM learn from a stronger Teacher on the histories it encounters during execution? We present WAM-OPD, which collects Student rollout histories and queries a Teacher for paired video and action targets. The Student learns from both targets while retaining its one-step video and action generation at deployment. Across 12 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks, WAM-OPD improves average success from 33.8% to 65.7%; across four real-robot tasks, it improves average success from 51.4% to 64.6%. With the collected Student histories held fixed, joint video-action supervision achieves the highest observed success on all three ablation tasks, while either modality alone also improves performance. A separate comparison with Teacher-generated histories finds task-dependent differences between the two history sources. These results demonstrate the value of paired video-action supervision for improving WAM policies without increasing their deployed sampling budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WAM-OPD 用 Student 自身 rollout 历史向更强 Teacher 查询成对的视频与动作目标，同时监督两个模态，且部署时仍保持单步生成视频与动作。在 RoboTwin 2.0 的 12 项任务上平均成功率从 33.8% 升到 65.7%，四项真机任务从 51.4% 升到 64.6%，且不增加部署采样预算。
Motivation: 预训练 World Action Model 在执行中遇到的历史分布上难以从更强 Teacher 获益：视频与动作两个输出彼此关联，但缺少在 Student 自身轨迹上成对的监督信号。
Method: 收集 Student rollout 历史，向 Teacher 查询配对的视频与动作目标，用两者联合监督 Student 的一步视频与动作生成；部署阶段不改变单步生成方式。另做固定 Student 历史的消融（联合 vs 单模态）以及与 Teacher 生成历史的对比。
Result: RoboTwin 2.0 上 12 项任务平均成功率 33.8% → 65.7%；四项真机任务 51.4% → 64.6%。固定 Student 历史时，联合视频-动作监督在全部三项消融任务上取得最高成功率，单独任一模态也有提升；与 Teacher 生成历史的对比呈现任务相关的差异。
Conclusion: 在 Student 自己的执行历史上做配对视频-动作监督即可提升 WAM 策略，无需增加部署采样预算；历史来源（Student rollout vs Teacher 生成）的优劣依任务而定。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: [EDGE] A grouped calibration test for logistic regression that tolerates a few corrupted records
papers.abstract_en: The Hosmer-Lemeshow calibration test groups patients by predicted risk for a valid reference and loses power that more groups cannot recover. Later tests weight each record's residual alone, which makes them fragile: on an otherwise correct model, one record in a thousand with a corrupted covariate raises the false-alarm rate of Stukel's score test from 5% to 12%, and ten to 63%. Pooling on equal-size groups bounds a wrong record's influence, dividing its residual by its groupmates' variance; without pooling, the same directions are as fragile as Stukel's test after a refit. EDGE, the test proposed here, projects the grouped residuals onto a small basis of calibration shapes. Its degrees of freedom do not depend on the number of groups, so the partition becomes a setting, fine-grained for power and coarse when records may be wrong, and its reference needs no resampling. In a prespecified simulation EDGE was comparable in power to Stukel's test on clean data and 0.064 more powerful on average than the ten-group Hosmer-Lemeshow test. With one and ten exaggerated covariates in a thousand its false-alarm rates were 0.056 and 0.097, and with ten groups below 0.10 up to about ten exaggerated or five reversed. In external validation, at ten groups, its average power was that of Cox's recalibration test and the GiViTI belt, and its false-alarm rate stayed below 0.10 with ten reversed records in a thousand, where theirs did not. In a 70,000-patient cohort its verdict did not change with the partition.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables; Supporting Information as an ancillary file. v2: revised and retitled, with new studies of corrupted records and external validation and a clinical cohort. R package ebrahim.gof (CRAN). Archive: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23079225. Develops a method introduced in one chapter of the first author's M.Sc. thesis (arXiv:2608.11140)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出分组校准检验 EDGE：把分组残差投影到少量校准形状基上，自由度不随分组数变化，从而可用细分组换功效、粗分组抗污染记录，且参考分布无需重采样。在预设模拟中功效与 Stukel 检验相当、平均比十组 Hosmer-Lemeshow 高 0.064；每千条一条夸大协变量时误报率 0.056、十条时 0.097，而 Stukel 从 5% 升到 12%、十条升到 63%。
Motivation: Hosmer-Lemeshow 按预测风险分组虽参考分布有效但功效损失且加组无法挽回；逐记录加权的后期检验（如 Stukel's score test）对单条污染协变量极脆弱，一条/千条即把 5% 误报抬到 12%、十条抬到 63%。
Method: EDGE 将分组残差投影到一小组校准形状基上，自由度与分组数无关，分组方案成为可调设置（细分求功效、粗分抗错），参考分布解析给出、不需重采样；在预设模拟、外部验证与 70,000 患者队列上检验，并提供 R 包 ebrahim.gof。
Result: 预设模拟中 EDGE 功效与 Stukel 检验相当，平均比十组 Hosmer-Lemeshow 高 0.064；每千条 1 条和 10 条夸大协变量时误报率分别为 0.056 与 0.097（Stukel 对应 12% 与 63%）；十组设置下可容忍约 10 条夸大或 5 条反向记录而误报低于 0.10。外部验证十组时平均功效与 Cox recalibration test、GiViTI belt 相当，且每千条 10 条反向记录时误报仍低于 0.10 而两者不满足；70,000 患者队列中判定不随分组方案改变。
Conclusion: 通过分组池化并把残差投影到固定小基，校准检验可以在不牺牲功效的前提下把单条污染记录的影响限制住，分组数从检验定义降为可调设置。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 预设模拟中 EDGE 功效与 Stukel 检验相当，平均比十组 Hosmer-Lemeshow 高 0.064；每千条 1 条和 10 条夸大协变量时误报率分别为 0.056 与 0.097（Stukel 对应 12% 与 63%）；十组设置下可容忍约 10 条夸大或 5 条反向记录而误报低于 0.10。外部验证十组时平均功效与 Cox recalibration test、GiViTI belt 相当，且每千条 10 条反向记录时误报仍低于 0.10 而两者不满足；70,000 患者队列中判定不随分组方案改变。
summary_sections.conclusion: 通过分组池化并把残差投影到固定小基，校准检验可以在不牺牲功效的前提下把单条污染记录的影响限制住，分组数从检验定义降为可调设置。

papers.title: Fixed Points Without Fixed Diffusion: Implicit Neural Sheaves for Convergent Test-Time Computation
papers.abstract_en: Implicit Graph Neural Networks (IGNNs) define node representations as fixed points of graph neural operators, enabling effectively infinite-depth propagation, iteration-independent parameterization, and flexible test-time computation. Yet these benefits depend on the equilibrium being unique and reached by fixed-point iteration. Existing constructions often impose constraints on recurrent updates to obtain these guarantees, limiting the transformations available at equilibrium. This raises a central question: can IGNNs gain expressiveness through richer, edge-dependent transformations while retaining the inherent strengths of their equilibrium formulation? We introduce SheafDEQ, a subhomogeneous deep-equilibrium architecture with adaptive neural-sheaf propagation. Its learned, matrix-valued sheaf restriction maps can align, mix, or reverse neighbouring representations. Under mild regularity conditions, we prove that SheafDEQ admits a unique equilibrium reached globally by fixed-point iteration from any positive initial state. Contractivity further guarantees convergence under bounded communication staleness. We evaluate SheafDEQ on distributed-inference tasks requiring repeated nonlocal aggregation and on community detection whose rewiring increasingly favours cross-community interactions. SheafDEQ improves over implicit baselines on Sums, MNIST Terrain, and Coordinates, and on community detection as connectivity becomes increasingly heterophilic. SheafDEQ remains competitive with recurrent models without equilibrium guarantees. Continued-iteration diagnostics show decreasing residuals and retained test accuracy through 100 iterations, unlike the finite-horizon control, while delayed-update experiments show low sensitivity to bounded communication staleness.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 5th Learning on Graphs Conference (LoG 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SheafDEQ 用可学习的矩阵值 sheaf restriction map 做边相关的自适应传播，使隐式图神经网络在更丰富的平衡态变换下仍保证唯一平衡且从任意正初值经不动点迭代全局收敛。在 Sums、MNIST Terrain、Coordinates 分布式推断与异质性增强的社区发现上优于隐式基线，迭代到 100 次残差持续下降且测试精度保持。
Motivation: IGNN 的无限深度与迭代无关参数化依赖平衡唯一且可由不动点迭代达到，但现有构造靠限制递归更新来换取这些保证，牺牲了平衡态可用的变换表达力。
Method: 提出次齐次 (subhomogeneous) 深度平衡架构 SheafDEQ，配自适应神经 sheaf 传播：学到的矩阵值 restriction map 可对齐、混合或反转邻域表示；在温和正则条件下证明唯一平衡与全局不动点迭代收敛，并由压缩性 (contractivity) 保证有界通信延迟下的收敛。
Result: 在分布式推断任务 Sums、MNIST Terrain、Coordinates 上优于隐式基线；在连通性日益偏向跨社区交互（heterophilic）的社区发现上同样提升；与无平衡保证的循环模型相比保持竞争力。持续迭代诊断显示残差递减、100 次迭代后测试精度保持（有限步对照则不然），延迟更新实验对有界通信 staleness 敏感度低。
Conclusion: 边相关的丰富变换与平衡态的唯一性、收敛性保证可以兼得，且在有界通信延迟下仍保持收敛与精度。

papers.title: Fine-Tuning Generative Models for Extreme Events via CVaR-Penalized Wasserstein Gradient Flows
papers.abstract_en: In many high-stakes domains, extreme events carry substantial consequences, yet learning the heavy-tailed distributions that govern them from finite samples remains challenging: the quantities of interest are driven by a few extreme observations, so the tail is under-sampled relative to its importance. Even generative models tailored for heavy tails capture the tail region inadequately in practice. We propose the Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR)-penalized Generative Particle Algorithm (CVaR-GPA), a tail-agnostic algorithm for fine-tuning generative models toward heavy-tailed targets, built as a time discretization of the Wasserstein gradient flow of the Lipschitz-regularized KL divergence penalized by a CVaR discrepancy term. Such a flow can be initialized from the output samples of the pre-trained model, which are then transported along the gradient descent of the loss functional, without requiring access to the pre-trained model's internal architecture. The Lipschitz-regularized KL divergence requires minimal assumptions on the target, while the CVaR penalty focuses the flow on the tail. The CVaR penalty depends on the target only through a scalar tail statistic, inducing a velocity field that remains active in the under-sampled tail region at a dimension-free estimation cost. The resulting velocity field, and hence the depth of the transport map, implicitly adapts to the target, without target-specific modifications. Across four targets, including two real-world, high-dimensional datasets (daily streamflow in the Ohio River basin ($d=64$) and the Fama-French portfolios ($d=25$) with tail indices ranging from $1.05$ to $3.34$), fine-tuning with CVaR-GPA reduces global and tail errors by geometric-mean factors of $14.0 \times$ and $9.8 \times$, respectively, across seven pre-trained models spanning GANs, diffusion models, and other generative flows, with a single set of hyperparameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CVaR-GPA：对预训练生成模型输出样本做 Wasserstein 梯度流的时间离散微调，损失为 Lipschitz 正则 KL 散度加 CVaR 惩罚项，把流的注意力压到重尾的欠采样区域。在四个目标（含 Ohio River basin 日流量 d=64、Fama-French 组合 d=25，尾指数 1.05–3.34）上，对七个预训练模型用同一组超参微调，全局误差与尾部误差按几何平均分别降低 14.0× 与 9.8×。
Motivation: 极端事件由少数极端样本主导，尾部相对其重要性被严重欠采样；即便面向重尾设计的生成模型，实践中对尾区的刻画也不足。
Method: CVaR-GPA 是 Lipschitz 正则 KL 散度加 CVaR discrepancy 惩罚的 Wasserstein 梯度流的时间离散化；可直接从预训练模型的输出样本初始化，沿损失泛函梯度下降输运，无需访问预训练模型内部架构。CVaR 惩罚只通过一个标量尾统计量依赖目标，估计代价与维度无关，速度场在欠采样尾区保持活跃。
Result: 在四个目标上（含两个真实高维数据集：Ohio River basin 日流量 d=64、Fama-French 组合 d=25，尾指数 1.05 至 3.34），对七个覆盖 GAN、diffusion 与其他生成流的预训练模型，用单一超参组合微调后全局误差与尾部误差按几何平均分别降低 14.0× 与 9.8×。
Conclusion: 只用一个标量尾统计量做 CVaR 惩罚，就能在不改目标特定结构、不接触预训练架构的前提下，把生成模型微调推向重尾目标并同时压低全局与尾部误差。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: XClipGS: Exact Half-Space Clipping for Medical Volume Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian-splatting proxies enable interactive rendering of volumetric medical scans, but a clipping plane exposes anatomy not constrained by external-view training and intersects primitives that conventional splatting can only keep or drop whole. We present XClipGS (eXact Clipping), which treats these as two separate problems: the render-time clip operator and supervision of the hidden interior. Under the local affine model used by EWA splatting, the ray integral of a half-space-restricted Gaussian factorizes exactly into its ordinary 2D footprint and a conditional Gaussian CDF whose argument is affine in pixel coordinates. The resulting closed-form per-pixel operator introduces no learned clipping parameters or auxiliary network and remains differentiable with respect to the primitive and plane. We use multi-distance reference views with varied clipping-plane axes and offsets to supervise the interior through the same operator. We also introduce a paired clipped/unclipped cut-face protocol with difference-referenced cut error (CDE) and culled-side leakage (Leak), because global image metrics dilute errors near the plane. On eight CT and MRI volumes with plane offsets not used for training, XClipGS attains the highest PSNR on every volume (33.56 versus 32.34 dB for ClipGS) while rendering at over 650 FPS, far above real time, versus 278 FPS. On voxel-axis cut-face views, it raises average band SSIM from 0.809 to 0.860 and leaks roughly 40 times less. Without retraining, it also achieves the best average across all four metrics on arbitrary-normal planes; on a fixed interior, it matches RaRa's face fidelity with about 16 times less leakage. Project page: https://gaozhongpai.github.io/XClipGS/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: XClipGS 把医学体数据 Gaussian Splatting 的裁剪面问题拆成渲染时裁剪算子与被遮挡内部监督两件事：在 EWA 局部仿射模型下半空间限制的高斯光线积分精确分解为常规 2D footprint 与参数对像素坐标仿射的条件高斯 CDF，得到闭式、可微、无学习参数的逐像素算子。在 8 个 CT/MRI 体积、训练未用过的平面偏移上 PSNR 每个体积都最高（33.56 vs ClipGS 32.34 dB），渲染超 650 FPS（ClipGS 278 FPS），体轴切面带内 SSIM 从 0.809 升到 0.860 且泄漏少约 40 倍。
Motivation: 裁剪面会暴露外部视角训练从未约束的内部解剖，而传统 splatting 对被平面穿过的图元只能整体保留或整体丢弃，切面附近误差被全局图像指标稀释。
Method: 在 EWA splatting 的局部仿射模型下把半空间限制高斯的光线积分精确分解为常规 2D footprint 与条件高斯 CDF（参数对像素坐标仿射），得到闭式逐像素裁剪算子，对图元与平面均可微、无学习参数与辅助网络；用不同距离、不同裁剪轴与偏移的参考视图经同一算子监督内部，并提出配对裁剪/未裁剪切面协议，含差分参照切面误差 (CDE) 与被剔除侧泄漏 (Leak)。
Result: 在 8 个 CT 与 MRI 体积、平面偏移未参与训练的设置下，XClipGS 每个体积 PSNR 均最高，平均 33.56 dB vs ClipGS 32.34 dB，渲染超 650 FPS vs 278 FPS；体轴切面视图上平均带内 SSIM 从 0.809 提到 0.860，泄漏少约 40 倍；无需重训在任意法向平面上四项指标平均最优，在固定内部设置下以约少 16 倍泄漏匹配 RaRa 的切面保真度。
Conclusion: 把裁剪面的渲染算子与内部监督分开处理，用闭式可微的半空间裁剪即可同时提高切面保真度、压低泄漏并保持远超实时的渲染速度，且对训练未见的平面偏移与任意法向泛化。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: ORACLE: Agentic AI Orchestrator Routing Via Adaptive Verifier Calibration Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Modern enterprise agent deployments consist of a heterogeneous pool of large language models (LLMs) having diverse capabilities and cost. Existing model routing strategies optimize the quality-cost trade-off, while providing request-level static decisions. More recent solutions address agentic routing as a task-level selection with a serial verifier based router feedback loop. However, their fixed verifier suitable for homogeneous workloads may not generalize to heterogeneous batches of agentic tasks (example: coding, general conversational). Additionally, due to the verifier placement in the critical path of the loop, serving quality may be affected during multiple concurrent requests routing. To mitigate these issues, we present ORACLE. It is a concurrency-aware online routing mechanism that aligns adaptive routing with adaptive verification for feedback. ORACLE acts as a training-free drop-in 'feedback loop' on top of any model-selection policy to first classify the task type and then dynamically assigns a task-appropriate verifier. Further, we develop a delayed feedback strategy for concurrent requests that largely removes verifier latency from the dispatch critical path. We then present a post-routing dispatch scheduler, namely DISC. DISC reserves each task's peak KV footprint at admission and dispatches to an alternate backend when the reward gain from reduced wait exceeds the reward loss from lower accuracy. Extensive evaluation on SWE-bench, tau2-bench, and Terminal-Bench 2.0 shows that ORACLE improves the accuracy-cost frontier by up to 7 percentage points over state-of-the-art routing baselines, while ORACLE with DISC improves program throughput by up to 1.8x. To facilitate reproducibility and support future development, we open-source the code-base of ORACLE at https://github.com/ORACLE-org/ORACLE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ORACLE 是面向企业级异构 LLM agent 部署的并发感知在线路由机制：先分类任务类型再动态分配匹配的 verifier，并用延迟反馈把 verifier 延迟移出并发请求的派发关键路径，其上再叠加派发调度器 DISC。在 SWE-bench、tau2-bench、Terminal-Bench 2.0 上，ORACLE 相对最先进路由基线最多提升 7 个百分点的 accuracy-cost frontier，叠加 DISC 后程序吞吐量最高提升 1.8 倍。
Motivation: 现有模型路由只做请求级静态决策；较新的 agentic 路由用固定 verifier 做任务级串行反馈，但固定 verifier 在异构任务批次（编码、通用对话）上不泛化，且 verifier 位于回路关键路径，多并发请求时拖累服务质量。
Method: ORACLE 是训练无关 (training-free) 的即插即用反馈回路，叠加在任意模型选择策略之上：先做任务类型分类，再动态指派任务适配的 verifier；对并发请求采用延迟反馈策略，把 verifier 延迟移出派发关键路径；其后接派发调度器 DISC，在准入时预留每个任务的峰值 KV 占用，并在等待缩短带来的 reward 增益超过精度下降的 reward 损失时改派到备用后端。
Result: 在 SWE-bench、tau2-bench、Terminal-Bench 2.0 上，ORACLE 相比 SOTA 路由基线最多提升 7 个百分点的 accuracy-cost frontier；ORACLE 加 DISC 使程序吞吐量最高提升 1.8 倍。
Conclusion: 把自适应路由与自适应验证对齐、并把 verifier 移出并发派发关键路径，可以在异构 agentic 工作负载上同时改善质量-成本权衡与吞吐；代码已开源。
Relevance: 0
