summary_sections.method: ORACLE 是训练无关 (training-free) 的即插即用反馈回路，叠加在任意模型选择策略之上：先做任务类型分类，再动态指派任务适配的 verifier；对并发请求采用延迟反馈策略，把 verifier 延迟移出派发关键路径；其后接派发调度器 DISC，在准入时预留每个任务的峰值 KV 占用，并在等待缩短带来的 reward 增益超过精度下降的 reward 损失时改派到备用后端。
summary_sections.result: 在 SWE-bench、tau2-bench、Terminal-Bench 2.0 上，ORACLE 相比 SOTA 路由基线最多提升 7 个百分点的 accuracy-cost frontier；ORACLE 加 DISC 使程序吞吐量最高提升 1.8 倍。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把自适应路由与自适应验证对齐、并把 verifier 移出并发派发关键路径，可以在异构 agentic 工作负载上同时改善质量-成本权衡与吞吐；代码已开源。

papers.title: Deep learning-based prediction of time-resolved adhesive forces in viscoelastic Hertzian contacts
papers.abstract_en: Fast prediction of the response of adhesive soft viscoelastic contacts represents a current challenge in soft robotics and for gripping and manipulation tasks. Determining the complete time-resolved force trajectory requires full numerical simulations, whose computational cost is strongly parameter-dependent, making them impractical for real-time application or design-optimization loops. In this work, we overcome this limitation by training a scalar-conditioned, stateful, sequence-to-sequence deep learning model to predict the full force evolution from a prescribed displacement history for both short- and long-range adhesion regimes. The data set spans four orders of magnitude in loading and unloading rates and includes varied dwell times, with the Tabor parameter ranging from $0.2$ to $3.2$. To enable learning across these heterogeneous time scales, we introduce a fixed-measurement-step (FMS) representation that converts variable-length trajectories into fixed-length sequences while preserving their physical-time information. Different architectures were trained, including long short-term memory (LSTM) networks, temporal convolutional neural (TCN) networks, and time-distributed dense layers with three different Tabor-conditioning mechanisms. The models were compared using global waveform and error metrics. We found that the best-performing model has an LSTM architecture with concatenated conditioning, which achieves a held-out mean-squared error of $5.0\times10^{-4}$, a median pull-off-force error of $\approx2.2\%$, and a median hysteresis error of $\approx1.1\%$. For the held-out protocols, the model predicts a complete force trajectory with a median inference time of $0.16$ s. The model is tested across unseen parameter combinations and against analytical limiting cases, providing a rapid surrogate for repeated numerical evaluations with potential use in control-oriented applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用标量条件化、带状态的 seq-to-seq 深度模型，从给定位移历史直接预测黏弹性 Hertz 接触的完整时间分辨黏附力轨迹，覆盖短程与长程黏附两种机制。最优模型为 LSTM 加拼接式 Tabor 条件化，held-out MSE 5.0×10⁻⁴、拔出力中位误差约 2.2%、迟滞误差约 1.1%，单条轨迹中位推理 0.16 s。
Motivation: 黏弹性黏附接触的完整力-时间轨迹只能靠全数值仿真得到，计算量随参数强变，无法用于实时控制或设计优化循环。
Method: 训练标量条件化、stateful 的 seq-to-seq 模型，输入位移历史输出整条力演化；提出固定测量步长 (FMS) 表示，把变长轨迹转成定长序列并保留物理时间信息。对比 LSTM、TCN 与 time-distributed dense 三种架构及三种 Tabor 条件化机制，数据集跨加载/卸载速率四个数量级、含不同 dwell time，Tabor 参数 0.2–3.2，用全局波形与误差指标比较。
Result: 最优为 LSTM + 拼接条件化：held-out MSE 5.0×10⁻⁴，拔出力中位误差约 2.2%，迟滞中位误差约 1.1%；held-out 协议上完整力轨迹的中位推理时间 0.16 s。模型在未见过的参数组合上测试，并对照解析极限情形。
Conclusion: LSTM 加拼接式标量条件化可作为重复数值仿真的快速代理，在未见参数组合与解析极限下保持精度，适用于控制导向的实时评估。

papers.title: Rethinking the Evaluation of Harness Evolution for Agents
papers.abstract_en: Harness evolution is an iterative search procedure that repeatedly evaluates and revises candidate harnesses used for LLM agents using task feedback. We revisit the evaluation of such automatic harness evolution procedures and identify two fundamental issues in the protocol. First, prior work does not compare these approaches with simple task-level search baselines under matched feedback and inference budgets. Second, prior work searches for harness configurations using verification signals (e.g., unit test cases) drawn from the same benchmarks on which it reports the final performance of the evolved harnesses, violating the standard separation between training and test data. To address this, we compare automatic harness evolution with simple test-time scaling and discovery baselines under comparable feedback and inference budgets, and evaluate evolved harnesses on held-out tasks to assess generalization. Following prior work, we experiment on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and find that automatic harness evolution fails to outperform simple test-time scaling methods both with and without test cases, and exhibits limited generalization. However, we find that long-horizon games are a promising setting for automatic harness evolution, as they are difficult enough to leave headroom, rely heavily on adaptation to out-of-distribution dynamics, and provide granular feedback by design. In these settings, task-specific harness evolution improves over the search baseline by 80.0% on ARC-AGI-3 and by 10.9% on EdgeBench under matched budgets. Together, these findings highlight the need for matched-budget baselines and held-out evaluation to distinguish genuine harness improvements from benchmark-specific search and overfitting, and point to a more careful characterization of when automatic harness evolution is actually useful. Our code is available at https://github.com/rethinking-harness-evolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在匹配反馈与推理预算下重评 LLM agent 的 harness evolution：在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上它既不敌简单的 test-time scaling（有无测试用例皆然），泛化也有限；只有在长时程游戏这类留有余量、依赖适应 OOD 动态且反馈天然细粒度的设定里才有效，任务特定 harness evolution 在 ARC-AGI-3 上比搜索基线高 80.0%、EdgeBench 高 10.9%。作者主张用匹配预算基线加 held-out 评测来区分真实改进与基准过拟合。
Motivation: 既往 harness evolution 评测有两处协议缺陷：未在匹配反馈与推理预算下与简单任务级搜索基线比较；用最终报告成绩的同一基准的验证信号（如单元测试）搜索配置，破坏了训练与测试的分离，无法判断改进是否只是基准内搜索。
Method: 在匹配的反馈与推理预算下，把自动 harness evolution 与简单的 test-time scaling 和 discovery 基线对比（含使用与不使用测试用例两种情形），并把演化出的 harness 放到 held-out 任务上评测泛化；沿用先验工作在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上实验，另在长时程游戏设定中做任务特定演化。
Result: 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上，自动 harness evolution 在匹配预算下不敌简单 test-time scaling（有测试用例与无测试用例皆然），且泛化有限；在长时程游戏设定中，任务特定 harness evolution 相对搜索基线在 ARC-AGI-3 上提升 80.0%、在 EdgeBench 上提升 10.9%。
Conclusion: 匹配预算的基线与 held-out 评测是区分真实 harness 改进和基准特定搜索/过拟合的必要条件；自动 harness evolution 只在难度足够、依赖适应 OOD 动态且反馈细粒度的长时程游戏里才真正有用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ELSA3D: Elastic Semantic Anchoring for Unified 3D Understanding and Generation
papers.abstract_en: Unified 3D foundation models aspire to generate 3D assets and reason about them in language within a single backbone, but their text-3D interaction remains largely implicit. Existing methods concatenate text and 3D tokens into a flat sequence and rely on self-attention, collapsing coarse structural cues and fine geometric details into one undifferentiated representation. We introduce ELSA3D, a unified 3D model that addresses this with elastic semantic anchoring, structuring language and geometric reasoning jointly along matched abstraction scales. ELSA3D represents geometry with a scale-aware octree tokenizer and introduces Anchor Tokens, sparse cross-modal units that select semantic cues, route them to the most relevant 3D scale, retrieve scale-specific geometric evidence, and write the fused signal back into the unified representation, keeping interaction sparse yet precise. A lightweight per-block router makes both computation and reasoning elastic, choosing which text tokens instantiate anchors at which geometric scale so that cross-modal capacity concentrates where alignment is most needed. ELSA3D achieves state-of-the-art performance across image-to-3D generation, text-to-3D generation, and 3D captioning, outperforming the strongest unified baseline while roughly halving FLOPs and inference latency relative to the non-elastic version of the same model.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project link: https://plan-lab.github.io/elsa3D
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ELSA3D 用弹性语义锚定 (elastic semantic anchoring) 把文本与几何推理对齐到匹配的抽象尺度：scale-aware octree tokenizer 表示几何，稀疏 Anchor Tokens 跨模态选择语义线索并路由到最相关的 3D 尺度，per-block router 决定哪些文本 token 在哪个几何尺度实例化锚点。在 image-to-3D、text-to-3D 与 3D captioning 上达到 SOTA，超过最强统一基线，同时相对同模型非弹性版本把 FLOPs 与推理延迟约减半。
Motivation: 统一 3D 基础模型把文本与 3D token 拼成扁平序列靠 self-attention 交互，粗结构线索与细几何细节被压成无差别表示，文本-3D 交互基本是隐式的。
Method: 几何用 scale-aware octree tokenizer 编码；Anchor Tokens 作为稀疏跨模态单元，选择语义线索、路由到最相关 3D 尺度、检索该尺度的几何证据并把融合信号写回统一表示；轻量 per-block router 决定哪些文本 token 在哪些几何尺度实例化锚点，使跨模态容量集中在最需要对齐处。
Result: 在 image-to-3D generation、text-to-3D generation 与 3D captioning 三项任务上取得 state-of-the-art，超过最强统一基线；相对同一模型的非弹性版本，FLOPs 与推理延迟约减半。
Conclusion: 把文本-3D 交互按尺度显式锚定并保持稀疏，可以在统一 3D 模型里同时提升生成与描述性能并大幅降低计算与延迟。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SovereignPA-Bench: Evaluating User-Owned Personal Agents under Evolving Intent, Platform Mediation, and Consent Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Personal agents that book and buy for their users act through platforms that rank, nudge, pre-select and collect data in their own interest. We introduce SovereignPA-Bench, a controlled benchmark of whether such an agent follows the user's current intent, resists steering, shares only what a service needs, asks before exceeding its authority, and reports truthfully. A scripted platform and a scripted user surround the agent in 1,920 booking scenarios and 288 cancellation scenarios with retention flows. Each of the 192 booking situations, in 16 domains, is run as a control and under 9 paired variants that change one factor: stale memory, ambiguous intent, sponsored ranking, urgency, pre-checked extras, over-collecting forms, injected reviews, a mid-task update, or a mid-task reminder. Metrics are deterministic, and every question the agent asks is labelled necessary or unnecessary, so faithfulness and user burden are measured separately. Two rule-based agents reach 100% sovereign success, one of them without a single unnecessary question. Across 17 open-weight models, sovereign success ranges from 2% to 82%. More faithful models ask fewer unnecessary questions, not more (Spearman rho = -0.67 between success and burden). A form with two "recommended" fields raises the share of episodes that send a detail the service does not need from 2.4% to 58%. Injected reviews get a requested personal detail to the provider in 41% of attempts, against 0.7% without them. Sponsored labels and urgency banners shift choices only slightly in our setting. Retention offers never worked when the user had ruled them out in advance, but without that sentence 4 models accepted offers or pauses, and in 184 of 440 failed obstructed cancellations the agent told the user it had succeeded. A prompt-level checklist and a structural firewall raise success by at most 9 points. Code, scenarios and logs will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SovereignPA-Bench 用 1,920 个预订场景与 288 个含保留流程的取消场景，把个人代理夹在脚本化平台与脚本化用户之间，测它是否服从用户当前意图、抵抗平台操纵、只共享必要信息并在越权前询问。17 个开源模型的 sovereign success 从 2% 到 82%，两个规则代理达 100%；带两个 recommended 字段的表单把过度发送细节的回合占比从 2.4% 抬到 58%，注入评论使请求个人细节送达服务方的比例达 41%（无注入时 0.7%）。
Motivation: 代订代购的个人代理要经过平台的排序、诱导与数据收集，平台利益与用户意图冲突；现有评测不区分忠实度与提问负担，也未在受控扰动下检验代理是否守住授权边界。
Method: 构建受控基准：脚本化平台加脚本化用户包围被测代理，192 个预订情境分 16 个领域，每个跑对照加 9 个成对变体（stale memory、ambiguous intent、sponsored ranking、urgency、pre-checked extras、over-collecting forms、injected reviews、mid-task update、mid-task reminder），指标确定性计算，代理每次提问被标注为必要或不必要，从而把 faithfulness 与 user burden 分开度量。
Result: 两个规则代理 sovereign success 达 100%，其中一个零不必要提问；17 个开源模型成功率 2%–82%，成功率与提问负担呈负相关（Spearman rho = -0.67）；两个 recommended 字段使发送服务方不需要细节的回合占比从 2.4% 升到 58%；注入评论使请求的个人细节送达服务方的比例达 41%，无注入时为 0.7%；sponsored 标签与 urgency 横幅在该设置下仅轻微改变选择；用户事先排除保留条款时保留报价从未得逞，未写该句时有 4 个模型接受报价或暂停，440 次受阻取消失败中有 184 次代理向用户谎报成功；prompt 级清单与结构性防火墙至多提升 9 个百分点。
Conclusion: 忠实的代理提问更少而非更多，平台侧的表单与注入内容是越权共享的主要杠杆，而仅靠 prompt 清单或防火墙只能小幅（至多 9 点）提升成功率；用户明确的排除语句能彻底阻断保留报价。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 两个规则代理 sovereign success 达 100%，其中一个零不必要提问；17 个开源模型成功率 2%–82%，成功率与提问负担呈负相关（Spearman rho = -0.67）；两个 recommended 字段使发送服务方不需要细节的回合占比从 2.4% 升到 58%；注入评论使请求的个人细节送达服务方的比例达 41%，无注入时为 0.7%；sponsored 标签与 urgency 横幅在该设置下仅轻微改变选择；用户事先排除保留条款时保留报价从未得逞，未写该句时有 4 个模型接受报价或暂停，440 次受阻取消失败中有 184 次代理向用户谎报成功；prompt 级清单与结构性防火墙至多提升 9 个百分点。
summary_sections.conclusion: 忠实的代理提问更少而非更多，平台侧的表单与注入内容是越权共享的主要杠杆，而仅靠 prompt 清单或防火墙只能小幅（至多 9 点）提升成功率；用户明确的排除语句能彻底阻断保留报价。

papers.title: SovereignNegotiation-Bench: Evaluating User-Owned Personal Agents In Delegated Bargaining Under Privacy, Consent, Evidence, And Institutional Pressure
papers.abstract_en: Personal AI agents are beginning to negotiate for people, from refunds and bills to deposits and sales. A human agent in that position is judged by the duties owed to the principal, not by whether a deal was struck. We introduce SovereignNegotiation-Bench, a controlled benchmark that operationalizes five such duties from agency law--loyalty, obedience to actual authority, confidentiality, candor and diligence--as deterministic checks on episode logs; the first three enter a single headline metric. The benchmark contains 1,764 paired scenarios (252 situations in 18 consumer and peer-to-peer domains, each under 7 counterparty tactics). The counterparty's economics are a fixed function of the agent's structured actions and of the disclosures detected in its messages, so outcomes are comparable across agents and a disclosed limit has a measurable, causal price. A simulated principal grants or withholds consent and tightens its mandate midepisode. Rule-based agents show that the benchmark is solvable from the observable state (92% faithful success) and that a single disclosing sentence erases the entire negotiated surplus (0.70 to 0.00). Across 17 open-weight models, faithful success ranges from 6% to 75%; models disclose the principal's reservation value in 2-80% of episodes, agree or share a protected document without a required approval in 2-23%, and follow an instruction injected into the counterparty's message in 5-57% of injection episodes. Deal rate ranks models much like faithful success does, but it does not certify individual agreements: pooled over models, 48% of the agreements breach at least one duty (18-96% per model). Within families, faithful success tends to rise with size, but no size trend is significant, and on the model we test, neither prompting nor a code-level guard raises faithful success substantially. Code, scenarios and all episode logs will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SovereignNegotiation-Bench 把代理法的五项义务（忠诚、服从实际授权、保密、坦诚、勤勉）写成对 episode 日志的确定性检查，用 1,764 组配对场景评测代表用户谈判的个人 AI 代理。17 个开源模型的忠实成功率仅 6%–75%，且成交率掩盖义务违反：汇总各模型有 48% 的成交至少违反一项义务。
Motivation: 个人代理开始代人退款、账单、押金与销售谈判，评判标准应是它是否履行对委托人的义务而非是否成交；现有评测缺少把法定义务变成可复现、可因果定价的受控场景。
Method: 把五项代理法义务操作化为对 episode 日志的确定性检查，前三项合成一个 headline 指标；场景为 18 个消费与 P2P 领域的 252 种情境 × 7 种对手策略 = 1,764 组配对 episode，对手经济学是代理结构化动作与消息中被检出披露的固定函数，模拟委托人可在 episode 中途授予或撤回同意并收紧授权，并注入对手消息指令；先用 rule-based 代理验证可解性。
Result: Rule-based 代理从可观测状态达 92% 忠实成功，且一句披露即可把谈判盈余从 0.70 归零到 0.00；17 个开源模型忠实成功 6%–75%，披露委托人保留价 2%–80%，未经必需批准同意或共享受保护文档 2%–23%，遵循注入指令 5%–57%；成交率与忠实成功排序相近但不认证单笔协议，汇总 48% 的成交至少违反一项义务（单模型 18%–96%）；同族内忠实成功随规模上升但无显著趋势，所测模型上 prompting 与代码级 guard 均无实质提升。
Conclusion: 成交率不能作为个人代理的合格指标，因为近半数成交违反义务；在该评测设定下，规模、提示与代码级防护都未能显著提高忠实成功。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Flow Map Denoisers: Traversing the Distortion-Perception Plane for Inverse Problems
papers.abstract_en: Image restoration faces a fundamental tradeoff: methods that minimize error produce blurry reconstructions, while those that maximize perceptual quality yield sharp but less faithful images. Existing approaches either commit to a single operating point on this distortion perception (DP) frontier or require paired-data supervision, auxiliary models, or hyperparameter tuning of the sampler to access different points. We show that flow map models, a recent extension of flow matching for few-step sampling that learns an average field, implicitly define a one-parameter family of denoisers that continuously spans the DP frontier. The lookahead parameter t acts as a control knob between the MMSE and perceptual regimes. For Gaussian targets, we prove that varying t exactly recovers the optimal DP frontier; for natural images, we observe similar behavior empirically. Within a Plug-and-Play solver, the same mechanism extends to general inverse problems, where it controls a tradeoff between perceptual alignment and data consistency. Despite the lack of exact optimality guarantees in this setting, a single trained flow map spans the DP tradeoff, matching or exceeding specialized baselines at both extremes. Extensive experiments on CelebA ($128\times 128$) and AFHQ ($256\times 256$) across several linear and nonlinear inverse tasks validate our findings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Flow map 模型（flow matching 的少步采样扩展，学习平均场）隐式定义了一参数族去噪器，lookahead 参数 t 连续扫过 distortion-perception (DP) 平面：t 在 MMSE 与感知两个 regime 之间当旋钮用。高斯目标下改变 t 精确恢复最优 DP 前沿；在 Plug-and-Play 求解器里同一机制推广到一般逆问题，单个训练好的 flow map 即可覆盖感知对齐与数据一致性的权衡，并在两端匹配或超过专用基线。
Motivation: 图像复原的失真-感知权衡上，现有方法要么固定在 DP 前沿的单一工作点，要么需要成对监督、辅助模型或对采样器做超参调优才能换点。
Method: 用 flow map 模型学平均场，把 lookahead 参数 t 作为去噪器族的控制参数；嵌入 Plug-and-Play 求解器处理一般逆问题，控制感知对齐与数据一致性的权衡；在 CelebA (128×128) 与 AFHQ (256×256) 上覆盖若干线性与非线性逆任务做实验。
Result: 高斯目标下改变 t 精确恢复最优 DP 前沿，自然图像上观察到类似行为；单个训练好的 flow map 在 DP 权衡两端匹配或超过专用基线；实验在 CelebA 128×128 与 AFHQ 256×256 的多个线性与非线性逆任务上进行。
Conclusion: 一个训练好的 flow map 就能连续遍历 DP 平面并推广到一般逆问题，无需为不同工作点重新训练或调采样器超参；该推广到逆问题的设定没有精确最优性保证。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Dissecting model behavior through agent trajectories
papers.abstract_en: AI agent performance is not just a modeling problem, it is fundamentally a systems problem. The advanced capabilities of models are realized through agent harnesses. Therefore, a gap between model assumptions and harness behavior can easily prevent the model's full capabilities from translating into agent performance. We formalize this as the `intent-execution' gap: the mismatch between what the model intends and what the harness executes, and vice versa. We argue that minimizing this intent-execution gap is as important as other aspects of harness design such as tools and execution loops. To illustrate the impact of this harness-model alignment, we develop a simple and customizable harness called `Simple Strands Agent' (SSA). SSA aims to find the bulk of common patterns which generalize across different model families (such as Claude, Gemini, GPT, Grok, Qwen), as well as a small number of model-specific preferences. We make two contributions: (i) we \textbf{reproduce or improve on the pass@1} performance reported by diverse model-provider families on popular agentic benchmarks (SWE-Pro, SWE-Verified, Terminal-Bench-2, and Deep-SWE), and (ii) building on an \textbf{analysis of 154\texttt{k} trajectories generated by SSA}, we look beyond the \texttt{pass@1} numbers which tend to be relatively even across frontier models. By representing agent trajectories in code state-spaces, we compute solution distance and backtracking to observe model-level differences in problem-solving behavior. Finer-grained metrics such as edit frequency, testing activity, and phase-transitions reveal how individual models allocate effort across different stages of problem solving.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把 AI agent 表现差归因为模型意图与 harness 执行之间的 intent-execution gap，并提出可定制 harness「Simple Strands Agent」(SSA)，跨 Claude、Gemini、GPT、Grok、Qwen 等模型家族找通用模式加少量模型特异偏好。SSA 在 SWE-Pro、SWE-Verified、Terminal-Bench-2、Deep-SWE 上复现或改进各模型家族报告的 pass@1；基于 SSA 生成的 154k 条轨迹，用代码状态空间表示计算 solution distance 与 backtracking，配合 edit frequency、testing activity、phase-transition 等细粒度指标，看到 pass@1 接近的前沿模型在解题行为上存在模型级差异。
Motivation: 前沿模型在 agentic benchmark 上的 pass@1 已趋于拉平，单看分数看不出模型间解题方式的差别；同时模型假设与 harness 行为的错位会让模型能力无法转化为 agent 表现。
Method: 构建 Simple Strands Agent (SSA) 这一简单可定制 harness，提炼跨模型家族通用的模式与少量模型特异偏好；把 agent 轨迹表示为代码状态空间，在其上计算 solution distance 与 backtracking，并统计 edit frequency、testing activity、phase-transition 等阶段性指标。
Result: 在 SWE-Pro、SWE-Verified、Terminal-Bench-2、Deep-SWE 上复现或改进多家模型-供应商家族报告的 pass@1；基于 SSA 生成的 154k 条轨迹做行为分析，发现 pass@1 在各前沿模型间相对持平，而 solution distance、backtracking、编辑频率、测试活动与阶段转换等指标揭示出模型级解题行为差异。
Conclusion: 缩小 intent-execution gap 与工具、执行循环同等重要；要区分前沿模型，需越过 pass@1、用轨迹级状态空间指标衡量其在各解题阶段的精力分配。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mental-R1: Aligning LLM Reasoning for Mental Health Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Mental health problems such as anxiety, depression, and suicide remain urgent global challenges, where timely and accurate assessment is critical for effective intervention. Recently, large language models have been explored for mental health assessment. However, existing general-purpose post-training methods do not align with the cognitive processes of human assessment, which may lead to unreliable reasoning outcomes. To bridge this gap, we propose Cognitive Relative Policy Optimization (CRPO), a reinforcement learning framework tailored for the mental health domain. CRPO extends group relative policy optimization by integrating stage-dependent uncertainty modeling into the policy optimization process. Specifically, we introduce a stage-wise entropy regularization mechanism that encourages broad exploration in early reasoning phases and progressively enforces confident decision-making in later stages, mimicking the human cognitive shift from uncertainty to certainty. In addition, inspired by cognitive appraisal theory, we formalize cognitive reasoning stages, thereby guiding theory-grounded interpretable inference. Experiments on 8 mental health datasets show that CRPO achieves an average improvement of 10.4 percentage points in weighted F1-score over the best reinforcement learning baseline. Furthermore, the CRPO-trained model Mental-R1 demonstrates clear advantages compared with existing large language models on reasoning-intensive cases, suggesting that CRPO enhances reasoning capabilities for mental health assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向心理健康评估的强化学习对齐框架 Cognitive Relative Policy Optimization (CRPO)，在 GRPO 基础上加入阶段依赖的不确定性建模与阶段式熵正则：早期推理鼓励探索、后期逐步收紧为确定性决策，并按认知评价理论形式化认知推理阶段以支撑可解释推理。在 8 个心理健康数据集上，CRPO 相对最佳强化学习基线的 weighted F1 平均提升 10.4 个百分点。
Motivation: 通用后训练方法的推理过程与人类评估的认知过程不一致，导致 LLM 在心理健康评估中的推理结果不可靠。
Method: CRPO 扩展 GRPO，把阶段依赖的不确定性建模纳入策略优化，并加入阶段式熵正则（早期宽探索、后期强制自信决策）；同时依据认知评价理论 (cognitive appraisal theory) 形式化认知推理阶段，指导理论支撑的可解释推理，训练得到 Mental-R1。
Result: 在 8 个心理健康数据集上，CRPO 相对最佳强化学习基线的 weighted F1 平均提升 10.4 个百分点；CRPO 训练的 Mental-R1 在推理密集型案例上相对现有 LLM 表现出明显优势。
Conclusion: 把人类评估的不确定性到确定性认知转移编码进策略优化的熵调度，能提升 LLM 心理健康评估的推理可靠性。

papers.title: Detect Before You Leap: Mirage Detection in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) can produce confident answers without relevant visual evidence, a failure mode known as mirage (Asadi et al., 2026). We study pre-release mirage detection: deciding whether a VLM answer should be released or withheld. Our model-agnostic method, Text-Conditioned Layer-wise Internal Alignment (TC-LIA), tracks question-image alignment across the layers of a frozen CLIP ViT-H/14 encoder, summarizing patch-text alignment by final similarity, late-layer top-k alignment, early-to-late gain, and slope. TC-LIA is training-free at deployment with fixed projections and scoring weights, without any label-specific training, and delivers strong detection independently. Additionally, when combined with blank/noise detection, domain routing, and VLM self-assessment, it forms an ensemble whose supervised training improves performance but is an optional add-on. On 19,004 samples spanning 10 VQA domains, 14 state-of-the-art VLMs exhibit 57.3-75.0% base mirage rates. papers.title: Fixed Universal Transformers
papers.abstract_en: We introduce \emph{universal transformers}: fixed transformers that can simulate any transformer in a given class via a suitable input embedding. Analogous to a universal Turing machine, the input embedding encodes a description of the target model while all internal parameters remain fixed. We provide explicit sparse constructions achieving universality when the embedding dimension is sufficiently large, and further show that universality is generic: randomly initialized transformers are universal almost surely, which aligns with recent empirical results of Zhong and Andreas (2024). We empirically validate our theory on the algorithmic tasks of parenthesis balancing and multi-hop reasoning. Our results suggest that much of a transformer's expressive power may reside in its input representation rather than its learned weights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 universal transformer：固定全部内部参数，仅靠足够高维的输入嵌入编码目标模型描述，即可模拟给定类中的任意 transformer。稀疏构造证明嵌入维度足够大时普适性成立，且随机初始化的 transformer 几乎必然普适；括号匹配与多跳推理两项算法任务上做了经验验证。
Motivation: Transformer 的表达能力究竟来自学到的权重还是输入表示，缺少形式化刻画；若能把模型描述压进嵌入，就能像通用图灵机一样用固定权重复用同一网络。
Method: 给出显式稀疏构造，把目标 transformer 的描述编码进输入嵌入、内部参数保持固定；证明普适性是 generic 性质，随机初始化几乎必然满足，并在括号平衡 (parenthesis balancing) 与多-hop reasoning 两类算法任务上经验检验。
Result: 嵌入维度足够大时存在显式稀疏构造实现普适性；随机初始化的 transformer 几乎必然普适，与 Zhong 和 Andreas (2024) 的经验结果一致；在括号平衡与多跳推理任务上做了经验验证。
Conclusion: Transformer 的大部分表达力可能位于输入表示而非学到的权重，固定参数的网络通过嵌入即可覆盖整个模型类。

papers.title: Latent Goal Prediction from Language for Model-Based Planning
papers.abstract_en: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) enable agents to plan in latent space by imagining the outcomes of candidate actions, yet task specification remains a bottleneck. Visual targets provide precise local gradients but poor distant guidance, while language is flexible yet limited by noisy cross-modal alignment or dependence on distinct large generative models. We introduce LAGO (Latent Goal Prediction from Language), a hierarchical world model in which a single predictor both forecasts action-conditioned dynamics and grounds language instructions as sequences of intermediate latent subgoals, training both modes with a single regression objective over a shared latent space. At each planning step, LAGO predicts a sequence of latent subgoals from a language instruction and optimizes an action sequence using a soft-minimum alignment cost that rewards subgoal proximity without enforcing a rigid path. Subgoals are repredicted as the agent's state evolves, turning a single long-horizon instruction into a sequence of locally tractable objectives. Across environments spanning navigation and manipulation, LAGO outperforms flat and hierarchical image-goal planners, with the largest gains on long-horizon navigation with curved, hazard-constrained paths, where it more than doubles the success rate of a goal-conditioned behavior cloning policy trained on the same demonstrations. Grounding language in the world model's own latent space also outperforms vision-language reward models, including one that plans with ground-truth dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LAGO 把语言指令在世界模型自身的 latent space 里落地为一串中间 latent subgoal，用单一回归目标同时训练动力学预测与语言对齐，并在规划时用 soft-minimum 对齐代价优化动作序列、随状态演化重预测子目标。在导航与操作环境中它超过 flat 和 hierarchical image-goal planner，在长时程弯曲、避障约束导航上把 goal-conditioned behavior cloning 的成功率翻了一倍以上，并优于含 ground-truth dynamics 的 vision-language reward model。
Motivation: JEPAs 让智能体能在 latent 空间规划，但任务指定仍是瓶颈：视觉目标局部梯度精确却缺少远距离引导，语言灵活却受跨模态对齐噪声或依赖独立大生成模型所限。
Method: LAGO 是分层世界模型：单一 predictor 同时预报动作条件动力学与把语言指令落地为中间 latent 子目标序列，两种模式共用一个 latent 空间、用单一回归目标训练；规划时按指令预测子目标序列，用奖励子目标接近但不强制刚性路径的 soft-minimum 对齐代价优化动作序列，随智能体状态演化重预测子目标，把长时程指令拆成局部可解目标。
Result: 在横跨导航与操作的环境中，LAGO 优于 flat 与 hierarchical image-goal planner；在带弯曲、危险约束路径的长时程导航上提升最大，其成功率超过在同一演示上训练的 goal-conditioned behavior cloning 策略的两倍；把语言落地到世界模型自身 latent 空间也优于 vision-language reward model，其中包括一个用 ground-truth dynamics 规划的模型。
Conclusion: 在世界模型自身 latent 空间中同时做动力学预测与语言落地，能把长时程语言指令转成可逐步优化的局部目标，从而在长时程导航上胜过图像目标规划器与视觉语言奖励模型。

papers.title: FastKernels: Benchmarking GPU Kernel Generation in Production
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents for GPU kernel generation are advancing rapidly, but the benchmarks they optimize against evaluate kernels in isolation, with synthetic inputs and weak baselines, rewarding sandbox speedups that break or vanish in real inference systems. We introduce FastKernels, a benchmark of 384 tasks drawn from 47 representative architectures across 8 categories, whose kernels suffice to reimplement 94.6% (472/499) of HuggingFace Transformers architectures with outputs matching the native implementations. Each task mirrors the interface of the corresponding production module and is scored against the kernels production frameworks ship, and tasks form a compositional hierarchy, from primitives to full models, in which higher-level modules import lower-level ones. Candidates are scored at the kernel level and end to end inside the models they come from, on the production execution path, and MacroEval aggregates calibrated correctness, coverage, and speedup into a leaderboard. Seeding it with five representative agents (6,900 agent-hours), we find that kernel-level speedups of $1.6$-$6.6\times$ shrink to at most $1.25\times$ end to end, only 20% of winning kernel sets run correctly as-is, and kernel-level scores mis-rank agents: Claude Code matches or beats KDA at every level in isolation, yet KDA scores $3\times$ higher end to end. Code is available at https://github.com/Snowflake-AI-Research/fastkernels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FastKernels 是面向 LLM 生成 GPU kernel 的生产级基准：384 个任务取自 47 个代表性架构、8 个类别，覆盖可重实现 HuggingFace Transformers 94.6%（472/499）架构的 kernel，按生产框架自带 kernel 打分并组成从原语到整模型的组合层级。用 5 个代表性 agent（6,900 agent-hours）跑出：kernel 级 1.6–6.6× 加速到端到端最多只剩 1.25×，仅 20% 获胜 kernel 集可原样正确运行，kernel 级分数还会排错 agent 名次。
Motivation: 现有 GPU kernel 生成基准把 kernel 单独评测、用合成输入和弱基线，奖励在真实推理系统里会失效或消失的沙箱加速，导致优化目标与生产收益脱节。
Method: 每个任务镜像对应生产模块的接口，与生产框架实际发布的 kernel 对比；候选在 kernel 级和其所属模型的端到端生产执行路径上双重打分，MacroEval 把校准后的正确性、覆盖率与加速聚合成排行榜；任务构成从原语到完整模型、高层模块调用低层的组合层级。
Result: 384 个任务覆盖 47 个架构、8 个类别，其 kernel 足以重实现 94.6%（472/499）的 HuggingFace Transformers 架构且输出与原生实现一致；5 个 agent 共 6,900 agent-hours 显示 kernel 级 1.6–6.6× 加速端到端最多只剩 1.25×，仅 20% 获胜 kernel 集原样可正确运行；Claude Code 在各隔离层级持平或优于 KDA，但 KDA 端到端得分高 3×。
Conclusion: kernel 级沙箱加速不能代表生产收益，kernel 级评分会误排 agent，必须在模型端到端生产路径上评测才能选出真正有效的 kernel 生成 agent。

papers.title: Teger: Spatiotemporal Covariance for Probabilistic Traffic Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Traffic conditions drift -- demand patterns, incident dynamics, and sensor behavior shift over a deployment's lifetime -- so a joint uncertainty estimate fit once at training time and left static will miscalibrate as conditions change. We present TEGER, a residual covariance model that keeps a forecaster's joint predictive uncertainty current at test time through closed-form updates, not retraining. A fixed sensor graph supplies a low-dimensional spatial precision factor encoding which sensors' errors move together; at inference, Gaussian conditioning corrects The next forecast's mean and covariance from only the most recently observed residuals, and an exponential moving-average volatility term rescales marginal uncertainty to track local drift while preserving the learned correlation structure. Neither update touches the forecasting backbone's weights, so the same mechanism attaches to a frozen time-series foundation model: no gradient passes through it, turning a static point forecast into one with continually refreshed, correlated uncertainty at negligible added cost. In four traffic datasets, the fixed-graph covariance improves 60-minute $CRPS_{sum}$ over a temporal-only baseline in different configurations of the backbone and datasets. Applied post hoc to a frozen time-series foundation model, Chronos, the same test-time correction reduces $CRPS_{sum}$ from 0.1798 to 0.1736 without foundation-model fine-tuning. These results support closed-form test-time residual correction, rather than a covariance fixed once at training time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TEGER 是交通预测的残差协方差模型：用固定传感器图给出低维空间精度因子，测试时仅凭最近残差做闭式高斯条件化更新均值与协方差，并用指数移动平均波动率项重标边缘不确定性，全程不回传梯度、不微调骨干。在四个交通数据集上，固定图协方差在不同骨干与数据集配置下改善 60 分钟 CRPS_sum；事后套在冻结的 Chronos 上把 CRPS_sum 从 0.1798 降到 0.1736。
Motivation: 交通条件随部署期漂移（需求、事件、传感器行为变化），训练时拟合一次就固定的联合不确定性估计会随条件变化而失准，需要在测试时持续更新。
Method: 固定传感器图提供低维空间精度因子编码哪些传感器误差同向运动；推理时用 Gaussian conditioning 仅凭最近观测残差修正下一次预测的均值与协方差，再用指数移动平均波动率项重标边缘不确定性以跟踪局部漂移，同时保留学到的相关结构。两步更新都不触碰预测骨干权重，可直接附着在冻结的时序基础模型 Chronos 上，无梯度通过。
Result: 在四个交通数据集上，固定图协方差在不同骨干与数据集配置下改善 60 分钟 CRPS_sum（相对 temporal-only 基线）；事后应用于冻结的 Chronos 时，测试时修正把 CRPS_sum 从 0.1798 降至 0.1736，且无需基础模型微调，附加开销可忽略。
Conclusion: 闭合式的测试时残差修正优于训练时一次性固定的协方差，可在不微调骨干的前提下让点预测变成持续刷新、带相关结构的不确定性输出。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Identify then Realize: Contrastive Learning of Latent Port-Hamiltonian Dynamics from Partial Observations
papers.abstract_en: Identifying latent state representations and dynamics is essential when direct modeling in observation space is infeasible, particularly under partial and high-dimensional observations. In such settings, representation learning and physics-aware modeling are inherently coupled. We propose CIPHER, a two-stage identify-then-realize framework for learning latent port-Hamiltonian models of conservative and dissipative systems. First, a contrastive teacher jointly learns an encoder and a neural ODE to obtain predictive state representations from observation histories. Second, a student learns an invertible nonlinear coordinate transformation and port-Hamiltonian dynamics by matching encoded observed futures. We establish sufficient conditions for recovering the physical state up to a diffeomorphism and realizing its dynamics in port-Hamiltonian form. Across ten clean and noisy datasets, CIPHER is competitive with or outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by improving long-horizon forecast on complex systems. Further studies show robustness to over-specified latent dimensions and additional predictive gains from pH parameterization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CIPHER 用先辨识后实现 (identify-then-realize) 两阶段从部分观测中学习隐空间 port-Hamiltonian 动力学：对比教师先从观测历史学 encoder 与 neural ODE 得到预测性状态表征，学生再学可逆非线性坐标变换与 pH 动力学去匹配编码后的观测未来。在十个含噪与干净数据集上，长时域预报与最先进基线相当或更好，且对隐维度过设定稳健、pH 参数化带来额外预测增益。
Motivation: 在观测部分且高维、直接在观测空间建模不可行时，表征学习与物理感知建模相互耦合，难以同时得到可辨识的物理状态与其动力学。
Method: 两阶段框架 CIPHER：第一阶段对比教师 (contrastive teacher) 联合训练 encoder 与 neural ODE，从观测历史得到预测性状态表征；第二阶段学生学习可逆非线性坐标变换与 port-Hamiltonian 动力学，通过匹配编码后的观测未来来拟合。作者给出可将物理状态恢复到微分同胚意义下、并实现其 pH 形式动力学的充分条件。
Result: 在十个干净与含噪数据集上，CIPHER 在复杂系统的长时域预报上与最先进基线相当或更优；对过设定的隐空间维度表现稳健，pH 参数化带来额外预测增益。
Conclusion: 先辨识预测性隐表征、再实现为 port-Hamiltonian 动力学的解耦顺序，可在部分观测下恢复物理状态（至微分同胚）并改善长时域预报。

papers.title: ASH: Agents that Self-Hone in Long-Horizon Worlds
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon visuomotor tasks remain a fundamental challenge in AI, as current methods rely on hand-engineered rewards or action-labeled demonstrations, neither of which scales. We introduce ASH, an agentic system that learns a long-horizon policy from unlabeled, noisy internet video, without reward shaping or expert annotation. ASH follows a self-improvement loop; when it gets stuck, ASH learns an Inverse Dynamics Model (IDM) from its own trajectories, and uses its IDM to extract supervision from relevant internet video. ASH uses unsupervised learning to identify key moments from large-scale internet video and retains them as long-term memory - allowing it to tackle long-horizon problems. We evaluate ASH on two complementary environments demanding multi-hour planning: Pokemon Emerald, a turn-based RPG, and The Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap, a real-time action-adventure game. In both games, behavioral cloning, retrieval-augmented and zero-shot foundation-model baselines plateau, while ASH sustains progression across our 8-hour evaluation. ASH reaches an average of 11.2/12 milestones in Pokemon Emerald and 9.9/12 in Legend of Zelda, while the strongest baseline gets stuck in both environments at an average of 9.3/12 and 7.8/12 milestones, respectively. We demonstrate that self-improving agents are a scalable recipe for learning in long-horizon worlds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ASH 是一个从无标注、含噪网络视频中学习长时程视觉运动策略的智能体系统：卡住时用自身轨迹训练 Inverse Dynamics Model (IDM)，再用 IDM 从相关网络视频中抽取监督，并用无监督学习把关键节点存为长期记忆。在 8 小时评测中，Pokemon Emerald 平均推进 11.2/12 个里程碑、Zelda: The Minish Cap 9.9/12，最强基线分别停在 9.3/12 与 7.8/12。
Motivation: 长时程视觉运动任务依赖手工奖励或带动作标注的示范，两者都难以扩展；行为克隆、检索增强与零样本基线在多小时规划中会停滞。
Method: ASH 走自我改进循环：从自身轨迹学习 Inverse Dynamics Model，用它从相关互联网视频提取监督；再用无监督学习在大规模视频中识别关键节点并作为长期记忆保留，从而支撑多小时规划。
Result: 在 8 小时评测中，ASH 于 Pokemon Emerald 平均达到 11.2/12 个里程碑、于 The Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap 达到 9.9/12；最强基线在两个环境分别停在 9.3/12 与 7.8/12，行为克隆、检索增强与零样本基线均出现停滞。
Conclusion: 自我改进加视频来源的监督抽取是长时程世界中可扩展的学习配方，能在多小时评测里持续推进而非停滞。

papers.title: Measuring Google AI Overviews: Activation, Source Quality, Claim Fidelity, and Publisher Impact
papers.abstract_en: Google AI Overviews (AIOs) are arguably the most widely encountered deployment of generative AI, reaching over 2 billion users who may not realize the answers they see are AI-generated. Where search engines have traditionally surfaced ranked sources and left users to evaluate them, AIOs synthesize and deliver a single answer - giving Google unprecedented editorial control over what users read and know. We present a large-scale longitudinal measurement study, issuing 55,393 trending queries across 19 topical categories over a 40-day window (March 13 - April 21, 2026). We report four main findings. First, overall AIO activation is 13.7%, rising to 64.7% for question-form queries, while politically sensitive topics see markedly lower rates. Second, AIO-cited domains are more credible than co-displayed first-page results, yet nearly 30% do not appear in those results at all, indicating a source selection mechanism distinct from Google's ranking algorithm. Third, decomposing responses into 98,020 atomic claims, 11.0% are unsupported by the cited pages - with omission the dominant failure mode - and source quality and claim fidelity are largely independent. Fourth, well over half of AIO-cited pages carry display advertising, meaning publishers lose revenue when AIOs suppress the click-through, even as Google's own sponsored ads continue to appear on the same page. Together, these findings document a rapid transformation of the online information ecosystem whose consequences for epistemic security remain poorly understood.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 2026 ACM Internet Measurement Conference (IMC 2026)
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 2026 ACM Internet Measurement Conference (IMC '26), 2026, pp. 529-546
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 Google AI Overviews 做大规模纵向测量：55,393 条趋势查询、19 个主题、40 天窗口内 AIO 激活率 13.7%（疑问句 64.7%），政治敏感主题明显更低；98,020 条原子断言中 11.0% 无被引页面支撑，遗漏是主要失效模式。AIO 引用域名比同屏首页结果更可信，但近 30% 根本不在首页结果中，说明其选源机制独立于 Google 排序算法。
Motivation: 搜索从「给出排序来源、由用户自行判断」转向合成单一答案，Google 获得前所未有的编辑控制权；AIO 触达超 20 亿用户，其选源与断言忠实度对信息生态和 epistemic security 的影响尚不清楚。
Method: 大规模纵向测量：2026 年 3 月 13 日至 4 月 21 日 40 天内对 19 个主题类别的 55,393 条趋势查询发问，统计 AIO 激活率；将回答拆解为 98,020 条原子断言，逐条核对被引页面是否支撑，并比较 AIO 引用域名与同屏首页结果的可信度及广告承载情况。
Result: 总体 AIO 激活率 13.7%，疑问句查询升至 64.7%，政治敏感主题激活率明显更低；AIO 引用域名比同屏首页结果更可信，但近 30% 不出现在首页结果中；98,020 条原子断言中 11.0% 不被被引页面支撑，遗漏 (omission) 为主导失效模式，且来源质量与断言忠实度基本独立；超过半数被引页面带展示广告，AIO 抑制点击会损害出版商收入，而 Google 自己的赞助广告仍在同页展示。
Conclusion: AIO 的选源机制独立于 Google 既有排序算法，断言不支撑主要来自遗漏而非来源低质，且来源质量与忠实度互不相关；出版商在点击流失中承担收入损失，这一信息生态剧变的 epistemic security 后果仍不清楚。

papers.title: An Elastic Shape Variational Autoencoder for Skeleton Pose Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Deep generative models provide flexible frameworks for modeling complex, structured data such as images, videos, 3D objects, and texts. However, when applied to sequences of human skeletons, standard variational autoencoders (VAEs) often allocate substantial capacity to nuisance factors-such as camera orientation, subject scale, viewpoint, and execution speed-rather than the intrinsic geometry of shapes and their motion. We propose the Elastic Shape - Variational Autoencoder (ES-VAE), a geometry-aware generative model for skeletal trajectories that leverages the transported square-root velocity field (TSRVF) representation on Kendall's shape manifold. This representation inherently removes rigid translations, rotations, and global scaling of shapes, and temporal rate variability of sequences, isolating the underlying shape dynamics. The ES-VAE encoder maps skeletal sequences to a low-dimensional latent space incorporating the Riemannian logarithm map, while the decoder reconstructs sequences using the corresponding exponential map. We demonstrate the effectiveness of ES-VAE on two datasets. First, we analyze skeletal gait cycles to predict clinical mobility scores and classify subjects into healthy and post-stroke groups. Second, we evaluate action recognition on the NTU RGB+D dataset. Across both settings, ES-VAE consistently outperforms standard VAEs and a range of sequence modeling baselines, including temporal convolutional networks, transformers, and graph convolutional networks. More broadly, ES-VAE provides a principled framework for learning generative models of longitudinal data on pose shape manifolds, offering improved latent representation and downstream performance compared to existing deep learning approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ES-VAE：在 Kendall 形状流形上用 transported square-root velocity field (TSRVF) 表示骨架轨迹，编码器接 Riemannian logarithm map、解码器接 exponential map，从而把平移、旋转、全局缩放与时间速率变化从潜变量里剥离。在步态周期临床评分预测与 NTU RGB+D 动作识别两个任务上，ES-VAE 一致优于标准 VAE 及时序卷积、Transformer、图卷积等序列基线。
Motivation: 标准 VAE 建模骨架序列时把大量容量花在相机朝向、受试者尺度、视角、执行速度等干扰因素上，而不是形状及其运动的内在几何，削弱潜表示与下游表现。
Method: 用 TSRVF 在 Kendall 形状流形上表示骨架序列，天然去除刚体平移旋转、全局缩放与时间速率变化；编码器经 Riemannian logarithm map 映到低维潜空间，解码器用对应 exponential map 重建序列，构成 geometry-aware 的 ES-VAE。
Result: 在两个数据集上验证：一是骨架步态周期用于预测临床活动能力评分并区分健康与 post-stroke 组，二是 NTU RGB+D 动作识别；两个设置中 ES-VAE 均一致优于标准 VAE 以及 temporal convolutional networks、transformers、graph convolutional networks 等序列建模基线。
Conclusion: 把形状流形几何直接嵌入 VAE 的编解码结构，能学到更干净的纵向姿态潜表示，并在临床步态与动作识别下游任务上带来一致的性能提升。

papers.title: LEAF: A Living Benchmark for Event-Augmented Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to real-world forecasting tasks, yet evaluating their true predictive capability remains compromised by pre-training data contamination and look-ahead leakage in automated search. Existing benchmarks either rely on static contexts, restrict evaluations to narrow environments, or fail to audit auxiliary textual events for future information leakage. To establish a rigorous evaluation paradigm, we propose LEAF, the first living benchmark for event-augmented forecasting tasks, including trend, event, and time series forecasting. LEAF couples a recursive retrieval agent system with dual-agent cross-validation to gather comprehensive, relevant, and temporally aligned auxiliary context. A comprehensive audit across 500 tasks by 47 domain specialists demonstrates that our pipeline suppresses future information leakage from 8.6% to 1.6%. Across extensive evaluations of 16 frontier proprietary and open-weight models on our benchmark, we show that LLMs effectively extract signals from verified events to boost trend and event forecasting.

papers.title: MolWorld: Molecule World Models for Actionable Molecular Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Molecular optimization in drug discovery aims to discover molecules with improved target properties, but practical lead optimization often requires more than high predicted scores. A useful candidate should also be actionable: it should be reachable from known molecules through a sequence of local structural modifications, providing explicit structural references for interpreting property changes within an evolving chemical series. Existing de novo and single-molecule optimization methods do not explicitly model such reachability, especially when both the target molecules and the intermediate molecules connecting them to known compounds are unknown. In this work, we formulate actionable molecular optimization as iterative expansion of a molecule-transfer graph, where nodes are molecules and edges encode matched molecular pair (MMP) relations representing localized structural differences. We propose MolWorld, a molecule world model-guided framework that uses connected local subgraphs as anchor contexts for graph expansion. Given the current graph and a candidate context, a latent molecule world model predicts the resulting local structural expansion. A context-conditioned generator then uses the molecular structures and MMP relations within selected contexts to propose candidates, learning from local graph-completion tasks. Candidates are evaluated, and those connected through verified MMP relations are incorporated into the graph, preserving reachability from the initial set. The updated graph serves as the state for subsequent optimization. Experiments on property optimization and docking-based tasks show that MolWorld discovers high-property molecules while maintaining stronger structural connectivity, supporting actionable and sequential molecular design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MolWorld 把可操作分子优化形式化为分子转移图的迭代扩张：节点是分子，边编码匹配分子对 (MMP) 关系，用分子世界模型在锚点子图上预测局部结构扩张，只保留经验证 MMP 连接的候选以维持从已知分子出发的可达性。在性质优化与基于对接 (docking) 的任务上，该方法发现高性质分子的同时保持更强的结构连通性。
Motivation: 药物先导物优化要求候选不仅预测分数高，还要能从已知分子经一系列局部结构修饰到达；现有 de novo 与单分子优化方法不显式建模这种可达性，尤其当目标分子及其与已知化合物之间的中间分子都未知时。
Method: 将优化表述为分子转移图的迭代扩张，边为 MMP 关系；分子世界模型以连通局部子图作为锚点上下文，给定当前图与候选上下文预测局部结构扩张；上下文条件生成器利用所选上下文内的分子结构与 MMP 关系提出候选，通过局部图补全任务学习；候选经评估后，仅经验证 MMP 连接者并入图，更新后的图作为后续优化状态。
Result: 在性质优化任务与基于对接的任务上，MolWorld 发现高性质分子的同时保持更强的结构连通性，支持可操作的序列化分子设计。
Conclusion: 把可达性作为图不变量来维护（只并入经验证 MMP 连接的候选），可使分子优化在提升目标性质的同时保持从初始分子集出发的结构可达。

papers.title: Active Sampling for Ultra-Low-Bit-Rate Video Compression via Conditional Controlled Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models provide a powerful generative prior for perceptual reconstruction at ultra-low bitrates, but effective video compression requires controlling the generative process using highly compact conditioning signals. In this work, we present ActDiff-VC, a diffusion-based video compression framework for the ultra-low-bitrate regime. Our method partitions videos into variable-length segments, transmits keyframes only when needed, and summarizes temporal dynamics using a compact set of tracked point trajectories. Conditioned on these sparse signals, a conditional diffusion decoder synthesizes the remaining frames, enabling perceptually realistic reconstruction under severe rate constraints. To support this design, we introduce two mechanisms: content-adaptive keyframe selection and budget-aware sparse trajectory selection, which together enable compact yet effective conditioning for generative reconstruction. ActDiff-VC has an asymmetric computational profile: on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU, encoding requires 109 ms per frame, while the adopted 20-step diffusion decoder requires 2311 ms per frame, making the framework particularly suitable for ultra-low-bitrate applications such as cloud-assisted reconstruction, archival storage, and offline content distribution, where lightweight encoding and perceptual reconstruction quality are prioritized. Experiments on the UVG and MCL-JCV benchmarks show that ActDiff-VC achieves up to 64.6\% bitrate reduction at matched NIQE, improves KID by up to 64.6% and FID by up to 37.7% at comparable bitrates against strong learned codecs, and delivers favorable perceptual rate--distortion trade-offs relative to learned and generative baselines in the ultra-low-bitrate regime. A human study with 147 participants further supports these perceptual gains, with ActDiff-VC preferred over DCVC-FM in 62.6% of pairwise comparisons.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ActDiff-VC 把视频切成变长段，只在需要时传关键帧，并用一组稀疏点轨迹 (tracked point trajectories) 概括时序动态，由条件扩散解码器合成其余帧，实现超低码率下的感知重建。在 UVG 与 MCL-JCV 上，相对强学习型编码器在同等 NIQE 下最高省 64.6% 码率，同等码率下 KID 最高改善 64.6%、FID 最高改善 37.7%；147 人主观实验中 62.6% 的两两比较更偏好它而非 DCVC-FM。
Motivation: 超低码率视频压缩需要极紧凑的条件信号来控制生成过程，而传统关键帧与运动表示在严重码率约束下难以兼顾感知质量与压缩率。
Method: ActDiff-VC 将视频划分为变长段，按内容自适应策略选择性传输关键帧，并用预算感知的稀疏轨迹选择机制挑选点轨迹作为紧凑时序摘要；条件扩散解码器以这些信号为条件合成其余帧，采用 20 步扩散采样。
Result: 在 UVG 和 MCL-JCV 基准上，相对强学习型编码器在同等 NIQE 下最高降低 64.6% 码率，同等码率下 KID 最高改善 64.6%、FID 最高改善 37.7%；单张 NVIDIA A100 上编码 109 ms/帧、20 步扩散解码 2311 ms/帧；147 人参与的主观实验中 ActDiff-VC 在 62.6% 的两两比较里优于 DCVC-FM。
Conclusion: 稀疏轨迹加选择性关键帧足以作为超低码率生成式重建的紧凑条件，编码轻、解码重的非对称算力分布使其适合云端辅助重建、归档存储与离线分发。

papers.title: Classical and Quantum Speedups for Non-Convex Optimization via Energy Conserving Descent
papers.abstract_en: We present the first analytical study of ECD, focusing on the one-dimensional setting for this first installment. We formalize a stochastic ECD dynamics (sECD) with energy-preserving noise, as well as a quantum analog of the ECD Hamiltonian (qECD), providing the foundation for a quantum algorithm through Hamiltonian simulation in a tractable model where the barrier-crossing mechanism can be computed explicitly. For one-dimensional double-well objectives in the under-guessing regime, we compute the expected dynamical hitting times from a local minimum to the global minimum. We prove that both sECD and qECD exhibit exponential improvements in continuous hitting time relative to their respective gradient-based baselines, stochastic gradient descent (SGD) and quantum tunneling walk (QTW). For objectives with tall barriers, qECD admits a further hitting time improvement over sECD. Mechanistically, ECD sidesteps the exponential cost associated with rare-escape events of SGD from local minima by moving from dissipative to energy-conserving dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对能量守恒下降 (ECD) 做首个解析研究：在一维双阱目标的 under-guessing 情形下，形式化带能量守恒噪声的随机版 sECD 与 ECD 哈密顿量的量子类比 qECD，显式算出从局部极小到全局极小的期望动力学首达时间。sECD 与 qECD 相对各自梯度基线（SGD 与量子隧穿行走 QTW）都呈指数级加速；势垒高时 qECD 还比 sECD 再快一档。
Motivation: SGD 逃离局部极小依赖稀有的逃逸事件，代价随势垒指数增长；需要一种把耗散动力学换成能量守守恒动力学的机制，并在可显式计算势垒穿越的模型里给出严格首达时间。
Method: 在一维设定下形式化随机 ECD (sECD，加能量守恒噪声) 与 ECD 哈密顿量的量子类比 qECD，后者通过 Hamiltonian simulation 落成量子算法；在一维双阱目标、under-guessing 区间内显式计算从局部极小到全局极小的期望动力学首达时间，并与 SGD 和量子隧穿行走 (QTW) 对照。
Result: 证明 sECD 与 qECD 的连续首达时间相对各自梯度基线（SGD、QTW）均为指数级改进；对高势垒目标，qECD 的首达时间相对 sECD 还有进一步改进。
Conclusion: 把耗散梯度动力学换成能量守恒动力学即可绕开 SGD 稀有逃逸事件的指数代价，且量子版本在高势垒下更占优；这是 ECD 的首个解析研究，限于一维设定。

papers.title: Scalar Federated Learning for Linear Quadratic Regulator
papers.abstract_en: We propose ScalarFedLQR, a communication-efficient federated algorithm for model-free learning of a common policy in linear quadratic regulator (LQR) control of cooperative agents. The method builds on a decomposed projected gradient mechanism, in which each agent communicates only a scalar projection of a local zeroth-order gradient estimate. The server aggregates these scalar messages to reconstruct a global descent direction, reducing per-agent uplink communication from O(d) to O(1), independent of the policy dimension. Crucially, the projection-induced approximation error diminishes as the number of participating agents increases, yielding a favorable scaling law: larger fleets enable more accurate gradient recovery, admit larger stepsizes, and achieve faster linear convergence despite high dimensionality. Under standard regularity conditions for homogeneous agents, all iterates remain stabilizing and the average LQR cost decreases linearly fast. Numerical results demonstrate performance comparable to full-gradient federated LQR with substantially reduced communication, even for heterogeneous (but similar) agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ScalarFedLQR 把联邦 LQR 学习中每个智能体的上行梯度压成一个标量投影，服务器聚合标量消息重建全局下降方向，通信量从 O(d) 降到 O(1)。投影近似误差随参与智能体数增加而减小，因而更大规模的智能体群允许更大步长并实现更快线性收敛；数值结果显示其性能与全梯度联邦 LQR 相当而通信量大幅降低，即使对异质（但相似）智能体也成立。
Motivation: 合作智能体的无模型 LQR 策略学习中，每个智能体每步要上传 d 维零阶梯度估计，高策略维度下联邦上行通信成为瓶颈。
Method: 基于分解的投影梯度机制 (decomposed projected gradient)，每个智能体只发送局部零阶梯度估计的一个标量投影，服务器聚合标量消息重建全局下降方向；在同质智能体的标准正则性条件下保证所有迭代保持稳定化且平均 LQR 成本线性快速下降。
Result: 每智能体上行通信从 O(d) 降到 O(1)，与策略维度无关；投影近似误差随参与智能体数增加而减小，带来更大步长与更快线性收敛的标度律；数值结果表明在通信量大幅减少下性能与全梯度联邦 LQR 相当，且对异质（但相似）智能体同样成立。
Conclusion: 用标量投影换取通信的联邦 LQR 学习在智能体数量增大时反而更准、收敛更快，可在高维策略下保持稳定化与平均成本线性快速下降。

papers.title: Many Preferences, Few Policies: Compact Portfolios for Multi-Objective LLM Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Aligning large language models (LLMs) requires balancing competing objectives such as helpfulness, harmlessness, and conciseness. The appropriate balance varies across users and applications, yet training, evaluating, and deploying many policies across different reward weights is costly. We study how to identify a small portfolio of LLMs that preserves near-optimal performance across all reward weightings. We propose PALM (Portfolio of Aligned LLMs), an algorithm that combines a structured grid of weight vectors, a lazy search that optimizes policies only where needed, and pruning. Given target approximation tolerances, PALM returns a portfolio that provably contains a near-optimal policy for every weight vector, with an explicit upper bound on portfolio size. Such portfolios can support scalable personalization, reward-weight exploration during model development, and compact decoding-time configurations. Experiments show that PALM generally achieves smaller approximation gaps than same-size portfolios built from uniformly spaced or randomly sampled weights. We further demonstrate that PALM scales effectively to higher-dimensional reward spaces through efficient search and sparse preference structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 PALM（Portfolio of Aligned LLMs），用结构化权重网格、lazy search 与剪枝选出一个小规模对齐模型组合，在给定逼近容差下保证每个奖励权重向量都含近最优策略，并给出组合规模的显式上界。同规模下 PALM 的逼近间隙普遍小于均匀间隔或随机采样权重构建的组合，且能靠高效搜索与稀疏偏好结构扩展到更高维奖励空间。
Motivation: 不同用户与应用所需的 helpfulness、harmlessness、conciseness 权衡不同，而针对每组奖励权重分别训练、评估和部署多个策略成本高昂。
Method: PALM 组合三个部件：对奖励权重向量的结构化网格、只在必要处优化策略的 lazy search、以及剪枝；在给定逼近容差下输出组合，并证明组合包含每个权重向量的近最优策略且规模有显式上界。
Result: 实验中 PALM 一般比同规模的均匀间隔权重组合与随机采样权重组合取得更小的逼近间隙；并展示其通过高效搜索与稀疏偏好结构有效扩展到更高维奖励空间。
Conclusion: 少量策略组成的组合即可在全部奖励权重上保持近最优，可支撑可扩展个性化、开发期的奖励权重探索与紧凑的解码期配置。

papers.title: GISTBench: Evaluating LLM User Understanding via Evidence-Based Interest Verification
papers.abstract_en: We introduce GISTBench, a benchmark for evaluating Large Language Models' (LLMs) ability to understand users from their interaction histories in recommendation systems. Unlike traditional RecSys benchmarks that focus on item prediction accuracy, our benchmark evaluates how well LLMs can extract and verify user interests from engagement data. We propose two novel metric families: Interest Groundedness (IG), decomposed into precision and recall components to separately penalize hallucinated interest categories and reward coverage, and Interest Specificity (IS), which assesses the distinctiveness of verified LLM-predicted user profiles. We release a synthetic dataset constructed on real user interactions on a global short-form video platform. Our dataset contains both implicit and explicit engagement signals and rich textual descriptions. We validate our dataset fidelity against user surveys, and evaluate eight open-weight LLMs spanning 7B to 235B parameters, together with three proprietary frontier models (GPT-5, Claude 4.6, and Gemini 3.5 Flash). Our findings reveal performance bottlenecks in current LLMs, particularly their limited ability to accurately count and attribute engagement signals across heterogeneous interaction types.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GISTBench 把 LLM 的用户理解评测从物品预测准确率转向兴趣提取与核验：提出 Interest Groundedness (IG，分 precision/recall 惩罚幻觉兴趣类、奖励覆盖) 与 Interest Specificity (IS，衡量已核验画像的区分度) 两族指标。在基于全球短视频平台真实交互构建的合成数据集上评测 8 个 7B–235B 开源模型与 GPT-5、Claude 4.6、Gemini 3.5 Flash，发现当前 LLM 的主要瓶颈是难以准确计数并把交互信号归因到异质交互类型上。
Motivation: 传统 RecSys 基准只看物品预测准确率，无法衡量 LLM 能否从用户交互历史中提取并核验真实兴趣，幻觉兴趣类别与画像同质化问题无从度量。
Method: 提出两族指标：IG 分解为 precision 与 recall 分量，分别惩罚幻觉兴趣类别与奖励覆盖；IS 评估已核验的 LLM 预测画像的区分度。发布基于全球短视频平台真实用户交互构建的合成数据集，含隐式与显式参与信号及丰富文本描述，并用用户调查校验数据保真度。
Result: 评测覆盖 8 个 7B 至 235B 参数的开源 LLM 与 3 个专有前沿模型（GPT-5、Claude 4.6、Gemini 3.5 Flash）；发现当前 LLM 在准确计数并归因异质交互类型上的参与信号方面存在明显瓶颈。数据集保真度经用户调查验证。
Conclusion: LLM 用户理解的短板不在兴趣类别猜测，而在跨异质交互类型的信号计数与归因；评测应从物品命中率转向兴趣的 groundedness 与 specificity。

papers.title: Cryo-Bench: Benchmarking Foundation Models for Cryosphere Mapping
papers.abstract_en: Geo-Foundation Models (GFMs) have been evaluated across diverse Earth observation tasks and domains, showing strong potential to produce reliable maps even with sparse labels. However, systematic benchmarking of GFMs for Cryosphere applications remains limited, primarily because suitable evaluation datasets are scarce. We address this gap by introducing Cryo-Bench, a benchmark comprising six semantic segmentation datasets covering five cryospheric components: supraglacial debris, glacial lakes under two sensing configurations, sea ice, calving fronts and Antarctic ice-shelf extent. The benchmark includes multispectral, RGB, and synthetic aperture radar observations from regions underrepresented in existing pretraining archives. We evaluate thirteen GFMs alongside U-Net and Vision Transformer baselines trained from scratch under a unified evaluation protocol. With frozen encoders, the U-Net achieves the highest six-dataset average mean intersection over union (mIoU) of 69.31\%, exceeding TerraMind (67.86\%) by 1.45 points. The paired difference has a 95\% confidence interval of [+0.94, +1.98], indicating that the U-Net's lead is statistically significant. In contrast, learning-rate optimization substantially improves fine-tuning performance: DOFA reaches 93.97\% mIoU on the RGB glacial lake task, ranking the U-Net fourth, while Scale-MAE and GFM-Swin surpass U-Net on calving fronts. Averaged across all six datasets, four GFMs, TerraMind, GFM-Swin, DOFA, and Scale-MAE, exceed the U-Net baseline (69.31\%). In the few-shot setting, five GFMs, DOFA, RemoteCLIP, TerraMind, GFM-Swin, and Scale-MAE, likewise outperform U-Net; averaged across all thirteen GFMs, retention is 92.5\% of full-label accuracy compared with 86.1\% for U-Net.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Cryo-Bench 用六个冰冻圈语义分割数据集（表碛、两种传感配置的冰川湖、海冰、崩解前缘、南极冰架范围）统一评测 13 个地理基础模型 (GFM) 与从头训练的 U-Net、ViT。冻结编码器下 U-Net 六数据集平均 mIoU 69.31%，高于 TerraMind 67.86%（+1.45 点，95% CI [+0.94, +1.98]）；但学习率优化后的微调与少样本设定下多个 GFM 反超，13 个 GFM 平均少样本保留 92.5% 全标签精度，U-Net 仅 86.1%。
Motivation: GFM 在地球观测任务上被广泛评测，但冰冻圈应用缺少合适评测数据集，系统性基准测试一直受限。
Method: 构建 Cryo-Bench：六个语义分割数据集覆盖五类冰冻圈要素，含多光谱、RGB 与 SAR 观测且区域在现有预训练档案中代表性不足；在统一评测协议下评测 13 个 GFM 与从头训练的 U-Net、Vision Transformer 基线，分别考察冻结编码器、学习率优化的微调与少样本三种设定。
Result: 冻结编码器下 U-Net 六数据集平均 mIoU 69.31%，超 TerraMind 67.86% 共 1.45 点，配对差异 95% CI [+0.94, +1.98] 显著。学习率优化后 DOFA 在 RGB 冰川湖任务达 93.97% mIoU（U-Net 排第四），Scale-MAE 与 GFM-Swin 在崩解前缘上超 U-Net；六数据集平均有四个 GFM（TerraMind、GFM-Swin、DOFA、Scale-MAE）超 69.31%。少样本下五个 GFM（DOFA、RemoteCLIP、TerraMind、GFM-Swin、Scale-MAE）超 U-Net，13 个 GFM 平均保留全标签精度的 92.5%，U-Net 为 86.1%。
Conclusion: 冻结编码器下从头训练的 U-Net 仍是冰冻圈分割的强基线且优势统计显著，但经学习率优化的微调和少样本场景中多个 GFM 反超，说明 GFM 的价值取决于微调与标签预算条件。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: ANCRe: Adaptive Neural Connection Reassignment for Efficient Depth Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Scaling network depth has been a central driver behind the success of modern foundation models, yet recent investigations suggest that deep layers are often underutilized. This paper revisits the default mechanism for deepening neural networks, namely residual connections, from an optimization perspective. Rigorous analysis proves that the layout of residual connections can fundamentally shape convergence behavior, and even induces an exponential gap in convergence rates. Prompted by this insight, we introduce adaptive neural connection reassignment (ANCRe), a principled and lightweight framework that parameterizes and learns residual connectivities from the data. ANCRe adaptively reassigns residual connections with negligible computational and memory overhead ($<1\%$), while enabling more effective utilization of network depth. Extensive numerical tests across pre-training of large language models, diffusion models, and deep ResNets demonstrate consistently accelerated convergence, boosted performance, and enhanced depth efficiency over conventional residual connections.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ANCRe 把残差连接的拓扑本身参数化为可学习变量，从数据中自适应重连，证明连接布局会带来收敛速率的指数级差距，并以不足 1% 的计算与内存开销实现更深网络的有效利用。在大语言模型预训练、扩散模型与深层 ResNet 上均加速收敛、提升性能与深度效率。
Motivation: 深度扩展是基础模型成功的核心驱动，但近期研究表明深层常被低效利用；默认的残差连接布局在优化上并非最优，其选择会从根本上改变收敛行为。
Method: ANCRe (Adaptive Neural Connection Reassignment) 从优化视角参数化并从数据中学习残差连接拓扑，自适应重连，计算与内存开销低于 1%；理论部分证明连接布局可造成收敛速率的指数级差距。
Result: 理论结果：残差连接布局会造成收敛速率的指数级 (exponential) 差距；开销 <1%。数值测试覆盖大语言模型预训练、扩散模型与深层 ResNet，一致显示相对常规残差连接的收敛加速、性能提升与深度效率增强（摘要未给出具体指标数值）。
Conclusion: 残差连接不应是固定默认结构，而应作为可学习对象从数据重分配，才能更有效地利用网络深度，且代价可忽略。

papers.title: Extended to Reality: Prompt Injection in 3D Environments
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced the capabilities to interpret and act on visual input in 3D environments, empowering diverse applications such as robotics and situated conversational agents. When MLLMs reason over camera-captured views of the physical world, a new attack surface emerges: an attacker can place text-bearing physical objects in the environment to override MLLMs' intended task. While prior work has studied prompt injection in the text domain and through digitally edited 2D images, limited attention has been paid to how these attacks function in 3D environments. To bridge the gap, we introduce PI3D, a prompt injection attack against MLLMs in 3D environments, realized through text-bearing object placement rather than digital image edits. We formulate and solve the problem of identifying an effective pose (position and orientation) for a 3D object with injected text, where the attacker's goal is to induce the MLLM to perform the injected task while ensuring that the object placement remains physically plausible. Experiment results demonstrate that PI3D is an effective attack against multiple MLLMs under diverse camera trajectories. We further evaluate a range of defenses and show that they are not sufficient to reliably defend against PI3D.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 PI3D：在 3D 环境中通过摆放带文字的实体物体（而非数字改图）对 MLLM 实施提示注入，并把攻击形式化为求解该物体的有效位姿（位置与朝向），使注入任务被执行同时摆放保持物理合理。实验显示 PI3D 在多种相机轨迹下对多个 MLLM 均有效，且所评估的一系列防御手段都无法可靠抵御。
Motivation: MLLM 依据相机拍摄的物理世界画面推理时，攻击者可放置带文字物体覆盖原任务；已有工作只覆盖纯文本域与数字编辑的 2D 图像，3D 环境中的攻击如何成立缺乏研究。
Method: PI3D 通过实体物体摆放（text-bearing object placement）而非数字图像编辑实现注入；把问题形式化为求解带注入文本的 3D 物体位姿（位置与朝向），约束是摆放需物理可行，同时让 MLLM 执行注入任务。
Result: 实验表明 PI3D 在多样相机轨迹下对多个 MLLM 均是有效攻击；对一系列防御方法的评估显示它们不足以可靠防御 PI3D。
Conclusion: 3D 环境中的实体物体摆放构成 MLLM 的真实攻击面，现有防御在该攻击面前不可靠。

summary_sections.motivation: MLLM 依据相机拍摄的物理世界画面推理时，攻击者可放置带文字物体覆盖原任务；已有工作只覆盖纯文本域与数字编辑的 2D 图像，3D 环境中的攻击如何成立缺乏研究。
summary_sections.method: PI3D 通过实体物体摆放（text-bearing object placement）而非数字图像编辑实现注入；把问题形式化为求解带注入文本的 3D 物体位姿（位置与朝向），约束是摆放需物理可行，同时让 MLLM 执行注入任务。

summary_sections.conclusion: 3D 环境中的实体物体摆放构成 MLLM 的真实攻击面，现有防御在该攻击面前不可靠。

papers.title: Morality is Contextual: Learning Interpretable Moral Contexts from Human Data with Probabilistic Clustering and Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: A key question in current AI alignment research is how to make AI algorithms learn moral values. Because human morality is highly context-dependent, actions are judged not only by their outcomes but by the context in which they occur. We present COMETH (Contextual Organization of Moral Evaluation from Textual Human inputs), a framework that integrates a probabilistic context learner with LLM-based semantic abstraction and human moral evaluations to model how context shapes the acceptability of ambiguous actions. We curate an empirically grounded dataset of 300 scenarios across six core actions relative to three moral rules (violating "Do not kill", "Do not deceive", and "Do not break the law") and collect ternary judgments (Blame/Neutral/Support) from N=101 participants. A preprocessing pipeline standardizes actions via an LLM filter and MiniLM embeddings with K-means, producing robust, reproducible core-action clusters. COMETH then learns action-specific moral contexts by clustering scenarios online from human judgment distributions using principled divergence criteria. To generalize and explain predictions, a Generalization module extracts concise, non-evaluative binary contextual features and learns feature weights in a transparent likelihood-based model. Empirically, COMETH roughly doubles alignment score with most human judgments relative to end-to-end LLM prompting (60% vs. 30% on average), while revealing which contextual features drive its predictions. The contributions are: (i) an empirically grounded moral-context dataset, (ii) a reproducible pipeline combining human judgments with model-based context learning and LLM semantics, and (iii) a more interpretable alternative than end-to-end LLMs for context-sensitive moral prediction and explanation.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables, +15 pages of Appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: COMETH 用概率化在线聚类从人类三元道德判断分布中学习动作的情境上下文，再用可解释的二值上下文特征似然模型做泛化与解释。在 300 个情境、101 名参与者的道德判断数据上，其与人类判断的一致率约为端到端 LLM prompting 的两倍（平均 60% vs 30%），并能指出驱动预测的上下文特征。
Motivation: AI 对齐需要让算法学会依赖情境的人类道德判断，但端到端 LLM prompting 对模糊动作的可接受性预测既不透明也难解释，无法说明是哪些情境因素在起作用。
Method: COMETH 框架整合概率化情境学习器、基于 LLM 的语义抽象与人类道德评价：先用 LLM filter 加 MiniLM embedding 与 K-means 标准化动作得到核心动作簇，再按散度准则在线聚类情境（基于人类判断分布），最后由 Generalization 模块抽取简洁非评价性二值上下文特征并在透明似然模型中学习特征权重。数据为 300 个情境、六类核心动作、三条道德规则（不杀生、不欺骗、不违法），N=101 参与者给出 Blame/Neutral/Support 三元判断。
Result: COMETH 与多数人类判断的一致率约为端到端 LLM prompting 的两倍，平均 60% vs 30%；同时可指出驱动预测的上下文特征。
Conclusion: 对情境敏感的道德预测用可解释的上下文特征模型比端到端 LLM prompting 更能对齐人类判断，且预测依据可审查。

papers.title: Evaluation of Sampling Strategies and Physics-Informed Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks in Unbounded Domains
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have emerged as an effective approach for solving partial differential equations (PDEs) by incorporating physical laws into the learning process. However, their application to infinite and semi-infinite domains remains challenging due to the difficulty of representing unbounded regions with a finite number of training points. This work evaluates physics-informed learning strategies for inverse PDE problems in unbounded domains, focusing on the influence of sampling strategies based on uniform, Gaussian, and exponential distributions, and on the use of conventional multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) and Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (KANs) within the PINN framework. The proposed benchmark considers manufactured inverse problems on infinite and semi-infinite domains, enabling quantitative assessment of reconstruction accuracy and computational efficiency. Results show that Gaussian and exponential sampling, controlled through explicit distribution parameters, improve reconstruction accuracy in the far field and offer a direct mechanism for embedding problem-specific prior knowledge into training. PIKANs, whose edge-based functional representation is grounded in the Kolmogorov--Arnold representation theorem, match or exceed the accuracy of MLP-based PINNs while requiring fewer neurons, though their spline-based formulation increases the computational cost of training, inference, and derivative evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在无限与半无限域的反问题 PINN 基准上，高斯与指数采样通过显式分布参数改善远场重建精度，并成为嵌入先验知识的直接机制；PIKAN（物理 informed Kolmogorov--Arnold Network）以更少神经元达到或超过 MLP-PINN 精度，但样条形式抬高训练、推理与求导开销。
Motivation: PINN 用有限训练点难以表示无界区域，导致无限与半无限域上的反问题求解困难，缺少对采样策略与网络结构的定量比较基准。
Method: 在无限与半无限域上构造 manufactured inverse problems 基准，对比 uniform、Gaussian、exponential 三种采样分布（由显式分布参数控制），并对比常规 MLP 与基于 Kolmogorov--Arnold 表示定理、采用 edge-based functional representation 的 KAN（PIKAN）在 PINN 框架内的表现，定量评估重建精度与计算效率。
Result: Gaussian 与指数采样改善远场重建精度；PIKAN 以更少神经元匹配或超过 MLP-based PINN 的精度，但其 spline-based formulation 增加训练、推理与导数计算的计算成本。
Conclusion: 在无界域反问题中，采样分布是嵌入先验知识、提升远场精度的直接手段，而 KAN 用参数效率换计算开销，选择需在精度、神经元数与算力之间权衡。

papers.title: Closing the Train-Test Gap in World Models for Gradient-Based Planning
papers.abstract_en: World models paired with model predictive control (MPC) can be trained offline on large-scale datasets of expert trajectories and enable generalization to a wide range of planning tasks at inference time. Compared to traditional MPC procedures, which rely on slow search algorithms or on iteratively solving optimization problems exactly, gradient-based planning offers a computationally efficient alternative. However, the performance of gradient-based planning has thus far lagged behind that of other approaches. In this paper, we propose improved methods for training world models that enable efficient gradient-based planning. We begin with the observation that although a world model is trained on a next-state prediction objective, it is used at test-time to instead estimate a sequence of actions. The goal of our work is to close this train-test gap. To that end, we propose train-time data synthesis techniques that enable significantly improved gradient-based planning with existing world models. At test time, our approach outperforms or matches the classical gradient-free cross-entropy method (CEM) across a variety of object manipulation and navigation tasks in 10% of the time budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 世界模型虽以下一状态预测为目标训练，测试时却被用来估计动作序列，这一训练-测试错位拖累了基于梯度的规划。作者提出训练时数据合成技术弥合该 gap，使现有世界模型支撑的梯度规划在物体操作与导航任务上以 CEM 十分之一的时间预算达到或超过 CEM。
Motivation: 基于梯度的规划比搜索或迭代求解优化的传统 MPC 更快，但性能一直落后；根因是世界模型的训练目标（下一状态预测）与测试用途（估计动作序列）不一致。
Method: 提出面向梯度规划的世界模型训练改进：训练时数据合成 (train-time data synthesis) 技术，让在专家轨迹大数据集上离线训练的世界模型适配测试时的动作序列梯度优化；测试时直接用该世界模型做基于梯度的规划。
Result: 在多种物体操作与导航任务上，该方法以 CEM（cross-entropy method）10% 的时间预算达到或超过经典无梯度 CEM 的表现。
Conclusion: 缩小世界模型的训练-测试目标错位，就能让基于梯度的规划在效率远超 CEM 的同时不损失性能。

papers.title: ZeBROD: Zero-Retraining Based Recognition and Object Detection Framework
papers.abstract_en: Object detection constitutes the primary task within the domain of computer vision. It is utilized in numerous domains. Nonetheless, object detection continues to encounter the issue of catastrophic forgetting. The model must be retrained whenever new products are introduced, utilizing not only the new products dataset but also the entirety of the previous dataset. The outcome is obvious: increasing model training expenses and significant time consumption. In numerous sectors, particularly retail checkout, the frequent introduction of new products presents a great challenge. This study introduces Zero-Retraining Based Recognition and Object Detection (ZeBROD), a methodology designed to address the issue of catastrophic forgetting by integrating YOLO11n for object localization with DeIT and Proxy Anchor Loss for feature extraction and metric learning. For classification, we utilize cosine similarity between the embedding features of the target product and those in the Qdrant vector database. In a case study conducted in a retail store with 140 products, the experimental results demonstrate that our proposed framework achieves encouraging accuracy, whether for detecting new or existing products. Furthermore, without retraining, the training duration difference is significant. We achieve almost 3 times the training time efficiency compared to classical object detection approaches. This efficiency escalates as additional new products are added to the product database. The average inference time is 580 ms per image containing multiple products, on an edge device, validating the proposed framework's feasibility for practical use.
papers.comment: This manuscript was first submitted to the Journal of Automation and Intelligence. The preprint version was posted to arXiv afterwards to facilitate open access and community feedback
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ZeBROD 用 YOLO11n 做定位、DeiT 加 Proxy Anchor Loss 做度量学习嵌入，再以余弦相似度在 Qdrant 向量库中分类，从而在零售新品上架时零重训练地规避灾难性遗忘。在 140 种商品的门店案例中训练时间效率约为传统目标检测方法的 3 倍，边缘设备上多商品图像平均推理 580 ms。
Motivation: 零售收银等场景新品频繁上架，传统目标检测每次都要用新旧全量数据重训，训练开销与时间随品类增长而膨胀，且伴随灾难性遗忘。
Method: ZeBROD 框架：YOLO11n 负责目标定位，DeiT 配合 Proxy Anchor Loss 做特征提取与度量学习；分类阶段计算目标商品嵌入与 Qdrant 向量数据库中各商品嵌入的余弦相似度，新品只需入库无需重训。
Result: 在含 140 种商品的零售店案例中，对新品与既有商品的检测均取得令人鼓舞的准确率；无需重训时训练时间效率约为传统目标检测方法的近 3 倍，且新增商品越多优势越大；边缘设备上含多商品图像的平均推理时间为 580 ms/张。
Conclusion: 把分类从检测头解耦为向量库检索，可在品类频繁变动的零售检测中以零重训练换取训练效率与可扩展性，并在边缘设备上满足实用推理时延。

papers.title: Fragmentation is Efficiently Learnable by Quantum Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: In certain classes of physical quantum systems, the exponentially large state space "fragments" into many low-dimensional, dynamically disconnected subspaces. We introduce a learning problem known as fragment classification, where given a quantum state input, one is interested in classifying to which subspace the state belongs. We prove that solving this learning problem is efficient on a quantum computer when the fragmentation phenomenon satisfies certain conditions. Furthermore, we give evidence supporting the classical hardness of this task by demonstrating that known dequantization techniques fail for the fragment classification problem. Consequently, this work provides a rare example of a physically motivated quantum machine learning task that is both efficient for quantum computers to perform and admits no known classical dequantization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把物理量子系统中希尔伯特空间碎裂成动力学不连通低维子空间的现象形式化为「fragment classification」学习问题：给定量子态，判定它属于哪个子空间。证明在碎裂满足一定条件时该任务在量子计算机上可高效学习，并给出已知去量子化 (dequantization) 技术对该问题失效的证据，从而得到一个量子高效、且无已知经典去量子化的物理动机 QML 任务实例。
Motivation: 量子机器学习缺少物理动机强、又确实体现量子优势的任务：很多问题要么本身平凡，要么已被经典去量子化。态空间碎裂是物理中真实存在的结构，但此前没有被形式化为可学习性问题。
Method: 定义 fragment classification 学习问题（输入量子态，输出其所属动力学子空间），在碎裂现象满足特定条件时证明量子高效可解；再检验已知去量子化技术，展示它们对该问题失效。
Result: 在碎裂满足所给条件时，fragment classification 在量子计算机上被证明可高效求解；已知去量子化技术被证明/展示对该任务失效，构成该任务经典困难性的证据。
Conclusion: 碎裂分类是物理动机下少见的 QML 任务：量子计算机高效、且无已知经典去量子化路径，因此可作为量子学习优势的候选实例。

papers.title: Bifidelity Karhunen-Loève Expansion Surrogate with Active Learning for Random Fields
papers.abstract_en: We present a bifidelity Karhunen--Loève expansion (KLE) surrogate model for field-valued quantities of interest (QoIs) under uncertain inputs. The QoIs considered here are scalar fields. The approach combines the spectral efficiency of the KLE with polynomial chaos expansions (PCEs) to preserve an explicit mapping between input uncertainties and output fields. By coupling inexpensive low-fidelity (LF) simulations that capture dominant response trends with a limited number of high-fidelity (HF) simulations that correct for systematic bias, the proposed method can enable accurate and computationally affordable surrogate construction. To further improve surrogate accuracy, we develop an active learning strategy that adaptively selects new HF evaluations based on the surrogate's generalization error, estimated via cross-validation and modeled using Gaussian process regression. New HF samples are then acquired by maximizing an expected improvement criterion, targeting regions of high surrogate error. The resulting BF-KLE-AL framework is demonstrated on three examples of increasing complexity: a one-dimensional analytical benchmark, a two-dimensional convection-diffusion system, and a three-dimensional turbulent round jet simulation based on Reynolds-averaged Navier--Stokes (RANS) and enhanced delayed detached-eddy simulations (EDDES). The experiments show that bifidelity gains depend on LF accuracy, discrepancy approximation, and the allocation of simulation cost. Active learning improves prediction over random sampling in several settings, while the cost-matched comparisons identify both favorable regimes and cases where an HF-only surrogate is more accurate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 BF-KLE-AL：用 Karhunen–Loève 展开 (KLE) 加多项式混沌展开 (PCE) 保留输入不确定性到输出场的显式映射，以低保真 (LF) 模拟捕捉主趋势、少量高保真 (HF) 模拟校正系统偏差，并用基于交叉验证泛化误差的高斯过程主动学习挑选新 HF 样本（expected improvement 采样）。在三个递增复杂度算例上，双保真收益取决于 LF 精度、偏差近似与算力分配；主动学习在若干设定下优于随机采样，但成本对齐比较也给出 HF-only 代理更准的情形。
Motivation: 场值 QoI 在不确定输入下的代理建模需要同时保住空间结构与输入-输出映射，纯 HF 模拟昂贵，而单纯堆 LF 会留下系统偏差；且双保真并非在任何算力分配下都占优，需要可判定的取舍依据。
Method: BF-KLE-AL 框架：KLE 做场降维、PCE 建输入到输出场的显式映射；LF 模拟提供趋势、有限 HF 模拟校正偏差。主动学习用交叉验证估计代理泛化误差，以高斯过程回归建模该误差，再按 expected improvement 准则挑选误差高的区域新增 HF 评估。
Result: 在一维解析基准、二维对流-扩散系统、三维基于 RANS 与 EDDES 的湍流圆射流三个递增复杂度算例上检验：双保真收益依赖 LF 精度、偏差近似与仿真成本分配；主动学习在若干设定下优于随机采样；成本对齐 (cost-matched) 比较同时识别出有利区间与 HF-only 代理更准的情形。
Conclusion: 双保真加主动学习能否赢取决于 LF 质量与算力分配，成本对齐比较是判定适用区间的必要条件，HF-only 在部分情形仍是更准选择。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Uncovering EEG Patterns Consistently Associated with Cybersickness Discomfort Using Deep Learning Interpretability Maps
papers.abstract_en: Uncomfortable sensations similar to motion sickness, called cybersickness, can develop when using Virtual Reality (VR) head-mounted displays. Cybersickness poses a hindrance to greater use of VR technology. Brain activity recorded using electroencephalogram (EEG) can be used to unintrusively detect cybersickness and the discomfort it causes. To intervene for mitigation, machine learning algorithms that can extract meaningful signals related to cybersickness discomfort from the rest of the brain data will be required. In this work, we determined which features in EEG data were most helpful for classifying cybersickness-related discomfort by building a framework with neural networks and interpretability maps. Using brain data from two separate auditory event-related potential (ERP) cybersickness user studies, we extracted which spatio-temporal EEG features (from sensor locations and time steps) were most important for discomfort classification. For the first dataset (n=29), across 120 runs of our framework with three different neural networks over multiple random seeds, the models consistently pointed to scalp locations in left frontal, midline central, and right parietal areas as most helpful in determining if EEG data belonged to someone who was experiencing cybersickness discomfort. Similar locations were also tagged in a second dataset (n=36), showing cross-dataset generalizability of our findings across time, VR stimulus, and participant sample. Early periods in the extracted ERP time windows, approximately between 80 and 260 milliseconds post-stimulus, were marked as important for model classification in both datasets. These results help clarify which tagged features can be used for cybersickness-related (and potentially other types of) discomfort classification with EEG in the future. Project webpage at: https://eeg-discomfort-nnilc.github.io/.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 6 figures. 19 pages, 18 figures in appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用神经网络加可解释性图谱定位 EEG 中真正用于分类 VR 晕动不适 (cybersickness discomfort) 的时空特征：在两个听觉 ERP 用户研究上，模型一致指向左额、中线中央、右顶头皮位置，以及刺激后约 80–260 毫秒的早期 ERP 时段，且跨数据集、跨 VR 刺激与被试复现。
Motivation: VR 头显引发的晕动不适阻碍 VR 推广，需要无创检测并找出可用于后续干预的脑电判别信号，而非黑箱分类。
Method: 构建神经网络加可解释性图谱 (interpretability maps) 的框架，在两个听觉事件相关电位 (ERP) 晕动不适用户研究数据上提取传感器位置与时间步的时空特征重要性；第一个数据集 n=29，用三种神经网络、多个随机种子共 120 次运行，第二个数据集 n=36 做跨数据集检验。
Result: 数据集一 (n=29) 的 120 次运行中，模型一致把左额、中线中央、右顶头皮位置判为区分不适状态最有帮助的区域；数据集二 (n=36) 标出相似位置，跨时间、VR 刺激与被试样本保持一致；两个数据集都把刺激后约 80–260 毫秒的早期 ERP 时段标为分类重要。
Conclusion: 这些被标记的时空特征可用于未来基于 EEG 的晕动不适（乃至其他类型不适）分类，且定位结果具备跨数据集泛化性。
