papers.title: Cocoon: A System Architecture for Differentially Private Training with Correlated Noises
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning (ML) models memorize and leak training data, causing serious privacy issues to data owners. Training algorithms with differential privacy (DP) have been gaining attention as a solution. However, these algorithms add noise at each training iteration and degrade accuracy, limiting their real-world adoption. To improve accuracy, a new family of approaches adds carefully designed correlated noises, so that noises cancel out each other across iterations. We performed an extensive characterization study of these new mechanisms and show they incur non-negligible overheads when the model is relatively large or uses large embedding tables compared to the hardware capacity. Motivated by the analysis, we propose Cocoon, a framework for efficient training with correlated noises. Cocoon stores and processes the large noise history across CPU, GPU, and memory extension module, introduces optimizations for sparse embedding tables, and leverages to-be-commercialized near-memory processing (NMP) devices. On a real system with an FPGA-based NMP device prototype, Cocoon improves the performance by 1.23-10.82x.
papers.comment: Published in the Proceedings of 20th USENIX Symposium on Operating Systems Design and Implementation (OSDI'26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Cocoon 是面向差分隐私 (DP) 相关噪声训练的系统架构：把跨迭代累积的大规模噪声历史分布到 CPU、GPU 与内存扩展模块上，并针对稀疏 embedding 表优化，利用近内存计算 (NMP) 器件降低开销。在基于 FPGA 的 NMP 原型机上，性能提升 1.23–10.82 倍。
Motivation: DP 训练每步加噪导致精度下降，而相关噪声机制靠噪声跨迭代抵消来提精度，却在模型或 embedding 表相对硬件容量较大时产生不可忽略的系统开销，限制实际部署。
Method: 先对相关噪声机制做系统刻画 (characterization) 定位开销来源，再提出 Cocoon：将大规模噪声历史跨 CPU、GPU 与内存扩展模块存储与处理，为稀疏 embedding 表引入专门优化，并使用可商用化的近内存处理 (NMP) 器件。
Result: 在搭载 FPGA 版 NMP 器件原型的真实系统上，Cocoon 将性能提升 1.23–10.82 倍；刻画研究显示相关噪声机制在模型较大或 embedding 表超出硬件容量时开销不可忽略。
Conclusion: 相关噪声 DP 训练的瓶颈是噪声历史的存储与访问，把该状态分布到异构内存并交给 NMP 处理即可把开销压到可接受范围。

papers.title: A fast non-reversible sampler for Bayesian mixture models
papers.abstract_en: Mixtures models are a cornerstone of Bayesian modelling, and it is well-known that sampling from the resulting posterior distribution can be a hard task. In particular, popular reversible Markov chain Monte Carlo schemes are often slow to converge when the number of observations $n$ is large. In this paper we introduce a novel and simple non-reversible sampling scheme for Bayesian mixture models (with fixed or varying number of components), which is shown to drastically outperform classical samplers in many scenarios of interest, especially during convergence phase and when components in the mixture have non-negligible overlap. At the theoretical level, we show that the performance of the proposed non-reversible scheme cannot be worse than the standard one, in terms of asymptotic variance, by more than a factor of four; and we provide a scaling limit analysis suggesting that the non-reversible sampler can reduce the convergence time from O$(n^2)$ to O$(n)$. We also discuss why the statistical features of mixture models make them an ideal case for the use of non-reversible discrete samplers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用于贝叶斯混合模型的非可逆 MCMC 采样方案（分量数固定或可变），在观测数 n 大、混合分量重叠明显时收敛显著快于经典可逆采样器。理论上渐近方差最多劣于标准方案 4 倍，scaling limit 分析表明收敛时间可从 O(n²) 降到 O(n)。
Motivation: 贝叶斯混合模型后验采样本就困难，而常用的可逆 MCMC 在观测数 n 大时收敛很慢，尤其在混合分量重叠时混合性差。
Method: 构造一个针对贝叶斯混合模型（分量数固定或可变）的简单非可逆离散采样方案；理论上给出渐近方差比较界与 scaling limit 分析，并论证混合模型的统计特性为何特别适合非可逆离散采样器。
Result: 在多种场景下大幅优于经典采样器，尤其在收敛阶段以及分量重叠不可忽略时；渐近方差相对标准方案的劣化不超过 4 倍；scaling limit 分析给出收敛时间由 O(n²) 降至 O(n)。
Conclusion: 非可逆性可把贝叶斯混合模型的采样收敛时间从 O(n²) 降到 O(n)，且渐近方差有 4 倍的最坏情形保证，混合模型是非可逆离散采样器的理想用例。

papers.title: Quantum parameter estimation with uncertainty quantification from continuous measurement data using neural network ensembles
papers.abstract_en: We show that ensembles of deep neural networks, called deep ensembles, can be used to perform quantum parameter estimation while also providing a means for quantifying uncertainty in parameter estimates, which is a key advantage of using Bayesian inference for parameter estimation that is lost when using existing machine learning methods. We show that optimizing for both accurate parameter estimates and well calibrated uncertainty estimates does not lead to degradation in the former as opposed to only optimizing for accuracy. We also show that the drift detection capabilities of these ensemble models can be used to detect drift in the experimental data used during inference. This approach is also shown to provide much faster inference time than both likelihood-based and likelihood-free Bayesian inference. These results suggest that such models could enable accurate, real-time parameter estimation with quantified uncertainty, making them promising candidates for deployment in experimental settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用深度集成 (deep ensembles) 做量子参数估计，同时输出参数估计值和校准过的不确定性，并用集成的漂移检测能力发现推理阶段实验数据的漂移。联合优化估计精度与不确定性校准不会牺牲前者；相比基于似然与免似然的贝叶斯推断，推理时间大幅缩短，因而可实时部署到实验场景。
Motivation: 现有机器学习方法做量子参数估计时丢掉了贝叶斯推断的不确定性量化能力，而基于似然的贝叶斯推断推理太慢，难以在实验中实时使用。
Method: 训练多个深度神经网络组成 deep ensemble，同时优化参数估计精度与不确定性校准两个目标；用集成成员间的分歧做漂移检测，覆盖推理时输入的实验连续测量数据。
Result: 联合优化精度与校准不确定性不会导致估计精度相对只优化精度下降；集成模型的推断速度快于基于似然和免似然两类贝叶斯推断；集成的漂移检测可用于识别推理所用实验数据的漂移。
Conclusion: deep ensembles 可作为实验场景下实时量子参数估计的候选方案：既给出带量化不确定性的估计，又保留漂移检测与速度优势。

papers.title: Multimodal Representation Learning Conditioned on Semantic Relations
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal representation learning has been largely driven by contrastive models such as CLIP, which learn a shared embedding space by aligning paired image-text samples. While effective for general-purpose representation learning, such models typically produce a single embedding per sample that is reused across different semantic relations and contexts. However, in many real-world applications, relevance between samples is inherently relation-dependent, with different semantic relations emphasizing different aspects of multimodal data. In this work, we propose Relation-Conditioned Multimodal Learning (RCML), a framework that treats semantic relations as explicit conditions of multimodal representation learning. Rather than producing relation-agnostic embeddings, RCML learns representations conditioned on natural-language relation descriptions, allowing the same sample to be represented differently under different relational contexts. The framework constructs relation-aware training pairs, introduces a relation-conditioned module to adapt embeddings to relation semantics, and employs a unified contrastive objective to jointly model cross-modal alignment and relation-induced inter-sample structure. Experiments on multiple datasets show that RCML consistently outperforms strong baselines on retrieval and classification tasks in zero-shot, fine-tuned, and out-of-domain settings, highlighting the effectiveness of leveraging semantic relations to guide multimodal representation learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RCML 把语义关系作为多模态表征学习的显式条件，用自然语言关系描述驱动同一图像-文本样本在不同关系上下文下产生不同嵌入，而非 CLIP 式的单一关系无关嵌入。在检索与分类任务的 zero-shot、fine-tuned、out-of-domain 设置上一致优于强基线。
Motivation: CLIP 类对比模型对每个样本只产出一个嵌入并跨关系复用，但真实场景中样本间相关性依赖具体语义关系，不同关系强调多模态数据的不同侧面。
Method: RCML 框架包含关系感知训练对构造、以自然语言关系描述为条件的关系条件化模块（adapt embeddings to relation semantics），以及统一的对比目标，联合建模跨模态对齐与关系诱导的样本间结构。
Result: 在多个数据集的检索与分类任务上，RCML 在 zero-shot、fine-tuned 与 out-of-domain 三种设置下均一致优于强基线。
Conclusion: 用语义关系引导多模态表征学习有效：让嵌入随关系上下文变化，比关系无关的单一嵌入更能适配不同关系下的检索与分类需求。

papers.title: Continuous Policy and Value Iteration for Relaxed Stochastic Control Problems and Its Convergence
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a continuous policy-value iteration algorithm where the approximations of the value function of a stochastic control problem and the optimal control are simultaneously updated through Langevin-type dynamics. This paper focuses on the entropy-regularized relaxed control problem with infinite horizon. We establish policy improvement and demonstrate convergence to the optimal control under the monotonicity condition of the Hamiltonian. By utilizing Langevin-type stochastic differential equations for continuous updates along the policy iteration direction, our approach enables the use of distribution sampling techniques in machine learning to optimize the value function and identify the optimal control simultaneously. Numerical experiments are presented for LQ model with a non-concave reward, and a non-LQ example with a skewed-Laplace optimal control.
papers.comment: 34 pages, 2 figures. Revised to focus exclusively on the relaxed control problem
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出连续策略-值迭代算法：值函数与最优控制的近似由 Langevin 型随机微分方程沿策略迭代方向同时更新，从而可直接套用机器学习中的分布采样技术。在 Hamiltonian 单调性条件下证明策略改进与向最优控制的收敛；数值实验覆盖非凹奖励的 LQ 模型与 skewed-Laplace 最优控制的非 LQ 例子。
Motivation: 熵正则化 relaxed control 的无限时域问题中，值函数与控制的离散策略迭代需要交替求解，难以接入采样式优化工具。
Method: 针对无限时域熵正则化 relaxed control 问题，用 Langevin 型 SDE 沿策略迭代方向连续更新值函数与最优控制，使二者同时被优化；收敛性依赖 Hamiltonian 的单调性条件。
Result: 建立策略改进性质并在 Hamiltonian 单调性条件下证明收敛到最优控制；数值实验包含带非凹奖励的 LQ 模型和具有 skewed-Laplace 最优控制的非 LQ 例子。
Conclusion: 连续化的 Langevin 策略-值迭代在单调性条件下可收敛到熵正则化 relaxed control 的最优控制，并把采样类 ML 优化器引入该问题。

papers.title: Infinity Search: Approximate Vector Search with Projections on q-Metric Spaces
papers.abstract_en: An ultrametric space or infinity-metric space is defined by a dissimilarity function that satisfies a strong triangle inequality in which every side of a triangle is not larger than the larger of the other two. We show that search in ultrametric spaces with a vantage point tree has worst-case complexity equal to the depth of the tree. Since datasets of interest are not ultrametric in general, we employ a projection operator that transforms an arbitrary dissimilarity function into an ultrametric space while preserving nearest neighbors. We further learn an approximation of this projection operator to efficiently compute ultrametric distances between query points and points in the dataset. We proceed to solve a more general problem in which we consider projections in $q$-metric spaces -- in which triangle sides raised to the power of $q$ are smaller than the sum of the $q$-powers of the other two. Notice that the use of learned approximations of projected $q$-metric distances renders the search pipeline approximate. We show in experiments that increasing values of $q$ result in faster search but lower recall. Overall, search in q-metric and infinity metric spaces is competitive with existing search methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Infinity Search：用保最近邻的投影算子把任意距离函数映射到 ultrametric（infinity-metric）空间，再学习该投影的近似以快速计算查询与数据点之间的 q-metric 距离，使搜索复杂度降到 vantage point tree 的深度。实验显示 q 越大搜索越快但 recall 越低，整体与现有向量检索方法相当。
Motivation: 一般数据集并非 ultrametric，直接用 vantage point tree 检索无法享受树深级别的最坏复杂度；而精确投影又难以高效计算，需要在速度与召回之间可控折衷。
Method: 先证明 ultrametric 空间上 vantage point tree 检索的最坏复杂度等于树深；再构造保持最近邻的投影算子把任意 dissimilarity 变为 ultrametric，并学习该投影的近似以高效计算 q-metric 距离（三角形边的 q 次幂不超过另两边 q 次幂之和），学习近似使整个检索管线成为 approximate search。
Result: 实验中 q 取值增大带来更快的搜索速度但更低的 recall；在 q-metric 与 infinity metric 空间中的检索与现有检索方法相比具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 把任意 dissimilarity 投影到 ultrametric/q-metric 空间并学习其近似，可在树深级复杂度下做近似向量检索，q 是速度与召回之间的直接调节旋钮。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VTBench: Evaluating Visual Tokenizers for Autoregressive Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive (AR) models have recently shown strong performance in image generation, where a critical component is the visual tokenizer (VT) that maps continuous pixel inputs to discrete token sequences. The quality of the VT largely defines the upper bound of AR model performance. However, current discrete VTs fall significantly behind continuous variational autoencoders (VAEs), leading to degraded image reconstructions and poor preservation of details and text. Existing benchmarks focus on end-to-end generation quality, without isolating VT performance. To address this gap, we introduce VTBench, a comprehensive benchmark that systematically evaluates VTs across three core tasks: Image Reconstruction, Detail Preservation, and Text Preservation, and covers a diverse range of evaluation scenarios. We systematically assess state-of-the-art VTs using a set of metrics to evaluate the quality of reconstructed images. Our findings reveal that continuous VAEs produce superior visual representations compared to discrete VTs, particularly in retaining spatial structure and semantic detail. In contrast, the degraded representations produced by discrete VTs often lead to distorted reconstructions, loss of fine-grained textures, and failures in preserving text and object integrity. Furthermore, we conduct experiments on GPT-4o image generation and discuss its potential AR nature, offering new insights into the role of visual tokenization. We release our benchmark and codebase publicly to support further research and call on the community to develop strong, general-purpose open-source VTs.
papers.comment: Accepted to AACL-IJCNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 26 pages, 13 figures, 8 tables. Code: https://github.com/huawei-lin/VTBench. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/huaweilin/VTBench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VTBench 把视觉 tokenizer (VT) 从端到端生成中剥离出来单独评测，围绕图像重建、细节保持、文本保持三项任务系统比较当前 SOTA 离散 VT 与连续 VAE。结论是连续 VAE 在空间结构与语义细节上明显占优，离散 VT 的退化表征会导致重建扭曲、细粒度纹理丢失以及文字与物体完整性失败。
Motivation: 现有图像生成基准只看端到端生成质量，无法区分是 VT 还是 AR 模型的问题；而离散 VT 已显著落后于连续 VAE，其质量直接决定 AR 图像生成的性能上限。
Method: 提出 VTBench 基准，把 VT 评测拆成 Image Reconstruction、Detail Preservation、Text Preservation 三类任务并覆盖多种评测场景，用一组重建质量指标系统评估 SOTA VT；另在 GPT-4o 图像生成上做实验并讨论其可能的 AR 机制。
Result: 系统评测发现连续 VAE 产出的视觉表征优于离散 VT，尤其在保留空间结构与语义细节方面；离散 VT 的退化表征造成重建扭曲、细粒度纹理丢失、文字与物体完整性保持失败。基准与代码库公开发布（GitHub 与 Hugging Face）。
Conclusion: VT 质量是 AR 图像生成的瓶颈，社区需要更强的通用开源 VT；VTBench 提供隔离 VT 性能的评测入口。

papers.title: Noise Sensitivity and Learning Lower Bounds for Hierarchical Functions
papers.abstract_en: Recent works explore deep learning's success by examining functions or data with hierarchical structure. To study the learning complexity of functions with hierarchical structure, we study the noise stability of functions with tree hierarchical structure on independent inputs. We show that if each function in the hierarchy is $\varepsilon$-far from linear, the noise stability is exponentially small in the depth of the hierarchy. Our results have immediate applications for agnostic learning. In the Boolean setting using the results of Dachman-Soled, Feldman, Tan, Wan and Wimmer (2014), our results provide Statistical Query super-polynomial lower bounds for agnostically learning classes that are based on hierarchical functions. We also derive similar SQ lower bounds based on the indicators of crossing events in critical site percolation. These crossing events are not formally hierarchical as we define but still have some hierarchical features as studied in mathematical physics. Using the results of Abbe, Bengio, Cornacchiam, Kleinberg, Lotfi, Raghu and Zhang (2022), our results imply sample complexity lower bounds for learning hierarchical functions with gradient descent on fully connected neural networks. Finally in the Gaussian setting, using the results of Diakonikolas, Kane, Pittas and Zarifis (2021), our results provide super-polynomial lower bounds for agnostic SQ learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在独立输入的树状层级函数上证明：若层级中每个函数都 ε-远离线性，则噪声稳定性随层级深度指数衰减。由此在 Boolean 与 Gaussian 设定下推出 agnostic 学习的超多项式 SQ 下界，并结合既有结果给出全连接网络上梯度下降的样本复杂度下界。
Motivation: 深度学习在层级结构数据上的成功需要理论解释，而层级函数的学习复杂度此前缺少刻画噪声稳定性与下界的工具。
Method: 研究独立输入下树状层级函数的噪声稳定性，证明各层级函数 ε-远离线性时噪声稳定性随深度指数小；再分别嫁接 Dachman-Soled 等 (2014) 的 Boolean 结果、Abbe 等 (2022) 的梯度下降结果与 Diakonikolas 等 (2021) 的 Gaussian 结果，导出各类学习下界。
Result: 噪声稳定性随层级深度指数衰减（各函数 ε-远离线性时）；对基于层级函数的类给出 agnostic 学习的超多项式 SQ 下界；对临界位点渗流 crossing 事件指示函数给出类似 SQ 下界；推出全连接网络梯度下降学习层级函数的样本复杂度下界；Gaussian 设定下给出 agnostic SQ 学习的超多项式下界。
Conclusion: 层级结构本身（各组成函数偏离线性）就足以造成指数级噪声稳定性衰减与超多项式学习下界，这为理解深层网络的学习难度提供了复杂度论解释。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Heads, Tails, and AI Fails: LLMs, Randomness, and Human Judgments
papers.abstract_en: Randomness is central to human cognition and to many applications in which large language models are deployed, yet probabilistic token generation does not imply that LLMs can produce unbiased random sequences. We study how contemporary LLMs generate binary random sequences using the classic behavioral-science paradigm of simulated coin flips. Across single flips, 20-flip sequences, n-gram statistics, run lengths, alternation rates, and next-flip predictability, we compare model outputs to both true Bernoulli baselines and human data from prior work. We find that LLMs reproduce several canonical human randomness biases, including over-alternation, aversion to long runs, and first-flip biases, but often amplify them or introduce model-specific distortions. Increasing temperature reduces some rigid patterns but does not eliminate systematic structure. We further investigate over-alternation through prompt-framing experiments, continuation tests, corpus searches, and residual-stream probes, finding evidence that this bias is not explained by direct memorization or tokenization alone. These results show that LLMs are unreliable generators of randomness and imperfect simulators of human randomness judgments, with implications for applications requiring stochasticity, fair sampling, or behavioral simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用模拟抛硬币范式检验当代 LLM 生成二元随机序列的能力，发现模型复现并常常放大人类的过度交替、厌恶长连段与首枚偏差，升温只能削弱部分僵硬模式而不能消除系统性结构。结论是 LLM 不可作为随机数生成器，也不适合作为人类随机性判断的模拟器。
Motivation: 概率 token 生成并不等于无偏随机序列，而 LLM 又被部署在需要随机性、公平抽样与行为模拟的场景，其偏差会直接传导到下游用途。
Method: 以模拟抛硬币范式让 LLM 生成单次与 20 次序列，比较 n-gram 统计、连段长度、交替率与下一枚可预测性，对照真实 Bernoulli 基线与既有人类数据；再用 prompt 框架实验、续写测试、语料检索与 residual-stream probes 追查过度交替来源。
Result: LLM 复现过度交替、厌恶长连段、首枚偏差等典型人类随机性偏差，且常放大之或引入模型特有扭曲；提高 temperature 可减少部分僵硬模式但不消除系统性结构；过度交替不能由直接记忆或 tokenization 单独解释。
Conclusion: LLM 是不可靠的随机性生成器，也是不完美的人类随机性判断模拟器，涉及随机性、公平抽样与行为模拟的应用应避免依赖其输出。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MintFlow: Minimal Trajectory Intervention for Constrained Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching models excel at generative modeling, and many downstream applications require their samples to satisfy prescribed constraints, such as observed measurements and physical laws. However, existing constrained samplers often face a trade-off: \textit{enforcing constraints can substantially displace samples from the pretrained data distribution}. To address this trade-off, we introduce \textbf{MintFlow}, a training-free constrained sampling framework that formulates constraint enforcement as a minimal intervention on the pretrained flow trajectory. MintFlow seeks the minimal perturbation of an intermediate flow state such that its subsequent evolution under the pretrained flow field satisfies the target constraint. By minimally perturbing the flow state while keeping the pretrained flow field unchanged, MintFlow enforces the constraint while minimizing unnecessary deviation from the pretrained distribution. An adjoint formulation yields a closed-form expression for this perturbation, eliminating expensive iterative optimization. Furthermore, MintFlow adaptively selects the intervention time to balance the required perturbation magnitude with its amplification by the remaining flow. Across a range of tasks in generative vision and physical system modeling, MintFlow achieves competitive constraint satisfaction while preserving the pretrained generative distribution substantially better than state-of-the-art constrained methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MintFlow 是一个免训练的约束采样框架：把约束执行写成对预训练 flow 轨迹的最小干预，用伴随 (adjoint) 推导出闭式扰动公式，避免迭代优化，并自适应选择干预时刻以平衡扰动幅度与其被剩余流场的放大。在生成视觉与物理系统建模任务上，它在保持约束满足竞争力的同时，比现有约束方法更好地保留预训练生成分布。
Motivation: 现有约束采样器存在权衡：强制执行约束（观测数据、物理定律）会把样本大幅推离预训练数据分布，导致生成质量下降。
Method: MintFlow 只对中间 flow 状态做最小扰动，使该状态在预训练流场下的后续演化满足目标约束，而流场本身保持不变；伴随形式给出该扰动的闭式解，无需昂贵的迭代优化；干预时间自适应选择，以平衡所需扰动幅度与其被剩余 flow 的放大。
Result: 在生成视觉与物理系统建模的一系列任务上，MintFlow 取得有竞争力的约束满足 (constraint satisfaction)，并比 state-of-the-art 约束方法更大幅度地保留预训练生成分布；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 对预训练 flow 轨迹做最小干预即可同时兼顾约束满足与分布保持，闭式伴随解与自适应干预时刻是实现这一权衡的关键。

papers.title: Parameter-Free Interval-Dynamic Regret under Heavy-Tailed Noise
papers.abstract_en: We study online convex optimization with one unbiased stochastic subgradient per round and an unknown finite conditional $p$th noise moment, $1<p\le2$. For every fixed interval $I$ of length $n$ and comparator path with $Λ_I=1+P_I/D$, one learner achieves \[ E[Regret_I(u)]\le\min(GDn, C[GD\sqrt{n(Λ_I+\log^2(2T))} +σDn^{1/p}(Λ_I+\log^2(2T))^{(p-1)/p}]). \] The learner uses none of $G,σ,p,I,P_I$, and the constant is universal. Interval adaptation adds to comparator complexity, preserving the distinct mean-gradient and noise exponents. The analysis controls calibration in expectation and limits the cost of observation-scale changes. Its general theorem compares to distributions over predictably available experts with relative-entropy dependence on a nonuniform prior. A common prior favors long windows and long restart lengths. With the statistics supplied, the interval cost becomes $1+\log(T/n)$, including the optimal full-horizon static rate. A change-of-measure lower bound identifies the noise power of this logarithm for learners retaining a full-horizon optimal guarantee, under explicit conditions. Static comparisons and deterministic partitions follow from the same decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线凸优化中每轮仅一个无偏随机次梯度、噪声条件 p 阶矩未知且 1<p≤2 时，提出一个不依赖 G、σ、p、区间 I 与比较器复杂度 Λ_I 的单学习器，对任意固定区间 I 给出期望区间动态 regret 上界 min(GDn, C[GD√(n(Λ_I+log²2T)) + σDn^{1/p}(Λ_I+log²2T)^{(p-1)/p}])，常数通用。区间自适应把代价压到 1+log(T/n)，覆盖最优全时域静态率；变分测度下界指出保留全时域最优保证的学习器该对数的噪声幂。
Motivation: 区间动态 regret 通常需要已知噪声矩 p、噪声尺度 σ、梯度界 G 与区间长度，且区间自适应会把比较器复杂度与噪声代价混在一起，难以同时保住均值梯度与噪声的不同指数。
Method: 构造单一学习器，对每个固定区间 I 与比较器路径 Λ_I=1+P_I/D 直接给出期望 regret 界；在期望意义下控制校准并限制观测尺度变化的代价，一般定理比较对象为可预测可得专家上的分布、相对熵依赖非均匀先验，再由同一决策导出静态比较与确定性划分。
Result: 区间 regret 上界为 min(GDn, C[GD√(n(Λ_I+log²(2T))) + σDn^{1/p}(Λ_I+log²(2T))^{(p-1)/p}])，常数通用且学习器不用 G、σ、p、I、P_I；给定统计量时间隔代价为 1+log(T/n)，含最优全时域静态率；变分测度下界在显式条件下确定该对数的噪声幂。
Conclusion: 参数无关的区间自适应可以同时保留均值梯度与噪声的不同指数，并把区间代价降到 1+log(T/n)；保留全时域最优保证的学习器无法避免该对数项。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: TRACE: A Reproducible Benchmark for Electricity Price Forecasting with Official Operational Text
papers.abstract_en: Electricity price forecasting (EPF) supports scheduling, bidding, and risk management in electricity markets, yet existing benchmarks focus mainly on numerical inputs, leaving the forecasting value of forecast-time textual context insufficiently evaluated. We introduce TRACE, a reproducible benchmark of 7,300 zone--day instances pairing prices from five zones in a major U.S. market with official operational text available at the forecast cutoff. TRACE reconstructs official operational text at each cutoff, preventing post-cutoff information leakage. We evaluate TRACE for semantic alignment and forecasting value. Semantic assessments align with central movement and both tail risks in ground-truth prices, most consistently for upper-tail price risk. Forecasting value is reflected in a median 7.4\% reduction in upper-tail pinball loss across time-series foundation models. A controlled cross-day text-mismatch ablation reverses the gains, falling below the no-text baseline.
papers.comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Time Series (FMTS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRACE 是一个可复现的电价预报 (EPF) 基准，把五个美国大型市场分区的价格与预报截止时刻可得的官方运行文本配对，共 7,300 个 zone-day 实例，并在每个 cutoff 重建文本以杜绝事后信息泄漏。在多个时间序列基础模型上，加入文本使上尾 pinball loss 中位数下降 7.4%，而受控的跨日文本错配消融会把这一增益反转到低于无文本基线。
Motivation: 现有电价预报基准主要只用数值输入，预报时刻的文本上下文对预测价值缺乏系统评估，而文本是否真带来增益、还是靠泄漏，无法区分。
Method: TRACE 构建 7,300 个 zone-day 实例，配对五个分区价格与 cutoff 时刻的官方运行文本，并在每个 cutoff 重建文本以防止 post-cutoff 泄漏；评测分两部分：语义对齐评估（对照真实价格的中枢变动与两端尾部风险）与预报价值评估（在时间序列基础模型上比较有无文本的 pinball loss），另加一个受控的跨日文本错配 (cross-day text-mismatch) 消融。
Result: 语义评估与真实价格的中枢变动及两端尾部风险对齐，其中对上尾价格风险的一致性最高；加入文本后上尾 pinball loss 在时间序列基础模型上中位数下降 7.4%；跨日文本错配消融使增益反转，落到无文本基线以下。
Conclusion: 截止时刻的官方运行文本对电价上尾风险确有预报价值，且该价值依赖文本与当日的正确匹配，错配即失效。

papers.title: MACTS-EM: Multi-Agent Collaborative Time Series Forecasting with Emergent Memory
papers.abstract_en: Time series forecasting remains a critical challenge across numerous domains. Despite significant advancements, existing approaches struggle with complex phenomena such as regime shifts, cross-domain knowledge transfer, and multimodal data integration. This paper introduces Multi-Agent Collaborative Time Series Forecasting with Emergent Memory (MACTS-EM), a novel framework where specialised agents collaborate to achieve superior forecasting performance. The MACTS-EM architecture integrates: (1) domain-specialised forecasting agents for pattern recognition, anomaly detection, causal inference, and uncertainty quantification; (2) a meta-cognitive layer for dynamic agent allocation; (3) an emergent memory mechanism enabling cross-domain pattern transfer; (4) multimodal contextual integration; and (5) adversarial robustness components. Evaluation across financial markets, climate patterns, energy consumption, and pandemic propagation demonstrates that MACTS-EM outperforms existing approaches in most scenarios, with 8-12% improvement in forecasting accuracy, 22-27% better zero-shot transfer capability, 16-21% enhanced resilience during regime shifts, and 15-18% faster recovery after distribution shifts. Our findings suggest that collaborative, agentic approaches to time series forecasting represent a promising direction beyond traditional architectures, particularly for complex real-world scenarios requiring multi-resolution temporal understanding and contextual adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MACTS-EM 把时间序列预报拆成多个专职 agent（模式识别、异常检测、因果推断、不确定性量化），由 meta-cognitive 层动态分配 agent，并用 emergent memory 机制跨域迁移模式，再叠加多模态上下文与对抗鲁棒性组件。在金融市场、气候模式、能源消耗与疫情传播四类数据上，预报精度提升 8-12%，零样本迁移能力提升 22-27%，regime shift 中的韧性提升 16-21%，分布偏移后恢复速度快 15-18%。
Motivation: 现有时间序列方法难以处理 regime shift、跨域知识迁移与多模态数据整合，单一架构在复杂真实场景下表现受限。
Method: 框架含五个组件：领域专职预报 agent（模式识别、异常检测、因果推理、不确定性量化）、负责动态 agent 分配的 meta-cognitive 层、实现跨域模式迁移的 emergent memory 机制、多模态上下文整合，以及对抗鲁棒性组件。
Result: 在金融市场、气候模式、能源消耗、疫情传播四类场景的评估中，多数情形优于现有方法：预报精度提升 8-12%，零样本迁移能力提升 22-27%，regime shift 期间韧性提升 16-21%，分布偏移后恢复速度提升 15-18%。
Conclusion: 协作式 agentic 时间序列预报是超越传统架构的有前景方向，尤其适用于需要多分辨率时间理解与上下文自适应的复杂真实场景。

papers.title: Overcoming Challenges of Interpretive Structural Modeling with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Interpretive Structural Modeling (ISM) is a well-known process for multi-criteria decision making. The success of ISM over other methodologies is its ability to model causal relationships, the binary scale of factors, and resulting hierarchical representation. Traditionally, the modeling process is performed by repeated interactions with subject matter experts until consensus is reached. This process is tedious, labor-intense, and most importantly limits the ability of ISM to scale to studies with hundreds of variables. Drawing on existing work of causal graph discovery with large language models (LLM) as imperfect experts, this work explores an integrated LLM-ISM approach for ISM. Pairwise, k-wise, rowwise, and full graph discovery methodologies are compared and evaluated. It is shown that causal graph discovery methods for ISM perform best using rowwise (SHD=160, F1-score=0.77) and full graph methods (SHD=135, F1-score=0.73).
papers.comment: This preprint has not undergone peer review or any post-submission improvements or corrections
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM 当作不完美专家来替代 ISM（解释结构建模）中反复的人工共识访谈，比较 pairwise、k-wise、rowwise、full graph 四种因果图发现方式。结果显示 rowwise（SHD=160，F1=0.77）与 full graph（SHD=135，F1=0.73）两类方法在 ISM 因果图发现上表现最好。
Motivation: ISM 依赖领域专家多轮交互直至达成共识，过程繁琐、人力密集，且难以扩展到含数百个变量的研究。
Method: 提出 LLM-ISM 混合流程，用大语言模型作为不完美专家做因果图发现，替代专家共识访谈；对比 pairwise、k-wise、rowwise、full graph 四种图发现方法并以 SHD 与 F1-score 评估。

papers.title: Approximation Property of Dropout Neural Networks: Sobolev Rates and Confidence Bounds
papers.abstract_en: The universal approximation property of dropout neural networks does not by itself describe the network size required for an accurate random realization. In this work, we study approximation of the unit ball of $W^{n,\infty}([0,1]^d)$ by ReLU networks whose edges are retained independently with probability $p$. The approximation error is measured uniformly over the input domain, and the guarantee holds with probability at least $1-δ$ for a single sampled network. We construct networks of constant depth and size $\widetilde O_{n,d}(p^{-9}\varepsilon^{-\max\{d/n,2\}} \log(1/δ))$. The construction combines bounded local subnetworks, localization on a successful approximation event, and a multiscale Taylor decomposition. Conversely, Sobolev capacity imposes a lower bound on the number of surviving edges, while approximation of a fixed affine function requires an output-layer cost of order $((1-p)/p)\varepsilon^{-2}\log(1/δ)$ at sufficiently high confidence. For fixed $p\in(0,1)$ and $δ<\min\{1/2,1-p\}$, the upper and lower bounds match in the accuracy exponent under a fixed or logarithmic depth budget. When $d\leq2n$, they also match in confidence up to logarithms of accuracy. We extend the lower bounds to $W^{n,r}$ targets with $L^s$ error, and distinguish this extension from the upper bound for $W^{n,\infty}$. The optimal retention dependence and logarithmic factors remain open.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明 dropout ReLU 网络对 Sobolev 单位球 W^{n,∞}([0,1]^d) 的逼近率与置信界：常数深度下构造规模为 Õ_{n,d}(p^{-9} ε^{-max{d/n,2}} log(1/δ)) 的网络，使单次随机采样实现以至少 1-δ 概率达到一致逼近误差；在固定或对数深度预算下该上界与 Sobolev 容量给出的存活边数下界在精度指数上匹配，d≤2n 时置信项也匹配到精度的对数因子。
Motivation: dropout 网络的通用逼近性只保证存在某个实现，不刻画随机采样出的单个网络达到给定精度所需的规模与失败概率 δ，缺少带置信度的样本复杂度刻画。
Method: 上界由三部分组合：有界局部子网络、在成功逼近事件上的局部化、以及多尺度 Taylor 分解，构造常数深度网络；下界用 Sobolev 容量约束存活边数，并对固定仿射函数给出输出层代价 Ω(((1-p)/p) ε^{-2} log(1/δ))；再把下界推广到 W^{n,r} 目标配 L^s 误差。
Result: 上界规模 Õ_{n,d}(p^{-9} ε^{-max{d/n,2}} log(1/δ))，常数深度，单次采样以 ≥1-δ 概率一致逼近；固定仿射函数的输出层代价为 ((1-p)/p) ε^{-2} log(1/δ)。固定 p∈(0,1) 且 δ<min{1/2,1-p} 时，上下界在固定或对数深度预算下精度指数一致；d≤2n 时置信项也匹配到精度的对数因子。
Conclusion: 带 dropout 的 ReLU 网络在精度指数上是率最优的（给定深度预算下），置信代价在 d≤2n 时同样最优；最优的保留概率 p 依赖与对数因子仍是开放问题。

papers.title: Counterfactual Predictions in Scientific Emulators Without Controlled Experiments
papers.abstract_en: Many scientific questions require reasoning about what was never observed: What if the conditions, interventions, or history had been different? Models can predict accurately on observed data yet fail on such what-if queries when correlated inputs are varied independently. A common remedy is to add controlled simulation data in which these factors are explicitly disentangled, but this requires access to a simulator, can be computationally expensive, and inherits the simulator's modeling assumptions. We introduce ReRoute, a framework for targeted scientific what-if prediction that combines factual data with partial mechanistic knowledge, without requiring controlled intervention data for adaptation. ReRoute fixes the queried input of a pretrained backbone to a reference value, reintroduces its variation through a known mechanistic pathway, and fine-tunes on the original factual data, while leaving downstream effects to the learned dynamics. We provide a causal identification result for this construction under explicit structural assumptions, with the core argument machine-checked in Lean. After showing that ReRoute achieves highly accurate counterfactual predictions in a controlled advection-diffusion system where exact responses are available, we turn to state-of-the-art climate emulation. On held-out coupled-climate interventions, ReRoute reduces aggregate climate error by 18.2-31.8% under severe CO$_2$ distribution shifts while preserving skill under standard conditions, at a small fraction of the cost of retraining on additional controlled simulations, without even accounting for the substantial expense of generating such data. Finally, on an emulator trained from historical ERA5 reanalysis, where no counterfactual reference exists, ReRoute preserves substantially more of the surface warming implied by the observed boundary conditions under a fixed-CO$_2$ counterfactual.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReRoute 在不引入受控干预数据的前提下做科学 what-if 反事实预测：把预训练 backbone 的被查询输入固定为参考值，再通过已知机理通路重新注入其变化，只在原始 factual 数据上微调，下游效应交给学到的动力学。在 CO2 分布严重偏移的留出耦合气候干预上，聚合气候误差降低 18.2–31.8%，且成本只是用额外受控模拟重训的一小部分。
Motivation: 模型在观测数据上预测准确，但当相关输入被独立改变时，what-if 查询会失效；补受控模拟数据需要访问模拟器、计算昂贵，且继承模拟器的建模假设。
Method: ReRoute 框架结合 factual 数据与部分机理知识：固定被查询输入为参考值，经已知机理通路重新引入其变化，在原始 factual 数据上微调；给出该构造的因果识别结果，核心论证用 Lean 机器检验。评估对象包括可控 advection-diffusion 系统、气候 emulator，以及由历史 ERA5 reanalysis 训练的 emulator。
Result: 在留出的耦合气候干预上，CO2 分布严重偏移时聚合气候误差降低 18.2–31.8%，标准条件下保持技巧，成本只是用额外受控模拟重训的一小部分；在可控 advection-diffusion 系统中给出高度准确的反事实预测（有精确响应可对照）；在历史 ERA5 训练的 emulator 上，固定 CO2 反事实下保留了观测边界条件所隐含的大部分地表增暖。
Conclusion: 只用 factual 数据加已知机理通路重注入，就能在结构假设下识别并做出准确的反事实预测，无需生成受控干预数据。

papers.title: Rank-Aware Speculative Sampling for Diffusion Draft Trees
papers.abstract_en: Speculative sampling accelerates diffusion generation by verifying inexpensive draft states in parallel while preserving the target law. Recent tree-based methods allocate the parallel compute budget more effectively than single-chain drafts, as demonstrated by Diffusion Greedy Rejection Sampling (D-GRS). D-GRS generates $K$ conditionally independent candidates per node, and sequentially tests them in their generation order. Yet the sampled candidates admit an informative ranking without additional target-model evaluations. To exploit this, we introduce Rank-Aware Speculative Sampling (RASS), a verification rule for speculative draft trees based on rank-aware list coupling. RASS orders draft candidates along the proposal-target mean displacement and samples a rank with weights optimized to minimize total variation between the selected-proposal and target laws. Finally, the selected candidate is maximally coupled with the target, with residual correction ensuring exact sampling for any choice of rank weights. We evaluate RASS on a Gaussian-mixture target, unconditional pixel-space generation on FFHQ, conditional generation on CIFAR-10, and latent diffusion with Stable Diffusion 3.5 using COCO2014 prompts. Measured by the ratio of standard to speculative sampling's target-model evaluation counts, RASS improves on D-GRS across the evaluated settings, with gains reaching approximately 20% on CIFAR-10 at matched compute budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RASS 用 rank-aware list coupling 重排扩散草稿树中已采样的候选：沿 proposal-target 平均位移排序，按最小化总变差的权重抽一个 rank，再把该候选与 target 做最大耦合、用残差校正保证任意 rank 权重下都精确采样。在 Gaussian-mixture、FFHQ 无条件生成、CIFAR-10 条件生成与 Stable Diffusion 3.5 + COCO2014 上，其相对 D-GRS 的加速比在各设置均更高，CIFAR-10 在等算力预算下增益约 20%。
Motivation: 树式投机采样 (tree-based speculative sampling) 已比单链草稿更会分配并行算力，但 D-GRS 每节点生成 K 个条件独立候选后只按生成顺序逐一检验，丢掉了候选本身携带的排序信息。
Method: 提出 Rank-Aware Speculative Sampling (RASS)：沿 proposal 与 target 的平均位移对草稿候选排序，用为最小化 selected-proposal 与 target 间总变差而优化的权重抽取 rank，随后将选中候选与 target 最大耦合 (maximal coupling)，并以残差校正 (residual correction) 保证对任意 rank 权重都精确采样。
Result: 以标准采样与投机采样的 target-model 评估次数之比衡量，RASS 在 Gaussian-mixture target、FFHQ 无条件像素空间生成、CIFAR-10 条件生成、Stable Diffusion 3.5 + COCO2014 prompt 的 latent diffusion 上均优于 D-GRS，CIFAR-10 在匹配算力预算下增益约 20%。
Conclusion: 在不额外调用 target 模型的前提下，草稿候选的排序信息足以改进投机草稿树的验证规则，并在保持精确采样的同时普遍提高相对 D-GRS 的加速比。

papers.title: Nearest-neighbour baselines for fingerprint prediction from MS/MS spectra under different assumptions
papers.abstract_en: It has recently been shown that nearest-neighbour retrieval provides a strong baseline for molecular fingerprint prediction from MS/MS spectra, with several variants matching or outperforming current deep learning models (Khoo and Barzilay, 2026; Liu et al., 2026; Gupta et al., 2026). Importantly, "nearest neighbour" encompasses a family of retrieval methods that differ in the information assumed to be available at inference. In this report, we systematically compare several nearest-neighbour variants and show how these differing assumptions affect performance. Our goal is to establish stricter baselines that enable more rigorous benchmarking and better measure progress in this area.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 系统比较多种最近邻检索 (nearest-neighbour) 变体在 MS/MS 谱图分子指纹预测上的表现，说明推理期可用信息的不同假设如何改变性能，旨在为该任务建立更严格的基线。
Motivation: 最近邻检索已是分子指纹预测的强基线，多个变体匹配或超过深度模型，但不同变体对推理期信息的假设不同，缺少统一比较，导致基准不够严格、进展难以衡量。
Method: 系统对比若干最近邻变体，按推理期可用信息的不同假设分组考察其对性能的影响，目标是建立更严格的基线以支持更严谨的 benchmarking。
Result: 报告指出多个最近邻变体在分子指纹预测上匹配或优于当前深度学习模型（Khoo and Barzilay, 2026; Liu et al., 2026; Gupta et al., 2026），并给出不同信息假设下的性能差异比较。
Conclusion: 最近邻家族可作为分子指纹预测的更严格基线，评估时必须明确推理期信息假设，否则性能比较不具可比性。

papers.title: State-Space Unlearning for Non-Stationary Bias in Land Surface Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Operational land surface forecasting systems built on Mamba-family Structured State Space Models absorb non-stationary confounding events (unrecorded irrigation booms, dam-operation shifts, sensor recalibrations) into their state-transition matrices, silently biasing NDVI, LST, and crop phenology predictions long after the physical cause ends. This paper introduces SSU-LSF (State-Space Unlearning for Land Surface Forecasting), the first machine-unlearning framework purpose-built for geoscientific Mamba-based SSMs. We develop EKFac influence functions specialized to the Mamba state matrices via a closed-form matrix-exponential gradient, use spectral-radius-weighted elbow thresholding to localize a temporal confounding footprint $Φ$, and apply Hessian-free projected gradient ascent within a KL-divergence trust region augmented by spatial total-variation (TV) regularization. Proposition 1 establishes that residual confounding is bounded by $\mathcal{O}\big((1-ρ(\bar{A})^{T_c})/((1-ρ(\bar{A}))μ)\big)$, which grows with the window length $T_c$. Across three heterogeneous benchmarks and eleven baselines, SSU-LSF achieves confounding reduction rates of $0.773$ (CropHarvest), $0.821$ (NDVI-LST), and $0.859$ (ERA5), with worst-case clean-domain RMSE degradation of $4.2\%$ on ERA5, converging in 3--5 epochs at $8.4\times$ lower GPU-cost per unlearning request than full retraining. Code: https://github.com/Anidipta/SSU-LSF
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 Mamba 类结构化状态空间模型把非平稳混淆事件（未记录的灌溉激增、水库调度变化、传感器重标定）吸收进状态转移矩阵、长期带偏 NDVI、LST 与作物物候预测的问题，提出首个面向地学 Mamba-SSM 的机器遗忘框架 SSU-LSF：用闭式矩阵指数梯度定制 EKFac 影响函数，以谱半径加权肘部阈值定位时间混淆足迹 Φ，再在 KL 散度信任域内做无 Hessian 的投影梯度上升并加空间 TV 正则。三个异构基准上混淆削减率 0.773（CropHarvest）、0.821（NDVI-LST）、0.859（ERA5），最坏干净域 RMSE 仅退化 4.2%，3–5 epoch 收敛且单次遗忘 GPU 成本比全量重训低 8.4 倍。
Motivation: 业务化地表预报系统会把已结束的非平稳混淆事件永久编码进状态转移矩阵，使 NDVI、LST 与作物物候预测在物理成因消失后仍长期带偏；现有机器遗忘方法未针对地学 Mamba 状态矩阵设计。
Method: SSU-LSF 通过闭式矩阵-exponential 梯度为 Mamba 状态矩阵定制 EKFac 影响函数，用谱半径加权肘部阈值定位时间混淆足迹 Φ，随后在 KL 散度信任域内执行无 Hessian 的投影梯度上升 (projected gradient ascent)，并加入空间全变分 (TV) 正则约束；Proposition 1 给出残余混淆上界 O((1-ρ(Ā)^{T_c})/((1-ρ(Ā))μ))，随窗口长度 T_c 增长。
Result: 在三个异构基准、十一个基线上，混淆削减率分别为 0.773（CropHarvest）、0.821（NDVI-LST）、0.859（ERA5）；最坏干净域 RMSE 退化为 ERA5 上的 4.2%；3–5 个 epoch 收敛，单次遗忘请求 GPU 成本比全量重训低 8.4 倍。
Conclusion: 地学 Mamba-SSM 的非平稳混淆可以用基于影响函数的定向遗忘在保持干净域精度的同时低成本移除，且残余混淆随遗忘窗口长度 T_c 增大而受 Proposition 1 的谱半径界约束。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Toward Controlling Biology with Language:Offline Learning of Prompt-Conditioned Interventions for Cells, Organoids, and Biobots
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence increasingly serves as a natural-language interface to complex technical systems, letting people accomplish sophisticated tasks by describing what they want rather than specifying how to do it. Extending this interface to living systems is harder: unlike code or images, a biological intervention has no closed-form linguistic meaning, and the paired language-intervention-outcome data needed to learn such a mapping is expensive to collect, since each example requires its own wet-lab experiment. One way around this is to treat an existing archive of interventions and their already-observed outcomes as a fixed, offline dataset, and use a vision-language model to judge, without any new experiments, whether an archived outcome matches a natural-language description. But whether that judgment is reliable enough to train a language-to-intervention mapping on -- without new experiments and without human validation -- has remained unclear. Here we show that a natural-language interface for a living organism -- a xenobot, a synthetic multicellular construct with no nervous system -- can be learned entirely offline this way, using a vision-language model's own judgment as the sole training reward: an instruction is mapped to the intervention already on record as producing the described behavior. This mapping generalizes to entirely new instructions, evaluated against archive data withheld from training (80.0% held-out accuracy vs a $66.7% chance baseline, matching a network trained directly on ground-truth labels).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 对既有干预档案的结局做自动判分，作为唯一训练奖励，离线学出自然语言指令到细胞/器官/生物机器人 (xenobot) 干预的映射。在留出档案数据上，新指令的准确率达 80.0%，对比随机基线 66.7%，与直接用真值标签训练的网络持平。
Motivation: 语言到生物干预的映射没有闭式语义，且每个样本都要一次湿实验，配对数据昂贵；离线利用已有档案、不加新实验与人工验证能否训出可靠映射一直不清楚。
Method: 把既有干预及其已观测结局当作固定离线数据集，用 VLM 判断结局是否符合自然语言描述，并以该判断作为唯一训练奖励；指令被映射到档案中记录的、能产生所述行为的干预，对象是无神经系统的 xenobot。
Result: 在训练中留出的档案数据上，对全新指令的准确率为 80.0%，随机基线为 66.7%，且与直接用真值标签训练的网络表现相当。
Conclusion: 仅凭 VLM 自身判断作为奖励、完全离线训练，就能学到可泛化到新指令的语言到干预映射，无需新实验或人工验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Missing Latent, Not a Missing Simulator: Radius-Augmented Inference for Real JWST Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Amortized simulation-based inference (SBI), which is trained on radiative-transfer simulators, recovers exoplanet atmospheres accurately on synthetic James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) spectra but collapses when it comes to real reduced spectra. The flow posterior collapsed on real WASP-39b (importance-sampling effective sample size (ESS) = 1, best-fit \c{hi}2/N = 301), and such a failure is usually blamed on missing the forward-model physics, but ruling these levers out with nested sampling first (a temperature gradient, SO2 opacity, and a high-fidelity opacity set) leaves the fit unchanged, meaning the collapse is not from the simulator misspecification but instead from a missing latent, the planet radius. To fix this, we build MIRAGE, a radius-augmented flow-matching posterior calibrated against an independent nested-sampling reference with importance sampling and an optimal-transport map, which yields a physical and literature-consistent retrieval of real WASP-39b (with \c{hi}2/N from 301 to 0.06). This same method transfers unchanged across two instruments and three real JWST targets, including one spectrum self-reduced end-to-end from raw Mikulski Archive for Space Telescopes(MAST) data. The lesson is cross-domain, as a latent the simulator encodes but the inference omits can masquerade as misspecification.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Includes appendix and paper checklist
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对摊销式 SBI 在真实 JWST 光谱上后验坍缩的问题，作者先用 nested sampling 排除前向模型物理缺失，再把行星半径作为缺失隐变量补入，提出 MIRAGE——半径增强的 flow-matching 后验，用重要性采样与最优传输映射对独立 nested-sampling 参考做校准。真实 WASP-39b 的 χ²/N 从 301 降到 0.06，且方法原样迁移到两台仪器、三个真实 JWST 目标。
Motivation: 摊销式 SBI 在合成 JWST 光谱上恢复系外行星大气很准，但一到真实降维光谱就坍缩；通常把失败归咎于前向模型物理缺失，需要区分到底是模拟器错设还是推断遗漏了隐变量。
Method: 先用 nested sampling 逐一排除温度梯度、SO2 不透明度与高保真不透明度集这些前向模型杠杆；再提出 MIRAGE，把行星半径作为隐变量加入 flow-matching 后验，并用重要性采样和最优传输映射 (optimal-transport map) 对独立的 nested-sampling 参考做校准。
Result: 真实 WASP-39b 上流后验坍缩：重要性采样有效样本量 ESS = 1，最佳拟合 χ²/N = 301；加入半径隐变量后 χ²/N 从 301 降到 0.06，得到物理上与文献一致的检索结果。同一方法原样迁移至两台仪器和三个真实 JWST 目标，其中一个光谱是从 MAST 原始数据端到端自行降维的。
Conclusion: 真实数据上的后验坍缩可以不是模拟器错设，而是推断遗漏了模拟器编码的隐变量（此处为行星半径）；补上该隐变量即可恢复可用检索，这一教训可跨领域推广。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: RxnOptBench: Benchmarking LLMs for Reaction-Condition Optimization in Organic Methodology
papers.abstract_en: Chemical reaction-condition optimization -- choosing the catalyst, ligand, solvent, reagent, temperature, time, and atmosphere that jointly maximize yield and stereoselectivity -- is a central, judgement-laden subtask of organic methodology research that large language models are increasingly expected to support. Yet existing chemistry benchmarks evaluate reaction-class labelling, retrosynthesis, or SMILES manipulation, and do not ask models to read a real condition-screening table and pick the best set. We introduce RxnOptBench, a benchmark whose every option and precedent is a real wet-lab entry mined from the optimization tables of organic-methodology papers published in 2025, graded by a continuous relative score derived from a declared headline utility that combines reported yield with enantiomeric excess (ee), diastereomeric ratio (dr), and regioisomeric ratio (rr), and equipped with a paired precedents-vs-no-precedents design that isolates in-context use of literature evidence from parametric memorization. Across nine frontier LLMs and three Chemistry LLMs, even the best models leave substantial headroom: chemistry-specialized models fall to the random-baseline floor on multi-axis selection, while open-weight models have closed most of the gap to proprietary frontier models. We release the final human-reviewed benchmark test set and evaluation code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RxnOptBench 把 2025 年有机方法学论文优化表中的真实湿实验条目做成反应条件优化基准，效用分数由产率与 ee、dr、rr 合成，并用有/无文献先例 (precedents) 的配对设计分离上下文证据使用与参数记忆。九个前沿 LLM 与三个化学专用 LLM 上最好的模型仍有明显差距：化学专用模型在多轴选择上跌到随机基线水平，开放权重模型已追平大部分与闭源前沿模型的差距。
Motivation: 现有化学基准只考反应分类、逆合成或 SMILES 操作，不考读真实条件筛选表并选出最优条件组合，而 LLM 越来越被期待支持这类判断密集的有机方法学子任务。
Method: 每个选项与先例均取自 2025 年有机方法学论文优化表的真实湿实验条目；用声明的 headline utility 把产率与 enantiomeric excess (ee)、diastereomeric ratio (dr)、regioisomeric ratio (rr) 合成连续相对分数；配对的 precedents-vs-no-precedents 设计隔离上下文使用文献证据与参数记忆；评测九个前沿 LLM 与三个 Chemistry LLM。
Result: 九个前沿 LLM 与三个 Chemistry LLM 上最好的模型仍有大量 headroom：化学专用模型在多轴选择上跌到随机基线 (random-baseline floor)，开放权重模型已补上与闭源前沿模型的大部分差距；发布人工复核的最终测试集与评测代码。
Conclusion: 反应条件优化对当前 LLM 仍是未解难题，化学专用化并不自动带来多轴条件选择能力，而文献先例的上下文可用性是可被配对设计单独度量的变量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hardware-Native Joint Sparse-Quantization for Trillion-Scale Mixture-of-Experts
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures allow frontier language models to scale to trillions of parameters, but their deployment is constrained by massive memory footprints and memory-bandwidth limitations. Although modern accelerators provide Sparse Tensor Cores (SpTCs) that reduce weight storage and increase throughput through low-precision semi-structured sparsity, exploiting them for MoEs remains challenging because of substantial model-quality degradation and the lack of grouped sparse GEMM primitives. We present an end-to-end hardware-software co-design framework that compresses expert weights into hardware-native, low-precision sparse representations and accelerates their execution on SpTCs. Algorithmically, our framework relaxes discrete semi-structured support selection through continuous reparameterization, enabling differentiable joint optimization with quantized weights under a router-weighted reconstruction objective and scalable expert-parallel compression. Systemically, we develop a custom grouped sparse GEMM kernel tailored to low-precision sparse MoE inference on SpTCs. Across MoE models ranging from 30 billion to one trillion parameters, our framework improves state-of-the-art joint sparse-quantization accuracy by up to 4.35 percentage points while preserving 96.09% of the original model's performance. On NVIDIA B200 GPUs, our kernel outperforms the vendor baseline by up to $1.65\times$, increasing serving throughput by $1.18\times$ and reducing end-to-end latency by up to $4.03\times$. These results establish hardware-software co-design as a practical path toward scalable and efficient MoE deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向万亿级 MoE 部署，提出硬件原生联合稀疏-量化 (joint sparse-quantization) 软硬协同框架：用连续重参数化放松离散半结构支撑选择，在 router 加权重建目标下与量化权重可微联合优化，并配套面向 Sparse Tensor Cores 的 grouped sparse GEMM kernel。在 30B 到 1T 参数 MoE 上，联合稀疏-量化精度最多提升 4.35 个百分点、保留原模型 96.09% 性能；NVIDIA B200 上 kernel 较厂商基线最多 1.65×，serving 吞吐 1.18×、端到端延迟最多降至 1/4.03。
Motivation: MoE 扩到万亿参数后受显存占用与内存带宽制约；Sparse Tensor Cores 虽能用低精度半结构稀疏省显存提吞吐，但用于 MoE 时模型质量掉得多，且缺少 grouped sparse GEMM 原语。
Method: 算法侧用连续重参数化放松离散半结构支撑选择，使支撑与量化权重在 router 加权重建目标下可微联合优化，并做可扩展的 expert-parallel 压缩；系统侧为 SpTC 上低精度稀疏 MoE 推理编写定制 grouped sparse GEMM kernel，端到端软硬协同设计。
Result: 在 300 亿到 1 万亿参数的 MoE 模型上，联合稀疏-量化精度较 SOTA 最多提高 4.35 个百分点，同时保留原模型 96.09% 的性能；在 NVIDIA B200 GPU 上，kernel 较厂商基线最多快 1.65×，serving 吞吐提升 1.18×，端到端延迟最多降低 4.03×。
Conclusion: 硬件-软件协同设计是让大规模 MoE 可部署、高效推理的现实路径：把稀疏支撑与量化放进同一个可微目标、并自研 SpTC kernel，可同时守住模型质量与系统吞吐。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: GlanceWAM: Sparse Test-Time Imagination for World-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Video generative models provide rich physical priors for robot learning, yet existing world-action models (WAMs) face a fundamental trade-off: synchronous video generation at control rate is latency-prohibitive, while abandoning test-time visual imagination sacrifices task success. We show that visual imagination achieves both real-time inference and superior success rates when generated asynchronously off the critical path and consumed directly in latent space. We introduce GlanceWAM, which decouples imagination from control on a single shared video DiT backbone: an asynchronous proposer glances ahead on a slow clock to imagine a single lookahead frame seconds into the future in the background, while an action head decodes action chunks at control rate (48 ms) purely in latent space without blocking. Enabled by a non-interfering attention mask that isolates video representations and staleness-robust horizon training that accommodates asynchronous lookahead aging, GlanceWAM breaks the speed-success dilemma. Trained purely on demonstrations, it attains 72.2% on the 24-task RoboCasa kitchen benchmark (vs. 67.1% for synchronous Cosmos Policy) and 99.0% on LIBERO while cutting per-chunk control latency $24\times$ relative to synchronous world-action models (48 ms on one A100). In single-arm and bimanual real-robot manipulation, it achieves higher average success than $π_{0.5}$ without any robot-data pretraining. Code is available at https://github.com/linhanwang/GlanceWAM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GlanceWAM 把视觉想象从控制回路中解耦：在共享 video DiT 上用异步 proposer 在慢时钟上提前想象未来数秒的单帧 lookahead，action head 则在控制频率（48 ms）纯 latent 解码动作块而不阻塞。配合 non-interfering attention mask 与 staleness-robust horizon training，它在 RoboCasa 24 任务上达 72.2%（同步 Cosmos Policy 67.1%）、LIBERO 99.0%，单块控制延迟相对同步 world-action 模型降低 24×。
Motivation: world-action 模型 (WAM) 面临速度-成功率两难：按控制频率同步生成视频延迟过高，放弃测试时视觉想象又损失任务成功率。
Method: 单一共享 video DiT backbone 上解耦想象与控制：异步 proposer 在慢时钟后台提前想象单帧 lookahead，action head 以控制频率在 latent 空间直接解码动作块；用 non-interfering attention mask 隔离视频表征，并以 staleness-robust horizon training 容忍异步 lookahead 老化，纯 demonstrations 训练。
Result: RoboCasa 24 任务厨房基准 72.2%（同步 Cosmos Policy 67.1%），LIBERO 99.0%；单块控制延迟 48 ms（单张 A100），相对同步 world-action 模型降低 24×；在单臂与双臂真机操作上平均成功率高于 π0.5，且无任何机器人数据预训练。

papers.title: DuetMoE: Coupling Inter- and Intra-Subgroup Robustness for Fair Medical Image Analysis
papers.abstract_en: As medical AI expands across diverse healthcare settings worldwide, equitable performance across patient populations is becoming essential to trustworthy clinical use. Fairness in medical image analysis is often evaluated through average performance across predefined subgroups, yet similar subgroup averages can conceal substantial variation among individual patients. Therefore, a reliable medical AI requires addressing two complementary objectives: \emph{inter-subgroup fairness}, which reduces performance disparities across groups, and \emph{intra-subgroup robustness}, which protects poorly served patients within each group. To jointly address these objectives, we propose \textbf{DuetMoE}, a subgroup-aware mixture-of-experts framework that couples group-level adaptation with patient-specific clinical guidance, enabling more reliable medical image analysis for individual patients. For settings without linked clinical records, we further introduce \textbf{DuetMoE+}, which retains subgroup-routed experts and incorporates a KL-constrained distributionally robust objective to address intra-subgroup robustness. We evaluate our methods on PI-CAI, radiotherapy, and Harvard-FairSeg. Across four evaluation settings, our methods lead in overall or equity-scaled performance, reduce the inter-subgroup mean Dice gap by up to $30.7\%$, and raise intra-subgroup 25th-percentile Dice by up to 11.5 points over the strongest reported baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DuetMoE 用子群感知的 mixture-of-experts 把组级适配与患者级临床指导耦合，同时压低子群间性能差距与子群内弱势患者的低分；在无关联临床记录的场景改用 DuetMoE+，以 KL 约束的分布鲁棒目标替代患者级指导。在 PI-CAI、放疗与 Harvard-FairSeg 四个评测设置中，相对最强基线把子群间平均 Dice 差距最多缩小 30.7%，把子群内第 25 百分位 Dice 最多提高 11.5 点。
Motivation: 医疗影像的公平性通常只看预定义子群的平均性能，相近的子群均值会掩盖组内个体患者的大幅差异，无法保证弱势患者获得可靠服务。
Method: DuetMoE 是子群感知的 mixture-of-experts 框架，把组级自适应与患者特异的临床指导耦合，分别对应 inter-subgroup fairness 与 intra-subgroup robustness 两个目标；对没有关联临床记录的设置提出 DuetMoE+，保留按子群路由的专家并加入 KL 约束的分布鲁棒 (distributionally robust) 目标。
Result: 在 PI-CAI、radiotherapy 与 Harvard-FairSeg 上的四个评测设置中，该方法在总体或 equity-scaled 性能上领先：相对最强已报告基线，子群间平均 Dice 差距最多降低 30.7%，子群内第 25 百分位 Dice 最多提高 11.5 点。
Conclusion: 把组级公平与组内鲁棒作为联合目标、用子群路由专家加 KL 约束鲁棒损失实现，可在医疗影像分割上同时收窄子群差距并抬高组内最差患者的 Dice。

papers.title: CORE: COverage CAlibration and Evicted-Mass REdistribution for KV Cache
papers.abstract_en: Long-context decoding is increasingly constrained by key--value (KV) cache memory and bandwidth. Existing fixed-budget compression methods typically separate retention from compensation, while a retention ranking specifies neither discarded attention mass nor the direction of induced output error. We start from an exact factorization: eviction error equals evicted attention mass times the directional gap between the evicted centroid and retained output, highlighting the importance of set-level coverage in retention and mass-preserving memory writing. We introduce CORE COverage Calibration and Evicted-Mass REdistribution for KV Cache, which distills an offline allocation combining query utility and log-determinant coverage into a lightweight cache-aware indexer. At inference, one calibrated distribution drives both channels: its Top-$B$ ordering retains complementary KV states, while its excluded allocation mass and conditional weights parameterize latent-memory writes without a separate write-weight predictor or online log-determinant evaluation. Our analysis provides a four-term pre-compensation error certificate, characterizes non-additive coverage interactions, and establishes mass-independent write stability with hierarchical bounds through recurrent and query-adaptive normalization. Across three backbones, CORE exceeds the strongest RULER baseline by up to 3.78 points at 90\% compression; LongBench and repeated-eviction evaluations further demonstrate strong effectiveness and decoding efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CORE 针对长上下文解码的 KV cache 压缩，把保留与补偿统一到一个校准分布：先蒸馏出结合 query utility 与 log-determinant coverage 的 cache-aware indexer，推理时其 Top-B 排序保留互补 KV 状态，被排除的分配质量与条件权重直接参数化 latent-memory 写入。在三个 backbone 上，90% 压缩率下 CORE 比最强 RULER 基线最多高 3.78 分。
Motivation: 固定预算的 KV cache 压缩把保留与补偿分开处理，而保留排序既不说明被丢弃的注意力质量，也不说明诱导输出误差的方向，导致驱逐误差不可控。
Method: 从精确分解出发：驱逐误差 = 被驱逐注意力质量 × 被驱逐质心与保留输出的方向差。蒸馏一个融合 query utility 与 log-determinant coverage 的轻量 cache-aware indexer，用单一校准分布同时驱动 Top-B 保留与 latent-memory 写入，无需独立写权重预测器和在线 log-determinant 计算；分析给出四项预补偿误差证书、非可加 coverage 交互刻画，以及经递归与 query 自适应归一化的分层界所支撑的质量无关写入稳定性。
Result: 在三个 backbone 上，CORE 在 90% 压缩率下比最强 RULER 基线最多高 3.78 分；LongBench 与重复驱逐 (repeated-eviction) 评测进一步显示其有效性与解码效率。
Conclusion: 把保留与补偿统一到一个校准分布并按质量守恒写入记忆，可在 90% KV cache 压缩下同时保住长上下文精度与解码效率。

papers.title: Budgeted Cache Repair for Cross-Context KV-Cache Reuse
papers.abstract_en: Cross-context KV-cache reuse predicts a shared segment's keys and values under a new prefix instead of recomputing them, and has been reported to do so without quality loss. We find otherwise, and identify two problems. (1) A hidden cost: on MMLU and GSM8K, reuse costs substantial accuracy. (2) A decision at the wrong unit: no rule for deciding whether to reuse a cache removes that cost. What does help is choosing which parts of the cache to recompute, and the value of choosing well falls as the unit of choice grows: informed selection removes 49.5% of the cache error beyond chance at single rows (one token's keys and values), 10.6% at 64-token chunks, and nothing at the level of whole calls. Budgeted Cache Repair (BCR) acts at the unit where selection still pays. It drafts two tokens from the assembled cache, ranks cache rows by the attention those tokens pay them, and recomputes a fixed budget of rows exactly, in one of three layouts. The cost is paid rather than predicted away, and the draft that fails as a gate succeeds as a selector. BCR restores GSM8K to dense-prefill accuracy while still serving most calls from cache, and its best layout outperforms every reuse baseline's mean in the reference grid. The draft also beats a coin-flip selector at the same budget - a control prior evaluations lack.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 跨上下文 KV-cache 复用在 MMLU 与 GSM8K 上实际损失精度，且按整次调用决定复不复用无法消除该代价。选择粒度越细价值越大：单行（一个 token 的 K/V）可消除超出随机水平 49.5% 的 cache 误差，64-token chunk 只剩 10.6%，整次调用层面为零。BCR 因此在行级操作：用两个 draft token 的注意力给 cache 行排序，按固定预算精确重算，把 GSM8K 恢复到 dense-prefill 精度同时大部分调用仍走 cache。
Motivation: 跨上下文 KV-cache 复用被报告可在无质量损失下预测共享段的 K/V，作者发现这不成立：复用在 MMLU 和 GSM8K 上代价可观，而按整次调用决定是否复用的任何规则都消不掉这个代价。
Method: Budgeted Cache Repair (BCR)：从拼装好的 cache 起草 (draft) 两个 token，按这两个 token 对各行的注意力给 cache 行排序，再在固定预算内精确重算选中的行，支持三种布局 (layout)；draft 作为门控失败但作为选择器有效。
Result: 在 MMLU 与 GSM8K 上复用造成显著精度损失；有信息的选择可消除超出随机水平的 cache 误差比例为单行 49.5%、64-token chunk 10.6%、整次调用层面为零。BCR 把 GSM8K 恢复到 dense-prefill 精度，同时大部分调用仍由 cache 服务；其最佳布局在参考网格上超过所有复用基线的均值，且在同等预算下胜过掷硬币选择器。
Conclusion: 复用的代价要靠选择重算哪些行来支付，而不是靠决定整次调用复不复用来回避；选择的收益随决策单元变大而消失，因此 BCR 停在仍有收益的行级。

papers.title: Generalizable single-cell perturbation response prediction using energy-guided flow matching
papers.abstract_en: Predicting phenotypic and transcriptional responses to perturbations at single-cell resolution provides a powerful tool for probing biological systems. However, existing methods typically rely on fixed mappings learned during training, making it challenging to calibrate distribution shifts or adapt to novel perturbation conditions during inference. Here, we present scEGFlow, an energy-guided flow matching framework that dynamically bridges control and perturbed cellular states. scEGFlow models continuous transitions from control cell populations to perturbed states using conditional flow matching. It then applies condition-specific energy gradients to correct and steer these predictions, enabling flexible adjustments without retraining the flow model. Evaluations across benchmarks spanning imaging phenotypes and transcriptomic profiles show that scEGFlow outperforms existing methods in reconstructing response distributions under both seen and unseen perturbation conditions, faithfully preserving cellular manifold geometry and population heterogeneity. This advantage is notable when adapting to new conditions with only a few measured cells, consistently improving prediction accuracy. Furthermore, scEGFlow accurately recapitulates perturbation-induced up- and down-regulation patterns across consensus gene expression signatures, where energy guidance improves the agreement between predicted and observed regulatory directions. Ultimately, these findings demonstrate that scEGFlow provides a modular, generalizable, and steerable solution for single-cell perturbation modeling. By grounding generative flows in learned biological landscapes, this architecture establishes a new computational paradigm for navigating and manipulating cellular behavior in silico.

papers.title: Feature tracking in physics-informed neural networks via joint optimization of nonlinear deformation manifolds: application to shocks
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) often converge to inaccurate solutions for conservation laws with shocks, because uniformly distributed collocation points undersample localized features and let the residual be dominated by regions that are already well resolved. We propose a feature-tracking PINN (FT-PINN) in which the solution network is defined on a fixed reference domain and composed with a diffeomorphic deformation map from a parameterized nonlinear manifold. The deformation and solution-network parameters are trained jointly by minimizing the pulled-back conservation-law residual. This lets collocation points concentrate along features of essentially arbitrary geometry, including curved, oblique, and merging shocks, without prior knowledge of their locations. The framework is agnostic to the choice of parameterization. Boundary preservation is enforced exactly through a tangential projection of the displacement, and folding is discouraged by a one-sided penalty on the Jacobian determinant. On four test problems (space-time viscous Burgers with merging shocks, a decelerating Burgers shock, the space-time Euler shock tube, and steady 2D Euler regular shock reflection), FT-PINN resolves shocks at their correct locations with a limited collocation budget. A vanilla PINN with the same architecture, budget, and training either misplaces the shocks or fails to form them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FT-PINN 把解网络定义在固定参考域上，再与参数化非线性流形的微分同胚变形映射复合，联合优化变形与网络参数以最小化拉回守恒律残差，使配点自动聚集到任意几何的激波上。在四个含激波算例（含合并激波的时空黏性 Burgers、减速 Burgers 激波、时空 Euler 激波管、稳态 2D Euler 规则激波反射）中，FT-PINN 在有限配点预算下把激波定在正确位置，而同架构同预算的 vanilla PINN 要么错位要么无法形成激波。
Motivation: 含激波的守恒律上 PINN 常收敛到错误解：均匀配点欠采样局部特征，残差被已充分分辨的区域主导。
Method: FT-PINN：解网络定义在固定参考域，与参数化非线性流形导出的微分同胚变形映射复合；变形与网络参数通过最小化拉回 (pulled-back) 守恒律残差联合训练，参数化形式可任意选择。边界保持由位移的切向投影精确施加，折叠由 Jacobian 行列式的单侧罚项抑制。
Result: 在四个测试问题上（含合并激波的时空黏性 Burgers、减速 Burgers 激波、时空 Euler 激波管、稳态 2D Euler 规则激波反射），FT-PINN 在有限配点预算内把激波解析在正确位置；同架构、同预算、同训练的 vanilla PINN 要么激波错位，要么无法形成激波。
Conclusion: 让配点随变形流形聚集到特征上，可以在不预先知道激波位置的前提下解决守恒律 PINN 的残差主导问题，且不依赖具体参数化选择。

papers.title: The Price of Greenwashing: Algorithmic Verification and Market Discipline using Conformal Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: While corporate sustainability mandates are expanding, the systemic reliance on self-reported emissions data exposes financial markets to pervasive greenwashing. Current literature relies heavily on subjective ESG ratings or textual sentiment analysis, leaving a critical econometric gap in objectively quantifying physical climate realities. To resolve this information asymmetry, we fuse U.S. SEC financial fundamentals with facility-level EPA greenhouse gas registries to establish a mathematically guaranteed baseline of physical corporate emissions. Leveraging a gradient boosting architecture and Mondrian Conformal Prediction, we quantify the shortfall between self-reported data and this algorithmic baseline into a novel Conformal-Weighted Continuous Divergence (CWCD) metric. Evaluating this divergence via a cross-sectional lead-lag econometric design, we uncover a robust mechanism of market discipline: algorithmic emissions divergence exhibits a severe, statistically significant negative relationship with subsequent market valuation (Tobin's Q) and operational profitability (ROA). Providing definitive evidence against the market blindness hypothesis, this study proves that institutional capital actively prices environmental deception not merely as an ethical lapse, but as a leading indicator of fundamental corporate mismanagement. Ultimately, these findings provide the quantitative justification necessary for asset managers and regulators to deploy algorithmic auditing infrastructure at scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 SEC 财务基本面与 EPA 设施级温室气体登记融合，用梯度提升加 Mondrian Conformal Prediction 构造带数学保证的排放算法基线，量化自报数据与基线的差距为 CWCD 指标。截面 lead-lag 检验显示 CWCD 与后续 Tobin's Q 和 ROA 呈显著负相关，即市场会为算法识别出的排放虚报定价。
Motivation: 企业可持续性强制披露扩大，但市场依赖自报排放数据，现有文献靠主观 ESG 评级或文本情感分析，缺少对物理排放现实的客观计量，造成信息不对称。
Method: 融合 U.S. SEC 财务基本面与 EPA 设施级温室气体登记，训练 gradient boosting 架构给出带 Mondrian Conformal Prediction 数学保证的排放基线；把自报值与基线之差定义为 Conformal-Weighted Continuous Divergence (CWCD)，再用截面 lead-lag 计量设计检验 CWCD 与后续 Tobin's Q、ROA 的关系。
Result: 算法排放 divergence 与后续市场估值 (Tobin's Q) 及经营盈利 (ROA) 存在严重且统计显著的负向关系；该结果被作者视为反对 market blindness hypothesis 的确定性证据。
Conclusion: 机构资本会把环境欺骗当作企业管理失当的先行指标来定价，因此资产经理与监管者有量化依据大规模部署算法审计基础设施。

papers.title: Hybrid Machine Learning-Assisted Raman Spectroscopy with Generative Feature Augmentation for Pharmaceutical Identification
papers.abstract_en: Rapid and reliable identification of pharmaceutical residues is important for safeguarding public health, ensuring food safety, and enabling practical Raman-based screening. In this study, we propose HyMLRaman, a hybrid Raman spectroscopy framework that combines deep spectral feature extraction, generative models, and classical machine-learning classifiers to identify six pharmaceutical compounds, including amoxicillin, chloramphenicol, ciprofloxacin, tetracycline, ibuprofen, and paracetamol. Raman spectra are converted into spectral images and encoded with several deep neural-network backbones, among which EfficientNet-B3 yields the most effective representation. The resulting 1536-dimensional embeddings are then used to train downstream classifiers, including SVM, KNN, logistic regression, random forest, XGBoost, and ANN, using stratified 10-fold cross-validation. The hybrid EfficientNet-B3--SVM configuration achieves the strongest baseline performance, reaching 96.31% accuracy and a macro-F1 score of 96.36%, outperforming the standalone CNN baseline. To address limited-data conditions, a generative model, a DDPM-based feature augmentation, is introduced in a PCA-reduced EfficientNet-B3 latent space. The low-data ablation results show that DDPM augmentation provides selective benefits, particularly for KNN with reduced training fractions, and that its effect remains classifier-dependent. Finally, an application-level Raman Pharmaceutical Analyzer demonstrates the feasibility of embedding the trained model into an interactive Raman analysis workflow. These results suggest that HyMLRaman provides a practical and interpretable route for rapid Raman-based pharmaceutical screening.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 HyMLRaman：把 Raman 光谱转成光谱图像，用 EfficientNet-B3 编码成 1536 维嵌入再接经典分类器，EfficientNet-B3–SVM 达到 96.31% 准确率与 96.36% macro-F1。在低数据条件下于 PCA 降维的嵌入空间做 DDPM 特征增强，收益是选择性的、主要惠及训练比例降低时的 KNN，且随分类器而变。
Motivation: 药物残留的快速可靠筛查依赖 Raman 光谱，但深度谱特征模型在训练样本有限时性能受限，需要在不采集新数据的前提下改善低数据条件下的识别。
Method: Raman 光谱转为光谱图像后由多个深度 backbone 编码（EfficientNet-B3 表征最佳），1536 维嵌入送入 SVM、KNN、logistic regression、random forest、XGBoost、ANN 等分类器，用分层 10 折交叉验证训练；低数据场景下在 PCA 降维的 EfficientNet-B3 潜空间中用 DDPM 做特征增强。
Result: 识别 6 种化合物（amoxicillin、chloramphenicol、ciprofloxacin、tetracycline、ibuprofen、paracetamol）；EfficientNet-B3–SVM 达 96.31% 准确率、96.36% macro-F1，优于单独 CNN 基线；低数据消融显示 DDPM 增强带来选择性收益，对训练比例降低时的 KNN 尤其明显，效果随分类器而异。
Conclusion: 深度谱嵌入加经典分类器可为 Raman 药物筛查提供实用且可解释的路线，生成式特征增强只在特定分类器与低数据比例下值得用。

papers.title: Causal discovery identifies pathways linking physical activity to dementia risk in the UK BioBank
papers.abstract_en: Physical Activity (PA) is consistently associated with lower risk of dementia, yet the mechanism linking PA to dementia prevention remain incomopletely understood. Here, we integrate large language model (LLM)-guided causal discovery with mediation analysis in 42,293 older adults aged 60 years or older from the UK Biobank to systematically identify pathways connecting objectively measured moderate-to-vigorous physical activity (MVPA) to dementia risk. Across behavioral, psychological, functional, and clinical domains, causal discovery consistently identified interconnected pathways linking higher MVPA to lower dementia risk through depression, functional capacity, smoking behavior, hypertension, cardiovascular disease, chronic kidney disease, and brain injury. Chain mediation analyses further identified depression as a central pathway, accounting for 15.1% of the overall association between MVPA and dementia risk. Sex-stratified analyses revealed distinct mechanistic patterns, with females exhibiting predominantly metabolic and functional pathways, while males showed behavioral and cardiometabolic cascades involving smoking and cardiovascular disease. Together, these findings suggest that the protective association between PA and dementia is mediated through interconnected behavioral, psychological, and cardiometabolic processes rather than a single pathway. Depression emerged as a prominent and potentially modifiable pathway, highlighting opportunities for integrating dementia prevention strategies that combine PA promotion with mental health and cardiovascular risk management.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 UK Biobank 42,293 名 60 岁以上老年人中，用 LLM 引导的因果发现结合链式中介分析，识别出中高强度体力活动 (MVPA) 降低痴呆风险的多条互联通路，抑郁是核心中介，占总关联的 15.1%。性别分层显示女性以代谢与功能通路为主，男性以吸烟与心血管疾病的行为-心代谢级联为主，说明保护作用经由互联的行为、心理与心代谢过程而非单一通路实现。
Motivation: 体力活动与痴呆风险降低的关联已被反复观察到，但连接二者的具体机制通路仍不清楚，难以据此设计针对性的预防干预。
Method: 在 UK Biobank 42,293 名 60 岁及以上受试者中，以客观测量的中高强度体力活动 (MVPA) 为暴露，整合 LLM 引导的因果发现 (causal discovery) 与链式中介分析 (chain mediation analysis)，跨行为、心理、功能与临床域识别通路，并做性别分层分析。
Result: 因果发现一致识别出经抑郁、功能能力、吸烟、高血压、心血管疾病、慢性肾病与脑损伤的互联通路，方向为更高 MVPA 对应更低痴呆风险；抑郁占 MVPA 与痴呆总关联的 15.1%；女性以代谢与功能通路为主，男性为涉及吸烟与心血管疾病的行为与心代谢级联。
Conclusion: 体力活动对痴呆的保护作用由互联的行为、心理与心代谢过程共同中介而非单一通路，抑郁是突出且可干预的环节，预防策略应把体力活动推广与心理健康、心血管风险管理结合起来。

summary_sections.result: 因果发现一致识别出经抑郁、功能能力、吸烟、高血压、心血管疾病、慢性肾病与脑损伤的互联通路，方向为更高 MVPA 对应更低痴呆风险；抑郁占 MVPA 与痴呆总关联的 15.1%；女性以代谢与功能通路为主，男性为涉及吸烟与心血管疾病的行为与心代谢级联。
summary_sections.conclusion: 体力活动对痴呆的保护作用由互联的行为、心理与心代谢过程共同中介而非单一通路，抑郁是突出且可干预的环节，预防策略应把体力活动推广与心理健康、心血管风险管理结合起来。

papers.title: RINS: Residual-Image Neural Subspace Solvers for Large Sparse Linear Systems
papers.abstract_en: Large sparse linear systems from PDE discretizations require correction subspaces whose operator images explain the current residual. We study this residual-image viewpoint and propose Gate-RINS, a neural subspace solver that generates polynomial correction bases from cached residual probes and modulates them with a lightweight residual- and coordinate-dependent pointwise gate. The projected least-squares update remains unchanged, so the neural component only chooses the expansion directions while the numerical closure tests them through \(\operatorname{range}(AQ_t)\). We also introduce a hybrid controller schedule that composes GRANS-style graph controllers with Gate-RINS under the same projected solver. Across six PDE-derived benchmark tasks and two scales, Gate-RINS reaches fixed relative-residual thresholds faster in synchronized wall-clock time than GMRES and a recent graph-only neural baseline in most settings, and hybrid schedules further improve the residual trajectory. Difficult-mode diagnostics and trajectory visualizations support the interpretation that these gains are associated with operator-image subspaces that align more effectively with the current residual.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RINS 提出残差像 (residual-image) 视角的神经子空间求解器 Gate-RINS：从缓存的残差探针生成多项式校正基，用轻量的残差与坐标相关逐点门控调制，而投影最小二乘更新与 range(AQ_t) 数值闭合保持不变，神经部分只负责选扩张方向。在六个 PDE 基准任务、两种规模上，同步墙钟时间下 Gate-RINS 在多数设置中比 GMRES 与纯图神经基线更快达到固定相对残差阈值，GRANS 式图控制器与 Gate-RINS 组成的混合调度进一步改善残差轨迹。
Motivation: PDE 离散得到的大稀疏线性系统需要校正子空间，其算子像要能解释当前残差；纯图神经子空间基线在残差对齐上仍有差距，而完全替换投影求解器又会牺牲数值闭合的可靠性。
Method: Gate-RINS 从缓存的残差探针 (residual probes) 生成多项式校正基，用轻量的残差与坐标依赖逐点门控 (pointwise gate) 调制；投影最小二乘更新保持不变，数值闭合通过 range(AQ_t) 检验这些扩张方向。另提出混合控制器调度，把 GRANS 式图控制器与 Gate-RINS 组合在同一投影求解器下。
Result: 在六个 PDE 衍生基准任务、两种规模上，同步墙钟时间下 Gate-RINS 在多数设置中比 GMRES 和一个近期纯图神经基线更快达到固定相对残差阈值；混合调度进一步改善残差轨迹。困难模式诊断与轨迹可视化支持增益来自与当前残差对齐更好的算子像子空间这一解释。
Conclusion: 让神经模块只挑选扩张方向、把数值闭合留给投影求解器，可以在保持求解器结构不变的前提下加速大稀疏线性系统的残差收敛，且与图控制器组合仍有额外收益。

papers.title: MiDShip: Multimodal Dataset of Ship Cargo Hold Structures for Engineering Design
papers.abstract_en: Ship structures govern vessel strength, safety, and manufacturability, but their design must satisfy hundreds of classification society requirements, making the process complex and iterative. Data-driven approaches are limited by the lack of structured datasets linking design geometry, structural performance, and rule-based constraints. This paper presents MiDShip, a multimodal dataset of 12,753 synthetic cargo-hold structural designs: 6,020 random, 496 generated by an SGLD-inspired procedure, and 6,237 generated by an equation-informed repair procedure. Each design includes parametric data, full and mesh-ready 3D geometry, engineering drawings and annotations, a bill of materials, and preliminary structural evaluations. Twenty-five constraints derived from a subset of ABS MVR are also evaluated. None of the random designs satisfies all constraints. Among the SGLD-inspired designs, 322 (64.9%) were fully compliant, with an average of 0.409 violations, 82.7% below the seed mean and 96.9% below the random-design mean. The repair procedure, developed through LLM-assisted code analysis, produced 4,952 fully compliant designs (79.4%), averaging 0.296 violations, 97.1% below the paired-source mean. In equal-size comparisons, mean nearest-neighbor distances in the scaled 120-parameter space were 3.495 for repaired designs, 1.144 for SGLD batches, and 3.729 for random designs. The primary contribution is the synchronized dataset and its generation and evaluation infrastructure; the generation studies demonstrate its utility rather than proposing new optimization algorithms. MiDShip supports machine learning, generative design, and automated rule-based evaluation for ship structures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MiDShip 提供 12,753 个合成货舱结构设计的多模态数据集，把参数化数据、3D 几何、工程图纸、材料清单与基于 ABS MVR 规则子集的 25 条约束评估同步绑定。随机设计无一满足全部约束，而 SGLD-inspired 生成有 322 个（64.9%）完全合规、方程引导的修复流程产出 4,952 个（79.4%）完全合规，说明合规设计可以在数据集生成阶段被批量制造出来。
Motivation: 船舶结构设计需满足数百条船级社规则，流程复杂反复；数据驱动方法受限于缺少把设计几何、结构性能与规则约束关联起来的结构化数据集。
Method: 数据集含 12,753 个合成货舱设计：6,020 个随机、496 个由 SGLD-inspired 流程生成、6,237 个由方程引导的修复流程（经 LLM 辅助代码分析开发）生成。每个设计附参数数据、完整与可网格化 3D 几何、工程图纸与标注、材料清单和初步结构评估，并评估取自 ABS MVR 子集的 25 条约束；合规性与最近邻距离在缩放后的 120 维参数空间中度量。
Result: 随机设计中无一满足全部 25 条约束。SGLD-inspired 设计有 322 个（64.9%）完全合规，平均违规 0.409 条，82.7% 低于种子均值、96.9% 低于随机设计均值。修复流程产出 4,952 个（79.4%）完全合规设计，平均违规 0.296 条，97.1% 低于配对来源均值。等规模比较下，120 维参数空间中的平均最近邻距离为修复设计 3.495、SGLD 批次 1.144、随机设计 3.729。
Conclusion: 主要贡献是同步的数据集及其生成与评估基础设施，生成研究用于展示数据集用途，而非提出新的优化算法；该数据集面向机器学习、生成式设计与自动化规则评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ClarifyCodeBench: Evaluating LLMs on Clarifying Ambiguous Requirements for Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models have emerged as programming assistants. However, the efficacy of code generation is constrained by the quality of input requirements, which are frequently ambiguous, incomplete, or underspecified. While LLMs excel at one-shot code synthesis, their ability to proactively clarify intent remains underexplored, as a critical trait for robust software engineering. Existing benchmarks largely overlook this interactive bottleneck, assuming perfectly specified prompts that do not reflect the iterative nature of requirement elicitation. To bridge this gap, we introduce ClarifyCodeBench, a novel interactive benchmark for evaluating LLMs' capability in resolving requirement ambiguity. Constructed from real-world programming tasks, ClarifyCodeBench features high-quality manual annotations, including N unique ambiguity types, associated clarification questions, and corresponding ground-truth answers. Furthermore, we formalize two rigorous metrics to assess the interaction quality: Turn-discounted Key Question Rate, which penalizes inefficient questioning, and Optimal Round Adherence, which measures the precision of the elicitation process. We conduct a systematic evaluation of six state-of-the-art LLMs using ClarifyCodeBench. Our empirical results yield three critical insights: 1) Capability Decoupling: Strong code generation performance does not inherently translate to effective requirement clarification; 2) The Reasoning Paradox: While increased computational thinking enhances code correctness, it yields marginal gains in identifying ambiguities; 3) The Multi-ambiguity Ceiling: LLMs' clarification performance degrades sharply as the density of ambiguities increases, revealing a significant bottleneck in handling complex, real-world specifications. Our work underscores the necessity for future AI4SE research to transition from static synthesis to interactive elicitation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ClarifyCodeBench 是一个交互式基准，用真实编程任务加人工标注的歧义类型、澄清问题与标准答案，评估 LLM 主动澄清需求的能力，并提出 Turn-discounted Key Question Rate 与 Optimal Round Adherence 两个指标。对六个前沿 LLM 的评测给出三条结论：代码生成强不等于澄清强，加推理计算只带来识别歧义的边际收益，歧义密度上升时澄清表现急剧下降。
Motivation: 现有代码生成基准假设提示已被完整规格化，忽略了需求获取的交互环节，LLM 主动澄清意图的能力缺乏可评测的场景。
Method: 从真实编程任务构建 ClarifyCodeBench，含人工标注的 N 类歧义、对应澄清问题与 ground-truth 答案；定义 Turn-discounted Key Question Rate（惩罚低效提问）与 Optimal Round Adherence（衡量澄清过程精度）两个指标，用它们系统评测六个 state-of-the-art LLM。
Result: 六个前沿 LLM 的评测给出三条发现：能力解耦——代码生成强不自动转化为有效的需求澄清；推理悖论——增加计算思考提升代码正确性，但识别歧义只有边际收益；多重歧义天花板——歧义密度升高时澄清表现急剧下降。
Conclusion: 作者主张 AI4SE 研究应从静态代码合成转向交互式需求澄清 (interactive elicitation)，因为澄清能力与代码生成能力是可分离的，且在高歧义密度下构成明显瓶颈。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Multi-Modal Environment-Aware Beam Management for Massive MIMO: A Geometry-Driven Virtual Base Station Framework
papers.abstract_en: High-frequency massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems promise ultra-high data rates. However, efficient beam management remains challenging due to the prohibitive beam training overhead and intricate coordination required in multi-user MIMO (MU-MIMO) scenarios. To address these bottlenecks, environment-aware communications have emerged as a promising paradigm, leveraging site-specific knowledge to circumvent exhaustive pilot-based beam training and streamline multi-user communications. In this paper, we propose an interpretable and geometry-driven framework that utilizes multi-modal environmental data, specifically regional 3D light detection and ranging (LiDAR) point clouds and location information, to construct an offline virtual base station (VBS) database. By modeling dominant reflection paths via mirror symmetry across building facades reconstructed from the point clouds, the VBS database provides a compact and sparse description of the wireless propagation environment. To bridge the semantic gap between geometric information and wireless channels, we develop a coarse channel reconstruction mechanism that estimates channel parameters directly from VBS-derived geometric relationships. Based on the resulting coarse beamspace representation, we design a VBS-assisted orthogonal-pilot (VOP)-based partial beam training scheme to refine the coarse estimates with minimal online training overhead. Finally, to tackle the combinatorial beam selection problem and manage inter-user interference, we propose a hierarchical deep reinforcement learning framework, namely a dual-agent dueling double deep Q-network, for coordinated beam selection (DD3QN-CBS). Simulation results demonstrate consistent gains in both beam training efficiency and beam selection performance over heuristic and learning-based baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向高频 massive MIMO 波束管理，用区域 3D LiDAR 点云与位置信息离线构建几何驱动的虚拟基站 (VBS) 数据库，以建筑立面镜像对称建模主反射路径，再由 VBS 几何关系直接重建粗信道并做粗波束成形。仿真显示该方案在波束训练效率与波束选择性能上相对启发式和学习型基线均取得一致增益。
Motivation: 高频 MU-MIMO 中穷举导频波束训练开销过高、多用户协调复杂，环境感知通信需要把场地几何知识转成可直接用的信道描述以绕开在线训练。
Method: 用 LiDAR 点云重建建筑立面并以镜像对称建模主反射路径，构建稀疏 VBS 数据库；提出粗信道重建机制从 VBS 几何关系估计信道参数得到粗波束空间表示，再用 VBS 辅助正交导频 (VOP) 的部分波束训练以极少在线开销精化；组合波束选择与多用户干扰用分层双智能体 dueling double DQN（DD3QN-CBS）协调求解。
Result: 仿真结果表明，所提方案在波束训练效率与波束选择性能上相对启发式与学习型基线取得一致增益。
Conclusion: 几何驱动的 VBS 框架加少量在线精化与分层 RL 协调，可在降低波束训练开销的同时维持多用户波束选择性能。

papers.title: IntentCoding: Amplifying User Intent in Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities in code generation, but their adherence to fine-grained user intent with multiple constraints remains a significant challenge. Our empirical analysis reveals two key observations: 1) Model performance deteriorates quickly as the number of constraints in the user intent increases, and 2) While user intent does influence the model's logits, such an influence may not be strong enough to effectively steer the decoding process. To this end, we propose Intent-Amplified Code Generation (IntentCoding), a novel decoding strategy that enhances an LLM's ability to follow user intent. IntentCoding captures the influence of user intent by masking out the intent, and applies a multi-strength ensemble mechanism to amplify the effect of user intent during generation. IntentCoding is model-agnostic, requires no additional training, and integrates seamlessly with existing decoding procedures. To enable systematic evaluation, we also construct CodeConstraints, a benchmark dataset specifically designed to test user intent compliance under varying numbers of constraints. Experiments on our constructed Constraints, as well as popular IFEvalCode, HumanEval and LiveCodeBench datasets, show that our IntentCoding model significantly improves both constraint satisfaction and functional correctness compared to standard decoding approaches. IntentCoding achieves up to 71.0% relative improvement on CodeConstraints, achieves up to 67.3% relative improvement on IFEvalCode and achieves up to 29.3% relative improvement in pass@1 on HumanEval and LiveCodeBench compared with greedy decoding.

TL;DR: IntentCoding 是一种免训练的解码策略：通过屏蔽用户意图来度量意图对 logits 的影响，再用多强度集成 (multi-strength ensemble) 在生成时放大该影响，使 LLM 更服从多约束指令。在自建 CodeConstraints 以及 IFEvalCode、HumanEval、LiveCodeBench 上，相对 greedy decoding 约束满足度最高提升 71.0%（CodeConstraints）与 67.3%（IFEvalCode），pass@1 最高提升 29.3%。
Motivation: LLM 代码生成在用户意图含多条约束时服从度差：实证分析显示约束数量增加时性能快速退化，且用户意图虽影响 logits，但影响强度不足以在解码过程中真正引导生成。
Method: IntentCoding 在解码时屏蔽 (mask out) 用户意图以捕获意图对模型输出的影响，再用多强度集成机制放大该影响；模型无关、无需额外训练，可直接嵌入现有解码流程。同时构建专门的基准 CodeConstraints，用于在不同约束数量下系统评测意图服从度。
Result: 相对 greedy decoding，IntentCoding 在 CodeConstraints 上约束满足最高 71.0% 相对提升，在 IFEvalCode 上最高 67.3% 相对提升，在 HumanEval 与 LiveCodeBench 上 pass@1 最高 29.3% 相对提升；评测覆盖自建 Constraints、IFEvalCode、HumanEval、LiveCodeBench。
Conclusion: 用户意图对 logits 的影响可以被显式放大，从而在不训练模型的前提下同时改善约束满足与功能正确性；意图服从度应随约束数量分档评测。
